Upon its return, Little Sparrow flew straight to Huang Qingling, released the paper from its mouth, and a note fell out.
Huang Qingling caught it, glanced at it, and then said to Lin Jing,
“They have received the message and are getting ready, they will be here shortly…”
Meanwhile, Little Sparrow flew directly to Lin Jing’s side.
“Chirp..
Little Sparrow chirped once, then circled Lin Jing twice, staring intently at his storage bag around his waist before looking up at Lin Jing.
The intent was unmistakable, Little Sparrow was asking Lin Jing for its reward.
Without any fuss, Lin Jing reached into his storage bag and took out that medium-grade Gathering Yuan Pill.
No sooner had the elixir reached Lin Jing’s hand than Little Sparrow transformed once again into a streak of black light, darting towards Lin Jing. Immediately after, the pill disappeared from Lin Jing’s hand and reappeared at Little Sparrow’s beak.
With a smug look at Lin Jing, Little Sparrow opened its beak and swallowed the pill.
Lin Jing and Huang Qingling both watched Little Sparrow and found, even though it swallowed the elixir whole, there was nothing unusual about it, and it continued to hop and skip about.
Nothing like human cultivators, who needed to meditate and refine the pill’s strength through practice.
At that moment, Huang Qingling spoke up,
“Since they say they will be here soon, let’s clean up the kitchen. After all, my kitchen has not been used for quite some time…”
“Alright, then let’s go,” Lin Jing said.
After saying that, he stood up and walked with Huang Qingling toward the kitchen…
Once they arrived at the kitchen, and after some bustling about, they finally got it cleaned up.
Just as the two sat down for a rest after finishing up, a knock at the door resounded from outside the courtyard.
Hearing the knock, Lin Jing and Huang Qingling exchanged glances.
“It must be them…” Huang Qingling said.
“Then I’ll go open the door.”
After saying this, Lin Jing got up and headed towards the entrance.
At the courtyard gate, Lin Jing reached out and opened the door. Standing there was a young girl with one hand on her hip and her chest heaving as she panted heavily.
This girl was none other than Li Qingqing.
Seeing Li Qingqing in this state, Lin Jing asked,
“Cultivator Qingqing, what happened to you? Why are you in such a hurry?”
Li Qingqing gasped for breath and said,
‘Where’s Little Sparrow, where’s Little Sparrow?”
“I’ve come to settle accounts with it…’
Judging by her appearance, it seemed that Li Qingqing had been quite frightened by Little Sparrow.
That’s why she came over in such a state.
“Little Sparrow is inside…”
“Cultivator Qingqing, why such great anger toward Little Sparrow?”
Grinding her teeth with fury, Li Qingqing said,
“When that Little Sparrow came, it deliberately scared me. I must settle this with it.”
Feeling somewhat embarrassed as the instigator, Lin Jing quickly tried to console her,
“Well…
“Cultivator Qingqing, there’s a reason for this, don’t be hasty.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing with confusion,
“There’s a reason for this?” “Yes…” Lin Jing said.
“By the way, where is your brother?”
Seeing only Li Qingqing had come and not seeing Li Tangyu, Lin Jing asked.
“Oh, he and Zhang Yuan are out buying ingredients,” Li Qingqing said.
“Brother Zhang is here too?”
Lin Jing was surprised and said to Li Qingqing,
“Wasn’t he practicing a new cultivation technique with the Zhang Family Patriarch?”
Not long after the last gathering, Zhang Yuan had gone into seclusion with the Zhang Family Patriarch, it seemed, to be taught a cultivation technique.
He was to finish learning it before he could come out.
It seems this Zhang Family Patriarch intends to groom Zhang Yuan as the next family head.
Li Qingqing said, “He has just completed his cultivation and emerged from seclusion not long ago. He came looking for my brother right away.”
“That’s perfect…”
“Since the last gathering, he has been in secluded cultivation, and I haven’t seen him for a while either. Now that he’s emerged, it’s perfect…”
After finishing, Lin Jing spoke again, asking:
“Did Zhang Yuan seek out your brother just after coming out of seclusion because he ran into some trouble?” “It’s nothing major…”
Li Qingqing began speaking:
“Some of our juniors from the Li Family and the Zhang Family were bullied by others outside, so he came to my brother to discuss a strategy.”
Lin Jing was immediately astonished and displayed an incredulous expression:
“Someone dares to bully people from your two families in Fang Market, could it be members of other families?”
Li Qingqing shook her head and said:
“Not in Fang Market, but in the Night Mist Mountain Range. The ones who made a move are very mysterious, and we still don’t know who did it…”
“Let’s not talk about that for now, let’s go in.”
“Alright…” Lin Jing replied.
Then…
Lin Jing led the way, with Li Qingqing following behind, and the two walked in.
Upon arriving in the courtyard, Li Qingqing immediately noticed Little Sparrow beside Huang Qingling.
“Well, well, Little Sparrow, you still dare to show your face in front of me.” As she spoke, Li Qingqing approached Little Sparrow.
Seeing Li Qingqing, Little Sparrow, whether feeling guilty or for some other reason, didn’t wait for Li Qingqing to get close.
With a “swoosh,” it transformed into a streak of black light and shot out, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Li Qingqing was left standing there as she watched Little Sparrow flee, unable to do anything about it.
At that moment, Huang Qingling also came over. “Qingqing, did Little Sparrow scare you?”
“Yes, it really gave me a fright…”
Li Qingqing subconsciously responded, but then sensed something was off, and quickly turned to look at Huang Qingling, asking in surprise:
“Hold on, how did you know that…”
A sly smile appeared on Huang Qingling’s face.
Lin Jing saw this and thought to himself, this isn’t good, but before he could speak, Huang Qingling had already spilled the beans.
“You can’t blame Little Sparrow for this; it was Lin Jing who asked Little Sparrow to scare you.”
After saying this, Huang Qingling quickly turned to Li Qingqing and asked:
“And your brother, I also had Little Sparrow scare him. So, did it work, was he scared?”
After hearing Huang Qingling’s words, Li Qingqing gazed at Lin Jing with a look of deep grievance.
“Lin Jing…”
“When did you become so naughty?” Lin Jing offered an embarrassed smile:
“Heh heh…”
“It’s just that I saw some changes in Little Sparrow, so I thought about testing it out…”
“Here’s the deal…”
“Tell me what you’d like to eat later, and I’ll cook it for you as a way of apologizing. ”
Hearing what Lin Jing said, Li Qingqing finally let go of her resentful gaze.
“You said it…” “I’ll leave it to you then when my brother and the others arrive.”
“No problem.”
Lin Jing stated openly.
Following that…
Li Qingqing then said to Huang Qingling:
“Little Sparrow appeared out of nowhere, pouncing in front of me before I could even react, startling me quite a bit before it flew away.”
“I wanted to settle the score with Little Sparrow afterwards, but when I found my brother, I learned that it was you two who invited us.”
“After getting the news from my brother, I came straight here without thinking too much about it.”
“Why don’t you ask him about it when he arrives later?”
“Alright then…” Huang Qingling said..

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 164 The Robber with the Unpleasant
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: The Robber with the Unpleasant
Voice
Translator: 549690339
“Right…’
“Lin Jing brother…”
Li Qingqing turned her head to look at Lin Jing and asked,
“You said earlier that Little Sparrow has changed, but what kind of change?”
“Haven’t you noticed that Little Sparrow has gotten smarter?” Lin Jing reminded her.
“Hasn’t Little Sparrow always been very smart?”
Li Qingqing responded directly, but after saying it, she felt something was off. Remembering Little Sparrow’s behavior today, she indeed sensed something amiss.
So she spoke again,
“It does seem like it a little. But I really haven’t paid much attention to that.” Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing with a resigned expression and said,
“Forget it, let’s wait until your brother and the others arrive before we talk about it…”
“Alright…” Li Qingqing nodded.
Soon, another hour and a half passed before there came a knock at the door.
Upon hearing the knock, Lin Jing immediately stood up and walked towards the door.
Opening the courtyard door, standing there as expected, were Li Tangyu and Zhang Yuan.
“Brother Li, Brother Zhang…” Lin Jing greeted them with a fist and palm salute.
“Brother Lin…”
“Brother Lin…”
Both of them returned the salute with a fist and palm salute as well.
“Come in, please…”
Lin Jing stepped aside, gesturing for them to enter.
After they entered, Lin Jing closed the courtyard door and followed them inside.
In the courtyard, at this time, Huang Qingling and Li Qingqing were still drinking tea under the large tree.
This courtyard where Huang Qingling was staying had been selected by Elder Bai and was much larger than the one Lin Jing was staying in.
Moreover, the courtyard contained a tree several Zhang high with the ability to gather spirit energy. Cultivating under this tree was significantly more effective than other places, a special preparation from Elder Bai for Huang Qingling.
Seeing the newcomers, Li Qingqing stood up and walked over, saying to the two men,
“You’ve finally arrived; I’ve been waiting so long, I’m hungry…”
Li Tangyu replied with a smile,
“Didn’t you say last time that you wanted to eat a Spirit Feather Chicken? We went to the trouble of getting one for you. Spirit Feather Chickens are hard to find, so that’s why we’ve only just arrived.” Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing’s eyes lit up as she said,
“I knew my brother was the best to me.”
“Lin Jing brother…”
Then, she addressed Lin Jing,
“I want the Spirit Feather Chicken roasted, that kind where it’s crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, sizzling with oil – you promised…”
“No problem…” Lin Jing said.
At this time…
Huang Qingling also stood up and eagerly asked Li Tangyu,
“Tan Yuyi…”
“When Little Sparrow went to call for you, did it scare you?” Li Tangyu replied,
“Was it you who taught it to sneak attack? I was almost scared…”
Huang Qingling glanced upwards and said,
“I didn’t, it learned that on its own.”
Seeing Huang Qingling’s denial, Li Tangyu sighed and continued,
“It’s a good thing Brother Zhang warned me in time, so I was on guard. Besides, I feel that Little Sparrow seems smarter now and even more formidable than before.”
Lin Jing was curious and then asked Zhang Yuan,
“Brother Zhang, how did you detect Little Sparrow’s sneak attack?”
Zhang Yuan replied,
“The Cultivation Technique I practice is not ordinary, so I was able to sense Little Sparrow in advance.”
Lin Jing nodded, assuming that this was indeed the Cultivation Technique Zhang Yuan had been practicing with the Zhang Family Patriarch recently. At this moment, Li Tangyu spoke again, earnestly saying,
“This Little Sparrow is very formidable now. It was within five meters of me before I noticed it.”
“Regarding this, Brother Zhang and I have discussed…”
“If Little Sparrow were to launch a sneak attack now, it could silently take out a Cultivator at the later stages of Foundation Establishment.”
Zhang Yuan also nodded in agreement at this.
Then, Li Tangyu turned his head to look around and didn’t spot Little Sparrow, then he said:
“Where’s Little Sparrow, not here now?”
“Little Sparrow, it got scared by Qing Qing. When Qing Qing came looking to settle the score, it just hid away…”
Li Tangyu: “Alright then…”
At this point, Lin Jing looked up at the sky and realized that dusk was approaching and it was already getting late.
So he turned to the others and said:
“Let’s not talk about Little Sparrow’s issue for now.”
“It’s getting late, we should start getting ready now, or it will be dark soon.”
“Alright…!’
Next, everyone went to the kitchen. Li Tangyu and Huang Qingling took out the ingredients from the Storage Bag, and then everyone got busy.
Before long, all the ingredients were prepared, and it was Lin Jing’s moment to shine…
About an hour passed before the feast was finally ready.
Then, with the dishes served, everyone took their seats.
As soon as she sat down, Li Qingqing couldn’t wait and started to help herself to the deliciously roasted Spirit Feather Chicken.
Lin Jing even poured a cup of wine for each person.
Just as the first sip of wine went down, Li Tangyu started speaking:
“Brother Lin, I recall that the offering tasks for Yuebaolou are supposed to be submitted today, right?”
“Have you completed it?”
“Not to hide it from Brother Li, I’ve barely completed it,” said Lin Jing.
Li Tangyu continued:
“Brother Lin’s talent in the Alchemy Dao seems quite extraordinary as well. It’s only been a few months, and you can already complete the offering tasks for Yuebaolou by yourself.”
Lin Jing quickly waved his hands in modesty and said: “Brother Li overpraises me…”
“Compared to you, I still have a long way to go.”
“Brother Lin is being too modest. Actually, my current achievements are mainly due to the support of my family. Not like you, who rely solely on yourself,” Li Tangyu added.
Huang Qingling couldn’t watch this anymore and directly said:
“Alright, you two, just toast to each other and stop being so modest.” Lin Jing and Li Tangyu both felt a bit embarrassed.
Following this, Lin Jing picked up the wine jug and poured a cup for both of them.
“Cheers…”
Then, both of them drained their cups in one go.
At this moment, Huang Qingling asked Li Tangyu:
“Qing Qing mentioned earlier that a junior within your family was bullied.
What happened with that?”
Li Tangyu set down his wine cup and said:
“Actually, it’s not a big deal. A disciple from each of our families was robbed while gathering Spirit Grass on the outskirts of the Night Mist Mountain
Range.”
“The good thing is, the two of them were only robbed of some possessions and were not injured.”
Upon hearing about the robbery, Lin Jing was taken aback, and he immediately thought of Little Sparrow.
“It can’t be such a coincidence…” Lin Jing thought to himself.
Looking at Huang Qingling, her expression was similar to Lin Jing’s, and the two involuntarily exchanged glances.
Lin Jing quickly asked:
“Someone dared to rob the juniors of your two families? Which power is behind this?”
After hearing this, Li Tangyu shook his head.
“No power…”
“To be exact, neither of them saw the person who robbed them…”
“They didn’t see the robber…” Lin Jing exclaimed in surprise.
Then he couldn’t help but wonder, “Could it really have been Little Sparrow?” Li Tangyu nodded and continued:
“Yes, they said someone shouted ‘This is a robbery!’ and used a very fast Black
Artifact to attack them.”
“This person only damaged their clothes but did not harm them, using that to threaten them into handing over their valuables.”
“Seeing that the person’s cultivation was not low, they had no choice but to comply… ”
“And they also said that the robber’s voice was quite strange, somewhat…”
Li Tangyu paused for a moment, then said:
“Unpleasant….”

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Robbery to the Face
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Robbery to the Face
Translator: 549690339
Hearing this, Lin Jing turned his head to look at Huang Qingling.
By this time, Huang Qingling had already buried her head into her chest, and Lin Jing guessed she was probably looking for a crack in the ground to crawl into.
It was a good thing Little Sparrow wasn’t here; otherwise, Huang Qingling might have already erupted.
“What exactly did they lose, Brother Li, do you know?”
Lin Jing asked again.
Li Tangyu smiled and said,
“Actually, it’s nothing valuable, just two or three Magic Artifacts, and a few stalks of Spirit Grass and several low-level Elixir Medicines.”
“Is there a Magic Artifact shaped like a crescent moon and another that looks like a stick…”
Huang Qingling then lifted her head and spoke.
After hearing Huang Qingling’s words, Li Tangyu and Zhang Yuan looked at each other and then both turned to look at Huang Qingling.
“There are indeed two Magic Artifacts that look like that…”
“Sister Qingling, how do you know?”
Huang Qingling covered most of her face with her hand, instantly feeling utterly shamefaced.
Fortunately, the people present were all very familiar with each other; otherwise, she would never have spoken out.
“Can you two wait for a moment…”
With that, Huang Qingling stood up, left the room, and headed for her bedroom.
The two looked at Lin Jing, not understanding the situation.
Lin Jing appeared helpless and responded,
“You’ll find out soon…”
At Lin Jing’s words, not only did Li Tangyu and Zhang Yuan become curious, but even Li Qingqing was intrigued.
The three of them lost the appetite to continue eating, so they turned their heads and looked toward the door, waiting for Huang Qingling to return.
It wasn’t long before Huang Qingling returned.
In her arms, she carried a pile of sundries, which were exactly the Magic Artifacts, Spirit Grass, and Elixir Medicines that Little Sparrow had robbed.
Under the shocked gazes of the three, Huang Qingling brought the pile of sundries to Li Tangyu, pouring them all into his arms in one go.
Li Tangyu finally recovered from his shock and hurriedly caught them, fearing they might fall to the ground. “See if these are the ones…”
Huang Qingling said.
Li Tangyu began to examine them one by one, the crescent-shaped Magic Artifact, the Elixir Medicines, the Spirit Grass…
These were exactly the same as the items reported lost by the disciple, except for two Elixir Medicines that were missing; the rest were all here.
“Sister Qingling, what’s going on here?”
“How did these items end up in your possession?” Li Tangyu asked, looking bewildered and puzzled. Huang Qingling sighed helplessly,
“Sigh…’
“The thief you mentioned, it’s Little Sparrow…”
First came a deathly silence.
Then, both Li Tangyu and Li Qingqing let out a cry of alarm, and even the normally composed Zhang Yuan, for a moment, failed to react, standing there stunned.
“How can Little Sparrow talk, and even learn to rob…”
“Could it be, you taught it…?”
After her surprise, Li Qingqing looked at Huang Qingling inquisitively. Huang Qingling quickly spoke up in her own defense,
“How could I possibly teach it that? It’s completely embarrassing…” “It often runs outside; where it learned these things, I have no idea.” Then Huang Qingling continued with an indignant tone,
“That silly bird has caused me such trouble, I must deal with it when it comes back.”
Just as Huang Qingling finished speaking,
Zhang Yuan suddenly said,
“Little Sparrow is nearby, not far away. I can feel it.”
The others looked at Zhang Yuan, puzzled by what kind of powerful Cultivation Technique this was.
Lin Jing was now also at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and he hadn’t sensed anything, not to mention Li Tangyu, who was in the later stages of Foundation Establishment.
From his reaction just now, Lin Jing knew that even Li Tangyu was unaware that Little Sparrow was nearby.
Hearing Zhang Yuan speak, Huang Qingling directly called out to the outside:
“Little Sparrow, come here…”
“Otherwise, I’m going to deal with you…”
As expected…
The moment Huang Qingling’s words ended, Little Sparrow flapped its wings and flew in, albeit wobbling and at a slow speed, as if it were heading to its own execution.
Little Sparrow, seemingly aware of Huang Qingling’s fury, didn’t dare to fly close to her but instead perched on Lin Jing’s shoulder.
At this moment, everyone turned their gaze towards it.
Li Tangyu was still quite perplexed, sizing up Little Sparrow from top to bottom.
“Can this Little Sparrow speak?”
“It can currently only say two words,” Huang Qingling explained, feeling somewhat helpless.
“It wouldn’t be those two words, would it?” Li Tangyu and Li Qingqing exchanged glances.
Li Qingqing looked around the group and noticed that her brother and Zhang Yuan both looked very intrigued, so she suggested:
“Why not have it speak for us to hear?”
“Are you sure?” Huang Qingling asked, looking at the three of them with interest.
“Mmm-hmm…”
The three nodded repeatedly.
“Alright then…”
Huang Qingling seemed quite helpless and then spoke to Little Sparrow: “Little Sparrow, how do you rob someone? Give them a demonstration.” Little Sparrow turned its head to look at Huang Qingling, who gave it a look.
Then…
In an instant, Little Sparrow moved like an arrow, charging towards Li Tangyu. At the same time, a strange and somewhat unpleasant sound was heard:
“Hand it over…”
As the two words fell, Little Sparrow was already atop the roof beam, with a crescent-shaped Magic Artifact in its beak.
It was the very one that Li Tangyu had been holding a moment before.
Looking back at Li Tangyu, he had just begun to realize what happened and looked up towards the ceiling…
Already shocked by the fact that Little Sparrow could speak, Li Tangyu was frozen for a moment, and coupled with this sudden attack…
Li Tangyu was so caught off guard that he lost a Magic Artifact from his grasp without even realizing it.
Seeing this scene, everyone was struck dumb.
After a moment, Li Qingqing reacted and burst into uncontrollable laughter while thumping the table.
“Hahaha…”
“My brother…my brother, he was actually robbed by Little Sparrow, right in front of his eyes.”
“Hahaha, I’m dying of laughter…”
As Li Qingqing laughed so hard she could barely catch her breath, Li Tangyu’s face flushed red, but he didn’t try to explain himself.
Because, indeed, he had been completely taken by surprise and Little Sparrow had snatched the Magic Artifact.
Mainly, Little Sparrow was really fast, and it had chosen the perfect moment, just as Li Tangyu was taken aback.
Li Tangyu was just careless enough to fall prey to the trick.
And Zhang Yuan, sitting beside Li Tangyu, was twitching the corners of his mouth.
Because he, too, had been briefly stunned just now; luckily, Little Sparrow hadn’t targeted him,
After a while, Li Qingqing had also finished her laughing and calmed down.
Then Li Tangyu opened his mouth again:
“This Little Sparrow, seems rather extraordinary…”
Li Qingqing teased him, saying:
“Of course, it’s extraordinary, able to snatch things right from you. Little Sparrow is really amazing.
“I’ve decided, the scare Little Sparrow gave me is now water under the bridge.”
Li Tangyu’s face immediately went slack, worried that this incident, through Li Qingqing’s telling, would become an embarrassing story for the ages. Given Li Qingqing’s nature, he feared she might never let him live it down..

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 166 Demon Cultivator
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Demon Cultivator
Translator: 549690339
Following that, Li Tangyu spoke seriously: “Qing Qing, stop fooling around…”
“I’m talking about a serious matter…”
“Oh…” Li Qingqing nodded, and then settled down.
After Li Qingqing had calmed down, Li Tangyu continued to ask Huang Qingling:
“Fellow Daoist Qing Ling, has Little Sparrow had any unusual encounters recently?”
Huang Qingling pondered for a moment before answering:
“Unusual encounters?”
“I’m not sure…”
“Because I have been letting it roam outside recently and haven’t been paying much attention to it.”
“However, I indeed feel it has been getting smarter…”
“And now, it no longer eats food but has started consuming Elixir Medicines, those that enhance cultivation.”
“Not eating food but consuming Elixir Medicines…”
Li Tangyu repeated then seemed to recall something.
He reached into his Storage Bag and pulled out a walnut-sized black sphere.
Lin Jing looked closely, noticing that the surface of the sphere was pitted, and there were some dark red marks on it.
What Li Tangyu was holding was a Demonic Beast Inner Core.
Then, Li Tangyu displayed the Demonic Beast Inner Core to Little Sparrow.
“Little Sparrow, this is for you…”
Upon hearing Li Tangyu’s words, Little Sparrow cocked its head to look at Huang Qingling.
Huang Qingling looked up and said to Little Sparrow:
“Go ahead…’
“Also, return that Magic Artifact to him.”
Seeing that Huang Qingling had spoken, Little Sparrow did not hesitate, flying down from the roof beam.
It returned the Magic Artifact it had taken and then took the Demonic Beast Inner Core from Li Tangyu’s hand.
After that, it flew back to Huang Qingling’s side.
That’s right
Little Sparrow itself was capable of consuming Demonic Beast Inner Cores.
The first time Lin Jing saw Little Sparrow, it had taken the opportunity to attack when that yak-like Demonic Beast was gravely injured, burrowing into the creature’s skull and snatching its inner core.
It was only after Little Sparrow followed Huang Qingling and was disciplined by Elder Bai that it became much more docile.
But in its essence, it was still a Demonic Beast capable of swallowing Demonic Beast Inner Cores directly.
And then…
Little Sparrow opened its mouth wide, like a gaping abyssal maw, and actually swallowed the walnut-sized Demonic Beast Inner Core in one gulp.
The Inner Core, nearly as big as Little Sparrow’s head, slid smoothly down its throat and into its stomach.
After swallowing the Demonic Beast Inner Core, Little Sparrow then contentedly patted its belly with its wings.
Seeing Little Sparrow ingest the Inner Core, Li Tangyu reached into his Storage Bag again, then pulled out a small porcelain bottle.
He then opened the bottle and poured out an Elixir Medicine.
Lin Jing looked intently and saw that it was a Gathering Yuan Pill, and moreover, it was of Medium Grade.
Li Tangyu, holding the Gathering Yuan Pill, asked Huang Qingling:
“Sister Qing Ling, can it consume this?”
“It can…”
Huang Qingling nodded.
“Before you all arrived, Lin Jing already fed Little Sparrow one.”
After finishing her sentence, Huang Qingling’s eyes shifted, her lips curving into a mischievous smile. She pointed at Lin Jing and continued:
“And furthermore, this was the reward for letting Little Sparrow give you all a scare. ”
As soon as Huang Qingling finished speaking, the other three people all turned their heads, looking at Lin Jing.
“Cough cough…”
Feeling somewhat uneasy under the gaze of the three, Lin Jing quickly coughed twice to hide his embarrassment.
Then he went on:
“I was just impressed by how smart Little Sparrow is, and wanted to test her,” “It turns out that Brother Lin shares my curiosity about this matter.”
Li Tangyu, upon hearing this, did not blame Lin Jing but instead expressed understanding.
Zhang Yuan also nodded in agreement.
Li Qingqing, the only one who was frightened and a bit emotional, also forgave Lin Jing for the sake of the delicacy.
This, however, let Huang Qingling down as she was hoping to see some excitement.
Next, Li Tangyu placed the Elixir Medicine in his palm and said to Little Sparrow:
“Little Sparrow, this is for you…”
Little Sparrow, who had been listening to the conversation, turned her head upon hearing Li Tangyu’s words, glanced at Huang Qingling, and seeing no objection, flew straight over.
She came to Li Tangyu, opened her beak to place the Magic Artifact in his hand.
Then, she took the Medium Grade Gathering Yuan Pill and flew back to Huang Qingling’s side.
Just like before, Little Sparrow swallowed the pill directly.
She then continued standing on Huang Qingling’s shoulder as if nothing had happened, looking at everyone.
After witnessing this, Li Tangyu frowned and pondered for a long while before saying:
“Being able to consume Demonic Beast Inner Cores, as well as Elixir Medicine that enhances Cultivation…”
“If I’m not mistaken, Little Sparrow’s condition should be transitioning towards becoming a Demon Cultivator.”
Zhang Yuan next to Li Tangyu nodded upon hearing this:
“Brother Li is correct, there are records of this in my family’s library.”
“However, Little Sparrow seems to be different…”
Lin Jingzhi had heard about Demon Cultivators before but didn’t understand the specifics, so he asked:
“What exactly is a Demon Cultivator?”
“And…”
“What does Brother Zhang mean by saying Little Sparrow is different? Is she unlike other Demonic Beasts?”
When Lin Jing finished speaking, Zhang Yuan began to explain:
“Demon Cultivators are divided into two types…”
“One type is born with spiritual intelligence and resembles Human Cultivators in appearance but retains some features of Demonic Beasts, as well as their racial talents.”
“Only after passing the transformation tribulation can they completely transform into the human form.”
“Such Demon Cultivators have ancestors who were powerful Demonic Beasts that overcame the transformation tribulation, and it’s precisely because their ancestors were so strong…”
“That they are born as Demon Cultivators instead of Demonic Beasts.” “The other type originates from Demonic Beasts who cultivate.”
“To transform into a Demon Cultivator, a Demonic Beast first needs strong Cultivation and must awaken spiritual intelligence…”
“After these two conditions are met, through prolonged cultivation, they can undergo a metamorphosis and become a true Demon Cultivator.”
“Of course…”
“There are also some powerful Demonic Beasts who, after awakening spiritual intelligence, choose not to assume human form.”
“Instead, they continue cultivating in their bestial form.”
“Ordinarily, Demonic Beasts improve their Cultivation, gradually awakening spiritual intelligence. The higher the Cultivation of the Demonic Beast, the greater their intelligence, until eventually they become indistinguishable from humans…”
“Around that time, they would typically undergo the transformation tribulation…”
“But to see Little Sparrow awaken spiritual intelligence so early and start transitioning towards being a Demon Cultivator is a first for me.” “That’s what makes her different from the rest, ” Zhang Yuan said.
After a moment of silence, Li Tangyu spoke again:
“Actually, there are other methods that can enable a Demonic Beast to awaken spiritual intelligence early on and begin the transformation into a Demon
Cultivator.”
After thinking for a moment, Zhang Yuan nodded and said:
“Enlightenment by a great demon…” “Right,” Li Tangyu nodded. “It’s impossible for a great demon…”
Zhang Yuan shook his head:
“In the entire Nanming Domain, there are no great demons capable of enlightening Demonic Beasts….”

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 167 Tracking
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Tracking
Translator: 549690339
Li Tangyu pondered for a moment, then spoke again:
“In fact, besides the enlightenment by a great demon, there’s another method that can allow Little Sparrow to awaken its spiritual wisdom early and begin transforming into a demon cultivator.”
Zhang Yuan suddenly realized, “A large amount of demon qi…”
“Little Sparrow must have absorbed a large amount of demon qi…”
Places with a large amount of demon qi indeed do exist in this Night Mist Mountain Range.
All of them thought of the same place without prior consultation.
“Demon Race Secret Realm…
Thinking of this, they looked at each other.
Could it really be that demon qi leaked from within the Demon Race Secret Realm?
Li Qingqing then voiced her doubts:
“Didn’t we ask the two Nascent Soul seniors from Qingyuan Sword Sect to seal the secret realm last time?”
“And those two Nascent Soul seniors also said that this seal could last for ten years…”
“How long has it been since then?”
Recalling the beast tide incident from last time, they sighed:
“Yeah, how long has it been…”
“Moreover, that was a seal personally set by two Nascent Soul True Monarchs.”
Following that, everyone fell silent for a moment.
A short while later, Zhang Yuan spoke:
“Brother Li, what should we do next?”
“Do we explore on our own, or do we report directly to the clan?”
Li Tangyu thought for a moment, then said:
“If it truly is a problem at the Demon Race Secret Realm, then there’s not much we can do if we go there, and we might even encounter danger.”
“Let’s report it to the clan. This matter has already exceeded our abilities.”
“That’s for the best…”
Zhang Yuan nodded.
“Sister Qing Ling, Brother Lin…”
“It seems that we few will have to meet another day. We need to report this matter to the clan. Whether it’s true or not, at the very least we must be prepared.”
Li Tangyu bowed to the two of them.
“Indeed, that’s the right thing to do…”
Lin Jing also bowed in response.
Then, Li Tangyu, Li Qingqing, and Zhang Yuan stood up, took their leave from Lin Jing and others. “Sister Qing Ling, Brother Lin, we take our leave.” After speaking, they left.
Lin Jing and Huang Qingling then saw them off.
After returning, Lin Jing helped Huang Qingling tidy everything up, and then
he too lett.
Back in his own courtyard, Lin Jing pondered for a while.
If the seal of the Demon Race Secret Realm was truly broken and another beast tide occurred, he wouldn’t actually need to worry now.
After all, his situation was not like before, since he now lived in the Inner Fang Market, protected by its formations. Even if a beast tide approached, there would be no need for fear.
Afterward, Lin Jing put his thoughts aside.
He disregarded these matters and entered the System Space.
Tonight was another night for alchemy.
The next day, as dawn broke…
Little Sparrow flapped its wings and came to Lin Jing’s courtyard, apparently remembering Lin Jing’s words from yesterday.
By then, Lin Jing had already emerged from System Space, waiting for Little Sparrow.
Seeing Little Sparrow’s arrival, Lin Jing beckoned for it to come down, and once Little Sparrow did, he said:
“Little Sparrow, I want you to help me track someone.”
Little Sparrow tilted its head, looking at Lin Jing.
“You just need to see where he goes every day and then come back, and you’ll take me through it.”
“Of course, it’s best if he doesn’t notice you…”
“After this tracking mission is complete, I’ll give you a few Medium Grade Gathering Yuan Pills, the same kind you had last night…”
Upon hearing this, Little Sparrow nodded.
Seeing Little Sparrow nod in agreement, Lin Jing then took Little Sparrow and left the house.
To enable Little Sparrow to track that Pill Master surnamed Wang, he had to first introduce Little Sparrow to the man.
Previously, after finding out about Lin Jing’s relationship with Elder Yu, the Pill Master surnamed Wang, in an attempt to curry favor, had told Lin Jing where he lived.
Thus, Lin Jing knew where the Pill Master surnamed Wang resided.
This time, he was taking Little Sparrow to the residence of the Pill Master surnamed Wang so that Little Sparrow could memorize the man and thereafter follow him.
Upon leaving the house, they turned a couple of alleys and then walked some distance before arriving near the Pill Master surnamed Wang’s courtyard.
As both were Pill Masters serving under Yuebaolou and lived in courtyards provided by Yuebaolou, their residences were not very far from each other. Next, Lin Jing stopped and then turned to Little Sparrow, saying,
“Remember, the person living in this courtyard, as soon as he steps out, you follow him without letting him discover you…”
“When he returns to the courtyard, come back to find me, and then take me through the places he has been to.”
After Lin Jing finished speaking, he looked at Little Sparrow.
Little Sparrow nodded her head.
“Alright, off you go. Remember to be careful and keep a certain distance from him. You must not let him detect you.”
Lin Jing reiterated.
Little Sparrow cocked her head, cast a glance at Lin Jing, then flapped her wings and flew away.
Indeed, she was clever; when Little Sparrow flew over, she made no sound at all.
However, Lin Jing was still a bit worried, fearing any mishap.
Therefore, after Little Sparrow flew off, and upon seeing that there was no one around, Lin Jing moved closer and also entered System Space.
After entering System Space, Lin Jing instantly activated Observation Mode.
Immediately, the viewpoint rose, and Lin Jing looked toward the interior of the courtyard.
Lin Jing spotted Little Sparrow; at that moment, she was hiding on a tree inside the courtyard. Lin Jing didn’t interfere with her but continued to look around at other places.
The courtyard where the Pill Master surnamed Wang lived was similar to the one Lin Jing stayed in, both designed in the same style.
Therefore, it didn’t take much effort for Lin Jing to locate the bedroom.
Following that…
Lin Jing controlled the viewpoint of Observation Mode and peered into the bedroom where the Pill Master surnamed Wang resided.
This Observation Mode was extremely powerful; as long as it was within the observational scope, it could penetrate any obstacle.
Lin Jing controlled the viewpoint to pass through the wall and saw the scene inside the bedroom.
It was a simple bedroom, everything visible at a glance.
However, Lin Jing didn’t find any trace of the Pill Master surnamed Wang there.
“Not here?”
Lin Jing furrowed his brow, muttering to himself.
Then, he continued to control the observational viewpoint, rising until it passed through the roof and scanned over the entire courtyard from above.
Lin Jing noticed that behind the bedroom, there was a small room emitting a faint light. With a thought, he maneuvered the viewpoint towards that room.
This small room was the Alchemy room.
Of course, it seemed that the Pill Master surnamed Wang was in the middle of Alchemy.
Next, Lin Jing controlled the viewpoint to pass through the wall of the Alchemy room and witnessed the scene inside.
He saw the Pill Master surnamed Wang currently engaged in Alchemy, sweating profusely on his forehead, eyes intently fixed on the Pill Furnace, carefully manipulating the Foundation Building True Fire.
It appeared that it was a critical moment in the Alchemy process.
Before long, the batch of Elixir Furnace Medicine was completed.
After the Elixir Medicine was complete, the Pill Master surnamed Wang walked over, opened the Pill Furnace…
Then he took out the Elixir Medicine, his lips moved slightly, and he muttered a curse under his breath.
It seemed the batch of Elixir Medicine didn’t meet his expectations.
After that, the Pill Master surnamed Wang stored the Elixir Medicine in a small porcelain bottle and placed it into his Storage Bag,
then rummaged through the Storage Bag for a while. Moments later, the Pill Master surnamed Wang let out a coarse curse:
“Shit, it’s all used up again…”
He then got up, tidied up his slightly crumpled clothes, and walked out of the Alchemy room.
As he walked into the courtyard, Lin Jing saw Little Sparrow move as well, turning her head to stare at this man; however, he did not notice Little Sparrow.
After the Pill Master surnamed Wang left the Alchemy room and went into the bedroom, not long passed before he came out again.
Afterward, the Pill Master surnamed Wang closed the door, left the courtyard, and walked down the alley.
Seeing this, Little Sparrow quietly took flight and stealthily followed behind him
The Pill Master surnamed Wang, from beginning to end, never noticed..

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 168 Little Sparrow Is Very Busy
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Little Sparrow Is Very Busy
Translator: 549690339
Lin Jing did just that, in Observation Mode, watching Little Sparrow follow the Wang-surnamed Pill Master as they left.
It wasn’t until the Wang-surnamed Pill Master had gone far away that Lin Jing left the System Space and returned to his own small courtyard.
Next, it was just a matter of waiting for Little Sparrow to come back.
Little Sparrow returned just as the sky had begun to darken.
As soon as it came back, Little Sparrow set its sights on Lin Jing’s Storage Bag, seeming to ask Lin Jing for its reward.
Lin Jing didn’t waste words; he directly took out a Medium Grade Gathering Yuan Pill and tossed it to Little Sparrow.
Little Sparrow caught it with a flying leap, then landed on one side and immediately opened its beak wide to swallow it in one gulp.
After swallowing the Elixir Medicine, Little Sparrow once again looked toward Lin Jing’s Storage Bag but was stopped by Lin Jing.
“Alright, Little Sparrow…”
“You can’t be greedy; you get one a day. Tomorrow if you help me track again,
I’ll give you another one.”
“Chirp…”
Little Sparrow responded with a cry, then reluctantly withdrew its gaze.
“You weren’t noticed while tracking today, were you?” Lin Jing asked Little Sparrow once more.
“Chirp…”
Little Sparrow lifted its neck, a hint of pride in its eyes, and chirped a sound.
It was as if to say, “Piece of cake.”
Lin Jing extended his hand and stroked Little Sparrow; perhaps because it had just eaten Lin Jing’s Elixir Medicine, this time Little Sparrow did not dodge.
Then Lin Jing said,
“The person you were tracking for me today, where did they go? Lead me there…”
Because Little Sparrow couldn’t actually speak, Lin Jing could only communicate in this way to get the tracking results from it.
Following that, Lin Jing left the house with Little Sparrow.
Leaving the courtyard, Lin Jing let Little Sparrow lead the way, while he followed behind.
In this manner, Lin Jing was led by Little Sparrow as they wandered through the Fang Market…
From the courtyard where the Wang-surnamed Pill Master stayed, then to Yuebaolou, and even to several other shops in between, until at last, they arrived at a brothel…
The trip had taken more than half an hour to complete, but all of this was normal, and Lin Jing hadn’t found anything unusual.
When Lin Jing returned to the small courtyard, he spoke to Little Sparrow again,
“Little Sparrow, you’ll go track him again tomorrow…”
“Don’t count the places he went today—we’re only interested in new locations.
If he goes somewhere else, come back and let me know right away.”
“Do you understand?”
Little Sparrow bobbed its head up and down in agreement.
Just when Lin Jing was about to let Little Sparrow go back, a crisp voice came from outside the door:
“Little Sparrow, you’ve been mischievous again, haven’t you…”
At the sound of this voice, Little Sparrow was scared into a shiver.
Lin Jing was also startled, not knowing why Huang Qingling would come at this time.
Lin Jing hurriedly comforted Little Sparrow,
“Little Sparrow, don’t be afraid, I’ll explain for you…”
The initially somewhat anxious Little Sparrow instantly became less so.
Then it called out to Lin Jing again.
But in that call, one could clearly hear a mood of relaxation.
“Lin Jing, open the door…” Huang Qingling called from outside at this moment.
“Coming, Qingling Daoyou, please wait a moment.”
Following that, Lin Jing walked toward the door.
Upon opening the courtyard door, Lin Jing’s first sight was Huang Qingling, and trailing behind him was Li Tangyu.
“Qingling Daoyou… ”
“Brother Li…”
Lin Jing spoke up, greeting both men.
“Brother Lin…” Li Tangyu replied with a salute.
Then, Huang Qingling spoke,
“Lin Jing, has Little Sparrow come to find you again? I knew that greedy bird would come looking for Elixir Medicine from you…”
“It was one thing for you to indulge its cravings for fine food before, but now it’s even clinging to you for Elixir Medicine…”
“Little Sparrow is really getting out of hand. I must discipline it today…”
As she spoke, Huang Qingling was about to walk inside.
Lin Jing quickly spoke up:
“Daoyou Qingling is mistaken, it wasn’t Little Sparrow who came to ask me for
Elixir Medicine, it was I who sent for Little Sparrow…”
“You sent for Little Sparrow?”
After hearing Lin Jing’s words, Huang Qingling suddenly turned her head and looked at him with confusion.
“What could you possibly need Little Sparrow for? You’re not trying to excuse it, are you?” Huang Qingling scrutinized Lin Jing, her eyes filled with suspicion.
Lin Jing was at a loss whether to laugh or cry: “Daoyou Qingling is thinking too much…”
“Come, let’s talk inside!”
Saying this, Lin Jing gestured for the two of them to come in.
After the two entered, Lin Jing closed the courtyard door behind them and followed them inside.
While walking, Lin Jing explained:
“Didn’t I notice yesterday that Little Sparrow was so intelligent? I just tested it a bit by having it scare Daoyou Qing Qing and Brother Li, right?” “Mm.” Huang Qingling nodded and then continued to ask:
“Wasn’t the test completed yesterday?”
“That was only half of it; what’s happening now is a follow-up to yesterday…” Hearing this, Huang Qingling was quite speechless and she couldn’t help but say:
“You really do have too much time…”
Even Li Tangyu, who was following behind, looked at Lin Jing with a similarly odd gaze.
They probably both thought that Lin Jing was having Little Sparrow go scare people again.
Lin Jing didn’t bother to explain.
Then, Lin Jing asked the two:
“You’ve come so late, was it specifically to find Little Sparrow?”
“Not to hide anything from Brother Lin, indeed it is…” Li Tangyu said.
At this moment, the three of them had arrived inside the courtyard. As soon as Huang Qingling entered the courtyard, she saw Little Sparrow.
“Little Sparrow, come here…”
Only then did Little Sparrow reluctantly and slowly fly over, fearful of being punished.
“It’s all right, Little Sparrow.”
“I’ve already explained everything to Daoyou Qingling, and she won’t punish you,” Lin Jing said to Little Sparrow at this time.
“Chirp.”
Upon hearing this, Little Sparrow let out a chirp and then sped up a bit, flying in front of Huang Qingling, circling around her twice, and then landing on Huang Qingling’s shoulder.
And true enough, Huang Qingling didn’t go on to lecture it.
“Brother Lin, if you need to test Little Sparrow again, you might have to wait another two days,” Li Tangyu spoke up at this time.
“You’re taking Little Sparrow away?” Lin Jing asked.
Li Tangyu shook his head and then explained:
“Not us, but my grandfather and several other Golden Core Immortals…”
As soon as Li Tangyu said this, Lin Jing immediately understood what was going on.
“It’s about the Demon Race Secret Realm, isn’t it…”
Li Tangyu nodded and said:
“Yes…”
“After we told my grandfather about the incident yesterday, he immediately went to investigate and found cracks above the sealing formation, though no demon qi had leaked out.”
“He also searched the surrounding area but still could not sense any demon qi.
Having no other options, he had to return and notify the other immortals.”
“After discussing with them, my grandfather and the others decided to bring Little Sparrow with them to look for the suspected spot where demon qi might be leaking. After all, the matter of the Demon Race Secret Realm is not to be taken lightly.”
“If by any chance there is some accident, Qingyuan Sword Sect must be informed as soon as possible.”
After saying that, Li Tangyu looked toward Little Sparrow and spoke again:
“Little Sparrow might be busy these next few days…”
“The test you have for Little Sparrow, Daoyou Lin, will have to wait….”

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Investigation
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Investigation
Translator: 549690339
“The work you are doing is what’s important; my test is not a big deal…” Lin
Jing said.
Li Tangyu nodded, then immediately added,
“Alright, Brother Lin, we will take our leave now…”
“We still need to take Little Sparrow back to see my grandfather and the rest.”
“Okay…”
Lin Jing responded.
After saying goodbye to Lin Jing, the two of them left with Little Sparrow.
Having seen off the two guests, Lin Jing returned to the courtyard and not long after, he entered the System Space to engage in alchemy.
Time flew by swiftly, and two days passed quickly.
On this day, Lin Jing was in the middle of alchemy within the System Space when an alert from the system was issued.
“Alert!”
“Intruder detected within the alert perimeter, please respond in a timely manner, host.”
At that moment, Lin Jing was at a critical stage in his alchemy, too busy to pay heed; he did not attend to it further and continued to focus his energies on refining the Elixir Medicine.
rlWvo quarters of an hour passed before Lin Jing completed the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
After the refinement was finished, Lin Jing immediately stored away the Elixir Medicine and then he said,
“System.”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
Subsequently, Lin Jing’s perspective shifted above the small courtyard.
He then moved his viewpoint toward the gate, but found no one there.
“It seems they must have seen that no one was around and left already…” Lin Jing muttered to himself, not really concerned.
Lin Jing then turned his viewpoint around to survey around the courtyard. Finding nothing out of the ordinary, he exited Observation Mode.
Fearing further disturbances, Lin Jing decided not to continue alchemy but instead left the System Space.
Subsequently, Lin Jing began to meditate and cultivate inside the house.
Roughly half an hour later, while he was meditating, Lin Jing suddenly heard a noise from outside.
So he opened his eyes and sent his Divine Sense out.
With this sweep, he discovered that it was Little Sparrow outside.
“It seems that the alert from the system just now must have been Little Sparrow…” Lin Jing thought to himself.
Little Sparrow had returned at some point, indicating that the investigation of the Demon Race’s Secret Realm had concluded, and therefore Little Sparrow had been released to return.
At that moment, Little Sparrow perched in front of Lin Jing’s door, chirping inside.
“Little Sparrow, you’re back…” Lin Jing spoke in response.
He then got up, walked over, and opened the door.
As soon as the door was opened, Little Sparrow gripped Lin Jing’s sleeve in its beak and flew outside.
Lin Jing was initially startled but then realized what was happening and said to Little Sparrow,
“Little Sparrow…”
“Is it that the person I asked you to track has gone to a new location?”
Little Sparrow nodded its head like a pecking chicken.
“Okay, I’ll follow you right now…” Lin Jing said.
“It must be said, Little Sparrow is indeed dedicated; having only just completed the reconnaissance, and without even seeing me, it went straight to tracking.”
“Little Sparrow, you really are busy…”
With Little Sparrow leading the way, Lin Jing followed quickly behind.
In this manner, Little Sparrow led Lin Jing out of the alley and then through the bustling streets of Fang Market.
In the end, they arrived near a grand residence with towering gates, and Lin Jing saw that the courtyard was actually the Liu Clan’s.
Lin Jing then stopped in his tracks.
Afterwards, Little Sparrow gestured insistently towards the Liu Clan’s home to Lin Jing.
“Little Sparrow, are you saying that the person went inside this courtyard?” Lin Jing asked Little Sparrow.
Upon hearing this, Little Sparrow nodded.
That Pill Master surnamed Wang had actually entered Liu Manor. Following this, Lin Jing fell silent for a moment, then said to Little Sparrow:
“Little Sparrow, you don’t need to follow anymore. Go back first and come to find me tonight. I will give you the elixir medicine then.”
Little Sparrow cocked its head, looked at Lin Jing for a while, and then flew away directly.
“Is this Pill Master surnamed Wang really colluding with the Liu Clan?”
“Could he have been sent by Liu Yiyuan?”
Lin Jing had suspected this before, but he couldn’t be certain.
After all, the actions of this Pill Master surnamed Wang were too abnormal without reason.
As the saying goes, an abnormality signifies something demonic.
Therefore, he had Little Sparrow tail this Pill Master surnamed Wang.
The reason Lin Jing let Little Sparrow go back first was to better eavesdrop on information.
However, the Liu Clan’s defenses were too strict; Lin Jing definitely couldn’t get in.
What’s more, there was a Wu Cai Immortal inside.
so…
He didn’t plan to go in, but to use another method to investigate.
Having used Observation Mode during this period, he had gained new understandings of it.
Observation Mode was, without a doubt, the best for eavesdropping on information.
Because Observation Mode could ignore terrain obstacles and probe directly into any place, but its only drawback was that Observation Mode had a range limitation.
Lin Jing had to first get close to the target he wanted to investigate. He must get as close to the Liu Clan’s compound as possible.
Then, Lin Jing looked around…
Next to the Liu Clan to the west was another family’s yard in the Inner Fang Market, with a narrow passageway between the two houses.
However, because this place was secluded, there were very few other people coming and going, which made it relatively quiet.
Seeing this alleyway, Lin Jing had an idea.
He first crossed the street and then bypassed the Liu Clan’s front entrance, heading towards that alleyway.
After turning into the alleyway and taking two turns, Lin Jing saw that there was no one around and directly called out the system, entering the System Space.
Just arriving in the System Space, Lin Jing began to call out the system.
“System.”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
Then, Lin Jing’s point of view ascended, appearing directly above the Liu Clan.
Next, Lin Jing began to control the observation perspective, searching within the Liu Clan compound.
However, the Liu Clan’s compound was indeed not small; Lin Jing found that the area he could probe with Observation Mode was less than half of the Liu Clan’s estate.
The observation range of Observation Mode was determined by the size of the Spirit Field within his System Space.
His current Spirit Field was thirty acres, meaning the maximum range Lin Jing could probe was also this large, but even with such an area, he could only see a small part of the Liu Clan.
And this was in the Inner Fang Market, indicating the Liu Clan’s strength was extraordinary…
Lin Jing used Observation Mode to search the whole area he could probe, including the underground chambers.
Yet he did not see the Pill Master surnamed Wang, nor did he even see Liu Yiyuan.
“Nothing, it seems I need to find a different position,” Lin Jing thought to himself after the search.
Since the System Space was centered on Lin Jing’s own location, and he was now on the west side of the Liu Clan, there was a large area on the east side that he couldn’t observe.
To observe, he had to go to the east side alone and then enter the System Space to be able to observe it.
Following that…
Lin Jing exited Observation Mode and left the System Space.
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing walked out along the passageway, turned two corners, and entered an alley.
Lin Jing followed the alley eastward and soon arrived at the east side of the Liu Clan…
Afterward, in a place where there was no one around, Lin Jing once again entered the System Space.
Immediately following, he initiated Observation Mode and began to probe.
In less than a quarter of an hour, Lin Jing finally found Liu Yiyuan in a secret chamber.
Alongside him stood the Pill Master surnamed Wang…
“These two are indeed in cahoots….’

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Failed to Gather Information
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Failed to Gather Information
Translator: 549690339
Lin Jing manipulated the observation perspective, looking towards Liu Yiyuan.
He found that the man’s face was haggard, and his eyes were filled with dense bloodshot veins, indicating that his state was not looking good.
The Pill Master with the surname Wang standing opposite him, on the other hand, wore a fawning expression.
Then, Liu Yiyuan opened his mouth:
‘You go and test the waters again these next couple of days. If that doesn’t work, we’ll raise the stakes. I refuse to believe he won’t be tempted.”
“In any case, within these two days, you find a way to lure him out of Fang
Market…”
“Once he’s out of Fang Market, everything will be much easier.”
“Understood, Young Master Liu, I will test his intentions tomorrow,” the Wang-surnamed Pill Master said.
At this moment, after listening in, Lin Jing thought to himself:
“The ‘he’ they’re referring to must be myself…”
Following that, Lin Jing withdrew his mind, continuing to eavesdrop, hoping to uncover more information.
But just then, Liu Yiyuan spoke up directly, dashing Lin Jing’s hopes to eavesdrop further.
“Alright, you may go back now…”
Liu Yiyuan waved his hand, dismissing the Wang-surnamed Pill Master. It seemed their conversation had concluded.
“Yes, Young Master Liu…”
The Wang-surnamed Pill Master bowed to Liu Yiyuan and then exited the secret chamber.
Seeing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but sigh with regret.
If he had been able to follow Little Sparrow out right away the first time she came, he might have overheard some useful information.
But he was delayed by Alchemy at first, and then spent such a long time investigating, that by the time Lin Jing arrived here, they had already finished their conversation.
This left Lin Jing feeling helpless; this attempt at gathering intelligence was a failure.
“However, what can be confirmed now is…”
“This Pill Master surnamed Wang is indeed colluding with Liu Yiyuan. Thus, his invitation to visit some Fourth Grade Pill Master’s residence might very well be a part of Liu Yiyuan’s scheme.”
“As Elder Yu said, Liu Yiyuan is someone who holds grudges. Even now, he can’t let go of the past hostility between them…”
“Even after Elder Bai mediated, he doesn’t dare to oppose me openly. However, he still wants to lure me out of the Inner Fang Market to my disadvantage.” At that moment…
Lin Jing also recalled the Offering Priest assessment from before, where the Wang-surnamed Pill Master had interfered with him twice.
Lin Jing had suspected that the Pill Master might have done it on purpose, and what he witnessed today further confirmed his suspicion.
It seems…
At that time, he probably wanted to make me fail the assessment,
Then let Zheng, the manager, strip me of my status as a Pill Master at Yuebaolou, and reclaim the residence I was living in…
So that I would be forced to move out of the Inner Fang Market.
After all, the Outer Fang Market is not as safe as the Inner Fang Market. Even if I do nothing and just stay at home, I could still encounter unforeseen disasters.
Once I’m out of the Inner Fang Market, my safety can hardly be guaranteed.
Thinking of the assessment, Lin Jing also thought of that new manager, Zheng.
It’s just unknown what the relationship between this new manager Zheng and the Liu Clan really is.
After all, manager Zheng did visit the Liu Clan soon after his arrival.
But…
Since the last assessment, manager Zheng has not bothered me again after canceling the privilege granted by Elder Bai.
As a result, Lin Jing found it somewhat unfathomable.
After the Wang-surnamed Pill Master left, Lin Jing did not exit Observation Mode, but continued to observe Liu Yiyuan.
To see if his subsequent actions would reveal any bit of news.
However, after the Pill Master left, Liu Yiyuan didn’t say anything. Instead, he started to meditate and cultivate.
Lin Jing observed for a while longer before sighing quietly in the dark, realizing he couldn’t glean any more information, and then he exited Observation Mode.
Afterward, Lin Jing left the System Space and walked out along the small path.
He kept pondering even as he returned to his small courtyard.
“If nothing unexpected happens, that Pill Master surnamed Wang will definitely come looking for me tomorrow…”
“So, how should I respond to him tomorrow…”
After deliberating for a moment, Lin Jing decided to agree first and test the waters.
Lin Jing knew that once he agreed, the Pill Master surnamed Wang would surely go back to report to Liu Yiyuan.
When he went back to report, Lin Jing would take the opportunity to gather some information from the Liu Clan and plan his next move.
After all, the information he currently had was too little; he knew nothing about their plans or how they were laid out.
Lin Jing’s previous guesses were just that, mere conjectures. Only by grasping their specific actions could he better prepare his response.
Indeed, Lin Jing could also refuse the Wang surnamed Pill Master, which would certainly foil their plans.
But if Lin Jing refused this time, what about the next time, or the time after that?
Liu Yiyuan had a petty nature and his hatred for him had obviously reached its peak, eager to eliminate Lin Jing as soon as possible.
He couldn’t remain passive like this forever; there was no logic in being a thief for a thousand days but not being prepared against a thief for a thousand days.
so…
Lin Jing also wanted to find an opportunity to get rid of Liu Yiyuan,
The reason he wanted to agree temporarily was to see if such an opportunity existed.
If not, Lin Jing would have to endure for the time being and slowly increase his own strength.
Fortunately, Liu Yiyuan currently didn’t dare to confront Lin Jing openly, so as long as he stayed in the Inner Fang Market, there was nothing to fear.
Otherwise…
He wouldn’t be trying so hard to lure Lin Jing out.
In the evening, Little Sparrow came over.
As soon as Little Sparrow arrived, it grabbed Lin Jing’s Storage Bag with its beak and placed it in his hand, clearly indicating its purpose. Lin Jing needed to deliver the reward for the tracking.
Lin Jing smiled and stroked Little Sparrow, saying,
“Little Sparrow, don’t be anxious. Rest assured, you’ve made a contribution this time, and you won’t be forgotten.”
Then, Lin Jing opened the Storage Bag and took out a Medium Grade Gathering Yuan Pill and a Superior Gathering Yuan Pill, offering them to Little Sparrow.
He had plenty of such Elixir Medicines, and now that Little Sparrow had made a contribution, Lin Jing was thinking of rewarding it with an extra Superior Gathering Yuan Pill.
After placing the Elixir Medicines in his hand, Little Sparrow cocked its head to look at Lin Jing with a slightly puzzled gaze. “Eat up, it’s your reward…” Lin Jing said.
“Chirp..
Then Little Sparrow flapped its wings, chirped, and snatched up one pill and swallowed it,
However, no sooner had the first gone down than Little Sparrow grabbed the second pill and swallowed it too.
Lin Jing watched Little Sparrow with a touch of envy, wondering how it could ingest so many Elixir Medicines consecutively without any issue.
Usually, Cultivators take one Elixir Medicine, practice for a while, and absorb the Spiritual Power from the medicine completely.
But after absorption, they still need to convert this Spiritual Power, transforming it into their own.
Therefore, they cannot immediately take a second pill; they must wait for some time before they can continue.
But for some reason, Little Sparrow could take them simultaneously.
After swallowing the Elixir Medicines, Little Sparrow prepared to leave.
Lin Jing called it back and informed it that from tomorrow on, there was no need to follow anymore.
Lin Jing’s goal had been achieved, and Little Sparrow no longer needed to track.
Little Sparrow seemed quite disappointed, but after Lin Jing’s persuasion, it ultimately nodded and left..

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 171 Waiting for a Rabbit by a Tree Stump
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Waiting for a Rabbit by a Tree Stump
Translator: 549690339
The next day…
Lin Jing was in the System Space, training in the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique, when the system warning sounded at this moment.
“Warning!”
“Someone has intruded into the warning perimeter, please host respond in time.”
Hearing the system warning, Lin Jing paused for a moment, then a huge boulder, several feet tall, in front of Lin Jing suddenly split silently into two halves.
“Boom…”
The boulder collapsed to both sides, kicking up a cloud of dust.
At this time, a transparent object flew towards Lin Jing, and the aura emanating from this object was extremely faint; if one were not careful, it would be very hard to detect.
The transparent object stopped right in front of Lin Jing and was then grabbed by him,
It turned out that this transparent object was the Flawless Sword.
The boulder just now had clearly been split by this Flawless Sword.
The reason the Flawless Sword could move so silently was entirely the merit of the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique.
During this period, Lin Jing, besides Alchemy, had also taken out some time to specialize in training the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique.
By now, Lin Jing had cultivated the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique to the third layer,
The power exhibited by the third layer of the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique was slightly stronger than other Foundation Establishment Stage Sword Control Techniques.
Furthermore, upon reaching the third layer, the Ling Yin Imperial Sword
Technique’s ability to conceal was even more superior. If he were to launch a sneak attack on a cultivator at the early Foundation Establishment, they might not be able to react in time.
Of course, if faced with a mid or late Foundation Establishment cultivator, then the concealing effect of the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique might be greatly reduced.
Unless, Lin Jing continued to advance the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique to the fourth layer.
Then it might still be possible to pose a threat to mid or late Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Afterward, Lin Jing put away the Flawless Sword, and then spoke:
“System, restore the terrain…”
As Lin Jing’s words fell…
Immediately after, the huge boulder in front of Lin Jing, as well as the area of the Stone Forest full of giant rocks ahead, started collapsing, falling to the ground and slowly turning back into rocks,
Then, the ashen rocks also gradually changed color, ultimately turning back to the sandy yellow soil.
During this time, Lin Jing had been practicing the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique in this manner.
The transformed terrain could be freely destroyed by Lin Jing; in the end, it could all be restored.
After restoring the terrain, Lin Jing activated Observation Mode to take a look around.
When he saw the Pill Master surnamed Wang standing outside the door, the corners of Lin Jing’s mouth slightly curled up.
“Here he comes…”
Then, he left the System Space.
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing walked out of the room and towards the door of the yard.
Walking along the road, Lin Jing looked up at the sun above his head, which had already risen quite high.
Since yesterday, when Lin Jing heard that the Pill Master surnamed Wang would come today, he had been waiting for him. Lin Jing had actually expected him to arrive early in the morning.
For this reason, Lin Jing had waited for some time, and when he did not show up, Lin Jing entered the System Space to cultivate the Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique.
Upon reaching the door, Lin Jing stretched out his hand and opened the gate.
Seeing the Pill Master surnamed Wang standing at the door.
The Pill Master surnamed Wang, seeing Lin Jing, spoke first:
“Lin Daoyou, I hope I am not intruding. I didn’t interrupt your Alchemy today, did I?”
Lin Jing shook his head and replied, “I was just cultivating, why did Wang Daoyou come now?”
The Pill Master surnamed Wang looked around quietly and then spoke softly:
“Lin Daoyou, about the matter we discussed a few days ago, I was wondering how you have considered it?”
After listening, Lin Jing frowned slightly, appearing to be in quite a dilemma. “Daoyou, please come inside to discuss further…”
Saying this, Lin Jing stepped aside to let the Pill Master surnamed Wang in.
“It really isn’t appropriate to speak of such confidential matters at the doorstep. ”
“Alright…”
The surnamed Wang Pill Master didn’t delay and walked straight in.
Upon entering the courtyard, the surnamed Wang Pill Master opened the conversation:
“Lin Daoyou, do you have any concerns?”
Lin Jing then sighed and said,
“Without concealment from Wang Daoyou, indeed, I have seriously considered the matter you mentioned and am inclined to go there, but recently I have indeed been rather busy.”
At this, the surnamed Wang Pill Master said, “Lin Daoyou, whatever you’re busy with can be postponed for now. As you know, opportunities wait for no one.”
“This secret cave abode is indeed hidden, and currently, I am the only one who Imows about it…”
“But the formation originally used to conceal the cave abode has been accidentally damaged by me, and occasionally, some aura may leak out. There’s no guarantee when it might be discovered by others.”
“If you continue to hesitate, I may have to find someone else…” After finishing his statement, the surnamed Wang Pill Master continued:
“You need to realize, that is a Fourth Grade Pill Master’s cave abode, any item you obtain there would be extremely rare and precious.”
“Wang Daoyou, you must think this through,” Lin Jing urged.
Lin Jing then lowered his head and hesitated for a moment before suddenly raising it as if he had made up his mind, looking at the surnamed Wang Pill Master:
“Daoyou, in that case…”
“I’ve decided to go with you to the cave abode, but not right now. I still have some matters to deal with, and afterward, I need to prepare…”
“It might take a few days…”
“Daoyou has made up his mind, that is truly wonderful…” the surnamed Wang Pill Master said joyfully.
“Of course, preparation is necessary, not just for Lin Daoyou, but for myself as well. May I know how long you need to prepare?”
“Three days…” Lin Jing replied. “Three days should be about right…”
“Alright…” the surnamed Wang Pill Master said:
“You prepare first in these three days, and I will also make some preparations…”
“After three days, I will come here, and we will go to the cave abode together.”
“Alright…” Lin Jing replied.
“Also, the Cleansing Spirit Flower you promised…”
Afterward, a trace of greed flashed in Lin Jing’s eyes as he looked at the surnamed Wang Pill Master.
Since the surnamed Wang Pill Master believed him to be inherently greedy, then he would just act as wished.
“Lin Daoyou, rest assured, I do not have the root of the Cleansing Spirit Flower with me right now. In three days, when we set off, I will make sure to give it to Lin Daoyou,” the surnamed Wang Pill Master patted his chest and promised.
“In that case, we have an agreement…” Lin Jing said.
“Mhm, please be at ease, Daoyou,” the surnamed Wang Pill Master replied.
Following that, the two had a further conversation, and then the surnamed Wang Pill Master left.
After the surnamed Wang Pill Master had gone, Lin Jing changed his clothes and disguise, then left the house.
This time, he arrived at an alley not far from the Liu Clan. Taking advantage of no one being around, Lin Jing entered the System Space.
All along the way…
Lin Jing didn’t dare to delay, wanting to get there before the surnamed Wang Pill Master’s arrival.
To eavesdrop on their plan.
Lin Jing knew that if everything went as expected,
the surnamed Wang Pill Master would definitely come here as soon as possible to report this news to Liu Yiyuan.
And Lin Jing himself only needed to wait here for his quarry to appear..

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 172 Changing Strategy
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Changing Strategy
Translator: 549690339
Afterwards, Lin Jing spoke up:
“System, enter Observation Mode.”
The next moment, the perspective shifted, and Lin Jing’s viewpoint appeared above the Liu Clan estate.
Next, Lin Jing controlled the observation angle to move, arriving at the courtyard where Liu Yiyuan was located, then directly passing through the room and entering the secret chamber.
Inside the secret chamber, Liu Yiyuan was at that moment meditating in seclusion, and the surnamed Wang Pill Master was not present.
Clearly, he hadn’t arrived yet.
Then, Lin Jing continued to elevate his viewpoint, coming to the skies above the Liu Clan, and kept watching the Liu Clan’s front gate, waiting for the arrival of the surnamed Wang Pill Master.
Less than two quarters of an hour later, from afar, Lin Jing saw the surnamed Wang Pill Master walking towards the Liu Clan.
As expected.
Lin Jing’s guess was correct, he had come.
As soon as the surnamed Wang Pill Master entered the Liu Clan, a Cultivator who seemed to be the butler took him to the courtyard where Liu Yiyuan was.
After that, the butler gestured for the Pill Master to go in while he stood guard outside the front door of the house.
Upon entering, the Pill Master familiarly proceeded into the secret chamber.
And Lin Jing also controlled the Observation Mode to re-enter the secret chamber.
“Young Master Liu…”
The Pill Master didn’t go directly inside the secret chamber; while still in the corridor leading to the chamber, he called out. Then, he heard Liu Yiyuan’s voice from inside.
“Come in…”
Not until Liu Yiyuan had finished speaking did the Pill Master walk inside.
Upon seeing Liu Yiyuan, the Pill Master promptly said:
“Young Master Liu, he agreed.”
When Liu Yiyuan heard what the Pill Master said, his eyes suddenly burst with a sharp light as he intently looked at the Pill Master.
“You’re saying, he agreed…”
‘Yes, Young Master Liu.”
The Pill Master said, cupping his hands in a salute.
After hearing this, Liu Yiyuan immediately burst into laughter:
“Haha…”
“He agreed, very good…”
Then, he continued to sDeak to the Pill Master:
“Then, our plan can commence now.” Hearing this, the Pill Master eagerly continued:
“Young Master Liu…”
“Lin Jing said that he has been somewhat busy lately, and needs a few more days to prepare.”
“Therefore, I used this as an excuse to set the date for three days from now.” Upon hearing the full account, Liu Yiyuan nodded and said:
“That’s fine, I can wait for three days… It gives us just enough time to arrange things in advance, so we can leave him without a place to be buried when the time comes.”
At that time, the Pill Master saluted again, saying:
“Then do we follow the original plan and lead him to that valley next?”
Liu Yiyuan spoke directly.
The Pill Master looked at Liu Yiyuan with confusion and asked:
“Then, where shall we set the ambush this time?”
A cold light flashed in Liu Yiyuan’s eyes as he replied:
“This time, to prevent any unexpected events, I plan to set the ambush site on the road you must take to reach the valley.”
“Please inform me of the specifics of the ambush, so I can also be prepared ahead of time.”
“Of course, I need to tell you. I’ve already decided… it will be at…”
Since only the two of them were in the secret chamber, Liu Yiyuan did not hesitate to inform the Pill Master of the exact location of the ambush.
What they did not expect was that the target of their ambush, Lin Jing, had overheard every single word without missing a beat.
“At the appointed time, just lead him over there according to the original plan…”
After finishing speaking, Liu Yiyuan gave the Pill Master a few more instructions.
“Understood…”
The Pill Master said, and after pondering for a moment, he continued to ask:
“Young Master Liu, for this ambush, may I ask how many people you plan to arrange?”
Liu Yiyuan wore a look of disdain:
“Is an Energy Refinement Cultivator even worth our full effort?”
“If not for being in Inner Fang Market, I fear he would have already died without a place to be buried.”
“Master Liu speaks the truth…”
The Wang-surnamed Pill Master clasped his hands, then swiftly changed the subject, sharing his own view:
“However, Master Liu…”
“I think, even so, to be on the safe side, it’s better to bring a couple more people. If we, by some mischance, let him escape, I fear we won’t have such an opportunity again.”
As the words of the Wang-surnamed Pill Master fell, Liu Yiyuan sank into thought.
After pondering for a moment, Liu Yiyuan nodded his head and spoke again:
“You’re speaking sense. When the time comes, I’ll bring one more person along.
With him there, Lin Jing will not be able to escape no matter what…” “After all, this matter isn’t suitable for too many people to Imow.”
‘We three Foundation Establishment Cultivators will make a move against a single Qi Refinement Realm Cultivator.” “I think…”
“Even in his death, he should rest in peace.”
The Wang-surnamed Pill Master clasped his hands and flattered:
“Master Liu’s insight is profound…”
As the plan proceeded smoothly, Liu Yiyuan felt relieved at heart. Even his cultivation, which had been stagnant for a long while, seemed to have grown somewhat.
It was as though Lin Jing was already dead before his eyes.
But in front of the Wang-surnamed Pill Master, he still pretended to be composed and said:
“Alright, you may go. You’ve played no small part in this affair, and after it’s done, rest assured you won’t be forgotten.”
“Thank you, Master Liu. I will take my leave.”
The Wang-surnamed Pill Master quickly bowed and said..
“Hmm…” Liu Yiyuan responded.
After that, the Wang-surnamed Pill Master walked out.
Once the Wang-surnamed Pill Master had left, Lin Jing did not bother with him and continued observing Liu Yiyuan.
Then, Liu Yiyuan’s lips curved into a cold smile:
“Lin Jing, you’re as good as dead this time…”
Afterward, he closed his eyes once more and began to meditate.
Lin Jing also fell silent.
This time, they actually planned to deploy three Foundation Establishment experts.
Although Liu Yiyuan did not specify, Lin Jing believed that the last person Liu Yiyuan planned to bring was very likely a late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Lin Jing had initially thought to take advantage of this opportunity to eliminate Liu Yiyuan.
But faced with three Foundation Establishments, no matter how well he prepared, the chances were slim.
And it could easily put him in grave danger.
Now, he realized his previous thoughts were impractical.
Just then, Liu Yiyuan, who was meditating, suddenly opened his eyes.
Lin Jing quickly gathered his thoughts and resumed his observation of Liu
Yiyuan.
Liu Yiyuan smacked his head and muttered to himself:
“Almost forgot…”
“I still have to inform the elder about this…”
“Last time, the elder already warned me; I can’t afford to make another mistake.”
Hearing Liu Yiyuan’s words, Lin Jing’s brows furrowed tightly. “It seems that Wu Cai Immortal knows about this affair too…”
“And he has even tacitly consented to it…”
Looking at it this way, Wu Cai Immortal clearly didn’t take Elder Bai’s words seriously.
And Lin Jing’s situation was even more dangerous than he had imagined.
Now, there was no way for him to take action against Liu Yiyuan, for if anything happened to Liu Yiyuan, Wu Cai Immortal would be the first to seek him out.
“It seems I can only find an excuse to turn down the Wang-surnamed Pill Master’s invitation.”
“What a pity, that Cleansing Spirit Flower’s stem and root, is exactly what I wanted…”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but sigh inwardly. Suddenly, Lin Jing was startled awake:
“Right…’
“Liu Yiyuan is no ordinary cultivator; trying to get rid of him is as hard as ascending to heaven, and it’s normal enough if I can’t…”
“But the Cleansing Spirit Flower’s stem and root are in the hands of the Wang-surnamed Pill Master. I could find a way to get my hands on it; that wouldn’t be a loss at all….”

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 173 Wü Cäi l s Strategy
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Wü Cäi l s Strategy
Translator: 549690339
Afterward, Lin Jing began to ponder over how to acquire the Cleansing Spirit Flower’s root stalk from the Pill Master surnamed Wang…
Just at that moment, Liu Yiyuan rose to his feet and left the secret chamber.
Lin Jing quickly halted his musings and focused on Liu Yiyuan’s actions, controlling the Observation Mode to follow behind him, hoping to eavesdrop on his conversation with Wu Cai Immortal.
As Liu Yiyuan made his way toward the inner courtyard of the Liu Clan…
Lin Jing discovered that the Observation Mode had reached its maximum range and could not move forward any further.
The Liu Clan was simply too vast; with the range of Observation Mode, he couldn’t infiltrate it at all.
Unless…
He could enter the Liu Clan’s inner courtyard, but such an act was undoubtedly a death wish.
It seemed that overhearing the conversation between Liu Yiyuan and Wu Cai Immortal was out of the question.
Since he had already obtained the information he wanted, there was no point for Lin Jing to linger here any longer.
Afterward, Lin Jing exited Observation Mode, left the System Space, and departed from this place.
At this time, Liu Yiyuan arrived at the inner courtyard where Wu Cai Immortal resided.
Liu Yiyuan bowed respectfully at the entrance and said,
