“I will consider it…”
Around noon…
Ning Yue left, together with the Ning Family elder.
Before leaving, Lin Jing still went to see her off.
After all…
The two had known each other for quite some time.
Also present to send her off were the siblings Li Tangyu.
After seeing off Ning Yue, Lin Jing said goodbye to Li Tangyu and the siblings, then continued back to his own small courtyard.
Just as he returned to the small courtyard, and before Lin Jing had a moment to rest, there was another knock at the door.
This time the knocking was much more urgent.
Lin Jing shook his head helplessly and then headed towards the door.
When he got to the courtyard gate, Lin Jing stretched out his hand and opened the gate.
He was immediately greeted by the sight of Huang Qingling and the Little Sparrow on her shoulder.
Huang Qingling was very close, and Lin Jing could even smell the faint fragrance emanating from her…
As soon as Huang Qingling saw Lin Jing, she spoke directly:
“I heard, Ning Yue has left…”
“Did you go to send her off?”
Huang Qingling stood at the doorway, her gaze wandering as she carelessly looked into Lin Jing’s courtyard and spoke.
“Qing Ling Daoyou, please come in…”
Lin Jing said, inviting Huang Qingling into the courtyard.
Huang Qingling did not decline, and as if returning to her own home, she directly passed by Lin Jing and entered.
Lin Jing then closed the gate behind her.
Following behind Huang Qingling, he too walked in.
“Yes, she has left…”
Lin Jing quickened his pace to walk alongside Huang Qingling and then continued speaking.
“Mm…”
Huang Qingling nodded.
Then she spoke again:
“Actually, this morning, I saw…”
Huang Qingling stretched out her hand, teasing Little Sparrow as if she didn’t care much about it.
“Uh…”
“Why didn’t you come over…?”
Lin Jing was taken aback for a moment, and then he asked, puzzled.
“I didn’t want to intrude on your farewell, so I didn’t come over…”
Huang Qingling said, pursing her lips.
Lin Jing then scratched his head and said with a smile:
“Actually, it wouldn’t have mattered.”
“After all, we are all friends…”
“Of course I know…”
Having finished speaking, Huang Qingling turned to look at Lin Jing, and her hand stopped teasing Little Sparrow.
“Lin Jing…”
“Do you really plan to go to Linxian City?”
Huang Qingling asked, looking at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing turned his head to look at Huang Qingling.
Clearly, the conversation he had with Ning Yue earlier had been overheard by Huang Qingling.
“Maybe…”
Lin Jing looked up at the vast expanse of blue sky.
Then, looking back down at Huang Qingling, he said seriously:
“However…”
“Even if I were to go, it wouldn’t be right now.”
“There’s just too much here that I can’t bear to part with, and if I really had to leave this place, I would actually find it hard to let go.”
Upon hearing this, Huang Qingling seemed to let go of something…
Her eyes curved into crescents as she smiled and said:
“Actually…”
“If one day you are truly out of options, you can also seek out Ning Yue. After all, she’s about to become the head of a family. As her friend, she definitely won’t mistreat you.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing turned his head and stared straight at Huang Qingling, making her feel a bit uneasy.
“Did you listen in on the entire conversation from start to finish…?”
Huang Qingling was clearly a bit sheepish and quickly objected:
“What… no way…”
“I just accidentally overheard a tiny bit…”
After finishing her sentence, her earlobes turned visibly red at a discernible pace.
“That’s quite the ‘tiny bit’ indeed…”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but complain inwardly.
He felt rather helpless about it and just let it be.
After this little episode…
Huang Qingling reverted back to her usual playful self.
Following that…
She talked with Lin Jing for a bit more.
Then, she said she wanted Lin Jing to accompany her to Yuebaolou.
Lin Jing was about to agree when suddenly a system notification rang out in his mind.
“System notification: Alchemy Room upgrade successful. Host can check at any time…”
This system notification made Lin Jing pause.
Then, using Alchemy as an excuse, he refused Huang Qingling’s request.
Although Huang Qingling seemed a bit disappointed, she left on her own.
However, just before she left for good, Huang Qingling suddenly looked seriously at Lin Jing and said:
“Lin Jing…”
“If you really decide to leave, please tell me…”
“I don’t have many friends, and you’re one of them…”
After that…
Huang Qingling left without looking back.
Lin Jing stood at the doorway, deep in thought for a long time.
He had known Huang Qingling for quite a while now, and indeed, as she said, aside from the few of them, Huang Qingling seemed not to have many friends.
Lin Jing wasn’t even clear about Huang Qingling’s family matters; he had never heard her mention them.
Perhaps she had some sad past she didn’t want to speak of.
And they had never broached the subject.
This had become a kind of tacit understanding between them.
“Maybe one day, she will bring it up on her own.”
With this thought…
Lin Jing sighed, closed the courtyard gate, and went back inside the house.
Back inside, Lin Jing took a deep breath, shook his head, put aside the matter with Huang Qingling,
and then called out directly for the system.
“Enter System Space!”
This time, the scene before Lin Jing blurred and then changed.
Afterward, he found himself inside the System Space.
Upon arriving at the System Space…
Lin Jing, unable to wait, headed straight for the Alchemy Room.
He wanted to see what the Alchemy Room had become now.
Soon…
Lin Jing arrived at the Alchemy Room, looked around, and felt that the Alchemy Room hadn’t changed much.
However, his Divine Sense had clearly become much more robust, which was obviously the wondrous benefit of the Alchemy Room’s upgrade.
Then…
Lin Jing said:
“System, open the Alchemy Room panel.”

chapters.title: Chapter 225: 218: Ning Family Settled, Cleansing Spirit Pool Opened
chapters.content:
Following Lin Jing’s words, the Alchemy Room panel appeared before him.
Alchemy Room: Level 4
Divine Sense Intensity Increase: 40%
Alchemy Success Rate Increase: (First Grade 40%), (Second Grade 30%), (Third Grade 20%), (Fourth Grade 10%)
Quality of Elixir Medicine Increase: (First Grade 40%), (Second Grade 30%), (Third Grade 20%), (Fourth Grade 10%)
Probability of Producing Pure Elixir: (First Grade 40%), (Second Grade 30%), (Third Grade 20%), (Fourth Grade 10%)
Upgrade Requirements: (49/10000 Harvest Points)
This time the upgrade of the Alchemy Room didn’t introduce new features.
The rest remained the same as before.
The chance of alchemy had also increased by another 10%.
Since the Alchemy Room had been upgraded again, and there was nothing urgent to do, perhaps it was a good idea to try alchemizing another elixir…
With this thought, Lin Jing immediately sprang into action.
He first took out the Fire Meteor Four-Pattern Furnace from his Storage Bag, and then placed it in the center of the Alchemy Room.
Following that…
Lin Jing cast a spell to enlarge the Fire Meteor Four-Pattern Furnace.
After that, he took out the materials from the Storage Bag…
Then he concentrated the flames…
Time flew by quickly…
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed since Ning Yue left.
And Lin Jing’s life had returned to its usual state.
The days continued in this uneventful way.
Lin Jing also enjoyed this kind of life.
During this half-year…
The matters involving the Ning Family and the Yun Family had finally come to a resolution.
After the elder of the Ning Family took the seed back, he cared for it night and day without rest.
At last, two months ago, that seed fully sprouted.
Moreover, the elder of the Ning Family had asked someone from the Nanming Immortal Sect to bear witness.
This way…
Even if the Yun Family wanted to quibble, it was already too late.
And the Ning Family won the bet.
Initially…
After the Ning Family won the bet, the Yun Family should have given them two hundred thousand Midium Grade Spirit Stones, as per the agreement.
However, at this point, the Yun Family could not produce that many Spirit Stones.
Consequently…
The elder of the Yun Family used his personal connections to invite a high-status Nascent Soul Elder from the Nanming Immortal Sect to mediate.
In the end.
After the mediation by that Nascent Soul Elder, both sides reached a settlement.
Following the mediation, the Ning Family received some of the Yun Family’s properties in Linxian City as compensation.
But these properties combined were far from being worth two hundred thousand Midium Grade Spirit Stones; they weren’t even worth one hundred thousand.
Yet…
The Nascent Soul Elder spoke up.
In this matter…
The Ning Family conceded a point.
He would compensate the Ning Family from other sources, ensuring that they would not be at a loss.
As a family under the jurisdiction of the Nanming Immortal Sect with a focus on the Alchemy Dao, and with good relations with the sect on normal days, the Ning Family naturally had to give face to this elder.
Moreover…
Since the Nascent Soul Elder made such a statement, in the end, the Ning Family wouldn’t really be at a loss.
On the contrary, it was the Yun Family that suffered a great loss in this affair.
They owed a favor to the Nascent Soul Elder for nothing.
In fact…
The Yun Family was quite wealthy.
If it had been some time in the past, they would certainly have paid the Spirit Stones directly.
Rather than using this kind of method to seek a settlement.
In doing so, they not only tarnished their reputation but also owed a favor to that Nascent Soul Elder.
But there was no helping it.
Because…
The Yun Family had spent their Spirit Stones elsewhere.
Ever since the Li Family’s downfall, the Li Family’s position in Nanshan Immortal City could not be maintained.
The Yun Family took this opportunity to occupy the Li Family’s estate and some of their properties when the Li Family withdrew.
The price they paid was merely to ensure temporary safety for the remaining members of the Li Family.
The Yun Family had set their sights on the rise of Nanshan Immortal City.
Hence, they intended to move their entire family to Nanshan Immortal City.
For this purpose…
The Yun Family made a lot of preparations, and the Spirit Stones spent were numerous.
It was also because the Yun Family invested a large amount of Spirit Stones in this endeavor that they couldn’t afford to pay the two hundred thousand Midium Grade Spirit Stone bet.
With this…
The dispute between the two families was resolved.
Besides the Yun Family and Ning Family affairs…
After half a year of fermenting.
The matter of the Cleansing Spirit Pool had become known to more and more people.
Of course…
Those who became aware of it were limited to the cultivation families.
As for the Loose Cultivators…
They only knew that new Demon Cultivators had appeared within the Demon Race Secret Realm, and the three major Sects had resealed the Secret Realm for safety.
Beyond that, they were unaware of anything else.
It was like this that the entire Demon Race Secret Realm had been sealed by the people of the three major Sects until now.
But…
The major families within Nanshan Immortal City knew very well that the people from the three major Sects had long given up on searching for that Demon Cultivator.
The reason they acted this way…
Was actually to occupy the Cleansing Spirit Pool and cultivate their Sect’s Disciples.
Although these families knew of this, they harbored grievances in their hearts but dared not express them.
With such a rare Spiritual Spring, who wouldn’t want to claim it as their own?
If it weren’t for the fact that the Cleansing Spirit Pool couldn’t be moved, the people from the three major Sects would have probably divided it among themselves long ago.
However…
According to what Lin Jing knew…
After half a year, the Disciples from the three major Sects had mostly been nurtured once through.
Thus, in these past few days…
The three major Sects had decided to reopen the Demon Race Secret Realm.
They also planned to open up the Cleansing Spirit Pool, allowing members of these families from Nanshan Immortal City to enter.
Upon hearing this news, members of various families.
Also began making preparations, planning to send the most talented Disciples from their families in for cultivation.
Lin Jing too was somewhat looking forward to this Cleansing Spirit Pool, for his Spiritual Root aptitude was far too poor. If he could improve it somewhat through the Cleansing Spirit Pool, nothing could be better.
Only, the method of enhancing Spiritual Root aptitude through ingesting Cleansing Spirit Liquid was incredibly slow in efficiency.

chapters.title: Chapter 226: 218: Ning Family Matters Resolved, Cleansing Spirit Pool Opens_2
chapters.content:
So…
Lin Jing actually didn’t hold too much hope.
However, although the hope was not great, it was better than having no hope at all.
Yesterday, when Lin Jing went to Yuebaolou, he even ran into Elder Yu.
Elder Yu said to let Lin Jing and Huang Qingling come together to Yuebaolou to find him today.
Lin Jing guessed…
It must be about the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
But at that time, Elder Yu was in a hurry, said just this one line, and then left.
Lin Jing also didn’t have the opportunity to ask more.
After returning from Yuebaolou yesterday, Lin Jing entered the System Space and began his alchemy cultivation.
Until just now…
Lin Jing, who was meditating, suddenly opened his eyes, calculated the time, and it was indeed about time.
So Lin Jing stood up.
He then called out the system and left the System Space.
After coming out, Lin Jing walked out of the house and stretched.
A long period of cultivation, sometimes a little stretch was quite comfortable.
Next…
Lin Jing also straightened out his somewhat wrinkled clothes.
After straightening up, Lin Jing left the house, heading towards Huang Qingling’s courtyard.
He was ready to call her and the two of them would go to Yuebaolou together.
Arriving in front of Huang Qingling’s courtyard.
“Dong dong dong”
Lin Jing stepped forward and knocked on the door.
Very soon, a dark shadow flew over, flapping its wings.
This shadow was Little Sparrow.
“Wait a minute, changing clothes…”
Little Sparrow spoke, its voice crystal clear, and its two small eyes stared straight at Lin Jing’s Storage Bag, like a thief eyeing a chicken.
Lin Jing knew what Little Sparrow wanted, then he reached into the Storage Bag and tossed a medium-grade Gathering Yuan Pill to Little Sparrow.
“This is for you…”
Lin Jing said directly.
Little Sparrow’s eyes lit up, it dashed forward, picked up the medium-grade Gathering Yuan Pill, and then swallowed it in one gulp.
Then, it said to Lin Jing:
“Good person, good person…”
“This Little Sparrow…”
Lin Jing smiled wryly.
Now these Gathering Yuan Pills, he produced quite a few every day.
They might be very precious to others.
But for Lin Jing,, they really didn’t amount to much.
It wasn’t long before Huang Qingling came out.
At this moment.
She had already changed into a radiant red brocade dress and walked towards Lin Jing with a smile.
“Let’s go…”
Huang Qingling said with a smile.
“Alright…”
Lin Jing responded.
Then, the two of them headed for Yuebaolou.
When they arrived at Yuebaolou, they directly found Elder Yu.
“Elder Yu…”
Lin Jing gave a respectful bow and greeted Elder Yu.
Upon seeing the two of them, Elder Yu smiled and nodded, then spoke:
“You’ve come…”
At this time, Huang Qingling also asked:
“Elder Yu, what did you want to see us for?”
Elder Yu spoke to Huang Qingling:
“Follow me…”
“We’ll first go meet Elder Bai and let him explain it to you.”
After saying that, Elder Yu turned around and headed upstairs.
Lin Jing and Huang Qingling followed behind Elder Yu, also heading to the upper floor.
Soon, they reached the top floor of Yuebaolou and met Elder Bai.
As soon as they met, Elder Bai directly started:
“The Demon Race Secret Realm has opened once again, and the Cleansing Spirit Pool inside is also open to families outside of the three major Sects…”
“Yesterday I went to the archives, and I managed to secure two spots for you two to enter the Cleansing Spirit Pool.”
“The Cleansing Spirit Pool is open…”
Huang Qingling exclaimed in surprise.
Elder Bai nodded.
As soon as he heard about the opening of the Demon Race Secret Realm a few days ago, Elder Bai secured two spots for them to enter the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
The speed was indeed fast…
Then…
Lin Jing looked at Elder Yu, who was grinning by his side.
Lin Jing knew…
His spot must be related to Elder Yu.
Continuing, Elder Bai said:
“In a while, I’ll take you to the Li Family.”
“This time…”
“Neither Elder Yu nor I have the time, so I’ll speak to Old Li and let you follow the Li Family in.”
Even though the Demon Race Secret Realm had been open for a while, it was still not entirely safe inside.
Therefore…
Each entry had to be led by a Golden Core Immortal to ensure safety.
What Elder Bai meant was, for Lin Jing and Huang Qingling to follow the Li Family guided by the Li Family patriarch, together into the realm.
“Alright…”
Lin Jing and Huang Qingling replied in unison.
Afterward…
The group all headed towards the Li Family together.
Upon arriving at the Li Family, Elder Bai and Elder Yu were brought by the Li Family’s steward to find the Li Family patriarch.
While Lin Jing and Huang Qingling were led by someone else to the courtyard where Li Tangyu was located.
Just as the two of them reached the entrance of the courtyard without yet entering, they heard people talking inside.
One of them was actually Zhang Yuan.
Then, the two of them entered the courtyard.
Indeed…
Inside the pavilion of the courtyard, three people were drinking tea and chatting.
It was Li Tangyu, his sister, and Zhang Yuan.
“We heard your three voices before we even entered…”
“The three of you, gathering together without calling us, it’s simply too unsporting…”
Upon seeing them, Huang Qingling was the first to speak.
“Qing Qing, Lin Jing bro…”
“You’ve come too…”
Li Qingqing greeted them as soon as she saw them.
At this time…
Li Tangyu and Zhang Yuan both stood up and walked towards them.
“Brother Li…”
“Brother Zhang…”
Lin Jing cupped his hands and greeted the two men.
“Brother Lin…”
Both of them returned the gesture with a respectful bow.
“Please…”
Then, Li Tangyu gestured for them to join with an outstretched hand.
Ling Jing and the others seated themselves in the pavilion.
Li Tangyu poured them both a cup of tea.
“Brother Lin, what brings the two of you here so suddenly?”
“The two of us came with Elder Bai and Elder Yu…”
Lin Jing then explained the matter of Elder Bai looking for them.
When Lin Jing finished speaking, the three were also visibly surprised.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: 218: Ning Family Matters Resolved, Cleansing Spirit Pool Opens_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 218: Ning Family Matters Resolved, Cleansing Spirit Pool Opens_3
At this time, Li Tangyu spoke up:
“Brother Zhang also came here for this reason…”
“Brother Zhang’s family elder should be discussing this matter with my grandfather right now.”
“So…”
“Doesn’t that mean we can enter the Cleansing Spirit Pool together when the time comes?”
Li Qingqing’s eyes gleamed as she said.
“Mmm…”
Li Tangyu nodded.
Huang Qingling also spoke up at this time:
“That’s great, it’s better when there are more people…”
“I’ve always been by myself before, and it’s not interesting at all.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a mix of amusement and resignation.
Entering the Secret Realm seemed like just a fun outing for Huang Qingling.
Continuing…
Huang Qingling continued:
“Do you guys know what it’s like inside the Cleansing Spirit Pool this time?”
“My brother knows about this; we were just discussing it when you two arrived…” Li Qingqing hurriedly said.
At this time, Li Tangyu also spoke:
“Let me tell you about it…”
“I used to know a friend in Qingyuan Sword Sect, and I got some news from him…”
“The Cleansing Spirit Pool has been divided into three areas this time, from the inside to the outside, they are Core Area, Inner Area, and Peripheral Area.”
Li Tangyu’s words left Lin Jing rather confused.
It was puzzling.
He didn’t understand how a Cleansing Spirit Pool could be divided into three distinct areas.
“Brother Li, please elaborate…”
Lin Jing directly said.
Li Tangyu nodded and then continued:
“Basically, because the Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside the pool is so scarce, it cannot be distributed to everyone.”
“And we, naturally, cannot get even a single complete drop of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.”
“Around the Cleansing Spirit Pool, the Spiritual Energy there also carries some of the effects of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid…”
“So…”
“The people from the three major sects have divided the area surrounding the Cleansing Spirit Pool into three areas for us to enter and cultivate.”
“The closer to the center, the stronger the effect…”
“Until the outermost area, where the effect is negligible.”
Huang Qingling puckered her lips and said:
“So that’s how it is…”
“And here I thought each of us would get a few drops of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.”
After hearing this, Li Tangyu explained with a wry smile:
“There’s no helping it…”
“The Cleansing Spirit Liquid is just too scarce; even the people from the three major sects didn’t get much of it.”
“Aside from the top echelon of the three major sects, no one else, not even the disciples of the major sects, have the eligibility to obtain the Cleansing Spirit Liquid by themselves.”
“Of course, Core Disciples are an exception.”
After Li Tangyu finished explaining, Lin Jing nodded.
“The Cleansing Spirit Liquid is so rare that only Core Disciples and above in the three major sects can obtain it.”
“Thinking about it this way, it’s normal for these people not to get a share of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.”
Thinking this, Lin Jing asked:
“So which area will we be assigned to if we go in?”
“The Inner Area or the Peripheral Area?”
“I guess it definitely won’t be the Core Area.”
After hearing this, Li Tangyu nodded and said:
“We should be assigned to the Inner Area.”
“The Core Area would probably be for the Inner Sect Disciples of those three major sects.”
Huang Qingling followed with a complaint:
“Then in that case…”
“Without even a drop of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, wouldn’t it be even more impossible to enhance our aptitude with the Spiritual Energy that carries its effects?”
Li Tangyu spread his hands helplessly:
“There’s nothing that can be done about it…”
“But even this Cleansing Spirit Pool hasn’t appeared in our Nanming Domain for many years…”
As he spoke…
Li Tangyu looked up at the distant sky, lost in thought.
A moment later, he spoke softly:
“Our Nanming Domain is really too small…”
There seemed to be a hint of regret in his tone.
Meanwhile, Li Qingqing, who was beside him, looked at Li Tangyu with furrowed brows, her beautiful eyes revealing a complex emotion.
“Brother…”
Li Qingqing called out softly.
Li Tangyu then came back to his senses, giving Li Qingqing a gentle smile.
“I’m fine…”
However…
Seeing that smile, Li Qingqing’s brows furrowed even more.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: 219: Breakthrough, Foundation Establishment Level 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 219: Breakthrough, Foundation Establishment Level 5
Li Qingqing originally wanted to say something more, but Li Tangyu deflected the topic.
“Brother Lin…”
“You haven’t been to the Demon Race Secret Realm, so let me first tell you about the situation inside…”
Lin Jing was taken aback and then said:
“Okay…”
It seemed that Li Tangyu had something on his mind, but he didn’t want to share it.
Seeing this, the others didn’t feel it was appropriate to ask further.
“Inside the Demon Race Secret Realm…”
Following that, Li Tangyu began to explain to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing and the others stayed at the Li Family residence until it was night.
Elder Bai, Elder Yu, the Zhang Family Patriarch, and the Li Family elders talked about who knows what until very late, before they finished their conversation.
Then…
They were warmly treated by the Li Family once more.
And they agreed…
Three days later, Lin Jing and the other two would come to the Li Family.
They would be led by the Li Family elder to the Demon Race Secret Realm.
It wasn’t until deep into the night, after the banquet had ended, that they left.
After returning to his own courtyard, Lin Jing directly entered the System Space.
Inside the System Space, the Spirit Plants growing in the Spirit Field were lush and thriving.
The Eternal Youth Fruit tree that Lin Jing had planted first was now over a dozen zhang tall.
Within its canopy, several Eternal Youth Fruits were growing.
As the breeze blew, the leaves swayed back and forth, with fruits occasionally peeking from behind them.
However, these fruits were still green and not yet ripe.
The Eternal Youth Fruit tree had been planted by Lin Jing for more than two years now, and with the accelerated time flow in the System Space, almost eight years had passed.
It was still over two years until the fruits would ripen.
Taking into account the fourfold acceleration of time within the System Space, it would only be half a year.
Just half a year…
And the Eternal Youth Fruit tree would be mature.
At that time,
He could begin to concoct the Eternal Youth Elixir.
The Eternal Youth Elixir was different from other Third Rank Elixir Medicines; for concocting it, only the Eternal Youth Fruit tree, a Third Rank Spirit Plant, was needed.
All the others required some rare Second Rank Spirit Plants.
For Lin Jing, obtaining these Spirit Plants wasn’t really difficult.
Therefore…
Lin Jing just needed to wait for the Eternal Youth Fruit tree to mature, and then he could start concocting the Eternal Youth Elixir.
Afterward,
Lin Jing shifted his gaze away from the Eternal Youth Fruit tree and looked at the other Spirit Plants.
All of them were growing robustly.
Having checked on the Spirit Plants, Lin Jing nodded in satisfaction.
Then he headed towards the Alchemy Room.
Tonight…
He planned to begin his breakthrough to the fifth level of the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Since entering the Foundation Establishment Stage, Lin Jing found that the improvement of his cultivation was becoming increasingly slow.
It had taken him half a year to accumulate enough Spiritual Power to advance to the fifth level of Foundation Establishment.
If someone else could advance a level in half a year, they would probably wake up from their dreams laughing.
But Lin Jing was different.
He had the benefit of the System Space, where one day was equivalent to two days for others.
Moreover…
The concentration of Spiritual Energy inside the System Space was unmatched by others.
The level four space now had a Spiritual Energy concentration much more dense than that of a Golden Core Cultivator’s dwelling.
Lin Jing was so sure about this because…
He had visited the residences of Elder Bai and Elder Yu.
The concentration of Spiritual Energy in their dwellings was already inferior compared to the System Space.
For this, Lin Jing had even subtly inquired with Elder Yu.
He learned that the Spirit Gathering Array they had set up was no worse than those of other Golden Core Cultivators.
So, by that measure,
The dwellings of Golden Core Cultivators couldn’t match the concentration of Spiritual Energy in the System Space.
Besides the rich Spiritual Energy…
Lin Jing also occasionally took the Gathering Yuan Pills, which were free of impurities, to enhance his cultivation.
All these factors combined, it had taken him just half a year to barely reach the brink of a breakthrough.
It’s clear how difficult it was for him to make this breakthrough.
Then, Lin Jing collected his thoughts.
He went to the Alchemy Room and sat down cross-legged inside.
In the Alchemy Room, there was a 40% Divine Sense strength bonus, which was not only good for alchemy, but also very beneficial for breaking through.
After he sat down, Lin Jing stretched out his hand and took out two Pure Jade Boxes from his Storage Bag.
These contained the immaculate Gathering Yuan Pills.
In the past, one Gathering Yuan Pill had never been enough for Lin Jing’s breakthroughs.
Therefore, this time he took out two.
He planned to use these two immaculate Gathering Yuan Pills to assist in his direct breakthrough to the fifth level of the Foundation Establishment Stage.
After taking out the Gathering Yuan Pills, Lin Jing did not consume them immediately.
Instead, he closed his eyes and began to meditate.
Because he needed to first return his condition to its peak before he could carry out the breakthrough.
In the blink of an eye, four hours went by…
Lin Jing, who was meditating with his eyes closed, suddenly opened them.
After that, he picked up the Pure Jade Box beside him and opened it.
Without a word, he put the immaculate Gathering Yuan Pill into his mouth.
However…
One pill was not enough.
Lin Jing then, in the same manner, opened the second Pure Jade Box and put the immaculate Gathering Yuan Pill into his mouth as well.
After swallowing two immaculate Gathering Yuan Pills in succession, Lin Jing once again closed his eyes and began to circulate his cultivation technique, transforming the overwhelming medicinal power within his body.
The amount of Spiritual Power contained in these two Gathering Yuan Pills was indeed substantial.
After swallowing the two pills, Lin Jing felt his entire body brimming with Spiritual Power.
Lin Jing ceaselessly circulated the Immortal Five Elements Technique, transforming the Spiritual Power within his body, compressing it into his meridians, and continuously infusing it into his Dantian.
Just like that…
Another half an hour or so passed.
Finally, Lin Jing had transformed all the Spiritual Power contained in the two pills.
By now, Lin Jing’s meridians were filled to the brim with Spiritual Power.
He was ready to assault the bottleneck of the fifth level of Foundation Establishment.
Then, Lin Jing circulated his cultivation technique and charged towards the bottleneck.
This time, the Spiritual Power within Lin Jing was surging, and the momentum was strong.
With a “boom,” there was a sign that the bottleneck had loosened.
Immediately after, Lin Jing did not hesitate and launched another assault.
This second assault was stronger than the first.
Lin Jing turned his Divine Sense inward and felt his own body.
At this moment, he could clearly sense.
The bottleneck had now developed some cracks.
Over and over again…
This third time, Lin Jing gathered all his strength and charged at the bottleneck.
Shortly after…
There was a “crack crack” sound.
The bottleneck could not withstand the assault,
And it shattered loudly.
And Lin Jing…
Had finally reached the fifth level of Foundation Establishment.
Upon breaking through to the fifth level of Foundation Establishment, Lin Jing felt his meridians widen substantially.
And the Spiritual Power in his Dantian, which had been overflowing just moments before, was now reduced to a small fraction of what it was.
The capacity of his Dantian had also increased substantially from the fourth level of Foundation Establishment.
Besides that,
Even Lin Jing’s Divine Sense had grown significantly stronger.
Lin Jing then opened his eyes and called out to the system.
“System, open the host panel.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, a System Space panel appeared in front of him.
Lin Jing (27/300)
Spiritual Root: Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root (Low Grade)
Cultivation: Foundation Establishment Stage Level 5 (0%)
Cultivation Techniques: Immortal Five Elements Technique, Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique (Fourth Layer), Controlling Fire Technique (Perfected), Divine Fire Triple Realm (First Realm), Ning’s Alchemy Method.
Secondary Profession: Third-Rank Alchemist (22835/30000)

chapters.title: Chapter 229: 220 Heading to the Demon Race Secret Realm
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 220 Heading to the Demon Race Secret Realm
Foundation Establishment Fifth Level…
Lin Jing, feeling his current level of cultivation, couldn’t help but remember the time when he first crossed over.
Back then, he was only at the first level of Qi Refinement.
Moreover, he was cornered by Manager Li and Yuan Bo, in a very dangerous situation, and it was only then that he made a breakthrough to the second level of Qi Refinement on the spot.
Four years had passed since that incident.
In just four years, he had gone from the first level of Qi Refinement straight to the fifth level of Foundation Establishment.
Such a pace could certainly not be considered slow.
As for Manager Li from that time, Lin Jing didn’t know what had become of him.
If only…
he could see Lin Jing now, what would his reaction be?
Lin Jing believed that no matter how much Manager Li cultivated, he should not have surpassed the Foundation Establishment stage by now.
Because Foundation Building Elixirs were not so easily obtained.
Although…
he was a manager at the Qingyuan Sword Sect’s Qingtian Peak, his aptitude wasn’t great, and without any special contributions, it was difficult to receive the sect’s bestowed Foundation Building Elixirs.
The path to the Foundation Establishment was fraught with obstacles.
As for Yuan Bo, there was even less to say.
With Lin Jing’s current cultivation, he had probably left Yuan Bo far behind.
Besides those two, Lin Jing also thought of Senior Han.
He wondered how he was doing now.
Being an Inner Sect Disciple of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, he must be doing quite well.
Afterwards…
Lin Jing set aside his thoughts and continued to look at the panel.
After such a long time of continuous alchemy, Lin Jing’s alchemy proficiency had also reached over twenty thousand.
He estimated that in a few more months, he should reach the rank of Fourth Grade Alchemist.
Although…
he was about to be promoted to a Fourth Grade Pill Master.
He had not yet refined a single batch of Third Rank Elixir Medicine.
A Third Grade Alchemist who had never refined Third Rank Elixir Medicines was probably only Lin Jing himself.
Moreover, Lin Jing only needed to refine Second Rank Elixir Medicines to increase the proficiency of a Third Grade Pill Master.
About this…
Lin Jing was puzzled, but he couldn’t get an answer from the System.
He could only assume…
it was a BUG in the System.
After checking this information, Lin Jing then closed the system panel and left the System Space.
In the following two days…
Lin Jing entered the System Space a few more times, cultivated for two days, and stabilized his new realm.
Not until the third day did Lin Jing come out from the System Space.
Today…
was the day that they had all agreed to head for the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Early in the morning…
Lin Jing had already prepared everything.
Then he went out, called for Huang Qingling, and with Little Sparrow, the two of them plus the eagle headed towards the Li Family.
For this trip to the Demon Race Secret Realm, Huang Qingling planned to take Little Sparrow inside. Little Sparrow was just a beast pet and did not count towards the quota; it would be fine as long as it stayed with Huang Qingling.
Since the two lived in the outer city, they were quite a distance from the Li Family residence. By the time they arrived, Zhang Yuan had already reached the Li household ahead of them.
Once the two caught up…
everyone was ready.
Now they were just waiting for Elder Master Li, who was still with other members of the Li Family, apparently instructing them about something, and had not yet come over.
So…
they chatted and waited together.
Li Qingqing and Huang Qingling were having a great time playing with Little Sparrow.
It wasn’t long before…
Elder Master Li also appeared.
Once Elder Master Li arrived, the group set off and walked towards the outskirts of the city.
After leaving the city, they flew on their swords, speeding towards the Demon Race Secret Realm.
This flight, the distance was indeed not short.
Only after six hours did Elder Master Li, who was leading the way, begin to speak up again:
“Alright…”
“We are almost there, let’s land here; we’ll walk the remaining way.”
“Okay…”
Then everyone responded in unison.
Throughout the journey, Elder Master Li had constantly emanated his cultivation aura, and no Demonic Beasts dared to attack them.
Thus…
their journey was extremely smooth.
And up ahead…
was the entrance to the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Members from the three major sects were guarding there.
Continuing to fly openly would be somewhat inappropriate.
It was precisely because of this reason.
Elder Master Li then spoke up, asking them to walk over together.
A few people descended from the sky and followed Elder Master Li towards the entrance of the Demon Race Secret Realm.
About half an hour later, they arrived at the entrance of the Demon Race Secret Realm.
This place was a valley.
Inside the valley, trees were lush, and strange rocks stood tall. At the far end of the valley, there was a smooth stone wall.
It was on this stone wall that a light screen was emitting bursts of light.
Around the light screen, a Defensive Array had already isolated it.
Moreover, at the entrance of the array, personnel from the three major sects were standing guard.
And not far from the entrance,
The people from the three major sects had also built a complex of buildings.
Presumably, this would be where those guarding the entrance stayed.
Today, it was not just them who had come to this place but also some other individuals.
They were all queuing in front of the entrance of the formation, walking into the light screen one by one.
Lin Jing even saw Liu Yiyuan and Yun Long at the very front of the queue.
Unexpectedly, both of them had come as well.
Leading the two of them was a Golden Core Cultivator Lin Jing had never seen before,
At the moment, this Golden Core Cultivator was standing close to Yun Long, evidently conversing about something. It seemed that the Golden Core Cultivator was likely a member of the Yun Family.
Now that the Li Family had fallen, the Liu Clan had become involved with the Yun Family.
A few of them arrived, and they were also noticed by Liu Yiyuan and the others.
However, given the current situation, Liu Yiyuan just glanced over here and then turned his head away, no longer paying attention.
“You all wait here…”
Upon reaching the entrance, Elder Master Li said this to them
After that,
He walked towards an elder of the Qingyuan Sword Sect who was standing by the entrance.
After a brief conversation,
It wasn’t long before Elder Master Li returned.
“Let’s go…”
“That entrance to the secret realm is a Teleportation Array; when we enter, it will separate us.”
“Don’t worry, the distance we’ll be separated by won’t be too far.”
“Once inside, do not run around; I will find you very quickly. Once we’ve all regrouped, I will then take you to the Cleansing Spirit Pool.”
“And also…”
“Right after entering, remember to be very cautious; under no circumstances should you let your guard down, lest you be ambushed by the Demonic Beasts inside.”
After Elder Master Li finished speaking, everyone quickly nodded in response.
“Understood…”
Subsequently,
Elder Master Li then led them towards the entrance of the Secret Realm.
At this moment,
Those who had been ahead in line had already gone inside.
The group passed through the formation and approached the entrance to the Secret Realm.
First was Elder Master Li, who stepped forward and entered the light screen, vanishing within.
Immediately afterward,
Li Tan also followed closely behind, stepping into the light screen as well.
Subsequently,
One after the other, they all went in.
Lin Jing was the second to last to enter.
This was because Huang Qingling, seeing that Lin Jing had never been to the Secret Realm before, insisted on covering his rear.
Even though Lin Jing had said there was no need, Huang Qingling still insisted.
This left Lin Jing somewhat amused and exasperated.
Before long,
It was Lin Jing’s turn.
Lin Jing also took a step forward and then disappeared into the light screen.
Passing through the light screen, the intense brightness forced Lin Jing to squint, barely able to keep his eyes open.
Reluctantly…
Lin Jing had no choice but to close his eyes.
A few moments later, Jing clearly felt the change in the Spiritual Energy around him, markedly different from the outside world.
It was as if he was in another world entirely.
It was only then
That Lin Jing opened his eyes, finally seeing his surroundings clearly.
The place where Lin Jing found himself was lush with trees, which almost obscured the sky above.
Just as Lin Jing was about to turn and look behind him,
Suddenly,
A chilling coldness struck…
At the same time,
The system warning sounded at that moment.
“Warning!”
“Within the alert range, a living creature has launched a stealth attack on the host. Please respond in time.”

chapters.title: Chapter 230: 221 Little Sparrow Accomplishes a Merit
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 221 Little Sparrow Accomplishes a Merit
It was at this moment that Lin Jing caught sight of a red shadow lunging towards him from the corner of his eye.
And this red shadow was incredibly fast.
In the blink of an eye, it had already reached Lin Jing.
However…
Lin Jing’s reaction was not slow either. The instant the red shadow attacked, his Divine Sense had already probed out.
It wasn’t until then that Lin Jing realized…
The one ambushing him turned out to be a snake-like Demonic Beast, except that the beast’s body was blood-red, and on its head, there was a lump of flesh…
Coupled with its gaping maw, it looked extremely terrifying.
With its gaping maw wide open, revealing sharp fangs, the Demonic Beast pounced towards Lin Jing.
At this moment…
Lin Jing had already commanded the Flawless Sword, positioning it in front of himself.
The Flawless Sword was transparent, and it seemed the vision of the beast wasn’t very good, as it collided directly with the Flawless Sword.
Its attack, however, was precisely blocked by Lin Jing’s Flying Sword.
After colliding with the Flawless Sword, the beast let out a series of “hiss” noises…
Then it was sent flying backward.
Lin Jing, too, was knocked back several steps by the impact of the Demonic Beast, nearly falling to the ground.
Lin Jing quickly steadied himself and looked towards the Demonic Beast.
The snake-like Demonic Beast was fast, and its strength was not weak either.
Moreover.
Judging by the aura it was emitting…
The strength of this Demonic Beast should not be much different from Lin Jing’s own; to take it down, he estimated he would need to put in quite an effort.
Lin Jing kept a close watch on the beast while calculating in his mind how to defeat it.
Just as Lin Jing was deep in thought…
Suddenly…
The Demonic Beast shuddered violently, as if it had encountered its natural predator, first retracting, then turning around and fleeing as if flying.
Even faster than when it had attacked Lin Jing.
This action left Lin Jing dumbfounded.
Just as Lin Jing was confused and still dumbstruck…
A black shadow swooshed by, passing next to Lin Jing at a speed much faster than that of the snake-like Demonic Beast.
In an instant, the black shadow had caught up with the snake-like Demonic Beast.
“Screech…”
With a piercing shriek, the black shadow directly pounced on the snake-like Demonic Beast.
Upon hearing this cry, Lin Jing realized.
It turned out that this black shadow was none other than Little Sparrow.
However…
The snake-like Demonic Beast was so focused on fleeing that it didn’t even have time to look back before Little Sparrow struck it dead.
Lin Jing didn’t even see clearly how the snake-like Demonic Beast died.
He only saw Little Sparrow swooping down, skimming over the head of the snake-like beast like a dragonfly touching water…
Afterward…
The serpent-shaped Demonic Beast collapsed to the ground, its lump of flesh on its head split open, leaving a large hole from which blood was gushing out.
Under Little Sparrow’s claw, the snake-like Demonic Beast couldn’t last a single round and was instantly killed by Little Sparrow.
When it comes to Little Sparrow, although it may seem like a small glutton and even a bit silly at times,
It had in fact always been very powerful.
Speaking of which…
It had already reached the peak of the Foundation Establishment Stage, just one step away from the Golden Core.
It had always been stuck, never able to make the breakthrough.
Next…
Little Sparrow, with a Demonic Beast Inner Core in its mouth, flew towards Lin Jing.
This speed was as if it was just taking a leisurely stroll.
Compared to the speed when it had killed the serpent-shaped beast, it was a world apart.
Little Sparrow landed directly on Lin Jing’s shoulder.
After that…
Little Sparrow, with the Demonic Beast Inner Core still in its mouth, “gulp,” swallowed it down into its stomach.
Then it cocked its head, looking at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing, looking at Little Sparrow, asked:
“Little Sparrow…”
“How did you come to be here?”
“Where is Qing Ling?”
Hearing Lin Jing’s question, Little Sparrow tilted its head thoughtfully and then replied:
“Looking for you…”
Lin Jing immediately understood what Little Sparrow meant.
It must be that after Huang Qingling entered, she didn’t encounter any of them.
Then…
she sent out Little Sparrow to look for them.
Little Sparrow could fly very quickly and was quite familiar with the jungle.
Having it search for people couldn’t be more appropriate.
“Little Sparrow, could you please take me to find Fellow Daoist Qing Ling?”
Lin Jing spoke, addressing Little Sparrow.
“Understood…”
Little Sparrow nodded, agreeing with a sentence.
Afterward.
It flew up from Lin Jing’s shoulder and headed into the jungle behind them.
And Lin Jing, hastily followed behind Little Sparrow.
Here…
only the snake-shaped Demonic Beast’s corpse, without its Demonic Beast Inner Core, was left behind.
However, in just a short while, a swarm of insects and ants had surrounded the corpse of the snake-shaped demonic beast.
These insects and ants were incredibly fierce…
In just a moment, the corpse of the snake-shaped demonic beast was nibbled clean, without even leaving a trace of bone behind.
At this time…
in this dense jungle.
Lin Jing followed Little Sparrow, weaving through the dense forest.
Just like that…
roughly a quarter of an hour later, Lin Jing once again saw Huang Qingling.
The distance between the two was not very far.
However, navigating through the dense jungle was quite troublesome and took some time.
It was also fortunate that the distance between them was not great…
Otherwise.
Little Sparrow wouldn’t have been able to find Lin Jing so quickly.
“Fellow Daoist Qing Ling…”
The moment he saw Huang Qingling, Lin Jing greeted her first.
Huang Qingling also turned to greet him only after seeing Little Sparrow, and then saw Lin Jing following behind Little Sparrow.
“Lin Jing…”
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Huang Qingling quickly greeted him in return.
Seeing Lin Jing, Huang Qingling was visibly very happy.
“I didn’t expect Little Sparrow to find you so quickly…”
Lin Jing nodded and then said,
“I just encountered a Demonic Beast, but fortunately, Little Sparrow appeared and saved my life.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Little Sparrow proudly raised its head, looking at Huang Qingling.
It seemed to be waiting for Huang Qingling’s praise.
Even though Lin Jing could deal with the demonic beast on his own, it would require him to exert his true strength.
It wasn’t as effortless as it was for Little Sparrow.
And now, Little Sparrow was quite clever, almost able to communicate normally with people.
So…
In front of Little Sparrow, Lin Jing had no choice but to hide his strength.
“How are you, are you hurt?”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s story, Huang Qingling’s voice rose anxiously as she quickly looked him over.
“Little Sparrow arrived in time, so luckily, I was unharmed.”
Lin Jing said.
After hearing what Lin Jing said and seeing that there were no wounds on him, Huang Qingling finally let out a sigh of relief.
Subsequently.
Huang Qingling gently rubbed Little Sparrow and said to it,
“Little Sparrow, you did a great job…”
Receiving such treatment from Huang Qingling, Little Sparrow seemed to enjoy it immensely.
A moment later…
Huang Qingling looked up at Lin Jing and said,
“The Demonic Beasts here are mostly at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and it’s rare for them to attack people; they probably attacked you because they saw your cultivation was low.”
“Previously…”
“Everyone who came in here had at least the cultivation of the Foundation Establishment Stage.”
“I’m afraid you were the only one at the Qi Refinement Realm.”
Having said this, Huang Qingling then expressed self-reproach,
“We came in a hurry before and I neglected this matter; had I known, I would have prepared some talismans for you before entering.”

chapters.title: Chapter 231: 222 Heading to the Cleansing Spirit Pool
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 222 Heading to the Cleansing Spirit Pool
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, suddenly had an epiphany:
“No wonder it’s like this…”
Then he stepped forward and comforted Huang Qingling:
“Don’t worry, I have talismans with me.”
“Even if Little Sparrow hadn’t come, I could have fought that Demonic Beast.”
“Qingling, you shouldn’t blame yourself…”
Having said this,
Lin Jing quickly changed the subject.
“Shall we just wait here for Elder Master Li and the others to come over like this…” Lin Jing asked.
“Alright…” Huang Qingling replied.
Soon after,
Lin Jing sensed a powerful Divine Sense sweep over him.
“They’re here…”
Huang Qingling lifted her head and said to Lin Jing.
Indeed…
The moment Huang Qingling’s voice fell,
Elder Master Li, along with Li Tangyu and his sister, as well as Zhang Yuan, arrived at the scene.
Upon seeing the two,
Li Tangyu said with a smile:
“You two are quite lucky to have been teleported together…”
Lin Jing then explained.
“Li brother, you’re mistaken…”
“We were separated when we entered; it was Little Sparrow who found me…”
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than Huang Qingling continued:
“Lin Jing was attacked by a Demonic Beast; thankfully, Little Sparrow arrived in time…”
“Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.”
Hearing this, everyone quickly turned their gaze to Lin Jing.
The smile on Li Tangyu’s face also instantly vanished, and he quickly asked:
“What exactly happened?”
Lin Jing hurriedly said:
“Actually, it’s nothing…”
“I just encountered a Foundation Establishment Stage Demonic Beast. While I was confronting it, Little Sparrow arrived and killed the beast on the spot.”
Lin Jing simply relayed the incident,
Without mentioning the previous sneak attack by the beast.
Upon hearing this…
Even Elder Master Li fell into deep thought.
Because the place where they had just been teleported into was the outer edge of the Secret Realm, and the Demonic Beasts here were not very strong.
Previously, when they had been teleported in, there had been no incidents of Demonic Beasts actively attacking people.
So…
They subconsciously overlooked this point.
“This time, it was my negligence…”
“I forgot that your cultivation was too low, and it was very likely that Demonic Beasts would attack you.”
Elder Master Li frowned and spoke.
Lin Jing then said:
“Elder Li, it’s not a big deal…”
“I’m carrying some Second Rank talismans. Even if I can’t beat the beast, protecting myself is not a problem.”
Elder Master Li nodded his head.
Fortunately, Lin Jing was unharmed…
If Lin Jing had died in the jaws of a Demonic Beast right after entering the Secret Realm, he feared he would have trouble explaining it to Elder Bai and Elder Yu.
“Alright, let’s go…”
Afterwards,
They all proceeded together toward the front.
At this moment,
Walking through the jungle, Lin Jing finally had the leisure to feel the atmosphere of this Demon Race Secret Realm.
Here, it was somewhat different from the outside world.
The Spiritual Energy was much denser than in the outside world, and that wasn’t all…
Inside this Secret Realm, there seemed to be a special kind of aura; it was not greatly affecting them,
But…
Little Sparrow was clearly much more active here than in the outside world, continuously circling around them.
It was as if this was its true home.
The group continued their journey through the dense forest.
The forest was vast, and after walking for most of the day, the environment around them hardly changed. If it weren’t for the slight increase in the density of the Spiritual Energy…
Lin Jing even wondered if they were lost and going in circles.
It was at this moment…
That Li Tangyu slowed down, approached Lin Jing, and said:
“Brother Lin…”
“Since it’s your first time here, you probably aren’t aware…”
“We’ll have to walk for at least two days to reach the Cleansing Spirit Pool this time.”
Startled, Lin Jing responded to Li Tangyu’s words.
Then he turned his head to Li Tangyu, confused,
“Does it really take that long?”
Li Tangyu nodded:
“Yes…”
“This Demon Race Secret Realm is huge, almost like a small world.”
“As far as I know…”
“There are still many places within this secret realm that remain unexplored.”
“Exactly how big the entire secret realm is, nobody knows to this day.”
After hearing Li Tangyu finish.
Lin Jing looked up at the sky.
The sky within the secret realm was foggy and overcast, with no sunlight visible.
Then…
Lin Jing looked into the distance, where the mountains undulated, seemingly endless…
Afterward, Li Tangyu continued:
“Moreover…”
“We cannot fly at will in this dense forest.”
At this time.
Li Qingqing, who had been eavesdropping on their conversation, suddenly spoke up:
“I know this…”
“Grandfather mentioned before that the Demonic Beasts here are far more formidable than those outside.”
“If one carelessly flies on a sword, they might quickly be surrounded by Demonic Beasts, and even a Golden Core Immortal might get injured then.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“I heard before that an Elder from the Qingyuan Sword Sect, who was at the Golden Core stage, died at the hands of a Demonic Beast…”
“Indeed, that happened…” said Li Tangyu with a nod.
Subsequently…
They continued to walk and talk.
On their journey, they occasionally encountered Demonic Beasts that foolishly attempted sneak attacks.
But with Little Sparrow around, Elder Master Li of the Li Family didn’t even need to lift a finger, as those Demonic Beasts died one after another under Little Sparrow’s claws.
On their way.
Little Sparrow feasting on Demonic Beast Inner Cores probably had its fill by now.
And so.
The group walked from day into night.
Soon, night fell.
They found a large rock, started a campfire, and rested on the spot to recover their strength.
That night passed without incident.
The next day, they set off again.
The deeper they went into the secret realm, the denser the spiritual energy became.
And so.
The group continued to move deeper into the secret realm.
It was the afternoon of the second day when just after they crossed a mountaintop, Lin Jing looked up into the distance…
And he was stunned…
He saw a mountain range, winding and rugged, stretching across the ground.
Atop that mountain range, a colossal peak soared into the sky, piercing the clouds.
Even with Lin Jing’s vision, he could only see part of that peak before it was obscured by the clouds in the sky.
Li Tangyu came over and said with a smile:
“Brother Lin…”
“You must have never seen such a tall mountain before, right?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied:
“Yes!”
“I’ve never seen such a tall mountain before.”
After that, Li Tangyu continued:
“I was the same as you when I first came here…”
“And the Cleansing Spirit Pool is located below this mountain peak.”
Lin Jing looked towards the mountain peak and then expressed his admiration:
“No wonder…”
“Only a place full of natural spirit and exceptional beauty like this could produce Spiritual Objects like the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.”
At that moment…
Elder Master Li of the Li Family, who had been mostly silent, spoke up:
“Alright, we’re almost there…”
“This place isn’t very far from that mountain peak, and the three major sects have already cleared the area nearby. We can fly there on our swords now.”
“Good…” replied everyone.
Then…
They all took to their swords and flew towards the mountain peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 232: 223 Elder Wang
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 223 Elder Wang
There has been an ancient saying that speaks volumes.
“A watched pot never boils.”
This phrase couldn’t better describe Lin Jing and his companions’ current predicament.
They initially thought that the remaining distance wasn’t very far.
However…
It took them more than an hour of flying to reach the foot of that mountain peak.
Of course…
Aside from Lin Jingzhi, the others could have been faster.
But they deliberately slowed down to accommodate Lin Jingzhi.
And Lin Jingzhi himself…
Naturally, he didn’t dare reveal his true strength and flew with all his might at the speed that would be expected of someone at the eighth level of Qi Refinement.
Along the way…
Li Tangyu flew beside Lin Jingzhi, also helping to explain many things to him.
It was after listening to Li Tangyu’s explanation that Lin Jingzhi learned that the towering peak before them was known as the Skyreaching Peak.
Because of its shape resembling a pillar that connects heaven and earth.
That’s why it was called Skyreaching Peak.
Exactly how tall Skyreaching Peak is, remains unknown because no one has been able to reach its summit.
Numerous formations protect the entirety of Skyreaching Peak.
The people from the three major sects once thought there might be some rare treasures atop Skyreaching Peak and sought to break the formations to ascend to the summit.
But…
Even with the most skilled formation elders from the sects, they were unable to break the formations of Skyreaching Peak.
The person who set up these formations clearly had a mastery far beyond theirs, and even if there were incredible treasures up top, they could only sigh in longing.
Eventually, the three major sects also chose to give up.
They turned their efforts to other directions and continued to explore.
The group arrived at the foot of Skyreaching Peak.
Just like the entrance to the Secret Realm, this place too had been developed by the three major sects.
Lin Jing stood on his Flying Sword, looking down.
These buildings already had the makings of a Fang Market.
Seeing this, it seemed the three major sects planned to build a market here.
Presumably…
The people from the three major sects wanted to use the Cleansing Spirit Pool to develop this place for the long term.
No wonder so little of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid was being distributed.
It turns out the three major sects had a plan for steady and sustained growth.
But in fact, there’s nothing wrong with this approach.
The entirety of the Nanming Domain is just so big.
Securing cultivation resources is extremely difficult.
If they could make good use of this Demon Race Secret Realm.
They could raise the overall strength of the entire Nanming Domain by more than just one grade.
It was understandable for the three major sects to act this way.
“Let’s go, let’s head down…”
After Elder Master Li finished speaking,
he took the lead in putting away his Flying Sword and descended.
The others did the same, stowing their Flying Swords and landing alongside Elder Master Li at the entrance to the market.
They then followed Elder Master Li into the market.
At the entrance to the market,
there were disciples from the three major sects standing guard.
However…
Before they could enter the market,
an elder in a white robe emerged from within and approached Elder Master Li.
This elder in a white robe came up to them, smiling at Elder Master Li as he said:
“Elder Li…
“Aren’t you busy with alchemy at home? What brings you out here?”
It seemed…
This elder in a white robe was an old acquaintance of Elder Master Li’s and they shared a close relationship.
Elder Master Li also responded with a smile:
“Isn’t it that the younger generation in my family wanted to come to the Cleansing Spirit Pool? I’m not too busy recently, so I decided to accompany them on a visit.”
After Elder Master Li finished speaking, he immediately asked the elder in a white robe:
“Old Wang…”
“Is it your turn to stand guard here today?”
“Indeed…” replied the elder in the white robe.
After the elder in the white robe finished speaking, Elder Master Li turned to the group behind him and said:
“This one is Elder Wang from the Qingyuan Sword Sect.”
Several people nodded in understanding, and then they clasped their hands together and greeted Elder Wang:
“Elder Wang…”
“Good… good…”
Elder Wang smiled in response.
Then he looked towards Lin Jing and the other two, asking Elder Master Li:
“I’ve met these two members of your household before…”
“And these others, which family are they from?”
Elder Master Li first pointed towards Zhang Yuan and said:
“This one is a junior from the house of Chén Fán the Immortal…”
Elder Wang looked at Zhang Yuan and nodded his head:
“So, he’s from the house of Immortal Chén Fán…”
“Junior Zhang Yuan pays his respects to Elder Wang.”
Zhang Yuan quickly clasped his hand and bowed to Elder Wang.
“No need for such formalities. I’ve met your ancestor several times and even discussed the Dao with him. We can be considered friends.”
Elder Wang said with a smile.
Having said this.
Elder Wang then turned his head to look at Lin Jing and Huang Qingling.
And at that moment, Elder Master Li also began to introduce them.
“These two are juniors from Elder Bai’s Yuebao Lou.”
“Oh, is that so…”
Elder Wang uttered, nodding his head.
Since Elder Bai from Yuebaolou belonged to the Yiyun Pavilion, and rarely dealt with members of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, they were not very familiar with each other.
Thus, there wasn’t much to say.
Afterward…
Elder Wang didn’t engage the others further but started chatting with Elder Master Li.
“Let’s go, let’s enter and talk while we walk…”
Subsequently…
Elder Wang and Elder Master Li walked together towards the Fang Market.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing and the others followed behind the two men.
Upon arriving inside the Fang Market…
Elder Wang first found a place for them to stay, and then had a chat with Elder Master Li.
It wasn’t until a disciple from the Qingyuan Sword Sect came looking for Elder Wang on some business…
That he finally left.
After Elder Wang had departed, Elder Master Li called the others over.
Once everyone was present.
Elder Master Li took out several tokens and handed them to Li Tangyu.
“These are your tokens for entering the Cleansing Spirit Pool tomorrow. Each person gets one.”
“Tangyu, distribute them to them!”
“Yes, Grandfather…”
Then.
Li Tangyu handed out the tokens to them one by one.
Lin Jing received the token from Li Tangyu’s hand and began to examine it.
The token was made of jade, smooth and warm to the touch.
Moreover.
There were formation restrictions within the token, which seemed to indicate it might have other uses.
Beyond that, engraved on the back of the token were several large characters: Yi Seventeen.
But he did not know…
What the characters on it meant.
After all the tokens had been distributed, Elder Master Li spoke again:
“Just now…”
“Elder Wang briefly mentioned some details about the place of spiritual cleansing to me.”
“I will now relay that information to you.”
Hearing Elder Master Li say this, everyone listened earnestly.
Having just finished speaking.
Elder Master Li, fearing they might not understand, further explained:
“Oh…”
“The place of spiritual cleansing is the location you will go to tomorrow.”
The others nodded, indicating their understanding.
Then Elder Master Li continued:
“The token in your hands is the key to opening the cultivation cave dwellings.”
“By placing this token into the formation at the entrance of the cave dwelling, you can open the formation and enter the cave dwelling for cultivation.”
“Also, the engravings on the back of the token, you’ve all seen them, right…”
“The numbers inscribed are the code for your cave dwelling, which you can open with the tokens you have.”

chapters.title: Chapter 233: 233: Chapter 224: Liu Yiyuan’s Ulterior Motives
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 224: Liu Yiyuan’s Ulterior Motives
Elder Master Li’s words ceased, and Li Qingqing spoke, her voice full of doubt:
“Grandfather…”
“Didn’t you say this secret realm was a cave?”
“How come there are also cave dwellings?”
Not only Li Qingqing, but the others shared the same look of confusion.
Seeing their reactions…
Elder Master Li then spoke, explaining to everyone:
“The cave dwellings within the Cleansing Spirit Pool were specifically excavated by the three major sects…”
“Today, as you have entered this place, you must have seen it.”
“The original plan of the three major sects was to transform this area into the second Nanshan Market.”
“And behind this Fang Market, in the Cleansing Spirit Pool area, will become a gold mine for the sects to earn Spirit Stones in the future.”
“Now it hasn’t been completely built, and it hasn’t officially started yet.”
“In the future…”
“If you want to enter the Cleansing Spirit Pool, you will need to pay with Spirit Stones…”
With Elder Master Li’s explanation…
The group immediately understood.
It was no wonder…
That the three major sects would spend a significant amount of manpower and resources to build this Fang Market.
It turns out they intended to take the Cleansing Spirit Pool for themselves.
In doing so, not only could they train their own disciples, but they could also allow others to enter for cultivation and collect Spirit Stones.
It was truly killing two birds with one stone.
And they…
Seemed to be the first batch of experiencers of the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Afterward.
Elder Master Li continued:
“The tokens in your hands are exclusive to the internal region, and can only be used for cultivation within the internal area of the Cleansing Spirit Pool.”
“There are formations all over the Cleansing Spirit Pool, and without a token for the core region, it’s impossible to enter there.”
Elder Master Li’s words made Li Qingqing suddenly realize:
“No wonder…”
“So that’s what you meant earlier when you spoke of the core region, internal region, and the outer region…”
Elder Master Li nodded in affirmation.
“Yes…”
With this explanation, Lin Jing also understood.
Previously, Li Tangyu had mentioned these three areas to them.
So that was what he meant.
At this moment, Elder Master Li continued to speak:
“You only have seven days for this cultivation session…”
“You must make good use of it…”
After hearing this, everyone nodded.
Then…
Elder Master Li gave a few more instructions, and let them all go back.
Early the next morning.
The group finished their meditation early and gathered together.
Since Elder Master Li was responsible for leading them inside, but not entering himself,
Therefore.
Next, it was time for them to go together.
The group first went to Elder Master Li, said their farewells,
Then.
They left the small courtyard and headed toward the Cleansing Spirit Pool behind the Fang Market.
On this road, it wasn’t only them.
There were many other disciples from various family clans.
Basically.
All the clan disciples from inside and around Nanshan Immortal City were present.
With such an opportunity, naturally, none would miss it.
And so…
Lin Jing and the others, following the crowd, passed through the Fang Market towards the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Along the way.
Lin Jing saw Yun Long and Liu Yiyuan again.
This time.
Liu Yiyuan did not avoid him.
He glanced at Lin Jing, snickered, and then.
His gaze found Huang Qingling beside Lin Jing.
However, this time he only gave her a deep look, and then he turned his head away.
This scene.
Was naturally witnessed by everyone.
Li Tangyu, more rational, quickly consoled Lin Jing:
“At this moment, he wouldn’t dare to do anything to you, just ignore him.”
Lin Jing nodded his head.
Although Liu Yiyuan had always wanted to kill Lin Jing, he was no fool.
With disciples from three major sects present, and elders around, he dared only to provoke verbally.
He definitely wouldn’t dare to start a conflict with Lin Jing at this time.
If doing so led to his qualification to enter the Cleansing Spirit Pool being revoked, the loss would outweigh the gain.
As for Huang Qingling, she pursed her lips and said,
“This person really is like a bad penny…”
Although she was very dissatisfied with Liu Yiyuan,
she also knew that it was not appropriate to start a conflict at this time.
Thereafter…
To avoid encountering Liu Yiyuan again,
they deliberately slowed their pace, staying at the rear of the crowd.
Before long,
they followed the crowd to a huge cave entrance.
Just standing at this entrance, one could clearly feel the Spiritual Energy inside was extraordinary, drastically different from the outside.
At this entrance, there were several disciples from the three major sects standing guard.
Everyone entering the Cleansing Spirit Pool had to first have their Token inspected.
Only then would they be allowed to go in.
With the people from the three major sects managing the situation, no one dared to cause trouble here.
At that moment,
people in front had already had their Tokens checked and were gradually entering.
At the front of the queue were none other than Liu Yiyuan and Yun Long.
“Junior Brother Yun…”
The disciple from Nanyun Immortal Sect standing at the entrance was greeting Yun Long.
Clearly, he knew Yun Long.
“Senior Brother Yue…” Yun Long replied.
Senior Brother Yue then smiled and asked Yun Long,
“Did Elder Yun, the venerable one, bring Junior Brother Yun here?”
The Elder Yun he referred to in his words must be the Yun Family’s patriarch.
Yun Long shook his head and said,
“No…”
“Our patriarch has been quite busy recently, a clansman led us here.”
After hearing this, Senior Brother Yue nodded slightly and said,
“I see, that makes sense…”
“Your Yun Family has been busy lately, I’ve heard as much.”
Subsequently…
Yun Long took out a jade Token from his Storage Bag and handed it to Senior Brother Yue.
This Token glowed, markedly different from those in the hands of Lin Jing and the others.
“As I thought, I knew it…”
“The Token Elder Yun gave to Junior Brother must be for the core area.”
“Please, Junior Brother Yun, come in…”
Senior Brother Yue didn’t even check the Token and let Yun Long pass.
After Yun Long entered, he pointed to Liu Yiyuan behind him and said to Senior Brother Yue,
“This is Young Master Liu from the Liu Clan of Nanshan Immortal City, he’s with me…”
After hearing this, Senior Brother Yue nodded.
Then,
he directly let Liu Yiyuan through as well.
“Many thanks to Senior Brother Yue…”
Liu Yiyuan gave a fist salute to Senior Brother Yue.
“There’s no need for politeness…”
Senior Brother Yue nodded back to Liu Yiyuan and spoke.
After Liu Yiyuan entered, he turned his head back and saw Lin Jing’s group approaching them.
Next…
Liu Yiyuan turned his head and addressed Senior Brother Yue again,
“Senior Brother Yue…”
“Is there a cultivation requirement for entering this Cleansing Spirit Place?”
Senior Brother Yue knit his brows and pondered for a moment before replying,
“As of now, there is no such stipulation. As for requirements regarding cultivation, the elders have not mentioned any…”
Liu Yiyuan, looking back at Lin Jing and others, then continued,
“Oh…”
“I see…”
“I was considering reminding Senior Brother Yue not to let certain people below Foundation Establishment slip in…”
Senior Brother Yue, hearing Liu Yiyuan’s words,
followed his gaze, looking back…
and saw Lin Jing’s group, who were walking in their direction.
Within the group…
Lin Jing, at the mere eighth level of Qi Refinement, was particularly conspicuous.
Senior Brother Yue then turned back to look at Yun Long.
At this moment, it was quite clear that Yun Long had overheard the conversation, yet he said nothing.
Senior Brother Yue immediately understood.
He then said to Liu Yiyuan,
“I understand Young Master Liu’s intention, don’t worry…”

chapters.title: Chapter 234: 225: Periphery Area?
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 225: Periphery Area?
After speaking, Senior Yue felt something was amiss.
So he asked Liu Yiyuan again:
“What background does he have?”
“Does he have any connections with the three major sects?”
Liu Yiyuan shook his head and said:
“He’s just a Pill Master who offers his services to Yuebaolou, and he has a good relationship with a Golden Core Immortal there. Outside, everyone is saying that he’s that Golden Core Immortal’s nephew…”
“But I know, he is actually not.”
“Furthermore, I’ve known him for several years now, and he definitely doesn’t have the backing of any of the three major sects, otherwise, I wouldn’t dare to trouble him.”
After Liu Yiyuan had finished speaking, Senior Yue nodded and said:
“I’ll take care of this matter. While we won’t kick him out directly, it’s still possible to interfere subtly…”
Hearing what Senior Yue had said, Liu Yiyuan also understood that Senior Yue didn’t have the authority to expel someone directly.
He was doing this much out of respect for Yun Long’s face.
Knowing his limits, Liu Yiyuan didn’t push further.
He quickly clasped his fists in thanks towards Senior Yue:
“Thank you, Senior Yue.”
Senior Yue waved his hand and said:
“No need…”
After speaking.
Senior Yue then instructed a young disciple standing by, saying:
“Junior Brother…”
“Please inconvenience yourself to lead Brother Yun and this Mister Liu to their cavern abode.”
“Yes, Senior Yue…”
The young disciple from Nanming Immortal Sect saluted and said to Senior Yue.
After speaking.
He approached Yun Long and Liu Yiyuan, and said to the two:
“Brother Yun, Mister Liu…”
“Please follow me…”
Immediately after, he led the two of them towards the inside of the cave.
After the two had gone in.
It was only then that Lin Jing and the others arrived at the entrance of the cave.
At this moment.
Another group had just had their tokens checked and were being led in by a disciple guarding the entrance.
After those people had entered…
Li Tangyu took the lead and headed towards the entrance.
The guard at the entrance was still Senior Yue.
“Elder Brother, your efforts are appreciated.”
Senior Yue appeared quite mature, certainly in his thirties or forties.
Following custom…
Li Tangyu directly addressed him as Senior Brother.
After Li Tangyu spoke, he handed his token to Senior Yue.
Senior Yue took the token and examined it carefully before nodding to Li Tangyu:
“You should wait here for a while…”
“Soon another disciple will arrive to guide you to your destined cavern abode.”
“Thank you, Senior Brother…”
Afterwards.
Senior Yue returned the token to Li Tangyu.
After receiving his token, Li Tangyu stepped aside to wait for the remaining few.
After Li Tangyu had entered…
The next in line was Li Qingqing.
After a thorough inspection by the same Senior Yue, who found no issues,
He also allowed Li Qingqing to enter.
After Li Qingqing was checked, it was Zhang Yuan’s turn.
Then, it was Huang Qingling…
Everyone passed the inspection smoothly, leaving only Lin Jing still standing outside.
Next.
Lin Jing stepped forward and handed his token to Senior Yue.
Senior Yue, after glancing at the token, scrutinized it for a while.
Then, he gave Lin Jing a thorough look up and down, frowning deeply.
Following that, Senior Yue turned to another disciple from Nanming Immortal Sect and said,
“Junior Brother, go ahead and bring these few inside…”
“Yes, Senior Yue…”
The disciple saluted and responded to Senior Yue.
Senior Yue’s words made Li Tangyu and the others pause in confusion.
Because they had all been together before, and Senior Yue knew this.
Why were they being suddenly separated here?
Li Tangyu was quite puzzled.
However…
He still took a step forward and said to Brother Yue:
“This brother, we are with him and wanted to wait for him before going to the cave tabernacle.”
Brother Yue frowned upon hearing this and said with displeasure:
“You can go in first. The cave dwellings inside are all independent from one another.”
“There is no difference if we enter separately…”
After saying this, he then turned to Lin Jing and said:
“You come in first, and I’ll take you to your cave dwelling in a bit.”
Seeing Brother Yue saying so, Li Tangyu did not persist any further.
If they had come a bit earlier, perhaps they would have seen the conversation between Brother Yue and Liu Yiyuan.
In that case…
They probably wouldn’t have felt at ease letting Brother Yue separate Lin Jing from the rest of them.
Such a pity.
They had likely slowed down earlier to avoid Liu Yiyuan.
Therefore, they did not witness the two’s conversation.
Lin Jing was the same.
Although confused, he still went inside,
However…
Brother Yue still had not returned the token to Lin Jing.
“Junior Brother…”
“You first take them in. I’ll wait for two more people and bring them in together.”
After Brother Yue finished speaking, that disciple of the Nanming Immortal Sect then said to Li Tangyu and the others:
“Let’s go, everyone.”
Seeing Lin Jing had entered, despite their doubts, they followed the Nanming Immortal Sect disciple inside.
After they had gone in,
Brother Yue waited a bit longer. Seeing no one else was coming, he then said to Lin Jing:
“There’s hardly anyone coming behind us, I’ll take you inside first.”
After speaking…
Brother Yue instructed the other disciples guarding the entrance of the cave and then led Lin Jing into the depths of the cave.
Lin Jing felt something was amiss with what Brother Yue said, but couldn’t pinpoint what exactly was wrong at the moment.
Afterwards…
Lin Jing thought that since this was the territory of the three major sects, there probably wouldn’t be any danger. After pondering, he still followed…
Upon entering the cave, Lin Jing realized…
The interior was filled with bizarre rocks and formations, looking like an ancient cavern that had formed long ago.
Among these rocks, there were scattered crystals, sparkling brilliantly, quite beautiful to behold.
Beyond that.
The spiritual energy here contained some indescribable mystical element, making each inhalation feel very refreshing.
The cave seemed very deep, but as the two walked further inside, it didn’t feel gloomy at all.
Moreover.
Along the way, there were numerous magic artifacts for illumination embedded in the cave walls, emitting a soft glow that was particularly reassuring in this cavern.
Lin Jing thus continued to follow Brother Yue ahead of him.
They walked for almost half an hour before turning at a bend.
Suddenly…
A fork with two cave entrances appeared ahead.
On the rock above each entrance, a sign was placed indicating the destination of each pathway.
The sign above one of the paths was labeled “Internal Region.”
The other slanted pathway had a sign stating “Outer Region.”
Clearly.
These two paths led to different areas.
Moreover, Lin Jing could distinctly feel that the mysterious element in the cave leading to the internal region was much more concentrated.
Thereafter.
He saw Brother Yue head straight for the fork labeled “Outer Region.”
Lin Jing immediately became suspicious and stopped in his tracks, asking Brother Yue:
“Brother, my token is for the internal region, why are you taking me to the outer region?”
Originally.
Elder Master Li had told them when he handed them the tokens.
Their tokens were for the internal region.
And he also warned them not to go to the core region, Lin Jing remembered it very clearly.
Yet now.
The Nanming Immortal Sect disciple leading him in was actually trying to take him to the outer region.
Of course, this would arouse Lin Jing’s suspicion.
Brother Yue saw Lin Jing standing still and questioning him,
So he turned around and said with a frown:
“Your cultivation is too low, it’s not suitable for you to enter the internal region.”
“I’ll give you a token for the outer region later, and you’ll cultivate there instead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 235: 226: Meeting Senior Han Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 226: Meeting Senior Han Again
Hearing this…
