Lin Jing frowned in thought for a moment before speaking,
“This doesn’t seem quite right, Senior Brother…”
“When we arrived, there was no mention of a cultivation restriction for entering the inner area of the Spirit Cleansing grounds.”
“Moreover…”
“My token is specifically for the inner area, so why would I go to the outer area to cultivate?”
Senior Yue looked quite displeased and then said,
“Indeed, it wasn’t explicitly stated…”
“But that’s because it was unforeseen that someone with the cultivation of Qi Refinement Level Eight would come to the Spirit Cleansing grounds.”
Lin Jing was clearly skeptical of Senior Yue’s explanation.
“If that were truly the case, Elder Master Li would have informed me before I entered.”
With that thought, Lin Jing then addressed Senior Yue,
“Senior Brother, please return my token to me.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, Senior Yue’s brows inverted in irritation, saying impatiently,
“What now?”
“Do you think I would deceive you?”
“If you don’t wish to cultivate, then leave on your own.”
Having said that,
Senior Yue flicked his sleeve and turned to leave.
He showed no intention whatsoever of returning the token to Lin Jing.
Just then,
from a branch path in the inner area, a voice suddenly rang out, seemingly filled with disbelief.
“Lin Jing?”
Hearing this voice, Lin Jing was also startled.
He then turned his head to look at the person emerging from the inner area.
It was, surprisingly, Senior Han.
“Senior Han…”
“How could you…”
Immediately feeling something was amiss, Lin Jing corrected himself,
“So it turns out you are here as well…”
As an Inner Sect Disciple of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, it was not strange for Han Jing to be here.
At this moment…
The surprise was not limited to Lin Jing and Han Jing.
Even Senior Yue, who had turned to leave, was now frowning and standing still.
He recognized the newcomer.
An Inner Sect Disciple of the Qingyuan Sword Sect.
Last name Han, given name Han Jing.
This person, like him, was in charge of managing the Spirit Cleansing grounds.
Only…
It was unclear how he came to know Lin Jing.
Senior Yue was utterly puzzled.
If he was holding Lin Jing’s token without anyone else’s knowledge, that would be easy to handle.
As a manager of the Spirit Cleansing grounds, he could easily manipulate a minor Qi Refinement Level Eight cultivator.
But…
If this minor cultivator had connections with this ‘Junior Han’ from the Qingyuan Sword Sect…
Then things would be difficult.
After all,
this place was jointly managed by three major sects.
The Elders above, particularly concerned about the relations between the three sects, had repeatedly warned to maintain amicable relations, and to avoid conflict.
Subsequently,
he recalled what Liu Yiyuan had previously said, and immediately felt a surge of antipathy,
“This person clearly has the backing of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, yet Liu Yiyuan deliberately withheld this information from me, nearly causing me to make a grievous mistake.”
“Next time I see him, I must give him a proper warning.”
Seeing Han Jing, Lin Jing was overjoyed.
“Senior Han, I didn’t expect to encounter you here…”
Han Jing clearly had many questions:
“This place is under the management of the three great sects, and my current duty is to assist the Elders in overseeing it.”
“But you, how did you get in here…”
After finishing,
Han Jing sized up Lin Jing from head to toe and then said,
“You’re quite the lad, Qi Refinement Level Eight…”
“How did you cultivate so quickly?”
Han Jing knew Lin Jing very well and was aware that he possessed a talent of the Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root.
In his opinion…
For Lin Jing to have survived in the Fang Market at the foot of the mountain these past few years was already quite an accomplishment.
In terms of his cultivation, he could, at most, have improved to the third level of Qi Refinement.
But he never expected…
Lin Jing had actually made a breakthrough to the eighth level of Qi Refinement in one go.
For someone with the talent of a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root, this was truly defying the heavens.
“This is a long story, we’ll talk about it later…”
After finishing, Lin Jing looked towards Senior Yue.
At this moment…
Senior Yue finally found a chance to join the conversation.
“Senior Han, you… know each other?”
Senior Yue asked, pointing at Lin Jing.
Han Jing nodded and then said:
“This is Lin Jing, to put it in a way, he can be considered a junior brother of mine.”
“His father was once a disciple of Qingyuan Sword Sect, and he had helped me a lot…”
After speaking, Han Jing turned towards Senior Yue and asked:
“Senior Yue…”
“When I was inside just now, it seemed like there was an argument. May I know what that was about?”
Faced with Han Jing’s inquiry, Senior Yue, without a hint of embarrassment or skipping a beat, blurted out:
“Junior Han, it seems you must have heard wrong.”
“Just now…”
“I was introducing the Cleansing Spirit Ground to Junior Lin. Maybe I was a bit loud, which led you to mistake it for an argument.”
After speaking.
Senior Yue took out the token he had taken from Lin Jing and handed it back to him, adding:
“Junior Lin…”
“This token is the key to open the cave abode, you must keep it safe.”
Senior Yue’s actions were not due to fear of Han Jing.
Rather.
Provoking Han Jing without cause would be extremely disadvantageous to himself.
Even if this was all for earning a favor from the Young Master of the Yun Family…
If the matter was not handled well and it brought trouble upon himself, the loss would outweigh the gain.
So.
After much deliberation, he decided to actively reconcile with Lin Jing.
At this time, Han Jing also asked Lin Jing:
“Is that so?”
Lin Jing pondered for a moment…
Seeing Lin Jing remaining silent, Senior Yue’s heart skipped a beat, and his eyebrows furrowed tightly:
“Could he really think that I’m afraid? Does he intend to pick a fight?”
However, Lin Jing did not ponder for too long. After a short while, he nodded and said:
“It’s exactly as Senior Yue said, he was just informing me about the Cleansing Spirit Ground.”
“Thank you, Senior Yue.”
After speaking, Lin Jing even gave Senior Yue a fist salute.
Seeing Lin Jing being so cooperative, Senior Yue relaxed too and returned the gesture, saying:
“Not at all…”
“Junior Lin, you’re too polite…”
Seeing the two being so harmonious, Han Jing nodded and said:
“So that’s it…”
“It seems I really heard wrong.”
After speaking, Han Jing glanced at the jade token in Lin Jing’s hand and then spoke again:
“Lin Jing…”
“Come, let me have a look at your token…”
Lin Jing still trusted Han Jing very much.
He immediately handed the token to Han Jing.
Han Jing took the token and began examining it.
A moment later, after having looked it over…
He returned the token to Lin Jing and then said to Senior Yue:
“Senior Yue…”
“I know that guarding the entrance can be quite busy. Lin Jing is my junior brother; let me take him into the cave abode, so you won’t be troubled anymore…”
After hearing this, Senior Yue nodded:
“That would be good indeed, then I’ll leave it to you, Junior Han.”
“Both of you, if you’ll excuse me…”
After speaking.
Senior Yue gave them a fist salute and turned around, walking back the way he came.
However…
No sooner had Senior Yue walked past the entrance than his expression grew dark, and he said fiercely:
“Liu Yiyuan, I’ll remember you…”

chapters.title: Chapter 236: 227 Small Talk
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 227 Small Talk
In Senior Brother Yue’s opinion…
Liu Yiyuan must be hiding something from him to get him to deal with Lin Jing.
In fact, it was quite normal for Senior Brother Yue to think this way.
After all…
Lin Jing rarely interacted with outsiders.
Not many people knew about his expulsion from the Qingyuan Sword Sect.
After Senior Brother Yue left, Lin Jing and Han Jing watched him walk away.
Then,
Han Jing turned his head and said to Lin Jing,
“I actually heard all of your conversation just now…”
“You did very well just now…”
“I know a little bit about him, he’s not the kind to seek revenge for every grievance, but he’s also not very magnanimous.”
“Now that he has backed down, let’s give him a way out.”
“With what happened this time, I think he probably won’t trouble you again.”
Having said that…
Han Jing looked at him with satisfaction:
“It seems…”
“You have grown a lot during these years down the mountain.”
What Han Jing referred to,
was naturally the choice Lin Jing had just made.
Lin Jing knew that,
although Senior Han was there and could help him seek justice,
if he really confronted Senior Brother Yue, at most, the affair would be taken to the elders, and Senior Brother Yue would only be reprimanded.
Beyond that, things would continue as they were.
Even,
he might end up hating Lin Jing because of it.
So instead of escalating the issue, it was better to give him an out.
Although…
he probably wouldn’t be grateful to him, but at least it saved a lot of trouble.
“I owe a lot to Senior Han for this matter.”
Lin Jing gave Han Jing a fist salute.
Han Jing quickly stepped forward, placing his hand on Lin Jing’s wrist, and then said,
“There’s no need for that…”
He continued,
“Actually, the reason I came over…”
“was because I heard someone mentioning your name and wanting to deal with you, so I wanted to come and see.”
“I thought it might be a case of identical names, but after I arrived, I realized it really was you!”
“Senior Brother Yue acted against you because of this person.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing instantly understood.
Nobody else but Liu Yiyuan would target him like this.
In this place of the Cleansing Spirit Pool, only Liu Yiyuan had a grudge against him.
Han Jing went on to say,
“I don’t know that person…”
“What I do know is that the other person by his side is the Young Master of the Yun Family, Yun Long.”
“Don’t you have some issues with them?”
Lin Jing then shook his head and gave a bitter smile,
“Well, it’s a long story…”
“Listen,”
“Senior Han, it’s inconvenient to talk here, let’s go to my cave dwelling first…”
“I’ll tell you all about it after we get to my cave dwelling.”
Upon hearing this, Han Jing nodded and said,
“That sounds good…”
“Come, follow me, I’ll take you to your cave dwelling.”
Afterwards,
Lin Jing and Han Jing walked towards the branch path leading to the inner area.
They followed the twists and turns of the cave, and it wasn’t until a quarter of an hour later that they stopped at the entrance of a cave dwelling.
Calling it a cave dwelling,
was really just a cultivation room carved into the mountainside.
It was probably called a ‘cave dwelling’ just to sound a bit more impressive.
At the entrance of the cave dwelling, a stone door blocked the way. Etched upon the stone door were the characters for “Yi Seventeen” but there were no other carvings or patterns, making it look quite simple.
In front of the cave dwelling’s entrance, there was a defensive array, its light shining brightly at the moment.
At the front of the array, there was a raised stone platform, on which sat a recess filled with intricate patterns…
If compared with the token in Lin Jing’s hand, one would find that they matched perfectly.
It seems that this was the place meant for the token.
“This is your cave dwelling…”
Han Jing then spoke.
Lin Jing nodded.
Afterward, he took out the token and placed it on the stone platform.
Once the token was placed, the entire formation emitted a strong white light, which lasted for several breaths.
After the white light dispersed, the formation that had been blocking the entrance disappeared.
Soon after.
Lin Jing beckoned, and the token flew into his hand.
“Senior Han, please…”
Han Jing nodded, went to the entrance of the cave mansion, and directly pushed open the stone door.
Behind the stone door was a winding and meandering path.
Unexpectedly, the interior was quite deep.
Lin Jing originally thought that inside was just a man-made cavern.
Next.
The two followed the path deeper inside.
It wasn’t very far, and they soon reached the deepest part of the cave mansion.
The contents inside were simple.
A stone bed and a meditation cushion.
Upon entering the cave mansion, Lin Jing felt that the spiritual energy inside was much denser than outside.
Especially within the spiritual energy, the mysterious element seemed much more abundant.
“This inner area, although it can’t compare to the core area, is still very rare, and you should cultivate well.”
“Especially with your Spiritual Root aptitude, if you can make even a slight improvement, you’ll be able to go much further in the future.”
“Who knows…”
“Achieving the Golden Core might not be impossible.”
The two had just entered.
Han Jing began to advise Lin Jing.
Then, he continued speaking, asking Lin Jing:
“By the way…”
“How did you reach the eighth level of Qi Refinement?”
“With a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root, reaching the eighth level of Qi Refinement in such a short time must not have been easy; did you have some sort of fortuitous encounter?”
As Han Jing’s words fell, Lin Jing then spoke:
“Senior Han…”
“Actually, I have to thank you for this matter.”
“If you hadn’t helped to get the alchemy book from Manager Li, I probably wouldn’t have achieved what I have now.”
“It was after studying the Alchemy Technique that I discovered my alchemy talent is actually not low.”
“And…”
“I am now a Pill Master serving at Yuebaolou.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Han Jing was momentarily stunned, standing there in shock.
After a while, he came back to his senses.
Then with excitement, he said:
“A Pill Master serving at Yuebaolou…”
“Good lad…”
“I had no idea your talent for alchemy was so high.”
“If you were in the Sect, you’d probably be directly taken as a personal disciple by the Grand Elder of the Pill Peak.”
Having finished speaking.
Senior Han looked at Lin Jing with interest and eagerly said:
“Come…”
“Tell me, how did you do it…”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Alright…”
Then he began to tell Han Jing about the events that had occurred after he left the mountain…
“That day, after we parted ways…”
In the process.
He also briefly revealed some of the feud with Liu Yiyuan.
Of course.
In this exchange, Lin Jing certainly concealed a lot.
The System Space and the matter of being the Elixir Valley Heir definitely couldn’t be known to others.
Not even to Han Jing.
In the meantime…
Lin Jing also asked about the recent situation of Senior Han.
Han Jing also told him a lot about some of the things he had encountered during this time.
After the two had exchanged pleasantries.
Han Jing shared some information about the Cleansing Spirit Pool with Lin Jing.
It wasn’t until more than two hours later that their conversation concluded.
“Alright…”
“You should cultivate well here, I will be leaving now.”
After their talk, Han Jing stood up and bid farewell to Lin Jing.

chapters.title: Chapter 237: 228 Conditions for Simulating the Cleansing Spirit Pool
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 228 Conditions for Simulating the Cleansing Spirit Pool
He had only taken two steps when Senior Han halted.
Then, from his Storage Bag, he pulled out a jade pendant and handed it to Lin Jing, saying,
“This jade pendant is called the ‘United Hearts Pendant,’ and there are two pieces in total, with one of them being with me.”
While speaking,
Senior Han lifted the hem of his garment to let Lin Jing see the pendant hanging at his waist.
“You take this one.”
“If something happens, you can infuse it with Spiritual Power, and I will naturally be aware.”
Lin Jing was initially stunned, then nodded and reached out to take the jade pendant.
“Focus on your cultivation. This Cleansing Spirit Liquid is said to have a better chance of improvement for those with poorer Spiritual Root talent.”
“Perhaps you could improve because of it.”
Having said that,
Han Jing thought for a while and then said to Lin Jing,
“Furthermore…”
“I’ll think of another way to see if I can get you to cultivate in the core area for a while.”
“The probability of enhancing your talent would be greater there.”
Entering the core area,
Lin Jing knew what that meant.
It was probably difficult even for Senior Han with his current status, wasn’t it?
Although Lin Jing also deeply wished to enter,
It was likely that for Senior Han to accomplish these things, he would need to pay a significant price.
Therefore,
Lin Jing spoke up, saying to Han Jing:
“Senior Han…”
“Actually, there’s no need for such efforts; I can cultivate here just fine.”
Han Jing seemed to understand Lin Jing’s thoughts,
And immediately replied,
“Don’t worry…”
“Didn’t I just mention to you about the grand competition of the sect?”
Lin Jing nodded.
The Qingyuan Sword Sect would soon hold the grand sect competition, and the top three would become core disciples.
Han Jing had also mentioned it to Lin Jing before, and Lin Jing was somewhat aware of it.
Then Han Jing continued,
“I am hopeful to secure a top-three placement in this sect competition and become a core disciple.”
“Several elders have high hopes for me, and it should be easy enough if I ask them.”
“Top three in the sect competition…”
Lin Jing was immediately stunned. When had Senior Han become so powerful?
“Senior Han, you…”
Before Lin Jing could inquire further…
Han Jing interjected,
“I’ve had a mysterious encounter, but let’s not get into the specifics.”
Lin Jing nodded in response, asking no more.
Then,
Han Jing departed…
And Lin Jing returned to the cave dwelling to start cultivating.
As Lin Jing cultivated, the Spiritual Energy mixed with the Cleansing Spirit Liquid continuously entered his body.
This Spiritual Energy, upon entering the body, not only increased his Cultivation,
Lin Jing even felt that his body seemed to be nourished by the Spiritual Energy, as if it was repairing his body and his meridians.
Undoubtedly…
This must be the effect of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
However,
With such a short sitting time for meditation, the feeling wasn’t very clear.
So, up next…
Lin Jing set aside his thoughts and focused on diligently circulating his Cultivation Technique, cultivating seriously.
Time flew by, and two days had passed.
For these two days, Lin Jing had been continuously meditating and cultivating without stop.
He hadn’t even entered the System Space.
Not until the third day did Lin Jing finally reopen his eyes.
Feeling the Spiritual Power within his body, Lin Jing shook his head helplessly.
Initially, these Spirit Forces seemed somewhat effective,
But as the two days went by,
Lin Jing realized…
The effects of the Spiritual Energy carrying the factors of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid were minimal, essentially useless.
After understanding this fact, Lin Jing stood up and ceased his meditation.
Rather than cultivating here and wasting time,
He might as well go into the System Space…
Lin Jing has always been someone who would act immediately upon thinking of something,
After thinking it through, Lin Jing directly summoned the System.
He first re-established the boundaries of his cave abode as the limits of his territory.
By doing so,
if anyone sought to find him in his cave abode, Lin Jing would be able to know in advance.
Having finished all this,
Lin Jing silently recited in his heart:
“Enter the System Space.”
Immediately following…
the scenery before Lin Jing’s eyes shifted, and he found himself inside the System Space.
Inside the System Space,
Lin Jing couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
The Spiritual Power within the System Space was much denser than that of the Cleansing Spirit Area.
However…
it lacked the unique effects of the Spiritual Energy found in the Cleansing Spirit Area.
“I wonder if I can create a Cleansing Spirit Pool here within the System Space.”
“If I manage to do so, it wouldn’t be so troublesome; just by being in the System Space and potentially using the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, I might be able to enhance the quality of my Spiritual Root.”
Lin Jing gazed at the Spirit Field before him, deep in thought…
Suddenly,
a flash of inspiration struck him…
He remembered one of the functions of the System Space…
Environmental Simulation!
“If I simulate the necessary environment for the production of Cleansing Spirit Liquid,”
“is it possible for it to continuously produce the liquid on its own?”
With that thought, Lin Jing’s eyes sparkled.
The more he considered it, the more possible it seemed.
However…
Cleansing Spirit Liquid isn’t classified as a Spirit Plant; it’s a special kind of treasure (Tian Cai Di Bao).
Whether this is feasible remains uncertain.
Afterward, Lin Jing spoke up, calling out the System once again.
“System…”
“Can the environmental simulation function simulate the conditions required for the formation of special non-Spirit-Plant Spiritual Objects?”
After a while, the mechanical voice of the System responded.
“The System Space can simulate types: non-Spirit-Plant treasures’ generation environments, including Spiritual Springs, special metal ores, and various Spiritual Objects…”
(Note: Any non-living Spiritual Objects’ generation environments can be simulated by the System.)
“Simulating conditions: the host must bring the treasure into the System Space to activate the environmental simulation for that Spiritual Object’s growth.”
With the System’s explanation, Lin Jing instantly realized.
The System Space can indeed simulate the environment for the production of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
However…
Lin Jing would need to obtain at least one drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid and bring it into the System Space.
The System would then be able to activate the simulation for the production of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
For the current Lin Jing, even a single drop was beyond his reach.
To Lin Jing’s knowledge,
the only ones who obtained Cleansing Spirit Liquid were the Elders of the three major Sects and a few selected Core Disciples.
Apart from them,
no one else had received even a single drop.
Moreover…
the moment it left the Cleansing Spirit Pool, the liquid would quickly evaporate.
It was not allowed to be taken out.
To obtain it, Lin Jing was required to enter the core area, get close to the Cleansing Spirit Pool,
then extract the Cleansing Spirit Liquid and immediately enter the System Space right beside the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
However,
Senior Han had just mentioned…
that there was a powerful Formation guarding the vicinity of the Cleansing Spirit Pool, and without permission, no one could approach it.
In addition…
there were three Elders from the three major Sects guarding near the Cleansing Spirit Pool, in order to prevent any accidents.
For him to get past was an outright fantasy.
Furthermore,
Senior Han had said that the Core Disciples who had taken the Cleansing Spirit Liquid,
did so under the scrutiny of several Elders, took a single drop, consumed it, and then immediately left.
Even Sect members were under such restrictions.
This illustrates the extent of the three major Sects’ valuation of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Even though the System had shown Lin Jing a way to simulate the environment for the production of Cleansing Spirit Liquid,
the method was exceedingly difficult.
Afterward…
Lin Jing furrowed his brow in contemplation, pondering how to obtain the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Even just one drop would suffice!

chapters.title: Chapter 238: 229: Senior Brother Yue’s Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 229: Senior Brother Yue’s Thoughts
After a long contemplation,
Lin Jing had not come up with any method.
Therefore,
Lin Jing decided to observe first, to see if there were any other methods available.
With that thought, Lin Jing directly spoke, calling out the System.
“System.”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, his perspective began to change.
Soon, he found himself inside a cave dwelling.
Once inside the System Space, Lin Jing was entirely within the System Space.
Thus,
the current cave dwelling lay empty and deserted.
Afterwards,
Lin Jing adjusted the viewing angle slightly and then controlled the observation perspective to leave the cave dwelling.
After Lin Jing controlled the observation perspective to exit the cave dwelling, he directly went down the passageway, exploring further inside.
Not long afterward, he passed by another cave dwelling.
Lin Jing’s curiosity was piqued.
He directly controlled the observation perspective to look inside.
Since he was in Observation Mode and lacked a physical body, naturally, he wouldn’t be blocked by formations.
As Lin Jing controlled the observation perspective and entered this cave dwelling, he was stunned by what he saw.
It was because inside the cave dwelling, a female cultivator was sitting cross-legged on a stone bed, meditating.
Perhaps it was because she was alone inside the cave dwelling.
Or maybe it was for some other reason.
This female cultivator had actually removed all her clothes, placing them aside.
And on her body…
she had only a sheer gown remaining.
This sheer gown was translucent…
Lin Jing could even vaguely see through the gown, the proud height that it barely concealed…
After a moment, Lin Jing came to his senses.
He hurriedly controlled the observation perspective to leave that cave dwelling.
He could not look any longer.
Otherwise, it would truly be impolite.
After leaving that particular dwelling, Lin Jing calmed his emotions and controlled the observation perspective to continue forward.
In the meantime…
He passed by several other cave dwellings, which Lin Jing simply overlooked.
It wasn’t until he saw a dwelling labeled ‘Yi Nine’ that Lin Jing stopped.
This dwelling,
if he wasn’t mistaken, should be Huang Qingling’s.
Before setting out,
all of them had checked the numbers on their tokens.
Lin Jing remembered clearly that the number on Huang Qingling’s token was indeed Yi Nine.
Following that,
Lin Jing controlled the observation perspective and looked directly into Huang Qingling’s room.
Inside Huang Qingling’s room,
Lin Jing saw that at this moment, Huang Qingling was earnestly sitting in meditation.
Indeed, such an opportunity,
even Huang Qingling treasured it and didn’t want to waste a moment.
After looking around inside Huang Qingling’s dwelling, Lin Jing left soon afterwards.
After leaving Huang Qingling’s place,
Lin Jing went to check on Li Tangyu, Zhang Yuan, and Li Qingqing.
It could now be said that…
Aside from Lin Jing,
everyone else was cultivating earnestly, striving to absorb the Spiritual Energy here to improve their Spiritual Roots.
Later…
Lin Jing continued to look at several dwellings and found the same situation everywhere.
At the end,
Lin Jing even saw Liu Yiyuan by chance.
When Lin Jing had encountered Liu Yiyuan before, he had sensed his cultivation aura.
Liu Yiyuan’s cultivation was only at the fourth level of Foundation Establishment, a level lower than Lin Jing’s.
For some reason, Liu Yiyuan seemed to be in a sorry state; he had only managed to reach the fourth level of Foundation Establishment after such a long time.
Logically speaking,
as a scion of the Liu Clan, with ample cultivation resources at his disposal, his cultivation should not be this low.
This baffled Lin Jing.
In fact,
what Lin Jing didn’t know was…
the reason Liu Yiyuan’s cultivation was so low was that he had developed a Heart Demon, resulting from the affair between Lin Jing and Huang Qingling, which caused his cultivation to stagnate.
Although Lin Jing had previously investigated Liu Yiyuan,
it was only to learn about his conspiracy with that Wang surnamed Pill Master, unaware of Liu Yiyuan’s Heart Demon.
Otherwise…
he would probably laugh in his dreams.
Upon seeing Liu Yiyuan, Lin Jing even felt a sudden impulse, which was to use Fixed Point Teleportation to appear inside his cave dwelling suddenly and then kill him.
If he could quietly eliminate him, then in the future, it was likely he would avoid a lot of trouble.
However,
Lin Jing could only dream about it.
If he really did so, a fight between the two would definitely cause a big commotion and might attract the attention of others.
Moreover, there was no certainty of success.
Besides, there was also the risk of exposing the System Space.
After thinking it over, he decided against it.
Seeing that Liu Yiyuan was cultivating and probably wouldn’t stop any time soon,
Lin Jing controlled the observing perspective, ready to leave Liu Yiyuan’s place.
Right at this moment…
sounds suddenly came from outside Liu Yiyuan’s cave dwelling.
And Liu Yiyuan, sensing this disturbance, then opened his eyes and stood up to walk towards the entrance of his dwelling.
Lin Jing, however, was faster than Liu Yiyuan; he had already managed to control the observation perspective to the outside at the first hint of noise.
Afterward, he saw.
Standing at the entrance to the dwelling was none other than Brother Yue.
This person was actually looking for Liu Yiyuan, but for what purpose?
Lin Jing decided to wait and watch.
If it was still a conspiracy against him, he would be able to protect himself beforehand.
Before long, he saw the stone door of the dwelling opening.
Liu Yiyuan came out.
“Brother Yue…”
“How is that matter going?”
As soon as Liu Yiyuan saw Brother Yue, he asked him.
“Come…”
“Let’s go inside and talk.”
Having said that, the two entered the cave dwelling.
And Lin Jing also controlled the observation perspective to follow them.
Inside the dwelling, Brother Yue directly spoke to Liu Yiyuan:
“Young Master Liu…”
“There has been a complication regarding this matter of entering the core area for cultivation.”
“I’m afraid that you will need to prepare some more gifts before it can be arranged.”

chapters.title: Chapter 239: 229: Senior Brother Yue’s Thoughts_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 229: Senior Brother Yue’s Thoughts_2
Brother Yue’s words had scarcely fallen when Liu Yiyuan’s brow furrowed, his voice tinged with displeasure:
“Brother Yue…”
“For this matter, I have already paid out over a thousand Midium Grade Spirit Stones.”
“When you found me initially, that wasn’t what you said…”
Previously…
Liu Yiyuan had just arrived not long ago when this Brother Yue found him, saying he could help him enter the core cultivation area.
However.
He would need to pay a price, that is, hand over some Spirit Stones, and then he could arrange for his entrance into the core cultivation area.
Originally, Brother Yue said that only a hundred Midium Grade Spirit Stones were required.
Originally.
A hundred Midium Grade Spirit Stones weren’t much for Liu Yiyuan.
Moreover.
This man was a disciple of the Nanming Immortal Sect and also the senior brother of Yun Long; it seemed likely he could pull some strings to let him cultivate in the core area.
With this in mind…
Liu Yiyuan gladly agreed and gave Brother Yue a hundred Midium Grade Spirit Stones.
But the matter which had already been agreed upon, Brother Yue kept changing.
First it was a hundred, and then an unexpected increase to five hundred Midium Grade Spirit Stones.
And then…
He said he had yet to make some arrangements.
This Brother Yue took another five hundred Spirit Stones from him, which all together exceeded a thousand Midium Grade Spirit Stones.
Now, all the Spirit Stones he had were taken away by him.
And upon the arrival of Brother Yue, he was told that there had been yet another unexpected issue.
Of course, he felt uncomfortable, didn’t he?
Seeing Liu Yiyuan’s reaction, Brother Yue quickly tried to console him:
“Young Master Liu, don’t be anxious.”
“I didn’t explain things clearly just now, this is actually good news.”
After Brother Yue finished speaking, Liu Yiyuan, who was initially displeased, paused for a moment and then turned his head, looking at Brother Yue with confusion:
“Good news?”
Brother Yue nodded, then continued:
“Actually, it’s like this…”
“The arrangements for you to enter the core cultivation area had already been made.”
“But this incident inadvertently alarmed the Elder on duty.”
“The Elder, upon learning of this matter, did not stop it but merely gave me a lecture, asking me to be cautious and not to let the other two major sects know about it.”
After hearing this, Liu Yiyuan was stunned for a moment, then asked in bewilderment:
“The Elder actually allowed it?”
Brother Yue continued:
“Of course.”
“The reason for this…”
“Is because that Elder has a very good relationship with my master and usually treats me quite well.”
“It just so happens that it’s his turn on duty…”
“If it were any other Elder, I probably would’ve been punished by now.”
“So that’s how it is…”
“I misunderstood Brother Yue,” Liu Yiyuan spoke up.
“It’s nothing…”
Brother Yue waved it off and continued:
“So, I was thinking.”
“While he is on duty, maybe we could ask him for a favor to get you a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid for Young Master Liu.”
Upon hearing this, Liu Yiyuan was shocked, his eyebrows knitted together, and then he inquired:
“Cleansing Spirit Liquid?”
“Brother Yue can get Cleansing Spirit Liquid?”
Brother Yue nodded and said:
“I can’t guarantee it one hundred percent, but this time is an opportunity. If missed, there really will be none.”
“However…”
“This matter requires that Elder’s approval.”
“So, Young Master Liu…”
Brother Yue hadn’t finished his sentence when Liu Yiyuan already understood.
It was.
He would need to pay out even more Spirit Stones, to bribe that Elder.
Thinking of this, Liu Yiyuan’s frown deepened, and after a moment, he said:
“Brother Yue…”
“Indeed, Cleansing Spirit Liquid is precious, and anyone’s heart would be moved.”
“But I have no Spirit Stones left.”
“And moreover…”
“I don’t believe that I have anything that could move that Elder, just by myself.”
After listening to this, Brother Yue then said:
“Young Master Liu.”
“This truly is the only chance.”
“Don’t you still have a Defensive Magical Treasure, third-tier Talismans, and Forbidden Artifacts on you?”
“If you could take out one, I could deliver it to that Elder, and maybe this matter would be settled.”
As Brother Yue’s voice fell, Liu Yiyuan took a step back, becoming immediately vigilant.
“How do you know about these items on me?”
Liu Yiyuan did indeed have these items on him.
But these.
Were his life-saving tools, which he wouldn’t readily tell anyone.
Seeing Liu Yiyuan like this, Brother Yue sensed trouble and quickly started explaining:
“Young Master Liu, as the most cherished descendant of the Liu Clan of Nanshan Immortal City, isn’t it normal for you to have such items?”
Brother Yue’s words also reminded Lin Jing, who had been watching.
Indeed.
Liu Yiyuan was deeply favored by Wu Cai Immortal, and his father was also a Golden Core Immortal.
Thus, it wasn’t surprising for him to have some Golden Core Stage Defensive Magical Treasures, or third-tier Talismans and Forbidden Artifacts on him.
Before…
Lin Jing was thinking of entering the cave dwelling and killing Liu Yiyuan.
Now, thinking back, he realized how ludicrous that idea was.
After hearing Brother Yue’s words, Liu Yiyuan’s expression eased somewhat, but he still kept his brows furrowed, not lowering his guard.
For some reason.
This time meeting Brother Yue, he felt some unaccountable irritation.
Perhaps it was because he had given him so many Spirit Stones, yet he hadn’t accomplished anything for him.
Or perhaps, it was something else.
At first.
He had asked him for help in dealing with Lin Jing.
At that time, he still had some good feelings towards Brother Yue.
But after that incident, Liu Yiyuan felt that his attitude towards him had changed.
Although, during their few conversations.
He still maintained a smiling face when facing him, just as before.
But Liu Yiyuan sensed that Brother Yue was clearly distancing himself from him.
Even when he brought up the matter about Lin Jing, Brother Yue only gave perfunctory responses.

chapters.title: Chapter 240: 229: Elder Brother Yue’s Thoughts_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 229: Elder Brother Yue’s Thoughts_3
With these thoughts in mind, Liu Yiyuan spoke again to his senior disciple Yue:
“Senior Disciple Yue…”
“I am aware of the precious nature of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, and I have no such delusions,”
“I merely need Senior Disciple Yue’s help in securing a cave dwelling in the core area, and I will be satisfied,”
“If it’s difficult for Senior Disciple Yue, then I will have to try my luck with Young Master Yun,”
Previously,
this matter had always been discussed solely between Liu Yiyuan and this Senior Disciple Yue.
Yun Long was unaware of it.
However,
after taking Liu Yiyuan’s Spirit Stones, Senior Disciple Yue had been dragging his feet in taking care of the matter.
Thus,
Liu Yiyuan started to have his doubts.
He wondered if he was being deceived by Senior Disciple Yue.
Therefore,
he brought up Yun Long on purpose, to make Senior Disciple Yue wary.
After hearing this, Senior Disciple Yue quickly replied with a smile:
“Young Master Liu, there’s no need to bother Young Master Yun with this,”
“Rest assured…”
“Although I dare not guarantee the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, I assure you there’s no problem with procuring a core area cave dwelling,”
“Since Young Master Liu isn’t interested in the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, we needn’t trouble that Elder,”
“Just wait, Young Master Liu. The core area cave dwelling,”
“I will surely have it settled by tomorrow at the latest,”
Liu Yiyuan’s brows knitted tightly as he said:
“Senior Disciple Yue, please make it quick,”
“We have only seven days in total for the Cleansing Spirit venture, and it’s already the third day,”
“The remaining time is not plentiful,”
Senior Disciple Yue continued:
“Rest assured, Young Master Liu. You have a good relationship with Disciple Yun, so naturally, you are my disciple too,”
“I will ensure that you get into the core area for cultivation as soon as possible,”
Afterwards,
Senior Disciple Yue bid Liu Yiyuan farewell and left.
Lin Jing, driven by curiosity, controlled his perspective and followed behind Senior Disciple Yue.
As soon as Senior Disciple Yue stepped out of his cave dwelling, his expression turned grim.
Afterward,
with a dark face, he continued walking deeper into the tunnel.
Before long,
he arrived at the edge of the core area.
Just ahead, two disciples from the Nanming Immortal Sect were standing guard.
“Senior Disciple Yue…”
On seeing Senior Disciple Yue, the two greeted him.
Senior Disciple Yue nodded, returned the greeting, and then proceeded onwards.
It wasn’t long before
Senior Disciple Yue arrived at the entrance to a cave dwelling.
He reached into his Storage Bag and pulled out a Token.
This Token, unlike the one Lin Jing held, had a continuous flow of light moving on it.
Subsequently,
Senior Disciple Yue placed the Token on the stone pedestal at the entrance to the cave dwelling.
Then, the Formation vanished,
and after taking the Token back, he pushed open the door and went inside.
Afterward, Senior Disciple Yue approached the stone bed,
his eyes showing a thoughtful expression.
After a while,
his facial expression softened and with a sigh, he muttered to himself:
“This time, I have indeed been too hasty,”
“It’s no wonder Liu Yiyuan became wary of me,”
He smacked his forehead and spoke with annoyance:
“I really am an idiot; why did I bring up the Cleansing Spirit Liquid,”
“And some of his Magical Treasures are not for me to covet; I truly muddled things up this time, getting a little too greedy,”
“I suspect that I might have caught some influence from Liu Yiyuan,”
Then,
Senior Disciple Yue patted his Storage Bag and smiled with satisfaction, saying:
“However…”
“To trick him out of a thousand Medium Grade Spirit Stones isn’t too shabby,”
“It would take me decades to earn that many Spirit Stones on my own,”
He added, with a touch of envy:
“These scions of noble families…”
“Sometimes, you can’t help but feel jealous,”
“They really are born under a lucky star, not having to worry about cultivation resources,”
“Next…”
“I still need to figure out a way to have him cultivate in the core area for a couple of days. After taking his Spirit Stones and not following through…”
“If Young Master Yun finds out, it’s likely going to be hard to explain,”
“Hmm…”
“Besides, I have to give a little handout to my fellow disciples; a hundred Spirit Stones should suffice,”
“The rest will be all mine,”
“Hmm… this is a profitable haul,”

chapters.title: Chapter 241: 230: Core Area, Investigating the Cleansing Spirit Pool
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 230: Core Area, Investigating the Cleansing Spirit Pool
Senior Yue’s monologue was not lost on Lin Jing; he heard every word.
As for Senior Yue,
Lin Jing had no comment.
After all, it wasn’t his Spirit Stone that was being lost.
Afterward,
Lin Jing stayed a while longer.
Having received no more useful information, he then left the place.
Leaving Senior Yue’s dwelling, Lin Jing continued to explore deeper into the cave.
The cave was very deep.
However,
due to the limited range of the Observation Mode, Lin Jing ultimately did not find the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Reluctantly, Lin Jing gave up the idea of seeking the Cleansing Spirit Pool for the time being.
Next,
Lin Jing continued to cultivate within the cave dwelling.
It wasn’t until two days later that Senior Han came to find him.
When Senior Han arrived,
Lin Jing was cultivating inside the System Space.
It was through the system’s reminder that Lin Jing knew of his arrival.
Afterward,
Lin Jing left the System Space and opened the stone door to go out.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Senior Han spoke directly:
“Let’s go…”
“Follow me.”
Lin Jing, upon seeing Senior Han, was still puzzled and did not react at once.
Then he heard Senior Han explain:
“I’m taking you to the core area.”
“I’ve arranged a dwelling for you to cultivate in there.”
Upon hearing Senior Han’s words, Lin Jing was stunned for a moment and then nodded his head.
“Alright…”
Lin Jing knew there was no need for formalities with Senior Han.
Moreover,
Lin Jing did indeed need to head to the core area, as he still wanted to investigate the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Now, in this inner area, the distance was simply not enough.
If he were in the core area, he estimated the distance would be sufficient.
Having said that,
Lin Jing followed Senior Han toward the core area.
On the way,
Senior Han spoke again to Lin Jing:
“This time, I’ve left you two days. You can cultivate in the core area until it’s time for you to leave.”
“During these two days, you should cultivate well.”
“Who knows, with some luck, you could improve the quality of your Spiritual Root.”
“Rest assured, Senior Han!” Lin Jing nodded in response.
Having said that,
the two of them proceeded along the passage.
Before long, they arrived at the entrance to the core area.
The route they took this time was different from the one Senior Yue took when Lin Jing used the Observation Mode to follow him.
And,
this time there were two disciples of the Qingyuan Sword Sect guarding the entrance to the core area.
Upon seeing Han Jing, they greeted him.
“Senior Han…”
Senior Han nodded, and then addressed the two:
“This is a disciple I used to know well. I’m taking him inside for some cultivation. He doesn’t have a token. I’ve informed you in advance; when it’s time for him to leave, just let him out.”
The two nodded to Han Jing and said:
“Don’t worry, Senior Han.”
Han Jing cupped his fists and said to the two men:
“Thank you both, junior brothers.”
The two men also cupped their fists in response:
“Senior Brother Han, you are too kind. We hope that after you become a core disciple, you can give us some guidance.”
Han Jing nodded and then said to them:
“Don’t worry.”
After saying this,
Han Jing cupped his fists again and said to the two men:
“Alright, junior brothers, we’re going in now.”
“Farewell!”
“Senior Brother Han, farewell,” the two men replied, cupping their fists in unison.
Then,
he walked in with Lin Jing.
After the two had entered,
the two disciples at the door began to discuss among themselves.
The one on the left said:
“Is the cave dwelling that Senior Brother Han applied for actually for this person’s use?”
“Who is this person, do you know him?”
The disciple on the right first peeked inside for a moment, then shook his head and said:
“Not sure, I haven’t seen him before.”
“But…”
“If Senior Brother Han does this, I’m afraid it will displease the elder.”
“The elder arranged this cave dwelling for him to cultivate properly, to improve his cultivation as much as possible before the sect’s disciple conference.”
“To secure a place in the top three in the grand competition.”
“Now…”
“He has given this opportunity to an unknown little cultivator.”
“Moreover, this person doesn’t seem to be the child of one of those big families from Immortal City.”
“I doubt he can offer much in the way of Spirit Stones.”
The disciple on the left nodded in agreement after hearing this.
“Indeed…”
“You know, renting this cave dwelling to other cultivators to earn some Spirit Stones, to buy a few more pills, would be much better than this.”
The disciple on the right said:
“Sigh…”
“Indeed!”
“Who knows what Senior Brother Han is thinking.”
“I guess this cultivator must have a special relationship with Senior Brother Han.”
The disciple on the left curled his lips and said to the one on the right:
“You’re stating the obvious…”
“Otherwise, how could Senior Brother Han treat him so…”
While the two were chatting leisurely,
Senior Brother Han had already brought Lin Jing to the entrance of a cave dwelling in the core area.
The two stood outside the cave dwelling.
Senior Brother Han took a glowing token from his Storage Bag with his hand.
Then,
he placed the token onto the stone platform at the entrance of the cave dwelling.
After the token was placed, there was a fluctuation, and then the formation opened.
Senior Brother Han stepped forward, pushed open the stone door of the cave dwelling, and walked in.
Lin Jing also followed after Senior Brother Han, heading inside the cave dwelling.
This core area cave dwelling was slightly larger than those in the inner area.
After entering the cave dwelling, Senior Brother Han handed the token in his hand directly to Lin Jing.
“You hold onto this token. When you leave, just return it to me.”
Lin Jing took the token and nodded.
Afterward,
Senior Brother Han gave Lin Jing some instructions, and then he left the cave dwelling.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: 230: Core Area, Investigating the Cleansing Spirit Pool_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 230: Core Area, Investigating the Cleansing Spirit Pool_2
Not until Senior Han had left,
did Lin Jing finally calm down and carefully sense the components of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid mixed within the Spiritual Energy.
The concentration of Spiritual Energy here was indeed much denser than that of the internal area.
Even the components of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid were much more concentrated.
However,
Lin Jing just felt it briefly,
and had a rough idea in his mind.
If he were to cultivate here, the possibility of enhancing his own Spiritual Root aptitude would still be far from enough.
Unless he could stay here for at least a few years, then there might be a slight possibility.
But now, Lin Jing only had two days.
It was far from enough.
Therefore,
to improve his Spiritual Root aptitude, he still needed to start with the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
It wasn’t long after Senior Han had left,
that Lin Jing once again entered the System Space.
This time,
because Lin Jing’s location was in the core area, closer to the Cleansing Spirit Pool,
he thought he should be able to observe the Cleansing Spirit Pool this time.
Afterwards,
Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode and started exploring.
This time, he did not indiscriminately watch the other cultivators’ caves,
but went straight deeper inside at a slow pace.
Following the passage, all the way in,
after some time, Lin Jing finally saw a Formation.
He controlled the viewpoint of Observation Mode and easily passed through the Formation, then arrived inside a very large cavern.
In the center of this cavern,
there was a huge stone column that extended directly to the ceiling of the cave.
The middle of this stone column was hollow.
The milky white Cleansing Spirit Liquid was in the hollow within the stone column.
Lin Jing then turned the observation viewpoint around, observing the entire cavern.
At this time, in this cavern,
there were three elders, spread out, standing guard in three directions of the cave.
These three elders…
should be the three Nascent Soul Elders sent by the three great Sects to guard the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Lin Jing learned from Senior Han,
that unless a major event occurred, these three Nascent Soul Elders would not leave this place.
After observing around,
Lin Jing controlled the observation viewpoint to continue forward.
First, he passed through a Defensive Array, and then he arrived at the edge of this stone column.
The protection of this Cleansing Spirit Liquid was truly rigorous.
Apart from the three Nascent Soul Elders, there were actually two layers of Formations for protection.
However,
Lin Jing under Observation Mode could completely ignore these.
Of course,
he also could not take away even a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid while in Observation Mode.
Afterward, Lin Jing looked towards the small pool formed by the hollow in the stone column.
He saw the inside of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
There wasn’t much Cleansing Spirit Liquid, if it were put into a wine cup, it probably wouldn’t even fill it up.
But just this little bit of Cleansing Spirit Liquid,
was guarded by the three great Sects as if it were a precious treasure.
With such strict defenses, even if Lin Jing wanted to steal it, it would hardly be possible.
Previously, Lin Jing had even thought about using the Fixed Point Teleportation function of the System Space to come here and take a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
But looking at the situation,
it was hardly possible.
Probably as soon as Lin Jing teleported here, before he could take the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, he would be discovered by the three Nascent Soul Elders and be killed with a direct slap.
And for him to obtain the Cleansing Spirit Liquid,
unless there was some special circumstance that caused the three Nascent Soul Elders to leave at the same time,
otherwise,
he didn’t even need to think about it.
Afterward,
Lin Jing once again controlled the observation viewpoint, and observed inside the cavern for a while.
However, he found no clues.
Lin Jing looked at the less than one small cup of Cleansing Spirit Liquid and fell into deep thought.
Just at that moment, a sudden flash of inspiration struck Lin Jing.
He suddenly thought,
Observation Mode is not limited by terrain.
And if he couldn’t get the Cleansing Spirit Liquid in this cave, then perhaps he could find the source that produced this Cleansing Spirit Liquid…
With that thought,
Lin Jing became somewhat excited.
Then,
he controlled Observation Mode to carefully inspect the stone column.
He wanted to see how the Cleansing Spirit Liquid was produced.
After observing for a while, he found no clues.
Lin Jing simply controlled the observation viewpoint and delved into the stone column.
As soon as he entered the stone column, Lin Jing’s heart sank.
Because,
inside the stone column, the viewpoint of Observation Mode was pitch black.
Just as if someone had blindfolded him, he couldn’t see anything.
Lin Jing didn’t give up.
He continued to delve deeper within the stone column.
He didn’t know how deep he had gone,
when once again a dark red light appeared in the darkness.
And,
this dark red light seemed to be moving.
Lin Jing couldn’t help thinking aloud,
“This dark red color…”
“Could it be that I’ve delved too deep and reached the magma?”
“But…”
“This isn’t a volcano vent, logically speaking, it should be far from reaching magma.”
Lin Jing then approached it a bit more and looked carefully, only to discover…
It turns out that this dark red light was actually a group of ants.
Lin Jing had stumbled upon an ant nest.
But it was unknown what kind of ants they were.
Their bodies even emitted a dark red glow.
Thanks to the light from these ants, Lin Jing could vaguely make out some scattered stones.
So this place was still within the rock layers.
Lin Jing was not interested in the ants.
He continued his exploration.
However.
This time, even at the maximum range of Observation Mode, Lin Jing discovered nothing.
Helpless.
Lin Jing had no choice but to exit Observation Mode temporarily.
After coming out of Observation Mode, Lin Jing left the System Space directly.
Sitting cross-legged on the stone bed in his cave dwelling, he pondered.
He tried to think of some other methods.
For a long while.
Lin Jing racked his brains to the point of a splitting headache but still couldn’t come up with a better method.
Unless, he was willing to risk his life.
If it came to risking his life, then there was no need.
Lin Jing indeed wanted to improve the quality of his Spiritual Root.
But it was not to the extent that he had to take such risks.
Moreover.
This risk-taking was right under the eyes of a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
Lin Jing then shook his head.
Having the System Space, even with a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root,
his cultivation would be much easier than for others.
To take such a risk, which was almost certainly fatal?
Absolutely unnecessary…
“It seems this matter can only be left to fate.”
“If in the future, I get the chance to obtain Cleansing Spirit Liquid, then we will see.”
“Who knows, maybe in the future, I can obtain this Cleansing Spirit Liquid from some other place.”
Thinking thus, Lin Jing slowly let go of his fixations.
Afterward.
Lin Jing temporarily put aside this matter and began cultivating once again.
This round of cultivation lasted another day.
Today marked the sixth day since Lin Jing arrived at this Cleansing Spirit place.
One more day and they would be leaving.
Although the core area was indeed much better than the inner area,
the concentration of Spiritual Energy still could not compare with that inside the System Space.
And the effects produced by the Cleansing Spirit Liquid factors contained within the Spiritual Energy were not very significant.
Perhaps it was because Lin Jing possessed a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root.
His absorption rate of Spiritual Energy was much slower than others.
That could be why.
Despite this.
Lin Jing still did not give up.
Afterward.
Lin Jing continued to sit in meditation and cultivate.
However…
This time, Lin Jing had not been meditating for long,
perhaps not even an hour,
when he was startled awake by a sudden jolt.
Lin Jing frowned and then began to think.
“Why would there be a sudden tremor in this place of Cleansing Spirit?”
“Something’s not right…”
Then.
Lin Jing stopped meditating, sat cross-legged on the stone bed, and waited for Senior Han’s arrival.
Because Lin Jing knew…
If something really happened,
Senior Han would definitely inform him at the first opportunity.
However…
This time Lin Jing waited for half an hour, but Senior Han did not come, and the abrupt tremor did not occur again.
Curiosity arose within Lin Jing.
Afterward…
He entered the System Space once again.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode.
He then controlled the perspective to continue his exploration.
Soon.
Lin Jing discovered the two disciples of the Qingyuan Sword Sect who had been guarding the entrance to the core area.
The two were walking down the corridor, just past the entrance of a cave dwelling.
The stone door of this cave dwelling was open, and a cultivator stuck his head out, asking them:
“Fellow disciples, what happened with the sudden tremor just now?”
Obviously…
This person too was awakened by the unexpected tremor.
“Greetings, Senior Brother…”
“Just now, at the very back of the caves, some low-level Ant Demon Beasts caused a boulder to dislodge and fall, creating the tremors.”
“An Elder has already gone to handle it, and it’s estimated that it will be resolved in a short while.”
“Senior Brother need not worry, you can continue your cultivation in peace.”
After hearing this, the cultivator nodded.
“So that’s what happened…”
“Thank you both, fellow disciples.”
Having said this,
he then returned to his cave dwelling to continue cultivating.
And Lin Jing, upon hearing this, furrowed his brows and pondered for a moment.
Afterward.
He continued his exploration going forward.
“Ant Demon Beasts?”
“Could it be the ones I saw earlier?”

chapters.title: Chapter 243: 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid
Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode, reaching the deepest part of the cave.
As soon as he entered the cave, Lin Jing noticed that it was different from the last time he had been there.
A giant boulder lay in the middle of the cave.
There were also many fragments of rock strewn about in disarray.
At the rear of the cave, there was a massive new opening.
Lin Jing clearly remembered that, on his last visit,
this opening did not exist.
It was obviously newly formed.
And inside that opening, a chilling wind howled, with intermittent piercing shrieks resonating within.
In the cave,
the three Nascent Soul Elders who were supposed to guard it were now down to two.
And the remaining two Nascent Soul Elders had ceased their meditation.
At the mouth of the new opening, they had erected a barrier of light.
Seemingly stabilizing the entire cave.
Driven by curiosity, Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode
and peered into the newly formed opening.
After a period of exploration,
the cave turned sharply downward.
Lin Jing continued his exploration following the descent.
With the faint light to guide him, Lin Jing looked at the cave walls and could barely make out
that the walls, as though hewn by axe and chisel, were irregular but smooth in some areas.
They didn’t appear to be naturally formed at all.
It seemed more like a passage carved out by some creature…
After observing for a while, Lin Jing continued his descent.
Soon…
he reached the bottom of the cave.
At this point, the bottom of the cave was much more spacious than before.
Lin Jing moved on,
and finally…
he saw someone.
It was the third Elder who had been guarding the cave with the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
At that moment,
a Flying Sword was positioned by his side, ready to strike at what lay opposite.
And opposite him was a huge Ant Demon Beast, shrieking fiercely and confronting him.
The Ant Demon Beast was dark red all over and glowed brightly.
Just like…
the Ant Demon Beasts Lin Jing had seen before.
Only this one was much larger, the size of a calf.
Besides this colossal ant, there were countless other Ant Demon Beasts within the cave.
Even behind the Ant Demon Beast, the entire cave was a dark red hue, which looked quite terrifying.
However,
the standoff between the man and the beast did not last long before conflict erupted.
The largest Ant Demon Beast leaped forward, charging straight at the Nascent Soul Elder.
But the Nascent Soul Elder simply raised his hand,
and a sea of flames burst forth, rushing toward the swarm of ants.
Countless Ant Demon Beasts were incinerated to ash by the flames,
and only a few managed to survive.
Even the surrounding rocks had begun to melt.
Indeed, befitting of a Nascent Soul Cultivator, the casually unleashed sea of flames was terrifyingly powerful.
Yet, despite this,
the largest Ant Demon Beast emerged from the sea of flames unimpeded,
with not a single mark on its body.
Once again, the Nascent Soul Elder extended his hand and pointed forward.
The previously poised Flying Sword, shimmering with dazzling light, surged towards the Ant Demon Beast.
“Clang!”
Upon contact with the Ant Demon Beast, the Flying Sword produced a sound like metal striking metal.
The Ant Demon Beast shrieked in pain, yet bore no wound on its body.
After shrieking, it continued its charge towards the Nascent Soul Elder.
Just as it was about to rush over…
Suddenly,
a tremendous palm shadow flew out, directly swatting the Ant Demon Beast away.
“Elder Yue, how goes it?”
A voice then emanated from behind the Elder.
Lin Jing subsequently shifted the Observation Mode perspective and looked behind.
He saw that it was one of the men who had previously been above.
The Elder who had been fighting with the Ant Demon Beast didn’t even turn his head and responded:
“This Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant seems to have reached its climate, and might be close to morphing. My fire-based Divine Sense has no effect on it.”
“Elder Li, this Demonic Beast is not easy to deal with…”
The Elder who had just arrived furrowed his brows and replied:
“I did not expect it to be this troublesome…”
As soon as Elder Li finished speaking, Elder Yue once again started to explain:
“This place is not like the others; we need to ensure that the Cleansing Spirit Liquid remains unaffected.”
“Therefore…”
“we should resolve this battle quickly.”
Elder Li nodded in agreement.
He took a step forward, ready to join Elder Yue and slay the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant.
Seeing their intent, the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant seemed to realize it was no match for the two of them.
After a shriek, it turned and fled into the depths of the cave.
At the same time, the remaining Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants that had survived the sea of flames charged at the two Elders.
As the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant attempted to escape, the two Elders gave chase without hesitation.
Meanwhile, the Devouring Spirit Ants were deemed inconsequential by the Elders.
Elder Yue then waved his hand, and a wave of Spiritual Power swept over.
The Devouring Spirit Ants burst apart…
Lin Jing had wanted to keep watching the battle,
but not long into his pursuit, the range of Observation Mode reached its limit and could not extend any further.
Feeling helpless,
Lin Jing had no choice but to return.
When Lin Jing regained control over the Observation Mode, returning to the cave, only one Elder remained on guard there.
This remaining Elder stood at the entrance, gazing inside,
seemingly using Divine Sense to detect any activity inside the cave.
Yet,
there was not the slightest change in his expression.
Clearly,
the battle inside was well in hand.
The two Nascent Soul Stage Elders facing the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant should have an easy victory.
After waiting a little longer…
just as Lin Jing was about to exit Observation Mode and return to his cultivation,

chapters.title: Chapter 244: 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid_2
Suddenly…
An unexpected change occurred.
“Boom!”
Within the cave, there came a loud noise, and the ground shook violently.
The Elder who had been guarding the entrance with an unfazed expression,
suddenly turned pale and subconsciously wanted to rush into the cave.
But it looked like he remembered something…
He stopped abruptly.
He then turned to glance at the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Immediately after…
he took out a humanoid stone automaton from his Space Ring and placed it at the entrance of the cave.
This stone automaton was grayish-green, holding a spear, and appeared somewhat damaged, like an ancient burial item from a tomb.
Just as Lin Jing was puzzled,
he saw the Elder’s lips move slightly and then he stretched out his hand, shooting out a beam of green light from his palm.
It struck directly at the automaton’s forehead.
In no time at all, the stone automaton opened its eyes.
Its eyes were blood-red, surveying the entire cave.
Then,
after setting down the automaton, the Elder recited an incantation, and the stone automaton began to slowly move its body.
Afterwards,
it started patrolling back and forth inside the cave,
as if it were a loyal guardian.
Having done all this,
the Elder didn’t hesitate and rushed into the cave, then disappeared from view.
At this moment,
the three Elders who had originally been guarding this place had all left.
Within the cave, only the stone automaton patrolling back and forth remained.
And…
Lin Jing, inside the System Space using Observation Mode, watching all of this unfold.
Of course…
There was also the extremely precious Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Faced with this sudden turn of events,
Lin Jing was initially stunned, but then became extremely excited.
Lin Jing had long thought about scenarios like this.
How to lure the three Grand Elders away and then steal the Cleansing Spirit Liquid for himself.
He just hadn’t expected…
that a sudden incident would cause all three Elders to leave.
Leaving behind only the Formation.
And that constantly patrolling stone automaton.
If the three Nascent Soul Stage Elders were present, Lin Jing wouldn’t dare make any rash moves.
Even if there were just one Nascent Soul Stage Elder here,
Lin Jing wouldn’t dare to make a move.
Because…
The gap in Cultivation was simply too great, and Lin Jing feared he would be killed instantly as soon as he appeared.
Even with the System Space, he wouldn’t have a chance to steal the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
But.
Now that all three Grand Elders had left,
only the automaton remained.
As for the automaton…
Lin Jing began to ponder.
According to one method he had previously considered…
After arriving here, he could directly use the System’s Fixed Point Teleportation feature to teleport inside the Defensive Array.
The Formation protecting the Cleansing Spirit Pool would presumably have very strong defenses.
However…
Lin Jing could use Fixed Point Teleportation to teleport directly inside the Formation.
Then,
no matter how strong the Formation, it would be useless against him.
Upon teleporting inside the Formation, Lin Jing could directly collect the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Lin Jing had even planned ahead.
He wouldn’t take much, just one or two drops would suffice.
The System Space definitely needed a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Only by first bringing a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid into the System Space could he initiate the environmental simulation of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
After taking the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, Lin Jing would use the System’s Fixed Point Teleportation to return to the previous cave dwelling.
In this way, everything would be seamless.
Nobody would notice a thing.
Except for that,
the patrolling stone automaton.
However…
Since the Nascent Soul Elder dared to use the stone automaton, it must be quite formidable.
If Lin Jing were to suddenly appear,
he had no doubt that the automaton would immediately attack him.
Now, the only thing Lin Jing was unsure about was,
just how formidable the automaton was.
Whether it could break through the Formation protecting the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Because according to Lin Jing’s plan, he was going to teleport directly inside the Formation,
he could certainly rely on the Formation protecting the Cleansing Spirit Liquid to shield himself.
As for the automaton…
After contemplating for a while longer,
Lin Jing decided to act.
Because…
even if the automaton was incredibly powerful and could break the Defensive Array, the Formation would still hold up for a while.
That amount of time…
would be enough for Lin Jing to retrieve the Cleansing Spirit Liquid and then hide back in the System Space.
At this time,
the ground trembled violently again.
And a huge hissing sound came from inside the cave.
Furthermore, this hissing was different from what Lin Jing had heard before, clearly it was another, even more powerful Redflame Devouring Spirit Ant.
The consecutive appearance of two powerful Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants meant one thing for certain…
In the depths of the cave,
the three Nascent Soul Elders must be in a fierce battle with the Devouring Spirit Ants.
Meanwhile, the rocks above the cave were falling continuously amidst the violent tremors…
With such a commotion,
it was likely that not only the core area but even the outer regions could clearly feel it.
Although Lin Jing was inside the System Space and unaware of the situation in the core area,
he also knew.
With such a major event, the people from the three Sects would definitely not sit idly by.
It probably wouldn’t be long before someone arrived at the cave to notify him.
Possibly,
there would be a need to evacuate from the land of the Cleansing Spirit.
Time waits for no one, and Lin Jing’s opportunity was now or never.
Afterwards…
Lin Jing made up his mind and took a gamble.
Lin Jing had thoroughly explored this cavern before and knew that there was no Shadow Capture Orb present.
However…
he didn’t know whether the Nascent Soul Elders had a similar divine ability to reconstruct the scene at that time.
For the sake of caution…
Lin Jing changed into different clothing within the System Space, also activated the Hidden Dragon Pendant of the Azure Moon to alter his appearance, form, and Cultivation aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 245: 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 231 Accident, Stealing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid_3
After completing all these preparations,
Lin Jing spoke directly:
“System, activate the Fixed Point Teleportation function.”
The Fixed Point Teleportation feature was not frequently used by Lin Jing.
But at special times, it was exceedingly useful.
Like now, Lin Jing could even teleport directly inside the Defensive Array.
Following that…
Lin Jing quickly selected the location.
The next moment,
his whole person appeared within the Formation guarding the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
As soon as Lin Jing appeared, he felt the difference in the Spiritual Energy at this place.
The Spiritual Energy here was so intoxicating that one breath made it irresistible to indulge in it.
At the same time,
Lin Jing also discovered that, within this formation,
for some reason his Divine Sense was being heavily suppressed.
However,
even so…
Lin Jing didn’t have the luxury to contemplate further and dared not delay any longer as he quickly turned his attention toward the Cleansing Spirit Pool, ready to take action.
At this moment…
The stone automaton also reacted.
The moment it saw Lin Jing, red light flickered in the stone automaton’s eyes and it charged towards him.
At the same time, it swung its spear.
A dark red light emanated from the tip of the spear, flying out toward Lin Jing within the Defensive Array.
Upon witnessing this, Lin Jing instinctively dodged to the side,
and then he hurriedly made his way to the edge of the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Looking at the Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside the pool, Lin Jing’s eyes couldn’t help but shine with excitement…
There and then, the Cleansing Spirit Liquid was right in front of him.
And at that moment, the red light struck directly upon the Defensive Array.
Indeed, this Array was extraordinary.
After being hit by the red light, the entire Array shook violently for a moment before returning to normal.
As expected…
Even though the stone automaton was formidable, it still couldn’t break through the Array.
Although the stone automaton failed to break the Array open,
its attack, however…
caused Lin Jing inside to stagger, almost falling, and numerous rocks also fell from the stone pillars inside.
This is testament to its formidable power.
Nevertheless…
Before Lin Jing could relax,
a furious shout suddenly came from the hole that had been breached.
“Who is there?”
Together with this voice…
came an extremely strong oppressive force, which was so intense that Lin Jing almost couldn’t catch his breath.
Evidently,
the commotion here had been noticed by the Nascent Soul Elder who was fighting with the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants.
Seeing this, Lin Jing didn’t dare to delay any further.
He walked up to the front of the Cleansing Spirit Pool.
Using his Spiritual Power, he enveloped the Cleansing Spirit Liquid to contain it.
Due to the special nature of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid and his suppressed Divine Sense, Lin Jing could only barely manipulate it.
He could extract only a single drop at a time.
However,
as soon as Lin Jing had enveloped the Cleansing Spirit Liquid and extracted it from the pool, it began to dissipate rapidly,
just in the time it took to remove it from the pool, the drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid had already diminished by nearly half.
Because previously Lin Jing did not know how fast the Cleansing Spirit Liquid would dissipate,
he hadn’t made adequate preparations in advance.
If Lin Jing wanted to bring this drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid back to System Space, considering the delay in summoning the System…
he feared that by the time he reached System Space, the drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid would have completely dissipated.
There wouldn’t be a trace left.
But…
since he had already extracted it, Lin Jing certainly couldn’t put it back.
He opened his mouth directly and ingested the drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Afterwards…
Lin Jing didn’t dare to linger; he could clearly sense the terrifying presence getting closer…
and the stone automaton
kept on attacking the Formation relentlessly.
Next,
Lin Jing mentally summoned the System in his heart.
“Host, please issue your command.”
After receiving the System’s response, Lin Jing thought silently:
“Enter…”
Then, once again using his Spiritual Power, he enveloped another drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, directly into his palm…
“…System Space.”
Having completed his silent incantation, Lin Jing’s entire being instantly disappeared from the cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 246: 232: The Nascent Soul Elder’s Conjecture
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 232: The Nascent Soul Elder’s Conjecture
However…
Lin Jing had just disappeared, less than a moment’s time had passed.
An elder at the Nascent Soul Stage appeared at the breached cave entrance.
At this time, his expression was somber as he slowly walked out of the broken cave.
He entered the cavern.
In this cavern, the only thing left was the stone automaton.
From Lin Jing’s appearance to his ultimate disappearance…
it might seem slow to speak of, but it happened very quickly, taking only a moment.
Aside from the initial attack, the stone automaton, just as it rushed to the formation, had only struck two or three times before Lin Jing vanished.
After Lin Jing’s disappearance.
The stone automaton also stopped there, motionless.
Unlike a human cultivator, it could only detect its enemy through their aura.
Now that Lin Jing had entered the System Space and his aura had disappeared with him, it naturally stayed put, unable to sense anything.
The elder who walked in with a gloomy face looked towards the central stone pillar.
This elder was the same one who had placed the stone automaton there before.
He had already left.
But while he was in the midst of the fiercest battle with the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants, he suddenly felt the stone automaton stir.
The stone automaton was a unique magical treasure he had acquired while adventuring through ancient relics in the past.
After refining it, it became attuned to his will, and any unusual movements of the automaton were immediately perceptible to him.
When he sensed the stone automaton stirring, he immediately deployed his Divine Sense to probe this area.
The range of a Nascent Soul Cultivator’s Divine Sense was truly vast.
Even while battling with the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants, they could easily sense into this cave.
As his Divine Sense penetrated the cave, he detected a strange presence beside the stone pillar within the formation.
He was taken aback at that moment.
Because…
The formation protecting the Cleansing Spirit Pool was no simple matter, even for him, it was difficult to break through in a short time.
Moreover.
To prevent other high-level cultivators from causing trouble,
the formation could also shield against Divine Sense.
Even the Divine Sense of a Nascent Soul Cultivator, after passing through this formation, would be greatly weakened.
Especially when probing from outside the formation to the inside…
The power of the formation was terrifying, and there was nothing that could be done except for faintly sensing a hint of a strange aura.
So…
This Nascent Soul elder had not directly discovered Lin Jing.
He had only sensed some strange aura.
And the abnormality of the stone automaton…
made him very certain that someone must have been here.
Following that.
He came to the side of the stone pillar, outside the formation.
He circled around the stone pillar, examining it.
Seeing the stones scattered on the ground, he was even more assured of his guess.
These stones were in fact the result of the stone automaton attacking the formation and the resulting fluctuations causing them to fall.
Afterwards.
He turned his gaze towards the Cleansing Spirit Pool, where the Cleansing Spirit Liquid was the most critical.
This Cleansing Spirit Pool was not large, and the Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside was extremely scarce, only about as much as a small wine cup.
The elder looked and saw that the Cleansing Spirit Liquid seemed as abundant as before, as if it hadn’t been touched at all.
Since Lin Jing was in a hurry, he only took away two drops.
Two drops, in the context of a whole cup of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, was still very little.
If one wasn’t looking carefully, it would be impossible to notice.
But this elder was clearly a very meticulous person.
After noticing nothing unusual about the Cleansing Spirit Pool at first glance, he did not immediately relax.
Instead, he moved in a bit closer.
He examined it closely once more.
Moments later…
He finished his observation.
And then he muttered to himself:
“It is indeed less, looking at it, this person only took one or two drops…”
“Not much…”
“However…”
“The formation has not been damaged, so how did he pass through the formation and enter inside?”
“And how did he…”
“To suddenly appear within such a short time and then disappear before I returned?”
Having said this, he walked around the stone pillar once more.
But he found nothing.
Then, furrowing his brow, he muttered to himself:
“To leave not a single trace behind…”
“Indeed, that is unfathomable.”
“Or perhaps…”
“This person has an extremely powerful Magical Treasure with instant teleportation capabilities…”
“And has been monitoring us all along.”
“That’s why they appeared and stole the Cleansing Spirit Liquid as soon as we left.”
The Elder looked down in contemplation, then raised his head to gaze at the broken entrance:
“So, was the appearance of the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants their doing, or was it an accident?”
A moment passed.
The Elder’s tightly knit brows finally relaxed:
“Regardless of the connection to the Redflame Devouring Spirit Ants, since he dares not to show himself openly, it is obvious that his Cultivation is not strong.”
“And furthermore…”
“It is very likely that he possesses an extremely powerful Magical Treasure…”
“I have already memorized his aura, should I encounter him again, he will certainly not escape.”
“Once I capture him, that mysterious Magical Treasure will be mine…”
Having finished speaking.
The Elder looked at the stone statue, then his lips moved slightly, reciting a long incantation.
The stone statue also returned to its previous state.
Continuing to patrol inside the cave.
Only after doing all of this did the Elder leave.
However, what he did not know.
Was that the aura of Cultivation on Lin Jing’s body was also fake.
All of it was a disguise created by the Hidden Dragon Pendant of the Azure Moon.
After the Hidden Dragon Pendant of the Azure Moon merged into one, its grade substantially increased, and its ability to conceal was incredibly strong, even capable of deceiving the Divine Sense of a Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator.
……
Lin Jing, having entered the System Space, was unaware of everything that happened in the cave.
Just as he entered the System Space, a system notification reached his ears.
“Ding.”
