Lin Jing then stood still, extended his Divine Sense to probe ahead, and remained on alert, ready for any sudden attacks from the ‘Murderous Tree’.
However, when his Divine Sense reached out, a giant tiger with white cloud patterns on its body stepped out from behind the tree.
The whole thing had been the work of this Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger.
This giant tiger had a strong presence, even stronger than the ape-shaped Demonic Beast Lin Jing had encountered when he first arrived on Immortal Crossing Island.
But it was still far less formidable than the Golden Giant Eagle.
Clearly, it was also a Golden Core Stage Demonic Beast.
At this moment, the giant tiger bared its teeth and fixed its gaze on Lin Jing, while crouching low, as if ready to attack at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 305: 7 The Winter Remedy for Hidden Parasite Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 7 The Winter Remedy for Hidden Parasite Grass
Lin Jing was momentarily taken aback.
This was the first time he had encountered a Demonic Beast that didn’t run away after seeing him.
Seeing the posture of the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger, it seemed that if he took another step forward, the giant tiger would pounce on him.
Upon observing this, Lin Jing was just about to retreat.
But then he suddenly realized something was off.
This Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger didn’t seem as majestic as he had imagined.
Although it was baring its teeth at Lin Jing.
Its body was slowly but surely moving backward, and the speed was so slow that one could easily overlook it if not paying attention.
Apart from that, the fur on its body was also trembling slightly.
At first, Lin Jing thought it was the wind blowing, but then he reconsidered.
That’s not right…
There wasn’t even a slight breeze near the stone wall; how could the fur on the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger flutter without any wind?
Clearly.
The giant tiger was trembling, and it seemed to be bluffing.
It seems that the aura of the Divine Phoenix feather made the giant tiger fearful as well, but for some reason, it did not flee right away.
Instead, it stood guard at the entrance of the cave.
“Could it be that there are cubs inside?” Lin Jing couldn’t help but wonder.
Thinking this, Lin Jing decided to test the situation.
If the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger was really bluffing, it would surely react the moment Lin Jing advanced.
If it was indeed planning to attack, then Lin Jing could also be prepared to dodge into the System Space at any moment.
No sooner thought than done.
Afterward, Lin Jing gathered his momentum, stepped forward, and confronted the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger.
However, when Lin Jing moved forward, the giant tiger on the opposite side took a step back with a low growl.
“This is promising…”
Seeing this, Lin Jing’s lips curled into a smile, and then he leaped forward, charging towards the giant tiger.
This move made the tightly guarded giant tiger suddenly retreat…
At the same time, its eyes were filled with horror, watching Lin Jing who was rushing over.
Just then, with a “plop,” the giant tiger stumbled and fell while retreating.
After that, it quickly got up, its four paws scratching the ground rapidly, and it turned around and fled along the rock wall.
The rocks on the rock wall were dug out by its sharp claws, leaving several deep claw marks.
The Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger, true to its Golden Core Stage, disappeared over the rock wall and into the dense forest ahead in the blink of an eye.
Only after the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger had disappeared did Lin Jing reach the entrance of the cave.
This time, Lin Jing had gambled correctly; the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger was indeed bluffing.
Next, Lin Jing looked into the cave, which seemed very deep.
With only a glimmer of light from outside the cave entrance, the inside was pitch-black.
With the Divine Phoenix feather with him, he didn’t have to worry about being ambushed.
So, Lin Jing decided to go inside and take a look.
He wanted to see what made the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger so afraid yet still unwilling to leave.
Though there were no Demonic Beasts, he still needed to be well-prepared to explore this mysterious cave.
Subsequently.
Lin Jing first cast a spell to illuminate the cave ahead, and after ensuring there were no dangers, he proceeded with caution, slowly making his way deeper into the cave.
The cave was very deep; it took Lin Jing the time it takes for an incense stick to burn to almost reach the end.
It was not until he got to the end of the cave that Lin Jing understood why the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger was unwilling to leave.
It turned out that a Fourth Rank Spirit Grass was growing inside the cave, and this Spirit Grass was on the verge of maturing.
All it needed was a little more time, and the Spirit Grass would be ready for the picking, but it was precisely at this moment that Lin Jing arrived…
No wonder the Cloud Patterned Giant Tiger had initially been so unwilling to leave.
Gazing upon this stalk of Spirit Grass, Lin Jing couldn’t help but burst with joy, for this Spirit Grass was none other than one of the auxiliary herbs needed to refine the Nirvana Elixir—Ganshiva Grass.
This discovery sent Lin Jing into a frenzy of elation.
After all, if there was one, there surely must be a second and a third stalk of High-Grade Spiritual Plants.
These Spiritual Plants were usually guarded by high-ranking Demonic Beasts, and naturally, Lin Jing wouldn’t think of encroaching on their turf.
However, now that he had the feathers of the Divine Phoenix, there was no Demonic Beast daring to obstruct him.
Such an unparalleled advantage was not to be squandered.
Lin Jing quickly made up his mind.
This time, he was going to pillage this dense forest to settle the score for the chase he had faced when he first arrived.
Next, Lin Jing looked at the Ganshiva Grass growing in the dark cave and decided not to wait for it to mature but to start harvesting it right away.
This Fourth Rank Spirit Plant would be safer in his own Spirit Field.
With utmost care, Lin Jing uprooted the Ganshiva Grass. To prevent damaging its roots and stems, Lin Jing also dug out the surrounding soil, mixed with broken rocks, and brought it all out.
“Enter System Space.”
Having uprooted the Ganshiva Grass, Lin Jing immediately summoned the System and entered the System Space.
Once in the System Space, Lin Jing couldn’t wait to get to the number one Spirit Field and planted the Ganshiva Grass.
After planting it, Lin Jing noticed that the Ganshiva Grass seemed a bit off…
Lin Jing then realized he had forgotten to check the optimal growing environment for the Ganshiva Grass.
“System, check the current status of the Spirit Plant.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, a panel appeared above the Ganshiva Grass.
Lin Jing looked towards the panel.
There, the details of the Ganshiva Grass were recorded on the panel.
Spirit Plant: Ganshiva Grass (Fourth Rank)
Current Environment: Uninhabited Mountains.
Environment Match: Incompatible, slowly growing; 4 years remain until maturity.
Indeed, the environment of the Uninhabited Mountains did not match that required for the growth of the Ganshiva Grass.
“It seems I need to open up a new Spirit Field and plant it there.”
Thinking this, Lin Jing dug up the Ganshiva Grass once more and found another Spirit Field to plant it.
At the same time.
Lin Jing used the environmental simulation feature of the System Space to create an environment suitable for the growth of the Ganshiva Grass.
Initially, Lin Jing had thought that the mismatch in the growth environment was due to the cave, but it was not until the environmental simulation was complete that he realized his current location, Immortal Crossing Island, was different from other places.
Immortal Crossing Island turned out to be a special Secret Realm.
Lin Jing had, somehow, been transferred from the Demon Race Secret Realm to another Secret Realm.
This discovery left Lin Jing incredibly frustrated.
However, now that he had arrived,
he could only stay put for the time being and then figure out how to find an exit to this Secret Realm.
After planting the Ganshiva Grass, Lin Jing exited the System Space.
……
Once outside, Lin Jing felt extremely refreshed.
In the cave, Lin Jing surveyed the area once more and, seeing no other Spiritual Plants,
he walked out of the cave.
Next.
Lin Jing prepared to embark on his journey of pillaging Spiritual Plants…

chapters.title: Chapter 306: 8: Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 8: Harvest
In Immortal Crossing Island, how many high-grade spiritual plants could be collected within a month?
Many people probably couldn’t answer that question.
But Lin Jing was an exception; he answered this question with his actions…
During this month, Lin Jing kept venturing deeper into the dense forest, which seemed like it had no end. Lin Jing walked for a month, yet there was still no change.
Of course, Lin Jing wasn’t continuously on the move; he traveled intermittently, exploring many places and collecting high-grade spiritual plants.
Throughout this month.
Lin Jing constantly paid attention to the lairs of Demonic Beasts and areas where peculiar trees grew.
Those places usually had some spirit plants growing around them, although they were not of a high rank.
That day, Lin Jing found a Biling Flower near a pond.
The Demonic Beast that had been guarding this place had run off without a trace before Lin Jing’s arrival.
Within this month, Lin Jing had harvested over a dozen Third Rank spirit plants and also found one Fourth Rank.
Now Lin Jing had gathered all the spiritual plants needed to concoct the Third Rank Elixir Medicine, Zengyuan Elixir.
Zengyuan Elixir was a Supreme Elixir that could enhance one’s Cultivation at the Golden Core Stage.
With the Zengyuan Elixir, Lin Jing could rapidly increase his cultivation while at the Golden Core Stage.
Besides the Zengyuan Elixir, the other type meant for quick recovery of spiritual power during battle, the Yellow Dragon Elixir, lacked only the main ingredient, Yellow Dragon Spirit Grass, to complete the collection.
Having obtained so many rare spiritual plants, naturally, Lin Jing couldn’t contain his joy.
To obtain more high-grade spiritual plants, and also to explore a potential way out, Lin Jing continued to venture deeper into the dense forest.
Just how vast this forest was remained unknown; so far, Lin Jing felt as if he was still at the peripheral areas of the dense forest.
Then.
Two more days passed, and after climbing over a mountain,
Lin Jing finally noticed some changes up ahead.
A transparent Curtain of light, reaching the sky, enveloped the area in front.
Its presence seemed to divide the entire dense forest into two parts.
Lin Jing stood atop the mountain, looking down.
He saw that the dense forest behind the transparent Curtain appeared incredibly quiet, to the extent that even the traces of small Demonic Beasts were gone.
And within the range that Lin Jing could see, several rare Second Rank spirit plants were growing nonchalantly.
The fact that no Demonic Beast had collected them was indeed strange.
Spirit plants were not only beneficial to Human Cultivators, but also to Demonic Beasts; within the dense forest, many beasts specifically searched for spirit grass to consume and thereby increase their strength.
And those more powerful Demonic Beasts, already possessing a nascent intelligence, would even find some high-grade spiritual plants that were about to mature and guard them, becoming the guardians of that spirit plant.
They knew that only by consuming these high-grade spiritual plants after they had matured, could they reap the greatest benefits.
If even the Second Rank spirit plants here were already visible everywhere,
Then wouldn’t there be numerous Third Rank, or even Fourth Rank high-grade spiritual plants?
Thinking of this, Lin Jing decided to venture into the Curtain of light to investigate further.
Next, Lin Jing descended the mountain.
Having arrived at the base of the mountain, Lin Jing approached the Curtain. He channeled his spiritual power, covering his hand, and reached out to test the Curtain.
However, to Lin Jing’s surprise…
His hand passed right through the Curtain without any sense of resistance, as if the Curtain didn’t exist at all.
Lin Jing immediately felt puzzled.
He then picked up a pebble and threw it in.
It turned out to be true; the pebble, not infused with any spiritual power, also passed right through as if the Curtain were non-existent.
When the pebble landed on the ground, nothing out of the ordinary happened.
After probing the situation, Lin Jing decided to attempt an entry himself.
He first used spiritual power to form a spiritual shield, protecting himself before stepping in.
As soon as he entered, Lin Jing noticed that the spiritual energy inside the light screen was much denser than outside, and the air was filled with an ancient, decayed smell.
It was as if this forest had existed for many years and had begun to decay.
Moreover, there was a kind of indescribable element within this spiritual power, and when Lin Jing tried to sense it carefully, he couldn’t feel anything at all.
However, there didn’t seem to be any danger here.
After confirming the absence of danger, Lin Jing retracted his spiritual shield and cautiously continued deeper.
He first arrived by the mature Second Rank spirit plants, harvested their fruits, and then proceeded forward.
There seemed to be even fewer Demonic Beasts here.
Lin Jing walked a great distance without encountering any traces of Demonic Beasts’ movements.
However, he didn’t come across any Third Rank or higher spirit plants either.
There were quite a few Second Rank spirit plants, some of which had ripened and fallen to the ground to rot, untouched by any Demonic Beasts.
This made Lin Jing begin to wonder.
“Could it be that there are no Demonic Beasts here?”
After his moment of doubt, Lin Jing continued to explore further, and the deeper he went, the more desolate it seemed.
Moreover, the spiritual energy was becoming denser.
Unconsciously, Lin Jing had been walking for several hours, and night had fallen, darkening the skies.
However.
Just then, a strong aura suddenly came from the sky along with a shadow that flashed across.
Lin Jing looked up, but could only see a blur as, in the dark of night, the shadow was extremely difficult to spot.
However, the terrifying presence it emitted was not to be underestimated.
This presence was almost akin to that of the Golden Giant Eagle he had encountered before.
Clearly, it was at least a Nascent Soul Level Demonic Beast.
The shadow disappeared in the blink of an eye, seemingly without noticing Lin Jing’s presence.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing decided to rest here for a while. Although he had the protective feather of the Divine Phoenix, facing a Demonic Beast that vanished without a trace into the night, Lin Jing was for the moment unsure.
“Enter the System Space.”
Following that, Lin Jing entered the System Space.
Once inside the System Space, it was suddenly bright, and Lin Jing took a moment for his eyes to adjust back to normal.
In the Spirit Field at the very front, the high-grade spirit plants that Lin Jing had planted were growing vigorously.
Several of these high-grade spirit plants in the Spirit Field had been snatched from the Demonic Beasts over the past month.
For safety, Lin Jing decided to spend the night in the System Space.
And during this time, it was a good opportunity for him to cultivate.
……
The next day, Lin Jing timed his exit from the System Space just as dawn was breaking, and he continued on his journey.
He traveled for another half a day.
Half a day later, while Lin Jing was walking through the dense forest, he heard a faint sound of eagles and owls.
At the same time, a chaotic and violent aura surged through the forest. Although it was a distance away, Lin Jing could still feel it.
Lin Jing touched the Divine Phoenix feather sachet hanging in front of his chest and then decided to continue deeper into the forest.
To see what the situation ahead was.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: 9: Eternal Life Vine
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 9: Eternal Life Vine
Continuing deeper into the dense forest, Lin Jing had been walking for nearly four hours,
finally arriving at the place where that aura originated.
At this moment, Lin Jing stood beside a giant tree hundreds of meters tall, looking ahead…
In the sky in front of him, two Demonic Beasts were engaged in battle.
One of them was the Golden Giant Eagle he had seen before, while the other was a Black Hawk roughly the same size as the eagle, with a body of pitch black.
The two Demonic Beasts were fighting fiercely in the air.
The shrill cries of the eagle and the mournful hoots of the hawk kept sounding…
Every time the giant eagle spread its wings and flapped, visible black hurricanes howled into existence, uprooting the massive trees hundreds of meters tall.
After dodging the hurricane, the Black Hawk released countless black feathers, like numerous sharp swords, which shot towards the Golden Giant Eagle.
In a short time, they pierced the eagle, leaving it with numerous wounds.
However, the eagle, far from being disheartened by its injuries, seemed to become even more enraged, creating more of those terrifying hurricanes as if its life depended on it.
In an instant, several hurricanes surrounded and trapped the Black Hawk.
Seeing the danger, the hawk quickly ascended, trying to evade the enclosing hurricanes.
Very quickly.
The hawk took flight, soaring up towards the clouds.
However, the Golden Giant Eagle followed closely behind, determined not to let it escape, and thus, the two Demonic Beasts disappeared into the clouds.
Perhaps because Lin Jing was too far away, the two Demonic Beasts did not notice him, nor did they detect the Divine Phoenix Aura emanating from him.
After the two Demonic Beasts had left, Lin Jing looked forward again, to see that the battlefield they had left behind was totally devastated.
Not one of the trees and rocks remained intact.
Lin Jing’s gaze continued into the distance, where he saw a lake, and at the center of the lake, an island.
What caught Lin Jing’s attention was the colorful light shield enveloping the island at the center of the lake.
The island quickly piqued Lin Jing’s interest, for there might be something valuable on it.
Lin Jing then decided to move closer and observe.
If there was no danger, he would find a way to make a trip to the island.
Afterward, Lin Jing set off and walked forward.
However, he had not gone far.
“Plop!”
A drop of liquid fell from the sky, landing on Lin Jing’s shoulder.
Then a strong smell of blood reached him, invading his nostrils. Touching his shoulder, Lin Jing felt something sticky.
Bringing his hand to his face to look, he realized that the drop on his shoulder was actually fresh blood.
Lin Jing then looked up towards the sky.
But the clouds obscured his vision, and he couldn’t see anything.
Just then, it seemed that an object was falling from the sky.
Lin Jing watched as the object descended and furrowed his brow slightly.
As the object drew closer to Lin Jing, he realized that it seemed to be a branch-like object falling towards his location.
Seeing where the branch was falling, Lin Jing moved a couple of steps and reached out his hand to steadily catch the falling branch.
Then.
Lin Jing brought the branch up to his face to take a closer look.
The branch-like object was entirely grey but didn’t entirely resemble a branch; it had a few tendrils here and there, more like a vine.
It was just a small segment of the whole.
Lin Jing flipped it over to observe the vine, noticing that the cut at the end of the vine was uneven, as if bitten by something. He guessed it must be the work of one of those two Demonic Beasts.
And from the mid-section break of the vine, a green liquid was oozing out. Lin Jing reached out to touch it and found the liquid to be slightly sticky…
Lin Jing then brought his hand close to his nose to smell, the liquid had a faint fragrance.
After careful observation, he felt the branch seemed familiar, as if he had seen it somewhere before, but he couldn’t quite recall where at the moment.
Just then, the sound of eagles screeching pierced the air once again, and that wild aura came from the sky above.
It was at that moment.
Suddenly, a piece of information from a book popped into Lin Jing’s mind.
Lin Jing looked down at the vine in his hands in disbelief, his face showing surprise.
Because.
He finally knew what he was holding…
The Eternal Life Vine.
The main ingredient for refining Lifespan Extension Pills, the Eternal Life Vine.
This was something he had come across in one of Elder Yu’s books.
The characteristics of the Eternal Life Vine described in the book were identical to the branch in front of him, overall gray, with roots…
Most importantly, the ink-green liquid and its fragrant smell made Lin Jing certain that this was the Eternal Life Vine.
However, before Lin Jing could store away the Eternal Life Vine,
two dots had already appeared in the sky.
Along with them, the sound of eagles screeching once more…
The two Demonic Beasts, radiating a terrifying aura, dived down directly from above, rushing toward where Lin Jing was.
It was clear that these two Demonic Beasts were coming to snatch the Eternal Life Vine.
Their battle was likely due to the same reason.
Lin Jing saw the ferocity of the two Demonic Beasts and knew they meant no good, it seemed that the aura emitted by the Divine Phoenix feather had no effect on them.
Just as Lin Jing was about to enter the System Space to avoid the two Demonic Beasts,
a sudden change occurred.
The two Demonic Beasts, in the midst of their dive, suddenly halted, then frantically flapped their wings to stabilize their posture.
By now, they were not too far from Lin Jing.
Concentrating Spiritual Power in his eyes, Lin Jing could clearly see the panic and disbelief in their eyes, as well as the unmistakable color of fear they couldn’t conceal.
It seemed that the might of the Divine Phoenix carried by the feather did have an effect on the beasts, after all; they just hadn’t felt it from a distance before.
Now that they were closer to Lin Jing, they had finally sensed it.
Seeing this, Lin Jing discarded the idea of retreating into the System Space.
Having obtained the Eternal Life Vine, these two Demonic Beasts certainly wouldn’t let him off easily.
If he entered the System Space, they would surely lie in wait for him here.
Lin Jing would rather use the Divine Phoenix feather to scare them away.
After halting their dive, the two Demonic Beasts quickly flew to one side, each landing on a tree, maintaining a certain distance from Lin Jing and vigilantly watching him.
Lin Jing responded with equal vigilance towards the two Demonic Beasts.
If the Demonic Beasts made any unusual moves, Lin Jing would enter the System Space immediately.
Although the two Demonic Beasts were somewhat restless, they all greedily gazed at the Eternal Life Vine in Lin Jing’s hands.
Then, when looking at Lin Jing again, their small eyes were filled with suspicion.
Clearly, these two Demonic Beasts had gained a certain level of intelligence. Although they were daunted by the aura emanating from Lin Jing and dared not make any rash moves, they were also well aware of Lin Jing’s level of Cultivation.
These two Demonic Beasts were not as easily deceived as other Demonic Beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: 10 The Terrifying Old Ape
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 10 The Terrifying Old Ape
Lin Jing stood in standoff with the two Demonic Beasts before him.
He could clearly see that the two Demonic Beasts were not as composed as they seemed, their eyes filled with vigilance as they stared intently at the sachet on Lin Jing’s chest.
The aura emanating from within caused them to feel a fear that seemed to originate deep within their bones.
It was a suppression of their bloodline, something they could not avoid, even after gaining a modicum of wisdom.
And in this man’s hands was the very object they had both been vying for.
The two beasts understood that the vine was of great use to them, yet now it was in that person’s possession.
For the moment, Lin Jing also found himself unsure of what to do next.
He took in the fear in the eyes of the Demonic Beasts and their greed for the Eternal Life Vine one by one.
At this point, even if he wanted to back down, it was no longer possible.
Lin Jing said nothing further and, in front of the two beasts, directly removed the homemade sachet from his chest.
After the sachet was removed, the two beasts shrank back a bit more, and Lin Jing clearly saw that they seemed even more afraid.
Seeing this, Lin Jing decided to go all in and directly opened the sachet, taking out the Divine Phoenix feather from inside.
However.
When they saw the feather, the fear in the eyes of the beasts finally overcame their greed, and they beat a hasty retreat backwards, frenzied.
Eventually, after two shrill cries of alarm, the two beasts flew off into the sky simultaneously.
After the two beasts had left, only Lin Jing, who had just breathed a sigh of relief, remained at the scene.
With the departure of the beasts, Lin Jing came to understand the limits of the Divine Phoenix feather.
If he were to encounter higher-level, more formidable Demonic Beasts, the Divine Phoenix feather probably wouldn’t work.
Because, the higher the tier of the Demonic Beast, the greater its wisdom.
Lin Jing was currently just bluffing with the Divine Phoenix feather; if the Demonic Beasts didn’t fall for it, he would truly be in mortal danger.
Higher-tier Demonic Beasts with wisdom would naturally distinguish Lin Jing’s true level of Cultivation and see through his bluff.
The two beasts he’d encountered were simply overawed by the bloodline suppression of the Divine Phoenix feather and thus didn’t dare to act recklessly.
Having realized this, Lin Jing immediately decided not to venture further into the area.
It was better to leave this place as quickly as possible.
As for the small island in the lake ahead, Lin Jing no longer had any interest in exploring it.
Having finished his deliberation, Lin Jing repacked the sachet and then turned around, leaving the place to head outside.
However, just as Lin Jing had started to leave, he hadn’t walked more than a few steps…
Suddenly.
Without sound or warning, a Demonic Beast appeared in mid-air.
A Demonic Beast that was not large in size.
This beast, similar in size to a human, resembled an old monkey. It appeared immensely aged, hunched over like an elderly human, leaning on a walking stick, its feet hovering above the ground without any Magical Treasure, simply standing in the vacuum of space.
Not a hint of aura emanated from its body.
As if it had never existed at all.
Upon seeing this old monkey, Lin Jing instantly broke out in a cold sweat.
When had this old monkey appeared? He hadn’t noticed it at all.
Although there wasn’t a trace of aura from the other party, Lin Jing didn’t dare to let his guard down in the slightest.
It was precisely the absence of aura that made Lin Jing feel the true terror of this old monkey.
Then, the old monkey made its move.
It reached out its hand, and Lin Jing’s sachet flew up, aiming to float towards the old monkey.
But just at that moment, something unexpected happened.
The sachet suddenly exploded, revealing the Divine Phoenix feather within.
At that moment, the Divine Phoenix feather was ablaze with burgeoning flames. Within those flames, the feather slowly grew larger.
And then, it actually transformed into the illusion of a nine-colored, resplendent phoenix, no…
It was the illusion of a Divine Phoenix…
The Divine Phoenix silhouette circled above Lin Jing’s head, then transformed into a streak of light, rushing into Lin Jing’s brow.
Subsequently, a tiny Divine Phoenix Mark formed at Lin Jing’s brow.
A moment later, even the Divine Phoenix Mark vanished without a trace, as if it had never appeared.
The old ape opposite retracted its hand, stared intently at Lin Jing, and asked,
“The legendary Divine Phoenix hasn’t appeared for millions of years. How come you have a Divine Phoenix Feather bestowed by it?”
Lin Jing felt a force locking onto him, aware that any slight movement of his own would be detected by it.
Lin Jing understood that if he didn’t answer this question well, it was very likely that the old ape would slay him on the spot.
Therefore, Lin Jing didn’t hide anything and directly answered,
“I lived with her for a while, and this Divine Phoenix Feather was given to me when she was about to leave.”
As Lin Jing spoke, the old ape kept its eyes fixed on Lin Jing; only after Lin Jing finished speaking did the old ape nod slightly.
The old ape nodded at Lin Jing and said,
“Hmm…”
“I can tell that you are not lying.”
After speaking, it immediately followed up with a sigh,
“Perhaps Immortal Crossing Island has been isolated from the world for too long, to the point that even the rebirth of the Divine Phoenix has gone unnoticed by us.”
Then, it sized up Lin Jing with a slightly disdainful expression,
“Your Cultivation…”
“Is really too low.”
Facing the disdain of the fearsomely powerful old ape, Lin Jing had no solution but to say,
“Um…”
“I was just lucky enough to encounter a Divine Phoenix who was concealing her identity and undergoing trials.”
The old ape nodded again and continued,
“Indeed.”
“The fact that you were able to spend time with the legendary Divine Phoenix is truly an incredible stroke of luck.”
“However…”
At this point, the old ape’s tone shifted before continuing,
“You’ve received the protection of the Divine Phoenix, and ordinarily, I could have spared your life, but you not only intruded upon Immortal Crossing Island but also stole the treasures that belong to us.”
“Tell me…”
“What should we do about this?”
As the old ape said this, Lin Jing felt a mysterious and horrifying aura strike toward him unexpectedly.
However, though the aura was frightening, when it came upon him, it didn’t exert too much pressure, and the old ape opposite showed no sign of any action.
Lin Jing knew that this surely meant the old ape had held back.
It seemed the situation was negotiable after all; the old ape was probably just showcasing its strength to intimidate him.
Otherwise, it would have attacked already.
Confronted by the old ape whose level of cultivation was unknown, Lin Jing hurriedly lowered his stance, bowed to the old ape ahead, and said,
“I would appreciate the elder’s guidance…”
As he spoke, Lin Jing even took out the freshly acquired Eternal Life Vine from his hand and passed it over.
Although it was somewhat painful to give it up, faced with this predicament,
When it’s time to bow, one must bow.
Lin Jing certainly didn’t want to provoke this terrifying old ape over the Eternal Life Vine and risk his own life.
After all, his own life was of the utmost importance.
The old ape looked at Lin Jing, nodded slightly, but did not take the Eternal Life Vine. Instead, it said to Lin Jing,
“You do a task for me, and I will not only spare your life but also gift you this Eternal Life Vine.”

chapters.title: Chapter 309: 11 Little Gold and Little Black
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 11 Little Gold and Little Black
“Senior, what would you have me do for you?” Lin Jing bowed with his hands clasped and asked the old ape.
“Do you see that small island over there?” the old ape pointed at the small island in the middle of the lake and inquired.
Lin Jing looked towards the small island ahead and nodded.
Following that, the old ape spoke:
“I would like you to help me ripen a Spirit Plant on that island.”
“Ripen a Spirit Plant?”
Lin Jing was quite puzzled; he did not understand how one could ripen a Spirit Plant artificially.
“Don’t worry, ripening this Spirit Plant will not harm you. On the contrary, it will be beneficial for you, it will just take some of your time,” the old ape reassured.
“Are you willing?”
The old ape looked at Lin Jing as he asked this.
“Senior, I am willing,” Lin Jing replied.
After all, faced with the old ape, Lin Jing didn’t even have the capital to resist; if he refused, who knows what might happen.
The old ape nodded, then descended from mid-air and landed in front of Lin Jing, saying:
“Good.”
“Then, put away the Eternal Life Vine and follow me. When I say I will give it to you, I mean it, and I will not go back on my word.”
“Also, from now on you can just call me Senior Ape.”
“Alright, Senior Ape,” Lin Jing responded.
Afterward, Lin Jing put away the vine and followed the old ape, moving forward.
The primary reason why Lin Jing had continued to trust Senior Ape was in fact the most crucial detail.
That is, Senior Ape had never revealed any intent to kill him, not from the beginning to the end.
The system’s warning also remained silent.
Even at the very start, when he had been threatening him, there was likewise no lethal intent.
Thus, Lin Jing came to realize:
Perhaps in consideration of the Divine Phoenix, or maybe because the task of ripening the Spirit Plant that he had mentioned was too important, Senior Ape did not presently wish to harm Lin Jing.
And Lin Jing should be safe for now as well.
Following the old ape, Lin Jing walked straight ahead until he arrived at the edge of the lake.
Only when he got closer did Lin Jing notice the extremely magnificent Spirit Tree on the small island in the middle of the lake.
This tree consisted of five differently colored root systems, intertwining and rising to the very top of the tree.
At the top grew branches and leaves of five different colors.
In the very center of that treetop was a small tree crown made up of the five-colored branches and leaves, and at its apex grew a fruit, possessing all five colors.
The fruit was round and extraordinarily plump, with a seemingly dripping luster. Its five colors intertwined and circled around it, making it breathtakingly beautiful to behold.
Senior Ape pointed at the exceedingly beautiful Spirit Tree on the island ahead and said:
“That is the Five Elements Spirit Tree, the one I plan for you to ripen. You just need to ripen the Five Elements Spirit Fruits on it, and that will be all.”
Having said this, a surge of power erupted from the old ape, who then soared into the sky, carrying Lin Jing with him, enveloped in his Spiritual Power, and flew towards the small island in the lake.
At the same time, he did not forget to explain to Lin Jing:
“This lake may appear tranquil, but in reality, it is protected by a special prohibition, and one cannot normally fly over it. Furthermore, there is great danger lurking in its depths.”
“With your level of cultivation, if you were to fall into these waters, you would likely become bones in an instant.”
Lin Jing, looking down at the waters below, couldn’t help sweating profusely.
He had previously thought about flying over the lake to take a look at the island.
If he really had done so, he probably would have been reduced to a skeleton by now.
Lin Jing quickly said to the old ape, “Thank you for the warning, Senior Ape.”
The old ape did not pay heed to Lin Jing and continued to explain:
“Once you are on the island, do not wander off. Even if you wish to leave, let Little Gold and Little Black carry you out.”
“The two of them, you’ve already met before…”
Upon saying this, Lin Jing instantly understood that the eagle and the owl must be Little Gold and Little Black.
“Yes, I understand now.”
As they spoke, the Elder Ape had already led Lin Jing to the front of the light screen on the island.
With a wave of his hand, the Elder Ape tore open a hole in the light screen and immediately flew through it with Lin Jing.
After they entered, the hole in the light screen behind them slowly healed itself.
“Little Gold, Little Black…”
Upon reaching the island, the Elder Ape began calling out.
After calling out, the Elder Ape landed with Lin Jing next to the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
Soon, two exceedingly well-behaved and enormous raptors descended from the sky: it was the Golden Giant Eagle and the black owl from the previous altercation.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, the two raptors’ eyes opened wide, and then, as if frightened, they quickly hid behind the Elder Ape.
However, given their considerable size, even when curled up, they stood several meters tall, barely finding refuge behind the Elder Ape, who was only as tall as an average person.
In doing so, they inadvertently added a touch of comedy to the scene.
The Elder Ape was quite speechless at the behavior of the two beasts.
Turning around, he slammed his staff into the ground and scolded:
“You two, can’t you be a bit more ambitious?”
“Quarreling in the nest, you’re quite fierce. But now, merely at the sight of the Divine Phoenix Aura, you’re scared to this extent…”
The two beasts hung their heads, listening to the Elder Ape’s reprimand.
Then, the Elder Ape turned back to Lin Jing and asked:
“I still don’t know, what is your name?”
Lin Jing hurriedly clasped his hands in salute and replied:
“Senior, my name is Lin Jing.”
The Elder Ape nodded, then turned to the two beasts and said:
“This is Lin Jing. When I’m not here, you must protect him and not bully him.”
“If I come back and find out you’ve bullied him, watch out. I will discipline you thoroughly when I return.”
Upon hearing this, the two beasts shivered and swiftly shook their heads.
“Also, you two stop fighting. The Eternal Life Vine, I’m giving it to Lin Jing. I’m going inside this time to find some other Spirit Fruits suitable for you to consume,”
“Each of you will have some, so there’ll be no need to fight over them anymore.”
As the Elder Ape finished speaking, the two beasts couldn’t help looking at him, their eyes shining with eagerness.
However, the Elder Ape paid them no mind.
He then turned to Lin Jing and said:
“Soon, I’ll be going into the heart of Immortal Crossing Island to find a cultivation technique for you, which will be required to ripen the Spirit Plants.”
“This trip will take a few days, so you should cultivate here during this time. Little Gold and Little Black, I’ve already told them, and they will not harm you.”
“Alright, Senior Ape,” Lin Jing responded.
After the Elder Ape had finished instructing Lin Jing and gave one last command to Little Gold and Little Black, he soared into the air and left the island.
Once the Elder Ape had gone, the two beasts cocked their heads and looked at Lin Jing.
Perhaps the Elder Ape’s words had taken effect, for the two beasts no longer seemed as scared when looking at Lin Jing.
And Lin Jing, facing two huge creatures,
and considering that they were Nascent Soul Stage titans, still felt somewhat afraid inside.
After all, he was just a Junior Cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Stage; in a real fight, he wouldn’t be enough to fill the gap between their teeth.
However, the current docile demeanor of the two beasts considerably lessened Lin Jing’s fear for them.
In the coming days,
Lin Jing planned to communicate well with the two beasts…

chapters.title: Chapter 310: 12 The Secret of Immortal Crossing Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 12 The Secret of Immortal Crossing Island
After spending five days on the small island, Lin Jing had gotten quite familiar with the two beasts.
He had finally figured out their personalities.
Little Jin and Little Hei, the two beasts, couldn’t really be treated as Nascent Soul Demonic Beasts; although their strength was extraordinary, their intelligence was only about the same as Little Sparrow’s.
Sometimes they were even less clever than Little Sparrow.
And furthermore.
They couldn’t speak, and often acted like small children, especially after Lin Jing had once used Divine Phoenix feathers to scare them.
During the time they spent with Lin Jing, after gradually getting used to him and realizing he posed no threat, they often played pranks on him.
This left Lin Jing quite speechless.
He wanted to fight, but he couldn’t beat them…
He could only outsmart the two beasts with his intelligence, keeping himself from being at a disadvantage.
Fortunately, the two beasts followed the old ape’s orders and did not harm him.
It was not until the fifth day that the old ape returned.
However, the Cultivation Technique the old ape handed to Lin Jing left him stunned.
Because the technique he brought back was the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
The old ape held the technique and handed it to Lin Jing.
Seeing Lin Jing just standing there in a daze, it reminded him,
“Take it, if you want to cultivate the Five Elements Spirit Tree, you must practice this Immortal Five Elements Technique.”
Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling a bit embarrassed, and then he spoke to the old ape,
“Senior Ape…”
“I don’t mean to hide it from senior, but the technique I am practicing is exactly this Immortal Five Elements Technique.”
As the words left Lin Jing’s mouth, the old ape was also stunned, while behind him, Little Jin and Little Hei were squatting quietly on the ground, watching the two of them.
“……” The old ape was momentarily at a loss for words.
It never expected Lin Jing was practicing the Immortal Five Elements Technique, so it had gone to the trouble of finding this very technique.
If it had known earlier, it wouldn’t have had to go through so much effort.
Moreover, to exchange for this technique, it had to offer up many valuable heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Originally, it only wanted the first few volumes.
But that old friend it had known for many years insisted on trading the whole set.
For the sake of the Five Elements Spirit Fruits, the old ape had no choice but to grit its teeth and agree.
For this, it paid much more than it wanted to in spirit plants and spirit fruits, which pained it greatly.
After a long while.
The old ape spoke again to Lin Jing,
“Let me see your technique then”
Lin Jing then took the Immortal Five Elements Technique out of his Storage Bag and handed it to the old ape.
After receiving the Immortal Five Elements Technique, the old ape started to flip through it…
Quite some time passed.
The old ape finished reviewing and handed Lin Jing’s Immortal Five Elements Technique back to him.
Then it reached out its hand and grabbed Lin Jing’s wrist, saying to him,
“Run the technique so I can see it.”
Lin Jing nodded, calmed himself down, and began running the Immortal Five Elements Technique right away.
“All right, stop.”
After a short while, the old ape let go of Lin Jing’s wrist and then spoke,
“I didn’t expect you to be a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root.”
“Yes, senior…” Lin Jing said.
The old ape nodded, then continued,
“A Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root is a perfect match for practicing this Immortal Five Elements Technique, and if you were to hasten the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Fruits, it would be even faster.”
“Originally, I thought it would take you at least a few years,” he said contently as he looked at Lin Jing, and then he added, “Now it seems, in less than a year, you could fully mature the Five Elements Spirit Fruits.”
After speaking, he looked at Lin Jing with satisfaction and said:
“Come, let me teach you how to do it.”
“Okay…” Lin Jing nodded.
Then, the old ape led Lin Jing to the side of the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
Next, the old ape waved his hand, and a Formation appeared out of thin air beside the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
After that, he spoke to Lin Jing:
“You don’t have to do much, just cultivate within this Formation, and at the same time, infuse the Spiritual Power you cultivate into this Formation.”
“This Formation is connected to the Five Elements Spirit Tree. I need you to use the Spiritual Power cultivated by the Immortal Five Elements Technique to be absorbed by the tree, and then form a cycle…”
“This way, it could foster the growth of the Five Elements Spirit Tree.”
“Senior Ape, why must it be the Immortal Five Elements Technique? Won’t other cultivation techniques work?” Lin Jing looked at the Five Elements Spirit Tree and voiced his doubt.
“Of course…” said the old ape.
“The Spiritual Power cultivated through the Immortal Five Elements Technique is the most balanced. The Spiritual Power needed by the Five Elements Spirit Tree also requires a balance of five attributes, which perfectly matches the nature of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.”
“If other cultivation techniques were used, the absorption of the five attributes would not be balanced, which could potentially hinder the growth of the Five Elements Spirit Tree.”
“Even worse, it could lead to an imbalance of the five elements in the tree, resulting in its direct death.”
With the old ape’s explanation, Lin Jing understood as well.
Afterward.
Following the old ape’s signal, Lin Jing stepped into the Formation.
At that moment, the old ape continued:
“Oh, I forgot to tell you…”
“When you cultivate here for a certain period, the Spiritual Power of the Formation will reach an overflow state. If it reaches that state, you can come out and take a break.”
“Of course, you can also use the Spiritual Power here to nourish your body.”
“You have a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root. Using the Spiritual Power surrounding the Five Elements Spirit Tree to nourish your body will greatly benefit you in the future.”
Lin Jing nodded, then sat down cross-legged beside the Five Elements Spirit Tree and began to cultivate.
……
Two months swiftly passed…
Lin Jing also did not stop cultivating during these two months.
Of course, he occasionally took breaks or played with Little Gold and Little Black.
Or listened to the tales of Immortal Crossing Island narrated by Senior Ape.
In front of Senior Ape, Little Gold and Little Black were exceedingly well-behaved.
However, when Senior Ape went out and they faced Lin Jing alone, they were still very mischievous, always trying to tease Lin Jing, like little children.
Later, according to what Senior Ape said…
If one were to really consider it, they were indeed like little children because on Immortal Crossing Island, everyone had their own territory, and the two beasts, besides hunting in the outer areas of Immortal Crossing Island, rarely went elsewhere.
Here, they all obeyed Senior Ape’s words, as he had taken care of them from a young age.
As for their parents, they were the losers of the territorial competition on Immortal Crossing Island…
After all, Immortal Crossing Island was not as peaceful as it appeared to Lin Jing.
The competition on the island was also incredibly fierce.
It was from Senior Ape that Lin Jing learned about some of the conditions on Immortal Crossing Island.
Immortal Crossing Island was extremely unique.
Its location was elusive, always drifting in the Demonic Monster Sea region.
Only once every ten thousand years would Immortal Crossing Island appear in the central region of the Demonic Monster Sea, staying there for a period of time.
Only then could people ascend the island and seek opportunities on it.
Moreover, according to the rumors, there were secrets to becoming an immortal in the very center of Immortal Crossing Island.
Therefore, each time Immortal Crossing Island appeared, countless Human Cultivators and Demon Cultivators would come to the island, vainly trying to obtain the secret to immortality.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: 13: The Spirit Fruit Ripens, Beasts Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 13: The Spirit Fruit Ripens, Beasts Attack
But over countless tens of thousands of years, the number of people who have died on Immortal Crossing Island is innumerable, yet not a single person has become immortal.
Even so, every time Immortal Crossing Island opens, there are countless people who find themselves without hope for a breakthrough and come to the island seeking that slim chance of attaining immortality.
Apart from that time, it is rare for anyone to come to Immortal Crossing Island.
Because Immortal Crossing Island has its own rules, outside the opening period, even if one sees the island, it’s impossible to set foot on it.
However, there is one exception…
That is, someone like Lin Jing, who was intercepted by Immortal Crossing Island from the transmission channel.
Speaking of which, it was Lin Jing’s misfortune; the appearance of Immortal Crossing Island was erratic, and sometimes, as the island moved, it would affect the void tunnels.
It was just so for Lin Jing, who was originally transmitting just fine.
As a result, he was affected by the suddenly appearing Immortal Crossing Island, causing a deviation in his transmission that led him to be sent directly onto the island.
Of course, Lin Jing was not the only unlucky one.
But, it wasn’t very common either.
Because only when performing super-long-distance intercontinental transmissions could this kind of situation possibly occur.
Other short-distance transmissions could not affect Immortal Crossing Island at all, and therefore, wouldn’t be affected by it.
Beyond this, Lin Jing also learned about some of the situations on Immortal Crossing Island.
The area where Lin Jing was previous at and the space outside the light barrier were, at most, considered the boundary of Immortal Crossing Island, and could not even be counted as the outskirts.
And the small island in the lake where Senior Ape resided could, in reality, only be regarded as the outer area of Immortal Crossing Island.
Immortal Crossing Island is vast, immensely so…
If we were to truly compare, it is even larger than the Nanming Domain after the calamity.
As for the internal regions of Immortal Crossing Island, Senior Ape described it as follows.
Every time Immortal Crossing Island opens, several life-span-nearing Tribulation passers or peak Mahayana cultivators would head to the internal regions of the island, vainly seeking that slim chance of becoming immortal.
Yet in the end, not a single one of them would come out alive.
Additionally, Lin Jing received another piece of bad news.
After entering Immortal Crossing Island, one cannot leave…
Crossing to the immortal… Crossing to the immortal…
Either ferry to the Yellow Springs or ascend to immortality…
Beyond these, there is no third choice.
Upon hearing this news, Lin Jing’s heart sank; he definitely did not want to spend his life stuck on Immortal Crossing Island.
Eventually, after Lin Jing repeatedly pleaded and insisted, he finally managed to learn from Senior Ape about a possible way out.
At the very western edge of Immortal Crossing Island, there is a desert, and within that desert, there is a Trial Grounds.
By passing through the trials there, one could leave Immortal Crossing Island.
However, so far, innumerable people who ended up on Immortal Crossing Island and later regretted it, attempted those trials, but in the end, not one person managed to succeed.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing felt even colder at heart.
But, after several days of deep contemplation,
Lin Jing still decided to try his luck at the Trial Grounds.
Of course, before that, he had to help Senior Ape ripen the Five Elements Spirit Fruits.
After all, Senior Ape had been quite decent to him, never once using force to coerce Lin Jing from start to finish.
Moreover, during that time, Senior Ape provided Lin Jing with many Spirit Fruits and spirit liquid among other heavenly materials and earthly treasures for him to consume.
On one hand, consuming those Spirit Fruits was beneficial to the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Fruits.
On the other hand, it helped in cleansing Lin Jing’s body.
Under two months of ripening, The Five Elements Spirit Fruits underwent significant changes.
According to Senior Ape, if not for Lin Jing’s efforts in ripening them, it would have probably taken several more decades for the Five Elements Spirit Fruits to mature.
But, Senior Ape couldn’t wait anymore.
It was already at the peak of Nascent Soul cultivation, on the verge of stepping into the next realm.
It desperately needed the Five Elements Spirit Fruits to help itself break through to the next realm.
……
In the following period, Lin Jing continued to cultivate and at the same time, hastened the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Fruits.
Time flashed by, and soon, another three months had passed.
It had been five months since Lin Jing arrived here.
During this period, due to limitations, Lin Jing hadn’t entered the System Space even once.
However, Lin Jing wasn’t in a hurry.
On the contrary, cultivating daily under the Five Elements Spirit Tree, Lin Jing felt his progress wasn’t slow.
And indeed, as Elder Monkey had said, his body was undergoing subtle changes, slowly transforming.
Because Lin Jingzhi was a cultivator with a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root, he was able to hasten the ripening of the fruits much faster than Elder Monkey had anticipated.
After these five months of continuous hastening, the Five Elements Spirit Fruits were finally close to maturation.
At this moment, on the Five Elements Spirit Tree, in the very center of the small canopy, the dazzling and colorful Five Elements Spirit Fruits were emitting an unusual glow.
This glow bathed the entire small island in a brilliant array of colors.
Elder Monkey, hovering in midair, looked at the Five Elements Spirit Fruits that were about to ripen with great excitement.
And Little Gold and Little Black, the two fierce birds, also guarded the island on both sides, gazing towards the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
Meanwhile, Lin Jingzhi channeled his cultivation technique with all his might.
Countless streams of spiritual power surged from his hands, absorbed by the formation, and flowed towards the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
As time slowly passed, the glow emitted by the Five Elements Spirit Fruits on the tree became ever more resplendent.
One hour…
Four hours…
Six hours…
…
…
This final phase of maturation always seemed so difficult.
It passed like this, until ten hours had elapsed.
Finally, after a burst of exceptionally splendid radiance, the Five Elements Spirit Fruits matured.
At the moment the Five Elements Spirit Fruits ripened, several figures suddenly appeared, rushing towards the small island.
And Lin Jing was immediately startled.
He hadn’t expected that no sooner had the Five Elements Spirit Fruits matured than there would be those seeking to seize them.
“Hahaha…”
“Old Monkey, I’ll gladly take these Five Elements Spirit Fruits for myself…”
One of them, a resounding voice, rang out.
Lin Jing looked up to see a dark bear flying through the air towards the island.
“Blind bear, what mess are you making? These Five Elements Spirit Fruits should rightfully be mine…”
The second voice that came was very sharp.
Lin Jing turned to look and saw another creature with a pointed beak—it was a white crane.
The white crane and the black bear, one on the left and the other on the right, were both attacking the small island.
Besides this bear and crane, there was a crimson Giant Python that burst out from beneath the lake shore, rearing its head hundreds of meters high.
“You two, now is not the time to quarrel; let’s secure the Five Elements Spirit Fruits first…”
A hoarse voice spilled from the mouth of the Giant Python.
The Giant Python, unlike the bear and the crane just before, kept its gaze fixed on the Five Elements Spirit Fruits atop the Five Elements Spirit Tree on the island in the lake from the moment it appeared.
Just as the Five Elements Spirit Fruits ripened, three powerful Demonic Beasts took action to seize them.
And the aura emanating from their bodies was extraordinary; they seemed to be not much different from Elder Monkey in terms of strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: 14: Revenge from Xiaojin
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 14: Revenge from Xiaojin
At this moment, although the Five Elements Spirit Fruits on the tree had matured, they were still undergoing the final bit of change.
The entire Five Elements Spirit Tree began to wither slowly, and the essence within the tree started to converge rapidly into the fruits.
Only when the Five Elements Spirit Tree was completely withered and all its essence gathered inside the fruits, causing them to fall off on their own, would the Five Elements Spirit Fruits be considered fully mature.
At this time, three Demonic Beasts had already arrived, attacking the barrier together, yet these attacks only caused the barrier to tremble slightly.
It was evident that the senior ape had put considerable effort into this barrier.
Then, the senior ape called over Lin Jing and directly passed the Immortal Five Elements Technique it had obtained to him.
Afterwards, it left a breath imprint on Lin Jing.
It then spoke rapidly,
“This breakthrough of mine, will require no short amount of time…”
“This Immortal Five Elements Technique is sufficient for cultivation up to the Divinity Transformation Stage. It was left behind by a human cultivator who entered this Immortal Crossing Island before. Now, I’m giving it to you.”
“Also, if you go to the desert, should you encounter a remnant soul, no matter what he says, don’t believe him, remember to stay away from him…”
“If it’s impossible, come straight back…”
The hurried instructions from the senior ape afforded no time for explanations.
“In a moment, I will need to borrow the power of the Divine Phoenix feather on you again, consider it a reward for giving you this Immortal Five Elements Technique. Afterward, I’ll have Little Gold take you out to the boundary of Immortal Crossing Island.”
“Remember, stay along the boundary outside the light screen, never enter within the light screen. If you encounter other Demonic Beasts, the power of the Divine Phoenix feather is limited; it can’t protect you for too long.”
“The breath I left with you is only sufficient to keep you unharmed in the boundary region.”
At this time, the entire Five Elements Spirit Tree had withered away as well.
“Plop”
The brilliant Five Elements Spirit Fruit fell from the dried-up branches.
Seeing this, the three Demonic Beasts attacking the barrier grew even more frenzied.
Cracks began to appear on the barrier, and it looked as though it might shatter at any moment.
Just then, the senior ape stretched out his hand and summoned the Five Elements Spirit Fruit to him.
After that, he took off into the air with Lin Jing.
Seeing this, the three Demonic Beasts hurriedly attempted to follow.
At that moment, the senior ape placed a palm on Lin Jing.
After this palm, the virtual image of the Divine Phoenix appeared on Lin Jing’s forehead.
Instantly, a wild aura surged forth. Being so close, the three Demonic Beasts facing the virtual image of the Divine Phoenix were instantly stunned.
Seizing the opportunity, the senior ape quickly retreated backward.
Leaving Lin Jing still standing in place.
After the senior ape had retreated, he spoke loudly,
“Brother Bull, I leave the rest to you…”
Following the senior ape’s words, a Wild Bull Demon Beast materialized out of nowhere.
By this time, the three Demonic Beasts had just snapped out of their daze.
The Wild Bull Demon Beast opened its massive mouth.
“Moo…”
A tremendous roar of a bull erupted, causing Lin Jing to be shaken until he felt somewhat dizzy and involuntarily fall from the sky.
As Lin Jing fell, Little Gold flapped its wings, shooting up into the air to catch him.
Then, it soared higher, avoiding the three Demonic Beasts and flying away with Lin Jing.
Moments later, the three Demonic Beasts fully regained their senses.
All turned their heads, looking incredulously at Lin Jing.
However, at that moment, the Wild Bull Demon Beast spoke,
“Gentlemen, your opponent is me…”
“Let’s not break the rules among us beasts of Immortal Crossing Island.”
Upon hearing this, the three Demonic Beasts gave Lin Jing a deep look and then turned to the Wild Bull Demon Beast, responding,
“Fine…”
……
In the midst of the Wild Bull Demon Beast’s thunderous roar, it took quite a long time for Lin Jing to recover.
When he came to, he was lying on the back of the Golden Giant Eagle, Little Gold.
With wings spanning dozens of meters, Lin Jing lay upon its back, safe even while lying down.
Moreover, Little Gold’s speed was also very fast.
Thus, Lin Jing lay on Little Gold’s back, pondering the last words of Senior Ape.
Inside the desert, there is a remnant soul…
Also, do not trust what he says.
From this perspective, that remnant soul must be quite dangerous, which is why Senior Ape took the trouble to warn him.
For now, forget about these matters.
Let’s wait until we reach the desert to address it.
Afterward, Lin Jing thought of another warning from Senior Ape, not to enter the light curtain range of Immortal Crossing Island again.
Lin Jing naturally understood this.
This time, he had encountered Senior Ape, but next time, if he encountered other Demonic Beasts, he might not be so lucky.
Thinking about it, Lin Jing suddenly felt that his luck in encountering Senior Ape was actually quite good.
At the moment, lying on Little Gold’s back, the strong wind whistled past his ears.
In an instant, Lin Jing even felt a sense of comfortable pleasure.
Then, Lin Jing propped himself up, smoothed out the feathers on Little Gold’s back with his hand, placed his hands behind his head, and lay down again in a more comfortable position.
Following that, Lin Jing spoke to Little Gold:
“Little Gold, I have to leave. If you can’t see me anymore, will you miss me, huh…”
“Caw…”
Little Gold didn’t seem very enthusiastic, merely issuing a casual sound in response to Lin Kai.
Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t say much more.
After all, Little Gold was probably reluctant to be used as a beast of burden to carry him out.
After all, it was a Nascent Soul Stage Demonic Beast, whereas Lin Jing was only at the Foundation Establishment Stage…
It’s normal for it to be unhappy.
……
As a Nascent Soul Stage Demonic Beast, Little Gold’s speed was indeed very fast.
In just a few hours, Little Gold had carried Lin Jing out of the light curtain and to the outside world.
After finding a safe place, Little Gold suddenly flapped its wings and ascended into the sky.
The previously comfortable Lin Jing, lying on Little Gold’s back, failed to react in time and fell straight down.
There it was, Lin Jing and Little Gold, one human and one eagle, one ascending and the other descending, parting ways just like that.
As Lin Jing fell beside Little Gold’s claws, it suddenly extended its previously curled claws…
Just like flicking a forehead, it flicked him directly toward the ground with one toe.
Lin Jing instantly understood that Little Gold was blatantly seeking retaliation…
However, at that moment, Lin Jing couldn’t move even if he wanted to.
Because with that flick, Little Gold directly used a force of Spiritual Power to restrain him.
Then.
There was a loud “thump,” and a heavy object hit the ground.
This heavy object was none other than Lin Jing, who had fallen from the sky.
And he had landed face first.
Fortunately, Little Gold bore no ill will, as the Spiritual Power that bound Lin Jing protected him.
But even so, Lin Jing was covered in dust, looking quite disheveled.
At that moment, the Spiritual Power binding him dissipated, and Lin Jing was able to move his body, then looked up at the sky toward Little Gold.
Only to see Little Gold circling once above his head.
Lin Jing was just about to speak…
When an unidentified object fell from the sky.
As soon as Lin Jing recognized what was falling from the sky above, he didn’t care about his dusty, disheveled appearance anymore.
He leaped out with unprecedented speed.
“Splatter”
The unidentified object landed where Lin Jing had just been standing, splashing everywhere…
This lump of unidentified material was none other than Little Gold’s eagle droppings…

chapters.title: Chapter 313: 15: Foundation Establishment Level 7
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 15: Foundation Establishment Level 7
Fortunately, Lin Jing dodged in time and was spared.
Otherwise, if he had been splattered with eagle droppings, that really would have been a hoot.
This Xiao Jin was definitely taking revenge.
Lin Jing guessed that it was dissatisfied with being used as a mount.
The key issue was that Lin Jing was quite proud of it.
That was probably why Xiao Jin’s desire for revenge had intensified.
“Screech…”
Xiao Jin, seeing Lin Jing’s disheveled appearance, screeched happily before spreading its wings to fly into the sky and then disappearing from sight.
Lin Jing, watching Xiao Jin vanish, had no way to retaliate and could only say resentfully,
“Next time I see you, I’m definitely having golden roasted wings…”
After venting, Lin Jing also left the area right away.
After leaving the area, Lin Jing didn’t go far. After observing carefully for a while and seeing that there was no other activity around, he then directly entered the System Space.
Having not entered the System Space for several months, Lin Jing still missed it quite a bit.
As soon as he entered the space, the Spirit Plants of the Second Rank, already mature in the Spirit Fields behind him, displayed a variety of colors and were full of enticing fragrances from the mature Spirit Medicine, constantly swaying in the breeze.
Lin Jing flew past the Earth Spirit Fields planted with Third-Rank Spiritual Plants and went straight to the Spirit Fields in the back.
Looking at these mature Spirit Plants, Lin Jing then directly summoned the System.
“System, activate the harvesting function for Spirit Plants.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, a System panel appeared in front of him…
On the System panel, Lin Jing directly chose the Spirit Field that needed harvesting. Once the selection was made, the System’s voice rang out again.
“Harvesting Spirit Plants requires 1 Harvest Point. Would the host like to proceed with the harvest?”
“Harvest,” Lin Jing replied without hesitation.
“Ding”
“System notification: Host has used the harvesting function for the Spirit Field, deducting 1 Harvest Point, current remaining Harvest Points: 5563.”
As the System notification sounded, the mature Spirit Plants in the fields began to uproot themselves one by one…
This speed was much faster than if Lin Jing had harvested them himself.
In just a short while, all these Spirit Plants had been harvested and were neatly stacked at the edge of the fields.
Following the completion of the harvest, the System’s notification sounded again:
“Ding”
“System notification: Congratulations to the host on the successful harvest of Second Rank Spirit Plants, reward earned: 216 Harvest Points.”
These Second-Rank Spirit Plants yielded far too few Harvest Points.
For over thirty acres of Second-Rank Spirit Plants, only a couple hundred Harvest Points were awarded.
If he were to concoct Elixir Medicine, Lin Jing could gather these Harvest Points in less than half a month, and even have plenty to spare.
After the harvest of the Spirit Plants, Lin Jing briefly processed them and then stored them inside the System Space.
Next, he went to the front, to the fields planted with High-Grade Spiritual Plants.
Once in the fields, Lin Jing took out a Spirit-Quelling Box from his Storage Bag.
Then he opened it directly.
Inside this Spirit-Quelling Box were the Eternal Life Vine that Lin Jingzhi had obtained from Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei before.
Previously, Elder Ape had already given him the Eternal Life Vine and then compensated Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei with other Spirit Fruits.
Xiao Jin’s desire for revenge against Lin Jing also included this aspect.
After all, the Eternal Life Vine was found by Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei together.
Now that Lin Jing had obtained it, Xiao Jin was bound to hold some resentment.
Since acquiring it, Lin Jing had kept the Eternal Life Vine inside the Storage Bag all this time.
Because he hadn’t had the time to enter the System Space, Lin Jing had not planted it yet.
Now that he was inside the System Space, it was the perfect opportunity to plant it.
Next, Lin Jing came to the newly opened Spirit Field, dug a hole, and planted the Eternal Life Vine.
No sooner had he planted it than a system notification arrived.
“Ding.”
“System notification: The system has detected that the host has planted a High-Grade Spiritual Plant. Due to the excessive rank of the Spirit Plant, which surpasses the system’s level, the current level’s supply of Spiritual Power is insufficient for the growth of the Spirit Plant, resulting in its inability to grow normally.”
This notification made Lin Jing frown.
He hadn’t expected the rank of the Spirit Plant to be so high that it exceeded the system’s level.
Lin Jing now had a Fourth-Rank System Space and planting Fourth-Rank High-Grade Spiritual Plants was not an issue.
Therefore, the Eternal Life Vine must be at least Fifth-Rank.
Now that the Eternal Life Vine could not grow normally, Lin Jing had no choice but to dig it up again.
He then cleaned off the soil and put it back into the Spirit-Quelling Box.
Having done all this,
Lin Jing looked at the recently harvested clearing behind him, then went to the clearing and began to plant new Spirit Plants.
……
A day later, Lin Jing came out of the System Space.
This time,
Lin Jing had stayed in the System Space directly for a whole day.
He first replanted the thirty-odd acres of Spirit Field with Second-Rank Spirit Plants, then sat down to rest and meditate.
After completing all these tasks, Lin Jing then headed to the Alchemy Room.
He went to the Alchemy Room not to perform alchemy,
but to make a breakthrough. After accumulating for such a lengthy time, Lin Jing was fully prepared and could advance to the later stages of Foundation Establishment.
However, right at the beginning on the small island in the lake, Senior Ape noticed that Lin Jing was about to break through and directly suppressed Lin Jing’s realm, pushing it down.
And he advised him to firmly condense his Spiritual Power and cleanse his body.
And just like that, as soon as he came out,
the suppressed Spiritual Power within Lin Jing burst forth.
This time, Lin Jing did not even consume any Elixir Medicines and simply succeeded in charging through the barrier, advancing to the seventh level of Foundation Establishment.
He became a late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
After coming out, Lin Jing stretched his body briefly, feeling the surging Spiritual Power within him, and with a smile on his face, he took a long, deep breath.
Now, Lin Jing was one step closer to the Golden Core Stage.
Then,
Lin Jing determined his direction and set off towards the desert area that Senior Ape had mentioned.
The journey to the desert area would be a long one…
……
Immortal Crossing Island was vast, to an exaggerated extent.
This time, Lin Jing walked for a full six months before he left the dense forest area and reached the edge of the desert region.
In these six months, nothing unexpected occurred.
With the breath mark that Senior Ape had left on Lin Jing’s forehead, no Demonic Beasts dared to attack him on his journey.
And just like before, Lin Jing was searching for various High-Grade Spiritual Plants. On his way, he harvested several dozen Third-Rank Spirit Plants.
However, he found all the other Spiritual Grasses,
but the main ingredient for refining the Yellow Dragon Elixir, the Yellow Dragon Spirit Grass, remained elusive.
This unavoidably made Lin Jing feel a tinge of regret.
Nevertheless, now that he had already reached the desert area, Lin Jing gave up on the idea of searching further.
Otherwise, if he were to turn back, he wouldn’t know how much effort it would take, and it was still uncertain whether he would find it.
Then,
Lin Jing stood at the edge of the dense forest, gazing at the boundless desert before him, then lifted his leg and stepped forward, walking into it…

chapters.title: Chapter 314: 16: Entering the Desert
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 16: Entering the Desert
“`
Upon entering the desert region, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate at all and immediately headed deep into the sands.
According to Elder Yuan, the Trial Grounds lay within the deepest reaches of this desert.
……
In the blink of an eye, several days passed.
After days of arduous travel and crossing the peripheral zones of the desert, Lin Jing finally arrived within its true expanse.
With each step, his feet sank unevenly into the sand, making his trek through the desert arduous, very much like that of a traveler lost within its vastness.
This place was nothing like the periphery he had entered, where no harsh winds ravaged the land, no scorching sun beat down, and occasionally small Demonic Beasts could be seen frolicking and chasing one another.
Here, the real desert reigned, with sands engulfing the sky and the blazing sun overhead…
The sand underfoot was like grains in a frying pan; even shod in boots, Lin Jing still felt a burning sensation creeping up from the soles of his feet.
Above him, the relentless sun parched his lips.
Lin Jing looked up at the intense sun and couldn’t help shaking his head.
He then gathered Spiritual Power to form a sphere of water, which he poured over himself, and swallowed the remaining droplets.
It took the conjuring of two or three water spheres to alleviate the searing heat that had overtaken him.
Afterward, Lin Jing continued deeper into the desert.
……
The further he walked, the hotter the desert became.
At this moment, Lin Jing felt as if he were in a fiery furnace.
Harsh winds carrying sand and gravel battered against him, the particles cutting like blades against the Spiritual Shield he had formed with his Spiritual Power.
Without the protection of the Spiritual Shield, Lin Jing’s body would have been covered in cuts and abrasions by now.
Even before he ventured this deep, the signs of vicious winds had started to show, with gusts pelting his body painfully with sand.
However, the deeper he went, the more ferocious the desert winds became.
Eventually, not just sand but even pebbles were swept up by the tempest, striking against Lin Jing.
This could no longer be referred to as mere winds; it was a storm.
With no other choice, Lin Jing had to maintain his Spiritual Shield and continue marching through the storm.
Walking through the desert with a Spiritual Shield consumed Spiritual Power at an alarming rate, and there were times when Lin Jing could not endure even four hours before his reserves ran dry.
Moreover, the deeper he ventured into the desert, the thinner the Spiritual Energy became, making absorption from the surroundings impossible.
This meant that Lin Jing had to retreat into the System Space to rest after covering some distance.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had access to the System Space.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been sure he could have made it this far.
Before long…
Lin Jing could no longer hold on and once more retreated into the System Space, this time his Spiritual Power depleting in less than six hours.
As soon as he entered the System Space, the abundant Spiritual Energy made him take a long, deep breath.
Inside the System Space, compared to the outside desert, it was like heaven and hell.
“Having come this far, the Spiritual Energy in the desert is almost nonexistent. I wonder how the others manage to enter this place,” Lin Jing pondered, taking in the dense Spiritual Energy of the System Space while recalling the harsh exterior conditions.
“Oh, that’s right…”
“Others must possess strengths not inferior to my own. Entering the desert, they naturally wouldn’t struggle as much as I do,” he realized, following which Lin Jing let out a wry smile.
After all, those who could make it here were not of low Cultivation.
“`
Even others who, due to teleportation, had strayed onto the island, were not like Lin Jing, possessing such low cultivation.
How could those able to afford intercontinental teleportation be ordinary cultivators?
Lin Jing guessed that he was probably the cultivator with the lowest cultivation to enter the Immortal Crossing Island.
……
Within the System Space, Lin Jing sat and meditated for six hours to fully replenish his depleted spiritual power.
After resting, Lin Jing immediately entered Observation Mode, wanting to scout the path ahead.
Since entering the desert, Lin Jing had no specific route, only a general direction given to him by his predecessor, the Ape.
Following this direction, the Ape had told Lin Jing that this desert was peculiar, no matter which way one walked, they would never deviate from the central direction of the desert.
Because the desert was like a disc, once one entered, they would always be moving from the outside towards the center.
And the Trial Grounds were located right in the center of the desert.
In fact, to judge whether one was going in the wrong direction, one only needed to observe the wind and sand, as well as the surrounding environment.
The stronger the wind and sand, and the more adverse the environment, the closer one was to the center, meaning they were on the right path.
One only needed to keep moving inward.
After entering Observation Mode, Lin Jing first saw the sky filled with yellow sand, swept up by the fierce wind everywhere.
This fierce wind swept up not just sand and gravel, even smaller stones were lifted into the sky.
Some windblown sand on the desert ground also revealed the white bones of giant beasts buried in the sand.
These bones had been there for who knows how long, and despite being exposed to the wind and sun for such a long time, their surfaces remained smooth and shiny.
It can be assumed that the creatures were quite formidable in life.
Lin Jing had already seen many such bones along his way.
Lin Jing merely glanced at them and then paid no further attention.
Then, he raised his perspective and looked further inland.
As his view ascended, Lin Jing peered through the sandstorm ahead.
He saw what seemed to be a small green dot in the distance.
However, due to the distance and the wind and sand interference, Lin Jing couldn’t see it very clearly.
Next, with a thought, Lin Jing controlled the observational perspective to move forward, wanting to clearly see what was ahead.
As Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode, moving closer, the small green dot grew increasingly distinct.
Ahead…
It seemed to be an oasis in the middle of the desert.
And furthermore, Lin Jing observed that…
There seemed to be no wind and sand near that oasis.
Lin Jing immediately felt a surge of elation.
The time he had been in the desert had nearly driven him mad with the torment of wind and sand.
Afterward, Lin Jing exited Observation Mode, deciding to first take a look at the oasis nearby.
Upon leaving Observation Mode, Lin Jing stood up and condensed spiritual power into a Spiritual Shield before leaving the System Space.
Once out of the System Space, the hot air assaulted him instantly, along with the piercing wind, carrying sand and pebbles that “pounded” against Lin Jing’s Spiritual Shield.
Though the attack power of these sand and pebbles wasn’t very strong, they still consumed a substantial amount of spiritual power when hitting the Spiritual Shield.
Lin Jing continued like this, holding up the Spiritual Shield, step by step, walking towards what lay ahead.
Pity that in this desert, there were restrictions that prevented flight, forcing one to proceed on foot, just like Lin Jing was doing.
Otherwise, Lin Jing wouldn’t have had to suffer such hardship in his journey.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 17: Goodbye, Secret Box
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 17: Goodbye, Secret Box
When viewed from Observation Mode, the distance didn’t seem too far, but only when Lin Jing truly began the trek did he finally realize the hardship of this distance.
By the time he had left the sandstorm zone and reached the oasis, Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power was once again exhausted.
However, fortunately at this time, he had already arrived in the oasis area.
In this oasis area, there were no sandstorms, and even the climate here wasn’t as scorching as before.
