Yan Wanfei, extremely excited, took the small Jade Vial and then peeked inside, his gaze becoming stuck.
His behavior made Lin Jing, who was initially planning to take out the superior and Supreme-Grade Nirvana Elixirs, hesitate for a moment.
Seeing how excited he was about this Medium-Grade Nirvana Elixir,
If he were to show him the Superior-Grade and even Supreme-Grade Nirvana Elixirs, that might just drive Yan Wanfei mad today.
“Radiating purple light, rich and intoxicating pill fragrance…”
“It is indeed a Medium-Grade Nirvana Elixir.”
“Brother Lin, you are truly amazing…”
Lin Jing, flattered, quickly said to Yan Wanfei:
“Brother Yan, why don’t you calm down a bit…”
“After all, there’s more than one Nirvana Elixir here, I still have some.”
Lin Jing, at this moment, was being very vague.
He didn’t know how Yan Wanfei would react if he actually mentioned the Superior and Supreme-Grade Nirvana Elixirs.
“Other Nirvana Elixirs…”
“Oh…”
“You mean those Low-Grade Nirvana Elixirs; when the time comes, just hand them all to Brother Jiu, as his rank advancement this time was too rushed and preparations were not sufficient. A Medium-Grade Nirvana Elixir might not be enough.”
“By then, taking a few more Nirvana Elixirs can provide additional assurance, right?”
“By the way, Brother Lin, how many Nirvana Elixirs did you refine in total with this batch?”
Lin Jing then spoke, saying:
“This time in refining, a total of five were produced.”

chapters.title: Chapter 381: 81: Your surname is Lin?
chapters.content:
Chapter 381: Chapter 81: Your surname is Lin?
“Five…”
“To actually have so many, this is really too great.”
“After Brother Jiu’s tribulation, there will definitely be some left over.”
“The Nirvana Elixir is extremely precious, if there are any leftovers, even if sold, they would fetch a hefty sum of Spirit Stones,” Yan Wanfei said, very excited at this moment.
Lin Jing gave a slight smile.
Indeed, after Lu Youjiu’s tribulation, there would be extra Nirvana Elixirs remaining.
After all, these were not the Low Grade Nirvana Elixirs that Yan Wanfei imagined.
They were Supreme Grade, and even Superior Grade Nirvana Elixirs.
How could they be the same as the Low Grade Nirvana Elixirs?
Nevertheless, it was still necessary to inform Yan Wanfei, or it would truly be a bit unjustifiable.
Thus, Lin Jing opened his mouth and said:
“That…”
“Brother Yan, perhaps you should calm down first?”
Hearing Lin Jing speak like this, Yan Wanfei looked at him puzzled, not understanding why Lin Jing would say such a thing.
“Brother Lin…”
“Could it be there’s something you haven’t told me?”
“Speak, I’m all ears…”
Lin Jing, thereafter, handed over another small Jade Vial:
“How about you take a look at the Elixir Medicine in this little vial first?”
Yan Wanfei took the Jade Vial, glancing doubtfully at Lin Jing.
He just saw Lin Jing, with a smile on his face, watching him.
Subsequently.
Yan Wanfei then opened the vial.
Upon opening the vial, a fragrance richer than before entered his nostrils.
Yan Wanfei took a deep breath, his face full of intoxication.
He then picked up the small Jade Vial, peering straight into it.
Inside the Jade Vial, two dark purple Elixir Medicines lay at the bottom; the pills’ appearances were round and glossy, and a faint brilliance was shimmering through their cores…
After a short while.
Yan Wanfei looked up at Lin Jing, his eyes filled with immense excitement.
“Superior…”
“Superior Grade Nirvana Elixirs.”
“Brother Lin, you… you’ve actually refined Superior Grade Nirvana Elixirs.”
At this moment, Yan Wanfei was somewhat inarticulate.
Lin Jing nodded his head and then, smiling, handed over the last Jade Vial he held in his hand.
“And this one…”
“Take a look at this one too, and please, try not to get too excited…”
“I’m afraid you might let out a yell, making it known to everyone…”
“After all, this matter should be kept a secret.”
Yan Wanfei nodded repeatedly:
“I certainly understand this.”
“Brother Jiu already mentioned before that this matter must remain confidential.”
As he spoke, Yan Wanfei took the last small Jade Vial from Lin Jing’s hand.
Barely having received the Jade Vial, Yan Wanfei immediately opened it, and purple brilliance gleamed through the opening, revealing a hint of light.
Upon witnessing this, Yan Wanfei was stunned, then quickly covered the mouth of the vial again.
While Lin Jing was unsure of what was happening, he saw Yan Wanfei quietly open the bottle once more.
The purple brilliance appeared again from the opening.
Yan Wanfei, impatient, hurriedly peered inside the vial.
This time, Yan Wanfei’s Observation Mode lasted longer…
It was only much later that Yan Wanfei finally looked up.
Then, his gaze toward Lin Jing was as if looking at a monster.
Following that, he looked again at the Jade Vial, observed for a while longer, then looked up again, back at Lin Jing.
Only then did Yan Wanfei speak:
“Brother Lin…”
“Were you toying with us before?”
“You must be a Fifth-Rank…”
“No, a Sixth Rank Alchemy Master, right?”
“One furnace with five Nirvana Elixirs, two Supreme Grade, two Superior Grade, and one Medium Grade…”
“How could that possibly be the work of a Fourth Grade Alchemist who has never refined Fourth Order Pills?”
“To mention luck, that’s even more impossible.”
“Even if luck was good, refining one Supreme Grade Nirvana Elixir would be like smoke billowing from the ancestral grave.”
“If this is also considered luck…”
“Smoke from the ancestral grave isn’t enough, it’s more like the grave being on fire…”
“An all-encompassing blaze, impossible to extinguish.”
Lin Jing could only facepalm; his own pill refinement, in Yan Wanfei’s mouth, had apparently led to the ancestral grave catching fire.
Lin Jing, with a darkened expression, said:
“Brother Yan…”
“You’re being a bit too extravagant with your words…”
Yan Wanfei kept shaking his head, saying:
“No exaggeration, I’m not exaggerating at all.”
“You should know that even the Alchemists at Changyun Pill Pavilion wouldn’t dare to claim they could produce Elixirs of such quality.”
“You have left me…”
“Brother, nothing but admiration, complete admiration…”
Just as the two were talking, at that moment, a voice came over:
“Niu San, what are you admiring again?”
This voice was none other than Lu Youjiu’s.
As the sound fell, Lu Youjiu and Holaw Three Rivers approached.
Seeing Lu Youjiu’s arrival, Yan Wanfei immediately said excitedly:
“Brother Jiu, San He…”
“You’re back.”
“Brother Lin has already finished refining the Elixir.”
“Elixir?” After hesitating, Lu Youjiu reacted:
“Oh…”
“You’re talking about the Nirvana Elixir, right?”
“The Nirvana Elixir has been refined?”
After speaking, Lu Youjiu and Holaw Three Rivers both turned their gazes to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing nodded and said, “Yes, I had just finished refining it when I came down the mountain. I was actually coming to find you.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and then asked:
“The Elixir, how is its quality? Let me see.”
“It’s right here with me…” Yan Wanfei said, passing the several small Jade Vials he held in his hands.
Afterward, with a mysterious expression, he winked at Lu Youjiu and said:
“Brother Jiu, don’t be scared…”
Seeing Yan Wanfei’s expression, even Holaw Three Rivers became interested and took a small jade vial from Lu Youjiu’s hand.
He then opened it directly.
The moment the jade vial was opened, a rich and intoxicating pill fragrance rushed to their nostrils along with a purple brilliance radiating from within.
After being momentarily stunned, Holaw Three Rivers hurriedly looked inside the vial.
Even Lu Youjiu, neglecting the other two small jade vials in his hands, was drawn to the fragrance of the Elixir Medicine emanating from the one Holaw Three Rivers held.
They crowded together to peer inside.
However, the vial was too small, and with their crowding, neither could see anything.
Thus, Holaw Three Rivers poured out one of the pills into his hand.
This pill was exceptionally round with a surface that shimmered with a purple gleam, appearing extremely extraordinary.
“Supreme Elixir…”
Upon seeing this pill, Holaw Three Rivers blurted out.
Lu Youjiu nodded in agreement.
“Indeed, it is a Supreme Grade Nirvana Elixir.”
“If I take this pill, I am confident that my breakthrough to Nascent Soul will be successful.”
Following that, Holaw Three Rivers looked up at Lin Jing, his expression a mix of shock and inevitability.
In any case, it was very strange…
“Brother Lin…”
“Did you refine this?”
Yan Wanfei then said with a smile:
“Of course, it must be Brother Lin who refined it. Where else would these pills come from?”
“What do you think, are you shocked?”
“Cough… cough…”
Then, Yan Wanfei cleared his throat and solemnly said to Holaw Three Rivers:
“San He, stay calm, you must keep your cool…”
“Look at Brother Jiu, he’s much more composed than you.”
Indeed.
Lu Youjiu, though somewhat excited upon seeing the pills, was indeed calmer than both of them.
Ignoring Yan Wanfei’s smugness, Holaw Three Rivers took the other two small jade vials from Lu Youjiu’s hand.
He proceeded to open them one by one.
The more he opened, the more shocked Holaw Three Rivers became.
For the quality of this batch of Elixir Furnace Medicine had scared him.
Seeing Holaw Three Rivers’s actions, Yan Wanfei now laughed even more happily:
“How about it, San He…”
“One furnace of Elixirs yielded two Supreme Grade, two Superior, and one Medium Grade.”
“Have you ever seen such a thing?”
“You must know, these are not ordinary Elixirs but Fourth Order Nirvana Elixirs, which are the most difficult to refine.”
“Are you convinced or not?”
After examining the pills, Holaw Three Rivers also didn’t pay attention to Yan Wanfei, who kept bragging beside him.
Instead, he looked up at Lin Jing, with a serious face, and asked:
“Your last name is Lin? That Lin from the Lin Family?”
Obviously, Holaw Three Rivers had noticed something.
The words of Holaw Three Rivers made Yan Wanfei somewhat confused:
“Brother Lin’s last name is Lin, isn’t it?”
“What else could it be?”
Lin Jing also nodded, saying:
“Yes…”
Upon receiving Lin Jing’s confirmation, Holaw Three Rivers finally relaxed and smiled:
“No wonder…”
“That makes it easier to explain.”
“However, even so, the Elixir Furnace Medicine you’ve refined is impressive.”
Lin Jing humbly replied:
“Brother San He is too kind, it was just a bit of luck.”
Holaw Three Rivers had more to say but then turned his attention to Lu Youjiu who was standing nearby.
Seeing Lu Youjiu’s nonchalant reaction to their conversation and acting as if everything was expected, Holaw Three Rivers instantly understood, then turned to Lu Youjiu:
“Did you already know about this?”
Lu Youjiu gave a mysterious smile and said:
“Somewhat, at least earlier than you all…”
Holaw Three Rivers was momentarily speechless:
“You didn’t even tell Niu San, and you didn’t bother telling me either.”
Yan Wanfei, completely out of the loop, was growing desperate:
“What are you talking about? I don’t understand a single word!”
“How come I can’t understand anything?”
It was only then that Holaw Three Rivers turned to Yan Wanfei and said:
“I remember, you were quite smug just a moment ago, weren’t you…”
No sooner had Holaw Three Rivers spoken than Yan Wanfei inwardly dreaded:
“San He, I was wrong…”
“Just tell me…”
After saying this, Yan Wanfei even turned to seek help from Lu Youjiu:
“Brother Jiu…”
However, Lu Youjiu did not give him the time of day but looked directly at Holaw Three Rivers:
“Ask San He…”
Seemingly finding pleasure in the revenge, Holaw Three Rivers sneered and said:
“Maybe when I’m in a good mood some day…”
“Ah…” Yan Wanfei immediately looked crestfallen.
At that moment, Lu Youjiu spoke up, reminding:
“San He, this matter is of great importance, remember to keep it a secret.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded and responded:
“Don’t worry, I understand the gravity.”
After saying this, Holaw Three Rivers looked at Lin Jing again and said:
“Brother Lin…”
“You should change the place where you refine your Elixirs. In a little while, pick a place, and I will come and set up a new Formation for you.”
Lin Jing nodded, not refusing.
Indeed, Lin Jing had been thinking about changing the place where he practiced Alchemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: 82: News of Li Mingwu
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 82: News of Li Mingwu
After the Nirvana Elixir had been refined, Lin Jing had clearly become much more leisurely than before.
However, Holaw Three Rivers had started to become busy.
The site for Tribulation had already been chosen the last time they went out.
Next, Holaw Three Rivers needed to setup the Formation, and then prepare for the Tribulation.
In the meantime, he also had to set up a large Formation with various functions in Lin Jing’s new Alchemy Room.
It could be said that among them, he was the busiest.
Meanwhile, Lu Youjiu was undergoing his final meditation.
Only after this meditation would he be ready to attempt the Tribulation.
……
That day.
With nothing much to do, Lin Jing left the Alchemy Room and went down the mountain for a stroll.
He happened to see Yan Wanfei and Zhang Jian, who was with Yan Wanfei.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Zhang Jian hurriedly approached him.
“Brother Lin, you seem quite free today,” he said.
Lin Jing responded with a slight smile,
“Brother Zhang…”
“I heard from Brother Yan that you’re about to advance to a Fourth Rank Array Master, which is truly a joyous occasion.”
However, Zhang Jian waved his hand and said,
“Not at all…”
“Brother Lin is too kind; you are formidable, with extraordinary combat abilities, and you’re also a Fourth Grade Pill Master.”
At that moment, Yan Wanfei suddenly interjected,
“Alright, you two, stop praising each other. I can barely stand it.”
“Zhang, weren’t you going to ask Brother Lin about something concerning Spirit Plants?”
“Stop rambling; just ask now.”
Upon hearing this, Zhang Jian, with a dark face, turned to Yan Wanfei and said,
“Yan Shuishui, can you not call me ‘Cheap Zhang’?”
However, Yan Wanfei shook his head like a rattle-drum and then spoke up,
“I can’t do that.”
“Who asked you to be so persistent and annoying back then?”
Zhang Jian quickly retorted,
“How was I supposed to know you were pretending to be ‘Yan Shuishui’? If I had known it was you in disguise, I would never have approached you.”
At this, he sighed heavily.
“Ah…”
“My Pupil Skill has really gone to the dogs.”
“To think it added such a huge blemish to my life out of thin air.”
Yan Wanfei did not mince words,
“You’re blathering…”
“Do you think I wanted to? It was all for the mission.”
“And what about your Pupil Skill? Did you really think it would be able to see through the innate Divine Skills of our Green Illusion Demon Ox clan?”
“You underestimated our clan too much.”
Zhang Jian, almost tearful, lamented,
“My innocence…”
“To think I hesitated for days over a big male ox, and to say this out loud…”
“Forget it, I can’t speak of it…”
Yan Wanfei looked disdainfully at Zhang Jian,
“If you want to blame someone, blame Dai Mao for his tastes.”
At this point, Yan Wanfei suddenly paused, then shifted the conversation,
“Speaking of Dai Mao, I just remembered…”
“Last time, I asked you to secretly investigate Dai Mao’s whereabouts for us, how did that go?”
Since the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had left with Dai Mao’s body,
Yan Wanfei had Zhang Jian help in tracking Dai Mao’s movements as well.
When Dai Mao was mentioned, Zhang Jian got serious:
“You wouldn’t believe it, but recently, a friend of mine reported seeing Dai Mao’s whereabouts.”
“Just two months ago, my friend discovered a small island in the west of Thousand Islands Domain that was annihilated, and everyone on the island had been drained of their essence and died.”
“My friend, who was merely passing by and witnessed this scene, sensed danger and decided to leave.”
“Unexpectedly, he was ambushed by someone with a sky-high Demonic Qi.”
“At first, he tried to resist but quickly realized he was no match.”
“Eventually, he had no choice but to detonate his Magical Treasure to find a chance to escape.”
“However, during the explosion of his Magical Treasure, by chance, he saw the face of his assailant—it was Dai Mao.”
“According to his recollection, Dai Mao seemed seriously injured at the time, which is probably why he didn’t pursue him.”
“Otherwise, my friend would have never escaped.”
“These are all things my friend told me himself.”
After hearing this, Yan Wanfei began to query,
“Dai Mao was injured?”
“How could he have been injured?”
Zhang Jian gave him a look,
“How should I know? It’s abnormal for Dai Mao to be injured. Maybe he was still recovering from the beating you guys gave him initially.”
The question of Yan Wanfei was also Lin Jing’s query.
Because they hadn’t told Zhang Jian that Dai Mao was actually the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
So, what seemed perfectly normal to Zhang Jian, appeared abnormal instead.
What kind of person is the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, even if his recovery is slow, he should have mostly recovered by now.
How could he still suffer such severe injuries up to now?
Unless he met other Nascent Soul Cultivators and got seriously injured again in the fight.
Otherwise, there’s just no explanation.
Zhang Jian then said:
“If you want to deal with Dai Mao, I think it’s best to take advantage now, while he’s severely injured, otherwise once he recovers from his injuries, it will be troublesome.”
Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei glanced at each other and then said:
“Wait a moment…”
“We need to prepare for a while, in case of any deceit.”
“You know, Dai Mao is a Demon Cultivator, always full of tricks.”
After hearing this, Zhang Jian nodded:
“Hmm, Brother Lin is right…”
……
Then, Lin Jing asked Zhang Jian again:
“Right, Brother Yan mentioned earlier that you wanted to ask me about Spirit Plants, what did you want to know?”
At this mention, Zhang Jian immediately brightened up and hurriedly said:
“When I came here before, I saw that the Spirit Plants in the Spirit Field on this island are growing so well, how did you do it?”
“Honestly, I have a Spirit Field on Xian Yu Island too, but the growth of the Spirit Plants there is somewhat…hard to describe.”
Lin Jing then said with a smile:
“Of course, Spirit Plants need careful maintenance to grow well, you’re always running around every few days, and if you don’t have time to take care of the Spirit Plants in your own Spirit Field, how can they grow well?”
However, Zhang Jian shook his head and then said:
“That’s not it, Brother Lin…”
“If I’m not wrong, there should be someone on this island who is proficient in cultivating Spirit Plants, right?”
Although Zhang Jian had visited Li Yan Island many times, Yue Qiniang was almost always either cultivating or taking care of the Spirit Plants.
She hardly ever stayed long in Li Yan City.
So naturally, Zhang Jian didn’t know Yue Qiniang.
Zhang Jian continued:
“Previously, I visited one of the three major islands, Yue Tian Island, and there, there was a cultivator proficient in Spirit Plants cultivation, who also spent his days wandering about in search of rare Spirit Plants.”
“But the Spirit Plants in his field were growing even better than yours here.”
Hearing about Yue Tian Island, Lin Jing suddenly remembered something.
So he asked Zhang Jian:
“You’ve been to Yue Tian Island?”
Zhang Jian nodded and said:
“Yes, Yue Tian Island is an open island, just like Bihai City, accessible to everyone.”
“How strong is Yue Tian Island?” Lin Jing then asked.
“You came to develop in the Thousand Islands Domain without understanding the local forces beforehand?” Zhang Jian wondered.
Yan Wanfei then said:
“Actually, we haven’t…”
“We ended up on this Li Yan Island by accident, so please tell us…”
Seeing that Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei really didn’t understand the power distribution of the Thousand Islands Domain,
Zhang Jian started explaining:
“The Thousand Islands Domain contains three major islands, each of them almost equivalent to a small piece of land.”
“The strength of these three islands is also the most formidable, each island has a Divine Transformation Cultivator stationed on it, and the Yue Tian Island I just mentioned is one of these three major islands.”
“You just said that Yue Tian Island is an open island, does that mean anyone is allowed on the island?” Yan Wanfei asked at this point.
Zhang Jian nodded and said:
“Right…”
“The Domain has many islands, and some people, after taking possession, do not welcome others and directly close off the island, restricting others from entering.”
“While other islands are different, some cultivators, after taking over an island, do not isolate it but instead invite other cultivators to live together, collaborating to protect the island.”
“That’s what constitutes an open island.”
“Originally, Yue Tian Island was also a private island, but after it was taken over by the former Island Master Li Mingwu, he turned Yue Tian Island into an open island.”
“Li Mingwu?”
Lin Jing suddenly thought of Lingyin True Monarch’s last words.
He then asked Zhang Jian:
“This Li Mingwu you mentioned, is he also a Divine Transformation Stage Cultivator?”
Zhang Jian nodded and said:
“Of course…”
“As the Island Master of Yue Tian Island, one must possess the power of the Divine Transformation Stage to hold authority.”
“Moreover, it is said that Li Mingwu is very kind-hearted, often helping the cultivators on the island, and every time there is a crisis on the island, he is always the first to rush to the front, earning much praise from many people.”
“It’s just unfortunate that, hundreds of years ago, Li Mingwu disappeared, and by now, he has probably long passed away.”
“Dead?” Lin Jing looked surprised.
“Most likely…” Zhang Jian nodded.
“You see, he was already famous 2000 years ago, and passing so much time now without advancing beyond the Spirit Transformation, he couldn’t sustain his lifespan.”
“It was said that for this reason, he spent his last time searching for a breakthrough opportunity.”
“Up till now, hundreds of years have passed, and still, there has been no news of him, so there’s only one outcome.”
“Furthermore, even with the cultivation of the Divine Transformation Stage, not breaking through to Above the Spirit Transformation, 2,000 years are too much for his lifespan.”
“I see…” Lin Jing nodded.
Indeed, Lingyin True Monarch was a figure from 2000 years ago, and Li Mingwu being from the same era, even if he had ascended to the Divine Transformation Stage, his lifespan would still be just over 2000 years.
Not breaking through to the next rank would only lead to the depletion of his lifespan.
In this case, his death seems quite normal.

chapters.title: Chapter 383: 83 Lu Youjiu's Tribulation
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 83 Lu Youjiu’s Tribulation
“Oh right, bitch Zhang…”
“You kept mentioning ‘Above the Divinity Transformation,’ what exactly is that realm?”
At this moment, Yan Wanfei looked interested as he asked Zhang Jian.
Zhang Jian, looking helpless, spread his hands and said:
“I’m not clear about that…”
“The law is not to be passed on… It seems that this realm can only be known after reaching the Divinity Transformation Stage.”
“For us lower-ranked cultivators, we simply refer to it as ‘Above the Divinity Transformation.'”
Yan Wanfei pursed his lips and said:
“I thought you would know…”
“What a waste of my expressions.”
Zhang Jian directly glared at him and said:
“What do you think I am, a know-it-all?”
Yet, Yan Wanfei, still not giving up, continued to question Zhang Jian:
“Then, in the Southern Outer Seas, are there any existences ‘Above the Divinity Transformation’?”
Zhang Jian frowned, thought for a moment, and said:
“This…”
“I have indeed heard some things. It is said that the Lord of Bihai City is an existence ‘Above the Divinity Transformation.'”
“Other than that, I’m not clear.”
“As for the Thousand Islands Domain, I have never heard of anyone with a cultivation ‘Above the Divinity Transformation.’ Even if there were, if they do not wish to reveal themselves, we wouldn’t know.”
Yan Wanfei muttered:
“That’s true…”
After Yan Wanfei finished speaking, Zhang Jian continued to address the two of them:
“I find that you are too unfamiliar with the entire Thousand Islands Domain.”
“Thus…”
“When I return, I’ll find some relevant books or materials for you to read.”
“Don’t accidentally provoke those formidable individuals and bring unnecessary disaster upon yourselves.”
“In the Thousand Islands Domain, there are thousands of islands, and the minimum cultivation level of an island master is at the Golden Core Stage. Do you know how many Nascent Soul Cultivators there are here, or how many Divine Transformation Cultivators?”
“So, it is best to keep a low profile.”
After listening, the two nodded their heads, and then Lin Jing bowed with his fists and said:
“Then I’ll trouble Brother Zhang.”
“Brother Lin is too polite,” Zhang Jian replied.
“Oh right, Brother Zhang…”
“If you’re interested in cultivating spirit plants, there is indeed someone on our island who is proficient in cultivating spirit plants, and she also has a family spell specifically for taking care of spirit plants.”
“Brother Zhang, if you wish to learn, you’ll have to find her yourself. Although we now occupy this island, we can’t force her to do anything.”
After hearing this, Zhang Jian nodded:
“I understand, after all, there are many original islanders on each island, and cultivators, even if occupying an island, will coexist peacefully with them.”
After speaking, Zhang Jian continued:
“Since it is a family cultivation technique…”
“I will think about it. If not, I might pay a price to see if I can get her to print a copy for me.”
“That should be no problem…” Lin Jing added.
…
…
Afterwards, the group conversed for a while, and then Lin Jing took Zhang Jian to find Yue Qiniang to exchange cultivation techniques.
……
In the blink of an eye, another half a year had passed.
Lu Youjiu had finally accumulated enough and came out of seclusion.
As soon as Lu Youjiu emerged from seclusion, he met Lin Jing and the others.
At this time, Holaw Three Rivers stepped forward, pulled out a Storage Bag, and handed it to Lu Youjiu, saying:
“This is prepared for you, Tribulation-crossing Magical Treasure, and the Tribulation Elixir Medicine that Brother Lin prepared for you. All are here.”
“The location for crossing the tribulation that we previously found is also ready.”
“We can head there now.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and said:
“Good, let’s set off now.”
After speaking, the group boarded the Flying Boat and flew towards the previously-found location for crossing the tribulation…
……
Riding the Flying Boat after several days of continuous flight, Lin Jing and the others finally arrived at the small island prepared for crossing the tribulation.
This place, being quite far from the Thousand Islands Domain and surrounded by a region where spiritual energy is quite sparse, rarely saw other cultivators visit.
Thus, there would be no disturbances.
However, as a location for crossing the tribulation, it was perfectly suitable.
Upon arriving on the island, they immediately descended.
Just in the center of the island, a huge Formation had been leveled and dominated the area.
This Formation, set up by Holaw Three Rivers, was to assist Lu Youjiu in his tribulation.
After landing on the island, Holaw Three Rivers proceeded to check the Formation and, seeing no anomalies, indicated to Lu Youjiu that he could begin.
Lu Youjiu nodded, then settled himself cross-legged in the middle of the Formation.
Then.
Holaw Three Rivers turned back to Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei and said:
“Brother Lin, Niu San…”
“Each of you guard a direction. Be careful not to let any other cultivators or Demonic Beasts come and disturb us.”
Lin Jing nodded and said, “No problem.”
Yan Wanfei agreed as well, “Don’t worry, San He.”
Having said that, the two split apart, one to the south and the other to the north, leaving the island.
The island was not large, covering only a few square kilometers, and the tribulation Lu Youjiu had to cross was the Nascent Soul Heavenly Tribulation.
The range of the Nascent Soul Heavenly Tribulation was not small, so to avoid being detected by the Heavenly Tribulation, it was necessary to stay far from the island.
Only when they felt their positions were roughly right did the two stop.
Meanwhile, Holaw Three Rivers set up the final array encircling the entire island on the island.
This large array was not for aiding in resisting the Heavenly Tribulation, but the main purpose was for protection in case of accidents.
Several hours passed, and the island-surrounding large array had been set up, and Holaw Three Rivers also left the island.
At this moment, in the middle of the island, only Lu Youjiu remained, meditating.
……
Time elapsed, and quickly two days passed.
By now, Lu Youjiu had elevated his cultivation to its optimal state.
However, he suddenly opened his eyes, then took out a small jade vial from his storage bag, and poured out a Nirvana Elixir from it.
He then tossed it directly into his mouth and continued to meditate.
This scene was naturally seen by Lin Jing and the others.
Therefore, they retreated further back, waiting for the arrival of the Heavenly Tribulation.
…
…
Finally.
After a few more hours, Lin Jing and the others began to sense an unusual aura.
The atmosphere in the sky seemed to start becoming oppressive.
The originally calm sea surface also began to stir up waves at this time.
In the sky, dark clouds started to converge above the island, forming a layer of black curtain.
As time slowly passed, the dark clouds in the sky also became thicker.
Even the atmosphere between heaven and earth grew increasingly heavy with the gathering of the Tribulation Clouds.
Until an hour had passed, the Tribulation Lightning had still not descended.
However, by now, the Tribulation Clouds had completely enveloped the entire island.
Inside those clouds, the sound of rumbling thunder continued, along with various lightning continuously within the clouds.
As the dark Tribulation Clouds kept rolling.
By this time, Lu Youjiu had already stopped meditating, stood up, tilted his head back, and stared directly at the Tribulation Lightning above.
Even his Cold Light Longsword was already in his hands, clearly, Lu Youjiu was ready, just waiting for the Tribulation Lightning to fall.
Finally.
After waiting for quite a while more.
“Boom”
A loud thunderclap came, and the first wave of Tribulation Lightning struck directly towards the center of the island, where Lu Youjiu was.
At this moment, Lin Jing, watching this scene from afar on the sea surface, was also deeply shaken by this wave of Tribulation Lightning.
This being just the first wave of Tribulation Lightning, it was already terrifying.
Even from a distance, Lin Jing could distinctly feel the destructive aura of the Tribulation Lightning.
Moreover, this wave of Tribulation Lightning was thicker than any he had seen before, including those he experienced during his own tribulation.
A breath later.
The Tribulation Lightning dissipated, and Lin Jing saw everything on the island again.
This wave of Tribulation Lightning was indeed not small; the first strike alone destroyed a large area of the island’s mountains and trees.
It had flattened a whole large area.
However, situated at the center of the formation, Lu Youjiu seemed normal, showing no signs of abnormality.
Suddenly, the second wave of Tribulation Lightning followed.
The dazzling lightning engulfed Lu Youjiu once again…
At this moment, Lin Jing saw that the formation set up by Holaw Three Rivers was frantically operating, diverting the power of the Heavenly Tribulation elsewhere.
As for those powers that could not be diverted, they were directly absorbed by Lu Youjiu himself.
Only now did Lin Jing understand, no wonder the first wave of Tribulation Lightning caused such massive destruction to the island.
It was because of the formation.
The second wave of Tribulation Lightning also quickly dissipated.
Located within the formation, Lu Youjiu was still unharmed.
After a period of brewing in the sky, the Tribulation Clouds began to stir again, followed by…
The third wave…
The fourth wave…
The fifth wave…
…
…
Several consecutive waves of Tribulation Lightning struck down.
The formation set up by Holaw Three Rivers ultimately could not withstand it, and with a loud “bang,” it burst open.
At this time.
The sixth wave of Tribulation Lightning had just ended.
The entire island was already a sight of devastation.
Even the sole mountain on the island had been flattened by this terrifying Tribulation Lightning.
Fortunately, this was originally an uninhabited island; otherwise, no one would have escaped.
At this time, the defensive formation had shattered.
The subsequent last three waves of Tribulation Lightning were now up to Lu Youjiu himself.
However, fortunately, from the beginning to now, Lu Youjiu’s consumption had not been very great, so the upcoming waves of Tribulation Lightning should not pose any problem.
The final three waves of Tribulation Lightning always took a long time to brew.
By now, Lu Youjiu had already produced two Defensive Magical Treasures and looked up at the skies, at the ceaselessly churning Tribulation Clouds.
“Crackle…”
In an instant, countless Tribulation Lightning converged into a beam a hundred meters in diameter and struck directly down.
This seventh wave of Tribulation Lightning, before its appearance, had not shown any signs whatsoever.
From afar, Lin Jing, watching this robust column of thunder, felt somewhat terrified.
Moreover, this seventh wave of Tribulation Lightning lasted particularly long.
It lasted for three breaths.
When the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing saw Lu Youjiu in the center of the island, now injured and his spiritual power dimmed significantly.
At this moment, Lin Jing saw.
Lu Youjiu took out two Pure Jade Boxes, then took out the Elixir Medicine inside them and swallowed it.
After swallowing them, Lu Youjiu immediately sat down cross-legged and began to meditate again.
Because.
The upcoming last two waves of Tribulation Lightning were the most crucial and also the most challenging.
He had to restore his condition to its best, to face the upcoming two waves of Tribulation Lightning in a more perfect state.
Moreover, this challenge could only depend on him alone.
No one else could help him.

chapters.title: Chapter 384: 84 Tribulation Success, Obtaining Intelligence
chapters.content:
Chapter 384: Chapter 84 Tribulation Success, Obtaining Intelligence
The eighth thunderbolt of the tribulation took quite some time to brew.
Above Lu Youjiu’s head, within the tribulation clouds, the sound of “rumbling” thunder was incessant, and countless dazzling lightning bolts tumbled within the clouds alongside the thunder.
The oppression brought about by the entire tribulation cloud grew more and more terrifying.
Clearly, the eighth thunderbolt of the tribulation was about to finish brewing.
It was at this moment that Lu Youjiu suddenly opened his eyes and stood up, operating his Magical Treasure to protect his body.
Following that,
Lu Youjiu took the gourd from his waist, opened the stopper, and directly gulped down a mouthful of wine.
With this mouthful of wine, even though Lin Jing was far away, he could feel that the Spiritual Power in Lu Youjiu’s body surged tremendously in an instant.
After that, Lu Youjiu pointed his sword towards the sky and soared upwards.
It was at that moment,
that the eighth thunderbolt fell.
A massive column of thunderous light instantly engulfed Lu Youjiu entirely.
Lin Jing concentrated his Spiritual Power in his eyes just to barely make out what was happening inside.
At this moment, Lu Youjiu, whose injuries had almost healed, was once again wounded by the eighth thunderbolt, and the injuries were even more severe than before.
The two protective Magical Treasures emitted a cyan light as they worked at full capacity to protect Lu Youjiu.
Very quickly, the protective Magical Treasures could no longer hold on.
One of the treasures, which already had some cracks, could not withstand the devastation of the tribulation lightning anymore…
With a “bang,” it shattered.
In this way, it had fulfilled its mission.
And the situation with the other Magical Treasure was not optimistic either.
Finally, when the second Magical Treasure began to show extensive cracks and was about to shatter, the eighth thunderbolt had at last completed its course.
Now looking at Lu Youjiu again,
his body was covered in wounds, even his usually clean white clothes were stained red with blood.
In some places, they had stuck to the flesh exposed by his injuries.
At first glance, it was hard to distinguish between clothes and flesh.
Lu Youjiu was gravely injured, and the island under his feet had also been reduced by more than one layer by the thunderbolt.
The whole island had become incredibly flat.
The fragmented rocks on the island melted under the bombardment of the thunderbolt and then solidified into large clusters.
These clusters of rocks melted and solidified by the thunderbolt could no longer be considered as mere rocks but had turned into a kind of metal.
Lin Jing thought that these metals could even be used for Artifact Refining Materials.
Though they wouldn’t make Magical Treasures, they should be suitable for refining Magic Artifacts.
……
After the eighth thunderbolt had passed, Lu Youjiu once again took out two Elixir Medicines and consumed them.
He needed to take advantage of every moment available to recover quickly and prepare for the final thunderbolt.
Looking at Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei, their faces filled with worry as they watched Lu Youjiu in the center of the island.
Lin Jing, however, was paying attention to the churning tribulation clouds above Lu Youjiu’s head.
With the continuous sounds of “rumbling” coming from within the clouds, the tribulation clouds above were still consolidating.
By the looks of their preparation, this final thunderbolt could very well be several times more powerful than the eighth.
However, just as Lin Jing was pondering this…
Suddenly.
With a “crack,” the final thunderbolt unexpectedly fell.
At this moment, Lu Youjiu was still sitting in meditation below.
And the suddenness of the thunderbolt’s descent was so abrupt that the others didn’t even have time to react.
The thunderbolt engulfed Lu Youjiu completely.
The group was immediately shocked, as this final thunderbolt was too capricious and had come all too suddenly.
Lin Jing then looked at Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei.
Holaw Three Rivers had a grim expression, staring intently at the thick thunderbolt.
And Yan Wanfei was wearing a look of extreme anxiety.
But they both knew that no matter how anxious they were, they had to wait.
The Heavenly Tribulation did not care who was undergoing the tribulation; anyone rashly entering its range would cause the power of the Heavenly Tribulation to double instantly.
Therefore,
the two of them dared not act rashly at this time.
……
The last thunderbolt lasted for a full nine breaths’ time.
Once the thunderbolt dissipated, the three rushed to look towards the center of the island.
They saw a deep crater thousands of meters wide at the center of the island.
Around the edge of this crater were rocks that had been scorched red-hot, some of which had already melted by half.
Looking down from above, Lin Jing saw Lu Youjiu, whose body was charred black, at the center of the crater.
At that moment, Lu Youjiu was almost unrecognizable as human.
But he was still sitting cross-legged in the pit.
Lin Jing focused his gaze and could see that Lu Youjiu’s blackened chest rose and fell slightly.
Seeing this, Lin Jing let out a sigh of relief.
It seemed that Lu Youjiu had succeeded in overcoming the tribulation.
But at that time, the tribulation clouds in the sky above the island still lingered, so they did not dare to approach and could only watch from a distance.
Only after some time did the tribulation clouds over the island gradually disperse, and the weather returned to being clear.
Seeing that the tribulation clouds had completely scattered and that the oppressive and fearsome pressure of the heavens had vanished,
Lin Jing and the others finally returned to the island.
No sooner had they met than Yan Wanfei slapped his chest and said,
“I was scared to death just now, especially by that last thunderbolt, it was so sudden.”
“I thought we’d still have to wait a little longer for it to fall, but who knew it would come down so unexpectedly and without any signs.”
“It looked like Brother Jiu didn’t even have time to react.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded, still shaken, and said,
“Me too…”
“That last thunderbolt was really too strange.”
Lin Jing also nodded in agreement.
“`
“Let’s go check on Brother Jiu…” Yan Wanfei followed up.
San He nodded and said,
“Keep it down later, don’t disturb him. He just went through a tribulation, and now is a critical time.”
Yan Wanfei nodded repeatedly and said,
“Don’t worry, I know.”
Immediately after.
The three of them walked together towards the center of the island.
Upon reaching the middle, they stopped at the edge of the deep pit formed by the lightning strikes and did not disturb Lu Youjiu inside.
After observing for a while and seeing that Lu Youjiu was not in any serious trouble and was still recovering,
San He took out an Array Plate and placed a few Spirit Stones on it.
The grand formation appeared instantly, enveloping Lu Youjiu at the bottom of the pit.
Then, a surge of Spiritual Power began to flood towards the Array Plate…
It turned out that this was a Spirit Gathering Array.
After setting up the Spirit Gathering Array.
San He then gestured to Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei to leave the area with him.
Once out, they stayed on the island, waiting for Lu Youjiu to awaken.
……
This wait lasted several days.
It wasn’t until a few days later that Lu Youjiu finally began to wake up gradually.
The moment Lu Youjiu opened his eyes, an immense and terrifying Divine Sense pressure burst forth, appearing instantaneously.
This pressure appeared only for a moment before vanishing.
Afterwards, the group came back to the edge of the pit.
By then, Lu Youjiu had already stood up.
Then, with a smile on his face, he looked at them and said,
“Nascent Soul Stage, I’ve succeeded…”
Yan Wanfei chuckled and said,
“Heh, heh…”
“Congratulations, Brother Jiu, impressive as always.”
Lin Jing also spoke up at this point,
“Congratulations, Brother Lu, on successfully advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
San He smiled as he looked towards Lu Youjiu in the pit.
Following that.
Lu Youjiu waved his hand, and before everyone could react, he had already changed into a set of clean clothes.
And they were white.
Ever since Lin Jing had met him, he had always worn white.
He had never worn clothes of any other color, as if Lu Youjiu had a special preference for this white attire.
Then, with a flicker, he suddenly appeared in front of everyone.
“Now that I have successfully reached the Nascent Soul Stage, it’s time for us to settle the score with that Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.”
“Only I’m not sure how much his cultivation has recovered by now.”
“Do you have any news of him?”
After speaking, Lu Youjiu looked towards Lin Jing and the others.
Yan Wanfei then said,
“I know some…”
“A few months ago, Zhang Jian told me a bit about the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.”
“Moreover, it seems that not only has he not recovered, but his injuries have become even more severe.”
Yan Wanfei then relayed the information he received from Zhang Jian about Dai Mao to Lu Youjiu.
After hearing this, Lu Youjiu furrowed his brows in deep thought for a moment.
Then he said, “It’s been so long, and yet he hasn’t even recovered from his injuries, which seems rather unlikely.”
“Let’s head back now and then try to find out more.”
“After the investigation, we’ll make preparations and set off to eliminate this threat.”
“Okay…”
Everyone responded.
After returning to Li Yan Island, Lu Youjiu immediately began to investigate.
San He too was making preparations.
After all, this time, they planned to eradicate the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch once and for all,
and they couldn’t allow him to escape.
Therefore, the formations of San He were crucial.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei were relatively free with less to do.
A few days later, Lu Youjiu returned from Bihai City.
He also brought back some intelligence on the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch from the Seven Seas Hall.
It must be said, the Seven Seas Hall was indeed powerful;
even their intelligence capabilities were unmatched.
But this was to be expected.
With so many pact cultivators at their disposal, obtaining intelligence was surely an easy task.
One only had to issue a mission, and countless pact cultivators would help complete it.
Moreover, the Seven Seas Hall also consciously collected various intelligence on their own.
Even if someone had special information, they could submit it to the Seven Seas Hall, which would analyze and verify it. Once confirmed as accurate, they would reward the cultivator who provided the intelligence handsomely.
However, such a model did not put the Seven Seas Hall at a loss.
Because there would always be those who needed such intelligence.
Take Lu Youjiu, for instance,
he had purchased the intelligence about Dai Mao’s whereabouts through the Seven Seas Hall.
He even posted a mission at the Hall to learn a bit about the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s deeds.
Upon Lu Youjiu’s return, he immediately gathered everyone,
and when they arrived, he shared the intelligence he’d gathered:
“This is the intelligence obtained from the Seven Seas Hall, take a look.”
As he spoke, Lu Youjiu took out the intelligence he had acquired from the Seven Seas Hall.
Upon seeing the intelligence, Lin Jing and the others immediately crowded around.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 385: 85: Reunion with the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 385: Chapter 85: Reunion with the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch
“In mid-May, Sanxin Island was destroyed, and all the cultivators on the island perished…”
“The demon cultivator Dai Mao appeared near Sanxin Island, and the destruction of Sanxin Island is suspected to be related to him.”
…
“At the beginning of June, Qiying Island was attacked, by none other than Dai Mao. Several Golden Core cultivators joined forces, trying to take him down.”
“They were no match, drained dry into mummies.”
…
“In early July, Dai Mao encountered True Master Lianxin, and after hundreds of exchanges, they parted…”
“Dai Mao is suspected to cultivate the Devouring Human Essence and Blood Demon Skill, having successfully ascended to the Nascent Soul Stage. Be extremely cautious upon sight.”
…
“In late August, Dai Mao attacked Panqing Island, which led to its annihilation. Not a single member of the island’s Alchemy Dao noble family, the Pan family, survived; their clan’s treasured heirloom was lost…”
…
“At the beginning of September, five Golden Core cultivators died mysteriously, as tracks of Dai Mao’s recent presence were found nearby…”
…
“October…”
…
…
All these incidents, one after another, were the doings of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Moreover, by this time, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had already recovered to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Then, the group continued to read on.
Lastly, there were records of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s last known whereabouts.
“Dai Mao was last seen near the southwestern area of the Thousand Islands Domain, close to the Linxi triple islands…”
After reading, the group raised their heads.
Lu Youjiu then spoke, asking,
“Now that you’ve read it, what do you think?”
However, Yan Wanfei directly said,
“What’s there to think about?”
“Of course, it’s to find him and then blow him to smithereens.”
Yan Wanfei’s words were always so simple and straightforward.
Yet the words that followed from Lu Youjiu took the group by surprise.
“This time, I want to go alone…”
“The rest of you should stay here, no need to take risks.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei immediately turned her head, looking at Lu Youjiu with confusion, before asking,
“Why’s that? Big Bro Jiū…”
“Didn’t we agree to go together?”
Even Lin Jing and Holaw Three Rivers were puzzled, not understanding why Lu Youjiu would say this.
After pondering for a moment, Holaw Three Rivers furrowed his brows and said,
“That Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch is so vicious, it’s really not great for you to go alone.”
“Besides, didn’t I still need to help you set up the formation?”
“That’s true for Brother Lin and Niu San—they don’t necessarily need to go.”
Hearing this, Yan Wanfei immediately became dissatisfied,
“San He, why can you go, but we can’t?”
“No way, I also want to contribute.”
……
Lu Youjiu then spoke again,
“Actually, I do have some considerations for not letting you all go.”
“The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch ascending to the Nascent Soul Stage was within expectation, but it was only after my own ascension to the Nascent Soul Stage that I realized just how vast the gap between the Nascent Soul and Golden Core Stages truly is.”
“Before, we were too confident, thinking that with just a few of us, we could truly take down a Nascent Soul Cultivator.”
“You’ve also read the report just now; so many Golden Core cultivators teamed up against the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch and were all killed by him.”
“If you all come with me, I’m afraid something unexpected might happen.”
Lu Youjiu’s words left the group in deep thought.
After pondering for a while, Lin Jing looked directly at Lu Youjiu and said,
“Brother Lu…”
“This time, I’m afraid we really have to go together.”
Lu Youjiu then turned his head, looking at Lin Jing, waiting for his reasoning.
Lin Jing continued,
“We are going there to utterly defeat him, and if you go alone, it will be somewhat difficult to achieve that.”
“Brother San He needs to set up the formation, and that goes without saying.”
“And both Niu San and I can flank on the side. Even if we can’t match him, we have the capability to hold him back.”
“Moreover, we have to search for his hiding place this time. If you go by yourself, you will have to look on your own.”
“Perhaps he will wait for you to make a mistake and strike when you least expect it, but if we go together, we can help share that burden and then force him out.”
“That way, Brother Lu, you’ll be in a better condition to face the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch. With this plan, won’t our chances of success be even greater…”
After Lin Jing finished, Yan Wanfei quickly expressed her agreement,
“Right! Big Bro Jiū…”
“Brother Lin is right; if we’re going to take him down, it’s naturally better to do it together.”
Holaw Three Rivers also nodded,
“I’ve prepared two formations this time, which should play a significant role in the fight.”
Lin Jing continued,
“There’s also the most important point…”
“If you face him alone and something goes awry, allowing him to escape, then the three of us staying here might be in more danger than if we were with you.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu’s expression darkened.
Indeed, his original intent was not to expose the group to danger. Yet if that not only failed to keep them safe but instead put them in greater danger, then it was entirely pointless.
So…
After a moment of silence, Lu Youjiu said,
“Alright, then we’ll go together…”
…
…
Upon the serene sea surface, a silver-white streak of light suddenly shot across at an extreme speed.
After the light passed by, the Demonic Beasts that originally lingered on the surface, startled, swiftly dived into the depths of the sea.
That streak of light was the Flying Boat on which Lin Jing and his companions were embarked.
Several days had elapsed since their last meeting and discussion.
By now, Lin Jing and his companions had already reached the vicinity of the three western islands.
Moreover, they had already made two complete circles around the area.
At that moment, they were planning to head to a somewhat remote island to gather information.
Because, not long before, they had learned that Dai Mao might still be in this sea area and had not left.
Without any further discussion, they drove their Flying Boat there directly.
Inside the Flying Boat, Lu Youjiu was controlling the vessel, while Lin Jing and the other two sat in the cockpit, idly chatting.
Yan Wanfei said,
“Speaking of which, will the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch really head to Nanli Island?”
“On Nanli Island, there are several Golden Core Late Stage, and even Golden Core Peak Cultivators with formidable strength…”
“If he goes there now, he shouldn’t be able to gain much of an advantage, should he?”
However, Holaw Three Rivers said at this time,
“From the intelligence we’ve gathered, Nanli Island should be the most suitable for him.”
“Right now, he must be relying on devouring those Golden Core Cultivators to restore his Cultivation.”
“Thus, we must find him before he fully recovers and kill him.”
Lu Youjiu also spoke up to the others,
“Besides, he should be stronger now than before.”
“All of you need to be extra cautious.”
“Okay…” the group nodded in agreement.
Afterward, Lu Youjiu observed the front, controlling the Flying Boat as they proceeded forward.
Not much time passed, and about four hours later, they finally arrived at Nanli Island.
Even before reaching the island, they could already sense the tragic aura and smell the blood that permeated the air.
They then piloted the Flying Boat directly over Nanli Island.
In the middle of Nanli Island, there was a city, which at that moment lay silent as death.
Lin Jing and his companions subsequently disembarked from the Flying Boat and descended into the city.
Crimson bloodstains, contorted mummies, and even shattered corpses were everywhere to be seen.
Walking along the streets of the city, Lin Jing saw mummified bodies desiccated of all fluids everywhere.
These mummies looked ferocious, their bodies curled or contorted.
Clearly, they had suffered immensely before their deaths.
Most of these victims were ordinary people without any Cultivation.
It seemed that the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had used a wide-ranging Spell to drain everyone in the entire city.
Before this, when they read about such events in reports, it didn’t seem quite real.
But upon witnessing the horrific state of the city with their own eyes, Lin Jing was truly horrified by the stark reality.
Beyond these mummified bodies, there were other corpses, or rather, fragments of bodies.
These remains likely belonged to the Cultivators who had resisted first, and the results of their resistance seemed far from favorable.
Lin Jing swiftly moved through the alleys and streets, eventually rising to mid-air to survey the entire city.
But alas, he found not a single survivor.
Even sweeping with his Divine Sense, there was nothing but deadly silence everywhere.
A moment later, Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei approached Lin Jing.
“Everyone on the island is dead. I even saw a Golden Core Cultivator who died explosively,” Yan Wanfei said directly.
Holaw Three Rivers then said,
“These bloodstains haven’t completely dried up, it seems the massacre didn’t happen too long ago. If we pursue now, we should be able to catch up.”
Lin Jing nodded in agreement,
“Indeed…”
“Let’s go, we’re heading back to the Flying Boat now.”
Having said that, the three made their way back to the Flying Boat.
Once on the Flying Boat, Lu Youjiu spoke,
“Have you completed your investigation, what’s the situation?”
“Not a single survivor,” replied Holaw Three Rivers.
“However, the slaughter seems to have happened not too long ago, possibly within the last couple of hours. If we pursue now, we should be able to catch up.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and responded,
“Good…”
With that, they set off again, chasing toward the direction ahead.
After searching for half an hour, they finally discovered traces of battle left behind in the seas to the south of Nanli Island.
They continued to pilot the Flying Boat forward.
Before long, they felt a rampant aura ahead.
Within this aura was a powerful Demonic Qi suppressing several other breaths.
The group exchanged glances and then, Lu Youjiu directly steered the Flying Boat towards the ongoing battle.
In no time, they arrived near the battlefield.
Next, Lu Youjiu retracted the Flying Boat and flew through the air directly towards the battlefield.
Lin Jing and the other two followed closely behind on their flying swords.
When they arrived at the battlefield, they caught sight of the fierce combat between the two sides.
One of the parties was unmistakably in the likeness of Dai Mao, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was enveloped in a sky-covering demonic aura, shrouding the nearby area completely.
Each of his attacks carried a vast amount of Demonic Qi, enhancing the power of his Spells even further.
Opposite him, three Golden Core Late Stage Cultivators were jointly resisting the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
However, these three were covered in wounds, and the aura of their Cultivation fluctuated uncertainly.
The situation seemed extremely dire.
It appeared that they wouldn’t last much longer before falling at this place…

chapters.title: Chapter 386: 86: Besieged
chapters.content:
Chapter 386: Chapter 86: Besieged
At this moment, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was just about to gather Demonic Qi, aiming to take down the three individuals in one fell swoop.
However, just at that time, Lin Jing and his group arrived.
Charging at the forefront was naturally Lu Youjiu, who had already reached the Nascent Soul Stage.
When the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch saw the newcomers, he was stunned for a moment, and his attack slowed down a bit as a result.
The three Golden Core Late Stage cultivators, seeing this opportunity, quickly retreated a great distance.
……
It wasn’t until they saw the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch that Lin Jing and the others realized he was indeed stronger than they had imagined.
Over time, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had become more powerful, and even his cultivation had recovered to the middle phase of the Nascent Soul Stage.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch looked at the group, furrowed his brow, and spoke:
“It’s you few…”
Following that.
He gazed at Lu Youjiu at the very front:
“I didn’t expect you to have reached the Nascent Soul Stage already.”
“You actually dared to come here, quite confident, aren’t you?”
After speaking, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch glanced at Lin Jing behind him, then let out a cold snort.
“Hmph!”
“You don’t really think I’m scared of you, do you?”
At this moment, the three Golden Core cultivators stepped forward and said to Lu Youjiu:
“Senior, be careful…”
“This Demon Cultivator, Dai Mao, has cultivated some sort of demonic technique that is extremely difficult to deal with; he can even absorb people’s essence and blood to replenish himself.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and then indicated for the three of them to step back.
Recognizing the cue, they promptly moved to the side and started to recover on their own.
At this point in the arena, Lu Youjiu and the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch stood opposed to each other, while Lin Jing and the other two were ready to assist at any moment.
……
At this moment, Lu Youjiu made the first move. With the Cold Light Longsword in hand, he swung out with a strike.
A vast wave of white sword energy shot out, directly sweeping towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Upon seeing this, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch also gathered a massive amount of Demonic Qi, forming a crescent-shaped, sword-like black Demon Qi that collided with Lu Youjiu’s sword energy.
“Boom!”
A loud explosion erupted as Lu Youjiu’s sword energy collided with the black Demon Qi, causing them to explode violently.
The blast generated shockwaves that forced Lin Jing and the three Golden Core cultivators, as well as others, to involuntarily retreat a distance.
Even Lu Youjiu himself was forced two steps back.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch saw this and couldn’t help but laugh.
“Heh heh…”
“Just having entered the Nascent Soul Stage and you dream of troubling me, you’re far too naive.”
However, without uttering a word, Lu Youjiu simply took a large gourd from his waist and gulped down a mouthful of liquor.
In the next moment, Lu Youjiu’s aura surged, growing noticeably stronger.
Seeing this, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s brow furrowed, and he immediately gathered the black Demonic Qi around him and launched another attack at Lu Youjiu.
Lu Youjiu positioned the Cold Light Longsword in front of him and started to cast a spell with one hand, murmuring incantations.
Soon, the Cold Light Longsword began to divide: one into two, two into four, four into eight…
Before long, numerous longswords densely filled up the nearby area.
Right then, the black Demonic Qi reached him.
Lu Youjiu, unfazed, flicked his finger, and the Flying Swords moved in unison.
The swords, radiating white light, completely blocked the black Demonic Qi from getting through.
Then, Lu Youjiu directly controlled the Flying Swords and launched them toward the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch…
As Lu Youjiu charged forward, Lin Jing and his group also made their move.
As previously agreed, Lu Youjiu was responsible for the main assault.
The other three, Lin Jing included, each took a position in different directions.
Their purpose was to prevent the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch from escaping.
Even Holaw Three Rivers had started preparing to scatter Formation Flags nearby to trap the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch in place.
Seeing the others taking action, the three injured Golden Core cultivators, at first wanting to caution them,
fell silent upon spotting the Formation Flags in Holaw Three Rivers’ hands and retreated a good distance away.
At this point, although they weren’t completely depleted, they were nearly spent and remaining on the battlefield would provide no assistance.
It was better to withdraw and heal; once their strength was somewhat recovered, they could then offer help.
At the center of the battlefield, the countless Flying Swords Lu Youjiu wielded had firmly restrained the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
The battle between them was fiercely intense.
However, with the black Demonic Qi obscuring the view, the situation inside was largely unclear to the others.
All that could be seen was the swirling black Demonic Qi on the outside, and the sweeping lights of the swords inside…
Of course, there was also the explosive release of the terrifying cultivation auras from both individuals.
Under this stirring influence, a slight misstep could lead to injury. Lin Jing and Yan Wan wanted to join in but found themselves unable to intervene.
After all, the battlefield was dominated by two Nascent Soul cultivators, well beyond their means to take part in.
Meanwhile, Holaw Three Rivers continued to move around the edges of the battlefield, constantly planting Formation Flags in every corner of the arena.
Very quickly.
Just as the formation was about to be completed, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch realized something was wrong.
At this moment in the battlefield, most parts of the formation had been completed, needing only the last few formation flags to be inserted to finish the formation.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, sensing the imminent completion of the formation, began attacking Lu Youjiu with full force, attempting to push him back.
Lu Youjiu, naturally, would not allow him to succeed and also exerted all his strength, controlling his flying swords to continuously attack the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Seeing that he couldn’t break through, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch became anxious.
All of a sudden, he retracted all the black Demonic Qi into his body, and then bellowed:
“Get lost…”
Along with his roar, countless streams of black Demonic Qi gushed out, resembling sharp swords emerging from his body.
These Demonic Qi swords were extremely formidable; upon encountering the flying swords conjured by Lu Youjiu, they directly shattered them and pierced through.
In an instant, many flying swords were destroyed by these Demonic Qi swords.
Even, two of the swords pierced right through Lu Youjiu’s body, causing him severe injuries.
Lu Youjiu was forced to retreat temporarily to avoid their ferocity.
Meanwhile, the Demonic Qi swords did not cease and kept flying far away.
Fortunately, when these swords reached Lin Jing and his group, their speed had slowed down significantly, and the others were not injured.
However, two nearby formation flags close to Lin Jing were not so lucky and were hit by the Demonic Qi swords; although they did not shatter, some small cracks appeared.
It should be known that the material of each formation flag was extraordinary, and their hardness was almost equivalent to that of Magical Treasures.
Yet, even so, the formation flags still had cracks caused by the Demonic Qi swords.
That indicated just how powerful these swords were.
Seeing Lu Youjiu retreat, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was about to attempt a breakout.
However, at that moment, Holaw Three Rivers’ final formation flag had been cast.
Then, Holaw Three Rivers spoke up, shouting:
“Formation Merge, activate!”
As the words of Holaw Three Rivers fell, countless white Formation Patterns lit up, connecting all the formation flags that had been laid out.
The entire formation was formed, completely enveloping the area.
It also directly covered both the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch and Lu Youjiu.
Seeing this, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch regathered the black Demonic Qi, trying to break through the formation.
But at this moment, Holaw Three Rivers made his move.
Holaw Three Rivers formed a hand seal, and the Formation Pattern in front of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch lit up.
A screen filled with Formation Patterns appeared immediately.
It collided precisely with the black Demonic Qi released by the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
However, the black Demonic Qi seemed to meet its nemesis and quickly receded, while the formation remained unscathed.
At the same time, Holaw Three Rivers had already completed his hand seal, pointing directly at the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Formation Patterns above the formation lit up once again, and then a thunderbolt formed, striking towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Seeing this, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch hastily dodged.
Lu Youjiu, having recovered somewhat, once again lifted his Cold Light Longsword and advanced to kill the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Seeing himself trapped, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch glared furiously at the instigator Holaw Three Rivers, his eyes nearly shooting fire.
However, with Lu Youjiu attacking him again, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch couldn’t afford to be careless and had to intercept him once more.
Thus, with Lu Youjiu and the aid of Holaw Three Rivers controlling the formation, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was repeatedly forced back.
Soon, he had suffered several wounds.
At this time, the three Golden Core Cultivators, who had been healing at a distance, saw the few people trapping ‘Dai Mao’ with the formation.
Instantly energized, they forgot about their healing.
Instead, they stared intently at the battle between Lu Youjiu and ‘Dai Mao’ within the formation.
As time passed by, gradually, the aura of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch also began to wane.
Now the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had to guard against Lu Youjiu’s attacks and also beware of Holaw Three Rivers’ assaults through the formation.
It was bearable for a short time, but over a longer period, even as formidable as he was, he began to struggle.
Having no choice, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch roared furiously while going all out with his attacks.
Hoping to slay Lu Youjiu right there.
However, although Lu Youjiu had only recently advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage, his combat power was quite extraordinary.
Especially after drinking alcohol, his combat power significantly increased.
This made the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch lament endlessly.
Seeing that he couldn’t overcome Lu Youjiu, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, in his urgency, unleashed the black Demonic Qi explosively.
And this Demonic Qi kept spreading, soon filling the entire formation.
Holaw Three Rivers, seeing this, also hurriedly controlled the entire formation, starting its operation.
Instantly, all the Formation Patterns upon the formation lit up, twinkling with brilliant light.
It was at this moment that Lin Jing suddenly discovered.
There was a blank space in the formation on their side, not covered by Formation Patterns.
Lin Jing looked intently and realized that this blank space was precisely where the two formation flags hit by the Demonic Qi swords were located.
These two flags must have been damaged; they hadn’t been discovered earlier because they were not utilized until now.
Now that they were needed, the damaged areas began to show.

chapters.title: Chapter 387: 87 The Calculations of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 387: Chapter 87 The Calculations of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch
Even Holaw Three Rivers noticed this situation.
His face changed instantly, at first, he had only been focused on arranging the formation and hadn’t noticed the attack on the formation flags.
Unexpectedly, the formation patterns attached to the formation flags had been damaged.
These formation flags were forged as a set, with no possibility of replacement.
Very soon.
The black mist paused, then dissipated, revealing the figure of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch inside.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, with a face full of surprise, looked toward the missed spot in the formation.
Obviously.
This Heavenly Desire Demon Lord had also discovered the loophole in the formation.
After that, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch directly lunged out, aiming to rush toward the gap.
Upon seeing this, Lu Youjiu hurriedly stepped forward, wanting to obstruct him.
Holaw Three Rivers controlled the formation even more, releasing countless lightning bolts to block.
However, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch paid no attention.
He directly gathered the black Demonic Qi he had condensed into five thick streams of black mist, two of which lunged straight at Lu Youjiu.
The other three rushed towards the weakened part of the formation that had been damaged.
As for himself, he charged toward the fragile spot of the formation despite the bombardment of lightning on his head.
At that moment, Lin Jing stood outside the formation.
If the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch burst out, he might encounter Lin Jing first.
At this time, Lin Jing naturally couldn’t just wait to be captured; he definitely had to intercept him.
Therefore, Lin Jing activated Power Boost Augmentation.
In an instant, Lin Jing felt his Divine Sense surge, far surpassing its previous state.
A 50% increase in the strength of his Divine Sense made it almost comparable to that of a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
After activating Power Boost Augmentation, Lin Jing’s body was also covered in a layer of golden light.
To welcome the upcoming battle.
After all this preparation, Lin Jing then summoned his Flying Sword—the Ling Yin Flawless Sword.
The Ling Yin Flawless Sword was forged by the Artifact Refiner sought after by Yan Wanfei, who merged the Flawless Sword with the remains of a sword from the True Lord of Ling Yin.
Now, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword was incomparable to its previous version, and its quality had reached the level of a Superior Magical Treasure.
However, that transparent special material had not been integrated into it and was brought back by Yan Wanfei, who returned it to Lin Jing.
The power of the Superior Magical Treasure, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, was certainly extraordinary. Before the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch could burst out, Lin Jing had already cast Lingyin Yu Jian Jue, concealing the Flying Sword.
Following that.
Within the formation, the three streams of black mist repeatedly slammed into the weakened part of the formation.
“Boom”
“Boom”
“Boom”
With the impact of the three streams of black mist, the formation shook violently, and several cracks appeared on it.
Fortunately, the formation managed to block this round of attacks.
However, before everyone could relax, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had already charged to the edge of the formation, the area filled with cracks.
Afterward, one saw a layer of black light emerge from the hands of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, and he attacked directly towards the cracked area.
As soon as the black light touched the edge of the formation, it immediately seeped through the cracks in the formation.
As more black light spilled out, the cracks on the formation grew larger and larger.
Gradually, they spread over the entire formation.
Finally, after a series of “crackling” sounds, the entire formation could no longer hold and exploded with a bang.
When the formation shattered, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch let out a strange laugh:
“Hehehe…”
“I’ve come out.”
“Next, none of you will escape.”
After that, one saw the black Demonic Qi around the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch explode in an instant, becoming much stronger than when he was inside the formation.
And the injuries he had sustained inside the formation began to heal rapidly at this time.
Upon seeing this, Lin Jing immediately operated the Five Elements Divine Art and launched a stream of multicolored light, then charged towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At the same time, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword was hidden in the dark, ready to launch a surprise attack at any moment.
However, as soon as Lin Jing’s multicolored light was released, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch dodged it like a rat encountering a cat, hurriedly avoiding it.
He even disregarded his healing.
Afterward, he glared at Lin Jing with rage and said:
“Kid…”
“I almost forgot about you.”
“To avoid any accidents, I’ll kill you first…”
Having said that, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch charged straight at Lin Jing.
At the same time, a powerful Divine Sense reached Lin Jing’s mind ahead of him.
However, Lin Jing was currently in Power Boost Augmentation mode, with an incredibly strong Divine Sense. As soon as that Divine Sense attempted to enter his sea of consciousness, it was immediately met with a strong counterattack from Lin Jing and was expelled.
“Eh?”
“His Divine Sense is so strong?”
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was surprised that his Divine Sense attack didn’t affect Lin Jing.
But he didn’t care much, because he had arrived in person this time. He was very confident that, even without using Divine Sense, he could crush Lin Jing.
Seeing the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch charging at him, Lin Jing didn’t show the slightest panic.
Even though the multicolored light had been avoided, it had allowed Lin Jing to realize something.
That was, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch still feared the Five Elements Divine Art.
At this point, Lu Youjiu was chasing after him from behind, and all Lin Jing needed to do was to stall for a moment, allowing Lu Youjiu to catch up once again.
By then, even if the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch wanted to escape, it would be too late.
Seeing the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch approaching, Lin Jing did the same, his body glowing with golden light as he charged towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Lin Jing’s actions shocked both Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei.
They knew that this time was different from the last.
Last time Lin Jing charged forward, he had directly used the Five Elements Divine Art, detonating the restrictions that others had placed within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s body.
But this time, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had obviously recovered, and there seemed to be nothing amiss with him.
Moreover, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s cultivation was now at the Nascent Soul Stage.
If Lin Jing charged forward now, he feared he would not come out on top.
However, out of trust for Lin Jing,
this time when Lin Jing charged forward, they did not say much, only watched carefully and prepared.
They were ready to rescue Lin Jing at any moment if anything unexpected occurred.
Upon seeing Lin Jing rush toward him, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was initially taken aback, then his lips curled upward, revealing a cruel smile.
“If you seek death, then I shall fulfill your wish,” he said.
Then, he accelerated and charged toward Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing did not hesitate to control the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, striking at the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
The Ling Yin Flawless Sword, because of its unique characteristics and the enhancement from Lingyin Yu Jian Jue, silently and swiftly thrust toward the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Soon, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword neared the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
However, at that moment,
the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch suddenly reached out, and a black Demonic Qi extended, enveloping the Ling Yin Flawless Sword instantaneously.
The Ling Yin Flawless Sword was immediately immobilized, unable to advance even a fraction further.
With the Ling Yin Flawless Sword under control, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch let out a cold laugh and said,
“Hmph!”
“You really thought I wouldn’t know your tricks?”
“You’re far too naive.”
However, before the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch could finish speaking, Lin Jing burst forward with extreme speed and had already arrived in front of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At that moment, Lin Jing’s whole body shone with golden light, and in addition to this light, several traces of Wǔ Cǎi colored streamers wrapped around him.
Moreover, the Wǔ Cǎi streamers on Lin Jing’s fist were particularly bright, covering his entire fist.
Seeing Lin Jing suddenly appear, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s gaze, upon noticing the Five Elements Divine Art wrapped around Lin Jing, flashed with a moment of panic.
Then, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch furrowed his brows, forcefully dispelling the sense of panic, and his eyes once again filled with madness.
“Go to hell!!!” he exclaimed.
No sooner had the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch finished speaking than dense, black Demonic Qi burst from his body, instantly enveloping the area and forming a Demonic Energy Barrier.
Even Lin Jing was shrouded within this Demonic Energy Barrier.
Lu Youjiu, who was about to approach, was also repelled by this dense black Demonic Qi Barrier.
Upon seeing this, Yan Wanfei couldn’t help but cry out,
“Oh no… Brother Lin…”
Then, he flew toward the scene.
And Holaw Three Rivers followed suit, flying over as well.
Seeing this, Lu Youjiu hastily brandished his sword, slashing at the black Demonic Qi.
However, this black Demonic Qi was too dense, too terrifying.
Lu Youjiu launched several sword attacks, but the sword qi disappeared upon contact with the black Demonic Qi, engulfed and fading into nothing…
……
At this time, within the Demonic Energy Barrier.
Lin Jing was enveloped in Demonic Qi, and the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch said with a cruel laugh,
“Hehehe…”
“Still trying the same old tricks…”
“Did you really think I would fall for the same method twice?”
“How else could I lure you into the trap?” Lin Jing replied.
After speaking, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch looked at Lin Jing with a hint of appreciation, then said,
“You are indeed clever for knowing that the Five Elements Divine Art is indeed my nemesis.”
“But that depends on who is using it. Not just anyone can pose a threat to me.”
Having said that,
the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch summoned another surge of black Demonic Qi from his body.
This time the Demonic Qi nearly became tangible.
No sooner had this Demonic Qi appeared than it formed into a cage, imprisoning Lin Jing within.
