In the moment that the Demonic Qi was released, Lin Jing clearly felt that familiar sensation.
The Five Elements Divine Art within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had not been dispelled but was being suppressed all along with a substantial amount of Demonic Qi.
Lin Jing looked at the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch in surprise, then said,
“You haven’t dispelled the Five Elements Divine Art…”
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch spoke,
“Correct…”
“However, it’s not any Five Elements Divine Art, but the Five Elements Divine Technique that only Divinity Transformation Cultivators can cultivate…”
“This Divine Technique is attached to my Nascent Soul. Do you think it could be so easily dispelled?”
Lin Jing then said, “No wonder you’ve always feared the Five Elements Divine Art. It must be because the Five Elements Divine Art can detonate the Five Elements Divine Technique attached to your Nascent Soul.”
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch laughed menacingly,
“Indeed…”
“But now, you no longer have a chance.”
“Bound by my Demonic Qi Cage, you can’t perform any spells.”
“Once you are killed, no one in this Demonic Monster Sea will be able to restrain me.”
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch wasn’t lying. Lin Jing could feel that the Spiritual Power within his body was completely bound, unable to be mobilized.
Let alone casting spells.
Next,
the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, with a malevolent gleam in his eye, said,
“Alright…”
“I’ve said all that needs to be said. It’s time for you to die.”

chapters.title: Chapter 388: 88 Ambush
chapters.content:
Chapter 388: Chapter 88 Ambush
As the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s voice fell,
the cage formed from Demonic Qi began to tightly envelop everything within, completely wrapping Lin Jing.
Then, the Demonic Qi cage started to compress inward, and Lin Jing felt an extremely dangerous sensation coming.
At this moment, engulfed by the cage, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate, he directly summoned the System, and then silently recited in his mind:
“Enter the System Space.”
Following that, Lin Jing completely disappeared from inside the Demonic Qi cage.
It was only after his entire being appeared inside the System Space that Lin Jing truly breathed a sigh of relief.
What Lin Jing had done a moment before was indeed a bit risky, even nearly costing him dearly.
But it was a risk he had to take.
In fact, from the moment the formation was broken, Lin Jing knew the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had no intention of letting him go.
Because as soon as they had arrived, Lin Jing noticed there was something odd in the way the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch looked at him.
Moreover, since the formation was broken near where he was, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch certainly wouldn’t miss the opportunity.
Therefore, from that moment, Lin Jing had already started thinking of a strategy, and his strategy was simple, to use the Five Elements Divine Art…
And he himself also possessed the System Space, which wouldn’t let him fall into real danger…
Fortunately, all of this was still under Lin Jing’s control, and nothing had gone too awry.
……
All of this had transpired in the blink of an eye, within a very short time.
From Lin Jing rushing forward, to the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch deploying the Demonic Energy Barrier, trapping Lin Jing inside, all happened in less than the time it took to draw a breath.
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing didn’t linger but directly summoned the System, initiating the Fixed Point Teleportation feature.
With the initiation of Fixed Point Teleportation, Lin Jing’s perspective switched back to the outside world.
First and foremost, was the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At this time, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s face was gloomy, his Divine Sense ceaselessly sweeping back and forth inside the Demonic Energy Barrier.
After a long while, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch muttered to himself with a dark face,
“Impossible, how could he just vanish all of a sudden…”
“With the restraint of the Demonic Qi cage, he shouldn’t be able to use his Spiritual Power or cast any spells, there’s no reason for it…”
“But how, how did he escape…”
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was perplexed; the Demonic Qi cage was a spell he had mastered only after years of dedicated study.
Once cast, this spell was nearly invincible, never once having failed before.
Yet now, a mere early-stage Golden Core cultivator had escaped from his Demonic Qi cage.
He didn’t even know how his adversary had managed to escape.
And not just the Demonic Qi cage, but even within the Demonic Energy Barrier itself, there was no sign of him.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had swept with his Divine Sense several times over, he was certain that Lin Jing had indeed escaped the confines of the Demonic Energy Barrier.
This setback darkened the face of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch like a brooding storm.
At this moment, his Demonic Energy Barrier was still violently shaking, clearly due to the white-clad young man outside who was relentlessly attacking it.
The Demonic Energy Barrier wouldn’t hold up for much longer.
In truth, the situation of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was not favorable; he had already sustained no light injuries from the combined attack of Lu Youjiu and the Formation.
It was only after the formation broke that he thought to slay Lin Jing and then make his escape to heal in seclusion.
But now, with Lin Jing’s whereabouts unknown, his predicament had only worsened.
To make an escape now, he had to stir the battlefield into chaos first.
Thus, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch abandoned the Demonic Energy Barrier completely, letting the black Demonic Qi automatically disperse.
In an instant, countless streams of black Demonic Qi surged outward.
In a short while, it had enveloped the entire battlefield in its dark mists.
As the Demonic Energy Barrier dissipated, Lu Youjiu burst in.
Upon entering, he anxiously searched for Lin Jing.
The same time, his Divine Sense ceaselessly swept through the Demonic Qi.
The more he swept, the more panicked Lu Youjiu became, for within the Demonic Qi, there was no trace of Lin Jing.
He hadn’t even located the Heavenly Desire Demon Lord.
……
At that time, using the cover of the Demonic Qi, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s body was shrouded in swirling Demonic Qi, concealing his presence impeccably, rendering himself essentially invisible.
Taking advantage of this concealment, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had originally planned to retreat.
But just at that moment, an unexpected change occurred…
A burst of Wu Cai radiance suddenly appeared, and just as it manifested, it was already near the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Then, a loud shout followed:
“Explode!”
With that shout, the Wu Cai radiance, upon nearing the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, exploded on the spot.
This explosion was a trifling matter, but the Wu Cai radiance triggered the Five Elements Divine Technique within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, causing the suppressed Divine Technique to become restless in an instant.
Consequently, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch quickly gathered Demonic Qi, trying to suppress the Five Elements Divine Technique within him.
However, this action caused the surrounding black Demonic Qi to thin out in an instant.
At that moment, Lu Youjiu saw the immobile Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch and Lin Jing, who was escaping from nearby.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Lu Youjiu’s face lit up, and he let out a breath of relief.
“Brother Lin…”
But Lin Jing simply said to Lu Youjiu:
“Brother Lu…”
“Quick, he’s injured now, this is the moment.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Lu Youjiu instantly understood why the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch stood unmoving.
He was injured…
Without any hesitation, Lu Youjiu swung out a sword Qi, slashing towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
However, as the sword Qi approached the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, he began to move.
He waved his hand, releasing a mass of Demonic Qi to fend off the sword qi.
However, even though he blocked the sword qi,
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch could no longer suppress the turmoil of the Five Elements Divine Art within his body, and immediately, a mouthful of fresh blood sprayed out.
Afterward, he turned his head to look at Lin Jing, who was keeping his distance, his face filled with anger.
Had it not been for Lin Jing, he would not have sustained such severe injuries.
Despite his anger, there was one thing that he needed to clarify.
Thus, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch spoke up, questioning Lin Jing:
“How did you escape from my Demonic Qi cage?”
This matter was related to the System Space, so naturally, Lin Jing would not reveal it.
Only to see Lin Jing giving a cold laugh, he said:
“Want to know?”
“Maybe in your next life.”
Having said that, Lin Jing turned to Lu Youjiu and said:
“Brother Lu, he’s now injured; don’t give him a chance to catch his breath. Take him down in one go.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing say this, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch immediately let out an enraged roar:
“Bastard…”
As he spoke, he recklessly charged towards Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing also quickly put some distance between them.
At the same time, his hands didn’t stop moving, trying to once again trigger the Five Elements Divine Technique within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Witnessing the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch charging at Lin Jing, Lu Youjiu also hurriedly rushed towards the Demon Monarch,
Attempting to block him.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was in the middle stage of the Nascent Soul, while Lin Jing only at the early stage of the Golden Core—a whole major realm and more apart.
Moreover, when Lin Jing used Fixed Point Teleportation before to provoke the Five Elements Divine Technique within the Demon Monarch, he emerged very close to him.
Even though Lin Jing had retreated, he hadn’t gone very far.
To the mid-Nascent Soul stage Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, such a distance was actually insignificant.
Just when it seemed like the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was about to catch up with Lin Jing again,
Suddenly, several formation flags fell from the sky.
Then a voice sounded:
“Formation, complete!”
Immediately after, countless formation patterns lit up, creating a thick white fog around Lin Jing and the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
After only a moment, the fog around Lin Jing dispersed once again, while the fog around the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch grew even thicker.
The voice just then belonged to Holaw Three Rivers.
Clearly, Holaw Three Rivers had activated another formation, separating Lin Jing from the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At this moment, Lin Jing was unimpeded within the formation.
In contrast, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch gathered many black masses of Demonic Qi, striving to counter the white fog.
It was then that Lu Youjiu also arrived.
He exchanged a glance with Holaw Three Rivers, they nodded to each other, and without saying a word, directly charged into the fog.
After Lu Youjiu entered, the white fog began to disperse.
Lu Youjiu went straight towards the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
The two immediately clashed in battle.
Lin Jing also took this opportunity to step out of the formation’s range, moving to Holaw Three Rivers’ side.
It was only now that Yan Wanfei arrived, late to the scene.
The moment she saw Lin Jing, Yan Wanfei began to ask with concern:
“Brother Lin…”
“How are you, are you alright?”
“You have no idea, when I saw you enveloped by that Demonic Qi, I was scared to death.”
Lin Jing gave a slight smile and said:
“I’m fine…”
Yan Wanfei then continued:
“Brother Lin, how did you escape from that dangerous situation just now?”
“The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had clearly trapped you; how did he let you go so easily?”
Lin Jing then spoke up:
“Let’s talk about this later…”
“Right now, the crisis from the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch is not yet over.”
Yan Wanfei looked at the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, who was fighting with Lu Youjiu, and quickly said:
“Oh, right…”
“Let’s talk later. Let’s take down that bastard first.”
Then, just like that, the three of them watched the two combatants.
Lin Jing did not stand idly by but circled around the outside of the formation, looking for an opportunity, ready to intervene at any moment.
Meanwhile, Holaw Three Rivers kept controlling the formation, aiding Lu Youjiu in suppressing the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch’s roars of rage continued without any means of escape.
As time went by, the Demon Monarch’s momentum grew weaker and weaker,
While Lu Youjiu, who was fighting with him, seemed to be getting stronger and stronger.
At that moment, a surge of Demonic Qi suddenly burst within the formation,
Forcing Lu Youjiu out.
And with that, Holaw Three Rivers’ formation was also broken.
It was then that Lin Jing clearly sensed the mass of the Five Elements Divine Technique within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
Obviously, with this outburst, the Demonic Qi that the Demon Monarch had been using to suppress the Five Elements Divine Technique had been expended.
It looked like the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was on the brink of collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 389: 89: Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, Destroyed
chapters.content:
Chapter 389: Chapter 89: Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, Destroyed
After sensing the Five Elements Divine Technique, Lin Jing immediately sprang into action.
This time,
he had to keep the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch here.
Then, Lin Jing quickly rushed out towards the direction of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At the same time, Lin Jing’s hands were constantly moving.
He soon formed a cluster of five-colored auroras.
When the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch saw Lin Jing rushing towards him with the five-colored aurora in hand, a hint of fear appeared in his eyes, and he became flustered at once.
This time, his panic wasn’t feigned.
Without the suppression of Demonic Qi, the Five Elements Divine Art within his body could even claim his life directly.
This time, he had no strength left to create any Demonic Qi cage.
He had no choice but to wave his hand, releasing a large amount of Demonic Qi to block in front, trying to stop Lin Jing.
However, Lin Jing was not afraid at all, directly activating his Overlord Divine Physique, covering his body in a layer of golden light.
Then he burst forward at great speed toward the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
By the time Lin Jing passed through the Demonic Qi, he was already quite close to the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At this moment, the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was trying to gather his Demonic Qi, intending to suppress the Five Elements Divine Technique within his body.
But it was already too late.
Once Lin Jing rushed over, he found that his Five Elements Divine Art responded.
It seemed that he could now control the Five Elements Divine Technique within the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
So, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate at all.
He simply uttered a word:
“Explode!”
Firstly, the clump of five-colored aurora in his hand burst open directly.
Then, as if triggering a chain reaction,
that mass of Five Elements Divine Technique inside the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch also exploded violently after intense fluctuations.
The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch tried to stop it, but he had no way to do so.
He could only watch helplessly as streaks of five-colored light emerged from within his own body.
And gradually, they tore apart the body he had occupied, that of Dai Mao.
Only leaving a small figure in the middle, emanating a five-colored light and radiating golden light.
This small figure, it must be the Nascent Soul of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch.
At that moment, this golden, radiating small figure was enveloped by countless stripes of five-colored divine light.
And those five-colored divine lights were constantly devouring the vitality of the golden small figure.
The golden small figure looked extremely terrified.
As he watched those five-colored divine lights entwining around him, the golden small figure exhausted all methods, but no matter what, he could not drive them away.
As the five-colored divine light grew stronger, the golden small figure entwined in the middle grew weaker and weaker.
Finally, he directly faded into a phantom.
In the end…
The Nascent Soul of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch began babbling:
“Five Elements…”
“When the Five Elements gather, the relics appear…”
“I still have a chance, I can’t die here…”
But no matter what, he couldn’t stop the erosion of the five-colored divine light,
In the end, he let out a terrified scream:
“No…”
After the scream, the golden small figure was completely annihilated, vanishing completely.
Leaving behind only a cluster of five-colored divine light in that spot.
Lin Jing stared at the five-colored divine light, stunned for a moment.
Soon, Lu Youjiu flew over and looked at the floating five-colored divine light.
The aura of the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had disappeared completely.
Lu Youjiu looked at Lin Jing and asked:
“Is he dead?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes, I triggered the explosion of the Five Elements Divine Technique left in his body by the predecessor, and he was devoured.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and then said,
“Just now…”
“When he burst out with Demonic Qi, I felt that mass of Five Elements Power inside his body.”
“I knew then that this battle would still depend on you to end it.”
Just then, Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei both flew over as well.
Upon arriving, Yan Wanfei immediately asked:
“The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch?”
“Is he dead?”
Since the black Demonic Qi had previously covered everything nearby, Yan Wanfei didn’t see how the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch had died.
Lu Youjiu nodded, and then said:
“The Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch is dead, killed by Brother Lin.”
Yan Wanfei was shocked upon hearing this and then incredulously looked at Lin Jing:
“Holy…”
“Since when did Brother Lin become so powerful…”
Lin Jing spoke up, saying:
“Actually, it’s the same as before, I triggered the explosion of the Five Elements Divine Technique left in his body by the predecessor.”
“If you think about it, I merely played a simple assisting role.”
“But what truly destroyed the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was this…”
Lin Jing pointed ahead to the floating cluster of five-colored divine light.
“This?”
Yan Wanfei followed Lin Jing’s pointing direction and saw the cluster of five-colored divine light.
At that moment, Holaw Three Rivers looked at the cluster of five-colored divine light and said:
“Brother Lin…”
“Can you control this five-colored divine light?”
Lin Jing hesitated for a moment, then used the Five Elements Divine Art, causing the five-colored divine light to start moving with Lin Jing’s intentions.
This movement startled Yan Wanfei, who was observing, and she quickly took a couple of steps back.
However, the five-colored divine light didn’t make any other movements, but was controlled by Lin Jing, flying back and forth nearby.
Moments later, Lin Jing replied:
“I can indeed control this five-colored divine light.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded his head.
Then Lu Youjiu spoke up, saying:
“Since Brother Lin can control it, Brother Lin can take it away,” said Lu Youjiu.
“This five-colored divine light doesn’t look simple, and it should be helpful for your cultivation of the Five Elements Divine Art,” he continued.
Lin Jing nodded and tried to put away the five-colored divine light, but he encountered a problem at this moment.
The five-colored divine light could not be put into the Storage Bag.
Thus,
after a brief contemplation, Lin Jing decided to absorb the five-colored divine light into his own body.
Thinking this, Lin Jing immediately used the Five Elements Divine Art to control the five-colored divine light to drift toward him.
As the five-colored divine light approached him, to avoid any accidents, Lin Jing used the Five Elements Divine Art to condense a Five-Colored Aurora that enveloped the five-colored divine light.
After finishing all this, Lin Jing slowly began to integrate this mass of five-colored divine light into his body.
Although Lin Jing took such precautions, when the five-colored divine light entered his body, he didn’t feel any discomfort.
In fact, Lin Jing even felt a familiar and comfortable sensation on top of the colorless divine light.
It seemed that the five-colored divine light wouldn’t harm Lin Jing.
After Lin Jing absorbed the five-colored divine light, the three Golden Core Cultivators who had been standing at a distance came forward.
Upon their arrival, they bowed and said to Lu Youjiu and the others,
“We thank the senior and fellow Daoists for saving our lives.”
Lu Youjiu said,
“No need to be polite…”
“We came specifically to kill Dai Mao.”
The three were stunned at first, but then one of the older men angrily said,
“This Demon Cultivator Dai Mao has done all sorts of evil deeds. He deserves to be killed by everyone. He even slaughtered everyone on Nanli Island, not sparing even the common folks.”
“If it weren’t for the senior’s timely intervention, it wouldn’t just be Nanli Island at risk, but also our lives,” he added.
After saying this, the old man bowed again to Lu Youjiu and said,
“We three will never forget the great kindness of the senior.”
The two standing behind the old man similarly bowed and said to Lu Youjiu,
“Senior’s great kindness, we will never forget.”
Lu Youjiu looked at them, his brows slightly furrowed, and then he said,
“No need…”
However, the old man spoke up at this time,
“Senior, the three of us have decided to follow you to the death, and we hope the senior will accept us and let us accompany you.”
As the old man finished speaking, the two behind him hurriedly added,
“Yes…”
“Senior…”
“Nanli Island has been slaughtered, we three have nowhere to go. We hope the senior will take us in and let us follow you.”
At this, not only Lu Youjiu but Lin Jing and the others were also stunned.
Was this the situation?
After killing Dai Mao, people actually wanted to follow them.
However, Lu Youjiu glanced coldly at them, then directly declined their request.
“I only advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage with the help of myself and some brothers.”
“If you think that I have some powerful force backing me, then you are mistaken.”
“I am just a Loose Cultivator, acting entirely according to my own preferences, and do not need followers.”
“As for you all, you might as well give up on this idea,” he finished.
Then Lu Youjiu said to Lin Jing and the others,
“Alright…”
“This matter is settled, let’s go.”
Lin Jing and the others nodded, then together they boarded the Flying Boat and left the area.
At the original site, only the three somewhat embarrassed Golden Core Cultivators remained.
……
On the Flying Boat, Yan Wanfei asked Lu Youjiu:
“Brother Jiu…”
“Why didn’t you take them in just now?”
Lu Youjiu glanced at Yan Wanfei and then said,
“Their motives were not pure, it was quite obvious. Only a simpleton like you couldn’t see through them.”
Yan Wanfei scratched his head and said,
“Really? I really didn’t notice that.”
Lu Youjiu pursed his lips and said,
“That’s why I say you’re a simpleton.”
After speaking, Lu Youjiu paused, looked at Yan Wanfei, and said,
“Niu San…”
“I remember I still owe you several training sessions, right?”
Yan Wanfei nodded and said,
“Yes, Brother Jiu…”
“We were delayed by the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch before, so we never got around to the special training.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and said,
“Good…”
“Now that the matter with the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch is also resolved, I will arrange your special training as soon as we get back.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei’s eyes lit up, and he said,
“Really, Brother Jiu…”
“That’s great…”
Lu Youjiu looked at him with a smile and said,
“Of course, it’s true. I will definitely help you with your special training.”
These words should have made Yan Wanfei happy, but suddenly, he felt a mysterious chill.
Then, Yan Wanfei turned his head, looked at the smiling Lu Youjiu, and gently reminded him,
“Brother Jiu…”
“Remember what we agreed on, you can’t torment me during these training sessions.”
Lu Youjiu then said,
“Originally, I wasn’t planning to torment you…”
“But your performance this time was too disappointing, you didn’t play a single role.”
“So this time, I’ve decided to help you with a hundred training sessions to boost your strength, to avoid such situations in the future.”
“But don’t worry, if I promised not to torment you ten times, then it will be ten times.”
Yan Wanfei’s face immediately turned sour, and he then wailed,
“That still means there are ninety times you will torment me…”
“Brother Jiu, please no…”
Facing Yan Wanfei’s wails, Lu Youjiu was unrelenting, and firmly said,
“There’s no discussion on this matter. Prepare yourself for the coming period…”

chapters.title: Chapter 390: 90: Flame Spring Body Refining
chapters.content:
Chapter 390: Chapter 90: Flame Spring Body Refining
Time flew by, and another six months had passed since the issue with the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch was resolved, and everyone had returned to Li Yan Island.
Their lives had once again settled into tranquility.
During this time, Lu Youjiu had been giving Yan Wanfei special training, and Holaw Three Rivers was ceaselessly studying formations.
Only Lin Jing was a bit different.
In the past six months, besides alchemy in the System Space, Lin Jing spent most of his time cultivating in the Earthflame Spring.
After such a long period of cultivation, he was finally close to mastering the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique to perfection.
If nothing unexpected happened, it should be within the next few days…
……
Inside the Earthflame Cave at this moment.
Lin Jing was soaking in the Earthflame Spring.
Feeling the scalding heat of the Earthflame Spring, Lin Jing actually found it quite comfortable.
Although he wasn’t using Spiritual Power to protect his body, he was still as comfortable as a fish in water inside the Earthflame Spring and didn’t feel any discomfort.
Just then, a series of footsteps came from outside.
The footsteps were uneven, as if the person’s legs were not in good shape.
Lin Jing then swept out with his Divine Sense and couldn’t help but smile.
After a while, a rough burly man limped over.
Lin Jing turned his head to look at the man and laughingly said,
“Yan Brother, what happened today that you’re limping?”
The burly man who had arrived was none other than Yan Wanfei.
Hearing Lin Jing’s teasing, Yan Wanfei’s face immediately drooped as if he had just consumed freshly picked bitter herbs:
“It’s all because of Lu Youjiu…”
“He said he was going to give me special training, but it really was just an excuse to beat me up…”
“This time he nearly ripped off my leg.”
Yan Wanfei pointed at his limping leg and complained.
Lin Jing’s mouth twitched slightly, but he remained composed, and then said:
“Actually, you can’t really say that. Look, with the training over this period, haven’t you already broken through to the mid-stage of the Golden Core?”
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than Yan Wanfei approached the pool of the Earthflame Spring, getting close to Lin Jing and said:
“Speaking of which, I feel it’s mostly your merit, Brother Lin.”
“If it weren’t for your Elixir Medicine, perhaps I wouldn’t have broken through to the mid-stage of the Golden Core so easily.”
After speaking, Yan Wanfei still had a look of deep resentment, gazing at Lin Jing:
“I just didn’t expect that you would actually be a descendant of the Lin Family from the Ancient Alchemy Path.”
“And you guys kept it a secret from me for so long…”
“It wasn’t until now that I was told…”
Facing Yan Wanfei’s questioning, Lin Jing chuckled and then said:
“Lu Brother was worried you might spill the beans, which is why he specifically wanted to keep it from you.”
“Who would’ve guessed that you sometimes seem rather unreliable?”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei was left speechless:
“I’m really hurt now. I could accept it from Lu Youjiu, but even you think I’m unreliable.”
“Am I really unreliable…?”
“To think, I have always been wholeheartedly with my brothers, yet my brothers have been playing mind games with me…”
“Let it go…”
“I’m tired, might as well give up.”
Lin Jing was immediately at a loss for words, surprised that the casual remark he had made was so fluently used by Yan Wanfei.
However.
If he couldn’t suss out his brother Niu San’s intentions, Lin Jing wouldn’t deserve to be a veterinarian.
Err…
Then again, he wasn’t really a veterinarian in the first place.
But it didn’t matter, as long as the intent was understood.
Therefore, Lin Jing replied directly to Yan Wanfei:
“Stop making that pitiful face, just tell me, what do you want?”
Yan Wanfei immediately put on a cheerful expression, getting close to Lin Jing:
“Heh heh…”
“Brother Lin really gets me.”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but purse his lips.
Then Yan Wanfei said:
“Brother Lin, I actually just want an Eternal Youth Elixir for my wife.”
“Eternal Youth Elixir…”
Lin Jing then remembered that in his System Space, he had an Eternal Youth Fruit tree that had already matured.
He just hadn’t been concocting the Eternal Youth Elixir during this time because he had been busy with other elixirs.
Now, with the crisis over, he could start collecting ingredients for the Eternal Youth Elixir.
Lin Jing then said:
“Eternal Youth Elixir, a third-grade Elixir Medicine.”
“Aside from the main ingredient, Eternal Youth Fruit, the other ingredients are not hard to find…”
“Don’t worry, leave it to me.”
Yan Wanfei was overjoyed:
“I knew Brother Lin would be the best to me.”
With that, Yan Wanfei pulled out three Eternal Youth Fruits and handed them to Lin Jing:
“These are three Eternal Youth Fruits that I had Lu Youjiu help collect previously.”
“If it’s not enough, just say the word, and I’ll go find more Eternal Youth Fruits.”
Lin Jing did not reach out to take the Eternal Youth Fruits but instead sighed helplessly and then said:
“Sigh…”
“Actually, I have Eternal Youth Fruits on me; you really didn’t have to buy them yourself.”
However, Yan Wanfei persistently shook his head:
“How could that be okay? It’s already troubling enough to have you concoct the elixir; how could I let you provide the ingredients as well?”
“Besides, it’s very hard for Eternal Youth Fruit trees to mature on islands, so in the Demonic Monster Sea, Eternal Youth Fruits are particularly expensive. Just these three have already cost me a small fortune in savings, I definitely can’t let you provide the Eternal Youth Fruits.”
Actually.
If we were to talk about it, it wouldn’t be troublesome for Lin Jing to ripen Eternal Youth Fruits at the moment.
Even the needed Harvest Points were not that many.
Hearing Yan Wanfei speak in such a manner, Lin Jing even started to consider the idea.
Could he perhaps ripen some Eternal Youth Fruits and then sell them at the Seven Seas Hall…
Of course, Lin Jing just had the thought and then reined it in.
Although he could produce Eternal Youth Fruits now, it wouldn’t be appropriate to bring out too many.
Otherwise, it can’t be explained.
Thus, Lin Jing spoke to Yan Wanfei again:
“Brother Yan, what do you think of this…”
“You don’t have to collect Eternal Youth Fruits recently, when I was in Nanming Domain, I had the good fortune to come across a mature Eternal Youth Fruit Tree and harvested a few Eternal Youth Fruits.”
“This time, if there aren’t enough Eternal Youth Fruits, I’ll take out the ones I got myself and use them first.”
“As for you, keep an eye out for those High-Grade Spiritual Plant seeds for me, I’d like to try planting some.”
After hearing this, Yan Wanfei pondered for a moment and then said:
“Alright…”
“Let’s do that, and if there are High-Grade Spiritual Plant seeds, I’ll buy them for you.”
Lin Jing waved his hand and said:
“No need, just let me know, after all, those seeds are quite expensive.”
Yan Wanfei frowned immediately:
“How can that be?”
“You need to understand…”
Before Yan Wanfei could finish, Lin Jing interrupted him:
“Alright, let’s talk about this later.”
“I just remembered something…”
Yan Wanfei, who had been ready to argue, immediately backed down, and then with a puzzled face, asked:
“Brother Lin… what is it?”
Lin Jing then said with a smile:
“I remember, aren’t you quite afraid of your lady back home?”
“Why the sudden thought of giving her a gift?”
Yan Wanfei’s face suddenly flushed red.
Then he said in a low voice:
“Actually…”
“Afraid, indeed, I am a bit.”
“But the marriage has already been arranged by the family, there’s no running away from it, and the gifts that should be given, must still be given.”
“And this flawless Eternal Youth Elixir, she mentioned it a long time ago, it’s just that this flawless Eternal Youth Elixir is especially precious, and I’ve never been able to afford it.”
“Until I met you, Brother Lin, now there’s an opportunity, so, I made this request to you, hoping you wouldn’t mind.”
Lin Jing then said with a smile:
“Don’t worry, this time I’ll help you concoct a flawless Eternal Youth Elixir.”
When Yan Wanfei heard this, he was overjoyed:
“Thank you, Brother Lin…”
Lin Jing then said with a smile, “Why be so formal with me…”
……
Afterward.
The two chatted for a little while longer, then prepared to enter the deeper parts of the Earthflame Spring to begin cultivation.
The way the two were cultivating now was different from before.
Since they had become accustomed to the temperature of the Earthflame Spring, both Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei needed to submerge into its depths to practice their Body Refining Techniques.
The deeper into the Earthflame Spring, the higher the temperature, and only at very high temperatures could the best cultivation effect be achieved.
Just as Lin Jing was preparing to submerge, Yan Wanfei suddenly spoke up:
“Brother Lin…”
“I remember you saying last time that your Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was close to the seventh refinement’s completion, right?”
“When the seventh refinement is complete, won’t your body return to normal?”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“That’s right…”
“If it’s soon, then today, or within these next few days, I should be able to fully cultivate the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.”
Yan Wanfei nodded and then said:
“Good, Brother Lin, keep it up…”
“I’m going down first, today I have to break through the depth of fifty meters.”
After speaking, Yan Wanfei submerged into the spring.
And after Yan Wanfei went in, Lin Jing followed suit, diving into the deeper parts of the Earthflame Spring.
As Lin Jing continued to dive, the temperature around him grew hotter and hotter.
However, the current temperature was completely within Lin Jing’s tolerance.
Not only was he not using Spiritual Power to protect his body, but he also didn’t activate the golden light of the Overlord Divine Physique.
Ten meters, twenty meters, thirty meters…
Like this, Lin Jing kept diving deeper and deeper.
Finally, at around forty meters, Lin Jing saw Yan Wanfei.
After greeting Yan Wanfei, Lin Jing continued to dive towards the lower parts of the flame spring.
Soon, Lin Jing exceeded fifty meters.
Past the depth of fifty meters, there is actually a threshold.
The temperature below fifty meters is significantly higher than the temperature above it.
Even Lin Jing had to activate his Overlord Divine Physique, letting the layer of golden light cover his entire body.
Previously, Yan Wanfei was extremely shocked when he saw Lin Jing’s Overlord Divine Physique.
Especially upon seeing the special effects of the Overlord Divine Physique, he was incredibly envious.
However, regretfully…
As a Demon Cultivator, Yan Wanfei simply could not cultivate the Overlord Divine Physique but could only practice Body Refining Techniques unique to Demon Cultivators.
This made Yan Wanfei quite frustrated for a while.
……
Afterward, Lin Jing continued to dive.
Sixty meters, seventy meters, eighty meters…
This time, it took Lin Jing a bit longer to reach eighty meters.
Then, Lin Jing stopped for a while at the eightieth meter to adapt a little.
After that, Lin Jing continued his descent…
Eighty-five meters, ninety meters, ninety-five meters…
Ultimately, Lin Jing even directly dived to the ninety-ninth meter before stopping.
Any further down, and he would have exceeded one hundred meters.
However, that was not a barrier Lin Jing could break through at the moment.
Looking down, Lin Jing could even distinctly see the demarcation line between ninety-nine meters and one hundred meters…
Below him, it was exceedingly red, like magma, and emanated a terrifying heat.
Then, Lin Jing sat down cross-legged against the stone wall of the flame spring.
He closed his eyes and began to cultivate in this spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 391: 91 Farewell
chapters.content:
Chapter 391: Chapter 91 Farewell
This cultivation session, Lin Jing directly cultivated for several hours.
Only after several hours had passed did Lin Jing open his eyes and stop the continuous cultivation.
Immediately after, Lin Jing felt the extremely hot flame spring around him, and his brow furrowed.
Just now, Lin Jing had been attempting to draw the flame spring into his body, hoping to use it to fully master the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.
But after hours of cultivation, Lin Jing found that his physique had stopped improving after reaching a certain level.
Even at the end, Lin Jing had slowly withdrawn his protective spiritual power, enduring the unbearable high temperatures with only his body refining techniques.
Despite this, he still couldn’t break through the final barrier of the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.
It seemed as if something was constantly preventing him from completely mastering the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.
Lin Jing felt his body and began to ponder.
A moment later, Lin Jing looked down at his feet.
Under Lin Jing’s feet was the flame spring with a hundred-meter depth, glowing intensely red like the gaping maw of a gigantic beast, terrifying to behold.
Moreover, from this height of a hundred meters above, Lin Jing could distinctly feel the horrifying heat from below.
Then Lin Jing extended his divine sense, but it was blocked by the flame spring, unable to probe very deep.
Seeing this, Lin Jing’s frown tightened even more.
After thinking for a moment, Lin Jing decided to dive below the hundred-meter mark to try his luck.
And as he thought, Lin Jing first gathered his spiritual power to protect his body.
Afterward, he made some other preparations to prevent any unexpected occurrences.
Once all this was done, Lin Jing began his descent.
Upon contact with the area below hundred meters, Lin Jing immediately felt the terrifying temperature.
Instantly, the temperature on his body soared, rising to a level that Lin Jing himself almost couldn’t bear.
However, Lin Jing didn’t shrink back, but continued to dive deeper.
It wasn’t until his whole body was submerged below the hundred meters that Lin Jing stopped his descent.
At this moment, Lin Jing’s body was glowing red, like a red-hot shrimp.
Here, Lin Jing finally felt his Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique stir once more.
Therefore, Lin Jing sat down cross-legged right there and resumed his cultivation.
…
…
After another four hours of cultivation, Lin Jing had only just managed to adapt to the current temperature.
By now, he clearly felt that his Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was still a hair’s breadth away from perfection.
Lin Jing’s brow furrowed tight, and he couldn’t help but think.
Logically, with such high temperatures, the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique should have been perfected long ago; it shouldn’t be like this.
Lin Jing looked at his own body, which had been burnt bright red, while also feeling the endless power contained within.
It seemed that he was missing a catalyst…
Lin Jing then lowered his head in thought.
It wasn’t until a good while later that Lin Jing seemed to have an epiphany, suddenly lifting his head, his eyes flashing with light.
Subsequently.
Lin Jing straightened his posture, his gaze unwaveringly determined.
Then, he began to retract his spiritual power, gradually exposing his body protected by spiritual power to the flame spring.
The moment the spiritual power was retracted, Lin Jing felt an immense, unbearable pain.
Lin Jing clenched his teeth, silently enduring it.
The flame spring found every opening to seep through his skin, inching into his body bit by bit.
And within his body, the flame spring was far from tame; the fire-element essence brought by the flame spring rampaged through his body.
Causing continuous damage to his body…
And Lin Jing kept circulating the Overlord Divine Physique, trying to heal his damaged body.
In this cycle of destruction and repair,
The Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was improving bit by bit.
Indeed.
This was indeed the final way to improve the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique: to let his body accommodate more power through constant destruction and reformation.
Only, all this destruction and reformation were happening internally.
As the flame spring continued to penetrate deeper, Lin Jing’s body was completely occupied by the fire-element essence.
If some practitioner of fire-element cultivation techniques were to see this, they would certainly accuse Lin Jing of squandering precious resources.
Such rare fire-element essence, and he was using it for body refining…
Indeed, the fire-element essence could be used for cultivation, but Lin Jing was not absorbing it to maintain the balance of the five elements within his body.
He was merely using the fire-element essence brought by the flame spring to continuously cleanse his body.
By this method, he was aiming for a breakthrough in the strength of his physique.
……
And so, after just two hours,
Lin Jing suddenly felt a tremor in his body, followed by a wave of refreshing feeling that spread instantly throughout his body.
Afterward…
Lin Jing’s body began to slowly shrink.
The previously bulging muscles gradually disappeared, melting into his body.
Lin Jing knew that this meant he had mastered the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique to the seventh level of perfection.
That’s why this change occurred.
Although the muscles on his body vanished and his body shape reverted to its previous form,
His physique was stronger than before.
The entire process of transformation lasted for a quarter of an hour.
Until, after the quarter-hour had passed, Lin Jing’s body had fully returned to normal.
At this moment, Lin Jing felt the surging power within him, overjoyed.
Since the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was perfected, this round of cultivation was also concluded for Lin Jing.
Then.
Lin Jing didn’t linger any longer and started to ascend.
When he passed the fifty-meter mark, Lin Jing especially checked to see that Yan Wanfei had left at some point.
Just wondering whether he had managed to break through the fifty-meter barrier this time…
Afterward, Lin Jing continued upward.
Soon, he returned to the cave.
Then, Lin Jing changed into the clothes he had already prepared.
Only after examining his body did he nod in satisfaction.
Though he had been a hulking figure for several years, Lin Jing still preferred his current appearance.
After that, Lin Jing left the place.
When Lin Jing returned to Li Yan City, even Yue Qi, who saw him, was stunned.
If it weren’t for the familiar aura and voice, she wouldn’t dare believe that this was Lin Jing’s true appearance.
However, Lin Jing’s explanation soon helped her understand.
Next, Yue Qi told Lin Jing something.
Lu Youjiu and the other two had temporarily left Li Yan Island, apparently because they had some matters to attend to.
They hadn’t informed Lin Jing because they were afraid of disturbing his cultivation.
The reason Yue Qi had stayed behind was specifically to tell him this news.
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
Now that Li Yan Island was stable and there were no enemies left.
Moreover, since returning after dealing with the Heavenly Desire Demon Monarch, Holaw Three Rivers had built a defense-offense integrated fifth-rank grand formation for Li Yan Island.
This formation was even more formidable than the one previously set up by Dai Mao.
Therefore, there was no fear of any attacks.
Next, Lin Jing only needed to go about his business and didn’t need to worry about anything.
After talking with Yue Qi for a while, Lin Jing then left Li Yan City to return to his alchemy room.
He still needed to refine the Flawless Eternal Youth Elixir for Yan Wanfei.
According to what Yue Qi had just said, they would be gone for quite a long time.
Lin Jing thought to himself that he should refine the Flawless Eternal Youth Elixir before they returned to give Yan Wanfei a surprise…
……
Time passed quickly, and before he knew it, another three months had flown by.
Throughout this period, Lu Youjiu and the others hadn’t returned, not even sending any messages.
Then one day, as Lin Jing was practicing the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique in the Spirit Field in the northern part of Li Yan Island, repairing the delicate veins within the Spirit Plants…
Suddenly.
Lin Jing felt a powerful Divine Sense sweep over him, and he promptly activated his own Divine Sense to scan back.
When Lin Jing scanned back, he was immediately taken aback…
Then a Divine Sense message reached Lin Jing’s mind:
“Brother Lin…”
“Come quickly to Li Yan City, there are matters to discuss…”
It was Lu Youjiu and the others who had returned. The one transmitting the Divine Sense message was precisely Lu Youjiu.
Lin Jing promptly replied through Divine Sense:
“Brother Lu, please wait a moment…”
Having said that, Lin Jing immediately stood up.
Then he flew to Li Yan City on his Flying Sword.
Arriving at the City Lord’s Mansion in Li Yan City, Lin Jing immediately saw Lu Youjiu and the others.
Afterward, Lin Jing walked over with a smile:
“Brother Lu…”
“Brother San He, Brother Yan…”
“Your mission this time has been quite lengthy.”
Yan Wanfei then said:
“This time it was Brother Jiu who had some matters; we just accompanied him to take care of some business.”
Lin Jing then looked at Lu Youjiu with concern:
“Brother Lu, was the matter very troublesome?”
Lu Youjiu shook his head and said:
“It’s just some private affairs, nothing serious…”
After speaking, Lu Youjiu took out a transparent ‘stone’ of unknown material from his Space Ring and handed it to Lin Jing.
He then said:
“Brother Lin…”
“This is a piece of Flowing Light Gold Crystal, perfect for adding to your Ling Yin Flawless Sword to enhance its quality.”
“If combined with the Bright Spirit Origin Stone in your hand, it could even further upgrade your Ling Yin Flawless Sword.”
“You just need to find an Energy Refinement Master to meld it into your Ling Yin Flawless Sword when the time comes.”
The Bright Spirit Origin Stone was that transparent material Lin Jingzhi had obtained from the Island Master’s Storage Bag on Yuxing Island.
The Bright Spirit Origin Stone was incredibly precious, only a high-ranking Energy Refinement Master could refine and integrate it into a Flying Sword.
That’s why the Artifact Refiner Yan Wanfei had found earlier didn’t take the initiative on his own.
……
At that moment, Yan Wanfei quickly added:
“Brother Lin, I won’t be able to help you find an Artifact Refiner this time…”
“Because we three are leaving…”
Lin Jing was taken aback upon hearing this, and then asked with confusion:
“Leaving?”
“To where?”
When Lin Jing had come here, he felt that the atmosphere was a bit off.
Especially Yan Wanfei, who had lost his usual liveliness.
So this was the reason.
Lu Youjiu spoke up:
“This time, we’re planning to leave this southern outer sea and head to the Inner Sea…”
“Once we leave this time, we won’t be coming back for a short while. When we return, we don’t know how many years it will be.”
“So we’ve come to bid farewell to you, Brother Lin…”

chapters.title: Chapter 392: 92 Lu Youjiu Leaves
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 92 Lu Youjiu Leaves
Lin Jing then continued to speak, asking,
“Lu Brother…”
“Weren’t you always training in the outer southern seas before?”
“Why do you suddenly want to leave for the Inner Sea?”
Lu Youjiu paused for a moment and then looked at Lin Jing, explaining,
“Actually, my home has always been in the Inner Sea…”
“I was originally the son of the Shocking Seas Alliance’s Alliance Master Lu Jingtao…”
“It’s just that I had some disagreements with my family, which is why I came out to fend for myself…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was immediately startled and quickly asked,
“The Shocking Seas Alliance…”
“Is that the top-tier power known as the Shocking Seas Alliance, which is on par with the Seven Seas Hall and the Changyun Clan?”
Lu Youjiu nodded, saying,
“That’s right…”
Hearing Lu Youjiu confirm this, Lin Jing was also utterly shocked.
The Shocking Seas Alliance was an extremely famous top-tier force within the Demon Monster Sea’s Inner Sea.
Together with the Seven Seas Hall, Changyun Clan, and the Ice God Palace, they were known as the four great powers of the Demon Monster Inner Sea.
It can be said that the entire Demon Monster Inner Sea is under their control.
Moreover, the Shocking Seas Alliance’s strength is incomparably formidable, and within the alliance, there were also numerous experts.
In terms of combat power, it was close to the strongest, the Seven Seas Hall, and could almost be considered among the top two.
Unexpectedly, Lu Youjiu turned out to be the son of the Alliance Master of the Shocking Seas Alliance.
Lin Jing then gave a wry smile and said, “Lu Brother…”
“I had no idea you were the young master of the Shocking Seas Alliance, you kept it so well hidden from me.”
Lu Youjiu, however, shook his head, a trace of desolation in his gaze,
“Actually, sometimes I wish I were just a Loose Cultivator…”
A moment later, Lu Youjiu collected his emotions and continued,
“Let’s not talk about that now…”
“It was just three months ago that I received news that a major event happened in the Demon Monster Inner Sea, affecting many major powers, and the impact was not insignificant.”
“Furthermore, this matter has extensive implications.”
“If I were to stay here, not only would my safety be at risk, but it could even possibly implicate you as well.”
“That’s why I must return to the Shocking Seas Alliance. Only in this way can I ensure my own safety.”
“And…”
“After returning this time, I probably won’t be able to come out freely anymore.”
“Hence, we needed to come and bid you farewell.”
Lin Jing fell silent for a moment.
Then he turned his head, looking at Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei who were behind Lu Youjiu, and continued to ask,
“San He Brother, and Yan Brother, are you both going back with him?”
Lu Youjiu nodded, saying,
“Yes…”
“This time, I might get involved in some issues, so I need a few trustworthy people by my side.”
“The three of us have been together for many years and know each other quite well. These two are the right candidates.”
Lin Jing then fell silent for a while and said,
“I understand…”
After saying this, Lin Jing looked at the others and asked,
“So when do you plan to set off?”
Lu Youjiu pondered for a moment, then said,
“In a few days, we still need to make some other preparations these few days.”
“If that’s the case, we still have time for another gathering.”
……
Lu Youjiu didn’t propose that Lin Jing accompany them, and Lin Jing didn’t offer to follow…
Both knew that no banquet in the world goes on forever, and it was time for them to part ways.
Because.
Lin Jing’s identity was special, and there were likely still many enemies in the Demon Monster Inner Sea, so it wasn’t a good time for him to venture into the Inner Sea.
Lin Jing was also aware of this and naturally didn’t propose to go, to avoid causing trouble for Lu Youjiu.
……
Lin Jing then nodded,
“That’s good, how about we gather again tomorrow? I’ll cook…”
“Niu San has been looking forward to it for a long time…”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei immediately nodded repeatedly, saying,
“That sounds great…”
“To tell you the truth, I have been craving that seabird you roasted since last time.”
Lu Youjiu also nodded, saying,
“Mm, I was fortunate enough to eat it once…”
“The flavor really was good, Lin Brother, I’ll have to trouble you then.”
Lin Jing smiled and said,
“No problem, I’ll make sure you all have your fill next time.”
No sooner had Lin Jing’s voice faded when Holaw Three Rivers spoke up at this moment, very seriously saying,
“You all have had it, only I haven’t even seen it, let alone tasted it.”
“I always feel like I’m at a bit of a loss…”
Yan Wanfei then laughed and said to Holaw Three Rivers,
“That’s easy to fix, just eat twice as much next time, and you’ll be even…”
Hearing this, Holaw Three Rivers pondered seriously for a moment, then said,
“That proposal, I think it’s feasible…”
Lin Jing also smiled,
“No problem, you’ll get to eat your fill…”
At this point, Lin Jing suddenly remembered something and then said to Yan Wanfei,
“Niu San…”
Yan Wanfei turned his head to look at Lin Jing,
“Lin Brother, what is it? Tell me…”
“Following that…”
Lin Jing then directly took out a Pure Jade Box and tossed it to Yan Wanfei.
Seeing the object Lin Jing threw over, not even identifying what it was, Yan Wanfei quickly reached out to catch it.
Feeling the icy temperature in his hand, Yan Wanfei looked down…
He saw a perfectly square Pure Jade Box in his hands, and inside that box lay an almost transparent Elixir Medicine.
When he saw the Elixir Medicine, Yan Wanfei first froze for a moment, then became incredibly excited:
“Eternal Youth Elixir, Lin Brother, you truly managed to refine it…”
Lin Jing wore a light smile and then said,
“It was also a bit of luck, didn’t expect to succeed on the third try.”
Yan Wanfei then burst into hearty laughter:
“Hahaha…”
“Lin Brother, you’re really something else.”
“No way, I’ve got to give you a bear hug today no matter what…”
Speaking, Yan Wanfei spread his arms, ready to embrace…
Lin Jing’s smile immediately froze on his face,
Then he quickly reacted and hastily hid behind Lu Youjiu.
Then he began to stir the pot:
“Brother Lu, Niu San is being annoying again.”
“How about, we beat him up…”
Lu Youjiu nodded his head and looked at Yan Wanfei with a very unfriendly gaze before he spoke:
“Twice…”
“I was annoyed too.”
The initially excited Yan Wanfei was immediately stunned and then quickly began to explain:
“No, no, Brother Ji… Drink Brother…”
“It’s just that I couldn’t help myself, I wanted to express my gratitude to Lin Brother.”
“I protest, you can’t treat me like this…”
However, Yan Wanfei’s protest was directly rejected by Lu Youjiu:
“You’re too abnormal, protest denied.”
Holaw Three Rivers also nodded at that moment, giving Yan Wanfei a disdainful look before speaking:
“Add another one, I was disgusted just now as well.”
Lu Youjiu nodded, saying:
“No problem…”
Yan Wanfei incredulously widened his eyes, looking towards Holaw Three Rivers and said:
“No way, San He, even you too…”
But Holaw Three Rivers was dead serious, replying:
“Originally, I wanted to help out by providing a formation while he was beating you up, but since it’s the first time you’ve disgusted me to my face, I let go of that idea.”
“I think you should be thanking me.”
Yan Wanfei immediately collapsed:
“Oh my, what kind of people have I met…”
…
…
A few days quickly passed, and Lu Youjiu and the others left together.
Before leaving, Holaw Three Rivers made a move to reinforce the formations of Li Yan Island for Lin Jing.
Now, the entire defense level of Li Yan Island had been raised by more than a notch.
Then, according to Lin Jing’s plan,
he also arranged several formations within the mountain range to the north of Li Yan Island.
Following the idea Lin Jing had previously conceived, he turned the entire Li Yan Island into a semi-open island.
The southern area of Li Yan Island, where many original resident cultivators lived, could be open to the outside, conducting trade with other islands and such.
While the latter half of Li Yan Island, including the developed Spirit Fields and the mountains behind them, along with the Earth Flame Spring,
were treated as the forbidden area of Li Yan Island.
Usually shrouded by formations, they were off-limits to everyone.
And Lin Jing lived in the northern part of Li Yan Island.
This makeover of Li Yan Island was indeed a tiring task for Holaw Three Rivers.
First, there were three sets of stacked formations for the entire island, followed by the forbidden zone in the northern part of Li Yan Island, which also required formation protection.
All these required at least three sets of formations.
A Killing Formation, a Trapping Formation, and a Defensive Array, stacked together to form a chain of formations.
Beyond these formations,
Li Yan City also needed formation protection.
Originally, Li Yan Island had two cities.
The other city also changed its name to Li Yan Fang Market.
In the future, this will be the place responsible for trade with the outside world and other islands in the Thousand Islands Domain.
Naturally, Li Yan Fang Market also required formation defense.
And the Spirit Fields behind Li Yan City, too, naturally could not be without formation protection…
…
…
All of these kept Holaw Three Rivers extremely busy for the last few days…
Thankfully, with the assistance of Lin Jing and Yan Wanfei, these formations were finally completed.
After completion, Holaw Three Rivers handed over all the control methods for these formations to Lin Jing.
Now, Li Yan Island could be said to be entirely under Lin Jing’s control.
With these great formations in place, even if a Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator were to come, they might not be able to break through these formations for a while.
However,
If it were for a prolonged period, that might be a different story.
After all, Lin Jing’s cultivation was still far from sufficient.
So, for the time being, Lin Jing still needed to act with discretion, avoid attracting the attention of other formidable cultivators.
Otherwise, even with formations for protection, it wouldn’t be safe.
Besides,
Before leaving, Lu Youjiu distributed some Nirvana Elixirs that Lin Jing had previously refined among the group.
Since Lin Jing had provided the most crucial ingredient, the Nirvana Flower, and the elixir was made by his own hand,
Lu Youjiu took the initiative to give Lin Jing the Superior Nirvana Elixir and the Medium Grade Nirvana Elixir,
While the other two Superior Nirvana Elixirs were given to Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei, one for each, to be used when they attempt to reach the Nascent Soul Stage.
Beyond these elixirs,
Lu Youjiu also learned from Yan Wanfei that Lin Jing wanted to plant high-grade elixir medicine seeds,
So he arranged for Lin Jing to get two seeds through his own connections.
These two seeds were precisely the Spirit Plants needed for refining the Nirvana Elixirs.
Lin Jing didn’t refuse and took the two seeds without hesitation.
He genuinely needed these seeds.
Then, before leaving, Lin Jing also prepared some elixir medicines for Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei,
So that the two could quickly improve their strength.
Last,
The group said farewell to each other.
Lu Youjiu and the other two boarded the Flying Boat and then left Li Yan Island.
After Lu Youjiu and the others had departed on the Flying Boat,
Lin Jing stood in the sky above Li Yan Island, gazing long and hard…
In the future, they might meet again.
But by then, Lin Jing might already have enough strength not to worry about anything anymore.
But for now, he couldn’t do that…

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 93 Golden Core 3rd Layer
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 93 Golden Core 3rd Layer
After Lu Youjiu and the others left, Lin Jing’s life once again resumed its previous pattern.
Soon, another year had passed.
In that year, Lin Jing either engaged in alchemy or cultivation and seldom went out.
He had entrusted all the various affairs of Li Yan Island to Yue Qi’s mother to manage.
It must be said…
Yue Qi’s mother’s ability was indeed very strong.
Perhaps it was also because she was an original resident cultivator of Li Yan Island that, under her management, no problems ever arose.
It’s just that ever since she started managing Li Yan Island, she had much less time to take care of the Spirit Plants.
There was no choice, as Lin Jing currently had no other capable hands at his disposal.
Now, only Yue Qi’s mother was somewhat reliable.
It seems that if Lin Jing wishes to develop Li Yan Island in the future, he would have to think of ways to cultivate some more trustworthy people.
However.
While cultivating reliable people is important, enhancing one’s own strength is even more crucial.
Without strength, everything else is an illusion.
At this moment, Lin Jing was indeed such a case.
Right now, he was sitting cross-legged in the System Space, in closed-door cultivation, preparing to break through to the third level of the Golden Core Stage.
Next to him lay an empty Pure Jade Box, the Pure Elixir it once contained had already been consumed by Lin Jing.
For this assault on the third level of the Golden Core Stage, Lin Jing had made thorough preparations.
……
Actually.
Ever since entering the Golden Core Stage, Lin Jing’s cultivation speed had slowed down a lot compared to before.
Over such a long time, Lin Jing had only advanced from the first level of the Golden Core Stage when he first left Immortal Crossing Island to the peak of the second level.
It was not until recently that Lin Jing sensed the opportunity for a breakthrough and began to prepare for it.
For this breakthrough, Lin Jing even started preparations three months ago, refining the Pure Elixir.
Now, having taken the Pure Elixir, the spiritual power inside Lin Jing’s body was increasing continuously.
And converging toward his Dantian.
Due to his poor Spiritual Root aptitude, Lin Jing’s breakthroughs were always extremely difficult.
This time was no exception.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had Pure Elixir Medicine to assist in his breakthroughs.
Otherwise, waiting for his cultivation to accumulate to an overflowing state would probably take many more years.
One need only look at the Zhang Family Patriarch to understand the difficulty of Lin Jing’s breakthroughs.
The Zhang Family Patriarch took a full five hundred years to break through to the late Golden Core Stage.
And Lin Jing had resources that were many times more abundant than what the Zhang Family Patriarch possessed.
Not to mention, within the System Space, the abundant spiritual power was sufficient even for Divine Transformation Cultivators to practice cultivation.
And Lin Jing continuously used various elixirs to increase his cultivation…
With such favourable conditions, Lin Jing barely reached the peak of the Golden Core second level.
Moreover.
This was with the addition of the accelerated time flow of the System Space.
Taking into account the time within the System Space, Lin Jing’s actual cultivation time was even longer.
However.
Given Lin Jing’s poorer aptitude, such a speed of cultivation was actually acceptable.
Should he want to cultivate faster, he would need to find some heaven-defying treasures that could improve one’s Spiritual Root.
Like, for example, the Reversal Fruit.
But the Reversal Fruit was not so easy to find.
For now, Lin Jing could only wish for it.
……
Inside Lin Jing’s body, the spiritual power transformed from the Pure Elixir continued to converge.
Once these energies reached overflowing state, Lin Jing then controlled them, channeling them through his meridians before gathering them into his Dantian.
Merging into the Golden Core…
Time ticked by, and after an indeterminate amount, the spiritual power in Lin Jing’s Dantian had also grown more and more abundant.
These energies soon reached a saturated state.
Then, Lin Jing began to operate his Cultivation Technique and formed a small vortex in his Dantian, attempting to compress and condense these energies.
In this way, Lin Jing slowly focused all his body’s spiritual power toward his Dantian…
Finally, after several hours had passed…
Lin Jing suddenly felt a “boom” inside him as if he had broken through some kind of restraint, and then his body suddenly felt lighter, with his mind becoming exceptionally clear.
He had broken through to the third level of the Golden Core Stage…
Then, the system notification chimed:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Congratulations to the host for a successful breakthrough of the current realm, reward received: 30 Harvest Points.”
After the breakthrough, Lin Jing eagerly sensed the surging spiritual power within his body.
Indeed, the third level of the Golden Core Stage was much stronger than the second level.
Now, he had substantially increased his combat strength compared to before the breakthrough, almost doubling it.
Afterward, Lin Jing also took a moment to feel his Divine Sense.
He distinctly sensed that his Divine Sense had also grown stronger.
Once Lin Jing was satisfied with his current strength, he nodded contentedly.
Then, he left System Space and appeared in his alchemy room.
Lin Jing’s current alchemy room was no longer the one on the hilltop from before.
This new alchemy room was moved to the highest peak in the northern part of Li Yan Island.
Since the entire northern part of Li Yan Island was enveloped in a Formation and entry by others was not allowed,
Lin Jing enjoyed a lot of solitude here and was undisturbed.
Only Yue Qi’s mother, on the few occasions she had other matters to discuss with Lin Jing, would come over.
Following that.
Lin Jing left his alchemy room and flew on his sword toward Li Yan City.
Upon reaching Li Yan City, he went straight to the City Lord’s Mansion.
Here, Lin Jing met Madam Yue Qi.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Madam Yue Qi was first surprised, then she said,
“Island Master Lin, you’ve finally come down from the mountain…”
“Your period of seclusion this time was truly not short, a full six months.”
“Just like that, you left the entire Li Yan Island to me to manage, playing the role of an absentee shopkeeper.”
“You really trust me…”
“It’s made me now have even less time to Cultivate…”
As she uttered these words, there was a touch of grievance in Madam Yue Qi’s tone.
Lin Jing’s face turned red, and then he said,
“Now that the island has just started developing, we don’t have many people to use, so I’m troubling you to put in more effort.”
“Once we find suitable candidates, you will be able to relax a bit…”
Madam Yue Qi sighed helplessly, and said,
“Sigh…”
“Alright!”
“It seems like I’m not going anywhere for a while…”
Just as Madam Yue Qi finished speaking, she suddenly asked Lin Jing,
“Right, Island Master, do you have something to handle on your trip down the mountain this time?”
Lin Jing nodded and then replied,
“I’ve refined some Elixir Medicine and plan to sell them in exchange for some Spirit Stones.”
“After all, the island has many daily needs, and the Spirit Plants we’ve been growing have not yet matured and can’t be sold.”
“We can’t do without Spirit Stones.”
Actually, the main reason Lin Jing secluded himself for such a long time was that he spent most of it on Alchemy.
Before the Spirit Plants on Li Yan Island matured and started generating profit, Lin Jing needed a large amount of Spirit Stones to maintain the operation of the entire Li Yan Island.
This was how Lin Jing managed Li Yan Island, following the methods he had observed in Nanshan Immortal City.
Madam Yue Qi was responsible for management while under her, they divided several Foundation Establishment Cultivators, who in turn each had a number of people under them.
These Cultivators were recruited from the original inhabitants of Li Yan Island.
These local Cultivators were helping manage Li Yan City and Li Yan Fang Market, and naturally, Lin Jing had to pay them a salary.
Although currently, this approach did not seem to yield any results,
such early-stage investments were necessary.
In time, these efforts would show their worth.
Afterward, Lin Jing turned to Madam Yue Qi and asked,
“Madam Yue Qi, you must be close to advancing to the Golden Core Stage, aren’t you?”
Madam Yue Qi looked at Lin Jing gratefully, then said,
“Thanks to the Island Master’s help, if nothing unexpected happens, I should be able to start preparing for the advancement to the Golden Core Stage within half a year.”
Lin Jing nodded, then said,
“Good…”
“Once I’ve sold these Elixir Medicines, I’ll get you two Cultivation True Elixirs to help you advance to the Golden Core Stage.”
Madam Yue Qi bowed deeply in gratitude and said,
“Thank you, Island Master Lin…”
Lin Jing shook his hand, saying,
“You’ve been helping manage Li Yan City this whole time, and it’s been tough on you…”
“Once you advance to the Golden Core Stage, by then, you should pick someone trustworthy and hand over the management of Li Yan City to them.”
As he said this, Lin Jing suddenly remembered something and continued to ask Madam Yue Qi,
“Right…”
“What preparations have you made for your Tribulation?”
Madam Yue Qi quickly replied,
“Before, I made a deal with Senior Zhang Jian, I imparted to him the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique, and he agreed to help me prepare a Formation for crossing the Tribulation.”
“As for other preparations, there are none.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment and then said,
“Okay…”
“I understand.”
“You don’t have to worry about that; leave it to me when the time comes.”
Lin Jing knew the reason Madam Yue Qi had no other preparations was because she was financially embarrassed.
Before Lin Jing’s arrival, she could barely protect herself under Dai Mao, not to mention that advancing her Cultivation had become an unattainable luxury.
Where would she get the Spirit Stones to buy Magical Treasures or Elixir Medicine in preparation for advancing to the Golden Core Stage?
Even that Formation for crossing Tribulation was obtained through exchanging her family’s heritage Cultivation Technique, the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique.
Now,
Madam Yue Qi was working for Lin Jing, and naturally, he would not allow her to be treated unfairly.
This time, after selling the Elixir Medicines,
Lin Jing planned to prepare a Defensive Magical Treasure for Madam Yue Qi to aid her in crossing the Tribulation.
As for the Elixir Medicines, Lin Jing could refine them effortlessly, so they didn’t require much preparation.
Afterward, Lin Jing continued to Madam Yue Qi,
“Madam Yue Qi, I entrust Li Yan Island to you for the time being.”
“I’m going to Bihai City for a trip, and after I return from Bihai City, we will start preparing for your Tribulation.”
Madam Yue Qi quickly gave her thanks,
“Thank you, Island Master…”
Lin Jing replied, “There’s no need…”
“I will still need you to take on additional responsibilities in the future.”
With that said, Lin Jing handed over part of the Formation flags that controlled the island’s Formation to Madam Yue Qi.
Of course, this was only a part of them, which could simply control the Formation to attack or defend against invading enemies.
The truly important parts of the Formation, several core Formation flags and the Token used to control it, Lin Jing obviously wouldn’t hand over.
Madam Yue Qi then said,
“Rest assured, Island Master.”
“With these Formations, no one would dare to cause trouble on Li Yan Island.”

chapters.title: Chapter 394: 94 Selling Pills
chapters.content:
Chapter 394: Chapter 94 Selling Pills
After making all the necessary arrangements, Lin Jing mounted his sword and took off, leaving Li Yan Island directly.
The distance between Li Yan Island and Bihai City was not very far, to begin with.
However, without a Flying Boat, Lin Jing could only rely on sword flight, crossing the vast sea. To fly to Bihai City in this manner would still take several days.
On the other hand, traveling by Flying Boat would take at most a day or two to reach Bihai City.
If possible, Lin Jing would have liked to purchase a Flying Boat for himself.
But, the price of a Flying Boat was not cheap, costing at least a million Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
It was something he could not afford at the moment.
For now, Lin Jing could only dream about it…
……
After flying continuously for several days, Lin Jing finally arrived once again in Bihai City.
This time, since he planned to sell Elixir Medicine at the Seven Seas Hall, Lin Jing made thorough preparations.
On his way there, Lin Jing had already activated the Changyun Hidden Technique, altering his physique, appearance, and aura.
By the time he arrived in Bihai City, Lin Jing had already transformed into a slender middle-aged man.
Upon reaching Bihai City, Lin Jing looked at the grand buildings lining both sides of the main street.
He couldn’t help but feel emotional.
It was said that the City Lord of Bihai City possessed cultivation exceeding that of the Divinity Transformation.
Perhaps it was precisely because of his extraordinary strength that no one dared to provoke him lightly, which in turn had led to the prosperity of Bihai City at present.
Lin Jing wondered when he himself would reach such a level.
After his moment of contemplation,
Lin Jing crossed the street and headed straight for the Seven Seas Hall.
Previously,
Lu Youjiu had briefly introduced the process of selling Elixir Medicine to Lin Jing.
So although Lin Jing had never sold Elixir Medicine before, he was not unfamiliar with the process.
And so, Lin Jing went straight to the third floor of the Seven Seas Hall.
After reaching the third floor, Lin Jing declined the offer for guidance from the Attendant and walked through the hall to its furthest end.
At the very back, there was another room – where Lin Jing’s destination lied.
Upon entering the room, Lin Jing scanned the area.
Apart from a middle-aged steward behind the counter and two maidservants standing by the door, the room was empty.
The middle-aged steward had not concealed his cultivation – he was also a Golden Core Stage expert.
Moreover, his cultivation was slightly higher than Lin Jing’s, being at the mid-stage of the Golden Core Stage.
Upon Lin Jing’s arrival, the middle-aged steward directly addressed him:
“Fellow Daoist, I wonder if you wish to sell ‘overt goods’ or ‘covert goods’?”
Overt goods.
These were easy to understand. They referred to items that could be exposed, traded normally, and would not attract trouble.
Covert goods,
on the other hand, were exceptionally secretive items that needed to be kept hidden from the public eye.
For example, some of the Magical Treasures obtained by Bandit Cultivators. These treasures could be quite famous and not suitable for open use.
Or some rare Elixir Medicine and materials.
These might have been unexpected windfalls or acquired by some improper means, or perhaps, for some reasons, one simply did not want to reveal their identity.
However,
although the transaction of covert goods was secretive, and the Seven Seas Hall would not inquire further, it would require an additional fee of 10% compared to overt goods.
Moreover, the Seven Seas Hall could guarantee that anyone who sold covert goods through them would never be traced back to by the buyer.
Although boasting might be present in their claim, over the years, the Seven Seas Hall had indeed lived up to their promise.
Covert goods sold through the Seven Seas Hall had never had their sellers traced.
So, gradually…
More and more people began to sell their unseen Magical Treasures, Cultivation Techniques, or rare materials through the Seven Seas Hall.
Over time, the trade of covert goods became another major business of the Seven Seas Hall.
This time, Lin Jing naturally intended to sell his goods as covert goods.
Even though it would incur an additional 10% fee, the reduction in trouble made it worthwhile.
Lin Jing then spoke directly,
“Covert goods…”
The middle-aged steward nodded, then stepped out from behind the counter and said to Lin Jing:
“The sale of covert goods is not conducted here, fellow Daoist. Please follow me.”
With that, the middle-aged steward left the counter and directed Lin Jing towards a back room.
Lin Jing nodded and followed him.
Soon, the two arrived at the back room.
Inside the room, apart from an old man with white hair, there was no one else.
At that moment, the white-haired elder was leaning back in his chair, closely examining a Jade Pendant in his hand.
The middle-aged steward stepped forward and addressed the white-haired old man:
“Elder Ye…”
“This fellow Daoist has come to sell covert goods. Would you please take a look at them for us?”
The one referred to as Elder Ye, the white-haired old man, looked up at Lin Jing and then said to the middle-aged steward:
“All right, I’ve got it. You can go now.”
The middle-aged steward bowed to Elder Ye and said:
“Yes, thank you for your trouble, Elder Ye…”
After he finished speaking, the middle-aged steward left the room.
Then, Elder Ye sat up straight, put away the Jade Pendant, and said to Lin Jing:
“Please, take a seat…”
Lin Jing nodded and sat down opposite the white-haired elder.
Elder Ye continued,
“Take out all the covert goods you wish to sell, and I will help you evaluate the price.”
“If you find the price reasonable, we can complete the transaction; if you find it unreasonable, or have any questions, you are free to leave at any time.”
Indeed.
Upon learning of Lin Jing’s intentions, this elder from the Seven Seas Hall had asked nothing.
This was just as Lu Youjiu had told him beforehand.
Without hesitation, Lin Jing took out dozens of jade bottles from his Storage Bag.
After taking those out, Lin Jing then took out over a dozen Pure Jade Boxes from the Storage Bag as well.
The Elixir Medicines inside these Pure Jade Boxes were no ordinary matter.
These were all Third Rank Elixirs.
Lin Jing didn’t even bother taking out any Second Rank Pure Elixirs; all he took out were Third Rank Pure Elixir Medicines.
Because even though Second Rank Elixir Medicines, even Pure Elixirs, wouldn’t attract attention and didn’t need to be sold under the table.
Only these Third Rank Pure Elixirs might draw the attention of certain people if they were to be sold on a large scale.
Seeing Lin Jing take out these Elixir Medicines, the white-haired elder went from indifference to slight surprise in the end.
“Oh?”
“The Elixir Medicines you have on hand seem rather plentiful.”
Though surprised, Elder Ye was not astonished.
Having dealt with under-the-counter goods here for so long, he had seen this kind of situation countless times before.
He had even seen quantities greater than what Lin Jing had brought out.
In no time at all, Lin Jing took out all the Elixir Medicines he planned to sell.
“That’s all of them; please take a look…”
In fact, these were not all the Elixir Medicines Lin Jing possessed.
Because he didn’t plan to sell all of his Elixir Medicines just yet; he intended to sell only this amount for the time being.
As for the rest, aside from those he needed for his own use, Lin Jing also kept some as a precaution in case of emergency.
With Lin Jing’s words, Elder Ye then began to pick up the Elixir Medicines on the table and inspect them.
He opened the stoppers of the jade bottles one by one, poured them out to examine closely, and was very meticulous in his inspection.
It didn’t take long for him to finish inspecting all of the Elixir Medicines in the dozens of jade bottles.
Next, it was time to inspect those dozen or so Pure Elixirs.
At this moment, Elder Ye spoke to Lin Jing:
“Before inspecting the Pure Elixirs, I need to inform you that we will need to open the Pure Jade Boxes to inspect them.”
Lin Jing nodded and said, “Of course, feel free to begin the inspection.”
With Lin Jing’s permission, Elder Ye nodded and then opened one of the Pure Jade Boxes to begin his inspection.
