The moment the Pure Jade Box was opened, the fragrance of the Elixir instantly filled the air.
Yet, Elder Ye did not get distracted but continued his careful inspection…
After about half an hour, Elder Ye had finished inspecting all the Pure Elixirs Lin Jing had brought out.
After the inspection, Elder Ye first asked Lin Jing:
“Have you looked into the price of these Elixir Medicines before?”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“I have indeed done some research.”
Lin Jing wasn’t lying; he had already inquired about the prices of these Elixir Medicines before he planned to start selling them.
Elder Ye nodded and said:
“That’s good…”
“Since you also know the approximate prices of these Elixir Medicines, then I’ll just tell you directly.”
“The initial valuation I’ve assessed for these Elixir Medicines you’ve brought is 1.8 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones; if we deduct a 10% service fee, you should get about 1.62 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones.”
“If you think the price is right, we can make the trade now.”
“If you have any objections to this price, you can also take your Elixir Medicines and leave at any time.”
1.62 million Spirit Stones was actually not a small amount.
Keep in mind that back in the Nanming Domain, the Zhang Family Patriarch had nearly exhausted the family’s resources to gather 200,000 Spirit Stones to purchase a single Medium Grade Lifespan Extension Pill.
And now, Lin Jing would obtain 1.62 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones from selling his Elixir Medicines.
That was eight times what the Zhang Family had saved up before.
Of course.
These were Third Rank Pure Elixirs; it was quite normal to be able to sell them for such a price.
These Elixir Medicines.
If sold elsewhere, they would probably fetch around 1.8 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones, at most not more than 2 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones.
And that would also come with the risk of exposure and wasn’t very safe.
After pondering for a while, Lin Jing nodded and said:
“I have no objections to this price.”
Elder Ye nodded and then asked Lin Jing, “Would you like Superior Grade Spirit Stones, or Midium Grade Spirit Stones?”
“We can make the trade with whichever type of Spirit Stones you desire.”
After listening, Lin Jing thought for a moment and then said:
“I’ll take Midium Grade Spirit Stones.”
Lin Jing still had some Superior Grade Spirit Stones on him and was not in great need of them.
Elder Ye nodded and then directly summoned a female attendant to come in.
After the attendant walked in, Elder Ye said:
“Fetch 1.62 million Midium Grade Spirit Stones for this friend.”
“Yes, Elder Ye.”
The attendant bowed and then withdrew.
…
…
Less than a quarter of an hour later, the attendant returned.
In her hands, she was holding a Storage Bag.
After entering, the attendant went straight to Lin Jing and handed over the Storage Bag, then said:
“Senior, please have a look…”

chapters.title: Chapter 395: 95: The Trade Fair
chapters.content:
Chapter 395: Chapter 95: The Trade Fair
Lin Jing nodded, then opened the Storage Bag and sent his Divine Sense into it to investigate.
Inside the Storage Bag, stacks of Spirit Stones were neatly piled up.
After counting, Lin Jing confirmed that there were precisely 1,620,000 stones, not one more or less.
Having counted them, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense from the Storage Bag.
He then nodded to Elder Ye:
“That’s right…”
“1,620,000 exactly.”
Elder Ye nodded and said,
“Rest assured, our Seven Seas Hall never deceives the young or old.”
“If you have more goods to offer in the future, you’re welcome to come again.”
Lin Jing nodded and then bid farewell to Elder Ye, leaving the Seven Seas Hall.
After leaving Seven Seas Hall, Lin Jing found a secluded corner to revert to his original appearance.
Then, he headed towards Seven Seas Hall once again.
This time, Lin Jing was not there to sell Elixir Medicine but to browse and possibly purchase a Defensive Magical Treasure.
Upon reaching Seven Seas Hall again, Lin Jing went straight up to the third floor.
On this third floor, what was for sale were Magical Treasures, Cultivation Techniques, and even Elixir Medicine materials needed by Golden Core Cultivators.
The fourth floor above was specifically for items required by Nascent Soul Cultivators.
Since Lin Jing intended to buy a Golden Core Magic Treasure, there was no need for him to go up any further.
In the spacious hall of the third floor, there weren’t many people, only about a dozen…
Fewer compared to the cultivators on the lower two floors.
After all, those who came here were at least of the Golden Core Stage, not something the lower two floors could compare with.
These Golden Core Cultivators, either in small groups or alone, were searching for what they needed.
Lin Jing directly passed by the counters selling Elixir Medicine and various materials, heading deeper into the hall.
Where Magical Treasures were sold was at the very back of the hall.
Lin Jing approached the counter for Magical Treasures and examined each one on display.
Next to these treasures were detailed descriptions of each.
Including their functions, materials, and so on…
Some even had the name of the Artifact Refiner who had crafted them.
Because…
Some Artifact Refiners had illustrious reputations, and the treasures they crafted were coveted by many.
Sometimes, their names alone were like a living signboard.
These Refiners either cooperated with Seven Seas Hall or directly sold their treasures to it.
Which would then be resold by Seven Seas Hall.
Lin Jing examined these treasures carefully.
As he was preparing a Defensive Magical Treasure for Mother Yue Qi’s Tribulation, Lin Jing was only focused on Defensive Magical Treasures.
It must be said, the treasures sold by Seven Seas Hall were all quite excellent.
However, so were their prices.
Take for instance the Green Gold and Red Jade Shield Lin Jing was currently looking at.
It was a Superior Magical Treasure shield, crafted from green gold and red jade, and made by a renowned Energy Refinement Master.
Moreover…
Several Fourth Rank formations had been inscribed on the shield by an Array Master.
This Green Gold and Red Jade Shield fetched a sky-high price of 250,000 Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
And then…
There was the Green Jade Bead that Lin Jing had seen earlier, another Defensive Magical Treasure, which was similarly priced to the Green Gold and Red Jade Shield.
It was also a Superior treasure, marked with a price of 200,000 Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
Indeed, these treasures were quite remarkable.
But they were not the kind of shields Lin Jing was looking for.
Because he needed a Defensive Magical Treasure that could help Mother Yue Qi withstand the Heavenly Tribulation, particularly against lightning or lightning spells.
These two treasures lacked such a feature.
Lin Jing continued to look further.
Finally…
At the end of the counter, Lin Jing saw a shield Magical Treasure that could protect against the Heavenly Tribulation.
But the price tag shocked him.
This treasure was listed for 500,000 Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
At the moment, in front of the counter stood two other Cultivators, shaking their heads at the treasure.
One Yellow Pine Cultivator furrowed his brow and said,
“This shield is exorbitantly priced…”
The other red-haired Cultivator nodded in agreement, responding,
“Treasures capable of withstanding the Heavenly Tribulation are never cheap.”
“However, the pricing for this one is indeed inflated.”
“The actual value of this shield, at most, should be around 300,000 Medium Grade Spirit Stones.”
The Yellow Pine Cultivator nodded slightly and said,
“Indeed…”
“They only dare to charge so much because of the reputation of Master Qi Yan.”
The red-haired Cultivator continued,
“Master Qi Yan is among the most outstanding Energy Refinement Masters in the South Sea, and his crafts are indeed exceptional.”
“Unfortunately, Master Qi Yan seldom agrees to refine treasures for others, and any treasure from his hand is extraordinarily rare.”
“Therefore, some people with ulterior motives deliberately purchase them only to sell at an inflated price.”
“Thus, it’s also the reason why treasures refined by Master Qi Yan are becoming more and more expensive.”
Upon finishing, the red-haired Cultivator sighed,
“Ah…”
“Such a pity…”
The red-haired Cultivator nodded and said,
“Truly a pity…”
Lin Jing read the description of this shield, which indeed was refined by the Energy Refinement Master, Master Qi Yan.
Lin Jing didn’t pay much attention to Artifact Refiners and naturally didn’t know of Master Qi Yan.
It seemed that Master Qi Yan must have indeed possessed formidable prowess in artifact refining.
Otherwise, those two wouldn’t have shown such admiration for him.
Despite that, the price of this treasure was truly exorbitant.
Just then, the Yellow Pine Cultivator spoke again:
“The Shen Family Shop’s trade fair seems to be starting tonight. Why don’t we go take a look?”
“We might encounter some good things at the trade fair.”
Another red-haired cultivator nodded and said:
“That would be nice…”
“I heard that last time, someone brought a Nirvana Flower seed, hoping to trade it, but he actually wanted to exchange it for a Nirvana Elixir, which is ridiculous.”
The Yellow Pine Cultivator said:
“Indeed, he was really daydreaming. I heard that the same person is here again this time…”
“I would like to see if there really will be someone willing to trade with him.”
The red-haired cultivator immediately followed up with:
“Brother Li, stop joking…”
“What he wants is a Nirvana Elixir, that’s a Nirvana Elixir we’re talking about…”
“How could he possibly exchange it for that Nirvana Flower seed in his hands?”
“Moreover, there seems to be some problem with that seed; it’s questionable whether it can be grown at all.”
“By doing this, does he really think we are fools?”
The Yellow Pine Cultivator nodded and replied:
“Exactly…”
“If anyone really trades with him, they would indeed be a fool.”
Having said that, the Yellow Pine Cultivator changed the subject and spoke again:
“However, he seems to have a quite impressive Defensive Magical Treasure in his hands, not much inferior to those made by Qi Yan, the True Master…”
As soon as the Yellow Pine Cultivator finished speaking, the red-haired cultivator immediately said:
“He, well…”
“Don’t even think about that Defensive Magical Treasure in his hands. Many people have approached him and he has refused to trade…”
“He insists on exchanging for a Nirvana Elixir.”
After finishing, the red-haired cultivator shook his head and said:
“Alright…”
“There’s nothing interesting to see here anymore, let’s go…”
With that, the two prepared to leave.
Just at this moment, Lin Jing suddenly stepped in front of the two.
He then cupped his fists and said to them:
“Fellow cultivators, excuse my interruption…”
The Yellow Pine Cultivator looked Lin Jing over and then asked:
“May I ask why you have stopped us, fellow cultivator?”
Lin Jing then spoke:
“I overheard you mentioning the Shen Family Shop’s trade fair just now…”
“I am quite interested in this trade fair and would like to attend as well. Is that possible?”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, the two cultivators suddenly understood.
Then, the Yellow Pine Cultivator said to Lin Jing:
“I see…”
“The Shen Family Shop’s trade fair is actually organized by the Shen Family Shop specifically for us Golden Core Cultivators as a trading event.”
“At the trade fair, all transactions are free, and if you see something you like, you simply discuss it directly with the owner.”
Afterward.
The red-haired cultivator also chimed in, saying:
“You don’t need anything special to go to the trade fair. You just need to go to the Shen Family Shop at the very end of Bihai City’s Fang Market before Zi Time tonight and state your intention.”
“Thank you, fellow cultivators,” Lin Jing then said, bowing with his hands clasped.
“You’re welcome,”
they replied in unison, returning the gesture with a bow.
Afterward, the two said their goodbyes to Lin Jing and left the Seven Seas Hall.
After the two had left, Lin Jing wandered around the third floor a bit more.
Just when he decided to leave, he noticed a counter selling Flying Boats.
So, Lin Jing stopped to take a look.
Flying Boats, being one of the most important and convenient modes of transportation on the Demonic Monster Sea, are indeed not cheap.
The Flying Boats for sale in the Seven Seas Hall start at a minimum of one million Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
Even then,
this one million Medium Grade Spirit Stone Flying Boat is just the most basic kind.
This type of Flying Boat, whether in terms of speed or defensive capabilities, is much inferior to other Flying Boats.
And those slightly better ones start at a minimum of two million Medium Grade Spirit Stones…
This isn’t even considering the more expensive ones…
Lin Jing even saw one large Flying Boat that was valued at five million Medium Grade Spirit Stones…
No wonder there aren’t many people in the Demonic Monster Sea who own Flying Boats.
Such expensive Flying Boats are not something many forces can afford.
……
After looking at the Flying Boats, Lin Jing left the Seven Seas Hall directly.
Afterward.
He headed straight for Bihai City’s Fang Market.
Lin Jing had been to Bihai City’s Fang Market once before and was quite familiar with the way.
Upon arriving inside the market, it was as lively as the last time he had been there.
Lin Jing then headed straight inside.
The two cultivators at the Seven Seas Hall had mentioned that the Shen Family Shop was located at the very end of the Fang Market.
Lin Jing was now coming over to confirm the location in advance.
So, following the streets of the Fang Market, Lin Jing made his way inside.
The further he walked, the quieter the streets became.
Finally, upon reaching the very end, where there was no one else around, Lin Jing finally saw the Shen Family Shop.
From the outside, the Shen Family Shop didn’t look very big, and there was a wooden signboard hanging above the doorway.
The signboard bore the words ‘Shen Family Shop’ in large characters.
This conspicuous signboard was relatively prominent at the very end of the Fang Market.
However, the doors of the Shen Family Shop were firmly closed, not yet open.
Presumably,
they would only open when the trade fair began in the evening…

chapters.title: Chapter 396: 96 Lin Jue is Missing
chapters.content:
Chapter 396: Chapter 96 Lin Jue is Missing
The time was still early, the Shen Family Shop wasn’t open yet, and naturally it wasn’t convenient for Lin Jing to just wait around here…
Therefore.
After confirming the location of the Shen Family Shop, Lin Jing turned around and left the place.
After leaving the Shen Family Shop, Lin Jing walked the streets of Fang Market and thought of Lin Jue.
So much time had passed, he had no idea how he was doing now.
Following that, Lin Jing casually strolled through the Fang Market while looking for traces of Lin Jue.
He had combed through the entire Fang Market without finding any sign of Lin Jue.
Even that dark-skinned boy, Lin Jing did not see him this time either.
Fortunately, Lin Jing still remembered the location of Lin Jue’s house.
Thus, Lin Jing headed towards Lin Jue’s house according to his previous memory.
The ‘slum’ of Bihai City was just the same as the last time Lin Jing came, without any change.
Perhaps having grown accustomed to it, the cultivators living here didn’t find their situation unusual at all.
Some even took pride in being able to live in Bihai City.
Lin Jue’s house was in the very depths of this ‘slum’ and was among the more dilapidated ones.
When Lin Jing arrived at Lin Jue’s house, he saw a layer of dust on the doorknob and knew that Lin Jue must have been away for some time.
Lin Jing immediately activated his Divine Sense and probed into Lin Jue’s house.
The inside of Lin Jue’s house was as tidy as ever, just as he had left it.
But Lin Jue was not at home.
Moreover, a thin layer of dust had settled in the courtyard of Lin Jue’s house.
Looking at it, he must have been away for some time.
“If he hasn’t returned home, where could he have gone?”
Lin Jing then furrowed his brows in contemplation…
“Lin Jue has lived in this Fang Market for so long, he’s quite shrewd, he shouldn’t have provoked anyone without cause.”
“Moreover, he still has the Spirit Stones I had previously given him for support.”
“In terms of living expenses, he shouldn’t be struggling, and there wouldn’t be a lack of Spirit Stones forcing him to do anything unwillingly.”
“The decorations in his room also prove that he must have been living here until not long ago.”
“It doesn’t look like he moved out.”
“If he hasn’t moved, why hasn’t he returned for so long?”
“And…”
“Judging from the dust accumulated in the courtyard, Lin Jue has been away for at least half a month.”
After pondering for a while, Lin Jing had not a single clue.
Afterward, he gave up on contemplating.
As a member of the Lin Family, Lin Jing naturally could not ignore Lin Jue’s disappearance.
It seems.
After attending the trade meeting, Lin Jing would need to stay in here a few more days to search thoroughly.
The inexplicable disappearance of Lin Jue always gave Lin Jing an ominous premonition…
He only hoped that nothing unfortunate had happened to him…
……
It wasn’t yet Zi Time in the evening when Lin Jing, dressed up again in disguise as a burly, stout man, came to the Fang Market of Bihai City once more.
The Fang Market at late-night, the vendors had all packed up and left, and there wasn’t a single person in the entire market, making it eerily quiet.
Even the shops on both sides of the Fang Market had closed their doors.
Lin Jing then directly headed towards the Shen Family Shop within the Fang Market.
He went to the very back of the Fang Market.
When Lin Jing looked at the Shen Family Shop again, the shop’s doors were wide open this time.
There were also two big red lanterns hanging at the entrance.
Subsequently, Lin Jing walked inside the shop.
The shop was small; upon entering, Lin Jing immediately saw a middle-aged cultivator behind the counter,
who appeared to be the shopkeeper of the Shen Family Shop.
This shopkeeper was also a Golden Core Cultivator.
Furthermore, he was at the Golden Core Late Stage.
Seeing Lin Jing arrive, the shopkeeper smiled and said directly,
“Welcome, fellow Daoist, to our humble shop. May I inquire, what are you looking for?”
Lin Jing then replied with a cupped-fist salute,
“Fellow Daoist…”
“I’ve heard that the Shen Family Shop is hosting a trade event, and I’ve come today specifically to attend this trading session.”
After hearing this, the shopkeeper sized up Lin Jing up and down, and then replied with a smile,
“Ah, so you’re here for the trade meeting, my apologies for the oversight.”
Without further ado, the shopkeeper called over a servant and told the servant,
“This Daoist friend is here to attend the trade meeting, take him to the backyard.”
“Yes!” The servant nodded to the shopkeeper.
“Senior, this way please…”
Saying thus, the servant then led Lin Jing towards the backyard.
Soon.
With the servant’s guidance, Lin Jing came to the entrance of the backyard.
Inside the backyard, right past the entrance, there was a fairly large house.
At that time.
The servant stood at the entrance and pointed towards the house inside to Lin Jing, saying,
“Senior, the fellow Daoists attending the trade meeting are all inside. It’s not appropriate for me to enter, so I can only escort you to here.”
After speaking, the servant bade farewell to Lin Jing and left.
Then Lin Jing, upon the servant’s departure, walked towards the house inside the backyard.
Upon opening the door, several people turned to look over.
These individuals, after glancing at Lin Jing and finding him unfamiliar, returned to their own meditations, no longer paying him any attention.
Lin Jing then.
Found a corner to sit down.
After sitting down, he began to take in the entire room.
This room was unlike ordinary rooms.
Below, numerous tables and chairs were neatly arranged, and in the center of the room was a high platform.
The layout of the entire room resembled that of a venue specially designed for trading events.
At this moment, scattered throughout the venue were about a dozen cultivators.
When those people had been paying attention to Lin Jing just now, Lin Jing had likewise glanced over them.
The cultivation levels of these people varied, and there were even Demon Cultivators and Demon Cultivators among them.
There were even some whose cultivation Lin Jing could not discern, which suggested they must have concealed their abilities.
Afterward, Lin Jing waited for some more time.
Subsequently, several more people arrived one after another.
Until finally, there were about twenty cultivators present in the room.
Lin Jing even spotted the two cultivators he had encountered earlier that day.
These two were now greeting another cultivator, which suggested that the three of them were probably acquainted with each other.
Once everyone had arrived, the time also reached Zi Time.
Just then, the shopkeeper who had been outside in the store earlier came in.
As soon as he arrived, several people stood up to greet the shopkeeper.
It seemed that these people were not first-timers here and were familiar with the shopkeeper.
The shopkeeper smiled and responded to each of them in turn.
Following that,
The shopkeeper walked straight to the high platform in the center of the room.
He then opened his mouth, addressing everyone:
“Welcome, fellow Daoists, to the small trading event hosted by our shop.”
“This trading event has many familiar faces, of course, and also a few newcomers attending for the first time.”
Having said that, the shopkeeper turned his head to look at Lin Jing and a few other cultivators.
He then nodded to them.
Lin Jing and the others also nodded slightly in response.
Following this, the shopkeeper continued:
“The purpose of our shop’s trading event is to promote exchange between fellow Daoists and, of course, to trade what we each need the most.”
After finishing, the shopkeeper looked toward Lin Jing and a few others, then added:
“Some Daoists are here for the first time and might not be familiar with everything. Let me give you a brief introduction to our trading event.”
“Our trading event is simply to provide a convenient place for you all and does not charge any fees—you can rest assured, fellow Daoists.”
“This rule is well known to the old friends who often come to participate in the trading event…”
As the shopkeeper said this, many cultivators below nodded in agreement.
The shopkeeper then continued:
“Shortly, if anyone has treasures they wish to trade, they can come up on stage to display them, stating what they want in exchange. As long as both parties are satisfied, the trade can be completed.”
“All right…”
“That’s enough talk; you may begin.”
Having said that, the shopkeeper stepped down from the platform.
After the shopkeeper descended, an old man with a stooped back and a walking cane went up on the platform.
Although the old man seemed frail and elderly, there was a faint hint of Demonic Qi emanating from his body.
Clearly, this elder was a Demon Cultivator who practiced the Demonic Path Technique.
However, by his appearance, he did not seem like one of those extremely bloodthirsty types.
This was actually not unusual.
Not all Demon Cultivators were bloodthirsty and cruel by nature.
Some Demonic Path Techniques were more moderate.
Those who practiced such techniques might have Demonic Qi, but were much like ordinary cultivators.
Another type of Demonic Path Technique was more aggressive.
These practitioners’ Demonic Techniques were often harmful to the heavens, and they might even consume cultivators to bolster their own Cultivation.
These individuals were typically the cruel and bloodthirsty kind.
The elder on stage was obviously of the former type.
After stepping onto the stage, he chuckled and then spoke:
“Hehe…”
“Fellow Daoists, without further ado…”
“I wish to use this object in my hand in exchange for a Divine Sense Technique.”
As he spoke, he lifted the object in his hand for all to see clearly.
Immediately, someone exclaimed:
“It’s actually a Fourth Rank Spirit Plant, Jade Heart Vine…”
Another person, upon seeing it clearly, also added in a low voice:
“Mm, this Jade Heart Vine looks like it was harvested not long ago and is still quite intact.”
“But to exchange it for a Divine Sense Technique, I doubt that will be easy…”
The elder on the platform paid no attention to the various discussions below, simply maintaining a smile while looking at the crowd.
After a moment, a middle-aged cultivator stood up and addressed the elder on stage:
“I have a Divine Sense Technique, though it is somewhat incomplete, only cultivable up to the Golden Core stage.”
“If fellow Daoist agrees to the exchange, we can trade right away.”
After hearing this, the elder shook his head…
Clearly, he was not very satisfied with the incomplete Divine Sense Technique.
Then, another voice rang out, and a young cultivator stood up:
“I have a Superior Defensive Magical Treasure that I’d like to exchange for your Jade Heart Vine, I wonder if fellow Daoist would be willing.”
However, the elder shook his head, saying:
“I only want a Divine Sense Technique, I will not exchange for anything else.”
Upon hearing this, the young cultivator said no more and simply sat back down.
Then, after a while, there was no second offer.
Clearly.
The trade was about to fall through.

chapters.title: Chapter 397: 97: Shadow Escape Flying Boat
chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 97: Shadow Escape Flying Boat
The elder sighed helplessly at the sight.
“My fellow daoists, if anyone has a Divine Sense Technique, please don’t hide it. If you think this Jade Heart Creeper is not enough, I can add some Spirit Stones or other treasures.”
After the elder’s words fell, there was another round of murmuring below, but still, no one stood up.
Clearly.
This Divine Sense Technique was not so easy to obtain.
It seemed that none of these people had it on them.
Or perhaps, they simply did not want to take it out.
And Lin Jing was among them.
Lin Jing obtained the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique on Immortal Crossing Island before, which was a Divine Sense Technique.
But the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, just like the Overlord Divine Physique, was one of the top Cultivation Techniques in the Cultivation World.
Naturally, Lin Jing could not possibly take it out for an exchange.
After a while, when no one else stood up,
the Shopkeeper by the side asked:
“Does this daoist have any other items he wishes to exchange?”
The elder shook his head and said:
“No…”
The Shopkeeper continued:
“In that case…”
“It seems that none of our friends present today have a Divine Sense Technique, so please wait for the next opportunity…”
The elder nodded, then stepped down from the stage and returned to his seat to sit down.
After the elder stepped down, another Cultivator went up to the stage.
This Cultivator went straight to the point after getting on stage and directly took out a Magical Treasure, Flying Sword, and then said to the others:
“I will exchange this Flying Sword in my hand for a Formation to guard a dwelling.”
Having said that, he began to introduce the Flying Sword in his hand:
“This Flying Sword, called ‘Night Wasteland’, is a superior Magical Treasure made from…”
The Cultivator gave a detailed introduction…
A moment later, after the Cultivator finished presenting,
a woman Cultivator wearing a black veil immediately stood up.
She then said, “I do have a Formation here that is quite suitable for defending a dwelling.”
Having said this.
She also took out a few Formation flags and began introducing them…
In the end, both parties were very satisfied.
And successfully completed the transaction.
After the two completed their transaction, the Cultivator stepped down from the stage, and another Cultivator went up.
…
…
In this manner, each person who went up on the stage would present precious Magical Treasures, materials, Elixir Medicines, and the like for display.
The people below would then trade with those on stage based on their own needs.
And Lin Jing sat quietly in the corner, watching.
He never made a move.
Although some of the items displayed on stage did pique Lin Jing’s interest, they were not essential to him.
So, Lin Jing never made a move.
Soon.
Several Cultivators had displayed their treasures they wished to exchange.
On stage was the red-haired Cultivator Lin Jing had encountered before at the Seven Seas Hall. He had just come down from the stage.
He too had gotten what he wished, exchanging a Cultivation Technique for a Defensive Magical Treasure he needed.
After the red-haired Cultivator stepped down, another person went up.
This person was dressed in black and had a cold expression, exuding an extremely cool demeanor. Moreover, his Cultivation was not low, actually at the Golden Core Peak.
After getting on stage, he did not engage in any other conversation.
He directly took out a miniature silver-white Flying Boat, a seed, and a Defensive Magical Treasure.
Lin Jing’s gaze was immediately attracted to that seed.
Because it was a seed of the Nirvana Flower.
However, this Nirvana Flower seed was not whole, lacking a small part.
Then, the person directly said:
“No need to talk much…”
“This Flying Boat, named Shadow Escape…”
“And this Nirvana Flower seed, plus this Thunder Shock Shield in my hand…”
“I will exchange these three items for a Nirvana Elixir of at least medium grade quality.”
When this Cultivator took the stage, the audience began murmuring to each other.
Lin Jing perked up his ears, listening to their conversations.
From their talks, Lin Jing learned…
That this person was the one the red-haired Cultivator had mentioned before, the one who wanted to acquire the Nirvana Elixir.
When he presented these items, the Cultivators below immediately erupted into excitement.
Suddenly, someone exclaimed:
“Wow…”
“The Shadow Escape Flying Boat…”
“I remember that’s a flying Magical Treasure of an extremely mysterious Nascent Soul True Monarch. How did it end up in his hands?”
…
“Exactly…”
“The Shadow Escape Flying Boat is very famous; it’s said that in terms of speed, it ranks within the top ten that are known in the southern outer seas.”
“Moreover, the Shadow Escape Flying Boat also has a decent defensive capability, and that unique stealth function.”
“If we really talk about practicality, even if it doesn’t compare to the Nirvana Elixir, it’s not far off.”
…
Someone similarly agreed:
“Indeed, the value of this Shadow Escape Flying Boat is indeed considerable.”
“If it were auctioned, it might even be more expensive than the Nirvana Elixir.”
After the Cultivator’s words fell, someone immediately expressed a different opinion:
“Though the Shadow Escape Flying Boat is excellent, that Nirvana Elixir is not so easy to obtain.”
“It’s unusual to see one in tens of years, and even if it does appear, it’s targeted by the major powers, leaving none for us.”
“For us Loose Cultivators, who knows how many years of effort it would take to collect the ingredients for a batch to refine the Nirvana Elixir.”
“And even so, success in refining it is not guaranteed.”
“If someone has a Nirvana Elixir, who wouldn’t keep it for themselves to consume? How could they possibly trade it away?”
“No matter how powerful a Magical Treasure is, can it compare to the importance of one’s own strength increasing?”
……
At this point, he suddenly changed his tone and continued to speak:
“Unless…”
“Someone has more than one Nirvana Elixir.”
“Only in that case, would they take out a Medium Grade Nirvana Elixir to trade for this Shadow Escape Flying Boat.”
…
Then, another person similarly agreed and said:
“That’s also true…”
“Who would exchange a chance to break through to the Nascent Soul stage for a flying Magical Treasure?”
“Unless…”
“They already have Nascent Soul Cultivation and have no need for a Nirvana Elixir.”
“Or they have more than one Nirvana Elixir…”
……
While everyone was discussing fervently, another young Cultivator attending this trading assembly for the first time, asked the person beside him:
“But what kind of Magical Treasure is that Thunder Shock Shield? He didn’t give an introduction, did he?”
The Cultivator beside him then explained:
“He already introduced it once during the last trading assembly, you weren’t here last time, so naturally, you don’t know.”
“That Thunder Shock Shield, is also a decent Medium Grade Magical Treasure, and moreover, the shield is made of Thunder Wood, providing protection against the force of thunder, making it quite suitable for helping juniors to overcome their Tribulation.”
Upon hearing this, the young Cultivator who was new, instantly understood and said:
“I see…”
“However, the combined value of these three items is not low, trading them for a Nirvana Elixir shouldn’t be a problem, right?”
The person beside him disdained and said:
“Forget it…”
“Apart from that Shadow Escape Flying Boat, the others aren’t much to look at.”
“That Nirvana Flower seed seems precious, but a big piece is missing. Someone checked it last time; the inside of the seed has decayed, it can’t grow.”
“Furthermore, that Thunder Shock Shield is just a Medium Grade Magical Treasure, only useful for withstanding the Golden Core Tribulation, similarly not very valuable.”
“You could say, aside from the Shadow Escape Flying Boat, the other two items are just additions and can be completely disregarded.”
“So that’s how it is. Thank you, fellow Daoist, for clearing up my confusion…” the young man responded with a hand salute.
“It’s nothing…”
The Cultivator beside him waved his hand in dismissal.
……
At this moment, the black-clothed Cultivator above surveyed the crowd below.
Yet not a single person stood up.
Initially, Lin Jing had planned to use the Medium Grade Nirvana Elixir he had on hand to make the exchange.
If it were the Flying Boat or the Nirvana Flower seed, they would both be incredibly useful to him, not to mention the Magical Treasure Thunder Shock Shield.
But after listening to the conversation of those people just now, Lin Jing dismissed the idea.
Because doing so would draw too much attention to himself.
As a Golden Core early stage Cultivator, taking out a Nirvana Elixir to exchange for the Shadow Escape Flying Boat would undoubtedly raise suspicions.
After a moment of contemplation, Lin Jing decided to wait and not approach him for a trade just yet.
Instead, he planned to find him for a private exchange after the man had left.
Time passed, and still, no one made a move.
The black-clothed Cultivator also coldly packed up all his belongings.
To the outcome, neither the black-clothed Cultivator nor the crowd below found it surprising.
After all, it was a Nirvana Elixir.
And all those participating in the trading assembly were Golden Core Cultivators, who typically wouldn’t trade their Nirvana Elixirs if they had them.
One Cultivator left the platform, and several others went up in succession.
Even the young Cultivator who was new took the stage.
Once on stage, he directly took out an unremarkable Flying Sword and a broken Spirit Plant root.
“I wish to use this Superior Grade Flying Sword and the rootstock of the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf to exchange for two Pure Essence Enriching Elixirs.”
After speaking, he picked up the Flying Sword to show everyone:
“This Superior Grade Flying Sword, known as the Soaring Ancient Sword, was crafted by the Energy Refinement Master Lin Yue…”
…
…
Shortly after, he finished introducing the Soaring Ancient Sword, and then picked up the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf rootstock to introduce it.
“This rootstock of the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf, I wrested at the risk of my life from the maw of a Nascent Soul Demonic Beast… ”
“As everyone can see, the rootstock is incomplete, having been nibbled on by that Demonic Beast, and most of its medicinal efficacy has been lost.”
“Thus, I consider this rootstock of the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf as an extra, paired with the Soaring Ancient Sword, to exchange for two Pure Essence Enriching Elixirs.”
No sooner had the young Cultivator finished speaking than people below immediately began to discuss it.
They were all talking about the Soaring Ancient Sword, but no one seemed interested in the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf rootstock.
Time passed, and not a soul took the initiative to speak up.
Just when the young Cultivator thought no one would speak up and was preparing to step down,
Lin Jing, sitting in the very back corner, finally spoke up at this moment.
“That Soaring Ancient Sword, along with the remnant root of the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf, I’ll take them…”
His words made all the Cultivators in the room turn their heads to look at him.
At hearing this, the young Cultivator on stage was overjoyed.
To confirm, he even asked specifically once more:
“Fellow Daoist, are you planning to use two Pure Essence Enriching Elixirs to exchange for my Soaring Ancient Sword and this remnant root of the Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf?”
Lin Jing then nodded and said:
“Yes…”

chapters.title: Chapter 398: 98 Shopkeeper Shen's 'Good Deed
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 98 Shopkeeper Shen’s ‘Good Deed
“`
Having said that, Lin Jing didn’t waste any time and directly took out two Pure Jade Boxes from his Storage Bag.
Inside the Pure Jade Boxes, two Pure Elixirs shone with a captivating light.
Even before they were opened, everyone could already see that these were indeed Pure Primordial Growth Elixirs.
……
Upon seeing the Pure Primordial Growth Elixirs, there were immediately those who expressed their regret:
“Pure Primordial Growth Elixirs, they’d be so good for enhancing one’s own strength…”
However, someone immediately voiced their opinion:
“I think trading the Primordial Growth Elixirs for the Soaring Ancient Sword would be more worthwhile…”
“After all, having a good Magical Treasure can also significantly increase one’s combat power.”
Moreover, there were others who spoke up:
“The Soaring Ancient Sword is indeed not bad, exchanging it for two Pure Primordial Growth Elixirs is appropriate, it’s just a matter of different needs…”
…
…
The crowd below was buzzing with discussion, but not a single person mentioned the Thousand Spirit Divine Leaf Remnant Root.
Although the Thousand Spirit Divine Leaf is a Fourth Rank Spirit Plant, the one at hand was only its rhizome, and what’s more, it was an incomplete remnant root.
Even if one had a high-level Spirit Field, it wouldn’t be possible to cultivate.
In the eyes of others, this remnant root wasn’t of much value; it was almost fitting to give it away as an extra…
However.
In Lin Jing’s eyes, that Thousand Spirit Divine Leaf Remnant Root was much more precious than the Soaring Ancient Sword.
Even though it was a remnant root, in Lin Jing’s eyes, its value was not much different from a complete rhizome.
After all, his System Space had a Spiritual Plant Restoration Function; with just the expenditure of some Harvest Points, he could completely repair the rhizome.
In time, he could plant this Spirit Plant himself, and then he would own a complete Thousand Spirit Divine Leaf.
……
Next.
The young Cultivator descended from the stage and came in front of Lin Jing.
Subsequently, both parties examined the items they were about to trade in detail, and once both had finished their inspections and confirmed everything was correct,
they exchanged their items, completing the deal.
After the two had completed their deal, another two individuals went up; the two Cultivators showcased their treasures for trade.
Both of these individuals were lucky and completed their deals, acquiring the things they desired.
Once their transactions were done, only Lin Jing was left who hadn’t gone up.
When the crowd looked towards Lin Jing, he declined to go on stage using the fact that he had already completed his trade as a reason.
The crowd didn’t say anything more.
……
Soon after.
The shopkeeper took to the stage and announced the successful conclusion of the trade meet.
As the trade meeting came to an end and the crowd began to stir, preparing to leave,
the shopkeeper called out to them at that moment.
“Everyone, do not be hasty, please wait for a moment…”
The crowd looked up, all eyeing the shopkeeper with curiosity.
At this time, some Cultivators who were familiar with the shopkeeper asked:
“Shopkeeper Shen, is there something else?”
The shopkeeper then spoke:
“Indeed, there is one more matter I would like to discuss with all the fellow cultivators.”
“You can rest assured, fellow cultivators, it is a good thing…”
Upon hearing it was a good thing, some Cultivators immediately became interested.
The shopkeeper then directly said:
“Fellow cultivators, do not rush to leave; please hear what Shen has to say. If Shen’s good news interests you, then let us remain here to discuss it together.”
“If you genuinely have no interest, then you may leave at that time…”
After the shopkeeper finished speaking, even those who were not very interested halted their departure and sat back down, waiting quietly for the shopkeeper to continue.
By this time, a number of Cultivators familiar with the shopkeeper also spoke up:
“Shopkeeper Shen, you’re the one who said this…”
“Shopkeeper Shen, with you mentioning it like that, now I’m interested and want to see what this good thing really is.”
“Shopkeeper Shen, don’t keep us in suspense, just say it directly…”
…
…
And the shopkeeper responded to several people with a smile.
Seeing this situation, Lin Jing turned his head to look at the black-robed Cultivator; he also did not appear to have any intention of leaving.
Thus, Lin Jing too settled back into his seat, no longer in a hurry to depart.
Once everyone had taken their seats again, the shopkeeper spoke:
“Everyone…”
“I wonder, have any of you heard of Li Mingwu?”
Upon hearing the shopkeeper’s words, a shiver went through Lin Jing’s heart.
He immediately thought:
“Could it be that the shopkeeper’s news has something to do with Li Mingwu?”
“But wasn’t Li Mingwu said to have died hundreds of years ago?”
On the surface, however, Lin Jing showed no reaction.
At that moment, a Cultivator raised a question:
“Li Mingwu?”
“Is it Li Mingwu, the previous Island Master of Yue Tian Island?”
“But wasn’t he said to have died centuries ago?”
“Could it be that he is not dead and is still alive?”
Lin Jing had the same doubts.
And it wasn’t just Lin Jing alone.
Being seated at the back corner made it easy for Lin Jing to observe the actions of the Cultivators in front.
As soon as that Cultivator suggested that Li Mingwu might still be alive…
many people in the audience straightened up unconsciously, all turning their attention to the shopkeeper on the stage.
Clearly, they, too, were quite concerned about the life and death of Li Mingwu.
“`
Shopkeeper Shen then waved his hand and said with a smile:
“Fellow Daoist is joking…”
“It’s true that Li Mingwu was extraordinary, but he did not break through to a realm above Divinity Transformation. He perished long ago, several hundred years past, and it is impossible for him to be alive.”
“What I’m about to discuss has some connection to him, which is why I asked.”
“No wonder…” Having heard Shopkeeper Shen’s words, many relaxed slightly.
At that moment, someone else raised a question:
“Shopkeeper Shen mentioned Li Mingwu specifically, may I ask what matter is related to him?”
Shopkeeper Shen then continued:
“This matter is actually a secret…”
“Recently, I’ve come across some clues, and through these clues, I’ve learned about one thing…”
“While Li Mingwu was alive, he once strayed into an ancient relic and, in that place, he encountered some fortuitous adventures. Because of this, his cultivation later soared rapidly, allowing him to become the Island Master of Yue Tian Island.”
As soon as Shopkeeper Shen finished speaking, someone immediately raised an objection:
“That’s impossible…”
“Legend has it that Li Mingwu had excellent aptitude, and thus, he was able to break through smoothly and advance to the Divinity Transformation Stage.”
“Yes, I’ve heard about that too…”
Another person chimed in agreement.
While the rest did not voice their opinions explicitly, they nodded slightly when doubts were raised, showing agreement.
The reason was that Li Mingwu was too famous.
And he had disappeared for only a few hundred years.
Therefore.
The details of Li Mingwu’s life were easy to investigate.
Many among those who were participating in the trade meeting were likely well-versed in Li Mingwu’s history.
Thus.
All eyes turned to Shopkeeper Shen, awaiting his explanation.
Facing the doubts raised by others, Shopkeeper Shen did not argue but instead started speaking with a smile:
“Of course…”
“You must also know, Li Mingwu indeed had excellent aptitude, and you couldn’t believe he attained the Divinity Transformation Stage solely through some fortuitous adventure.”
Following that, Shopkeeper Shen scanned the crowd before saying:
“But what I’m going to tell you is that he indeed advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage because of a fortuitous adventure.”
At this point, before anyone could interject with doubts, Shopkeeper Shen continued:
“The reason I say this is because the chance encounter he had was with a ‘Mysterious Fruit.'”
As the words ‘Mysterious Fruit’ were spoken, the crowd collectively gasped in astonishment.
“Hiss~”
“Mysterious Fruit…”
“Shopkeeper Shen, the Mysterious Fruit is no trivial matter; are you certain about this?”
Straight away, a cultivator questioned Shopkeeper Shen.
The others, just as earnestly, listened in.
After all, the Mysterious Fruit was something of legends.
It was said that the Mysterious Fruit could defy the heavens and alter fate, forcibly elevating one’s Spiritual Root aptitude.
It was an extremely rare heavenly Spirit Fruit.
Within the Demonic Monster Sea, many top-tier forces sought it desperately but in vain.
Even in the Bounty Hall, the offers to purchase a Mysterious Fruit have reached the astonishing price of ten million Superior Grade Spirit Stones.
Yet, even with such offers, not a single Mysterious Fruit could be procured.
This demonstrated just how rare the Mysterious Fruit truly was.
If Li Mingwu’s fortuitous encounter was indeed with a Mysterious Fruit, then everything could be explained.
Because…
According to the records, Li Mingwu’s Spiritual Root aptitude was of the kind that defied the heavens, allowing his cultivation to soar at breakneck speed, straight into the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Shopkeeper Shen nodded and stated:
“Of course…”
“Have you heard of Ling Yin the True Lord?”
A few cultivators immediately nodded in agreement.
Shopkeeper Shen then proceeded to say:
“It is said that Ling Yin the True Lord was silenced by Li Mingwu because he had uncovered this secret.”
“Unbelievable…”
“Ling Yin the True Lord should be a figure from two thousand years ago, right?”
“Moreover, Ling Yin the True Lord was already a Nascent Soul Cultivator two thousand years ago.”
“Even if Li Mingwu wanted to harm him, it wouldn’t be easy.”
Shopkeeper Shen then smiled coldly and replied:
“Of course it was easy…”
“Because at that time, Ling Yin the True Lord was extremely close to Li Mingwu, harboring no defenses against him at all.”
“Thus, Li Mingwu was able to use despicable means to secretly eliminate Ling Yin the True Lord.”
Lin Jing was shocked upon hearing this.
The message he gathered from Ling Yin the True Lord’s last words was similar to what the shopkeeper knew.
But how did Shopkeeper Shen come to know this information?
Soon after, someone raised a question:
“Shopkeeper Shen, you say Li Mingwu secretly eliminated Ling Yin the True Lord, but how do you know of such an ancient matter?”
“Yes, Shopkeeper Shen, how did you come to learn about such a secret piece of information?”
Shopkeeper Shen answered:
“Because, when Ling Yin the True Lord was eliminated, an ancestor of our Shen Family was involved…”
“However, following the incident, this ancestor of ours was dealt with and also met a tragic end at the hands of Li Mingwu.”
“Fortunately, he had foreseen his fate and realizing he could not escape, he had already made arrangements, secretly sending his offspring away.”
“Only recently, from an heirloom left by my ancestor, did I uncover this secret.”
“And furthermore…”
“Within my ancestor’s heirloom, I also found the location of that ancient relic.”
The statements by Shopkeeper Shen ignited excitement among most people in the room.
Of course, this group of excited individuals naturally did not include Lin Jing.

chapters.title: Chapter 399: 99: Coercion
chapters.content:
Chapter 399: Chapter 99: Coercion
Lin Jing learned from the testament of Ling Yin the True Sage that to enter the relic site, it was necessary to gather all five Five Elements Command Tokens.
And one of those tokens was now in Lin Jing’s possession.
Was this Shopkeeper Shen planning to reveal the location of that ancient relic?
Lin Jing couldn’t help but doubt what the real intentions of Shopkeeper Shen were.
Scanning the room, Lin Jing noticed that the cultivators had different reactions upon hearing about the relic; some were worried, while others were excited.
Even more, like Lin Jing, were skeptical.
Besides,
there was one person who seemed wholly uninterested in everything that was happening.
This disinterested individual was the same black-robed cultivator who had wanted to exchange for the Nirvana Elixir earlier.
At the moment, he was leaning in a corner opposite Lin Jing, silently observing the crowd, saying nothing.
Then, another cultivator familiar with Shopkeeper Shen eagerly asked:
“Shopkeeper Shen, by revealing all this, could it be that you intend to lead us to explore that relic site?”
Shopkeeper Shen nodded before replying:
“Yes…”
“I want to take you all to explore the relic site together.”
At this point, Shopkeeper Shen paused, then continued:
“I’m sure everyone is very curious, since I found out the location of this relic, why not go by myself instead of sharing this information with everyone?”
The crowd also looked up at Shopkeeper Shen.
They were just as curious, knowing that the fewer people aware of the relic, the better.
Yet Shopkeeper Shen did the opposite, telling everyone present about it directly.
They also wanted to hear Shopkeeper Shen’s explanation.
Scanning the crowd, Shopkeeper Shen said:
“Actually…”
“The reason I’m doing this is that the relic site cannot be opened through the efforts of one person alone. By myself, I simply can’t open it.”
“That’s why I’m inviting all fellow Daoists to go together.”
Upon hearing Shopkeeper Shen’s explanation, everyone suddenly came to a realization.
No wonder…
That explained it.
Then, Shopkeeper Shen continued:
“Moreover, the relic is extremely dangerous, but if we really manage to open and enter it, I’m sure the rewards will be substantial…”
“The reason I asked you all to stay is to invite you to open the relic with me and equally share the treasures inside.”
“I wonder if all of you are willing…”
Having finished speaking, Shopkeeper Shen surveyed everyone present.
Immediately, some people couldn’t hold back and said:
“With a relic emerging, of course, we are willing to take the challenge…”
However, there were also those who thought more deeply.
“Shopkeeper Shen, are you sure that there are a great number of heavenly materials and earthly treasures inside the relic?”
“And is it really as dangerous as you say it is inside the relic?”
“Additionally…”
“The most crucial point is, can we really open the relic?”
After listening, Shopkeeper Shen responded:
“According to my ancestors’ records, Li Mingwu didn’t stay long after entering the relic and soon came out.”
“Therefore, there must still be many areas inside the relic that have not been explored…”
“The treasures within the relic need no further elaboration.”
Pausing for a moment, Shopkeeper Shen then continued:
“Another point…”
“Being a relic, it will certainly involve risks; I will explain this beforehand.”
“As to whether we can open the relic, I have no absolute certainty. I can only say the more people we have, the better…”
“Based on the clues provided by my ancestors, to open the entrance to the relic, we need a large amount of spiritual power. If that’s not enough, we have to find others to invite them to explore the relic with us.”
Upon hearing this, some people were immediately opposed:
“I think just us here are enough; there’s no need to find others.”
“Yes…”
“I think so too.”
At this point, Shopkeeper Shen spoke up again, addressing everyone:
“Ladies and gentlemen, you all must know…”
“Exploring a relic is likely to result in casualties. If anyone is unwilling to go, we will not force you; you may leave directly.”
No sooner had Shopkeeper Shen’s words fallen than someone spoke up:
“Where does Shopkeeper Shen get this idea? Exploring a relic naturally involves dangers.”
“From the moment we embarked on the path of cultivation, our fate was no longer our own. How can we get heavenly materials and earthly treasures without taking some risks?”
“If I should perish for it, there’s no one to blame.”
“Indeed…”
“To seek fortune, one naturally has to take risks.”
“Shopkeeper Shen, where exactly is the relic located?”
Raising his hand to stop everyone’s words, Shopkeeper Shen then said to the person:
“To prevent anyone from leaking information, I will not disclose the relic’s location for now. Once everyone agrees, I will share the location…”
After finishing, Shopkeeper Shen gave the crowd another look and said:
“Everyone, are you all willing to accompany Shopkeeper Shen to explore that relic?”
Many in the crowd began to shout:
“Of course…”
“Naturally, we all are willing.”
“I’m willing too…”
…
…
For a moment, the crowd was filled with voices of agreement.
Next, Shopkeeper Shen looked down at the audience and said:
“Ladies and gentlemen, this trip to the relic is completely voluntary. If anyone is unwilling to go, you may say so openly…”
Lin Jing’s brows immediately furrowed; he had the illusion of being coerced by the situation…
He glanced at the people in front, realizing that apart from those who were excited, there were also several cultivators with furrowed brows who seemed to have reservations.
Just then, an untimely voice came from a corner.
“I’m not going…”
Though the voice wasn’t loud, it struck like thunder, quieting the previously noisy crowd.
The crowd turned back, looking in the direction the voice had come from.
Lin Jing did the same, turning his head toward the source of the voice…
In the corner, the man in black who wanted to purchase the Nirvana Elixir was staring coldly at Shopkeeper Shen on the platform.
Seeing him, the others immediately calmed down, because this person possessed Cultivation at the Golden Core Peak, which was higher than all of theirs, and they didn’t dare say anything rashly for the moment.
Just as everyone was hesitating, another voice came from a different corner.
“I’m not going either…”
This time, the one who shouted this was Lin Jing.
Seeing the man in black taking the lead, Lin Jing naturally took this opportunity to express his opinion.
However.
Just as Lin Jing’s words fell, another person spoke up, saying:
“Then, I won’t go either…”
The one who said this was the young Cultivator who had traded the Flying Sword with Lin Jing, and it was also his first time participating in the trade conference.
At this point, unrest began to spread among the crowd.
By now, discontent had also started to arise:
“We had already agreed, why aren’t they going…”
“Exactly…”
“That’s an ancient relic, there could be many precious treasures inside, and it’s not impossible for another Reversal Fruit to appear.”
“Do they really not feel tempted?”
As the discontented voices grew louder, the crowd began to ostracize the three of them…
“Gentlemen, quiet…”
It was at this moment that Shopkeeper Shen spoke up.
Hearing Shopkeeper Shen’s words, everyone fell silent.
Shopkeeper Shen then looked at Lin Jing and the other two:
“I wonder if the three of you have any concerns about not wanting to go to the relic?”
And the man in black directly spoke out:
“There’s nothing I need inside that relic, going in would just be a waste of time.”
The crowd immediately understood that this person must be close to advancing to Nascent Soul, lacking only the Nirvana Elixir, which was certainly not going to be found inside the relic.
That’s why the man in black said that going into the relic would only be a waste of time.
After hearing this, Shopkeeper Shen nodded his head.
Then, he turned to look at Lin Jing.
The crowd followed Shopkeeper Shen’s gaze, looking at Lin Jing, waiting for his explanation.
Lin Jing then spoke bluntly:
“I am an Alchemist, I don’t need to explore relics to obtain the Cultivation resources I want.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the crowd began to stir once again.
“Alchemists can’t just say they don’t lack Cultivation resources…”
Another person retorted:
“That’s not necessarily true, some Alchemists really don’t need to go out and find resources themselves, like those from the Longyun Elixir Pavilion…”
“If you mention Longyun Elixir Pavilion, I believe it…”
“But, can he compare to them?”
…
“You two stop arguing, at this level, anyone who dares to call themselves an Alchemist definitely has some extraordinary Alchemy Dao Cultivation, indicating he is at least a Third Rank Alchemist.”
“And Fourth Rank Alchemist is not out of the question…”
“Don’t forget, he just took out two Pure Essence Pills just now, the rewards they get from a single round of Alchemy are worth what we strive for a long time, you all don’t need to bother.”
“That makes sense…”
The other two nodded and then fell silent.
Next, Shopkeeper Shen spoke, smiling as he said to Lin Jing:
“Fellow Daoist, I had no idea you were an Alchemist…”
“That was rather disrespectful of me.”
“Since that’s the case, as an Alchemist, you indeed don’t need to risk your life going there.”
After finishing, everyone turned to the last person who refused, that is, the young Cultivator.
“Fellow Daoist, not sure why you want to give up such a good opportunity, could it be that you are also an Alchemist?”
Shopkeeper Shen asked the young Cultivator.
The young Cultivator shook his head and said:
“I just advanced to Golden Core not long ago, and I feel that my strength is insufficient. I will not be participating in this relic expedition.”
As soon as the young man’s words fell, the crowd immediately started to murmur again.
Right then, someone scornfully said:
“A Cultivator who is so afraid of death, how can they achieve anything great?”
“Really, I don’t know how he managed to cultivate to his current level…”
“So timid…”
“Back in the day, just for Cultivation resources, I don’t know how many times I’ve risked my life to achieve my current Cultivation.”
“I can only say, he is really lucky…”
The crowd was talking at once, full of mockery.
And the young man, probably having never encountered such things before, was blushing with ears red.
But he kept his head down, not retorting a word.
It was in this moment that Shopkeeper Shen stopped several people’s words, then looked at the young man and asked:
“Are you sure you want to give up entering the relic?”
The young Cultivator lifted his head, his eyes resolute, and said:
“I am sure.”
Seeing how firm he was, no one said anything further…
Afterwards, Shopkeeper Shen nodded, then said:
“If you do not wish to go to the relic, you are naturally free to leave.”
Yet at this moment, others started to show their dissatisfaction.
“They can’t be allowed to leave; what if they leak the news?”
“Exactly, they can’t be let go. If the information really gets out, we can’t afford that.”
“Actually…”
“Let them leave if they must, but let them swear an oath with their Soul Spirits, ensuring they won’t leak this news.”
“Indeed…”
Then someone began to shout:
“Shopkeeper Shen, make them swear an oath with their Soul Spirits, to keep the relic’s secrets, before letting them go.”
“Yes, yes…”
…
…
Afterward.
All the Cultivators agreed and began to pressure the three of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 400: 100: The Trade
chapters.content:
Chapter 400: Chapter 100: The Trade
However, just when these people were still causing chaos and pressuring Lin Jing and the other two,
the man in black grew furious. The aura of his Golden Core Peak cultivation burst forth in an instant, pressing down on the crowd as he spoke coldly,
“What, do you really intend to forcefully keep me here?”
“Knowing full well that I am about to face the Heavenly Tribulation, yet you still want me to swear by my soul spirit. Do you wish to see me perish during the tribulation?”
As the man in black spoke, his eyes were cold, sweeping across the crowd.
Seeing this situation, everyone immediately calmed down.
Still, someone was dissatisfied with the man in black and muttered under their breath,
“It’s just a soul spirit oath, what does it matter as long as you don’t reveal it?”
After hearing this, the man in black’s eyes narrowed, and he turned his gaze toward the person who had just spoken.
His violent aura burst out instantly, pressing down on the person who had spoken…
At the same time, he had already summoned a Magical Treasure Flying Sword that emitted a dark light, pointing directly at the person who had spoken.
Seeing that the man in black wanted to take action, Shopkeeper Shen quickly stepped in to mediate, reminding,
“Fellow Daoist, do not be impulsive…”
“This is Bihai City, and if a fight really breaks out, I’m afraid none of us will end up well off.”
“As for swearing an oath by your soul spirit, let’s forget about it.”
Having said that, he turned to address everyone,
“This fellow Daoist is about to undergo his Tribulation. Before that happens, he cannot be affected in the slightest, let alone swear an oath by his soul spirit.”
“I believe they will certainly not reveal this matter.”
Then, Shopkeeper Shen turned to the man in black and said,
“I trust, fellow Daoist, that you will certainly not disclose this matter, right…”
Seeing Shopkeeper Shen speak this way, the man in black finally retracted his violent aura and replied coldly,
“I disdain to stoop to such petty actions…”
Shopkeeper Shen nodded, not saying anything further, then turned to look at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing naturally understood the intention of Shopkeeper Shen and then said,
“Shopkeeper Shen, rest assured, if we spoke out, it would only bring us unnecessary trouble. I certainly wouldn’t do such an unwise thing,”
“Moreover, we don’t even know the location of the relic. Even if we did speak out, I doubt anyone would believe us.”
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than the young cultivator also spoke up,
“I will do the same, I absolutely won’t reveal it.”
Seeing that everyone had said as much,
Shopkeeper Shen, smiling, said to the three of them,
“Alright, I trust you…”
“You may go now.”
Afterward, the man in black immediately turned around and left the room.
Just then, there was a disturbance in the crowd again, and someone seemed about to say something more but was stopped by a look from Shopkeeper Shen.
……
And Lin Jing, after bidding farewell to Shopkeeper Shen, followed the steps of the man in black and left the place.
After the two had stepped out of the room,
it wasn’t long before the young cultivator caught up with them.
In this manner, the three of them left the Shen Family Shop together.
As soon as they returned to Fang Market, the young cultivator said to Lin Jing and the man in black,
“Both of you, thank you…”
“Without you two, I fear I would have had trouble leaving the Shen Family Shop today.”
At this time, the man in black said,
“Those people… there’s something not right about them…”
“You two had better be careful.”
The young cultivator bowed and said to the man in black,
“Thank you for the warning, fellow Daoist. I will certainly be cautious.”
“Fellow Daoists, I will take my leave now. Goodbye.”
After saying this, the young cultivator left.
Once the young cultivator had gone, only Lin Jing and the man in black were left.
At this moment, the man in black turned his head towards Lin Jing and saw that he had no intention of leaving.
He thus spoke,
“What? Aren’t you leaving as well?”
However, Lin Jing in turn said to the man in black,
“I’d like to make a trade with you.”
The man in black frowned, looked Lin Jing up and down, and then asked,
“You…?”
“What trade do you intend to make with me?”
Lin Jing replied,
“This is not quite the right place.”
“Shall we find somewhere suitable to talk?”
At that moment, the two were still standing on the main street of Fang Market in Bihai City. The man in black then looked around…
After a moment,
he nodded and said to Lin Jing,
“I know a place. Follow me…”
And so, the man in black led Lin Jing around Bihai City for quite a while.
It wasn’t until half an hour later that the two found an inn that was still open for business.
The man in black led Lin Jing directly into the inn.
The innkeeper was not there, but a night-shift worker welcomed them.
The man in black directly rented a room and then led Lin Jing inside it.
Upon entering the room, a formation was immediately activated, enveloping the entire room.
Then, the man in black spoke to Lin Jing,
“Don’t worry, it’s safe here.”
“The innkeeper is a Nascent Soul Cultivator, and no one dares to cause trouble here.”
“Now, you can speak. What trade do you want to make with me?”
Lin Jing didn’t dawdle and promptly said,
“I have a Medium Grade Nirvana Elixir!”
Lin Jing’s words took the man in black by surprise. His eyes shone brightly as he stared at Lin Jing and said,
“Is that true?”
Lin Jing then took out a beautifully crafted jade box from his storage bag and placed it on the table.
This jade box, specifically for holding high-grade elixir medicines, also has the function of preventing the loss of spiritual power, similar to the Pure Jade Box.
Of course, what’s more important is that it looks good…
After all, these are precious high-grade elixir medicines; they can no longer be stored in small jade bottles.
Otherwise, it would greatly reduce the value…
After taking out the jade box, Lin Jing said,
“Just like before, at the Fang Market…”
“I’d like to trade this medium-grade Nirvana Elixir for the three items you showed earlier.”
“I wonder… would you be willing?”
The man in black nodded and said,
“Of course, there’s no problem…”
“I had intended to trade those three items for a medium-grade Nirvana Elixir anyway…”
As he spoke, the man in black paused, then looked at the jade box and said to Lin Jing,
“However…”
“I need to inspect your elixir medicine first.”
Lin Jing then passed the jade box over and said,
“No problem, as it’s a transaction, this step is definitely necessary.”
The man in black reached out, took the jade box, and then looked at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing didn’t speak; he just smiled and stretched out his hand in a welcoming gesture.
The man in black nodded, then opened the jade box directly.
Instantly, a fragrance of elixir medicine filled the air.
The man in black took a deep breath and nodded slightly.
Then, he began to carefully inspect the medium-grade Nirvana Elixir.
…
…
It wasn’t until a quarter of an hour later that the man in black finished his inspection.
After completing his examination, he closed the jade box.
He then looked up at Lin Jing and said,
“Not bad…”
“It is indeed a medium-grade Nirvana Elixir, and among medium-grade elixirs, it’s of the highest quality. If luck had been a bit better and there were fewer impurities, this elixir would have reached the quality of a superior grade.”
Having said that, the man in black asked Lin Jing again,
“Are you sure you want to trade this elixir with me?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Of course…”
“Otherwise, I wouldn’t have taken it out…”
“Good…” the man in black nodded in agreement.
Right after, he took out the silver-white Shadow Escape Flying Boat, which had been shrunk down, from his space ring.
He also took out the Nirvana Flower seed packed in a wooden box, and the Thunder Shock Shield.
After taking out those three items, the man in black additionally took out a jade slip from his space ring and pushed it along with the three treasures toward Lin Jing.
The man in black then said,
“You must already know about those three items…”
“As for this jade slip, it contains the instructions for controlling the Shadow Escape Flying Boat. With this jade slip, you can quickly get familiar with the flying boat, which will spare you a lot of trial and error.”
“I see…” Lin Jing nodded.
At that moment, the man in black asked Lin Jing,
“I’m curious, since you possess the Nirvana Elixir, why didn’t you trade with me at the Fang Market? Why insist on waiting until after we left?”
Lin Jing pondered for a moment before replying,
“There were too many people at the time, and it wasn’t convenient to trade…”
“That’s why I waited to find you afterwards for a private trade.”
The man in black nodded and said,
“You are very clever…”
“I have no doubt, had you completed the trade with me at the Fang Market.”
“You would probably have been ambushed and killed the moment you left the Bihai City area.”
“This is my third time participating in their market, and previously I hadn’t felt anything amiss…”
“But today, it seemed that there was something not quite right about those people…”
At this point, the man in black said to Lin Jing,
“Fellow Daoist, that Fang Market is very unusual; you should not go again next time…”
Lin Jing then cupped his fists in thanks and said to the man in black,
“Thank you for the warning, fellow Daoist…”
In fact…
Without the man in black’s warning, Lin Jing had also sensed that there was something amiss about the Fang Market.
At the beginning, Lin Jing hadn’t noticed anything unusual as the atmosphere there was no different from a typical trading event.
It wasn’t until the end, after the Fang Market concluded and the Shopkeeper Shen mentioned the ruins, that everything started to feel off.
Firstly, it was the fact that Shopkeeper Shen mentioned the ruins but omitted some information.
Because Lin Jing knew that without the Five Elements Command Token, they would not be able to open the ruins no matter what.
Could it be that Shopkeeper Shen didn’t know that the entrance to the ruins required a Five Elements Command Token to open?
Honestly, it was indeed possible, but not very likely.
Any sane person would definitely investigate beforehand upon receiving news of the ruins.
It was improbable for Shopkeeper Shen to rally a large group of cultivators to explore the ruins based on scant information without any prior investigation.
That would be unreasonable.
Furthermore, aside from those he was acquainted with, there were some who were attending the Fang Market for the first time, and they were not even familiar with it.
This was even more unreasonable…
But these people were all dazzled by the prospect of the ruins as presented by Shopkeeper Shen, and without deliberation, they agreed to search the ruins together.
In reality, they did think it through.
After all.
The ruins were a rarity, and regardless of whether what Shopkeeper Shen said was true or false, it was always right to go have a look…
Better to believe it exists than not.
This was precisely their thought process…
Little did they know, if there truly was a mishap, it was unlikely any of them would escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 401: 101: Jack of all trades
chapters.content:
Chapter 401: Chapter 101: Jack of all trades
Afterward, Lin Jing and the man in black had another conversation.
Later, the two separated.
Over the next two days.
Lin Jing was in Bihai City, searching for Lin Jue’s traces while refining the Shadow Escape Flying Boat.
With the introduction of that Jade Slip, Lin Jing had come to understand all the functions of the Shadow Escape Flying Boat.
Like other flying boats, the Shadow Escape Flying Boat also operated on Spirit Stones.
However, once the Shadow Escape Flying Boat was refined, its speed would increase, and it would become even easier to control.
This Shadow Escape Flying Boat, in fact, was much better than the one belonging to Lu Youjiu.
Aside from these features, many formations had been inscribed on the Shadow Escape Flying Boat, making its defenses extremely strong.
And furthermore.
The most important feature, which sets it apart from other flying boats,
was its superb invisibility function.
Once the Shadow Escape Flying Boat entered its flying state and activated the invisibility function, it could evade the probing of most cultivators.
It could even avoid the divine sense investigation of Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators.
……
Although refining the Shadow Escape Flying Boat went very smoothly, the process of searching for Lin Jue, was not.
In the past two days, Lin Jing had visited Lin Jue’s home vicinity twice, yet had not seen Lin Jue.
He had even asked Lin Jue’s former neighbors and the like, none of whom had seen him.
Moreover, over these two days, Lin Jing also made a round of the Fang Market but did not encounter that dark-skinned boy.
Apart from that dark-skinned boy, there were two other people who had also disappeared.
Those were the two cultivators who earlier had falsely accused and bullied Lin Jue.
The simultaneous disappearance of these two people and Lin Jue gave Lin Jing an uneasy premonition.
But Lin Jing had no good solutions.
Soon, the third day had already arrived.
Early in the day, Lin Jing set out.
This time, he didn’t head to the ‘slums’ of Bihai City first, but went to the Fang Market.
The day before, as Lin Jing had passed by a tavern, he had inadvertently heard that near the Fang Market, there was an ‘All-Knowing’ who claimed to be aware of everything happening within Bihai City.
For this reason, Lin Jing had specifically inquired further.
Therefore, early today, Lin Jing came to the vicinity of the Fang Market, intending to meet this ‘All-Knowing’.
Upon reaching the entrance of the Fang Market again, Lin Jing did not enter.
Instead, he bypassed the Fang Market and walked into a small alley next to the market.
After some inquiries, Lin Jing learned that the All-Knowing resided in this alley.
Proceeding inward all the way to the end of the alley, he finally saw a small courtyard with a door that was half-open.
Lin Jing then observed the small courtyard in front of him and muttered to himself:
“The door is half-open, painted red, with no signboard above; it should be this place.”
Next.
Lin Jing approached the courtyard and knocked on the door.
A hoarse, elderly voice soon came from inside:
“Please come in…”
Lin Jing then opened the door and walked in.
The courtyard was not large, containing only a single small house with its door also half-open.
That elderly voice came again from inside the house:
“I am inside, just come in directly…”
Lin Jing frowned slightly and walked in.
The lighting within the house was not good, a bit dim, but it did not affect Lin Jing at all.
Lin Jing then looked around.
The interior of the house was quite simple and plain, with only common household items and nothing superfluous.
Inside the bedroom sat an old man at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The old man’s bedroom was different from others’.
Inside his bedroom, there was no bed but a shallow pit where the old man sat cross-legged.
That pit was not only occupied by the old man; various snakes, rats, insects, and ants crawled all over the pit and on the man himself.
In this place, what were usually natural enemies like snakes and rats, including various insects, all meekly surrounded the old man.
There was no aggression among them.
It seemed this old man was likely some sort of Beast Taming Master.
Yet, he was different from other Beast Taming Masters.
Because other Beast Taming Masters would command all sorts of powerful Demonic Beasts.
But he commanded creatures like snakes, rats, insects, ants, and small birds, these kinds of small animals and insects.
Seeing Lin Jing arrive, the old man spoke up:
“Forgive me, Senior, I am in the midst of cultivating and cannot offer my respects…”
Lin Jing spoke directly:
“No matter…”
He then continued, “Are you the All-Knowing?”
The old man replied:
“Yes…”
“I do not know, Senior, what would you like to inquire about?”
“As long as it is anything that has happened within Bihai City, feel free to ask, Senior, but please forgive me if it’s about matters outside the city…”
“Also, there is another matter I need to inform Senior of ahead of time…”
Lin Jing looked at the All-Knowing and asked, “What is it?”
The All-Knowing responded:
“That would be that no matter what news Senior wishes to inquire about, the cost is ten Midium Grade Spirit Stones.”
Lin Jing didn’t care about the charge; he directly took out ten Spirit Stones from his Storage Bag, tossed them over, and then spoke:
“What I wish to inquire about are indeed the matters that occurred within Bihai City.”
The All-Knowing took the Spirit Stones and put them away before asking Lin Jing:
“May I know which matter Senior wishes to inquire about?”
Lin Jing said,
“I want to find a young man who lives here, named Lin Jue, who often used to set up a stall in the Fang Market…”
Lin Jing then proceeded to describe Lin Jue’s information.
Upon hearing this, Omniscient pondered for a moment before asking Lin Jing again,
“You’re saying he disappeared, and it has been more than half a month, is that right?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Judging from the situation at his home, that seems to be the case.”
Omniscient then said,
“Senior, please wait a moment…”
After speaking, Omniscient began to run his cultivation technique, and a distinctive aura emanated from his body.
The snakes, rodents, insects, and so on that had been surrounding him immediately quieted down.
Shortly after, Omniscient uttered some strange syllables, and the snakes, rodents, insects, and the like immediately crowded around him, as if they were listening intently.
It wasn’t until a moment later that the strange syllables from Omniscient’s mouth ceased.
These small animals and insects, whether burrowing into the ground, flying in the air, or crawling, all dispersed in different directions.
Even when passing by Lin Jing, these snakes, rodents, and insects made a point to detour around him.
Only then did Omniscient begin to speak again to Lin Jing,
“Senior, please wait a moment longer, my ‘friends’ are quite well-informed, and I estimate it won’t be long before they bring back some news…”
Lin Jing nodded and then patiently waited there…
After more than an hour had passed, various small animals and insects began to return from the outside and from underground.
These creatures differed from the ones before, as their bodies bore traces of spiritual power to varying degrees.
Clearly, these were the ‘scouts’ that Omniscient had trained…
After their return, each animal and insect approached Omniscient.
Some used physical gestures, while others made noises to convey messages to Omniscient.
Once all the messages had been relayed, Omniscient knitted his brows in thought for a while, then raised his head and said to Lin Jing,
“Senior…”
“I have found out…”
Lin Jing turned his gaze toward Omniscient and asked,
“Where did Lin Jue go?”
Omniscient then spoke,
“I just got news from my friends…”
“The Lin Jue that Senior is asking about was most likely tricked and kidnapped by two men.”
“Of those two men, one was somewhat fat, while the other was very sturdy, and they had distinctive features. One of them…”
“And the other one…”
…
…
As Omniscient described them, Lin Jing’s frown grew tighter because he recognized the description of the two men.
They were the same two men Lin Jing had disciplined before.
But how could they dare to lay hands on Lin Jue, especially since Lin Jing had already tampered with their sea of consciousness. Unless.
