"Because a year ago, the Guild Leader's younger brother was killed by a cultivator. By the time our Guild Leader found out about that cultivator, he had already entered the Sea of Blood."
"It wasn't until over half a month ago that this person returned from the depths of the Sea of Blood. Upon his return, Xu Ye immediately sought him out."
"Originally, the Guild Leader thought everything was under control and there was no need for tracking, but unexpectedly, the cultivator changed his appearance and went into hiding. That is why we are searching for unfamiliar cultivators."
With that explanation, Lin Jing understood what was happening...
So it turns out, the root of all this was because of that Golden Core ninth layer cultivator.
Having said this, the Yellow Pine Cultivator carefully observed Lin Jing.
At this moment, he had confirmed that this person before him was most likely the objective of his search.
Thereafter, Lin Jing looked at him and said:
"The actions against unfamiliar cultivators by your Puppet Guild lately are also because of this matter, right?"
The person hastily nodded and said:
"Yes, senior..."
Faced with Lin Jing's terrifying pressure, the Yellow Pine Cultivator dared not be arrogant and addressed Lin Jing as a senior.
Afterwards.
The person continued, saying:
"Moreover, our Guild Leader has already dealt with most of the unfamiliar cultivators. I believe it won't be long before he finds you, senior..."
Lin Jing, looking at the Yellow Pine Cultivator, saw that he seemed hesitant to speak, so he asked:
"Is there something you want to say?"
The man hastily nodded, then said:
"Senior, I can actually help you deal with the Puppet Guild if you'd only spare me."
Lin Jing then asked:
"How can you help?"
The cultivator then said:
"The Puppet Guild Leader is also aware that you are not easy to deal with. If he were to act against you, he would surely plan to exploit the night when you are less mobile and attempt to use Puppets for a sneak attack..."
"You just need to understand this Puppetry Technique, and you will be able to find a way to counter it..."
"I can teach you the Puppetry Technique and tell you some of its control methods."
"This way, you should be able to handle their night ambushes."
"If nothing else, you can at least disrupt the Puppets..."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing stared at the Yellow Pine Cultivator and said,
"How can I be sure that you are not deceiving me?"
Facing Lin Jing's question, the Yellow Pine Cultivator hastily assured him and said,
"Senior, I can swear on my Soul Spirit..."
"Furthermore, from this moment on, I will sever my ties with the Puppet Guild, stay away from the Sea of Blood shore, and never oppose Senior again."
Lin Jing gave a slight nod and said,
"Good..."
"If what you say is true, then I might indeed let you go..."
Upon hearing this, the Yellow Pine Cultivator was overjoyed and said,
"Thank you, Senior..."
......
True to his words, the Yellow Pine Cultivator then proceeded to pass on the Puppetry Technique to Lin Jing.
He was aware that if he wasn't honest, Lin Jing would certainly not let him off.
Moreover, after teaching the Puppetry Technique to Lin Jing, he also went out of his way to explain several important secrets of Puppetry Technique.
Especially regarding the control of the puppetry, as well as how to cope with the external conditions of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
After explaining all this, the man took out a puppet from his Storage Bag and handed it to Lin Jing, along with a piece of Black Jade Stone, which he also passed to Lin Jing.
Having taken these out, the man hurriedly stowed his Storage Bag away.
After securing his Storage Bag, the Yellow Pine Cultivator directly said to Lin Jing,
"That Black Jade Stone is used to control the puppet, and moreover, if other puppets appear nearby, the Black Jade Stone will also sense them."
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded...
Finally, after making sure everything was explained,
The Yellow Pine Cultivator formally swore on his Soul Spirit that he would never become Lin Jing's enemy.
Seeing the Yellow Pine Cultivator swear, Lin Jing lightly nodded his head.
The Yellow Pine Cultivator, seeing Lin Jing's nod, immediately gave his thanks and was about to leave.
However, at that moment, Lin Jing called out to him.
"Wait a moment..."
Upon hearing Lin Jing's voice, the Yellow Pine Cultivator paused and then turned around, smiling obsequiously and saying,
"Senior, do you have any further instructions?"
Lin Jing eyed the flattery in the cultivator's demeanor and ignored it, instead focusing on his waist where the Storage Bag was and said,
"Let me have a look at your Storage Bag..."
The Yellow Pine Cultivator's expression changed in an instant, and he said cautiously,
"Senior..."
"This seems somewhat improper... If I have no Spirit Stones, it would be difficult for me to survive in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm."
Lin Jing spoke directly,
"I don't want your Spirit Stones; I just want to see if you have what I'm looking for in your Storage Bag?"
Upon hearing this, the Yellow Pine Cultivator quickly replied, smiling at Lin Jing,
"Senior..."
"May I know what you are looking for? I can just hand it to you directly, there's no need for Senior to go through the trouble."
This action by the Yellow Pine Cultivator made Lin Jing's brows furrow slightly.
He had a feeling that something was not right...
This Yellow Pine Cultivator seemed particularly fearful of him seeing his Storage Bag.
But the more he acted like this, the more it proved that he had something to hide.
However, looking unflinchingly at the man, Lin Jing asked coldly,
"Are you refusing to hand over the Storage Bag?"
At that moment, the Yellow Pine Cultivator, with a face full of sorrow and anger, looked at Lin Jing and said,
"Senior..."
"I have told you everything and even sworn a Soul Spirit Oath to never be an enemy to Senior. Do you really intend to push me to death?"
Lin Jing's expression turned cold as he uttered,
"Enough prattle..."
Immediately, Lin Jing made his move, sending a Wǔ Cǎi light soaring towards the Yellow Pine Cultivator.
Seeing the Wǔ Cǎi light flying towards him again, the Yellow Pine Cultivator's face turned pale as he hastily turned around, attempting to escape...
However, the Yellow Pine Cultivator hadn't gotten far before he felt an overwhelming Divine Sense pressure descending from the sky.
This Divine Sense pressure was so formidable that the Yellow Pine Cultivator couldn't put up any resistance and stumbled to his knees, defeated.
At the same time, the Wǔ Cǎi light once again entered the body of the Yellow Pine Cultivator.
That familiar sensation besieged him again.
Then, Lin Jing retracted his Divine Sense and walked towards the Yellow Pine Cultivator.
The Yellow Pine Cultivator also turned his head, looking at Lin Jing, and said,
"Senior..."
"Why are you doing this? Do you, Senior, really intend to be known as a dishonorable and untrustworthy villain?"
Lin Jing simply replied,
"You seem very afraid of me checking your Storage Bag; what is inside it that makes you so nervous?"
"I am very curious..."
Hearing this, the Yellow Pine Cultivator's body was drenched in cold sweat as he hurriedly tried to explain,
"Senior..."
"Actually, there are some high-quality Elixir Medicines inside my Storage Bag. I feared Senior might take them, which is why I concealed them..."
"If Senior desires them, I will directly offer those Elixir Medicines to Senior."
However, Lin Jing did not have the patience to listen to his explanations and resolutely continued walking towards the Yellow Pine Cultivator.
Seeing this, the Yellow Pine Cultivator became even more frantic,
"Senior..."
"I can give you my Storage Bag, but please undo the spell on me first, and I'll unlock the restrictions on the Storage Bag for Senior..."

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 151: Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang Die
chapters.content:
Chapter 454 - 151: Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang Die
At this moment, Lin Jing had already reached the man and, with a wave of his hand, the man's Storage Bag flew directly into Lin Jing's hands.
Immediately afterward, Lin Jing picked up the Storage Bag, broke its seal, and sent his Divine Sense into it...
Inside were Spirit Stones, Elixir Medicines, various materials...
Even, there were a few Magical Treasures...
It was when Lin Jing saw these Magical Treasures that one Flying Sword caught his attention.
Because Lin Jing had seen this Flying Sword before.
It was indeed Qi Yuanshu's Flying Sword.
Qi Yuanshu's Flying Sword, however, in the Storage Bag of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, caused a sudden heaviness in Lin Jing's heart...
Then, Lin Jing took out the Flying Sword and placed it in front of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, his face stern as he stared him down and asked,
"This Flying Sword, where did you get it from?"
The Yellow Pine Cultivator, seeing Lin Jing take out this Flying Sword, had a moment of panic, aware that something was amiss, so he quickly defended himself,
"This Flying Sword, I found it on the Beach of the Sea of Blood, it should belong to some blood corpse."
Although the Yellow Pine Cultivator said so, his eyes could not hold steady, and even his attitude was not as certain as that of other cultivators.
Clearly, he was trying to conceal something...
But Lin Jing's Divine Sense had already spread out, covering him entirely. Under the surveillance of Lin Jing's Nascent Soul Stage Divine Sense, any minute movement by the Yellow Pine Cultivator couldn't escape Lin Jing's watchful sense.
Obviously, this Yellow Pine Cultivator was lying.
Seeing this, Lin Jing did not bother to speak any further.
Instead, he directly approached the Yellow Pine Cultivator, extending his hand, descending upon his head.
Seeing Lin Jing's icy gaze as his hand reached towards his own head, how could the Yellow Pine man not realize what Lin Jing was about to do?
His face filled with terror, one hand pressed against the ground as he continuously retreated, all the while shaking his head, trying to fend off Lin Jing's hand.
"No... no..."
"You can't do this, I've already told you everything I know..."
However, how could Lin Jing allow him to resist at this moment?
Suddenly, the multicolored radiance within the man's body surged, breaking through his form.
The Yellow Pine Cultivator immediately became immobilized.
And Lin Jing's palm was timely placed on top of the man's head.
Following that, Lin Jing activated his Divine Sense, directly probing into the Yellow Pine Cultivator's sea of consciousness.
Instantly, the memories of the Yellow Pine Cultivator unfolded scene by scene within Lin Jing's sea of consciousness.
Considering Lin Jing's strength of Divine Sense, he could indeed directly use the Soul Searching Technique on a Golden Core Cultivator.
But, the process of Soul Searching was hardly bearable.
Not only did the man being Soul Searched scream incessantly, but even Lin Jing himself suffered from the vastness of his memories, causing him a splitting headache.
Lin Jing endured the pain, rapidly sorting through the man's memories...
From childhood to adulthood, every little detail the Yellow Pine Cultivator had experienced was poured into Lin Jing's mind in a single breath.
Facing the growth history of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, Lin Jing naturally had no interest, and brushed quickly through it.
Until recently, Lin Jing finally found what he wanted to know in the man's memories.
Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang were both captured by the people of the Puppet Guild.
Moreover, it was this Yellow Pine Cultivator who led the capture, and the reason behind it was to find Lin Jing.
Then, Lin Jing continued sorting...
Just like this, up until a few days ago.
Lin Jing saw in the Yellow Pine Cultivator's memories that after getting information out of Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang, and draining all their worth, they were murdered...
Upon witnessing this scene, Lin Jing's anger surged to the sky.
Although he had only met Qi Yuanshu in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, the man was kind-hearted and good to his friends.
And Jian Yunxiang was very much like Qi Yuanshu.
Moreover.
Lin Jing also learned most of the secrets of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm from his mouth.
These were people who had been of great help to him.
Yet these two were cruelly murdered by people of the Puppet Guild simply for being acquainted with him.
This caused Lin Jing to burn with fury and a killing intent arose within him.
After completing the Soul Search, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense, looking coldly at the Yellow Pine Cultivator who had collapsed on the ground.
At this moment the Yellow Pine Cultivator, though unable to move, had eyes filled with pleading.
The capture of Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang was this man's idea, and the hand that ended their lives in the end was his as well.
Lin Jing had no mercy to speak of for this man.
And naturally, Lin Jing was not going to let him off.
Facing the pleas of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, Lin Jing thought of the tragic states of Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang before their deaths, his eyes growing colder...
Afterward.
The palm Lin Jing had on the Yellow Pine Cultivator's head exerted force, shattering his skull with a single blow.
The Yellow Pine Cultivator didn't even have the chance to beg for mercy before he died by Lin Jing's hand...
...
...
In fact, there was one more person...
Although this person was the mastermind behind the capture of Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang, the real cause of the matter lay with the Puppet Guild Leader.
Only by killing him could this be settled.
Besides, even if Lin Jing didn't seek out the Puppet Guild Leader, he would take the initiative to find Lin Jing.
Probably within these few days.
However, the Puppet Guild had no shortage of members, and even Lin Jing dared not be arrogant enough to directly trouble them.
Therefore, Lin Jing's next course of action was to find a way to eliminate the Puppet Guild Leader.
Or even to eradicate the Puppet Guild.
......
After taking care of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, Lin Jing removed his disguise and reverted to his original appearance, riding his Flying Sword towards the Sea of Blood beach.
From the memory of the Yellow Pine Cultivator, Lin Jing had learned that the leader of the Puppet Guild was extremely cautious and devious.
Even facing Lin Jing, his brother's killer, he did not plan to deal with him in an open and aboveboard manner.
Instead, he wanted to use the Puppet Guild's advantage at night, in conjunction with Blood corpses to eliminate Lin Jing.
And his idea coincided with Lin Jing's own plans.
Of course, Lin Jing did not wish to openly conflict with the Puppet Guild either, considering its numerous members—if a conflict really broke out, Lin Jing was not necessarily going to have the upper hand.
Lin Jing also planned to take advantage of the night when the members of the Puppet Guild were scattered and dared not venture out freely. He could then find their caves and defeat them one by one.
Therefore,
Lin Jing had revealed his true identity and came to the Sea of Blood beach for this purpose.
After making a round, Lin Jing immediately noticed that several cultivators had taken notice of him.
Presumably, they all were from the Puppet Guild.
As soon as Lin Jing appeared on the Sea of Blood beach, someone immediately reported this news to the Puppet Guild Leader.
After receiving this message, the Puppet Guild Leader thought for a moment and then asked the subordinate who had reported it:
"Are you sure, it's only him by himself this time?"
That cultivator responded:
"Yes, Guild Leader..."
"Just him alone, should we take action and eliminate this person?"
After hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader pondered for a moment, then his gaze sharpened, and he said:
"You go secretly follow him and find his cave. We'll move tonight..."
"Yes..." replied the cultivator, before he withdrew.
......
After circling the Sea of Blood beach, Lin Jing figured that the Puppet Guild Leader must have received the news.
Therefore, Lin Jing quickly left the area.
This time, Lin Jing did not return to the previous mountain peak.
Instead, he found an inconspicuous mountain peak not far from the Sea of Blood beach in the desolate mountain range and carved a cave to reside in.
Beforehand, Lin Jing's Divine Sense had been observing the surroundings.
Under the cover of Lin Jing's Divine Sense, a cultivator was found to have been following him ever since he left the Sea of Blood beach.
Up to now, this person was still carefully hiding and following behind him.
Although the person tried to conceal himself thoroughly, he could not evade the exploration of Lin Jing's Divine Sense. However, Lin Jing did not pay him any heed and entered the newly carved cave directly.
After Lin Jing entered the cave, that cultivator following him then left...
......
Only when dusk was about to fall did the cultivator return.
This time, besides him, he brought three others.
Together, four cultivators found a mountain peak not far from the one Lin Jing had occupied, and they, too, carved out a cave.
Lin Jing then sent out his Divine Sense, sweeping toward the caves of those four cultivators...
After some investigation, he discovered that the Puppet Guild Leader was not among them.
Lin Jing couldn't help feeling a bit disappointed...
Given the Guild Leader's cautious nature, this was to be expected.
However...
Lin Jing had already prepared a countermeasure for this.
So, he was not in a rush but retracted his Divine Sense, sat cross-legged inside the cave, and waited for nightfall.
Soon, night fell, and once again the world was bathed in silence.
Lin Jing held a Black Jade Stone in hand and waited quietly.
Before long, rustling noises came from the outside.
Soon, a voice came from outside:
"Brother Lin Jing, are you there?"
Since Li Qingqing had not come to the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, it naturally goes without saying that the voice belonged to that soul-devouring Yin spirit.
At this moment, the Black Jade Stone in Lin Jing's hand showed no reaction.
"I want to see you, can I come in, please..."
This voice belonged to Li Qingqing.
Since Li Qingqing had not come to the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, it naturally goes without saying that the voice belonged to that soul-devouring Yin spirit.
At this moment, the Black Jade Stone in Lin Jing's hand showed no reaction.
Clearly, those Puppet Cultivators had not yet made their move.
In the face of the noise outside, Lin Jing did not react at all.
After some time, the noise outside disappeared as well.
And Lin Jing continued to meditate inside the cave.
......
After the noise had disappeared and some time had passed, there was new activity outside.
This time...
Footsteps were heard approaching the entrance of Lin Jing's cave, then stopping just outside; followed by a series of loud bangs, accompanied by the sound of falling rocks.
This sound, along with the actions outside, truly seemed as if someone was damaging the entrance's black boulders.
If it were not for the lack of response from the Black Jade Stone in Lin Jing's hand, he might have thought that those Puppet Cultivators had made their move.
The noise did not last long and soon ceased.
After the noises stopped, some time passed.
The same sounds arose again.
However, this time the difference was
that the Black Jade Stone in Lin Jing's hand had become hot and was emitting a red glow.
It was obvious...
The Puppet Cultivators had already taken action, and at this moment, the puppets were already at the entrance of his cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: 152: The Daylight Pursuit
chapters.content:
Chapter 455: Chapter 152: The Daylight Pursuit
Seeing movement from the Black Jade Stone, Lin Jing hurriedly employed the Puppetry technique he had learned from the Yellow Pine Cultivator. He then placed the Black Jade Stone before him, his hands continuously forming seals.
Following that, the Black Jade Stone began to change in response to Lin Jing’s hand movements, gradually turning a bright red.
And the black light it emitted grew even more intense.
As the black light from the Black Jade Stone became stronger, the noises outside Lin Jing’s cave also gradually ceased.
And so, a while passed.
Outside, there was complete silence.
Then, another voice came:
“I’ll give you a chance, throw out your Space Ring, or don’t blame us for being impolite.”
Lin Jing was startled by this voice, then quickly realized what was happening.
It seemed that the soul-eating spirit was still at play.
Lin Jing immediately concentrated his Divine Sense, extending it out.
Previously, Lin Jing had learned from Jian Yunxiang that while this soul-eating spirit could control the Divine Sense of a Golden Core Cultivator, it could be completely resisted by the Divine Sense of someone at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Therefore, Lin Jing dared to extend his Divine Sense.
As soon as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached out, he immediately felt a strange power of consciousness attempting to influence his own Divine Sense.
However, despite this consciousness power being strong, Lin Jing was able to resist it completely.
Under the sweep of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense,
At this moment, in front of Lin Jing’s cave, there were four humanoid Puppets. These four Puppets stood motionless, their eyes tightly shut.
Behind each Puppet, there was an almost invisible black thread that connected far into the distance.
This was the way to control Puppets, and Lin Jing was able to see these threads precisely because he himself had acquired the Puppetry art.
If Lin Jing wished, he could even follow these threads to find the people behind the Puppets.
Apart from these four Puppets, there were several blood zombies behind them.
It was like they were working in concert.
The Puppets would break the black boulder, and then the blood zombies could rush into the cave to kill.
Atop the head of the leading blood zombie, Lin Jing saw the soul-eating spirit that had been misleading people.
At this time, the eyes of this soul-eating spirit had turned blood-red, spreading out countless black ripples.
Moreover, those ripples were relentlessly attacking Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
This soul-eating spirit was indeed troublesome.
In addition to its deceit, it was also capable of launching attacks using Divine Sense.
The attacks were strong; had Lin Jing’s Divine Sense not exceeded the Nascent Soul Realm, he doubted he could have withstood even for a moment.
Lin Jing concentrated his Divine Sense, braving the soul-eating spirit’s attacks to inspect those few Puppets.
He didn’t rashly venture out.
In fact, Lin Jing could have gone out and collected those Puppets.
Moreover, after collecting the Puppets, Lin Jing could enter the System Space to avoid the pursuit of the blood zombies and the soul-eating spirit.
If Lin Jing wanted, he could even do as the previous Body Refinement Cultivator did, find the caves of those four Puppet Cultivators, and directly kill all four of them.
But Lin Jing didn’t plan to do so; he didn’t want to expose his ability to move at night.
At least not before the Puppet Guild Leader arrived; he didn’t wish to raise any alarm.
If he could kill a few people during the night and still remain unharmed, that would surely alert the Puppet Guild Leader.
Lin Jing didn’t want to startle the snake in the grass.
The foundation of the Puppet Guild was entirely reliant on the Puppetry of its leader. If the Guild Leader died, the Puppet Guild would naturally disband.
Now, Lin Jing only needed to control the Puppets, ignoring everything else, and collect the Puppets after daylight tomorrow.
……
What followed,
Lin Jing just like that, controlled the Puppets to keep them immobilized, until daylight.
Only after daylight did Lin Jing rise, directly move the colossal black stone, and then collect those Puppets.
He had already discerned the locations of those Puppet Cultivators’ caves yesterday.
Therefore, after collecting the Puppets, Lin Jing did not linger; he directly leaped into action, rushing toward one of the Puppet Cultivators’ caves.
The reason Lin Jing waited until daylight to act was all part of his previous plan…
Although Lin Jing didn’t plan to reveal any other secrets, the Puppetry technique was something he was bound to expose.
Only by doing so could he make the Puppet Guild Leader aware that he had learned the Puppetry art and thus lure him into coming.
Lin Jing knew that the Puppetry technique he had acquired from the Yellow Pine Cultivator was flawed and that he could control Puppets, the Puppet Guild Leader surely had a countermeasure.
Only by exposing his use of Puppetry would the Puppet Guild Leader personally deal with him.
Now that his use of Puppetry last night had been made known to these four, the message was already out.
But Lin Jing didn’t plan to let all these people go; at most, he would leave one to deliver the message.
As for the other three, Lin Jing intended to keep them all.
So,
At the break of dawn, Lin Jing directly burst out of the cave, flying toward one of the Puppet Cultivators’ caves.
Upon reaching the cave entrance, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate at all; he sent his Divine Sense into it, and the situation inside the cave came to mind.
The Puppet Cultivator inside was just about to get up and leave the cave.
However, Lin Jing had already arrived.
After getting there, Lin Jing did not pause, he landed at the cave entrance and threw a punch to shatter the black boulder.
Following that,
Lin Jing charged into the cave and grabbed the Puppet Cultivator.
The moment this cultivator saw Lin Jing, he was overcome with terror:
“You…”
“You’re actually a Body Refinement Cultivator.”
But that sentence became his last words.
Afterwards, Lin Jing slapped the cultivator’s Dantian.
Instantly destroyed the man’s Dantian.
With his Dantian destroyed, even without Lin Jing lifting a finger, the eyes of the Puppet Cultivator instantly lost focus, turning him into a walking corpse.
Due to the noise Lin Jing had made earlier during his actions, he naturally attracted the attention of the other three who had been monitoring him.
No sooner had Lin Jing disposed of the first Puppet Cultivator than two other Divine Senses probed over.
Seeing this horrifying scene, how could the three not understand what had happened?
Seeing Lin Jing beginning to settle accounts, the remaining three were startled and immediately stopped lingering, hurrying to escape towards the Sea of Blood beach.
At this point, having lost their puppet, they had almost no ability to resist and could only hope to reach the Sea of Blood beach for help from others inside the Puppet Guild.
…
…
Having dealt with the first person, Lin Jing collected his Storage Bag and then acted again, flying towards the remaining two men.
However.
Before even entering the area of the Sea of Blood beach, Lin Jing had already caught up to them.
Seeing Lin Jing catching up so quickly, the three men, in desperation, accelerated even further, trying to escape the area as fast as possible.
At this time, the gap in cultivation between the men became evident; one with a higher cultivation moved the fastest.
Very soon, he had opened up a considerable distance from the two behind him.
Seeing this, Lin Jing burst forth at top speed, rapidly closing in on the two lagging behind.
By now, Lin Jing was not far from the two Cultivators.
With one more burst of extreme speed, he could catch up with the two men.
At this moment, the group was nearing the vicinity of the Sea of Blood beach. If they pursued further, they would likely enter Puppet Guild territory.
The commotion of this chase quickly attracted the attention of other Cultivators.
Those spectators, upon seeing someone brazenly killing Puppet Guild members in broad daylight, all gasped in shock.
Such a bold move had never been seen before.
When the onlookers saw Lin Jing’s explosive speed, someone immediately cried out:
“This is, a Body Refinement Cultivator…”
Ever since a Body Refinement Cultivator had withstood the attack of the blood corpses at night, found the Puppet Cultivator’s cave, and killed him…
The reputation of Body Refinement Cultivators within the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm had become prominent, and few wished to provoke such terrifying beings.
Aside from Body Refinement Cultivators who could cause trouble for the Puppet Guild, there was no one else.
Now, another Body Refinement Cultivator had appeared, openly attacking Puppet Guild members in broad daylight.
How could the gathering crowd not be shocked?
Seeing that the two trailing men were about to enter the domain of the Sea of Blood beach, Lin Jing immediately employed extreme speed again and appeared behind them in an instant.
Then, Lin Jing directly struck one of them on the top of the head with his palm.
The fleeing Puppet Cultivator attempted to dodge, but it was too late.
Lin Jing’s palm descended with incredible speed, landing on the Puppet Cultivator’s head.
As the palm struck, blood splattered everywhere, and the Cultivator’s skull collapsed instantly.
Following.
A crimson mix laced with gray splashed out…
The other person, seeing this, knew he could not escape and stopped running.
Instead, he covered himself with innumerable Spiritual Shields, his eyes bloodshot, and shouted:
“Go to hell…”
At the same time, his other hand formed a seal, summoning countless flashes of lightning. The lightning covered the sky, enveloping Lin Jing within it.
Seeing this scene, the person who had escaped the fastest, along with some of the original onlookers, immediately turned pale.
They quickly retracted their auras and withdrew a good distance to the rear…
Seeing this, Lin Jing also retreated, leaving the area.
The man was doomed.
His spell was too noisy and would inevitably attract blood corpses.
Indeed…
Before the spell was fully unleashed, several blood corpses rushed out from the Sea of Blood and arrived right next to the Cultivator.
The sight of the blood corpses filled the Cultivator with despair.
He knew he was doomed to die.
Therefore, he turned around, his eyes filled with madness, and charged at Lin Jing, trying to draw him into the perception range of the blood corpses.
However…
The man’s speed was no match for Lin Jing’s.
Before he could catch up with Lin Jing, Lin Jing had already retreated far away.
And at that moment, the blood corpses had already intercepted him and commenced battle.
……
This time, facing the blood corpses, he did not hold back.
A myriad of powerful spells were unleashed from his hands, immediately bombarding the blood corpses with wounds.
However, these blood corpses simply could not be killed.
No matter how severe the injury, they would promptly heal.
Before long, the Cultivator’s Spiritual Power was exhausted, and a blood corpse pierced his chest, causing him to fall.
After killing the Cultivator, the blood corpses, with his body in tow, flew back to the Sea of Blood.
By now, the recent battle had attracted quite a few onlookers, but none dared to make an appearance; even those who had been watching nearby were silent.
And the Cultivator who had escaped the fastest was nowhere to be found.
Presumably, he had already returned to Puppet Guild territory, bringing news back with him.
And Lin Jing…
At that moment, he too left the area on his sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 456: 153: The 'Final Battle' with the Puppet Guild
chapters.content:
Chapter 456: Chapter 153: The ‘Final Battle’ with the Puppet Guild
“`
After Lin Jing left, the cultivator he had been chasing finally let out a sigh of relief.
However, he dared not rest for long, as he needed to report the incident to the Guild Leader.
Without looking back, the man hurried away.
…
…
When the man arrived at the Guild Leader’s dwelling place of the Puppet Guild.
Seeing how disheveled the man was, the Puppet Guild Leader’s eyebrows immediately furrowed, and he asked:
“What happened, weren’t you supposed to ambush Lin Jing?”
“How did you end up in such a mess?”
Not daring to conceal anything, the man quickly said:
“Guild Leader, we miscalculated…”
“That Lin Jing, he also knows Puppetry Technique. When we sent over our puppets to control him, he took control of them with Puppetry Technique and we lost contact.”
“Just as dawn broke, he stormed out of the cave and attacked several of us.”
“Besides, Lin Jing is a Body Refinement Cultivator, and we, four people’s puppets, were seized by him and stood no chance at all.”
“The three of them, all died at the hands of Lin Jing, and only I was lucky enough to escape.”
“Body Refinement Cultivator…”
Hearing the cultivator’s words, the Puppet Guild Leader’s frown deepened and he asked the man:
“Are you saying he also practices Puppetry Technique?”
The cultivator replied:
“Yes, Guild Leader…”
“Last night, the four of us had coordinated our efforts to control puppets and go to his cave entrance, aiming to entangle him.”
“But not long after I sent my puppet over, it was controlled by someone else. It could not move and soon afterward, it was completely out of my control.”
“Originally, I planned to inform you as soon as dawn broke, but early the next morning, Lin Jing came out of the cave and directly found the third brother’s cave and killed him.”
“After killing the third brother, the few of us knew something was wrong and immediately tried to escape, but he was too powerful, and we were not his match. He quickly caught up with us…”
“In the end, only I managed to escape.”
After hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader pondered for a while and then asked:
“Do you know how he learned this Puppetry Technique?”
The man shook his head and said:
“I don’t know…”
“However, although he managed to control our puppets with Puppetry Technique, I could sense that his use of it was somewhat unskilled.”
“His time practicing Puppetry Technique couldn’t have been long.”
The Puppet Guild Leader nodded lightly and said:
“I see…”
The words of the Puppet Guild Leader left the cultivator somewhat puzzled, so he inquired:
“Guild Leader, you understand?”
The Puppet Guild Leader nodded and added:
“If there are no surprises, it should be that some of our own people had fallen into his hands before this, and that’s how he acquired the Puppetry Technique.”
“After all, we were in the light before while he was in the dark; it’s very easy to launch a sneak attack on someone within the Guild.”
Upon hearing this, the man suddenly realized and said:
“What the Guild Leader says makes sense…”
“So, what should we do next to deal with this person?”
After hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader looked at the man and asked again:
“Aside from being a Body Refinement Cultivator, does that person have any other hidden strengths?”
The cultivator who had escaped thought for a moment and responded:
“Because we lost the puppets, we didn’t confront him directly while avoiding his pursuit.”
“However, that man has the cultivation of a Golden Core at the ninth level, and combined with the incredible speed that a Body Refinement Cultivator can unleash, we were quickly caught up to.”
“If I must say, it’s that his speed is very fast, and his Divine Sense, able to control the four of us’ puppets, must also be exceptional…”
After listening, the Puppet Guild Leader nodded and said:
“Alright…”
“I understand.”
“Next, I will take action personally.”
Upon hearing this, the man’s eyes lit up as he said:
“Yes, Guild Leader.”
When the Guild Leader takes action, it is always extraordinary.
Previously, he had witnessed the Guild Leader’s puppet, which was comparable to a Body Refinement Cultivator at the Golden Core ninth level.
Moreover, the Puppetry Technique was originally transmitted by the Guild Leader himself. As long as he wishes, he can take control of anyone’s puppet.
Even if Lin Jing practices Puppetry Technique,
it would be useless in front of the Guild Leader’s puppet.
With the Guild Leader’s intervention, success is almost certain.
Then, the Puppet Guild Leader took out a small Storage Bag from his own Storage Bag and handed it to the cultivator, saying:
“Here are some Spirit Stones as a reward for your actions this time.”
The man accepted the Spirit Stones and said:
“Thank you, Guild Leader.”
Then the Puppet Guild Leader waved his hand and said:
“Alright, you may go now.”
However, the man spoke again:
“Guild Leader, this incident was seen by many, and I expect there will be rumors detrimental to our Puppet Guild.”
Upon hearing this, the Guild Leader’s brow creased slightly, and he nodded and stated:
“Hmm, I am aware…”
“Just wait…”
“In a few days, I’ll make all these rumors disappear…”
……
After leaving, Lin Jing returned directly to his previous cave dwelling.
However, not long after Lin Jing returned, Xu Ye came looking for him.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Xu Ye said:
“I saw you chasing down a cultivator from the Puppet Guild, what on earth is going on?”
“Don’t tell me you’ve been exposed?”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“`
“Hmm, yes…”
“Yesterday, I didn’t hide my identity and took a stroll on the Blood Beach, and they followed me.”
Xu Ye was startled and quickly asked:
“Lin Daoyou, why did you do that?”
Lin Jing looked up into the distance, fell silent for a moment, and then said:
“Consider it an act of revenge for friends. They killed two of my acquaintances in their search for me.”
Upon hearing this, Xu Ye’s eyebrows immediately furrowed:
“It’s like that…”
“Now that you’ve killed people from the Puppet Guild, they definitely won’t let you off.”
“What are your plans now? Are you going to hide again, or are you going to fight them head-on?”
“Do you need my help?”
Lin Jing then turned his head, looked towards Xu Ye, and said:
“Speaking of which, there really is something I need your help with, Xu Daoyou.”
Xu Ye hurriedly said:
“What is it? Please tell me, Lin Daoyou.”
Lin Jing then said:
“I need you to expose the location of my cave to them.”
Lin Jing’s words startled Xu Ye:
“Lin Daoyou, what do you mean by this?”
“If you expose the location of your cave, you’ll truly be in danger. I know the Puppet Guild Leader; he will definitely take the opportunity to retaliate against you at night.”
Lin Jing said:
“No worries…”
“I’ve already found a way to deal with him. I’m not afraid of him coming; I’m afraid he won’t come.”
Xu Ye looked at Lin Jing with a puzzled expression and said:
“Lin Daoyou, are you that confident?”
Lin Jing replied:
“Hmm…”
Seeing Lin Jing’s resolute attitude, Xu Ye nodded and then said:
“Alright…”
“Since Lin Daoyou says so, then I will do as you ask and expose the location of this cave.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“In that case, I’ll trouble you, Xu Daoyou…”
…
…
In the blink of an eye, several days had passed.
During these few days, the entire Blood Beach was abuzz with the incident involving Lin Jing.
However, Lin Jing had yet to make an appearance.
Aside from Lin Jing, even the people from the Puppet Guild had been keeping a low profile for these two days.
Lin Jing was originally waiting for the Puppet Guild Leader to bring his men, but there had been no movement for the past two days.
Even the location of Lin Jing’s cave had been secretly leaked to the Puppet Guild by Xu Ye.
But even so, the Puppet Guild Leader had still made no move.
Lin Jing had planned that if the Puppet Guild Leader really came with people to block him during the day, he would hide in the System Space to avoid them.
But now, to his surprise, no one came by even at night.
Just as Lin Jing was growing impatient and planned to take another walk near the Blood Beach, the Puppet Guild finally took action.
Under Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surveillance, the Puppet Guild had set up an encirclement around the mountain where Lin Jing was located.
This time, the Puppet Guild directly deployed eighteen cultivators around Lin Jing’s mountain.
Moreover, they had set up a large Formation around the mountain Lin Jing was on.
The Puppet Guild’s actions were extremely covert; if not for Lin Jing’s powerful Divine Sense, he likely wouldn’t have discovered any of this.
All of this was happening quietly…
Of course, this quietness was what the Puppet Guild members believed to be the case.
In fact, everything they did was under Lin Jing’s surveillance.
This incident gave Lin Jing a new understanding of the Puppet Guild Leader.
With so many subordinates, he was still so cautious.
He even wanted to quietly encircle him.
While they were busy, Lin Jing naturally couldn’t just sit idly by; he had already modified the cave.
It was interconnected in every direction.
Besides that, Lin Jing placed a large black stone at intervals within the cave.
His purpose was naturally to disrupt their operations.
Though Lin Jing was inside the cave and didn’t go out, his Divine Sense had long probed out to observe their actions, even carefully watching the Formation they had set up.
Just to ensure there were no oversights.
You must know, in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, Spirit Stones are incredibly precious.
And setting up a Formation requires a large number of Spirit Stones, so it was clear that the Puppet Guild Leader had really spared no expense to deal with him.
And so…
Until this day, as night fell, the Puppet Guild’s people were all prepared.
Including the Puppet Guild Leader, eighteen Puppet Cultivators had encircled Lin Jing.
The Puppet Guild had only a little over forty members, so these eighteen accounted for almost half of their number.
Although they had strength in numbers, Lin Jing was not afraid.
As long as the Puppet Guild Leader made a move, that would be sufficient.
If it really came to a fight, Lin Jing would let them know what it meant to ‘fight fire with fire.’
Soon, the sky darkened.
At this time, the blood corpses were about to emerge.
Lin Jing took advantage of this moment to probe out with his Divine Sense once more, confirming the positions of the Puppet Guild’s cultivators surrounding him, as well as the Puppet Guild Leader’s location.
Once sure there were no errors, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense.
Next…
He just needed to wait for the blood corpses to appear, and then Lin Jing could start his move…

chapters.title: Chapter 457: 154 Night Action
chapters.content:
Chapter 457: Chapter 154 Night Action
It wasn’t long before night fell.
Outside, the rustling sounds could be heard again.
Soon after, the noises stopped.
And then, a new voice came from outside:
“Uncle Lin Jing…”
“Mommy isn’t home, Luo Luo came to play with you.”
This time, it was Luo Luo’s voice.
Lin Jing was taken aback for a moment, then shook his head helplessly.
The voices that the soul-eating spirits created were always those he was once familiar with.
Just like Luo Luo…
If it were the real Luo Luo, she should be grown up into a young woman by now.
Not still the same child he once knew, with such a tender, childish voice.
The seduction of the soul-eating spirits was getting quite uninspired.
Following that, Lin Jing gathered his focus and immediately condensed his Divine Sense to probe outward.
Outside Lin Jing’s cave, sure enough, there were blood corpses and soul-eating spirits.
And as soon as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached out, it was attacked by the soul-eating spirits.
However, fortunately, Lin Jing was well-prepared.
Such attacks were not a concern for him.
Knowing that the zombies had come to his door, it was now time for Lin Jing to take action.
Right after withdrawing his Divine Sense, Lin Jing immediately summoned the system and entered into the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing did not linger but spoke up directly:
“System…”
“Activate Fixed Point Teleportation!”
As Lin Jing’s words ended, the system began to respond.
The teleportation function of the system activated, like entering Observation Mode.
Lin Jing’s perspective began to shift, appearing above the mountaintop.
At this moment, the moon had not yet risen.
It was an opportune time for action.
Otherwise, it would be more troublesome once the moon appeared.
Next, a rough area appeared before Lin Jing’s eyes.
This view was the range within which Lin Jing could teleport.
Lin Jing then directly chose a mountaintop closest to one of the Puppet Guild members for teleportation.
As Lin Jing selected the teleportation location, the system’s prompt tone also sounded at this time.
“System notification: Fixed Point Teleportation successful, deducting Harvest Points: 1 point.”
“Current Harvest Points remaining: 2084 points.”
Soon after, Lin Jing felt a tearing force, and the scenery in front of his eyes began to blur.
Then, by the time Lin Jing’s vision cleared again,
he had arrived at the location he had selected. Just as Lin Jing appeared, his Divine Sense was immediately attacked by the soul-eating spirits.
And Lin Jing also saw several blood corpses speeding towards his location.
At night, as soon as any living creature appears, the blood corpses could immediately sense it.
That was why this situation occurred.
Lin Jing didn’t now have the time to entangle with these blood corpses. Upon emerging, he dashed at high speed towards the mountains outside.
With Lin Jing’s speed, even the blood corpses were left far behind.
It wasn’t until Lin Jing reached the edge of the Formation that he came to a stop.
Then, right at the edge of the Formation, Lin Jing entered System Space again.
After Lin Jing entered the System Space, the blood corpses that had been pursuing him suddenly stopped.
They seemed to be frozen in place, remaining where they were.
It was only after a moment that the blood corpses began to move again, heading towards a nearby peak.
Lin Jing didn’t enter System Space because of the blood corpses,
but because of the great Formation.
This Formation was composed of several Fourth Rank Formations, which had encircled the mountain peak where he was located.
The purpose was to trap him on that mountain peak, preventing his escape.
Of course, there was another reason.
It was to protect themselves.
The Body Refinement Cultivator who had braved the assault of the blood corpses and forcefully killed one of their Puppet Guild members had left them all shaken.
The aim of this Formation was naturally to prevent such an incident from happening again.
And Lin Jing’s re-entry into System Space was also to use Fixed Point Teleportation again to pass through the Formation.
This way was not only convenient but would also catch them by surprise.
After entering System Space, Lin Jing once again activated the Fixed Point Teleportation function.
This time, Lin Jing directly selected a cave of a Puppet Guild Cultivator that was relatively close.
Then he used the Fixed Point Teleportation function.
“System notification: Fixed Point Teleportation successful, deducting Harvest Points: 1 point.”
“Current Harvest Points remaining: 2083 points.”
As the system’s prompt sounded, Lin Jing directly arrived inside the cultivator’s cave abode.
The moment Lin Jing appeared, he threw a punch out.
This cultivator was controlling a puppet, heading towards Lin Jing’s cave.
However, while he was manipulating the puppet, a sudden and extreme sense of danger overwhelmed him.
At that moment, before he could react, his body was pierced straight through by a fist.
Only at this point did he come out of his control over the puppet and regain his senses, then he saw the fist that had gone through his body.
Afterward, the man turned around and saw Lin Jing.
The terror and confusion in his eyes were even more intense…
“You…”
“How did you appear here…”
However, Lin Jing had no time to answer his question.
Afterward, Lin Jing’s spiritual power erupted, directly destroying the man’s divine sense.
The man fell to the ground with a “thud”.
Even in death, his eyes remained wide open.
The confusion in his gaze seemed to linger for a long time.
With that, the first person was taken care of.
After dealing with the first, Lin Jing no longer hid.
He took the man’s Storage Bag and directly shattered the boulder blocking the entrance to the man’s cave.
By now, he was outside the range of the Formation, and naturally, Lin Jing didn’t need to hide anything.
At this moment, the Cultivators from the Puppet Guild were busy controlling the puppets and heading towards their own caves.
They were completely neglecting their own stronghold.
Moreover, even if they did hear some noise, would they dare believe it?
Would they dare to extend their Divine Sense to check?
Therefore, in the night, Lin Jing could maximize his advantages.
And eliminate these people one by one.
The second Cultivator from the Puppet Guild that Lin Jing was looking for was not far from this peak, on a smaller hill. His cave was there.
However…
Just now, as Lin Jing broke the black boulder, those blood corpses immediately rushed in.
At the same time, the Soul-Eating Yin Spirit continuously launched attacks on Lin Jing’s divine sense.
Even the Cultivator from the Puppet Guild whom Lin Jing had just killed stood up once more.
However, when he stood up this time, his expression was dull, and his eyes lifeless.
Clearly, he had become a walking corpse.
Seeing the blood corpses coming at him, Lin Jing immediately took action, sending several multicolored streaks of light into the bodies of the blood corpses.
Then, with a thought from Lin Jing, those multicolored streaks of light exploded within the blood corpses.
They were blown into chunks, and even that Soul-Eating Yin Spirit was thereby affected.
Temporarily halting its attack on Lin Jing.
Next, the eyes of the Soul-Eating Yin Spirit turned red, and in its hands, a red blood sphere appeared.
Then, the Soul-Eating Yin Spirit waved its hands continuously, and the blood sphere split, turning into several droplets of blood that flew towards the blood corpses.
Upon contact with the blood, those blood corpses began to wriggle.
In no time, countless pieces of flesh gathered, and the blood corpses revived once more.
Seeing the blood corpses resurrected again, Lin Jing paid them no further attention and instead bypassed these corpses, continuing his charge towards the next person.
These blood corpses were really like dog skin plasters, impossible to shake off.
Seeing Lin Jing attempting to leave, the blood corpses directly blocked Lin Jing’s path and launched an attack on him.
Lin Jing had no time to entangle with these blood corpses.
Hence, he immediately unleashed his extreme speed to get rid of the blood corpses and continued to fly towards the cave of the second Cultivator from the Puppet Guild.
……
Upon reaching the second cave, outside the cave, there was still a Soul-Eating Yin Spirit and several blood corpses.
Seeing Lin Jing flying over, the Soul-Eating Yin Spirit and the blood corpses directly launched an attack on him.
But Lin Jing didn’t even dodge, directly charging at the blood corpses.
This time, Lin Jing’s body was covered with a layer of golden light, and he had activated his Overlord Body.
Lin Jing simply threw a punch, and the blood corpse blocking him in front burst open, then turned into countless chunks that scattered on the ground.
Lin Jing didn’t stop, he went straight to the entrance of the cave and with a punch shattered the black boulder blocking the entrance.
Inside the boulder, there was also a Magical Treasure meant for alerts, which Lin Jing similarly smashed with a punch.
However, after breaking through the cave, there was no one inside.
Lin Jing, of course, knew this.
Perhaps out of habit or due to caution.
The person was not in this cave, but in another cave deep inside this layer.
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense had already made that clear.
The Cultivator, after Lin Jing shattered the black boulder, immediately gave up control of the puppet and came to his senses.
Upon regaining consciousness, he knew someone had attacked his cave.
Therefore, he promptly abandoned his original place and continued to hide further inside the cavern.
His cave was also interconnected in many directions.
If it were an ordinary Cultivator facing this situation, they might really have left.
But under Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, all of his actions were clearly visible.
So, Lin Jing directly took out the Ling Yin Flawless Sword and sent it slashing into the depths of the cave.
The seemingly inconspicuous stone wall behind the cave was immediately penetrated by the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, revealing the inner cave.
After that, Lin Jing directly maneuvered the Flawless Sword, breaking through several boulders in succession.
Finally, just in front of the boulder where the person was hiding, a shout came from inside the cave:
“Senior, I was blind to Mount Tai…”
“Please, spare my life, senior. From now on, at any time, I will follow your lead and be at your disposal.”
In response to this person’s pleas, Lin Jing paid no heed.
Although this person was smart and cautious, he had joined the Puppet Guild and clearly was not a good person by any means.
Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t let this person go.
Then, with a thought from Lin Jing.
The Ling Yin Flawless Sword struck once more, targeting the last boulder…
…
…
A moment later, there was an additional walking corpse in this place…
After killing this person, the next closest was the leader of the Puppet Guild…

chapters.title: Chapter 458: 155: Snatching the Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 458: Chapter 155: Snatching the Treasure
After killing that Puppet Guild cultivator, Lin Jing once again burst forth at extreme speed and left the person’s cave.
He immediately rushed towards a nearby mountain peak where the Puppet Guild Leader resided…
The mountain peak where the Puppet Guild Leader resided was extremely easy to recognize as the tallest mountain peak in this area.
Before long, Lin Jing ascended the mountain peak where the Puppet Guild Leader resided and arrived at the entrance to the Puppet Guild Leader’s cave.
This entrance to the Puppet Guild Leader’s cave was also protected by a separate Fourth Rank Defensive Array.
And even those blood corpses were kept out by the array.
In this Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, due to the absence of Spiritual Energy, one could only rely on Spirit Stones to provide the Spiritual Power needed for the operation of a formation.
This formation consumed a considerable number of Spirit Stones overnight, at least a few thousand, if not tens of thousands of Medium Grade Spirit Stones.
Moreover.
That was just the consumption needed to maintain the formation.
If the formation were attacked, it would probably consume even more fiercely; tens of thousands of Spirit Stones might not even be sufficient.
Keep in mind that this was only the consumption for one night; over a longer period, the cost would be even greater…
The Puppet Guild Leader was indeed quite generous.
……
At this moment, Lin Jing was flying at top speed. Behind him followed the blood corpses he had encountered in those two caves, amounting to as many as nine.
When Lin Jing arrived at the Puppet Guild Leader’s cave, those five blood corpses, which had originally been blocked outside the array, also charged towards Lin Jing upon detecting him.
All together, there were fourteen blood corpses and three Soul Devouring Yin Spirits.
Lin Jing was not worried about the blood corpses; the only thing giving him a headache was those Soul Devouring Yin Spirits.
One of these Soul Devouring Yin Spirits alone wasn’t much of a threat.
But these three together…
When their Divine Sense attacks overlapped and amplified each other’s effects, they could unleash even greater power.
These Divine Sense attacks were so powerful that even Lin Jing felt a faint pain in his mind and struggled to withstand it.
Seeing the blood corpses gathering, Lin Jing dared not be careless any longer and directly summoned the system to enter the System Space.
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing immediately took out a Yellow Dragon Elixir and swallowed it.
Having expended a lot of Spiritual Power in killing those two people and facing the blood corpses, Lin Jing took this opportunity to replenish his energy.
This time he was facing the Puppet Guild Leader, and Lin Jing needed to be fully prepared.
After taking the Yellow Dragon Elixir and recovering for a while in the System Space, Lin Jing once again summoned the system and activated the Fixed Point Teleportation feature.
Due to the existence of that array, Lin Jing needed to use Fixed Point Teleportation to enter inside the array.
Otherwise, it would be extremely difficult to break through the array from the outside.
Naturally, Lin Jing would not do such a thankless task.
It would be much better to teleport directly inside, kill the Puppet Guild Leader, and solve the problem once and for all.
After entering Observation Mode, Lin Jing selected the inside of the cave and initiated Fixed Point Teleportation.
As Lin Jing chose to teleport, the system notification sound also rang out at this time.
“System notification: Fixed Point Teleportation successful, deducting Harvest Points: 1 point.”
“Current Harvest Points remaining: 2082 Harvest Points.”
…
…
Clothed in a grey robe, the Puppet Guild Leader looked extremely mysterious. After using Fixed Point Teleportation, Lin Jing appeared directly behind the Puppet Guild Leader.
Immediately, Lin Jing threw a punch and attacked the Puppet Guild Leader.
Because Lin Jing’s appearance was so sudden, it wasn’t until Lin Jing’s fist landed that the Puppet Guild Leader became aware.
However, even though Lin Jing’s fist had struck, he felt that something was off.
The punch had not landed on his body but on the grey robe.
Where Lin Jing’s fist made contact with the robe, it did not shatter but instead flipped over, turning into a massive pocket, attempting to envelop Lin Jing within.
It seemed that this grey robe was a Magical Treasure of no low grade.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly retreated.
At the same time, he drew out the Ling Yin Flawless Sword and stabbed towards the grey robe, trying to cut it apart.
As Lin Jing retreated, he also saw the Puppet Guild Leader roll forward, moving out of Lin Jing’s attack range.
The Ling Yin Flawless Sword swiftly stabbed forward and soon made contact with the robe.
However, the normally extremely sharp Ling Yin Flawless Sword could not leave even a mark on the grey robe.
And the robe directly wrapped up the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, rendering it immobile.
Quickly…
Lin Jing lost control over the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, and his connection to it vanished.
Lin Jing was shocked, not expecting the grey robe to be so formidable that it could sever the link between a Magical Treasure and its owner.
Seeing that Lin Jing could no longer control the Ling Yin Flawless Sword,
The Puppet Guild Leader reached out with his hand, and the robe returned to his grasp.
This time, bringing with it the Ling Yin Flawless Sword.
Only then did Lin Jing look up and get a clear view of the Puppet Guild Leader’s face.
The Puppet Guild Leader looked utterly ordinary, the kind that would go unnoticed even when thrown into a crowd.
But he was extremely cautious, and when he looked at Lin Jing, he did so with a strong sense of curiosity.
Next to him stood a puppet, and the aura emanating from the puppet was also very formidable.
The aura of the puppet was at the very least equivalent to a Golden Core Peak cultivator.
It seemed that the Puppet Guild Leader had quite a few tricks up his sleeve.
Previously, Lin Jing had also inquired about the Puppet Guild Leader, but he never knew that his grey robe had such an effect.
Nor had the Golden Core Peak puppet ever been displayed in public.
……
At this time, the Puppet Guild Leader curiously looked at Lin Jing and asked,
“My cave is clearly protected by a formation, how did you manage to pass through the formation and come into my cave, hmm?”
“And without damaging the black boulder.”
Lin Jing swept a glance at the grey robe and the puppet before turning to the Puppet Guild Leader and spoke:
“You’ve hidden your capabilities so deeply, possessing such a magical treasure and puppet, yet never making them known.”
The Puppet Guild Leader then spoke to Lin Jing:
“Hand over the method you used to pass through the formation and enter this cave, and I might spare you.”
Lin Jing snorted coldly and said:
“Dream on…”
With that, he charged straight forward toward the Puppet Guild Leader.
The Puppet Guild Leader stepped back two paces, watching Lin Jing with wariness.
He immediately chanted an incantation, and under his spell, the Golden Core Peak puppet’s eyes snapped open, awakening, and charged towards Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing also made his move, trading a punch with the puppet.
“Boom!”
A loud noise erupted, and Lin Jing was shaken back several steps by the punch.
Meanwhile, the puppet was only forced back two steps.
In this head-on clash, Lin Jing seemed to be at a slight disadvantage.
It should be noted that Lin Jing cultivated the Overlord Divine Physique, which was unlike that of ordinary Body Refinement Cultivators.
Lin Jing then shook his numb arm, his gaze locked onto the Golden Core Peak puppet.
The Puppet Guild Leader across from him was equally astonished.
After all, his puppet was not ordinary.
This puppet had consumed countless efforts of his; although it appeared to be only at the Golden Core Peak, its true combat power was almost on par with a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
And now, a Body Refinement Cultivator was able to match this puppet.
Next, the Puppet Guild Leader looked at Lin Jing and said:
“Give up. You can’t possibly be a match for my puppet.”
“As long as you leave behind the method you used to penetrate into this defensive array, I will spare your life, and you can even join the Puppet Guild.”
“I truly do not wish to be enemies with someone as strong as you.”
Facing the words of the Puppet Guild Leader, Lin Jing naturally held them in contempt:
“Do you really think that with this puppet, you can defeat me?”
The Puppet Guild Leader replied:
“My puppet might not be able to hold you down, but you won’t be able to escape my Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe.”
“This Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe is a Dao Artifact capable of enveloping all things in heaven and earth. Any magical treasure, once shrouded by it, can be disconnected from its owner and claimed as my own…”
While the Puppet Guild Leader spoke, he retrieved the Ling Yin Flawless Sword from within the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe.
At this moment, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword was covered with a layer of grey.
Seeing him take out the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, Lin Jing tried to wield it but found it completely beyond his control.
The Puppet Guild Leader thus directly placed the Ling Yin Flawless Sword into his own Space Ring in front of Lin Jing.
Then, the Puppet Guild Leader continued:
“If you hand over the technique that allows you to silently enter my defensive formation, I will spare your life, and you can also join the Puppet Guild.”
Lin Jing gave a cold laugh and said:
“Aren’t you going to avenge your brother’s death?”
However, the Puppet Guild Leader was remarkably calm as he replied:
“He was just a half-brother, arrogant and bound to meet disaster. Even if he didn’t die at your hands, he would have perished by someone else’s sooner or later, it’s nothing unusual…”
“If not for the reputation of my Puppet Guild, I really wouldn’t want to make an enemy of you.”
“With your exceptional skills, if we work together, we can certainly leave the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.”
Lin Jing then looked at the Puppet Guild Leader and said:
“However, do you really think that with just a puppet and that grey robe, you can take me down?”
The Puppet Guild Leader frowned, observing Lin Jing for a moment, then spoke:
“Your Flying Sword has been taken by me, and your Body Refinement skills are restrained by my puppet. Do you have any other means to counter my Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and puppet?”
Lin Jing laughed coldly and answered:
“You can try…”
Upon hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader’s brow furrowed even deeper. After surveying Lin Jing once more, he said:
“I don’t believe you possess an artifact beyond the level of a Dao Artifact. As long as it is not an artifact of that caliber, no magical treasure or Dao Artifact can escape the envelopment of the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe.”
Having said that, the Puppet Guild Leader once again chanted, and the puppet lunged forward, attacking Lin Jing.
At the same moment, the Puppet Guild Leader also controlled the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, attempting to shroud Lin Jing within it.
Then, the Puppet Guild Leader said:
“Once trapped by the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, even with the strength to reach heaven, you can’t break free…”
Facing the combined attack of the puppet and the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, Lin Jing was not only unafraid but even rushed forward, with a faint smile playing at the corners of his mouth.
This outcome was exactly what Lin Jing had wanted.
When the Puppet Guild Leader saw the smile on the corner of Lin Jing’s mouth, his heart skipped, and he instantly felt uneasy.
Although he was not clear on what was wrong, his innate caution prompted him to beat a retreat.
He wanted to retract his Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe immediately.
Seeing the Puppet Guild Leader attempt to take back the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, Lin Jing certainly wouldn’t allow it.
Ever since he saw the capabilities of the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, Lin Jing had set his sights on it.
Now, with his plan nearing success, how could he allow the Puppet Guild Leader to take back the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe?
Next…
Lin Jing burst forth with extreme speed, suddenly appearing next to the retreating Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, grabbing hold of it.
His other hand had already grasped the Golden Core Peak puppet’s arm.
At the same time, Lin Jing silently summoned in his mind:
“Enter the System Space…”

chapters.title: Chapter 459: 156: The Puppet Guild Leader of Duobao
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 156: The Puppet Guild Leader of Duobao
After the spatial transmission was initiated, this time it was different from past teleportations; a force that seemed to want to tear through space came, attempting to transfer Lin Jing into the midst of it.
However, both the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet at the peak of the Golden Core stage were frantically resisting this spatial tearing force.
Nevertheless.
The item that Lin Jing had grasped in his hand was futile to escape, even if it wanted to.
Because the transmission from the System Space followed system rules and was not like other teleportation arrays.
If it were another teleportation array, it might be possible for the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet to slip away.
But the transmission function of the System Space wouldn’t allow it…
Afterward, Lin Jing felt himself enshrouded by an extremely familiar aura, the unique aura that only the System Space possessed.
And it was not just Lin Jing…
The familiar aura even wrapped up the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet at the peak of the Golden Core stage in Lin Jing’s hand.
Immediately following that, Lin Jing’s vision blurred, and the scenery became indistinct…
When Lin Jing could see clearly once again, he had already entered the System Space.
This time, he was again met with the view of the vast and lush green Earth Spirit Fields, and the Spiritual Energy within this space felt so refreshing.
And in Lin Jing’s hand, he was still holding onto the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet at the peak of the Golden Core stage.
If it hadn’t been for the Puppet Guild Leader using the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe to take away his Ling Yin Flawless Sword, Lin Jing would not have thought of this method.
It was unexpected that even on someone as cautious as the Puppet Guild Leader, there would still be such good items.
Now, within the System Space, the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe had lost control and drooped down, and the puppet at the peak of the Golden Core also closed its eyes once more, no longer moving.
Things that entered the System Space were naturally disconnected from the outside world. This time, the Puppet Guild Leader had indeed suffered a huge loss.
Subsequently, Lin Jing threw both the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet at the peak of the Golden Core into the System Space.
He himself, on the other hand, left the System Space once more.
Now with the Puppet Guild Leader still outside, Lin Jing had no time to refine those two treasures.
When Lin Jing returned to the cave, and the Puppet Guild Leader saw him, he immediately asked:
“Who exactly are you?”
“It’s impossible, absolutely impossible…”
“The Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe was my life-bound Magical Treasure refined with the Blood Refinement Method, and that puppet was consecrated by me with a special technique; it’s impossible for them to lose connection with me…”
At this moment, the Puppet Guild Leader no longer had his previous caution and composure, replaced instead by a face filled with shock and fear.
Because, the Lin Jing before him was too bizarre.
He had vanished suddenly, then reappeared just as quickly, and took the two most important things to him.
He also took away his biggest reliance.
No matter what, he could not sense the presence of those two items.
He was extremely panicked at this point, continuing to ask Lin Jing:
“Who exactly are you?”
“How can you come and go as you please in this Devouring Spirit Blood Realm?”
“Do you have any connection with that Divine Transformation Cultivator?”
At this point, the Puppet Guild Leader suddenly stopped being panicked but his eyes lit up, suddenly excited:
“That’s it…”
“Only that way could you move freely in this Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.”
Having said that, he directly opened his Space Ring and took out the Ling Yin Flawless Sword.
Then he said:
“I will return your Flying Sword…”
“I will also give you the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and that puppet; I assure you I will not be your enemy anymore, I only ask you to help me get out.”
At this moment, the Puppet Guild Leader seemed like he had found a lifesaver, hurriedly speaking to Lin Jing with an eager face.
Lin Jing, upon seeing this scene, was also taken aback.
He had not expected the Puppet Guild Leader to mistake him for the underling of a Divine Transformation Cultivator.
However, facing the Puppet Guild Leader, Lin Jing showed no good expression.
He directly said:
“Want to get out? Dream on!”
Then the Puppet Guild Leader’s face stiffened, but he quickly replied:
“I can give you everything, I can even be your servant, as long as you take me out, you can have whatever you want…”
At this moment, the Puppet Guild Leader was almost frenzied, so desperate to get out that he was disregarding everything else.
Lin Jing looked at the Puppet Guild Leader, his brow furrowed slightly, then he said to him:
“You want me to take you out?”
After hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader nodded repeatedly, his eyes filled with hope as he looked at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing smiled at the corner of his mouth and said again:
“Okay…”
“First, dismantle this formation, and then I can take you out.”
After hearing this, the Puppet Guild Leader was first taken aback, then nodded and said:
“Sure…”
“I will dismantle this Defensive Array right now.”
Having said that, he walked towards the Formation Eye at the center of the formation.
Next, the Puppet Guild Leader approached the Formation Eye, his back to Lin Jing, and then placed his hand on the Formation Eye, chanting an incantation.
The entire formation’s Formation Patterns then surfaced, and those patterns also began to fade slowly.
It looked like the formation was about to be dismantled.
But just at that moment…
The Puppet Guild Leader suddenly let out a fierce shout:
“Freeze!”
In that instant, a red light burst forth from the palm of his hand, spreading rapidly throughout the entire cave.
The moment the red light touched Lin Jing, he felt his Divine Sense being assaulted; he could not move, and even the Spiritual Power within his body became stagnant and was impossible to mobilize.
This attack appeared to be related to Divine Sense.
Meanwhile, a red light protected the Puppet Guild Leader himself, leaving him unharmed.
The sudden appearance of this red light was too abrupt; Lin Jing hadn’t even had time to react before he was immobilized on the spot.
Only then did the Puppet Guild Leader turn around. At the same time, a red bead appeared in his hand.
The Puppet Guild Leader now had a smile of successful conspiracy on his face as he said to Lin Jing:
“This Boundary-Fixing Spirit Bead can even freeze space itself, I don’t believe that you can still escape like this…”
“Today, only by killing you can I truly be at ease…”
“Go to hell…”
As he spoke, the Puppet Guild Leader’s smile disappeared, and his gaze became fixed, as he directly summoned his Flying Sword and attacked Lin Jing.
Facing the incoming Flying Sword, Lin Jing showed no sign of panic.
Instead, he chanted silently in his heart:
“System!”
“Activate the Strengthening Possession feature.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, Strengthening Possession was activated, and the system prompt followed.
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Strengthening Possession activated successfully, 5 Harvest Points deducted, 1 Harvest Point will be deducted every minute after 5 minutes.”
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged, and his body regained mobility instantly.
Even the Spiritual Power in his body, which had been stagnant, began to circulate again.
What Boundary-Fixing Spirit Bead? It was nothing more than a simulation of Divine Sense pressure, a special kind of Divine Sense attack. As long as one’s Divine Sense was strong enough, it could be lifted.
In fact, when the Puppet Guild Leader first took out the Boundary-Fixing Spirit Bead, Lin Jing had already known.
Lin Jing had originally thought it was another offensive Magical Treasure that needed to be used against oneself to attack.
Lin Jing was already prepared to dodge into the System Space at any moment.
To his surprise, the Puppet Guild Leader launched the attack directly while his back was turned toward Lin Jing.
Lin Jing himself didn’t react in time.
However, it was also because of the special nature of the Boundary-Fixing Spirit Bead’s attack that Lin Jing understood its actual effect.
And when the red light swept over him, it further confirmed Lin Jing’s conjecture.
Therefore, he had activated the Strengthening Possession feature just as the Puppet Guild Leader was preparing to make his move.
……
Just as the Puppet Guild Leader commanded his Flying Sword to kill, Lin Jing, who had shaken off the influence of the red light and recovered, burst forth at high speed, charging toward the Puppet Guild Leader.
The Puppet Guild Leader, who had thought Lin Jing couldn’t move and could only wait for death, saw Lin Jing charging again.
His eyes bulged in disbelief.
And Lin Jing also reached the Puppet Guild Leader’s side at that moment.
However, the Puppet Guild Leader reacted incredibly fast, conjuring a shield to block in front of him as Lin Jing charged.
Lin Jing’s charged punch smash hit the Puppet Guild Leader’s shield.
When Lin Jing’s fist landed on the shield, dense formation patterns emerged on it instantly, dissipating all the force from Lin Jing’s punch.
This Puppet Guild Leader…
It had to be said that he really had many Magical Treasures.
After pounding on the shield, Lin Jing then used the force to retreat.
Meanwhile, the Puppet Guild Leader took out a golden whip from his Space Ring and gripped it in his hand.
At the same time, he said to Lin Jing:
“Return my Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and the puppet, and from then on, we’ll stay out of each other’s way.”
This time, the Puppet Guild Leader was extremely serious, and his eyes were filled with caution as he looked at Lin Jing.
Now, he genuinely did not want to be enemies with Lin Jing anymore.
However, Lin Jing had no intention of letting him off so easily.
Sneering coldly, Lin Jing said,
“Hmph!”
“I want to see just how many Magical Treasures you have.”
With that, Lin Jing charged once more at the Puppet Guild Leader.
But this time, not only did the Puppet Guild Leader block with the shield, but he also swung the golden whip.
As the golden whip was wielded, it emitted a golden light, mixed with the sound of a fierce whistling.
Lin Jing, who wanted to charge through, found his movements affected by the golden light, and he slowed down significantly.
Lin Jing, slowed down, couldn’t pose a threat to the Puppet Guild Leader.
Seeing this, Lin Jing had to retreat from the area where the whip was swinging.
The Puppet Guild Leader frowned and said to Lin Jing:
“Give up…”
“You’re just a Body Refinement Cultivator…”
Hearing this, Lin Jing scoffed and said,
“Who said I’m merely a Body Refinement Cultivator?”
Immediately after, Lin Jing activated the Five Elements Divine Art, and a stream of Five Elements Divine Light flew from his hand, quickly heading towards the Puppet Guild Leader.
Seeing this, the Puppet Guild Leader’s face changed drastically and he exclaimed,
“Five Elements Divine Light, you’ve actually cultivated the Five Elements Divine Art…”
At the same time, the Puppet Guild Leader no longer cared about the Magical Treasures in his hand, hastily dropping them and retreating while operating his Cultivation Technique, a light cyan glow radiating from his body in an attempt to resist that colorful stream of light.
Suddenly, the colorful stream of light touched the light cyan glow surrounding him, the two intertwining.
The colorful stream of light was incredibly powerful, completely overpowering the light cyan glow.
Helplessly, the Puppet Guild Leader had to mobilize more of the light cyan glow, enveloping the colorful light to slowly extinguish it.
Finally, after some time, the stream of colorful light was extinguished…
However.
That was just the beginning.
Lin Jing did not give him a chance to catch his breath.
Afterward, Lin Jing activated his Cultivation Technique again, and several streams of Five Elements Divine Light flew out, converging into a mass of colorful light that headed towards the Puppet Guild Leader.
Seeing the light mass, the Puppet Guild Leader became highly alarmed and tried to retreat.
But the cave was only so big; he had nowhere left to retreat.
Seeing that he couldn’t avoid the mass of colorful light, the Puppet Guild Leader shouted to Lin Jing:
“Spare me, I know something about the Five Elements Divine Art…”
But Lin Jing did not hold back, taking advantage of the Puppet Guild Leader’s distraction to burst forth at extreme speed, arriving beside him…
Then he struck out with a punch, sending the Puppet Guild Leader flying.
Lin Jing’s punch was not easy to endure.
With one strike, the Puppet Guild Leader spat out a great mouthful of blood and flew backward.
And that mass of colorful light took the opportunity to enter the Puppet Guild Leader’s body…

chapters.title: Chapter 460: 157: Bountiful Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 157: Bountiful Harvest
Upon seeing the colored light clusters entering his body, the Puppet Guild Leader hurriedly circulated his cultivation technique, increasing the cyan light around him, hoping to force the colored light clusters out of his body.
However, the cyan light, despite becoming increasingly dazzling, was futile.
This was because once the colored light clusters had entered the body of the Puppet Guild Leader, they dispersed again, spreading throughout his body and clinging to his meridians, making them impossible to expel.
Seeing this, the Puppet Guild Leader immediately panicked, quickly wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, and said to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, please show mercy…”
“I know of a cultivation technique that matches your Five Elements Divine Art perfectly.”
“The technique is known as the Immortal Five Elements Technique, and I know where it is. Just spare me, and I’ll tell you.”
Lin Jing had no intention of letting the Puppet Guild Leader off.
However,
