It would affect Xu Ye’s tribulation, and that would be troubling.
……
At this time, near the Sea of Blood beach.
Xu Ye’s Heavenly Tribulation had already taken shape, whether in terms of the clouds’ extent or the pressure beneath them, it was far less than Lin Jing’s tribulation.
Suddenly, a thunderous “boom” resounded through the sky.
It was the first thunderbolt of the tribulation falling.
This thunderbolt was the first of Xu Ye’s tribulation…
This thunderbolt was tremendously powerful.
It left the Wu surnamed cultivator and the other protectors around him utterly shocked.
Of course.
Far away, hundreds of miles distant in the mountain range, Lin Jing also sensed the breath of the thunderbolt as it descended.
Although Lin Jing’s Heavenly Tribulation had arrived first, it was still in the brewing stages.
By now, the tribulation clouds had already enveloped the whole nearby mountain range.
Fortunately, to be cautious earlier,
The Blue-Robed Cultivator and his fellows had asked everyone in the area to leave.
Otherwise, if others were involved in the Heavenly Tribulation, with its power doubled, even Lin Jing himself might have difficulty passing through it safely.
Meanwhile, the Blue-Robed Cultivators below had retreated another distance, and they were now all as quiet as cicadas in winter.
Not daring to make the slightest noise, lest they disturb Lin Jing’s tribulation.
Yet within the hearts of the few, a wave of regret was incessantly spreading.
…
…
Fortunately, though the Heavenly Tribulation was powerful, it had its limits.
And the event that Lin Jing had been worried about did not occur.
After engulfing the nearby mountain range, the clouds of tribulation had ceased expanding, no longer growing.
Instead, the tribulation clouds continued to intensify in a different manner.
The air grew more and more condensed with a potent atmosphere, and even the surrounding pressure of heaven and earth became increasingly intense.
Even the Blue-Robed Cultivators, who hadn’t entered the range of the Heavenly Tribulation, were affected by this terrifying pressure.
They had only endured this pressure of heaven and earth for a short while before they could no longer bear it and retreated dozens of miles away.
They only dared to look on at Lin Jing’s side from a far distance, not daring to get close.
At that moment, the power of the tribulation lightning had fully accumulated.
Continuous muffled rumbles emanated from the tribulation clouds above.
Suddenly.
A bright blue light flashed across the sky…
A thunderous “boom” sounded.
A blue lightning bolt, hundreds of feet thick, struck down, enveloping Lin Jing and the entire mountaintop.
Before that, Lin Jing had activated his Overlord Body, covering himself with a layer of golden light to resist the Heavenly Tribulation.
This first lightning bolt had come fast and left just as swiftly.
Soon, the first bolt of lightning dissipated.
In the aftermath, the ground near Lin Jing was completely scorched black.
Even the very summit where Lin Jing stood had a layer sheared off by that first strike of lightning.
Yet, there was not a single scratch on Lin Jing’s body.
The Blue-Robed Cultivators, who had witnessed the first bolt of lightning, were left dumbfounded.
Such was the power of the first bolt of lightning.
Wouldn’t the subsequent bolts then be several times stronger?
If it were they who faced it, they would likely be severely injured by this first lightning strike.
……
At this time, Lin Jing, looking up at the sky, saw the thunder within the tribulation clouds tumbling unceasingly.
Clearly, the second bolt was garnering strength.
Right then, Lin Jing sensed it.
Another bolt of lightning had descended upon Xu Ye’s location.
This lightning bolt should be Xu Ye’s sixth.
The lightning strikes befalling Xu Ye were much faster than Lin Jing’s.
And so, after waiting a little while longer,
Lin Jing’s second bolt of lightning finally descended.
This second bolt was also blue.
Only, it was much thicker than the first bolt.
In the face of this second lightning strike, Lin Jing, aside from operating the Overlord Divine Physique, did not take any defensive measures.
Of course, there was also a Formation that took on some of the damage from the lightning strike for Lin Jing.
Shortly after, the third bolt arrived…
It was still a blue lightning strike.
This third bolt finally made Lin Jing feel some pressure.
After the third strike, the color of the lightning within the tribulation clouds in the sky changed.
It turned red.
Countless red electric arcs, accompanied by a “rumbling” sound, churned nonstop within the clouds.
After a moment, the rumbling sound suddenly choked.
Lin Jing’s heart went on alert immediately, he looked up quickly while operating the Overlord Divine Physique, ready to withstand the incoming bolt.
Indeed.
Just as the golden light on Lin Jing’s body reached its peak, a red lightning bolt, hundreds of feet thick, struck down in response.
The red lightning was incredibly fierce.
The moment it contacted the Formation set up to aid Lin Jing in his tribulation, it directly shattered it…

chapters.title: Chapter 469: 166 Hidden Truths
chapters.content:
Chapter 469: Chapter 166 Hidden Truths
One must know that the formation was a Fourth Rank Formation.
It was specifically designed for use against Nascent Soul Cultivators, and although it might not have been perfect due to the materials used, it was not far off from a true Fourth Rank Formation.
Unexpectedly, under the assault of the red tribulation lightning, it failed to last even a single breath.
After the formation shattered, the red tribulation lightning struck down towards Lin Jing’s head without any impediment.
Lin Jing hurriedly circulated his Overlord Divine Physique, intensifying the golden radiance around him, doing his utmost to resist the descending red tribulation lightning.
This bolt of red tribulation lightning persisted for a full three breaths before it finally dissipated.
Once the tribulation lightning had vanished, the mountain peak where Lin Jing stood had been sheared off substantially, and the originally red mountaintop had turned even more crimson.
This was because even the rocks themselves had been melted by the tribulation lightning, transforming into glowing red magma.
At this point, to withstand that first bolt of tribulation lightning, Lin Jing had used up quite a bit of spiritual power.
So, Lin Jing quickly took out a flawless Yellow Dragon Elixir from his space ring and swallowed it.
After swallowing it, a warm current created by the elixir’s liquid flowed down into Lin Jing’s abdomen.
Lin Jing then took this opportunity to quickly sit down cross-legged.
Hoping to recover as much as possible.
…
…
But not much time had passed, and Lin Jing had not yet fully recovered when,
he sensed a rumbling within the tribulation clouds above, a sign that the next bolt of tribulation lightning was about to strike.
Consequently, Lin Jing got to his feet, his eyes fixed on the clouds above, ready to face the fifth bolt of tribulation lightning.
“Boom!”
The fifth bolt of tribulation lightning arrived just as Lin Jing had anticipated, right on schedule.
Fortunately, Lin Jing was already well-prepared.
This fifth bolt was strong but could not truly harm Lin Jing.
After the fifth bolt had passed,
the sixth bolt of tribulation lightning followed in quick succession…
The sixth bolt caused Lin Jing some injuries.
Afterwards,
Lin Jing took out another flawless healing pill, the Huansheng Elixir, from his space ring and swallowed it.
After taking the Huansheng Elixir, Lin Jing swiftly sat down cross-legged again, ready to recover…
However, just as Lin Jing had sat down cross-legged,
the color of the tribulation lightning in the sky changed once more.
From red to purple.
And this time, the lightning came swiftly.
Just as Lin Jing had sat down and began his practice, not even completing two cycles, the seventh bolt of purple tribulation lightning struck.
This seventh bolt was utterly sudden,
giving Lin Jing no time to react, and there had been no warning at all beforehand.
When the hundred-zhang-thick purple tribulation lightning cleared, it revealed Lin Jing, who had been struck until his flesh was lacerated and his skin split open.
Moreover, over Lin Jing’s wounds, purple arcs of lightning scurried incessantly, continuously damaging the wounds to prevent them from healing.
Thankfully, Lin Jing’s Overlord Divine Physique healed at an astonishing rate. Although the purple arcs were destroying it, his skin still rapidly restored to its original state.
Next, Lin Jing swallowed another Yellow Dragon Elixir and a Huansheng Elixir.
Preparing for the upcoming eighth bolt of tribulation lightning.
At that moment, Lin Jing also brought out the shield he had obtained from the Puppet Guild Leader, rotating it around himself.
This eighth bolt of tribulation lightning took quite a while to gather.
However, the longer the lightning charged, the more powerful it became.
As the eighth bolt of tribulation lightning descended, it was still a column of purple lightning, but now accompanied by black arcs of lightning that twirled around it.
After the eighth bolt of lightning struck,
Lin Jing swiftly brought out the shield to defend.
However, the shield lasted only a single breath before it was shattered by the tribulation lightning.
Then, unimpeded, the lightning bore down on Lin Jing.
With time ticking away gradually.
The eighth tribulation thunder showed no signs of dissipating.
One breath…
Two breaths…
Three breaths…
…
…
Just like that, a full six breaths passed.
Only then did the eighth tribulation thunder completely scatter.
After the tribulation thunder had dissipated, upon looking at Lin Jing, one could see he was charred all over, almost beyond recognition as a human.
Most of the flesh on Lin Jing’s body had also been melted by the thunder.
At this moment, one could even peer through the charred flesh and see Lin Jing’s heart, weakly pulsating.
Moreover, there were black arcs of lightning traveling incessantly across Lin Jing’s body, causing the already charred wounds on his body to crack and reveal the red flesh underneath.
By this time, the mountain peak where Lin Jing had been standing had long since disappeared, leaving behind only a deep pit.
It was at this moment…
A tremendously strong divine sense swept over the area.
Then, a figure suddenly appeared near the mountain range.
Without using any magical treasures, he stood in midair, his expression cold, but when he looked toward Lin Jing at the center of the tribulation clouds, his eyes filled with concern.
Immediately after, he took a step forward and vanished in an instant, appearing next to the blue-robed cultivator and several others when he re-emerged.
The blue-robed cultivator, seeing the newcomer, quickly bowed his head and cupped his hands, saying:
“Xu Daoyou…”
“Senior Xu…”
It turned out that this individual was none other than Xu Ye, who had just completed his tribulation and successfully advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Xu Ye nodded slightly at him, then asked the blue-robed cultivator:
“Which tribulation thunder is Lin Daoyou currently facing?”
The blue-robed cultivator was somewhat nervous, and he quickly responded:
“Back…back to Senior Xu…
“Lin Daoyou has just passed the eighth tribulation thunder, and now there’s only the last one left.”
Xu Ye looked at him, his brow furrowing slightly, assuming it was the imposing aura he couldn’t quite conceal after his own tribulation that was making the cultivator nervous.
Shortly after, Xu Ye didn’t think much of it and turned his attention back to Lin Jing at the center of the tribulation clouds.
The tribulation clouds in the sky were still brewing the final thunder.
As for Lin Jing, he was rapidly self-recovering at the moment.
The potent medicinal power of the Wugou Huan Sheng Elixir, coupled with the abnormally powerful self-healing ability of the Overlord Divine Physique Lin Jing had cultivated,
took just a few breaths for Lin Jing’s charred flesh to fall off on its own, and for new flesh to quickly regenerate at a pace visible to the naked eye…
Just as Lin Jing was healing, a few more people flew in this direction.
These individuals were none other than the Wu surnamed cultivators who had been Xu Ye’s protectors.
After Wu and the others arrived,
they greeted Xu Ye and proceeded to question the blue-robed cultivator about the situation.
The blue-robed cultivator answered, but his responses were hesitant.
It seemed as if there was something he was concealing.
Wu looked at the blue-robed cultivator, whose gaze, however, was somewhat evasive.
Even the other cultivators standing by the blue-robed cultivator turned their heads aside, as if they had done something wrong.
Some even sneakily glanced at Lin Jing.
Having lived for hundreds of years, Wu, well-versed in the ways of the world,
could not help but realize that there must be some hidden matters.
Then, Wu’s expression darkened as he said to the blue-robed cultivator:
“Qu Daoyou…”
“You and I have known each other for a long while. Speak plainly if there is a hidden matter, for if you wait until Elder Lin has finished the tribulation to tell us, it will be too late…”

chapters.title: Chapter 470: 167: The Last Lightning Tribulation
chapters.content:
470  Chapter 167: The Last Lightning Tribulation
The blue-robed cultivator knew he couldn't escape, so he had no choice but to tell everything that had happened before.
When he heard that a few people were serving as protectors, they abandoned Lin Jing alone and hid by themselves.
The first to react was Xu Ye.
All one could see was Xu Ye's icy gaze turning towards those few blue-robed cultivators...
At the same time, the wild divine sense pressure of the Nascent Soul Stage, without any hesitation, pressed directly towards them.
The few couldn't withstand it and immediately stumbled, kneeling on the ground...
Xu Ye said coldly,
"Is this how you few serve as protectors for Lin Daoyou?"
Facing Xu Ye's pressure, their bodies shook like chaff in the wind...
The blue-robed cultivator hurriedly explained:
"Xu... Senior Xu..."
"We were also possessed by a moment of folly then."
"Seeing that the Heavenly Tribulation had not yet come, and the blood corpses had already revived, we had no choice but to hide."
"We also earnestly beg Senior Xu to spare us..."
However, the explanation of the blue-robed cultivator did nothing to quell Xu Ye's anger.
But just at this moment...
A Wu-surnamed cultivator made a move directly, concentrating spiritual power, forming a huge yellow palm imprint, and slapped down at the few cultivators.
At this time, those few were trembling under Xu Ye's pressure and didn't dare to resist...
With that slap, they all flew backward, coughing up blood.
This slap was certainly not light.
Following that, "plop" "plop"...
The few fell to the ground.
Just then, the Wu-surnamed cultivator stepped forward, berating them and said:
"What did we say before?"
"That as Senior Lin and Senior Xu undergo Tribulation and lead us out, we are to ensure their safety before the Tribulation."
"What did you do?"
The blue-robed cultivators, upon hearing this, hurriedly hung their heads in shame.
And those standing behind the Wu-surnamed cultivator looked at the blue-robed cultivators with scorn on their faces.
They, too, had encountered the same situation earlier.
At that time, Xu Ye also had not yet attracted the Heavenly Tribulation while the blood corpses arrived.
However, not a single one of them retreated; they held off those blood corpses on the outside.
Only after Xu Ye's Heavenly Tribulation descended and the blood corpses collapsed did they finally catch their breath.
Thus, they held disdain for the blue-robed cultivators for their behavior of retreating during the battle...
Following that, the Wu-surnamed cultivator went on to say:
"For such conduct..."
"If not for the need to have you set up the Teleportation Array afterward, I would want to cripple you right now."
At this point, Xu Ye frowned and asked:
"Does the Teleportation Array specifically require these few people to set up?"
The Wu-surnamed cultivator answered:
"Senior Xu..."
"It's not that no one else but these few can do it, but it's not so easy to find someone else at this moment..."
Xu Ye then turned his head to the Wu-surnamed cultivator and said:
"Wu Daoyou, you don't have to call me senior; just calling me Daoyou is fine..."
"You've also felt the Tribulation; I estimate that after we get out, you'll likely undergo Tribulation very soon."
After listening to Xu Ye's words, the Wu-surnamed cultivator nodded, then turned to ask Xu Ye:
"Xu Daoyou..."
"How then should we deal with these few?"
Xu Ye looked at the few and said with a cold face,
"As for these few..."
"I naturally wouldn't presume to make decisions for Lin Daoyou, so let's leave it up to him to handle them..."
Having said that, Xu Ye looked down at Lin Jing, who was sitting in meditation, recovering underneath the thundercloud.
The surnamed Wu cultivator also followed Xu Ye's gaze, looking towards Lin Jing.
Then.
Xu Ye turned his head and said to the surnamed Wu cultivator:
"You have seen Lin Daoyou's Heavenly Tribulation, his accomplishments clearly do not stop here."
"Later, if Lin Daoyou truly does not spare them, don't act smart on your own and try to absolve them of their crimes, otherwise, even I won't be able to save you..."
What Xu Ye referred to was naturally the palm strike from the Wu surnamed cultivator a moment ago.
That one palm strike, although it heavily injured them.
But by acting before Xu Ye, it had reduced Xu Ye's anger and made him show mercy to them.
Otherwise, he truly did not know if an angered Xu Ye would have directly killed them.
......
The surnamed Wu cultivator understood what Xu Ye meant, so he nodded and said:
"Rest assured, Xu Daoyou!"
"At that time, no matter what decision Lin Daoyou makes, I will not interfere..."
Xu Ye nodded slightly, then turned his head again to look at Lin Jing in the Heavenly Tribulation.
......
At this moment, Lin Jing's injuries had healed a lot compared to before, and he was basically in no great danger.
Even the black lightning arcs that had roamed around his body had been absorbed by Lin Jing into his body.
At this point, the thundercloud above Lin Jing's head was still constantly rolling...
And within the thundercloud, numerous black lightning arcs appeared, accompanied by constant "thunderous" dull roars, churning within the thundercloud.
Just as the purple lightning mixed with black lightning arcs was rolling continuously, Lin Jing had already stood up.
Now, new flesh had grown on his body again, and the golden light reflecting on Lin Jing's body started to change once more.
Perhaps due to absorbing the black lightning arcs, hints of black started to appear within the gold, transforming towards a dark golden color.
At this time, Lin Jing stood up, looking up at the thundercloud above his head...
Then, Lin Jing directly summoned the system and silently recited in his mind:
"System..."
"Activate the enhancement possession feature!"
Immediately after, a system prompt sound echoed in Lin Jing's mind:
"Ding!"
"System prompt: Enhancement possession activated successfully, deducting 5 Harvest Points, and after 5 minutes, 1 Harvest Point will be deducted every minute."
The reason for activating the enhancement possession feature was because this last bolt of Tribulation Lightning, like the Heavenly Tribulation of the Golden Core Stage, also contained attacks on the Divine Sense.
This final bolt of Tribulation Lightning was actually the most unexpected and difficult to defend against.
After the activation of the enhancement possession, Lin Jing took out two Pure Elixirs from his Space Ring and swallowed them down.
To fully confront this last bolt of Tribulation Lightning.
Just then.
The thunderclouds in the sky suddenly stopped rolling, and the "thunderous" noise also abruptly came to a halt; even the purple lightning and black lightning arcs disappeared all of a sudden.
Between heaven and earth, the terrifying pressure became even more dreadful at this moment.
Lin Jing knew that the last bolt of Tribulation Lightning was about to come...
Lin Jing quickly gathered his spirit, ready to face the Tribulation Lightning.
"Thunderous Roar!"
...
...
A loud boom came from within the thundercloud, so loud that it could probably be heard clearly hundreds of miles away.
After that, all the lightning within the entire thundercloud converged towards the center.
After gathering in the middle, the lightning turned into a hundred-zhang-thick pillar of purple lightning.
This lightning pillar was not entirely purple.
On the outside, countless black lightning arcs wrapped around the entire pillar.
Just like that, the huge pillar of lightning struck down at Lin Jing.
At this moment, Lin Jing had no defensive Magical Treasures left to use and had to fully operate the Overlord Divine Physique, allowing the light with a hint of dark gold to cover his entire body, facing the descending Tribulation Lightning.
Soon, this last bolt of Tribulation Lightning fell, engulfing Lin Jing entirely within the lightning pillar...

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 168 Successful Tribulation, Nascent Soul 3rd Layer
chapters.content:
Chapter 471 - 168 Successful Tribulation, Nascent Soul 3rd Layer
Within the column of lightning, Lin Jing instantly felt that terrifying pressure of heaven and earth assail his Divine Sense.
At this moment, Lin Jing was in a state of enhanced possession, facing the mighty pressure, he was still able to resist...
But this pressure was only one aspect.
There was also the purple tribulation lightning and those black arcs of lightning.
That were ceaselessly bombarding Lin Jing's body.
Lin Jing's body, amidst this tribulation lightning, was instantly lacerated and flesh torn apart.
And those black lightning arcs, taking advantage of this moment, drilled into Lin Jing's body and wreaked havoc.
Although Lin Jing had the robust recovery ability of the Overlord Divine Physique and the medicinal power of the rejuvenating pill, constantly repairing his body,
this recovery ability still seemed inadequate under the destruction caused by the black lightning arcs.
Soon, Lin Jing's flesh and blood could no longer withstand it and began to slowly dissipate; some areas even revealed the white bones within.
At this point, the tribulation lightning had only lasted for five breaths...
If the estimate wasn't wrong, the duration of Lin Jing's tribulation lightning would be at least nine breaths.
Lin Jing didn't dare to be careless at all.
He even sped up the operation of his Overlord Divine Physique.
In this manner...
The sixth breath, Lin Jing struggled to withstand.
...
The seventh breath, there wasn't a single intact place left on Lin Jing's body...
...
The eighth breath, the power of the purple lightning column doubled, and the flesh on Lin Jing's body was mostly vaporized by the tribulation lightning.
Those black lightning arcs clung to his bones, seemingly burrowing into them.
But Lin Jing still endured through this difficult eighth breath.
Quickly, the ninth breath arrived; as long as he could endure this breath, his tribulation would be considered complete.
Although, at this point, Lin Jing's Divine Sense was almost crushed by the heavenly pressure, to the point of near collapse...
He was still gritting his teeth and persevering...
At this time, the flesh and blood of Lin Jing's entire body were almost completely vaporized, even the internal organs protected by the Spiritual Power were full of cracks...
Lucky for Lin Jing who cultivated the Overlord Divine Physique, otherwise with his current injuries, even a Golden Core Cultivator might not escape death.
Soon.
The ninth breath came...
In just an instant, Lin Jing's bones crumbled...
And the Spiritual Power that protected his vital organs also revealed flaws at this moment.
Those black lightning arcs, taking advantage of this, entered Lin Jing's internal organs and bones...
At this point, Lin Jing wanted to stop them, but he was already powerless to do so.
Under the fierce tribulation lightning, Lin Jing was, by now, almost out of control over his own body, with only his consciousness still somewhat lucid...
If one were to reckon, nine instants would be about the time of one breath; however, the ninth breath of tribulation lightning had passed by only in an instant.
Just when Lin Jing thought the tribulation lightning would lead to failure and he himself would be devoured by it...
Suddenly.
Those black lightning arcs that had entered his body didn't seem to be damaging it, but instead were assisting him in absorbing the tribulation lightning.
As the tribulation lightning was absorbed, Lin Jing's once feeble state quickly improved.
Afterward, the ninth breath passed...
However, the tribulation lightning did not stop and even ushered in the tenth breath...
At this moment, Lin Jing, who was in the midst of the tribulation lightning, was stunned.
Even the people outside watching Lin Jing's tribulation were also stunned.
Everyone knew...
Nine is the extreme number, and the Heavenly Tribulation, at most, lasts for nine breaths...
But Lin Jing's Heavenly Tribulation was not only exceedingly powerful but had even surpassed the commonly known nine breaths of tribulation lightning.
This phenomenon left the onlookers completely dumbfounded.
The Blue-Robed Cultivator and others had bitter expressions on their faces at this moment, deeply regretting their previous actions...
......
The tenth breath of Heavenly Tribulation was different from the previous ones. This tribulation thunder contained a vast amount of Spiritual Power, which poured into Lin Jing's body...
And Lin Jing, under the forceful infusion of the tribulation thunder, seamlessly entered the Nascent Soul Stage.
After entering the Nascent Soul Stage, Lin Jing's body rapidly healed. In just a few moments, Lin Jing's body had restored to its original state...
However, the tribulation thunder still did not stop.
Under the infusion of the tribulation thunder, Lin Jing's body continued to passively receive the terrifying Spiritual Power from it...
Even Lin Jing himself was unable to control it.
Next, the eleventh breath, the tribulation thunder persisted...
And Lin Jing, in the midst of the immense infusion of Spiritual Power, advanced to the second layer of the Nascent Soul Stage.
At this time, Lin Jing, within the midst of the tribulation thunder, was unaware.
But those who were observing the tribulation noticed that the tribulation clouds above Lin Jing's head were shrinking at a visible rate to the naked eye.
As if they were being absorbed by the thick tribulation thunder.
...
...
Yet in the midst of the tribulation thunder, Lin Jing felt remarkably comfortable.
The sensation of increasing cultivation made Lin Jing entirely intoxicated, almost causing him to forget everything in the outside world.
This tribulation thunder ultimately lasted for twelve breaths of time.
After the twelfth breath had passed, Lin Jing's cultivation had finally reached the third layer of the Nascent Soul Stage.
The moment the tribulation thunder disappeared, Lin Jing hurriedly took out clothes to put on.
As for his original clothes, they had long since turned to ash amidst the tribulation thunder.
Next, Lin Jing circulated his Cultivation Technique, feeling his own Spiritual Power.
At the third layer of the Nascent Soul Stage, Lin Jing felt as if in a dream. By merely surviving the Heavenly Tribulation, he had already reached the third layer of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Afterward, Lin Jing looked down at his own body.
Lin Jing's body was now very symmetrical with perfect muscular lines but not overly bulky.
At this time, Lin Jing's skin was no longer as fair as before; it had become somewhat darkened.
Now, he somewhat resembled a Body Refinement Cultivator.
Moreover.
A layer of dark golden light was reflected over Lin Jing's body, an indication that the Overlord Divine Physique had once more improved.
And that was not all. When Lin Jing circulated the Overlord Divine Physique, he could even feel the power of thunder coursing through his body...
However, Lin Jing had yet to experiment with whether his punches would carry the power of thunder when he struck.
Having just successfully undergone the tribulation, and possessing the cultivation of the third layer of the Nascent Soul Stage, stunned those who were watching nearby.
It was a long while before someone came to their senses...
If he could harness this thunderous power within his body for his own use, that would be even more perfect...
Afterwards, Lin Jing looked towards the spectators surrounding him.
Having just successfully undergone the tribulation, and possessing the cultivation of the third layer of the Nascent Soul Stage, stunned those who were watching nearby.
It was a long while before someone came to their senses...
At this time, the first to react
was naturally Xu Ye...
Once Xu Ye came to his senses, he stepped forward, and in the next moment, he arrived beside Lin Jing.
This was a magical ability, reducing the earth to inches, that only Nascent Soul Cultivators could perform.
When Xu Ye arrived next to Lin Jing, he first sized Lin Jing up and down before speaking:
"Lin Daoyou..."
"I never imagined you would be so strong. The Heavenly Tribulation you just went through is simply unheard of."
"Even, after the tribulation..."
"Lin Daoyou, you have already surpassed me by two whole realms, it's really..."
"Before, I was quite confident..."
"But now..."
"In front of Lin Daoyou..."
"I feel like I'm just a piece of trash."

chapters.title: Chapter 472: 169 Strange Demonic Beasts
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 169 Strange Demonic Beasts
Facing Xu Ye’s praise, Lin Jing didn’t know whether to laugh or cry…
“Xu Daoyou…”
“You’re thinking too much. The fact that you were able to successfully advance to the Nascent Soul Stage is already extraordinary…”
“What happened to me was purely an accident.”
“As for why it was like this, I’m not very clear myself.”
After hearing this, Xu Ye expressed his astonishment:
“Lin Daoyou, you actually do not know about your own Heavenly Tribulation?”
Lin Jing shook his head and said:
“No idea…”
“During the Golden Core Tribulation, although it was equally grand in scale, it wasn’t like now, where just undergoing one Tribulation led to an advancement to the third level of the Nascent Soul directly.”
Xu Ye stroked his chin and after pondering for a while, said:
“I’ve never heard of a Heavenly Tribulation like the one Lin Daoyou has just experienced.”
At that moment, the Wu-surnamed cultivator came up and said to Lin Jing:
“Congratulations Lin Daoyou…”
“On successfully advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
Lin Jing nodded slightly and then looked at the Wu-surname cultivator, saying:
“You flatter me, Wu Daoyou…”
“Seeing Wu Daoyou’s extraordinary aura, I estimate that you could soon undergo Tribulation and advance to the Nascent Soul Stage if all goes well!”
The Wu-surnamed cultivator modestly said:
“Yes…”
“However, I can’t compare to Lin Daoyou, who was able to directly advance three minor realms in this Tribulation.”
“It’s truly unprecedented and unheard of…”
Xu Ye also nodded his head in agreement.
Lin Jing could only helplessly shake his head in response.
Afterward, Xu Ye spoke up, glanced at the Blue-Robed Cultivators, and said to Lin Jing:
“Those people should have been your protectors, but they fled at the critical moment, how do you plan to deal with them?”
The Wu-surnamed cultivator also spoke at this moment:
“I am also responsible for this. Choosing the wrong people reflects badly on me, and I’ve let down Lin Daoyou.”
“Here, let me first apologize to Lin Daoyou…”
“As for those few, it’s up to Lin Daoyou to deal with them.”
Lin Jing turned his head and glanced at them.
Then he said to the Wu-surname cultivator:
“Since you called them here, you deal with them.”
The Wu-surname cultivator was stunned for a moment and then asked:
“Me?”
Lin Jing nodded and said, “Yes…”
The Wu-surname cultivator turned to look at Xu Ye and, seeing that Xu Ye had no objection, he gave a cupped-fist salute to Lin Jing and said:
“Rest assured, Lin Daoyou, I will give you a proper resolution…”
Saying this, he left alone, flying towards the direction where the Blue-Robed Cultivators were.
After the Wu-surname cultivator left, Xu Ye asked:
“Why didn’t you just kill them?”
Lin Jing replied:
“After all, they were arranged by Wu Daoyou. It’s better to let him handle it…”
“Besides, among them is an Array Master. If we kill them rashly, we’ll need someone to set up the Teleportation Array when we leave later.”
Hearing this, Xu Ye nodded.
……
Before long, the Wu-surname cultivator returned, holding a Storage Bag in his hand.
After the Wu-surnamed cultivator came back, he handed the Storage Bag directly to Lin Jing, saying:
“This is what those few are offering as compensation for their wrongdoing, Lin Daoyou, please accept it…”
Lin Jing took the Storage Bag and then let his Divine Sense probe into it, taking a glance, and nodded…
Inside the Storage Bag were several million Spirit Stones, along with various Spirit Plants and materials.
What pleased Lin Jing was…
Inside the Storage Bag, there was a Fourth Rank Spirit Plant that Lin Jing had been lacking — the Green Spirit Grass.
Furthermore, this Green Spirit Grass was quite intact, with its roots included, allowing it to be planted in the System Space.
Green Spirit Grass was the main ingredient for refining Green Spirit Pills.
And the Azure Spirit Pill is used to increase one’s Cultivation during the Nascent Soul Stage.
However, Azure Spirit Grass usually only grows in deep mountains with extremely dense Spiritual Energy, which is very rare in the Demonic Monster Sea.
Therefore, Lin Jingzhi had not acquired any until now.
After that, Lin Jing stowed the Storage Bag away.
Then, the Wu-named Cultivator continued:
“Furthermore…”
“Aside from those two Array Masters, I will have the rest scout ahead.”
“As for whether they live or die, that’s up to their fate.”
Lin Jing nodded slightly and said:
“Alright…”
“Let’s do that then…”
Previously, Lin Jing had learned from Shopkeeper Shen’s memory that after leaving the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, the outside would be very dangerous.
There would be strange Demonic Beasts that could attack at any moment.
Setting up the Formation to exit would also require a location that is closest to the exit and rich in Spiritual Energy.
Therefore, someone needed to scout the way.
Originally, the Wu-named Cultivator had already arranged for people to scout ahead.
Now, he was simply adding a few more to the group.
After settling this matter…
The Wu-named Cultivator spoke again to discuss leaving the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm with Lin Jing and another person…
……
Two days later…
On a vast, boundless plain.
A group of Cultivators was walking across the plain in formations.
Each of them was in a defensive stance, being very cautious…
At the very front of the group, two Cultivators were leading the way…
Those two at the forefront were none other than Lin Jing and Xu Ye.
Suddenly.
“Ah…”
A scream rang out, and at the rear of the group of Cultivators, one who was on full alert and defending keenly, was suddenly bisected.
An immense amount of blood spattered onto the yellow-brown ground.
The surrounding Cultivators hastily maneuvered their Magical Treasure Flying Swords, striking towards the front of the Cultivator who was cut in two.
“Boom!”
“Bang!”
“Clang!”
With the sounds of impact, a yellow-brown silhouette appeared in front of the bisected Cultivator.
It resembled a mantis, but its body was as thin as a bamboo pole, with flat forelegs sharp like blades.
At this moment, blood was dripping down from it…
Clearly, the Cultivator had been cleaved in half by this mantis-like bizarre Demonic Beast.
The attacks from the Magical Treasures seemed to barely affect this strange Demonic Beast.
The numerous attacks at most left only shallow marks on its body.
Seeing more Magical Treasures flying towards it, the creature forcefully leapt, instantly retreating a great distance.
After it was out of the reach of the attacks, the strange Demonic Beast’s form began to fade rapidly, and in just a moment, it was no longer visible.
This bizarre Demonic Beast could actually turn invisible.
However, at that moment.
A figure suddenly appeared where the beast had turned invisible.
The figure then struck towards the void with a punch.
There was tremendous force behind the fist, and as it was thrown, one could vaguely see black arcs of lightning appearing.
The person who had appeared suddenly was Lin Jing.
After Lin Jing threw the punch, the mantis-like Demonic Beast’s form was revealed.
Struck by Lin Jing’s punch, the creature’s bamboo-pole-like body snapped in half.
However, it did not die…
Instead, it forcefully pushed off with its legs, dragging the broken half of its body as it pounced towards Lin Jing.
Lin Jing then stepped forward and reappeared right in front of the bizarre Demonic Beast.
He followed up with another punch, blasting a large hole through the Demonic Beast’s head.
And with that, the beast remained frozen in place, then fell heavily to the ground.
Dead beyond any doubt…

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 170 Escaping Danger
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 170 Escaping Danger
After this Demonic Beast died, Lin Jing directly reached his hand into its skull and after groping around for a while, he found a dark brown Demonic Beast Inner Core.
He then wiped it clean and put it away.
After putting away the Demonic Beast Inner Core, Lin Jing once again returned to the front of the group of cultivators…
This time, a thousand people altogether had been deceived into entering the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, but less than two hundred survived and walked out of it.
And among these two hundred people, not many had actually made contributions to leaving the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
But, they were all companions in misfortune.
The cultivator surnamed Wu had previously shared the news about leaving with them, and when faced with their request to travel together, he did not refuse.
Thus, these people left the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm together with Lin Jing and the others.
After leaving the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, everyone arrived at this plain. Although this plain is outside of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm,
it is equally dangerous.
Just like the strange Demonic Beast that resembled a praying mantis, appearing on this plain at any moment.
Moreover, these strange Demonic Beasts are extremely unique.
They can enter an invisible state.
Once entering the invisible state, even Divine Sense can’t detect the Demonic Beasts, making them very eerie.
The moment these people entered the plain, they were attacked by those strange Demonic Beasts.
That attack caused a sudden casualty of twenty or thirty people among those who had just come out of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
Some among them even tried to quickly escape the area by flying on their swords.
However…
Only after they flew into the sky did they realize that it was even more dangerous there.
Because those Demonic Beasts could also fly…
If on the ground, people could still counterattack, then in the sky, they didn’t even have the chance to retaliate.
Several cultivators had just flown up when they were directly split in half by those strange Demonic Beasts.
Eventually, after pooling their wisdom, they formed this mutual defense formation and moved towards the entrance where the Teleportation Array could be set up.
As for the previously planned reconnaissance mission, it had to be scrapped.
Under these circumstances, straying alone meant certain death.
And during Lin Jing’s Tribulation, the few who had hidden away, apart from two Array Masters, who needed to set up the Teleportation Array and were being protected by the cultivator surnamed Wu,
the rest died under the sneak attacks of those strange Demonic Beasts…
…
…
Traveling in a defensive formation, although the pace was slower, under mutual defense, those strange Demonic Beasts dared not attack rashly.
Only occasionally, some more powerful beasts would make sneak attacks when someone let down their guard.
That was what happened just now.
The reason that cultivator was killed was that there was no prior detection by anyone.
It must be due to negligence on the part of that small team.
The invisibility of those Demonic Beasts was particularly powerful; even when concentrating Divine Sense to its full extent for surveillance, they could barely detect the beasts’ shapes a few meters before the creatures lunged at them.
And even for Lin Jing, concentrating Divine Sense to its full extent for surveillance, he could not maintain it for a very long time…
Therefore, over the past couple of days, there were continuous casualties among the cultivators.
Until now, the number of remaining people had already dropped below a hundred…
However.
As everyone proceeded, they clearly felt that the Spiritual Energy was growing richer. It is estimated that it won’t be long before they reached the entrance, set up the Formation, and left this ghastly place.
…
When Lin Jing returned to the front of the group, Xu Ye spoke to Lin Jing:
“Let’s continue on…”
“Quickly get away from this ghastly place…”
Lin Jing nodded and then, together with Xu Ye, led the way at the front, guiding the people behind them as they continued walking forward.
The death of that person just now did not sadden anyone.
At this point, nothing else mattered.
Preserving one’s own life is of utmost importance.
After all, no one knows whether the next stroke of bad luck will fall upon themselves.
…
…
The next day, the remaining group finally made their way out of the plains and arrived at the base of a mountain.
By this time, the team that had originally numbered close to two hundred people had dwindled to only about fifty.
This was simply because the further they went, the more exhausted people became.
And the defensive formation started to and more flaws.
So on this last day, nearly forty people were left behind on the plains, forever.
When they reached the foothills of the mountain, the people did not stop to rest.
They headed up the mountain under the leadership of Lin Jing and Xu Ye.
At this point, the mountain’s spiritual energy was denser than any they had encountered before.
Moreover, since arriving at the base of the mountain, the group had not suffered any attacks.
After climbing some distance and finding no dangers, everyone finally began to relax.
And so, they climbed until they reached the summit.
Atop the mountain, besides the bare peaks, there was a simple courtyard enclosed by a fence.
In the courtyard stood a thatched hut…
And next to that hut was a formation that had been destroyed…
Upon seeing this thatched hut, Lin Jing’s heart couldn’t help but skip a beat…
This house must be the one that Lin Jing had seen in the reflection while in Observation Mode.
At that time, the withered old man was inside this house, and Lin Jing had later confirmed that he was the Divine Transformation Cultivator.
At this moment…
The Wu-surnamed cultivator stepped forward, examined the formation next to the hut, and then said:
“This formation seems to be a Teleportation Array.”
“And it has been damaged.”
After speaking, he gestured towards the Blue-Robed Cultivator and said,
“Come here, take a look at this formation…”
The Blue-Robed Cultivator then walked over, studied the formation closely, and afterward said to the Wu-surnamed cultivator:
“This formation is indeed a Teleportation Array.”
“Furthermore, it was not damaged by someone, but rather, someone used the Teleportation Array to leave, allowing the formation to self-destruct.”
“If we can make use of this self-destructed Teleportation Array, setting up the new one would save us quite a bit of trouble.”
After hearing this, the Wu-surnamed cultivator nodded and said:
“Let’s leave this task to you…”
“This time, I hope you won’t cause me any more problems, or else I won’t be able to protect you.”
Hearing this, the Blue-Robed Cultivator repeatedly nodded, saying:
“Rest assured, this time I will make sure to repair the Teleportation Array properly.”
Before, the Blue-Robed Cultivator along with a few other Array Masters had been protected in the middle of the group, preventing any accidents from befalling them.
Their protection was naturally concerned with this Teleportation Array.
It was time for them to do their part.
Having said this, the Blue-Robed Cultivator immediately called the other Array Masters to start examining the Teleportation Array.
Lin Jing, meanwhile, looked at the thatched hut and said to Xu Ye:
“Fellow Taoist Xu…”
“Shall we go in and take a look?”
Xu Ye nodded and replied,
“Very well…”
With that, the two walked into the courtyard and headed for the thatched hut…

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 171 Leaving
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 171 Leaving
Lin Jing and Xu Ye arrived at the thatched cottage, and with a mere extension of his hand, Xu Ye pushed the door open directly.
Then, what was revealed was the interior arrangement of the cottage…
Lin Jing looked at the thatched cottage, feeling an immense sense of familiarity. It was indeed the dwelling place of the Divine Transformation Cultivator.
That Divine Transformation Cultivator was not here.
It was likely that earlier, when Lin Jing was about to undergo his Tribulation, the Divine Transformation Cultivator had intended to intervene.
But he was wounded by the Heavenly Tribulation, no doubt seriously.
Therefore, he had no choice but to use the Teleportation Array to leave.
If he were still here, probably none of them, Lin Jing and his companions, would have escaped.
……
The cottage’s interior was very simple, exactly the same as Lin Jing had seen before.
However, in the very center of the cottage, there was a well…
Xu Ye, upon seeing the well, was very curious and quickly walked up to look inside…
“Eh?”
No sooner had Xu Ye leaned over than he cried out in astonishment.
After which, upon realizing what it was, he was utterly shocked:
“This…”
“Lin Daoyou, come quickly…”
Lin Jing then also went over and looked down into the well…
He saw reflected within the well the scene of none other than the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm…
The blood-red earth, and the Sea of Blood, which had once again become tranquil…
And those blood corpses, after Lin Jing and his companions departed, had once more entered the Sea of Blood.
Most of those blood corpses were cultivators like themselves who had been deceived into entering.
However, these people had not been able to walk out of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm alive, all having become blood corpses left inside.
This included Qi Yuanshu and Jian Yunxiang among others…
Less than two hundred managed to leave the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
But a large portion of these two hundred couldn’t make it even out of the plains, their bones buried within this relic…
Now, including Lin Jing and Xu Ye, only fifty-two people had survived.
After watching for a while, Lin Jing, finding it uninteresting, left the well and walked a circle within the cottage.
This thatched cottage was just the extremely ordinary kind.
Nothing special about it, probably built by that Divine Transformation Cultivator before.
After all…
Besides him, there was no one else here.
It’s just that Lin Jing still didn’t know who that Divine Transformation Cultivator was, what his name was.
As for the previous threats of the Divine Transformation Cultivator, Lin Jing didn’t really take them to heart.
Because, when Lin Jing underwent his Tribulation, he had concealed his true appearance and aura.
After practicing the Changyun Hidden Technique, one could deceive cultivators who were two major realms higher in cultivation than oneself.
Lin Jing, at the Golden Core Peak, was just able to deceive that Divine Transformation Cultivator.
So, Lin Jing was not afraid of being exposed at all.
As long as he changed back to his own appearance after leaving, it would be very difficult for the Divine Transformation Cultivator to find him again.
By then, Lin Jing could also hide in the dark, investigating the true identity of the Divine Transformation Cultivator.
After circling the thatched cottage and finding nothing, Lin Jing left the cottage with Xu Ye.
As the two came out, the Wu-named cultivator immediately approached, asking with confusion:
“Xu Daoyou…”
“Lin Daoyou…”
“What is inside the cottage?”
Xu Ye responded directly:
“Go and take a look for yourself, and you will know…”
The Wu-named cultivator nodded, then entered the cottage.
After a short while, the Wu-named cultivator inside the house let out the same sound as Xu Ye…
“Eh?”
“This…”
The cultivators gathered outside, hearing this, also became curious and looked towards the thatched cottage.
At this moment.
Lin Jing and Xu Ye had already walked out of the courtyard.
The cultivators outside looked questioningly towards the thatched cottage, and then glanced at Lin Jing and Xu Ye…
Seeing this, Xu Ye addressed the crowd:
“Those who want to take a look, go ahead, don’t mind us.”
Hearing Xu Ye say this, the cultivators then swarmed into the courtyard and made their way towards the thatched cottage…
Xu Ye then turned around and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“We are about to leave soon.”
Lin Jing nodded, saying:
“Yes…”
Xu Ye continued:
“I do not know where Lin Daoyou resides, but if there is time, I would like to visit to discuss our Dao…”
Lin Jing nodded and then said:
“If Xu Daoyou wishes to find me, you can directly come to Li Yan Island in the Thousand Islands Domain…”
Upon hearing this, Xu Ye nodded slightly:
“Thousand Islands Domain, Li Yan Island…”
“Alright…”
“If there’s time, I will certainly visit Lin Daoyou.”
Lin Jing gave a slight smile and said,
“You are most welcome…”
……
Soon, several more hours had passed.
The Teleportation Array had finally been repaired and completed.
By this time, the others had already finished touring the thatched cottage.
One by one, they were all sitting cross-legged on the ground, meditating and resting…
Upon hearing the news that the Teleportation Array was repaired, everyone was overjoyed, opening their eyes one after another and standing up to approach the Teleportation Array.
Having been trapped in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm for so many years, everyone was in danger, and now, hearing the news that the Teleportation Array was fixed,
how could they not be excited?
Not to mention the other Cultivators, even Lin Jing himself felt a sense of joy that he could finally leave.
At this moment, the Blue-Robed Cultivator was explaining the situation of the Teleportation Array to a Cultivator surnamed Wu:
“Wu Daoyou…”
“This Teleportation Array is a random one. Its range isn’t very wide, just within the area of the Thousand Islands Domain in the southern outer seas.”
“Furthermore…”
“This Teleportation Array may have a slight deviation during the teleportation, but the deviation should not exceed ten thousand sea miles…”
Ten thousand sea miles might seem far, but to the entirety of the southern outer seas, it wasn’t much.
This deviation was within an acceptable range for everyone present.
Upon hearing this, the Cultivator surnamed Wu nodded and said,
“Alright…”
“Since the Teleportation Array has been completed, then we can leave now.”
“So who’s going first?”
At this point, the ones who had just been excited now fell silent.
Perhaps they still couldn’t believe it, or perhaps they were still worried about the Teleportation Array…
This time, surprisingly, not a single person stepped forward…
Seeing this, the Blue-Robed Cultivator quickly said to everyone,
“Everyone…”
“This Teleportation Array is definitely reliable, you don’t need to worry…”
However, as soon as the Blue-Robed Cultivator said this, the Cultivators still did not move.
So the Blue-Robed Cultivator directly said,
“Everyone…”
“If that’s the case, then I’ll go first.”
“To spare you all any worry!”
After saying this, he strode forward and stood on the Teleportation Array.
As he stepped on it, the light of the Teleportation Array slowly started to glow.
It was at this moment that the Blue-Robed Cultivator directly clasped his hands towards Lin Jing and said,
“Senior Lin…”
“For the previous matter, I once again apologize to senior. If I get out, you’re welcome to visit Yue Tian Island, and I shall compensate you…”
Lin Jing looked at the Blue-Robed Cultivator and gently nodded…
As for going to Yue Tian Island, Lin Jing didn’t entertain the thought.
But considering that the Blue-Robed Cultivator, after that incident, had behaved properly all along this journey,
and also because he had repaired the Teleportation Array they would use to leave, Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t dwell on the past issue anymore.
His nod was to let this person be at ease.
……
Afterwards, the white light brightened, becoming so blinding that one couldn’t keep their eyes open…
Following a “whoosh,” the white light dissipated, and the Blue-Robed Cultivator was teleported away…
After the Blue-Robed Cultivator had been teleported out, the others eagerly responded, wishing to leave as well.
Thus,
Under the arrangements of the Cultivator surnamed Wu, these Cultivators were all teleported out, one after another.
Lin Jing and Xu Ye, the two of them waited until almost everyone had left…
Leaving just the Cultivator surnamed Wu and a few other Array Masters.
Only then did the two of them move forward.
The Cultivator surnamed Wu was responsible for arranging everyone’s departure, so he stayed until the end, while those Array Masters stayed behind in case anything unforeseen happened with the Formation.
These few remained till the last.
Similarly, Lin Jing and Xu Ye had the highest Cultivation.
If anything were to occur, they would be able to act defensively; therefore, they weren’t in a rush to leave.
Now, only a few of them remained.
It was time for Lin Jing and Xu Ye to leave.
Approaching the Formation, Lin Jing stepped onto it.
Then, as the light from the Formation brightened, Lin Jing also felt the tearing force brought by the teleportation.
At this moment,
Xu Ye spoke up, cupping his fists towards Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, we’ll meet again someday…”
Lin Jing replied in kind, clasping his fist,
“Until we meet again…”
Immediately following this, Lin Jing’s voice fell,
and the Teleportation Array was already activated, whisking Lin Jing away from that place…

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 172: Spirit Rock Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 172: Spirit Rock Island
In the Southern Sea Region, near Spirit Rock Island…
This entire sea area falls under the jurisdiction of Spirit Rock Island.
In the outer southern sea, most people are aware that on Spirit Rock Island, there is a mysterious family adept at cultivating Spirit Plants. This family is not only proficient in growing Spirit Plants but is also very powerful.
Therefore, in the sea near Spirit Rock Island, whether it’s any cultivator or other forces, generally, they all give Spirit Rock Island some respect.
When passing by, they would all steer clear of this sea area…
After all, the rumors say…
That on Spirit Rock Island, there might be Divine Transformation Cultivators.
At this moment, in the sea near Spirit Rock Island, a figure suddenly appeared…
After appearing, this figure glanced around, then muttered with confusion:
“Where have I been teleported to? This place doesn’t quite feel like the outer southern sea…”
This person who had just been teleported was none other than Lin Jing.
Looking at the somewhat unfamiliar sea area, Lin Jing couldn’t help frowning.
Because if everything were normal, the outer southern sea should not have such strong Spiritual Energy. However, the Spiritual Energy here was obviously more intense than in the outer southern sea…
Lin Jing even suspected that he might have been teleported incorrectly again, ending up in some other place.
However, it was good to be teleported out…
Without further concern, Lin Jing immediately activated the Changyun Hidden Technique and restored his original appearance.
Now that he had emerged, naturally, there was no need to hide anymore…
After regaining his original appearance, Lin Jing looked around for a while, then directly chose a direction.
With one step, he left the place…
Lin Jing’s current cultivation level had reached a point where he actually no longer needed to fly with a sword.
Back in the Golden Core Stage, perhaps his speed wasn’t that fast…
But after entering the Nascent Soul Stage, all cultivators would undergo a transformation.
That transformation involved Aerial Void Crossing and shortening vast distances to mere inches.
During the Golden Core Stage, Lin Jing needed to wield a Magical Treasure or condense his own Spiritual Power to levitate in the air.
But it was different in the Nascent Soul Stage…
Nascent Soul Cultivators, due to the presence of the Nascent Soul within their bodies, could initially control the Spiritual Power within several meters around themselves and practice Aerial Void Crossing.
Even without any Magical Treasure, they could stand in the void.
Furthermore, they could walk through the void as if on solid ground.
Besides that, Nascent Soul Cultivators could also use the technique of covering great distances in a single step.
Covering great distances in a single step touched upon the mysteries of space. With one step, one could cover several miles.
This was especially true for Body Refinement Cultivators.
With the enhancement of covering great distances in a single step, it was like adding wings to a tiger, catching other cultivators completely off guard.
Apart from these, the greatest change for Nascent Soul Cultivators was the condensation of the Nascent Soul.
The Nascent Soul was extremely enigmatic. After cultivating a Nascent Soul, one need not fear injury. Unless it was some extremely fatal damage, no matter how severe the injury, it could heal quickly.
Even if one suffered fatal injuries such as decapitation or disintegration…
The Nascent Soul within a Nascent Soul Cultivator’s body could escape from the physical vessel and seize a new one…
Or, it could also enter a soon-to-be-born infant and reincarnate to cultivate anew.
Cultivating a Nascent Soul meant that one had transcended the cycle of rebirth.
Of course, there were exceptions, such as being killed by someone, with even the Nascent Soul unable to escape.
Then, that would mean true death, without any chance of reincarnation or rebirth.
At this moment.
In Lin Jing’s Dantian, a two-inch tall figure was seated cross-legged, surrounded by numerous strands of Spiritual Power, seemingly in deep cultivation…
That figure was an exact miniature version of Lin Jing.
It was Lin Jing’s Nascent Soul.
……
Lin Jing continued on his journey.
Before long, I spotted an island.
Moreover, it was an inhabited one.
Upon seeing this, Lin Jing immediately cheered up and flew straight toward the island.
However,
Just as Lin Jing was about to approach the island, he discovered a large formation in front of him.
It turned out that the entire island was protected by a formation, and what’s more, this formation was a fifth-rank trapping and killing array.
Luckily, Lin Jing noticed it in time and didn’t step into it.
Nonetheless,
Lin Jing’s sudden arrival had still triggered the formation, which emitted a dazzling white light.
And at that moment, a deep and rich voice came through:
“Who dares to forcefully intrude upon Spirit Rock Island?”
Accompanying the voice was a middle-aged cultivator.
This middle-aged man had a jade-like complexion, was dressed in a Confucian robe, and appeared scholarly, but the aura he exuded was remarkably composed.
Moreover, his cultivation was not low, possessing a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivation.
After the middle-aged man appeared, he first sized up Lin Jing, noticing that Lin Jing also had a third-layer Nascent Soul cultivation, and then he greeted Lin Jing with a fist and palm salute:
“This fellow Daoist…”
“May I inquire what business brings you to suddenly enter the bounds of Spirit Rock Island?”
Spirit Rock Island was closed off year-round, and formations were set up in the surrounding sea region in addition to having a Divinity Transformation Cultivator in residence, which made its reputation widely known.
Therefore, it was rare for anyone to intrude upon the island without reason.
This time, Lin Jing’s sudden arrival had truly surprised the middle-aged man, but seeing no hostility from Lin Jing, he lowered his guard and asked politely.
It was also from this middle-aged man that Lin Jing learned that he was within the boundaries of Spirit Rock Island.
Suddenly it all made sense…
No wonder the spiritual energy was so rich here.
Following that, Lin Jing also gave a fist and palm salute in return:
“I only took the teleportation array, and by accident, I was transported to the range of Spirit Rock Island.”
“I apologize for the disturbance…”
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man immediately understood and responded with a salute:
“I see now…”
Lin Jing gave the middle-aged man a quick once-over, and then he spoke:
“If I’m not mistaken, fellow Daoist should be the father of Yan Xing and Yan Yue…”
The reason Lin Jing said this was because he felt a sense of familiarity upon his first glimpse of the middle-aged man.
Not until he mentioned Spirit Rock Island…
Did Lin Jing recall the two young girls, Yan Xing and Yue’er, whom Yan Wanfei once saved from the demon cultivator Dai Mao.
And this middle-aged man did bear a resemblance to Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Lin Jing’s words left the middle-aged man immensely surprised and a bit more guarded as he said:
“You know my daughter?”
“My daughter has grown up on Spirit Rock Island and seldom left its shores, and even when she did, I personally accompanied her…”
“Having never met you before, may I ask where you made the acquaintance of my daughter?”
After a brief moment of contemplation, Lin Jing began:
“That would have been around twenty years ago, I believe…”
“Back then, Lu Brother, San He Brother, Yan Brother and I were all setting out to deal with the demon cultivator Dai Mao. It was then that I met Yan Xing and Yue’er…”
Hearing Lin Jing’s story, the middle-aged man’s eyes suddenly brightened, and he said:
“So you’re the ‘Uncle Lin’ that Xing’er and Yue’er always talk about…”
Lin Jing smiled and nodded, then he gave a fist and palm salute to the middle-aged man:
“I am Lin Jing…”

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 173: Reunion with Yan Xing and Yan Yue
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 173: Reunion with Yan Xing and Yan Yue
The middle-aged man also clasped his fist and responded to Lin Jing:
“Yan Ming…”
“Lin Daoyou, since you have come, it’s also a twist of fate. Why not come to the island for a chat? It’s a good opportunity to see how Xing’er and Yue’er, those two girls, are doing.”
Facing Yan Ming’s invitation, Lin Jing did not decline and nodded:
“Since Brother Yan has kindly invited me, I shall humbly accept.”
Yan Ming smiled and gestured with his hand to guide Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, please…”
Afterward.
Yan Ming led the way in front, opening the Formation that protected the island. Together with Lin Jing, they arrived on Spirit Rock Island.
As soon as he set foot on Spirit Rock Island, Lin Jing felt the difference in this place.
The Spiritual Energy on the entire island was exceptionally rich.
Moreover, this richness was not caused by a Spirit Gathering Array; it was as if there was a Spirit Vein beneath Spirit Rock Island itself.
However, Lin Jing did not ask further.
After all, the reason Spirit Rock Island had been kept sealed off must have been due to its unique features.
……
In the interior of Spirit Rock Island, unlike other islands, it was covered with various Formations of different colors, covering almost the entire island area.
Only in the very center of the island was there a city and its surrounding areas that were not covered by the Formations.
Lin Jing followed Yan Ming to the mountain behind the central city.
No sooner had the two landed on the mountain than a person emerged from a courtyard on the mountaintop.
This person was an elderly man; though old, his stature was exceptionally robust, not at all like that of an old man.
With thick eyebrows and large eyes, and a face full of robust features, topped with a head of disheveled red hair, he exuded a rugged air.
Upon coming out, the elder immediately said to Yan Ming:
“Yan Ming, you said someone has broken onto the island, is it this youngster?”
While speaking, the elder sized up Lin Jing:
“Hmm…”
“His Cultivation level is quite good.”
Yan Ming then spoke up, introducing to Lin Jing:
“This is my dear friend, Qi Yan Zhenjun…”
“Qi Yan Zhenjun, he is a renowned Energy Refinement Master of the southern outer seas.”
After that, Yan Ming introduced Lin Jing to Qi Yan Zhenjun:
“This is the ‘Uncle Lin’ that Xing’er and Yue’er have been incessantly talking about…”
Hearing this, Qi Yan Zhenjun suddenly became interested, taking another look at Lin Jing, and said:
“Oh?”
“I often hear those two girls talk about Uncle Yan and Uncle Lin; so, it’s you…”
Lin Jing, with a smile on his face, replied:
“I have also heard of Qi Yan Zhenjun’s great reputation for a long time.”
At this time, Yan Ming also looked at Lin Jing, smiling, and said:
“I have already notified Xing’er and Yue’er just now. They will probably come over in a bit. I’m sure they will be very happy to see Lin Daoyou.”
Yan Ming had just come onto the island with Lin Jing. Lin Jing had not seen him make any move to inform Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Presumably, it was after the two of them entered the island that he secretly notified the two girls.
The purpose, no doubt, was also to verify the authenticity of this ‘Uncle Lin’.
Lin Jing also thoroughly understood this.
Lin Jing then nodded, saying:
“Very well…”
“It’s been many years since I’ve seen those two girls; by now, they must have grown into young ladies.”
At this point, Lin Jing suddenly asked Yan Ming:
“Brother Yan…”
“I wonder, how is the Cultivation of Yan Xing and Yan Yue now?”
“Have they advanced to the Golden Core Stage?”
Yan Xing and Yan Yue, though daughters of Yan Ming, only had four-attribute Spiritual Roots, which were not of high quality.
Logically, with the conditions on Spirit Rock Island and the assistance of a Nascent Soul Cultivator, as long as their Spiritual Roots were not too poor, they should have become Golden Core Cultivators by now.
But those two little girls had such poor talent that Lin Jing wasn’t clear on what level of cultivation they’d achieved by now.
Upon hearing this, Yan Ming couldn’t help but say:
“I took my two daughters, only to regret that their talents were too poor.”
“Even though I have exhausted all resources to train them, up to now, they have only reached the peak of Foundation Establishment and have not been able to enter the Golden Core Stage.”
Lin Jing nodded his head, showing understanding:
“Indeed…”
“With the talent of four attribute Spiritual Roots, it is indeed quite difficult to improve.”
Just at this moment, two beautiful figures walked into the courtyard from outside.
After the two of them came in, they directly greeted Yan Ming and Qi Yan with a bow:
“Daddy…”
“Grandpa Qi Yan…”
Lin Jing then looked at the two of them, although they had grown up and become two beautiful young ladies.
But it was not hard to recognize that they were the two little girls, Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Yan Ming then addressed his two daughters, Yan Xing and Yan Yue:
“Xing’er, Yue’er…”
“Look, who is this?”
When Yan Xing and Yan Yue first came in, they directly looked at Yan Ming and Qi Yan.
To them, Lin Jing was just a friend of their father, and they didn’t take a closer look.
Thus, the two hadn’t recognized Lin Jing right away.
When they heard Yan Ming speak, they finally lifted their heads and looked towards Lin Jing.
When they looked at Lin Jing, they were initially confused. However, after observing more carefully, they suddenly realized…
Only to see Yan Xing’s eyes light up, as she exclaimed with surprise,
“It’s Uncle Lin…”
Yan Yue also came to her senses, saying:
“Uncle Lin, it really is you!”
Yan Ming, upon seeing his two daughters recognize this ‘Uncle Lin,’ also secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, Yan Ming explained to Lin Jing:
“When I notified them just now, I didn’t reveal your identity because I wanted to give you a surprise.”
“Lin Daoyou, you won’t mind, will you?”
Understanding Yan Ming’s intentions, Lin Jing chuckled and said:
“Yan Daoyou worries too much, of course, I won’t…”
Yan Ming then nodded and said:
“Good, good…”
After that, Yan Ming, with a stern face, said to Yan Xing and Yan Yue:
“You two, always talking about Uncle Lin, Uncle Yan…”
“Now, your Uncle Lin is right here, and yet it took you so long to recognize him…”
The two immediately tried to explain:
“It’s not that…”
“I remember that Uncle Lin didn’t look like this before.”
Yan Xing nodded in agreement and added:
“Right, Uncle Lin used to be more robust.”
“He even looked stronger than Grandpa Qi Yan.”
Yan Yue nodded again and again:
“Uncle Lin has changed so much, he’s gotten thinner and also more handsome.”
“So, that’s why at first my sister and I didn’t recognize him.”
Qi Yan’s build was indeed very robust compared to the average person, but for Lin Jing, who previously practiced Body Refining Techniques, it was still somewhat lacking…
It was understandable that the two young ladies didn’t recognize Lin Jing immediately.
Moreover, it had been nearly twenty years since Lin Jing had been apart from the two of them.
Thus, Lin Jing also helped to explain:
“Yan Daoyou…”
“By saying so, you’ve wronged them…”

chapters.title: Chapter 477: 174 Qi Yan True Monarch and Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 174 Qi Yan True Monarch and Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique
After listening to the defenses of the two women and Lin Jing’s self-vindication, Yan Ming also knew there must be some reasons behind it all.
He then asked Lin Jing with some curiosity:
“Oh?”
“Could it be that compared to before, Lin Daoyou has undergone a significant change?”
Lin Jing nodded, and then said:
“That’s right…”
“Previously, on Li Yan Island, I had been practicing a Body Refining Technique, which made my physique incredibly exaggerated, even more robust-looking than Master Qi Yan’s.”
“It wasn’t until Brother Lu and the others brought Yan Xing and Yan Yue back to Spirit Rock Island that I managed to cultivate this technique up to the seventh level, the highest, which allowed me to return to my original state.”
After hearing Lin Jing’s words, Yan Ming suddenly turned his head and looked toward Qi Yan Immortal…
Qi Yan Immortal also furrowed his brows slightly before he asked:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“If I’m not mistaken, the Body Refining Technique you practiced before was the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique, wasn’t it?”
Lin Jing was somewhat surprised and nodded:
“Master Qi Yan really is knowledgeable; indeed, I practiced the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.”
Yan Ming seemed to know something, so he spoke up:
“Lin Daoyou, you misunderstood. The reason Master Qi Yan knows so clearly is because the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique has some connections with him…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing turned around, looking at Qi Yan Immortal with puzzlement…
Qi Yan Immortal lowered his head, silent for a moment, then raised it and explained to Lin Jing:
“This Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was created by my master. However, after certain events, my master was pursued by enemies, and he disappeared.”
“The Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique that he created disappeared along with my master.”
“As of now, my master has been missing for hundreds of years; I’m afraid he has long since perished…”
“May I know where Lin Daoyou found this technique?”
“Have you encountered my master’s remains?”
Lin Jing suddenly realized why Qi Yan Immortal was so familiar with this technique.
Thus, Lin Jing replied:
“I obtained the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique from the body of an enemy, but as for where he acquired it, I have no idea.”
After listening, Qi Yan Immortal again fell into silence and then said:
“I see…”
Having finished speaking, Qi Yan Immortal looked at Lin Jing earnestly and said:
“Lin Daoyou!”
“I have an impertinent request…”
“I would like to reclaim the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique left by my master from Lin Daoyou. I wonder if Lin Daoyou would be willing?”
“As long as Lin Daoyou is willing to part with this technique, I am ready to pay any price.”
Seeing his manner, Lin Jing did not hesitate and took out the technique from his Space Ring, handing it to Qi Yan Immortal, saying:
“What are you saying, Master Qi Yan…”
“This technique originally belonged to the master, I’ll simply give it to you.”
Qi Yan Immortal looked at Lin Jing and did not reach out to take the book, instead saying:
“One should not accept rewards without deserving them. Since this technique was obtained by Lin Daoyou, it naturally belongs to you, and I have no right to just take it.”
“Tell me, what do you want?”
At this point, Yan Ming also spoke up, saying:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“What Master Qi Yan said is right, although this technique was previously owned by his master, it has now come into your hands, and it is naturally your possession.”
“Whatever you need, do not hesitate to ask.”
“Whether it’s a Magical Treasure, Spirit Stones, or rare Spirit Plants, we will strive to fulfill your needs…”
……
After listening, Lin Jing pondered for a moment, then spoke:
“Master Qi Yan, if I may, I do have a matter for which I need Master Qi Yan’s assistance…”
Qi Yan Immortal immediately opened his mouth to speak:
“Lin Daoyou, please proceed…”
Lin Jing then spoke to Qi Yan Immortal:
“Master Qi Yan, I possess a Magical Treasure I wish to upgrade. The materials have already been prepared by me, but I have not yet found a suitable Energy Refinement Master.”
“Your esteemed name, Master Qi Yan, has long reached my ears, and I am aware that you are a renowned Energy Refinement Master in the southern outer seas.”
“So…”
“If possible, I hope that Master Qi Yan could take a look and see if that Magical Treasure can be upgraded.”
Upon hearing this, Qi Yan Immortal raised an eyebrow, instantly intrigued, and said:
“Oh?”
“What kind of Magical Treasure? Bring it to me to see.”
After saying this, Qi Yan Immortal added:
“Lin Daoyou, our levels of Cultivation are not much different, there’s no need to call me master, just call me daoyou.”
Lin Jing nodded and replied:
“Very well…”
“Please wait a moment, Qi Yan Daoyou…”
After finishing his words, Lin Jing directly took out his Magical Treasure – the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, and the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique, and handed them over to Qi Yan Immortal.
Qi Yan Immortal reached out and took the Ling Yin Flawless Sword and the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.
Then…
Qi Yan Immortal first glanced at the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, placing it aside, and then picked up the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique, wiping it gently, his eyes filled with reminiscence.
After wiping, he opened it and began to read through the contents…
It was only after a moment that Qi Yan Immortal withdrew his somewhat melancholic gaze and said softly:
“This Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique is indeed the one created by my master…”
“Back then, in order to accelerate my entry into the path of Artifact Refining, my master specially crafted a Cultivation Technique for me, this Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique.”
“Now when I think about it, it has already been more than a thousand years ago, and even my master’s disappearance has been several hundred years…”
“How time flies…”
Having said that, Qi Yan Immortal lifted his head and asked Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, do you know where your enemy acquired this technique?”
Lin Jing responded:
“This Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique was taken from his Storage Bag after my enemy’s death. As for where he got it, I’m not entirely certain.”
“However…”
“I do know that the enemy had once established a ruin in the Demonic Monster Sea, and it’s very possible that he acquired the technique there.”
“A ruin?”
“What sort of ruin is it?” wondered Qi Yan Immortal.
Lin Jing recalled for a moment, thinking about the previous conversation between Wu Cai Immortal and the Zhang Family Patriarch in the Demon Race Secret Realm, and the techniques both practiced…
He then spoke:
“This ruin…”
“Is very likely related to the Five Elements. Qi Yan Daoyou might want to pay attention to this.”
After hearing this, Qi Yan Immortal’s brow furrowed as he mused:
“A ruin related to the Five Elements?”
A moment later, Qi Yan Immortal seemed to have thought of something and spoke:
“Speaking of ruins related to the Five Elements in the southern outer seas, there indeed is one…”
“To my knowledge…”
“Thousands of years ago, there was once a Cultivator who practiced Five Elements Spells in the southern outer seas, remarkably powerful, asserting dominance over the entire region single-handedly.”
“It is said…”
“The Five Elements Cultivation Technique he practiced was obtained from a certain ruin, and what you, Lin Daoyou, mentioned might indeed be that very ruin…”

chapters.title: Chapter 478: 175: Return to Flame Island
chapters.content:
Chapter 478: Chapter 175: Return to Flame Island
Lin Jing, after listening, was also surprised and said,
“Qi Yan Daoyou, do you know exactly where those ruins are?”
True Monarch Qi Yan shook his head and replied,
“These ruins have always been a secret…”
“I don’t know their exact location either.”
“However, now that I have this information, I will investigate it eventually. At the very least, I need to find my mentor’s remains and give them a proper burial.”
At this time, Yan Ming spoke up to True Monarch Qi Yan,
“Rest assured, Brother Qi Yan, I will also find a way to help you locate the ruins…”
True Monarch Qi Yan took a deep breath to contain his emotions and said,
“Alright…”
“This matter cannot be resolved in a short time. First, I’ll take a look at the Flying Sword for Lin Daoyou.”
Having said that, True Monarch Qi Yan put away the Seven Refinement Body Forging Technique and then picked up the transparent Ling Yin Flawless Sword to examine it closely.
After picking up the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, True Monarch Qi Yan’s gaze became extremely serious.
His eyes sparkled as he scrutinized the Ling Yin Flawless Sword carefully, until after a long while, True Monarch Qi Yan finally looked up and asked Lin Jing,
“This Flying Sword, with a transparent blade and extreme sharpness, is indeed a fine Magical Treasure. If paired with a Cultivation Technique that hides one’s aura, it would be most suitable for stealth attacks.”
“Also, has this Flying Sword been reforged by someone before?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Your insight is profound, Qi Yan Daoyou. When I first acquired this Flying Sword, it was merely a superior Magic Artifact.”
“Later, due to a stroke of fortune, I obtained another damaged Magical Treasure Flying Sword of nearly the same quality. After that, I had someone fuse the two swords together to create this current Flying Sword.”
True Monarch Qi Yan nodded lightly and said,
“I can tell that the craftsman who forged this Flying Sword did a good job. The fusion of the two swords was done just right, maximizing their potential value.”
After speaking, True Monarch Qi Yan then asked Lin Jing,
“Did you mention earlier that you have prepared materials as well?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Yes…”
