As he spoke, Lin Jing took out the Flowing Light Crystal Gold and Bright Spirit Origin Stone he had previously collected from his Space Ring.
He then handed them to True Monarch Qi Yan, saying,
“Qi Yan Daoyou, these are the materials I prepared earlier. Please take a look…”
Upon seeing the materials in Lin Jing’s hand, True Monarch Qi Yan’s eyes immediately lit up, and he reached out to take the two pieces of material from Lin Jing’s hands.
After observing them for a moment, he commented,
“Flowing Light Crystal Gold and Bright Spirit Origin Stone…”
“Impressive, both of these materials are far from ordinary.”
Hearing this, Yan Ming also hurried over and said to True Monarch Qi Yan,
“Aren’t these two materials what you mentioned before, not typically used for forging Dao Artifacts?”
True Monarch Qi Yan nodded and answered,
“Indeed, they are materials for forging Dao Artifacts, and both of them perfectly match the attributes of Lin Daoyou’s Flying Sword.”
Lin Jing then spoke up and asked,
“Qi Yan Daoyou, what do you think?”
“Is it possible to further improve the quality of this Ling Yin Flawless Sword?”
“If it can be improved, whatever other materials are needed, just say the word, Qi Yan Daoyou, and I’ll find a way to obtain them.”
True Monarch Qi Yan waved his hand and said to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“There’s certainly no problem in enhancing this Flying Sword.”
“And with these two materials, it’s completely sufficient to improve the Ling Yin Flawless Sword; we don’t need anything else. In fact, adding other materials might be counterproductive.”
After finishing, True Monarch Qi Yan looked at Lin Jing and said,
“However, the enhancement of this Magical Treasure won’t be accomplished in a short time, I need to make some preparations in advance.”
Lin Jing replied,
“There’s no rush…”
“`
“Qi Yan Daoyou, whenever you have time, just come and help me enhance it,” Lin Jing said.
True Master Qi Yan nodded, then handed the Ling Yin Flawless Sword and the two materials back to Lin Jing, saying,
“Lin Daoyou, may I know where you are currently residing? Once I have finished with my affairs here, I will begin preparations to help you enhance the quality of this Ling Yin Flawless Sword.”
“You can just give me the address, and when the time comes, I’ll go directly to find you.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I am currently living on Li Yan Island.”
“Qi Yan Daoyou can go directly to Li Yan Island to find me when the time comes.”
True Master Qi Yan spoke,
“Alright…”
“Once I’m done with my affairs, I’ll head straight to Li Yan Island to find you.”
After the two had finished discussing, Yan Ming joined in and said,
“That works out well…”
“Since Xing’er and Yue’er are almost facing their Tribulation, I might as well take them with me to Li Yan Island to visit.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Yue looked at Yan Ming with profound grievance and said,
“Daddy…”
“You’re finally willing to let us go out.”
Yan Xing, too, nodded repeatedly, saying,
“Yes…”
“Ever since Uncle Yan sent us back last time, we’ve hardly been out. We’re almost dying of boredom on the island.”
Faced with his daughters’ aggrieved looks, Yan Ming felt somewhat overwhelmed and hurriedly explained,
“The two of you have such low cultivation; I’m worried about you encountering some mishaps.”
“Just like last time, if you hadn’t met Uncle Lin and Uncle Yan, you might have been out of luck by now.”
“So this time…”
“How about on this trip to Li Yan Island, I let you two play for a few extra days, would that be okay?”
Upon hearing this, the two girls nodded eagerly and said,
“Yes…”
“It’s about time we went to visit Uncle Yan, Uncle Lu, and Uncle San He again…”
At this point, Yan Yue turned her head and asked Lin Jing,
“By the way, Uncle Lin…”
“Why haven’t Uncle Yan, Uncle Lu, and Uncle San He come this time?”
Lin Jing replied to the two,
“Your Uncle Yan, Uncle Lu, and Uncle San He are not currently on Li Yan Island; they have gone to other places.”
Yan Yue then frowned and said,
“Is that so…”
“I was hoping to give Uncle Yan a surprise.”
After dealing with the affair concerning Dai Mao, Lin Jing, Lu Youjiu, and Holaw Three Rivers had all been quite busy.
For half a year, it had been Yan Wanfei and Yue Qi who had been accompanying the two young ladies, so they were closer to Yan Wanfei and Yue Qi.
Lin Kai then said,
“Uncle Yan won’t be there, but Aunt Yue Qi will be. When that time comes, you can meet with Aunt Yue Qi…”
Upon hearing this, the two girls were delighted and said,
“Great…”
Having said this,
Lin Jing then discussed with everyone else about the next meeting on Li Yan Island.
After the discussion was over, Lin Jing did not stay long on Spirit Rock Island and, after declining Yan Ming’s invitation to stay as a guest, bid farewell to everyone and left Spirit Rock Island.
Only after leaving the boundaries of Spirit Rock Island did Lin Jing take out the Shadow Escape Flying Boat and fly towards Li Yan Island.
Having been away for so long, he imagined that Li Qingqing, along with Lin Jue and Ye Yun, must be quite anxious by now.
And as for Li Yan Island, he wondered how it was faring…
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 479: 176: Meeting
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 176: Meeting
Lin Jing piloted the flying boat, speeding all the way.
Within less than two days, he had returned to the region of the Thousand Islands Domain.
As Lin Jing approached Li Yan Island on his flying boat, before he even caught sight of it, he sensed that something was amiss.
Because…
Up to now, Lin Jing had not seen a single cultivator heading towards Li Yan Island.
Ever since Li Yan Fang Market’s prosperity, although the vicinity of Li Yan Island was not as bustling with people coming and going incessantly like Bihai Island,
it was never completely deserted.
Sensing this situation, Lin Jing felt a sense of foreboding, and immediately extended his divine sense towards Li Yan Island…
After advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage, Lin Jing’s divine sense had been further strengthened, and although he was now merely at the early stages of the Nascent Soul Stage,
his divine sense had already reached the peak of the Nascent Soul Peak Stage.
The scope within which the divine sense of the Nascent Soul Peak Stage could investigate was dozens of times greater than that during the Golden Core Stage.
If he were on Li Yan Island, with Lin Jing’s current divine sense, he could easily envelop Li Yan Island and the surrounding sea in it.
At this moment, although he had yet to see it, Lin Jing was not far from Li Yan Island.
That is why Lin Jing had extended his divine sense towards Li Yan Island.
As soon as he probed Li Yan Island, Lin Jing frowned.
For as Lin Jing used his divine sense to probe Li Yan Island, he discovered that the fifth-rank trap-killing formation designed to protect the island was currently activated.
This fifth-rank trap-killing formation would normally not be activated and would only be triggered when danger was encountered.
Activating this formation signified that Li Yan Island was facing an enemy,
and moreover, an enemy that the people of Li Yan Island could not resolve on their own.
……
Now that he was very close to Li Yan Island, there was no need to continue piloting the flying boat.
Lin Jing then directly stored the flying boat and continued flying towards Li Yan Island.
Upon arriving outside Li Yan Island, Lin Jing stood firmly in front of the fifth-rank trap-killing formation.
At this time, the fifth-rank trap-killing formation in front of him was activated, and the entire array was shrouded in a dense white fog, shielding any sight of what lay within.
Even divine sense could not penetrate it.
You must understand, this was a fifth-rank trap-killing formation that could even block a Divinity Transformation Cultivator for a time.
Let alone Lin Jing.
If Lin Jing rashly barged in, he might immediately become ensnared by the formation.
However, Lin Jing did not need to force his way through the formation.
He could control it.
After Holaw Three Rivers completed the arrangement of the formation, he gave Lin Jing several array plates used to control the entire formation
as well as the corresponding control incantation.
Apart from the master control plate Lin Jing had on him, he had also handed out two auxiliary control plates.
These two auxiliary control plates were given to Yue Qi’s mother and Li Qingqing.
Similarly, Lin Jing taught them the incantations needed to control the array plates.
Normally, there was no difference between the master control plate and the auxiliary control plates, as both could control the formation.
However, commands issued from the master control plate superseded those from the auxiliary control plates.
Just like now.
The fifth-rank trap-killing formation had been closed and controlled by the auxiliary control plates in the hands of Li Qingqing or Yue Qi’s mother.
Lin Jing could open it using the master control plate.
But if the situation were reversed, Lin Jing would not be able to open the formation and enter Li Yan Island.
This was, in fact, a special safety measure set up by Holaw Three Rivers to prevent others with ulterior motives from obtaining the array plates and incantation.
……
Lin Jing then took out the master array plate from his space ring, holding it in his hand.
The array plate was not large, only about the size of a palm.
At this time, before activation, it looked like a round copper piece engraved with countless fine lines.
Those fine lines were actually formation patterns.
Lin Jing held the array plate and then started to channel spiritual power into it.
As Lin Jing input his spiritual power, the array plate slowly lit up with white light, enveloping it completely.
Subsequently, his lips moved slightly as he recited the incantation.
The formation patterns on the array plate also started to activate, lighting up.
After a moment, the array plate was fully activated, and an image of an active fifth-rank trap-killing formation appeared on it.
Then, Lin Jing began to control the array plate, manipulating the trap-killing formation, and started to slowly open it…
As Lin Jing operated the array plate in his hand, the trap-killing formation protecting Li Yan Island in front of him also started to glow with formation patterns, gradually changing.
Until after a while, the white fog within the trap-killing formation began to slowly disperse.
And the entire formation began to slowly conceal itself.
After the formation had completely disappeared, Li Yan Island appeared once again before Lin Jing.
In the sky above Li Yan Island, several people stood tense and ready in front of Lin Jing, their gazes fixed upon him.
These individuals were the group of Golden Cores from Li Yan Island.
Yue Qi’s mother, Li Qingqing, and Lin Jue were among them.
In addition to them, there were Huang Linxian, Yan Liyun, and the Golden Core Cultivator who guarded the Spirit Field.
One could say that aside from Ye Yun, all the Golden Cores within Li Yan Island were present.
Upon seeing Lin Jing,
they were initially startled, and then suddenly erupted into joyous exclamation.
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“Brother…”
“Island Master…”
…
…
Shortly thereafter, they hurriedly flew over to Lin Jing.
The first to approach was Lin Jue. Upon her arrival, she immediately latched onto Lin Jing’s arm and then gave it a squeeze,
as if she couldn’t believe it was real.
Li Qingqing was next.
When she reached Lin Jing, she stopped.
Her eyes were slightly red as she called out to Lin Jing,
“Brother Lin Jing…”
After that,
Li Qingqing took a good look at Lin Jing and then said,
“Zhang Jian said you might not come back…”
“But I didn’t believe it!”
“So, I’ve been waiting for you to return…”
“Sure enough…”
“I knew it, Brother Lin Jing, you would definitely come back.”
Lin Jing turned to Li Qingqing with a smile and said,
“There was a bit of an accident earlier, but it’s all sorted out now.”
At this time, the others also reached Lin Jing.
“Island Master…”
“You’ve finally come back.”
Yue Qi’s mother said with a laugh, as if a weight had been lifted from her shoulders.
The rest of them, though silent, wore excitement on their faces that was evident beyond words.
Lin Jing examined each person carefully and nodded,
“Yes, I’m back.”
“Has everything been alright while I was away?”
“We’ve all been fine, it’s just that we’ve been quite worried about the Island Master.” Yue Qi’s mother said.
“Yes…”
“We’ve all been alright…”
The others echoed in agreement.
Lin Jing looked at them, saw that none had any signs of injury, and nodded in relief.
Then, Lin Jing spoke again, addressing Yue Qi’s mother,
“Yue Qi’s mother…”
“Why was the Defensive Array activated? Could it be that we at Li Yan Island have encountered a formidable enemy?”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s question, Yue Qi’s mother suddenly fell silent.
Not just her, but Li Qingqing, Lin Jue, and the others also became quiet.
After a moment, Yue Qi’s mother began to speak,
“This is a long story…”
“Let’s return to Li Yan City and discuss it there.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Alright…”
Afterward,
Lin Jing and the others returned to Li Yan City together.

chapters.title: Chapter 480: 177: Nightfall
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 177: Nightfall
On his way back, as he passed through the Fang Market of Li Yan.
Lin Jing took a special look, noting that the Fang Market had expanded significantly compared to when he had left.
It was at least five times larger than before.
However, the market was now incredibly deserted, with not a single person in sight; even the shops on the street had their doors firmly shut, a stark contrast to the past.
After returning to Li Yan City, the group headed straight for the City Lord’s Mansion’s council hall.
Upon taking their seats, Lin Jing immediately asked,
“Tell me, what exactly happened?”
Yue Qi then stood up and said,
“Island Master…”
“Actually, this matter goes back to the Fang Market of Li Yan…”
“Before your disappearance, Island Master, hadn’t we already planned the expansion of the market?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“The previous Fang Market was indeed too crowded, and without expansion, it would have impacted future development negatively.”
After finishing, Lin Jing added,
“Qi, could it be that it’s because of the expansion of the Fang Market of Li Yan that we attracted powerful enemies, forcing you to activate the defensive array?”
Yue Qi nodded and replied,
“Pretty much…”
“Our market’s expansion gradually took shape, and the market became formalized, attracting many people. However, this also incited jealousy from others.”
“Then, some people set their sights on us.”
“Moreover, your prolonged absence, Island Master, also made some people restless.”
“Although we have always told the outside world that you were in seclusion,”
“But…”
“There are still some who wish to take over our island, desiring to claim Li Yan Island as their own.”
“And those people are extremely powerful in their cultivation; we are no match for them.”
“We had no choice but to activate the defensive array to protect ourselves.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing’s expression grew solemn, and a cold light flickered in his eyes.
As for those who wanted to take advantage of the situation and target Li Yan Island, Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t let them off easily.
Now that he was back, it was time to settle past scores…
Afterward, Lin Jing asked Yue Qi,
“Who are these people?”
Yue Qi pondered for a moment before speaking,
“At first, after you disappeared, Island Master, there weren’t any issues. But after the Fang Market was fully expanded, a huge fire broke out.”
“Unexpectedly, several islands near Li Yan Island, and even other places in the Thousand Islands Domain, heard about our Fang Market.”
“They came flocking…”
“When this happened, I realized something was wrong and immediately suspended the market.”
“But even then, a few Island Masters from other islands recognized the value behind the Fang Market of Li Yan and became eager to take it over, even Li Yan Island itself.”
“Those people…”
“All have at least late-stage Golden Core cultivation. We, a few, are simply no match for them.”
“It wasn’t until later, that Zhang Jian, a fellow Daoist, took action and taught them a lesson, which quelled some people’s intentions.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing felt deeply relieved; he truly hadn’t misjudged Zhang Jian.
He really stepped up when needed…
Yue Qi continued,
“Currently, it seems only Jin Jue and his brother Jin’Ao from Yin Sha Island are still coveting our Li Yan Island.”
“The Jin brothers, both at the peak of Golden Core cultivation, also wish to encroach on Li Yan Island.”
“Moreover, Daoist Zhang has taken action before, clashing with them in a battle. However, being alone, Daoist Zhang was not a match for the Jin brothers.”
“For this matter, Fellow Daoist Zhang suffered some injuries and should be recovering on Yuxing Island now.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing’s eyebrows slightly furrowed as he said,
“Zhang Jian was injured?”
Yue Qi nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“During their confrontation, Zhang Jian wasn’t their match and suffered some injuries.”
“Just when the situation was most perilous, a mysterious demon cultivator appeared out of nowhere and fought alongside Fellow Daoist Zhang against the Jin brothers.”
“That demon cultivator seemed to have some old acquaintance with Fellow Daoist Zhang, and he was not lacking in strength either; he also had the cultivation of the Golden Core Peak.”
“Only through their joint efforts were they able to defeat and drive away the Jin brothers…”
“After defeating the Jin brothers, the mysterious demon cultivator left directly, and Fellow Daoist Zhang was too injured to defend…”
“Thus, we activated this Fifth-Rank confinement and killing formation.”
“Until you, Island Master, returned…”
Lin Jing nodded slightly.
That demon cultivator, if Lin Jing wasn’t mistaken,
must be Li Tangyu; Li Tangyu and Zhang Jian joining forces were barely a match for the two Jin brothers.
It seems, the skills of those two were not ordinary either.
However,
now, in Lin Jing’s eyes, those two Jin brothers amounted to nothing.
With his own Nascent Soul Stage cultivation, he could easily annihilate both of them.
And if those two intended to invade his Li Yan Island, then Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t treat them politely.
This was just right, for Lin Jing felt that the Harvest Points were not sufficient.
He wanted to expand the range of the Spirit Fields and continue planting Spirit Plants.
Now, it seemed that the Yin Sha Island of the Jin brothers was quite suitable.
……
Lin Jing then spoke up once more, asking Yue Qi,
“Apart from the Jin brothers, has anyone else shown covetous intentions towards our Li Yan Island?”
Yue Qi knitted her brows in thought for a moment before answering,
“Besides the Jin brothers, I’ve also heard that when our Li Yan Fang Market experienced its explosion, it had some impact on the business at the Yelin Island Market.”
“There’s information suggesting that the True Lord of Yelin Island also intends to take over our Li Yan Island, although the True Lord of Yelin has yet to take any action, so we don’t know if the news is true.”
“That’s all there is to it…”
After hearing this, Lin Jing frowned slightly.
He did not regard those Jin brothers as a concern, but since the True Lord of Yelin was a Nascent Soul Cultivator, Lin Jing had to be somewhat more cautious.
Lin Jing had heard of the True Lord of Yelin before.
He was a Nascent Soul Mid-Stage cultivator, occupying the sole mid-sized island in this sea region, Yelin Island.
Of course, Yelin Island wasn’t known by this name before, but was renamed after being occupied by the True Lord of Yelin.
Moreover,
there was also a market on Yelin Island, except that this market didn’t engage with the low-tier loose cultivators in the Thousand Islands Domain.
Seeing this market gap was what led Lin Jing to think of establishing the Li Yan Fang Market.
Originally, Lin Jing had planned to slowly control the scale of the Li Yan Fang Market, expanding it gradually without drawing much attention.
But before he could implement his plan, he was transported into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, and the sudden explosion of activity in the Li Yan Fang Market drew the eyes of others.
This was what led to the current situation.
However, now Lin Jing was back.
And,
he also had the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Stage, so Lin Jing now had enough strength to get the Li Yan Fang Market back up and running.
As for the True Lord of Yelin, Lin Jing felt it was necessary to find a time to meet with him…

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 178: Li Qingqing's Affections
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 178: Li Qingqing’s Affections
Afterward,
Lin Jing spoke to Yue Qi, saying,
“Qi… Prepare yourselves. We’re going to reopen Fang Market.”
Upon hearing this, Yue Qi couldn’t help but feel puzzled. Logically, with the crisis not yet resolved, the last thing one should do was to reopen the market. So she asked,
“Island Master, this…”
“What if those Jin brothers come again? How should we deal with them?”
“And there’s also True Monarch Ye Lin. Right now, we still don’t know whether he intends to take over Li Yan Island. If True Monarch Ye Lin truly harbors the idea to take over our Li Yan Island, even activating the Formation would be useless.”
“The Fifth-Rank Formation might be powerful, but True Monarch Ye Lin would certainly be able to find someone to break it.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I’m well aware of that!”
“However, this time with me here, no one will dare to cause trouble on our turf.”
Having said that, Lin Jing directly unleashed his cultivation, letting the aura of a Nascent Soul Cultivator burst forth from his body in an instant.
As a Nascent Soul Cultivator, he might not be the strongest in the Thousand Islands Domain, but he still belonged to the top tier of powerhouses.
With Lin Jing’s cultivation, protecting a small Fang Market like Li Yan was no problem at all.
After all, it was not as if he was competing with other Nascent Soul Cultivators on those medium-sized or large islands.
Lin Jing only wished to protect his own patch of land on Li Yan Island.
When the people around felt the violent surge of cultivation emanating from Lin Jing…
They were first startled and then their pupils dilated with disbelief as they looked towards Lin Jing.
“Island… Island Master…”
“You… you’ve advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage…?”
Yue Qi was utterly shocked and quickly asked.
But her tone still carried some disbelief.
After all, that was a Nascent Soul True Monarch…
A Nascent Soul True Monarch could even become the master of a medium-sized island in the Thousand Islands Domain.
Furthermore, a Nascent Soul Cultivator, if desiring to join a force, would already be a main combatant in any given force.
At the very least, they could become an Offering Priest or an Elder, with the treatment they received naturally extraordinary.
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“Although I’ve experienced some events, I’ve managed to gain something from them and luckily achieved a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
The cultivation Lin Jing displayed this time was not the actual third level of Nascent Soul but the first level.
After all, less than ten years had passed since he last left.
In such a short time, advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage would be plausible to explain, but showing a third-level Nascent Soul cultivation would have been truly inexplicable.
Another concern was that Lin Jing’s tribulation in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm had been too extravagant, and it was certain to pique someone’s interest.
Those who were with him in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm had also emerged.
The issue of that tribulation could potentially become exposed.
If he suddenly appeared with a third-level Nascent Soul cultivation, it would likely be associated with him by others, and if that caught the attention of those Divinity Transformation Stage old monsters, it would be problematic.
Right now, a first-level Nascent Soul cultivation was just right.
At this moment, not only Yue Qi,
But also Li Qingqing, Lin Jue, and the other three Golden Core Cultivators were equally shocked as they looked towards Lin Jing.
A moment later,
Lin Jing retracted his aura and hid it again, and only then did the others come to their senses.
Li Qingqing was relatively calm, looking at Lin Jing with a smile.
Whereas Lin Jue’s eyes sparkled with an unusual light, suppressing her excitement.
Lin Jing was certain that if it weren’t for the need to conceal his identity, she would likely pounce on him the next moment.
After all, Lin Jue’s appearance was still that of a handsome young man.
The other three, however, were extremely excited, their eyes filled with admiration as they looked at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing then addressed everyone, saying,
“Everyone…”
“Regarding my whereabouts during this time, I hope that you all will keep it a secret.”
“If anyone inquires, just continue to say, as before, that I’ve been in closed-door cultivation, and only a few days ago, I had the good fortune of breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
“Understood…” Several people hurried to open their mouths and said.
“Island Master, rest assured, we will definitely keep this matter a secret.”
At this moment, Li Qingqing looked towards Lin Jing with some concern and said:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“Did you encounter any difficulties outside?”
Lin Jing then smiled and said:
“Not at all…”
“It’s just that if it gets exposed, there might be some unnecessary trouble. Qing Qing, you don’t need to overthink it.”
“Alright, Brother Lin Jing…” Li Qingqing nodded and said.
After that.
Lin Jing reassured everyone for a while.
Then, he had the other three leave.
Not long after the three of them left, Lin Jing suddenly sensed that someone was racing towards Li Yan Island.
Therefore, he directly stimulated his Divine Sense to probe outward.
When Lin Jing’s Divine Sense detected the approaching person, a smile immediately appeared on his lips.
He then spoke to Yue Qi:
“Qi Mother, we have a visitor; please go welcome them.”
Seeing the smile on Lin Jing’s lips, Yue Qi understood that the guest was not an unfriendly one, which was why Lin Jing was acting like this…
So, Yue Qi asked:
“Zhang Jian, Zhang Dao-friend?”
Lin Jing smiled and nodded:
“Go welcome him first, and see what he’s here for this time. I’ll go out later and give him a surprise…”
Yue Qi nodded, saying:
“Alright, Island Master…”
Having said that, Yue Qi walked out.
And Lin Jue, also interested, hurriedly spoke:
“I’ll go too…”
With that, she quickened her pace, catching up to Yue Qi, and walked out with her.
As for Lin Jing, after Yue Qi and Lin Jue had gone out, he used his Spiritual Power to shield the entire room.
Shielding the room was to hide from Zhang Jian’s Divine Sense, while Lin Jing’s Divine Sense could probe without any hindrance.
After the room was shielded, only Lin Jing and Li Qingqing were left inside.
At this time, Li Qingqing came to Lin Jing’s side, looked at him, and asked:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“Where have you been during this time?”
Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing, seeing the full concern in her eyes.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a warmth in his heart.
“I assume you already know about my participation in the trade fair previously…”
Li Qingqing nodded and said:
“That’s right…”
“Not even half a day after you left, Zhang Jian came back…”
“He said you went missing, along with everyone who attended the trade fair.”
As she spoke, Li Qingqing pursed her lips and then continued:
“At first…”
“I didn’t believe it.”
“Brother Lin Jing, you survived from the Demon Race Secret Realm.”
“How could you possibly just disappear all of a sudden?”
“Not long after that…”
“News came again, everyone was tricked, and over a hundred cultivators went missing from the trade fair.”
Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing, her eyes slightly red and the concern in them even more clearly visible:
“I thought that…”
“I might never see you again.”

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 179 Jin Clan Brothers
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 179 Jin Clan Brothers
Lin Jing then took two steps forward, gently stroked Li Qingqing’s head, like a big brother, and revealed a warm smile. He said to Li Qingqing,
“Qingqing, there’s no need to worry…”
“There are not many places I could be trapped. Look, I’m fine and have already come back…”
However…
Faced with Lin Jing’s gesture, Li Qingqing inexplicably froze and then quickly lowered her head, her ears turning red with a “whoosh”…
Then, she softly uttered a “hmm”…
After this, Lin Jing did not respond for a long time.
Li Qingqing immediately became puzzled, quickly raised her head, and looked at Lin Jing.
She saw Lin Jing looking up into the distance, his brow slightly furrowed.
Li Qingqing couldn’t help asking with confusion,
“Brother Lin Jing, what has happened?”
Lin Jing nodded, saying,
“Someone else is coming…”
“If I’m not mistaken, this time, it should be ‘unwelcome guests’…”
……
Yue Qi’s mother and Lin Jue had just come out when they saw Zhang Jian, who had just arrived above Li Yan Island.
Upon seeing Yue Qi’s mother, Zhang Jian frowned and asked,
“Fellow Yue, why have you opened the defensive array?”
“You must know that the Jin brothers might come at any time. If the array isn’t there to protect us, they’ll charge directly into the city, and by then, no one will be able to stop them.”
Yue Qi’s mother replied,
“I’ll close the array in a moment…”
“Oh, by the way…”
“Fellow Zhang, you came rushing over. Is there something wrong?”
Zhang Jian no longer mentioned the defensive array, instead, he excitedly blurted out,
“They’ve come out, they have all come out…”
Zhang Jian’s sudden statement confused Yue Qi’s mother.
“What has come out? Exactly who has come out?”
“Be clear…” Yue Qi’s mother said.
Zhang Jian hurriedly explained,
“Those who attended the trade fair, they have come out…”
“Lin, Brother Lin, he might have come out with them.”
Yue Qi’s mother continued to press,
“Are you certain, has the Island Master come out?”
Zhang Jian was startled for a moment, then somewhat sheepishly said,
“I think so…”
“After receiving this news, I thought to immediately inform you all. I forgot to ask anything else and just came straight here…”
Yue Qi’s mother was speechless…
However.
She could understand.
Initially, Lin Jing had gone to the trade fair with Zhang Jian.
Furthermore, it was Zhang Jian who had insisted on Lin Jing accompanying him.
But with that one trip, Lin Jing had been dragged into a conspiracy, while Zhang Jian, by some stroke of luck, had managed to escape.
Therefore.
Over these years, Zhang Jian had constantly been racked with guilt.
During these years, Zhang Jian had been always seeking news about Lin Jing. Any slight clue led her to go check it out personally.
In this time, she had fostered countless hopes, only to be met with disappointment time and again.
It was precisely because of his guilt towards Lin Jing.
That Zhang Jian was particularly concerned about Flame Island’s affairs.
Even going to the extent of helping Flame Island repel those who harbored ill-intentions towards Fang Market multiple times.
Even when facing the Jin brothers, Zhang Jian, knowing he was no match, did not shrink back, and if it weren’t for Li Tangyu, Zhang Jian would have probably suffered more than just injuries.
……
Yue Qi’s mother thought of Zhang Jian’s past actions and felt a tinge of compassion. She was just about to reveal the news about Lin Jing.
But just at that moment…
From afar, a deep and rough voice came…
“How is it?”
“Does the cowardly Island Master of Li Yan Island finally dare to come out?”
“This time, he has even opened the defensive array.”
“Hahaha…”
“Now, the whole Li Yan Island is ours…”
As this voice sounded, two figures appeared on the distant horizon.
Riding their flying swords at high speed, flying towards here.
Zhang Jian’s face changed drastically when he saw the two figures.
“Quick, activate the defensive array…” Zhang Jian urged urgently.
However, Yue Qi’s mother made no movement.
Zhang Jian, however, hadn’t noticed Yue Qi’s wife’s actions; he was intently watching the two figures that were rapidly approaching from ahead…
Upon seeing the two people swiftly nearing Li Yan Island, Zhang Jian’s face instantly darkened:
“Forget it, no need…”
Because by that time, those two had already crossed the perimeter of the defensive array and entered Li Yan Island.
Very soon.
The two of them arrived in front of Zhang Jian and Yue Qi’s wife amongst others.
“Zhang Jian…”
“What, do you still intend to be the hero today?”
Zhang Jian frowned deeply, facing the two immensely arrogant figures before him.
These two men had similar features—thick eyebrows, large eyes, and beards—along with equally stern gazes.
At the moment, their stern looks also carried arrogance, and with a disdainful glance at Zhang Jian, they spoke:
“Your wounds from last time haven’t healed yet, but you still want to play the hero. It seems you don’t take us brothers seriously.”
Facing the two brothers’ aggressive stance, Zhang Jian’s expression grew solemn as he said:
“Jin Jue, your arrogance knows no bounds. Don’t tell me you really believe that no one can handle the two of you?”
“Hahaha…” Jin Jue and Jin’Ao burst into wild laughter.
“Just the few of you?”
“Besides those Nascent Soul True Monarchs in the Thousand Islands Domain, we brothers have yet to meet our match.”
“And let me tell you, when we brothers join forces, even a Nascent Soul Cultivator can fight toe to toe with us.”
Actually, they weren’t wrong in their claim.
Both of them were at the Golden Core Peak in cultivation, and they had also cultivated a joint offensive technique.
When deployed together, their cultivation levels would stack, effectively rivaling that of the Nascent Soul Stage.
It was because of their unique joint cultivation technique that they dared to speak so boldly.
Last time, they could fend off the two because of Li Tangyu’s unpredictable demonic techniques, with Zhang Jian lending a hand on the side and other Golden Core Cultivators from Li Yan Island forming an array in support.
That’s how they managed to drive the two away.
Now, with Li Tangyu absent, it was clear that on Li Yan Island, there was nobody they feared.
……
Facing the aggressive Jin brothers, Zhang Jian’s frown deepened.
Yet, he never took a step back.
Seeing this, Jin Jue snorted coldly and said:
“Hmph!”
“Since that’s the case, there’s nothing more to say…”
Having said that, Jin Jue, along with Jin’Ao, simultaneously brought out their magical treasures.
Although Zhang Jian was still injured, he had no intention of retreating and also summoned his flying sword, standing off against the two brothers.
At this tense moment.
Suddenly, a figure appeared beside Zhang Jian, a hand landing on his shoulder all at once.
At the same time, a voice reached Zhang Jian’s ears:
“Brother Zhang…”
“You take a rest first; leave these two to me.”
Caught up in the standoff with the Jin brothers, Zhang Jian was startled by the sudden appearance of the figure.
Instinctively, he wanted to command his flying sword to attack.
But then, the familiar voice resounded, and Zhang Jian was instantly filled with excitement.
He quickly turned, looking incredulously at the suddenly appearing Lin Jing, exclaiming with surprise:
“Brother Lin, you…”
“You’re still alive…”
Zhang Jian, who would usually remain silent, was now making a shockingly bold statement.
Any touch of emotion Lin Jing might have felt instantly vanished within that utterance.
With a full head of black lines, Lin Jing then said:
“Yes…”
“I’m still alive. You’re not fully recovered; rest up for now, and let me handle these two.”
After speaking, Lin Jing turned his head to look at the opposing Jin Jue and Jin’Ao brothers.
Zhang Jian, his attention thoroughly absorbed by the Jin brothers, was unclear about Lin Jing’s arrival.
But the Jin brothers saw everything clearly.
They watched as Lin Jing suddenly appeared beside Zhang Jian.
Yes, just appeared out of nowhere.
And Lin Jing, without commanding any magical treasure, managed to stand in mid-air.
That instantly put the brothers on alert.
Furthermore, they couldn’t detect any trace of cultivation from Lin Jing.
There were only two possibilities for such a situation.
One, the other party practiced a cultivation technique that could hide their cultivation level.
The second, the other party’s cultivation was far higher than theirs, and if they didn’t want to be seen, naturally, they would remain unseen.
However, judging by Lin Jing’s demeanor since his appearance,
it was quite clear that the second possibility was the likely one.
Jin Jue and Jin’Ao, no longer sporting their previous arrogance, became cautious…

chapters.title: Chapter 483: 180 Lin Jing's 'Dao Companion
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Chapter 180 Lin Jing’s ‘Dao Companion
Lin Jing emerged and after assessing the Jin brothers, he said:
“Is it you two who desire to forcefully take over my Li Yan Island?”
At this moment, both of them were extremely cautious, guarding carefully while using their Divine Sense to stealthily probe towards Lin Jing.
However, before their Divine Sense could even reach Lin Jing, it mysteriously vanished.
Their faces changed drastically on the spot.
Initially, as soon as Lin Jing appeared, they sensed that his cultivation was extraordinary, at least that of the Nascent Soul Stage.
But now, their Divine Sense could not detect any information about their opponent.
This could only mean that the opponent’s Divine Sense was likely far stronger than theirs…
Since the opponent’s Divine Sense was so formidable, it was very likely that he was not just in the early stages of the Nascent Soul.
At the very least… he was in the late Nascent Soul Stage…
The two had originally thought that if the Nascent Soul Cultivator before them was just in the early Nascent Soul Stage, they could use their Combination Technique to fight with him for a while.
But this person in front of them had an abnormally strong Divine Sense, very likely a late Nascent Soul Stage Cultivator.
Under no circumstances could the two of them be a match for him.
Therefore,
Jin Jue hurriedly spoke with a forced smile:
“Senior, I believe this is a misunderstanding…”
“We did not know that this island belonged to you, we will leave immediately…”
However,
Lin Jing had no intention of letting them go.
Lin Jing snorted coldly and said:
“Hmph!”
“You desire to seize my Li Yan Island by force and even injured my friend, do you think you can just get away with it?”
Cold sweat immediately started to pour down their bodies, and they said:
“Senior…”
“This is all a misunderstanding, we will compensate, whatever senior wants, we will give it to you.”
At this time, Yue Qi spoke up to Lin Jing:
“Island Master…”
“You must not let them off, their notoriety is known to all in the nearby seas, and they are also exceedingly treacherous. If you let them go now, it will bring endless troubles.”
Zhang Jian also voiced his agreement:
“Brother Lin…”
“You cannot let them go, doing so will lead to endless troubles, and these two have been coveting Brother Lin’s partner, eyeing her with ill-intent.”
“They even declared they wanted to take her away to be their dual cultivation furnace.”
Upon hearing this, the two brothers’ faces changed dramatically.
If all the prior misunderstandings could still be explained, then the matter of snatching someone’s partner was something they could never clear up.
Lin Jing had no intention of letting the two go, but Zhang Jian’s direct mention of his ‘partner’ left Lin Jing somewhat puzzled, as he wondered when he had acquired a ‘partner’.
Lin Jing, looking puzzled, turned his head to Zhang Jian…
But the Jin brothers took this opportunity to directly maneuver their Magical Treasures in an attack against Lin Jing.
Although Lin Jing was looking at Zhang Jian, his Divine Sense was always monitoring the Jin brothers.
Seeing the two maneuvering their Magical Treasures for an attack, Lin Jing didn’t delay and instantly activated the Five Elements Divine Art. Then, streams of Wǔ Cǎi light converged, ready to strike at the Jin brothers.
Witnessing Lin Jing’s conjuring of the spell, the brothers acted decisively…
And just as those two Ring Treasures had not yet reached Lin Jing, the two brothers shouted in unison:
“Explode!”
The two Ring Treasures immediately blew up in mid-air.
“Boom!”
“Boom!”
Suddenly, two huge explosions erupted.
The explosion, mixed with the furious spiritual power, instantly created a massive shockwave that surged towards Lin Jing, Zhang Jian, Yue Qi’s mother, and Lin Jue.
Moreover, the location of the Magical Treasure’s explosion was not far from the skies above Li Yan City; the violent spiritual power attacked not only Lin Jing and the others.
It also swept through half of Li Yan City; if the explosion were ignored, the lower half of Li Yan City would surely suffer greatly.
When the two shouted “Explode,” Lin Jing immediately sensed trouble.
He then quickly gathered spiritual power to form an incredibly thick, slightly curved, vast Spiritual Shield in front of them.
Following that.
“Boom… Boom…”
Two loud explosions—the rampant spiritual power was on its way.
However…
Although the self-detonation of the Jin Clan brothers’ Magical Treasure was not a small feat, it still couldn’t mask Lin Jing’s defense.
Under the effect of the Spiritual Shield, the entire direction of the explosion was altered, avoiding Lin Jing and the others, as well as the lower part of Li Yan City.
If Lin Jing hadn’t reacted so quickly this time…
The explosion would likely have severely injured the three of them and even demolished much of Li Yan City below.
After the light from the explosion had dispersed, the figures of the two were no longer visible; they had taken advantage of the explosion to quickly leave the area.
Seeing the resolute action taken by the Jin Clan brothers, a cold light flickered in Lin Jing’s eyes.
These two, they mustn’t be left alive.
For they are like venomous snakes.
Capable of biding their time and striking at critical moments; keeping them would pose a tremendous threat to Li Yan Island.
With this in mind, Lin Jing immediately extended his Divine Sense outward.
Indeed.
On the sea surface a hundred miles away, Lin Jing found the two desperately fleeing.
Without hesitating, Lin Jing took a step and chased after them.
The two had a swift escape, but compared to Lin Jing, it wasn’t enough.
In just a dozen or so breaths, Lin Jing had already appeared in front of the two, blocking their path.
The two were startled upon seeing Lin Jing catch up so quickly.
Therefore, they hastily pleaded:
“Senior…”
“It’s all a misunderstanding; we didn’t know that Li Qingqing was your beloved. We will never dare to have such improper thoughts again.”
“We only ask that you spare us, senior; we are willing to offer all our treasures, even if we have to serve you as if we were oxen or horses.”
However, in the face of their pleas,
Lin Jing did not pay them any heed.
Instead, he immediately took action, instantly conjuring countless streaks of Wǔ Cǎi radiance and shooting towards the two.
Seeing Lin Jing make a move, the two knew that anything they said now would be meaningless.
Thus,
They hardened their gaze and struck back, bringing forth two Magical Treasures and attacking Lin Jing.
At this moment, the two operated an unknown Cultivation Technique, and a green light immediately glowed upon their bodies.
Furthermore, between the two, several strands of spiritual power condensed into green threads, connecting them.
Even the Magical Treasures they now summoned were different from before.
This time, the two Magical Treasures they brought forth were both semi-circular, one large and one small.
And those two treasures could be combined.
Now, after the two treasures danced in the air for a moment, they directly merged into one another, forming a ring-shaped Treasure and attacking Lin Jing.
Before the Ring Treasure could reach him, Lin Jing’s Wǔ Cǎi radiance was already nearing the two.
It aimed directly for the green light, seeking to pierce through and enter the bodies of the two.
The two caught a glimpse of the thin, silk-like Wǔ Cǎi radiance; noticing that its emitted aura was not very strong, they then circulated their Cultivation Technique to intensify the green glow around them.
After doing all of this, the two no longer paid attention to the streaks of Wǔ Cǎi radiance, instead focusing all their effort on controlling the Magical Treasures to attack Lin Jing.
It seemed that the two had great confidence in the green light around them, believing that the green glow could withstand the Wǔ Cǎi radiance.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: 181 Night Approaches True Lord and Xue Yilin
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Chapter 181 Night Approaches True Lord and Xue Yilin
However…
What they hadn’t expected was that the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light, upon entering the cyan glow, did not dissipate directly.
Instead, it became even more active, attempting to burrow into the bodies of the two men.
The Jin brothers sensed the seemingly inconspicuous Wǔ Cǎi flow of light and their expressions changed drastically. They couldn’t help but exclaim:
“Our Protective Divine Light can ward off any spell in the world.”
“There is only one kind of spell that can infiltrate before the cyan light breaks, and that is the Five Elements Divine Art…”
“The Five Elements Divine Art has been lost for many years; why does it appear in your hands to be executed?”
Facing their questions, Lin Jing coldly replied:
“That is none of your concern.”
Having said that, Lin Jing directly manipulated the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light within the cyan light to drill toward the two men’s bodies.
Although the two brothers were running their Cultivation Technique with all their might, making the cyan light around their bodies more brilliant, they could only slow down the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light and were utterly unable to eliminate those strands of Wǔ Cǎi flow.
Seeing this, the Jin brothers exchanged a look and then directly maneuvered their Ring Treasure to come in front of Lin Jing.
Thereafter, another loud shout came:
“Explode!”
The Ring Treasure exploded once again.
However, this time Lin Jing was well prepared.
Before the Ring Treasure could explode, Lin Jing had already stepped out and instantly appeared in front of the two brothers.
Next, Lin Jing threw a punch directly, landing it on Jin Jue’s body.
The power of Lin Jing’s punch was not to be underestimated.
It struck squarely on the cyan light outside Jin Jue’s body, yet despite the punch, Lin Jing’s fist did not penetrate the cyan light.
Lin Jing discovered that at the moment his fist made contact, the filament connecting Jin Jue and Jin’Ao suddenly lit up brightly, and Jin Jue’s entire aura suddenly intensified.
As for Jin’Ao, the aura around his body weakened.
And also…
Even the cyan light on his body had greatly diminished.
In this exchange of increasing and decreasing strength, Jin Jue managed to withstand Lin Jing’s punch.
Even the cyan light outside Jin Jue’s body showed no sign of dissipating.
Only now, both Jin Jue and Jin’Ao were sent flying far away by Lin Jing’s punch.
Although they were protected by the cyan light, they were still seriously injured by Lin Jing’s punch and couldn’t help but spit out a large mouthful of blood.
However, that was enough.
Just now, in order to defend against Lin Jing, Jin’Ao’s cyan light had weakened, allowing the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light to take advantage of the vulnerability and penetrate into Jin’Ao’s body.
Lin Jing then directly operated the Five Elements Divine Art, taking control of the Wǔ Cǎi flow in Jin’Ao’s body and igniting it.
In an instant, the Wǔ Cǎi light burst forth from within Jin’Ao’s body, causing Jin Jue to cry out in horror:
“Brother…”
However, by then the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light had already erupted within Jin’Ao’s body.
There was nothing Jin Jue could do but watch helplessly.
At that moment, Jin’Ao’s face was twisted in agony as he struggled to speak:
“Brother, run…”
No sooner had the words left his lips than Jin’Ao was engulfed by the Wǔ Cǎi light, and in moments, he disappeared without a trace…
Upon Jin’Ao’s death, the cyan light on Jin Jue’s body dissipated at once.
However, as Lin Jing had already set off the Wǔ Cǎi flow of light within Jin’Ao’s body, the remaining Wǔ Cǎi flow that had not yet penetrated Jin Jue’s body also dissipated.
Now, with Jin’Ao dead and Jin Jue looking as grey as death, there was no intention to resist.
Because he knew that on his own, it would be very difficult to escape Lin Jing’s pursuit.
Of course, Lin Jing could not possibly spare this troublemaker and was about to lower his hand to strike…
But just as Lin Jing was ready to strike, a voice came from afar:
“Fellow Daoist, please hold on for a moment…”
Afterward, they saw two figures, one fat and one thin, rapidly flying toward them from afar.
Upon hearing this voice, Jin Jue, whose face had been grey as death, suddenly saw a glimmer of hope.
“It’s Lord Yelin…”
Just as Jin Jue’s voice fell, two cultivators, one fat and one thin, arrived together at the scene.
Moreover, both of these individuals had mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivation.
Upon seeing the newcomers, Jin Jue hastily addressed the one with handsome features and a lean figure:
“Master Yelin, save me…”
It turned out, this person was Master Yelin.
However, it was unknown why Master Yelin was entangled with the Jin brothers.
After his arrival, Master Yelin stepped forward, shielding Jin Jue behind him, and then he eyed Lin Jing, saying:
“This fellow cultivator, I am Master Yelin of Yelin Island.”
“I am not sure how the Jin brothers have offended you, that you would seek to utterly annihilate them.”
Facing Master Yelin, Lin Jing showed no fear and looked directly at him, saying:
“These Jin brothers intend to forcefully occupy my Li Yan Island and have also injured my friend.”
“Master Yelin…”
“Tell me, should I let them go?”
Previously, Yue Qi had mentioned that Master Yelin might have designs on Li Yan Island.
Nonetheless, Master Yelin ultimately did not take any action.
That intention was merely a speculation by Yue Qi and her group; Lin Jing could not rashly make an enemy of him.
Hence, he spoke as he did.
His goal was also to probe the truth of the matter.
In fact,
There was another point: Master Yelin’s appearance was too coincidental.
Lin Jing suspected that Master Yelin might have a connection with the two Jin brothers.
He said so to gauge Master Yelin’s reaction.
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than the other fat cultivator by Master Yelin’s side said:
“The recent affairs of the Li Yan Fang Market have been the talk of the town; I have heard a bit about it.”
“So it turns out you’re the Island Master of Li Yan Island…”
“I am Xue Yilin of Yue Tian Island, may I inquire as to your honorable name?”
Lin Jing looked toward Xue Yilin, noting his corpulent figure, with a head even larger than that of an average person, and eyes that became mere slits when he smiled.
At this moment, he was smiling faintly, looking at Lin Jing, waiting for his response.
Facing Xue Yilin, Lin Jing was unsure of his intentions, but seeing him like this, it seemed that he harbored no hostility toward Lin Jing.
Thus, Lin Jing said:
“Lin Jing…”
Xue Yilin nodded, saluted Lin Jing with a fist, and said:
“So you are Fellow Lin…”
After speaking, Xue Yilin directly addressed Master Yelin:
“Master Yelin…”
“Actually, this matter is quite clear. The Li Yan Island incident has been widely known, and these Jin brothers were among those who caused the most commotion.”
“Fellow Lin was in secluded cultivation and unaware, allowing these Jin brothers to create such chaos…”
“Now that Fellow Lin has left seclusion, naturally, he will not let them off. This is only human nature…”
“If you ask me, it is better to hand Jin Jue over to Fellow Lin…”
Lin Jing was somewhat surprised by Xue Yilin’s words.
What Lin Jing did not expect was that Xue Yilin would actually speak on his behalf.
Given Master Yelin’s actions earlier, it was clear that Master Yelin had indeed considered protecting Jin Jue.
However, right after Xue Yilin finished speaking,
Jin Jue spoke up again, saying:
“Elder Xue…”
“Aren’t you looking for someone who practices the Five Elements Cultivation Technique?”
“This Lin Jing, he practices the long-lost Five Elements Divine Art…”

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 182 Regional Division of the Thousand Islands Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Chapter 182 Regional Division of the Thousand Islands Domain
Xue Yilin heard the words, and a chill suddenly burst forth from his smiling eyes.
Then, with a wave of his sleeve, he shot three black streaks directly from his cuff.
These black streaks did not head for Lin Jing, but aimed straight at Jin Jue.
Jin Jue, for his part, would never have imagined that Xue Yilin would kill him at this moment. He didn’t have time to react before the three black streaks pierced through his body.
He looked at Xue Yilin with eyes full of disbelief.
Afterward, Jin Jue lost his breath and plummeted directly into the sea below.
However, that was not all.
The three black streaks seemed to carry a potent poison, as Jin Jue’s body began to decay while he fell.
First the skin, then the flesh, and finally the internal organs—all corroded completely…
By the time Jin Jue hit the sea, he was nothing but a blackened skeleton.
It was truly horrifying.
After killing Jin Jue, Xue Yilin once again reverted to his smiley demeanor.
He then turned his head and said to True Lord Ye Lin:
“True Lord Ye Lin…”
“This guy was very dishonest.”
“Yet a mere Golden Core Stage cultivator fancied to drive a wedge between our relationship.”
“I decided to take action and solve the problem myself. I hope that doesn’t upset you, True Lord Ye Lin.”
True Lord Ye Lin looked down at the sea below, his expression revealing none of his emotions.
And then he spoke:
“Indeed, that man deserved to die; you have spared me the trouble, Brother Xue.”
The actions of the two left Lin Jing somewhat confused.
Originally, Lin Jing thought that the two had come to assist Jin Jue.
But unexpectedly, Xue Yilin took action and killed Jin Jue outright.
Even Lin Jing had not reacted in time.
Following that, True Lord Ye Lin looked at Lin Jing opposite him and asked:
“Brother Lin…”
“There have been rumors saying that you’ve secluded yourself. Could it be, Brother Lin, that you have actually been preparing to advance to the Nascent Soul Stage?”
Lin Jing nodded:
“I had some insights before, so I went into seclusion, hoping to break through to the Nascent Soul Realm.”
“Fortunately, luck was on my side…”
True Lord Ye Lin nodded and said:
“Brother Lin’s luck indeed seems fortuitous.”
“Now that Brother Lin has become a Nascent Soul Cultivator, there is no need to keep certain matters from you any longer.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing became puzzled.
“What matters?”
True Lord Ye Lin continued:
“It is about the territorial redivision of the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“The Thousand Islands Domain has many islands, but the forces within it are extremely fragmented.”
“Therefore, the three major islands intend to consolidate the domain’s strength and redivide the regional powers.”
“Especially for us Nascent Soul Cultivators, after the redivision, it is estimated that each one of us will be able to manage a not insignificant region.”
“And Brother Xue has come this time to convey this message.”
Xue Yilin then also spoke:
“Brother Lin…”
“This territorial redivision is extremely beneficial to us Nascent Soul Cultivators. After the redivision, each of us will oversee several, or perhaps dozens of islands.”
“And those other island masters will be under your jurisdiction. At that time, you will be the ruler of this maritime domain.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment before asking:
“What about us? Will we have to obey the three major islands?”
Xue Yilin nodded and said:
“Yes…”
Lin Jing frowned at once…
To obey the three major islands was to lose freedom and be subjugated to others for their benefit.
Seeing Lin Jing’s hesitation, Xue Yilin said:
“Brother Lin, please be assured.”
“Though it is to obey the three major islands, the islands beneath them will not be required to offer anything up.”
“Moreover, this is a defensive alliance agreement.”
“Its purpose is also to collectively defend against external enemies when they arise, without causing any harm to the islands themselves.”
“On the contrary, if outsiders seek to forcibly take over the islands, the three major islands will provide protection.”
Having heard this, Lin Jing finally understood.
The territorial division was actually a strategy to strengthen the management of the Thousand Islands Domain by the three major islands.
Xue Yilin continued to speak:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Now that you have reached the Nascent Soul Stage, you count as having stepped into the upper echelons within the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“In two months, come to Yue Tian Island to attend the territorial division conference. At that time, all Nascent Soul Cultivators from our Thousand Islands Domain will be present.”
“Moreover, the Island Masters of the three great islands will be there in person to carry out the division.”
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Alright…”
“Since that is the case, I will definitely head over in two months.”
At this, Xue Yilin returned to his usual smiling demeanor, cupped his fists towards Lin Jing, and said:
“Then at that time, I will await Lin Daoyou on Yue Tian Island.”
Lin Jing also cupped his fists in response to Xue Yilin:
“Rest assured, Xue Daoyou, I will certainly go.”
Xue Yilin said with a smile, “That’s very good…”
At that moment, Lin Jing, puzzled, asked Xue Yilin:
“Xue Daoyou, if someone disagrees with this territorial division, what will happen?”
Xue Yilin’s eyes, though squinted, flashed coldly as he replied directly:
“This time, the division of power is personally ordered and overseen by the Island Masters of the three great islands.”
“If someone truly disagrees, they must either leave the Thousand Islands Domain or… never be able to leave again.”
“I think nobody would seek discomfort for themselves by opposing the Island Masters at the Divinity Transformation Stage.”
“Lin Daoyou, you agree, don’t you…”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Indeed…”
……
Xue Yilin said to Lin Jing:
“Alright…”
“Lin Daoyou, Night Lin and I were merely passing through this place, but we have other matters to attend to now, so we shall take our leave.”
“Lin Daoyou, farewell!”
At this moment, Night Lin, who had remained silent up until now, also clasped his hands and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, farewell!”
Lin Jing, in turn, clasped his hands and said to the two:
“Since you both have matters to attend to, I won’t keep you any longer.”
“Xue Daoyou, Night Lin…”
“Farewell!”
Just as they were about to leave, Xue Yilin suddenly turned his head and asked Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, Jin Jue just mentioned that you practice the long-lost Five Elements Divine Art, is that correct?”
Lin Jing had fought Jin’Ao earlier, and since they were not far from each other, they might have seen him use the Five Elements Divine Art.
Therefore, Lin Jing did not have much to hide.
Lin Jing looked at the still-smiling Xue Yilin and nodded:
“Yes, I indeed practice the Five Elements Divine Art.”
“Previously, I acquired this spell by chance from an enemy…”
“May I know what advice Xue Daoyou has to offer?”
Xue Yilin waved his hands repeatedly, his face still smiling as he said:
“Lin Daoyou, you give me too much credit; I dare not presume to teach…”
“It’s just that I may need to ask for a small favor from you in the future.”
“Of course, for requesting your help, I will surely offer a reward that will satisfy you.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing asked casually:
“Xue Daoyou, may I know what kind of help you need?”
Xue Yilin said:
“It’s not yet certain at this moment. I will tell you once it’s confirmed.”
“Of course, it will entirely depend on whether Lin Daoyou is willing. Even if you decide not to help, I won’t bear any grudge.”
“Well, with that said…”
“Lin Daoyou, we shall meet again.”
Without waiting for Lin Jing to answer, Xue Yilin and Night Lin left the place together.
And once again, Lin Jing was left alone in this place…

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 183: Reunion
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Chapter 183: Reunion
This time.
Lin Jing saw the Lord of Nightfall and that Xue Yilin.
Lin Jing observed the Lord of Nightfall very clearly, previously, he indeed had the intention to save Jin Jue.
However, Xue Yilin didn’t seem to get along well with the Lord of Nightfall.
He didn’t give the Lord of Nightfall any face at all.
And it seemed that the Lord of Nightfall also had some reservations about Xue Yilin.
Even when Xue Yilin killed Jin Jue right in front of him, the Lord of Nightfall still didn’t take any other action.
And then there was Xue Yilin.
Even though he looked all smiles, appearing amiable and very easy to talk to.
In reality, he was also an extremely dangerous individual.
This could be seen from his sudden, unexpected strike to kill Jin Jue.
Nevertheless, Lin Jing found his sudden action quite baffling and always felt the reason for his strike was far-fetched.
Of course, it could also be because of the Five Elements Divine Art.
This Xue Yilin, it seems that next time they meet, he would have to be more cautious.
……
After the Lord of Nightfall and Xue Yilin left, Lin Jing also returned to Li Yan Island.
After returning, he saw the questioning looks of everyone and nodded.
Everyone sighed in relief.
At that moment, Zhang Jian hurried to Lin Jing’s side and carefully examined him:
“Brother Lin…”
“You’ve actually entered the Nascent Soul Stage so quickly.”
Lin Jing then said with a smile:
“Let’s go…”
“First, let’s go back to my small courtyard, we’ll talk more once we’re back.”
“Alright…” Zhang Jian quickly agreed.
Subsequently.
Lin Jing led Zhang Jian and several others back to his own residence in the northern part of Li Yan Island.
As soon as they arrived in the courtyard, Zhang Jian began to inquire:
“Where exactly did those who attended the trade meeting that time go?”
“You don’t know, after you disappeared, many people have been looking for you.”
“And after your disappearance, some others also went missing one after another, but in the end, nothing was found.”
Lin Jing then spoke up, explaining the ins and outs of the matter to everyone.
Upon hearing what Lin Jing said, everyone was immensely shocked.
They had not expected that someone could use the sacrifice of Golden Core Cultivators to help themselves break through their realm.
Such an inhumane act was also a violation of heavenly principles, and yet there were people who dared do it.
And Zhang Jian felt even more remorse, saying:
“If it weren’t for me, Brother Lin, you wouldn’t have fallen into such misfortune.”
This event had no warning beforehand.
Moreover, even without Zhang Jian, Lin Jing might have also decided to check out the trade meeting on his own.
After all, at that time, Lin Jing was still in need of High-Grade Spiritual Plants and wanted to collect them.
Encountering such a situation was completely unexpected, and Zhang Jian couldn’t be blamed.
Therefore.
Lin Jing spoke to comfort him:
“Brother Zhang…”
“You can’t blame yourself for this, there’s no need for self-reproach.”
After saying this, Lin Jing continued:
“During this time, I have also been greatly indebted to Brother Zhang; otherwise, my Li Yan Island would have fallen into the hands of others long ago.”
Zhang Jian replied:
“There’s nothing worth mentioning about what I did; you were trapped because of me, Brother Lin, what I’ve done was merely my duty.”
Lin Jing shook his head and then took out several top-grade life-reviving pills from his Space Ring and handed them to Zhang Jian.
Seeing the life-reviving pills Lin Jing took out for recovering from injuries, Zhang Jian didn’t stand on ceremony and directly accepted them.
As he took the life-reviving pills, Zhang Jian also pulled out a small, trade-use Storage Bag from his own and handed it over to Lin Jing.
“Brother Lin…”
“The two hundred thousand Spirit Stones I borrowed from you before, I’d like to take this opportunity to return them.”
“You mustn’t refuse, after all, although we share a good relationship, since I borrowed it, I must return it.”
“As for the rest, let’s discuss them separately,”
Lin Jing nodded, then said:
“Okay…”
Having finished speaking, Lin Jing asked Zhang Jian:
“Brother Zhang…”
“You are now at the pinnacle of Golden Core cultivation, I estimate you must be facing Tribulation soon and advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage, right?”
After hearing this, Zhang Jian shook his head and with a bitter smile replied:
“No…”
“The cultivation technique I’ve practiced on my own is indeed not reliable.”
“Although I’m at the peak of Golden Core cultivation, my Golden Core Peak is extremely unstable, and my combat power has suffered greatly.”
“Otherwise, I wouldn’t have been injured so severely by those two brothers from the Jin Clan.”
At this point, Zhang Jian pondered for a while and then continued:
“I estimate…”
“It will take me at least decades or a hundred years to stay at this Golden Core Peak before I can start advancing to Nascent Soul.”
“Otherwise, if the foundation is not solid, undergoing Tribulation would be seeking death.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing immediately remembered Zhang Jian’s previous ordeal and then spoke:
“Then, the Frostbone Erosion you experienced before…”
Lin Jing had barely started speaking when Zhang Jian interrupted him.
Zhang Jian trembled all over, hurriedly reached out to cover Lin Jing’s mouth, and stuttered from deep inside:
“Don’t…”
“Don’t mention it…”
“Brother Lin, please spare me.”
It was then that Lin Jing remembered that Zhang Jian indeed had told him about this matter.
He was tormented by Frostbone Erosion, suffering from psychological trauma, and couldn’t stand hearing those words.
He would tremble at the mere mention.
Lin Jing had remembered this before.
But after the journey into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm,
Lin Jing had completely forgotten about this matter.
This time, it was Zhang Jian’s reminder that jogged Lin Jing’s memory.
So he hurriedly stopped speaking and couldn’t help but sheepishly grin:
“Heh heh…”
“Sorry Brother Zhang, it slipped my mind…”
But Zhang Jian stopped Lin Jing from continuing and opened his mouth to say:
“As long as you don’t mention that matter, we’re still good friends…”
Lin Jing was speechless, never expecting that offending that woman in white back then would leave Zhang Jian still not recovered to this day.
It also served as a warning to Lin Jing that in the future, no matter what, unless absolutely necessary, he must not offend those female cultivators who appeared cold and aloof and possessed formidable strength.
Afterward.
The group went inside a room, where Lin Jing listened to them recount some of the experiences they had over the years.
In the middle of their talk, Ye Yun suddenly appeared.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Ye Yun was immediately overjoyed, with his eyes even turning slightly red.
It turned out that Ye Yun had been cultivating at the Land of Earthly Flame’s spring.
Therefore, he hadn’t been there before.
Because of Lin Jing’s disappearance, Ye Yun’s cultivation had become even more zealous, and now his level had surpassed that of Yue Qi and Li Qingqing.
He was the only one among the few Golden Core Cultivators on Li Yan Island who had broken through to the mid-stage of Golden Core.
Even Li Qingqing, although she had started a few years earlier than Ye Yun,
was now only at the third layer of Golden Core cultivation.
Whereas Yue Qi, due to the nature of her Spiritual Root, had only managed one breakthrough over this long period.
She was currently at the second layer of Golden Core cultivation.
But now that Lin Jing had returned,
everything became easier.
With Lin Jing present, he could craft Gathering Yuan Pills to help them break through swiftly.
Of course, to achieve a breakthrough, the quality of one’s Spiritual Root is the most important factor.
Besides crafting Gathering Yuan Pills,
Lin Jing also needed to start collecting materials for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - 184 Li Tangyu's Choice
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Chapter 184 Li Tangyu’s Choice
And so it continued, until darkness fell.
Only then did the people conclude their conversation.
Afterward.
They each returned to their own affairs, and Zhang Jian also returned to Yuxing Island to heal his injuries.
Before the others left, Lin Jing issued some instructions to Zhang Jian and Ye Yun regarding his own previous experiences.
Because of the existence of that mysterious Divine Transformation Cultivator.
Lin Jing did not want others to know that he had entered the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, nor that he had advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage within it.
Due to his Tribulation, that Divine Transformation Cultivator had failed to advance, so it was possible that this person was secretly investigating, looking for him.
However.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had disguised himself before, and as long as he did not expose himself voluntarily, that Divine Transformation Cultivator should not be able to find him.
Moreover, Yue Qi and the others, in order to avoid trouble, had deliberately concealed Lin Jing’s whereabouts.
Thus.
Everyone thought that he, the Island Master of Li Yan Island, had quietly gone into secluded cultivation and suddenly broke through to the Nascent Soul Stage.
This was a fortuitous act; it saved him the trouble of explaining further.
As long as Zhang Jian was careful not to let anything slip, everything would be fine.
……
A few days later, Li Tangyu received the news and hurried over.
Lin Jing held a conversation with Li Tangyu too.
Before leaving, Lin Jing had made a Detoxification Pill for Li Tangyu, which Little Sparrow delivered to him, and upon receiving it, Li Tangyu took it immediately.
The Gu toxin in his body had long been cured.
And.
Li Tangyu, with the help of the seventh disciple of the Demon Lord, had broken free from the restrictions of the Cultivation Technique imposed by the Shadow Demon Lord.
One could say that he had regained his freedom.
Still, Li Tangyu continued to disguise himself, engaging in a power struggle with the Shadow Demon Lord.
This was also one of the conditions for Li Tangyu’s cooperation with the seventh disciple of the Demon Lord.
The seventh disciple of the Demon Lord would help Li Tangyu out of his predicament, while Li Tangyu would assist the latter in dealing with the Shadow Demon Lord.
The two of them were almost ready now, and it was estimated that they would soon take action against the Shadow Demon Lord.
What they were doing was not necessarily to kill the Shadow Demon Lord; even just defeating him and imprisoning him would suffice.
Because the Great Demon Lord had always encouraged competition among his disciples.
If one were to emerge victorious, not only would they gain the favor of the Great Demon Lord, but they could even receive rewards.
Of course.
If they failed, even if they did not die, the outcome would not be pleasant.
The ranks of the Great Demon Lord’s disciples were always limited to seven, and these seven positions were secured through mutual strife.
For Li Tangyu to break free from the control of the Shadow Demon Lord, he first had to get rid of the Gu toxin, and then solve the hidden dangers within that Cultivation Technique.
The last step was to defeat the Shadow Demon Lord, thus earning rightful recognition and entering into the view of the Great Demon Lord.
Now, the Detoxification Pill refined by Lin Jing had cured the Gu toxin.
The hidden dangers within that Cultivation Technique were also resolved with the help of the seventh disciple of the Great Demon Lord.
Now, all that remained was to defeat the Shadow Demon Lord.
This path was by no means easy.
But it was one Li Tangyu had to take.
Otherwise, his death was certain.
After hearing this, Lin Jing asked if Li Tangyu needed help, but he shook his head and refused Lin Jing’s offer.
Because it concerned the Demon Lord, if it was internal competition among them, it would be one thing, but if Lin Jing got involved, the nature of the matter would change.
If Lin Jing rashly joined, the Great Demon Lord might very likely send someone to act and directly eliminate Lin Jing.
In fact, that was also the reason why Li Tangyu had initially colluded with the seventh disciple of the Demon Lord.
In doing so, whatever Li Tangyu did would be justified and without issue.
However.
Lin Jing was quite curious about whether the seventh disciple of the Demon Lord could be trusted.
Yet, Li Tangyu expressed with certainty that there was no problem with this person, and upon receiving Li Tangyu’s affirmation, Lin Jing no longer pressed the matter.
Li Tangyu was unlike Li Qingqing; his experiences had made him extremely cautious.
Since he was so confident, then he must have had full assurance.
……
Li Tangyu’s visit this time, apart from catching up with Lin Jing,
was also to ask a favor of him.
“`
That was his upcoming tribulation.
Li Tangyu wanted Lin Jing’s help to refine the elixir medicine required for the tribulation.
For Lin Jing, refining this tribulation elixir medicine wasn’t a big deal.
As Lin Jing had some leftover top-quality Nirvana Elixir from his previous tribulation.
There were also other elixirs, such as supreme or flawless Yellow Dragon Elixirs and Huan Life Elixirs.
Lin Jing had them all on hand.
Lin Jing didn’t waste words and directly handed all these elixir medicines over to Li Tangyu.
True, Lin Jing had agreed to prepare a Nirvana Elixir for Zhang Jian.
But since Zhang Jian was still far from facing his tribulation, it made more sense to give the Nirvana Elixir to Li Tangyu first.
As for Zhang Jian, he could simply refine another one for him when the time came.
After all, the spirit plants needed to refine the Nirvana Elixir were all available in the System Space, and he could quickly mature them for refinement, which wasn’t troublesome.
Li Tangyu didn’t stand on ceremony and took the Nirvana Elixir before choosing a few from the other Yellow Dragon Elixirs and Huan Life Elixirs.
He indicated that these would be sufficient.
Lin Jing nodded and then collected the remaining elixir medicines.
Afterwards.
Li Tangyu fell silent for a moment and then solemnly told Lin Jing.
After this, his path of cultivation would drastically change, and he might very well embark on the true path of a demon cultivator.
Moreover.
Li Tangyu entrusted Li Qingqing to Lin Jing’s care earnestly.
Lin Jing felt a great deal of sympathy for Li Tangyu’s plight.
Initially a refined and genteel scion of a noble family, he unexpectedly found himself forced onto a demonic path.
Seeing Li Tangyu’s current state, it seemed that he had resolved to stride further and further down the demonic path…
Before leaving, Li Tangyu earnestly said to Lin Jing:
“Lin brother…”
“No matter what I become in the future, you will always be my brother, Li Tangyu, and I will always trust you.”
Lin Jing smiled and responded:
“So will I…”
After this, Li Tangyu left.
Lin Jing knew.
Upon Li Tangyu’s departure, upon his return, he would very likely have become a true demon cultivator.
……
After Li Tangyu left, Lin Jing returned to his usual, tranquil life.
Zhang Jian, after healing from his injuries, visited twice.
That was until half a month later, someone else sought out Lin Jing once more.
This time, the visitors were…
Yan Ming and the Qi Yan True Lord.
Of course, they brought along the sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Moreover.
At the time of their arrival, Zhang Jian also happened to be there.
Zhang Jian’s presence here, of course, was because Lin Jing had pulled him in to help with the construction of a formation.
Back at the trade conference, Zhang Jian had evaded the conspiracy by virtue of his understanding of formations.
And now, thanks to his insights into formations, he was directly promoted to a Fifth-Rank Array Master.
In the spirit field of Li Yan Island, there was still one Nirvana Flower missing.
Now, with the Nirvana Flower planted by Lin Jing, naturally, a matching formation was required.
Zhang Jian’s injuries had healed, so naturally, Lin Jing pulled him in as labore.
Of course, Lin Jing provided the materials for constructing the formation himself.
Seeing the Nirvana Flower, Zhang Jian was extremely excited, even willing to toil gladly as a laborer.
When the two came, the formation was at a critical point in its layout, and Zhang Jian couldn’t leave his post.
Therefore, Lin Jing just mentioned to Zhang Jian that he would go out to welcome the visitors.
When Lin Jing arrived at Li Yan City,
he saw Yan Ming and the Qi Yan True Lord.
And Mother Yue Qi.
At that moment, Mother Yue Qi, meeting again with Yan Xing and Yan Yue, the three were happily chatting about family matters.
Yan Ming and the Qi Yan True Lord, however, were watching the scene quietly with smiles on their faces.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 185 Qi Yan Zhenjun's Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Chapter 185 Qi Yan Zhenjun’s Request
Speaking of which, during the half-year on Li Yan Island, Mother Yue Qi certainly spared no effort in taking care of the sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
When they saw Mother Yue Qi again, they were naturally overjoyed.
Moreover, they had grown up and become much more lively, no longer as shy as they were when little.
The three of them chatted and laughed together, looking very harmonious.
Lin Jing arrived at Li Yan City and went straight to the group.
Then, Lin Jing clasped his fists and said to the two:
“Yan Daoyou…”
“Qi Yan Daoyou…”
Both of them also clasped their fists in return, saying:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Lin Daoyou…”
After the greetings, Qi Yan Zhenjun directly addressed Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, I have prepared everything and can help you craft your Flying Sword at any time.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was immediately pleased:
“In that case, I must thank Qi Yan Daoyou.”
Qi Yan Zhenjun waved his hand and replied:
“Lin Daoyou, you’re too courteous.”
Afterward, Qi Yan Zhenjun seriously said:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Your Flying Sword, combined with those two materials, if crafted by me, should be between a Mid-grade and Superior Dao Artifact.”
“Any higher would probably be impossible. I need to make this clear to you in advance.”
The gap between Magical Treasures and Dao Artifacts is akin to a Cultivator’s Nascent Soul ascending to Divinity Transformation; it’s an immense chasm.
If those two materials could integrate into the Ling Yin Flawless Sword and raise it to the quality of a Dao Artifact, Lin Jing would be satisfied.
If it really were as Qi Yan Zhenjun said, elevating it to the quality of a Mid-grade Dao Artifact, that would be an unexpected pleasure.
Lin Jing certainly had no issues with that.
Therefore, Lin Jing said to Qi Yan Zhenjun:
“Qi Yan Daoyou, then I’ll trouble you with this task.”
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded in assurance, indicating no problem.
Just at this moment.
Yan Ming suddenly asked Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, I heard from my daughters that you are also an Alchemist?”
Lin Jing nodded and confirmed:
“That’s correct…”
“I indeed am an Alchemist.”
Qi Yan Zhenjun then inquired:
“May I ask how adept you are in Alchemy, Lin Daoyou, and up to what rank can you refine Elixir Medicine?”
Lin Jing pondered for a moment, then replied:
“Currently, I suppose I have exceeded Fourth Grade, but I have never had the chance to collect High-Grade Spiritual Plants and thus have never refined Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicine.”
“Fifth-Rank Pill Master…”
When they heard Lin Jing claim to be a Fifth-Rank Pill Master, both took in a sharp breath.
Lin Jing nodded and continued:
“Yes…”
Qi Yan Zhenjun first turned to glance at Yan Ming, then hesitated for a moment.
