After a short while, Qi Yan Zhenjun spoke with a hint of difficulty:
“Lin Daoyou, I have an impudent request…”
Seeing Qi Yan Zhenjun’s troubled expression, Lin Jing directly asked:
“Qi Yan Daoyou, go ahead; is it regarding Alchemy?”
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded and said:
“I want to refine a batch of Elixir Medicine, but I’ve never found a suitable Alchemist. I don’t know if Lin Daoyou could lend a hand.”
Lin Jing, wearing a smile, responded without hesitation:
“There’s naturally no problem in refining Elixir Medicine.”
“But may I know what Elixir are you looking to refine, Master Qi Yan?”
Qi Yan Zhenjun seemed very troubled; he hesitated for a moment and then looked at Lin Jing before saying:
“Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicine, the Revival Elixir.”
“Of course…”
“I know the preparation of fifth-rank Elixir Medicine is quite difficult, but if I seek help from other Alchemists outside, I can’t feel completely at ease, which is why I wanted to try and see if Lin Daoyou would give it a try.”
“If Lin Daoyou finds it difficult, then forget I mentioned it…”
“Revival Elixir…” Lin Jing showed a contemplative expression, seeming a bit hesitant:
After a moment, Lin Jing spoke directly:
“Qi Yan Daoyou, to tell you the truth…”
“Although I am a fourth-grade Alchemist, I haven’t been at this level for very long.”
“I have never personally prepared Revival Elixir, and I don’t even have the recipe for it…”
“As for the preparation of the Revival Elixir, I can only say I’m somewhat confident, but this confidence is not that great.”
“If Qi Yan Daoyou trusts me, I am willing to give it a try…”
Actually, with the system’s blessing, Lin Jing’s chances of successfully making a fifth-rank Elixir Medicine are not very low.
But Lin Jing had indeed never encountered fifth-rank Elixir Medicine, so he did not boast or exaggerate.
If Qi Yan truly needed the Revival Elixir urgently, then Lin Jing could ‘accidentally’ produce a batch when it came time.
……
Qi Yan hesitated for a moment, then spoke directly:
“The recipe for the Revival Elixir is easy to obtain; I can get that for you. And besides the recipe for the Revival Elixir, I can help you obtain any other recipes you might need.”
“I just don’t know which recipes Lin Daoyou is missing?”
Lin Jing was slightly embarrassed and said awkwardly:
“To not conceal from Qi Yan Daoyou…”
“Currently, I only have one fifth-rank recipe, which is for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir. Unfortunately, I lack the corresponding Spiritual Plants and have never prepared it.”
Upon hearing that Lin Jing had the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, Qi Yan and Yan Ming were immediately shocked.
Especially Yan Ming, who was visibly excited:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“You actually have the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir?”
“I had heard before that among the major powers of the Inner Sea, there was a circulated Elixir Medicine that could alter the quality of one’s Spiritual Root, the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.”
“But that recipe is hard to find, and I had only seen a damaged recipe once through a friend.”
“I wonder if you could let me have a look at your recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir…”
Lin Jing nodded, then took out the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir from his Space Ring and handed it to Yan Ming.
Yan Ming took the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir and unfurled it immediately. Qi Yan also approached to take a look at this time.
The two of them carefully reviewed the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
The more they looked, the more excited they became.
While reading, they even discussed the contents of the recipe.
It wasn’t until a good while later that the two of them finished looking through the recipe.
Then Yan Ming handed the recipe back to Lin Jing.
“This is indeed the recipe for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, and it’s complete too.”
“I wonder how Lin Daoyou came into possession of this recipe?”
Lin Jing then said:
“Obtaining this recipe was a bit of serendipity…”
“There are some complications involved, so I’d rather not speak about them in detail. I hope you two Daoyou can understand.”
The two nodded and did not press the matter further.
Then, Qi Yan smiled and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Since it’s like this, I will go collect the Spiritual Plants and recipe. As for the Alchemy, I will leave it in your capable hands, Lin Daoyou.”
Lin Jing looked at Qi Yan and asked:
“Qi Yan Daoyou has really decided to let me prepare the Revival Elixir?”
Qi Yan nodded:
“Fifth-rank Elixir Medicine are rare due to the difficulty in finding the materials, and they don’t appear often in the southern outer sea.”
“Moreover, those who have personally prepared fifth-rank Elixir Medicine are not many.”
“Instead of finding someone else to perform Alchemy, I’d prefer to let you, Lin Daoyou, give it a try…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing responded with a cupped fist salute:
“Since Qi Yan Daoyou places such trust in me, I will certainly give it my all.”
Hearing that, Qi Yan, too, offered a salute with his fist and said to Lin Jing:
“In that case, I must entrust this task to you, Lin Daoyou.”

chapters.title: Chapter 489: 186: Refining the Revival Elixir
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Chapter 186: Refining the Revival Elixir
Afterward, Qi Yan True Master turned his head and said to Yan Ming:
“Old Yan, I remember you have a Revival Vine on your Spirit Rock Island, don’t you? I’ll be borrowing it for now, I will return it to you later.”
Having said that, Qi Yan True Master turned to look at Yan Xing and Yan Yue, who were with Yue Qi Mother, and said:
“I’ll let these two nieces of mine stay here for now; they seem quite happy. We’ll make a trip back to Spirit Rock Island and retrieve the Revival Vine.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Ming exchanged glances with Qi Yan True Master, then nodded, and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“We’re entrusting the young girl to your care for now; we’ll be back shortly.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Rest assured, fellow Daoists.”
Thereafter, Yan Ming instructed Yan Xing and Yan Yue:
“Xing’er, Yue’er, you two stay and play here with Uncle Lin, your Seventh Qi Yan grandfather and I have some matters to handle and will be back very soon.”
The two girls had just happily chatted with Yue Qi Mother and were naturally very willing to stay.
Thus,
after taking their leave from Lin Jing, Yan Ming and Qi Yan True Master boarded a flying boat and departed from Li Yan Island.
…
After leaving Li Yan Island,
inside the flying boat, while True Master Qi Yan was swiftly maneuvering it over the sea, he asked Yan Ming:
“Old Yan, do you think this Lin Jing is reliable?”
“Could he truly be a fifth-grade Alchemy Grandmaster?”
“He doesn’t seem like it…”
Yan Ming frowned, pondering for a moment before speaking:
“Indeed, it doesn’t quite seem like it…”
“Before this, when Yan Xing and Yan Yue had just been brought back by Brother Lu and others, they mentioned that there was an Uncle Lin who is an Alchemist.”
“However, at the time, since all of them possessed only Golden Core Stage cultivation, I didn’t pay much attention to it and quickly put it out of my mind.”
“Even the grade of the alchemist wasn’t something I inquired about.”
“If only I had asked in passing at that time.”
At this point, Yan Ming also sighed:
“Alas…”
True Master Qi Yan then said:
“This Lin Jing…”
“He must have advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage only recently.”
“Although not numerous, there are indeed some who attain the status of a fifth-grade Alchemy Master while being at the Golden Core Stage. Since he claims to be a fifth-grade Alchemy Master, it probably isn’t false.”
“Then how about we first test him with the Revival Elixir?”
“If he can truly concoct the Revival Elixir, we can then ask for his help in concocting the Cleansing Spirit Elixirs needed for our two nieces.”
After listening, Yan Ming nodded and said:
“It seems we have no other choice…”
“But the concoction of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir isn’t easy, involving others is somewhat too risky, and there seems to be some trouble at Changyun Elixir Pavilion. Our acquaintance, Pill Master Li, has returned to the Inner Sea…”
“After much thought, it seems we only have Lin Jing to consider now…”
True Master Qi Yan nodded and said:
“That’s the only option we have!”
“However…”
“It’s quite unexpected that he could possess the Cleansing Spirit Elixir formula; having the formula means he should be more familiar with it than others, which should also increase the success rate of concoction compared to others.”
Yan Ming nodded and said:
“Indeed…”
“To think of the effort we put in to obtain that incomplete Cleansing Spirit Elixir formula.”
Master Qi Yan sighed helplessly and said:
“All of this is for the sake of those two nieces.”
“If we don’t improve their aptitude, reaching the Golden Core Stage might be the end of the road for them.”
Yan Ming also sighed and nodded:
“Indeed…”
“I just hope this Lin Jing can give us a pleasant surprise.”
…
When Master Qi Yan and Yan Ming returned, it was already five days later.
Aside from going back to Spirit Rock Island, they also made a trip to Bihai City, purportedly to collect some of the other Spiritual Plants needed for concocting the Revival Elixir.
Not until five days later did they return to Li Yan Island.
Upon their return, Lin Jing immediately invited them to come to his small courtyard in the northern part of Li Yan Island.
Since Li Yan City was now a bit crowded, it was better to be in the restricted area in the northern part of the island.
Due to the news of Lin Jing’s advancement to the Nascent Soul Stage being spread, Li Yan Island’s fame had grown even greater, attracting many visitors.
Now, the Li Yan Fang Market was slowly recovering, with many people returning to continue trade.
However,
most people weren’t aware of Lin Jing’s identity; they only knew that the Island Master of Li Yan Island was now a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
And he had assertively killed the Jin brothers, who had intended to forcefully occupy the island.
You must understand,
the Jin brothers were quite famous in this region due to their extraordinary cultivation.
With Lin Jing’s action of directly killing them, naturally, he deterred many petty criminals.
Those who had previously attempted to conquer Li Yan Island and were driven off by Zhang Jian, upon hearing this news,
were so terrified that they were beside themselves with fear.
Soon enough, there were those who couldn’t bear it and sought Lin Jing’s forgiveness by any means necessary.
However, Lin Jing didn’t pay much attention to these people and left everything to Yue Qi Mother to handle.
Although Lin Jing had no intention of taking action against them, he still issued an order to Yue Qi Mother.
That was to make them bleed significantly and suffer once before they could learn their lesson.
With Lin Jing’s command, Yue Qi Mother acted without any reservations.
Making those people pay a hefty price.
Despite the price, these individuals indeed did so willingly.
Subsequently,
after these people had paid a significant price, Lin Jing let Yue Qi Mother warn them and then put the incident behind them, allowing them to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 490: 186: Refining the Revival Elixir_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 186: Refining the Revival Elixir_2
Upon learning that the matter was resolved, those people all breathed a sigh of relief and departed with gratitude.
…
After True Master Qi Yan and Yan Ming returned, True Master Qi Yan handed over the Revival Elixir recipe and materials to Lin Jing.
Upon receiving the recipe and Spirit Plants, Lin Jing first browsed through the recipe, then examined the Spirit Plants.
After the examination, Lin Jing found that some of the Spirit Plants were freshly picked.
There was also an extra piece of the Revival Vine.
Originally, to forge the Revival Elixir, only two to three inches of the vine were required, but the piece of Revival Vine given to Lin Jing by True Master Qi Yan measured a full five inches.
This development pleasantly surprised Lin Jing.
He could plant the extra Spirit Plants in the Spirit Field of the System Space.
After handing over the Revival Elixir recipe and materials to Lin Jing, True Master Qi Yan took Lin Jing’s Ling Yin Flawless Sword and two other ingredients with him.
He said he would take this time to help forge the Ling Yin Flawless Sword.
Moreover, True Master Qi Yan had even procured a special material from Bihai City, intending to incorporate it into Lin Jing’s Flying Sword.
He said he wanted to give Lin Jing a surprise.
Naturally, Lin Jing waited with great anticipation.
Subsequently, the two left Lin Jing’s place.
True Master Qi Yan went to forge the Ling Yin Flawless Sword for Lin Jing, while Yan Ming returned to Li Yan City, to be with Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
As for Lin Jing himself, he entered the System Space to begin Alchemy…
After entering the System Space, he did not rush to the Alchemy Room.
Instead, he took out a segment of the Revival Vine and snipped off a small piece.
Next.
Lin Jing took that small segment of the Revival Vine and began to plant it in the Spirit Field.
Of course, before planting, Lin Jing did not forget to adjust the environment to suit the growth of the Revival Vine.
After Lin Jing planted the Revival Vine, a system prompt immediately sounded:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Congratulations to the host for planting a high-grade Spirit Plant, which is in a damaged state and currently unable to grow.”
“The Spirit Plant can be repaired; repair will cost: 1000 Harvest Points.”
One thousand Harvest Points was manageable.
Lin Jing could afford it.
Therefore, without hesitation, Lin Jing used the Harvest Points to repair it.
After the repair, Lin Jing checked it again.
Fifth-Rank Spirit Plant: Revival Vine
Current Environment: Uninhabited Mountains.
Environment suitable, normal status, growing rapidly, time to maturity: 1000 years.
Seeing that the Revival Vine was growing normally, Lin Jing then set his mind at ease.
Afterward.
Lin Jing left the Spirit Field and entered the Alchemy Room to start preparing for the Revival Elixir’s forging process.
Before forging the Revival Elixir, Lin Jing would certainly study the recipe in detail; the method for forging the Revival Elixir and the key points to pay attention to were all documented in the recipe.
If anything were amiss or incorrect, it was very likely that this batch of Elixir Medicine would fail.
If that were to happen, it would be quite inexcusable.
…
Lin Jing studied the recipe while simultaneously forging some other Elixir Medicines.
He did this to maintain his condition.
Thus, three days passed before Lin Jing finally finished preparing and decided to start forging the Revival Elixir.
The first step in forging the Revival Elixir, just like with other Elixir Medicines, was to process the already prepared Alchemy Ingredients and then set them aside.
After processing the ingredients, Lin Jing quickly began to operate the Divine Fire Triple Realm, starting to condense the flames.
Since advancing to the Nascent Soul Stage, Lin Jing’s flames had grown more formidable, and with the empowerment of the Divine Fire Triple Realm, Lin Jing could even condense flames for use against enemies.
After condensing the flames, Lin Jing controlled them, focusing the blaze at the bottom of the Pill Furnace.
Then, Lin Jing began adding the ingredients.
Adding the ingredients occurred in stages, perfectly following the directions in the recipe to the letter.
As such, the temperature in the Pill Furnace climbed higher and all the ingredients were added throughout this process.
Once all the ingredients were in and the timing seemed right, Lin Jing immediately closed the furnace lid and sealed it, commencing the true Alchemy process.
The forging of the Revival Elixir was not very difficult.
It was somewhat easier compared to the Fourth-Rank Nirvana Elixir.
Additionally, since Lin Jing had studied the recipe carefully before, he made no mistakes during the process.
Thus, the forging went rather smoothly.
As time slowly passed.
It wasn’t until ten hours had passed.
A rich fragrance wafted from the Pill Furnace, and the refining of the Revival Elixir had started to take shape at this time.
At this moment, Lin Jing increased his Spiritual Power output, fueling the flames at the bottom of the furnace more intensely.
The temperature inside the Pill Furnace also grew higher and higher.
After a little while, the System’s notification sound rang out:
“Ding.”
“System notification: Congratulations to the host for successfully refining a Fifth-Rank Elixir for the first time, reward: 50 Harvest Points.”
“Elixir refining successful, alchemy proficiency +65.”
With the successful refining of the Revival Elixir, Lin Jing heaved a sigh of relief.
Afterward, Lin Jing opened the Pill Furnace.
He took out the elixirs from inside the furnace.
This batch of Revival Elixir had yielded one Supreme Elixir, one Superior, as well as two Medium Grade and one Low Grade Elixir.
Though these did not compare to the other Elixirs he had refined before,
the fact that he was able to produce a Supreme Elixir on his first attempt at refining a Fifth-Rank Elixir left Lin Jing very satisfied.
Even before starting alchemy, Qi Yan the True Monarch had specifically stated that he did not have high expectations for this refining session.
As long as there was a Medium Grade Elixir, he would be content.
Now, with the appearance of a Supreme Elixir, Lin Jing had far exceeded Qi Yan the True Monarch’s expectations.
After the Elixirs were completely refined, Lin Jing then packed up the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace and exited the System Space.
To avoid trouble, Lin Jing, except when performing alchemy, kept the alchemy furnace stored in his Space Ring that he carried with him at all times.
This allowed him to avoid certain situations and be ready to take out the alchemy furnace and start refining immediately should the need arise.
Otherwise, if the alchemy furnace remained in the System Space, there could be times when sudden situations might arise, leaving him with no chance to enter the System Space and retrieve the alchemy furnace.
Lin Jing kept the alchemy furnace on his person to prevent such scenarios.
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing went straight to Li Yan City.
At this time, the two of them were still there.
Seeing Lin Jing’s arrival,
Qi Yan the True Monarch and Yan Ming quickly greeted him.
Especially Qi Yan the True Monarch, who came forward and eagerly asked,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“How did the refining of the Revival Elixir go?”
Lin Jing smiled and nodded,
“Fortunately, I did not fail…”
Next, Lin Jing took out the already refined elixirs from the Space Ring and handed them to Qi Yan the True Monarch.
Qi Yan the True Monarch opened the jade bottle containing the elixirs, and then slowly uncorked it.
The moment it was opened, the rich fragrance of the elixirs instantly filled the air.
The fragrance was so intense that upon smelling it, Qi Yan the True Monarch felt joy in his heart.
He then looked directly inside.
“Inside here…”
Qi Yan the True Monarch was first surprised, then he poured out the elixirs from the jade bottle to see them, and upon seeing the elixirs, Qi Yan the True Monarch became even more excited.
“There is actually one Supreme Elixir and one Superior! ”
“I had thought that if you, Lin Daoyou, could refine a Medium Grade Elixir, it would have been impressive enough, but you’ve given me such a big surprise.”
“Could it be that Lin Daoyou, you were being modest earlier, and this isn’t your first time refining Revival Elixir?”
Upon hearing what Qi Yan the True Monarch said, Yan Ming also quickly came up to take a look.
Seeing that it was indeed as Qi Yan the True Monarch had said, Yan Ming was equally delighted.
The higher Lin Jing’s alchemy skills, the greater the chance of refining Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Lin Jing then simply smiled and said,
“Indeed, this is my first time refining the Revival Elixir; I was just lucky this time.”
Qi Yan the True Monarch waved his hand and said,
“Lin Daoyou, you are far too modest.”
After finishing, Qi Yan the True Monarch smiled and said,
“However, since you gave me a surprise, naturally I must also return the favor with a surprise for you…”
With that, Qi Yan the True Monarch immediately took out an almost transparent Flying Sword from his Space Ring and handed it to Lin Jing.
This sword was the Ling Yin Flawless Sword that had been given to Qi Yan the True Monarch for refinement.
It was now completed.
Lin Jing accepted the Ling Yin Flawless Sword for a closer look, and then exclaimed:
“This is…”
“A Superior Dao Artifact!!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 187 Yan Ming's Thoughts
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 187 Yan Ming’s Thoughts
Lin Jing, holding the Supreme Grade Dao Artifact, the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, was immediately dumbfounded with astonishment.
Previously, Qi Yan True Monarch had said that the Ling Yin Flawless Sword could, at best, be between a Mid-grade Dao Artifact and a Superior Dao Artifact.
Yet, who would have thought that, after Qi Yan True Monarch truly forged it, he unexpectedly created a Supreme Grade Dao Artifact, which greatly exceeded Lin Jing’s expectations.
And moreover,
Lin Jing also knew that with the materials he provided himself, they simply weren’t enough to upgrade the Ling Yin Flawless Sword to the level of a Supreme Grade Dao Artifact.
Thus, the only possibility was that Qi Yan True Monarch had added more advanced materials, which enabled the Ling Yin Flawless Sword to be forged into a Supreme Grade Dao Artifact.
Lin Jing, holding the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, carefully examined it before raising his head to Qi Yan True Monarch and saying,
“Qi Yan Daoyou, this…”
“I know that with the materials I provided, it definitely wouldn’t be possible to enhance the Ling Yin Flawless Sword to the level of a Supreme Grade Dao Artifact.”
“You must have added other precious materials into it, materials that are certainly quite valuable.”
Having said this, Lin Jing looked towards Qi Yan True Monarch and spoke again,
“Qi Yan Daoyou…”
“By doing this, I’m afraid you have something in mind that you want my assistance with, right?”
Upon hearing this, Qi Yan True Monarch did not conceal anything and directly responded,
“In the process of reforging this Flying Sword for you, besides the two materials provided by Lin Daoyou, I indeed added two other rare materials.”
“However, these materials were not provided by me, instead, they were provided by Old Yan.”
“Yan Daoyou?” Lin Jing, puzzled, turned to look at Yan Ming beside him.
Qi Yan True Monarch nodded and continued,
“Old Yan, he needs your help with something.”
At this time, Yan Ming also hurriedly clasped his fists and said,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“I have a favor to ask and hope that Lin Daoyou can grant it.”
Lin Jing also clasped his fists in response,
“Yan Daoyou…”
“You are too polite. Just say the word, and if I can be of help, I will do my best to assist.”
“But may I ask what it is you wish for my help with?”
At this, Qi Yan True Monarch interjected,
“Alchemy…”
“Alchemy?” Lin Jing became confused.
“If you need help with Alchemy, Yan Daoyou only needs to ask, and I will naturally lend a hand.”
As he spoke, Lin Jing looked at the Ling Yin Flawless Sword in his hand and said,
“Why would you need to go to such lengths as Yang Daoyou has?”
Indeed, in Lin Jing’s opinion,
Given his relationship with Yan Xing and Yan Yue, even if Yan Ming required Alchemy, Lin Jing would not normally refuse.
Besides, Yan Ming was the Island Master of Spirit Rock Island, and Spirit Rock Island possessed many rare High-Grade Spiritual Plants.
He himself might need to obtain some rare Spiritual Plants from Spirit Rock Island at any time.
Therefore, Lin Jing was also keen to maintain good relations with Yan Ming and Spirit Rock Island.
But, Yan Ming came forth providing a great surprise right away,
Directly supplying materials to upgrade the Ling Yin Flawless Sword to the level of a Supreme Grade Dao Artifact.
In doing so, Lin Jing involuntarily owed Yan Ming a huge favor, and if Yan Ming then made some requests, Lin Jing would find it difficult to refuse.
Moreover, once bound by such a big favor, Lin Jing would always feel indebted, which was inconsistent with his nature; he would certainly find a way to repay the debt.
Originally, Lin Jing had thought that Yan Ming had done so because there was some difficult matter to handle.
But it turned out to be just Alchemy…
Clearly, what Lin Jing was expected to offer did not compare to what Yan Ming had provided.
It was unreasonable.
……
“`
Following this, Lin Jing reflected for a moment before he said:
“Yan Daoyou doing this…”
“Could it be that the Elixir Furnace Medicine he wants to craft is not easy to make?”
Yan Ming nodded and said:
“Indeed, it is so…”
Lin Jing inwardly nodded, knowing it must be for this reason that Yan Ming was willing to make such a big sacrifice from the start.
His purpose was to make it difficult for Lin Jing to refuse.
Then Lin Jing continued to ask:
“May I know what kind of Elixir Medicine Yan Daoyou wants my help in crafting?”
Yan Ming looked at Lin Jing and said:
“Cleansing Spirit Elixir…”
“And at the very least, it has to be of Supreme Grade or above.”
“Crafting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is not easy, and the higher the quality, the harder it is to achieve. Hence, to acquire at least a Supreme Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir, crafting just one batch might not suffice.”
“At least several batches, or even more than a dozen, might be necessary to have the chance of obtaining one.”
“Moreover, the Supreme Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs I need are not just one, but two…”
After hearing Yan Ming’s words, Lin Jing suddenly had a flash of understanding.
“Yan Daoyou, is this for Yan Xing and Yan Yue…”
Yan Ming nodded and said:
“Xing’er and Yue’er’s talents are simply too poor. If I, as their father, do not do something for them, then it’s very likely they will only reach the Golden Core Stage in this lifetime.”
“A cultivator at the Golden Core Stage has a lifespan of only five hundred years…”
“And I am already over three hundred years old. If I just let things be, it’s very possible I will face the tragedy of an elder burying the young.”
“That’s why I sought out Lin Daoyou…”
“As long as their Spiritual Root talents can be further enhanced, with the foundation of our Spirit Rock Island, we can push the two of them to the Nascent Soul Stage…”
“As for whether they can continue to improve beyond the Nascent Soul Stage, that will depend on their own fortunes.”
“As a father, this is all that I can do.”
“I hope Lin Daoyou can understand…”
Lin Jing looked at Yan Ming and couldn’t help but clasp his fist and say:
“Yan Daoyou, for the sake of your daughters, has gone to such lengths, which truly fills me with deep respect.”
“Leave the matter of alchemy to me.”
This statement came sincerely from Lin Jing’s heart.
After all, how much would Spirit Rock Island have to sacrifice for Yan Ming’s decision?
The Cleansing Spirit Elixir, as a Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicine, has materials that are already highly valuable in themselves.
Then there’s the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, which is even rarer and commands an exorbitant price.
Moreover, crafting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is not guaranteed success with just one batch.
Even if the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is crafted, it doesn’t mean the enhancement will surely be successful.
Different grades of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir contain different effects, meaning the probability of enhancing the Spiritual Root talent also varies.
For example:
Taking a Low-Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir only has a 10% chance of improving one’s Spiritual Root.
Meanwhile, a Medium-Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir has a 20% chance of enhancement.
A Superior Cleansing Spirit Elixir is much better, offering a 50% chance of raising the Spiritual Root talent by one grade.
And then there’s the Supreme Grade, probably the highest.
It has an 80% chance of upgrading one’s own Spiritual Root talent by one grade.
Of course.
This is under the condition that no Pure Elixir is available.
If it were a Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixir, then the chance is 100%, guaranteeing successful enhancement upon consumption.
However, compared to other Elixir Medicines, crafting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is somewhat more challenging and it is also hard to ensure its quality.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 188 The Strength of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 188 The Strength of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan
And furthermore,
the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is different from other elixir medicines, as each person can only consume one in their lifetime.
Of course, unless you have a Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Even if you fail to enhance your spiritual root with other qualities of Cleansing Spirit Elixir, you can still remedy it with a Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
But even with the Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixir, it can only enhance once; after a successful enhancement of one’s talents, taking another Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixir will have no effect whatsoever.
However, concocting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is not easy to begin with, let alone the Pure Elixir Medicine, which is even more unimaginable.
Therefore, Yan Ming requested Lin Jing to refine at least a top-grade quality Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
“If so, I shall entrust this to Lin Daoyou,” Yan Ming said with a fist salute.
Lin Jing waved his hand quickly, saying,
“You’re too courteous, Daoyou…”
Having said that, Lin Jing continued to ask,
“I just wonder, how many spirit plants for concocting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir has Yan Daoyou collected?”
Yan Ming then spoke,
“Actually…”
“Ever since their birth, I have been looking for some Spiritual Treasure Elixir that can enhance the quality of the spiritual root.”
“During that time, I also collected a few drops of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.”
“However, after they each consumed it, although there were some improvements, it was still far from enhancing their spiritual roots.”
“With no other choice, I had to search again for other heavenly materials and earthly treasures that could enhance the quality of their spiritual roots.”
“I even inquired about the legendary Contrary Fate Fruit, but there was no news at all…”
“It wasn’t until an auction over a decade ago that I learned such an elixir medicine called the Cleansing Spirit Elixir was circulating among the top powers of the Inner Sea.”
At this point, Yan Ming said somewhat sheepishly,
“I do not wish to deceive Lin Daoyou; the friend I mentioned earlier who had obtained a fragmentary Cleansing Spirit Elixir recipe…”
“In fact, it wasn’t any friend, but myself…”
“I won that partial Cleansing Spirit Elixir recipe at the auction, and since then, I have begun collecting materials for it.”
“Up to now, aside from the few drops of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, only two drops remain. I only lack one main spirit plant to gather a full set of ingredients for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing was extremely surprised. He hadn’t expected Yan Ming to have collected so much already, so Lin Jing asked,
“May I know which spirit plant Yan Daoyou is still missing?”
After pondering for a moment, Yan Ming replied,
“The accompanying Spirit Grass of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.”
The White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass, as white as jade, resembles common weeds and is very easy to identify.
The White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass requires extremely harsh conditions for growth, only growing beside long-established Spiritual Springs.
For example, the Spiritual Spring in the Demon Race Secret Realm that we encountered earlier had only a small cupful of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, nowhere near enough to sustain the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.
Therefore, there was no growth of the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass beside that Cleansing Spirit Pool.
To collect the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass, one must find a Spiritual Spring of older vintage with a greater abundance of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
Such stringent conditions naturally make it hard to find.
Lin Jing then fell into deep thought. After a moment, he spoke,
“White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass is indeed difficult to find. We must first locate a Spiritual Spring before there’s any chance of finding the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.”
Yan Ming also frowned and said,
“Indeed…”
“Nowadays, let alone an ancient Spiritual Spring, even a tiny Cleansing Spirit Pool is hard to come by, not to mention the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.”
At that point, Lin Jing suddenly looked at Yan Ming and said,
“Speaking of the Cleansing Spirit Pool, I happen to know of a place that possesses one.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Ming immediately looked up at Lin Jing, asking with a look of surprise,
“Lin Daoyou knows the location of a Cleansing Spirit Pool?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Yes…”
“It’s just that we probably can’t enter that place now,”
“We can’t enter?”
“Secret Realm or relic?”
“Could it be a special relic in a closed state?”
Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“It’s not a relic, but a Secret Realm.”
“In the Nanzhou Underworld, there is a Demon Race Secret Realm with a Cleansing Spirit Pool inside. However, that Cleansing Spirit Pool is likely occupied by the Howling Sky Wolf Clan right now.”
“We simply can’t get past.”
“The Howling Sky Wolf Clan…” Yan Ming furrowed his brows, sinking into deep thought.
After a moment, Yan Ming spoke,
“I am aware that there have indeed been some issues in the Nanzhou Underworld and that the instigator is the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“That’s right…”
“It was through that Secret Realm that the Howling Sky Wolf Clan entered the Nanzhou Underworld.”
“The Cleansing Spirit Pool I spoke of is within that Secret Realm. However, there is not much Cleansing Spirit Liquid in that Secret Realm. It likely doesn’t have the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass that you’re looking for.”
Lin Jing’s words drew Yan Ming into contemplation.
After a while, having finished his thoughts, Yan Ming spoke,
“What Lin Daoyou has said should be correct…”
“If it were indeed an ancient Cleansing Spiritual Spring that has accumulated over time, it definitely wouldn’t have been kept secret.”
“It would only be those Cleansing Spirit Pools, not ancient and without much accumulated Cleansing Spirit Liquid, that would not become well-known.”
“I’m afraid that as soon as that Cleansing Spirit Liquid was discovered, it was completely divided up.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
The Howling Sky Wolf Clan had seized the Cleansing Spirit Pool, but it was unknown if they would protect it like the three major Sects did.
But even if they protected it, what then?
There was just a pitcher’s worth of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, possibly not even a hundred drops, nowhere near enough to share.
Lin Jing remembered very clearly that he himself had continuously used the Cleansing Spirit Liquid for over a month, at least one drop every day.
Sometimes several drops in a day…
Even so, it took Lin Jing more than a month to enhance his natural talent.
By that account, Lin Jing had consumed at least dozens of drops of Cleansing Spirit Liquid to improve his aptitude.
Even his enhancement was so difficult.
If the Howling Sky Wolf Clan encountered others who wanted to enhance their abilities, wouldn’t it mean at most one or two people could be improved before the Cleansing Spirit Liquid was exhausted?
In that case, how could it have become known?
……
At this moment, Qi Yan Zhenjun spoke,
“The current situation in the Nanzhou Underworld is not good to involve ourselves in…”
“It’s said that the Nanzhou Underworld has already lost ninety percent of its control, with less than ten percent still under the command of the three major Sects.”
“Even this is under the circumstance where the Howling Sky Wolf Clan has not fully mobilized.”
“If the Howling Sky Wolf Clan were to mobilize their entire clan, I estimate the three major Sects of the Nanzhou Underworld would have long been obliterated.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing asked Qi Yan Zhenjun,
“Qi Yan Daoyou…”
“Is the Howling Sky Wolf Clan really that powerful?”
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded and replied,
“The Howling Sky Wolf Clan is also among the top five Demon Cultivator clans in the Western Demon Region.”
“If they were to fully mobilize, erasing all the Human Cultivators in the Nanzhou Underworld would be effortless.”
“The current stalemate exists mainly because they are still facing pressure from the Human Cultivators from the Western Demon Region.”
“That’s why…”
“The Howling Sky Wolf Clan dares not expend too much effort in the Nanzhou Underworld…”

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 189 Spirit Storing Bead
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 189 Spirit Storing Bead
“The cultivation world of the Western Demon Region?” Lin Jing asked in confusion.
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“The Western Demon Region is far from peaceful. For countless years, human cultivators have been engaged in endless struggles with demon cultivators, which has resulted in the current balance of power.”
“Now, in the Western Demon Region, the power of human and demon races has almost reached a balance.”
“If the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, one of the top five in the demon race, were to suddenly deploy their battle force to the Southern Nether Domain, it’s very likely that cultivators from the Western Demon Region would notice.”
“If that happens, the delicate balance between the two sides will be broken, and it will have a huge impact on the demon race of the entire Western Demon Region.”
“Therefore, the Howling Sky Wolf Clan wouldn’t dare to make such a move lightly.”
Afterwards, Lin Jing frowned and said,
“Even so, the Southern Nether Domain still can’t withstand the invasion of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.”
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded and couldn’t help but sigh,
“Indeed…”
“Since the catastrophe a million years ago, the entire Southern Nether Domain has been almost completely devastated, and the surviving human cultivators have nearly lost their lineage.”
“What’s worse, the Spiritual Energy of the entire Southern Nether Domain became extremely scarce after the disaster.”
“It’s simply not suitable for cultivators to live anymore.”
At this point, Qi Yan Zhenjun spoke with some indignation,
“If not for that, how could the Southern Nether Domain have fallen to such a degree, to be bullied by the likes of a minor Howling Sky Wolf Clan.”
At this moment, Yan Ming also spoke up,
“I have learned from some ancient texts that the Southern Nether Domain used to be very powerful, the strongest among the Four Domains.”
“One could even say that it teemed with Divinity Transformation experts everywhere…”
“If it were the Southern Nether Domain before the catastrophe, perhaps any faction of cultivators could eradicate the entire Howling Sky Wolf Clan with ease.”
Qi Yan Zhenjun nodded and said,
“There’s a saying, ‘prosperity leads to decline’…”
“No power in this world can prosper forever, just like the once far-famed Lin Family from the Ancient Alchemy Path within our Demonic Monster Sea.”
“They too faced a sudden divine punishment at their peak, causing the entire family to go from prosperity to extinction within ten thousand years.”
“Perhaps it is because the Southern Nether Domain was too prosperous that it invited this disaster.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing also fell silent.
……
Seeing that the atmosphere had become somewhat silent, Qi Yan Zhenjun hurriedly spoke again,
“However…”
“There’s no need to worry about the affairs of the Southern Nether Domain.”
“The matter of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan’s invasion of the Southern Nether Domain should have already been reported to the Western Demon Region by now, unless something unexpected happened.”
“I estimate that the Western Demon Region will take action soon.”
“By then, once the cultivators from the Western Demon Region drive out the wolf pups of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan from the Southern Nether Domain…”
“Perhaps the secret realm you mentioned, Lin Daoyou, will open again, and then we can go and see if there are other Spiritual Springs in the secret realm.”
“Since there are conditions for the formation of Spiritual Springs there, maybe there are other Spiritual Springs in other places within that secret realm?”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“There is indeed such a possibility…”
“Before, many places in that Demon Race Secret Realm occupied by the Howling Sky Wolf Clan were still unexplored.”
On hearing this, Yan Ming immediately perked up and hastily asked Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, are you telling the truth?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Of course…”
“`
“I wonder, Lin Daoyou, how come you’re so well-informed?” Yan Ming looked at Lin Jing with puzzlement and asked.
Lin Jing was silent for a moment before he spoke,
“To be truthful with the two of you, I was originally from the underworld of the Southern Continent.”
“It was only after the Howling Sky Wolf Clan invaded the underworld of the Southern Continent that by a stroke of luck, I arrived in the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“So that’s how it is…”
After Yan Ming and Qi Yan Master finished speaking, they didn’t dwell on the topic any longer…
……
Afterwards.
The two of them then discussed with Lin Jing about the matter of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Through negotiation, Lin Jing even obtained Yan Ming’s permission to go to Spirit Rock Island at any time to retrieve the materials for refining the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
When Lin Jing learned that those Spirit Plants were all planted by Yan Ming in the Spirit Field on Spirit Rock Island,
he specifically told Yan Ming that he might take some extra roots, stems, and seeds of the Spirit Plants.
Yan Ming, knowing that Lin Jing had a Spirit Field on Li Yan Island, didn’t mind and agreed to Lin Jing’s request.
Of course, Lin Jing’s intent was to collect these Spirit Plants needed for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir into his System Space.
In this way, he wouldn’t have to bother with searching for Spirit Plants everywhere himself.
Moreover, Lin Jing already had a Cleansing Spiritual Spring within the System Space.
He could plant the other Spirit Plants in the System Space where he could ripen them at any time.
Eventually, with his own Cleansing Spirit Liquid and other materials, he would only need a stalk of White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass to be able to refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Lastly.
The two also discussed the matter of the Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
From the conversation just now, Lin Jing learned that Yan Ming had two drops of Cleansing Spirit Liquid, but due to its nature, once removed from the Cleansing Spirit Pool, it would evaporate very quickly.
Since Yan Ming had obtained the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, he must have a method of preservation, so Lin Jing asked once more about this preservation method.
As a result, Yan Ming directly gave Lin Jing a very inconspicuous bead, only the size of an ordinary prayer bead.
It was called a Spirit Storing Bead.
Though the Spirit Storing Bead seemed insignificant, it was made of special materials and refined by a master of Artifact Refining.
The bead itself amounted to a treasure-grade Spatial Treasure; it is called a treasure, but it cannot be used against enemies.
Moreover, its internal space is pitifully small.
The only purpose it serves is to prevent the Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside from evaporating.
During Alchemy, you can put the bead filled with Cleansing Spirit Liquid into the Pill Furnace and then open it at the appropriate time.
That’s how the Cleansing Spirit Elixir can be refined.
Of course, you can still refine the Elixir without this Spirit Storing Bead if your Cultivation has surpassed Divinity Transformation and you can use your Soul Spirit to envelop the Cleansing Spirit Liquid for the Alchemy process.
Or you could use a Spatial Treasure similar to this bead…
After obtaining the Spirit Storing Bead, Lin Jing didn’t stand on ceremony and immediately took it for himself.
When Lin Jing put away the Spirit Storing Bead, a sweep of his Divine Sense also detected a grey robe.
With a thought, Lin Jing took the grey robe out from his Space Ring.
This grey robe was the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe he had obtained from the Puppet Guild Leader.
Back then, Lin Jing was very pleased with the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe for its incredibly powerful effect.
However, because it had been blood-refined by the Puppet Guild Leader, Lin Jing had been unable to use it.
So it had remained in his Space Ring.
Now, with Master Qi Yan present, maybe he had a way to solve this problem.
Therefore.
Lin Jing took out the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, intending to show it to Qi Yan Master…
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 190 Rumors
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 190 Rumors
After taking out the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, Lin Jing directly addressed the True Flame Monarch:
“True Flame Daoyou…”
“I have a Daoist artifact here that I obtained from my enemy. However, this Daoist artifact has been subjected to his blood refinement, and I have been unable to refine and claim it as my own.”
“I wonder if you, True Flame Daoyou, might have another method?”
After hearing this, the True Flame Monarch reached out to Lin Jing and said:
“Come…”
“Let me take a look.”
“Alright…” Lin Jing then directly handed over the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe to the True Flame Monarch.
Upon receiving the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe, the True Flame Monarch took a careful and thorough look at it.
Afterward, he used spiritual power and Divine Sense separately to probe it.
It wasn’t until a good while later that the True Flame Monarch finally spoke to Lin Jing:
“I presume your enemy has long since met with death.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Yes.”
The True Flame Monarch lightly nodded before continuing:
“Normally, magical treasures subjected to blood refinement are nurtured with the cultivator’s essence blood from the very beginning of their forging. Such nurtured treasures slowly develop a spirit and become increasingly bonded with their owner.”
“Magical treasures created this way have many advantages, but the downside is also clear; once the owner dies, the magical treasure can no longer be left behind.”
“However, this robe wasn’t nurtured using the Blood Refinement Method from the moment it was forged.”
“It’s very likely that your enemy obtained it from somewhere else. Only after acquiring it did he refine it using the Blood Refinement Method…”
“So that’s how it is…” With the True Flame Monarch’s explanation, Lin Jing suddenly understood the situation.
Lin Jing then continued to ask:
“Can this robe have the previous owner’s Blood Refinement Method removed so I can refine and claim it?”
The True Flame Monarch nodded and said:
“Of course…”
“If this were his life-bound magical treasure nurtured through his own Blood Refinement Method, then indeed, for the time being, I wouldn’t have a good solution.”
“But this robe was merely nurtured by the Blood Refinement Method and is not his life-bound magical treasure.”
“I do have a method to cleanse the remnants of the Blood Refinement Method left on it.”
“Leave this robe with me. In a few days, I’ll be able to remove the remnants of the Blood Refinement Method left on it.”
“At that time, you, Lin Daoyou, will be able to refine and use it anew.”
“In that case, I thank you greatly, Daoyou.” Lin Jing quickly said, cupping his fists in gratitude.
“No need for such courtesy, Lin Daoyou…” The True Flame Monarch also returned the gesture with cupped fists.
……
Following that.
Yan Ming and the True Flame Monarch stayed on Li Yan Island for several more days.
It wasn’t until several days later, after the True Flame Monarch had removed the Blood Refinement Method from the Heaven Concealing Qiankun Robe and handed it over to Lin Jing, that the two of them left Li Yan Island.
This time upon leaving, Lin Jing also went with the two of them to Spirit Rock Island.
Naturally, the visit to Spirit Rock Island was for the purpose of obtaining Spirit Plants required for crafting Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
Only after obtaining the other Spirit Plants needed for the Crafting Spirit Elixir from Li Yan Island did Lin Jing return there.
Upon his return to Li Yan Island, Lin Jing resumed his reclusion in his small courtyard for alchemy…
……
Time swiftly passed, and soon another month went by.
The Power Division Conference, as mentioned by Xue Yilin, was about to commence.
In fact a month prior, the Power Division Conference had already been a hot topic of conversation.
As it affected all of the cultivators in the Thousand Islands Domain, the cultivators there paid it great attention.
As for those other low-ranking cultivators below the Golden Core Stage, it did not matter much to them. No matter how the Thousand Islands Domain changed, they could not resist and could only endure in silence.
After all,
If they left the Thousand Islands Domain, they would have nowhere else to go.
Fortunately, no matter the changes, this division of power meeting would not affect these individuals.
The ones most affected were naturally the Golden Core Stage Island Masters of the other small islands.
Originally, they each, or in groups of two or three, occupied an island and lived comfortably.
But with this change, it was as if there was now another manager above them on their island.
And this manager was a Nascent Soul Cultivator, making it impossible for them to even think about resisting.
Of course, they would not dare to resist because this was news that came from within the three major islands.
In the Thousand Islands Domain, no one dared to defy the commands of the three major islands; otherwise, even if they wanted to flee, they could not.
When this order first surfaced, due to the absence of certification by the Island Masters of the three major islands, people were skeptical and adopted a wait-and-see attitude.
It was only when the event caused a great uproar, and the division of power meeting was about to commence,
that the Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Bai Yi, stepped forward to confirm the news.
After receiving definite news, some Island Masters who cherished freedom and disliked being managed simply left the Thousand Islands Domain.
Their departure was just a prelude.
After all, they were only a very small portion, and most people were unwilling to leave the Thousand Islands Domain.
Following their departure, some other cultivators immediately took over their islands.
Regarding these matters, everyone was well aware that this was bound to happen.
Therefore, no one from the three major islands stepped forward, and things were just tacitly accepted as they happened.
Apart from that, there was Zhang Jian.
Previously, Lin Jing had inadvertently revealed this information to Zhang Jian in a casual chat.
However, since the news had not been released at that time, although Zhang Jian had learned about it, he was not overly alarmed.
Until the news spread later.
People began to speculate about the intentions of the three major islands, and suddenly rumors were flying all over.
Some said that the three major islands controlling the various islands were planning on dominating the entire Thousand Islands Domain to prepare for war with other sea domains.
Others said that this was a way for the three major islands to centralize resources from each island for their own use.
Some of the most exaggerated rumors even claimed that the three major islands were doing this to set up a grand formation that would envelop the entire Thousand Islands Domain,
and then sacrifice all living beings of the Thousand Islands Domain.
Afterwards, through that sacrifice, the Island Masters of the three major islands would ascend.
…
…
And so on and so forth…
A multitude of rumors left many people uncertain.
Even Zhang Jian was puzzled.
So Zhang Jian hurriedly came to ask Lin Jing what exactly was going on.
Regarding this matter, Lin Jing did not know much either and could not provide Zhang Jian with an answer.
He would only understand clearly after attending the division of powers meeting.
However, regarding those rumors circulating outside, Lin Jing did not believe them.
This was, after all, the Thousand Islands Domain, thousands of islands, and countless living beings resided here.
How could it be so easily sacrificed at someone’s whim?
As for the rumors, Lin Jing paid them no mind and continued making his Elixir Medicine.
Until this day, someone came to Li Yan Island, inviting Lin Jing to go to Yue Tian Island for the meeting regarding the division of regional authority.
The person who came looking for Lin Jing was none other than Xue Yilin…

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 191 Xue Yilin's Mission
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 191 Xue Yilin’s Mission
When Lin Jing saw Xue Yilin, he was still the same as before, all smiles and appearing completely harmless to humans and animals.
But Lin Jing knew that although this man always wore a smile, he was very decisive.
Moreover, his methods were ruthless, not to be underestimated.
Then, Lin Jing stepped forward, cupped his fists towards Xue Yilin, and said,
“Xue Daoyou…”
“With the regional power division conference about to start, what leisure brings you to my Li Yan Island?”
Xue Yilin also cupped his fists with a smile and replied,
“Isn’t it that I have some tasks to carry out, and just so happen to pass by Lin Daoyou’s Li Yan Island?”
“So I came to invite Lin Daoyou, planning to go together to Yue Tian Island.”
“This time to find Lin Daoyou, I didn’t send a message in advance, I hope Daoyou doesn’t mind.”
Lin Jing then spoke,
“It doesn’t matter…”
“Xue Daoyou thinks too much, I was also about to set off to Yue Tian Island.”
“Now that Xue Daoyou is here, it’s perfect for us to go together.”
Upon hearing this, Xue Yilin said with a smile,
“In that case, shall we depart now, Lin Daoyou?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Good…”
Seeing Lin Jing agree, Xue Yilin hurriedly summoned his own flying boat, then said to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“The journey is long, why not ride on my flying boat?”
Lin Jing hesitated for a moment…
Although this Xue Yilin was unpredictable and ruthless,
Lin Jing had no conflict with this person.
Nor would he say, suddenly act against him.
From their encounter two months ago to this reunion, Xue Yilin had never shown hostility towards him, more so, he seemed to intentionally get close to him.
Lin Jing didn’t know why, but he suspected it must be for some purpose.
Traveling together, Lin Jing could also probe further along the way.
With this in mind, Lin Jing nodded in agreement to Xue Yilin’s request.
Even if Xue Yilin had any hostility towards him, Lin Jing was not afraid of this man.
Although Lin Jing was only at the early Nascent Soul stage of cultivation, if it really came to a fight, he felt that he was not necessarily this man’s match.
Especially now, with the Ling Yin Flawless Sword upgraded to an exceptional magical treasure.
Therefore,
Facing this man’s invitation, Lin Jing did not refuse and directly boarded the flying boat.
After both men had boarded the flying boat, Xue Yilin directly controlled the flying boat, and with a “swoosh,” they shot forth.
This man’s flying boat was no ordinary item.
Though it wasn’t as good as Lin Jing’s Shadow Escape Flying Boat, its speed was still much faster than other flying boats.
……
The flying boat rapidly traveled through the sky above the Thousand Islands Domain, and Lin Jing started to chat casually with Xue Yilin.
Halfway through the journey, Xue Yilin suddenly changed direction and flew towards another destination.
Lin Jing’s brows immediately furrowed, not understanding what Xue Yilin was intending.
However,
Before Lin Jing could ask, Xue Yilin explained with smile,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“I still have a task on my hands, I hope for a bit of delay, and I hope Lin Daoyou doesn’t mind.”
Hearing Xue Yilin’s explanation, Lin Jing’s brows relaxed as he said,
“What is the task that requires Xue Daoyou to make this trip before the start of the regional power division conference?”
Xue Yilin narrowed his eyes and then said,
“Surely Lin Daoyou is aware of the recent rumors spreading around, right?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Indeed, I have heard quite a few.”
“However, these rumors are nothing more than wild guesses by some, causing no significant upheaval, so I didn’t pay much attention to them.”
Xue Yilin then shook his head and said,
“Lin Daoyou, if you think that way, then you are mistaken.”
“Oh?” Lin Jing asked, puzzled,
“Is there something more to it that’s hidden?”
Xue Yilin nodded and replied,
“Of course…”
“The reason these rumors are spreading is that someone is taking advantage of this moment to stir up trouble with the aim of harming the Three Great Islands.”
Lin Jing exclaimed in surprise,
“Someone wants to harm the Three Great Islands?”
“In the Thousand Islands Domain, who would have the audacity?”
Having said that, Lin Jing expressed his doubts,
“But even if that’s true, inciting these lower-level cultivators, what’s the use? Could he really believe that with these lower-level cultivators, he could overthrow the Three Great Islands?”
“Isn’t that a bit too fanciful?”
Xue Yilin’s eyes narrowed, and then he said,
“Naturally, it’s not that simple.”
“These lower-level cultivators, no matter what rumors they spread, can’t shake the foundation of the Three Great Islands.”
“It’s just that someone wants to take advantage of this matter to stir up trouble during the regional power division meeting.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was even more confused,
“How does this matter relate to the regional division meeting?”
Xue Yilin then chuckled lightly and said,
“Hehe…”
“You will understand once we get to Yue Tian Island.”
After saying that, Xue Yilin looked ahead at an island and said,
“All right…”
“I have reached my destination, Lin Daoyou, please wait a moment, I’ll be right back.”
As he spoke, Xue Yilin left the Flying Boat and flew towards the island ahead.
The island in front, much larger than Li Yan Island, was openly approached by Xue Yilin without concealing his aura.
When Xue Yilin arrived at the island, two Golden Core Peak Cultivators immediately attacked him with their Magical Treasures.
Neither side spoke as they met.
The two Golden Core Peak Cultivators started off with full force.
Xue Yilin, unambiguously, brought out an ancient green bronze furnace and placed it above their heads.
As Xue Yilin instigated the green bronze furnace, several streams formed by black mist emerged as skeletal skulls, attacking the two Golden Core Cultivators.
Immediately after, a fierce battle began.
Black mist-formed skeletal skulls wailed ceaselessly while the two Golden Core Peak Cultivators summoned various Magical Treasures, with countless dazzling lights changing the color of the sky.
However, the two Golden Core Peak Cultivators, despite their uncommon abilities, were no match for Xue Yilin.
In no time, they were slain by Xue Yilin.
Even more, Xue Yilin decapitated both men, taking their heads with him.
After killing them, Xue Yilin even controlled the Black Skull Heads to descend towards the town below, flying toward the most magnificent building in the middle of the town.
En route, the Black Skull Heads ignored any evasion and burst through the city directly towards the building.
Wherever the Black Skull Heads passed, whether it were cultivators or some ordinary people, they couldn’t last a single breath and all fell to the ground.
Even their deaths were ghastly, the entire person turned into a dried corpse.
Clearly, their life force was absorbed in an instant by the Black Skull Heads, which is why it happened like this.
Lin Jing witnessed this scene and merely frowned slightly, but he didn’t step in to stop it.
After all, these people had nothing to do with him, and he didn’t need to risk his neck for them.
Besides, considering that Xue Yilin, a cultivator from Yue Tian Island, was here on a mission, this affair was definitely related to the Island Master of Yue Tian Island.
It wasn’t time for him to act rashly…

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 192 Yue Tian Hall
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 192 Yue Tian Hall
“`
However,
Xue Yilin did not embark on a large-scale massacre after reaching the front of that magnificent building.
Instead, those black skeletons directly destroyed the building.
After the destruction, a red teleportation array was revealed…
a teleportation array Lin Jing was quite familiar with.
Seeing the red teleportation array, Lin Jing’s brows immediately furrowed.
Because the array was exactly the same as the one that had teleported him to the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm before.
Even the aura emanating from the formation was one that Lin Jing found familiar.
It was indeed the aura of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
Could it be that the two Golden Core Peak cultivators he had just seen were connected to that mysterious Divine Transformation Cultivator?
While Lin Jing was deep in thought, Xue Yilin had already commanded the Black Skull Head to charge at the formation.
Unable to bear the load, the formation exploded with a “Boom”.
After destroying the teleportation array, Xue Yilin scanned the area, and seeing no significant oversight, flew back.
Not until Xue Yilin had departed did the cultivators and mortals within the city below cautiously come out to survey the situation.
Once back on the flying boat, Xue Yilin once again donned his signature smile and said to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“My task is now complete; we can set out for Yue Tian Island.”
“I know you must have many questions at this moment, Lin Daoyou. Once we are on Yue Tian Island, I will explain everything to you.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and responded,
“Alright…”
Having said that, the two boarded the flying boat and continued their journey toward Yue Tian Island.
Thus, the pair traveled on the flying boat until they reached Yue Tian Island.
This was Lin Jing’s first time visiting Yue Tian Island.
As one of the three major islands in the Thousand Islands Domain, the size of Yue Tian Island was indeed considerable.
The island was not only abundant in Spiritual Energy but also featured continuous mountain ranges, as well as deserts, grasslands, and other terrains typically found on mainland.
With such diverse terrain came an abundance of resources, and Yue Tian Island even contained a small vein of Superior Grade Spirit Stones.
For this reason,
Yue Tian Island was home to many cultivators, including those at the Foundation Establishment and even Golden Core Stages.
These cultivators were spread across three cities on the island.
Among them was Yue Tian City, where the successive Island Masters of Yue Tian Island had resided, and it was also the largest of the cities.
The regional power division conference was to be held within this Yue Tian City.
Before they reached Yue Tian Island, Xue Yilin retracted the flying boat and, together with Lin Jing, flew toward Yue Tian City within the island.
This was another rule of Yue Tian Island: no one landing on the island may pilot a flying boat.
This rule was the same as in Bihai City.
Being Nascent Soul cultivators, both Lin Jing and Xue Yilin were fast, and in less than an hour, they arrived at Yue Tian City.
Once they reached Yue Tian City, Xue Yilin said to Lin Jing directly,
“Lin Daoyou, follow me…”
Saying this, he led Lin Jing into Yue Tian City.
Yue Tian City was no small place, almost comparable to Bihai City in size.
Inside Yue Tian City, much like Bihai City, the streets were lined with shops on both sides, with many cultivators coming and going, a bustling scene of activity.
Behind Yue Tian City stood a towering mountain. Atop that mountain was Yue Tian Hall, where the Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Lord Bai, resided.
It was said that Yue Tian Hall was built by the previous Island Master Li Mingwu.
However, after Li Mingwu had vanished, Bai Yi secured the position of Island Master of Yue Tian Island after a struggle and moved into Yue Tian Hall.
Just like that, the two made their way through Yue Tian City and directly arrived at the foot of the mountain where Yue Tian Hall was located.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but look towards Xue Yilin with a puzzled expression:
“`
“Xue Daoyou, the power division meeting for that region shouldn’t be held in Yue Tian Hall, should it?”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Correct, the regional power conference will be held in Yue Tian City.”
“However, I brought you here because Lord Bai wants to see you.”
“See me?” Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
“Yes!” Xue Yilin nodded.
“Lin Daoyou, let’s go. Once we go up there, you’ll understand.”
Lin Jing looked up at the summit’s Yue Tian Hall and started to ponder to himself:
“I am just an inconspicuous small island master in the Thousand Islands Domain, usually not showing off or standing out. Why would the island master of Yue Tian Island want to find me?”
“Unless…”
“I have some special quality that has caught his attention.”
Lin Jing thought it over and over, and there was only one possibility…
It was the Five Elements Divine Art.
Previously, he had learned from Jin Jue that Xue Yilin was looking for someone who cultivated the Five Elements Cultivation Technique, and Jin Jue was even killed by Xue Yilin because of it.
And Xue Yilin was indeed a subordinate of Lord Bai Yi from Yue Tian Island.
So it was clear, it was Lord Bai who was looking for someone who practiced the Five Elements Cultivation Technique, and it just so happened that I practiced the Five Elements Divine Art.
Therefore, Xue Yilin specifically came to find me and take me to meet Lord Bai Yi of Yue Tian Island.
However, now that I know their purpose, I can put my mind at ease.
At this point, I am already here; there’s no escaping it. I can only go up to see what the matter is.
After that, Lin Jing nodded and said to Xue Yilin:
“Good…”
“Please lead the way, Xue Daoyou.”
Xue Yilin nodded, then led Lin Jing towards the mountain summit.
The two arrived at the entrance, where two Golden Core Stage guards stood at the stairs leading to the mountain top.
Upon seeing Xue Yilin, they hurriedly made way and bowed, saying:
“Senior Xue…”
Xue Yilin, expressionless, simply nodded slightly, then swept past them and stepped onto the ascent stairs.
And Lin Jing followed behind Xue Yilin, walking upwards as well.
The mountain peak on which Yue Tian Hall was built soared into the clouds, and even the stairs they tread upon, leading to the mountain top, were exceptionally magnificent, piercing into the sky.
Lin Jing and Xue Yilin did not fly but walked up just like ordinary people, step by step.
This rule had been set by Li Mingwu before.
Anyone ascending to Yue Tian Hall must not fly, must not use spells.
Otherwise, it would be considered a provocation to the island master of Yue Tian Island and the offender would be directly killed on the spot.
Although a new island master, Lord Bai Yi, had taken over, this rule still had not changed.
Lin Jingzhi was aware of these matters from a conversation with Xue Yilin during their time on the flying boat.
However,
even though the staircase was long, for cultivators like them, it was not a difficult task.
Especially since Lin Jing was a Body Refinement Cultivator, climbing these stairs was a breeze for him.
Thus, after more than an hour, the two reached the mountain summit.
Atop the summit stood the majestic and resplendent Yue Tian Hall.
After the two arrived,
the massive doors of Yue Tian Hall, towering more than ten Zhang high, slowly began to open…
Then,
a commanding voice came from within Yue Tian Hall:
“You are here, come in together!”

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 193: The Purpose of Regional Division
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 193: The Purpose of Regional Division
Following that, Lin Jing walked into Yue Tian Hall together with Xue Yilin.
The interior of Yue Tian Hall was equally dignified.
At the very back of Yue Tian Hall, there stood a young man around thirty, with a handsome face.
There was actually something astonishing about this person, his eyes calm, and his gaze piercing as if tangible, directed at Lin Jing and his company.
Lin Jing even had the feeling as if this person could see right through him.
At this moment, Xue Yilin stepped forward, clasped his hands towards the man, and said,
“Island Master…”
“This is Lin Daoyou from Li Yan Island.”
By then, Lin Jing knew who the man before him was; he was the current Island Master of Yue Tian Island, the Divine Transformation Cultivator Bai Yi.
In the presence of a Divinity Transformation Cultivator, Lin Jing naturally didn’t dare to act carelessly, so he also followed Xue Yilin’s lead and clasped his hands towards Bai Yi, saying,
“I am Lin Jing, and I have had the honor of meeting Lord Bai.”
Bai Yi looked down at Lin Jing, and then with a smile on his face, he said,
“Island Master Lin is far too courteous.”
“I must apologize for not informing you in advance and suddenly requesting your presence, I hope you do not take offense.”
Lin Jing then spoke,
“Lord Bai jests…”
“If Lord Bai has summoned me here, there must certainly be a pressing matter.”
Bai Yi nodded and said,
“Indeed…”
“I have come to seek your help with a certain matter.”
“Xue Yilin, explain it to him.”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Yes, Island Master.”
Then, turning to Lin Jing, Xue Yilin said,
“Lin Daoyou, we would like you to use the Five Elements Divine Art to help us open a cavern.”
“Moreover, this cavern has something to do with the previous Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Li Mingwu.”
“Li Mingwu?” Lin Jing asked, puzzled, and then continued, “Wasn’t it said that he had vanished hundreds of years ago and is now presumed dead?”
Xue Yilin shook his head and replied,
“Previously…”
“We indeed thought that Li Mingwu had died.”
“You must have heard about the incident with the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm not too long ago.”
“A mysterious Divine Transformation Cultivator used the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm in an attempt to refine a thousand Golden Core Cultivators to assist his breakthrough and reach beyond the realm of Divinity Transformation.”
Lin Jing then looked at Xue Yilin and asked,
“Xue Daoyou, are you saying that this mysterious Divine Transformation Cultivator is none other than Li Mingwu?”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Indeed, as you have guessed, Lin Daoyou, that mysterious cultivator is Li Mingwu.”
Upon hearing Xue Yilin’s confirmation,
Lin Jing was utterly shocked; he could hardly believe that the withered old man he had seen through Observation Mode before was actually Li Mingwu.
This was truly beyond belief.
Previously, Lin Jing had made specific inquiries from various sources and the information he got was that Li Mingwu had disappeared when his lifespan was nearing its end.
Now, hundreds of years later, it was feared that he had long since turned to dust.
Yet, unexpectedly, he was still alive.
Afterward, Lin Jing spoke, asking Xue Yilin,
“Xue Daoyou, has this been confirmed?”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Lord Bai had hypothesized that Li Mingwu might have taken the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, which is why he has not reached the end of his lifespan after all these years.”
“The Longevity Life-Extension Elixir?” Lin Jing asked, puzzled, and then continued, “I have heard of Lifespan Extension Pills, but never the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.”
Xue Yilin spoke,
“The Longevity Life-Extension Elixir is an ancient recipe passed down from antiquity, a seventh-grade elixir medicine that is extremely rare. It is normal that Lin Daoyou has not seen it,”
“The Longevity Life-Extension Elixir’s effect of increasing one’s lifespan is tenfold that of the Lifespan Extension Pill.”
“However, now the main ingredient, Longevity Grass, for crafting the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir is nearly extinct, and even the recipe itself has been almost lost to time, which is why very few are aware of it.”
“No wonder…” Lin Jing nodded.
……
“Additionally…”
After explaining the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir to Lin Jing, Xue Yilin continued,
“The reason we are certain that the mysterious cultivator in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm is Li Mingwu actually involves another factor…”
As he spoke, Xue Yilin glanced towards Bai Yi…
Seeing this, Bai Yi took out an ancient-looking scroll and threw it to Lin Jing.
“This scroll was found in a secret vault left by Li Mingwu; it records the evil sacrificial technique he used. You can take a look…”
Lin Jing caught the ancient-looking scroll and opened it carefully, then began to read intently.
…
…
After a while, Lin Jing lifted his head, suddenly saying,
“So that’s how it is…”
Inside the scroll was the exact sacrificial rite Li Mingwu had used in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
It required the Golden Cores of a thousand Golden Core Cultivators, melted together to craft a single Blood Elixir, which after consumption, could help one break through to a realm above Divinity Transformation.
As for what lay beyond the realm of Divinity Transformation, the scroll did not specify.
Following that.
Lin Jing rolled the scroll back up and handed it to Bai Yi.
Bai Yi gestured with his hand, and the scroll flew back into his possession.
He then continued to speak,
“From the cultivators who were deceived into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, I learned that in a bid for self-rescue, they summoned the Heavenly Tribulation, disrupting Li Mingwu’s plan, and Li Mingwu was heavily injured trying to stop the tribulation.”
“Even though he once consumed a Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, I estimate it was at most of superior quality. After so many years, I suspect he is still on the verge of his life’s end.”
“Therefore…”
“Li Mingwu must have thought of using that evil sacrificial technique to attempt a breakthrough in his realm.”
“And now that his plan has failed and he has been injured by the Heavenly Tribulation, recovery will be extremely difficult.”
Bai Yi paused for a moment, then continued,
“To my knowledge, Li Mingwu had previously found an ancient cave hidden away by a great power within the Thousand Islands Domain. That cave may contain methods to heal, and Li Mingwu is very likely to head there.”
“Opening that cave requires a person who has cultivated the Five Elements Cultivation Technique. This is exactly why I asked Xue Yilin to invite you here, to help us open that cave.”
After listening, Lin Jing then asked,
“May I know where this cave is located?”
Bai Yi shook his head and said,
“I don’t know…”
“The location of that cave, only Li Mingwu knows.”
As soon as Bai Yi finished speaking, Xue Yilin addressed Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, do you know why there is a regional power division conference this time?”
Lin Jing shook his head and then said,
“Please enlighten me, Xue Daoyou…”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“The division of the three major islands’ territories is actually to set up a surveillance array that can cover the entire Thousand Islands Domain, to monitor all unusual activities within it.”
“Additionally…”
“It is also to keep an eye on the actions of Li Mingwu.”
“When Li Mingwu attempts to open the cave, it will inevitably cause a special fluctuation in spiritual power. As soon as any such fluctuations arise, they cannot escape the surveillance of the formation.”
“At that time, we will be able to locate that cave through the formation.”
“However, constructing this large formation is quite costly, and at each critical point of the formation, the presence of at least one Nascent Soul Cultivator is required to oversee it.”
“Hence, there is this regional power division conference.”

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 194: Cross-realm Transmission Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 194: Cross-realm Transmission Formation
Yue Tian Island, Wan Mo Island, and True Dragon Island were the largest in area and also the strongest among the three major islands of the Thousand Islands Domain.
The Island Master of each of these three major islands was a Divine Transformation Cultivator, each with cultivation at least in the late stage of Divinity Transformation.
It was unknown what Li Mingwu had done to provoke the Island Masters of the three islands to join forces against him.
If it were said to be due to the matter of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, Lin Jing was definitely not convinced.
While the impact of a thousand Golden Cores was significant, it was still not enough to make the Island Masters of the three islands expend such considerable effort to deal with this person.
Instead, Lin Jing was more inclined to believe that there was something inside that unidentified cave mansion that the three Island Masters needed.
At this moment, Bai Yi opened his mouth with a smile and said to Lin Jing,
“Island Master Lin, how have you considered it? Are you willing to help us open that cave mansion?”
“If Island Master Lin helps us open the cave mansion, we will certainly provide you with substantial benefits.”
Although Bai Yi wore a smile, the aura emanating from him had become more inscrutable than before.
Lin Jing knew that if he did not agree, he probably would not be able to get off easily either.
Currently, Lin Jing had no choice.
However.
This was perhaps for the better.
Although doing so might bring Li Mingwu’s animosity,
in fact, ever since Lin Jing obtained the Lingyin Yu Jian Jue, he was destined to confront Li Mingwu.
Additionally, the matter of the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, where Lin Jing caused the Heavenly Tribulation to descend, seriously injuring him, albeit temporarily hidden from Li Mingwu,
Lin Jing was not sure how long he could keep this a secret.
At present, although helping to open the cave mansion might attract Li Mingwu’s attention sooner,
Lin Jing was not afraid.
Because behind him stood the Island Masters of the three major islands in the stage of Divinity Transformation. If Li Mingwu became angry, he would definitely tackle the trouble with those three Island Masters first.
Moreover, was he the only one doing this?
Probably not…
Lin Jing felt they would certainly find others to help open the cave mansion as well.
Therefore, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“No problem…”
Upon receiving Lin Jing’s response, Bai Yi nodded slightly, and even the aura around him became much more amiable.
“That’s very good…”
“At that time, we will trouble Island Master Lin.”
Lin Jing then spoke up,
“Lord Bai, I actually have a question.”
“Please speak…” said Bai Yi.
“May I know what this cave mansion is like, and why does it require someone who practices a Five Elements Cultivation Technique to open it?”
Bai Yi looked at Lin Jing and asked,
“Island Master Lin, I heard that the Five Elements Cultivation Technique you practice is the Five Elements Divine Art, right?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Yes…”
Bai Yi continued to inquire, “May I know where you acquired this Five Elements Divine Art?”
Lin Jing then spoke,
“To not conceal anything from Lord Bai, this Five Elements Divine Art of mine was obtained from an enemy of mine. As for where that enemy acquired it from, I do not know…”
Bai Yi nodded affirmatively and responded,
“Your enemy, if I’m not mistaken, must be someone from the Thousand Islands Domain or one who once stayed in the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“Because that cave mansion is called the Five Elements Cave Mansion, and it has a deep connection with the Five Elements Divine Art you are practicing.”
Lin Jing expressed his surprise,
“I did not expect my cultivation technique to have such an origin…”
Bai Yi nodded and said,
“To my knowledge, there is another cultivation technique that is compatible with the Five Elements Divine Art, which may be inside that cave mansion.”
“Once the cave mansion is opened, if that technique is obtained, I can make the decision to present it directly to Lord Lin.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing hurriedly clasped his fists and said,
“If that is the case, I would be deeply grateful to Lord Bai.”
