The cultivation technique related to the Five Elements Divine Art is naturally the Immortal Five Elements Technique. To be cautious, Lin Jing did not reveal the existence of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
Then, Bai Yi looked at Lin Jing and continued,
“You don’t need to attend the upcoming conference for the division of regional powers.”
“I hear you’ve put a lot of effort into Li Yan Island, both cultivating Spirit Plants and setting up Fang Markets.”
“As such, we will use Li Yan Island as the core and designate a region for you.”
“Furthermore, I’ve heard from Xue Yilin that you have a good relationship with Zhang Jian from Yuxing Island…”
“The region I am designating for you will be centered on your Li Yan Island, expanding outwards all the way to Yuxing Island…”
“I will entrust you with the management of several islands within this area, what do you think?”
Bai Yi spoke as if it was all settled, seemingly having investigated Lin Jing before his arrival.
This method of division truly catered to Lin Jing’s needs, so naturally, there were no issues, and Lin Jing had no objections.
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“If so, I would again be deeply grateful to Lord Bai.”
Bai Yi nodded slightly, then continued,
“Within the region you govern, you may act as you wish.”
“Should anyone dare to disobey or engage in any other anomalous acts, you may kill them directly, without any hesitation.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded…
Subsequently,
Lin Jing and Bai Yi spoke some more about the cave mansion. After the discussion, Lin Jing followed Xue Yilin out of Yue Tian Hall.
With this matter agreed upon, all that remained was for Li Mingwu to open that cave mansion.
Afterwards, Lin Jing did not attend the regional power division conference held in Yue Tian City, but instead bid farewell to Xue Yilin and left Yue Tian Island.
The region allocated to Lin Jing was already agreed upon, and all that followed was left to Xue Yilin’s handling. Xue Yilin would take care of everything for Lin Jing.
……
The regional power division conference concluded shortly after Lin Jing’s departure.
After its conclusion, came a period of busyness.
With the cooperation of three major islands, the deployment of formations was quite swift.
In merely two months, the surveillance formation enveloping the entire Thousand Islands Domain was fully deployed.
Though called a single formation, it was actually a combination of several formations, functioning as a whole yet each controllable on its own.
And in the heart of Li Yan City, a towering spire reaching into the clouds had appeared.
The core of the formation for this region was situated atop that tower.
Once the formation deployment was complete, Xue Yilin also gave Lin Jing an Array Plate, specifically for controlling the formation in his region.
After the formation had been set up, Lin Jing no longer paid attention to it and went back to his alchemy life.
And so, a year passed by.
No news had come from Li Mingwu.
However, another piece of news arrived, relating to the Nanming Domain.
The three major sects of the Nanming Domain had sought aid from the Western Demon Region, asking for help in expelling the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, which had been met with a response.
Upon learning the specifics, the human forces of the Western Demon Region decided to establish a large Teleportation Array capable of crossing domains between the Western Demon Region and the Nanming Domain.
However, given the vast distance between the Western Demon Region and the Nanming Domain, the construction of this large Teleportation Array was not a simple task.
Therefore,
Seeking the next best option, the human forces of the Western Demon Region planned to establish two large Teleportation Arrays using Bihai City as an intermediate station, connecting the Western Demon Region to the Nanming Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 195: The Location of the Cave Mansion Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 195: The Location of the Cave Mansion Appears
“Lin Jing, do you know?”
“If nothing unexpected happens, we should be able to return to the Nanming Domain very soon.”
Li Qingqing had just received the news and was extremely happy, so she immediately ran to inform Lin Jing.
Li Qingqing was clearly very concerned about matters pertaining to the Nanming Domain.
At that time, Lin Jing had just finished a period of seclusion and was unaware of what had happened.
After hearing Li Qingqing’s words, Lin Jing was also very puzzled and confused.
“Return to the Nanming Domain?”
“Has something happened?” Lin Jing then asked Li Qingqing.
Li Qingqing nodded and excitedly said:
“The Qingyuan Sword Sect sent people to the Western Demon Region for help, and there have been results. The Sects in the Western Demon Region are preparing to establish a Teleportation Array between the Nanming Domain and the Western Demon Region.”
“This is to facilitate sending people to expel the Howling Sky Wolf Clan from the Nanming Domain. As long as the Howling Sky Wolf Clan is expelled from the Nanming Domain, then we can return…”
Returning to the Nanming Domain had always been an obsession for Li Qingqing.
Previously…
Li Qingqing had expressed the desire to return to the Nanming Domain several times during casual conversations with Lin Jing.
First, to see how the Li Family was doing.
Second, to pay respects to Elder Master Li and the other Li Family members who had died in battle.
However, due to the Howling Sky Wolf Clan’s rampage throughout the Nanming Domain, it was too dangerous, which had thwarted their plans.
Now that she had received news of support from the Western Demon Region for the Nanming Domain, Li Qingqing was naturally very happy.
Subsequently, Li Qingqing continued:
“And…”
“This Teleportation Array being established, due to the great distance, will have an intermediary stop in Bihai City. If we want to go back, we just need to go to Bihai City and use the Teleportation Array to return.”
After speaking, Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing and asked:
“Lin Jing, are you planning to go back?”
When Nanming Domain was mentioned, Lin Jing immediately thought of Huang Qingling, Elder Yu, Elder Bai, and Zhang Yuan…
They were all in Qinghuang Palace, and he wondered how they were doing now.
If possible, Lin Jing truly wanted to go back and see for himself.
It’s just that he didn’t know.
Whether he could set foot on Qinghuang Peak again.
Moreover, there were Senior Han and Ning Yue.
As a disciple of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, he supposed there should be no issue for him.
As for Ning Yue, that was unclear. He just hoped she was safe and sound.
Thinking this, Lin Jing nodded and said:
“If the Nanming Domain is restored, I’ll go back with you to take a look…”
Li Qingqing then spoke:
“That’s great. When the time comes, you, me, and my brother, we can all go back together…”
After speaking, Li Qingqing complained:
“I don’t know what’s come over my brother recently; he hasn’t visited in such a long time.”
The last time Lin Jing came out from the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, he met with Li Tangyu.
But that was their last meeting.
From that time until now, Li Tangyu hadn’t appeared again.
Li Qingqing might be unaware, but Lin Jing knew.
At this moment, Li Tangyu should be at the most critical moment, and by his calculations, should be undergoing Tribulation to enter the Nascent Soul Stage.
Moreover, the conversation they had the last time they met, Lin Jing also did not tell Li Qingqing.
Because.
Li Tangyu had made a choice, to take another path, and Li Qingqing would surely be heartbroken if she knew.
For now, it’s better to keep it from her.
……
As the two were discussing, a sudden disturbance came.
Lin Jing’s eyebrows slightly furrowed, and he immediately extended his Divine Sense.
Under the observation of his Divine Sense, Lin Jing saw that the tower used to monitor abnormal spiritual power fluctuations showed some changes.
Then, Lin Jing said to Li Qingqing:
“Qingqing, please wait for a moment. I’ll go out and check.”
At this moment, Li Qingqing didn’t know what had happened, but still nodded in response:
“Alright…”
After that, Lin Jing immediately took a step and left the small courtyard.
In just a few steps, Lin Jing arrived near the tall tower.
At the top of the tower, the formation that usually remained concealed was now revealed, furiously in operation.
This situation indicated that there was an anomaly in the energy fluctuations, and it was very possible that Li Mingwu had opened that cave dwelling.
Continuing.
Lin Jing quickly wiped his hand and took out a circular Array Plate from his Space Ring.
Then, Lin Jing began to channel his Spiritual Power into the Array Plate.
The Array Plate started to operate, resembling a star map with dozens of shining points interconnected by white silken threads.
These dozens of shining points represented the islands within the territory under Lin Jing’s jurisdiction, and the displayed map on the Array Plate was of the sea territory he governed.
At this moment, on the Array Plate, aside from these shining points and white threads, there was no sign of any anomaly.
Since the formations were connected, any disturbances in other areas would have been transmitted to Lin Jing as well.
Right now, there were no signs of disturbance on Lin Jing’s Array Plate, indicating that the anomaly had not occurred within the sea territory he controlled.
Lin Jing then put away the Array Plate and looked towards the distant sea.
If the disturbance was truly caused by Li Mingwu opening the cave dwelling, it probably wouldn’t be long before news of it arrived.
Facing the encirclement of three Divinity Transformation Cultivators, Li Mingwu probably couldn’t hold on for too long.
If Li Mingwu were to escape, it likely wouldn’t take long for Xue Yilin to come looking for him to “get to work.”
For now, all Lin Jing had to do was wait.
Afterward, Lin Jing returned to the courtyard. As soon as he arrived, Li Qingqing came to greet him and asked,
“Brother Lin Jing, has something happened?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“There’s been an incident, but don’t worry, it’s not connected to Li Yan Island.”
“I see…” Li Qingqing visibly relaxed.
Then, Lin Jing continued to Li Qingqing,
“Qing Qing…”
“I might have to leave for a few days. If there’s anything happening on the island during these days, I’ll have to trouble you.”
“Also, yesterday Mother Yue Qi mentioned that the stocks of Pure Accumulation Pill at Li Yan Elixir Pavilion are running low. You’ll need to make some in these next few days.”
Li Qingqing quickly looked at Lin Jing with concern and said,
“Are you in danger on this trip?”
Lin Jing smiled and replied,
“Don’t worry, there’s no danger this time.”
“And, this time it’s just in the Thousand Islands Domain, so I should be back very soon.”
Li Qingqing frowned with worry and said,
“Last time was also in the Thousand Islands Domain, and you were gone for eight years…”
Lin Jing found himself at a loss for words…
……
Originally…
Lin Jing had thought the matter would be resolved quickly.
However, several days passed before Xue Yilin finally arrived at Li Yan Island, and no news had come before his arrival.
As soon as Xue Yilin arrived, a puzzled Lin Jing asked him,
“Fellow Daoist Xue, have you encountered any trouble?”
Xue Yilin nodded and then said,
“I won’t lie to you, Fellow Daoist Lin, indeed there was some trouble, which is why I’m late.”
Lin Jing nodded and asked,
“What about Li Mingwu, was it really him who opened that cave dwelling?”
Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“The cave dwelling has been opened.”
Lin Jing immediately asked,
“Do you know where exactly that cave dwelling is?”
Hearing Lin Jing’s question, Xue Yilin’s expression turned a bit strange. After a moment of silence, he finally spoke,
“Yue Tian Island…”

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 196 Explore the Five Elements Cave Mansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 196 Explore the Five Elements Cave Mansion
Xue Yilin’s answer astonished Lin Jing.
Lin Jing’s mouth twitched involuntarily, and after a long while, he finally said,
“What a… good place…”
To think that the cave dwelling would actually be on Yue Tian Island.
Lord Bai had occupied Yue Tian Island for at least a few hundred years, yet even he had been unaware.
However.
Li Mingwu really was bold, daring to go to Yue Tian Island alone to open that cave dwelling.
Could it be that he wasn’t afraid of being intercepted by Lord Bai, who might ally with Demon Lord and the True Dragon Island Master, and be kept here?
Or perhaps, was there something of vital importance in the cave dwelling that he couldn’t wait any longer?
Moments later, Lin Jing spoke again, asking Xue Yilin,
“What about Li Mingwu, Daoist Xue?”
“How is he?”
“Entering Yue Tian Island, causing such a commotion, he must have alerted Lord Bai, and I suppose a great battle must have ensued between the two.”
Xue Yilan nodded, saying,
“They did indeed fought a battle…”
“However, with Li Mingwu’s cultivation at the Nascent Soul Peak, Lord Bai couldn’t stop him, and before the Demon Lord and the True Dragon Island Master could arrive, he managed to escape…”
“Okay…”
“Lin Daoyou, let’s not discuss that now.”
“The cave dwelling has already been opened, and fortunately, Li Mingwu has not yet succeeded. Now we need you to take action.”
“Moreover, the three Island Masters are waiting as well.”
Lin Jing nodded, saying,
“Alright…”
“In that case, let’s go.”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Xue Yilin did not waste any words and immediately brought out his Flying Boat.
Then.
Lin Jing and Xue Yilin together boarded the Flying Boat and flew towards Yue Tian Island.
……
This time, perhaps because the three great Island Masters were present, Xue Yilin spoke very little along the way, piloting the Flying Boat with seriousness and at a significantly faster speed than before.
In a bit more than an hour, the two arrived at Yue Tian Island.
Upon reaching Yue Tian Island, Xue Yilin led Lin Jing directly to the entrance of the cave dwelling.
When Lin Jing saw the entrance of the cave dwelling, he suddenly understood.
No wonder Lord Bai had never discovered it.
The entrance to the cave dwelling was deep in the northern mountain range of Yue Tian Island, which was desolate and uninhabited, with only Demonic Beasts present.
The entrance to the cave dwelling was right next to a Demonic Beast’s cave.
Moreover, it was concealed by a hidden Formation, so, it was quite normal for it to go unnoticed.
When Lin Jing arrived, several people were already there.
In the forefront, three individuals stood, emitting an aura belonging to beings at the Divinity Transformation Stage.
One of them was none other than Bai Yi.
The other two: one was enveloped in surging Demonic Qi, his face hidden by the black Demonic Qi, presumably he was the Demon Lord.
The other was an old man in white robes, with the appearance of a young child despite his snow-white hair.
This elder seemed very ordinary, easy to overlook.
Lin Jing, for instance, had forgotten the man’s face almost immediately after glimpsing it.
Among the three, it was this elder whose aura was the calmest and easiest to overlook.
Conceivably, it was related to the Cultivation Technique he practiced.
Upon seeing Lin Jing’s arrival, a look of joy appeared on Bai Yi’s face.
Then he turned to the two beside him and said,
“Gentlemen, this is the individual I mentioned to you.”
Upon hearing this, the two looked over at Lin Jing.
At this moment, Lin Jing stepped forward, saluted with his hands clasped and said to the three,
“I have seen the three Island Masters.”
Their reactions varied: the Demon Lord merely grunted, and the old man nodded slightly.
Only Bai Yi responded with a smile,
“Good… good…”
After speaking, Bai Yi turned again to the Demon Lord and the old man, saying,
“Now that everyone has arrived, let’s explore the Five Elements Cave Mansion together.”
Both of them nodded.
After that, Bai Yi made arrangements.
The three Divinity Transformation cultivators would go in first, and after half a quarter of an hour, they would all enter together.
Apart from the three Divinity Transformation Stage Island Masters, there were six people in total, including Lin Jing, all Nascent Soul Cultivators.
Moreover, aside from Lin Jing and Xue Yilin, the other four were all Array Masters skilled in formations.
The reason was that the mansion was filled with formations, and not just any formations, but high-level ones. A single misstep could trigger a formation, resulting in serious injury or even instantaneous disintegration.
That’s why they brought the four of them along.
In fact, Lin Jing’s role was very similar to theirs.
……
Following that, the Island Masters of the three great islands were the first to enter the mansion via the Teleportation Array.
At this time, Xue Yilin spoke up and transmitted his voice to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Be extra careful after you go in.”
“The formations in there are anything but simple.”
Lin Jing gave a slight nod and transmitted back:
“Understood…”
Soon, half a quarter of an hour passed.
Lin Jing and the others also stepped onto the Teleportation Array.
As the white light from the array shone, they were immediately transported away.
Inside the mansion, the Spiritual Energy was extremely dense.
As soon as Lin Jing entered, he saw the lush greenery in front of him…
These were Spirit Plants.
At first glance, there seemed to be mostly Second Rank and Third Rank, but it was not difficult to spot a few Fourth Rank Spirit Plants among them.
However, the fruits and flowers at the top of those Fourth Rank Spirit Plants had already been picked.
The place they were transported to appeared to be a medicinal field planted by someone.
At this time, the three Island Masters were still standing at the end of that field.
In front of them was an impenetrable white fog.
The three Island Masters were currently standing in front of that fog.
Upon seeing the others arrive, Bai Yi gestured to them:
“You guys, come over here…”
Afterwards, Lin Jing and the others walked over.
Once they did so, Bai Yi directly said to them:
“Follow us closely.”
“Be careful not to get lost.”
They all nodded, then followed the three Island Masters into the white fog.
Upon entering the fog, their visibility was reduced by the fog, so that they could not see anything beyond two meters in front of them.
Lin Jing then extended his Divine Sense, only to find that it too was affected.
With Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, he could only extend it a maximum of five meters within the fog.
It’s worth noting that after Lin Jing’s advancement to Nascent Soul, his Divine Sense had also greatly increased, directly breaking through from the early stage of Nascent Soul to the late stage.
Now, his Divine Sense could only reach out five meters in this fog.
As for the others, needless to say, their range was likely even less.
Perhaps only the range of the three Divinity Transformation Stage Island Masters ahead was somewhat larger.
Lin Jing and the others closely followed the Island Masters deeper into the fog.
The deeper they walked, the denser the fog became.
At this moment.
Lin Jing’s range of vision was left with only one meter.
Even his Divine Sense was reduced to half its previous range.
Just then.
Lin Jing suddenly sensed a dangerous aura.
Without hesitation, Lin Jing dodged to the side.
Just as Lin Jing had swiftly moved, a white shadow passed by where he had been moments before.
This white shadow flitted by and before Lin Jing could see it clearly, it disappeared into the fog…

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 197: Breaking the Five Elements Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 197: Breaking the Five Elements Formation
The white figure had appeared so abruptly, but thanks to Lin Jing’s timely reaction, he barely dodged it.
After evading, Lin Jing realized that he and the others had been separated and could no longer see anyone else.
Just as Lin Jing was pondering how to search for the others, a fluctuation suddenly came from not far behind him, followed by a muffled groan.
Then came an exclamation:
“What the hell is this thing?”
Clearly, someone other than Lin Jing had also encountered an attack, just like him.
Immediately after, Lin Jing felt strong fluctuations of cultivation energy behind him, with immense spiritual power erupting and stirring the mist into disarray.
Since they were all close together before, Lin Jing felt it particularly keenly.
Judging by the situation, it seemed that some of the others were engaged in a fight with the white figure.
However, the fight didn’t last long, only a few breaths’ time before it ceased.
At that moment, a voice came from ahead.
“What’s going on?”
This voice was somewhat aged, likely belonging to the Island Master of True Dragon Island.
No sooner had the Island Master’s voice faded away than another voice arose from a short distance behind Lin Jing:
“It’s nothing…”
“Just now we ran into a puppet attack, but it’s been dealt with.”
Then, Bai Yi’s voice came from the front:
“Be careful. There are quite a few formations here. If we’re not cautious, even the three of us could end up in hot water.”
“Don’t worry, Island Master, we’ll be careful…” from not far beside Lin Jing, Xue Yilin’s voice followed.
Although they were not far apart, Lin Jing could not detect Xue Yilin’s presence even when expanding his Divine Sense.
He could only determine his location by sound, which was not far from him.
“Don’t get too far away; stay close to us…”
Bai Yi’s voice came through again.
“Okay…”
Afterward, Lin Jing followed the voices, groping his way forward.
Before long, the group had gathered again.
Even the cultivator who had gotten a bit further away due to the puppet attack arrived shortly after the others had regrouped.
After everyone had come together, Bai Yi brought out a copper candle Magical Treasure that emitted a bright red flame, casting a hazy red glow that enveloped them all.
The light from the flame dispersed much of the white mist around them.
Their line of sight instantly broadened from an initial range of about a meter to more than ten meters.
“From here on out, be cautious…”
Bai Yi spoke, issuing a warning, and then he led the group onward.
With the copper candle illuminating the way, their visibility greatly improved. This time, when they encountered another sneak attack, Lin Jing finally got a clear view of the assailant.
It was a humanoid puppet, completely white, blending in with the mist and hard to detect.
This time, with a wide-open view.
The humanoid puppet was noticed before it could launch an attack.
The three Island Masters at the front, upon spotting the puppet, took action immediately. With a single strike, the puppet burst apart, scattering its materials all over the ground.
The puppet was not very strong.
Even Lin Jing and the others found it easy to deal with.
The only issue was that the puppet could launch a surprise attack from within the mist, catching one off guard.
Now, with the copper candle Magical Treasure enhancing their visibility, the puppet’s only advantage—its concealment—no longer existed, so naturally, it posed no threat to the group.
In this manner, Lin Jing and the rest proceeded without incident, safely emerging from the range of the white fog.
Leaving the range of the white mist, the group finally arrived in front of a valley.
At the entrance of the valley, there was a huge Formation blocking the way.
This Formation was different from others; it was a combination of five smaller Formations, each of a different color. These five smaller Formations overlapped to form the massive Formation before them.
And furthermore,
Atop this Formation, five-colored lights were intertwined, constantly shifting.
Upon seeing this Formation, Bai Yi turned his head towards the others and said,
“Next, it’s your turn.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing and the others immediately stepped forward.
At that moment, Xue Yilin turned his head to Lin Jing and said,
“Lin Daoyou, when we start breaking the Formation, we’ll need your help.”
“Just listen to me when the time comes. You act when I tell you to.”
“Alright…” Lin Jing nodded in agreement.
After that, Xue Yilin and the other four went up to the Formation and began to study it.
To Lin Jing’s surprise, Xue Yilin turned out to be an Array Master as well.
But on second thought, it made sense.
Apart from the three Island Masters, there were only six of them brought for the exploration of the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Since they were brought along, obviously there was a need for their abilities.
In this Cave Mansion, aside from the omnipresent Five Elements, the most abundant were the various Formations.
In this way, it was quite reasonable.
After the few of them stepped forward, the three Island Masters retreated to the side, quietly watching them.
After exploring, Xue Yilin and the others discussed for a while and then each began to bring out their Array Plates.
They started to work on solving the Formation.
At the entrance’s Five Elements Great Formation, each of the five of them was responsible for one.
Thus, they alternated between forming hand seals and manipulating their Array Plates, attempting to merge their Array Plates into the Formation.
About an hour later, the large combined Formation that was originally mixed together had been separated, and the assorted Five Elements Power that had been swirling around it also returned to their respective smaller Formations.
At this moment, Xue Yilin spoke to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, it’s your turn now…”
“Please use the Five Elements Divine Art and, according to the theory of the mutual conquest of the Five Elements, transfer the Five Elements Power within each Formation.”
“Remember, you must do it simultaneously.”
“Otherwise, if the Five Elements become imbalanced, the Formation will immediately become a Killing Formation, and we will all be in trouble.”
Lin Jing nodded and then approached the Formation.
At this time, Xue Yilin and the others, each controlling one Formation, were completely tied up with the task at hand.
Lin Jing then came next to Xue Yilin.
The Formation controlled by Xue Yilin was crimson, representing fire.
Fire conquers metal, and metal is white.
Next, Lin Jing looked towards the person controlling the white Formation, who was the Cultivator that had been attacked by a Puppet earlier.
Lin Jing needed to transfer the fire attribute power within the Formation controlled by Xue Yilin to the metallic Five Elements Formation of the Cultivator who had been attacked, to break this smaller Formation.
That was the method.
However, the Formation was a combined Fusion Formation of the Five Elements, and Lin Jing needed to use the power within all five Formations simultaneously for the transfer.
No wonder only Cultivators who had practiced the Five Elements Cultivation Technique could accomplish this task.
If it were other Cultivators, due to their own attributes and the limitations of their Cultivation Methods, it would be very difficult to maintain the balance of the five properties during the transfer.
Perhaps, if they were not careful, due to an imbalance of attributes, the entire endeavor would fail, turning the Formation into a Killing Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 198: Enter the Valley, Into the Palace
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 198: Enter the Valley, Into the Palace
Lin Jing first stood before the Formation, observing for a while.
After observing, Lin Jing had devised a plan, and then began to take action.
Subsequently.
Lin Jing channelled the Spiritual Power within his body, using the method of the Five Elements Divine Art, releasing five different streams of Spiritual Power.
These streams of Spiritual Power, each a different color, corresponded precisely with the five Formations.
After Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power infiltrated them, it merged with the Formation’s Five Elements Spiritual Force within a short time.
Once these powers merged, Lin Jing began to control his own Spiritual Power, using it as a primer to stimulate the Formation’s Spiritual Power and start to mobilize the Five Elements Power within it.
At first, Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power only caused slight fluctuations in the Five Elements Power within the Formation.
Gradually, as time passed, Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power slowly took the dominant role, drawing the Five Elements Spiritual Force to keep moving within the Formation.
Only when he felt the timing was right, did Lin Jing control the transference of the Five Elements Power within each Formation.
During this step, Lin Jing was extremely cautious.
Even the Island Masters of the three great islands stretched out their Divine Sense, continuously scanning the surroundings to clear any interference for Lin Jing.
If Lin Jing were to be disturbed at this moment, it would spell disaster.
The Formation would transform into a Killing Formation, sweeping Lin Jing and the others into it. Even if they were fortunate enough to survive, they would surely be gravely injured.
At that time, the Formation would become extremely dangerous, and breaking the Formation would become dozens of times more difficult.
Therefore, the Island Masters from the three great islands also acted with extreme caution, fearing any unexpected incidents might occur.
Time ticked away, and only after two quarters of an hour did the Five Elements Power within the Formation finally get transferred completely.
Just as the Five Elements Power within the Formation had been fully transferred, the Formation began to show changes.
Initially combined as one large Formation, it collapsed instantaneously after Lin Jing completed the transference of the Five Elements Power, reverting back to five smaller Formations.
These five smaller Formations then dimmed and, moments later, sunk into the ground and disappeared.
The Five Elements Formation at this entrance was thus broken.
With the disappearance of the Five Elements Formation, the scenery inside the valley also re-emerged.
Lin Jing stood at the entrance, looking inside…
He could see the lush and verdant inside, full of vitality, with a vast palace occupying hundreds of mu, settled in the center of the valley.
Lin Jing looked towards the palace in the valley and found that it was also built with the convergence of the Five Elements in mind.
In each of the five directions of this Five Elements palace, there extended an annex hall.
And.
These five annex halls each had a distinct color.
Red, yellow, blue, black, and white, these five palaces corresponded exactly to the Five Elements.
However, of these five annexes, three had collapsed, leaving only the black and blue ones intact.
If one were to consider the Five Elements, they would correspond precisely to the elements of water and wood within the Five Elements.
A larger Five Elements Formation enveloped these palaces, within which the Five Elements Power circulated.
But now only blue and black remained.
Looking at the situation, this Five Elements Formation should be based on the five annex halls, ultimately converging at the central main hall, forming a large Formation.
At this moment.
The Island Masters of the three great islands also raised their heads, eyes flickering with unusual light, gazing at the palace within the valley.
Soon after, Bai Yi opened his mouth, addressing everyone:
“Let’s go…”
“We’re going inside.”
“There are many Formations inside that need to be deciphered slowly; this is not the time to rush.”
The Demon Lord of Myriad Demons and the Island Master of True Dragon Island nodded, then followed Bai Yi towards the valley.
Lin Jing and the others stood aside, allowing the three Island Masters to enter first.
After the Island Masters had entered, Lin Jing and his group followed behind them.
……
Walking through the valley, everyone was cautious.
The valley wasn’t calm inside, though from the outside, it seemed quite ordinary.
But once inside, the situation was entirely different.
There were many formations here.
Most of these formations were hidden, so Lin Jing and his companions found their journey far from smooth.
It took several days for the group to break through the formations along the way and arrive at the entrance to the palace.
When they reached the entrance to the palace, they all breathed a sigh of relief, including the three great Island Masters.
After breaking through the valley’s formations, only the palace formations remained, bringing them closer to their destination.
At that moment.
At the entrance to the palace, another Five Elements Grand Formation appeared, much like the one at the entrance to the valley.
It was also composed of five smaller Five Elements Formations.
Afterward,
the group followed the same steps as before, with Xue Yilin and his companions attempting to break the formation first, followed by Lin Jing using the Five Elements Divine Art to transfer the Five Elements Power.
Along the way, they encountered dozens of similar formations, and Lin Jing’s group became more adept at breaking them.
This time, they didn’t take too long to break through the formation at the palace entrance and then walked inside.
Upon entering, there was a spacious square that seemed like a Five Elements formation diagram, divided into five smaller squares.
Three of these smaller squares had been destroyed and were not protected by formations, corresponding to the three side halls that had already been breached.
The other two were still protected by formations.
At the back of the square was a luxurious palace with an ancient style.
At this point, Xue Yilin approached Bai Yi and said:
“Island Master…”
“According to the message left by my grandfather before his death…”
“When he and Li Mingwu came here last time, they only opened the Metal, Fire, and Earth side halls, taking away the corresponding three Five Elements Command Tokens.”
“Now, only the Water Hall and the Wood Hall remain.”
“And Li Mingwu, being injured, needs the Spiritual Medicine that can heal his Soul Spirit wounds, which is within the Five Elements Wood Hall.”
“We just have to open these two side halls to get the two tokens, and then, Li Mingwu won’t be able to gather all Five Elements Command Tokens to enter the main hall and gain the Five Elements inheritance.”
“Nor will he be able to use the Teleportation Array inside the main hall to enter the Five Elements ruins for greater opportunities.”
“Even more, if possible, the Island Master could trade that Spiritual Medicine for the Five Elements Command held by Li Mingwu.”
As Xue Yilin spoke, the other two Island Masters listened intently.
When Xue Yilin finished speaking, the True Dragon Island was the first to respond:
“Bai friend, let’s remember what we agreed upon beforehand…”
“We help you deal with Li Mingwu, and after opening the two side halls, Demon Lord and I each take one Five Elements Command Token, with the rest belonging to you.”
The Demon Lord of Wan Mo didn’t bother with pleasantries and directly said:
“I want the Five Elements Water Command Token.”
Bai Yi responded to the two of them with a smile:
“Rest assured, dear friends, we already agreed on this beforehand, and I definitely won’t go back on my word.”
“Moreover, once we open the Five Elements ruins, we will need the concerted effort from both of you.”
The Island Master of True Dragon Island said with a smile:
“In that case… very good…”
The Demon Lord, meanwhile, simply looked up at the Five Elements Water Hall, paying no mind to the other two.
At this moment, Bai Yi addressed Xue Yilin:
“Next, taking care of the remaining two side halls will be up to you.”
Xue Yilin hastened to assure:
“Rest assured, Island Master.”
After speaking, Xue Yilin signaled to Lin Jing and the others to approach the formation ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 503: 199: Breaking the Five Elements Water Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 199: Breaking the Five Elements Water Formation
The first Formation they arrived at was the one with the black Formation Patterns.
This Formation differed from the ones they had encountered before; the Five Elements Power within had already fused together, presenting a five-colored radiance that permeated the entire Formation.
Above the Formation were densely packed, black wave-like Formation Patterns.
Approaching the Formation, Xue Yilin spoke directly to the group:
“Fellow Daoists, this Formation is the Five Elements Water Formation, linked to the Water Hall. Inside, there is also a Teleportation Array. As long as we break this Formation, we’ll be able to enter it through the Teleportation Array.”
“Furthermore, this Formation is different from those we’ve broken before. The power of the Five Elements inside is formidable, which is why we’re presently safe within this Formation.”
“In a moment, the five of us will need to break the external Five Elements Water Formation first. Then, we’ll set up a Restraining Formation to contain the Five Elements Power inside.”
“After that…”
“It will be up to Lin Daoyou to use the Five Elements Cultivation Technique to control that Five Elements Power and transfer it out.”
“This process may be somewhat cumbersome, so I hope my fellow Daoists will be cautious to prevent any mistakes.”
After hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Then, Xue Yilin turned to Lin Jing and said:
“Lin Daoyou, once we open the Formation, I’ll trouble you to transfer the Five Elements Power from within the Five Elements Water Formation. You’ll only need to move it outside the Formation.”
“Once drawn out, this Five Elements Power will dissipate on its own.”
Lin Jing nodded in response.
The group then began to take action.
Xue Yilin and the others, one at each position, started to deploy their methods to break the Formation.
It wasn’t easy to break this Formation.
It took them several hours just to dim the Formation slightly.
Throughout this time, Lin Jing observed the others.
He noticed that aside from Xue Yilin and the cultivator who had been previously attacked, the others struggled considerably.
Only those two seemed more at ease.
It seemed that their understanding of Formations was likely higher, which was why they appeared so.
Especially that attacked cultivator, who possessed a late-stage Nascent Soul cultivation, it was no wonder he managed to easily resolve the attacking puppet earlier.
Several more hours passed, and the Formation Patterns on the Formation dimmed, flickering on and off, and the whole Formation seemed on the verge of being broken.
At this time, the Five Elements Power within the Formation roiled, trying to merge with the Formation. However, they were restrained by a small Formation set up jointly by the group, and like trapped beasts, they were unable to effect anything.
Just then, Xue Yilin spoke to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, get ready, it’s time for you to act.”
Lin Jing nodded and prepared himself.
Sure enough, before long…
The external layer of the Formation was broken and vanished, and the Five Elements Power within the Formation became even more turbulent, causing the Formation that the group had set up to shake incessantly.
Xue Yilin and the others quickly performed hand seals to stabilize the Formation again.
At that moment, Lin Jing made his move.
He employed the Five Elements Divine Art, attempting to control the Five Elements Power within the Formation.
However, after trying for a while, Lin Jing found it was not easy to control these forces. He couldn’t even quell the Five Elements Power within the Formation slightly.
Lin Jing furrowed his brow, then, he channeled the Five Elements Divine Art, condensing a stream of Wǔ Cǎi radiance that plunged into the Formation.
With the entry of the Wǔ Cǎi radiance, Lin Jing’s perception of the Five Elements Power inside became even clearer.
Lin Jing could distinctly feel the ferocious aura within; the Five Elements Power was incredibly potent, and if it was allowed to burst forth, the entire plaza would likely be destroyed.
Beyond the ferocious aura, Lin Jing also distinctly felt that this Five Elements Power didn’t seem to be directly drawn from the natural Five Elements Power of heaven and earth.
It seemed as though it had been cultivated by someone before being condensed into being.
Lin Jing clearly sensed that although he could quell the Five Elements Power within the formation by using the Five Elements Divine Art,
it was extremely draining.
He feared that if he were to draw out all the Five Elements Power, he would likely collapse on the spot, utterly defenseless for the taking.
Given his current predicament, if he were to expend himself without reserve, leaving no energy to resist,
he might not only gain no advantage but could also potentially plunge himself into real danger.
That would not be a wise move.
If he did nothing, however, the island masters of the three large islands behind him would not let him off.
Lin Jing looked at the Five Elements Power within the formation.
Suddenly, an idea flashed through his mind…
Why not try using the Immortal Five Elements Technique?
If the Five Elements Power within the formation had indeed been cultivated by someone, then using the Immortal Five Elements Technique could likely establish some sort of connection with it and bring it under better control.
And for him, it would be much easier,
so that after transferring out this Five Elements Power, he wouldn’t be depleted of Spiritual Power, leaving him without any strength to resist.
However, when operating the Immortal Five Elements Technique, he had to be careful not to be noticed by others.
Especially Bai Yi and Xue Yilin.
For safety’s sake, Lin Jingzhi had not previously revealed that he cultivated the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
So they had always been unaware.
Now that he wanted to use it, he had to be cautious and it would be best to conceal it somehow.
As for concealing, he cultivated the Changyun Hidden Technique, so even Xue Yilin, let alone Bai Yi, couldn’t detect his true cultivation level—there shouldn’t be any major issue.
……
While Lin Jing was hesitating,
Xue Yilin noticed Lin Jing’s odd behavior and asked,
“Lin Daoyou, what’s wrong?”
“Is there a problem?”
While Lin Jing was using the Five Elements Divine Art to control the Wu Cai flowing lights and trying to merge into the Five Elements Power of the formation, he replied,
“This Five Elements Power is quite difficult to control…”
Following that, Xue Yilin spoke to Lin Jing,
“Hmm, this formation is the final defense of the side hall, and it is indeed not easy, Lin Daoyou, take your time, there is no need to rush…”
Not only Lin Jing but also the others furrowed their brows at Xue Yilin’s words.
After all, maintaining the formation was not easy for them either.
Lin Jing hesitated briefly and then said to the cultivators,
“I’ll trouble my fellow Daoists then, I will do my best to transfer these Five Elements Power out as quickly as possible.”
Having said this, Lin Jing fell silent and sat down cross-legged, then he condensed several streams of Wu Cai lights again and merged them into the formation.
At the same time, the aura about Lin Jing grew stronger; he appeared to be making an all-out effort.
At this moment, Lin Jing was using the Wu Cai lights to merge into the Five Elements Power within the formation.
At the same time…
Lin Jing also quietly started to operate the Immortal Five Elements Technique, attempting to control the Five Elements Power within the formation with it.

chapters.title: Chapter 504: 200: Sudden Change, Black Fog
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 200: Sudden Change, Black Fog
“`
As Lin Jing activated the Immortal Five Elements Technique, the violent Five Elements Power became somewhat stabilized.
Indeed.
Lin Jing’s guess was correct.
The Five Elements Power could indeed be controlled by the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
Even though it could be controlled, to completely pacify the Five Elements Power within the Formation would still require considerable effort.
However, Lin Jing was not in a hurry right now.
If he were to pacify it too quickly, that would truly be problematic.
Thus, Lin Jing, while using the Five Elements Divine Art to control the colorful stream of light, continuously moved through the Formation.
At the same time, he secretly utilized the Immortal Five Elements Technique to slowly control the violent Five Elements Power, allowing that power to gradually calm down.
Throughout this time, Lin Jing maintained a deep frown, pretending to be fully exerting himself, and with the concealment effect of the Changyun Hidden Technique, no one noticed anything out of the ordinary.
In this manner, several hours passed, and the Five Elements Power within the Formation slowly returned to a state of calm.
At this moment, Lin Jing appeared much weaker compared to before, and his face showed signs of fatigue.
Then, Xue Yilin spoke to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Next, all we need to do is transfer out this Five Elements Power.”
Lin Jing nodded.
After that, he controlled the Five Elements Power to move within the Formation, until after a moment, Lin Jing said to the others:
“Fellow Daoists, we can now dismantle the Formation.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, the others also sighed with relief, and then began to dismantle the Formation.
With the dismantling of the Formation, Lin Jing then controlled the Five Elements Power to the center of the plaza.
After that, Lin Jing released his control over the clump of Five Elements Power, and it began to slowly dissipate.
Just as the Five Elements Power was dissipating…
Suddenly…
A violent fluctuation emanated throughout the entire space.
Then, on the ground of the plaza, a gigantic Formation appeared, and upon its emergence, several beams of light in various colors shot up into the sky.
These beams were divided into five colors: red, yellow, green, white, and black, two of each color.
Furthermore, the light beams didn’t gather together but were distributed across the plaza in a Formation arrangement.
After the appearance of the light columns, a pitch-black fog rose from outside the palace, and this black fog was slowly moving, crossing over the palace walls and surging into the plaza.
Moreover, this black fog was approaching from all four directions, everywhere at once, and in a moment, the people were surrounded by it.
Xue Yilin’s expression changed dramatically upon seeing the black fog, and his face sank as he said:
“How can this be…”
A moment later, Xue Yilin said to the others:
“Fellow Daoists, this black fog is dangerous. Quickly take refuge inside the Formation Eyes.”
As he spoke, Xue Yilin took shelter inside a nearby beam of light that radiated black luminance.
Seeing Xue Yilin’s reaction, Bai Yi furrowed his brows and asked him:
“What’s going on?”
Xue Yilin hurriedly explained:
“Island Master…”
“An accident must have occurred in the Water Hall of the Five Elements, causing this situation. This black fog is different from the white fog outside. It must not be touched at all costs. Only by taking refuge within the Formation Eyes can one be safe.”
Upon hearing Xue Yilin’s words, the first to react was not Bai Yi, but the Demon Lord, who promptly summoned a Flying Sword and charged into the black fog.
However, upon contact with the black fog, the Flying Sword started to slowly dissolve.
“`
In just a short while, the Flying Sword lost control, and only half of it clanged onto the ground before being devoured by the surging black fog.
Seeing this, everyone’s expression turned grim.
At that moment, the Demon Lord spoke to Xue Yilin, asking:
“How long will this black fog last?”
Xue Yilin promptly replied:
“Replying to the Demon Lord, the black fog will persist for three days before it gradually dissipates.”
“We’ll wait here within the Formation Eye for three days, and then the square will be safe. At that time, we can head to the Water Hall of Five Elements to see what the situation is.”
After hearing this, the Demon Lord spoke no further and walked straight towards a nearby column of light.
Seeing this,
the others chose a column of light and entered it as well.
Lin Jing looked at the black column of light not far ahead, just as he thought to step into it.
However, as soon as Lin Jing moved, the column was claimed by another, none other than the cultivator who had been attacked by a puppet before.
Seeing the column taken, Lin Jing frowned slightly and then chose another direction, heading towards a red column of light a little further away.
This time, they would have to hide within the Formation Eye for three days, and Lin Jing did not wish to stay with the others.
Though Lin Jing preferred solitude, there were others who were close and prepared to move to one of the Formation Eyes together.
Just then, Xue Yilin hurriedly spoke up:
“Fellow Daoist…”
“Only one person can be accommodated within each Formation Eye. If too many enter, it will not serve any protective purpose. Remember to stay separated.”
Heeding Xue Yilin’s warning, the two immediately halted their steps and, cupping their fists towards Xue Yilin, said:
“Many thanks for the reminder, Fellow Daoist…”
After speaking, the two parted ways, heading towards different Formation Eyes.
There were a total of ten Formation Eyes and there were nine of them, so there was no need to compete for space, as there were more than enough to accommodate everyone.
It wasn’t until everyone had entered a Formation Eye that the black fog slowly drifted over.
The black fog was dense, obscuring everything around it so tightly that nothing could be seen.
Quickly, in just a dozen or so breaths, the black fog had already drifted close to the farthest unoccupied Formation Eye.
However, as the black fog neared the Formation Eye, it was directly blocked by the column of light.
It failed to enter the Formation Eye.
Upon seeing this, everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, the black fog drifted again, approaching the second Formation Eye.
At this moment, the cultivator inside that Formation Eye was also intently watching the black fog with furrowed brows.
It wasn’t long before the second Formation Eye was engulfed.
Just like with the first Formation Eye, the column of light kept the black fog at bay.
The cultivator inside was at last able to ease up.
In this manner, the black fog surged from all directions, confining Lin Jing and his companions within the Formation Eyes.
The area inside the Formation Eye was not large, only about twenty feet in size, making it difficult to move around much.
Fortunately, everyone was a cultivator, and three days’ time was simply a matter of meditating to pass it by.
Outside the Formation Eye, it was truly ink-like black fog.
Once outside the Formation Eye, nothing could be seen, such was the density of the black fog.
Moreover, Lin Jing tried to extend his Divine Sense and discovered that even the Divine Sense could not probe outwards. If Lin Jing’s Divine Sense could not reach out, it was certainly the same for others.
However,
fortunately, Lin Jing still had the System Space. If he wanted to investigate, he could just use the Observation Mode, so there wasn’t too much to worry about…

chapters.title: Chapter 505: 201 Investigation, Five Elements Water Hall (Two in One)
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 201 Investigation, Five Elements Water Hall (Two in One)
“`
Staying within this formation would require at least three days, and during this period, it was uncertain whether any accidents might occur.
Lin Jing naturally did not wish to remain within the Eye of the Formation the entire time.
Since there was nothing to do at the moment, it was a good opportunity to use the System’s Observation Mode to explore the outside situation.
Having thought of this, Lin Jing immediately called out to the System and entered the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing spoke again:
“System!”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
As his words fell, the scenery before Lin Jing’s eyes began to change, and moments later, his perspective was above the Eye of the Formation.
At this time, outside was still pitch black.
The black fog rolled continuously, attempting to invade the interior of the Eye of the Formation, but it was blocked by the column of light at the Eye, unable to enter.
This situation was indeed as Xue Yilin had said; staying within this formation was the safest option.
Previously, Xue Yilin mentioned that his grandfather had entered this place with Li Mingwu.
His knowledge of the Five Elements Cave Mansion stemmed from his grandfather.
Looking at it this way, the collapse of the three Five Elements Halls was likely caused by Li Mingwu during his last visit.
The palace area was a hundred acres in size, and the location of the side halls was not too far from this main hall’s plaza.
Apart from the three collapsed side halls, there were two intact side halls standing there.
If Lin Jing wanted to enter the side halls, he could do so by directly using the Fixed Point Teleportation function.
However, it was unknown what dangers, if any, lurked within the Five Elements Hall and what treasures it held?
Lin Jing was quite curious.
Logically speaking, treasures that would tempt a Divinity Transformation Cultivator must be extraordinary.
At this thought, Lin Jing became somewhat tempted…
“Perhaps…”
“I should first use Observation Mode to explore, and if there is no danger, then wouldn’t the treasures inside be mine without any cost?”
After contemplating for a moment, Lin Jing decided to take action.
Before acting, to avoid any unexpected situations, Lin Jing wanted to first see what the others were doing.
Subsequently,
Lin Jing controlled Observation Mode to explore other areas.
Although Lin Jing’s vision was obscured by the black fog in Observation Mode, making it impossible to see clearly,
he already had a good sense of the location of the other Formation Eyes, so he did not exert much effort to find the others.
Then, following the directions in his memory, Lin Jing set out to observe these people…
Lin Jing first observed those who were closest,
Some were meditating and cultivating; others were studying their Cultivation Techniques, and still, others were looking at the black fog outside, seemingly lost in thought.
That was the state of the Cultivator who had previously been attacked,
standing in the Eye of the Formation, staring at the black fog in front, seemingly thinking about something,
Or perhaps waiting for something…
After observing these people, Lin Jing turned his attention to observing the three Island Masters.
The three Island Masters were much calmer, all meditating with their eyes closed. Lin Jing also observed the trio for some time and did not manage to discover any secrets on their persons.
So he gave up.
After checking on the three Island Masters, only Xue Yilin was left.
Because the Eye of the Formation where Xue Yilin was located was somewhat further from Lin Jing, it was only at the end that Lin Jing checked this place.
When Lin Jing investigated Xue Yilin’s location, he immediately perceived something was amiss.
The black fog near the Eye of the Formation where Xue Yilin was appeared to churn violently.
Confused, Lin Jing continued to probe deeper.
When Lin Jing moved his observational perspective inside the Eye of the Formation where Xue Yilin was, he instantly understood what was happening.
There before Xue Yilin floated a white token made of an unknown material; in front of the token was a Formation about a dozen inches across, suspended in mid-air.
Moreover, the white token was embedded within this airy Formation.
Lin Jing brought his observational perspective closer and could see the words “Five Elements” on the token.
The token was strikingly similar to the one Lin Jing had previously obtained from the true mystic Ling Yin,
The only difference being that Lin Jing’s token was red, while this one was white.
Looking at Xue Yilin himself, he was at that moment forming seals with both hands, his lips moving slightly, as though reciting incantations,
Seemingly in control of this Eye of the Formation.
As Xue Yilin continued his hand seals, the entire Eye of the Formation, along with the black column of light, expanded continuously, eventually doubling in size.
It was at this moment that a change occurred within the Eye of the Formation. The Formation Patterns at the base of the Eye began to operate,
Before long, they actually formed a Teleportation Array.
As this Teleportation Array took shape, it began operating immediately.
At this time, was someone about to be teleported in?
With the light on the Teleportation Array within the Eye of the Formation growing brighter, a vague figure began to appear at its center.
When the Teleportation Array finished operating, a person materialized at its heart,
Someone Lin Jing had not expected.
This person was the very Cultivator who had been attacked by a puppet earlier.
Xue Yilin had actually summoned this person through the Teleportation Array.
Moreover, after being teleported in, the man stood within the same Eye of the Formation as Xue Yilin, and the Eye exhibited no issues, still blocking the black fog from the outside.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but suspect whether Xue Yilin lied, and more than two people could indeed coexist within the pillar of light?
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 506: 201 Investigation, Five Elements Water Hall (Two in One)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 201 Investigation, Five Elements Water Hall (Two in One)_2
Just as Lin Jing was puzzled, Xue Yilin’s following words startled him as well.
He saw Xue Yilin giving a respectful bow and said to the man:
“Senior Li…”
The cultivator nodded, subsequently starting to transform his appearance, and before long, the person turned into a withered old man.
This old man was very familiar to Lin Jing. Wasn’t it the withered old man Lin Jing had encountered in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm?
It turned out to be Li Mingwu.
Li Mingwu actually appeared here, right under the noses of the three Island Masters.
At this moment, Li Mingwu looked even older and more haggard than last time.
Upon closer observation, Lin Jing could also see some bloodshot in his eyes, and his complexion seemed off, as if he was injured and had not yet fully recovered.
Then, Lin Jing shifted his Observation Mode to look at Xue Yilin who was nearby.
From Xue Yilin’s attitude towards Li Mingwu, it was evident that this entire affair was closely related to Xue Yilin.
Without Xue Yilin as an inside agent, it would probably have been difficult for Li Mingwu to come in.
What was unknown was the true identity of Xue Yilin, who could deceive the three Island Masters, especially Bai Yi.
At that moment, Li Mingwu spoke to Xue Yilin:
“Ling Yi…”
“Over these years, you’ve stayed by Bai Yi’s side under another identity, doing many things for me. It has been hard on you…”
“After this matter is over, once I ascend to the Solidifying Body Realm, I will help you break through to Divinity Transformation.”
Li Mingwu’s words shocked Lin Jing once more.
Unexpectedly, Xue Yilin was actually the mastermind who had deceived them into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, the true Lord Ling Yi.
Furthermore, Lin Jing also paid attention to the words Li Mingwu had said afterward.
“Ascend to the Solidifying Body Realm!”
This Solidifying Body Realm must be the realm above Divinity Transformation.
Xue Yilin then respectfully said:
“Thank you, senior…”
Li Mingwu gave a slight nod, and then turned to Xue Yilin, who was also known as Lord Ling Yi, and said:
“Enough…”
“We should set off now, to the Five Elements Water Hall. My injuries cannot be delayed for too long.”
Xue Yilin nodded and afterwards said:
“Yes, senior…”
Then, Xue Yilin placed his hand upon the Token, channeling Spiritual Power into it.
Subsequently, several white Formation Patterns appeared within the Five Elements Command Token, connecting with the Teleportation Array within the Formation Eye.
The Teleportation Array beneath their feet immediately underwent a change.
Following that, the Teleportation Array lit up once more, emitting a light of interwoven black and white. As the light grew increasingly stronger to the point of being dazzling, it suddenly flashed intensely, and the two persons were directly transported away.
After the pair had left, the Formation Eye returned to its calm state.
Seeing the two being teleported away, Lin Jing gazed at the empty Formation Eye. After hesitating for a moment, he too controlled his Observation Mode to leave, probing toward the Five Elements Water Hall.
Lin Jing wanted to find out exactly what the two were up to.
Lin Jing was already clear about the location of the Five Elements Water Hall. Although there were black mists on the way that obstructed sight, even in Observation Mode, it was impossible to see through, but Lin Jing was confident he would not err.
Sure enough, as Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode, moving forward for a while and closing in on the extreme limit of the observable distance, he finally arrived at the Five Elements Water Hall.
Inside the Five Elements Water Hall, there was no black mist. As soon as Lin Jing peered into the Five Elements Water Hall, he saw Li Mingwu and Xue Yilin.
But that’s wrong, it wasn’t just the two of them; there was another person…
Or rather, a corpse.
This corpse looked exactly the same as the cultivator whom Li Mingwu had previously transformed into.
Seeing the current situation made it not hard to guess.
It was highly likely that this cultivator had suffered an attack by Li Mingwu and was killed by him.
Li Mingwu then took his identity and followed the others into the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but recall the previous attack incident that occurred within the white fog.
Because vision was obstructed in the white fog, making it extremely difficult to see, and Divine Sense could also not penetrate it.
If it was indeed Li Mingwu who launched the stealth attack, it would have been during that time.
For Li Mingwu, a Cultivator at the Nascent Soul Peak, to launch a surprise attack on a Nascent Soul Cultivator, clearly the latter would not have time to react.
There wouldn’t even be a chance to sound an alarm.
This would explain it all.
The white fog and the white Puppet were all providing cover for these actions.
But upon further thought, it made sense.
In terms of understanding the Five Elements Cave Mansion, probably no one could surpass Li Mingwu.
I estimate that the white fog, as well as the puppet, were both prepared in advance, and with Xue Yilin, who was familiar with the internal situation of the Five Elements Cave Mansion, the three Island Masters naturally wouldn’t suspect anything.
After the sneak attack, Li Mingwu didn’t make much noise, and he didn’t dispose of the cultivator’s body either, but instead brought it to this Five Elements Water Hall.
Just as Lin Jing was pondering, trying to sort out his thoughts,
Xue Yilin made his move, conjuring a black light that shot towards the cultivator’s corpse.
That cultivator’s body immediately began to decay, and eventually turned into black smoke that disappeared without a trace.
Leaving behind only a set of robes and a Space Ring on the spot.
Xue Yilin then picked up the robes and the Space Ring, and handed them directly to Li Mingwu.
Li Mingwu just glanced at them and then said to Xue Yilin,
“You keep these…”
“Once I get the Elixir Medicine from the Wood Hall that treats injuries to the Soul Spirit, I’m going to go into seclusion for a while.”
“By then, be careful when you handle these items, and don’t let anyone discover anything suspicious.”
“I don’t want any accidents occurring before I advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.”
Xue Yilin nodded and responded,
“Thank you for your guidance, Senior.”
After finishing his words, Xue Yilin stored away the Space Ring and the robes.
After storing them, the two proceeded into the depths of the main hall.
This Five Elements Water Hall was shaped like a convex character, with the Teleportation Array that they had arrived through at the upper half of the convex shape.
Walking out led to the spacious main chamber of the Five Elements Water Hall.
In the center of the great hall, there were three platforms, two low and one high, all protected by a Formation.
Through the Formation, Lin Jing could see.
On the higher platform in the middle, there lay a Token, which was black and also had the words ‘Five Elements’ inscribed on it.
This must be the Five Elements Water Command.
On the other two slightly lower platforms, one of them contained an Elixir Medicine stored in a Pure Jade Box.
The other, a Cultivation Technique Jade Slip.
Then,
The two approached the middle platform, with Li Mingwu bringing out the Five Elements Command Token used for teleportation, placing it before the Formation.
Then, he channeled his Spiritual Power into the Token, causing the white Formation Patterns within it to reappear and flow towards the Formation encapsulating the platform.
The Formation dissipated as quickly as snow melts under the scorching sun.
The platform was thus exposed before the two men.
Afterward, Li Mingwu reached out and grasped the Token in his hand.
With the Token in hand, a smile curled on Li Mingwu’s lips as he gazed at the black Token and said,
“Five Elements Water Command!”
“After so many years, it’s finally in my grasp.”
“Having this Five Elements Water Command would allow us to enter the final Wood Hall early and obtain that last Five Elements Wood Command, as well as the Elixir Medicine to heal my Soul Spirit injuries.”
At this moment, Xue Yilin also spoke up to Li Mingwu,
“Congratulations, Senior…”
“With these two Commands in your possession, Senior, you now have three of the Five Elements Command Tokens. You only need the last Earth Command and Fire Command to gather all five and enter the Five Elements relic.”
“I have heard that within the Five Elements relic, there is not only the method to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm but even the unparalleled treasure, the Life Reversing Fruit. I wonder if it’s true…”
Li Mingwu nodded and said,
“Of course…”
“However, these things are all within the very heart of the Five Elements relic, and the relic itself is no ordinary danger.”
“Even with all five Five Elements Command Tokens and access to the relic, they won’t be easy to obtain.”
At this point, Li Mingwu suddenly changed the subject, asking Xue Yilin,
“Right…
“Keep an eye on the Five Elements Earth Command carried by Bai Yi. If possible, it would be best to acquire it.”
“And the whereabouts of the Five Elements Fire Command, how is your investigation going?”
Xue Yilin then said,
“Bai Yi is well aware of the importance of the Five Elements Earth Command and keeps it close to his heart. There’s no way for me to even approach it.”
“Unless, after Senior’s injuries are healed, we could find a way to snatch it from him.”
“As for the other Five Elements Fire Command…”
At this point, Xue Yilin frowned and continued,
“Originally, the Five Elements Fire Command was acquired by the gravely injured Cultivator Ling Yin.”
“And when he fled with his critical injuries, he used a special shifting Formation, making it impossible to track where he was eventually transferred to. He may not even be within the Demonic Monster Sea anymore.”
“Over the years, I’ve also been trying my best to assist you in the search…”

chapters.title: Chapter 507: 202 Exploration of the Five Elements Wood Hall (Two in One)
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 202 Exploration of the Five Elements Wood Hall (Two in One)
Li Mingwu snorted coldly after listening,
“Hmph!”
“I know Ling Yin’s injuries best. When I injured him, he was almost at death’s door, and there was no way he could have survived.”
“Ling Yin was asking for trouble, opposing me like that. His fate was his own making.”
“It’s just unfortunate that he escaped back then. Escaping would have been fine, but what’s most infuriating is that he took the Five Elements Fire Command with him when he ran away.”
After listening, Xue Yilin hesitated for a moment before speaking up,
“Senior Li, so much time has passed by now, it’s probably even harder to find that Five Elements Fire Command.”
“We’re likely going to need to put in quite an effort.”
Li Mingwu, upon hearing this, spoke directly,
“If that Five Elements Fire Command really can’t be found, then let’s not look for it for the time being…”
“As long as we obtain the other tokens, we can infer the location of that Five Elements Fire Command based on the connection between the tokens.”
“To deduce the position of the Five Elements Fire Command, we need to gather at least three Five Elements Commands, and the price we have to pay is not small.”
“However, the price to compute its position is too high, and unless it’s absolutely necessary, I don’t wish to use divination to find it…”
“For now, we should still try our best to look for it.”
Upon hearing this, Xue Yilin nodded and said,
“Understood, senior…”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown when he heard their conversation, not expecting that the Five Elements Command could be located through divination.
Luckily, Lin Jing had come along this time and eavesdropped on this news; otherwise, he might have been caught off guard if Li Mingwu had suddenly found him one day.
“No…”
“I can’t keep carrying the Five Elements Fire Command with me from now on.”
Lin Jing immediately resolved not to keep the Five Elements Fire Command in his Space Ring anymore. After all, the Five Elements Command was too special, and its position could be inferred using other tokens.
He didn’t want to be caught off guard.
However,
though he couldn’t keep it in the Space Ring, he could place it in the System Space.
Lin Jing didn’t fully understand the existence of the System Space, but its function was so powerful, far surpassing the Five Elements Command by more than one level, that it could surely avoid detection through divination.
Lin Jing didn’t believe Li Mingwu could deduce the existence of the System Space.
Afterward, Lin Jing made a decision in his heart,
“Hmm…”
“As soon as I get out, I’ll put the Five Elements Fire Command in the System Space, and they’ll never be able to deduce it no matter how hard they try.”
Then,
Lin Jing looked again towards the two individuals.
By now, the two had used the same method to activate the formations on two other platforms.
Within one of the formations was a Pure Elixir, the Soul Condensing Pills.
The other platform contained a Water System Technique, which Li Mingwu gave to Xue Yilin.
After obtaining the items from the three platforms, Li Mingwu and his companion didn’t leave but continued to converse.
Xue Yilin, holding the Jade Slip of the Water System Technique, first examined it and then spoke up to ask Li Mingwu,
“Senior Li…”
“Each of these five halls contains a Cultivation Technique. I wonder if the one inside the central Five-Element Divine Temple is the final Five Elements Cultivation Technique?”
Li Mingwu looked towards the central platform and nodded slightly,
“If I’m not mistaken, it should be the last Five Elements Cultivation Technique.”
“But I’m not interested in that Five Elements Cultivation Technique…”
Xue Yilin, puzzled, asked,
“Why?”
Li Mingwu explained,
“That Five Elements Cultivation Technique is indeed excellent, but it requires a Cultivator with the Five Elements Spiritual Root to cultivate it to achieve the best effect.”
“Unlike the times of antiquity or the far ancient era, when Spiritual Energy was dense and there were many kinds of Spirit Plants and immortal liquids that could enhance one’s Spiritual Root.”
“As for now…”
“Spiritual Herb Elixirs capable of improving the quality of a Spiritual Root have almost disappeared. Possessing the Five Elements, that is to say, a Five Elements Mixed Spirit Root, makes cultivation exceptionally difficult. Without the support of Elixir Medicines to improve one’s qualities, even if one practices the Five Elements Cultivation Technique, achievements won’t be very high.”
“If a person with other Spiritual Root qualities cultivates it, it would only slow down their own cultivation speed, which would be worse than cultivating other techniques.”
After listening, Xue Yilin nodded,
“I see. It seems that the Five Elements Cultivation Technique isn’t all that remarkable after all. It isn’t even as good as this Water System Technique I have.”
Li Mingwu shook his head and said,
“If that technique had appeared in earlier times, it would definitely have been a top-tier technique, causing countless powerful forces to compete for it.”
“But now, the Spiritual Energy in the entire cultivation world is sparse, and there’s a severe shortage of rare resources. Without enough resources to support it, you can’t cultivate the Five Elements Cultivation Technique too highly, and it seems somewhat pointless.”
“It’s not that the technique isn’t good; it’s just that times have changed…”
After hearing this, Xue Yilin was silent for a while and then spoke up,
“What if someone truly managed to cultivate that Five Elements Cultivation Technique to Divinity Transformation, or even to the physical embodiment stage?”
“Senior Li, do you think there’s a chance of that happening?”
Li Mingwu, after listening, pondered for a moment before speaking,
“If someone really managed to cultivate that Five Elements Cultivation Technique to Divinity Transformation or the embodiment stage, then only two possibilities exist…”
“Either this person has the support of a top-tier powerful force behind them, with unconditional, limitless resources, or,”
“the person has profound luck and carries astonishing secrets…”
“Those are the only two possibilities…”
“This…” Xue Yilin was about to say something when he suddenly noticed that Li Mingwu’s face had drastically changed.
Even the energy around his body began to fluctuate violently.
Li Mingwu quickly sat down cross-legged and took out an Elixir Medicine from his Space Ring and put it in his mouth before closing his eyes and starting to meditate.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 202 Exploration of the Five Elements Wood Hall (Two in One)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 202 Exploration of the Five Elements Wood Hall (Two in One)_2
At this moment, Li Mingwu’s face was trembling slightly and becoming more and more pale, as if he was enduring immense pain.
Xue Yilin also stepped back a bit to avoid disturbing Li Mingwu.
…
Not long after, probably less than an hour, Li Mingwu recovered and reopened his eyes.
It was then that Xue Yilin approached cautiously and spoke:
“Senior Li…”
“The wounds to your Soul Spirit seem to be erupting more frequently.”
Li Mingwu’s expression turned grave, he said:
“Heavenly Tribulation, indeed, is not to be trifled with.”
“Even with extensive preparations, and only daring to let my Divine Sense probe within the scope of the Heavenly Tribulation, I’ve still been so gravely injured.”
“Had it not been for that special place, the Heavenly Tribulation would have likely locked onto me already.”
After speaking, a strong hatred burst forth from Li Mingwu’s eyes as he said through gritted teeth:
“That damned ant disrupted my plan at the critical moment, causing my advancement to Solidifying Body Realm to fail and making me suffer constantly from these Soul Spirit injuries.”
“Rest assured…”
“Once I heal my injuries, I will find that person and make them pay.”
Xue Yilin then spoke up:
“Senior Li, I am also helping you investigate the person who injured you.”
“However, since the incident just happened, I dare not make too conspicuous inquiries; I can only find out indirectly through those who came out from the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm…”
“And I have learned that there were two people undergoing the Tribulation at that time. Since they were undergoing the Tribulation together, they should have some connection.”
“We just need to find one of them, and through him, we can find the other. Then, we can capture both of them.”
After hearing this, a faint light flickered in Li Mingwu’s eyes:
“Two people…”
“They both deserve to die. Once my injuries are healed, I’ll no longer have to worry about anyone else. I’ll take action directly and capture those who came out from the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, and perform a Soul Search on them personally.”
“I refuse to believe that they cannot be found…”
Hearing this, Lin Jing’s heart skipped a beat.
Right now, because of his own injuries, Li Mingwu didn’t dare to act rashly. If Lin Jing allowed him to recover, then not only because of the Token, but just for having disrupted his advancement to Solidifying Body Realm, Li Mingwu would have enough reason to relentlessly pursue him.
Therefore.
Li Mingwu must not be allowed to recover from his injuries so quickly.
And as for the Five Elements Wood Hall, he must enter it before anyone else, no matter what, and get the Elixir Medicine that can heal the Soul Spirit.
Without that Elixir Medicine for the Soul Spirit, he won’t be able to recover. With such severe injuries, he wouldn’t dare to make any rash moves.
As for the Five Elements Wood Command, it was less of a concern.
With his own Five Elements Fire Command, they would never be able to gather all five of the Five Elements Command Tokens and thus would fail to enter the Five Elements relic.
Of course.
It would be even better if he could get his hands on the Five Elements Wood Command.
Apart from these, there were also Xu Ye and Zhao Linxing.
After entering the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, Lin Jing rarely showed his true face.
The only ones who might know his real appearance were probably just those two. Lin Jing had even told Xu Ye that he was on Li Yan Island.
Therefore, once he got out, he would have to find them quickly to inform them, urging the two to hide as soon as possible.
Regarding the others, Lin Jing had not disguised himself when he first attended the trade meeting; he had used his real appearance.
At the time of the trade meeting, it was inevitable that other people might have remembered his face, intentionally or unintentionally.
If Li Mingwu recovered from his injuries and started searching the souls of others upon going out, his own identity would likewise be exposed.
Therefore, this further strengthened Lin Jing’s determination to explore the Five Elements Wood Hall.
If possible, he even wanted to keep Li Mingwu trapped here forever.
However, Li Mingwu’s Cultivation was too high, and Lin Jing was far from being his match , so he couldn’t possibly keep him here by himself.
The only thing he could take advantage of were the three Island Masters.
And.
If he was to do this, Lin Jing himself must not expose his presence.
Otherwise, if Li Mingwu were to escape, it would be dangerous for him.
To accomplish this, Lin Jing would need to plan carefully.
But before that, Lin Jing had to first get his hands on the healing Elixir Medicine, he absolutely couldn’t let it fall into Li Mingwu’s hands.
To obtain the Elixir Medicine, it was necessary to enter the Five Elements Wood Hall; after entering the Wood Hall, he still needed to find a way to break the Formation at the high platform,
Lin Jing only had a Five Elements Fire Command in his hand, and he didn’t know if it could be used to open that Formation.
Or, if there were other methods to break the Formation.
Therefore,
Lin Jing still needed to continue observing, to see if he could get the method to break that Formation from their conversations.
Lin Jing didn’t have to wait long; the two people began discussing how to enter the Five Elements Wood Hall.
It was also at this moment that Lin Jing learned from Li Mingwu.
They entered the side hall by following the rule of the Five Elements generating each other, holding the Five Elements Gold Order, they could pass through that black Formation Eye and enter the Five Elements Water Hall in advance.
