To concoct a Supreme Elixir Medicine, one must go through a long period of accumulation and only after one’s alchemy skills have improved could there be a possibility of success.
Just like how Lin Jing, back in the beginning at Yuebaolou, gradually step by step revealed his alchemy talent.
Before this…
Ji Ling had also heard from Yan Ming that Lin Jue, just like him, had recently been promoted to a Fourth Grade Alchemist.
That’s why Ji Ling wasn’t worried at all about being defeated.
Yet the opponent had actually concocted a Supreme Elixir Medicine in this alchemy competition.
Did that mean the opponent had already advanced to a Fourth Grade Pill Master, lingering in this realm for decades?
If that was indeed the case, then it would truly be terrifying.
This person did not seem very old; if it really were so, then wouldn’t his talent in Alchemy Dao surpass even his own aunt’s?
Ji Ling would rather believe that Lin Jue was extremely lucky than to accept that Lin Jue’s talent in Alchemy Dao could surpass his aunt’s.
……
At this moment.
Ji Xiyue’s expression was grave as she fixed her eyes on that pill. Then she turned to Yan Ming and said:
“Yan Daoyou, could you please hand that pill over for me to take a look…”
Yan Ming nodded and handed the Supreme Spirit Pill over to her.
After receiving the elixir, Ji Xiyue immediately began a detailed examination.
Ji Xiyue was very meticulous in her observation of the Elixir Medicine.
It was a while before Ji Xiyue finished her examination and then returned the pill back to Yan Ming.
Then, Ji Xiyue spoke:
“It is indeed a Supreme Elixir Medicine, we lost this alchemy competition.”
At this time, Lin Jue spoke, lifting his head to address Ji Ling:
“Hey…”
“Well, are you satisfied now? Hurry up and apologize to my brother…”
Ji Ling’s face darkened and he lowered his head. He never expected to lose so thoroughly.
Ji Xiyue glanced at Ji Ling and then started speaking:
“Little Ling, apologize!”
Now that Ji Xiyue had personally spoken, Ji Ling no longer said anything and directly approached Lin Jing, saying:
“Senior, I’m sorry…”
“Previously, it was my lack of understanding, and I was disrespectful to you. Please forgive me.”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Ling and nodded slightly, accepting the apology.
Lin Jue became even happier and spoke again to Ji Ling:
“Also, don’t forget our bet…”
Hearing Lin Jue’s words, Ji Ling did not argue this time. Without saying anything else, he took out a Demonic Beast Inner Core and tossed it to Lin Jue.
“A sixth rank Demonic Beast, the Flame Soul Crimson Dragon Beast’s Inner Core, should be enough for the bet…”
After finishing his words, Ji Ling turned around, head lowered, and left the alchemy room.
Lin Jue, not at all modest, played with the Demonic Beast Inner Core, looking quite pleased with it.
And so, the alchemy competition ended, and Lin Jue ultimately won the contest.
After the contest, the group exchanged pleasantries and then dispersed. Lin Jing also took Lin Jue and Ye Yun back to their lodgings.
On the way back, Lin Jue was very excited, continuously talking about how she had methodically planned each step and started to break down Ji Ling’s composure even before the contest began…
Indeed…
Lin Jue, that clever girl, would never come out on the losing end. In fact, this entire duel was something she orchestrated by seizing the opportunity to intentionally provoke Ji Ling.
However, all of this was for Lin Jing…
……
Not long after they returned, someone came to visit.
It was Ji Xiyue.
Upon her arrival, Ji Xiyue directly invited Lin Jing to go out for a talk.
Lin Jing hesitated for a moment and then nodded his head, leaving the residence with Ji Xiyue.
The two of them walked out together.
Ji Xiyue led Lin Jing to a beautiful, secluded hillside and stopped.
Once there, Ji Xiyue turned and her beautiful eyes shone with brilliance. She looked at Lin Jing carefully and then spoke:
“So Lin Daoyou is also a descendant of an ancient Alchemy Dao lineage.”
“I had thought Lin Daoyou was just a Loose Cultivator. It was a lapse on my part…”
Alchemists with an Alchemy Dao heritage differ slightly from those without when they concoct Elixir Medicines,
To others, the difference might not be noticeable, but Ji Xiyue, being an alchemist herself, could easily see it.
Therefore, Lin Jing didn’t react too strongly.
Ji Xiyue continued to speak, inquiring:
“However, I wonder which family Lin Daoyou belongs to, if it’s convenient to disclose?”
There are many Alchemy Dao lineages in the Cultivation World, and while they all differ from one another, the Elixir Medicines they produce are quite similar, making it difficult to identify the lineage based on the Elixir Medicine alone.
Therefore.
Even Ji Xiyue, the number one talent of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, couldn’t determine which Alchemy Dao family Lin Jing belongs to.
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue. Her eyes sparkling with curiosity, she seemed to be smiling as she stared at Lin Jing, seemingly very interested in him.
Then Lin Jing shook his head lightly and said:
“Ji Daoyou…”
“Indeed, I have an Alchemy Dao heritage, but I am sorry, I cannot disclose this heritage.”

chapters.title: Chapter 531: 215 Ji Xiyue's Purpose
chapters.content:
Chapter 531: Chapter 215 Ji Xiyue’s Purpose
Ji Xiyue, upon hearing this, nodded slightly and then said,
“So it is. Then indeed, it is my presumption.”
Lin Jing, with a calm demeanor, replied,
“No matter…”
“If there is nothing else Ji Daoyou needs, I shall take my leave first.”
Lin Jing felt that there was something off about Ji Xiyue, sensing an inexplicable strangeness, and naturally wished not to linger, hence the suggestion to depart.
After hearing this, Ji Xiyue chuckled and said,
“Lin Daoyou, I did indeed come to you for a reason…”
Lin Jing then spoke up, asking,
“What is it?”
Ji Xiyue smiled and replied,
“I want to have a competition with you…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was initially stunned and then looked at Ji Xiyue, who was also gazing into his eyes, locking stares.
Though Ji Xiyue was smiling as she spoke those words, her eyes were incredibly serious.
It appeared she was not jesting but truly wished to test her skills against Lin Jing.
Lin Jing lowered his head to avoid Ji Xiyue’s gaze and began to contemplate.
Moments later, Lin Jing raised his head again to look at Ji Xiyue and said directly,
“Ji Daoyou…”
“I’m afraid I cannot accede to your request. During this period, I still need to make more preparations to concoct the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.”
“Furthermore…”
“I do not like to be disturbed when I practice alchemy, and unless it is a special circumstance, I equally dislike competing in public.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Ji Xiyue nodded slightly and mused,
“Ah…”
“So that’s it…”
After finishing her sentence, Ji Xiyue pondered for a while and then added,
“Since Lin Daoyou does not like to be disturbed during alchemy, why don’t we try a different method and compete separately?”
Lin Jing observed Ji Xiyue, who still looked at him with a beaming smile, showing no sign of abandoning the idea of challenging him.
Lin Jing frowned slightly and then questioned Ji Xiyue,
“Is this competition really necessary?”
Ji Xiyue nodded, her face breaking into a smile as she said,
“My nephew may be no good, but as his aunt, I must reclaim some face for him.”
“Otherwise, if he complains to his grandfather about me not helping him, then I’ll truly be in trouble…”
Although she said this, the smile on Ji Xiyue’s face remained, showing no genuine concern.
Lin Jing furrowed his brows and after a moment of thought, finally said,
“What method do you suggest, Ji Daoyou?”
Ji Xiyue then said,
“Lin Daoyou are you not meant to help Yan Daoyou concoct the Cleansing Spirit Elixir? Let’s take the task of making the Cleansing Spirit Elixir as our competition.”
“I will go to Yan Daoyou and ask him for a set of components for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir. I will concoct one, and you Lin Daoyou will concoct another.”
“Then, we can compete in this manner.”
“Of course…”
“Our competition need not specify location or time, nor will there be an audience to witness. We simply concoct our own elixirs, and in the end, we shall see whose elixir is of higher quality.”
“Lin Daoyou, what do you think?”
After she finished, Ji Xiyue continued to look at Lin Jing with interest, awaiting his response…
The concoction of this Cleansing Spirit Elixir is not so simple; Lin Jing will inevitably have to enter the Alchemy Room in the System Space to have any chance of producing the Supreme Elixir that Yan Ming needs.
This is one reason why Lin Jing would not engage in a competition with Ji Xiyue.
For the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, Yan Ming has already expended too much effort, and since he trusts Lin Jing so much, Lin Jing would not wish to disappoint him.
Therefore, in this round of alchemy, Lin Jing would give it his all.
There is another thing.
It’s that Ji Xiyue seems very off.
Lin Jing always felt that she might have learned something.
Observing the look in Ji Xiyue’s eyes when she gazed at him, and that indescribable smile on her stunningly beautiful face…
Lin Jing even began to suspect that his identity as a descendant and heir of the Lin Family might have already been exposed.
……
After giving it some thought, Lin Jing found Ji Xiyue’s method for the challenge to actually be quite suitable.
If she really had discovered his identity, there was no way he could avoid it.
He might as well agree to it directly, and also take the opportunity to probe her true intentions.
Lin Jing then nodded and said,
“Very well…”
“I accept this challenge!”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s response, Ji Xiyue’s eyes crinkled at the corners, and she laughed…
When Ji Xiyue laughed, she looked even more beautiful.
However, with his guard fully raised now, Lin Jing was unclear about this woman’s motives,
and naturally had no heart to appreciate her beauty.
Continuing on, Ji Xiyue spoke again,
“Good…”
“Since Lin Daoyou has agreed, we naturally need to discuss the matter of the stakes…”
After speaking, Ji Xiyue turned to Lin Jing and directly asked,
“I’m just not sure what Lin Daoyou would want for the stakes – the Peerless Elixir Manual, divine weapons, or some rare and extraordinary treasure?”
“As long as Lin Daoyou states it, no matter what it is, I will do my best to satisfy your demands, even if Lin Daoyou wishes to become the Offering Priest Elder of the Elixir Hall of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, it’s not out of the question…”
On hearing Ji Xiyue’s generous offer, Lin Jing’s brow furrowed even more deeply.
Just a small competition, yet she was giving away such considerable conditions; it was simply too unreasonable.
Lin Jing then looked at Ji Xiyue, who still wore that same smiling expression, her eyes brimming with laughter as she looked at him.
“Could this competition in fact be a trap?” Lin Jing couldn’t help pondering…
A moment later, Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue and directly asked,
“The stakes Ji Daoyou is offering are so significant, it’s somewhat difficult for me to decide. I’d like to know, what price would I need to pay if I were the one to lose?”
Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing and said,
“What I want is actually quite simple…”
“If I win, all I need is for Lin Daoyou to answer a single question for me.”
“Just one question?” Lin Jing asked in disbelief after hearing this.
“Yes…” Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing and nodded.
“What would that question be?” Lin Jing asked directly.
Ji Xiyue spoke again, this time with a serious expression, saying to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Are you the descendant of an Ancient Alchemy Path family?”
“You just need to answer this question for me.”
As expected, Ji Xiyue had her suspicions about him and had come prepared.
She must have begun to suspect him when Lin Jue successfully produced the Elixir Medicine, only she wasn’t quite sure.
Therefore,
She had proposed this competition as a way to confirm Lin Jing’s identity.
And now that the situation had progressed to this point with Ji Xiyue revealing her purpose,
even if Lin Jing were to suggest giving up the competition now, it would no longer be meaningful.
Because the very proposition of this competition was a trap in itself. If Lin Jing were to suggest giving up now, it would only further confirm Ji Xiyue’s speculations.
Furthermore,
it seemed that the outcome of the competition was not so important anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 532: 216 Three Questions
chapters.content:
Chapter 532: Chapter 216 Three Questions
Ji Xiyue was known as the number one genius alchemist of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, and her own strength must be extraordinary. If Lin Jing could win against her in the competition,
then even if Lin Jing didn’t answer that question, the result would be the same.
After all, anyone who could defeat the number one talent of the Xingluo Elixir Sect must surely be a descendant of a family with an even longer heritage of the Ancient Alchemy Path.
So,
whether he spoke the answer or not, what difference would it make?
And the bet she proposed was a trap set to prevent Lin Jing from deliberately losing to her.
This woman, she really knows how to scheme.
It’s just unknown whether she has other motives for doing this…
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue, and at this moment, she was still smiling at Lin Jing, waiting for his answer, without any hurry.
“Alright…”
“If you win, I will naturally tell you,” Lin Jing then spoke.
Hearing that Lin Jing had accepted this bet, Ji Xiyue smiled even more joyfully, before asking Lin Jing again:
“Lin Daoyou, I wonder if you have thought about it, if you win, what would you want?”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue and then spoke directly:
“Since you want me to answer a question for you, correspondingly, if you lose, I need you to answer three questions for me.”
“I wonder what Ji Daoyou thinks about this?”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue was momentarily startled, then smiled and said:
“Three…”
“Lin Daoyou, you really don’t let yourself be at a disadvantage at all…”
With that said, Ji Xiyue continued:
“Three it is, I’ll take the bet with you!”
“But I don’t know what three questions Lin Daoyou is going to ask?”
Lin Jing replied:
“Those three questions, I haven’t thought of them yet. Once I have, I will naturally tell you.”
“That’s fine then!” Ji Xiyue said.
And so, the affair of the competition was settled between the two of them.
Next.
Lin Jing didn’t stay long here but said goodbye to Ji Xiyue directly and left.
After seeing Lin Jing off, Ji Xiyue stared in the direction he had departed, lost in thought for a long time, wondering what…
………
Upon returning, Lin Jing was immediately surrounded by Lin Jue and Ye Yun.
Lin Jue’s curiosity was indeed quite strong.
“Brother…”
“What did that woman want with you?”
“She even asked to meet you alone; could it be that she’s taken a fancy to you?”
“Cough…”
Upon hearing Lin Jue’s words, Ye Yun coughed and said:
“Isn’t this a bit inappropriate to say…”
“Ye Blockhead, what else could she want by asking to meet my brother alone…” Lin Jue glanced askance at Ye Yun.
“I… I’m not sure…”
Faced with Lin Jue’s strong rebuff, Ye Yun’s momentum immediately waned.
Then, Lin Jue turned back to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing then began to speak:
“She wants to have an alchemy competition with me.”
“An alchemy competition?” Lin Jue and Ye Yun exclaimed in unison, both looking at Lin Jing.
“Could it be because of today’s events? She’s still not convinced, so she wants to regain her honor against you, brother…” Lin Jue said somewhat angrily.
Lin Jing then looked at Lin Jue and said earnestly:
“You…”
“In the future, you should also start to control your temper.”
“Me?” Lin Jue looked at Lin Jing puzzled, very much not understanding: “What about me?”
Lin Jing spoke straightforwardly:
“That Ji Xiyue must have already guessed the identity of our Lin Family’s descendant.”
“Ah?”
“No way!”
Lin Jue suddenly felt a bit guilty, recalling the way Ji Xiyue had seriously observed the elixir medicine at the alchemy room.
“How did she guess? Could it be because of the elixir medicine I made?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“That should be the case.”
“Although we now possess a part of the Lin Family’s Alchemy Dao heritage, it is actually only a fraction of the entire Alchemy Dao heritage.”
“The complete Alchemy Dao heritage should include not only the Alchemy Technique but also the identification of Spirit Plants and various Elixir Medicines.
“Especially the Elixir Medicines produced by the various Alchemy Dao noble families, with our current knowledge, we can’t tell any difference at all.”
“But if it were a noble family with the complete heritage of the Alchemy Dao, or another power, they might very well be able to distinguish the differences and, naturally, identify our identities through the Elixir Medicines.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jue immediately lowered her head, full of regret, and said,
“Brother…”
“I was wrong, I really shouldn’t have been so impulsive.”
Lin Jing then spoke, consoling,
“Actually, it’s not entirely your fault…”
“After all, you did it with good intentions, and I only realized this issue after the incident occurred.”
“You just need to be a bit more careful when practicing alchemy in the future.”
Lin Jue nodded, then asked Lin Jing,
“Brother…”
“Now that our identities have been discovered by her, what should we do?”
Lin Jing thought for a moment, then said,
“Actually, it can’t be said that we’ve been exposed, only that she has her suspicions. Her request to compete with me was actually a test.”
“It’s not just a test, but also a stratagem…”
Upon hearing these words, the two of them were lost in a fog, even more clueless as to his meaning.
Lin Jing then shared his own conjectures with them.
Upon hearing them, both seemed troubled.
Lin Jing spoke to comfort them,
“Actually, there’s no need to worry…”
“Even if our identities are exposed, it doesn’t matter.”
“After all, our Lin Family had no previous dealings with the Demon Monster Inner Sea or the Western Demon Region, and Ji Xiyue probably bears us no ill will either.”
“Brother, are you sure?” Lin Jue looked at Lin Jing with doubt.
Lin Jing pondered for a moment, then spoke,
“I feel…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jue was momentarily speechless…
“Brother…”
“You haven’t been bewitched by that woman, have you? You can’t be, Qing Qing is still waiting for you…”
Lin Jing’s face was immediately lined with black…
Lin Jue, this girl, now dared to tease him like this.
Lin Jing then promptly spoke to Lin Jue,
“You should worry about yourself first.”
“And there’s Ye Yun, shouldn’t you two decide on your own matters as well?”
“If you two have come to an agreement, I can make the decision and arrange a wedding banquet for you, and then you two will be Dao companions.”
“Master… Master…”
“This… this…”
When it came to these matters, Ye Yun became incredibly nervous, and his face turned red in an instant, he even began to stutter.
Lin Jue was the same, blushing instantly upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, and quickly tried to defend herself,
“This… this matter, we’re not ready for it yet, there’s no rush…”
Lin Jing looked at the two of them, shaking his head helplessly,
“You two, ah…”
“Forget it, you two discuss it amongst yourselves…”
“Understood, brother…”
“You get some rest, we’ll be going now.”
As soon as Lin Jue finished speaking, perhaps afraid that Lin Jing would bring the topic up again, she immediately ran away.
“Master… Master.”
“You rest well, I’m also going back.”
Lin Jing waved his hand at Ye Yun, saying,
“Hmm…”
“Go ahead!”
Afterward, Ye Yun directly gave Lin Jing a bow and left as well…

chapters.title: Chapter 533: 217: New System Feature: Spirit Field Expansion
chapters.content:
Chapter 533: Chapter 217: New System Feature: Spirit Field Expansion
On the morning of the second day, Yan Ming found Lin Jing and inquired about the competition between the two of them.
It turned out that early in the morning, Ji Xiyue had sought out Yan Ming to inform him about the competition with Lin Jing, and she had obtained a list of materials for refining the Cleansing Spirit Elixir from Yan Ming.
Yan Ming was quite confident in Ji Xiyue’s alchemy level and was very pleased that she was willing to craft the elixirs for him.
After all, Ji Xiyue was the recognized top talent alchemist of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, so there was no need to elaborate on her alchemy skills.
Although the two knew each other, their relationship was not yet at that level of closeness.
Yan Ming himself was very aware that Ji Xiyue’s friendship was not enough for her to agree to craft elixirs for him.
When Yan Ming confirmed the alchemy competition details from Lin Jing, he was silent for a while before patting Lin Jing on the shoulder, comforting him with a few words, and then said no more.
Clearly, even Yan Ming, who had asked Lin Jing to craft elixirs, did not have high hopes for him.
Lin Jing had nothing to say about this.
Everything would have to wait until the Elixir Medicine was refined.
Yan Ming did not stay long here, after exchanging a few pleasantries with Lin Jing and offering some words of comfort, he left.
Soon, another two days had passed.
The upgrade of Lin Jing’s System Space had reached the sixth day and would be complete in just one more day.
It was early in the morning on this day that Ji Xiyue came to Lin Jing and stated she was ready to start the alchemy process.
And furthermore.
Ji Xiyue had specifically invited Lin Jing to observe her alchemy.
After considering Ji Xiyue’s invitation, Lin Jing decided to decline it politely.
Although.
Watching the preparation process before crafting the Elixir Medicine would have been somewhat helpful to him.
However, Lin Jing being there might influence Ji Xiyue, and while it would have been fine under normal circumstances,
this alchemy session involved a wager between them, so it wouldn’t be fair to Ji Xiyue for Lin Jing to observe her process in advance.
For this reason, Lin Jing chose to refuse.
Hearing Lin Jing’s explanation, Ji Xiyue didn’t say anything more, bade him farewell, and left.
Ji Xiyue had arrived in the morning, and by the time the news of her finishing the Cleansing Spirit Elixir came, it was already evening.
Ji Xiyue truly lived up to her reputation as Xingluo Elixir Sect’s recognized genius alchemist for she succeeded in her first attempt at crafting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
This batch yielded a Superior grade and a Medium Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
However, she failed to refine a topmost grade elixir.
Yan Ming felt somewhat regretful about this outcome.
Taking a topmost grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir would result in an 80％ chance of enhancing the spiritual root’s quality by one grade,
whereas for a Superior grade elixir, the chance was only 50％.
To talk about it, a 50％ chance was actually not low.
But…
given the special nature of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, each person could only consume one pill, as the second would be useless.
Although Yan Ming’s plan was for Yan Xing and Yan Yue, the sisters, to take the topmost grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir,
after Ji Xiyue had refined the elixirs, Yan Ming, holding the Superior grade elixir, still wrestled with his thoughts for a long time…
Considering whether to let the sisters take the Superior Elixir Medicine immediately and try to enhance their spiritual roots.
In the end.
After a struggle, Yan Ming decided not to let the sisters consume the Elixir Medicine for the time being.
Nevertheless, there would be one more opportunity, so it might as well be Lin Jing’s turn to try.
After all.
This was about his daughter’s lifetime, and Yan Ming didn’t want any mishaps to occur.
After finishing the Elixir Medicine refinement, Ji Xiyue came to Lin Jing once more.
And informed Lin Jing of some particular things to pay attention to when crafting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
While Ji Xiyue was telling Lin Jing about the important points during the process, Lin Jing looked at her somewhat distractedly…
Afterward, Lin Jing voiced his doubts:
“Ji Fellow Daoist, you actually don’t care about the outcome of this competition, right?”
Ji Xiyue then looked up at Lin Jing, meeting his scrutinizing gaze.
“Caring and not caring…”
“It’s pretty much the same to me, I’m just looking for an answer,” Ji Xiyue said softly, looking at Lin Jing.
Subsequently, Lin Jing did not ask any more questions.
And after speaking with Lin Jing, Ji Xiyue left directly.
……
Quickly, another day passed by.
Seven days had passed, and the system prompt that Lin Jing had been eagerly awaiting finally rang out again.
“Ding!”
“System prompt: System upgrade complete. System Space now reopened, new feature unlocked. The host may enter the System Space to check.”
After receiving the prompt that the System Space had successfully upgraded, Lin Jing first extended his Divine Sense to sweep around, ensuring there were no abnormalities. Then, he called out the system and entered the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, the first thing Lin Jing felt was the thick Spiritual Energy.
The concentration of Spiritual Energy this time was unprecedented. It surpassed even the most enriched Spirit Field on Spirit Rock Island and the Yue Tian Hall on Yue Tian Island, places Lin Jing had visited before.
Then, Lin Jing spoke out loud to call out the system again:
“Open the system panel!”
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, a system panel appeared in front of him.
System Space (Level 7)
Remaining time: 206 hours (Accumulable: 700 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field area: 70 acres
Spiritual Energy concentration: 7
Time flow rate: 7
Daily entry time: 12 hours (Full)
Upgrade requirements: (550/1,000,000 Harvest Points)
Special Functions: Alert, Observe, Time Accumulation, Four Seasons, Environmental Terrain, Spirit Plant Repair, Bonus Attachment, Instant Growth of Spirit Plants, Elixir Medicine and Spirit Plant Recycling.
New Feature: Spirit Field Expansion. (The host may spend Harvest Points to expand the Spirit Fields within the System Space. The Harvest Points required will increase progressively with the expansion area.)
This new system feature was Spirit Field expansion. Previously, Lin Jing had always felt that the area of the Spirit Field was too small and hardly sufficient.
That’s why he had opened up a Spirit Field on Li Yan Island and planted Spirit Plants to use for alchemy and to obtain Harvest Points.
Now with this new feature, things were much better. Even if he was not on Li Yan Island, he could still expand the Spirit Plants, planting more low-grade Spirit Plants, in order to refine elixirs at any time.
He would no longer have to worry about running out of Spirit Plants.
However, it was not stated how many Harvest Points were needed for the Spirit Field expansion, which he would have to check himself.
Afterward, Lin Jing called out the system again:
“System!”
“Use the new feature, Spirit Field Expansion!”
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, the system panel in front of him changed.
A new interface appeared on the panel, featuring 70 bright little squares.
Besides these bright squares, around them, there were also many dark square shadows.
Lin Jing then reached out to one of the dark shadows and touched it. Upon touching, a system prompt box popped up.
“Spirit Field Expansion requires 100 Harvest Points.”
“Do you wish to expand?”
Lin Jing hesitated for a moment before choosing to expand.
After Lin Jing made the choice to expand, a system prompt followed:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host has expanded the Spirit Field, spending 100 Harvest Points, current remaining Harvest Points: 450 Harvest Points.”
As the system prompt finished, changes began to occur in the System Space. At the edge of the Spirit Field, a barren piece of ground began to transform.
The rocky soil slowly changed, turning from stone to earth in the blink of an eye, as the transformation completed.
And that rocky ground turned into fertile Spirit Field.
Lin Jing stepped forward to inspect the newly expanded Spirit Field, which was indistinguishable from the other Spirit Fields and covered the same one-acre area.
After inspecting, Lin Jing opened the Spirit Field expansion panel again and chose to expand a second Spirit Field.
Now, this second Spirit Field expansion required 200 Harvest Points.
This time, Lin Jing frowned slightly but chose to expand again.
Then, he selected another plot.
The expansion of this third Spirit Field required 300 Harvest Points. With only 250 Harvest Points left, Lin Jing didn’t have enough and chose not to expand further.
By now, Lin Jing had understood the increment rule for Spirit Field expansion.
The first plot was 100 Harvest Points, the second was 200, and the third would be 300…
That’s how they progressively increased.
In this way, it was actually manageable, and Lin Jing could afford it.
After expanding the Spirit Fields, Lin Jing didn’t stay longer in the System Space and immediately left.
Upon leaving the System Space, Lin Jing headed towards Yan Ming’s residence to collect the materials needed to refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir and prepared to start alchemy…

chapters.title: Chapter 534: 218: Refining the Cleansing Spirit Elixir
chapters.content:
Chapter 534: Chapter 218: Refining the Cleansing Spirit Elixir
When Lin Jing arrived at Yan Ming’s residence, he found that Ji Xiyue was also there.
Yan Ming and Ji Xiyue seemed to be discussing something at the time.
After Lin Jing arrived, the two of them stood up and approached him.
As the three of them came closer, Yan Ming spoke with a puzzled tone, asking Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Why have you come? Could it be that you are ready?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Yes…”
“I have finished my preparations and am ready to start alchemy.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Yan Ming smiled and said,
“Good…”
“I’ve been preparing these materials all along…”
Upon finishing his sentence, Yan Ming didn’t hesitate and took out the Cleansing Spirit Elixir materials he had prepared from his Space Ring and handed them to Lin Jing.
At this moment, Ji Xiyue also promptly said,
“Lin Daoyou, you need not worry about making the Elixir Medicine. Just go ahead and give it your best shot.”
“If this batch of Elixir Medicine doesn’t succeed, then I will simply return to the Nanming Domain and get two White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grasses from my father.”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue, somewhat puzzled.
Ji Xiyue then explained,
“The challenge to alchemize was proposed by me, so naturally, I shouldn’t let Yan Daoyou bear the cost of the materials alone.”
“I have already discussed it with Yan Daoyou. After the challenge, if the alchemized Supreme Cleansing Spirit Elixirs are fewer than two, I will compensate Yan Daoyou with two more White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grasses.”
“However, if you, Lin Daoyou, can alchemize two Supreme Elixir Medicines in a single batch, then I will give those two White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grasses to you.”
At this point, Yan Ming also added,
“Ji Daoyou was just now discussing this matter with me.”
“Lin Daoyou, from here on, it’s all up to you.”
Lin Jing glanced at Ji Xiyue and then turned to Yan Ming, saying,
“I will do my utmost…”
……
After leaving Yan Ming, Lin Jing went straight to the Alchemy Room.
Previously, Lin Jing had made it clear that he preferred not to be disturbed while performing alchemy.
Therefore, Lin Jing went there alone.
The Alchemy Room on Spirit Rock Island was quite decent, and the Formation in the Alchemy Room was not simple either.
After arriving at the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing activated the Formation of the room and then entered the System Space within the Alchemy Room.
Once inside the System Space, Lin Jing quickly set up the alarm range to avoid any accidents.
Subsequently, he went inside the Alchemy Room of the System Space.
Now, the Alchemy Room of the System Space had been upgraded to level six by Lin Jing.
A sixth-level Alchemy Room had a 20% chance to enhance the quality of Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicines, potentially creating Pure Elixirs.
This was Lin Jing’s greatest reliance on alchemizing the Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
Upon entering the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing first took out the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace and placed it in the center of the room.
Then, he took out the Spirit Plants he had just received from Yan Ming from his Space Ring.
Of course, there was also a Spirit Storing Bead among them, which contained a drop of Cleansing Spirit Liquid.
This Cleansing Spirit Liquid was also of utmost importance.
After retrieving the materials, Lin Jing began the preliminary refining process.
Once he had processed all the materials, Lin Jing started to operate the Divine Fire Triple Realm.
Subsequently, a cluster of purple flames burst forth from Lin Jing’s hands, which he then moved to the bottom of the Pill Furnace.
It wasn’t until a moment later that Lin Jing began to add the various Spirit Plants into the Pill Furnace one by one in sequence.
This time,
Lin Jing added all the Spirit Plants into the furnace save for the Cleansing Spirit Liquid and White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.
The concoction of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir was slightly different from other Elixir Medicines.
It required the other Spirit Plants to be refined first, turning them into medicinal liquid before the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass could be refined.
The Cleansing Spirit Liquid was the catalyst for fusing the two medicinal liquids together and was also the most critical component.
Once Lin Jing added all other Spirit Plants besides the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass into the Pill Furnace, he immediately began the sealing and refining process.
…
…
As time slowly passed, after more than two hours, all of those Spirit Plants in the Pill Furnace had been refined into a black medicinal liquid.
It was at this point that Lin Jing, while continuing the refining process, opened the Pill Furnace.
He then added the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass and the Spirit Storing Bead into the Pill Furnace.
After adding all these into the Pill Furnace, Lin Jing resealed the furnace and continued the refining.
At this juncture, Lin Jing had to control the flame at the bottom of the furnace as well as everything inside the Pill Furnace.
Inside the furnace at this time, the black medicinal liquid was ceaselessly churning and changing shape, while the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass stayed away from the black liquid, undergoing continuous refining.
The Spirit Storing Bead containing the Cleansing Spirit Liquid had not yet been opened and was situated at the topmost part of the Pill Furnace.
Lin Jing needed to ensure that the three did not interfere with each other, which was one of the more challenging aspects of concocting the Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Ji Xiyue had also mentioned this to Lin Jing, that this step must not be taken lightly; the slightest slackness would ruin the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
Time continued to pass, and almost three hours went by.
At this stage, Lin Jing had been concocting this batch of Cleansing Spirit Elixirs for close to twelve hours.
Inside the Pill Furnace, the black medicinal liquid had turned transparent, and the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass had been fully refined into a solution resembling white jade.
Lin Jing, who was seated cross-legged beside the Pill Furnace, was already sweating slightly from his forehead, not daring to be negligent in the slightest, focusing intently on controlling the two batches of medicinal liquid inside.
The concoction of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir was extremely draining, even someone with Lin Jing’s strength of Divine Sense found it taxing.
Fortunately, the Elixir Furnace Medicine was nearing the final step, and as long as there were no mistakes at this juncture, the batch would be successful.
A moment later, the two batches of medicinal liquid swirled and chased each other inside the Pill Furnace like a pair of goldfish.
It was then that Lin Jing used his Divine Sense to control the Spirit Storing Bead, bringing it between the two medicinal liquids, before slowly opening it.
The moment the Spirit Storing Bead opened, the Cleansing Spirit Liquid within began to evaporate, but this time, the evaporation occurred inside the Pill Furnace and was enveloped by the two medicinal liquids.
Both batches of medicinal liquid greedily absorbed the Cleansing Spirit Liquid from the Spirit Storing Bead, and as they continuously absorbed it, they slowly began to change.
Finally, under Lin Jing’s careful control, the two batches of medicinal liquid fused into one, forming a white glowing solution.
It was the instant this solution formed that the rich and refreshing fragrance of the Elixir wafted from it.
At this point, the batch of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir was almost ready.
Lin Jing then immediately activated his cultivation technique, consolidating Spiritual Power, and intensified the flame at the bottom of the furnace, commencing the final pill condensation…
In less than a quarter of an hour, the fragrance of Elixir filled the entire Alchemy Room, and then a system notification popped up.
“Elixir Medicine concoction successful, Alchemy proficiency +75.”

chapters.title: Chapter 535: 219 Cleansing Spirit Elixir Successfully Refined
chapters.content:
Chapter 535: Chapter 219 Cleansing Spirit Elixir Successfully Refined
The system prompt came, but there was no notification of reward with Harvest Points.
The batch of Elixir Medicine Lin Jing refined didn’t result in the production of Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
Failing to produce Pure Cleansing Spirit Elixirs was actually quite normal, given that the chance of producing Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicines wasn’t that high.
Moreover, this was his first attempt at refining Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, so the absence of Pure Elixir Medicine was within Lin Jing’s expectations.
Then…
Lin Jing stood up, took a step forward, opened the Pill Furnace, and looked inside. He saw four Elixir Medicines, the color of creamy white jade, lying inside the Pill Furnace.
Next to the Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, there lay a Spirit Storing Bead, which, like the Elixir Medicines, lay at the bottom of the Pill Furnace.
However, the Spirit Storing Bead was in an open state at this time, and the Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside it had disappeared, having been fully absorbed into the Elixir Medicines.
Afterward, Lin Jing extended his hand and, summoning his Spiritual Power, enveloped the Elixir Medicines inside the Pill Furnace and brought them in front of him for a closer inspection.
Out of the four Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, two were extremely round, the entire Elixir Medicine flawless like white jade and emitting a rich fragrance.
These two were precisely the superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs that Yan Ming had been so eagerly anticipating, which Lin Jing had managed to refine in a single batch.
Besides those two superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs…
There was another Elixir Medicine, also resembling white jade, but with some slight imperfections on its surface.
This was a Superior-grade Elixir Medicine.
The last one was neither very round nor smooth, its surface marred by clearly visible mottled impurities; it was a Medium Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
In this batch, Lin Jing had produced two superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, while Ji Xiyue had managed to produce only two Medium Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs…
It was evident that Lin Jing had won this competition.
Thinking back to the wager they had made before, Lin Jing couldn’t help but ponder for a moment.
Since he had won the bet, Ji Xiyue would have to answer three of his questions, which Lin Jing still needed to consider carefully…
After all, Ji Xiyue’s behavior earlier had been all too suspicious, and Lin Jing was eager to find out how much she knew and what her real intentions were.
……
A moment later, Lin Jing took out three jade bottles and divided the Elixir Medicines among them for packaging.
These Elixir Medicines were all meant for Yan Ming in the end.
Lin Jing himself had no intention of keeping any for himself.
After all, the Alchemy Ingredients were provided by Yan Ming, who also invited him to assist with the Alchemy. Doing otherwise would not only be unfair to Yan Ming but also to the sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Even though Lin Jing only needed to present one of the superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs to satisfy the agreement and win the bet with Ji Xiyue…
Lin Jing disdained to do so.
Over the years, he had acquired many rare Spirit Plants from Spirit Rock Island; Yan Ming had never said much about it, and when it came to very rare Spirit Plant seeds, Yan Ming was quite generous.
Besides, Lin Jing’s Spirit Fields in the System Space already contained most of the materials needed for refining Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, except for the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass.
If he wanted Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, he just needed to acquire White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass to start the refining process.
The reason Lin Jing had been able to possess these Spirit Plants so quickly was all thanks to Yan Ming’s efforts.
Having refined these two superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs today, Lin Jing felt he can finally give Yan Ming a proper explanation.
……
After packing the Elixir Medicines, Lin Jing retrieved the Spirit Storing Bead from the Pill Furnace and stored the Pill Furnace itself in his Space Ring.
Having completed all these tasks, Lin Jing then left the Alchemy Room and went to the nearby Spirit Fields outside.
With the System upgrade, Lin Jing used Harvest Points to expand by two more acres, resulting in a total of twelve additional acres of Spirit Fields now.
These Spirit Fields should naturally not be left barren, Lin Jing thought, it was essential to plant some Spirit Plants in them…
However, Lin Jing didn’t have any ready Spirit Plant seeds.
Even if he wanted to accelerate the growth of a Spirit Plant to produce an extra portion, he didn’t have enough Harvest Points at the moment.
But Lin wasn’t worried.
Although Lin Jing didn’t have any with him, this place was Spirit Rock Island, and Lin Jing could ask Yan Ming for some lower-ranked Spirit Plant seeds when the time came.
“Hmm, let’s do that…”
After pondering, Lin Jing didn’t stay long in the System Space and immediately left it, reappearing in the Alchemy Room on Spirit Rock Island.
Once back in the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing first sent out his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
No sooner had Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached out than he detected Lin Jue and Ye Yun.
They had actually been standing guard outside the Alchemy Room all along, acting as protectors for him.
This Alchemy process was taking place within Spirit Rock Island; it was supposed to be relatively safe and not necessarily require protectors.
Presumably, they were afraid Ji Xiyue or Ji Ling might come to make trouble, and that’s why they did so.
After all, there was a bet previously between the two.
However, they didn’t really need to do this, as the Formation outside the Alchemy Room on Spirit Rock Island was not simple and not easily broken.
Besides, let alone Ji Xiyue, even Ji Ling wouldn’t likely be able to pull off such a feat here on Spirit Rock Island.
Having detected Lin Jue and Ye Yun, Lin Jing chose not to pay them any mind.
As Lin Jing had completed the elixir in the System Space, although six hours had passed inside, with the sevenfold time acceleration of the System Space,
in the outside world, barely an hour had actually gone by.
Technically, Lin Jing should still be in the midst of Alchemy, which wouldn’t be a suitable time to emerge.
With the Formation’s concealment, the two were also unaware of the situation inside the Alchemy Room, so Lin Jing didn’t need to worry.
Consequently, Lin Jing began to meditate in the Alchemy Room, sitting cross-legged.
And so, Lin Jing continued to meditate until the next day, when he finally concluded his meditation.
During this period, although Lin Jing was meditating, he was constantly aware of the time.
By now, more than twelve hours, a whole day, had passed since Lin Jing entered the Alchemy Room.
It was time for him to go out.
Following that,
Lin Jing got up, shut down the Alchemy Room’s Formation, and then made his way outside.
Before leaving, Lin Jing again extended his Divine Sense to sweep the exterior.
As his Divine Sense passed over, Lin Jing found that several people had gathered outside the Alchemy Room.
In addition to previously seen Lin Jue and Ye Yun, Yan Ming, and both Ji Xiyue and Ji Ling had also arrived.
When Yan Ming saw the Alchemy Room’s Formation being removed, he immediately brightened, then anxiously turned his gaze to the Alchemy Room.
Even Ji Xiyue had an expectant look, focused on the Alchemy Room.
Subsequently, Lin Jing did just that, opening the door of the Alchemy Room and stepping out under everyone’s watchful eyes.
Upon Lin Jing’s reappearance, Yan Ming, unable to contain his excitement, stepped forward to meet him.
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Your Alchemy session sure took a while,
“How did it fare, what are the results of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir?”

chapters.title: Chapter 536: 220: Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Chapter 536: Chapter 220: Misunderstanding
At this moment, the others also surged forward, coming to Lin Jing’s side.
Even Ji Ling, though he feigned indifference, followed behind the crowd over to Lin Jing.
Obviously.
Even he was very concerned about the outcome of Lin Jing’s alchemy.
Given that Ji Ling was this concerned, Ji Xiyue needless to say was even less able to restrain herself, and directly asked Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“How did the refinement of the Cleansing Spirit Elixir turn out?”
Lin Jing nodded, then took out the prepared Elixir Medicine from his person and handed it to Yan Ming, then said:
“I was just lucky this time, I have managed to barely live up to the expectations and barely managed to refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir required by Yan Daoyou.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing say he barely managed to refine it, Yan Ming was suddenly stunned…
Following that.
Yan Ming’s mood instantly plummeted, and after a forced chuckle, he then comforted Lin Jing:
“After all, the Cleansing Spirit Elixir is not easy to refine, managing to refine it successfully is already quite good, but I wonder, what quality is the Cleansing Spirit Elixir refined by Lin Daoyou?”
At Yan Ming’s words, Ji Ling immediately perked up, and then looked at Ji Xiyue with a smug face.
However, Ji Xiyue, on the contrary, looked towards Lin Jing with disbelief, just like Lin Jue.
Lin Jue was aware of Lin Jing’s alchemy level, so he found it hard to believe what Lin Jing claimed about barely managing to refine it.
Why then did Ji Xiyue react this way?
It somehow made one puzzled, as if Ji Xiyue, like Lin Jue, also knew very well about Lin Jing’s alchemy level…
When Lin Jing heard Yan Ming’s words, he was first taken aback…
A moment later, he realized.
Obviously, Yan Ming had misunderstood Lin Jing’s words, thinking he had not managed to refine a Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Only a Lower or Medium Grade Elixir Medicine.
However.
Since the misunderstanding had already occurred, there was no need to clarify it at this point, it would be better to give Yan Ming a surprise instead.
Therefore, Lin Jing directly spoke to Yan Ming:
“Yan Daoyou, just see for yourself.”
“Alright…”
While speaking, Yan Ming took the three jade bottles containing the Elixir Medicine from Lin Jing’s hands.
Immediately afterward, Yan Ming opened the first jade bottle.
The moment the jade bottle was opened, the scent of the elixir wafted out, and Ji Xiyue already smelled the elixir fragrance, proclaiming:
“Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir…”
This fragrance, Ji Xiyue was quite familiar with, and naturally, she wasn’t mistaken.
When Yan Ming poured out the elixir from the jade bottle, it was indeed the Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Yan Ming then picked up this Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir and carefully examined it, after a while, he put the elixir back away, and then said to Lin Jing:
“Being able to refine a Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir is already very impressive.”
Just at this time, Lin Jue also comforted Lin Jing:
“Brother…”
“It’s okay, this time you managed to refine a Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir, I believe that next time, you will definitely be able to refine a Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir.”
Just then, an untimely remark suddenly blurted out:
“Superior-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir…”
“My auntie, she managed to refine two of them.”
This statement clearly came from an elated Ji Ling.
When Ji Ling said this, he specifically looked at Lin Jue, his expression filled with provocation.
Obviously, Ji Ling was not quite willing to concede defeat to Lin Jue.
Upon hearing Ji Ling say this, anger surged in Lin Jue’s eyes, and she turned her head to glare at Ji Ling furiously.
And at this moment, Ji Xiyue also turned her head, stared at Ji Ling, and rebuked sharply:
“Shut your mouth!”
“If you continue to be so reckless, from now on you’ll stay at the Xingluo Elixir Sect and forget about going out again.”
Being scolded by his aunt, Ji Ling was somewhat puzzled and hurriedly looked up, incredulously turning to Ji Xiyue.
When he saw the sharpness in Ji Xiyue’s eyes, he immediately wilted and quickly said,
“Auntie, I was wrong…”
“I won’t dare to do it again.”
Clearly, Ji Ling fully understood that his aunt was truly angry this time.
Yet Ji Ling couldn’t understand why his aunt would be like this.
In the beginning.
It was his aunt who said that she would help him regain face, and though she had already won, he was merely stating the truth, yet she was angry.
Although Ji Ling was very puzzled, he didn’t dare say anything more, so he just shrank to one side and stopped speaking…
Following that, the patriarch of the Yan family took the jade bottle containing the elixir from Lin Jing’s hands and opened it directly.
This was just a small interlude…
After this incident passed, Yan Ming immediately opened another jade bottle which contained a medium grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir.
Upon inspecting the medium grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir, only the last jade bottle was left.
“This last jade bottle doesn’t contain a low-grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir, does it?” Yan Ming asked Lin Jing at this moment.
Lin Jing did not respond, but directly said,
“Lin Daoyou, just open it and see for yourself…”
Then, without any further hesitation, Yan Ming opened the last jade bottle.
The moment the jade bottle was opened, the refreshing fragrance of the elixir immediately wafted out.
This fragrance of the elixir was so rich that it was much more intense than that of the superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixir from before.
When Yan Ming smelled this fragrance, he was momentarily stunned and then became excited,
“This fragrance, could it be a superior…”
At this moment.
Ji Xiyue herself couldn’t wait and hurriedly said,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“Quickly take out the elixir and have a look…”
Lin Jue and Ye Yun also approached at this time, while Ji Ling stood somewhat absent-mindedly to one side.
Afterward.
Yan Ming quickly poured out the elixir from the jade bottle, to reveal two perfectly round elixirs that rolled into the palm of Yan Ming’s hand from within the bottle.
Both elixirs were of a pure white jade color, not only were they perfectly round, but they also had no impurities on them at all.
Upon seeing these two elixirs, Ji Xiyue was the first to react and exclaimed,
“Superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, and there are two of them…”
Yan Ming followed, and upon seeing the two superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, he began to breathe more rapidly.
However, Yan Ming still managed to suppress the excitement in his heart and carefully examined the two superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
Only after a good while did Yan Ming finally look up at Lin Jing again, his face flushed with excitement as he said with a smile,
“Well done…”
“Lin Daoyou, you really are…”
“You’ve completely fooled me; you actually made two superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, how can this be considered barely successful in your alchemy?”
“This batch of elixir medicine has directly resolved the worry in my heart.”
Lin Jing also smiled and said to Yan Ming,
“What I said was that I barely managed to refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir that Lin Daoyou needed…”
“It’s just that Lin Daoyou misunderstood it yourself.”
After hearing this, Yan Ming laughed even more cheerfully,
“Good…good…”
“It was a misunderstanding, indeed it was my misunderstanding.”
At this moment, Yan Ming was incredibly happy, Lin Jing’s alchemy yielded two superior grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, which had completely resolved his concerns and worries.
Even if it was a misunderstanding, it was a good one.
This misunderstanding, he would rather have more of it…

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 221: Enchantment
chapters.content:
Chapter 537: Chapter 221: Enchantment
Lin Jue was extremely excited at this time, and he kept glancing at Ji Ling with a triumphant expression on his face.
Meanwhile, Ji Ling craned his neck, staring dumbfounded at the two top-quality Cleansing Spirit Elixirs in Yan Ming’s hands.
He didn’t notice Lin Jue at that moment, but even if he had, he probably wouldn’t have been able to say anything.
After observing the two top-quality Cleansing Spirit Elixirs for a while, Ji Xiyue withdrew her gaze, turned to Lin Jing, and said,
“Lin Daoyou, for this competition, it’s you who has won.”
“About the bet between us, when do you plan to settle it?”
Lin Jing turned his head to look at Ji Xiyue and then said,
“The matter of the bet is not urgent right now…”
After speaking, Lin Jing turned his head again to Yan Ming and said,
“Yan Daoyou…”
“When do you plan to have Yan Xing and Yan Yue, the two sisters, take the Elixir Medicine?”
After hearing this, Yan Ming replied directly to Lin Jing,
“Now…”
“After waiting for so long and finally getting these top-quality Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, I don’t want to wait another moment, of course now…”
Having said that, Yan Ming carefully put away the two top-quality Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.
After storing the Elixir Medicine, Yan Ming looked up at Lin Jing again and said earnestly,
“Lin Daoyou, I won’t say much else…”
“From now on, no matter what difficulties you encounter, just let us know, and Spirit Rock Island will definitely give its full support.”
Having finished speaking.
Yan Ming bade farewell to the others, took the Elixir Medicine, and went to find the Yan sisters.
And at this place, only Lin Jing and his three companions were left, as well as Ji Xiyue and her nephew…
After Yan Ming had left, Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue and asked,
“Ji Daoyou…”
“Is it convenient for you now?”
Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing with a smile and said,
“Lin Daoyou, are you planning to settle the bet now?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes…”
Ji Xiyue nodded and then said,
“Of course…”
Following that.
Lin Jing said to Lin Jue and the other,
“You two, go back first!”
Lin Jue and Ye Yun didn’t waste any words and directly left the place.
After the two had left, Ji Xiyue also convinced Ji Ling to go back.
After everyone had left, Ji Xiyue spoke to Lin Jing,
“Follow me…”
Lin Jing nodded and then followed Ji Xiyue to the same hillside where they had talked last time.
Once they arrived there, Ji Xiyue spoke directly to Lin Jing,
“It’s quieter here, Lin Daoyou. Whatever you want to ask, you can ask directly now.”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue in front of him, who didn’t seem at all frustrated by losing the competition, but rather was looking at him with interest.
Lin Jing, seeing Ji Xiyue’s demeanor, had a thought and then suddenly said,
“When I ask questions, you won’t just make up answers to fool me, right?”
“If that’s the case, then there wouldn’t be any point in me asking you questions.”
Ji Xiyue was taken aback by Lin Jing’s sudden comment…
After coming to her senses, Ji Xiyue was quite annoyed and sharply said,
“What do you take me for? Am I that kind of person?”
“Ask or not, it’s up to you. If you don’t ask, then I’m leaving!”
Seeing Ji Xiyue’s reaction, Lin Jing knew she must definitely have her reasons, so she would likely not deceive him.
Therefore, Lin Jing quickly said with a smile,
“I’ll ask…”
“Of course, I want to ask.”
“I just spoke out of turn just now, I hope Ji Daoyou won’t mind.”
Afterward.
Lin Jing thought for a moment and then directly said,
“My first question is…”
“Ji Daoyou, how did you find out my identity?”
Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing, blinked, and asked,
“You mean…”
“Your identity as the descendant of the Lin Family?”
Lin Jing nodded.
Ji Xiyue then laughed, a very happy laugh,
“Well…”
“That was, of course, a guess!”
“Alright, the first question is answered, let’s move on to the second question.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing’s face instantly darkened, and he turned to walk down the hill.
Seeing Lin Jing’s reaction, Ji Xiyue hurriedly called out to him,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“You have two more questions, don’t you want to ask them?”
Lin Jing stopped in his tracks, turned around, and said directly,
“Ji Daoyou, you should know what I want to ask…”
“If you’re going to take this attitude, then there’s no point in asking this question!”
After Lin Jing spoke, Ji Xiyue shook her head with a sigh of helplessness,
“Sigh…”
“It’s really not easy to fool you…”
Having said that, Ji Xiyue spoke again to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou, come back…”
“I will tell you everything you want to know.”
Lin Jing’s expression eased considerably upon hearing Ji Xiyue’s words, and then he walked back.
Next, Lin Jing looked up again, waiting for Ji Xiyue to speak.
It had to be said, Ji Xiyue was very beautiful, even exuding a dignified and elegant aura.
However, from her behavior, it was clear that her temperament was quite contrary to her appearance.
At this point, Ji Xiyue put on a serious face, which made her look much more serious, and then she said to Lin Jing,
“Actually…
“Before this, I was fortunate enough to have come across a fragment of an alchemy tome, which is a legacy of an Ancient Alchemy Path family. Although the alchemical techniques in it were incomplete and no longer practicable, there are still some valuable inheritances within, which have remained.”
“So, is it that you found out about my identity during the time Lin Jue was concocting the Elixir Medicine, through that incomplete alchemy tome?” Lin Jing then asked.
Ji Xiyue nodded and continued,
“Actually, when Lin Jue first concocted the Elixir Medicine, I was already suspicious of your identities, but I was not yet certain.”

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 221 Enchantment_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 538: Chapter 221 Enchantment_2
“`
“So…”
“That’s why I sought you out for the upcoming competition.”
“And just as expected, you won!”
At this point, Ji Xiyue looked up, staring straight at Lin Jing before speaking,
“To truly confirm your identity, it was actually just now…”
“Just now?”
Lin Jing’s brows furrowed slightly as something seemed to dawn on him.
“Yes, just now…”
“When I asked you earlier, didn’t you respond?”
“What could be more genuine than you admitting your own identity with your own lips?”
“Isn’t that right, the heir of the Lin Family, the long-established family of the Ancient Alchemy Path, Lin Jing!”
At this, Ji Xiyue laughed again, her eyes curving like crescent moons. She seemed very pleased, almost like a little fox that had stolen a chicken…
Lin Jing found himself at a loss for words, not expecting it to be like this; he had been outwitted by this woman.
“So you’ve been uncertain all along, always just probing me?” Lin Jing said, his face darkening.
Ji Xiyue nodded and spoke to Lin Jing,
“Yes, it’s exactly like that!”
After finishing, Ji Xiyue didn’t forget to console Lin Jing,
“But you don’t have to worry about it. Whether or not you admit it, it doesn’t make much difference.”
“After all…”
“The Elixir Medicine you’ve concocted doesn’t lie,”
“Since I had my suspicions, I would surely use all means to collect evidence and confirm your identity.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing looked up at Ji Xiyue.
Ji Xiyue hurriedly said,
“Don’t look at me like that…”
“You should understand that it’s not just me— as long as you continue alchemy, someone will always be skeptical.”
“Your identity won’t stay hidden for long.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing also fell silent.
He understood this truth all too well.
He needed Elixir Medicine to enhance his cultivation, and those around him needed them as well. The more Elixir Medicines he produced, the more inevitable it was that flaws would be exposed, greatly increasing the chances of being discovered.
But that didn’t mean he could afford to give up on Alchemy for fear of choking.
Moreover, Lin Jing, aside from practicing the Alchemy Techniques of the Lin Family, also had access to the System Space.
And the Alchemy Dao of the Lin Family could serve as a cover for the existence of the System Space, preventing unnecessary suspicion.
Therefore, he was determined to continue with alchemy.
What Lin Jing could do was to try his best not to concoct Elixir Medicines in front of others, thereby delaying the time of exposure.
“So that’s the first question asked, right?” Ji Xiyue said, addressing Lin Jing.
Lin Jing nodded and answered,
“Yes…”
“I’ve finished asking the first question.”
Then, Lin Jing turned to Ji Xiyue to say,
“Now, onto the second question.”
“What is your true intention in doing this?”
…
…
“I want to take you as my master and become your disciple!!!”
Ji Xiyue looked directly at Lin Jing and said it straight out.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing’s eyebrows immediately knitted together, then he answered,
“Impossible…”
“You should know, the Alchemy Techniques aren’t something to be passed on lightly.”
“Moreover, since you have your own Sect, it’s even less likely that I would take you as my disciple.”
However, Ji Xiyue’s next words left Lin Jing completely silent.
“What if I leave the Xingluo Elixir Sect, would you take me on then?”
The top talent of the Xingluo Elixir Sect planning to leave…
Even if Ji Xiyue dared to leave, Lin Jing wouldn’t dare to accept her as a disciple.
Furthermore, Ji Xiyue’s father was the Grand Elder of the Xingluo Elixir Sect—could she even manage to leave if she wished to?
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue and saw that she was gazing back at him, her expression extremely serious.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a sinking feeling,
“Could Ji Xiyue really be considering leaving the Xingluo Elixir Sect to become my disciple?”
Then, Lin Jing quickly shook his head, outright refusing,
“That’s not possible…”
“`
“You are the first genius Alchemist of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, how could you possibly take me as your master? If you were to suddenly become my disciple, not to mention the other members of the Xingluo Elixir Sect, I’m afraid even your father would not let me off the hook,”
However, at this moment, Ji Xiyue took a step forward, approaching Lin Jing and whispered softly:
“How about I secretly become your disciple?”
“To the outside world we would still be considered fellow Daoists, but if there are no outsiders around, you would be my master. If Master wants me to do anything at that time, I won’t have any problems with it…”
“As long as you pass on some Alchemy Techniques to me, that would be enough…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing suddenly turned his head to look at Ji Xiyue.
And Ji Xiyue, not avoiding his gaze at all, looked into Lin Jing’s eyes with some longing…
This eye contact between the two lasted for a full quarter of an hour.
Not until a quarter of an hour later did Ji Xiyue lower her head with a blushing face.
And Lin Jing’s expression had become much colder:
“Ji Daoyou…”
“I think there’s nothing left to talk about between us.”
On hearing this, Ji Xiyue’s face turned slightly red as she bowed her hands towards Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, I’m sorry…”
“It was presumptuous of me. I will definitely not use any charm enchantments on Lin Daoyou again.”
…
In fact.
The reason Ji Xiyue acted the way she did was because she practiced a kind of charm enchantment.
This charm enchantment was different from others. It slowly infiltrated the sea of consciousness and subtly changed some of a person’s thoughts.
Most people would not notice it.
The reason Lin Jing suddenly changed his attitude was because he discovered Ji Xiyue was secretly using the charm enchantment on him.
And Ji Xiyue’s objective, needless to say, was directly aimed at the Lin Family’s Alchemy Techniques.
Originally, that charm enchantment should have been very difficult for Lin Jing to detect.
Only, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense was extremely powerful. Although his Cultivation was only at the seventh layer of Nascent Soul, his Divine Sense had long surpassed Ji Xiyue’s and reached the Nascent Soul Peak Stage.
It was precisely because his Divine Sense was so strong that Lin Jing was not influenced by Ji Xiyue and was able to detect the inappropriateness.
Moreover, Ji Xiyue seemed to be too hasty in her action, which was also too irrational.
Such behavior from Ji Xiyue had touched Lin Jing’s bottom line, thus his face turned cold at that moment.
…
After that.
Seeing that Lin Jing’s expression did not improve, Ji Xiyue quickly spoke up to explain:
“Lin Daoyou, it was indeed my fault just now, and I apologize to you.”
“In fact, my goal was not to become your disciple, and I know that to ask you to be my master is impossible.”
“I just wanted you to help me repair the incomplete technique I had previously obtained.”
“As long as Lin Daoyou can help me repair that technique, whatever you need, just say it, and I will try my best to satisfy your request.”
When Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue again, his expression was indifferent as he spoke directly:
“Ji Daoyou…”
“I think you have misunderstood. Between us, there is only the wager on those three questions. Besides that, there are no other ties.”
“Also, it seems you have overestimated me.”
“The books of Ancient Alchemy Path handed down from ancient times are not something anyone can repair.”
“Well then…”
“If there’s nothing else, I’ll be leaving now, farewell!”
After saying that, Lin Jing began to walk down the mountain.
At this moment, Ji Xiyue quickly spoke up and called out to Lin Jing:
“Lin Jing…”
“There’s still one question you haven’t asked…”
However, without turning back, Lin Jing replied:
“No need, it’s no longer necessary.”
Then, without any pause, Lin Jing continued down the mountain.
Only after Lin Jing had been gone for a long time…
Did Ji Xiyue, who had been staring at his departing figure, finally snap back to reality.
Looking in the direction where Lin Jing had gone, Ji Xiyue furrowed her brows and after a while, muttered to herself:
“It’s over now, he’s really angry…”
Then, glancing down the mountain again and not seeing that familiar figure, she immediately looked dejected.
After a while, Ji Xiyue said indignantly:
“Ji Xiyue, how could you be so foolish to think of using charm enchantments on a descendant of the Ancient Alchemy Path with strong Divine Sense.”
“Now look what you’ve done, you’ve messed it all up…”
Afterward, Ji Xiyue’s brows furrowed again as she looked up in the direction Lin Jing had left:
“Looks like it’s going to take a lot of effort to mend my relationship with him from now on…”

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 222 The Little Girl in the Fang Market
chapters.content:
Chapter 539: Chapter 222 The Little Girl in the Fang Market
After descending from the mountain, Lin Jing went straight back to his residence.
Upon seeing Lin Jing’s return, Lin Jue hurried over and asked:
“Brother…”
“How did it go, did you find out what that woman’s purpose really is? Did you get it out of her?”
“Also, didn’t you say before that she guessed our identities?”
“Is that really true?”
Lin Jing then spoke to Lin Jue:
“She indeed knows our identities. From now on, both of you must stay away from her.”
“Knowing our identities, won’t she put me at a disadvantage, exposing our identities?” Lin Jue couldn’t help but worry.
Lin Jing pondered for a moment before speaking:
“It’s unlikely…”
“She currently needs me, so she probably won’t do something like that…”
“Moreover, that Ji Xiyue practices the art of enchantment. Both of you try to avoid her as much as possible and never be alone with her.”
“The art of enchantment…”
Lin Jue and Ye Yun looked at each other, then began to size up Lin Jing curiously.
By the looks of it, they were very curious about what Lin Jing had gone through previously.
But Lin Jing paid no attention to them and went straight back to his room.
Lin Jing still had to think about how to interact with this Ji Xiyue.
This woman was somewhat difficult to deal with, and more importantly, she knew his identity, and since she was from the Xingluo Elixir Sect, Lin Jing couldn’t possibly kill her.
At the moment, it was not yet time to completely break with her. He needed to maintain a certain relationship with her to ensure she kept his secret safe.
After all, he was too weak right now. If his identity were exposed, it would definitely be dangerous.
Thinking back on this now, Lin Jing felt somewhat annoyed.
He had left too quickly before…
…
The news came the following day…
Sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue had taken the premium Cleansing Spirit Elixir and successfully enhanced their Spiritual Roots.
The two sisters, who had just succeeded in their enhancement, were immediately brought by Yan Ming to Lin Jing to express their gratitude.
Seeing the improved Spiritual Roots of the two sisters, Yan Ming smiled from ear to ear, and Yan Xing and Yan Yue were both extremely excited as well.
Lin Jing also felt very gratified looking at the two sisters.
Afterwards,
Yan Ming found Lin Jing alone and told him that Ji Xiyue had looked for him the previous day, wanting to talk to Lin Jing and specifically requested Yan Ming to convey this message.
After finishing the message, Yan Ming was quite curious about what exactly had happened the day before to lead to such a situation that he had to come and deliver the message.
Lin Jing didn’t go into details, only mentioning that there had been some disagreements between him and her that led to an unpleasant conflict.
Later, Lin Jing also agreed to the request to meet with Ji Xiyue again for a discussion.
Yan Ming did not ask further and expressed that he would relay the message to Ji Xiyue after going back.
After the matter regarding Ji Xiyue was settled, Yan Ming brought up another matter to Lin Jing.
The successful enhancement of Yan Xing and Yan Yue’s Spiritual Roots was a joyous event, so tonight Spirit Rock Island would hold a grand banquet to celebrate the sisters’ Spiritual Roots enhancement.
Their visit was also specifically to invite Lin Jing and his companions to the banquet.
Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t refuse the invitation to the banquet and agreed right away.
…
…
On the next day, Lin Jing bid farewell to Yan Ming and then left Spirit Rock Island with Lin Jue, Ye Yun, and Little Sparrow.
After leaving Spirit Rock Island, Lin Jing did not return to Li Yan Island but instead steered the Flying Boat directly towards Bihai City.
The banquet held last night was very lively.
And during the banquet, Lin Jing even met with Ji Xiyue thanks to Yan Ming’s arrangement.
This time, Ji Xiyue was very humbled and as soon as they met, she apologized to Lin Jing.
She promised to never disclose Lin Jing’s identity and vowed never to do so in the future.
And Lin Jing…
Forgave her previous behavior after her earnest promises.
Afterward, to compensate Lin Jing, Ji Xiyue consulted with Yan Ming and decided to give Lin Jing the two White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grasses that were originally prepared as a backup for the bet.
Lin Jing gladly accepted them.
With these two White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grasses, he could refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir to enhance the Spiritual Roots of himself and others around him.
As for Ji Xiyue, Lin Jing also understood her purpose, which was for that incomplete elixir tome.
This time, Lin Jing didn’t refuse but said he would help her look into it when he had time…
After this conversation, the relationship between the two of them had eased significantly.
And Lin Jing could finally relax.
…
In less than a day’s time, Lin Jing arrived near Bihai City riding the Flying Boat.
Since flying directly into Bihai City was prohibited due to restrictions, Lin Jing put away the Shadow Escape Flying Boat when they were still not in Bihai City, and then the three of them flew towards the city together.
Now that the Cross-realm Transmission Formation was built, Bihai City had become even more prosperous.
Cultivators were coming and going incessantly.
Many cultivators from families or other factions frequently came here to use the Teleportation Array, heading to the Nanming Domain or the Western Demon Region.
Lin Jing saw the two towering beams of light from a great distance away before reaching Bihai City.
Those two beams of light naturally came from the two Cross-realm Transmission Formations; both were bi-directional and could be used by cultivators from both regions for travel.
Although the formation made traveling much more convenient,
The cost of teleportation was by no means cheap.
Using these Teleportation Arrays required a fee of one hundred Superior Grade Spirit Stones per person per use.
And.
At the time of teleportation, only Superior Grade Spirit Stones were accepted, neither Medium Grade nor Low Grade Spirit Stones would work.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 222: The Little Girl in Fang Market_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 540: Chapter 222: The Little Girl in Fang Market_2
In the southern outer sea region, Superior Grade Spirit Stones were already few and far between, requiring about one hundred and twenty Midium Grade Spirit Stones to exchange for one Superior Grade Spirit Stone.
Ever since the Teleportation Array was established, the price of Superior Grade Spirit Stones became even higher.
One needed at least one hundred and thirty Spirit Stones to exchange for a single Superior Grade Spirit Stone.
Even so, there were still people unwilling to make the exchange.
However,
Lin Jing didn’t have to worry about Spirit Stones.
Previously, Lin Jing had obtained most of the Black Shark Gang’s assets from the Space Ring of the Black Shark Gang Leader, amassing a total of over two hundred thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones.
Added to that were the Spirit Stones he got from the Puppet Guild Leader and other Cultivators of the Puppet Guild during his time in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
Lin Jing had nearly three hundred thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones on him.
With so many Superior Grade Spirit Stones, Lin Jing had more than enough for his use.
After arriving at Bihai Island, the three people and one eagle passed through the city gates and entered Bihai City.
Looking at everything familiar inside Bihai City, Lin Jue and Ye Yun’s eyes also revealed a nostalgic look.
The two had hardly visited Bihai City since they followed Lin Jing to Li Yan Island.
In particular, in recent times, the two had not been to Bihai City for a good ten plus years.
Lin Jue was immersed daily in the Lin Family’s Alchemy Techniques, crafting Elixir Medicines for the Li Yan Elixir Pavilion, and would occasionally come out to help Yue Qi ma’am manage Li Yan City.
As for Ye Yun, his outings were even rarer.
Most of the time, he was cultivating at the Groundflame Spring, and it was precisely because of his relentless cultivation that his Cultivation had advanced so quickly.
Then, Lin Jue spoke to Lin Jing,
“Brother…”
“We’d like to go back and have a look first…”
“It’s been so long since I’ve been back to the little house Grandpa left me.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Alright…”
“I’ll come with you.”
Lin Jue looked up at Lin Jing with a smile and said to him,
“Thank you, brother…”
Lin Jing also smiled as he looked at Lin Jue and replied,
“I’m your brother, no need to be so polite with me…”
“Let’s go…”
Having said that, Lin Jing took the lead and started walking towards the interior of Bihai City.
Lin Jue and Ye Yun hurriedly followed.
The group moved along, and they quickly arrived at Fang Market in Bihai City.
The market was just as before, seemingly not much had changed.
If one had to point out some changes, it would probably be the people; the market was bustling with people coming and going, and the stall owners seemed to change over time.
Now, with dozens of years passed, surely more than one generation of sellers had come and gone.
Then, Lin Jue and Ye Yun walked into the market, with Lin Jing following behind them.
In Fang Market, Lin Jue and Ye Yun looked around east and west, stopping to gaze, sometimes walking briskly forward…
They were engrossed in conversation, immersed in memories of the past,
Both had spent not just a little of their childhood in this market.
It wouldn’t be an overstatement to say this market held the memories of their youth; their demeanor made perfect sense to Lin Jing.
So Lin Jing followed quietly behind them without disturbing their reminiscing.
It was their unique memory, and naturally, Lin Jing did not intrude.
Their actions at the moment caught some sideways glances from others, but once those people noticed their Cultivation, they would quickly turn their heads away as if they had seen nothing.
Even though Lin Jing followed them, he had already concealed his own Cultivation before entering Bihai City.
Now, Lin Jing appeared to be just an ordinary Golden Core Stage early phase Cultivator, naturally attracting little attention.
In this way, Lin Jing and his companions walked on and directly reached the spot where Lin Juezhi used to set up his stall.
That place,
was also where Lin Jing and Lin Juezhi first met.
Previously, the spot was rather desolate due to its proximity to the heart of the market, with few stalls around.
But now, perhaps due to the establishment of the Teleportation Array, even the deepest parts of the market were bustling with activity.
At the location of Lin Juezhi’s former stall, it was already occupied by someone else.
There stood about an eleven or twelve-year-old girl, who, despite appearing somewhat thin, had a determination in her eyes that seemed beyond her years.
Besides that…
On the stall in front of the young girl, there were several porcelain bottles containing Elixir Medicines.
This little girl, she too sells Elixir Medicine.
Her slender frame, resolute eyes…
This little girl, she closely resembled Lin Jue when Lin Jing first met her.
Seeing the little girl, Lin Jue thought of her past self, immediately a nameless emotion surged in her heart.
Following that.
Lin Jue walked forward and softly asked the girl:
“Did you refine all these Elixir Medicines yourself?”
Seeing someone inquiring about the Elixir Medicines at her stall, the girl quickly came over to greet:
“Yes, senior…”
“All the Elixir Medicines at this stall were refined by me.”
“May I know what kind of Elixir Medicine the senior is looking for?”
Despite her young age, she was not in the least bit shy, and by the looks of it, she must have been running her stall in Fang Market for quite a while now.
Lin Jing looked at the little girl and couldn’t help feeling a sense of familiarity, as if he had once seen her as a little girl himself.
Then, Lin Jing couldn’t help but laugh, shaking his head…
Lin Jing hadn’t been out of Li Yan Island for a long time, so how could he recognize this eleven or twelve-year-old girl?
It was probably because she reminded him of Lin Jue of the past that he felt this familiarity.
Lin Jue then spoke:
“Could you please bring that bottle of Elixir Medicine here for me to look at?”
Lin Jue didn’t specify which Elixir Medicine she needed, but simply pointed at one of the porcelain bottles.
“Alright…”
“Please wait a moment, senior…”
The girl was very polite, saying so, she handed over the bottle of Elixir Medicine to him.
After receiving the bottle, Lin Jue did not directly open it but instead directly asked the girl:
“Little sister…”
“Where is your family? How come you’re here at the stall alone? Aren’t your family worried?”
