Moreover, if that elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect were to really take action, it would mean a fight to the death between Lin Jing and the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Would the Nanming Immortal Sect really provoke such a formidable enemy for the sake of the Yun Family?
Probably not.
Even if that elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect wanted to obtain the Li family’s legacy of Alchemy Techniques, he would still have to weigh his options with Lin Jing present.
He would have to consider whether it was worth it or not.
After listening, Li Qingqing pondered for a while, and then, as if she had made a certain decision, she said directly:
“All right then…”
“You come with me.”
Having said that, Li Qingqing led Lin Jing and the other two toward the Li family’s council hall.
Just as Li Qingqing and Lin Jing’s group stepped into the courtyard of the council hall, even while they were still outside the courtyard, they heard a voice coming from inside.
“I’d like to know, patriarch, isn’t it a little improper for you to suddenly leave when we are in the middle of a discussion?”
“And…”
“Who are those people behind you? Even if they are friends of the patriarch, this is an internal secret matter of our Li Family. Is it really appropriate to bring them here now?”
As soon as this voice stopped, another voice spoke:
“Qingqing…”
“It’s not for me to say, Third Uncle…”
“At this time, your sudden departure, and bringing your friends here, isn’t it a bit too much?”
Having finished speaking, the voice spoke again:
“Elder Jin…”
“Take those people to the guest rooms first, don’t delay our discussion.”
Then another voice spoke:
“Sorry, Third Master…”
“Before the old master passed away, he instructed that I only take orders from Master Qing Qing.”
Upon hearing this familiar voice, Lin Jing was taken aback, and then peered into the room.
Indeed.
Lin Jing once again saw that familiar figure.
It was the same Elder Jin who was adept in Spirit Plant cultivation that Lin Jing had met at the Li Family.
Previously, Li Qingqing had said he had died in battle, yet here he appeared again, which left Lin Jing rather puzzled…
Thereafter, Li Qingqing with a cold expression directly led Lin Jing and the two with him into the discussion hall.
When Lin Jing entered, Elder Jin saw him and immediately broke into a smile:
“I was wondering who it was that made Qing Qing so anxious, to run out without care to greet, it turns out it’s you, kid…”
Lin Jing approached Elder Jin, studied him carefully, then said with a smile:
“Elder Jin…”
“So you’re alright, I heard from Qing Qing that you had an accident, I thought that…”
“Now that you are alright, it is truly wonderful.”
Elder Jin, smiling, responded:
“I thought I was going to hand over my old bones when I encountered those wolf cubs, who would have thought, I didn’t die.”
“Not only did I not die, but I also turned misfortune into a stroke of luck and successfully advanced to the Golden Core Stage. It must be said, my luck is quite good.”
Before, Elder Jin himself was at the Foundation Establishment Stage, and logically speaking, at his age, it would be even more difficult to break through to the Golden Core than for most people.
Yet, Elder Jin had managed to advance to the Golden Core Stage even under those circumstances, one couldn’t help but say that Elder Jin’s luck was exceptionally good…
In this discussion hall, aside from their group, there were three others.
Two of them were mid-stage Golden Core Cultivators, while another was at the mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
At this moment.
The mid-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator approached, glanced at Lin Jing, and snorted coldly:
“This… young friend…”
“I am Qing Qing’s Third Uncle. Regardless of what relationship you had with Qing Qing before, right now we in the Li Family are in the midst of a discussion.”
“Isn’t it rather improper for a young friend like you to come here so rashly?”
Lin Jing had heard of this Third Uncle of Li Qingqing before.
He wasn’t very talented and was an idler at best.
Although the Li Family was originally known for its Alchemy Dao, Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle had no interest in the Alchemy Techniques whatsoever.
All day long, he relied on the Li Family’s reputation to behave recklessly.
Elder Master Li was very disappointed in him, so he had sent this Third Master of the Li Family away early on, to manage one of the Li Family’s Elixir Pavilions in another Immortal City.
However.
It was precisely for this reason.
That this Third Master of the Li Family was lucky to escape the Howling Sky Wolf Clan’s onslaught and survived.
And now.
As Li Qingqing rebuilt the Li Family, his Third Uncle, hearing winds of change, came back too.
After all.
It’s always pleasant to enjoy the shade under a big tree; as long as the Li Family existed, even if he lived poorly, it wouldn’t be too bad.
It was still a hundred times better than the time he spent alone.
However.
No sooner had his words fallen than Li Qingqing’s face turned cold and she spoke directly:
“Third Uncle…”
“Lin Jing is a guest I personally invited to help resolve the Li Family’s crisis. Moreover, Lin Jing’s cultivation is much higher than yours.”
“That manner of address is indeed inappropriate.”
As Li Qingqing’s words ended, Ye Yun immediately revealed his cultivation, and instantly a terrifying aura enveloped the whole hall.
Then, Ye Yun, looking coldly at the other three people, walked up to Lin Jing and respectfully called out:
“Master…”

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 239 Traitor
chapters.content:
Chapter 574: Chapter 239 Traitor
That call of “Master” took Li Qingqing’s third uncle and the other two cultivators by surprise.
Even Elder Jin, looking at Lin Jing, was filled with disbelief…
Ever since he had entered the room, Lin Jing had been catching up with Elder Jin, and the few of them hadn’t paid any attention to Lin Jing’s cultivation level.
Especially Li Qingqing’s third uncle, seeing how familiar Lin Jing was with Li Qingqing, even more considered himself a senior of the Li Family and called Lin Jing “junior friend”.
But what they hadn’t expected was that Lin Jing was actually the master of the Golden Core Cultivator from before, and considering the aura that Golden Core Cultivator had released, he was at least at the Golden Core Late Stage.
To be the master of a Golden Core Late Stage cultivator, wouldn’t that require at least the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Stage?
...
And a Nascent Soul True Monarch, within the entire Nanming Domain, belonged to the top echelon, let alone the Li Family, even the Yun Family wouldn’t dare to provoke them lightly.
Li Qingqing’s third uncle, looking at Lin Jing at this moment, couldn’t help but feel his heart tremble…
After all,
he was only at the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment; to dare to call a Nascent Soul True Monarch “junior friend” was truly outrageous.
A moment later, Li Qingqing’s third uncle came to his senses and immediately became more cautious, and even his attitude towards Lin Jing became much more humble:
“I wonder what… senior…”
“has such a cultivation level?”
The other two in the room had already extended their Divine Sense towards Lin Jing to probe him as soon as they could.
However,
after probing, they found that Lin Jing’s cultivation was only at the Golden Core Mid-Stage, and no matter how they probed, they couldn’t find any flaws.
Their foreheads immediately furrowed.
How could a cultivator at the Golden Core Late Stage possibly recognize a Golden Core Mid-Stage cultivator as their master?
Unless this person’s cultivation was much higher than theirs, or this person possessed an extremely powerful concealment cultivation technique, which is why they couldn’t detect anything.
After probing, one of them spoke up:
“Third Master…”
“This… fellow Daoist…”
“must have concealed his true cultivation level. He likely doesn’t want to reveal too much, so there’s no need for you to ask further, Third Master.”
After hearing this, Li Qingqing’s third uncle understood and then said:
“Indeed, I was presumptuous…”
“Since that’s the case, then I won’t ask further.”
At this time, Li Qingqing looked at her third uncle and said directly:
“Third Uncle…”
“I’ve invited my friend to participate in our Li Family council.”
“You don’t have any objections, right?”
Li Qingqing’s third uncle, with an awkward smile, replied:
“Since he has come to aid our Li Family, of course, I have no objections…”
Li Qingqing nodded slightly upon hearing this.
Then, she turned around, pointed at the two Golden Core Mid-Stage cultivators, and said to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“These two are Offering Priest Luo and Offering Priest Yang…”
“Uncle Luo and Uncle Yang have been on good terms with our Li Family since my grandfather’s time. When they learned of my return to rebuild the Li Family, they joined and became offering priests of our Li Family.”
“During this time, they have been quite helpful to me.”
After saying this, Li Qingqing looked towards Offering Priest Luo and Offering Priest Yang and said:
“Uncle Luo, Uncle Yang…”
“Didn’t you say earlier that you have a way to help our Li Family through this crisis?”
“Why don’t you share it, so everyone can hear…”
Faced with Li Qingqing’s question, Luo and Yang, the two offering priests, hesitated.
First looking at Lin Jing, then Offering Priest Luo addressed Li Qingqing:
“Family Head…”
“May I know if your friend is a Nascent Soul True Monarch?”
“If he truly is a Nascent Soul True Monarch, then we need to make some changes to our earlier plan.”
No sooner had Offering Priest Luo finished speaking than Li Qingqing promptly replied:
“My brother Lin Jing is indeed a Nascent Soul True Monarch…”
“However, he has only recently advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage, and due to some accidents during the advancement, his realm is not yet stable, and thus he can’t take action lightly.”
After speaking, Li Qingqing looked at them again:
“Uncle Luo, Uncle Yang…”
“Brother Lin Jing’s condition must not be revealed to outsiders, I hope you two uncles can keep this a secret.”
After hearing this, they promptly pounded their chests and said:
“Family Head rest assured, this matter is of great importance, we will definitely keep it a secret.”
Then, Li Qingqing continued:
“So, uncles, what exactly is the plan? I suppose you can speak now.”
Upon hearing this, the two exchanged a look, then Offering Priest Luo spoke up again:
“Our plan is to first compromise with the Yun Family and give them the Inheritance Elixir Technique.”
“As you know, Family Head, the Yun Family is only after the Inheritance Elixir Technique. If we just imprint a copy and hand it over to them, I’m sure they wouldn’t trouble our Li Family too much.”
“And Yun Long will certainly not dare to speak wildly anymore about taking you as his concubine and humiliating our Li Family.”
“By just imprinting a copy of the Inheritance Elixir Technique, we can not only preserve the Li Family’s inheritance but also protect you, Family Head.”
“From the current situation, this seems to be the most cost-effective method.”
As he said this, Offering Priest Yang also interjected at this time, cupping his hands in persuasion:
“Family Head…”
“The Yun Family’s power is immense, not something we can afford to provoke, especially now with the Yun Family Ancestor’s advancement to the Nascent Soul, which has greatly increased the entire Yun Family’s power, completely binding them with the Nanming Immortal Sect.”
“Our Li Family cannot compete with them.”
“Moreover, it’s not just the Yun Family we’re facing, but also the Nanming Immortal Sect behind them.”
“Even if your friend is a Nascent Soul True Monarch, facing the Nanming Immortal Sect backed by the Yun Family, he would be powerless.”
“So…”
“I think under the current circumstances, it’s most important to ensure the safety of the Li Family and you, Family Head.”

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 239 Traitor_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 575: Chapter 239 Traitor_2
Li Qingqing listened and frowned:
“Uncle Luo, Uncle Yang…”
“You must also know the importance of inheriting Alchemy Techniques to an alchemical family…
“Inheriting Alchemy Techniques is the foundation of our Li Family, and it’s impossible to give it away.”
Offering Priest Luo looked at Li Qingqing’s firm stance, helplessly shook his head, and sighed, then said:
“Alas…”
...
“If that’s the case, we have no other choice.”
And Offering Priest Yang felt the same way.
Li Qingqing watched the two, silent for a long time…
After a long silence, Li Qingqing spoke again:
“Let’s conclude today’s discussion here.”
“Uncle Luo, Uncle Yang, thank you for your troubles…”
The two waved their hands repeatedly, saying:
“The Family Head is too courteous…”
“It is our duty to share the Family Head’s concerns.”
After finishing, the two bade farewell to Li Qingqing and the few people with Lin Jing, and left the council hall.
After the two had left, Li Qingqing’s third uncle suddenly spoke:
“Qingqing ah…”
“Think over the suggestions from your Uncle Luo and Uncle Yang again…”
“I think what they said makes sense.”
“Our Li Family truly cannot afford to provoke the Yun Family now.”
Li Qingqing looked up at her third uncle, then spoke:
“Third Uncle…”
“During this time, just stay at home. If there’s nothing important, try not to go out.”
Li Qingqing’s third uncle wanted to say something upon hearing this.
But, seeing the sharpness in Li Qingqing’s eyes, he immediately swallowed the words that had reached his lips.
Afterward, Li Qingqing’s third uncle also left.
Following the departure of Li Qingqing’s third uncle,
only Elder Jin, Li Qingqing, and the few people with Lin Jing remained in the council hall.
Of course, there was also a Little Sparrow.
Just then, Li Qingqing spoke to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“Please shield this place. There are some matters I need to discuss with you all.”
Lin Jing nodded, then lifted his hand, and spiritual power immediately surged out, forming a light screen that enveloped the entire council hall.
Having done all this, Lin Jing said:
“It’s ready…”
Li Qingqing nodded, then spoke again:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“The reason I concealed something earlier is that those two offering priests have already betrayed us and sided with the Yun Family.”
Lin Jing then nodded and said:
“I had guessed as much…”
Previously, when Li Qingqing introduced Lin Jing, he remained silent and didn’t reveal his true cultivation.
If Li Qingqing refused to tell the truth, it must be because there was something wrong with those two.
Li Qingqing continued to say:
“Originally…”
“If Brother Lin Jing and the others hadn’t come, I would have planned to continue dealing with them for a while.”
“But now that Brother Lin Jing and the others are here, I no longer have anything to worry about.”
“Now that you have arrived, Brother Lin Jing, I deliberately leaked the news that you are a Nascent Soul; I guess they will soon go to report to the Yun Family.”
“It won’t be long before the Yun Family takes action; when that time comes, I will need Brother Lin Jing to make a move.”
“If it’s possible, Brother Lin Jing, as long as you make a move and deter them, they should know better and dare not provoke the Li Family again.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Don’t worry…”
“Leave it to me when the time comes…”
Li Qingqing nodded, then spoke again:
“Besides those two…”
“I also suspect that my third uncle is colluding with the Yun Family, although I’ve never been completely certain.”
At this point, Li Qingqing turned to Elder Jin:
“Elder Jin…”
“During this time, I will trouble you to keep an eye on my third uncle.”
“If he goes out, let him go out. Don’t stop him, just to see if he’s really colluding with the Yun Family.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Jin nodded:
“Understood, I’ll keep a close watch on the Third Master…”
…
Before long, the group finished their discussion.
Elder Jin left first, while Lin Jing and the others followed Li Qingqing back to the courtyard prepared for them by Li Qingqing.
Here, free from the trivial matters of the Li Family, they had a lively chat.
During the conversation, Li Qingqing suddenly suggested:
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“Since you left the Nanming Domain, you haven’t really tasted any delicacies, have you?”
Lin Jing thought about it and realized that it was indeed the case.
Since leaving the Nanming Domain, he had spent most of his time either in alchemy or cultivation, seldom taking the time to specifically indulge his appetite.
Even when he was on Li Yan Island, it was the same.
Lin Jing nodded…
Li Qingqing then continued:
“How about this—afterward, let’s go together to the Immortal Gathering Tower and try the delicacies there as well…”
“Lin Jing, brother, what do you think?”
“The Immortal Gathering Tower is still around?” Lin Jing was somewhat surprised.
“Of course…” said Li Qingqing.
“Behind the Immortal Gathering Tower is the Qingyuan Sword Sect.”
“No wonder…” Lin Jing suddenly realized.
“If that’s the case, then let’s go to the Immortal Gathering Tower,” Lin Jing said.
After discussing it, Lin Jue was also very curious about the Immortal Gathering Tower mentioned by the two.
So, at Lin Jue’s urging, the group quickly set off and left the Li Family.
Just outside the Li Family, Li Qingqing immediately spoke up.
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“It’s still early. Before we go to the Immortal Gathering Tower, I’ll take you to a place first.”
“What place?” Lin Jing asked, puzzled.
Li Qingqing gave a mysterious smile and said:
“Follow me, and you’ll know when we get there.”
Then, under Li Qingqing’s lead, the group walked down the main street and headed in another direction.
Along the way, Li Qingqing walked and introduced Lin Jing to some changes in Nanshan Immortal City during this time.
As she spoke, Li Qingqing would sometimes sigh and talk about the old days between them.
Whenever this happened, Lin Jue would ask with curiosity, incessantly inquiring about some of Lin Jing’s past.
Li Qingqing, on the other hand, spilled everything about the experiences they had shared.
…
In this way, they wandered around for quite a while.
And as they walked along the route Li Qingqing was leading them on, Lin Jing got a rough idea of where they were heading.
If Lin Jing’s guess was right, the place Li Qingqing was leading them to should be the courtyard where he and Huang Qingling used to live.
Sure enough.
After a period of trekking, the group passed through the main street and arrived at another quiet long street.
Even though the whole place had greatly changed, Lin Jing could still recognize it as the street in front of the courtyard where he and Huang Qingling had lived.
However, the alleyway in front of the courtyard had now turned into a street.
On both sides of the street were rows of shops, and some cultivators hurriedly walked on the street. Although this long street was also wide, it was much quieter compared to the main street.
Afterward.
Li Qingqing led Lin Jing to the front of a shop with its door closed on the street side.
Looking at the shop, Lin Jing felt a bit bewildered and couldn’t help but reminisce about the past…
The location of this shop was precisely where the small courtyard he had lived in for several years had been.
Back then, this place was part of Yuebaolou.
Looking again now, the two rows of shops flanking this street must have been taken back by the Nanming Immortal City a long time ago.
At this moment, Li Qingqing spoke:
“I have bought this shop…”
Having said that, Li Qingqing walked straight up and opened the door to the shop.
After the shop’s door was opened, Li Qingqing directly called out to Lin Jing:
“Lin Jing, brother, come quick…”
“I bought this shop especially for you.”
“Come inside and take a look…”
As she spoke, Li Qingqing took the lead and stepped into the shop.
Driven by curiosity, Lin Jue also went inside.
Following behind Lin Jue was Ye Yun.
Only after all three had entered did Lin Jing snap out of his reverie.
Then, Lin Jing also followed them in.
Upon entering the shop, it was completely empty inside.
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“Come over here, I have a surprise for you…”
As Li Qingqing spoke, she crossed the shop’s front hall and headed inside.
With a bout of curiosity, Lin Jing followed her inside.
Behind the shop, there was a not-so-small courtyard.
Lin Jing stopped short as soon as he entered the courtyard.
Because the courtyard behind the shop…
Was an exact replica of what it was when Lin Jing lived here before.
Whether it was the pavilion in the middle of the courtyard, the rockery, or even the kitchen…
All were built exactly as they had been before.
Clearly.
This must be the surprise Li Qingqing was talking about…

chapters.title: Chapter 576: 240
chapters.content:
Chapter 576: 240
Lin Jing walked in the courtyard, looking around as he went.
Even Little Sparrow was in this yard, flitting back and forth without stopping.
Seeing these familiar scenes, memories of the past flashed through his mind, triggering a wave of nostalgia in Lin Jing.
It was at this moment that Li Qingqing, who had been following Lin Jing, spoke up again:
“It’s not just this little courtyard…”
“I also bought the yard where Qing Qing stayed and restored everything to how it used to be, just like this one.”
...
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing stepped forward and vanished on the spot.
The next moment, he appeared in midair.
Standing in the void above the courtyard, Lin Jing looked towards the yard where Huang Qingling had lived.
Huang Qingling’s yard was very close to Lin Jing’s, and he could clearly see everything in that yard.
The yard had also been restored by Li Qingqing, made to look exactly as it did before.
After observing for a while, Lin Jing descended from midair and looked back at Li Qingqing, feeling somewhat touched in his heart.
Li Qingqing was still sentimental, and it was precisely because of that he had returned to the Nanming Domain to rebuild the Li Family.
At this time, Li Qingqing came over with a smile and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“Won’t you go inside and take a look?”
Lin Jing nodded at her words and said:
“Indeed, I should take a look.”
With that, Lin Jing walked towards the house in the courtyard.
Upon reaching the front of the house, Lin Jing reached out and pushed open the door.
The instant the door opened, a wave of familiarity hit him.
The arrangement inside the room had also been meticulously restored by Li Qingqing, exactly the same as before.
Even the scent in the room seemed to have barely changed.
Looking at the familiar room and smelling the familiar scent, Lin Jing, at that moment, suddenly felt a sense of tranquility.
At that moment, he felt as if he had merged with the space around him, with the whole world seeming to consist only of himself.
He didn’t understand why he felt this way.
Afterwards.
Lin Jing closed his eyes and began to concentrate on the feeling.
As Lin Jing cherished this sensation, a mysterious aura rose from him, circulating around him, seemingly isolating him from the rest of the world.
This situation was something none of them, Li Qingqing, Lin Jue, nor Ye Yun, had ever witnessed before.
However, no one dared to disturb Lin Jing at this time.
So.
Under Li Qingqing’s gestured instruction, the three of them left the room.
On their way out, the trio didn’t dare make the slightest noise for fear of disturbing Lin Jing.
It wasn’t until the three of them had left the room and returned to the courtyard that Lin Jue dared to whisper:
“Qing Qing, sister…”
“What’s happening to my brother? Is this what they call an epiphany in the legends?”
Li Qingqing shook her head and replied softly:
“I’m not sure…”
“But right now, it’s best we do not disturb him.”
Li Qingqing nodded and said nothing more.
Then the three of them waited silently in the yard, just watching Lin Jing…
…
Meanwhile, in another part of Nanshan Immortal City, two people entered a lavish mansion.
This mansion was the home of the Yun Family.
Those two people, had Lin Jing and the others been there, would have been recognized as the Offering Priests Luo and Yang, who had just left the Li Family not long ago.
Upon entering the Yun Family, they were immediately greeted by a butler, who led them towards the inner courtyard of the Yun household.
Upon reaching the inner courtyard, the butler guided the two through the compound, to a secluded yard deep within.
This small courtyard, unlike other areas of the Yun Family, was enveloped by a Formation, with an eerie aura permeating throughout.
In the deepest part of the yard stood a square hall.
This entire hall was wrapped by the Formation inside the yard, and on the Formation, there were sinister red threads that extended into the hall.
After bringing them to the courtyard, the butler left.
Once the butler had left, the two Offering Priests, Luo and Yang, approached the hall and called out with clasped hands:
“Young Master Yun, we have an important report.”
As their voices fell, a response came from inside the room:
“Come in…”
With the voice, the doors automatically opened.
Afterwards.
The two Offering Priests entered.
Just inside the hall, they saw a massive Formation, and at its center sat a young Cultivator in disheveled clothing and hair.
Beside the Cultivator lay a female Cultivator, naked, with her eyes tightly closed, motionless on the cold ground.
It was unclear whether she was dead or alive.
After the two Offering Priests entered the room, they merely glanced at the female Cultivator lying on the ground and proceeded to ignore her, then they greeted the seated young Cultivator with a bow.
The young Cultivator suddenly opened his eyes and then spoke:
“Someone come…”
Following his voice, two servants dressed as Foundation Establishment Cultivators entered from outside the yard.
Seeing them enter, the young Cultivator glanced at the female Cultivator on the ground and simply commanded:
“Throw her into the Formation outside for disposal.”
“Yes,” the two servants nodded.
They then entered the hall, produced a piece of black cloth, and efficiently wrapped up the female Cultivator with practiced motions.
Watching their skilled actions, one could surmise they did this regularly.
As the two of them rolled up the female Cultivator, her fingers twitched involuntarily, clearly indicating she was still alive.
However.
The two servants did not halt their actions; once they had wrapped the female Cultivator, they carried her away from the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 577: 240 Sudden Enlightenment_2
chapters.content:
F{h*F5.*LjChapter 240 Sudden Enlightenment_2
After the two had left, the young man waved his hand, and the doors of the grand hall closed on their own.
It was not until this moment that the young man lifted his head to look at the two, and spoke:
“Offering Priest Luo, Offering Priest Yang…”
“You have come now; could it be that something has happened with the Li Family?”
The two nodded, and then Offering Priest Luo spoke:
“Yes…”
...
“Young Master Yun Long…”
This youth was none other than Yun Long, the Young Master of the Yun Family.
Yun Long looked at the two and asked:
“What kind of incident?”
Offering Priest Luo responded:
“Today, Li Qingqing had friends visit the Li Family, three of them in total, one of whom is suspected to be a Nascent Soul True Monarch.”
“A Nascent Soul True Monarch?” Yun Long’s eyebrows furrowed, and then he looked at Offering Priest Luo and asked:
“Are you certain?”
“Have you seen him demonstrate his true strength?”
Offering Priest Luo shook his head, hesitating to say:
“Not completely certain…”
“That man appears to have a Golden Core Mid Stage cultivation, but among their group, another Golden Core Late Stage youth called him master.”
“The Golden Core Late Stage youth revealed his cultivation aura. Judging from the aura he revealed, he has the strength of the eighth level of Golden Core.”
“Furthermore, the way he looks at the person suspected to be a Nascent Soul True Monarch doesn’t seem feigned.”
After hearing this, Yun Long’s brow immediately knitted tightly:
“A Nascent Soul Cultivator, and you didn’t test him yourselves?”
Offering Priest Yang clasped his hands and said to Yun Long:
“We indeed wanted to test him, but as we were about to inquire, Li Qingqing stopped us.”
“Li Qingqing said that the person had just advanced to Nascent Soul and had encountered some accidents, so he couldn’t act rashly. We didn’t test him in order to avoid exposure.”
At this time, Offering Priest Luo also spoke up, adding:
“Yes…”
“And besides, the Black Kite that used to follow Li Qingqing, it has returned with them this time.”
After hearing this, Yun Long continued, asking:
“You said that person is a friend of Li Qingqing, right? What is his name, do you know?”
“We do…” Offering Priest Luo nodded and promptly responded.
“Li Qingqing calls him Brother Lin Jing, so his name must be Lin Jing…”
“Lin Jing…”
“Why does that name seem somewhat familiar?”
Yun Long frowned and then began to ponder.
A moment later.
Yun Long suddenly realized, and then said:
“Lin Jing…”
“I remember now.”
“It’s him, that mere ant.”
“Young Master, you know this person?” Offering Priest Luo asked, puzzled.
Yun Long let out a cold laugh and said:
“Hmph!”
“Of course, I know him. He was nothing but a mere ant in the past.”
After finishing, Yun Long looked at the two with undisguised scorn in his eyes:
“You say that he is a Nascent Soul True Monarch?”
Offering Priests Luo and Yang nodded repeatedly.
Yun Long then scoffed disdainfully:
“Before the Howling Sky Wolf Clan launched their massive invasion, I had seen him. At that time, he was just a Qi Refinement ant.”
“It has only been a few decades since then; how could he possibly have become a Nascent Soul True Monarch?”
“That’s simply impossible.”
“The cultivation technique I’m currently practicing is fast enough, isn’t it? Still, I’m only at the Golden Core Late Stage.”
“Unless I find another female cultivator at the Golden Core Stage for dual cultivation, I won’t be able to advance to the Golden Core Peak.”
“What skills or virtues does he possess that allow him to cultivate to the Nascent Soul Stage so quickly?”
After saying this, Yun Long looked up at the two and stated plainly:
“You two have been deceived by them.”
The two were extremely astonished upon hearing this.
“What?”
“The Qi Refinement Stage…”
“No wonder Li Qingqing said that he was not convenient to take action.”
“So they were bluffing all along.”
As they spoke, the two suddenly realized and then said:
“They managed to deceive even the two of us…”
“Doesn’t this mean that Li Qingqing has started to suspect us?”
However.
Yun Long showed no surprise but directly stated:
“Isn’t it normal for Li Qingqing to suspect you? After all, you have done so much for me; it’s normal to slip up sometimes.”
“And that Li Qingqing, she’s not simple either.”
“I don’t know where she has cultivated such abilities from. The Li Family was already falling apart, yet she managed to prop it up again.”
At this point, Yun Long suddenly grew contemplative and said:
“To tell the truth…”
“If she truly submits to me, I really want to take her as my concubine.”
“Setting aside her cultivation level, just her abilities alone would help me manage the Yun Family in the future.”
When Yun Long said this, his face rarely showed a hint of regret.
After a moment of reflection, Yun Long suddenly turned his head and looked at Luo and Yang, the two offering priests, and said:
“Right…”
“How goes the investigation I tasked you with, regarding Li Tangyu?”
“Didn’t Li Qingqing say that Li Tangyu is now a Nascent Soul True Monarch.”
“Is that true?”
The two shook their heads and then replied:
“We’ve looked into it as well, but found no evidence.”
Upon hearing this, Yun Long snorted coldly, and then spoke:
“Hmph!”
“It seems to be another bluff, a trivial show of force.”
“Li Qingqing really has perfected the art of deception.”
Then the two bowed and asked Yun Long:
“So, Young Master Yun, now that we have been exposed, what should we do next?”
Yun Long looked at them and said:
“Since they did not reveal you on the spot, act as if nothing has happened and return to the Li Family for now.”
“Wait a few days; after the ancestor returns from the Nanming Immortal Sect, I will make a trip to the Li Family.”
Offering Priest Luo and Offering Priest Yang looked at each other and then said:
“Does Young Master Yun intend to make a move against the Li Family?”
Yun Long nodded and replied:
“That’s right…”
“We should swallow the Li Family soon, and after we get the Inheritance Elixir Technique, we must send it to the Nanming Immortal Sect quickly…”
“The person at the Nanming Immortal Sect seems to be getting impatient.”
At this point, Yun Long sneered:
“And Li Qingqing…”
“If she knows what’s good for her, fine, but if not, she can’t blame me for being ruthless.”
“I just so happen to need a Golden Core female cultivator to help me break through to the Golden Core Peak.”
Luo, the Offering Priest, and Yang, the Offering Priest, exchanged a look, and then said in unison:
“Then let us congratulate Young Master Yun in advance.”
At this, Yun Long looked up at the two and then said:
“Whatever you two are thinking, don’t assume I am unaware.”
“Rest assured, the Yun Family will naturally keep the promise we made to you.”
“But after we obtain the Li Family’s properties, you surely haven’t forgotten what to do, have you?”
The two hurriedly nodded and said:
“Rest assured, Young Master Yun.”
“If we acquire the Li Family’s properties, we will certainly follow the lead of the Yun Family.”
Yun Long nodded, then said:
“Alright…”
“Go back for now. In a few days, once the ancestor returns from the Nanming Immortal Sect, we will commence our action.”
“Alright…”
…
Meanwhile, on Lin Jing’s side.
After more than half an hour had passed, Lin Jing finally woke up again.
As soon as Lin Jing regained consciousness, he immediately felt that his Divine Sense was somewhat different.
It seemed more solidified than before.
Moreover, awakening from that special state of enlightenment, Lin Jing seemed to have gained some new understanding of the world around him.
He felt that the world had become more real.
This feeling was as if he had been living in an illusion before, and the sudden insight.
Seemed to have brought him in touch with the real world.
This feeling was quite marvelous…
Just then, seeing Lin Jing awake, Li Qingqing and the other two hurried over.
“Lin Jing, how do you feel?” Li Qingqing asked with concern.
And at that moment, Lin Jue also asked:
“Brother…”
“Was that an epiphany just now?”
Ye Yun did not speak but also looked at him with inquiring eyes.
Lin Jing looked at the three and nodded, then said:
“I indeed had a different kind of enlightenment just now…”
After speaking, Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing and said:
“After this matter with the Yun Family is settled, I plan to stay here for a while and not go back to Li Yan Island.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing’s eyes suddenly lit up:
“Lin Jing…”
“Really?”
Lin Jing nodded.
“That’s great news.” Li Qingqing was overjoyed.
Lin Jing then looked at the small courtyard again.
Having reached that special state of enlightenment, Lin Jing had a sudden stroke of inspiration, sensing that his opportunity to reach Divinity Transformation might well lie within the Nanming Domain…

chapters.title: Chapter 578: 241: The Yun Family Conspiracy Revealed
chapters.content:
F{h*F5.*LjChapter 241: The Yun Family Conspiracy Revealed
Soon after, several people left the small courtyard.
Having left the courtyard, Lin Jing and his companions headed towards the Gathering Immortal Tower.
On the way to the Gathering Immortal Tower, Lin Jing also took the opportunity to ask Li Qingqing about some matters concerning the Demon Race Secret Realm.
After some inquiry, Lin Jing learned that the Demon Race Secret Realm had been sealed not long ago and was currently in a sealed state.
The reason for sealing the Demon Race Secret Realm, reportedly, was because the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, having suffered a loss, allied with other demon clans of the Western Demon Region and transported several demon cultivators at the Corporeal Refinement Stage in preparation for a counterattack.
To protect the Nanming Domain from further catastrophe, Corporeal Refinement cultivators from the Western Demon Region consulted with the three major sects and decided to seal the Demon Race Secret Realm again, trapping them within.
...
Moreover,
this time, the sealing was personally undertaken by two Corporeal Refinement cultivators supported by the Xingluo Elixir Sect and the Yuling Dao Sect, and it took a tremendous amount of effort to set up the seal.
Even with several Corporeal Refinement demon cultivators transported inside the Demon Race Secret Realm, they couldn’t break the seal for the time being.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but sigh deeply.
Originally, he had hoped to visit the Demon Race Secret Realm in a short while.
Huang Qingling and Elder Yu were still inside the Demon Race Secret Realm, and Lin Jing wanted to go in and check on them.
To see if he could once again reach the Qinghuang Palace.
Now, with the Demon Race Secret Realm being sealed again, even if Lin Jing wanted to enter, he was powerless to do so.
…
Afterward,
while walking and chatting, it didn’t take long for them to arrive at the Gathering Immortal Tower.
Upon arriving at the Gathering Immortal Tower, the shopkeeper immediately came out to greet them.
After all,
Li Qingqing was not only a Golden Core Immortal but also the current head of the Li Family.
The shopkeeper of the Gathering Immortal Tower naturally recognized her.
After exchanging a few pleasantries with the shopkeeper, Li Qingqing was led upstairs by the maids.
Li Qingqing chose a private room with a window facing the street.
Inside this room, opening the window provided a view of the street below.
One could enjoy the fine food while watching the bustling crowd on the street below, which was quite charming.
Once they entered the private room, Li Qingqing and Lin Jue had a pleasant conversation, while Lin Jing looked through the window at the street below.
Despite all the time that had passed, and though most things had changed, the lively atmosphere of Nanshan Market remained unchanged.
As usual, people were hurrying back and forth on the street, and some were engaged in lively discussions.
To better sense the familiar vitality of life, Lin Jing extended his Divine Sense while he watched.
At that moment,
inside a small shop directly across from the Gathering Immortal Tower, two Foundation Establishment cultivators were talking…
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense swept over them, but they didn’t notice it at all.
After all, there was an immense gap between them and Lin Jing; they simply couldn’t detect his probing.
The topic of their conversation soon caught Lin Jing’s attention.
Lin Jing then focused his mind, paying attention to their discussion.
One of the yellow-robed cultivators began, saying,
“Zhao brother…”
“Have you heard? Since the Demon Race Secret Realm has been sealed, those remaining Howling Sky Wolf Clan demon cultivators have become increasingly rampant.”
The other, dressed in black, nodded and replied,
“Of course, I’ve heard… I heard that recently many cultivators outside the city have been attacked, and even many female cultivators have just disappeared.”
“I’ve heard that some demon cultivators from the Howling Sky Wolf Clan are licentious by nature, specifically abducting those female cultivators for their own pleasure.”
The yellow-robed cultivator nodded and added,
“Yes… I’ve also heard that those Howling Sky Wolf Clan demon cultivators are incredibly wild and have even gone to several Fang Markets outside Immortal City to abduct people.”
“It’s said that a few days ago, a female Golden Core cultivator from the Qingyuan Sword Sect stationed in Hongtong Fang Market was captured by a demon cultivator from the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.”
“It’s been several days now, and she is still missing.”
“I’m afraid the chances for that Golden Core lady are slim. Although she has the cultivation of the Golden Core Stage, there are several powerful Golden Core demon cultivators in the Night Mist Mountain Range.”
The black-robed cultivator glanced cautiously around before whispering,
“I just received some news not long ago, the Golden Core woman from the Qingyuan Sword Sect has been found.”
“It is said that a Golden Core from the Yun Family, while exterminating the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, discovered her in one of their dens.”
At this point, the black-robed cultivator leaned in closer to the yellow-robed one and whispered,
“I also heard that the Golden Core woman had just advanced in her cultivation recently and was a descendant of an elder with the surname Wang from the Qingyuan Sword Sect, who was about to advance to the Nascent Soul Stage…”
“They say that when the Golden Core woman was found, she was completely unclothed and had been dead for some time, and from the marks on her body, it seemed she was tortured to death after having her cultivation drained.”
“I’ve heard that those from the Howling Sky Wolf Clan are extremely brutal, and they actually…”
…
…
Upon hearing this, the yellow-robed cultivator was shocked and exclaimed,
“They’re that cruel?”
The loud shock in the yellow-robed cultivator’s voice made several passersby who were walking by the shop look over in curiosity.
The yellow-robed cultivator quickly closed his mouth,
and the passersby on the street naturally didn’t pay them much attention and soon left.
Only then did the yellow-robed cultivator whisper,
“Are those demon cultivators from the Howling Sky Wolf Clan really that cruel?”

chapters.title: Chapter 579: 241 Yun Family's Conspiracy Revealed_2
chapters.content:
F{h*F5.*
LjChapter 241 Yun Family’s Conspiracy Revealed_2
The black-robed cultivator glanced at him and spoke softly,
“You think that’s just any group? That’s the Howling Sky Wolf Clan…”
“They say that the Golden Core female cultivator is the most beloved junior of Elder Wang. Seeing the tragic state of his junior, he nearly succumbed to madness on the spot. Fortunately, the other Elders of the Qingyuan Sword Sect were there to help him stabilize.
Otherwise, he would have likely gone mad right there, beyond all hope of recovery.”
After hearing this, the yellow-robed cultivator couldn’t help but sigh,
“Anyone who went through that would probably not be able to bear it.”
...
“Especially when it’s the most beloved junior. I guess this calamity might have damaged his cultivation as well.”
The black-robed cultivator nodded and said,
“It is said that although Elder Wang had help and didn’t completely succumb to madness, his mental state has nonetheless fallen. Advancing to Nascent Soul is now hopeless, and he will probably remain at the Golden Core Peak.”
The yellow-robed cultivator shook his head and said,
“Alas, what a pity…”
“Otherwise, it wouldn’t be long before the Qingyuan Sword Sect gained another Nascent Soul True Monarch.”
The black-robed cultivator seemed unconcerned,
“So what if he is a Nascent Soul True Monarch? It’s of no concern to us anyway.”
“I’m just expressing my sentiments…” the yellow-robed cultivator began to say.
In the middle of speaking, the yellow-robed cultivator suddenly changed the subject and then looked at the black-robed cultivator,
“By the way…”
“Shouldn’t this information be confidential? Where did you get it from? Also, I’ve noticed that your information has been increasingly accurate lately.”
The black-robed cultivator looked at the yellow-robed cultivator, chuckled, and said,
“Heavenly Secrets Association, have you ever heard of it?”
“Of course…” The yellow-robed cultivator nodded upon hearing this.
“Could it be that you bought this information from the Heavenly Secrets Association?”
“Information from the Heavenly Secrets Association doesn’t come cheap.”
The black-robed cultivator chuckled and then proceeded to say,
“I can’t afford information from the Heavenly Secrets Association.”
“I’ve just been helping the Heavenly Secrets Association with some work, gathering information for them or verifying the authenticity of certain information.”
“By working for the Heavenly Secrets Association, naturally, I can get my hands on some information from inside the association, which, relatively speaking, isn’t of very high value.”
Upon hearing this, the yellow-robed cultivator was very surprised,
“So that’s how it is…”
“I just wonder if there’s a chance for me to join the Heavenly Secrets Association?”
The black-robed cultivator said,
“Of course, there’s no problem. Otherwise, why do you think I’m telling you all this?”
“The Heavenly Secrets Association has just arrived in the Nanming Domain not long ago and is currently expanding. They are in need of people like us to gather information for them.”
“As long as you help gather information, you can get some rewards from the Heavenly Secrets Association, such as Spirit Stones, Magical Treasures, Elixir Medicines, Cultivation Techniques, among other cultivation resources.”
“All we have to do is join the Heavenly Secrets Association and become one of their peripheral members.”
After hearing this, the yellow-robed cultivator asked,
“Do I have to join the Heavenly Secrets Association to get rewards?”
“If I have some very important information, can I choose not to join the Heavenly Secrets Association and just sell the information to them?”
The black-robed cultivator said,
“Of course, you can…”
“If you have any special information, you can also seek out the Heavenly Secrets Association for a transaction. As long as the association confirms the accuracy of the information, they will certainly reward you.”
“Now I understand…” the yellow-robed cultivator said.
Then, the yellow-robed cultivator gave a fist salute and said,
“Brother Zhao…”
“Please take care of the matter of joining the Heavenly Secrets Association for me.”
The black-robed cultivator replied,
“Don’t worry, I’ve got this handled…”
Lin Jing stopped paying attention to the rest of their conversation and began to ponder deeply…
At this moment, Lin Jue noticed that Lin Jing seemed distracted and called out to him,
“Bro…”
“Are you alright?”
Lin Jing came back to his senses and then said,
“I’m fine…”
After speaking, Lin Jing turned to ask Li Qingqing,
“Qingqing…”
“Earlier, when your grandfather took us to the Demon Race Secret Realm, wasn’t there an Elder Wang from the Qingyuan Sword Sect? I remember he’s your grandfather’s good friend, right?”
Li Qingqing nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“Elder Wang is indeed my grandfather’s good friend.”
“How is he doing now?” Lin Jing continued to ask.
Li Qingqing replied,
“Elder Wang has been assigned to another Immortal City, he’s probably busy. I’ve been tied up with family affairs lately and haven’t had a chance to visit him. It’s been quite some time.”
Lin Jing nodded and then briefly recounted the information he had just overheard, sharing it with Li Qingqing.
After listening, Li Qingqing fell silent for a while then spoke,
“Qingyuan Sword Sect elder with the surname Wang, there are three, and among them, two have descendants.”
“I also don’t know if it’s him…”
“Once the matter with the Yun Family is settled, I’ll go see him…”
Next, the food was served, and the group began to eat.
However, during the meal, Li Qingqing seemed somewhat distracted.
Lin Jing naturally understood what Li Qingqing was worried about.
The meal ended quickly.
After eating, they returned to the Li Family.
…
Since returning from the Drunken Immortal Pavilion, for the following several days, Lin Jing and the others did not go out.
Offering Priest Luo and Offering Priest Yang, as usual, attended to their own matters.
However.
During those few days, they tried to make contact with Lin Jing several times, attempting to probe Lin Jing’s cultivation.
Nevertheless, each time they were blocked by Li Qingqing.
Lin Jue once asked Li Qingqing why not let Lin Jing display his cultivation, to intimidate the two priests and deter them from any rash actions.
Li Qingqing then explained to Lin Jue.
If they were truly loyal to the Li Family, they would naturally know what they should do, but if the two harbored ulterior motives, even if they got through this difficulty, they would still betray the Li Family the next time.
It’s better to take this opportunity to clear them out of the Li Family once and for all.
And so, several more days passed.
Then one day, Elder Jin found Li Qingqing.
And informed her that Li Qingqing’s third uncle, together with Offering Priests Luo and Yang, had gone to the Yun Family.
Upon receiving this news, they all knew that they were probably preparing to take action.
As expected.
Before long, Offering Priest Luo hurried back.
After returning, Offering Priest Luo directly went to see Li Qingqing.
Then, not much later, Li Qingqing sent someone to call for Lin Jing to discuss matters in the great hall.
When Lin Jing arrived, Li Qingqing and Offering Priest Luo were already there.
Elder Jin was also standing by the side.
As soon as Lin Jing stepped into the council hall, Offering Priest Luo took the initiative to speak:
“Senior Lin…”
“Qingqing’s third uncle is in trouble?”
Lin Jing, puzzled, asked:
“What happened?”
At that moment, Li Qingqing also spoke:
“Uncle Luo, please tell Lin Jing about it…”
Offering Priest Luo nodded and then began to recount to Lin Jing.
In Offering Priest Luo’s account, he and Li Qingqing’s uncle had gone out, initially planning to handle some matters at the Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion.
However, unexpectedly, Li Qingqing’s uncle encountered a junior from the Yun Family on the way.
Because the junior was disrespectful toward Li Qingqing, her uncle, unable to stand by, taught him a lesson.
But unexpectedly, Yun Long was also nearby.
Seeing his family’s junior being bullied, Yun Long naturally could not stand by and immediately captured Li Qingqing’s third uncle.
He asked Offering Priest Luo to relay a message: if Li Qingqing wanted to save her third uncle, she needed to personally go to the Yun Family and apologize.
Otherwise, the Yun Family would take matters into their own hands and deal with Li Qingqing’s third uncle themselves.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing knew that it was a scheme of the Yun Family.
Even though it was the Yun Family’s scheme, Li Qingqing could not ignore it.
After all.
No matter what, that was Li Qingqing’s third uncle.
Even though she suspected collusion between him and the Yun Family, without evidence, in the eyes of others, he was still Li Qingqing’s third uncle.
Therefore, for the Li Family, it’s likely that Li Qingqing had to go this time.
Otherwise, if Li Qingqing dared not go to the Yun Family and let her third uncle be dealt with by others,
it would dishearten many people.
The Li Family could become disunited because of this, and possibly even fall apart.
Li Qingqing had always held the Li Family in high esteem and naturally would not allow this to happen.
After Offering Priest Luo finished speaking, he then directly said:
“Senior Lin…”
“Going to the Yun Family rashly might not be safe.”
“How about you accompany the family head, Senior Lin, on a trip to the Yun Family?
“With the senior present, I believe the Yun Family will certainly not make things difficult for Family Head Qingqing.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said:
“No problem!”
Lin Jing’s forthright response surprised Offering Priest Luo.
But in a moment, he recovered.
Offering Priest Luo then smiled and said:
“That’s wonderful, we’ll be troubling Senior Lin then…”

chapters.title: Chapter 580: 242: Testing
chapters.content:
Chapter 580: Chapter 242: Testing
Li Qingqing glanced at Offering Priest Luo before speaking:
“Uncle Luo…”
“You go back and get ready first, I have something to discuss with Brother Lin Jing, and later you’ll join us for a trip to the Yun Family.”
Offering Priest Luo nodded and said:
“All right, Family Head!”
After saying that, Offering Priest Luo left first.
...
Once Offering Priest Luo had left, Li Qingqing then spoke, asking Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin Jing…”
“Do you think that my Third Uncle could be colluding with them?”
Lin Jing replied:
“Let’s not think too much for now, we’ll talk after we arrive at the Yun Family.”
Li Qingqing nodded…
Next.
The two didn’t keep Offering Priest Luo waiting for too long, not even half an hour had passed before both were ready.
Afterward.
Li Qingqing, along with Lin Jing and Offering Priest Luo, set out towards the Yun Family.
For this trip to the Yun Family, only the three of them went, without notifying anyone else, nor did they take Lin Jue and Ye Yun with them.
After all.
Lin Jing possessed a cultivation at the Nascent Soul Stage, and even if there were any plots against them, as long as Lin Jing was present, there would be nothing to worry about.
Being prominent families within the same district of Nanshan Immortal City, the Li Family and Yun Family’s residences weren’t too far from one another.
Before long, the trio arrived at the Yun Family.
Upon arriving, Shopkeeper Luo explained the situation, and then a steward from the Yun Family came out to greet them, leading Lin Jing and his party into the Yun Family’s compound.
After entering the Yun Family, the steward led the way, with Lin Jing and his companions following behind, heading towards the Yun Family’s inner court.
As soon as he entered the Yun Family, Lin Jing felt a faint trace of Divine Sense enveloping the group.
Lin Jing immediately understood that it must be the Yun Family ancestor who was currently extending his Divine Sense, surveilling every move they made.
Although he was trying hard to hide it, Lin Jing could still clearly sense its presence.
Apart from this Divine Sense, the entire Yun Family compound was imbued with a strange aura, somewhat reminiscent of Demonic Qi.
This special aura was much more concealed than the Divine Sense that enveloped them, and if Lin Jing’s own Divine Sense had not been so powerful, he would surely not have noticed it.
Lin Jing, while walking, casually looked around as if completely unaware of this.
Lin Jing did not make any rash moves.
Instead, he continued to follow the Yun Family steward deeper inside.
Thus, the three of them followed the steward through the compound, eventually arriving at a hall that seemed to be used for receiving guests.
After bringing the three of them in, the steward then said to Lin Jing and his companions:
“The young master is currently busy, please wait here for a moment…”
After speaking, the steward summoned two maids to attend to Lin Jing and the others, then left the room himself.
After the steward had left, Offering Priest Luo seemed a bit restless.
He moved closer to Li Qingqing before speaking:
“Family Head…”
“What do you think they mean by this? Just leaving us here like this?”
Li Qingqing was very calm, directly saying:
“Offering Priest Luo, stay calm and do not be agitated!”
Meanwhile, Lin Jing, after taking his seat upon entering, began to close his eyes to rest, seemingly indifferent to whatever was about to unfold.
While Lin Jing was resting with his eyes closed, that Divine Sense did not linger for too long before it was withdrawn.
As soon as the Divine Sense receded, Lin Jing’s own Divine Sense stretched out.
He quickly found the steward who had just left them, and surreptitiously left a trace of Divine Sense on him.
Lin Jing kept his Divine Sense on that mark, following the steward as he continued to probe into the Yun Family’s inner court.
The reason Lin Jing did this was two-fold: one was to find out what exactly was wrong with the Li Family that was making him uneasy,
and the other was concerning Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle.
He followed the steward with his Divine Sense in hopes of potentially locating Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle and overhearing their conversation.
After all, it was still unclear whether Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle had truly betrayed the Li Family.
Lin Jing hoped to uncover some information through the steward.
In this manner, Lin Jing followed the steward for quite a distance until he eventually arrived in front of the Yun Family’s inner court.
The inner court of the Yun Family was different from that of the Li Family.
The Yun Family had actually set up a Formation within their inner court, and it was a Fifth-Rank Defensive Array at that.
This Formation was capable of defense and also had the ability to obstruct Divine Sense.
The moment the steward entered the inner court, the Divine Sense mark that Lin Jing had left on him instantly dissipated.
Lin Jing’s own probing Divine Sense was pushed back, blocked outside of the Formation.
There was something very off about the Yun Family.
Having set up a Formation within their own home was one thing, but for it to be of such a high level that it could even block the Divine Sense of someone at the Nascent Soul Stage was quite another.
With the Yun Family ancestor currently there, it was obviously not necessary for Lin Jing to probe any further.
Forcefully continuing to investigate could potentially trigger the array’s response, alerting them and causing more problems than it would solve, so he decided it was better to simply give up for now.
After Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense…
The steward who had led them, upon entering the inner court, walked quite a distance further.
He went all the way to the doorway of a courtyard deep within the complex, which was different from the other courtyards.
This area wasn’t just protected by its own separate Formation but was also guarded by two people.
When the steward arrived at the entrance of the courtyard, he said to one of the Cultivators guarding the door:
“Please inform the young master that Li Qingqing from the Li Family has arrived…”

chapters.title: Chapter 581: 242: A Probe_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 581: Chapter 242: A Probe_2
And the cultivator guarding that place spoke up:
“The young master is currently cultivating, let them leave first,”
“Besides…”
“This time calling them here was merely a test.”
“Before the young master began his training, he had already made arrangements, that after a few days he will personally visit the Li Family, so they should prepare themselves.”
“Alright, I will return now and notify them.”
...
The housekeeper nodded and then directly turned around and left.
As for the two cultivators, they did not pay any more attention to him, continuing to faithfully guard the front of the courtyard.
Lin Jing and the others did not wait too long before the housekeeper came back, and spoke directly to Lin Jing and the other two:
“Our young master is currently cultivating and it is inconvenient for him to meet with you.”
“You should leave for now.”
“The young master said that, in a few days, he will personally visit the Li Family regarding today’s matter; you should prepare yourselves in advance.”
As these words were spoken, the housekeeper’s expression was quite arrogant, as if he did not put Lin Jing and his party in his eyes at all.
Offering Priest Luo became angry on the spot:
“What do you mean by this?”
“Our family head has already come in person, and yet your Yun Family dares to leave us hanging like this?”
Li Qingqing also frowned slightly.
However, she did not say anything but looked towards Lin Jing.
And it was at this moment that Lin Jing spoke up, saying:
“If that’s the case, then we should leave for now.”
Offering Priest Luo was startled for a moment, and then looked at Lin Jing with some surprise:
“Senior Lin…”
“Are we just going to leave like this?”
Lin Jing nodded.
Seeing this, Li Qingqing did not say any more but spoke up directly:
“Then let’s do that, we’ll leave first.”
After speaking, without waiting for Offering Priest Luo to say anything else, she stood up first and walked outside.
And Lin Jing also followed behind Li Qingqing and went out.
Offering Priest Luo, with no other choice, shook his head and also followed behind Lin Jing and left.
As the group stood up and left, Lin Jing once again felt that Divine Sense sweeping over him.
That must have been a test by the Yun Family patriarch.
Yet Lin Jing acted as if he hadn’t noticed, with no unusual behavior, continuing to follow Li Qingqing and walking out.
Before long, the three of them left the Yun Family.
And the Divine Sense that had enveloped them also withdrew.
After they came out from the Yun Family, Offering Priest Luo was the first to bid farewell to Li Qingqing, stating he had other matters to attend to.
Naturally, Li Qingqing agreed.
After Offering Priest Luo had left, Li Qingqing couldn’t help but express her curiosity to Lin Jing:
“Why did we leave earlier?”
Lin Jing replied:
“There’s something off about the Yun Family.”
Li Qingqing, puzzled:
“Something off?”
“Could it be dangerous?”
Lin Jing thought for a moment and said:
“When we entered the Yun Family just now, there was a Divine Sense examining our every move.”
“That Divine Sense has reached the Nascent Soul Stage, it must be that Yun Family patriarch.”
“Of course, that’s only one thing.”
“Additionally, the entire Yun Family also seemed somewhat off.”
“I think it’s better to investigate first before saying anything…”
After saying this, Lin Jing turned to Li Qingqing and said:
“Qingqing, you go back first.”
“Hmm…” Li Qingqing nodded.
“Lin Jing, be careful.”
Lin Jing smiled and said:
“Don’t worry…”
“The entire Yun Family combined is not my match, what’s most important is the Nanming Immortal Sect behind the Yun Family.”
After Li Qingqing had left, Lin Jing did not choose to leave.
Instead, he took a detour and found a secluded place not far from the Yun Family, and entered the System Space.
Since the Yun Family was protected by that great Formation, if Lin Jing wanted to investigate without alarming them, it would definitely be more appropriate to use Observation Mode.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode.
After entering Observation Mode, Lin Jing continued probing towards the Yun Family under Observation Mode.
However, as soon as Lin Jing’s probe touched the Yun Family, he detected a person.
It was the Offering Priest Luo who had just been with Lin Jing and the others.
At this moment, Offering Priest Luo was conversing with the butler from before.
“Second Steward…”
“What is going on with Young Master Yun Long, wasn’t he supposed to be bringing over Li Qingqing?”
“How come after I brought Li Qingqing here, they immediately let them go?”
The butler began to speak:
“This was merely a test by the young master.”
Upon hearing this, Offering Priest Luo immediately said:
“The young master is being too cautious.”
“I’ve said before, that Lin Jing is definitely posing as someone else, he surely doesn’t have Nascent Soul Stage cultivation.”
At this point, Offering Priest Luo’s face was full of contempt:
“Given his performance today, surely the Second Steward also saw it, with the way he acted, he doesn’t resemble a Nascent Soul True Monarch in the least.”
“If he were truly a Nascent Soul True Monarch, he probably would have turned hostile on the spot.”
The Second Steward, with a calm expression on his face, straightforwardly said:
“This is the young master’s decision, there’s no need for you to worry about it.”
After listening, Offering Priest Luo was left speechless.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing decided not to continue eavesdropping any further.
Following that.
Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode to probe deeper into the Yun Family’s inner courtyard.
With such tight security in the Yun Family’s inner courtyard, there must be secrets unknown to the public.
Lin Jing, using the Observation Mode, arrived at the inner courtyard of the Yun Family and proceeded to investigate several courtyards in succession, finding nothing out of the ordinary.
However, after exploring these courtyards, Lin Jing raised the perspective of Observation Mode and noticed there was a courtyard within the deepest part of the inner courtyard, protected by a Formation.
Seeing this courtyard, Lin Jing immediately understood…
He must have found the target of his search.
Afterward, Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode to probe towards that courtyard.
At the entrance of this courtyard, there were two cultivators standing guard.
As Lin Jing probed through, a voice emerged from within the courtyard.
“Someone…”
Upon hearing this, the two cultivators immediately took out a Token from their bodies and stuck it onto the Formation.
Following that.
With a wave of ripples, the Formation became elusive, and then the two men, holding the Token, directly passed through the Formation and entered.
Lin Jing followed the two men inside as well.
Once inside the courtyard, Lin Jing saw a square hall in the center of this courtyard.
The entire hall was enveloped by the courtyard’s internal Formation, and atop this Formation, there were red, slightly eerie threads being funneled into the hall.
The doors to the hall were already open.
Inside the hall was a huge Formation, with a person sitting in the middle of it.
That person was Yun Long.
Apart from Yun Long, there was also a female cultivator lying motionless at one side, completely nude.
This female cultivator appeared to have gone through inhuman torture, as there wasn’t an inch of her body that was intact.
However, she was still alive, not dead yet.
Through Observation Mode, Lin Jing could even clearly see the slight movements of her eyelashes.
But after the two of them entered,
they directly produced a piece of black cloth and swiftly wrapped up the female cultivator with it.
Then.
They immediately lifted the wrapped woman and left.
After the two left, they carried the woman behind the grand hall.
Thereafter, the two took out the Token they had used before, performed a set of hand seals in the void, and then the Token emitted a bright light. After the bright light passed, a hole appeared instantly.
When the hole appeared, the two men frowned and then quickly removed the black cloth from the female cultivator’s body, lifted the woman they had just wrapped, and threw her into the hole.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Jing was very curious, so he controlled the Observation Mode to peer into the hole.
Following the hole inside, Lin Jing suddenly discovered that it led to a very large blood pool.
Inside the blood pool were numerous female cultivators’ corpses—how many, Lin Jing couldn’t tell…
But from what Lin Jing could see, there were at least dozens.
Some of these bodies were intact, while others were decomposed and looked extremely horrifying.
Above the blood pool was a Formation.
This Formation seemed to be constantly absorbing the malevolent energy from the blood pool, transferring it to somewhere else.
Lin Jing looked upward and then directly controlled the perspective to pass through that Formation.
Afterwards, he went through the blood pool below and appeared within the grand hall.
So it turned out that the blood pool was connected to the Formation inside the grand hall.
And the malevolent force accumulated in that blood pool was naturally supplied to the Formation within the grand hall.
Moreover.
At this time, the Formation inside the grand hall was flashing with red light, and Yun Long was sitting in the middle of the grand hall’s Formation, his eyes closed as he cultivated…

chapters.title: Chapter 582: 243: Inquiring about News
chapters.content:
Chapter 582: Chapter 243: Inquiring about News
However, within a mere moment, Yun Long had absorbed the red glow and then opened his eyes…
At this time, the red glow in Yun Long’s eyes appeared and disappeared intermittently.
The aura surrounding his body had also become extremely sinister and strange.
Some time passed, and the red glow in Yun Long’s eyes completely vanished, along with the aura around his body.
After the aura disappeared, the cultivation aura on Yun Long’s body burst forth; clearly, it had become several degrees mightier than before.
At this time.
...
The two cultivators had finished dealing with the female cultivator and came back from the back of the great hall.
After the two returned, they clasped their hands towards Yun Long and said:
“Young Master…”
“Just now, while you were cultivating, the Second Steward came to report that Li Qingqing had already visited.”
“We delivered the message you told us to give him, as previously instructed by you, Young Master.”
Upon hearing this, Yun Long nodded.
“Okay…”
“I know.”
“You two stand guard here, I need to step out for a moment.”
After saying this, Yun Long walked out.
Seeing Yun Long leaving, Lin Jing soon controlled the observation perspective and followed along.
After leaving the small courtyard, Yun Long skirted around the yard and continued towards the deeper parts of the Yun Family’s inner residence. Before long, he arrived at a secluded corner in the inner court and entered another slightly shabby courtyard.
This courtyard, unlike the one where Yun Long resided, contained only a flower garden and a lone room in the center of the yard.
That was all there was.
Upon entering the courtyard, Yun Long approached the front of the room.
He bowed respectfully towards the room:
“Old Ancestor…”
As Yun Long finished speaking, the door of the room automatically swung open, and then a voice came forth from inside.
“Come in…”
Then.
Yun Long got up and stepped inside.
Lin Jing, controlling the observational view, also followed in.
Inside the room, Lin Jing scanned the area and saw that there were not many items inside.
A table, two chairs, and a somewhat old bed.
These were all the furnishings within the room.
In the center of the room sat an old man with white hair and beard, sitting on a chair, holding a carving knife in one hand and a piece of wood of unknown material in the other.
Bowing his head, he was engrossed in his carving.
This wood carving was mostly completed; its overall contours were already evident, and it appeared to be the figure of a person.
After entering the room, Yun Long clasped his hands again and said to the old man:
“Old Ancestor…”
“With Li Qingqing’s arrival, I presume you’ve already been informed, Old Ancestor.”
As it turned out, this old man was indeed the Yun Family Old Ancestor.
The Yun Family Old Ancestor, without lifting his head, spoke directly:
“I’ve been informed; there’s nothing remarkable about it…”
Yun Long then asked:
“What about Lin Jing, what cultivation level is he really at?”
“Is it truly Nascent Soul?”
The Yun Family Old Ancestor did not reply but picked up the carving knife and continued to carve into the wood for a while…
After finishing the carving, the Yun Family Old Ancestor blew out a breath of air, blowing off the wood shavings from the wood.
Once the wood shavings were gone, the carving took shape.
It was a lifelike, human-shaped wood carving with clear and discernible facial lines.
And this wooden carving depicted none other than Lin Jing.
The Yun Family Old Ancestor looked over the wood carving and then spoke:
“Although I did not expend much effort, it should be sufficient to deal with a mid-stage Golden Core cultivator.”
The tone of the Yun Family Old Ancestor was casual, as if he had only undertaken a trivial task.
After finishing speaking, the Yun Family Old Ancestor lifted his head.
He directly tossed the wood carving to Yun Long.
Yun Long hurriedly caught the carving and then carefully put it away.
The Yun Family Old Ancestor then spoke again:
“In a few days, go to the Li Family by yourself.”
“The Li Family doesn’t have anyone who could threaten you.”
Yun Long nodded and then clasped his hands:
“I understand, Old Ancestor…”
“Please rest assured, Old Ancestor; in a few days, I will surely acquire the Li Family’s Inheritance Elixir Technique for you.”
The Yun Family Old Ancestor nodded slightly.
Then.
He raised his head again, looking towards Yun Long in front of him.
Yun Long immediately sensed something amiss and quickly spoke up:
“Old Ancestor, may I ask if you have further instructions?”
The Yun Family Old Ancestor then said:
“Our Yun Family, although not weak, still needs to rely on Nanming Immortal Sect for reassurance. Whatever we do, we must consider the Nanming Immortal Sect’s stance and not bring trouble down upon them…”
“Do you understand?”
With these words, the Yun Family Old Ancestor’s gaze was penetrating as it focused on Yun Long.
Yun Long immediately bowed his head and clasped his hands:
“Old Ancestor, I understand…”
However, no sooner had Yun Long spoken when the Yun Family Old Ancestor’s aura surged, and that chilling gaze had already shot over.
Yun Long broke out in a cold sweat and dropped to his knees on the ground.
The Yun Family Old Ancestor’s face was icy as he looked at Yun Long:
“I allowed you to cultivate those Demonic Techniques; do you think you’ve become so powerful that you no longer need to take me into account?”
Yun Long hastily defended himself:
“Old Ancestor, Yun Long wouldn’t dare…”
The Yun Family Old Ancestor snorted coldly:
“Humph!”
“Not dare?”
“Even the Qingyuan Sword Sect you dared to provoke, what wouldn’t you dare to do?”
“Do you know the consequences of provoking the Qingyuan Sword Sect?”
Yun Long raised his head to look at the Yun Family Old Ancestor and hurriedly explained:
“Old Ancestor…”
“The matter with the Qingyuan Sword Sect was an act of desperation.”
“At that time, I was just visiting Fang Market to take care of some business when I happened to experience a breakthrough. My Demonic Techniques became uncontrollable, the Yin Sha aura surged, and I could not suppress it.”
“This is why she noticed me.”
“If I had left her be, she would surely have reported it to the Qingyuan Sword Sect, and then they would definitely take action to investigate.”
“By that time, it would have been too late.”
“That is why I took preemptive action.”

chapters.title: Chapter 583: 243: Inquiring about News_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 583: Chapter 243: Inquiring about News_2
“I beg father to kidnap her, then silence her forever, and blame it on the Howling Sky Wolf Clan of the Night Mist Mountain Range.”
After speaking, Yun Long’s expression was sincere as he continued to add:
“Ancestor…”
“Our Yun Family has come this far with great difficulty, and I cannot let this incident doom our family.”
“If they find out we have this Demonic Technique in our hands, they will definitely not let our Yun Family off.”
Hearing Yun Long’s defense, the complexion of the Yun Family’s old ancestor eased considerably, and his imposing aura receded as well.
...
“Alright, stand up.”
“Your father has already explained it to me.”
“Otherwise…”
“Do you think you’d still be able to stand here unharmed?”
Upon hearing this, Yun Long breathed a sigh of relief, then respectfully stood up.
Looking up at Yun Long, who stood respectfully, the Yun Family’s old ancestor spoke again:
“Your handling of the situation, although a last resort, has ultimately covered up the incident.”
“However…”
“Because of this, it has caused panic outside, so for the next while, you should keep a low profile and stop kidnapping people.”
“You’ve kidnapped so many, it has already alerted the three major Sects, who have begun to investigate the matter.”
Yun Long was startled for a moment, then asked:
“Ancestor…”
“Then what should I do next?”
“If I don’t kidnap people, how can I improve my cultivation?”
The Yun Family’s old ancestor looked at Yun Long and then said:
“For now, take care of the Li Family’s matter first. After that is done, I plan to send you to the Demonic Monster Sea.”
“Within the Demonic Monster Sea, there are many Demon Cultivators and Demon Cultivators, and moreover, the territory of the Demonic Monster Sea is much larger than the Nanming Domain.”
“There, with many Cultivators, even if some go missing, it will not attract attention. You practicing this technique will surely be more appropriate there.”
“As long as you can successfully break through to Divinity Transformation, our Yun Family will no longer have to be subservient to others.”
“If you advance beyond Divinity Transformation, our Yun Family will become the foremost noble family controlling the entire Nanming Domain.”
After hearing this, Yun Long quickly bowed and said:
“Ancestor, I understand.”
The Yun Family’s old ancestor nodded, then continued to instruct Yun Long:
“Alright…”
“You may leave now.”
“In a few days, the matter with the Li Family will be entirely up to you.”
“The Li Family doesn’t have a Nascent Soul; they pose no threat to you. You must handle this matter well for me.”
Yun Long bowed quickly and said:
“Rest assured, Ancestor.”
“I will handle this matter well.”
The Yun Family’s old ancestor nodded, and then gestured with his hand…
Seeing this, Yun Long promptly bowed and then slowly exited the room.
After Yun Long left, the room’s door automatically closed.
Yun Long then bowed toward the room and left the courtyard; upon exiting the courtyard, he turned and departed from there.
After Yun Long left, Lin Jing followed behind, continuing his observation.
Next,
Yun Long met with the Offering Priest Luo, and after chatting for a few moments, they went together to see Li Qingqing’s third uncle.
Li Qingqing’s third uncle.
was forcibly controlled by the Yun Family.
In Observation Mode, Lin Jing listened to their conversation and understood that Li Qingqing’s third uncle had not colluded with the Yun Family.
He was deceived by Offering Priest Luo and Offering Priest Yang, merely being used by the Yun Family.
Indeed, Li Qingqing’s third uncle was originally an incapable fool.
He was fine for indulgence in eating, drinking, and merrymaking.
But if he were to commit these acts of betraying the Li Family, with his intelligence, he couldn’t manage it at all.
Although Li Qingqing’s third uncle was controlled by the Yun Family, his life was not in danger, Lin Jing did not bother further.
After some more investigation, with no further gains,
Lin Jing ended his observation.
After ending the observation, Lin Jing left the System Space and headed toward the Li Family, organizing the information he had obtained along the way.
The Yun Family’s affair involved the Nanming Immortal Sect and Qingyuan Sword Sect, complicating the matter significantly.
Having sorted out the situation, Lin Jing decided to return to the Li Family first to discuss the matter with Li Qingqing.
Upon returning to the Li Family, Lin Jing went straight to Li Qingqing, and when he relayed the information he had gathered,
Li Qingqing was shocked and speechless.
After all, the matter of Cultivators disappearing had been causing quite a stir recently, and naturally, Li Qingqing had also heard about it.
Many of these missing cultivators’ disappearances were blamed on the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, but it was unexpected that the Yun Family was behind it all.
The Yun Family had one Nascent Soul, and three Golden Cores.
They were formidable, and the family’s influence was significant.
It wouldn’t be an overstatement to call them the number one family of Nanshan Immortal City.
If this matter were to be exposed,
it would likely not only affect the Yun Family but also the Nanming Immortal Sect backing them.
After all, it was common knowledge that the Yun Family was supported by one of the three great sects, the Nanming Immortal Sect.
If this incident were exposed, it’s feared that without the need for others to intervene, the Nanming Immortal Sect would act in its own interests and clean up the Yun Family.
After discussing with Li Qingqing, Lin Jing decided to let this information out.
However…
Although they needed to disclose this, it could not come directly from the mouths of the Li Family or Lin Jing; they needed to have someone else spread the word.
After all, the Li Family still needed to establish itself in the Nanming Domain.
They could not rashly offend one of the three great sects of the Nanming Domain, the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Moreover,
the person spreading the news had to have certain influence for it to be credible.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing immediately thought of an organization…
The Heavenly Secrets Association.
