But now, with the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, their enhanced aptitude could take their cultivation journey further, perhaps even leading them to greater distances.
Lin Jing did not consider himself a saint, but for his close friends, he would help as much as he could.
Continual companionship on his journey was a kind of happiness in itself.
…
Afterward, Lin Jing spoke to the two,
“Both of your Spirit Root Aptitudes have successfully improved, which is excellent…”
“Next…”
“We should discuss the matter of that Demon Cultivator.”
Hearing Lin Jing bring up the Demon Cultivator again, both Li Qingqing and Ye Yun turned serious.
Li Qingqing then asked,
“Lin Jing, do you know that Demon Cultivator?”
Lin Jing pondered for a moment, then nodded and said,
“Yes…”
“If I am not mistaken, the Demon Cultivator who injured Ye Yun should be Yun Long, the Young Master of the Yun Family.”
“Ah…?”
“Yun Long…” Li Qingqing looked incredulous.
Ye Yun’s brow furrowed as well.
Ye Yun was obviously aware of Yun Long.
“Wasn’t the Yun Family already dealt with by the three major sects?
Why would Yun Long still appear?”
“Lin Jing, could you be mistaken?” Li Qingqing asked doubtfully.
Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“The Demonic Qi in the wounds on Ye Yun is too familiar to me.
When I visited the Yun Family before, I saw Yun Long casting Demonic Techniques, and it was exactly this type of Demonic Qi.”
“Furthermore, based on Ye Yun’s previous description, I am certain that the assailant was definitely Yun Long…”

chapters.title: Chapter 594
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 594: Chapter 249: Linxian City, Meeting Ning Yue Again Chapter 594: Chapter 249: Linxian City, Meeting Ning Yue Again “This…”
Li Qingqing and Ye Yun both fell silent after hearing it.
Yun Long not only survived but also reappeared, which was quite extraordinary.
Initially, the Yun Family practiced Demonic Techniques, and were publicly exposed by Lin Jing, leading to their destruction.
This issue was significant, with all three major Sects of the Nanming Domain intervening and taking control of the Yun Family, taking away key members.
Logically, after such a major incident involving the Yun Family, even the Qingyuan Sword Sect got involved.
Even if their relationship with the Nanming Immortal Sect was extraordinary before, they should not have been so easily released to cause more chaos.
Even if the Nanming Immortal Sect was willing, the Qingyuan Sword Sect would probably not be happy about it, not to mention anyone else, especially Elder Wang, who would definitely be the first to object.
...
Unless…
There were other secrets involved in this matter.
Li Qingqing and Ye Yun obviously realized this too.
So they both turned, looking at Lin Jing.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing spoke to Li Qingqing,
“Qingqing…”
“You have some connections with Elder Wang, right?Could you find a way to inquire about the Yun Family’s situation from Elder Wang?”
“I want to know how the three major Sects handled the Yun Family.
Also, does Elder Wang know about this or not?”
Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing, suddenly speaking,
“Brother Lin Jing, do you mean that it’s very likely that the Nanming Immortal Sect did this, and the other two Sects don’t know?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“That’s possible, so we need to ask first.”
Li Qingqing nodded and said,
“I understand, Brother Lin Jing…”
This time Yun Long did not reveal his true identity.
Even if he encountered others, they would not be able to recognize him.
Clearly, he did not dare to expose himself brazenly; he was probably also apprehensive.
But with the intervention of the three major Sects, he should not have emerged.
Clearly, someone must have helped him.
Lin Jing was now unsure who this helper was.
Or rather, if it was the Nanming Immortal Sect doing it.
So, Lin Jing had to let Li Qingqing first find out clearly.
After Li Qingqing’s words had fallen, Lin Jing spoke again, adding,
“If Elder Wang does not know about this, do not tell him about it either.”
“If it is as we suspect, I think Elder Wang, even if he knew, would only be adding to his troubles.”
“If the Nanming Immortal Sect truly wants to protect the Yun Family like this, it might be better if we handle it…”
Lin Jing’s words left Li Qingqing very puzzled.
“Handle it ourselves?”
“Brother Lin Jing, are you planning to take action personally and eliminate Yun Long?”
Facing Li Qingqing’s question, Lin Jing then said,
“Yun Long being able to come out must have had assistance, and the only one capable of interfering in this matter to help Yun Long would be the Nanming Immortal Sect among the three major Sects.”
“Wasn’t there news before that the Yun Family was working for the Nanming Immortal Sect, and their desire to obtain the Li Family’s Inheritance Elixir Technique was also the intent of the Nanming Immortal Sect?”
“Now it seems…”
“This statement might indeed have some basis.”
“If that’s the case, then Yun Long will definitely reappear and cause trouble for your Li Family.”
After hearing this, Li Qingqing frowned deeply, inevitably feeling worried.
If the Nanming Immortal Sect was actually behind this, then even within Nanshan Immortal City, she might not be able to escape its reach.
However, the Li Family still had some connections at the Qingyuan Sword Sect, which might be why they were holding back for now.
If the Nanming Immortal Sect really could not wait any longer and decided to forcibly take what they wanted, the Li Family’s Elixir Technique would likely be undefendable.
Seeing Li Qingqing’s troubled expression, Lin Jing naturally understood her worries and thus comforted her,
“Qingqing, don’t worry…”
“I won’t go back for now.
I will stay here and see if Yun Long will show up again.”
“If he doesn’t appear, so be it…”
“If he does appear, I will take action against Yun Long and see what the Nanming Immortal Sect really wants.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing nodded, saying,
“Thank you, Brother Lin Jing…”
…
In the following days, the Elixir Pavilion and Spirit Field of the Li Family faced frequent disturbances, all was not well.
However, during these days, Li Qingqing went to the Qingyuan Sword Sect to find Elder Wang for information.
It wasn’t until several days later that Li Qingqing returned, having finally gathered some news.
After receiving the information, she came to find Lin Jing and Ye Yun to share what she had learned…
The matter involving the Yun Family had indeed been handled by all three major Sects initially, but later, when everything was confirmed, the Divinity Transformation Elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect personally stepped in and took all the direct descendants of the Yun Family, stating that the Nanming Immortal Sect would handle it themselves.
Moreover, for this matter.
The Nanming Immortal Sect even conceded many benefits to the other two major Sects.
Since the Yun Family was originally a subordinate family of the Nanming Immortal Sect, this time the Divinity Transformation Elder of the Nanming Sect personally stepped in.
The Qingyuan Sword Sect and the Yiyun Pavilion thus said no more, instead handing over the remaining direct descendants of the Yun Family to the Nanming Immortal Sect for handling.
Afterward, the Nanming Immortal Sect took the direct descendants back, executed a batch, and invited members from the other two major Sects to witness in person.
As for remaining members like Yun Long and Ancestor Yun, the real power holders of the Yun Family, they were detained and sent to a Demon Cave specifically used by the Nanming Immortal Sect to punish Disciples.
ṅονǤ0.сο
It’s said that no one sent to that Demon Cave has ever emerged alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 595
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 595: Chapter 249 Linxian City, Seeing Ning Yue Again_2 Chapter 595: Chapter 249 Linxian City, Seeing Ning Yue Again_2 Even the demonic techniques, in front of the other two sects’ members, were publicly burned by the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Seeing that the demonic techniques were already destroyed, the members from the other two major sects no longer pursued the matter.
And with that, the issue was resolved.
However…
Since Yun Long had reappeared, it went without saying, all of this must have been the Nanming Immortal Sect’s strategizing.
Lin Jing now also confirmed one thing, that everything that had befallen the Li Family was most likely orchestrated by the Nanming Immortal Sect.
But could it really be that just for the sake of the Li Family’s Inheritance Elixir Technique, the Nanming Immortal Sect would go to such great lengths?
...
Lin Jing felt that something didn’t quite add up.
Lin Jing was perplexed, so he decided he must find a way to uncover the true intentions of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
…
Once the matter became clear, Li Qingqing suddenly felt lost.
Li Qingqing was a person who cherished the past deeply.
She returned to the Nanming Domain simply because she couldn’t bear to see the Li Family collapse.
Thus, she had rebuilt the Li Family all by herself.
Yet unexpectedly, not long after the Li Family was rebuilt, they caught the attention of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
To Li Qingqing, the Nanming Immortal Sect loomed like a great mountain overhead, leaving her in despair.
Li Qingqing, looking at Lin Jing, said somewhat absent-mindedly:
“Lin Jing, brother…
“Was I wrong to want to rebuild the Li Family?”
Lin Jing shook his head:
“You did nothing wrong!”
Li Qingqing then said:
“The Nanming Immortal Sect is not something our Li Family can afford to provoke.
No matter what, we can’t overcome them.
“If it weren’t for our relations with the Qingyuan Sword Sect, we would have probably been devoured by the Nanming Immortal Sect a long time ago.”
Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing and spoke:
“They’re the Nanming Immortal Sect, with Divine Transformation Cultivators in their ranks, we can only avoid them for now.”
Ye Yun, however, spoke up at this moment:
“Sister Qingqing…
“Actually, rebuilding the Li Family doesn’t necessarily have to be in the Nanming Domain.
What if you followed us to the Thousand Islands Domain?
“We could help you take over an island, and you could settle the Li Family there.
Wouldn’t that be good?”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing began to think seriously.
Moving the Li Family to the Thousand Islands Domain was something she had never considered before.
ƝονǤο.с0
She had grown up in the Nanming Domain, and the Nanming Domain, including Nanshan Immortal City, contained everything she knew.
If she were to leave, then everything she was familiar with would cease to exist.
But if she didn’t leave, then she would have to hand over the Li Family’s Inheritance Elixir Technique.
This Elixir Technique was the symbol of the Li Family’s legacy, and Li Qingqing’s grandfather valued it more than his own life, and had instilled the same importance in them since they were young.
Therefore, Li Qingqing was even more unwilling to let go of the Inheritance Elixir Technique.
Now, she had no choice but to follow Ye Yun’s suggestion and leave the Nanming Domain.
Li Qingqing then turned to Lin Jing and said:
“Lin Jing, brother…
“If it’s not feasible, then as Ye Yun suggested, I’ll take the Li Family to the Thousand Islands Domain.”
Lin Jing turned, looked at Li Qingqing, and said:
“Going to the Thousand Islands Domain is actually not a bad idea.”
Li Qingqing nodded…
Just then, someone from the Li Family came to report that another incident had occurred at one of the Li Family’s properties in Linxian City.
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing immediately stood up and went out.
About half an hour later, Li Qingqing returned and reported the situation.
This incident was similar to the previous ones, and the Li Family needed to dispatch someone to handle it.
After being informed, Lin Jing immediately made a decision.
“This time, let Ye Yun handle it again.
I will go with him.
“I want to see what lies behind such actions by the Nanming Immortal Sect.”
Li Qingqing nodded and then spoke:
“Then I’ll have to trouble you, brother Lin Jing…”
…
Linxian City
Linxian City is also a well-known large city within the entire Nanming Domain.
It falls under the jurisdiction of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Therefore, many of the powers in Linxian City are inextricably linked to the Nanming Immortal Sect.
When the Howling Sky Wolf Clan attacked, Linxian City was also significantly affected due to its proximity.
And the Nanming Immortal Sect was also not spared from the impact.
The Linxian City of today has already been rebuilt.
Previously, the Yun Family was the largest power within Linxian City.
But the Yun Family had already moved the family’s focus to the Nanming Immortal City prior to the Howling Sky Wolf Clan incident.
The remaining large forces in Linxian City only consisted of the Ning Family and some other powers.
However, the landscape of Linxian City changed again after the Howling Sky Wolf Clan incident.
The biggest power in Linxian City now were two families, one of which was the Ning Family that Ning Yue belonged to.
And another, a rising family, the Zhao Family.
This time, it was the Zhao Family that had come into conflict with the Li Family.
At the gates of Linxian City, Ye Yun, Lin Jing, along with two cultivators from the Li Family, made their appearance.
The main responsibility for handling the conflict with the Zhao Family lay with Ye Yun, while Lin Jing accompanied him to prevent any further surprise attacks.
Afterward, the group entered Linxian City.
Inside Linxian City, the scene was bustling, hardly less so than in Nanshan Immortal City.
Having notified in advance and made arrangements, the group headed straight for the location where negotiations were to be held upon entering the city.
However, just as they were nearing that location, they were suddenly stopped in their tracks.
“Excuse me, are you people from the Li Family?” the person blocking their path asked very politely.
One of the Li Family’s cultivators stepped forward and replied,
“Indeed…”
“We are from the Li Family.”
“May I ask why you are stopping us, fellow cultivator?”
The person who had blocked their way then spoke,
“Our Family Head wishes to see you for a discussion, please come with us.”
After the person finished speaking, the brows of the Li Family cultivator who was talking to him furrowed slightly, he couldn’t help but ask doubtfully,
“Which family do you belong to?”
“The Zhao Family?”
Shaking his head, the person replied,
“It’s not the Zhao Family, you will know once you get there.”
The Li Family cultivator frowned and then said,
“Sorry…”
“We have matters to attend to…”
He had not finished speaking when Lin Jing interrupted him.
“It wouldn’t hurt to meet them.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, the Li Family cultivator quickly stepped back.
On this outing, they were to follow the arrangements of Lin Jing and Ye Yun, as Li Qingqing had told them before they left.
So, faced with Lin Jing’s sudden interruption, the cultivator didn’t say anything more and simply stepped back.
After the Li Family cultivator stepped back, Ye Yun immediately came forward and said to the person who blocked their way,
“Alright…”
“Then we will accompany you to meet your Family Head.”
“Please follow me,” said the person who had stopped them and started to lead the way.
Lin Jing and the others followed behind.
In this manner, the group followed the person through the streets and into a narrow alleyway.
Eventually, after winding through the alley for a good distance, they stopped in front of a small courtyard deep within.
There, the person who had blocked their way stood at the doorway and announced,
“Family Head…”
“I have brought the people from the Li Family.”
As his words fell, the gate of the courtyard opened by itself.
Then a pleasant voice came from inside the courtyard,
“Please, come in…”
Hearing this pleasant voice, the corners of Lin Jing’s mouth curved into a smile.
He had guessed right!
The voice that came from the small courtyard belonged to Ning Yue.
If there was anyone in Linxian City who had some connection to the Li Family,
It would only be the Ning Family.
Previously, when the Ning Family clashed with the Yun Family, they had sought help from the Li Family.
Now, as soon as they arrived in Linxian City, someone had found them right away.
Besides the Ning Family, Lin Jing really couldn’t think of anyone else who would do such a thing.
Therefore, Lin Jing had chosen to interrupt the Li Family cultivator, allowing the person blocking their way to bring them here.
Ning Yue must have chosen to do this at this time because she had some unspeakable difficulties to discuss.
“Please, come inside…”
The person at the door gestured for them to enter.
Lin Jing nodded and made his way inside.
As they entered the courtyard, a beautiful and lovely woman came out from one of the rooms in the courtyard.
It was Ning Yue.
Not having seen her for such a long time, Ning Yue had not changed much and was still very beautiful.
When Ning Yue raised her head and saw Lin Jing,
She froze and then became rooted to the spot.
Only after a moment did Ning Yue speak, her voice tinged with disbelief,
“Lin Jing…”
With a smile on his face, Lin Jing looked at Ning Yue and said,
“Fellow Ning, long time no see…”

chapters.title: Chapter 596
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 596: Chapter 250: The Old Ancestor of Southern Ming Chapter 596: Chapter 250: The Old Ancestor of Southern Ming After gathering her senses, Ning Yue hurried over and then spoke:
“Lin Jing…”
“How come…”
Having only spoken half her words, Ning Yue examined Lin Jing and continued:
“I had asked about you before, I heard that before the Howling Sky Wolf Clan invaded, you had already disappeared.”
“I thought you might have had an accident…”
Seeing Lin Jing, Ning Yue, after her initial surprise, was noticeably more excited.
Lin Jing looked at Ning Yue and replied:
“Indeed, I did encounter some accidents, but luckily, nothing perilous…”
While speaking, Lin Jing looked at Ning Yue, examining her carefully, and then said:
“It seems you’ve been doing quite well over the years.
So much time has passed and your appearance has hardly changed.”
“Even your cultivation has reached the Golden Core Stage.”
Ning Yue smiled and said:
“It’s been fifty years since we last parted, and many things have happened over these decades.
The entire Nanming Domain has undergone tremendous changes, and naturally, so have I.”
“The reason my appearance has not changed is that I once took a Flawless Eternal Youth Elixir.”“No wonder…”
Having said this, Lin Jing suddenly changed the subject and asked:
“By the way…”
“Has Luo Luo returned over the years?”
Ning Yue shook her head:
“No…”
“Ever since Luo Luo left with her master, she has never returned.”
“However, the life token she left at home has always been safe and sound, so she must still be cultivating with her master.”
“I see…” Lin Jing nodded lightly.
Ning Yue looked at Lin Jing, then said thoughtfully:
“Back then, in Nanshan Market, we both only had the cultivation of the Qi Refinement Realm.”
“Now, not to mention me…”
“Even you have reached the Golden Core cultivation level, haven’t you?”
“I guess Wei Zhengqing by now must have at least reached the Golden Core Late Stage.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing was stunned for a moment, then asked:
“Ning friend, have you not seen Brother Wei all this time?”
Ning Yue looked at Lin Jing with some confusion:
“No…”
“Ever since that time when he and Yan Xiong took me back to the Ning Family, they went adventuring, and we haven’t seen each other since.”
Lin Jing then replied:
“I met Brother Wei in the Demonic Monster Sea, and we returned together.”
“I thought you had seen him.”
Ning Yue was taken aback for a moment, then asked:
“He has returned too?”
Lin Jing nodded.
“Yes, and Brother Wei now even has a daughter; he returned with his daughter…”
After hearing this, Ning Yue, laughing, said:
“It seems he has finally let go.”
After that, the two changed the subject and did not talk about Wei Zhengqing anymore.
Lin Jing continued:
“Are you the Family Head of the Ning Family now?”
Ning Yue nodded and said:
“The old ancestor passed the position of the Family Head of the Ning Family to me several years ago.”
“You mentioned needing our help, what is it about?” Lin Jing asked Ning Yue.
...
Ning Yue then spoke:
“I originally had a message that I wanted you to pass on to Li Qingqing, but now that you are here, that will be easier.”
“What message?” Lin Jing asked.
Ning Yue glanced at the others briefly, then suddenly sent a divine message to Lin Jing:
“The Zhao Family has a conspiracy against you.”
“Once you’ve dealt with this, rush back and inform Li Qingqing that the Nanming Immortal Sect is now collecting Alchemy Techniques, and if possible, it would be best to hand them over.”
“Our families cannot compete against the Nanming Immortal Sect.”
Lin Jing also sent a divine message asking:
“Why is the Nanming Immortal Sect collecting Alchemy Techniques?”
Ning Yue replied:
“I also don’t know…”
“Our Ning Family has already handed over the Alchemy Techniques; otherwise, we wouldn’t have remained safe this whole time.”
“If Li Qingqing doesn’t hand over the Li Family’s Alchemy Techniques, I’m afraid the Nanming Immortal Sect will take action themselves.”
“Otherwise, you should consider leaving the Nanming Domain.”
“However, based on my understanding of the Nanming Immortal Sect, leaving might not be so easy.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing was silent for a moment, then said:
“I understand…”
Afterward.
Lin Jing and Ning Yue chatted for a while, but he did not stay long and soon left.
After leaving the small courtyard, Lin Jing and his group continued toward the previously agreed-upon location.
Soon.
They arrived at the meeting spot, which was a Zhao Family Elixir Pavilion.
And the Li Family Elixir Pavilion was right opposite it.
Given how close the two family’s Elixir Pavilions were, it would be unusual not to have conflicts.
This negotiation was managed by Ye Yun, so Lin Jing did not accompany him during the talks.
After Ye Yun and the others entered, Lin Jing waited at a nearby small tavern, ordering a pot of wine and a couple of side dishes to wait.
Meanwhile, his Divine Sense had already stretched out, covering the entire vicinity.
Anything stirring could not escape his surveillance.
That included the negotiations with the Zhao Family, which Lin Jing continuously monitored.
The negotiations lasted for several hours before both parties reached an agreement.
Actually, it wasn’t a big deal.
Lin Jing was very aware.
This time, like the last, the real uncertainty would likely be on their journey back.
When Ye Yun, after completing the negotiations with the Zhao Family, came with the two Li Family cultivators to the tavern where Lin Jing was,
“Master…”
“Everything has been settled, what shall we do now?”
Lin Jing looked at Ye Yun and then said:
“In a while, we two will head back first.”
After finishing, Lin Jing again turned his head, looked at the other two Li Family cultivators, and said:
“As for you two, stay here and go back after half a month.”

chapters.title: Chapter 597
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 597: Chapter 250 Ancestor of Southern Ming_2 Chapter 597: Chapter 250 Ancestor of Southern Ming_2 There might be some danger on the way back, but Lin Jing and Ye Yun, being of higher cultivation, would not be greatly troubled even if they were to encounter an attack.
However, the two cultivators from the Li Family were only at the Foundation Establishment Stage and there was no need for them to risk accompanying them.
The two understood Lin Jing’s meaning and nodded immediately, indicating their agreement.
After making arrangements, it didn’t take long for Lin Jing and Ye Yun to leave Linxian City together.
When the two left, they didn’t make any attempt to conceal themselves and just walked back openly and aboveboard.
…
To return to Nanshan Immortal City from Linxian City, one must pass through a mountain range.
...
That mountain range was sparsely populated and teeming with Demonic Beasts.
But these Demonic Beasts were all of lower orders, and even those at the Golden Core Stage were rarely encountered.
If Yun Long truly intended to ambush them, then this mountain range would undoubtedly be the best location.
As Lin Jing and Ye Yun flew over the mountain range on their swords, their powerful auras spread out, causing the Demonic Beasts in the mountains below to be as still as the chill of winter, daring not to move a muscle.
At that moment, Lin Jing suddenly stopped.
Ye Yun also halted, following Lin Jing’s lead.
“Master?” Ye Yun looked at Lin Jing, somewhat puzzled.
Lin Jing then spoke,
“Someone is waiting for us…”
Upon hearing this, Ye Yun’s brow furrowed.
“So they really do plan to ambush us after all?”
Lin Jing shook his head,
“No…”
“Openly and blatantly!”
Having said that, Lin Jing told Ye Yun,
“You take a detour back, leave them to me.”
Ye Yun turned his head to look at Lin Jing and said,
“Master…”
“Yun Long is merely at the Golden Core Peak, I’ll stay with you!”
Lin Jing looked at Ye Yun and replied,
“You go back first…”
“This time, it’s not just Yun Long; Ancestor Yun of the Yun Family is also there!”
“If a fight does break out later, I’m afraid you might get caught up in it, so you better head back.”
After hearing this, Ye Yun did not insist any further and then bowed to Lin Jing,
“Master, be careful…”
Lin Jing nodded lightly.
Then, Ye Yun changed direction and flew off another way.
Ye Yun had great confidence in Lin Jing.
Just Ancestor Yun and Yun Long themselves, they were no match for Lin Jing.
After Ye Yun left, Lin Jing flew forward once again.
Shortly after, Lin Jing arrived at the ambush site.
No sooner had Lin Jing flown there than suddenly, a beam of red light shot out from the dense forest below.
Following that red light was a black figure.
However, before the red light even reached him, Lin Jing had already detected it.
Then, with an effortless wave of his hand, Lin Jing flung out a palm strike.
This palm strike, although seemingly effortless,
had an astonishingly powerful momentum.
The entire palm print expanded in mid-air and then directly stamped down towards the black figure below.
The black figure trembled at the sight of this palm print, and even the red light it controlled wavered along with it.
The palm print descended, touched the red light, and immediately dispersed it.
At that moment, the figure radiated the light of teleportation, clearly using a Teleportation Talisman.
And just like that, the black figure vanished from its original spot.
Following that,
the palm print continued to fall down, and with a thunderous “boom,” it smashed into the forest below.
Instantly, an enormous palm print, hundreds of yards in size, appeared in the forest below.
Everything under that palm print, be it rocks or trees, was pulverized, and the ground where the palm print landed was depressed by several meters.
Lin Jing rarely used pure Spiritual Power against enemies; this was almost his first time.
But the power of it was sufficiently daunting.
Then,
Lin Jing looked up, his gaze directed to the opposite side.
There, two figures stood.
Both were wearing Magical Treasure Masks, which had incredible concealing effects, such that even Lin Jing’s Divine Sense couldn’t penetrate them.
However, even with the masks on, Lin Jing was all too familiar with their auras.
It was Yun Long and Ancestor Yun from the Yun Family.
At this moment, the young man clad in black brocade robes, who obviously seemed young, began to speak.
“I never imagined you truly were a Nascent Soul Cultivator…”
Lin Jing turned to the young cultivator and said,
“Yun Long…”
“Why do you continue to hide?
Do you think it still holds any meaning?”
“Why not take off your mask?”
The young cultivator spoke,
“Lin Jing…”
“I indeed underestimated you at first.
I never expected that in such a short span of time, you would advance to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
“Your pace of advancement is truly frightening.”
As the young cultivator spoke, he slowly removed the mask on his face, revealing his true appearance.
It was none other than Yun Long.
Seeing Yun Long removing his mask, the other cultivator beside him, his hair peppered with grey, also took off his mask, revealing his true countenance.
To Lin Jing’s expectations, it was indeed Ancestor Yun from the Yun Family.
After Ancestor Yun removed his mask, he scrutinized Lin Jing thoroughly before exclaiming,
“I’ve heard from Yun Long…”
“He said that fifty years ago, he had met you when you were still a Junior Cultivator in the Qi Refinement Realm.”
“It is unexpected that in merely fifty years, you’ve ascended from the Qi Refinement Realm to the Nascent Soul Stage.”
“Such a speed of cultivation is unheard of, and it is truly terrifying!”
“It’s just such a pity that a genius like you is our enemy!”
At this point, Ancestor Yun spoke once more,
“If I’m not mistaken, you were the one who took action against us back in Nanshan Immortal City, weren’t you?”
“That’s right!” Lin Jing nodded.
There was no need to conceal it anymore at this stage.
Lin Jing turned his gaze towards the two men.
While Yun Long’s eyes were filled with hatred,
Ancestor Yun’s eyes showed astonishment and a mix of regret.
In their gaze, there was not the slightest hint of fear.
Back in Nanshan Immortal City, Ancestor Yun couldn’t withstand a single move from Lin Jing, but now he was able to guess this and yet remain so composed…
Lin Jing then said,
“The two of you, you have a contingency plan…”
Ancestor Yun nodded and replied,
“We are here…
“In fact, for you.
You are a rare talent, and even though I have cultivated for several hundred years more than you, I have to admit that I am not your match.”
“Your current strength, it should be in the late Nascent Soul Stage, indeed terrifying…”
“Just a few decades and you have already reached this point…”
“Since we have our suspicions and wish to deal with you, naturally we have prepared a contingency plan.”
Just as Ancestor Yun finished speaking, a very powerful aura suddenly emerged from behind the two of them.
“Their contingency plan is me!”
The voice arrived, but the person was not yet in sight.
ɴονǤ0.сο
This overwhelming aura was much stronger than Lin Jing’s.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown.
He never expected that he would ultimately have to confront him…
This powerful aura was not unfamiliar to Lin Jing; the newcomer was of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
And the only one who could appear here at this time, other than the Divinity Transformation Stage Ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect, was unlikely to be anyone else.
The person Lin Jing least wanted to encounter now was precisely the Divinity Transformation Stage Ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Right from the start, since Lin Jing had learned about the conflict between the Li Family and the Yun Family in Sea-Watch City and its possible connection with the Nanming Immortal Sect from a cultivator of the Heavenly Secrets Association…
Lin Jing had been wary that this worst-case scenario might occur.
But now, the Ancestor from the Nanming Immortal Sect had truly appeared…
When that voice settled, an old man with a somber expression and a hunched body, appearing weak and frail, stood before Lin Jing.
However, the aura emanating from him was exceedingly astonishing.
Even Lin Jing couldn’t help but furrow his brow and be on guard upon seeing this old man.
As soon as the old man arrived, Yun Long and Ancestor Yun quickly bowed and respectfully addressed the old man,
“Ancestor…”
“This is Lin Jing.
In just fifty years, he advanced from the Qi Refinement Realm to the late Nascent Soul Stage.”
“With such a rapid advancement, there must be a great secret upon him.”
At this point, the old man lifted his eyes, gave Lin Jing a glance, and then spoke,
“He looks indeed quite young…”
The voice of the Nanming Ancestor was hoarse, sounding like stones grinding on the ground.
Yet, when the voice reached one’s ears, it felt like a demon’s whisper, terribly uncomfortable to hear…

chapters.title: Chapter 598
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 598: Chapter 251: Ancestor Yun Dies, Yun Long Self-Destructs Chapter 598: Chapter 251: Ancestor Yun Dies, Yun Long Self-Destructs Having spoken, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect turned to Lin Jing and continued:
“I won’t say much more…”
“As long as you hand over the secret to your cultivation enhancement, I will let you go.”
Facing the oppressive demand of the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect, Lin Jing frowned slightly and then, with a look of concentration, asked the Ancestor:
“Was targeting the Li Family your idea?”
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect nodded:
“Indeed…”
“At first, I only wanted the Li Family’s Inheritance Elixir Technique, but I hadn’t expected you to appear.”
“Looking at it now…”
“Your value is much greater than that Elixir Technique.”
Lin Jing fell silent for a moment before continuing to ask:
“I also want to know if the Demonic Techniques practiced by the Yun Family are related to Nanming Immortal Sect.”
The Ancestor of Nanming looked at Lin Jing, smiled with a sneer, and said:
“As long as you hand over the secret that allows you to enhance yourself so rapidly, then I can tell you.”
Lin Jing then spoke:
“I’m afraid you can’t take my secret!”
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect looked at Lin Jing with a face full of disdain:“Do you really think you can escape today?”
Lin Jing then said:
“How would I know without trying…”
As his words fell, the aura around Lin Jing suddenly surged upward.
Opposite the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect, although his aura was not as fierce as the Ancestor’s, it was still not weak.
The Ancestor Yun and Yun Long, caught between them, were now in a difficult situation.
Seeing Lin Jing attempting to resist under these circumstances,
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect’s face suddenly turned cold.
“Courage is commendable, but it’s a pity you’re facing me…”
“Without reaching Divinity Transformation, you’ll never understand the gap between Nascent Soul and Divinity Transformation.”
However.
Before the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect could finish speaking, Lin Jing had already begun to act.
Suddenly bursting with speed, he appeared beside Ancestor Yun instantaneously.
...
For the upcoming confrontation with the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect, Lin Jing did not want any distractions.
Therefore, without hesitation, he directly struck at Ancestor Yun.
The sudden outburst from Lin Jing took Ancestor Yun by surprise.
Fortunately, he was always on guard.
The very moment Lin Jing disappeared, Ancestor Yun shouted:
“Life-bound Puppet, come forth!”
With Ancestor Yun’s command, a giant Golden Armor Puppet clad in golden armor appeared, standing in front of Ancestor Yun.
This Golden Armor Puppet, as soon as it appeared, lifted its huge hammer and smashed it towards Lin Jing.
However, seeing this, Lin Jing didn’t even bother to dodge; his body suddenly shone with dark light as a formidable aura erupted from him.
Next.
Lin Jing shot through the air towards the Golden Armor Puppet.
Lin Jing’s action caused Ancestor Yun, who was hiding behind the armor, to have a solemn expression.
Without the slightest hesitation, Ancestor Yun opened his mouth and spurted out a mouthful of blood onto the puppet…
As Ancestor Yun’s blood was absorbed by the Golden Armor Puppet, it suddenly exploded with intense golden light.
And at that exact moment, Lin Jing collided with the Golden Armor Puppet.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.с0
With a “boom,” the earth-shaking noise emanated from their contact.
Ancestor Yun, looking slightly pale, then spoke:
“My Life-bound Puppet is as hard as a Dao Artifact.
Even if you are a Body Refinement Cultivator, you won’t be able to break it instantly.”
And the puppet, as if it had its own consciousness, shone even brighter with golden light, looking even more majestic.
However…
Just as the golden light on the puppet was at its strongest, the light suddenly disappeared…
No, it was not just the light…
The entire puppet just vanished into thin air.
The moment the Golden Armor Puppet disappeared, Ancestor Yun’s face turned as white as a sheet.
A gush of blood spurted out as he gasped:
Ancestor Yun, filled with disbelief, pointed at Lin Jing and said:
“You…”
“My Life-bound Puppet…”
“Where did you send my Life-bound Puppet?”
Lin Jing did not answer, his Divine Sense instantly probed out, attacking Ancestor Yun.
Simultaneously, another invisible Flying Sword hidden in the shadows also struck at Ancestor Yun.
At that moment, Ancestor Yun, still incredulous, did not react.
Just as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense was about to reach Ancestor Yun…
A Divine Sense force, even more powerful than Lin Jing’s, suddenly emerged, protecting Ancestor Yun.
And Lin Jing’s Flying Sword was struck by a sudden surge of tremendous force, revealing its presence.
Clearly.
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect had personally taken action.
Feeling the overwhelming Divine Sense force bearing down on him, Lin Jing quickly retreated.
While doing so, he made sure to recall his Flying Sword.
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect was just too strong.
Especially his Divinity Transformation Stage Divine Sense.
Under which all of Lin Jing’s subtle moves were exposed.
Just now, Lin Jing had been thinking of secretly using his Ling Yin Flawless Sword to launch a surprise attack and first eliminate Ancestor Yun.
However, under the Divine Sense of the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect, his plan was exposed as soon as it started.
There was no choice.
After all, there was a realm difference between the two of them; his Divine Sense was simply too strong.
After Lin Jing withdrew, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect did not give chase but stood in front of Ancestor Yun instead.
Next.
He looked up at Lin Jing, his gaze full of scrutiny.
“It seems there are indeed many secrets on you.”
“How that Golden Armor Puppet vanished just now, even I couldn’t see clearly.”
“Do you perhaps have a space-related Daoist Treasure on you?”
At this time, Ancestor Yun, having lost his Life-bound Puppet, had sustained serious injuries, and his aura was extremely unstable.

chapters.title: Chapter 599
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 599: Chapter 251 Ancestor Yun Dies, Yun Long Self-Destructs_2 Chapter 599: Chapter 251 Ancestor Yun Dies, Yun Long Self-Destructs_2 He couldn’t care less about stabilizing his own breath and glared at Lin Jing angrily:
“Where is my Life-bound Puppet?
Where did you hide it?”
The Life-bound Puppet had naturally been taken by Lin Jing into the System Space.
But faced with the scrutiny from the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect and the questioning of Ancestor Yun…
Lin Jing didn’t speak.
Instead, he sheathed the Ling Yin Flawless Sword, and suddenly burst into extreme speed, running away.
Upon seeing Lin Jing’s sudden escape, the complexion of the Nanming Immortal Sect’s Ancestor immediately darkened.
The Nanming Immortal Sect’s Ancestor snorted coldly:
“Hmph!”
“Do you think you can escape from me?”
Having said that, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect took a step and chased after Lin Jing.
...
As a Divinity Transformation Cultivator of Nanming Immortal Sect, his speed was naturally fast.
However, Lin Jing was an eighth layer Nascent Soul Body Refinement Cultivator, and the burst of extreme speed of a Body Refinement Cultivator far surpassed that of cultivators of the same rank.
Therefore, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect did not catch up with Lin Jing immediately.
After turning to flee, Lin Jing was, of course, aware of the Nanming Immortal Sect’s Ancestor pursuing him.
Lin Jing did not dare to underestimate the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect and burst into extreme speed several times in a row to widen the distance between them.
Although it was only a temporary distance, the Nanming Immortal Sect’s Ancestor followed closely behind Lin Jing like burr attached to bone.
Although Lin Jing could burst into extreme speed and temporarily widen the gap, doing so was only a temporary measure that couldn’t last long.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense entered his Space Ring, and he took out a Great Teleportation Charm from within.
Then, Lin Jing directly crushed the Great Teleportation Charm.
At the same time as the Great Teleportation Charm was crushed, a strange spatial force enveloped Lin Jing…
Just at this moment, a Divine Sense came from behind:
“Great Teleportation Charm…”
“But it’s all in vain…”
“Do you really think that with a Great Teleportation Charm, you can escape from my grasp?”
However, Lin Jing did not pay any attention to that Divine Sense, and instead silently recited in his heart:
“Enter the System Space!”
As if the Great Teleportation Charm had taken effect, at the moment when the spatial force was at its strongest, Lin Jing suddenly disappeared from where he had been…
…
Inside the System Space, Lin Jing suddenly appeared.
After appearing in the System Space, without any hesitation, he immediately summoned the System and said:
“System, activate Observation Mode!”
Right now, next to Lin Jing, the huge Golden Armor Puppet lay motionless.
However, Lin Jing didn’t have time to study the Golden Armor Puppet at the moment.
As Lin Jing’s words ended, the scene before his eyes changed again, and he appeared outside.
This time, Lin Jing’s body was in the System Space, but he observed the outside world in Observation Mode.
Through Lin Jing’s perspective of observation, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect soon flew over.
After arriving, the Ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect stopped, then extended his Divine Sense, scanning around ceaselessly…
As time passed, the Nanming Immortal Sect Ancestor’s complexion became increasingly gloomy.
It was only after a while that he spoke with a dark expression:
“It shouldn’t be…”
“Just a Great Teleportation Charm should not have such a long distance…”
“Could it be that I have been tricked?”
After the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect finished speaking, he looked up ahead.
ƝօνǤο.сο
It was then that two more figures flew over from behind.
The two who arrived were none other than Ancestor Yun and Yun Long.
After their arrival, seeing only the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect there, they felt puzzled.
Then, Ancestor Yun saluted with his hands and inquired of the Ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect:
“Ancestor…”
“Where is Lin Jing?
Have you not caught up with him?”
The Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect turned his head and gave the two a cold glance.
They felt as if they had fallen into an ice cave, and immediately lowered their heads, not daring to speak…
Subsequently…
The Ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect retracted his gaze, looked forward, and said:
“He can’t run away…”
After speaking, the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect looked at the two again and spoke:
“This time coming out, Lin Jing was with his disciple, and his disciple should still be within this mountain range, not far away…”
“You two, go and capture his disciple…”
Ancestor Yun and Yun Long hurriedly bowed and said:
“Yes…”
The two finished speaking and saw no response.
Only when they stood up did they realize that the Ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect had already disappeared without a trace.
Yun Long and Ancestor Yun exchanged a glance, then spoke:
“Ancestor…”
“Let’s go and capture that disciple of Lin Jing…”
Ancestor Yun nodded:
“Hmm!”
Afterward, the two of them discerned the direction and turned to fly towards Nanshan Immortal City.
However,
just as the two of them relaxed their vigilance and turned around,
a figure suddenly appeared.
Ancestor Yun had just become alert when he felt something strange with his body.
Ancestor Yun looked down and suddenly discovered a burst of Five-Colored Aurora at his chest.
This Five-Colored Aurora was beautiful at a glance, yet it was so dazzling.
If it appeared somewhere else, he might have stopped to admire it.
But, it was on his own chest.
Accompanying the appearance of the Five-Colored Aurora was a hole in his chest, large enough to fit a fist…
Ancestor Yun struggled to turn his head and looked behind.
He also saw that familiar figure…
He couldn’t help but blurt out:
“Lin Jing…”
However,
these two words would be the last he would ever say.
The Five-Colored Aurora erupted, engulfing Ancestor Yun completely.
And Yun Long, just before the explosion of the Five-Colored Aurora, had already retreated in advance, leaving Ancestor Yun’s side.
Yun Long looked at Ancestor Yun enveloped by the Five-Colored Aurora and was struck with grief:
“Ancestor…”
However, Ancestor Yun could no longer hear anything.
Because, by that time, the Five-Colored Aurora had already dissolved most of Ancestor Yun’s body.
Even the Purple Nascent Soul, less than two inches big inside him, was also bound by the Five-Colored Aurora, struggling in vain to break free.
It could only watch as the Five-Colored Aurora slowly consumed it.
This process might seem slow to describe, but it didn’t even take a single breath.
Ancestor Yun was consumed by the Five-Colored Aurora, disappearing completely.
Only then did Yun Long come back to his senses from his grief.
Yun Long’s eyes were bloodshot, with Demonic Qi bursting from his body, almost forming a substantial presence.
Yun Long glared at Lin Jing, teeth clenched, and said:
“Lin Jing…”
“You’ve destroyed my Yun Family, killed our Ancestor, I, Yun Long, swear that if I am fortunate enough to not die today, one day, I will surely kill everyone close to you and reduce you to ashes.”
Confronted with Yun Long’s threat, Lin Jing only found it laughable.
Since he had chosen to act, he naturally had no intention of sparing Yun Long.
As Yun Long’s words fell, the Demonic Qi on his body suddenly burst forth, and then, he rushed towards Lin Jing like a madman.
Facing Yun Long’s charge, Lin Jing reached out his hand and several streams of Five-Colored Aurora flew out from his hand.
Then they headed towards Yun Long.
Yet Yun Long, his eyes filled with madness, didn’t retreat in the face of the Five-Colored Aurora.
Rather, he continued flying towards Lin Jing.
However,
just as the Five-Colored Aurora was about to reach Yun Long, the frenzied Demonic Qi around him suddenly stalled,
managing to blockade the Five-Colored Aurora for a moment…
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Yun Long charged at Lin Jing, and as he neared Lin Jing…
Yun Long’s body, like an inflating balloon, suddenly swelled, emanating an extremely unstable and dangerous aura.
Then, with a loud “boom,” Yun Long exploded into pieces.
Yun Long’s flesh and blood scattered with the explosion…
The blast was indeed powerful.
Within a radius of several kilometers, it created a vast crater, and the ground around the crater was also leveled by the explosion…
Above the crater, Lin Jing still stood there, in front of him a Spiritual Shield condensed by Spiritual Power, protecting him.
And he was completely unharmed.
The destructive power of Yun Long’s self-destruction was immense, but the gap in cultivation between him and Lin Jing was simply too great.
Even allowing him to get close was not enough to harm Lin Jing.
Lin Jing dispelled the Spiritual Shield and then looked down into the crater…
Inside the crater, a conspicuous pool of red was visible.
This was all that was left of Yun Long after his self-destruction; as for the rest of his flesh, it had likely been blasted far away.
The once haughty Young Master of the Yun Family, Yun Long, in the end, was reduced to nothing but a pool of blood.
Even on that bloodstain, Lin Jing could still feel a faint trace of Demonic Qi…

chapters.title: Chapter 600
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 600: Chapter 252: Yun Long Revives, Speculations of the Ancestor of Nanming Chapter 600: Chapter 252: Yun Long Revives, Speculations of the Ancestor of Nanming Yun Long had actually self-destructed just like that.
Lin Jing stood above the deep pit, looking down at the bloodstains imbued with Demonic Qi, lost in thought.
Yun Long’s self-destruction felt extremely off to Lin Jing.
Just moments ago, he was spouting madness, looking as if he wanted to devour Lin Jing alive.
Yet, in the next moment, he had ended his own life in such a drastic way by self-destructing.
Was it merely to deal a fatal blow to himself?
That seemed somewhat unlikely.
...
He should have known that even if he self-destructed, he could not possibly hurt Lin Jing.
Could there be another variable involved?
Lin Jing furrowed his brows, staring at the bloodstain exuding Demonic Qi below, a thought crossed his mind…
Following that,
Lin Jing extended his hand, and a Five-Colored Aurora emerged from it, shooting towards the pool of blood in the pit at a very high speed.
The Five-Colored Aurora was swift, reaching the bloodstain in an instant.
However, the bloodstain showed no response…
Originally, Lin Jing had planned to investigate further, but just then, a strong presence was rapidly approaching.
Clearly, the noise from Yun Long’s self-destruction had alerted the senior of the Nanming Immortal Sect, who was now rushing towards this location at high speed.
Lin Jing immediately decided not to delay any longer and quickly left the area, flying towards the distance.
However, it wasn’t long before Lin Jing entered the System Space again.
After returning to the System Space, Lin Jing immediately activated the Observation Mode to return to the pit.
ƝονǤօ.сօ
Lin Jing didn’t believe that Yun Long had just died like that, but there was no more time for further investigation.
So, Lin Jing had to return to the System Space and observe secretly.
Indeed, not long after Lin Jing left, the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect arrived at the pit.
Upon arrival, he extended his Divine Sense, scanning the surrounding area thoroughly.
After scanning the area, the senior from the Nanming Immortal Sect frowned…
The senior looked down at the pit with the blood tainted with Demonic Qi, then gestured with his hand…
Suddenly, the pool of blood detached from the pit and rose into the air.
Accompanying the blood were countless flesh fragments also flying towards the senior of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Soon, those bloodstains began to coalesce into a single drop of blood exuding Demonic Qi.
At that moment, the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect acted again.
He made a swipe with his hand, and a red streak of Demonic Qi appeared, forming into a strange formation that enveloped the coalesced blood drop.
Following this, the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect’s aura began to change, and countless red Demonic Qi surged from within him.
The change in the senior’s aura now resembled Yun Long’s…
Unexpectedly, this senior from the Nanming Immortal Sect had also cultivated those Demonic Techniques.
When the senior no longer concealed his practice of Demonic Techniques, his aura grew even stronger.
If previously the senior’s Cultivation was only at the first or second level of Divinity Transformation, now with the exposed Demonic Techniques, his Cultivation was at least between the fifth and sixth levels.
His entire power had increased significantly.
If it had been the early stages of the Divinity Transformation, Lin Jing might have fought against him, but now at the mid-stage, fighting him would be hopeless.
After the formation coalesced, the senior’s Demonic Qi burst forth, and he cast several seals with his hands.
After the seals were cast, they flew towards the formation in midair, which immediately expanded, encompassing a wide area around it.
And the droplet of blood tainted with Demonic Qi floated in the middle of the formation.
As the formation expanded, the bloodstains and shattered flesh began to gather towards the center of the formation.
Lin Jing, within the System Space, used the Observation Mode to watch this.
At this moment, Lin Jing refrained from taking any rash actions.
Observing the actions of the senior from the Nanming Immortal Sect, it seemed as though he intended to resurrect Yun Long.
At this time, Lin Jing could have suddenly appeared and ambushed the senior from the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Yet, he couldn’t do that.
The Demonic Techniques enabling revival even after self-destruction should not be underestimated.
Lin Jing observed in this manner to better understand the Demonic Techniques, preparing himself for the upcoming encounter with the senior from the Nanming Immortal Sect.
From the moment Lin Jing encountered the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect, it was destined that the senior would not let him go.
And if Lin Jing wanted to protect himself, he had no choice but to think of a way to eliminate the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect.
As time slowly passed, the flesh began to merge together.
With the aid of Demonic Techniques, it gradually formed a human shape.
Just then, the senior from Nanming Immortal Sect waved his hand, and countless red Demonic Qi burst from him.
The Demonic Qi surged, swirling towards the human-shaped blood and flesh.
Then, the Qi enveloped the human-shaped blood and flesh.
At that moment,
The formation emitted a faint red glow and began to rotate.
Lin Jing noticed that, as the formation started rotating, something began emerging from beneath the ground.
When that thing appeared, Lin Jing immediately recognized it.
It was a dark red blood drop, shimmering with a green light.
If Lin Jing’s guess was correct, this blood drop effusing green light was the key to Yun Long’s resurrection.

chapters.title: Chapter 601
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 601: Chapter 252: Yun Long Revives, Speculations of the Ancestor of Nanming_2 Chapter 601: Chapter 252: Yun Long Revives, Speculations of the Ancestor of Nanming_2 After the blood droplet appeared, it was immediately attracted by the Formation.
Then, the blood droplet slowly flew towards the center of the Formation.
As the blood droplet drew near, the demonic qi enveloping the humanoid flesh dispersed.
Through the gaps that opened up, Lin Jing saw that the humanoid flesh had transformed back into the shape of Yun Long.
This demonic technique was indeed eerie.
It even included such a life-preserving method.
Following this, the blood droplet emitting a blue light flew to Yun Long’s forehead and then slowly entered it.
...
Once the blue light entered Yun Long’s forehead, the red demonic qi gathered again, enveloping Yun Long once more.
After that, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect waved his hand again, and a great amount of demonic qi burst forth from his body, surging towards the Formation.
After being enveloped by the demonic qi again, the ancestor of Nanming made several hand signs, condensing numerous seal scripts that flew towards the Formation.
After the seal scripts flew out, the Formation began to rotate faster, and even as it spun rapidly, it also kept shrinking…
Throughout this process, Lin Jing watched intently.
It wasn’t until an hour later that the Formation faded and finally disappeared, and Yun Long within the Formation revealed his form once again.
When the Formation completely vanished, even its aura disappeared out of existence.
It was at this moment that Yun Long opened his eyes.
Upon opening his eyes, Yun Long first appeared stunned for a moment, then he came to his senses.
Realizing his situation, Yun Long quickly turned his head, looking around.
When he spotted the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect, he hurriedly came before him and knelt down.
“Master…”
“Ancestor Yun of my Yun Family was ambushed and killed by Lin Jing!”
It was only with this cry of “Master” that Lin Jing realized that Yun Long was, in fact, a disciple of the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
The ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect looked at Yun Long with a calm expression,
“Lin Jing is a late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator, much higher than you all, and moreover, he shamefully launched a sneak attack.
Such an outcome is quite normal.”
“But rest assured, he won’t be able to escape.”
With that said, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect looked up, his expression serious, gazing ahead.
He was looking in the direction where Lin Jing had headed after Yun Long’s self-destruction.
Under his powerful Divinity Transformation stage Divine Sense, it seemed none of Lin Jing’s movements could escape detection.
Seeing the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect so earnest, Yun Long quickly got up and stood to the side.
Then, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect spoke directly:
“Lin Jing…”
“I know you are nearby.”
As the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect spoke, his words rang with shock.
But his expression was serious, and his tone was very firm.
It appeared he was quite certain that Lin Jing was nearby.
His words made Yun Long at his side look utterly shocked.
Soon, he hastily turned his head, glancing around, but found nothing.
The ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect’s face remained calm, before he continued:
“Earlier…”
“You pulled out a Great Teleportation Charm, and I initially thought you were going to flee, so I chased after you, but to think, you actually duped me, turning back to launch a sneak attack on them both…”
“I must say, that was truly a poor decision…”
After finishing, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect even shook his head regretfully:
“I don’t know what you were thinking…”
“But it’s this sneak attack that has confirmed something for me.”
“On you, there absolutely is a Daoist Treasure, or even an Innate Dao Treasure level Spatial Treasure that can temporally allow one to hide.”
“I won’t say anything else…”
“Surrender this Spatial Treasure, and I will spare your life.”
Having finished speaking, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect once again extended his Divine Sense, scanning the vicinity.
Yun Long, standing beside him, also scanned around, yet he looked puzzled.
As the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect finished speaking, there was no response for a long time.
He furrowed his brows, then spoke again:
“It seems…”
“You do not intend to come out, do you?”
After saying this, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect scanned the area again, but still, there was no response.
He continued:
“Although I have never seen such a treasure before, I also know that the higher the rank of a treasure, the harder it is to control.”
“Moreover, using it consumes a tremendous amount of Spiritual Power.”
“Since you wish to hide, I shall see just how formidable your treasure really is and how long you can endure?”
Having said this, the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect directly crossed his legs and simply sat down next to the deep pit formed by Yun Long’s self-detonation.
As for Yun Long, although somewhat suspicious,
he also sat down behind the elder of Nanming Immortal Sect.
The words of the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect were indeed true,
but that was in reference to the Spatial Treasure.
However, Lin Jing’s System Space did not fall into that category.
At that time, both were outside, guarding Lin Jing.
If Lin Jing were to leave now, he would definitely be discovered immediately.
Though Lin Jing was not a match for the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, once outside, relying on his own strength, Lin Jing believed he could still hold his own against him for a while.
But that was merely holding his own…
Thinking about defeating him, or even killing him, was nothing but wishful thinking.
If it were under his normal cultivation, Lin Jing might have still tried, but this elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect had practiced Demonic Techniques, drastically increasing his strength and crossing several minor realms in succession, making Lin Jing completely no match for him.
Lin Jing not leaving was also continuously thinking of how to deal with this person.
Lin Jing had also thought about, after leaving, luring him to the other two sects and having the other two great sects’ elders take action.
But that was simply courting death.
Not to mention, the elders of the two sects were already acquainted with the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, and it was possible that upon being led there, before Lin Jing could even speak, they might join hands in hunting him.
Moreover, Lin Jing did not even know them, and even if he truly exposed the matter of the elder of Nanming Immortal Sect practicing Demonic Techniques, who would believe him?
At that time, the elder of Nanming Immortal Sect would counteract, and Lin Jing would be even more unable to justify himself.
Perhaps, it would also implicate the Li Family and Li Qingqing…
Thus, this was absolutely not an option.
Unable to rely on others, Lin Jing could only rely on himself.
In this way, the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect continued to guard outside where Lin Jing was, while Lin Jing used Observation Mode, observing and simultaneously thinking of a strategy…
…
In this way, several hours passed in a flash.
The elder from Nanming Immortal Sect looked towards the front, his expression grim, and the aura around him also began to fluctuate.
It seemed, he was gradually becoming impatient.
Seeing that Lin Jing still did not appear, the elder from the Nanming Immortal Sect could not help but speak again:
“Lin Jing…”
“I know you are nearby.”
“You won’t come out, huh.”
“Since it is so, don’t blame me.”
Having said this, the elder from the Nanming Immortal Sect turned his head and said to Yun Long at his side:
“Yun Long, take a trip to Nanshan Immortal City, annihilate the Li Family, and by the way, capture Li Qingqing, the family head…”
After hearing this, Yun Long quickly bowed and said:
“Yes, master…”
Having said this, Yun Long then rode his Flying Sword and flew towards the direction of Nanming Immortal City.
Meanwhile, the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect continued to wait in the same place, waiting for Lin Jing to appear.
The thing Lin Jing feared most had finally happened.
Unable to catch Lin Jing, the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect started to cause trouble for Li Qingqing.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had anticipated this and had already thought of a strategy.
This was the elder of Nanming Immortal Sect’s solution to break the situation, but it was also Lin Jing’s opportunity.
If Yun Long had stayed by the side of the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, Lin Jing would have really found it difficult to kill him.
Ɲονǥօ.сօ
But now that they were separated, Lin Jing also had a chance to kill him.
This time.
Lin Jing would not give him another chance to come back to life.
Just as Yun Long rode his Flying Sword and left, Lin Jing also controlled the observation angle, keeping up with Yun Long.
Lin Jing knew, with Yun Long leaving, the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect would definitely be watching closely.
But precisely at this time, Lin Jing wanted to eliminate Yun Long.
Otherwise, when Lin Jing truly confronted the elder from Nanming Immortal Sect, he would no longer have the energy to deal with Yun Long.
Yun Long would then become the biggest variable; his Demonic Techniques were too sinister, threatening both himself and the people around him.
Lin Jing must eliminate him before that.
Remembering the arrogant words Yun Long had declared before his self-detonation.
Lin Jing could not help but sneer:
“Still want to kill the people around oneself, to scatter one’s own ashes?”
“Don’t even think about it…”
Since Lin Jing decided to kill him, he would definitely not leave any troubles behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 602
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 602: Chapter 253 Yun Long Dies, Barren Forbidden Zone Chapter 602: Chapter 253 Yun Long Dies, Barren Forbidden Zone Lin Jing followed behind Yun Long until he reached the maximum range of Observation Mode.
As soon as Yun Long left the observation scope of the apocalypse, Lin Jing no longer hesitated and called out to the System.
“System…”
“Activate the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function!”
Lin Jing knew that the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect had been closely watching any movements near Yun Long.
Even the possibility that Yun Long was sent to the Li Family might very well be a trap laid by the Immortal Sect’s ancestor.
Their purpose was to draw him out.
Although he had anticipated this, Lin Jing didn’t care.
Killing Yun Long was essential, and Lin Jing was confident that he could escape from the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect after slaying Yun Long despite the distance.
...
As Lin Jing finished speaking, his observational perspective shifted, and everything in the nearby area came clearly into his view.
Lin Jing then chose a spot beside Yun Long and used Fixed-Point Teleportation…
After Lin Jing made his choice, the System’s prompt sounded again:
“Ding!”
“Host has used Fixed-Point Teleportation Function, 1 Harvest Point deducted, remaining Harvest Points: 16879.”
Right after the System’s prompt ended, Lin Jing was transported out of the System Space and appeared at the previously selected location.After Lin Jing emerged, before he could make a move, a voice reached his ears:
“As expected…”
“I guessed correctly, you really possess that extraordinary mysterious Spatial Treasure…”
Accompanying the voice was an extremely terrifying Divine Sense oppression.
This Divine Sense oppression was very formidable; even though Lin Jing was well-prepared and concentrated his Divine Sense power for defense, the defense couldn’t last very long.
In just a moment, the Divine Sense oppression suddenly intensified, breaking through Lin Jing’s defense.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had another card up his sleeve.
ƝοѵǤ0.с0
As the Divine Sense was about to breach his defenses, Lin Jing had already called out to the System again.
“System…”
“Activate Bonus Attachment Function!”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the System promptly responded:
“Ding!”
“Bonus Attachment activated successfully, 5 Harvest Points deducted, current remaining Harvest Points: 16874.” (Note: Bonus Attachment lasts for five minutes, after which 1 Harvest Point will be deducted per minute.)
With the sound of the System’s voice, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged, and the dreadful Divine Sense oppression significantly weakened at that moment.
At this time, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect had already made his move.
The ancestor of the sect drew out a Crimson Flying Sword and launched it at Lin Jing with incredible speed.
The Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor followed closely behind the sword, aiming to kill Lin Jing.
At this moment, Lin Jing couldn’t afford to worry about what was behind him and turned his focus toward Yun Long, who was not far ahead.
He burst forward with extreme speed, pouncing towards Yun Long.
Lin Jing’s sudden appearance stunned Yun Long for a moment, but it was just for an instant before Yun Long reacted.
Once Yun Long recovered, he hastily called out:
“Master, Lin Jing…”
However, Yun Long had only let out those few words before he abruptly stopped because Lin Jing had already appeared in front of him.
Having arrived in front of Yun Long, Lin Jing had already gathered the Five Elements Power, which this time wasn’t just one or two streams but dozens converging into a cluster.
Indeed, it was even more than he had used when annihilating the ancestor of the Yun Family.
It had already surged forth, penetrating Yun Long’s body.
As the Five Elements Power entered Yun Long’s body, Lin Jing bellowed:
“Explode!”
Afterward, Lin Jing did not look back and flew forward once more.
Because he could clearly sense that the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect was closing in from behind, and if he delayed even a moment longer, it might be difficult to escape.
As for Yun Long, there was no need to pay him any further attention, as his fate was already sealed…
The Five Elements Power exploded within Yun Long’s body, which was now enveloped in a Five-Colored Aurora.
Under the influence of the Five Elements Power, Yun Long’s body began to slowly disintegrate.
Yun Long’s face was filled with terror, and by the time the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect caught up, hope flickered across Yun Long’s face upon seeing him.
Then he pleaded:
“Master, save me…”
This cluster of Five Elements Power was immensely powerful; even the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor frowned and did not get too close.
“Five Elements Divine Art…” the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor said with knitted brows.
After speaking, he turned his gaze back to Yun Long.
By then, Yun Long’s condition had worsened, as one of his arms and a leg had completely disintegrated.
And another arm was left with only half…
Yun Long, panic-stricken, beheld the dazzling Five-Colored Aurora with increasing alarm.
Like a flame fed by oil, no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t extinguish it.
At this point, Yun Long turned to the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor again, about to seek rescue, but he saw that the ancestor had begun to move…
Yun Long’s heart surged with overwhelming joy.
Just when Yun Long thought he would be saved, the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor did something utterly unexpected.
The ancestor extended a hand, transforming it into a blood-red palm that passed through the Five-Colored Aurora and landed on top of Yun Long’s head.
Yun Long, sensing impending doom, quickly said:
“Master…”
“What are you doing?”
However, the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor did not reply, and a flash of red light in his eyes was followed by the appearance of a blood-red Spiritual Power at the top of Yun Long’s head.
It was then absorbed into the palm…
As the blood-red Spiritual Power emerged, Yun Long’s body disintegrated even faster.
Yun Long screamed out in agony:
“Aah…!”
Then, his eyes filled with anger, he looked at the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor:
“Master…”
“Why are you doing this?”
Only then did the Nanming Immortal Sect’s ancestor spoke:

chapters.title: Chapter 603
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 603: Chapter 253 Yun Long Dies, Barren Forbidden Zone_2 Chapter 603: Chapter 253 Yun Long Dies, Barren Forbidden Zone_2 “Lin Jing used the Five Elements Divine Art, you are undoubtedly going to die this time…”
“It’s a pity, I originally wanted to wait until you transformed into divinity, then refine you to aid me in advancing to the Solidifying Body Realm.”
“Now there’s no way around it; since you’re bound to die, I can only absorb your cultivation ahead of time for my own use.”
When the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect spoke these words, his expression was calm and his tone was untroubled.
But to Yun Long, these words thundered in his ears…
Yun Long looked at the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, his eyes filled with disbelief.
“You…”
“You took me as your disciple, just to refine me…”
The elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect didn’t stop his movements, saying indifferently:
“Of course…”
“With the Yun Family, you’re not worth my attention.”
“Otherwise, why do you think I took you as my disciple, teaching you demonic techniques?”
“So that’s how it is…” Only then did Yun Long come to a realization.
However, there was no chance for him to regret it anymore.
By now, under the influence of the Five Elements Power and the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, Yun Long’s body had mostly dissolved.
Only his upper body and head remained.
...
At this moment, Yun Long’s face was full of regret.
It was unclear whether he regretted practicing demonic techniques or joining the Nanming Immortal Sect…
Later, Yun Long looked at the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, his eyes brimming with immense hatred:
“Today”
And at this moment, the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect exerted more force, and the blood-red spiritual power above Yun Long’s head momentarily thickened.
In just a moment, all the spiritual power within Yun Long’s body was absorbed by the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, and without the support of spiritual power, Yun Long instantly died.
Until the moment of his death, Yun Long’s eyes were still wide open, looking at the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, his hatred unabated.
Soon after, Yun Long was completely devoured by the Five Elements Power.
After absorbing Yun Long’s spiritual power, the aura of the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect grew even stronger.
Yun Long’s death was known to Lin Jing.
Indeed, there are no such things as pie falling from the sky in this world.
Yun Long, who thought he was inducted by the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, only realized at the last moment that it was all a lie.
Once the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect had absorbed all the blood-red spiritual power from Yun Long, he stayed in place for a while…
Apparently absorbing…
After he finished absorbing, Lin Jing had already flown far away.
The elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect looked up in the direction Lin Jing had fled, and then a cold smile appeared on his lips.
He then took a step and pursued Lin Jing…
…
The area of the Nanming Domain is actually very large.
If it were hundreds of thousands of years ago, it would have taken Lin Jing at least several years, or even more than a decade, to cross the Nanming Domain.
But since the catastrophe a million years ago, when an unknown object broke through the boundary and fell into this cultivation world,
and that unknown object landed right in the middle of the Nanming Domain.
At that time, the Nanming Domain, could be said to be the strongest existence among the Four Domains.
It housed a large number of cultivators, even in the Mahayana and Tribulation realms, making up about forty percent of the entire cultivation world.
But that catastrophe covered more than ninety percent of the Nanming Domain.
Most of the Nanming Domain, apart from the surviving areas, turned into forbidden zones.
And in the regions engulfed by the catastrophe, whether they were cultivators or mortals, not one escaped.
Such a huge event immediately caught the attention of the entire cultivation world.
After sensing the catastrophe, forces from the other three domains and the demonic and monster inner sea sent powerful beings to investigate the center of the catastrophe.
Some went alone, and some went in groups of two or three into the range of the catastrophe.
However…
After entering, some people didn’t stay long before they hurriedly came out.
Upon their return, each of them was pale as if they had encountered something extremely terrifying.
Others stayed inside a bit longer.
When these people came out, each of them was extremely haggard, as if they had suddenly aged a lot.
Of course, there were also some who entered and never came out again…
Those who came out from the center of the catastrophe, after returning, were unanimous…
That was the region shrouded in catastrophe, and from then on, it was a forbidden zone, where no cultivator was allowed to approach carelessly.
Thus, after that announcement was made, the powerhouses from the other three domains and the demonic sea within the Nanming Domain left directly.
From then on, the Nanming Domain completely declined.
And the area, making up over ninety percent of the Nanming Domain that was struck by catastrophe, was called the Barren Forbidden Zone.
It was named the Barren Forbidden Zone because within the whole zone, there were no living beings.
Only endless Yin Spirits…
And now, Lin Jing was on the outskirts of the Barren Forbidden Zone.
The outskirts of the Barren Forbidden Zone, where the Nanming Domain bordered the Barren Forbidden Zone, still some distance away from the Barren Forbidden Zone itself.
The sky here was gloomy, looking extremely oppressive.
Looking up, one’s eyes met dry trees and layers of fallen branches and leaves that had accumulated unknowingly over a long time.
Moreover, there was no sound here; the world between heaven and earth was utterly silent.
Lin Jing hovered in mid-air, with only the whistling wind carrying a smell of decay and his own faint heartbeat beside his ears.
This place had no living beings.
Not even insects or the like…
Standing here, Lin Jing’s heart inexplicably throbbed, feeling as if there was something especially dangerous existing inside the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Lin Jing looked toward the interior of the Barren Forbidden Zone, furrowing his brows in thought for a moment before continuing to fly inward.
Although the Barren Forbidden Zone was dangerous, it was not unexplored.
ƝօνǤ0.сο
Long ago, when Lin Jing was browsing books at Elder Yu’s place, he had seen some descriptions of this Barren Forbidden Zone.
There were even some notes left by people who had ventured into the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Those who had explored the Barren Forbidden Zone all shared one piece of unified advice:
That was, when entering the Barren Forbidden Zone, one should not stay too long; moreover, one should not go too deep.
Also, be extremely cautious in everything.
Especially when facing Yin Spirits, it’s best to hide and not get noticed by them.
If one accidentally encounters Yin Spirits, one must flee quickly, otherwise the Yin Spirits will gather in increasing numbers, and by then, even if one wants to escape, they won’t be able to.
Furthermore, in the Barren Forbidden Zone, those Yin Spirits are protected by a mysterious force and cannot be killed.
…
Lin Jing’s appearance here was naturally to escape from the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
This was something Lin Jing had thought of beforehand.
The ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect was too difficult to deal with, and Lin Jing was simply no match for him, only able to use the special nature of the Barren Forbidden Zone to buy some time.
The two of them, one chasing and one fleeing, from the initial mountain range to the outskirts of the Barren Forbidden Zone, had taken half a month’s time.
Half a month ago, Lin Jing had already secretly sent out a message, instructing Li Qingqing to take the Li Family members and Ye Yun to leave the Nanming Domain and return to Li Yan Island.
And Lin Jing was leading the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect toward the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Now that half a month had passed, Lin Jing assumed they had already left, and he no longer had any concerns.
If Lin Jing could now escape from the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect, he would be free of worries…
However, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect clung to him like a persistent plaster, never loosening his grip no matter what.
Especially…
When Lin Jing, during a crisis, produced the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect became even more convinced of his own thoughts.
He clung tightly to Lin Jing, determined to take him down.
Lin Jing was also extremely speechless but helpless.
The situation at that time was too perilous, and Lin Jing had to take out the Great Dream Ancient Mirror and forcibly activate it, allowing him to barely escape.
Furthermore, after that incident.
Because Lin Jing had forcibly used the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, he paid a considerable price, and after escaping, he rested in the System Space for several days before he recovered his strength.
Lin Jing was also very grateful that he had previously studied the method of forcibly using the Great Dream Ancient Mirror.
Otherwise, that time would have been truly perilous for him.
…
Not long after Lin Jing departed, another figure appeared where Lin Jing had just been.
This figure was none other than the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
The ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect looked up, his brow furrowed as he gazed in the direction Lin Jing had fled, and then he snorted coldly:
“Trying to enter the Barren Forbidden Zone to escape from me?”
“Humph!”
“Delusional…”
“The treasures on you won’t escape, they are all mine…”
Saying this, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect flashed and chased into the Barren Forbidden Zone…

chapters.title: Chapter 604
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 604: Chapter 254 Bait Chapter 604: Chapter 254 Bait In the Barren Forbidden Zone, Spiritual Energy is extremely scarce, even more so than outside the zone.
The reason for this, some speculate, is the mysterious substance from a million years ago, which continuously absorbs Spiritual Power, thus creating such a scarce Spiritual Energy environment.
Moreover, apart from the scarcity of Spiritual Energy, there is another characteristic within the Barren Forbidden Zone…
A characteristic that instills fear…
