This sudden blow nearly caused them to collapse.
Now, after persistent trials, the demon cultivators realized their cultivation could not be recovered, and looking at Grandfather Shi San, they became extremely angry…
Being stripped of their cultivation was more unbearable than being outright killed.
But they knew they were no match for Grandfather Shi San; although they were angry, they did not rashly charge forward.
However, at this moment, a teleportation array in the depths of the Demon Race Secret Realm suddenly emitted a strong light.
This teleportation array was the one set up by the Howling Sky Wolf Clan that directly connected from the secret realm in the Western Demon Region to the Demon Race Secret Realm.
When the Howling Sky Wolf Clan first entered the Nanming Domain, they traveled through this teleportation array to the Demon Race Secret Realm, and then from there, they entered the Nanming Domain.
As the light grew stronger, a figure clad in white appeared atop the teleportation array.
After appearing, this figure in white vanished from the spot…
Shortly after…
The vanished figure in white suddenly appeared in front of those demon cultivators.
It turned out that this figure in white was an old man.
He was thin and hunchbacked, yet his eyes were like the bright moon in the night sky, deep yet luminous.
Upon seeing this person, the demon cultivators seemed to have found their backbone and hurriedly gathered around him.
“Ancestor of the Wolves…” they bowed and said.
The demon cultivator of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan also quickly bowed:
“Forefather…”
It turned out that this old man was the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.
Upon arriving, the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan took a quick glance at them before fixing his vigilant gaze on Grandfather Shi San.
Especially the astonishing aura emanating from Grandfather Shi San made him wary of making any rash moves.
He had felt something was amiss.
He sensed that something unexpected had occurred in the Demon Race Secret Realm and rushed over to check it out.
Yet, he had not expected that the person appearing in the Demon Race Secret Realm would be so formidable.
The aura exuding from the opponent was enough to keep him from acting recklessly.
“May I inquire who you are?” asked the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, hesitantly addressing Grandfather Shi San.
Grandfather Shi San gave the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan a look and simply stated,
“Eastern Spirit Realm, Shi Yuan.”
“Eastern Spirit Realm, the Shi Family…” upon hearing this, the face of the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan immediately turned pale.
Ji Xiyue’s father and the Solidifying Body cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect apparently also knew of Grandfather Shi San’s origins, and their gaze towards Grandfather Shi San became even more reverent.
Knowing the identity of the person before him, the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan frowned deeply.
Although he did not want to offend the other party, he looked at the several cultivators beside him whose cultivation had been stripped away.
He gritted his teeth and took a step forward:
“I wonder what offense my Demon Clan has caused to the senior for such anger to have stripped away their cultivation…”
“Senior Shi…”
“They are the core descendants of my Demon Clan, carrying the critical responsibility for the clan’s survival.
I hope that the senior can restore their cultivation for the sake of the Demon Emperor.”
Just as the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan finished speaking, they immediately heard a cold snort coming from Grandfather Shi San.
Following that…
The forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan felt himself engulfed by an extremely terrifying presence, accompanied by a fleeting intent to kill…
Unable to bear it any longer, the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan roared angrily, and then a huge white wolf phantom emerged.
The phantom quickly shrank and merged into the body of the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.
At this point, the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan’s eyes turned blood red, his aura became wild and spread around him, causing the demon cultivators around him to retreat consecutively, forced to avoid him.
But soon after…
Grandfather Shi San simply pointed forward, and a streak of green light shot from his hand, aiming straight at the forehead of the forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.
The forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan wanted to dodge, but he could not react in time.
He was hit by the green light.
The forefather of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan struck by the green light had his wild aura instantly dissipate, and his whole being immediately slumped.
Then…
They heard Grandfather Shi San say coldly,
“You have no right to bargain with me…”
“If it weren’t for the Demon Emperor’s sake, I wouldn’t have spared any of the seven great Demon Clans…”
“Go back and tell the Demon Emperor that the Nanming Domain is not your Demon Clan’s backyard to come and go as you please…”
“If I find out that your Demon Clan is attempting to meddle with the Nanming Domain again, I wouldn’t mind slaughtering my way through the Western Demon Region…”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 636
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 636: Chapter 270 Tribulation Chapter 636: Chapter 270 Tribulation Ultimately…
The elder of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan still fled in disgrace, bringing along those seven Demon Cultivators whose cultivation had fallen.
He only possessed Dao Integration cultivation, and compared to Grandfather Shi San, the gap was truly too vast.
If not for the Demon Emperor, it’s likely that none of them would have escaped.
After the elder of the Howling Sky Wolf Clan had led all the members of the Demon Clan away, Grandfather Shi San even more so casually struck, directly destroying the entire Teleportation Array.
Once the Teleportation Array was destroyed, the entire Demon Clan could no longer use it to invade the Nanming Domain.
From then on, the Nanming Domain was finally completely safe.
...
After those members of the Demon Clan had left, the remaining few immediately stepped forward, clasping their hands to Grandfather Shi San:
“Thank you, elder, for your assistance…”
Grandfather Shi San glanced at them and then spoke:
“I came to this Secret Realm ultimately for my own matters, you need not thank me.”
As soon as Grandfather Shi San finished speaking, the elder of the Qingyuan Sword Sect spoke up:
“Grandfather Shi, you are too modest…”
“By taking action to drive away the Demon Clan and saving the Nanming Domain from perils, such a great favor is unforgettable.”
And the elder of Yiyun Pavilion also hurriedly chimed in:“Yes…”
“Elder, you are indeed too modest.”
This time Grandfather Shi San didn’t respond but looked at them and directly said:
“For the next few days, I need to borrow this Secret Realm for some time; you folks should leave first.”
Grandfather Shi San’s words were firm, leaving no room for doubt; this was not a discussion, but a direct notification.
The four looked up at Grandfather Shi San, although they did not know why he wanted to temporarily use the Demon Clan’s Secret Realm, they still respectfully said:
“May I ask elder how long you plan to stay in this Secret Realm?
“This way, we can prepare to guard the entrance properly and prevent anyone from accidentally entering.”
“Not long, a few days at least, a month at most; once he exits, you all may come and go as you please in this Secret Realm…” Grandfather Shi San directly told Lin Jing.
At this moment, they also turned their heads, looking towards Lin Jing.
They did not ask further, but directly clasped their hands towards Grandfather Shi San:
“Very well, Grandfather Shi…”
“We will leave now.”
“Rest assured, elder, we will not let anyone enter the Secret Realm during this period.”
Grandfather Shi San nodded slightly.
Then the few once again clasped their hands towards Grandfather Shi San, and then turned around, prepared to leave.
But just at that moment…
Grandfather Shi San suddenly spoke up, stopping them.
The few turned around, clasping their hands:
“Elder…”
“May I ask if there is anything else you require?”
Grandfather Shi San directly spoke:
“I’ve heard that up until now, you are still seeking the murderer who killed the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, aren’t you?”
“Yes…” The few looked at each other and hurriedly responded.
Since the elder before them brought up this matter, the demise of the Nanming Immortal Sect’s elder might have another explanation…
Grandfather Shi San continued:
“No need to look further.
He disregarded the name of the three major sects of the Nanming Domain, cultivated strange Demonic Techniques, and all was simply retribution he brought upon himself.”
The few suddenly realized and looked at Grandfather Shi San with grateful eyes:
“Thank you, elder, for ridding the Nanming Domain of another scourge…”
“Otherwise, once this person’s demonic power was fully developed, there’s no telling how many people he would have harmed.”
Grandfather Shi San did not rebut, but directly waved his hand at them:
“Alright…”
“You may go!”
“Yes…” Having said that, the few clasped their hands to Grandfather Shi San, bade farewell, and then departed from the place.
After the four had left, within this entire Demon Clan Secret Realm, only Lin Jing and Grandfather Shi San remained.
Subsequently…
Grandfather Shi San led Lin Jing, flying towards the depths of the Demon Clan Secret Realm.
Only after they had flown a considerable distance did the two stop on a rock shoal deep within the Secret Realm.
In front of the rock shoal was a desert, exactly the place they had passed on their way in.
Behind the rock shoal, it was enveloped in gray mist.
Upon arriving there, Grandfather Shi San first looked around and then peered into the gray mist.
A moment later, Grandfather Shi San nodded, seeming very satisfied.
“Right here…”
“You shall undergo your Tribulation here.”
After saying this, Grandfather Shi San looked at Lin Jing and said:
“You are a Body Refinement Cultivator, who wishes to advance your Body Refinement cultivation to Divinity Transformation; this Tribulation should not rely on any external aids, not even Elixir Medicine.”
“Only by enduring the Tribulation Lightning to temper your body can your path in the Martial Dao truly begin.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Elder, I understand…”
But Grandfather Shi San, as if still concerned, spoke again:
“Also…”
“That final bolt of Tribulation Lightning mainly targets the Soul Spirit; a moment’s inattention can lead to losing your way and requires extra caution.”
Lin Jing nodded, indicating he understood.
Grandfather Shi San nodded, then turned and walked away from the spot.
This place was where Lin Jing would undergo his Tribulation, and being too close could potentially involve him.
Therefore, he needed to temporarily leave the area…
Lin Jing, after Grandfather Shi San had left, walked towards the shoal, then chose a spot that looked favorable and sat down to begin his Tribulation.
After Lin Jing sat down, he then started circulating his Cultivation Technique, adjusting his state, and attracting the Heavenly Tribulation.
…
Lin Jing sat cross-legged, circulating his Cultivation Technique, his aura also continuously rising.
This Tribulation did not take too long.
The sky soon reacted, becoming oppressive.
For this Tribulation, Lin Jing had prepared for a long time, so as soon as he released his aura, it quickly triggered the Heavenly Tribulation’s response.
In the sky, the clouds of Tribulation also began to gather.
The power of this Heavenly Tribulation should be extraordinary, as evident from the clouds in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 637
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 637: Chapter 270 Tribulation_2 Chapter 637: Chapter 270 Tribulation_2 That day, the dark tribulation clouds in the sky gathered above Lin Jing’s head, quickly covering the entire nearby region.
The heavens and earth turned from daylight to nightfall in an instant.
The scope of the tribulation clouds was several times larger than when Lin Jing had advanced to the Nascent Soul stage.
However, this was not all.
For at this moment, the tribulation clouds above Lin Jing’s head were still amassing, showing no signs of stopping.
At this time, Grandfather Shi San, who was watching all this from a distance, furrowed his brows slightly.
…
...
…
Time passed, and several hours later, the tribulation clouds above Lin Jing were still increasing.
ƝονǤᴑ.ƈօ
By now, the tribulation clouds gathered above Lin Jing had grown to several times their initial size.
Grandfather Shi San, who had already kept his distance, seeing this situation, had no choice but to retreat even further away.
At this moment, he looked at Lin Jing at the heart of the tribulation clouds with a trace of worry flitting across his eyes.
However, now that the tribulation clouds had gathered, the Heavenly Tribulation was about to manifest, and it was already impossible for Lin Jing to give up.
…
Fortunately, it wasn’t long before the tribulation clouds finished gathering and ceased to grow.
After the completion, streaks of thunder began to appear within the tribulation clouds.
It was clear, the tribulation clouds had finished amassing.
Next, the Heavenly Tribulation was going to arrive.
At this moment, at the very center of the tribulation clouds, above Lin Jing’s head, the pitch-black clouds would occasionally flash with purple lightning.
The tribulation lightning that condensed was that purple lightning.
It must be noted that during the advancement to Nascent Soul, only the final three bolts of tribulation lightning were purple.
And this was merely the first…
At this time, Lin Jing also felt the terror of the Heavenly Tribulation thunder above.
He stood up and activated the Overlord Divine Physique, with a layer of dark golden light emerging from his body, enveloping him entirely.
At this time,
Above Lin Jing’s head, the purple lightning became more and more intense, like countless purple-gold dragons shuttling through the tribulation clouds.
And within the tribulation clouds, the rolling thunderous rumble continued to emanate incessantly.
It was as if mighty dragons were growling…
With these growls came an increasingly oppressive and terrifying aura of dread…
…
…
“Boom!”
A blinding bolt of purple lightning dragon struck down, followed by a roar as fierce as a dragon’s bellow.
This first bolt of tribulation lightning descended, striking directly towards Lin Jing.
In front of the colossal purple lightning dragon, Lin Jing was like an insignificant ant, instantly engulfed by the lightning.
…
…
After a few breaths, the first bolt of tribulation lightning dissipated after exhausting its strength.
Following the dissipation of the first bolt, Lin Jing, who had been submerged in lightning, reappeared.
At this time.
After the tribulation lightning, a huge pit a thousand zhang in radius had been carved into the ground below Lin Jing’s feet.
The pit was profound, the result of the very first bolt of tribulation lightning.
And Lin Jing’s clothes had been shredded by this bolt, revealing his robust physique, with several obvious wounds upon his body.
Lin Jing looked at the wounds on his body and frowned…
This first bolt of tribulation lightning had injured him, even though he had activated the Overlord Divine Physique.
This was the first time Lin Jing had encountered such a situation.
He had not expected the Divinity Transformation Heavenly Tribulation to be so strong.
Not just Lin Jing.
Even Grandfather Shi San, who was observing Lin Jing undergo the tribulation from a distance, couldn’t help but furrow his brows, murmuring to himself:
“What’s going on with this lad?”
“Why is his Heavenly Tribulation so powerful?”
“Could it be that he has cultivated some special Cultivation Technique?”
“This kind of Heavenly Tribulation is simply not something a cultivator of his level should be able to withstand…”
Having said that, he looked at Lin Jing at the center of the tribulation clouds, seeing that he was not in serious trouble, then turned his gaze away and spoke again:
“Forget it…”
“Let’s wait and see; if things don’t look good, I’ll have to forcibly intervene and save his life…”
…
Nascent Soul Cultivators possess strong regenerative abilities; they can even regenerate severed limbs, so the wounds on Lin Jing’s body were swiftly healed.
After repairing these wounds, Lin Jing looked up again at the tribulation clouds above.
Because the gathering for the second bolt of tribulation lightning was nearly complete, and it was about to descend.
Lin Jing had to concentrate his Cultivation to face the incoming second bolt of tribulation lightning.
“Boom!”
This second bolt of tribulation lightning also descended on cue.
The second bolt was stronger than the first, causing Lin Jing’s newly healed wounds to tear open again.
Moreover, these wounds were even more numerous than before.
After the tribulation lightning passed, there were still strands of purple lightning arcs lingering at the wounds, continuing to wreak havoc and hindering Lin Jing’s recovery.
However, these arcs were not too difficult to deal with and were cleared out easily.
After clearing the arcs and once again healing his injuries, Lin Jing looked up again at the sky.
And then the third bolt of tribulation lightning suddenly descended.
The signs before its fall were not very noticeable.
However, its power was not diminished in the least.
The wounds that burst open on Lin Jing’s body from this bolt were more than double the previous ones; he looked as if he had been retrieved from a pool of blood.
After this third bolt of tribulation lightning vanished, Lin Jing was forced to sit cross-legged and accelerate his recovery.
However…
After this third bolt of tribulation lightning, another change occurred within the tribulation clouds above Lin Jing.
What was initially the purple lightning slowly disappeared from view.
And within the tribulation clouds, only the thunderous rumbles continued, with no other lightning to be seen.
However, upon closer inspection, one would realize,
It wasn’t that there was no lightning; rather, the flickering had turned pitch black, blending seamlessly into the ink-like tribulation clouds.

chapters.title: Chapter 638
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 638: Chapter 270 Tribulation_3 Chapter 638: Chapter 270 Tribulation_3 If you don’t look carefully, you simply won’t notice.
The extremely potent Black Tribulation Lightning started appearing from the fourth strike this time.
Lin Jing’s tribulation was indeed extraordinarily perilous.
At this moment, seeing the Black Tribulation Lightning, Grandfather Shi San’s brow furrowed even tighter.
And in his hand, a faint blue light was vaguely visible…
…
The fourth strike of Tribulation Lightning was not as swift.
...
It finally gave Lin Jing a moment to breathe.
By the time the fourth strike of Tribulation Lightning was ready, Lin Jing was prepared, just waiting for the lightning to strike.
“Boom!”
This fourth strike of Tribulation Lightning, like darkness descending, completely engulfed Lin Jing within the black column of lightning.
And within that black column of lightning, Lin Jing instantly felt as if his flesh was being ground in a mill…
Such pain was almost unbearable for ordinary people.
But Lin Jing clenched his teeth tightly, enduring it directly.
“Here it comes…”
Lin Jing instantly knew in his heart.
He knew this moment had finally arrived.
Long before the tribulation, Lin Jing had learned about this from the Martial Dao insights that Grandfather Shi San had given him.
Ɲ0νǤ0.сο
In the practice of Martial Dao, transforming into Divinity is crucial.
Before the Divinity Transformation, one could only be called a Body Refinement Cultivator.
Only after entering Divinity Transformation could one be said to have stepped onto the Martial Dao.
And entering the Martial Dao required passing this very hurdle.
To refine the soul, to merge the intent…
With one’s unbreakable will, merging it into every limb and even into the bloodstream.
Lin Jing knew this step would be painful, but he did not realize it would be so excruciating.
And in such a situation, he could rely on no one but himself.
This fourth strike of Tribulation Lightning lasted for nine breaths.
Nine is the extreme number, and nine breaths is also the longest duration for the Tribulation Lightning.
After nine breaths, the Tribulation Lightning dispersed.
When Lin Jing was seen again, the flesh on his body was all exposed, looking extremely terrifying.
And on his body, the roaming black lightning arcs continued to erode his flesh relentlessly.
However…
Lin Jing at this moment had no time to pay attention to those black lightning arcs.
Because the next strike of Tribulation Lightning was coming…
Skin, muscles, viscera…
The three strikes of Tribulation Lightning respectively corresponded to three types of body parts, but from the fourth strike on, it was the real Martial Dao Heavenly Tribulation.
The first three strikes were just appetizers.
“Boom!”
Another strike of Tribulation Lightning fell, this strike, like a massive boulder pressing down fiercely.
It caused Lin Jing’s entire skeleton to shatter immediately.
And those black lightning arcs penetrated directly through his already tattered flesh, merging into his entire skeletal structure.
When the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing collapsed completely to the ground.
Because at this moment, Lin Jing’s entire skeleton could no longer support him to stand.
Just as the fifth strike of Tribulation Lightning had barely dissipated, following closely…
“Rumble…!”
The sixth strike of Tribulation Lightning arrived on cue…
This sixth Tribulation Lightning corresponds to the viscera.
Under this Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing’s viscera instantaneously cracked open…
Lin Jing hastily gathered Spiritual Power, trying to repair the viscera within his body.
He was but a Nascent Soul Cultivator then, not yet having achieved Divinity Transformation.
If the body were severely injured, a Nascent Soul Cultivator would still die, at most leaving behind only the Nascent Soul.
But under this Heavenly Tribulation, a Nascent Soul without a body’s protection was undoubtedly doomed to die.
Only by achieving Divinity Transformation could a Divine Transformation Cultivator survive, as long as the Soul Spirit was not extinguished, they could reconvene a body at any time.
…
This sequence of Tribulation Lightnings was indeed too powerful.
After that sixth Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing laid crumpled on the ground like a torn sack of cloth.
At this point, nearly all his flesh was gone, every bone in his body was broken, and even his internal organs were all split apartâ€”only enveloped by Spiritual Power, thus not completely shattered.
Yet even under such circumstances, Lin Jing’s body was still engulfed by black lightning arcs, continuously ravaging his body…
At this time, Lin Jing’s breath was faint, and his entire body was wracked with endless agony.
Under such extreme pain, even he almost passed out, but he could not afford to faint, as doing so would mean certain death.
From death comes life…
This is the first step into the path of Martial Dao.
Now, Lin Jing had to grit his teeth and endure…
While enduring, Lin Jing continuously gathered Spiritual Power, repairing the injuries on his body…
Meanwhile, from a distance, Grandfather Shi San, watching Lin Jing’s dire state, couldn’t help but tremble for a moment with his hands behind his back, though he quickly steadied himself.
And his face still had a deeply furrowed brow…
…
After this sixth Tribulation Lightning, the tribulation clouds showed no movement for a long time, nor did they dissipate.
It seemed as though those three consecutive Tribulation Lightnings had exhausted the Heavenly Tribulation Power, now gathering strength once more.
It was during this time, though, that the wounds on Lin Jing’s body were slowly healing.
And…
The healing began slowly but accelerated progressively.
At this moment, as his own injuries healed, Lin Jing’s eyes grew increasingly bright.
Refining the body, integrating the intent…
Lin Jing had already completed body refining, and now, through this transition from death to life, was the integration of intent…
When Lin Jing’s injuries were completely healed, and he stood up again, he had undergone an earth-shattering transformation.
Not just physically, but more so in his aura.
His entire demeanor had become extremely fierce.
It was as if he possessed a confidence that transcended the heavens and the earth.
As Lin Jing’s injuries healed, he looked up at the sky, his eyes twinkling with sharpness.
At this moment, the tribulation clouds in the sky continually roiled.
The dull rumbling sounds continued, and the black lightning arcs were also converging towards the center of the tribulation clouds.
Then…
“Boom…!”
A thunderous roar resounded; the seventh Tribulation Lightning descended in response, this seventh Tribulation Lightning, though also black, was several times thicker than the sixth Tribulation Lightning just then.
As this seventh Tribulation Lightning fell, Lin Jing surged skyward, charging directly into it.
The moment they made contact, countless wounds burst open on Lin Jing’s body, and copious amounts of fresh blood fell.
But Lin Jing merely furrowed his brow slightly, then without any hesitation, plunged directly into the lightning.
Having just undergone a rebirth through death, integrating intent into his body wasn’t enough…
Next…
Lin Jing still needed to use those last three Tribulation Lightnings to experience another phoenix-like rebirth, thus completely integrating the intent, stepping into the Divinity Transformation stage of the Martial Dao…

chapters.title: Chapter 639
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 639: Chapter 271: Successful Tribulation, Entering Divinity Transformation Chapter 639: Chapter 271: Successful Tribulation, Entering Divinity Transformation Nine breaths…
This seventh Tribulation Lightning was the same, lasting for nine breaths.
When the seventh Tribulation Lightning disappeared, atop that massive pit, only Lin Jing remained.
As the seventh Tribulation Lightning struck, Lin Jing even felt fluctuations ripple through the surrounding space.
At this moment, his body was torn and flesh burst open, even the broken bones inside were exposed.
However.
Though the seventh Tribulation Lightning was fierce, after enduring the earlier strikes, Lin Jing’s recovery speed had increased significantly.
...
It wasn’t long before Lin Jing’s body began to heal once again.
Even though this seventh Tribulation Lightning was powerful enough to cause spatial fluctuations,
it still failed to inflict fatal damage on Lin Jing.
…
…
“Boom…!”
While Lin Jing still hadn’t fully recovered, the eighth Tribulation Lightning suddenly descended.
The pitch-black Lightning, like a waterfall, fell from the Tribulation clouds, creating ripples wherever it covered due to the spatial fluctuations.
Then, the Lightning struck directly down, engulfing Lin Jing once more.
Grandpa Shi San remained standing in the distance, watching Lin Jing weather the Tribulation.
At this moment, his face was calm as he watched Lin Jing being swallowed by the Lightning from within the clouds.
And the hands he held behind his back were, without anyone noticing, already withdrawn.
…
…
After the eighth Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing reemerged.
Though he was in disarray, the aura around Lin Jing had grown even stronger after being tempered by the Lightning.
Following the eighth Tribulation Lightning, the speed of recovery from his injuries had increased once more.
And…
After recovering from the injuries, the dark gold light that had been reflecting on Lin Jing’s body had completely vanished.
This time, there was no light covering his body.
Though he no longer had the protective layer of reflected light, Lin Jing felt his body had never been in better condition.
It was only now that he truly sensed the terrifying power hidden within his body.
At this point, Lin Jing’s body had fully recovered.
However, the clouds above his head seemed to still be brewing something.
Lin Jing then raised his head, looking upwards.
He saw the black Tribulation clouds starting to converge towards the center.
And as the clouds drew closer together, the aura emanating from within grew increasingly terrifying.
Grandpa Shi San also witnessed this scene from afar…
Upon seeing this, he furrowed his brows after an initial moment of confusion, peering at the Tribulation cloud above Lin Jing, lost in thought…
And then…
The Tribulation cloud above Lin Jing’s head, after converging to a certain point, started to transform, no longer black but shifting to other colors.
Witnessing this, Grandpa Shi San was immediately struck with dismay…
“Impossible…”
“How could he have attracted such a terrifying Heavenly Tribulation…”
…
…
Grandpa Shi San noticed something amiss, and Lin Jing, being directly targeted by the Tribulation cloud, felt it even more intensely.
At this moment, the Tribulation cloud above his head had changed from black to multicolored.
This multicolored Tribulation cloud looked beautiful, but the aura it emitted was unimaginably terrifying.
Unsure what kind of Heavenly Tribulation this was, Lin Jing was deeply shocked just by the aura it released.
Furthermore, within the cloud, multicolored lightning arcs occasionally shuttled through.
And the aura emanating from these lightning arcs was several times more terrifying than that of the clouds themselves.
Just then, a voice suddenly reached Lin Jing’s ears:
“This final Tribulation Lightning has unexpectedly changed, turning into the legendary Silent Extermination Celestial Lightning.”
“The Silent Extermination Celestial Lightning is a type of Tribulation Lightning that appears only when one is transcending to become an immortal, its power extremely formidable.”
The voice abruptly stopped and then continued after a pause:
“No…”
“That’s not right…
“The Silent Extermination Celestial Lightning is of nine colors, not just multicolored; this isn’t the Silent Extermination Celestial Lightning…”
“Although this isn’t the Silent Extermination Celestial Lightning, the aura of this Tribulation Lightning is still not something you can withstand at your current level…”
“If you have any Magical Treasures, use them all, you must think of every possible way to survive this last Tribulation Lightning.”
“Also…”
“Remember to steady your Soul Spirit…”
This voice belonged to Grandpa Shi San.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing hurriedly summoned his Ling Yin Flawless Sword.
Then, he brought out a shield.
This shield, which he had obtained alongside the Five Elements Fire Command, had been forgotten by Lin Jing for a long time.
It had only come to mind recently.
In addition to these two items, there was also the Great Dream Ancient Mirror and a gourd.
Although those two Magical Treasures were not of low rank, Lin Jing had not refined them, and even if he took them out, they would be of no use.
After taking out the treasures, Lin Jing quickly called upon the System, then said:
“System…”
“Activate Bonus Attachment!”
This last Tribulation Lightning was mainly aimed at the Soul Spirit, and Lin Jing dared not be the slightest bit careless.
“Ding!”
“Bonus Attachment activation successful, deducting 5 Harvest Points, remaining Harvest Points: 18,825.”
With the Bonus Attachment activated, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged instantaneously.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.с0
Meanwhile…
The Tribulation cloud above Lin Jing’s head pressed down lower and lower, and the multicolored lightning within grew ever more dazzling.
Clearly, this last Tribulation Lightning was about to form…
…
…
“Boom!”
A thunderous roar resounded.
In the sky, a dazzling multicolored Tribulation Lightning struck down.
This final Tribulation Lightning, after brewing for a long while, ultimately descended.
Lin Jing quickly maneuvered the shield to meet it.
Wherever the multicolored Tribulation Lightning passed, space distorted and even the thinnest spatial cracks began to appear…
The Dao Artifact shield, upon just touching the Lightning, instantly cracked and then shattered completely.

This final WÇ” CÇŽi Tribulation Lightning lasted only five breaths before it dissipated.

After this Tribulation Lightning had dissipated, the WÇ” CÇŽi clouds in the sky also slowly dispersed.
...
The heavens and earth returned to a state of clarity…
Only…
Along with the Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing had vanished as well.
After the Tribulation clouds had disappeared, Grandfather Shi San hurried forward.
He arrived where Lin Jing had just faced his Tribulation.
The place where Lin Jing had faced the Tribulation, struck by the Tribulation Lightning, had now formed a deep pit of unknown depth.
Grandfather Shi San approached the pit and peered inside.
To his surprise, a familiar aura pulsated from deep within the pit.
Grandfather Shi San immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Next.
He entered the pit and saw a figure enveloped in a blood mist within.
The aura of Lin Jing was indeed emanating from this blood mist.
Grandfather Shi San extended his Divine Sense to probe Lin Jing in the blood mist and only then did he completely relax.
Afterward, he took out a stone Token from his body and placed it in front of Lin Jing on an outcropped rock.
He then spoke to Lin Jing,
“I am leaving…”
“If one day you come to the Eastern Spirit Realm and encounter any difficulties, you can always come to the Shi Family for help…”
Having said this, he gave Lin Jing one last look and then left the pit.
Grandfather Shi San, after leaving the pit, appeared right outside of it.
He then waved his hand and a light barrier fell, covering the pit.
Next.
The aura around Grandfather Shi San surged as a Stone Pagoda suddenly appeared in his hand.
This Stone Pagoda, though it appeared simple, was surrounded by mist, clearly not an ordinary item.
In the next moment, Grandfather Shi San’s gaze was sharp as lightning.
He directly offered up the Pagoda, casting it toward the empty space before him.
As the Stone Pagoda flew out, with a “boom,” it smashed into the void ahead, causing the surrounding space to twist and warp, with numerous spatial rifts appearing all around.
After casting the Stone Pagoda, Grandfather Shi San did not stop but instead called it back and continued to smash it into the same spot.
With the Stone Pagoda falling once more…
The space before him shattered like a broken mirror, cracks spreading until it could no longer hold together, revealing the pitch-black outer space.
This spatial rift was several feet wide.
As it appeared, all the surrounding stones and trees were immediately sucked into it.
Once coming into contact with the spatial rift, the stones and trees disintegrated instantly.
And the gravitational pull was so strong that even several huge rocks around the pit were drawn towards it, fortunately, the pit was protected by the light barrier released by Grandfather Shi San, which remained unharmed inside.
Grandfather Shi San then turned back, glanced at the pit, then retracted the Stone Pagoda and stepped towards the rift…
As Grandfather Shi San entered the spatial rift and disappeared, the rift slowly healed behind him.
The surroundings again became tranquil.
…
It was unknown how much time had passed before Lin Jing finally opened his eyes and came to from his meditative state.
Once awakened, Lin Jing saw the stone Token right before his eyes.
While Grandfather Shi San was leaving, Lin Jing was actually aware of it.
But at that time, having just passed the Heavenly Tribulation, it was a critical moment when he could not afford to be distracted.
Clearly, Grandfather Shi San also knew this and did not disturb Lin Jing much, leaving behind only that stone Token and a few words before he left.
Lin Jing looked at the Token before him, then reached out and summoned it into his hand.
The Token was white, resembling a special kind of stone, with the character for “stone” inscribed on the front.
Now, the Token was covered with a layer of dust, indicating that some time had passed since Grandfather Shi San had left.
Lin Jing gently wiped the dust from the Token and then stored it away.
After putting away the token, Lin Jing looked around.
The pit was truly enormousâ€”big enough to accommodate an entire town.
It was evident just how terrifying that final bolt of Tribulation Lightning had been.
Then Lin Jing looked up at the sky.
Through the mouth of the pit, he could even see the azure sky, but because he was within this deep pit, that sky felt so distant…
With a thought, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged forth.
Next…
Lin Jing took a step and vanished from the pit, appearing outside it in an instant.
Earlier, that last bolt of Tribulation Lightning was too exaggerated.
Even though Lin Jing had done his best to defend against it, he had even activated his Bonus Attachment.
But that final bolt of WÇ” CÇŽi Tribulation Lightning nearly caused Lin Jing to lose his Soul Spirit…
Lin Jing’s entire body was also again grievously wounded, nearly obliterated.
However, fortunately, Lin Jing ultimately withstood that bolt of Tribulation Lightning.
The Heavenly Tribulation that Lin Jing faced was extremely exaggerated, to the extent that saying he went through a life-and-death experience wouldn’t be an exaggeration.
But the more formidable the Heavenly Tribulation, the greater the benefits one receives after surviving itâ€¦
After passing through the Heavenly Tribulation, Lin Jing’s cultivation didn’t stay at the first level of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Instead, just like when he passed the Nascent Soul Heavenly Tribulation, he bypassed the first and second levels and directly entered the third level of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Only at the peak of the third level of the Divinity Transformation Stage did he stop.
And…
During this Tribulation, Lin Jing not only made a simple breakthrough in his Divine Transformation Cultivation, but his Body Refining Techniques also successfully fused with his intent, entering the Martial Dao Divinity Transformation.
With these two enhancements combined, Lin Jing’s true combat strength became immeasurable.
One could say that if Lin Jing now were to encounter the old ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect in his prime, he would probably be able to kill him outright.
It was no longer possible, like before, where upon seeing him Lin Jing could only flee, and in the end, had to rely on the Yin Spirits in the Barren Forbidden Zone to resolve the threat.
…
After entering the Divinity Transformation Stage, the Nascent Soul at Lin Jing’s Dantian disappeared, transforming into a Soul Spirit residing in his sea of consciousness.
Once entering Divinity Transformation, as long as the Soul Spirit is not extinguished, the cultivator becomes immortal, unable to be killed no matter how many times their body is destroyed.
As long as their Soul Spirit remains intact, they can reconsolidate their body.
This is a major characteristic of Divine Transformation Cultivators.
However, there was still a Nascent Soul within Lin Jing’s Dantian, less than half an inch big.
This Nascent Soul was the Demon Infant left behind by the old ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect using the Blood Infant Pact.
After the baptism of the Heavenly Tribulation, that Demon Infant had become transparent, and all the Demonic Qi within it had vanished.
At this moment…
The Demon Infant contained the old Nanming Immortal Sect ancestor’s lifetime of cultivation as a reward for Lin Jing’s victory, available for him to extract at any time.
Next.
With a thought, Lin Jing activated his Divine Sense to envelop the entire nearby area.
In no time at all, many fragments of Magical Treasures started to float up within the region shrouded by Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
Some of these fragments were black, while others were transparent.
These were precisely the fragments of the Magical Treasures that had shattered during the Tribulation under that last bolt of Tribulation Lightning.
ɴονǤο.сᴑ
Lin Jing collected these fragments up once again.
After collecting those fragments, Lin Jing then soared into the sky and left this place…
…
Now that Divinity Transformation had been achieved, the next step was to find a way to refine his own Divine Arts.
Divine Arts are powerful spells that only Divine Transformation Cultivators can cultivate.
Divine Arts are different from ordinary spells.
Since the most important aspect for Divine Transformation Cultivators is the Soul Spirit, not only are the Divine Arts incredibly powerful,
they can also directly obliterate another’s Soul Spirit.
Therefore…
The first thing that every cultivator does after entering Divinity Transformation is to comprehend their own Divine Arts.
Lin Jing was naturally no exception.
At this moment, Lin Jing, while contemplating the matter of Divine Arts, flew onwards…
But just then, a towering peak suddenly appeared before him.
That mountain peak, Lin Jing was all too familiar with.
For it was Tongtian Peak, also known as Qinghuang Peak.
On that mountain peak resided Huang Qingling, Elder Yu, Elder Bai, and Zhang Yuanâ€¦

chapters.title: Chapter 641
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 641: Chapter 272 Huang Qingling Disappeared Chapter 641: Chapter 272 Huang Qingling Disappeared Lin Jing gazed at Qinghuang Peak and paused for a moment.
Then he directly changed direction and flew toward Qinghuang Peak.
Seventy years had passed since he last left, and Lin Jing had grown from a Foundation Establishment Cultivator at the time of his departure to a Divine Transformation Cultivator now.
He wondered how the few people on Qinghuang Peak were doing after so many years.
Lin Jing wanted to go up and take a look…
Ɲ0νǥօ.сο
Before long, Lin Jing arrived at the foot of Qinghuang Peak.
...
Standing at the base of the mountain and looking upward, Qinghuang Peak stood toweringly tall.
From Lin Jing’s position below, it was as if he were an ant facing a towering tree.
Moreover, there were many formations and prohibitions on Qinghuang Peak, their purpose being to prevent anyone from reaching the summit.
When the Demon Race Secret Realm first opened, the ancestors of the three major sects had tried to reach the top.
Despite resorting to all sorts of methods at that time, they only managed to climb a kilometer in height.
They didn’t even come close to reaching halfway up the mountain.
Lin Jing’s current cultivation was not even comparable to theirs, so his chances of climbing up were probably even less than theirs.
But since he had come, he had to give it a try.
After that, Lin Jing hesitated no more and began to make his move.
The formations at the foot of the mountain were all of the lowest level.
Lin Jing could completely disregard them and forcefully break through them without suffering any harm.
However, Lin Jing didn’t go straight ahead but instead turned to the other side of the mountain base.
This other side, thanks to the previous efforts of the ancestors from the three major sects, had a pathway paved, making it completely unobstructed to ascend from there.
Using this pre-established path to climb the mountain, Lin Jing naturally would not go through the trouble of carving out a new path.
Stepping onto that path, Lin Jing ascended all the way up, encountering no obstacles in the middle.
In doing so, he climbed a kilometer up to the end of this path.
Beyond that point was a forest, and within that forest floated countless formation patterns.
The sudden appearance of these formation patterns looked out of place against the forest.
Lin Jing took one look and knew what was going on.
This entire Qinghuang Peak was protected by many formations.
Some formations were visible in plain sight, and others had their traces concealed.
If one did not step into them, one might not even be able to detect them at all.
Clearly, the forest in front of him was one such formation.
However, this formation had already been half-solved by the three major sects, and its concealment feature had lost its effect.
Hence, the situation presented as it was now.
Upon seeing the forest, Lin Jing did not rush forward but extended his Divine Sense to scout it first.
After a while of scouting, Lin Jing didn’t find anything else, so he directly gathered a ball of Five Elements Power and attacked the formation within.
This ball of Five Elements Power radiated colorful glows and swiftly advanced towards the forest ahead.
Right after it entered the forest, an intensely hot aura suddenly exploded from within.
A burst of flames fiercely appeared out of the forest and raced towards Lin Jing.
The temperature of this flame was extremely high, and even from a distance, Lin Jing already felt the searing heat.
Fortunately, the speed of the fire was relatively slow compared to Lin Jing.
At the moment the flames approached, Lin Jing had already dodged.
But just then, an unexpected change occurred…
The flame, which Lin Jing had initially dodged, suddenly changed direction and continued to chase after Lin Jing.
At the same time, another hot aura emerged from between Lin Jing’s eyebrows.
And then…
A phantom image of the Divine Phoenix emerged from between Lin Jing’s eyebrows and shot out.
The flame, seemingly like a long-lost child reunited with its mother, rushed toward Lin Jing with even greater speed.
No…
It was actually rushing towards the phantom of the Divine Phoenix that had appeared from Lin Jing’s forehead.
Seeing this, Lin Jing no longer tried to avoid it.
Following that.
The flame arrived and collided with the Divine Phoenix phantom.
The phantom then directly engulfed the flame.
After swallowing the flames, the Divine Phoenix phantom immediately solidified, and then it seemed to be reborn from the ashes, its eyes filled with fiery flames.
It then looked towards the summit and, with a flap of its wings, flew straight towards the top of Qinghuang Peak.
Where the Divine Phoenix passed, it left behind a corridor, and the formations on either side of the corridor directly lost their effectiveness.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly followed after the Divine Phoenix phantom, charging towards the summit of Qinghuang Peak…
With no formations to block him, the ascent to the top was actually very fast.
In less than a quarter of an hour, Lin Jing had already arrived at the top of the peak.
At that moment, the Divine Phoenix phantom, as if it had exhausted all its energy, returned to being a phantom state and merged back into Lin Jing’s forehead.
This Divine Phoenix phantom was exactly the one sent by Huang Qingling.
It had been a long time since it had last appeared, leading Lin Jing to think it might have run out of energy and dissipated.
Yet unexpectedly, it had reappeared this time.
After coming up, Lin Jing looked at the familiar Qinghuang Palace in front of him with some emotion.
After so many years of absence, he had returned to this place once again.
Then, Lin Jing stepped inside.
Entering Qinghuang Palace, Lin Jing immediately headed toward the largest hall in the center of the palace.
Whether it was Huang Qingling herself, Elder Bai, Elder Yu, or Zhang Yuan, all three were inside that hall.
Lin Jing walked quickly towards it, and it was only in front of the hall that he realized something was amiss.
The doors of the hall were wide open.
Yet despite the wide-open doors, there was no sign of life emanating from within.
Lin Jing hurriedly quickened his pace and walked into the hall.
However, to his surprise, he found that not a single person was inside the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 642
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 642: Chapter 272: Huang Qingling Disappears_2 Chapter 642: Chapter 272: Huang Qingling Disappears_2 Lin Jing stood frozen in place.
Huang Qingling…
Elder Yu, Elder Bai, and Zhang Yuan, all three of them, had disappeared.
Inside the great hall, everything else remained the same, but the shield that had originally protected Huang Qingling’s true body in the middle of the hall had also vanished.
It only left behind the empty jade platform in the center.
Lin Kai hurried forward, arrived at the jade platform in the center of the grand hall, and inspected it.
Perhaps due to the influence of Qinghuang Palace, there were no traces or dust on the jade platform.
...
Lin Jing circled the platform, inspecting it, but found nothing.
Then, he stepped down from it.
He went to the side of the stone platforms where Elder Yu, Elder Bai, and Zhang Yuan had previously been placed.
At that moment, these stone platforms were also completely empty.
But after Lin Jing conducted an inspection, he found traces on the stone platform suggesting someone had lain there.
“Could it be that they have already left?”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but think to himself.
No one could climb up to this Qinghuang Peak, not even the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.
And now, having suddenly disappeared, it was very likely that Huang Qingling had awakened and taken them away.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be possible.
Of course, these were just Lin Jing’s own speculations and he didn’t know the actual situation.
After another round inside the grand hall, Lin Jing found nothing and subsequently left the hall.
After leaving the grand hall, Lin Jing continued exploring the entirety of Qinghuang Palace.
But he still didn’t find anything.
Ultimately, he returned to the teleportation array he had used to leave before.
The teleportation array was the same as it always had been.
It just hadn’t been activated in a long time.
…
Huang Qingling had disappeared, along with Elder Bai, Elder Yu, and Zhang Yuan.
They disappeared without leaving any message.
Lin Jing felt somewhat bewildered for a moment.
If it weren’t for the fact that there were no signs of anyone coming to the Qinghuang Palace,
Lin Jing might have even suspected that they had all been abducted by members of the Demon Clan.
But Lin Jing knew that was impossible.
It was simply not possible for anyone to climb up Qinghuang Peak.
Earlier, Lin Jing had made a round below and even saw the formation; the highest-level formation that had been deciphered covered less than half of Qinghuang Peak.
Of course…
Unless someone could find a way up, similar to how Lin Jing had,
but obviously that was impossible…
…
Lin Jing went back to the grand hall, lingered there for a while, and then left.
Upon leaving, Lin Jing felt somewhat empty inside.
Perhaps it was because he was in Qinghuang Palace, and the Divine Phoenix Mark between his eyebrows was very active.
As Lin Jing prepared to leave, the Divine Phoenix silhouette reappeared and then led the way in front of him, guiding Lin Jing out of Qinghuang Palace.
Descending from Qinghuang Peak, Lin Jing returned to where he had been before climbing the mountain.
The Divine Phoenix silhouette then merged back into Lin Jing’s forehead and disappeared after he descended the mountain.
With the Divine Phoenix silhouette merging back into Lin Jing’s forehead, the path leading to Shenhuang Peak was also concealed, once again covered by the formation.
Lin Jing stood at the foot of the mountain, looking up toward the peak.
After staring for a moment, Lin Jing then turned and walked down the mountain.
After leaving Qinghuang Peak, Lin Jing didn’t linger further and left the area directly.
…
At the entrance to the Demon Race Secret Realm, there was a market town that was on the verge of developing into a town.
This market existed because of the Demon Race Secret Realm.
One could say it was created by and destroyed by the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Previously, the market had developed to a certain scale, right at the time when the three major sects were preparing to invest heavily and develop it into an Immortal City.
But then the Howling Sky Wolf Clan suddenly arrived.
Because the attack was so sudden, the Howling Sky Wolf Clan quickly took over the Demon Race Secret Realm and invaded the entire Nanming Domain from the realm.
And this well-developed market was the first to be hit, completely destroyed.
Even the people who escaped from the market were few.
Afterward, Nanming Domain couldn’t withstand the Howling Sky Wolf Clan and was completely defeated, with the clan invading much of the domain.
It wasn’t until later, when the forces from the Western Demon Region came to aid, that they drove the Howling Sky Wolf Clan back into the Demon Race Secret Realm.
ƝονǤο.ᴄ0
The two Solidifying Body Realm cultivators who came to assist directly sealed the entrance to the Demon Race Secret Realm.
And this Fang Market had been rebuilt and turned into a stronghold for watching over the entrance to the Demon Race Secret Realm by the three major sects.
Until not long ago, when the seven major Demon Clan had joined hands in a raid.
As soon as the news arrived, this market had once again descended into chaos…
Within less than an hour, this market was abandoned again, with everyone previously stationed here fleeing the area.
However, this time the market was not destroyed.
For before the seven powerful beings of the Demon Clan could appear, a mysterious top cultivator entered the Demon Race Secret Realm and defeated them all.
And destroyed the Teleportation Array, expelling them all from the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Since then, the Nanming Domain no longer had to worry about invasions from the Demon Clan.
With no more threats from the Demon Clan, the market also began to develop once again.
Now it had already taken on the form of a small town.
And within this town, the ancestor of the Qingyuan Sword Sect had been constantly stationed, reportedly because that mysterious top cultivator was inside the Secret Realm.
So he was stationed here to guard against anyone entering the Secret Realm and offending that mysterious top cultivator.
This showed his deep regard for the mysterious top cultivator within the Secret Realm.
With the Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor in place, although many were extremely curious, no one dared to rashly enter.
Otherwise, it is estimated that before the mysterious top cultivator in the Secret Realm could take action, the Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor would have directly eliminated them on the spot.
In the blink of an eye, it had been a month since the Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor took his post here.
That day…
The Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor was guarding the entrance to the Secret Realm as usual.
…
Just then…
Suddenly, several presences transmitted from a distance.
The Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor then opened his eyes and looked into the distance.
He saw several figures flying towards him.
Seeing these figures, the Qingyuan Sword Sect ancestor immediately stood up.
Because…
The two people flying at the front were the two Solidifying Body Realm cultivators who supported the Nanming Domain.
Behind them, there were also a younger male and female disciple from their sects.
Following those two disciples was the ancestor from the Yiyun Pavilion.
By this time, even he had arrived.
Upon seeing this situation, the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect immediately understood what was happening.
Previously, when the group was preparing to leave, the senior had said he would stay inside for at most a month.
Now that a month had passed, and these two from the Western Demon Region had brought sect disciples with them, it seemed likely they wanted them to meet the senior.
It was quite a normal thought.
After all, with the senior’s cultivation level, just a few pointers from him would be beneficial for a lifetime.
When the group arrived near the entrance to the Secret Realm, they went directly to the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
“Two seniors…”
Seeing them arrive, the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect stepped forward and bowed his hands in salute to the two.
The two nodded gently, and then the Solidifying Body Realm cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect spoke:
“During our time away, has there been any movement in this Secret Realm?”
The elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect then spoke,
“Aside from the initial disturbances, there have been no further movements during this time.”
The Solidifying Body Realm cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect nodded after hearing this.
“This period must have been demanding for you, Senior Shi and the others should be coming out soon, let’s just wait together for Senior Shi to emerge.”
“Yes…” replied the elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Having said that, he turned and said to the young cultivator behind him:
“Chengxuan…”
“When Senior Shi comes out, remember to be respectful.”
“Senior Shi is a Mahayana cultivator, and the Shi Family is very renowned in the Eastern Spiritual Realm.
Gaining favor from Senior Shi could be very beneficial for your future.”
The young man nodded, then spoke:
“Uncle Master, rest assured…”
At the same time, on the other side, Ji Xiyue’s father also turned back to address the woman behind him:
“Xiyue…”
“You are about to head to the Eastern Spiritual Realm, I won’t say much else, just remember to make a good impression on Senior Shi.”
“And…”
This time going to the Eastern Spiritual Realm, don’t be willful again…”
It turned out the two young disciples were the talented disciples from the Xingluo Elixir Sect and the Yuling Dao Sect respectively, Ji Xiyue and Mo Chengxuan…

chapters.title: Chapter 643
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 643: Chapter 273: Leaving the Secret Realm Chapter 643: Chapter 273: Leaving the Secret Realm “I understand, Father.”
Ji Xiyue nodded in response.
At that moment, Ji Xiyue looked modest and proper, without a trace of the laziness and relaxation she had shown in front of Lin Jing.
Mo Chengxuan also had an extraordinary presence, with his sharp eyebrows and bright eyes.
Indeed, the two of them seemed to be a match made in heaven.
However, Ji Xiyue seemed to have no interest in Mo Chengxuan at all.
From the time they arrived until now, aside from responding to her father, she had not made any other movements.
She just stayed there.
...
While Mo Chengxuan also stayed in place, he glanced at Ji Xiyue a few times, intentionally or not.
And Ji Xiyue, as if she heard nothing, did not show any reaction.
Just as everyone had arrived and waited for a moment, the entrance to the Demon Race Secret Realm suddenly emitted a fluctuation.
Seeing this fluctuation, those waiting hurriedly prepared.
Even Ji Xiyue and Mo Chengxuan straightened up and respectfully looked towards the entrance of the Secret Realm.
After all, that was a cultivator from the Mahayana Realm, and they naturally did not dare to be negligent.
Shortly thereafter…
Those gathered saw the fluctuations at the entrance of the Secret Realm grow increasingly intense like ripples, and at that moment, a figure emerged from the entrance…
……
After leaving Qinghuang Peak, Lin Jing did not stop but directly flew towards the exit of the Secret Realm.
Upon reaching the exit, Lin Jing walked straight towards it.
Just as he was about to step through the exit and leave the Secret Realm, he suddenly stopped…
Then, Lin Jing turned around and looked back at the Secret Realm…
Within this Demon Race Secret Realm, Lin Jing had obtained the Cleansing Spirit Liquid, eliminated his enemy Liu Yiyuan, and also encountered danger…
Too much had happened in this Secret Realm.
Now in the Secret Realm, Huang Qingling and the others had also disappeared without a trace, their whereabouts unknown.
This Secret Realm now held no more attachments for him.
If nothing unexpected happened, Lin Jing would probably leave this Secret Realm and not return.
After looking back, Lin Jing turned around and took a step out, heading towards the outside of the Secret Realm…
……
Just as one foot stepped out of the Secret Realm, Lin Jing realized something was amiss.
When his entire body passed through the exit, the scene before his eyes also left him momentarily stunned.
Two body-solidifying cultivators from the two major sects of the Western Demon Region were there in the Nanming Domain; behind them stood a young man and woman.
Lin Jing did not recognize the man, but from his attire and the aura of cultivation emanating from him, he seemed to be no ordinary person.
As for the woman, Lin Jing was quite familiar with her; it was Ji Xiyue.
Behind these two were the Elders from the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion.
“It’s you!”
“It’s you!”
Both Ji Xiyue’s father and the body-solidifying cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect exclaimed simultaneously.
Seeing that the first to come out was Lin Jing, they were evidently very surprised.
In their minds, even if two people were to emerge, it should have been Elder Shi San coming out first, followed closely by Lin Jing.
Just as they finished speaking, another cry of astonishment was heard, coming from Ji Xiyue.
“Lin Jing…!”
“What are you doing here?”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue’s father and the body-solidifying cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect quickly turned back to look at Ji Xiyue.
ṅονǤ0.сο
Even Mo Chengxuan, not understanding the situation, turned his head to look at Ji Xiyue.
“Xiyue, you know this fellow cultivator?”
Though Ji Xiyue’s father asked the question, his tone obviously carried a hint of pleasant surprise.
Ji Xiyue nodded and softly said:
“Yes.”
“I have known Lin Daoyou for quite some time now.”
At that moment…
Lin Jing also reacted and clasped his hands in greeting towards Ji Xiyue’s father and the body-solidifying cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect:
“Elders.”
“You are here to welcome Elder Shi, are you not?”
The two turned back to Lin Jing and nodded:
“Indeed.”
“Might I ask, fellow cultivator, is Elder Shi still within the Secret Realm?”
Lin Jing shook his head:
“Elder Shi has already left the Secret Realm and gone to the Outer Spatial Void.”
“So, he went to the Outer Spatial Void, no wonder…”
The two sighed, clearly disappointed.
After all, their purpose was to greet Elder Shi San here, and with his absence, their prior arrangements were all for naught.
However, they were only disappointed for a moment before regaining their composure, and then they turned their attention back to Lin Jing.
Still, Ji Xiyue’s father reacted quickly, immediately smiling warmly:
“Fellow Lin, it seems, is it?
I am Xiyue’s father.”
“May I know when the two of you made each other’s acquaintance?”
After he finished, he glanced at Ji Xiyue:
“That girl Xiyue really is quite tight-lipped, never mentioning this to me before.
I apologize for any oversight towards you, Fellow Lin.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing appeared very courteous:
“Elder Ji is too polite.”
“I have some connections with the Yan Family on Spirit Rock Island, and I met Fellow Ji during my time there.”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue’s father suddenly realized:
“So that’s how it is…”
“Xiyue went to Spirit Rock Island, to help deliver the White Jade Cleansing Spirit Grass; thinking about it, that must have been twenty years ago.”
“I hadn’t realized that the two of you have known each other for so long.”
Just as Ji Xiyue’s father was about to further inquire, the body-solidifying cultivator from the Yuling Dao Sect suddenly interjected:
“Fellow Lin!”
“Seeing you so young and already at the Divinity Transformation Stage, your future must be limitless,” he said.
After finishing, he pointed to Mo Chengxuan behind him and said,
“This is Mo Chengxuan, the finest disciple of the Yuling Dao Sect.
You appear to be of similar age; you could exchange views more often in the future.”
As soon as he finished speaking, Mo Chengxuan stepped forward, cupped his fists, and said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou, it’s my good fortune to meet you!”
“It’s my good fortune as well!”
Lin Jing returned the gesture.
At this moment, Ji Xiyue’s father also timely spoke up:
“This is Elder Tao from the Yuling Dao Sect, who has reached the third layer of the Solidifying Body stage.”
“So, it’s Elder Tao, my apologies for any disrespect,” Lin Jing then bowed with his hands clasped together.
“Lin Xiaoyou, you are too courteous,” Elder Tao said with a smile.
After finishing, he opened his mouth again and asked Lin Jing:
“If I may be so bold as to ask, what is your relationship with Elder Shi?”
Having said that, Elder Tao turned towards Lin Jing, waiting for his response.
At this moment, Ji Xiyue’s father also leaned in closer.
Clearly, this was what both of them were most concerned about.
Lin Jing smiled slightly and then said:
“Actually, I haven’t known Elder Shi for too long either; it was after coming to the Nanming Domain that we met.”
“I merely helped him with some matters.”
Lin Jing’s response was quite simple and didn’t reveal much.
But it was enough.
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s response, both men were slightly disappointed.
They had initially thought Lin Jing had a special relationship with Grandfather Shi, hoping to rely on Lin Jing to establish some connection with the Shi family of the Eastern Spiritual Realm.
After knowing Lin Jing’s circumstances, their expectations were dashed.
However, after a brief disappointment, they quickly rationalized and regained their composure.
After all, that was a Mahayana cultivator; if Lin Jing truly had an extremely close relationship with him, he wouldn’t have simply left Lin Jing behind.
At the very least, he would have escorted him back to the Eastern Spiritual Realm.
Having thought this over, Ji Xiyue’s father spoke again:
“Xiyue.”
“Since you and Lin Xiaoyou are old acquaintances, why don’t you two head back together?
Elder Tao and I need to check inside the Secret Realm of the Demon Clan again.”
“Alright, Father!” Ji Xiyue replied immediately.
Afterward.
Elder Tao also instructed Mo Chengxuan briefly and then entered the Demon Clan Secret Realm with Ji Xiyue’s father…
After the two men had left, Ji Xiyue turned back to Lin Jing, smiling slightly as she said:
“Lin Daoyou!”
“I didn’t expect you to reach the Divinity Transformation Stage so quickly, it truly amazes me.”
Lin Jing then looked at Ji Xiyue, smiling as he spoke:
“Ji Daoyou, you aren’t far behind either, aren’t you also at the Divinity Transformation Stage now?”
The aura of cultivation on Ji Xiyue’s body was the same as Lin Jing’s, both at the first level of Divinity Transformation.
However, the aura of Ji Xiyue’s cultivation was still not very stable, clearly indicating she had just advanced to Divinity Transformation recently.
As for Lin Jing, after passing the Heavenly Tribulation, his cultivation had skyrocketed, breaking through to the third layer of Divinity Transformation.
The level of cultivation Lin Jing was displaying was merely a disguise of the first layer of Divinity Transformation, using the Changyun Hidden Technique.
……
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Ji Xiyue couldn’t help but shoot Lin Jing a glance filled with allure…
“You can compare yourself to me?”
“I’ve been at the Nascent Soul Peak Stage for quite some time already.”
“This breakthrough to Divinity Transformation only happened recently with the help of the Sect.”
“And you…”
Ji Xiyue sized up Lin Jing from head to toe, then began speaking, her tone somewhat sour:
“You certainly have an extraordinary fortune…”
Twenty years ago when Lin Jing and Ji Xiyue met, Ji Xiyue had already reached the Nascent Soul Peak Stage, while Lin Jing was only at the seventh level of the Nascent Soul.
Now, twenty years later to meet again with equivalent levels of cultivationâ€”and hers was only achieved with the Sect’s aidâ€”
Ji Xiyue felt quite speechless, as if all her dedicated cultivation had become a joke.
And naturally, Lin Jing understood Ji Xiyue’s implication.
She didn’t mention it outright also because such matters were too sensational, especially since it wasn’t just the two of them here.
Moreover…
For Lin Jing to have advanced so quickly, he surely had his own secrets; Ji Xiyue naturally wouldn’t disclose them, which was why she spoke that way.
Lin Jing laughed and replied:
“You had the Sect’s assistance, and I naturally had help as well.”
“Truth be told, neither of our fortunes are shallow.”
Ji Xiyue, upon hearing this, also smiled:
“Indeed, being in a powerful Sect is my greatest fortune.”
“I was overly concerned.”
Seeing Lin Jing and Ji Xiyue chatting so happily, Mo Chengxuan seemed a bit upset, but didn’t show it too obviously.
As soon as Ji Xiyue finished speaking, Mo Chengxuan took this opportunity to say:
“What Xiyue said is true.”
“As disciples of the Sect, from the moment we were born, we received opportunities many people can only dream of.
Being born in the Sect is our fortune but also our restraint.”
“On the other hand, Lin Daoyou, standing alone unencumbered, is something I truly envy.”
After saying this, Mo Chengxuan turned his head to continue speaking to Lin Jing:
“Lin Daoyou!”
“Perhaps you aren’t aware yet that Ji Xiyue and I will soon be heading to the Eastern Spiritual Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 644
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 644: Chapter 274 Elixir Alliance Chapter 644: Chapter 274 Elixir Alliance “`
“Heading to the Eastern Spirit Realm, I do so for the sake of the Sect and for myself.
I just don’t know how long it will be before I can return again.”
Although Mo Chengxuan seemed to be reflecting, his words sounded somewhat uncomfortable to the ear.
However, Lin Jing seemed to not catch his actual intent and instead expressed surprise:
“You’re going to the Eastern Spirit Realm?”
Lin Jing didn’t react, but Ji Xiyue, on the other hand, seemed displeased and spoke directly:
“Alright, Mo Chengxuan!”
“We should be heading back now.”
Seeing that Ji Xiyue was somewhat unhappy, Mo Chengxuan subsequently fell silent.
Afterward, Ji Xiyue spoke to Lin Jing:
“I’ll tell you about this matter once we get back.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
Then.
The three of them prepared to leave, and the elders of the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion also came forward.
Looking at the two elders, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling sentimental.
...
Previously, he had been a Spirit Farmer for the Qingyuan Sword Sect and had even joined Yuebao Tower, becoming an Offering Pill Master.
Yuebao Tower was the property of Yiyun Pavilion.
Who would have thought that now, in terms of cultivation, he was on par with the elders of both Sects.
It was unimaginable, if he were to tell these elders of his past experiences, how they would feel.
Shock and surprise would certainly be included.
I just wonder if they would have regrets…
Of course, this kind of matter was something Lin Jing could only ponder; he was determined not to disclose it carelessly.
Of course.
As for his past experiences, he would not deliberately conceal them; if the other party wanted to investigate, it was up to them.
Thereafter, Lin Jing bid farewell to the two elders with his companions, and the trio made their departure.
……
Having returned from the Demon Race Secret Realm, Lin Jing went straight back to his small courtyard in Nanshan Immortal City.
Although the Li Family had moved to Li Yan Island, the small courtyard remained.
Arriving with Lin Jing was Ji Xiyue.
Initially, Mo Chengxuan wanted to invite Ji Xiyue to return to the two Sects with him, but she outright refused.
Left with no choice, Mo Chengxuan went back alone.
The two reached the small courtyard, where layers of dust had accumulated.
The withered yellow leaves had piled up layer upon layer as well.
As for other areas, fallen withered leaves were everywhere.
The pond that had been used to keep fish was now murky and unclean.
After all, Lin Jing had not returned for twenty years, so the condition of the courtyard was somewhat understandable.
Ji Xiyue looked at the courtyard, then turned to Lin Jing with a puzzled expression:
“How many years has it been since you last came here?”
“It wasn’t like this when I was around.”
Lin Jing responded:
“Not long after you left, I moved away.”
“During this time, I traveled around, then Master Shi gave me some guidance.
I’ve been cultivating for a few years, and it wasn’t long after I had stepped into Divinity Transformation that I met you.”
“I see…” Ji Xiyue nodded.
“But you advanced to Divinity Transformation so quickly, especially the realization right before, you managed to perfect it so fast.”
“You should know, others need at least decades to achieve that.”
As she spoke, Ji Xiyue couldn’t help but size up Lin Jing:
“Do you have some kind of secret?
Tell me about it.”
Lin Jing turned his head and glanced at Ji Xiyue.
The Ji Xiyue before him no longer held her former dignified composure.
In front of Lin Jing, she appeared as relaxed as she would be with a friend, with no need for many reservations.
“You know, I am originally from this Nanming Domain.”
“After you left, I traveled around the Nanming Domain, experienced some things, and met a few old acquaintances.”
“After my journey ended, my realization was close to perfection.”
“So that’s how it was…” Ji Xiyue suddenly understood.
“To think you perfected your realization in such a way.”
Lin Jing nodded, then lifted his hand, conjuring a whirlwind.
This whirlwind, though not large, immediately began to wander through the courtyard, sweeping up the fallen leaves and dust wherever it passed.
In just a short moment, the entire courtyard was spotlessly cleaned by the whirlwind.
At this point, Lin Jing asked Ji Xiyue:
“How about some tea?”
Ji Xiyue nodded:
“That would be nice…”
Lin Jing gave a gentle nod, then walked to the pavilion in the middle of the courtyard.
He took out a tea set from his Space Ring and placed it on the table in the center of the pavilion.
Next, he simply waved his hand in the air, drawing forth a sphere of clear water, which he then led into the kettle for boiling.
After completing these actions, he finally conjured a ball of flame under the kettle, then left it to be, allowing the tea water to slowly come to a boil.
By this time, Ji Xiyue had also settled down in the pavilion.
Previously, when she came to Lin Jing to repair the Elixir Scripture, she had frequented this place.
She was quite familiar with it.
And now, it was still the two of them, in the same courtyard.
Only, they were somewhat different from before.
Staying in this courtyard, they both felt as if they were experiencing a sense of dÃ©jÃ  vu.
“Let’s talk about you, how have you been?”
“If I’m not mistaken, you’ve become a Sixth Grade Alchemist and successfully nullified your betrothal, haven’t you?”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue, then spoke.
Ji Xiyue nodded:
“Yes!”
“`
“As for Mo Chengxuan whom you met today, I don’t like him at all.
If it weren’t for the fact that I can’t ruin the relationship between our two sects, I wouldn’t even want to deal with him.”
Lin Jing smiled:
“I actually think he quite likes you.”
Ji Xiyue gave Lin Jing a white look:
“Him?
Better forget it.”
“The good attitude he showed you today is probably because of Senior Shi.”
“Usually, he is quite different from how he was today.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
After all, he had only met Mo Chengxuan once and naturally could not claim to understand him.
Nor could he make a groundless judgment based on this one encounter.
“Gurgle…
Gurgle…”
The tea water kept rolling in the pot, already boiling.
At this moment, without waiting for Lin Jing to take action, Ji Xiyue had already taken the initiative, lifting the teapot to start brewing.
Until the brewing was finished, Ji Xiyue pushed one of the tea cups in front of Lin Jing.
Only then did Lin Jing speak, asking:
“Are you going to the Eastern Spirit Realm?”
Ji Xiyue had just picked up the tea cup, paused for a moment, then put down the tea cup and said:
“Yes…”
“Since the last time I went back, I immersed myself in studying the Elixir Scripture you helped me repair, and after several years, I finally advanced to a Sixth Grade Alchemist.”
“After advancing to a Sixth Grade Alchemist, I participated in the Alchemy Competition of our Western Demon Region and got second place.”
“It was only after the Alchemy Competition that I found out that people from the Elixir Alliance in the Eastern Spirit Realm had also observed the competition.”
“They noticed my talent for alchemy, specifically invited me to join the Elixir Alliance, to obtain better opportunities, and to have the chance to reach the real peak of Alchemy Dao.”
“Elixir Alliance?”
Lin Jing had not heard of this organization, so he was a bit puzzled.
“It sounds like a purely Alchemist organization.”
Ji Xiyue nodded:
“It’s normal for you not to have heard of it.”
“Even I heard of it for the first time.”
Having said that, Ji Xiyue picked up the tea cup, took a small sip, and then continued:
“The Elixir Alliance is indeed an organization consisting only of Alchemists.”
“Moreover, it is an organization that only those true high-level Alchemists can join.”
“To join the Elixir Alliance, one must at least possess the strength of a Sixth Grade Alchemist, and if they are too old with no hope of breakthrough, the Elixir Alliance will not accept them, even if they are long-standing Sixth Grade Alchemists.”
“Everyone who joins the Elixir Alliance is a pill refining talent with exceptional potential.”
“I see…” Lin Jing said, coming to a realization.
“If that is the case, the strength of the Elixir Alliance must be extraordinary indeed.”
“Naturally.” Ji Xiyue said.
“The Elixir Alliance itself already possesses impressive strength, and I heard that there are legendary Ninth Grade Alchemists within the Alliance.”
“What’s more important is that the Elixir Alliance is an extremely special organization within the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
“The Elixir Alliance typically only focuses on alchemy and does not join in the disputes of other forces.”
“And…”
“Since the Elixir Alliance is essentially made up of Alchemists, they can refine some of the top tier Elixir Medicines that are extremely difficult to concoct.”
“Therefore, the Elixir Alliance has good relations with many other forces, and if anyone foolishly provokes them, many forces will take the initiative to help without the Alliance having to act.”
After listening, Lin Jing nodded gently.
“This Elixir Alliance is indeed extraordinary!”
Then, Lin Jing continued to ask:
“So, if you join the Elixir Alliance, there won’t be any problems with the Xingluo Elixir Sect, right?”
Ji Xiyue nodded:
“After joining the Elixir Alliance, the Xingluo Elixir Sect won’t be at a disadvantage.
The Elixir Alliance will not only gift some resources to my current sect but also provide some other compensations.”
“Besides, joining the Elixir Alliance is one of the most proud achievements for us Pill Sects.
Many sects spend a considerable amount of resources to train a disciple to join the Elixir Alliance.”
“Yet, in the end, very few succeed in joining.”
“My ability to join the Elixir Alliance is a positive development, so naturally, my sect wouldn’t obstruct it.”
“This is also why my marriage withdrawal went so smoothly.”
“No wonder…” Lin Jing nodded.
It made sense.
Joining the Elixir Alliance was a joyous event all Pill Sects yearned for, and since Ji Xiyue had been recognized by the Alliance, she naturally couldn’t become Dao companions with Mo Chengxuan.
Otherwise, the Elixir Alliance would probably be the first to disagree.
Understanding all this, Lin Jing was relieved.
After a while, Lin Jing suddenly remembered another matter.
He then asked Ji Xiyue again:
“Ji Daoyou!”
“You were seen by the Elixir Alliance and recruited as a disciple, and now you are heading to the Eastern Spirit Realm.
What about Mo Chengxuan?”
“Didn’t he say he was also going to the Eastern Spirit Realm, could he have another opportunity?”
Ji Xiyue said:
“Mo Chengxuan is different from me.
He is going to the Eastern Spirit Realm because the Yuling Dao Sect paid a price for him to cultivate in the better-resourced Eastern Spirit Realm.”
“Our paths aren’t even the same.”
“I see.” Lin Jing suddenly understood.
“Ji Daoyou, your joining the Elixir Alliance means your accomplishments will surely be extraordinary in the future.”
“I would like to offer my congratulations in advance.” Lin Jing said with a smile.
Ji Xiyue then looked at Lin Jing, her expression serious:
“Lin Daoyou.”
