“Other people may not realize it, but I am well aware that your achievements will in no way be inferior to mine.”
“I believe it won’t be long before I see you again in the Eastern Spirit Realm…”

chapters.title: Chapter 645
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 645: Chapter 275: The True Spirit of the Five Elements Chapter 645: Chapter 275: The True Spirit of the Five Elements Lin Jing and Ji Xiyue talked for a long time, not parting until dusk was nearing, when Ji Xiyue bid farewell and left.
After Ji Xiyue left, Lin Jing cleaned up the other areas of the courtyard.
Once done, he went back into the room to ensure even the interior was tidied up.
Next.
Lin Jing also planned to reside there for a while, taking the opportunity to try to understand his divine skills.
Having entered the Divinity Transformation Stage, it was time to comprehend his own divine skills.
A Divine Transformation Cultivator with divine skills and one without were starkly different beings.
...
Basically, the first thing every cultivator who just entered the Divinity Transformation stage did was to comprehend their own divine skills.
Of course.
There were exceptions, such as Ji Xiyue.
After cleaning up, Lin Jing returned to the room, and then directly summoned the System.
“Enter the System Space.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, in the next moment he vanished from the room and entered the System Space.
Inside the System Space, as soon as Lin Jing’s vision cleared, he saw a vibrant array of colors before him.
In front of Lin Jing, various Spirit Plants in the Spirit Field were ripe in abundance.
There were crisp and translucent Spirit Grass; there were brightly colored flowers dripping with hue; and of course, there were the red and luscious Spirit Fruits hanging on the branches, almost bending them with their weight.
Ever since he began his travels, Lin Jing had not entered the System Space again.
During his travels, immersed in the mundane world, perceiving the heavens and the earth, he naturally put the System Space to the back of his mind.
After returning from his travels, he had been with Grandpa Shi San the whole time and hadn’t had the opportunity to enter the System Space again.
Therefore.
It wasn’t until now that he reentered the System Space.
Twenty years had passed in the outside world, but with the seventh-level Flow of Time Speed in the System Space, one hundred and forty years had passed inside.
One hundred and forty years was indeed not a short time.
In his Spirit Field now, apart from those Fourth-Rank special Spirit Plants and some Fifth-Rank Spirit Plants,
All the other Spirit Plants had ripened.
Some had even outlived their lifespan, causing tremendous changes to the whole plant.
Like the Blood Red Vermilion Fruit tree in front of Lin Jing.
Several massive Blood Red Vermilion Fruits hung on the branches.
These Vermilion Fruits were at least half as large as the others and were as freshly spilled blood – vivid and striking.
Even just standing at the edge of the Spirit Field, Lin Jing could smell the light fragrance emanating from the Blood Red Vermilion Fruits.
This was a sign that the Blood Red Vermilion Fruits were already fully ripe.
With the Spirit Plants mature, it was time to harvest.
First, Lin Jing activated his Divine Sense to envelop the entire Spirit Field, and then he classified all the ripe Spirit Plants.
Since these mature Spirit Plants were different, after sorting them out, Lin Jing further divided them based on the types of Spirit Plants.
Some plants only needed to have their fruits picked without harming the plant itself, while others, like Spirit Grass, needed to be cut from the root, leaving some stems, which could continue to grow.
Then there were some, like the vine-type Spirit Plants, that required the use of the plant’s roots, so these needed to be uprooted entirely, after which a section of the rootstock could be planted back in the Spirit Field to continue growing.
Under the might of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, it took only a moment to sort these Spirit Plants.
After that, Lin Jing began the harvesting process.
…
…
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the host for harvesting the High-Grade Spiritual Plant, Blood Red Vermilion Fruit, and receiving a reward of 420 Harvest Points.”
…
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the host for harvesting the High-Grade Spiritual Plant, Thousand Spirits Divine Leaf, and receiving a reward of 560 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the host for harvesting the Low-Tier Spirit Plant, Moon Crow Root, and receiving a reward of 280 Harvest Points.”
…
…
For a time, countless System notices popped up one after another.
And so…
This harvest, taking less than four hours, saw all mature Spirit Plants in the Spirit Field reaped by Lin Jing.
After the entire harvest, Lin Jing couldn’t wait to open the System panel and check it.
The System panel displayed prominently: Upgrade Requirement: (171579/1000000 Harvest Points)
From this harvest of Spirit Plants, Lin Jing had accumulated over one hundred and fifty thousand Harvest Points.
Adding the ten thousand or so he already had, his current total was now more than one hundred seventy thousand points.
One hundred seventy thousand Harvest Points were actually quite substantial.
After checking the Harvest Points, and seeing the barren Spirit Field, Lin Jing got busy again.
With the Spirit Plants harvested, it was time to plant anew; the Spirit Field couldn’t be left empty.
Several more hours passed by the time Lin Jing planted the Spirit Field full again.
After the planting was complete, Lin Jing got up with satisfaction.
Then, he categorized the harvested Spirit Plants and placed them all in the Space Ring.
Having done all this, Lin Jing finally left the Spirit Field and headed towards the Alchemy Room.
…
Upon entering the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing sat down cross-legged.
He wasn’t there to perform alchemy, but rather, he wanted to practice divine skills.
Previously, in the Five Elements Cave Mansion, Lin Jing obtained a Jade Slip from the main hall, which had been left by a senior who had practiced the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
Lin Jing certainly hadn’t forgotten about that Jade Slip.
The content within the Jade Slip was of great help to him.
More importantly, the Jade Slip had a second half that could only be accessed by a Divine Transformation Cultivator.
Now that Lin Jing had entered Divinity Transformation, he naturally wanted to take out the Jade Slip and closely examine it.

chapters.title: Chapter 646
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 646: Chapter 275 Five Elements True Spirit_2 Chapter 646: Chapter 275 Five Elements True Spirit_2 Lin Jing retrieved the jade slip from within the space ring.
He then directly delved into it.
Lin Jing was already familiar with the content of the jade slip, so he skipped over the beginning.
Instead, he searched further back and soon, Lin Jing reached the sealed area again.
The senior who had left this jade slip had once said that to continue viewing the content beyond, one must enter the state of Divinity Transformation and use the power of the Soul Spirit to break this seal.
Lin Jing didn’t hesitate and immediately mobilized a strand of his Soul Spirit, rushing towards the seal in the jade slip.
“Boom!”
The force of Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit collided with the seal.
...
The seemingly indestructible seal was merely touched by that slight force from Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit and it shattered like a crumbling tile.
It seemed that this was also intentionally done by the senior who left the jade slip, making it effortless for Lin Jing to break the seal after entering Divinity Transformation.
Having broken the seal, Lin Jing then eagerly extended his Divine Sense to start viewing the subsequent content.
As soon as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense caught sight of the content beyond, it was immediately captivated because these contents were methods for comprehending Divine Skills.
Although Grandpa Shi San had previously given him some methods to comprehend Divine Skills, this jade slip was left by a senior who had practiced the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, making him essentially a senior from the same sect as Lin Jing.
This method was certainly of greater help to him.
…
This time,
Lin Jing delved into the jade slip for a long time until he had browsed through all the content at the back.
Only then did he withdraw his Divine Sense from the jade slip.
After withdrawing his Divine Sense, Lin Jing continued to sit cross-legged there, pondering for a long time.
Indeed, there was a set of methods to comprehend Divine Skills in the jade slip, and it was extremely suitable for Lin Jing.
Ɲονɡᴑ.сο
Other cultivators could be bestowed with Divine Arts from within the Sect, or they could comprehend them on their own.
But those who practiced the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique could only rely on their self-comprehension.
The Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique and the Five Elements Divine Art, ever since they were created by the Five Elements Ancestor, those who had practiced this technique, even if they hadn’t advanced to the forefront, were at least numerous.
Theoretically, since they all practiced the same technique, the Divine Skills mastered by the Five Elements Ancestor and other seniors practicing the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique should be transmittable.
But the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique was an exception.
Anyone practicing the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, regardless of what Divine Skills they had comprehended, would never pass them down.
And later generations of practitioners could only rely on their own comprehension.
Just like Lin Jing’s current situation, the jade slip contained no Divine Skills left by that senior; in fact, he didn’t even mention them.
Initially, Lin Jing had wanted to refer to that senior’s Divine Skills.
Now, he also had to abandon this idea.
However, that senior had also mentioned in the jade slip that each cultivator practicing the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique has Divine Skills related to their other cultivation techniques or Magical Treasures.
The Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique cultivates five types of Spiritual Powers, gathered together by the Five Elements, but precisely because it brings together the Five Elements, the balance among the five types of Spiritual Powers causes some difficulty when refining Divine Skills.
Only by focusing on other cultivation techniques or special methods as the primary and the Five Elements as a secondary, can one more easily refine their own Divine Skills.
Of course.
Over the countless years, many have cultivated the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, with certainly some who took the Five Elements Divine Art as the core to comprehend Divine Skills.
There were indeed those who succeeded, and the Divine Skills they comprehended were also formidable.
These individuals either devoted more time and energy than the average person or had extraordinary comprehension skills, beyond what ordinary people could achieve.
At this moment, Lin Jing was contemplating what type of Divine Skill he exactly needed.
After contemplating for a while, Lin Jing gave up.
Having just entered Divinity Transformation, it was naturally impossible for him to comprehend Divine Skills that rapidly.
This matter wasn’t urgent for now, so it was still better to take it slow.
…
Beyond comprehending Divine Skills, there was another part of the content related to advancing to the Solidifying Body Realm.
To advance to the Solidifying Body Realm, one must cultivate a Five Elements Spiritual Body, only by merging the Five Elements can one enter the Solidifying Body Realm.
Only after reviewing the jade slip did Lin Jing understand.
Previously, in the Demon Race Secret Realm, Xiyue’s father and the giant silhouettes behind the seven great Demon Cultivators from the Demon Clan were indeed the Five Elements Spiritual Bodies they had cultivated.
Cultivators cultivating the Five Elements Spiritual Body could use it to mobilize the Spiritual Power of heaven and earth at will, using it for themselves, allowing them to exert strength several times beyond their own.
And cultivating this Five Elements Spiritual Body was not a simple task.
Five Elements Spiritual Power needed to gather together.
At this step, the advantage of having a Five Elements Spiritual Root became evident.
Those with a Five Elements Spiritual Root, harboring all five elements, found it extremely simple to condense the Five Elements Spiritual Power.
However, for those cultivators without a Five Elements Spiritual Root, it was exceedingly difficult.
They might have once been peerless geniuses with a single Spiritual Root, cultivating at a rapid pace.
Or perhaps they had dual Spiritual Roots, regarded as elites within a sect.
But at the stage of the Solidifying Body Realm…
They had to cultivate Spiritual Power of their own attributes, condense the True Spirit, and seek True Spirits of other attributes that were dispersed between heaven and earth to compensate for their missing Spiritual Roots.
Only when the True Spirits of all five attributes were gathered, could they merge together and advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.
Five Elements True Spirits are a type of Spiritual Body birthed when Spiritual Power reaches its pinnacle.
Unlike Yin Spirits or other Spiritual Bodies, they have no life, yet are immensely compatible with Spiritual Power.
Cultivators, besides relying on their cultivation, could also find some spawning in certain places in the Cultivation World.
However, the conditions for its birth are exceedingly harsh.
Only in those special places where the Spiritual Power is particularly rich is it possible for them to appear, and they are extremely rare.
Although Five Elements True Spirits possess no intelligence, capturing them is also incredibly difficult.
Therefore, for other cultivators wishing to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm, it was not easy.
Compared to those cultivators with other kinds of Spiritual Roots, Lin Jing, possessing a Five Elements Spiritual Root, only needed to continuously cultivate in order to form True Spirits of all five attributes and thus cultivate a Five Elements Spiritual Body, advancing to the Solidifying Body Realm.
Although at this step, Lin Jing’s process might be much simpler than theirs, it was not necessarily faster than their speed of advancement.
Because…
All those genius disciples who joined large sects had their sects start looking for Five Elements True Spirits for them right from the outset.
Even some top-notch sects, with their terrifying resources, found a few Five Elements True Spirits to be a mere trifle.
They did not need to worry at all.
After reaching the Solidifying Body Realm, there is still some difference between the Five Elements Spiritual Root and other Spiritual Roots.
That is, the True Spirits condensed from a Five Elements Spiritual Root are more compatible with oneself than those captured from between heaven and earth.
Naturally, there will also be some difference in their combat power.
Cultivators with a Five Elements Spiritual Root in the Solidifying Body Realm will be much stronger than those who use captured True Spirits.
However…
Because all those who possess a Five Elements are classified as mixed Spiritual Roots, their cultivation speed is exceedingly slow.
Struggling to even advance to the Golden Core, let alone the Solidifying Body Realm, becomes immensely challenging.
Millions of years ago, the entire Cultivation World no longer saw a cultivator with a Five Elements Spiritual Root reach this step.
Especially nowadays, having a Five Elements Spiritual Root almost directly signifies a bleak path of cultivation.
Even those top-notch sects that are not lacking in resources would not waste their effort to nurture such a wastrel.
Although Lin Jing also had a Five Elements Spiritual Root, he had the System Space, and it was with the aid of the System Space that he had reached this stage.
Moreover…
Lin Jing had also obtained Cleansing Spirit Liquid, refined the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, and enhanced his Spirit Root aptitude.
Although it was a Five Elements Spiritual Root, his cultivation speed had already reached the pace of triple or even dual Spiritual Roots.
…
The entire content of the Jade Slip covered these two aspects.
Whether it was due to the limitations of the previous cultivator’s cultivation, this Jade Slip did not include some subsequent information.
But even this was enough.
In the last part of the Jade Slip, the previous owner of the slip emphatically advised Lin Jing to make a journey to the Five Elements Ruins.
He said it would be immensely helpful to him.
Actually, without the reminder from this predecessor, Lin Jing would have still gone there.
After all…
Lin Jing’s current Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique only reached up to the Nascent Soul Peak, and he no longer had follow-up cultivation techniques beyond that.
The subsequent phases of the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique were located within the Five Elements Ruins, so Lin Jing definitely needed to visit the Five Elements Ruins to seek further techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 647
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 647: Chapter 276 Clownish Diversion, Departure Chapter 647: Chapter 276 Clownish Diversion, Departure “`
To enter the Five Elements Ruins, one must gather all five Five Elements Command Tokens.
Lin Jing currently has two of them in his possession.
The other three are distributed with Li Mingwu holding two, and Bai Yi one.
If Lin Jing wishes to enter the Five Elements Ruins and cultivate the complete Immortal Five Elements Technique, he must obtain the remaining three tokens from them.
However, the Five Elements Command Tokens are far too precious for either of them to relinquish voluntarily.
And their cultivation levels are certainly not low.
It seems unlikely that he can seize them by force.
...
Therefore,
in order to enter the Five Elements Ruins, he must find them and cooperate together to collect all five Five Elements Command Tokens and gain access to the ruins.
Nevertheless,
Lin Jing, who has just entered the Divinity Transformation Stage, has yet to comprehend any Divine Arts and even his cultivation level is significantly lower than theirs.
If Lin Jing were to rashly reveal that he possesses the Five Elements Command Tokens, his situation would become very dangerous.
Lin Jing has no doubts that they would kill for the tokens.
Even though he now possesses the cultivation at the Divinity Transformation Stage, it doesn’t necessarily mean he can match them.
Moreover, he has just advanced to Divinity Transformation and hasn’t yet grasped any Divine Arts.
Lin Jing, if he wants to enter the Five Elements Ruins, needs to wait till he has fully assimilated the cultivation from the Demon Infant within him and grasped his own Divine Arts.
ṅονǤ0.сο
After digesting the cultivation of the Demon Infant, Lin Jing should at least be able to break through to between the fifth and sixth layer of Divinity Transformation.
With the cultivation of the fifth or sixth layer of Divinity Transformation, although he may not be quite a match for Li Mingwu, he should be comparable to Bai Yi and the others.
Even with his concurrent practice of the Martial Dao, Lin Jing could have the strength to fight Li Mingwu.
With that, Lin Jing would not fear any of them.
Further, there’s another point…
One of the tokens in his possession, he acquired during his last visit to the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
If he were to carelessly bring it out, it would certainly be extremely disadvantageous for him, and might even alert the others, potentially leading them to join forces against him.
Hence, Lin Jing does not plan to reveal the Five Elements Wood Command, but intends to find another way to dispose of or directly sell it.
By then, possessing the Five Elements Fire Command will be sufficient for him.
…
After reviewing the content on the Jade Slip, Lin Jing put it away.
Once he stored the Jade Slip, he took out another from his Space Ring.
This Jade Slip contained the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique he obtained from Immortal Crossing Island.
Lin Jing had been cultivating this Cultivation Technique, but he had only practiced half of it.
The first half of the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, which can reinforce one’s Divine Sense, doesn’t have cultivation level restrictions for practice.
The latter part, however, requires a cultivator to have reached the Divinity Transformation Stage to continue.
Lin Jing glanced at it previously, but only briefly; when he realized he couldn’t cultivate it further, he gave up and didn’t check it again.
Now that Lin Jing has reached the Divinity Transformation Stage, he is in the right position to cultivate it.
Therefore, he thought of taking this opportunity to look at the latter half of the technique.
If possible, he might as well start preparing to cultivate the latter part of Dao Transformation Divinity Technique right away.
After taking out the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, Lin Jing activated his Divine Sense and probed into it.
He was already extremely familiar with the preliminary content; without hesitation, he rapidly skimmed through it to examine the latter part of the technique.
Dao Transformation Divinity, as its name suggests, is about condensing the Soul Spirit to enhance one’s Divine Sense power and then separating a part of one’s Soul Spirit.
Somewhat like cultivating a clone, one must first condense their Soul Spirit and, once it becomes powerful, separate a part of it.
Moreover,
the separated part of the Soul Spirit is not completely detached and normally functions as one entity.
Only at critical moments, such as during battle…
can one activate the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, separate their Soul Spirit, and with two Soul Spirits control oneself and a Puppet to attack the enemy, creating a situation of attacking with superior numbers to quickly secure a victory.
This Cultivation Technique was created by a brilliantly gifted Puppet Master.
Ordinary Puppet Masters need to split a part of their Divine Sense to control Puppets.
Even though such a method can be used against an enemy, it’s very susceptible to disturbances.
If the Puppet Master is attacked, then the Divine Sense controlling the Puppet will also be affected, thereby limiting the Puppet’s performance.
Therefore, that Puppet Master put great effort into researching and creating this Dao Transformation Divinity Technique.
This remarkably ingenious Puppet Master came up with a method to separate his Soul Spirit in another way, allowing his consciousness to split into two without affecting each other.
This is akin to having another clone.
Normally, if one encounters a Puppet Master, one could directly besiege the Puppet Master to exert pressure.
Then the actions of the controlled Puppet would inevitably be heavily affected.
But after cultivating the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, Puppet Masters and their Puppets become two separate entities.
Even if the Puppet Master is surrounded, it will not affect the actions of the Puppet and might even catch the enemy off-guard.
Although the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique is extraordinary, its cultivation is also extremely challenging.
Firstly,
to master the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique, one’s Soul Spirit must be stronger than others, and the stronger the Soul Spirit, the easier it is to succeed in cultivating Divinity.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 648
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 648: Chapter 276 Clownish Diversion, Departure_2 Chapter 648: Chapter 276 Clownish Diversion, Departure_2 Otherwise, if the soul spirit’s strength is insufficient, not only is failure likely, but there’s also a risk of injuring oneself during the soul-splitting process.
In severe cases, it might even lead to direct demise.
Secondly,
during the initial soul-splitting, one requires a divine sense that is stronger than one’s own soul spirit as support.
The strength of this divine sense must be at least close to twice that of the soul spirit’s strength.
Fulfilling this condition also presents some difficulty.
A cultivator’s divine sense is generally comparable to the strength of their soul spirit.
The stronger the soul spirit, the stronger the divine sense naturally becomes.
...
Wanting the divine sense to surpass the soul spirit requires external assistance.
It could be through the use of certain elixir medicines or spirit grass to stimulate, or some special magical treasures, or even certain cultivation techniques that can enhance one’s divine sense in a short time.
There are even some special places that can strengthen the divine sense.
Seeing this second condition, Lin Jing felt somewhat relieved.
The Alchemy Room in the System Space just happened to be able to enhance the divine sense, so there was no need to worry further.
Inside the Alchemy Room, one’s divine sense could be increased by 60%, and if upgraded once more, it could be enhanced by 70%.
With such an enhancement, even if there are deficiencies, by refining some elixir medicines that can temporarily boost the divine sense, this problem can be easily resolved.
Having solved the issue of divine sense, there is now only one problem left.
That is the elixir medicine to strengthen the soul spirit.
The soul spirit is fundamental to a cultivator, and elixir medicines that enhance it are exceedingly rare.
As far as Lin Jing knows, among fifth-grade elixir medicines, the Revival Elixir can repair a damaged soul spirit, but it cannot strengthen it.
And there’s another fifth-grade elixir medicine, Gathering Spirit Elixir, which can enhance the divine sense for a short period.
As for elixir medicines that can strengthen the soul spirit, Lin Jing has never heard of any.
Afterward,
Lin Jing finished checking the entire jade slip.
At the end of the jade slip, he saw such a message:
“When cultivating to split the soul, Nascent Soul Peak is optimal.
Otherwise, if the soul spirit’s strength is insufficient, failure is highly likely.”
“In addition…”
“Jade Soul Algae often grows in extremely harsh sea regions and can enhance the soul spirit when consumed and refined directly.”
Reading until the end, Lin Jing was quite surprised; he did not expect that there would be a method to enhance the soul spirit at the end.
Jade Soul Algae.
It seems that later, when he returns to the Demonic Monster Sea, he will have to search carefully.
After checking, Lin Jing placed the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique into the Space Ring.
This cultivation technique is also currently beyond his ability to practice.
Since he could not practice it, Lin Jing could only put it aside for the moment.
Next,
Lin Jing took out the Great Dream Ancient Mirror from the Space Ring, ready to continue with its refinement.
During the Tribulation, Lin Jing’s Ling Yin Flawless Sword was already shattered.
Now, he has no usable magical treasures on him.
It was just right to try refining the Great Dream Ancient Mirror now that he had advanced to Divinity Transformation.
And for the upcoming period, Lin Jing had already made plans to refine the Great Dream Ancient Mirror while understanding his own divine arts.
…
A few days later, Ji Xiyue prepared to leave the Nanming Domain and once again came to Lin Jing’s courtyard to bid him farewell.
As they prepared to part, the two exchanged courteous words.
Ji Xiyue couldn’t help but express her feelings,
“Honestly, I’m still somewhat short of the Elixir Alliance’s standards.”
“Without your help, the Elixir Alliance wouldn’t have even considered me.”
At this point, Ji Xiyue looked toward Lin Jing, and continued,
“I believe that with your alchemy level, if you were in the Elixir Alliance, you would definitely amaze those old timers.”
“And I believe that with your skills, plus the resources of the Elixir Alliance, you would quickly surpass me, even directly reaching the Seventh Grade, or even Eighth Grade Alchemist.”
Lin Jing just smiled and said,
“Ji Dao friend!”
“Don’t sell yourself short.
I believe that when you’re at the Elixir Alliance, with guidance from the Alchemy Dao predecessors, your alchemy will definitely become increasingly formidable.”
“Who knows, when we meet again, you might have far surpassed me.”
Hearing this, Ji Xiyue gave Lin Jing a sidelong glance and pouted, saying,
“Are you not the heir of an ancient alchemy family?
Is your confidence really that lacking?”
“Well, it’s not easy to say…” Lin Jing said sheepishly.
Ɲ0νǤ0.сο
Now when Lin Jing practiced alchemy, the proficiency he could gain was becoming less and less; even when making low-tier elixirs, he didn’t get any proficiency at all.
And the proficiency needed to level up had become an astronomical figure.
Unless he took refuge in one of the top alchemy sects and continuously crafted fifth-grade, or even sixth-grade elixirs, to acquire proficiency,
Otherwise,
Just relying on his current method of cultivating spirit fields or using spirit stones to sporadically purchase spirit plants for refinement,
He wouldn’t be able to refine more than a few elixir furnaces in a year, so how could he continue to level up?
It’s possible that by the time they met again, Ji Xiyue would have already become a seventh-grade alchemist, while he would still be hovering at the sixth-grade.
To advance to a seventh-grade alchemist, it seemed he would need to think of more ways.
…
Ji Xiyue didn’t ask further, but by her expression, it seemed she didn’t believe Lin Jing at all and probably thought he was being modest.
And Lin Jing didn’t explain.
Afterward, the two spoke for some time.
Later, they bid farewell to each other, and Ji Xiyue left.
Ji Xiyue needed to return to the Western Demon Region first, and then from there, travel with the people from the Elixir Alliance to the Eastern Spirit Realm.
After Ji Xiyue left, Lin Jing stood in the courtyard for a long time, until the sunset began to slope westward, he seemed to come back to his senses, murmuring softly,
“It seems, I should also be heading back…”
In the following days, Lin Jing sought out Wei Zhengqing for a brief gathering.
After an extensive chat with him, Lin Jing bid farewell.
After leaving Wei Zhengqing, Lin Jing went to Linxian City, met with Ning Yue, and learned from her that the Ning family had already parted ways with the Nanming Immortal Sect.
Ever since Grandpa Shi San spoke those words in the Demon Race Secret Realm, the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion had thoroughly investigated the Nanming Immortal Sect.
If it had been any other time, given that the Nanming Immortal Sect was one of the three major sects, no one would dare to cause trouble at Nanming Immortal Sect even if the ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect was not present,
But this time, the trouble originated from the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect.
And it was Grandpa Shi San who personally revealed that the ancestor of Nanming Immortal Sect was practicing demonic techniques, so naturally, the ancestors of Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion did not dare to neglect this.
They immediately initiated an investigation.
After the investigation, indeed, significant discoveries were made.
The Grand Elder of the Nanming Immortal Sect, along with several other powerful elders, were found to be practicing demonic techniques.
Even some of the core disciples of Nanming Immortal Sect were also practicing demonic techniques.
This situation shocked both Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion, who are also among the three major sects.
The ancestors of both Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion personally took action, executing all those who practiced demonic techniques,
Not a single one of those demon cultivators, including the Grand Elder of Nanming Immortal Sect, escaped.
With the loss of these individuals, the Nanming Immortal Sect no longer had the capital to be counted as one of the three major sects.
Moreover, when this incident came to light, many disciples of Nanming Immortal Sect voluntarily left the sect.
After this ordeal, the entire Nanming Immortal Sect had completely declined.
All the families and smaller sects that were affiliated with it also left following this event.
The Ning family also departed from the Nanming Immortal Sect during this time.
Upon leaving the Nanming Immortal Sect, the Ning family not only didn’t suffer any losses, but there were even signs of growth.
Upon learning of this, Lin Jing merely smiled and offered his congratulations.
Afterward, Lin Jing bid farewell to Ning Yue and then left Linxian City.
After leaving, Lin Jing set off for Sea-Watch City.
On the way, Lin Jing took a detour to Tianxin City to see Steward Cheng, then returned to Mo City, looking at Yu Yan from a distance,
And even Yu Ling, he even saw Yu Ling’s son.
Although Yu Ling didn’t have a spiritual root, her son possessed a three-attribute spiritual root,
With a three-attribute spiritual root, in Mo City, he could be described as having an exceptionally good aptitude.
Another ten years had passed since the last time, and Yu Ling had already become a woman in appearance.
Though she hadn’t aged, her youth was no longer.
This time, as Grandpa Shi San went to the Outer Spatial Void to find a cure for Shi San, it was unknown how long it would take.
It was likely to be a long time.
It is very possible that by the time Shi San woke up again, Yu Ling would have passed away.
But this is the separation between the mortal world and immortality; it cannot be changed.
Mo City was Lin Jing’s last stop in the Nanming Domain.
After leaving Mo City, Lin Jing didn’t linger any longer, instead, he flew directly towards Sea-Watch City…

chapters.title: Chapter 649
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 649: Chapter 277: Encountering the Trade Fair Again Chapter 649: Chapter 277: Encountering the Trade Fair Again When Lin Jing came to the Nanming Domain, the journey was not very smooth, but when he left, there were no obstacles at all, and the departure was unusually smooth.
Lin Jing arrived in Sea-Watch City just as several cultivators needed to use the Teleportation Array, and he joined them conveniently.
Without any delay, they directly boarded the Teleportation Array and left the Nanming Domain.
…
In Bihai City’s Teleportation Array, a beam of light shot up to the sky, enveloping the entire array platform in the blinding light produced by the teleportation.
After the teleportation light faded, several people appeared in the middle of the array.
Some of them were gathered together, obviously acquainted with each other, and not far from them was another person standing alone.
...
The group of cultivators seemed to be intentionally keeping a certain distance from the solitary cultivator.
And although they were together, they seemed particularly restrained.
The solitary cultivator was none other than Lin Jing.
Traveling with Lin Jing were several Golden Core Cultivators, who maintained a certain distance from Lin Jing due to the vast difference in their cultivation levels.
They did not dare to come too close, fearing they might anger Lin Jing.
This was actually quite normal in the Cultivation World.
Although Lin Jing had already advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage, he did not reveal his true cultivation level but continued to conceal it at the Nascent Soul Stage.
The reason for this was his fear of encountering acquaintances.
Even revealing his Nascent Soul cultivation level was enough to gain considerable attention; if he were to expose his Divinity Transformation Stage cultivation level, it would be even more shocking and astounding.
It might be a bit of a hassle, but this approach was indeed effective for Lin Jing.
Just as he stepped out of the array, Lin Jing heard a voice filled with pleasant surprise:
“Uncle Lin.”
“Yan Xing, look quicklyâ€¦”
“It’s Uncle Lin!”
As soon as these words were uttered, another voice filled with excitement followed:
“Really, it is Uncle Lin.”
Hearing the voices, Lin Jing quickly turned his head to see two stunningly beautiful women waving at him from the plaza where the Teleportation Array was located.
These two women were none other than Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Lin Jing was also somewhat surprised to see them.
He hadn’t expected to run into acquaintances just after teleporting.
Lin Jing waved back at them and then left the Teleportation Array to walk toward the two sisters.
This time, the Elder in charge of the array was not the Elder Qin from before but someone Lin Jing did not recognize.
Seeing Lin Jing, the man just gave him a glance and then paid him no further attention.
Lin Jing, of course, did not bother him and instead walked directly toward Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
Approaching them, Lin Jing sized up the two sisters with a smile and asked:
“What are you two doing here?”
“Where is your father?”
It had been more than twenty years since he last saw them.
For mortals, twenty years might make up a third of their lifetime, and if they didn’t see each other during that time, they would likely return with greatly changed appearances and could hardly recognize each other.
However, for cultivators, twenty years brought little change.
For instance, although Yan Xing and Yan Yue hadn’t seen Lin Jing for twenty years, they didn’t appear much different.
Especially since both sisters had long taken the Eternal Youth Elixir, ensuring their beauty remained unchanged, looking no different from before.
What changed visibly was probably their demeanor; Lin Jing could clearly sense that they had matured compared to the last time he saw them.
Of course, their cultivation levels had changed too.
Lin Jing had just glanced at them and immediately noticed that the sisters had both reached the early stages of the Golden Core, nearing the middle stage.
Clearly, after taking the Cleansing Spirit Elixir last time, the sisters had quickly advanced to the Golden Core stage after their Spirit Root Aptitudes were enhanced.
Lin Jing had watched these two sisters grow up, so he felt an inexplicable sense of affection when facing them.
Seeing them successfully form their Golden Cores, Lin Jing was very gratified.
The sisters, on their part, were also very happy to face Lin Jing.
Yan Yue then spoke:
“Father and our great grandfather also came to Bihai City, but they had some matters to attend to and temporarily went back to Spirit Rock Island.”
“We had nothing to do, so we came out for a walk.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
Yan Xing then continued:
“We’ve been out for a while now, so I guess our great grandfather and father should be back soon.”
“Uncle Lin, why don’t you join us in returning home?
Father will surely be very pleased to know you’re here.”
Yan Yue nodded and added:
“And great grandfather too.”
“He’s also been missing Uncle Lin for a long time.
He’s been saying he wants to meet you.
Last time when you came to Spirit Rock Island, it was a pity that great grandfather wasn’t there, and you didn’t get to meet.”
The Yan Family’s great grandfather was the Divine Transformation Cultivator from the Yan Family.
ṅονǤ0.сο
He had been in the Nanming Domain the last time Lin Jing visited, so they hadn’t met.
Since it was the Yan Family’s great grandfather, it would indeed be right to meet him.
Lin Jing then nodded and replied:
“Alright!”
“Then I’ll accompany you both back.”
After hearing this, the sisters were very pleased and eagerly led the way.
Lin Jing then followed Yan Xing and Yan Yue away from the plaza where the Teleportation Array was located.
After leaving the plaza, Lin Jing accompanied the two sisters to a spacious street in the center of Bihai City, where the Yan Family had set up a shop.
This shop was not small, and it was located right in the center of Bihai City, which reflected the considerable strength of the Yan Family.
The purpose of this shop was mainly to serve the Yan Family, helping them to buy and sell various Spirit Plants.

chapters.title: Chapter 650
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 650: Chapter 277: Encounter the Trade Fair Again_2 Chapter 650: Chapter 277: Encounter the Trade Fair Again_2 Lin Jing followed the two sisters into the merchant shop and was immediately greeted by members of the Yan Family.
Yan Yue briefly introduced Lin Jing, and then led him through the shop towards the back.
Behind the shop was a fairly large courtyard.
This courtyard was where the Yan Family members rested while in Bihai City.
When the three of them arrived, the old ancestor of the Yan Family and Yan Ming had not yet returned.
It wasn’t until an hour later that Yan Ming came back to this place.
At that time, Lin Jing was chatting with the two sisters when he heard Yan Ming’s hearty laughter:
“Haha…”
“Brother Lin, it has indeed been a long time since we last met,” Yan Ming said.
...
Upon hearing this voice, Lin Jing immediately turned his head and saw Yan Ming approaching.
“As soon as I got back to the shop, I was told that Brother Lin had arrived.
It’s been a long time since you’ve appeared, Brother Lin, and your visit today is truly a pleasant surprise,” Yan Ming said with a smile.
Lin Jing stood up and went to meet Yan Ming.
Ɲονɢᴑ.сο
“Brother Yan!”
“I’ve just returned from the Nanming Domain when I ran into Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
I thought it had been a long time since I’d seen you, so I came over to check in,” Lin Jing said.
At that time, Yan Ming came over to Lin Jing, sized him up, and then said:
“Indeed!”
“Brother Lin, you went to the Nanming Domain and ended up staying there for over twenty years; that’s quite a long time,” Yan Ming remarked.
Lin Jing nodded:
“I hadn’t planned to stay so long, but some matters arose that caused the delay,” he replied.
Upon hearing this, Yan Ming quickly asked:
“Did you encounter any trouble?”
“If there’s trouble, Brother Lin, feel free to speak up; our Yan Family will surely provide full support,” Yan Ming offered eagerly.
Lin Jing then chuckled and waved his hand:
“Brother Yan, you worry too much; it was just some issues with cultivation, and there wasn’t any trouble,” he assured.
Yan Ming, hearing this, breathed a sigh of relief:
“That’s good to hear.”
After speaking, Yan Ming quickly changed the subject:
“Brother Lin!”
“Your return is timely indeed,” Yan Ming continued.
Lin Jing, confused by the remark, looked questioningly at Yan Ming.
Yan Ming spoke again:
“Today there’s a high-end trading conference, and those participating in this conference are all at least of the Nascent Soul Stage in cultivation.”
“Such a high-end trading conference isn’t easy to come by, and since you’ve returned today, we can go together and take a look,” he suggested.
“A trading conference?”
As soon as Lin Jing heard about the trading conference, his brow furrowed instantaneously.
The mention of a trading conference immediately brought to mind Shopkeeper Shen; he had used one to deceive many cultivators into entering the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
And the sinister mastermind behind it all was Li Mingwu.
In the end, even Shopkeeper Shen himself was deceived by the Great Cultivator Ling Yi and was transported into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, where he ultimately perished.
Now that another trading conference was being mentioned, Lin Jing couldn’t help but suspect whether this could be another of Li Mingwu’s schemes.
At this moment, Yan Ming was eagerly looking forward to Lin Jing’s response.
When he mentioned the trading conference, he saw that Lin Jing’s reaction wasn’t one of excitement, but rather one of concern.
This left Yan Ming quite puzzled, so he asked:
“Brother Lin, is there a problem?”
Lin Jing looked at Yan Ming and then said:
“Whenever I hear about a trading conference, I remember a major event that happened in the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“The former Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Li Mingwu, used a trading conference to deceive cultivators, luring them into a secret space with the intent of using the cultivators for alchemy to aid his own breakthrough.”
“Brother Yan, you must have heard of that incident, right?” Lin Jing inquired.
Yan Ming nodded in response:
“Of course.”
“That incident was widely discussed; I’ve naturally heard about it,” he acknowledged.
“Is that what you’re worried about?” Yan Ming asked, and without waiting for Lin Jing to answer, he reassured him with a smile:
“Rest assured, Brother Lin, there’s absolutely no problem with this trading conference.”
“This is a high-end trading conference, and all the participants are renowned figures from the Southern Outer Sea, including several Divine Transformation Cultivators,” Yan Ming explained.
“For instance, the God of Dongji Island from the Eastern Sea Domain and Li Chen from the Jingyuan Sea Domain are both figures close to the peak of Divinity Transformation.”
“Aside from them, the Island Master of True Dragon Islandâ€”one of the three major islands in your Thousand Islands Domainâ€”is also attending this trading conference.”
“And my family’s old ancestor didn’t come with me because he went ahead to the conference earlier.”
“Moreover…”
“This trading conference is being held inside the Welcoming Immortals Tower in Bihai City, and Li Mingwu wouldn’t dare to touch any of these people, even if he were bold enough.”
“So don’t worry, Brother Lin, this trading conference is absolutely safe,” Yan Ming assured.
After hearing this, Lin Jing was relieved.
Even with all his power, Li Mingwu wouldn’t dare to act against the participants of this trading conference, especially not in Bihai City.
Afterward, Yan Ming continued:
“Also, last time you helped Xing’er and Yue’er to refine the Cleansing Spirit Elixir, my family’s ancestor was very grateful and has always said that he wanted to meet you,”
“This is a good opportunity.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded:
“Indeed!”
“I should indeed pay a visit to Elder Yan.”
“Since that’s the case, let’s go to this trading event and see.”
“That is how it should be,” Yan Ming nodded in agreement.
“This trading event is quite high-end; I expect that many treasures that are rarely seen will appear.
Perhaps we will even find the treasures we are looking for,”
Lin Jing nodded.
“Good…”
“Then let’s go take a look together.”
After finishing, Yan Ming then gave some instructions to Yan Xing and Yan Yue.
After the instructions, he led Lin Jing away from the place.
Yingxianlou is the largest tavern in Bihai City and also the venue for this trading event.
After leaving the Yan family shop, Lin Jing and Yan Ming went straight to Yingxianlou.
Yan Ming, as the current head of the Yan family, was naturally very familiar with the shopkeeper of Yingxianlou.
No sooner had the two arrived than the shopkeeper of Yingxianlou came out to greet them.
Then, the shopkeeper personally led the two of them upstairs.
The venue for the trading event was on the eighth floor of Yingxianlou, which was very spacious.
Because of the trading event, the entire eighth floor had been closed off.
At the entrance of the stairs, two Golden Core Cultivators were arranged to stand guard.
The shopkeeper of Yingxianlou only escorted the two to the entrance before leaving.
Now it was the turn of the two Golden Core Cultivators standing at the entrance.
These two Golden Core Cultivators obviously recognized Yan Ming as well.
As soon as the two arrived, the Golden Core Cultivators hurriedly greeted them and then guided them upstairs.
As soon as Lin Jing entered the trading hall, they immediately caught the attention of others.
Some turned their heads to look while Divine Sense directly swept over them.
Others made no movement, as if they were indifferent to anything.
But when they saw Yan Ming, they all turned their heads away, and those who extended their Divine Sense simply swept over briefly.
After all, the Yan Family had a renowned name in the Southern Outer Sea.
Moreover, the Elder of the Yan Family was a Great Cultivator at the peak of Divinity Transformation.
No one dared to offend him lightly.
As for Lin Jing, who was beside Yan Ming, although they did not recognize him, Lin Jing himself had the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Stage and met the requirements to attend this trading event.
Furthermore, being together with Yan Ming clearly indicated a good relationship with Yan Ming, suggesting he was invited by Yan Ming.
The most they did was show curiosity and secretly note down Lin Jing’s identity.
As fellow Nascent Soul Cultivators, they might deal with each other in the future.
While they were observing him, Lin Jing was also observing them.
At the moment, there were about a dozen people on the entire eighth floor.
Not one of them was in Divine Transformation; all of them had the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Stage.
The Divine Transformation Cultivators, including the ancestor of the Yan Family, were not there at that time.
After arriving upstairs, Yan Ming also took a look around and then said to Lin Jing:
“The ancestor is not here.”
“Not only the ancestor, but the other Divinity Transformation Cultivators are also not present; it seems they should be together,” Yan Ming stated.
Lin Jing nodded.
After that, the two of them, like everyone else, found a place to sit down and waited for the trading event to start.
…
Time passed by little by little.
From an originally sparse crowd, the eighth floor gradually filled up with more people arriving.
The number of attendees at the trading event had increased to more than twenty.
At this moment, Lin Jing finally saw two familiar faces.
One of them was the True Lord of Yelin Island from Thousand Islands Domain, who also participated in this trading event.
The other was the True Lord Qi Yan.
Upon arrival, True Lord Qi Yan immediately saw Lin Jing and Yan Ming.
He walked straight towards the two of them.
Just as True Lord Qi Yan arrived, before he could speak, Yan Ming took the initiative to say:
“Previously when we searched for you, you said you wouldn’t come.
Why the change of heart?”
True Lord Qi Yan seemed a bit embarrassed and spoke awkwardly:
“The Magical Treasure I was refining failed unintentionally, and I am here to see if I can find some useful materials.”
After speaking, True Lord Qi Yan looked towards Lin Jing and then said with a smile:
“Lin Daoyou, long time no see.”
Lin Jing also responded with a smile:
“Qi Yan Daoyou, long time no see…”

chapters.title: Chapter 651
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 651: Chapter 278: Protection of the Yan Family’s Ancestor Chapter 651: Chapter 278: Protection of the Yan Family’s Ancestor “How is the Ling Yin Flawless Sword I forged for you holding up?”
Qi Yan looked at Lin Jing and asked.
After speaking, Qi Yan wore a self-satisfied expression:
“That Ling Yin Flawless Sword can be considered the pinnacle of my current forging skills, a supreme grade Dao Artifact.
Throughout the entire Southern Outer Seas, I fear no one else but myself could craft it.”
Seeing Qi Yan’s face exude pride and self-satisfaction, Lin Jing was momentarily at a loss for words, unsure of how to respond.
It wasn’t exactly feasible for him to tell Qi Yan that the Ling Yin Flawless Sword had already been destroyed by the Heavenly Tribulation.
It wasn’t until Qi Yan finished speaking and looked towards Lin Jing that Lin Jing quickly spoke up:
“Um…”
“It’s…
it’s very useful, quite effective indeed.”
Since the Ling Yin Flawless Sword was destroyed by the Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing dared not reveal the truth.
Seeing Qi Yan as he was, if he were to find out that the Ling Yin Flawless Sword had shattered, he would likely be dumbfounded.
...
And continuously inquire about the reasons.
After all, a supreme grade Dao Artifact had suddenly shattered, which was hard to justify.
And Lin Jing did not want to reveal too much, so he could only conceal the truth for the time being.
However,
fortunately, Qi Yan did not continue to inquire, which really relieved Lin Jing.
Afterward, the three of them chatted idly.
After a long while, just as the trade fair was about to start, another person entered, also a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
This person looked around after arriving.
When his gaze landed on Lin Jing, he paused momentarily, then quickly swept to other areas.
This odd behavior naturally caught Lin Jing’s attention.
Lin Jing turned around for a look but discovered that he did not know this person.
Lin Jing was puzzled for a moment, then turned his attention back.
Just when Lin Jing turned his head, he saw Lord Ye Lin also slightly frowning and turning to look at that cultivator.
From that new Nascent Soul Cultivator’s gaze, Lin Jing and Lord Ye Lin were directly in line.
“Perhaps he has seen Lord Ye Lin before, which is why he looked this way,” Lin Jing thought to himself, then felt reassured.
Lord Ye Lin also saw Lin Jing and nodded at him in greeting.
Lin Jing also nodded lightly, acknowledging the greeting.
Both tactfully remained silent.
The unfamiliar Nascent Soul Cultivator, after scanning the area, did not approach Lord Ye Lin but instead walked towards an inconspicuous corner.
Seeing this, Lin Jing no longer paid attention but turned his head and continued talking with Yan Ming and Qi Yan.
After a while, several Divine Transformation Cultivators participating in this trade fair descended from the ninth floor.
The person leading was an old man in white clothes.
This elder appeared calm, his aura hidden, and his demeanor was tranquil and unassuming, much like a wise elder who had seen through the vicissitudes of life.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.сօ
Behind the elder were four others.
Among these four, Lin Jing had only met the island master of True Dragon Island; he did not recognize the others.
After the elder descended from the upstairs, he directly walked towards Lin Jing.
At this moment, Yan Ming spoke up, reminding Lin Jing:
“This is the ancestor.”
As the Yan Family ancestor approached, Yan Ming quickly bowed his hands:
“Ancestor!”
Lin Jing and Qi Yan also bowed their hands in unison:
“Elder Yan!”
“Elder Yan!”
The Yan Family ancestor nodded, then looked at Lin Jing and with a smile, said:
“I presume you must be Lin Jing?”
Lin Jing nodded and bowed:
“Yes, elder.”
The Yan Family ancestor spoke in a tone as serene as an elder of a mortal family would continue:
“Yue’er and Xing’er often mention you, so much so that my ears are almost calloused.”
“Now it appears, you truly are extraordinary.”
“So young yet with such cultivation, and also a Fifth Grade Alchemist, which is even more remarkable.”
“Elder flatters me,” Lin Jing said modestly.
The Yan Family ancestor continued:
“Thank you for the Cleansing Spirit Elixir before.”
“If you ever encounter any trouble, feel free to come to Spirit Rock Island.
I still have some influence in the Southern Outer Sea.”
What the Yan Family ancestor meant by saying this was to offer his protection.
The conversation, especially the last statement, was deliberately loud, obviously for others to hear.
With this move by the Yan Family ancestor, others glanced sideways, and the other four Divine Transformation Cultivators also looked over.
Among them was an older man, pockmarked, hunchbacked, and with bent posture, who chuckled and then spoke:
“Heh heh…”
“I say, Elder Yan, aren’t you trying to entice this talented alchemist to join the Yan Family and become an exclusive Pill Master for your family?”
The old man’s voice was hoarse, especially when he laughed, it was even more chilling.
After hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor turned back to the old man and said:
“I say Old Toad, can you not project your own ways onto others.”
“My Yan Family has always been clear about gratitude and grievances.
Have we ever mistreated anyone who has helped our family?”
“If I indeed need his help for alchemy, I will state it clearly, not resorting to any schemes, and if he is unwilling, I certainly will not force him.”
“Besides, this young man has done a great favor for my Yan Family.
We naturally will protect him from being bullied by others.”
“Even if it’s you, if you have any ideas against him, I will not hesitate to step in and give you a beating.”

chapters.title: Chapter 652
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 652: Chapter 278 Protection from the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 Chapter 652: Chapter 278 Protection from the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 Hearing this, many people around looked at Lin Jing with immense envy.
With the words of the Yan Family ancestor, in the future, in the Southern Outer Sea, there would probably be very few who dared to offend Lin Jing.
After all,
since the Yan Family ancestor had spoken, if anyone dared to target Lin Jing, it would be like slapping the Yan Family ancestor in the face.
These people weren’t fools; naturally, they wouldn’t casually offend a Divine Transformation Peak Great Cultivator.
The hunchbacked old man twitched the corners of his mouth upon hearing this and then repeatedly waved his hands:
“Forget it, I wouldn’t dare, I’m afraid you’d beat me up.”
Lin Jing could tell that the hunchbacked old man must have had a good relationship with the Yan Family ancestor; otherwise, he wouldn’t have made such a joke.
…
After the jokes, the True Dragon Island Island Master spoke up:
“Well, now that everyone is here, can we start the trading assembly?”
The rest nodded:
“Fine, let’s start now.”
Then, several people took their seats, with the Yan Family ancestor even sitting directly beside Yan Ming.
...
After sitting down, the Yan Family ancestor continued:
“That old toad is from the Northern Divine Toad Island, the Divine Toad himself.
He and I have a fairly good relationship.”
“If you run into trouble in the northern part of the Outer Seas, you can ask him for help.
On account of my face, he won’t ignore you.”
The weight of this statement was certainly not light, and it left Lin Jing feeling unexpectedly honoured.
“Senior…”
“How can I accept this?”
If, because of Yan Xing and Yan Yue, the Yan Family ancestor supported Lin Jing on the spot, that could be seen as the Yan Family’s gratitude towards Lin Jing.
But now, even bringing in his own trusted friend, it went beyond simple gratitude.
The Yan Family ancestor seemed to sense Lin Jing’s concern and spoke up:
“I do this because there is actually something I need your help with.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing finally breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, one should not accept rewards without merit, and Lin Jing had only refined two batches of Elixir Furnace Medicine, yet the Yan Family ancestor treated him to such an extent.
It was clear that the Yan Family ancestor was being too good to him, a kindness that felt somewhat unreal to Lin Jing.
After all, he seemed to only possess Nascent Soul cultivation, while the other party was a whole major realm higher than him.
Now that he was asked for help, everything seemed reasonable.
Lin Jing hurriedly responded:
“Senior Yan, please speak.”
The Yan Family ancestor then said:
“The Yan Family has cultivated Spiritual Plants for many years, and every so often, we accumulate a good number of High-Grade Spiritual Plants.”
“Among these plants, some special Spirit Plants cannot be stored for long.
They must be refined into Elixir Medicine soon after harvesting, otherwise, much of their medicinal potency will be lost, even if refined into Elixir Medicine, the quality will be diminished greatly.”
“Just those plants I mentioned, they could be refined into more than twenty batches of Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicine.”
“In the past when our Sect had a backlog of such imperishable Spiritual Plants, we found other Alchemists to refine them into Elixir Medicine.”
“But since last time, Ming’er said your Alchemy is extraordinary, if refined by you, there should be the possibility of producing Superior or even Supreme Grade Elixir Medicine.”
“That way, we wouldn’t waste those Spirit Plants.”
“So, I was thinking of asking for your help to refine these Elixir Medicine.”
“What do you think about this?”
Having finished, the Yan Family ancestor added another sentence:
“Of course, if you are unwilling, we will not force you, and we will find someone else.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was momentarily stunned.
Alchemy might be troublesome for others,
but for him, it was a good opportunity.
Not to mention, Lin Jing was currently worrying about where to find High-Grade Spiritual Plants.
Ɲονǥօ.сօ
Now that he had become a Sixth Grade Pill Master, he could only increase his Alchemy Proficiency by refining Fifth-Rank or higher Elixir Medicine.
Without High-Grade Spiritual Plants, his Alchemy Proficiency would come to a complete halt, and to ascend to be a Seventh Grade Alchemist, who knew how long that would take.
Now with the Spirit Plants from the Yan Family, Lin Jing could continue to increase his Alchemy Proficiency.
Furthermore, if he refined Elixir Medicine within the System Space, with the bonus of the Alchemy Room, there was a very possible chance of producing Pure Elixir.
Fifth-Rank Pure Elixirs were exceedingly rare.
Just one could sell for an astronomical price.
If Lin Jing truly refined Pure Elixir Medicine, he would definitely keep them for himself.
Unfortunately, whether it was the System Space or his status as a Lin Family successor, Lin Jing could not expose either.
In order not to arouse suspicion, even if he produced Pure Elixir Medicine while helping the Yan Family, he could not reveal them.
As for the other Elixir Medicine, he could leave them all to the Yan Family.
His own involvement in refining could also lead to a not-so-small chance of producing Supreme Grade Elixir Medicine.
With those Supreme Grade Elixir Medicine, he would certainly delight the Yan Family.
“It’s just Alchemy, a small matter.”
“Elder, please rest assured, leave the matter of Alchemy to me,” Lin Jing spoke.
The Yan Family’s ancestor nodded and then looked toward the few Divine Transformation Cultivators ahead and said:
“Since you’re helping us refine elixir medicines, our Yan Family will certainly not treat you poorly.
Take a look at the items those old fellows will bring out later.”
“If there’s anything you fancy, just speak up, and I’ll help you obtain it.”
“Elder…”
Lin Jing had just begun to speak when he was interrupted by Yan Ming.
“Brother Lin.”
“Listen to me, don’t refuse the Elder’s kindness.
If you don’t accept, we’ll feel awkward asking you for Alchemy again.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was initially startled, then he realized and bowed to the Yan Family’s ancestor, saying:
“Alright!”
“In that case, I thank Elder Yan for his generosity.”
Upon hearing this, the Yan Family’s elder stroked his beard and smiled, saying:
“You’re too polite…”
…
While they were talking, the exchange meeting had already started.
The first to speak was none other than that Divine Toad Cultivator.
One could see the Divine Toad Cultivator stand up and extend his hand towards everyone present.
In his hands, two spherical objects floated in mid-air; they were purple, and within them seemed to flow something akin to clouds or mist.
The Divine Toad Cultivator then said:
“In my hands are two Explosive Poison Beads, personally forged by me as one-time forbidden treasures.”
“These Explosive Poison Beads are extremely simple to use, requiring no Refinement.
Just activate and throw them, and that’s it.”
“Moreover, their power is astonishing.
Once a poison bead explodes, its poisonous mist can spread for hundreds of miles in a short period.”
“And this poisonous mist, even Divine Transformation Cultivators wouldn’t dare to come into contact with it lightly; at the least it would cause their Cultivation to fall, or at worst, turn them directly into ash.”
Upon saying this, the Divine Toad Cultivator giggled and looked towards the other Divine Transformation Cultivators:
“Hehe…”
“So, do any of you fancy these Explosive Poison Beads?
I’m not asking much, just looking to trade for a Supreme Grade defensive Dao Artifact.”
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their heads away.
Despite the impressive description by the Divine Toad Cultivator, the beads weren’t as useful in practice.
The main issue was that the Explosive Poison Beads were indiscriminate in their attack.
Once thrown, even the user couldn’t go near them.
Moreover, the spread of the poison mist was slow, and Divine Transformation Cultivators could easily dodge it.
No one would foolishly stand in the area of the mist unless they faced some special situation that rendered them immobile.
Though the Explosive Poison Beads had many shortcomings, they could be quite effective for wiping out a Sect.
Particularly in the case of a Sect or Clan’s baseâ€”if one were to be thrown into it, the result would certainly be a horrific disaster.
The Divine Toad Cultivator’s practiced spells were related to poison, and his Divine Toad Island was known for breeding many poisonous creatures.
He himself had a particular fondness for researching such things.
So, nobody was interested in the items presented by the Divine Toad Cultivator.
Even the Yan Family’s ancestor spoke at this point:
“Old Frog, you’re being a bit greedy.”
“Who among us has a Supreme Grade defensive Dao Artifact?”
The Divine Toad Cultivator wasn’t offended and chuckled in response:
“Hehe…”
“Even if there’s no Supreme Grade defensive Dao Artifact, a Superior defensive Dao Artifact would do.
If not, I can add one more bead, making it three Explosive Poison Beads.”
The Yan Family’s ancestor shook his head helplessly:
“Enough…”
“With your Explosive Poison Beads, it’s unlikely anyone will want them.
Better to trade them for something else, or simply let the next person have a turn.”
Realizing the situation, the Divine Toad Cultivator no longer insisted and lowered his demands.
With one of the beads, he traded for some rare poisonous herbs needed for his poison art research.
Then he sat down contentedly.
After the Divine Toad Cultivator sat down, the real trading at the exchange meeting began.
One Cultivator after another displayed their items for trade, as well as what treasures they desired in exchange.
Lin Jing, however, remained still.
He didn’t currently have anything to barter with, and he didn’t have anything specific he wanted either.
It was then that the Yan Family’s ancestor had asked Lin Jing if there was anything he wanted, to which Lin Jing just shook his head.
Time passed in this way until finally, it was the turn of that Cultivator seemingly acquainted with Lord Ye Lin.
The Cultivator rose to his feet, faced Lin Jing’s direction, and then spoke to the Yan Family’s elder:
“Elder Yan!”
“I have heard that the Elder possesses a piece of Jade Soul Algae.
May I inquire if the Elder is willing to trade it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 653
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 653: Chapter 279: The Five Elements Wood Command Appears at the Trade Fair Chapter 653: Chapter 279: The Five Elements Wood Command Appears at the Trade Fair Hearing this, Lin Jing immediately turned his head, incredulously looking at the Yan Family ancestor, never expecting that the Yan Family ancestor would actually possess Jade Soul Algae.
However, the Yan Family ancestor looked towards the unfamiliar Nascent Soul Cultivator and spoke directly:
“Indeed, I have a piece of Jade Soul Algae, but I do not intend to trade it.”
The unfamiliar cultivator, upon hearing this, did not give up, but instead spoke again with respect:
“The Jade Soul Algae can enhance the Soul Spirit and is one of the rare spiritual objects that can reinforce Divine Sense.
It is extremely precious to Divine Transformation Cultivators.
I understand why Senior Yan is unwilling to trade.”
But, halfway through his words, the tone of the unfamiliar cultivator changed, and he continued:
“However…”
“I have a treasure here that is also very useful to Divine Transformation Cultivators.
Its effect is not less than that of the Jade Soul Algae.
Maybe Senior Yan would like it very much.”
“What is it?”
The Yan Family ancestor asked, his brows furrowing as he looked at the man.
Jade Soul Algae could enhance the Soul Spirit, and there weren’t many things that could replace it.
...
Even if there were other spiritual objects that could enhance the Soul Spirit, they would be even rarer than Jade Soul Algae, and one might not find them even in a lifetime.
The Jade Soul Algae was better in comparison; although it was also rare, as long as one sought it out and was willing to put in some effort, they could eventually find a few pieces.
Therefore, the Yan Family ancestor did not wish to trade it away.
The unfamiliar cultivator did not respond but directly took out an extremely delicate jade box from his Space Ring.
This jade box was entirely blood-red, and it was impossible to see what was inside.
There were also seals on it, preventing Divine Sense from probing inside.
After taking out the jade box, the unfamiliar cultivator formed hand seals and then stamped several imprints onto the jade box.
The jade box immediately underwent some changes, and an indescribable aura emerged from within.
Afterward.
The unfamiliar cultivator addressed the Yan Family ancestor:
“Senior Yan!”
“Inside this jade box is an object that I wish to trade for the Jade Soul Algae.”
“I can show the contents to Senior Yan, but I hope Senior Yan will keep it confidential and not reveal what it is.”
“If Senior Yan, after seeing it, chooses not to trade, then I will not insist.”
The contents of this jade box were so mysterious.
Not to mention others, even Lin Jing was extremely curious and wanted to know what exactly was inside.
And the other cultivators were clearly just as curious as Lin Jing.
Their eyes were all drawn to the jade box.
The Yan Family ancestor, looking at the unfamiliar cultivator with an intense gaze, said:
“I do not think we have met before, and yet you seem to trust me a great deal.”
“Aren’t you afraid that I’d simply take your possession?”
The unfamiliar cultivator then spoke with respect:
“I have heard some of the elder’s stories about Senior Yan, and I hold great admiration for Senior Yan’s character.”
After hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor focused his gaze, scrutinizing the unfamiliar cultivator closely.
After examining him, the Yan Family ancestor spoke directly:
“Fine!”
“Since you’ve put it that way, naturally I would not bully a junior.
If the item in your jade box really satisfies me, then I will trade with you.”
“Senior Yan, pleaseâ€¦” the unfamiliar cultivator gracefully bowed, then with a sweep of his hand, the jade box floated towards the Yan Family ancestor.
The Yan Family ancestor reached out his hand, and the jade box landed precisely in his grasp.
After receiving the jade box, the Yan Family ancestor waved his hand, and he was immediately shielded by a light screen, preventing those outside from seeing anything within.
Without a doubt, the protection set by the Yan Family ancestor also blocked out any probing Divine Sense.
After a quarter of an hour, the light screen faded away.
The Yan Family ancestor was revealed inside, along with the jade box that appeared unchanged.
After looking at the object inside the jade box, he closed it again, restoring it to its original state.
It could be said that now, apart from the unfamiliar cultivator and the Yan Family ancestor, no one present knew what was actually inside the jade box.
At this time.
Everyone’s eyes were on the Yan Family ancestor.
And the unfamiliar cultivator, likewise filled with anticipation, looked towards the Yan Family ancestor.
But the Yan Family ancestor, holding the jade box and frowning, appeared deep in thought.
It was quite some time before he finally lifted his head again and then, with a wave of his hand, sent the jade box flying back to the unfamiliar cultivator.
“Your item inside the jade box is indeed good.”
“Unfortunately, it is not what I am looking for.”
After receiving the Yan Family ancestor’s response, the unfamiliar cultivator did not persist.
He took back the jade box and respectfully bowed to the Yan Family ancestor:
“Thank you for your time, Senior Yan!”
After speaking, he returned to his seat.
And the Yan Family ancestor also did not say more and sat back down as well.
This trade was not concluded.
But the trading meeting was to continue.
Following that.
Another cultivator presented the treasure they wished to trade.
“Ladies and gentlemenâ€¦”
“This is a treasure I obtained from a ruin in the deep seaâ€¦”
People’s attention was immediately drawn to this new trade.
No longer did they pay attention to the unfamiliar cultivator.
Only a few people would occasionally turn their heads to glance at him again.
They were clearly intrigued by the mysterious treasure within the jade box on his person.
However, this was a trading meeting of the highest order, where even the cultivators who could attend were of renowned reputation.
Naturally, no one would make any inappropriate moves because of the mysterious treasure.
Even if someone did have any ideas, at the very least they would wait until they had left Bihai City.
But, the other party was no fool.
Since they dared to offer that item, they must have made thorough preparations beforehand, and as a Nascent Soul Cultivator, they would surely not fear them.
……
The trading meeting was still going on in full swing and quickly approached its climax.
Lin Jing had not participated in it from beginning to end.
Ɲονǥ0.с0
He had not chosen anyone’s treasures either.
Lin Jing hadn’t chosen any other treasures, not because he was in a rush, but Yan Ming beside him was getting somewhat anxious on Lin Jing’s behalf.
“Brother Lin, I thought the Magical Treasure offered by Dongji Divine Lord just now was quite good.
You didn’t show any interest?”
Lin Jing shook his head, “Let’s wait a bit more.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, Yan Ming could only helplessly shake his head as well.
Actually, the one thing Lin Jing was truly interested in was the Jade Soul Algae in the hands of the Yan Family’s ancestor.
However, from what had happened just now, it seemed that the Jade Soul Algae was extremely precious to the Yan Family’s ancestor, and Lin Jing naturally couldn’t just take someone’s beloved possession.
Therefore, Lin Jing didn’t have the heart to speak up.
Lin Jing’s intention was to wait until the trading meeting was over and then inquire with the Yan Family’s ancestor about the origin of the Jade Soul Algae.
Once he knew where it came from, he could search for it himself.
Because of the harsh conditions required for the growth of Jade Soul Algae, it only appeared in specific locations.
As long as he found that particular place, it would simply be a matter of expending some effort to eventually find it.
Just as Lin Jing and Yan Ming finished their conversation, the previously unknown cultivator stood up again.
“Everyone!”
“I have an item here, it is extremely precious, and I’d like to offer it for exchange.”
As the unfamiliar cultivator spoke again, it made everyone turn their attention towards him once more.
However, no sooner had his words fallen than Divine Toad Elder’s face showed displeasure as he bluntly spoke:
“If it’s something like before, something indecent, then do not bring it out again.”
The unfamiliar cultivator gave a polite bow to Divine Toad Elder and then said:
“Elder Divine Toad, please rest assured, I will not conceal this item any longer.”
“It is just that this item is a little different, and too precious.
I cannot determine its authenticity, so I brought it here for the elders present, as well as my fellow cultivators, to help identify its authenticity.”
“If this item is genuine, then I will offer it for trade with everyone.”
The Divine Toad Elder, showing impatience, directly said:
“What is it?”
“You’re making such a fuss about it, just bring it out already.”
“Really…”
“You want to trade something whose authenticity you don’t even know.”
The unfamiliar cultivator did not argue or get angry; instead, he showed considerable respect towards Divine Toad Elder:
“Alright, Elder Divine Toad.”
As he spoke, the unfamiliar cultivator didn’t waste any time and took out a green-colored token from his Space Ring.
On the token were the inscribed characters ‘Five Elements’.
“This…
this token…”
When the token was revealed, it immediately caused a stir, as it was evident that many recognized the token.
Even the Island Master of True Dragon Island, who had been quiet this whole time, suddenly stood up, looking at the token and involuntarily exclaimed:
“Five Elements Wood Command!!!”
The moment these words came out, it led the few cultivators who had not yet recognized the token to exclaim as well:
“This is actually the Five Elements Wood Command!!!”
The Five Elements Ruins might be secret, but the assembled cultivators were among the very top-tier of the Southern Outer Sea.
They had all heard about the Five Elements Ruins, although most did not know the specific location of the ruins.
However, they had all heard some legends or accounts passed down about the Five Elements Ruins, which naturally included the Five Elements Command Tokens.
Lin Jing, upon seeing the Five Elements Wood Command in the hands of the unfamiliar cultivator, knew it was fake without needing to discern further.
The authentic Five Elements Wood Command was securely placed inside his Space Ring, which meant that the token in the stranger’s hands was undoubtedly a counterfeit.
Although Lin Jing knew this token was a fake, he couldn’t show it and instead had to act as shocked as the people around him.
Lin Jing carefully observed the Five Elements Wood Command in the hands of the unfamiliar cultivator and also silently compared them in his mind.
This Five Elements Wood Command was exquisitely crafted and had a rich wood element aura emanating from it.
If Lin Jing hadn’t known the true Five Elements Wood Command was in his possession, he might have actually been fooled.
Obviously,
The maker of this Five Elements Wood Command must have seen the real Five Elements Command Token, or even possessed it at one point; otherwise, they could not have made it so realistic.
This inevitably led Lin Jing to wonder.
The unfamiliar cultivator, where did he obtain this token from?
Although Lin Jing reacted immediately.
The Island Master of True Dragon Island was unaware of the token’s authenticity.
Upon seeing the token, the eyes of True Dragon Island’s Island Master shimmered with keen light, and he hurriedly said to the unfamiliar cultivator:
“Hand over that token in your possession so I can have a look.”

chapters.title: Chapter 654
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 654: 280 Chapter 654: 280 The unfamiliar cultivator nodded and then stepped forward, coming directly in front of the Island Master of True Dragon Island.
“Senior, please look…”
The unfamiliar cultivator spoke, handing over the Five Elements Wood Command he held in his hand.
The Island Master of True Dragon Island took the token and immediately began to examine it.
ɴονǤօ.с0
After a while, the Island Master of True Dragon Island seemed to find nothing unusual and then asked the unfamiliar cultivator,
“Where did you obtain this token from?”
The unfamiliar cultivator spoke respectfully,
“To reply to senior!”
“This token was found by me on the deep seabed not far from the Thousand Islands Domain.
It was so bizarre how I obtained it that I dared not confirm whether this Five Elements Wood Command is genuine or not.”
While the two were speaking,
Divine Toad and the other three Divine Transformation Cultivators gathered around, and even the Yan Family’s ancestor hurried over.
Clearly, the Yan Family’s ancestor was also very interested in this Five Elements Command Token.
...
The Island Master of True Dragon Island nodded, then he observed the token in his hand again.
This time, the five of them gathered around, and soon they were closely encircling the token, making it impossible for other cultivators to see.
The group gathered, observing and discussing from time to time.
“Dragon fellow Daoist, what do you think?”
“Is this Five Elements Wood Command real or not?”
The one asking this was Divine Toad, and his query was directed to the Island Master of True Dragon Island.
