However, the Divine Toad Master didn’t give it the chance.
The dragon bone, once released, flew towards the Flood Dragon’s head with incredible speed.
The Flood Dragon tried to dodge by shaking its huge head, but it was to no avail.
Under the Divine Toad Master’s control, the dragon bone suddenly accelerated and shot into the Flood Dragon’s mouth.
As the dragon bone rushed into the Flood Dragon’s mouth, it let out a roar of agony.
It seemed to be in immense pain.
After that, the Flood Dragon, which was thousands of meters long, plunged directly from the sky into the sea below with a “splash.”
Seeing this, the Divine Toad Master said to Lin Jing,
“Just wait a moment…”
“I’ll take care of that Flood Dragon, then I’ll join you to see how your disciple is doing with his tribulation.”
Without waiting for Lin Jing’s response,
the Divine Toad Master leaped down and plunged into the sea as well.
It looked like,
today, the Divine Toad Master was determined to capture the Flood Dragon at all costs…

chapters.title: Chapter 663
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 663: Chapter 286: Divine Toad Elder Presents a Gift Chapter 663: Chapter 286: Divine Toad Elder Presents a Gift Lin Jing didn’t have to wait too long before the Divine Toad emerged.
When the Divine Toad first came out of the sea, there were still traces of blood on his body.
It was clear that he had dealt with the Flood Dragon just a moment ago.
After he emerged, he simply swept his hand over his body, and the bloodstains vanished without a trace.
Then, the Divine Toad approached Lin Jing and said,
“Let’s go.”
“I’ll go see how your disciple is doing.”
Lin Jing nodded and then gestured with his hand,
“Senior, please…”
Afterward.
The Divine Toad and Lin Jing flew towards the island where Ye Yun was undergoing his Tribulation.
Before long, the two returned to the island.
...
Lin Jing had sensed a presence and left directly before.
Although Yan Ming and Zhang Jian were somewhat puzzled, they did not ask further questions.
When Lin Jing returned, both of them quickly detected Lin Jing’s approach.
And.
Another cultivator accompanied Lin Jing.
Both were curious and turned their heads to look at Lin Jing and the other cultivator.
When they saw that it was the Divine Toad with Lin Jing,
Yan Ming was startled and then hurriedly made his way around the perimeter of the Heavenly Tribulation to the Divine Toad.
Not just Yan Ming, Zhang Jian followed along as well.
“Senior!”
Yan Ming bowed with his hands clasped and addressed the Divine Toad.
“I’ve seen the senior!” Zhang Jian also clasped his hands in greeting.
The Divine Toad looked at Zhang Jian and nodded.
Then, seeing Yan Ming, he also revealed a smile.
Only, due to his features shaped by his Cultivation Method, that smile was rather unsightly.
It was the kind of smile that could stop a baby’s crying at the sight.
“Ming lad, you’re here too,” said the Divine Toad with a chuckle.
Yan Ming nodded and said respectfully,
“I initially invited Brother Lin to Spirit Rock Island for Alchemy, but as it happened, Brother Lin’s disciple was undergoing Tribulation here, so I offered to act as a protector.”
“Where is your family’s ancestor now?
Is he on Spirit Rock Island?”
“I was planning to go to Spirit Rock Island to find him after dealing with this matter,” said the Divine Toad.
Yan Ming replied,
“The family’s ancestor is currently on Spirit Rock Island.”
“Good…
good…”
“Once this matter here is resolved, I’ll head straight to Spirit Rock Island.”
Having said this, the Divine Toad turned his gaze toward Ye Yun in the center of the island.
Lin Jing also looked towards Ye Yun at this moment, and the area around Ye Yun was now completely bare.
Even the Formation set up by Zhang Jian had collapsed, and traces of its existence were still visible nearby.
The ground where Ye Yun had been before had turned into a deep pit.
At this moment, Ye Yun was sitting at the edge of the pit with wounds crisscrossing his body, deep enough to reveal bone.
Clearly, he was severely injured.
Near him, a magical treasure resembling a broken plank lay at his side.
This relic of a magical treasure was what Ye Yun had prepared for the Tribulation.
It hadn’t always looked like this; it had taken on this form only after enduring the wash of the Tribulation Lightning.
However.
Although Ye Yun’s injuries were severe, a layer of golden light still covered him, indeed showing signs of transition towards something more potent.
At this time, Ye Yun’s wounds were healing at an astonishly fast pace, clearly the effect of taking Elixir Medicine.
Above Ye Yun’s head, the Tribulation Clouds grew even more ominous, with constant rumbling inside, and occasional flashes of red lightning on its surface.
The Red Tribulation Lightning, although not as formidable as the Black Tribulation Lightning Lin Jing had faced, was still terrifyingly powerful.
Lin Jing hastily asked Yan Ming,
“Which round of Tribulation Lightning is it now?”
Yan Ming spoke,
“The eighth has passed; now only the final round of Tribulation Lightning remains.”
The final round of Tribulation Lightning was the most formidable.
Looking at Ye Yun’s current state and sensing the aura around him,
Ye Yun should face no issues with this last round of Tribulation Lightning.
But this was the Heavenly Tribulation, and Lin Jing could not guarantee that Ye Yun would be unharmed.
At this moment, Lin Jing still felt a bit anxious.
Just then, the Divine Toad spoke up,
“Is your disciple practicing Body Refining Techniques?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes, Senior.”
“Body Refinement Cultivators, it’s been a long time since I’ve seen one.” The Divine Toad mumbled to himself as he watched Ye Yun.
While everyone was talking, the clouds in the sky started to churn violently, with the roar within the clouds intensifying.
Clearly, the last round of Tribulation Lightning was about to descend once more.
And Ye Yun too stood up at that moment, with determination in his eyes, looking towards the threatening clouds above.
“Boom!”
It seemed as though the Tribulation Clouds sensed Ye Yun’s indomitable will, intent on erasing it as the lightning roared down from within.
Ye Yun deployed the magical treasure and charged boldly towards the descending lightning.
The first to come into contact with the lightning was the plank-like magical treasure, which resisted for only a moment before shattering under the final blast of the Tribulation.
Without the protection of the magical treasure, Ye Yun faced the lightning head-on, and in an instant, he was engulfed.
This round of Tribulation Lightning, far thicker than the first, surrounded by purple arcs of lightning, made the entire display appear quite beautiful.
But the more beautiful it was, the more dangerous it became.
The dreadful pressure that the Tribulation Lightning carried made one’s blood run cold, giving a sensation of defying the heavens and earth itself, leaving one feeling utterly powerless.
…
Within the Tribulation Lightning, Ye Yun struggled to endure.
“The first moment…”
“The second moment…”
“The third moment…”
…
…
Apart from the single moment of resistance by the magical treasure, the subsequent moments, although seemingly swift, were also agonizingly long.
This lengthiness was in the perception of Ye Yun.
And it was the same for Lin Jing.
Lin Jing stood outside the range of the Heavenly Tribulation, watching Ye Yun within the lightning, as new wounds appeared on his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 664
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 664: Chapter 286: Divine Toad Gives a Gift_2 Chapter 664: Chapter 286: Divine Toad Gives a Gift_2 In the relentless bombardment of Tribulation Lightning, those wounds had no chance to heal and were torn even wider by the strikes.
Eventually, even chunks of Ye Yun’s flesh were being ripped apart…
Under such continuous onslaught of Tribulation Lightning, even the most potent healing Elixir Medicines became a joke.
Finally.
Nine breaths of time passed, and the Tribulation Lightning dissipated.
Ye Yun, however, stood motionless, appearing as if dead.
Only the occasional heartbeat let everyone understand that he had succeeded, passing the Nascent Soul Heavenly Tribulation.
...
The Heavenly Tribulation had passed, but now Ye Yun’s body was completely wrecked, barely able to stand.
Although the last bolt of lightning had struck, the tribulation clouds hadn’t yet cleared, and Lin Jing and the others naturally didn’t dare to enter the range of the clouds at this time.
Ye Yun first moved his fingers.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄօ
Then he sat down right there, cross-legged, and began to meditate for recovery.
After Ye Yun began his meditation recovery, the thunder in the tribulation clouds gradually ceased, and the horrifying pressure from heaven and earth also began to recede.
Not until the thunder stopped and the pressure from heaven and earth completely dissipated did the tribulation clouds slowly scatter.
In less than half an incense stick of time, the tribulation clouds above Ye Yun’s head had completely dispersed, revealing the clear and bright sky.
By then, the Heavenly Tribulation had just passed.
In the nearby sea area, the Demonic Beasts and seabirds, which had been frightened away by the celestial might, still didn’t dare to approach.
Today, there were neither wind nor waves, and the sea welcomed a rare moment of complete tranquility.
It was at this time that Lin Jing and the others came to the island.
Having just crossed the tribulation, the presence of the Nascent Soul Stage already emanated from Ye Yun.
However, his aura was still unstable, and he needed to continue meditating to stabilize it.
Seeing Ye Yun safe and sound, Yan Ming smiled and spoke, congratulating him:
“Brother Lin, congratulations.”
“Ye Yun has successfully crossed the tribulation and advanced to the Nascent Soul.
This adds another Nascent Soul Cultivator to Li Yan Island, truly a joyous occasion.”
“Thank you as well, Brother Yan, for your protection.” Lin Jing said, clasping his hands.
After speaking, Lin Jing continued:
“Now that Ye Yun has successfully crossed the tribulation, as soon as Ye Yun stabilizes his cultivation, I will head to Spirit Rock Island with Brother Yan.”
“You’re not heading back to Li Yan Island next?” Yan Ming asked.
Lin Jing nodded, “Not for now, I’ll head back after helping you with the Alchemy.”
The Divine Toad Sage then spoke up:
“In that case, we might as well go together.”
Yan Ming looked at the Divine Toad Sage, asking with some confusion:
“Elder Divine Toad, your Divine Toad Island is quite far away, how come you’re here?”
Everyone had been captivated by Ye Yun’s tribulation a moment ago, and Yan Ming hadn’t had the chance to ask.
“There was an Evil Jiao appearing near the Divine Toad Island, causing trouble in my absence, and I’m here to capture it.”
“I see…” Yan Ming realized.
…
It didn’t take long, just half a day, for Ye Yun to stabilize his own cultivation and finish meditating.
At this moment, the terrifying aura of the Nascent Soul Stage radiated from Ye Yun, covering the entire island.
After standing up, Ye Yun felt his own cultivation and immediately showed a face full of joy.
Then.
Ye Yun concealed his aura, and then approached Lin Jing.
“Master, I have successfully advanced.”
Lin Jing, seeing the excitement on Ye Yun’s face, couldn’t help but smile knowingly.
“Zhang Jian and you should head back first after this, I’m going to Spirit Rock Island.”
“Once you’re back, remember to immediately enter closed-door cultivation until you completely stabilize and familiarize yourself with your cultivation.
Then you can come out.” Lin Jing spoke earnestly.
Ye Yun nodded, saying:
“Yes, Master.”
Then, Lin Jing informed Zhang Jian, and was about to leave with the Divine Toad Sage and Yan Ming.
But just then, the Divine Toad Sage stopped the two.
“Wait a moment.”
Lin Jing and Yan Ming immediately halted and then looked questioningly towards the Divine Toad Sage.
The Divine Toad Sage then took a Jade Vial from his person and tossed it directly to Ye Yun.
The Jade Vial traced an arc through the air, falling straight into Ye Yun’s hands, who instinctively caught it.
Ye Yun, holding the Jade Vial, looked puzzledly at the Divine Toad Sage.
“Elder…”
Before Ye Yun could say more, the Divine Toad Sage interrupted him.
“This is Demonic Beast essence blood I have collected earlier.
This essence blood is very useful for Body Refinement Cultivators who have just entered the Nascent Soul Stage, especially those like you who have crossed the Heavenly Tribulation.”
“After taking it, it significantly enhances one’s physical strength.”
“I find favor in you, so I’ll just give you this Demonic Beast’s essence blood.”
Divine Toad spoke in a calm tone, yet his decisiveness left no room for refusal.
Although Divine Toad said this, Ye Yun hesitated.
After all, it was his first time meeting Divine Toad, and he hadn’t expected to receive such a grand gift right away.
This left Ye Yun somewhat unsure of how to respond.
Lin Jing, seeing this, wanted to say something.
However, Yan Ming beat him to it.
Yan Ming spoke right away:
“Divine Toad has always been a man of his word, and it’s rare for him to take such a liking to someone.
Since Divine Toad is giving it to you, just accept it.”
As he spoke, Yan Ming also secretly gave Lin Jing a meaningful look.
Lin Jing instantly understood and then said to Ye Yun:
“Ye Yun, aren’t you going to thank Divine Toad?”
Ye Yun looked at Lin Jing and then nodded.
“Thank you, Divine Toad.”
Divine Toad nodded slightly and then turned to address Lin Jing and Yan Ming:
“Let’s go then.”
“Alright!”
“Alright!”
The two agreed, and then the three of them left the place together.
…
Traveling from Tribulation Island to Spirit Rock Island was no short journey.
Even though the trio traveled by Flying Boat, it still took nearly a day.
When the three arrived at Spirit Rock Island, the Yan Family’s patriarch had already sensed their approach and was waiting for them before they even landed on the island.
As the Flying Boat descended, Divine Toad stepped out, and the Yan Family’s patriarch was surprised but then greeted him with a smile:
“Old Toad, I knew you would come.”
“I just didn’t expect you to come along with young friend Lin.”
“What?”
“Did you visit his Li Yan Island?”
Divine Toad curled his lip and said:
“Do you think I’m as idle as you?”
“We just happened to meet.”
At this moment, Lin Jing and Yan Ming, too, exited the Flying Boat and stepped forward, addressing the Yan Family’s patriarch:
“Elder Yan!”
“Grandpa!”
The Yan Family’s patriarch nodded and then spoke:
“Ming, I need to discuss some things with Old Toad, and we’re not in a hurry about the Alchemy matter.
You and young friend Lin go have some tea and relax first; we can talk after we’re done.”
“Alright, Grandpa!”
Having said this, Yan Ming led Lin Jing towards the inside of the island.
After they had walked quite a distance, Yan Ming said to Lin Jing:
“Earlier, on the way here, with Divine Toad present, it wasn’t appropriate to speak openly.”
“Do you know why, when Divine Toad gave Ye Yun the item, I immediately insisted that Ye Yun accept it?”
Lin Jing shook his head, “I don’t know…”
“I hope you can enlighten me, Brother Yan.”
Yan Ming then spoke:
“Divine Toad giving that item to Ye Yun was actually also to establish a good relationship with you.”
Lin Jing looked puzzled and utterly confused.
“To establish a good relationship with me?
Why?”
Divine Toad was a Divinity Transformation Cultivator, while Lin Jing had only ever shown the Cultivation of the Nascent Soul Stage.
With such a vast gap between them, how could Divine Toad be so inclined?
Yan Ming smiled and said:
“Actually, Divine Toad is quite a decent person.
His actions are just part of his character.”
“Divine Toad doesn’t like to be indebted to anyone.
He gave Ye Yun something in advance as a gesture of goodwill to you and also, probably because he wants you to help him with Alchemy.”
“Though, for Alchemy, there really was no need to go to such lengths,” Lin Jing said.
“It must be because the Elixir Medicine is somewhat tricky to concoct.
I’ve only heard Grandpa mention it briefly before, but I’m not quite clear on the specifics.”

chapters.title: Chapter 665
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 665: Chapter 287: System New Feature: Mastery of Pill Dao Chapter 665: Chapter 287: System New Feature: Mastery of Pill Dao Alchemy was indeed a trivial matter for Lin Jing.
Even if the Divine Toad had not done so, Lin Jing would have been happy to help.
However, given that things had come to this point, it was just the nature of the Divine Toad, and if he really sought Lin Jing’s help in alchemy, Lin Jing would certainly not refuse.
…
After Lin Jing and Yan Ming returned, Yan Ming brewed some Spiritual Tea unique to Spirit Rock Island, and the two chatted while drinking.
As a full hour passed, Lin Jing, who was chatting leisurely with Yan Ming, suddenly heard a system prompt in his mind.
“Ding!”
“System prompt: The System’s Alchemy Room has completed its upgrade and new functions have been unlocked.
...
Please check promptly, Host.”
System Space had completed its upgrade.
However,
now was not the suitable time to enter the System Space, so Lin Jing just paused for a moment before continuing his chat with Yan Ming.
Just like that,
another hour passed, and only then did the Yan Family ancestor and the Divine Toad finish their conversation and came over to where Yan Ming was.
Upon their arrival, the Yan Family ancestor took the lead and approached Lin Jing with a smile, saying,
“Young friend Lin!”
“We have some matters we would like to discuss with you.
What do you think?”
Lin Jing knew that if he wasn’t mistaken, the matter the Yan Family ancestor wanted to discuss next was probably the same matter Yan Ming had mentioned earlier.
Hearing this, Lin Jing did not hesitate and directly responded,
“Please speak, senior…”
The Yan Family ancestor looked towards the Divine Toad, who stepped forward and said,
“It’s like this…”
“I would like you to help me refine a certain Elixir Medicine.”
“Don’t worry, I won’t have you refine it for nothing.
As long as you can successfully make this Elixir, just tell me what you need, and as long as it’s not too excessive, I can agree to it.”
The Divine Toad was serious when he said this.
Lin Jing quickly replied,
“The matter of refining is but a simple effort for me; I am truly flattered by your consideration, Divine Toad senior.”
“There’s really no need for such courtesy, senior.”
Hearing this, the Divine Toad immediately said,
“This Elixir Medicine is quite special and rather troublesome to refine, and the key aspect is that I must be present during the process to help consolidate the final auxiliary ingredient for the Elixir.”
“Without this last auxiliary ingredient, the Elixir will undoubtedly fail.”
After saying this, the Divine Toad added,
“I know many Alchemists prefer to work alone and dislike others being present, let alone my involvement in the process, which might inconvenience you.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing’s brow furrowed slightly, and he couldn’t help but feel curious,
“What kind of Elixir Medicine is this, to be so troubling?”
The Divine Toad responded,
“This Elixir is known as the Poison-Absorbing Pill and is not an ordinary Elixir.
It is specifically designed to complement the Poison Art I am cultivating.”
“The Poison-Absorbing Pill is different from other Elixirs.
It is formed by merging venomous insects, poisonous herbs, and various rare toxins.
Once refined and consumed, it will be of considerable assistance to my cultivation.”
At this moment, the Yan Family ancestor also chimed in to explain,
“Originally, Old Toad had arranged with an old friend from Changyun Pill Pavilion to assist in the refinement.”
“But it seems there was an incident in the Changyun Clan, and his old friend had to return in a rush and won’t be back for a while.”
“If we were to find someone else, we wouldn’t feel as assured.
Seeing as your alchemy skills are quite good, I recommended you to Old Toad, thinking we might try seeking your help.”
“Rest assured, if you help Old Toad refine this pill, he will certainly not let your efforts go unrewarded.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing looked towards the Divine Toad and then asked,
“Divine Toad senior, may I first take a look at the Elixir Recipe?”
The Divine Toad nodded without hesitation, immediately took out a scroll made of animal hide, and handed it to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing accepted the Elixir Recipe and opened it in front of everyone to examine it.
The recipe listed all kinds of rare venomous insects and poisonous herbs, as well as some special Spiritual Objects that Lin Jing had never even heard of.
And the records on the recipe were exceptionally detailed,
including the processing of various toxins and the methods of their integration, all noted down.
As such, he read until the end,
and Lin Jing finally understood why the Divine Toad had to be involved in the refinement of this Elixir Medicine.
The refinement process was designed to complement the Poison Art that the Divine Toad practiced.
And during the key moment of merging the Elixir, the Divine Toad’s assistance was required, using his Poison Art as a catalyst to ensure successful refinement.
As for the refining techniques themselves, that was secondary.
Speaking of which, this Elixir was in fact equivalent to a somewhat more special Fifth Grade Elixir, but the time it took to refine was much shorter than that of a regular Fifth Grade Elixir.
Had it been an ordinary Fifth Grade Alchemist, accidents might occur.
But with Lin Jing refining it, and with the bonus from System Space, the chances of failing the refinement were almost none.
It merely required cooperation from the Divine Toad, which meant that Lin Jing couldn’t conduct the refinement within the System Space; he would need to activate Bonus Attachment.
Lin Jing’s Space had just been upgraded.
There were no spare Harvest Points available at the moment.
After examining the Elixir Recipe, Lin Jing then spoke up directly,
“No problem, I can refine this Elixir.”
“But it will take some time; I need to familiarize myself with the refinement process of this Elixir first, and I also need to refine some other Elixir Medicines to adjust my condition.”
Two people did not doubt Lin Jing’s words.

chapters.title: Chapter 666
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 666: Chapter 287: System New Feature: Mastery of Pill Dao_2 Chapter 666: Chapter 287: System New Feature: Mastery of Pill Dao_2 The Yan Family’s patriarch then spoke with a smile,
“Of course,”
“For alchemy, naturally one must first study the elixir recipe, and get familiar with the alchemy process.”
“And as for the alchemy, we’re not having you start crafting right now.
We already have some leads on the poisons required by the recipe, but we haven’t gotten them in hand yet.”
“Only when we have gathered all the poisons needed for this elixir recipe, can we begin.”
At this time, the Divine Toad also spoke,
“Old Yan and I are preparing to leave for a while to search for the missing Spiritual Object.
Once we find it and return, you can start crafting.”
Having said that, the Divine Toad looked at Lin Jing,
“Since you have agreed to help me with alchemy, I will not go back on my word; I shall definitely reciprocate.”
The Yan Family’s patriarch spoke with a chuckle,
“Ha ha…”
“Lin lad, you’ve really got yourself involved now.”
“The old toad is always true to his word; if there is anything you desire, just ask, and don’t be polite with him.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment before speaking,
“Divine Toad senior, when I saw you employ Divine Skills previously, I was greatly shaken.If possible, I wish to have you explain to me about domain-type Divine Skills.”
“You want to cultivate domain-type Divine Arts?” The Yan Family’s patriarch looked at Lin Jing, showing a hint of surprise.
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I have such thoughts.”
“The cultivation technique I practice is not suitable for offensive-type Divine Skills.
It was not until recently, seeing Divine Toad senior use his Divine Skills, that I felt inspired to understand and try them.”
“No wonder…”
The Yan Family’s patriarch nodded,
“In that case, it is indeed possible to get an early understanding.”
“This way, once you enter the Divinity Transformation Stage, you can quickly comprehend your own Divine Arts.”
The Divine Toad also nodded,
“Given your current cultivation, you can indeed start to ponder Divine Arts in advance.”
“Since you wish to comprehend domain-type Divine Skills, I shall definitely explain them to you clearly.”
“Then, I thank Divine Toad senior,” Lin Jing said as he clasped his hands in gratitude.
The Divine Toad waved his hand and then continued,
“Just Divine Arts?
...
Don’t you need anything else, like a Magical Treasure, perhaps?”
Lin Jing looked at the Divine Toad and said,
“This is already enough; I don’t need anything else.”
The relationship between Lin Jing and the Divine Toad was actually built on the face of the Yan Family’s patriarch.
Currently, it was just about crafting a single elixir.
For such a matter, the Divine Toad had already gifted Ye Yun a vial of Demonic Beast essence blood and promised to explain to Lin Jing those domain-type Divine Skills.
This was sufficient; to be too greedy might not be appropriate.
With the matter settled, all were pleased.
The group then discussed the upcoming matters for a while.
Next, the Yan Family’s patriarch and the Divine Toad planned to leave Spirit Rock Island to find the last missing poison.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing and Yan Ming would remain on the island.
By taking advantage of this time, Lin Jing would also craft all the elixirs he had promised to make for the Yan Family.
As for explaining the domain-type Divine Skills to Lin Jing, that would happen after Lin Jing had finished crafting elixirs for the Divine Toad.
There was no rush for these things; the two wouldn’t be gone long, at most two months, and they would be back.
Even if things went smoothly, they might return in less than a month.
As for Yan Ming, he was tasked by the Yan Family’s patriarch to help Lin Jing prepare all the alchemy ingredients he would need.
Once their discussion was complete, the Yan Family’s patriarch and the Divine Toad wasted no further time and departed from Spirit Rock Island directly.
…
After the two had left Spirit Rock Island, Yan Ming then arranged accommodations for Lin Jing.
Originally, it was suggested that Lin Jing rest for a while, without rushing into alchemy.
But at Lin Jing’s request, Yan Ming still arranged an Alchemy Room for him.
Furthermore, when Yan Ming learned that Lin Jing wanted to prepare and adjust his condition first,
he immediately prepared several batches of ingredients for crafting elixir medicines.
These ingredients were all Third-Rank.
Outside, Third-Rank elixir ingredients might be quite valuable.
But on Spirit Rock Island, they could be taken out at will.
After accepting those ingredients, Yan Ming left, and Lin Jing headed straight to the Alchemy Room.
On Spirit Rock Island, the Alchemy Rooms are protected by formations, isolating the entire room.
The purpose is to prevent disturbances during the alchemy process.
Of course, it also helps to prevent the noise from alchemy from disturbing other people on the island.
And.
The formation protecting this Alchemy Room is of a pretty high rank, such that even the Divine Sense of a Nascent Soul Cultivator cannot penetrate into it.
After Lin Jing arrived at the Alchemy Room, he didn’t linger inside for long.
Instead, he directly called out the System and entered the System Space.
The first thing Lin Jing did after entering the System Space was to adjust the alert range.
He was not on his own Li Yan Island now, and though the chances of being disturbed on Spirit Rock Island were slim, Lin Jing still had to be cautious.
After all, better safe than sorry.
If someone were to suddenly interrupt, it would be troublesome.
After adjusting the alert range, Lin Jing went straight to the Alchemy Room within the System Space.
Upon entering the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing couldn’t wait and immediately opened its panel.
The Alchemy Room had been successfully upgraded and a new function had appeared, which Lin Jing had not yet reviewed.
Opening the System panel, the message was strikingly displayed:
Alchemy Room: Level 7
Increase in Divine Sense Strength: 70%
Increase in Alchemy Success Rate: (Seventh Rank 10%)(Sixth Rank 20%), (Fifth Rank 30%), (Fourth Rank 40%), (Third Rank and below…
50% full)
Improvement in Elixir Medicine Quality: (Seventh Rank 10%), (Sixth Rank 20%)…
Chance of Producing Pure Elixir: (Seventh Rank 10%), (Sixth Rank 20%)…
Required for Upgrade: (0/1000000 Harvest Points)
New Function Unlocked:
Mastery of Pill Dao: When performing Alchemy, the acquisition of proficiency is no longer limited, and alchemy proficiency gained is doubled.
…
…
It seemed to know Lin Jing’s dilemma.
This new function was actually related to Alchemy Proficiency.
The acquisition of proficiency during Alchemy was no longer limited, which meant that Lin Jing could gain proficiency by concocting Elixir Medicines of any rank.
No longer was it like before, where he could only gain proficiency by concocting Fifth-Rank Elixir Medicines and above.
Fifth-Rank Spirit Plants are so hard to find.
With Lin Jing’s current level of Cultivation, he might not be able to successfully gather a complete set of Fifth-Rank Alchemy Ingredients even in several years.
Without ingredients, naturally, there would be no Elixirs to concoct.
Without Elixirs to concoct, naturally, there would be no way to gain proficiency and continue to upgrade one’s Pill Master rank.
This new function really served to eliminate Lin Jing’s troubles perfectly.
Moreover.
Besides, there was a doubling of Alchemy Proficiency.
From now on, his Alchemy would yield double the Alchemy Proficiency.
Although the higher the Pill Master rank, the more Alchemy Proficiency was required for promotion,
the speed at which Lin Jing’s Pill Master rank advanced would not slow down much.
This indeed was a wonderful feature.
After reviewing the new System functions, Lin Jing then looked at the Harvest Points required for the upgrade, a total of one million.
The upgrades for the Alchemy Room required the same number of Harvest Points as the upgrades for the space itself, both needing this much.
One million Harvest Points, that would take Lin Jing quite a while to accumulate.
What’s more, Lin Jing also had Spirit Fields to open up and Spirit Plant growth to accelerate and such.
It was estimated that some Harvest Points would be consumed for these purposes as well.
If counted like this, the time Lin Jing would need became even greater.
After taking a look, Lin Jing then closed the panel.
After that, Lin Jing took out the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace.
Planning to concoct a batch of Elixir Medicine to test.
After taking out the Pill Furnace, Lin Jing also brought out the Alchemy Ingredients that Yan Ming had prepared for him.
Then he started to get busy…
…
…
Four hours later, a System alert sounded:
“Ding!”
“System Alert: Congratulations to the host for successfully concocting Pure Elixir Medicine, award received: 30 Harvest Points.”
“Elixir Medicine concoction successful, Alchemy Proficiency +188.”
This first batch of Elixir Medicine resulted in the creation of Pure Elixir, and Alchemy Proficiency saw a substantial increase.
Lin Jing was inevitably filled with joy.
Afterwards.
Lin Jing opened the Elixir Furnace and took out all the Elixir Medicines within.
The quality of this batch of Elixir Medicine was quite good, with one Pure Elixir, two Supreme Grade, and then Medium Grade and Low Grade Elixir Medicines.
Just these few Third-Rank Elixir Medicines alone added 188 Proficiency.
This new System function indeed performed well.
After storing the Elixir Medicines, Lin Jing then made preparations once again, intending to start concocting the second batch of Elixir Medicine.
Now, while he had the time, Lin Jing naturally wanted to concoct several more batches…

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 288: The Elixir is Refined, The Change of the Divine Toad Sage
chapters.content:
Chapter 667 - 288: The Elixir is Refined, The Change of the Divine Toad Sage
"The latest time agreed upon was two months, but perhaps due to urgency, the ancestor of the Yan Family and the Divine Toad, took only a month to hurry back ahead of schedule."
"When the two returned, all the materials previously accumulated by the Yan Family had already been turned into elixir medicine."
"Upon their return, when they saw the elixir medicine, there was an instant burst of exclamations."
"It was for no other reason than that the quality of the elixir medicines refined by Lin Jing exceeded their expectations by a lot."
"The quality of these elixir medicines was not low at all."
"Most crucially, among these elixir medicines, there was actually a Flawless Elixir."
"Upon seeing the Flawless Elixir, the ancestor of the Yan Family immediately became so excited that he could not contain himself."
"Divine Toad as well, upon seeing these elixir medicines, was equally thrilled, for Lin Jing's level of alchemy was even higher than he had imagined."
"Among the materials from the Yan Family, Lin Jing had refined five Flawless Elixirs in addition to other varying qualities of elixir medicines."
"However."
"Out of these five Flawless Elixirs, Lin Jing only left one for the Yan Family, taking the rest for himself."
"Other qualities of elixir medicine were one thing, but having too many Flawless Elixirs would be somewhat difficult to explain."
"For these twenty-some batches of elixir medicine, being able to refine one Flawless Elixir was already extremely lucky; if there were too many, it really would be inexplicable."
"After all."
"Lin Jing was able to refine these Flawless Elixirs thanks to the bonuses from System Space."
"Moreover, the talent for alchemy he had consistently shown was beyond ordinary people's, capable of refining a Flawless Elixir."
"It was quite reasonable."
"After the two returned and their excitement had eased, they did not forget about the task at hand."
"They quickly had Lin Jing adjust his condition, preparing to refine the Detoxifying Elixirs because the last type of poison they had acquired was quite special."
"Even though it was sealed, its toxicity was still continuously leaking out and could not be delayed for too long."
"Lin Jing also understood the importance of this batch of Elixir Furnace Medicine, so without a second word, he immediately sat down to meditate and adjust his condition."
"While Lin Jing was adjusting his condition, Divine Toad began to refine some of the poisons."
"And naturally, it was most appropriate for Divine Toad, who practiced the Poison Art, to refine these poisons."
"In this batch of Elixir Furnace Medicine, some poisons did not need to be refined in advance and could be integrated directly, while others required prior refinement."
"Otherwise, they could not be incorporated into the elixir."
"And naturally, it was most appropriate for Divine Toad, who practiced the Poison Art, to refine these poisons."
"Once Lin Jing had finished adjusting his condition, Divine Toad had also completed refining those poisons."
"After that, alchemy began."
"The two came to the Alchemy Room on Spirit Rock Island together, Lin Jing took out the Pill Furnace and placed it in the center of the Alchemy Room."
"Divine Toad stepped forward at this time, handed over all the prepared poisons to Lin Jing."
"As for himself, he temporarily stepped back."
"This alchemy required the assistance of Divine Toad."
"However, this assistance was not needed throughout the entire process."
"Only during the crucial moment of collecting the elixir would Divine Toad's intervention be required."
"Therefore, at this moment, Divine Toad simply stepped aside, ensuring he did not disturb Lin Jing's work."
"Accompanying Divine Toad were the ancestor of the Yan Family and Yan Ming."
"Since the alchemy was to be made public anyway, having the two of them watch made no difference."
"Besides, since Lin Jing's previous alchemy had not been public, both were very curious."
"Lin Jing was indifferent to being watched."
"However, for this alchemy session, he did not plan to use the alchemy methods of the Lin Family."
"Lest they identify something peculiar."
"Lin Jing had previously learned the Ning Family's alchemy method and was also very familiar with the alchemy technique Ji Xiyue obtained while repairing the Elixir Scripture."
"Any of these alchemy techniques could be used."
"After taking out the Pill Furnace, Lin Jing then activated the Divine Fire Triple Realm; a ball of purple flame suddenly rose up in front of him."
"Upon seeing this flame, Yan Ming seemed to think of something; gazing at the purple flame in front of Lin Jing, he became contemplative..."
"At that moment, Lin Jing had already controlled the flame to the bottom of the Pill Furnace."
"The intense heat of the flame caused the Pill Furnace to react instantly; the cloud pattern on it began to move."
"Subsequently, Lin Jing took out the various poisons and cast them into the Pill Furnace."
"These poisons had already been classified by Divine Toad beforehand, even arranged in the proper sequence; Lin Jing just needed to follow the order to add them."
"This saved Lin Jing a lot of trouble."
"It was then that Yan Ming suddenly realized."
"'Divine Fire Triple Realm!' An exclamation escaped from Yan Ming's mouth."
"Perhaps influenced by the current atmosphere, Yan Ming's voice wasn't loud and it did not affect Lin Jing."
"However, it attracted the sidelong glances from Divine Toad and the ancestor of the Yan Family."
"Seeing both looking over, Yan Ming quickly activated his cultivation technique, gathering Spiritual Power to form a protective shield, enshrouding the three of them."
"After enshrouding the three, Yan Ming then spoke up:"
"'Ancestor!'"
"'The Cultivation Technique used by Brother Lin is none other than the Divine Fire Triple Realm.'"
"The ancestor of the Yan Family looked at Yan Ming and said:"
"'I noticed that a long time ago.'"
"Yan Ming then spoke again:"
"'I remember you once mentioned...'"
"'Advancing in the Divine Fire Triple Realm is difficult, especially the third level of the Divine Fire Triple Realm, which requires an extremely rare natural spiritual object for one to advance.'"
"'Yes, that's correct,' the ancestor of the Yan Family nodded."
"Yan Ming continued:"
"'Didn't you tell me that you knew where to find such a spiritual object?'"
"Upon hearing this, the ancestor of the Yan Family sighed softly and said:"
"'Sigh!'"
"'I understand what you mean.'"
"'To advance to the third level of the Divine Fire Triple Realm, one needs Blazing Marrow Spirit, but this Blazing Marrow Spirit is incredibly hard to find.'"
"'I had heard from someone before that wherever the Blazing Marrow Spirit appears, it must be a place with a strong fire attribute.'"

chapters.title: Chapter 668
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 668: Chapter 288: The Elixir Medicine is Refined, Changes in the Divine Toad Elder_2 Chapter 668: Chapter 288: The Elixir Medicine is Refined, Changes in the Divine Toad Elder_2 “The legendary Five Elements Ruins, encompassing all five forms, must have a place with an extremely concentrated Fire Attribute, and it is likely that Blazing Marrow Spirit exists there,”
“However, this information is just hearsay, and whether it is true or false is beyond my knowledge.”
“Moreover,”
“even if it were true, it would not be easy to enter the Five Elements Ruins.”
After finishing, the Yan Family’s ancestor turned to Yan Ming and said,
“Just listen to this matter and don’t take it too seriously.”
“So that’s how it is…” Yan Ming, having learned the truth, seemed clearly disappointed.
The Divine Toad initially showed some interest and listened carefully to their conversation, but after hearing this truth, he suddenly lost all interest.
After all, even if the matter was true, they were unable to enter the Five Elements Ruins to verify it.
Besides, the matter might not even be true.
While they were chatting, Lin Jing had already thrown all the prepared poisons into the Pill Furnace and sealed it.
Amidst it, Lin Jing even glanced at the three people, noticing that they had shrouded themselves with Spiritual Power.
And appeared to be talking about something.
...
Presumably, they were afraid of disturbing him.
Lin Jing couldn’t hear them and thus didn’t pay it any more mind.
Subsequently,
during their chat, Lin Jing activated the Bonus Attachment feature.
This time, the purpose of the attachment was not to enhance his Divine Sense, but for alchemy.
Originally, to avoid suspicion, he had ceased using the Lin Family’s Alchemy Dao methods.
Had he not used the System bonuses from System Space, the Elixir Furnace Medicine would likely prove difficult to concoct.
The Elixir Recipe for this Poison Absorbing Pill had been studied by Lin Jing for quite some time, and he knew it was not easy to make.
It was after studying the Elixir Recipe that Lin Jing decided to use the Bonus Attachment.
Although Lin Jing used the Bonus Attachment, to Yan Ming and the other two, Lin Jing appeared unchanged.
At this time, Lin Jing adeptly controlled the furnace flames, while his Divine Sense entered the Pill Furnace to carefully observe the interior circumstances.
Yan Ming and the others, on the other side of the Alchemy Room, watched intently.
As such, time trickled away bit by bit.
Soon, over an hour had passed.
The Elixir Medicine within the Pill Furnace gradually solidified under Lin Jing’s concoction.
However,
these various poisons were only transformed into liquid and were continuously repelling each other, never truly solidifying into one mass.
At this point, they reached the last moment of Solidifying Pill.
Lin Jing, carefully controlling the merging Medicinal Liquid, looked towards the Divine Toad.
“Elder, it’s your turn now,”
Lin Jing said.
The Divine Toad promptly came forward.
After the Divine Toad arrived, his aura surged, and countless purple and green mists emerged from his body.
At this moment, he extended both hands, the purple and green mists dispersing, and then condensed a purple and a green droplet in each palm respectively.
Once the droplets formed, the Divine Toad spoke,
“Open the Pill Furnace.”
Lin Jing, already prepared, didn’t hesitate and immediately opened the Pill Furnace.
After the Pill Furnace was opened, the Divine Toad swiftly directed the two droplets into the Pill Furnace, approaching the cluster of various poisoned Medicinal Liquid in the middle.
As the droplets drew near, initially, the Medicinal Liquid seemed very repellent.
As the droplets approached, the Medicinal Liquid seemed to come alive, pulling away.
But since there were two droplets, coming from different directions, the Medicinal Liquid eventually had no escape and was absorbed into the droplets…
At this moment, the Divine Toad took over, controlling the merged Medicinal Liquid to spin continuously.
As the Medicinal Liquid spun, the entire mass steadily shrank.
Only when the Medicinal Liquid had reduced to the size of a normal Elixir Pill did the Divine Toad release control of the Medicinal Liquid, handing it over to Lin Jing.
At this moment, when the Medicinal Liquid returned to Lin Jing, the liquid that had been smelted from various poisons had become unified, indistinguishable from each other.
The Elixir Pill was nearly formed at this point.
Lin Jing then controlled the unified Medicinal Liquid, putting it back into the Pill Furnace.
Afterward, with a thought, he sealed the Pill Furnace again.
Then, Lin Jing intensified the flames under the furnace, causing the temperature inside the Pill Furnace to continue to rise.
He began to solidify the Medicinal Liquid inside the Pill Furnace into the final Elixir Pill.
Until about half an hour later, the Elixir Pill was finally concocted.
Lin Jing opened the Pill Furnace, and a deep purple Elixir Pill emerged and flew right out from the furnace.
When Divine Toad saw the elixir medicine, his eyes instantly lit up.
Afterward,
Just as Lin Jing realized what was happening, Divine Toad reached out and directly grabbed the elixir medicine.
“It’s done!”
“This elixir medicine is of quite good quality.”
Looking at the elixir medicine in his hand, Divine Toad was very excited.
This Poison Devouring Pill, unlike other elixir medicines, had only one pill upon pill formation.
And its quality was determined by the shade of its color.
This pill was deep purple, so naturally, the quality was not bad.
At this time, Yan Family’s ancestor approached Divine Toad and said,
“Old Toad, it seems you’re quite lucky.”
Divine Toad was clearly very pleased as well and directly addressed Lin Jing,
“It’s Lin, young friend, who is skilled at alchemy.
I thought, if it turned out to be light purple, it would have been very impressive already.”
“But it turned out to be deep purple.”
After speaking, Divine Toad continued to Lin Jing,
“Lin, young friend.”
“This Poison Devouring Pill must be consumed immediately after its refinement; otherwise, the medicinal effect will dissipate quickly.”
“I will go take this pill first.
Once I have refined it, I will then help you understand the Domain Divine Arts.”
“Refining the pill is most important; explaining the Domain Divine Arts can wait, you go ahead, Senior Divine Toad.”
Having looked over the elixir recipe, Lin Jing naturally knew the characteristics of this Poison Devouring Pill and knew that it could not be stored but had to be consumed immediately.
As for the Domain Divine Arts, it wasn’t that urgent.
Divine Toad then addressed Yan Family’s ancestor,
“Old Yan!”
“I’ll go refine the Poison Devouring Pill first.
Keep Lin, young friend, well-entertained until I return.”
After hearing this, Yan Family’s ancestor curled his lip,
“As if I needed you to say that…”
However, he did not continue with his words.
Because Divine Toad, after saying that, had already left the Alchemy Room, and his figure could no longer be seen.
Clearly, Divine Toad did not want to delay for even a moment.
…
It took Divine Toad three days to refine this elixir medicine.
Three days might not be long, but when Divine Toad reappeared before them, he was completely transformed.
Now, Divine Toad had turned into a black-haired elderly man, and the various bumps on his face had also disappeared.
His face, while still showing some signs of aging, had become much smoother, and most crucially, his previously hunched back had miraculously disappeared.
Ɲονǥօ.сο
The current Divine Toad even looked much younger than Yan Family’s ancestor.
Seeing Divine Toad completely transformed, naturally, the most surprised was Yan Family’s ancestor.
Yan Family’s ancestor had known Divine Toad for a thousand years, ever since the first time they met, he was already in his previous appearance.
With a face full of frightful bumps and his hunched back, Yan Family’s ancestor had long gotten used to it.
Now that he looked like this, it was quite unaccustomed for the Yan Family’s ancestor.
Yan Family’s ancestor walked around Divine Toad twice, suspiciously looking at the figure before him:
“Are you really Old Toad?”
“This change is too drastic.”
Divine Toad curled his lips, then responded:
“Old Yan!”
“Don’t make me say it, you really think I was born like that?”
“It was practicing the Poison Art that caused me to look that way.”
“Tsk tsk…” Yan Family’s ancestor looked at Divine Toad, clicking his tongue twice.
“You look much more pleasant to the eyes now, and your voice has also changed back.”
“Remembering back to our first encounter, you frightened Xing’er and Yue’er into crying for half a day; no amount of consoling worked.”
“Your current look should really be seen by those two girls.”
“Naturally.” Divine Toad said.
“However…”
“I should first explain the Domain Divine Arts to Lin, young friend.”

chapters.title: Chapter 669
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 669: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain Chapter 669: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain Near Spirit Rock Island, there was a small area, yet it was an island towering above the sea surface.
Rather than an island, it actually resembled more like the peak of a mountain, except this peak rose from the seabed and soared above the sea surface, standing majestically.
Moreover,
this mountain peak was completely bare, with not a single tree or plant in sight.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.сᴑ
It was on this mountain peak that there were currently two figures.
If one got closer, one would notice,
that these two figures were none other than Lin Jing and Divine Toad.
At this moment, Lin Jing and Divine Toad were sitting facing each other, and Divine Toad was patiently explaining:
“Cultivators below the Divinity Transformation Stage, when casting spells, absorb beneficial Spiritual Energy from the outside world through cultivation, transform it into their own Spiritual Power, and then unleash it through various types of spells, thereby severely damaging their enemies.”
“The essence of spell casting is one’s own Spiritual Power.”
“The stronger the spiritual power oneself has, the more powerful the spells naturally become.”
At this point, Divine Toad quickly added:
“Of course.”
“There are some exceptions.”
“There are also some extremely powerful and exceptionally intelligent cultivators who create special spells, which, due to their unique spell techniques, can maximize the power of a spell, and their power should not be underestimated.”
…...
…
“But even if these spells are strong, they still have limits.”
“Because a cultivator’s own Spiritual Power is always limited, no matter how powerful the spells he casts are, they cannot exceed the upper limit of Spiritual Power that he can contain.”
“However, Divine Arts are different…”
“The cultivation of Divine Arts begins with merging the Soul Spirit, then using the Soul Spirit to communicate with the Spiritual Energy between heaven and earth, and using the power of the Soul Spirit to control the Spiritual Energy for one’s use, thereby casting powerful spells that far exceed one’s own Spiritual Power.”
“This is the essence of Divine Arts.”
Divine Toad spoke earnestly and Lin Jing listened intently.
At this point, Divine Toad paused for a moment, then looked at Lin Jing and continued:
“Moreover…
”
“When using Divine Arts, it is greatly related to one’s own Soul Spirit.”
“Therefore,”
“when Divine Transformation Cultivators are in battle, that which is most susceptible to damage is the Soul Spirit.”
“In the Divinity Transformation Stage, even if the body is severely injured, it can quickly recover, but if the Soul Spirit is damaged, it is extremely difficult to heal.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I have also heard about this…”
Divine Toad nodded slightly, then continued:
“Precisely because of this, Divine Transformation Cultivators, unless there is some deep hatred or the dispute is over some especially rare Spirit Plant treasure, generally do not use Divine Arts.”
“And once Divine Arts are used, it is truly a battle of life and death.”
“After all, when both parties use Divine Arts against each other, it is equivalent to a direct collision between Soul Spirits, which is very likely to injure the Soul Spirit, and in severe cases, it may even lead to direct demise.”
“Apart from this…”
“There is also another reason, that is, using Divine Arts consumes a huge amount of energy, and it is generally not used unless it is a critical moment.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded lightly.
Lin Jing was aware that Divine Arts were not to be used lightly.
For instance, during his time in the Nanming Domain, the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect only used Divine Arts at the last moment to deal with him.
Then,
Divine Toad continued:
“Coming back to Divine Arts…”
“There are also quite a few types of Divine Arts, among which the most common are those very similar to attack-oriented spells.”
“These types of Divine Arts are relatively simple to cultivate, although simple, their power is also formidable, and even some Divine Arts come with additional special effects.”
“And among them, the most common is binding.”
“Binding involves using the power of the Soul Spirit in the execution of Divine Arts to condense the space around the target enemy, thus creating a compressive effect that makes it unavoidable for the enemy.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing instantly recalled that when the ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect used Divine Arts, there was also a strange power that bound him.
It seems that was the special effect mentioned by Divine Toad.
Without stopping, Divine Toad continued:
“This binding force is extremely formidable against cultivators below the Divinity Transformation Stage, but if it is used against another Divine Transformation Cultivator, it is not very useful.”
“As long as the gap between them is not very large, cultivators of the same level can easily break free from the binding, thus escaping.”
“However, escaping from the binding does not necessarily mean one can evade the Divine Arts, as the range of Divine Arts is usually very large, and if the opponent’s Divine Arts have already formed, even a small amount of binding force can be enough to prevent escape.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded, indicating that he had taken note.
Divine Toad nodded, then continued:
“The Domain Divine Art I cultivate is somewhat different from other Divine Arts.”
“Domain Divine Art requires higher demands on the Soul Spirit, and its effect is more about control, controlling the Divine Arts within one’s own domain.”
“Previously when I deployed Divine Arts, as you must have seen, I can condense poison art to form a Poison Mist Space within a certain area, where any living being entering the space, I can ensure his safety or let him be instantly corroded by the poison mist.”
After saying this, Divine Toad directly stretched out his hand, condensing a drop of purple liquid in it.
This drop of purple liquid was very similar to that used by him during the deployment of Divine Arts before.
“Try feeling this…”
As Divine Toad finished speaking, the drop of purple liquid suddenly disappeared, and when it reappeared, it was already in front of Lin Jing.

chapters.title: Chapter 670
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 670: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain_2 Chapter 670: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain_2 After that, the drop of purple liquid exploded.
In an instant, it transformed into a purple poison fog and enveloped Lin Jing.
This purple liquid, both when it suddenly appeared and when it exploded, was at least a hundred times faster than the last time he faced the Flood Dragon.
Shrouded in poison, Lin Jing immediately felt surrounded by the poison fog, and breathing became somewhat difficult.
However, although he was within the range of the poison, the toxic fog swirling around his body did not enter his system at all.
He did not show the slightest sign of being poisoned.
This must be the control that the Divine Toad mentor mentioned earlier.
...
It was then that Lin Jing heard the Divine Toad mentor say:
“When facing that Flood Dragon before, I was simply trying to force it to turn back, so I didn’t use my full strength.
Actually, I can control the speed of this Divine Skill’s eruption.”
“You must have felt it just now.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I felt it.
The speed of the poison fog’s eruption just now was indeed very fast, making it hard for one to react in time.”
After a moment, the poisonous substances around Lin Jing all dispersed, and the surroundings became clear again.The Divine Toad mentor then continued:
“The speed at which different Divine Arts are unleashed can actually vary.”
“Some Divine Arts require a buildup of momentum, which is why they incorporate binding effects.”
“Others, however, do not need this at all, and thus their release is considerably faster.”
“In fact, no matter the Divine Art, the longer one comprehends it, the more proficient one becomes at casting it.
The speed of deployment also becomes faster, and if it’s a Divine Art that one has comprehended oneself, it can be continuously improved, making it stronger and stronger.”
Lin Jing nodded, then asked the Divine Toad mentor again,
“Senior, do domain-type Divine Skills require some form of medium?
Like the drop of purple liquid you used.”
The Divine Toad mentor shook his head and said,
“I need a medium because my Cultivation Technique is special; I practice the Poison Art, which aids me in using Divine Arts.”
“However, if one cultivates other Cultivation Techniques associated with the Five Elements properties, one can directly condense the Divine Skill and then invoke the Five Elements Spiritual Force from the outside world, using it directly to cast Divine Arts without needing a medium.”
“Moreover…”
“What I just demonstrated is just one of the ways to use the domain-type Divine Skills.”
“In fact, there is another way to use domain-type Divine Skills, which is to use oneself as a medium, expanding the domain outward from oneself.”
“However, fights among Cultivators nowadays usually involve Magical Treasures and various Spells.
Thus, if one centers themselves, the scope of their domain is limited, making it difficult to harm the enemy.”
“Furthermore, because domain-type Divine Skills are related to the strength of the Soul Spirit as well as the domain’s range, if the domain is expanded too large, then the power of the domain’s Divine Skill naturally decreases significantly.”
“In that case, it would not only fail to threaten the enemy but also put oneself in great danger.”
At this point, the Divine Toad mentor paused, then spoke again:
“Unless, you yourself are a Body Refinement Cultivator…”
After saying this, the Divine Toad mentor suddenly looked at Lin Jing and said,
“Right…”
“I seem to remember Old Yan saying you’ve practiced some Body Refining Techniques, haven’t you?”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes, senior.”
“I have practiced some.”
Lin Jing had never concealed the fact that he practiced Body Refining Techniques.
Yan Ming knew, so naturally, the Yan Family patriarch did too.
“Body Refining Techniques…” the Divine Toad mentor stroked his chin, lost in thought for a while.
After pondering for a moment, the Divine Toad mentor continued,
“If you can raise your Body Refinement Cultivation to the Divine Transformation Realm and step into the Martial Dao, and if you can further comprehend a domain-type Divine Skill,”
“then, I fear that within the Divine Transformation Realm, there will be very few who dare to make enemies with you.”
“Cultivators who have entered the Martial Dao are already very formidable.
If one adds a domain-type Divine Skill to that, it’s unimaginable how terrifying that would be.”
Having said that, the Divine Toad mentor sighed and then said,
“Alas…”
“It’s just a pity that for a Body Refinement Cultivator to enter the Martial Dao, it is much more difficult than for a Cultivator to enter the Divine Transformation Realm.”
“As for you, you could actually abandon the Body Refining Techniques by now.”
“After all, it’s extremely difficult to break through to the Divine Transformation Realm, and if you also divide your attention to practice Body Refining Techniques, it will become even more difficult.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing said,
“Thank you for the reminder, senior.
I’ll consider it…”
Lin Jing had now entered the Divine Transformation Realm, and even his Martial Dao Cultivation was at the Divine Transformation level.
He simply didn’t want to reveal it yet, which is why he was concealing it.
Facing the kind advice of the Divine Toad mentor, Lin Jing could only reply in this manner.
…
Afterwards.
The Divine Toad mentor told Lin Jing many things.
It wasn’t until a day later that the Divine Toad mentor imparted all his understanding and insights on domain-type Divine Skills to Lin Jing.
Ɲονǥ0.с0
Furthermore,
he also demonstrated his Divine Skills for Lin Jing several times, each experience bringing different sensations to Lin Jing.
After patient explanations from the Divine Toad mentor, Lin Jing also gained some insights into domain-type Divine Skills.
After the discussion, the two returned to Spirit Rock Island.
Not having stayed long on Spirit Rock Island, Lin Jing bid farewell to several people and returned to Li Yan Island.
As soon as he got back to Li Yan Island, Ye Yun, having heard of Lin Jing’s return, hurriedly sought him out.
It turned out that the vial of Demonic Beasts’ blood essence the Divine Toad mentor had given to Ye Yun hadn’t been used.
Instead, Ye Yun had been waiting for Lin Jing to come back, intending to offer it to Lin Jing.
The blood essence was a gift from the Divine Toad mentor to Ye Yun.
Besides, with Lin Jing’s current Cultivation level, even if he used the Demonic Beasts’ blood essence, the improvement would be insignificant.
Ye Yun had recently advanced to the next stage, so the blood essence was particularly suitable for his use, and it would bring him the greatest enhancement.

chapters.title: Chapter 671
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 671: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain_3 Chapter 671: Chapter 289: Comprehending Divine Skills: Five Elements Domain_3 Therefore,
Lin Jing did not accept Ye Yun’s kindness and asked Ye Yun to put it away instead.
After sending Ye Yun away, Lin Jing entered seclusion once again.
For this seclusion, Lin Jing had made preparations to only decide on leaving after having grasped the Divine Arts.
…
Spring went and autumn came; time flew by in a blink.
In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
Ten years for the outside world.
...
However, for Lin Jing, under the enhancement of the Flow of Time Speed in the System Space, he had lived through forty years.
The System Space allowed entry for twelve hours each day, but the Flow of Time Speed was seven times faster.
Coupled with the outside world’s twelve hours, it added up precisely to four days.
That is to say, one day for Lin Jing was equivalent to four days for others.
For others, ten years had passed, but for Lin Jing, it was forty years.
In forty years, Lin Jing had finally grasped the Divine Arts.
Each person, based on their own Cultivation Technique and unique traits, would grasp different Divine Skills.
The Divine Skills Lin Jing grasped were naturally Domain-related.
Unlike Divine Toad, Lin Jing, based on his Five Elements Cultivation Technique, ultimately grasped the Domain Divine Skill that was founded upon the Five Elements Cultivation Technique.
Lin Jing named it the Five Elements Domain.
Upon executing the Five Elements Domain, a field formed around Lin Jing as the center.
In Lin Jing’s domain, all Five Elements Spiritual Force was under his control.
This free-floating Spiritual Power from the outside could not only be used by Lin Jing but if an opponent entered Lin Jing’s domain, they would be unable to condense the outside Spiritual Power for their own use.
That is, within Lin Jing’s domain, at that moment, one would be unable to manipulate outside Spiritual Power to use Divine Arts.
Even more, Lin Jing could control the Five Elements Spiritual Force around him to form a cage and hinder his opponents.
Although he couldn’t completely bind them, he could still greatly restrict their movements, causing them to slow down considerably.
And not just these, if Lin Jing really wished to, he could even control the Five Elements Spiritual Force within his domain to form a burst and attack the enemy.
It could be said that within Lin Jing’s domain, it was as if one had entered a space devoid of Spiritual Power to battle with Lin Jing.
In a fight between those at the level of Divinity Transformation, not being able to summon outside Spiritual Power or use Divine Arts meant essentially, there was no chance of victory.
The only method was to leave the range of Lin Jing’s domain.
But if Lin Jing deployed his domain, how could he allow his opponent to escape at will?
Moreover, he was also a Body Refinement Cultivator who had stepped into the Martial Dao…
…
During this time, Lin Jing not only grasped the Five Elements Domain, but even his Cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds.
The Demon Infant from before had been completely refined by Lin Jing, and as expected, when the Demon Infant was entirely refined…
It allowed Lin Jing’s Cultivation to smoothly breakthrough to the sixth level of Divinity Transformation, and he was even not far from the seventh level.
During this period, while Lin Jing continuously grasped Divine Skills, his Cultivation was also increasing non-stop.
Lin Jing even took this opportunity to make a breakthrough to the seventh level of Divinity Transformation.
From the time Lin Jing underwent Tribulation in Nanming Domain to now, actually not much time had passed, yet Lin Jing had already entered the late stages of Divinity Transformation.
The speed of this breakthrough was truly terrifying.
Of course,
The most important factor was that Demon Infant.
Without the Demon Infant, Lin Jing would not have been able to reach the late stages of Nascent Soul so quickly.
…
Having grasped Divine Skills, Lin Jing also came out of the System Space.
This time, his ten years of seclusion had been undisturbed.
And it had lasted until now.
Now that he had grasped Divine Arts, it was time to go out and walk about.
Just as this thought settled in Lin Jing’s mind, an intense fluctuation suddenly came from outside Li Yan Island.
ƝονǤ0.с0
No sooner had the fluctuation passed than a very familiar voice came through:
“Brother Lin!”
“Quick!”
“Help me fend off the enemy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 672
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 672: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies Chapter 672: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies This familiar voice belonged to Li Tangyu.
Hearing Li Tangyu’s voice, Lin Jing hastily sent out his Divine Sense.
ɴ0νǤօ.сο
As Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached out, not far from Li Yan Island, he spotted two figures.
They were a man and a woman.
The woman wore a black veil that covered her face, only revealing her eyes, and it seemed that the black veil was also a Magical Treasure of no low grade, capable of blocking Lin Jing’s Divine Sense from penetrating, preventing him from seeing her full appearance.
And that man, was indeed Li Tangyu.
...
At this time, Li Tangyu seemed to be injured, holding onto the woman as they flew together towards Li Yan Island.
Following them was a man in black, his body swirling with Demonic Qi, also flying this way, and from the looks of it, he was in pursuit of Li Tangyu and the woman.
“Fifth Sister, Seventh Brother!”
“You two might as well save your energy, apart from the master, do you think there’s anyone else in the Thousand Islands Domain who can save you?”
At this point, the man seemed to remember something, suddenly changed his tone:
“Oh, right…”
“I almost forgot, our master has already fallen, now there’s even less chance for anyone to save you.”
When the man in black said this, his face showed a mocking smile, seemingly enjoying this cat-and-mouse game immensely.Lin Jing knew very well the identity of Li Tangyu.
The seventh disciple of the Demon Lord Wan Mo.
And that man in black had just addressed them as ‘Seventh Brother’ and ‘Fifth Sister’.
The fifth disciple of the Demon Lord Wan Mo, Lin Jing also knew this person.
It was the former seventh disciple who had helped Li Tangyu deal with the Yin Business Demon Lord.
After dealing with the Yin Business Demon Lord, the former seventh disciple rose in the ranks, taking over the position originally held by the Yin Business Demon Lord, becoming the new fifth disciple.
And Li Tangyu then became the seventh disciple of the Demon Lord Wan Mo.
At this moment, it appeared that the woman wearing the black veil must be the fifth disciple of the Demon Lord Wan Mo.
She was also someone whom Li Tangyu had always trusted.
Only, Lin Jing hadn’t expected that this fifth disciple of the Demon Lord would turn out to be a woman.
And…
The man in black also mentioned the word ‘master’…
From this, it could be inferred that he too was one of the disciples under Demon Lord Wan Mo.
However, it was unclear which number among the Demon Lord Wan Mo’s seven disciples this man in black held.
What shocked Lin Jing, though, was the phrase uttered by the man:
“The master has already fallen…”
This made Lin Jing start to wonder:
“Could it be that Demon Lord Wan Mo has already fallen?”
“He was of Divinity Transformation Cultivation, one of the very top existences throughout the entire Southern Outer Sea, who could have killed him?”
Although Lin Jing was puzzled, he did not dare to delay.
Now that Li Tangyu was being chased, it was natural for Lin Jing not to stand idly by.
Thus…
He took a step and instantly disappeared from the courtyard.
By now, that shadow had already come close to Li Tangyu and the woman.
However, upon arrival, he didn’t launch an attack on Li Tangyu and the woman.
Instead, he let out a cold laugh and said:
“Heh…”
“Did you come to this Li Yan Island just to seek help?”
“Within Wan Mo Island, your Second Senior Brother, apart from the Eldest Senior Brother, is the only one at the Nascent Soul Peak Stage.”
“Let alone Wan Mo Island, I’m afraid there are very few in the entire Thousand Islands Domain who can match me.”
“Do you really think, just with the cultivators on this island, anyone can contend with me?”
After speaking, the man in black turned his gaze to the black-veiled woman, who was supported by Li Tangyu due to her severe injuries, and his eyes showed a lascivious gleam as he said:
“Seventh Brother, I don’t want anything else.”
“Hand over the Cultivation Technique you got from the master, then give me Fifth Sister.”
“Out of respect for our fraternity as fellow disciples, I’ll spare you your life.”
“Otherwise, don’t blame me for showing no mercy.”
At this moment, although Li Tangyu’s body churned with Demonic Qi, his aura was extremely unstable.
And…
Despite Li Tangyu’s appearance of having almost no wounds,
the bloodstain at the corner of his mouth and the large patch of blood soaked into the front of his garments clearly indicated that his injuries must be internal.
And apparently, they were quite severe.
Yet, facing the man in black, Li Tangyu did not take a step back; on the contrary, he stepped forward to protect the woman behind him.
Seeing this, the man in black jeered at Li Tangyu even more:
“By the looks of it, Seventh Brother, you’re determined to oppose your Senior Brother here.”
Li Tangyu remained silent, fixating on the man in black as he gathered a ball of Demonic Qi in front of him.
The woman did likewise, her eyes filled with anger as she looked at the man in black; although her injuries were more severe, at this moment she placed her hand on Li Tangyu’s body, directly channeling the little remaining Cultivation in her body into Li Tangyu.
Their actions had already made clear their stance.
Seeing this, the man in black’s expression immediately turned colder, and with a cold snort, his aura shot up, as the tremendous Demonic Qi burst forth from his body.
After the Demonic Qi shot out, it immediately formed two black dragons, carrying a terrifying might, and they attacked Li Tangyu in an instant…
Seeing Li Tangyu’s resistance, the man in black did not hesitate to launch an attack.
As the menacing black dragons charged towards him, Li Tangyu quickly pulled together his scant amount of Demonic Qi, amassing it in front of him, trying to fend them off.
However…
The black dragons released by the man in black surged with Demonic Qi and overwhelming momentum; the very presence of these dragons was chilling.

chapters.title: Chapter 673
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 673: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies_2 Chapter 673: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies_2 Compared to Li Tangyu, though also condensing Demonic Qi,
Li Tangyu, because of his injuries, had unstable energy, so even the Demonic Qi he condensed was weak.
Comparing the two, the inferiority was clear, and at this moment, Li Tangyu would likely struggle to withstand the next attack from the man in black.
…
…
However…
At this critical moment, a person suddenly appeared in front of Li Tangyu.
This sudden arrival was none other than Lin Jing.
...
When Lin Jing appeared, the man in black recovered from his stupor in an instant.
Especially when he saw Lin Jing appearing between him and Li Tangyu, and right in front of the black dragon, the man in black’s lips immediately curled into a cruel smile.
He then controlled the two black dragons, charging straight towards Lin Jing.
Lin Jing, having suddenly appeared, didn’t seem to do anything, yet multicolored lights suddenly erupted around him.
These multicolored lights, swirling around Lin Jing, kept expanding outward.
At this moment.
Li Tangyu, having seen Lin Jing standing in front of him, suddenly changed color in alarm,
“Brother Lin, get out of the way…”
However.
Lin Jing neither dodged nor avoided, letting the two black dragons formed from Demonic Qi charge directly at him.
However, as these black dragons approached, upon coming into contact with the multicolored lights, for some reason, they crumbled inch by inch.
They didn’t even touch Lin Jing.
Ɲ0νǤ0.ƈο
This sudden turn of events left the man in black completely astonished.
Li Tangyu, upon witnessing this scene, also incredulously turned to look at Lin Jing.
…
Lin Jing had rushed over immediately after hearing Li Tangyu’s call for help.
When he arrived, he witnessed the man in black condensing black dragons and attacking Li Tangyu.
Seeing the man in black launch an attack on Li Tangyu, Lin Jing had a sudden idea to try out the recently comprehended Domain of Five Elements.
It must be said, the Divine Arts were indeed powerful.
The attack method of the man in black was aimed at killing Li Tangyu without holding back.
Logically speaking, even for an ordinary Divine Transformation Cultivator, it would take considerable effort to dissolve such an attack.
However, within Lin Jing’s domain, the dragon formed from Demonic Qi was easily disintegrated by Lin Jing upon contact with the domain.
“Who exactly are you?”
“And why was your spell like that?”
Seeing his own spell easily disintegrated by Lin Jing, the man in black, shocked, looked at Lin Jing with even more caution.
When Lin Jing had appeared, he had already sensed Lin Jing’s cultivation, knowing that Lin Jing had the same Nascent Soul Peak Stage cultivation as himself.
Especially when Lin Jing directly faced his spellcasting, he had inwardly scoffed at Lin Jing’s recklessness.
After all, the spell he had cast was quite formidable.
Even a cultivator of the same rank would find it difficult to intercept and would likely get seriously injured if they directly confronted his spell.
But the spell Lin Jing had used, emitting multicolored lights, directly disintegrated his own, causing the man in black to doubt.
This sudden arrival, what level of cultivation did he have?
Actually, the man in black had another question that he hadn’t voiced.
That was…
Why did Lin Jing’s spell seem somewhat similar to the Divine Skills of a Divinity Transformation Cultivator?
Lin Jing ignored the man in black and turned to Li Tangyu, while also glancing at the woman, who was visibly shocked.
“Brother Li!”
“What happened to you, how did you get so severely injured?”
Upon hearing this, Li Tangyu quickly recovered from his shock, then spoke,
“The Demon Lord Wan Mo is dead!”
“The whole Wan Mo Island is now in chaos, the one chasing us is the Demon Lord’s second disciple, wanting to seize a Cultivation Technique I obtained from the Demon Lord, and has been chasing us till now.”
After speaking, Li Tangyu turned to Lin Jing and then said,
“Brother Lin!”
“You…
have you entered Divinity Transformation?”
Lin Jing nodded.
Since Lin Jing had made such a move, he naturally wasn’t planning to hide it anymore.
Currently, Lin Jing had advanced to the late stage of Divinity Transformation and had also comprehended Divine Arts.
With Lin Jing’s current strength, even if facing Li Mingwu, he had nothing to fear.
He couldn’t keep hiding forever; it was time to reveal some of his cultivation.
…
Hearing Lin Jing admit to having entered Divinity Transformation, the first to react was none other than,
The man in black, also known as the second disciple of the Demon Lord Wan Mo.
This person, after hearing Lin Jing and Li Tangyu’s conversation, was also shocked and without another word, turned to flee.
Though this person reacted quickly, Lin Jing’s reaction was not slower.
As soon as the man moved to run, Lin Jing had already noticed.
The man in black had barely run far when he suddenly found the Lin Jing, who was just standing and talking with Li Tangyu, abruptly appearing in front of him.
Faced with the suddenly appearing Lin Jing, the man in black was taken aback…
But then,
realizing what was happening, the man in black tried to flee again, but before he could move again, he saw Lin Jing step forward, appearing right in front of him,
Thenâ€¦
Lin Jing struck out with one hand, his hand aglow with multicolored lights.
As Lin Jing’s palm fell, the multicolored lights surged into the man in black’s body, sealing his cultivation.
This, was the gap between Nascent Soul and Divinity Transformation.
With Lin Jing moving at extreme speed, the man in black couldn’t even think of escape.
Lin Jing had even subdued the man in black without using any Divine Skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 674
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 674: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies_3 Chapter 674: Chapter 290: Li Tangyu Seeks Help, Demon Lord Wan Mo Dies_3 The man in black was subdued by Lin Jing and felt the terror emanating from him; cold sweat was uncontrollably beading on his forehead.
With a cultivator at the Divinity Transformation Stage present, even the thought of escaping was a luxury.
He was very panicked and at the same time didn’t understand.
How could his unassuming seventh junior brother know someone so terrifying?
And from the conversation they had just now, it seemed that the two had a rather good relationship.
Faced with the pressure from Lin Jing, the man in black, although panicked, had an active mind and was not rigid in his thinking.
Understanding that he was no match for this person, and that escaping from his hands was impossible no matter what,
he thus.
...
hurriedly said:
“Senior…”
“This is a misunderstanding, senior; I am the second senior brother of Tanyu.
”
“I didn’t know about senior’s relationship with Tanyu before; it’s my fault…”
“Our master, Demon Lord Wan Mo, is already dead; in the future, I will surely follow senior’s lead, and I hope senior can spare my life.”
Facing the man in black’s plea for mercy, Lin Jing glanced at him and voiced:“Nonsense!”
And then, Lin Jing directly summoned a surge of Five Elements Power, sending it into the man’s body and intensifying the seal.
The man in black, sealed once more, couldn’t even speak this time.
And then.
Lin Jing grabbed the man in black and returned to Li Tangyu’s side.
At that moment, Li Tangyu, seeing Lin Jing subdue his former second senior brother so effortlessly, couldn’t help but be deeply moved.
Li Tangyu had a fairly good understanding of Lin Jing’s former realm and had thought that Lin Jing was now at the Nascent Soul Peak Stage,
in the same realm as his own second senior brother.
Therefore.
When the Demon Lord Wan Mo met with trouble and Li Tangyu was hunted down by his second senior brother, he wanted to find Lin Jing, so they could confront this person together.
After all.
Now that the Demon Lord Wan Mo is dead, the whole Wan Mo Island has almost disintegrated.
