The seven disciples of Demon Lord Wan Mo each had their own thoughts and naturally wouldn’t risk their lives for the Demon Lord.
Without the threat of Demon Lord Wan Mo, Li Tangyu naturally had no more apprehensions; he could now openly interact with Lin Jing.
Furthermore, in the entire Southern Outer Sea,
Li Tangyu really only trusted Lin Jing.
…
After Lin Jing subdued the man in black and brought him back here, several people appeared.
The leader was Li Qingqing, followed by Ye Yun and Lin Jue.
It was obvious that they had heard Li Tangyu’s call for help and had come to check the situation.
Upon arrival, Li Qingqing saw Li Tangyu and the somewhat recovered woman standing beside him.
However,
she didn’t pay attention to the woman but went straight to Li Tangyu to check on him.
“Brother!”
“You’re hurt.”
Li Qingqing said with concern.
“I’m fine!” Li Tangyu looked at Li Qingqing, his eyes instantly softening.
Just then, Lin Jing also came over with the man in black, and said directly to Li Tangyu:
“Does he have anything you need, or is there anything you want to ask him?”
Li Tangyu looked at the man in black, who, although he could not speak, was incessantly begging with his eyes,
as if pleading for mercy.
However, Li Tangyu was unmoved and simply said:
“No.”
“Just kill him.
Keeping him alive is only a curse.”
Lin Jing nodded, and then in the horrified gaze of the man in black, he detonated the Five Elements Power within the man’s body.
ṅοѵǤ0.сο
The explosion of the Five Elements Power instantly engulfed the man in black, and not even his Nascent Soul could escape.
The second disciple of Demon Lord Wan Mo died at the hands of Lin Jing just like that.
Li Qingqing and the other two showed no reaction to Lin Jing’s actions.
And as for the power demonstrated by Lin Jing, they were not surprised either.
Lin Jing could hide his true strength from others when outside,
but in front of Li Qingqing and the others, although Lin Jing also concealed some of it, he would still reveal a bit to reassure those close to him.
Therefore,
the fact that Lin Jing could easily deal with the man in black was not a surprise to the three of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 675
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 675: Chapter 291 Alliance Formation Chapter 675: Chapter 291 Alliance Formation Lin Jing had just dealt with the man in black when Yue Qiniang, hearing the commotion, arrived belatedly and rushed over at this moment.
Upon her arrival, Yue Qiniang didn’t find any trace of the enemy.
She only saw two demon cultivators beside Lin Jing, and she recognized one of them.
“It’s you…” Yue Qiniang said in surprise upon seeing Li Tangyu.
Previously, in Lin Jing’s absence, Li Tangyu had lent a hand to Li Yan Island.
Yue Qiniang had been present then and naturally recognized Li Tangyu.
At this time, Lin Jing introduced him to Yue Qiniang:
“Qiniang, this is my friend, Li Tangyu, and he is also Qing Qing’s brother.”
Upon hearing this, Yue Qiniang also instantly understood.
...
No wonder this man had come to help Li Yan Island before.
So that was the reason.
Following that,
Lin Jing turned to look at Li Tangyu and the woman beside him.
This woman, the fifth disciple of the Demon Lord, possessed cultivation far more formidable than Li Tangyu’s.
Li Tangyu’s cultivation had just entered the middle stage of Nascent Soul, while the woman had already reached the late stage of Nascent Soul.
For some reason, her injuries were much more severe than those of Li Tangyu.
Li Tangyu then spoke up, introducing her to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin!”
“This is Bai Zhi, my partner I mentioned to you before, and she is also the daughter of the Demon Lord behind the black market of Nanshan Market.”
“Back in the Nanming Domain, we had encountered each other several times, but at that time I was unaware of her identity.”
“It was only when we met again on Wan Mo Island that I came to know of it.”
“She ended up on Wan Mo Island due to some unexpected changes and became the seventh disciple of Demon Lord Wan Mo.”
“The Demon Lord’s daughter?” Lin Jing couldn’t help but look at Bai Zhi.
Seeing Lin Jing’s gaze, Bai Zhi removed the veil from her face to reveal her true appearance.
Bai Zhi was very beautiful, with a cool and distant demeanor.
Perhaps because of her injuries, her face was somewhat pale.
“Thank you for the rescue.” Bai Zhi said, giving a fist and palm salute to Lin Jing.
Bai Zhi’s voice was cold, and her tone was flat, as if it were her natural state.
Lin Jing returned the gesture with a slight smile:
“There’s no need…”
Having said that, Lin Jing didn’t pay any further attention to Bai Zhi but directly addressed Li Tangyu:
“This isn’t a convenient place.
Let’s head back first.”
Li Tangyu nodded:
“All right.”
Afterward, Lin Jing and Li Tangyu, along with a few others, flew toward Li Yan Island.
Upon returning to Li Yan Island, Lin Jing instructed the others to disperse.
Because of Bai Zhi’s severe injuries, Li Tangyu entrusted her to Li Qingqing to take her for treatment.
Only Li Tangyu and Lin Jing remained and proceeded to Lin Jing’s courtyard on the mountaintop.
“I just heard…
is it true that Demon Lord Wan Mo is dead?”
As soon as they arrived at the courtyard, Lin Jing brought up the subject.
Demon Lord Wan Mo was one of the three great island masters of the Thousand Islands Domain, ruling over Wan Mo Island.
He also possessed cultivation at the level of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
With such cultivation, how could he suddenly fall?
And who could have been responsible?
ƝονǤ0.ᴄօ
Lin Jing, unclear about the cause, naturally turned to Li Tangyu for information.
Li Tangyu nodded and confirmed:
“Yes, he’s dead.”
Although Li Tangyu was the seventh disciple of Demon Lord Wan Mo, he had rarely met with the Demon Lord.
He didn’t feel much attachment to the Demon Lord Wan Mo.
The title of disciple of the Demon Lord was in name only.
Demon Lord Wan Mo seldom involved himself with his disciples, letting them compete amongst themselves until one stood out and caught his eye.
Only then would the Demon Lord show interest.
Before that, even if one of his disciples died, it wouldn’t matter much to the Demon Lord; he would simply replace them.
As with the previous Shadow Demon Lord, upon his death, Li Tangyu became the new disciple of the Demon Lord.
It was precisely because of this, upon the death of Demon Lord Wan Mo, his disciples immediately dispersed.
…
Lin Jing was puzzled, so he asked Li Tangyu:
“Demon Lord Wan Mo was so powerful, in theory, there aren’t many who could be his match.
Even if he did encounter a strong enemy, if he couldn’t win, he should have been able to escape, right?”
“How did he fall?”
Li Tangyu replied:
“He was plotted against by the Island Master of True Dragon Island…”
“The Island Master of True Dragon Island came to Wan Mo Island under the pretense of a visit, but at a critical moment, he suddenly launched a surprise attack.
The Demon Lord, caught off guard, fell for it.”
“Furthermore, after the successful ambush, another cultivator with stronger cultivation, suspected to be at the Nascent Soul Peak stage, appeared.
Together, they managed to kill the Demon Lord.”
Hearing this, a chill went down Lin Jing’s spine, and he immediately thought of Li Mingwu.
In the Southern Outer Sea, there weren’t that many cultivators at the Divinity Transformation stage, and within the Thousand Islands Domain, cultivators at the Nascent Soul Peak were even rarer.
Incidentally, Li Mingwu was one of them.
If the person who acted was indeed Li Mingwu, the situation could be quite ominous.
So, Lin Jing promptly inquired:
“The strong elder you just mentioned who’s even stronger than the Island Master of True Dragon Island, do you know his name?”
“And…”
“Why did they kill Demon Lord Wan Mo?
Did they reveal their motive?”
Li Tangyu nodded and explained:
“When their battle began, Bai Zhi was a bit closer and overheard some of their conversation.”
“That Divinity Transformation Peak elder is likely called Li Mingwu.”
“According to Bai Zhi, the reason they moved against the Demon Lord seemed to be related to some token?”
“It seems that the Demon Lord had a token in his possession that they wanted.
So, they joined forces, killed the Demon Lord, and took the token from him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 676
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 676: Chapter 291 Alliance_2 Chapter 676: Chapter 291 Alliance_2 Upon hearing this, Lin Jing’s brows furrowed immediately.
True Dragon Island’s Island Master had indeed allied with Li Mingwu, and together, they had killed Demon Lord Wan Mo.
Their alliance was a cause for concern for Lin Jing.
There should have been some enmity between the three Island Masters and Li Mingwu.
But the two of them had cast aside their grudges and joined forces.
As for the Token, Lin Jing understood it without further explanation.
It was definitely the Five Elements Command Token.
...
The two had surely united over the matter of the Five Elements Command Token.
To enter the Five Elements Ruins, five cultivators were needed, each holding a Five Elements Command Token.
They had to act simultaneously to open the Teleportation Array leading into the ruins.
Both the five Tokens and the five cultivators were indispensable.
As for the reason why the two could ally, Lin Jing was also clear.
It was naturally because of the Tokens.
Among the three Island Masters, only the Master of True Dragon Island lacked the Five Elements Command Token, thus not eligible to enter the Five Elements Ruins.
And within the Five Elements Ruins, there was a method to breakthrough the Solidifying Body Realm, something the Master of True Dragon Island would definitely not want to give up.
Li Mingwu must have also thought of this, that’s why he sought to forge an alliance with the Master of True Dragon Island.
Then, the two joined together to kill Demon Lord Wan Mo.
With Demon Lord Wan Mo dead, the Five Elements Water Command that he held naturally became the spoils of war for Li Mingwu and the Master of True Dragon Island.
Up to this point, everything became clear.
The reason why the Master of True Dragon Island was willing to put aside his grievances and ally with Li Mingwu must be because of that Token.
Li Mingwu himself already possessed a Five Elements Gold Command, and after killing Demon Lord Wan Mo, that Demon Lord’s Five Elements Water Command naturally became the Master of True Dragon Island’s.
Furthermore…
Lin Jing knew that Demon Lord Wan Mo had a rather good relationship with Bai Yi, and both of them bore old grudges against Li Mingwu.
If it really was the two of them holding the Tokens to enter the Five Elements Ruins, then they would inevitably form an alliance to confront Li Mingwu together.
Li Mingwu sought out the Master of True Dragon Island to form an alliance and preemptively killed Demon Lord Wan Mo, seizing his Five Elements Water Command.
This strategy could truly be described as killing two birds with one stone.
This way, not only was Li Mingwu weakened, but their own strength was also increased.
Now, it was Bai Yi who was in danger.
With the two in alliance, Bai Yi naturally wasn’t a match for them, one just didn’t know if they would make a move against Bai Yi?
It’s highly likely they wouldn’t.
Lin Jing also reacted instantly.
Now that Demon Lord Wan Mo was dead, Bai Yi would certainly be on guard.
With Bai Yi already wary, it probably wouldn’t be easy for the two to kill him.
If they were to force a move, Bai Yi could fight back desperately, potentially causing them severe injuries.
Even perishing was not out of the question.
They likely wouldn’t take such a risk.
Besides.
Now that both had obtained a Token and could enter the Five Elements Ruins, they would be even less likely to fight to the death with Bai Yi over an extra Token.
…
…
Just then, Lin Jing suddenly remembered another matter, which was the Five Elements Wood Command.
If Li Mingwu allied with the Master of True Dragon Island, then they would surely communicate.
Once they communicated, they would realize that the Wood Hall Token was not in Li Mingwu’s hands.
Previously…
When several people broke into the Five Elements Cave Mansion, they entered the remaining Water and Wood Halls but obtained nothing.
And it was precisely because of Li Mingwu’s appearance that the three Island Masters assumed Li Mingwu had taken the items from the Wood Hall.
In reality, the items from the Wood Hall had been obtained by Lin Jing himself.
But at that time, the three Island Masters did not know this and thought Li Mingwu had stolen them.
Now that they had allied, this matter would definitely be exposed.
It was easy to guess this.
If the Five Elements Wood Command was not stolen by Li Mingwu, it must have been taken by the others who were present.
The two would undoubtedly check each person.
Lin Jing even suspected that Demon Lord Wan Mo’s death might also be related to this matter.
Now that Demon Lord Wan Mo was dead, they would surely find the Five Elements Water Command that Demon Lord Wan Mo had snatched from Li Mingwu in his leftover Space Ring.
Most importantly, Demon Lord Wan Mo had only one Five Elements Water Command in his possession.
And the Five Elements Wood Command was not there at all.
Unable to find the Five Elements Wood Command, Li Mingwu and the Master of True Dragon Island definitely wouldn’t let it go; they would suspect other people.
After all, the number of people who entered the Five Elements Cave Mansion was limited.
Xue Yilin, also known as Lord Ling Yi, was already Li Mingwu’s man; the rest were Bai Yi, Lin Jing himself, and a few other Array Masters.
Looking at it this way, Lin Jing was under considerable suspicion.
No…
Suddenly, Lin Jing realized his suspicion should be the greatest.
Bai Yi, having a Five Elements Earth Command in his possession and being closely surveilled by True Lord Ling Yi for many years, must be thoroughly understood by the latter.
If there were a way to enter the Wood Hall ahead of time, it is likely that True Lord Ling Yi would also be aware of it.
Otherwise, instead of taking action against Demon Lord Wan Mo, they might have very well targeted Bai Yi directly.
If Bai Yi were exempt from suspicion, then Lin Jing, who possessed the Five Elements Cultivation Technique, would become the prime suspect.
Realizing this, Lin Jing immediately broke out in a cold sweat.
…
“Brother Lin!”
“What’s wrong?
Is there something amiss?”
Seeing Lin Jing furrowing his brows in thought since speaking, Li Tangyu couldn’t help but ask.
ƝᴑνǤο.сο
Lin Jing lifted his head, looking at Li Tangyu and said,
“Besides these, have they revealed anything else?”
Li Tangyu shook his head,
“Due to the intensity of their battle, we didn’t dare to get close.
Bai Zhi was seriously injured because she was caught in the aftermath and couldn’t evade in time.”
“After we hid, we did not stray too far until we saw the Demon Lord fall, and only then, realizing the situation was grim, did we hastily flee Wan Mo Island.”
“Howeverâ€¦”
“Even though they killed the Demon Lord, both of them seemed to have sustained serious injuries and did not pursue any of us.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing’s eyes suddenly lit up, and he quickly asked,
“Are you saying that both of them were injured?”
Although Li Tangyu was puzzled by Lin Jing’s reaction, he still answered,
“Yes.”
“And from the looks of it, their injuries weren’t light.”
Lin Jing nodded, then fell into thought again.
Currently, Lin Jing had a Five Elements Fire Command and a Five Elements Wood Commandâ€”two tokens in hand.
The Island Master of True Dragon Island and Li Mingwu had seemingly formed an alliance, holding both the Five Elements Water Command and the Five Elements Gold Command.
The last Five Elements Earth Command was in Bai Yi’s hands.
Now, with the Island Master of True Dragon Island and Li Mingwu allied, they would definitely search for other tokens.
Thus, the Five Elements Wood Command would naturally be their primary target.
Fortunately, they were currently injured and would likely not come looking in the short term.
However, once they recuperated from their injuries, they would certainly find him.
Lin Jing’s cultivation was probably on par with the Island Master of True Dragon Island, though somewhat inferior to Li Mingwu.
But in terms of actual strength, Lin Jing felt that he had the upper hand over the Island Master of True Dragon Island.
Even facing Li Mingwu, he had the power to fight.
However, facing them both at the same time was a different story.
While he might not necessarily perish, he was sure to gain no advantage.
Furthermore, possessing a Five Elements Command meant having the qualification to enter the Five Elements Ruins, with only five people allowed entry.
If two of these five were allied, they could support each other within the ruins.
They could even pose a threat to others inside.
Since Li Mingwu could form alliances, so too could Lin Jing…
Moments later, Lin Jing looked up at Li Tangyu and said,
“Brother Li!”
“Take Qing Qing and the others and leave Li Yan Island for the time being, lying low.”
Li Tangyu was very puzzled and asked Lin Jing,
“Why so?”
Lin Jing responded,
“The token they are seeking is on me; by now, they must have begun to suspect me.”
“Take Qing Qing and the others away to hide.
I will go seek help.”
“What?”
Li Tangyu was taken aback.
“The token is actually on you…”
Lin Jing nodded,
“Yes, it’s a long story.”
“For now, take Qing Qing and Ye Yun with you, leave Li Yan Island and take refuge in Bihai City.”
“Once I have arranged everything, you can come back.”
Recognizing the gravity of the situation, Li Tangyu swiftly nodded,
“Alright.”
With that, Li Tangyu left.
After Li Tangyu departed, Lin Jing had already thought of a strategy.
He held two tokens, so he could afford to give one away in order to form an alliance with someone.
And.
He had already decided on the target of his allianceâ€”
The ancestor of the Yan Family…

chapters.title: Chapter 677
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 677: Chapter 292: Meeting the Yan Family Patriarch Chapter 677: Chapter 292: Meeting the Yan Family Patriarch The Yan Family patriarch, like Li Mingwu, also boasts a Nascent Soul Peak Cultivation.
When Lin Jing sought an alliance with him, even Li Mingwu would certainly have reservations.
Furthermore,
Given that the Yan Family patriarch himself is at the Nascent Soul Peak without advancing into the Solidifying Body Realm, it is likely due to a deficiency in the True Spirits of the Five Elements.
In the Five Elements Ruins, there should exist the True Spirits of the Five Elements, and the Yan Family patriarch would surely find such a temptation irresistible.
…
Not long after,
Li Tangyu, along with several others, arrived and under Lin Jing’s arrangement, they left together for Bihai City.
Lin Jing also departed from Li Yan Island, steering the Flying Boat directly towards Spirit Rock Island.
...
As for Li Yan Island, there was no need to bother with it.
Lin Jing’s sending several people away from Li Yan Island was merely a precaution, to prevent those close to him from suffering due to his own troubles.
But as long as none of them or Lin Jing himself were there, even if their opponents finished healing and came to Li Yan Island, finding Lin Jing absent, they wouldn’t eradicate his Li Yan Island outright.
Moreover…
This time, Lin Jing wasn’t fleeing; he was merely visiting Spirit Rock Island to discuss matters with the Yan Family patriarch, and after the discussion, they would naturally return to the Thousand Islands Domain.
The reason he had them flee,
Firstly, was to be safe rather than sorry, to avoid any harm to his close ones should their enemies indeed come over.
Secondly, he worried that in his absence they might kidnap his people to use as leverage against him.
As for the other residents of Li Yan Island, Lin Jing did not inform them; Li Yan Island was bustling as usual, with cultivators constantly coming and going.
…
A few hours later, Lin Jing finally arrived at Spirit Rock Island.
Upon reaching Spirit Rock Island, Yan Ming immediately sensed it, came out to check the situation, and, upon seeing that the visitor was Lin Jing, greeted him at once.
ɴονǥο.сο
“Brother Lin!”
“Why do you have the time to visit today?”
Yan Ming greeted him with a smile as he approached.
“I’m here to see Elder Yan; may I know if he’s available?”
Without beating around the bush, Lin Jing stated his purpose for the visit directly.
Caught off guard by the question, Yan Ming replied,
“He is.”
“The patriarch is in seclusion and isn’t here right now.”
“Brother Lin, do you have some urgent matter with the patriarch?”
“If it’s something urgent, I can take you to him right now.”
Lin Jing nodded and then quickly clasped his fists,
“If it’s not too much trouble, I would appreciate Brother Yan’s assistance.”
Seeing that Lin Jing seemed to indeed have important business, Yan Ming didn’t ask further and simply said to Lin Jing,
“Brother Lin, follow me!”
With that, Yan Ming soared into the sky on his sword and flew towards the sky above Spirit Rock Island.
Seeing this, Lin Jing followed suit.
…
The Yan Family patriarch’s place of seclusion was not on Spirit Rock Island.
It was, instead, on a small island just a kilometer in diameter above Spirit Rock Island.
The island was not large, yet lush with plant life, and in its center stood a vast hut wrapped in vines, which was undoubtedly the Yan Family patriarch’s place of seclusion.
Moreover, as they approached the island, Lin Jing also noticed that the Spiritual Energy surrounding the island was incredibly dense, several times more so than on Spirit Rock Island.
Clearly, the small island had been specially modified.
Upon nearing the island, Yan Ming did not set foot on it but stopped not far off the shore and then made a gesture toward the island,
“Patriarch, Lin Jing requests an audience.”
Following Yan Ming’s call, a Divine Sense swept over them first, and then, around the island, a Defense Array appeared.
Shortly after, the array started operating, and a passage leading directly to the island emerged in the middle of the array.
With the passage’s appearance, at this moment, the voice of the Yan Family patriarch came from inside the island,
“Young friend Lin, please come in.”
After the Yan Family patriarch spoke, Yan Ming then said to Lin Jing,
“Brother Lin.”
“You go on in.
Without the patriarch’s permission, we cannot freely enter the island; I will wait for you here.”
Lin Jing nodded his head in acknowledgment,
and then he walked through the passage in the array, entering the island.
As he went in, the passage behind him closed.
Lin Jing followed the passage all the way forward, directly to the front of the hut engulfed by vines.
Just as Lin Jing arrived, the doors to the hut opened.
And the voice of the Yan Family patriarch came out again:
“Young friend Lin, come in.”
“Yes, Elder,” Lin Jing responded with a nod, then stepped inside the hut.
It was only upon entering that Lin Jing realizedâ€”the inside of the hut was also overrun with vines, some passing through the walls, while others hung from the ceiling.
Even in the center of the room there was a high platform entirely formed by vines.
At that moment, the Yan Family patriarch was sitting cross-legged atop the platform, with his hands folded in his lap at the Dantian position, and above the palms, a cluster of green light was gathering.
From that green cluster, an extremely rich wood-attributed Spiritual Power was emanating.
And from the patriarch’s palms, Spiritual Power continuously flowed, consolidating into the green cluster.
Upon seeing the Yan Family patriarch, Lin Jing performed a polite salutation:
“Elder, forgive the disturbance.”
The Yan Family patriarch smiled at Lin Jing, then spoke,
“Young friend Lin comes for a visit; I wonder what matter brings you here?”
As he spoke, the posture of the Yan Family patriarch remained unchanged, and he continued ceaselessly channeling Spiritual Power into the green cluster above his hands.
“I wish to invite the Elder to form an alliance with me, to venture together into the Five Elements Ruins…”
Lin Jing then directly stated his reason for coming.
The Yan Family patriarch, upon hearing this, was visibly shaken.
Even the green cluster in his palms shook slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 678
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 678: Chapter 292: Meeting the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 Chapter 678: Chapter 292: Meeting the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 Afterward, Yan Family’s ancestor looked up and hurriedly looked towards Lin Jing.
When he saw the utterly serious expression on Lin Jing’s face, which did not seem like he was joking, Yan Family’s ancestor’s brows also furrowed slightly.
Then, Yan Family’s ancestor spoke directly to Lin Jing:
“Please wait a moment!”
After speaking, Yan Family’s ancestor closed his eyes and then directly gathered stronger Spiritual Power, channeling it into the green orb of light in the palm of his hand.
Not long after, less than a quarter of an hour, the orb of light became increasingly bright, and the wood attribute aura within it grew stronger.
Right when the wood attribute aura in the orb reached its peak, Yan Family’s ancestor directly caused the orb to rise and then merged it into his forehead.
After the orb of light merged into Yan Family’s ancestor’s forehead, the aura around his body gradually calmed.
Only then did Yan Family’s ancestor open his eyes.
...
He then looked towards Lin Jing with a serious expression:
“Is what you just said true?”
Although Yan Family’s ancestor looked serious, Lin Jing could hear from his voice that his heart must be quite restless at this moment.
…
The legends of the Five Elements Ruins were well known to Yan Family’s ancestor.
The legends spoke of items critical to advancing to the Solidifying Body Realm within the Five Elements Ruins, the Five Elements True Spirits.
These Five Elements True Spirits pose a great temptation to every Divinity Transformation Cultivator who has not yet entered the Solidifying Body Realm.
No one is an exception.
Naturally, Yan Family’s ancestor was also greatly tempted.
After all, that was the Solidifying Body Realm.
In the entire Southern Outer Sea, how many cultivators were there in the Solidifying Body Realm?
He had been stuck at the Nascent Soul Peak for hundreds of years, and without a fortunate opportunity, Yan Family’s ancestor had no doubts that he might be stuck there for the rest of his life.
The sudden words from Lin Jing now gave him hope, so how could he not be excited?
However, Lin Jing’s words were too astonishing; even though he trusted Lin Jing greatly, he still had to be cautious about this matter.
…
Lin Jing didn’t waste words and directly took out two tokens from the Storage Bag.
One, a Five Elements Earth Command, and another a Five Elements Fire Command.
Following that,
Lin Jing directly presented the two tokens.
Upon seeing the two tokens, Yan Family’s ancestor’s breath hitched, and even his eyes stared intently.
He had not expected Lin Jing to actually bring out Five Elements Commands, and furthermore, two of them.
After taking out the tokens, Lin Jing passed them over directly, and Yan Family’s ancestor, reacting quickly, reached out and took the tokens.
After receiving the tokens, Yan Family’s ancestor held them in his hands and thoroughly inspected them.
After a good while, after inspecting the tokens, Yan Family’s ancestor didn’t find any signs of forgery.
But seeing Lin Jing produce the Five Elements Commands, he still seemed unable to believe it and thus asked Lin Jing:
“Where did you get these tokens from?”
“They wouldn’t happen to be fake, would they?”
Understanding Yan Family’s ancestor’s skepticism, Lin Jing also understood.
After all, the Five Elements Commands were not ordinary treasures and were not so easily found.
Moreover, he had produced not one, but two.
Anyone would be suspicious.
So, Lin Jing spoke directly:
“Elder, don’t you have a method to verify the authenticity of the tokens?
You can check them at any time.”
Perhaps the matter was too shocking; Yan Family’s ancestor had inspected them but had forgotten to use the art of verification until Lin Jing’s reminder, and only then did he remember.
He then hurriedly said:
“Good…”
“I will inspect it right now.”
After saying this, Yan Family’s ancestor then began to gather Spiritual Power and started to verify the two tokens…
After Yan Family’s ancestor’s verification, both tokens were indeed genuine.
Yan Family’s ancestor then looked at Lin Jing again, his eyes filled with disbelief.
“Where did you get these Five Elements Commands from?”
“And to have acquired two at once.”
Lin Jing then spoke:
“These two tokens were found in different places.”
“One of them was found by chance on an uninhabited island.”
“And another one, from the Five Elements Cave Mansion.”
Upon hearing Five Elements Cave Mansion, Yan Family’s elder ancestor hurriedly asked:
“You have actually been to the Five Elements Cave Mansion!”
The Five Elements Cave Mansion, connected with the Five Elements Ruins, is the necessary passageway to enter the Five Elements Ruins, but the Cave Mansion has always been secretive, and many are unaware of its exact location.
Thus, the elder ancestor of the Yan Family was quite surprised that Lin Jing had entered the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Yes…”
“At that time, I was invited together with the three major Island Masters of the Thousand Islands Domain to enter the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
It was there I got a Five Elements Command Token.”
“It was them,” the elder ancestor of the Yan Family frowned slightly, then continued:
“Then it seems that the other Five Elements Command Tokens should be in their possession.”
Lin Jing nodded, “Yes, elder.”
“Now that all five tokens have appeared, besides these two tokens, the remaining three are in their hands.”
“Oh, and there’s Li Mingwu.”
“Former Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Li Mingwu, has a token, although I’m not sure if it’s one or two.”
“Li Mingwu…”
“I have heard of him, but we don’t really have any relations,” said the elder ancestor of the Yan Family.
Having finished, the elder ancestor of the Yan Family continued to inquire Lin Jing:
“So, what you just mentioned about inviting me to go to the Five Elements Ruins, what’s that about?”
Lin Jing opened his mouth and said:
“Now that all five Five Elements Command Tokens have appeared, I have two here, and Yue Tian Island’s Island Master Bai Yi has one.”
“The remaining two should be with Li Mingwu and True Dragon Island’s Island Master.”
“My intention is to offer one token to the elder, then we enter the Five Elements Ruins together.”
After hearing this, the elder ancestor of the Yan Family first looked at the Five Elements Command in his hand, rubbed it for a while, then raised his head, looking back at Lin Jing with curiosity and said:
“This token is so valuable, if you were to sell it, surely you could exchange it for quite a lot of cultivation resources, but to give it to me like this, isn’t that a loss for you?”
Lin Jing shook his head, then said:
“Elder might not be aware, but Demon Lord Wan Mo is already dead.”
“Demon Lord Wan Mo is dead?” the elder ancestor of the Yan Family frowned.
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Li Mingwu and the True Dragon Island Island Master joined forces, killed the Demon Lord Wan Mo, and took away the Five Elements Water Command that originally belonged to him.”
“Now Li Mingwu and the True Dragon Island Island Master have formed an alliance, and given that I’ve been into the Five Elements Cave Mansion, it’s likely that it will soon be exposed that I hold a Five Elements Command.”
“Soon, they will probably come looking for me.”
Having said this, Lin Jing did not continue.
But the elder ancestor of the Yan Family then continued:
“So.”
“You’ve come to me, offering me a Five Elements Command Token, and proposing an alliance with me to deal with those two.”
Lin Jing shook his head and said:
“Dealing with them might be a bit out of reach, at most we can only check them.”
“Five tokens allow only five people to enter into the ruins.”
“Entering the ruins is for the purpose of seeking the Five Elements True Spirit, to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm, so there will inevitably be competition.”
“Now…”
“With Li Mingwu and the True Dragon Island Island Master having formed an alliance, if they enter the Five Elements Ruins, the two of them together will indeed pose a threat to the other three.”
“My original thought was, since the two of them are in alliance, then I might as well invite the elder together.”
“And if possible, Yue Tian Island’s Bai Yi, who already has grievances with Li Mingwu, might also be invited…
“If the three of us join hands against the two of them, that would be even better.”
“However.”
“Ideally, this matter should still be initiated by the elder…”
After hearing this, the elder ancestor of the Yan Family nodded.
Ɲονǥօ.сο
“What do you think, elder?” Lin Jing then asked.
The elder ancestor of the Yan Family then spoke with a smile:
“Such an opportunity comes once in ten thousand years.”
“Since you are willing to offer me such an opportunity, I will gladly accept it.”
“Neither Li Mingwu nor that Daoist from the Dragon Island intimidate me; you just follow me when the time comes, and I will protect you.”
“Although I am not afraid of them, even if Li Mingwu and the Dragon Daoist are in alliance, they won’t be to my advantage.”
“If we want to seize the Five Elements True Spirit as you said, then Bai Yi, we can indeed try to contact him too…”

chapters.title: Chapter 679
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 679: Chapter 293: Inviting Bai Yi to Form an Alliance Chapter 679: Chapter 293: Inviting Bai Yi to Form an Alliance After making a deal with the ancestor of the Yan Family, Lin Jing naturally did not hide anything and took out the map he had obtained from the Five Elements Ruins.
“This is the map of the Five Elements Ruins, please take a look.”
“The map, let me see…” the ancestor of the Yan Family commented, his eyes brightening.
Given that Lin Jing had already revealed the Five Elements Command Token, the ancestor of the Yan Family was shocked, not to mention that Lin Jing even possessed the map of the Five Elements Ruins.
This was even more surprising to the ancestor of the Yan Family.
Lin Jing then handed over the map as well.
Upon receiving the map, the ancestor of the Yan Family began to study it, and after a while, he looked up at Lin Jing:
“How did you come by this map?”
After speaking, the ancestor of the Yan Family then added:
“I mean, does anyone else have this map in their possession?”
Lin Jing pondered for a moment, then responded:
“This map, I obtained it in the main hall of the Five Elements, and even if others have it, they probably don’t have it in such completeness.”
Since he had decided to form an alliance with the ancestor of the Yan Family, he certainly could not conceal his entry into the main hall of the Five Elements.
Moreover, being the most suspicious at the moment, he couldn’t hide it even if he wanted to; revealing this early to the ancestor of the Yan Family also demonstrated his sincerity.
...
Otherwise, once they reached the main hall and found everything on the high platform gone, others would certainly suspect him.
Even if handling it poorly, there might even be misunderstandings with the ancestor of the Yan Family.
Therefore,
telling him at this time was indeed the correct approach.
Hearing this explanation from Lin Jing, after digesting his words, the ancestor of the Yan Family promptly spoke, asking Lin Jing:
“From your words, it seems that you were the only person who entered that place?”
“Yes.”
“You must know, elder, that I practice the Five Elements Cultivation Technique, and I merely used some special means which they probably do not know about.”
Lin Jing answered thus without revealing how he had entered the main hall of the Five Elements.
Having said this, Lin Jing took out a map fragment that he had previously obtained through the help of the Black Shark Gang’s Space Ring.
“This is a piece of map I had previously obtained, this fragment, it exactly matches the complete map I obtained.”
“It appears that this map might also be circulating outside.”
After finishing his explanation, Lin Jing also handed over the map fragment.
The ancestor of the Yan Family took the map fragment and then compared it, finding it was indeed, as Lin Jing had said, exactly matching a corner of the complete map.
After comparing it, the ancestor of the Yan Family fell into deep thought.
A moment later, as if having come to a realization, he then spoke to Lin Jing:
“Since we need to enter the Five Elements Ruins to compete for the True Spirit of the Five Elements, we must be well-prepared.”
“Please tell me in detail about your previous entry into the Five Elements Cave Mansion; I think we can make use of these two maps to concoct a plan.”
Lin Jing nodded and then shared how several individuals had entered the Five Elements Cave Mansion, as well as the events that took place inside.
Most importantly, he also did not forget to mention some of the grievances among the individuals involved.
Of course, regarding his own matters, Lin Jing did not reveal too much.
After Lin Jing had finished speaking, the ancestor of the Yan Family also pondered for a long while.
After his contemplation, the ancestor of the Yan Family said to Lin Jing:
“I know what to do now.”
“When the time comes, we will first go and find Bai Yi.
I will reveal that all you did previously was under my command.”
“This way, they will focus their attention on me, and you will be much safer by comparison.”
“Furthermore.”
“With my cultivation at the Divinity Transformation Stage as a deterrent, they will not dare to act rashly against me.”
“Then, we will ally with Bai Yi…”
…
…
“Of course, Bai Yi cannot be completely trusted…”
…
…
Soon, the ancestor of the Yan Family laid out his entire plan.
The ancestor of the Yan Family was doing this partly to protect Lin Jing.
After all, the cultivation that Lin Jing had displayed was indeed too low.
However, Lin Jing was well aware of this fact.
After the ancestor of the Yan Family had finished explaining his plan, Lin Jing also displayed his cultivation.
Lin Jing did not reveal much of his cultivation, just enough to show the initial stage of Divinity Transformation.
However, that was already sufficient.
Upon seeing Lin Jing’s cultivation in the Divinity Transformation Stage, the ancestor of the Yan Family was first taken aback, then could not help but marvel.
After their discussion, the two decided to act immediately, and the ancestor of the Yan Family then left the small island with Lin Jing.
The ancestor of the Yan Family first went to Spirit Rock Island to talk to Yan Ming, and then left Spirit Rock Island together with Lin Jing.
…
Yue Tian Island, Yue Tian Hall.
Bai Yi’s expression was somber as he sat there.
Thinking back on past events, he felt irritated.
Previously, Bai Yi had received solid information that Xue Yilin, a traitor, had inadvertently left traces on an island in the northern part of the Thousand Islands Domain.
Naturally, Bai Yi wanted to tear Xue Yilin into a thousand pieces.
Bai Yi did not hesitate and immediately rushed over.
At the beginning of his chase, Bai Yi indeed saw traces left by Xue Yilin, though he did not encounter the man himself.
Thus,
Bai Yi followed these traces, continuing his pursuit, and it did not take long to find a second set of traces left by Xue Yilin.
Yet, this time too, he did not encounter the person.
In this manner, Bai Yi followed the traces left by Xue Yilin, persisting in his pursuit until after several instances before he realized something was amiss.
It seemed to be a conspiracy.
After this realization, Bai Yi immediately gave up the chase and hurried back to his island, Yue Tian Island.
Ɲονǥο.сᴑ
Upon returning to Yue Tian Island, however, he found that Yue Tian Island showed no anomalies.

chapters.title: Chapter 680
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 680: Chapter 293: Inviting Bai Yi to Form an Alliance_2 Chapter 680: Chapter 293: Inviting Bai Yi to Form an Alliance_2 This made Bai Yi very puzzled, he even began to doubt his own judgment.
However.
It wasn’t long before news arrived.
The Demon Lord Wan Mo had fallen, and the entire Wan Mo Island, after the demise of Demon Lord Wan Mo, fell into disarray.
Let alone the other Demon Cultivators, even the seven major disciples of the Demon Lord Wan Mo had vanished without a trace.
When Bai Yi heard the news of the Demon Lord Wan Mo’s demise, he instantly realized that he had been played and also understood that the mastermind behind this event was certainly Li Mingwu.
Nevertheless.
...
Bai Yi still could not believe that the Demon Lord Wan Mo had suddenly perished, considering that his Cultivation was at the late stage of Divinity Transformation, which would not have led to his downfall even if he were no match for Li Mingwu.
Thus, Bai Yi made his way to Wan Mo Island at once to investigate.
On Wan Mo Island, Bai Yi did indeed find traces of battle between the two sides.
From the marks of the struggle, it was clear there had been an intense battle, and it wasn’t limited to just the Demon Lord Wan Mo and Li Mingwu.
Another person had also taken part in this great battle.
Bai Yi carefully examined the traces of the battle and even managed to find a few Demon Cultivators from Wan Mo Island, whom he queried after some questioning.
Eventually, he was able to identify the third person.
It was the Island Master of True Dragon Island, the Dragon Taoist.
In the end, after some further investigation and even finding the sixth disciple of Demon Lord Wan Mo, Bai Yi learned about the situation at that time.
It turned out that the Demon Lord was first ambushed by the Dragon Taoist, and then Li Mingwu appeared; both attacked simultaneously, leading to the death of Demon Lord Wan Mo.
After learning of this, Bai Yi was fraught with concern.
He promptly returned to his Yue Tian Island.
Regarding their motives, Bai Yi needed only a brief moment of contemplation to understand them clearly.
The Five Elements Command Token, it must have been for this reason.
It was obvious that they must have attacked Demon Lord Wan Mo for the Five Elements Command Tokens.
Having three Tokens and paying a certain price, one could locate the positions of the other two Tokens.
And the last Five Elements Fire Command had not yet appeared.
In Bai Yi’s view, if the two of them conspired together to attack Demon Lord Wan Mo, it was certainly to snatch the Five Elements Water Command.
Moreover, with the Five Elements Water Command, they would have three Tokens, and with the help of a secret technique, they could track the trace of the Five Elements Fire Command.
Once they possessed four Tokens, they would undoubtedly come looking for him.
Or perhaps, they might even choose to confront him directly first.
Therefore, Bai Yi felt somewhat agitated.
Originally, his relationship with Demon Lord Wan Mo had been quite good, and they each possessed a Token, which would allow them to look out for each other after entering the Five Elements Ruins.
But now that Demon Lord Wan Mo was dead, it left only him to deal with Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist, putting himself in danger.
Even at the moment, he did not feel safe.
If the two of them truly joined forces against him, he would certainly not be a match for them, and his only option would be to try to escape.
But would Li Mingwu allow him to get away?
Having lived for so many years, Li Mingwu must have some unique methods that could pose a threat to him.
As for surrendering the Token to save his life?
Bai Yi would definitely not hand it over.
The Five Elements Ruins were key to his future, he naturally would not give them up, and if it came to the point where he had to, he would not let Li Mingwu have them.
Even if it meant destroying the Token, he would do so without hesitation.
Of course.
If it wasn’t absolutely necessary, he definitely would not take such a drastic measure.
Just as Bai Yi was immersed in his troubles, Yue Tian Island was suddenly swept by an extremely powerful Divine Sense.
Bai Yi, engrossed in thought, was suddenly startled.
“Could it be that they are coming?”
However.
Following that Divine Sense, another voice transmitted:
“Fellow Daoist Bai, I am Yan Yujiang.
I wish to discuss a matter with you.”
This voice instantly calmed Bai Yi quite a bit.
Bai Yi knew who Yan Yujiang was, the real name of the Yan Family patriarch.
However, Bai Yi was still very puzzled and did not know why the Yan Family patriarch would come to him at this time.
Following the voice, two figures appeared at the entrance of Yue Tian Hall.
Those who appeared were none other than the Yan Family patriarch and Lin Jing.
The two of them did not ascend the steps but flew directly over.
Yue Tian Hall had rules against flying, which applied only to other Cultivators.
For Yan Yujiang, a Divine Transformation Cultivator like Bai Yi, those rules were naturally as good as non-existent.
And when Bai Yi saw the two individuals, he hurried over.
Upon reaching their side, Bai Yi first glanced at Lin Jing; however, he did not pay much attention and then turned to the Yan Family patriarch, saying,
“Yan friend, why do you visit so suddenly today?”
The Yan Family patriarch looked at Bai Yi and then spoke:
“Bai friend, I’ll get straight to the point.
My visit here is to propose a partnership with you.”
“A partnership?”
Bai Yi looked at the Yan Family patriarch, his face filled with confusion.
The Yan Family patriarch didn’t waste any words and took out a green token from his Space Ring, then said,
“I’m sure you understand what this means, Bai friend.”
Upon seeing the token, Bai Yi’s pupils suddenly dilated.
He was utterly shocked and couldn’t help but exclaim,
“The Five Elements Wood Command!!!”
“How did this Five Elements Wood Command end up in your hands?”
But the Yan Family patriarch simply said,
“I suppose you must have thought that this Five Elements Wood Command was in Li Mingwu’s possession, right?”
Bai Yi looked at the Yan Family patriarch and nodded:
“Yes…”
“I thought the Five Elements Wood Command had been taken by Li Mingwu…”
At that point, Bai Yi suddenly paused.
He suddenly remembered an incident from the Bihai City Trade Fair ten years ago.
At the trade fair, the Yan Family patriarch showed particular care for one of the juniors who appeared there.
And the junior who appeared at that trade fair…
Bai Yi instantly realized, and then looked at Lin Jing by the side of the Yan Family patriarch:
“It was you!”
After saying this, he turned back to the Yan Family patriarch and suddenly said,
“This Lin Jing, he’s your man!”
The Yan Family patriarch smiled, not answering.
However…
In Bai Yi’s eyes, this was clearly an expression indicating everything was within his control.
This made Bai Yi even more convinced that this was the Yan Family patriarch’s strategy.
“Presumably, Bai friend, you already know Li Mingwu and Long Daoist have formed an alliance, and if we want to enter the Five Elements Ruins, we will inevitably have to cooperate with them,” said the Yan Family patriarch.
“Therefore, I want to form an alliance with Bai friend, to jointly contend against them.”
“How do you consider it, Bai friend?”
Upon hearing the Yan Family patriarch’s intention to form an alliance, Bai Yi did not agree immediately.
Instead, he frowned and pondered deeply.
After a moment of contemplation, Bai Yi looked up, once again facing the Yan Family patriarch, and then asked:
“Yan friend…”
“I would like to know, how long have you been plotting this?”
“Also, regarding the matter of the Demon Lord Wan Mo, whether you knew in advance, and how did you come to know of the alliance between Li Mingwu and Long Daoist?”
After listening, the Yan Family patriarch spoke directly:
“Firstly, my involvement in this matter was coincidental; I have not planned it for very long.”
“Secondly…”
“The fall of Demon Lord Wan Mo was something I learned from someone else after the fact,” he said.
While saying this, the Yan Family patriarch glanced at Lin Jing specifically, and Bai Yi also followed the Yan Family patriarch’s gaze, looking towards Lin Jing.
He immediately understood that it was naturally Lin Jing who had told the Yan Family patriarch about it.
Then, the Yan Family patriarch continued:
“As for the alliance between Li Mingwu and Long Daoist, that has become quite apparent now.”
“The Five Elements Wood Command is in my hands; Long Daoist does not possess a command token.
To enter the Five Elements Ruins, he will need to find another way.”
“And I heard that the Demon Lord Wan Mo had quite a good relationship with you.
Long Daoist needed a command token, Li Mingwu needed an ally, so the two struck a deal and made their move on Demon Lord Wan Mo,” he said.
ƝονǤօ.ᴄᴑ
“Not only did this weaken you by removing a potential ally, but it also strengthened their power.”
“It was truly killing several birds with one stone,” the Yan Family patriarch said.
At this point, the Yan Family patriarch paused for a moment, then looked at Bai Yi with a hint of puzzlement,
“What I don’t understand is, given the enmity that seems to exist between you and Li Mingwu, why didn’t he move against you first?”
Bai Yi, however, looked at Lin Jing and then said helplessly,
“Apparently, it’s because they thought that the Five Elements Wood Command was in the hands of the Demon Lord.”
“Just like I had always believed that it had been taken by him…”

chapters.title: Chapter 681
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 681: Chapter 294: Preparations Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins Chapter 681: Chapter 294: Preparations Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins “I have now told you everything.”
“What do you think?”
“Will you form an alliance with me, or do you plan to face Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist alone?”
After the Yan Family ancestor finished speaking, he looked at Bai Yi, waiting for Bai Yi’s response.
After hearing this, Bai Yi, facing the Yan Family ancestor, smiled and said:
“There’s no need to even say it, I naturally choose to form an alliance with you, Yan Dao friend.”
“The situation is very clear now, if the two of us don’t form an alliance, we are definitely not their match.
Only by uniting can we contend with them.”
As soon as Bai Yi’s words fell, the Yan Family ancestor corrected:
“Not two, but three of us.”
“Three?”
Bai Yi was quite puzzled, looking at the Yan Family ancestor, and for a moment he couldn’t react.
ɴοѵǤᴑ.сο
However,
the Yan Family ancestor then looked towards Lin Jing standing nearby.
Following the Yan Family ancestor’s gaze, Bai Yi saw Lin Jing just taking out a fiery red token from his space ring.
“The Five Elements Fire Command!”
The moment he saw the token, Bai Yi was immediately dumbfounded.
...
He hadn’t expected that the missing Five Elements Fire Command was actually in Lin Jing’s hands.
After a moment, Bai Yi came to his senses, looked back at the Yan Family ancestor with a face full of admiration:
“I can’t believe that the long-lost Five Elements Fire Command has been with you all this time.”
“Yan Dao friend!”
“Indeed, the older, the wiser, you truly are deserving of praise.”
Apparently, Bai Yi thought that the Five Elements Fire Command had been obtained by the Yan Family ancestor, and he didn’t suspect Lin Jing.
After all,
in his view, Lin Jing was only at the Nascent Soul Stage, and he hadn’t been in the Southern Outer Sea for long.
It was impossible for him to have planned so early, or to have obtained the Five Elements Fire Command.
He only thought that the Five Elements Fire Command must have been obtained by the Yan Family ancestor long before, and that Lin Jing was also a subordinate of the Yan Family ancestor.
In Bai Yi’s eyes, all this was planned by the Yan Family ancestor.
…
Subsequently, the Yan Family ancestor spoke:
“It was just good luck, obtained by chance.”
The Yan Family ancestor didn’t explain further.
And Bai Yi didn’t care, but instead said:
“Yan Dao friend, you plan to let Lin Jing enter the Five Elements Ruins with us, just…”
Bai Yi paused here, looking at Lin Jing, then somewhat hesitantly said:
“It’s just, his cultivation…”
Then, he turned to the Yan Family ancestor, saying:
“I presume you’re aware, Yan Dao friend, that this time, we’re facing Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist.”
“Though our cultivation levels can contend with them, Lin Jing’s cultivation is clearly insufficient.
If we really encounter a special situation, I’m afraid even if we want to protect him, it might be too late.”
Hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor instead laughed:
“Bai Dao friend, there’s no need to worry.”
After saying this, the Yan Family ancestor directly addressed Lin Jing:
“Since we’ve already formed an alliance, there’s no need to keep secrets from Bai Dao friend any longer.”
Lin Jing nodded and then released his cultivation, allowing his aura to climb until it stopped at the early Divinity Transformation Stage.
“Bai Dao friend, I had already reached the Divinity Transformation Stage decades ago, but due to certain reasons, it was kept secret.
I hope you don’t take offense, Bai Dao friend.”
“As for facing Li Mingwu, although I may not be a match for him, it’s certainly not easy for him to defeat me.
You don’t need to worry about this matter, Bai Dao friend.”
This had been agreed upon with the Yan Family ancestor before on the small island, and in facing Bai Yi, it was natural to reveal his cultivation to put him at ease.
Lin Jing’s sudden release of cultivation aura truly shocked Bai Yi, but seeing the Yan Family ancestor standing beside Lin Jing, he immediately understood.
After all, the Yan Family ancestor was also an old monster who had lived for over a thousand years, and although he usually didn’t show off, no one dared to underestimate him.
This was certainly a plan prepared in advance by him.
Then,
the Yan Family ancestor also looked towards Bai Yi, saying:
“Bai Dao friend, do you have any further objections?”
Bai Yi, with a smile, said:
“It seems that Yan Dao friend was well-prepared in advance, since this is your arrangement, I naturally have no objections.”
After finishing, Bai Yi again addressed the Yan Family ancestor:
“Yan Dao friend!”
“Since we’re allied, shouldn’t we first exchange some information?
I want to know how much Yan Dao friend knows about the Five Elements Ruins?”
“No problem, naturally, that is necessary…”
The Yan Family ancestor replied.
“Very well then!”
“Please follow me, Dao friends.”
Saying this, Bai Yi gestured with his hand, guiding the Yan Family ancestor and Lin Jing toward the inner hall of Yue Tian Hall.
In the inner hall of Yue Tian Hall was where Bai Yi usually lived and cultivated, and that place was also more suitable for discussion.
And the Yan Family ancestor didn’t mind, directly following Bai Yi toward the inner hall of Yue Tian Hall.
Lin Jing also followed closely, heading to the inner hall.
…
…
The next day,
news spread from Yue Tian Island that Bai Yi invited the Island Master of True Dragon Island, the Dragon Taoist, to the island to discuss an important matter.
But after the news was released, there was no response, and it seemed the Dragon Taoist wasn’t even on True Dragon Island.
Having waited a whole day and seen that the Dragon Taoist didn’t respond,
Bai Yi released a second message.
It stated that everything the Dragon Taoist wanted was in his own hands, and if he didn’t come, then he would just have to deal with it himself.
Soon after the message was released, the Dragon Taoist indeed came.
And,
with him was a mysterious old man with a concealed identity, the two of them arriving at Yue Tian Island together.
The matter of the Five Elements Ruins was originally not to be disclosed.
As for Li Mingwu, he was even less likely to reveal his true form.
Therefore, they could only use this method to bring Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist together.

chapters.title: Chapter 682
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 682: Chapter 294: Preparations Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins_2 Chapter 682: Chapter 294: Preparations Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins_2 Li Mingwu had also concealed himself.
After Dragon Daoist led that mysterious elder into Yue Tian Hall, they stayed for most of the day before departing with the mysterious elder.
As for what was discussed in Yue Tian Hall, other than those who were present at the time, I’m afraid no one else knew.
…
Time quickly passed, and half a month flew by.
Half a month ago, after Lin Jing left Yue Tian Island, he immediately went to Bihai City and brought several people back with him.
Now that all the discussions were completed, and Lin Jing’s crisis was temporarily resolved, it was time to bring them back.
...
After returning, Lin Jing did not continue his cultivation; instead, he made some Elixir Medicine and then made some preparations.
In this way, until recently, he had finished all his preparations.
Originally,
When Dragon Daoist took Li Mingwu to Yue Tian Island, those who were there had discussed entering the Five Elements Ruins together for most of the day, eventually coming to a conclusion.
That was, half a month later, they would go to the Five Elements Cave Mansion together and enter the Five Elements Ruins from there.
Before this, any grievances would be temporarily set aside.
After all, the strength of both parties was similar, and if a fight really broke out, it would inevitably lead to a lose-lose situation.
Now their only option was to cooperate with each other to maximize the benefits for both.
However,
before this, they each had to prepare.
Therefore, they set the half-month period, which was today.
Today, Lin Jing had already finished his preparations.
Now, he only needed to inform a few people on Flame Island, and they would immediately start their journey to the Five Elements Ruins.
Coming out of System Space, Lin Jing appeared directly in the Alchemy Room of his small courtyard.
Following,
Lin Jing shut down the Alchemy Room’s Formation, then walked straight out of the Alchemy Room, and after leaving the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing directly extended his Divine Sense.
This powerful Divine Sense unfolded, immediately enveloping the entire Flame Island.
At the same time, Lin Jing also found out the current situation of several people.
Li Qingqing’s Alchemy Room in the small courtyard had its Formation activated; it seemed like she was likely engaging in Alchemy.
And Lin Jue was currently in the City Lord’s Mansion of Li Yan City, discussing city affairs with Yue Qiniang.
Ye Yun was not in his own small courtyard.
However, it was normal for him not to be in the courtyard.
Because Ye Yun spent most of his time cultivating, and it was likely no different now.
Thus, Lin Jing directly invoked his Divine Sense, probing towards the cave near the Earthflame Spring on the island, and at the edge of the Spring in the depths of the cave, Lin Jing found Ye Yun’s neatly stacked clothes.
Lin Jing guessed correctly; Ye Yun had again entered the Earthflame Spring for Body Refinement.
This Earthflame Spring, Lin Jing had not been down for a long time.
At Lin Jing’s level, the Earthflame Spring’s enhancement was minimal, virtually useless.
Whether he went down or not was naturally inconsequential.
After checking on everyone, Lin Jing did not find Li Tanyu nor Bai Zhi.
The two were not on the island and their whereabouts were unknown.
Following,
Lin Jing left the mountain top and appeared directly at Li Yan City Lord’s Mansion.
As soon as Lin Jing arrived, he caught the attention of Lin Jue and Yue Qiniang.
When the two saw that the newcomer was Lin Jing, they immediately relaxed.
“Island Master!”
“Brother!”
The two greeted Lin Jing one after the other.
“Brother, are you finished with your busy work?”
Lin Jing nodded, then stepped forward and spoke to Yue Qiniang,
“Qiniang!”
“Ever since we obliterated Dai Mao and obtained Flame Island, you have been continuously busy, helping to establish Li Yan City and Fang Market.”
“You even managed the early stages of cultivating and managing the Spirit Fields.”
“For thisâ€¦”
“you have even sacrificed quite a lot of your Cultivation time; these days have indeed been hard on you.”
Upon hearing this, Yue Qiniang hurriedly clasped her hands,
“Island Master, you give me too much credit.
You helped me and all the native Cultivators on our island escape from Dai Mao’s grasp, and you even actively developed Flame Island.”
“You have improved our living standards considerably and also rewarded us with numerous Cultivation resources, advancing our Cultivation dramatically, and thus completely freeing us from oppression.”
“If anything, we should be the ones thanking you.”
The situation on Flame Island is actually quite rare.
Other islands almost covet collecting all Cultivation resources for themselves.
ƝονǤ0.сο
Only Lin Jing is different; he himself is not lacking Cultivation resources, and he has little regard for those lower-tier resources.
Moreover, Lin Jing regularly concocts large batches of Elixir Medicine to level up his Alchemy Technique and to collect Harvest Points.
Some of these Elixir Medicines are sold in the Flame Elixir Pavilion, and some are handed to Yue Qiniang to distribute according to each person’s contribution to Flame Island.
Even the Cultivation True Elixir provided by Lin Jing is included.
With the Cultivation True Elixir, advancing to the Golden Core Stage became possible.
With the hope of advancing, the Cultivators on Flame Island became even more diligent.
Latterly, under the arrangements made by Lin Jing, Spirit Fields were opened and many Spirit Plants were planted.
Flame Island itself cultivated some Alchemists who then used the Spirit Plants from the fields to make more Elixir Medicines.
Once Flame Island was on the right track, the entire island became abundant in resources.
Thus, compared to the time when Dai Mao was in charge, Flame Island is now much better.
The Cultivators on Flame Island have also made the other surrounding islands quite envious.

chapters.title: Chapter 683
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 683: Chapter 294 Preparation Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins_3 Chapter 683: Chapter 294 Preparation Before Entering the Five Elements Ruins_3 …
Lin Jing raised his hand to interrupt Yue Qiniang:
“No matter what, Flame Island wouldn’t be the same without you, you truly played an indispensable role.”
With that, Lin Jing took out a jade vial from the Space Ring and handed it over to Yue Qiniang.
“This Elixir Medicine is for you.”
“Find a place later and take it directly.”
Seeing that Lin Jing brought Elixir Medicine, Yue Qiniang did not decline and reached out to take it.
In her mind, she assumed it to be some sort of cultivation-improving Elixir Medicine.
However, out of curiosity, Yue Qiniang still asked:
“Island Master, what kind of Elixir Medicine is this?”
Lin Jing then spoke, his tone quite casual:
“It’s a Cleansing Spirit Elixir, it has a certain chance of enhancing your Spirit Root Aptitude.”
The words of Lin Jing left Yue Qiniang momentarily stunned, rooted to the spot.
A Cleansing Spirit Elixir, Yue Qiniang was somewhat bewildered, not expecting Lin Jing to actually give her such an elixir.
While Yue Qiniang was still in a daze, Lin Jing continued to speak:
“Oh, and…”
“This Elixir Medicine is precious, don’t let word of it get out.”It wasn’t until Lin Jing finished speaking that Yue Qiniang came to her senses, looking at the jade vial in her hands, her hands clutching the vial were trembling uncontrollably.
...
Ɲοѵǥ0.сο
Before meeting Lin Jing, Yue Qiniang had suffered a lot and endured much hardship.
All of that was because of her own aptitude.
Even her desire to seek revenge for her family was hampered by her own aptitude, which led to her slow progress in cultivation, turning it into a pipe dream.
This situation changed only after she met Lin Jing,
After meeting Lin Jing, Yue Qiniang had broken through from the late stage of Foundation Establishment to the mid-stage of Golden Core.
The improvement in cultivation brought changes to her life and made her family’s revenge no longer just a distant dream.
Therefore, she was always very grateful to Lin Jing.
But now, Lin Jing had brought out an Elixir Medicine that could change her aptitude.
This was an Elixir Medicine she had longed for, for a very long time.
If she had encountered such an Elixir Medicine before meeting Lin Jing, she would have done anything to obtain it, even resorting to the most despicable means if necessary.
For no other reason than her Spirit Root Aptitude had tormented her for far too long.
But now…
Yue Qiniang looked at the Elixir Medicine, hesitating for a moment, her eyes also showing a hint of reluctance, knowing what taking this pill would mean for her.
After hesitating, however, she handed the jade vial back to Lin Jing:
“Island Master…”
“This Elixir Medicine is too precious, I dare not accept it.”
“It seems wasteful just to give it to me, it should be given to Lin Jue and Ye Yun to take.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing looked at Yue Qiniang:
“You needn’t think so little of yourself, this Spirit Pill is specifically reserved for you.”
“As for Lin Jue and Ye Yun, they have already taken it.”
No sooner had Lin Jing’s voice faded than Lin Jue directly reached out to press Yue Qiniang’s hand back:
“Sister Yue, just accept it.”
“We’ve already taken ours.”
Yue Qiniang looked at Lin Jing and Lin Jue, hesitated for a while, and then nodded her head.
Lin Jing then spoke directly:
“Alright!”
“Find a quiet place now and refine and absorb this Elixir Medicine.”
“I have some matters to discuss with Lin Jue.”
After hearing this, Yue Qiniang nodded:
“Very well, Island Master.”
“Then I will take my leave now.”
Having said that, Yue Qiniang gave Lin Jing a bowed salute and then withdrew.

chapters.title: Chapter 684
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 684: Chapter 295: Ling Yi Dies, Advances to the Main Hall Chapter 684: Chapter 295: Ling Yi Dies, Advances to the Main Hall After Yue Qiniang left, Lin Jing took out several small jade vials and handed them to Lin Jue.
“Inside these, there are two Supreme Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, along with several Superior and Medium Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs.”
“Give one of the Supreme Grade Cleansing Spirit Elixirs to Li Tanyu and one to Zhang Jian.”
“I will be leaving soon, and after I leave, you can just hand the Cleansing Spirit Elixirs to them.”
“As for the other grades of Cleansing Spirit Elixirs, you can distribute them as you see fit.
If you want to sell them, that’s also an option, just be careful.”
Lin Jing had told Lin Jue and the others about his plan to venture into the ruins.
However,
due to the importance of the matter, Lin Jing did not tell them much, only that he would explore the ruins with others and would be away for some time.
As Lin Jing finished speaking, Lin Jue quickly looked at him, his eyes full of worries:
“Ah?”
“Brother, are you leaving now?”
“Yes,” Lin Jing nodded.
ƝονǤο.ƈ0
“Won’t you say goodbye to Qing Qing and the others?” Lin Jue then asked.
...
Lin Jing shook his head:
“No…”
“I have already told them before, I will not disturb them this time.”
“This departure, I don’t know how long it will take.”
“During the time I am away, Li Yan Island will be in your care.”
Although Lin Jue was reluctant, he knew Lin Jing had to go, so he did not say anything more, but his eyes were still filled with worry.
Lin Jing then reassured Lin Jue with a smile, ensuring he would be careful and telling her not to worry.
After calming Lin Jue, Lin Jing and Lin Jue walked out of the City Lord’s Mansion together.
Lin Jing was about to leave after bidding farewell to Lin Jue.
Just at that moment, a figure appeared in the skyline, quickly approaching Li Yan Island.
This figure had not yet reached Li Yan Island, but Lin Jing had already noticed it.
Lin Jing looked up toward the horizon.
Even though it was very far away, Lin Jing was very familiar with that figure; it was the Yan Family elder.
In but a moment, the Yan Family elder arrived at Li Yan Island.
“Senior!”
Upon seeing the Yan Family elder’s arrival, Lin Jing hurriedly greeted him respectfully.
At the same time, Lin Jue also bowed with Lin Jing:
“We have seen the senior!”
The Yan Family elder first nodded at Lin Jue, then addressed Lin Jing:
“Since we are both cultivators of the same rank, you really need not call me senior.”
Lin Jing respectfully said:
“Not only have you greatly favored me, junior, but you are also a senior of Brother Yan, so you deserve this title.”
In the entire Cultivation World, cultivators of the same rank generally address each other as Dao friends.
However, there are some exceptions, such as those older, highly esteemed cultivators.
Even if later generations advance to the same rank, many would still prefer to address them as seniors.
Especially those seniors who have helped them personally, calling them senior is a way to show respect.
This is no longer about Cultivation.
The Yan Family elder had indeed treated Lin Jing well, even blocking Li Mingwu and Dragon Daoist from causing him trouble half a month ago.
Therefore, Lin Jing held great respect for the Yan Family elder.
The Yan Family elder, hearing this, just smiled and said nothing more.
Afterward,
the Yan Family elder spoke to Lin Jing:
“Shall we leave now?”
Lin Jing nodded.
Then Lin Jing and Lin Jue waved goodbye, and he went with the Yan Family elder toward Yue Tian Island.
…
When the two arrived at Yue Tian Island, the other three were already there.
However, the aura around Bai Yi and Li Mingwu seemed off, as if they had just been through a fight.
The Yan Family elder noticed the tense atmosphere and frowned as he spoke to them:
“Didn’t we agree half a month ago?”
“Whatever grievances there are, they need to be set aside before entering the Five Elements Ruins.
What’s going on with you two?”
Li Mingwu’s gaze was chilly as he looked at Bai Yi and then spoke:
“We had agreed that we would each prepare for entering the Five Elements Ruins.”
“Yet Bai Yi took the opportunity to find Ling Yi and killed him.”
“What?”
“Do you really disregard our prior agreement?”
Bai Yi replied with a cold face:
“Since Ling Yi dared to betray me, naturally I couldn’t let him live.”
“This matter has nothing to do with our previous agreement.”
Seemingly emboldened by the presence of the Yan Family elder, Bai Yi looked at Li Mingwu:
“If you are not satisfied, we can fight it out first, determine the winner, and then enter the Five Elements Ruins.”
Hearing this, Li Mingwu’s gaze became even chillier as he stared at Bai Yi, his aura rising.
Ling Yi, although just a subordinate, had shown great respect and had done much for him.
Although Li Mingwu was also a cold-hearted person, such a loyal subordinate was rare, and he valued him highly, intending to nurture him.
Now that Ling Yi had been slain by Bai Yi, Li Mingwu was naturally enraged.
Especially since Bai Yi, after allying with the Yan Family elder, seemed to disregard him.
This made Li Mingwu even more inclined to eliminate Bai Yi.
At this point,
the Yan Family elder spoke up, attempting to mediate:
“Enough!”
“The two of you calm down for now, and let’s discuss this after we exit the ruins.”
Having said this, the Yan Family elder continued:
“This venture into the Five Elements Ruins is of great importance, and I assume you wouldn’t want any mishaps before we enter.”

chapters.title: Chapter 685
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 685: Chapter 295: Ling Yi Dies, Advances to the Main Hall_2 Chapter 685: Chapter 295: Ling Yi Dies, Advances to the Main Hall_2 “Additionally…”
“The situation inside the ruins is complex, and there might be dangers within.”
“If you really fight here and get injured, entering the ruins afterward could be fatal.”
“After all, none of us have been inside the Five Elements Ruins before, and we are all unclear about the specific conditions inside.”
As the Yan Family elder’s words fell, seeing that both men had fallen silent, it was evident from their eyes that they still harbored anger.
Seeing them like this, the Yan Family elder spoke again:
“We are all here to advance further, to ascend to the Solidifying Body Realm.
This opportunity might be the only one we encounter in our lifetime.”
“That’s all I have to say, I’ve said everything that needs to be said.”
“If you really insist on fighting now, then please go ahead.”
After the Yan Family elder finished speaking, the True Dragon Island’s master, Dragon Daoist, also stepped forward to persuade.
“Friend Yan is right.
This opportunity is rare.
Whatever grievances you have, can be resolved after returning from the ruins.”
Meanwhile, Lin Jing stood by and said nothing.
Following their advice, Li Mingwu temporarily set aside the matter and coldly said to Bai Yi:
“This matter, let’s set it aside for now.”“After this exploration of the ruins is over, I will seek justice for Ling Yi.”
Bai Yi also huffed coldly and said:
“Hmph!”
“Then I’ll be waiting for you.”
Ling Yi, this gentleman, had done much for Li Mingwu, originally tricking numerous people into the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm at the trade conference.
...
Even Lin Jing was unintentionally involved in this scheme.
Moreover, he had been undercover beside Bai Yi for many years, using the identity of Xue Yilin, ostensibly helping Bai Yi while actually secretly assisting Li Mingwu.
Naturally, Bai Yi was extremely annoyed and wanted to eliminate him swiftly.
Now, with Ling Yi ultimately dying at the hands of Bai Yi, it could be said he brought it upon himself.
Lin Jing felt no regret either.
…
Having temporarily calmed the two men, the group then set off together towards the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Before long, they arrived at the edge of Yue Tian Island, at the Teleportation Array leading to the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Since the last time they used it, this Teleportation Array had been sealed by Bai Yi.
Upon arrival, Bai Yi once again took action, unsealing the Formation of the Teleportation Array.
After that, the group entered the Teleportation Array one by one and passed through it to enter the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
The others entered first, while Lin Jing was the last one to step into the Teleportation Array.
After Lin Jing stepped into the Teleportation Array, a flash of light followed.
Then, a tearing force was felt, and Lin Jing also disappeared in the light.
Transporting into the Five Elements Cave Mansion was the same as last time, still within the Spirit Field.
And the mist remained thick.
Seeing Lin Jing had transported over, a few looked at Lin Jing and then turned around, heading into the white mist.
When they looked at Lin Jing just now, Li Mingwu’s gaze was particularly hostile.
ƝονǤο.с0
Not only Li Mingwu, but even the Dragon Daoist had unfriendly eyes when looking at Lin Jing.
Half a month ago, Bai Yi delivered information that led Li Mingwu and the Dragon Daoist to Yue Tian Island to discuss matters of the Five Elements Ruins.
It was that discussion that enlightened them on many things.
They also realized that all of this was because of Lin Jing’s meddling, and Li Mingwu understood the reason for his failure.
At that time, Li Mingwu had made a meticulous plan, which could be said to be flawless, but it was due to Lin Jing that he was completely exposed, forcing him to flee in disarray.
Originally, after killing the Demon Lord Wan Mo, both Li Mingwu and the master of True Dragon Island indeed suspected Lin Jing.
Originally, they indeed planned to find troubles with Lin Jing after healing.
But before they could act, they first received the news dispatched by Bai Yi.
Although Lin Jing indeed admitted everything.
However, all of this was arranged by the Yan Family elder, and with Lin Jing under the protection of the Yan Family elder, they could no longer touch Lin Jing.
…
Passing through the white mist, the group once again arrived at the entrance of the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
The Formation here had already been opened by the group last time, so this time, they directly entered.
The group stood at the entrance and looked inside.
The Five Elements Cave Mansion remained much the same as last time.
“Let’s go.”
After observing for a while, the Yan Family elder spoke and said to the group.
The group nodded and said:
“Let’s go!”
Afterward, several people followed the path they had broken through last time, heading towards the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
Since they were taking the old route they had traveled before, without any formations blocking their way, their speed was much faster.
In less than an hour, they had arrived at the square in the middle of the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
At that moment,
Li Mingwu first glanced at the side, where the Wood Hall Formation had been opened, his brows slightly furrowed.
He had been unable to enter this Wood Hall last time, which had left him quite regretful.
After looking over, Li Mingwu once again coldly glanced at Lin Jing.
It seemed that Li Mingwu harbored a deep grudge concerning the events of the last time.
However,
this action of his was naturally noticed by the elder of the Yan Family nearby.
The elder of the Yan Family looked at Li Mingwu and spoke out to remind him,
“Li fellow cultivator, right now we should focus on the Five Elements Ruins.”
“Let the past be the past.”
Li Mingwu heard this and looked towards the elder of the Yan Family.
At that moment, although the elder of the Yan Family was smiling, his eyes were full of warning.
Clearly, he was warning Li Mingwu not to think about acting against Lin Jing.
Li Mingwu was silent for a moment, then nodded.
Then he turned to look towards the back of the square at the majestic main hall.
At that moment,
in front of the Five Elements main hall, there was a huge formation.
This formation differed from the previous ones; it was laid out with a pentagram in the center, extending to the edges of the formation.
At each point of the pentagram, there was a raised stone platform, whose shape resembled that of the Five Elements Command Token.
Clearly, this was the place meant for placing the Five Elements Command Tokens.
The method of opening this Five Elements main hall required five cultivators, each holding a Command Token, to open it.
Upon seeing this formation, they immediately understood what was going on.
And at that moment, Li Mingwu spoke,
“Each of us should stand at the position that corresponds to our respective elements and then place the token on the raised stone platform and channel spiritual power into the token.”
“Shall we start now?”
“Alright, let’s begin then.” The elder of the Yan Family also echoed.
Following that, several people stepped forward, coming up to the formation.
Once they reached the formation, everyone scattered, walking towards their respective positions.
The raised stone platforms were each a different color, corresponding exactly to the Five Elements.
In Lin Jing’s hands was the Five Elements Fire Command.
Thus, he directly went and stood next to the red stone platform.
At that time, the others had also reached their respective positions.
Then, Li Mingwu made the first move; he took out the token and placed it on top of the stone platform, fitting perfectly into the stone.
At the same time, the others did the same,
placing their tokens on the stone platforms in front of them.
Once the tokens were placed, the entire formation immediately underwent a change.
Lights of various colors spread from the platforms, continuously spreading throughout the formation.
However, the spreading speed of the light was not fast.
At this moment, Li Mingwu spoke to the others,
“Everyone, it’s starting…”
“We input spiritual power, remember to maintain balance, otherwise, if the spiritual power becomes imbalanced, the formation will seal itself.”
“If it gets sealed, then we’re really in trouble.”
