Sure enough, Li Mingwu knew even this, his understanding of the Five Elements Cave Mansion was probably unmatched by anyone else.
As Li Mingwu’s words faded, the others began to circulate their cultivation techniques, gathering spiritual power, converging it above the token in front of them.
As they inputted their spiritual power, the spreading of those colorful lights suddenly accelerated significantly.
Before long, that spiritual power covered the entire formation.
When the light covered the entire formation, the colorful light instantly transformed into a beam of light shooting straight into the sky.
At that moment, the tokens that had originally fit into the stone platforms popped out, caught quickly by everyone.
Then, Li Mingwu swept a glance over the others and spoke,
“Alright…”
“The teleportation array leading to the Five Elements main hall is now usable.”
“So, who’s going in first?”

chapters.title: Chapter 686
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 686: Chapter 296: Cunning Dragon Taoist, Exchanging Maps Chapter 686: Chapter 296: Cunning Dragon Taoist, Exchanging Maps Li Mingwu finished speaking, swept his gaze around the room, and finally rested on Lin Jing.
After that.
Li Mingwu turned his head to the Yan Family’s senior ancestor and said,
“Yan Daoyou, didn’t you say before that the Five Elements main hall poses no danger, and that Lin Daoyou has even gone inside once?”
“How about letting Lin Daoyou go in first this time?”
Upon hearing this, the Yan Family’s senior ancestor frowned slightly and then looked at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing nodded to the Yan Family’s senior ancestor and then opened his mouth to say,
“The Five Elements main hall indeed poses no danger.
Since Li Daoyou is worried, then let me go in first.”
Seeing this, the Yan Family’s senior ancestor also nodded slightly to Lin Jing:
“Alright.”
“Then you go ahead.”
“But, be extremely careful,” the Yan Family’s senior ancestor added after finishing his sentence as a reminder.
Lin Jing nodded and then walked towards the Formation in the middle under everyone’s watchful eyes.
Just as he stood firm within the Formation, Lin Jing immediately felt the pulling force of the teleportation.
...
As the pulling force grew stronger, within moments, Lin Jing’s entire form vanished from the Formation, teleported away.
…
Inside the Five Elements main hall.
The Teleportation Array at the entrance, silent for many years, suddenly lit up with a glow, growing brighter and brighter.
Not until it illuminated the entire main hall did the light slowly fade away.
When the light had completely dissipated, Lin Jing appeared above the Formation.
Returning to the Five Elements main hall, Lin Jing first swept his gaze around.
The main hall hadn’t changed at all, it was still the same as before.
The three platforms which had lost their function still stood there.
And behind the platforms, the gigantic statue of the Five Elements Ancestor still stood tall and imposing.
Following that.
Ɲονɡᴑ.сο
Lin Jing walked out of the Formation and headed towards the statue.
After making a round around the statue, Lin Jing came behind it, where the Teleportation Array to the Five Elements Ruins was located.
This Formation was also unchanged from last time.
After making a round of the great hall, Lin Jing then returned to the front, waiting for another person to enter.
It wasn’t long before.
The Teleportation Array lit up once more, and after the light faded, another person appeared.
This person was none other than the True Dragon Island’s Island Master, Dragon Daoren.
Upon entering, Dragon Daoren first swept his gaze around and then looked towards Lin Jing at the front.
Then.
He walked over to Lin Jing.
Even though Dragon Daoren seemed harmless at that moment, Lin Jing still kept his guard up in secret.
Approaching Lin Jing, Dragon Daoren appraised him for a moment then spoke,
“Lin Daoyou, the last time I saw you, you were still at the Nascent Soul Stage.
I didn’t expect you to have reached Divinity Transformation by now.”
“Such speed is truly astonishing.”
“It seems you’ve encountered quite a few fortunes, Lin Daoyou.”
For some reason, as he talked, Dragon Daoren took a step closer, shortening the distance between them and Lin Jing.
Lin Jing’s brows furrowed slightly, then he discreetly stepped back two paces and spoke,
“Dragon Daoyou jests.
To reach the Cultivation of Divinity Transformation, which of us hasn’t had great fortunes?
“Even you, Dragon Daoren, must have had your share of opportunities.”
Seeing Lin Jing step back, Dragon Daoren didn’t come any closer but instead took a step back and laughed:
“What Lin Daoyou said is true.”
“Anyone who has reached our realm must have had great fortunes.”
“It was a lapse of judgment on my part, apologies…”
“It doesn’t matter,” Lin Jing replied succinctly.
Following that.
Lin Jing no longer paid attention to Dragon Daoren, who, knowing when to back off, didn’t say anything further.
The two of them just continued to watch the Teleportation Array.
Before long, the Teleportation Array glowed once again, signifying that another person had been teleported in.
This time, the one who was teleported in was Bai Yi.
After entering, just like Dragon Daoren, Bai Yi first scanned the entire great hall.
After scanning, he then looked towards the two men.
Next, Bai Yi walked towards them.
After approaching, Bai Yi came to stand beside Lin Jing.
Then.
Bai Yi leaned in close to Lin Jing and spoke,
“Dragon Daoren may seem harmless, but in fact, he’s the most scheming of all, and he’s also skilled at divination, knowing how to seek advantage and avoid harm.
You must be extra cautious around him.”
When Bai Yi said this, he didn’t lower his voice deliberately; on the contrary, he looked provocatively at Dragon Daoren.
Obviously, his words were a warning to Lin Jing, as well as a jab at Dragon Daoren.
Dragon Daoren’s face turned sour upon hearing Bai Yi’s words.
He spoke directly, his voice cold, to Bai Yi,
“Bai Daoyou, although I’ve formed an alliance with Li Mingwu, it’s merely to enter these Five Elements Ruins.”
“If because of this, you slander me, then I have nothing more to say.”
Bai Yi looked at Dragon Daoren with cold eyes and sneered,
“Heh…
whether it’s slander or not, you know very well in your heart.”
After Bai Yi spoke, the aura around both men surged instantly, setting them in opposition to each other…
…
…
Whether it was slander or not, not only Bai Yi and Dragon Daoren knew, but also in that moment, Lin Jing understood as well.
Originally.
When Dragon Daoren seemingly moved closer unintentionally, Lin Jing was already somewhat displeased and had therefore moved back.
Fortunately, Dragon Daoren did not continue to advance, and Lin Jing let it go.
However.
After Bai Yi’s comment, Lin Jing became instantly vigilant.
And as Bai Yi and Dragon Daoren faced off, Lin Jing quietly focused his Soul Spirit, meticulously scanning himself from head to toe.
After one thorough check, he discovered something unusual in one corner of his robe.
It was an extremely hidden and faint aura.
This aura was so well concealed that, were it not for the fact that Lin Jing’s own Cultivation was at the seventh layer of Divinity Transformation, and he had consumed the Jade Soul Algae, thereby enhancing his Soul Spirit a bit more,

chapters.title: Chapter 687
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 687: Chapter 296: Cunning Dragon Taoist, Exchanging Maps_2 Chapter 687: Chapter 296: Cunning Dragon Taoist, Exchanging Maps_2 That aura, he would never detect it.
Needless to say, that aura must have been stealthily left behind by Dragon Taoist when he approached just now.
The Dragon Taoist was very secretive, and he was also very cautious.
He did not leave that aura on Lin Jing’s body but rather on the hem of his clothes.
At that time, Lin Jing clearly had his guard up, yet he was still marked by the Dragon Taoist.
It had to be said that everything the Dragon Taoist did was indeed very covert.
It was exactly after discovering that aura, that Lin Jing believed in Bai Yi’s words.
...
This Dragon Taoist was not as he appeared to be but a sinister and cunning character.
Although he discovered that aura, Lin Jing did not make it known, nor did he remove it.
After all.
With the level of strength Lin Jing had shown, he should not have been able to detect that aura.
That’s why the Dragon Taoist could be so bold.
If he himself had removed the aura, that would have been problematic.
This aura, Lin Jing would keep it for now and consider it further upon entering the ruins.
Just as Bai Yi and Dragon Taoist were at odds, neither willing to give in, the teleportation array lit up once again.
This time, it was Li Mingwu who arrived.
After Li Mingwu came in, he said nothing and went straight towards the Dragon Taoist.
Not long after Li Mingwu was teleported in, the Yan Family Ancestor also arrived through teleportation.
With this, the five of them were all present.
After the Yan Family Ancestor entered, he glanced at the few people and then walked towards them.
At this moment.
Li Mingwu stepped forward and said to the Yan Family Ancestor:
“We agreed beforehand that once we arrived at this Five Elements Main Hall, we would exchange maps.
Shall we begin now?”
The Yan Family Ancestor looked at the few people and then nodded his head, saying:
“Yes, let’s start.”
With that, the Yan Family Ancestor directly took out a fragment of a map.
This map, was the very map fragment Lin Jing had obtained from the space ring of the Black Shark Gang Leader.
When the Yan Family Ancestor took out the map fragment, Bai Yi, Li Mingwu, and the Dragon Taoist also each took out their own maps.
The few of them had long coveted the Five Elements Ruins and were naturally very concerned about the map of the ruins.
Bai Yi had one fragment, Li Mingwu had two, and even the Dragon Taoist held a piece of the incomplete map.
After pulling out their maps, they one by one sent the map fragments forward, the pieces floating in front of them.
Then, under their control, the map fragments began to automatically piece together, eventually forming one complete map.
Though the map had fused together, it was still irregular in shape and appeared to be missing some parts.
So, the few of them gathered to observe it.
Li Mingwu, having examined the map, couldn’t help but frown deeply:
“This map is not complete, it’s missing a piece.”
Upon hearing his words, the others nodded in agreement.
“Indeed, what Li Daoyou said is correct.”
“The map does seem to lack a portion,” the Yan Family Ancestor also added.
But at this point, the Dragon Taoist turned to Lin Jing and spoke:
“Lin Daoyou!”
“When you entered this hall before, did you get only that one map fragment?”
After saying this, he turned his head to look at a stone platform beside him, and then spoke again:
“There are three stone platforms here.
Could there really be only one map fragment?”
Hearing the Dragon Taoist’s words, Li Mingwu also turned to look at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, frowned instantly and then spoke:
“I already mentioned half a month ago.”
“The items within this Five Elements Main Hall are related to the Five Elements Cultivation Technique I practice.
There was only that one piece of the map.”
After hearing this, the Dragon Taoist turned to the Yan Family Ancestor and said:
“Yan Daoyou!”
“It’s not that I don’t trust Lin Daoyou.”
“After all, he was the only one who entered this main hall at that time.
We don’t know what exactly was inside; we have only his word for it.”
“How about this?
Let’s have Lin Daoyou reveal what he obtained from this main hall for us all to see.”
“After seeing it, we will naturally be able to discern.”
“Otherwise, without evidence, how can we believe that the items on this stone platform are related to the Five Elements Cultivation Technique?”
At the same time, Li Mingwu too turned to look at Lin Jing.
Although he did not speak, his intent was clear to everyone.
Obviously, he too did not trust Lin Jing.
However.
Facing such a situation, Lin Jing simply spoke directly to them:
“On the statue’s finger behind you, there are a few lines of small characters.
Go take a look and you’ll understand.”
Being in the current predicament was within Lin Jing’s expectations, and even if they persisted, Lin Jing had a backup plan.
When he was on Spirit Rock Island, Lin Jing had a lengthy conversation with the Yan Family Ancestor.
There were contingency plans for all kinds of possible situations.
And the map obtained inside this main hall was not the incomplete map now assembled.
Lin Jing took out the complete map he had obtained from the main hall immediately after finding the Yan Family ancestor.
Even after looking over the map, the Yan Family ancestor made a copy.
Now, of this map, only Lin Jing and the Yan Family ancestor have a complete version, no one else does.
Even Bai Yi, the two had not shared the complete map with him.
…
This Five Elements Ruins is divided into six layers in total.
The first five are the Metal Realm, Wood Realm, Water Realm, Fire Realm, and Earth Realm.
Each of these realms occupies a separate layer, and one can only enter the next realm through a Teleportation Array.
After passing through the first five realms, the last sixth layer is the Five Elements Territory.
And the latter part of the Immortal Five Elements Technique that Lin Jing is looking for is within this final Five Elements Territory.
Just now, Lin Jing compared the incomplete maps obtained by the others with his complete version, and found that these incomplete maps only lacked a single piece compared to the complete map.
And that missing last piece is the map of the Five Elements Territory at the deepest level of the Five Elements Ruins.
The maps of the other areas, on the other hand, are complete.
Without the complete map, there might be some trouble later, but there is no impact on the earlier parts.
…
Hearing this, everyone hurriedly extended their Divine Sense toward the statue’s hand to scan it.
Very soon.
They discovered those few lines of small characters.
After discovering the inscriptions, Long Daoren stopped talking.
At this point, the Yan Family ancestor timely spoke to Li Mingwu and Long Daoren:
“Both fellow Daoists must have seen it, right?”
“This Five Elements Territory is predestined with Lin Daoyou, and now that we can come here together, we’re already taking a great advantage.”
“Moreover, the map is only missing a corner, and even without this corner, we can explore on our own.”
“Don’t you agree that this is the case?”
At this moment, Bai Yi also chimed in on the side:
“Indeed…”
“This map has been scattered around for many years, my fragment of the map was obtained unintentionally at an auction a hundred years ago.”
“That missing piece has probably been lost long ago, who knows where.”
“Why should the two of you still fret over this?”
Upon hearing this, Li Mingwu glanced at Bai Yi and then spoke:
“Fine!”
“Let’s just do it this way for now.”
“We each take a copy of this map, and once we’re inside, we’ll rely on our own fortunes.”
“As for the parts not covered by the map, we’ll explore them ourselves.”
Everyone nodded.
Then, they each made their own copy of the patchwork map with their Spiritual Power.
ɴονǤο.сᴑ
After copying, they headed toward the Teleportation Array at the back.
This Teleportation Array, similar to the one outside they encountered earlier, also had a Pentagram Array in the center.
It required the use of five tokens simultaneously to activate the Teleportation Array.
Following that.
Just like before, everyone took their respective positions and used the Five Elements Command Token to open the Teleportation Array.
As the Teleportation Array activated, a beam of light shot up into the sky.
At this moment, Li Mingwu spoke:
“I’ll go in first this time, no objections, right?”
The Yan Family ancestor glanced at Bai Yi and Lin Jing, then spoke:
“Then, Fellow Daoist Li, please go ahead.”
As for who would enter the Five Elements Ruins first, Lin Jing naturally didn’t care.
After all, the inside of the Five Elements Ruins was vast, and being first to enter didn’t guarantee finding treasures.
There could also be dangers inside.
Therefore, Lin Jing had no desire to compete for the order of entry.
The Yan Family ancestor and Bai Yi seemingly shared Lin Jing’s thoughts.
And Long Daoren naturally wouldn’t compete with Li Mingwu, either.
Afterward, Li Mingwu stepped into the center of the Teleportation Array.
As the light of the Teleportation Array flashed, Li Mingwu disappeared.
After Li Mingwu left, the second person to enter was Long Daoren.
Then came Bai Yi.
Following Bai Yi, the Yan Family ancestor also went in.
After the Yan Family ancestor entered, only Lin Jing was left in the Five Elements main hall.
Lin Jing looked around.
Then he too stepped into the Teleportation Array…

chapters.title: Chapter 688
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 688: Chapter 297 The Five Elements Metal Realm, Under Attack Chapter 688: Chapter 297 The Five Elements Metal Realm, Under Attack A pure white sky, a black ground, and on the ground, the occasional glint of gold or silver light.
This was the scene that Lin Jing witnessed upon entering the Five Elements Ruins.
After Lin Jing was teleported in, he didn’t encounter a single soul.
Just himself alone.
Upon entering, Lin Jing felt something was off.
He immediately extended his Divine Sense, allowing it to stretch out.
However…
...
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense only reached a distance of a hundred meters before it could extend no further.
For a moment, Lin Jing was extremely shocked; the Five Elements Ruins actually had a suppressing effect on Divine Sense.
Outside, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense could easily cover an area of several hundreds of miles, but here, even with all his might, it only extended just over a hundred meters before reaching the limit of his Divine Sense’s range.
The suppression of Divine Sense in the Five Elements Ruins was just too severe.
Unable to use Divine Sense was extremely inconvenient.
If there was any danger, it would be difficult to detect it in time.
However, since the entire first layer of the Five Elements Ruins was like this, it was likely the same for everyone else.
He just needed to be more careful and cautious.
It was unknown, however,
If the other layers were the same?
……
Following that,
Lin Jing looked up and ahead.
At a glance, besides the pure white sky and black ground, there were also metallic fragments randomly scattered on the ground, emitting dazzling light.
There was nothing else.
No flowers, no trees, no rivers or lakes, and even the black ground was just some unknown type of black metal, not real soil.
This place was the Metal Realm, the first layer of the Five Elements Ruins.
Lin Jing had initially thought that upon being teleported in, it would be like before, with a fixed teleportation spot.
But only after being teleported did Lin Jing come to a realization.
The teleportation was random.
Now recalling Li Mingwu’s actions before the teleportation, Lin Jing even began to suspect whether he knew about the situation inside the Five Elements Ruins.
During the earlier discussions, Li Mingwu might have concealed something and not told them the full truth.
However,
Even if he really did hide something, that was all it could be.
From now on, one could only take things one step at a time.
However,
Before that, there was another matter to take care of.
Lin Jing then looked down at the hem of his robe, where a trace of Dragon Daoist’s aura lingered.
The aura was so faint that it was difficult to detect, even in the Five Elements Ruins.
Clearly, Dragon Daoist had left this extremely faint aura on purpose, with the sole intent of using it to sense his location.
With Divine Sense being suppressed in this place, Dragon Daoist’s method of using this subtle method to probe his position was undoubtedly proof that he must know something about the conditions within these Ruins.
Exactly how they came to know of this, Lin Jing did not know.
But with this, entering the Ruins without these key pieces of information placed Lin Jing and the Yan Family Ancestor at a disadvantage.
There was no helping it, since Lin Jing had not known about the Five Elements Ruins for very long, and the Yan Family Ancestor was only brought in by Lin Jing at the last moment.
Clearly, he knew very little as well.
Li Mingwu and Dragon Daoist were different, though.
Two thousand years ago, Li Mingwu had entered the Five Elements Ruins alongside True Master Ling Yin, and it was then that True Master Ling Yin was harmed.
It was evident that Li Mingwu had long studied these Ruins, so it was not surprising that he knew some details about them.
Li Mingwu certainly had shared some of what he knew with Dragon Daoist.
So, the latter likely knew quite a bit as well.
……
Following that,
Lin Jing directly tore off the corner of his robe that had Dragon Daoist’s aura.
After tearing it off, Lin Jing did not discard it, but instead placed it inside his Space Ring.
Since Dragon Daoist wanted to track him using this method, Lin Jing could also think of a way to use this to his advantage and turn the tables on him.
This location was utterly empty, with nothing else around, definitely not suitable for action now, so he could only put it away first and prevent being tracked for the time being.
Having finished that, Lin Jing took out the complete map from the Space Ring, spread it out, and began to examine it.
This map was simply a topographical map, recording the terrain of every layer within the Ruins.
Besides the topography…
There were two marked locations on each layer.
One of these marks, located in the central area of each realm, was indicated with a mark.
That was the most dangerous place of the entire layer, and also the most likely location for the Metal Spirit to appear.
Additionally, the map indicated that,
In the center of each layer, not only would there be a Metal Spirit likely to appear, but also there was a high chance of extremely rare treasures emerging.
The other mark on the map was the place to leave this first layer, the Metal Realm.
If Lin Jing wanted to leave the Metal Realm and go to the next level, he would have to make his way there.
After looking at the map for a while, Lin Jing memorized the terrain of the Metal Realm, and then put the map away again.
After that,
Lin Jing needed to confirm his current position before deciding on his next move.
Should he head to the central region of the Metal Realm within the Five Elements and snatch the True Spirits and peerless treasures?
Or should he bypass this place and go directly to the next level?
Actually.
Lin Jing, possessing the Five Elements Spiritual Root, did not need to snatch True Spirits to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm, as he could cultivate them on his own.
Moreover, the True Spirits he cultivated would be more attuned to his body than those derived from nature.
It would also enable him to exert his strengths more effectively.
The only reason Lin Jing was here was for the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
But with Li Mingwu and Long Daoist present, if they did indeed encounter each other, Lin Jing could help the Yan Family’s ancestor compete for it.
Even Bai Yi could assist him.
At the very least, they must not allow Li Mingwu and Long Daoist to obtain it first.
According to the Yan Family’s ancestor, Li Mingwu was just missing one True Spirit to collect all the Five Elements True Spirits and advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.
As for which one he lacked, even the Yan Family’s ancestor did not know.
But if Li Mingwu managed to get that True Spirit, then he could directly use it to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.
……
Packing away the map, Lin Jing rose into the sky and flew toward the distance.
In the Metal Realm of the Five Elements, the Spiritual Energy was imbalanced.
The Metallic Attribute Spiritual Energy was overwhelmingly rich, while the energies of the other attributes were sparse, barely amounting to even one-tenth of the metal energy when combined.
The abundance of metallic energy in this place made it uncomfortable for Lin Jing, who cultivated the Five Elements Cultivation Technique.
After all.
Outside, even in the Demonic Monster Sea, the Five Elements were balanced.
Lin Jing had never before encountered a special region dominated by one type of energy.
For Lin Jing, the optimal way to absorb Spiritual Energy was a balanced distribution of the Five Elements, so absorbing energy in a place filled with metallic energy was extremely difficult for him.
This place was a paradise for those cultivating metallic attribute techniques, and their spells would greatly increase in power here.
But for cultivators of other attributes, it was extremely uncomfortable.
Luckily, the Immortal Five Elements Technique was exceptionally unique, allowing Lin Jing to absorb energy even in a place filled only with metallic Spiritual Energy.
He only needed to transform it using the Immortal Five Elements Technique after absorbing it.
Though effortful, it was still much better than for the others.
If he really found it bothersome, Lin Jing could also enter the System Space.
After all, the System Space was not affected by the rules of this world.
……
As he flew, Lin Jing quietly noted the terrain he passed.
Without knowing his location, Lin Jing had no choice but to memorize the terrain and compare it with the map to determine where he was.
After flying for most of the day, Lin Jing matched the terrain with the map and determined his location.
This place was on the eastern edge of the Metal Realm of the Five Elements.
To leave this realm, he had to cross the entire Metal Realm to reach the far west.
Because the exit from this realm was located in that extreme western land.
After confirming this, Lin Jing was rather speechless; his luck was truly terrible to be transported to the farthest spot from the exit.
Being sent to any other place would have been better; he wouldn’t have had to cross the entire Metal Realm.
But what’s done is done.
There was no other way, so he could only continue flying westward.
And so, Lin Jing continued his journey westward.
The Metal Realm of the Five Elements was incredibly monotonous, with only the black metallic earth and the flickering gold and silver lights shining from the ground.
Nothing else.
However, the closer to the central region, the more numerous the gold and silver flickering lights became.
But other than that, there were no changes.
As time went by, Lin Jing, while flying forward, suddenly felt a sense of alarm, as if danger was approaching.
After sensing danger, Lin Jing immediately stopped.
He quickly expanded his Divine Sense, careful to defend himself.
Since his Divine Sense was suppressed, even when expanded, the range it covered was limited.
ɴօνǤ0.сο
Lin Jing had to keep sweeping his surroundings vigilantly.
However, after scanning the area, Lin Jing did not detect anything amiss.
And the sudden sensation of danger he had felt disappeared just as quickly.
But just as Lin Jing was puzzled…
Suddenly.
A flash of silver-white light streaked by.
The silver-white light, hidden in the air with no energy emanating from it, was difficult to detect without close observation.
It was only because this silver-white light entered the range of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense that he became aware of it.
The light moved so fast that by the time Lin Jing reacted, it was already in front of him.
Fortunately, Lin Jing reacted swiftly; by the time the silver-white light entered his Divine Sense range, there was no time to cast a spell.
Lin Jing made a split-second decision and threw a punch directly.
This punch, carrying peerless might, distorted the space in front of Lin Jing.
However, the silver light seemed to detect the strength of Lin Jing’s punch and attempted to flee.
Yet.
Under Lin Jing’s punch, escape was simply not an option…

chapters.title: Chapter 689
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 689: Chapter 298: Core Area Chapter 689: Chapter 298: Core Area With Lin Jing’s punch blasting out, it heavily struck the area where the light flickered.
“Boom!”
A loud noise followed by a “crack” sound, like that of some metal object breaking, echoed through the air.
Immediately after, a silver-white liquid poured out.
It was not until then that Lin Jing had a sense of feeling.
This seemed to be a kind of intelligent beast.
……
Afterward.
...
The thing that attacked Lin Jing in front finally revealed its form, and it indeed was a strange beast.
And this strange beast seemed to also be capable of becoming invisible.
No wonder Lin Jing had not noticed anything before.
As the silver liquid flowed out, the beast’s shape also slowly became visible.
It was an owl-like beast, only much larger in size and completely silver-white in color, resembling a skeleton and just as smooth, as if cast from silver metal.
On its forehead was a silver bead.
However…
The silver bead seemed to have been shattered by Lin Jing’s punch just now, and the liquid inside it was leaking out.
As the silver liquid kept leaking, the body of the silver giant owl became more and more visible.
Clearly, it was the liquid inside the bead on its forehead that made it invisible.
Upon the death of the silver giant owl, its body began to fall downward.
Seeing this, Lin Jing reached out and directly caught the silver giant owl in his hand.
This silver giant owl could hide its form and breath; Lin Jing was indeed going to study it carefully.
Afterward.
Holding the giant owl in his hand, Lin Jing descended toward the ground below.
Beneath Lin Jing was a mountain peak.
This mountain peak was also black like the other areas, with flashes of silver and gold light on it.
Lin Jing descended from mid-air and landed on the peak.
Just as Lin Jing set down the corpse of the silver giant owl he was holding, intending to study it,
unexpectedly, another incident occurred.
In front of Lin Jing, the black ground suddenly lifted a large chunk without warning, and this piece of ground flew directly at Lin Jing.
Fortunately, having just experienced the attack of the silver giant owl, Lin Jing was still on high alert.
The moment there was any movement in the black ground, Lin Jing had already noticed it and was prepared.
Immediately.
Lin Jing threw another punch directly forward.
Under Lin Jing’s fist, the uplifted piece of ground shattered into pieces with a “thud.”
After the ground split open, a turtle-like strange beast was revealed within it.
The entire body of this strange beast, like the ground itself, was completely black, except for its eyes, which were different.
One glowed with a golden light,
while the other shimmered with a silver light,
much like the golden and silver flashes that could be seen everywhere on this black land.
This camouflage was simply perfect.
With the suppression of Divine Sense and relying only on visual observation, it was very difficult to detect their disguise.
However, even though this turtle-like strange beast pounced toward Lin Jing, its speed was not as fast as the silver giant owl beast.
With a punch from Lin Jing, striking the turtle’s shell, it felt like hitting steel.
The shell on the back of the old turtle was extremely hard.
But sadly, this hard shell could not withstand Lin Jing’s strike.
With just one punch, the shell on the turtle’s back cracked open.
And the turtle’s flesh was shattered, spilling out a large amount of silver blood,
dyeing the entire ground silver.
And the old turtle died instantly as a result.
After killing the old turtle, Lin Jing did not relax.
He quickly spread his Divine Sense to inspect the ground below,
to check if there were any other beasts lying in ambush nearby.
After some investigation and ensuring that there was no ambush by any other beasts in the vicinity, Lin Jing finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Both the giant owl and the old turtle beast were extremely difficult to detect when they were concealed.
Lin Jing was certainly going to find out why.
…
…
Four hours passed, and on top of the mountain, the bodies of the giant owl and the old turtle beast had been disassembled by Lin Jing.
In addition, there was another complete old turtle corpse lying next to Lin Jing.
After disassembling them, Lin Jing finally understood why these strange beasts could hide.
It was all because of Spiritual Power.
The first layer of the Five Elements Ruins was the Metal Realm, where Metallic Attribute Spiritual Power was dense.
And those two beasts relied on Metallic Attribute Spiritual Power for their survival.
Moreover,
the stronger the Metallic Attribute Spiritual Power, the stronger their abilities.
Besides, these strange beasts also had an ability to use Metallic Attribute Spiritual Power to conceal themselves, thus making it hard for enemies to sense their presence.
That was the reason why Lin Jing couldn’t feel anything before these strange beasts attacked.
Even the giant owl had a special ability to become invisible, making it even harder for Lin Jing, who could not use Divine Sense, to detect it.
Knowing that there were these beasts that could launch stealth attacks at any moment, Lin Jing then continued on his way.
However,
this time, Lin Jing was more cautious to avoid being ambushed.
……
In the blink of an eye, more than a month had passed.
The expanse of the Metal Realm of the Five Elements was vast.
It took Lin Jing more than a month to reach the central area of the Metal Realm.
At that time, Lin Jing, wearing a black straw raincoat, walked unhurriedly across the black land.
This black straw raincoat, coupled with the lack of any breath emanating from Lin Jing’s body, made it easy to overlook him unless one looked closely.
The straw raincoat on Lin Jing’s body was made from the softer underbelly hide of the old turtle beast.
Wearing this raincoat in the Metal Realm not only hid his form,
The most important thing is that it can conceal one’s own aura.
This helps avoid attacks on oneself.
Since the first attack, as I proceeded towards the central region, the frequency of such attacks increased.
Even my distinct aura, compared to that of the Five Elements Metal Realm, directly attracted the besiege of those exotic beasts.
Although these beasts couldn’t harm Lin Jing, they were quite annoying.
Countless exotic beasts attacked from dawn till dusk without rest.
And furthermore,
the closer Lin Jing got to the central region, the more powerful these beasts became.
Dealing with each beast required a considerable amount of energy.
It nearly brought Lin Jing to a point where he could hardly move.
Out of necessity,
Lin Jing had to find other ways to evade these beasts’ attacks.
It was by chance that Lin Jing discovered that the hide of an old turtle beast could block one’s aura.
Therefore,
Lin Jing thought of this method.
Using the hide of the old turtle beast, he crafted such a cloak.
And indeed, after donning this cloak and forcefully suppressing his own aura,
he could actually deceive the perception of those beasts.
He could even deceive those huge owl beasts in the sky.
However, after putting on this cloak, Lin Jing could no longer fly, forced instead to walk on the ground.
And he couldn’t move too fast either.
If he moved too quickly, he would still be noticed by those beasts.
……
Lin Jing walked lightly, without making a sound on the ground.
At the moment, not far from him underground, there lay a slumbering old turtle beast.
Although it was sleeping, any disturbance would immediately wake it up and it would instantly attack Lin Jing.
ɴονǥօ.сο
This situation was something Lin Jing had encountered many times before.
The old turtle beast had already been detected by Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
However, Lin Jing chose not to disturb it.
As long as it was not agitated, it would continue sleeping and would not attack Lin Jing.
Currently, this area is already within the central region of the Five Elements Metal Realm where the Metallic Attribute Spiritual Energy is even more concentrated.
And these beasts are even more formidable.
Lin Jing just wanted to quickly pass through here and didn’t wish to provoke them without reason.
Passing by the slumbering old turtle beast, Lin Jing continued forward.
Ahead of Lin Jing was a mountain range soaring into the clouds, stretching endlessly.
Beyond this mountain range lay the heart of the Five Elements Metal Realm, the most central area.
The Five Elements Metal Spirit resides in that central area.
And furthermore,
if he wanted to cross here to travel to the far west of the Metal Realm, he would also need to traverse this mountain range.
Lin Jing lifted his head, looking towards the mountain range ahead.
The mountain range spanned from the south to the north, with no end in sight.
At the top of the entire mountain range, there was a shimmering golden light, glittering brightly.
It seemed that even the mountain range was extraordinary.
Merely glancing upwards, Lin Jing then stopped hesitating and continued towards the direction of the mountains.
The mountain range was towering, visible from afar, but it wasn’t so easy to approach.
It took Lin Jing five days just to reach the foot of the mountains.
Then, after six more days, Lin Jing traversed the towering range and finally entered the core area of the center.
Within this core area, Lin Jing was even more cautious.
The beasts in this core area were three times larger compared to those in the outer central regions.
Presumably, the strength of these beasts would be even more terrifying.
However, the closer to the core area, the greater the danger, which was to be expected.
……
Lin Jing continued forward, now even more cautious and slower than before.
Finally, after two days, just as Lin Jing began to climb a hillside, he sensed a dangerous aura coming from ahead.
That’s when Lin Jing stopped.
He had decided not to proceed any further from here.
Further ahead should be the very center of the Five Elements Metal Realm, an extremely dangerous place.
At the same time, if there truly existed a Five Elements Metal Spirit, it would also appear there.
Ahead lay danger; a rash move could awaken the beasts, and in this place, Divine Sense was suppressed to an extreme extent.
To investigate, he would have to find another method.
But,
for Lin Jing, this wasn’t really a problem at all.
Because he had the System Space.
After stopping, Lin Jing immediately invoked the System and entered the System Space.
Once in the System Space, without delay, Lin Jing entered Observation Mode.
Inside the System Space, using Observation Mode to scout was much safer than doing it himself outside.
And furthermore,
the range of this scouting was much wider than using Divine Sense.
Lin Jing, now in Observation Mode, watched as his viewpoint appeared directly above where he had just been standing.
Afterwards, Lin Jing controlled the viewpoint to continue scouting ahead.
In Observation Mode, Lin Jing no longer had any concerns and directly controlled the viewpoint to rise.
Soon, the viewpoint surpassed the summit of the mountain he was on and he could see the scene ahead.
On the other side of the mountain where Lin Jing was located, in a valley, lay a colossal golden turtle.
This giant turtle was so large that its body covered an area of a thousand zhang in diameter.
It nearly filled the entire valley.
The sense of danger Lin Jing had felt before
came precisely from this giant turtle.
And most crucially…
As Lin Jing watched this golden giant turtle, he also noticed two figures in black armor acting stealthily.
Just by their stature, Lin Jing recognized them.
These two people were none other than Li Mingwu and Dragon Taoist.

chapters.title: Chapter 690
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 690: Chapter 299: Tracking Chapter 690: Chapter 299: Tracking Like Lin Jing, the two of them were wrapped in hides taken from the old turtle to mask their presences.
At this moment.
They were on another mountaintop, slowly moving toward the valley.
Observing them, they seemed to be exceedingly cautious.
They appeared acutely afraid of disturbing the golden turtle that was sleeping.
As the saying goes,
“Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be in peril.”
Having spotted the two, Lin Jing was certainly inclined to investigate further to see exactly what they were up to.
Along the way, he hoped to learn something about the Five Elements Ruins from them as well.
...
However, the two were located on the opposite side of the valley, a good distance away from Lin Jing.
Given the range Lin Jing could observe in Observation Mode, he was still far away from the two.
If he wanted to observe them, Lin Jing had to close their distance and enter the System Space at a position not far from them in order to explore their actions.
Luckily,
the Divine Sense in this space was greatly suppressed.
Even with Divine Sense, they probably couldn’t detect far.
This meant that Lin Jing, drawing closer to them, had a much lower chance of being detected.
Thinking thus, he recorded their position under Observation Mode, surveyed the surrounding terrain to determine the route forward.
Having planned everything, Lin Jing then exited Observation Mode and left the System Space.
Upon exiting the System Space, Lin Jing reappeared at the location he had been before.
Following,
instead of continuing to climb toward the mountain peak, Lin Jing turned and walked down the slope.
After descending the slope, Lin Jing skirted around the base of the mountain, heading towards the direction where Li Mingwu and Long Daoren were.
Throughout this journey, Lin Jing was extra careful,
lest he disturb the ancient turtle beast lurking underground.
At this distance, if Lin Jing alarmed the creature and a fight ensued, Li Mingwu and the other would definitely notice.
In fact, he might even disturb the golden turtle.
After all, only a single mountaintop separated them; Lin Jing naturally needed to be very cautious.
In this manner, it took Lin Jing an entire day to travel from his mountain to the foot of the mountain where Li Mingwu and his companion were located.
From there, although there was still some distance to the mountain they were on, he could go no further.
Any further, and he would be discovered.
The mountain currently shielded him from their sight, which was just perfect.
There, below that mountain, Lin Jing once again entered the System Space.
From within Observation Mode, Lin Jing saw the two men, who were not at the mountain top but in the valley.
The two were moving extremely slowly within the valley, as if inching along.
And that colossal golden turtle was just a thousand yards away from them.
At such a distance, the turtle could probably reach them with just a step.
However,
the golden turtle was still asleep and hadn’t woken up, unaware of Li Mingwu and his companion approaching it.
Li Mingwu and Long Daoren moved incredibly slowly, fearing they might awaken the giant turtle.
Inside the valley, every time they moved a distance, they would stop for a while, seemingly busy with something.
However,
Lin Jing was at the base of the mountain outside the valley and couldn’t observe them closely enough; he could only watch from afar by raising his observation angle.
Therefore, Lin Jing couldn’t determine what they were actually doing.
Clearly,
observing from this mountain base wouldn’t suffice.
From the base of the mountain, he was still too far from them.
Lin Jing would need to climb to the mountain peak…
…
…
It took him over two hours more to climb from the base to a spot near the mountain peak.
It was here that Lin Jing called out the System, murmuring in his mind:
“Enter System Space!”
As the scene in front of him changed, in the next moment, Lin Jing vanished from the spot, entering into the System Space.
After arriving in the System Space, Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode.
Next.
Lin Jing, once again through the observational view, saw the outside situation.
During the time it took Lin Jing to climb up the mountain, Li Mingwu and Long Daoren had already retreated from the valley.
At this moment, they were climbing from the foot of the valley towards the mountain peak.
Lin Jing adjusted the observation view, narrowing the distance, directly arriving in front of the two men.
Upon close observation, Lin Jing could clearly see them.
The two were dressed in black armor, which was tightly wrapped around their bodies; even other exposed parts were coated with a layer of silver fluid.
This silver fluid, Lin Jing knew,
was from the cranial bead of a silver giant owl that enabled the owl to become invisible.
After killing the silver giant owl, Lin Jing had also tried this fluid, which hadn’t made him invisible but, at most, shielded his sense like his armor from other beasts.
But the armor alone was enough,
so Lin Jing hadn’t thought much of this silver fluid.
Yet, they wore not only the armor but had also applied the silver fluid.
……
Now, both of them moved very slowly and were extremely cautious, even occasionally looking back at the golden turtle behind them.
Seeing their caution,
Lin Jing couldn’t help but have a malicious thought.
If he rushed out now, startling the Golden Turtle,
their previous efforts would most likely be in vain.
However, although such an idea appeared,
Lin Jing would not actually do that.
Doing so, firstly, would easily put himself in danger.
Secondly, Lin Jing still didn’t know what the two were doing in the valley,
or what their true purpose was.
If he wanted to take any action, he needed to understand their goals first.
Before that, it was necessary for Lin Jing not to disturb them and to carefully observe their actions.
……
Li Mingwu and Long Daoren moved slowly, taking most of the day to finally climb back to the mountain top.
After crossing the mountain top, the two did not stop but continued down the mountain.
Lin Jing followed and observed them for a while, noting that the two did not speak to each other but just kept moving downward.
It made sense since, even though they had left the valley, they were still too close to the Golden Turtle; even a slight noise could disturb it.
Once out of the valley, their descent down the mountain sped up.
Lin Jing used the Observation Mode to follow them.
Until the two reached the foot of the mountain and continued outward, moving beyond the maximum range of the Observation Mode.
Ɲ0νǤο.ƈο
To avoid wasting time, Lin Jing chose a spot where the two couldn’t see him and used Fixed Point Teleportation.
He had to ensure he didn’t lose track of them if he was to glean any information from them.
……
Afterward,
the two men kept walking outwards, seemingly no longer concerned about the Golden Turtle.
But Lin Jing knew that was not possible.
If they weren’t planning to deal with the Golden Turtle, they wouldn’t have entered the valley in the first place.
This way,
the two walked ahead, and Lin Jing silently followed behind them.
Two days later, perhaps feeling they were far enough not to disturb the Golden Turtle, the two finally took off their armor and stopped hiding.
Once they exposed themselves,
they were immediately attacked by several magical beasts.
Facing these assaults, the two men fought back mercilessly.
They used powerful spells and even resorted to various Magical Treasures,
and together, it didn’t take long before they had slain all the attacking beasts surrounding them.
After killing the magical beasts, they extracted the silver blood from the creatures’ bodies and collected it all.
Once the blood of the magical beasts was collected, the two men set off again, heading to another location.
At the next site, more hidden beasts attacked them.
These beasts, undeterred by fear of death, would immediately attack upon sensing their presence.
And the two men fought back again, killing the assaulting beasts…
This way…
The two continued forward, relentlessly killing magical beasts, whether they were burrowing old turtles or massive owls in the sky; none were spared.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing silently trailed behind, making no noise whatsoever.
After another three days, having jointly killed over a hundred magical beasts,
Finally,
after slaying the last old turtle beast, the two stopped.
After killing the beast, Long Daoren stepped forward, took out a Jade Vial, and collected all the blood from the old turtle beast.
After collecting the blood, Long Daoren returned to Li Mingwu’s side, handed him the Jade Vial, and then spoke,
“With so much essence blood from the magical beasts, should that be enough?”
Li Mingwu opened the Jade Vial, peeked inside, and then nodded,
“Enough!”
“With these essence bloods, we can lure out that giant Golden Turtle.”
Upon hearing this, Long Daoren nodded slightly, and then spoke again,
“Now that we have collected the essence blood of these beasts, you can tell me what to do next, right?”
“Of course,” Li Mingwu continued.
“Earlier, we had placed an extremely covert Formation within that valley.”
“Next, we will need to place these essence bloods within those Formations.”
“Once we evacuate, we can detonate the Formation.”
“Once the Formation is detonated, it will certainly enrage the Golden Turtle, at which point, I will lead the enraged Golden Turtle away.”
“Beneath the Golden Turtle, there is a deep pit, and the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements Spirit should be within that pit.”
“After I lead the Golden Turtle away, you should take the opportunity to approach the pit and retrieve the Metallic Attribute Five Elements Spirit inside.”
At this point, Li Mingwu changed his tone slightly, cautiously adding,
“You must remember.”
“Even without that Golden Turtle, the pit is still very dangerous.”
“You must be extremely careful.”
Long Daoren, upon hearing this, nodded,
“I am well aware of that,” he assured.
Having said this,
Long Daoren looked at Li Mingwu and spoke again,
“This time, as I help you get this Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements Spirit, the Fire Attribute Five Elements Spirit you promised to obtain for me, you must not go back on your word.”
Li Mingwu looked directly at Long Daoren and replied,
“Don’t worry,”
“Since we have formed an alliance, I will certainly keep my word.”

chapters.title: Chapter 691
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 691: Chapter 300 Action Chapter 691: Chapter 300 Action While listening to the conversation between the two, Lin Jing pondered.
It wasn’t difficult to discern from their exchange.
This Metallic Attribute Five Elements true spirit was something Li Mingwu needed.
Previously, the Yan Family patriarch had mentioned.
Li Mingwu only lacked one type of Five Elements true spirit to advance to the Solidifying Body stage.
Could the one he was missing be the Metallic Attribute Five Elements true spirit?
If that was the case, then he mustn’t let him obtain it so easily.
...
He must snatch it away.
Otherwise, if Li Mingwu got his hands on this Metallic Attribute Five Elements true spirit, by the time they met again, it was very likely he would have refined the Five Elements true spirit and advanced directly to the Solidifying Body stage.
By then, all of them combined would not be a match for Li Mingwu.
The difference between the Solidifying Body stage and the Divinity Transformation Stage was just too vast; it was not something that could be compensated for merely by numbers.
……
It was at this moment that the Dragon Daoist spoke up and asked Li Mingwu:
“The records you obtained about the Five Elements Ruins before, aside from the first layer, I presume you know something about the other layers as well.”
“Shouldn’t you also share this information with me?If we’re separated by teleportation again, I will be able to stay vigilant.”
Upon hearing this, Li Mingwu looked toward the Dragon Daoist and then nodded, saying:
“Of course.”
“The Jade Slip I obtained earlier contains some key information about the first five layers.”
“You already know about this first layer, so there’s no need to go over it again; next, I will tell you all about the other layers…”
…
…
Following that, Li Mingwu began to tell the Dragon Daoist.
As he spoke, Lin Jing also listened carefully…
ƝονǤօ.ᴄο
“The second layer is the Wood Element Realm.”
“The Wood Realm is overgrown with vegetation.
Upon entering, one must be exceedingly cautious.”
“Many of the plants have developed sentience and will actively attack intruders.”
“And just like this Metal Realm, they are extremely adept at camouflage, blending in with the common flora, and are very difficult to distinguish.”
“Apart from those sentient creatures, there is also a special type of being similar to Demonic Beasts, collectively known as Wood Spirits.”
“Wood Spirits usually hide among the trees, concealing their aura.
As soon as they sense an intruder, they will also launch an immediate attack.”
“Dealing with the Wood Spirits is not too difficult, the only thing to be cautious of is that Wood Spirits can wield wood-based Spells.”
…
…
“Following the Wood Realm is the Water Element Realm.”
“In the records, the Water Realm is deemed the most dangerous among the five realms.”
“And furthermore…”
“The Water Realm is the only place that has other Cultivators.”
On hearing this, the Dragon Daoist was utterly astonished:
“There are actually other Cultivators in the Water Element Realm?”
“That’s right…” Li Mingwu nodded affirmatively.
“There are indeed other Cultivators in the Water Element Realm.”
The Dragon Daoist then continued to inquire:
“The Five Elements Ruins have been unentered for a long time, so why would there still be other Cultivators in the Water Realm?”
Li Mingwu looked at the Dragon Daoist and asked:
“I presume you know about the Sea of Strange mists, right?”
“Of course, I do,” the Dragon Daoist nodded.
Li Mingwu immediately said:
“The Cultivators in the Water Element Realm are those who went missing in the Sea of Strange mists, which in fact, is a bizarre phenomenon of the Water Element Realm.”
As these words were spoken.
Not just the Dragon Daoist, but Lin Jing was shocked as well.
He hadn’t expected the enigmatic Sea of Strange mists to originate from the Water Element Realm of the Five Elements Ruins.
Li Mingwu glanced at the astonished Dragon Daoist and continued:
“Moreover, the Cultivators swept into the Water Element Realm are not weak.”
“It’s said that inside, there are not only Cultivators of the Solidifying Body stage but even those in Dao Integration and Transcendance Tribulation stages.”
“In the Water Element Realm, we must guard against various dangers, but the most important thing is to guard against other Cultivators.”
“Especially, you can’t let them know that you possess the Five Elements Command Token that allows you to leave the realm.”
“The Five Elements Command Token is the only item that can enable one to leave the Water Element Realm.
If they learn that you have a Token that permits immediate departure, then you will certainly be pursued.”
“By then, even if you wish to escape, you won’t be able to.”
…
…
As Lin Jing listened, he took careful mental notes.
Especially regarding the Water Element Realm, he could not afford to be careless.
After finishing the introduction to the Water Element Realm, Li Mingwu did not pause but continued:
“The layer below the Water Element Realm is the Fire Element Realm.”
“Aside from being extremely hot, the Fire Element Realm is, comparatively speaking, not so dangerous.”
“Although there will also be special creatures lying in ambush, it’s much easier compared to the Water Element Realm.”
“Lastly,”
“Is the Earth Element Realm.”
“In the Earth Realm, aside from the endless yellow sands, the only thing to be cautious of is an enormous worm buried under the desert with the length of ten thousand Zhang.”
“This giant worm doesn’t stay put in one place like the Golden Turtle; it can appear at any time, and it is unkillable.”
“Upon encountering it, all you can do is run.”
No sooner had Li Mingwu’s words fallen than the Dragon Daoist eagerly asked:
“What about the last layer?”
“There’s no introduction to the final layer?”
Li Mingwu’s brow furrowed slightly:
“No!”
“As for what lies in the final layer, I have no idea.”
At this point, Li Mingwu paused and then continued speaking:
“In fact, I have always suspected that Lin Jing obtained more than just that map fragment in the Five Elements main hall.
It’s very likely that the map of the last layer is also with him.”
“But that Yan Yujiang is too protective of him, making it impossible for us to lay a finger on him.”
As he said this, Li Mingwu turned his head to look at the Dragon Daoist:
“The mark you placed on Lin Jing before, have you sensed anything during this time?”
The Dragon Taoist subsequently opened his mouth and said:
“Since entering, there has been no sensation.”
“However, there’s no need to worry.
If the object marked is Yan Yujiang and Bai Yi, I can’t guarantee it won’t be discovered.”
“But that Lin Jing…”
“With his cultivation, no matter what, he cannot detect the mark I’ve left.”
“It’s just that, the range of my sensing ability for the mark is within a thousand miles; beyond that, I can’t sense anything.”
“And considering how vast these Five Elements Ruins are, it’s quite normal to not sense anything for the time being.”
Upon hearing this, Li Mingwu nodded slightly.
“Alright.”
“As long as you have an idea, that’s fine.”
“Once we sense that mark, we’ll go find him together.”
“I want to see if he really has the final layer of map to the Five Elements Territory on him.”
The Dragon Taoist nodded his head, then gazed into the distance.
His fingers, meanwhile, did not cease their motions, moving rhythmically with precision, and with each flicker of his fingers, a mysterious aura rose from his body.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu didn’t say anything.
He did not disturb the Dragon Taoist either.
Until a quarter of an hour later, the Dragon Taoist’s fingers suddenly stopped, and the mysterious aura surrounding him instantly faded away.
Then, the Dragon Taoist suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, his complexion turning pale in an instant…
However, the Dragon Taoist immediately began to regulate his breathing.
A moment later, his complexion returned to normal, and only then did he speak:
“It’s still no good.”
“For some reason, I can’t trace Lin Jing’s footsteps.”
Li Mingwu looked at the Dragon Taoist, frowning slightly:
“If you can’t deduce it, then let it be.”
The Dragon Taoist’s brow furrowed deeply before he replied:
“We can only leave it at that for now.”
……
Afterward, the two did not speak any further.
Having slain over a hundred Demonic Beasts, both of them had exhausted a considerable amount.
Therefore.
They each took out a Spirit Stone and began to absorb and recover.
In this space suffused solely with Spiritual Energy, drawing from the energy within Spirit Stones was undoubtedly the best method.
As they began their recovery, Lin Jing quietly withdrew, taking advantage of their restoration time to move a step ahead of them, making his way towards the valley in the core area.
Having heard what he wanted to know and aware of their intentions, Lin Jing naturally didn’t need to wait for them any longer.
Instead, he planned to return to the valley first, to prepare and await their arrival.
On his return, Lin Jing quickened his pace.
A journey that should have taken two days, Lin Jing completed in just over one.
And so he arrived back near the valley.
This time when he returned, Lin Jing did not go back to the mountain peak where he had been before.
That place was too close to them; even without Divine Sense, they could easily detect him.
After all, in this Metal Realm of the Five Elements, there were no trees to hide behind, everywhere was barren, making it hard to find any cover.
This time, Lin Jing took a whole day to circle the valley and came to the top of another mountain.
There, at the mountain’s peak, Lin Jing directly entered the System Space.
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing activated Observation Mode and waited for their arrival.
This time, only after a whole day passed…
Did Lin Jing see the figures of the two men appear.
Upon their arrival, they entered the valley with the same caution as before.
Within the valley, the colossal Golden Turtle was still in slumber, as if it would never awaken until the end of time.
Lin Jing raised his observation angle, watching the two men enter the valley.
The route the two men took was the same as the last time; after walking a certain distance, they would stop to place down a Jade Vial filled with the blood essence of the Demonic Beasts.
The location where they placed the Jade Vials had been set with extremely concealed formations.
After placing the Jade Vial, all was silent.
Neither the Golden Turtle nor any other Demonic Beasts were disturbed.
Thus, the two continued forward.
Gradually they approached the golden ginormous turtle.
When they were only a thousand yards away from the turtle, the Dragon Taoist stopped and did not go any further.
Only Li Mingwu kept moving forward with caution.
The two were so close to the turtle that any mishap would likely awake the colossal creature immediately.
Seeing this situation, Lin Jing knew:
His opportunity had come.
The two had placed a tracking mark on him, intending to deal with him.
So, naturally, Lin Jing could not let them succeed so easily.
Therefore.
Lin Jing maneuvered the Observation Mode to pinpoint their positions, and finding a spot invisible to both, prepared to teleport there.
“System!”
“Initiate Fixed Point Teleportation.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, Fixed Point Teleportation was activated.
“Ding!”
“System notification: Host has used Fixed Point Teleportation, deducting one Harvest Point.
Remaining Harvest Points: 67,652.”
As the system’s notification sounded, Lin Jing’s view shifted, and he instantly appeared in the outside world.
The position Lin Jing emerged in was on the opposite side of the colossal Golden Turtle, with both Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist’s line of sight obstructed by the turtle, unable to see Lin Jing.
However.
Upon emerging, Lin Jing was still clad in a straw cape and had not revealed his own aura.
But then.
Lin Jing put a slight force under his foot, causing the ground to immediately collapse and crack open…
Beneath the fissure, a circular body several yards wide with a full-body silver glow was exposed.
This was a silver-lit giant turtle Demonic Beast, and Lin Jing’s forceful step had struck the creature directly.
The previously slumbering giant turtle was immediately awakened.
With the silver turtle startled awake, Lin Jing no longer lingered, and called out to the system.
“Enter System Space!”
Then, Lin Jing was teleported once again into the System Space…

chapters.title: Chapter 692
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 692: Chapter 301: Creating Chaos, Seizing the Five Elements’ True Spirits Chapter 692: Chapter 301: Creating Chaos, Seizing the Five Elements’ True Spirits “Whoo:!”
As Lin Jing entered the System Space, a loud and piercing howl suddenly erupted.
The cry came too abruptly.
It startled Li Mingwu, who was nearing the Golden Turtle, and even the Dragon Taoist, who had been standing still, suddenly changed his expression.
The Golden Turtle, disrupted as if it had just been awakened, first trembled, and then its eyes slowly cracked open a slit.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu immediately ceased to delay.
He hurriedly retreated at high speed.
By then, he could no longer bother to conceal his figure.
...
Seeing Li Mingwu retreating, the Dragon Taoist didn’t dare to delay either and also stopped hiding before quickly flying backward with the Cultivation Technique in operation.
Their retreat was not a big deal, but their auras were completely exposed because of it.
The Golden Turtle, which initially had only a slit open in its eyes, upon sensing their auras,
immediately opened its eyes wide.
Then, dazzling golden light burst forth from the eyes of the Golden Turtle.
In fact, not only the Golden Turtle, but also the other mythical creatures in the surroundings, were awakened by this aura.
The black and silver turtles, along with the invisible giant owls in the sky, all attacked the two men.
During their retreat, Li Mingwu was not idle.
“Explode!”
At his single word, the Formation they had quietly laid out earlier instantly burst open.
The Jade Vial within the Formation, unable to withstand its self-destruction, exploded violently.
The mythical beast essence blood inside the Jade Vial burst forth, spraying everywhere.
This sudden explosion of the mythical beast essence blood momentarily stunned the Golden Turtle and the other creatures, but it was only for half a breath.
The creatures then reacted and furiously rushed at the two men.
…
“Whoo:!”
The Golden Turtle itself let out an earth-shattering roar, the sound vast and forming ripples that spread outward in every direction.
The ripple moved so fast, that when it swept over Li Mingwu, who was relatively closer, he was left somewhat dazed by the shock.
Even the ground around them vibrated with this roar.
For a moment, the entire valley, and the creatures outside the valley, were all awakened.
After the cry, the ground continued to tremble, and numerous old turtle creatures occasionally burrowed out from underground.
In the sky,
the invisibly gathering giant owls came together, forming a large mass, even creating a whirlwind.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu’s brow furrowed tightly as he stared straight at the giant turtle.
And the Dragon Taoist couldn’t help but feel his scalp tingle.
If there were only one, or even a few of these creatures, they would not be afraid, and even if dozens appeared at once, although troublesome, they could manage.
But with so many creatures together, there were more than just dozens, it was already in the thousands.
Aside from these creatures, there was also the massive Golden Turtle, which by now had fully awakened.
By then, the Golden Turtle had already risen.
Its four legs, as thick and mighty as pillars of the heavens, supported its huge body.
As it rose, beneath the body of the giant turtle, a deep pit exuding a white light was revealed.
Just as Li Mingwu had said, beneath the Golden Turtle was a deep pit, and the Metallic Attribute Five Elements true spirit must be within it.
After standing up, the Golden Turtle lifted one foot and then turned its body, seemingly attempting to turn its massive bulk to chase after Li Mingwu and the other.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu, while rapidly retreating, called out to the Dragon Taoist:
“Let’s split up; I’ll find a way to draw the Golden Turtle away.
If there’s a chance, you come back and look for the Metallic Attribute Five Elements true spirit,”
“If there’s no chance, prioritize your own safety.”
With that, Li Mingwu pulled out a Talisman emitting a golden light and tossed it to the Dragon Taoist.
The Dragon Taoist didn’t waste words; grasping the Talisman thrown by Li Mingwu, he retreated even faster.
At that moment,
“Boom!”
A loud noise came, and under it, the entire ground jumped.
On the mountains surrounding the valley, the originally immensely hard ground, due to this stomp, directly cracked apart.
Many pieces of the black ground with golden and silver gleams split into sections, rolling down the mountain.
It was the Golden Turtle’s raised foot, which at that moment came down.
Though the movement of the giant turtle was slightly slow due to its size, its body was so large that this one step spanned several miles.
And.
This wasn’t even its normal walking, but while turning around.
The first foot came down, then the Golden Turtle turned its body, while lifting another foot.
Just like that.
The Golden Turtle quickly left its original position, chasing after Li Mingwu.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu could no longer care about anything else.
“Explode!”
“Explode!”
“Explode!”
Li Mingwu blurted out, causing the previously laid Formation to explode all at once.
This Formation, originally meant to lure the Golden Turtle, had to be set off early due to the relentless attacks of the mythical creatures,
to help alleviate his own pressure.
Seizing the opportunity of the exploding Formation, Li Mingwu quickly summoned his Magical Treasure, and fled at high speed.
On the other hand, the Dragon Taoist, already somewhat behind, naturally retreated even faster.
By then, he had already made a breakthrough in another direction.
All the movements of the two men were clearly visible to Lin Jing, who was in Observation Mode.
Moreover,
because the Golden Turtle was chasing after Li Mingwu, the deep pit under the turtle was also exposed under Lin Jing’s observational view.
Upon seeing the deep pit, Lin Jing directly controlled the observation view to elevate, surveilled from above, and saw a corner of the pit.
Though it was called a deep pit, it actually wasn’t very deep.
ɴοѵǤ0.сο
From Lin Jing’s position, he could even see half of the turtle shell exposed inside the pit.
The turtle shell was golden as well.
It was also a Golden Turtle, but this one wasn’t very large and seemed to be an immature Golden Turtle.
At that moment, the immature Golden Turtle was lying in the pit, entirely motionless despite the commotions outside.
On the back of the Golden Turtle, a sphere emitting white light was quietly floating there.
Upon seeing the sphere, Lin Jing knew.
That was the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements spirit.
However, the Golden Turtle had just awoken and was still in a rage.
And Li Mingwu had not yet departed.
Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t carelessly appear and invite trouble.
If he were to take the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements spirit, it would be after Li Mingwu had left and the Golden Turtle had also chased away.
Since Li Mingwu was serving as bait, why not take advantage of the situation?
……
After deploying the Magical Treasure, Li Mingwu, who was controlling it, had sped up significantly.
In the blink of an eye, he had flown a great distance.
But the Golden Turtle, after turning around, also started to exert force, and its speed was not slow either, roaring and chasing after Li Mingwu.
For a moment,
the speed of the Golden Turtle actually surpassed Li Mingwu’s.
Seeing this, Li Mingwu was also startled.
He hurriedly accelerated to his full capacity, continuing to fly forward.
Although he wanted to lead away the Golden Turtle, if it endangered him, he naturally wouldn’t want to do it.
The speed of the Golden Turtle, as well as its imposing aura, exceeded Li Mingwu’s expectations.
If its strength was to be calculated according to the realms of Human Cultivators, it would be equivalent to a Cultivator in the Solidifying Body stage.
A beast in the Solidifying Body stage was not something he could withstand.
Li Mingwu could only flee.
However,
fortunately, the Golden Turtle didn’t seem adept at speed.
Moreover, Li Mingwu’s strength was indeed exceptional.
Although the Golden Turtle chased after him, it failed to catch up with him in a short time.
Ignoring the other beasts blocking his way, Li Mingwu used the Magical Treasure to protect himself and forcefully broke through an opening, then fled.
Seeing this, the Golden Turtle also hurriedly followed.
Every step the Golden Turtle took on the ground caused a thunderous “boom boom boom.”
The other old turtle-like beasts on the ground were also shaken and flipped over for quite a distance.
The Golden Turtle continued stepping forward, following Li Mingwu out of the valley.
Now,
Li Mingwu and Dragon Daoist had both fled, and the Golden Turtle had also chased out, followed by the other beasts.
The entire valley was then left with Lin Jing inside System Space and the immature, small Golden Turtle in the pit.
Seeing the opportunity was ripe, Lin Jing started to make his move.
After pinpointing the location, Lin Jing directly used Fixed-Point Teleportation, choosing a spot not far from the pit.
It couldn’t be helped.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to teleport directly into the pit, but due to the limited distance of Fixed-Point Teleportation, Lin Jing could only teleport to this spot.
This place, originally under the belly of the Golden Turtle, had no other beasts and the ground was relatively flat.
After using Fixed-Point Teleportation, Lin Jing instantly appeared at the spot he had determined.
However, just as he appeared,
he felt a dangerous aura emanating from the Golden Turtle in the pit.
The aura, although weaker than that of the giant Golden Turtle, was also extremely fearsome.
Lin Jing didn’t dare to underestimate it and immediately entered System Space right after teleporting.
After entering System Space, Lin Jing directly activated the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function again, choosing a new teleportation spot.
This time, Lin Jing chose the location right next to the Metallic Attribute Five Elements spirit on the back of the Golden Turtle.
And to grab the Five Elements spirit quicker, Lin Jing chose a spot that was less than a foot away from the Metallic Attribute Five Elements spirit.
This distance was close enough to reach out and grab it.
After preparing everything, Lin Jing used Fixed-Point Teleportation again.
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host used Fixed-Point Teleportation, deducting one Harvest Point.
Current Harvest Points remaining: 67650.”
As the system prompt ended, the next moment, Lin Jing appeared right on top of the Golden Turtle.
The moment he appeared, Lin Jing felt the Golden Turtle beneath his feet react.
Then,
countless beams of golden light emerged from the back of the Golden Turtle.
These beams, like tentacles, wound around as if trying to bind Lin Jing.
But at that moment, Lin Jing ignored the encircling golden light and concentrated his Soul Spirit power to envelop the white sphere.
The Five Elements spirit had no physical form and could only be transported in this manner.
After completely enveloping the Metallic Attribute Five Elements spirit with his Soul Spirit power,
the next moment, without any delay, Lin Jing again summoned the System and teleported himself into the System Space.
The teleportation force of System Space activated, and Lin Jing instantly disappeared from the back of the Golden Turtle, causing the golden beams that had wrapped around him to miss entirely.
After Lin Jing vanished, the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements spirit also disappeared from the spot with him…

chapters.title: Chapter 693
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 693: Chapter 302 Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit Obtained, Proceeding to the Next Level Chapter 693: Chapter 302 Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit Obtained, Proceeding to the Next Level From Lin Jing’s sudden appearance, to the absorption of the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit and then entering the System Space, the entire process took less than half a second.
The Golden Turtle hadn’t even fully reacted before Lin Jing had completely disappeared.
At this moment.
Inside the System Space, Lin Jing appeared along with the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, which also manifested within the System Space.
Bringing the Five Elements True Spirit into the System Space did not trigger the extermination rule for external creatures of the System Space.
The Five Elements True Spirit is considered a special Spiritual Body, inherently lacking spiritual intelligence, and naturally would not trigger the extermination rule of the System Space.
These were things Lin Jing had already understood.
...
Otherwise, Lin Jing wouldn’t have dared to bring the Five Elements True Spirit into the System Space.
After obtaining the Five Elements True Spirit, Lin Jing did not linger in the System Space.
Although he had entered the System Space, he had not yet left the danger zone.
The Golden Turtle in the deep pit would probably go mad once it realized that the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit had been taken by him, and it was very likely that its frenzy would draw back the colossal golden turtle.
What Lin Jing needed to do next was to leave the place quickly before the colossal golden turtle returned.
……
Afterwards.
Lin Jing released his control over the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit and summoned the System again.
Without Lin Jing’s control, the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit did not make any movements, but simply remained stationary, motionless in the same spot.
Lin Jing did not pay any further attention to the Five Elements True Spirit.
Instead, he directly entered Observation Mode.
Subsequently, Lin Jing’s perspective appeared above the deep pit.
At this moment.
The Golden Turtle in the pit had been alerted and was crawling out, glaring with its fist-sized eyes, ceaselessly scanning its surroundings.
After one sweep and not seeing an enemy,
the Golden Turtle directly lifted its head and emitted a long, mournful howl.
“Woo~”
As the howl resounded, Lin Jing knew something was wrong.
Because, this didn’t sound like the roar of anger from the golden colossal turtle earlier, but more like a call for something.
Lin Jing knew he had to leave now.
If he delayed any longer and the golden colossal turtle returned, even with the System Space, Lin Jing would struggle to escape.
Afterwards.
Lin Jing directly initiated Fixed Point Teleportation.
The Golden Turtle below seemed to be calling the giant golden turtle, so Lin Jing chose the opposite direction from where the giant golden turtle had left, selecting the farthest distance and used Fixed Point Teleportation.
Although he used Fixed Point Teleportation over the maximum distance, Lin Jing was still within the valley.
Lin Jing suddenly appeared, only to be sensed immediately by the Golden Turtle.
The Golden Turtle stopped its howling and twisted its neck to look in Lin Jing’s direction.
But when the Golden Turtle looked over…
the spot was completely empty, with nothing there.
Not finding anything, a flicker of confusion passed through the large eyes of the Golden Turtle before it turned its head and swept its gaze over other nearby areas.
After scanning all nearby areas and ultimately discovering nothing, the Golden Turtle put away its confusion and continued to howl upward.
……
At this point.
All of the Golden Turtle’s actions were clearly observed by Lin Jing through Observation Mode.
Ɲ0νǤο.сο
Seeing that the Golden Turtle had not found him and that there were no particular movements, Lin Jing finally relaxed.
Just now, after using Fixed Point Teleportation, Lin Jing did not delay whatsoever, immediately entering the System Space as he appeared.
The whole process was completed in the blink of an eye.
Therefore, although the Golden Turtle sensed Lin Jing’s presence, it did not spot him when it turned around.
Fortunately…
There were no limits on the number of uses or time to enter the System Space, which allowed Lin Jing to employ this method.
Otherwise, he would have had to fly out himself.
If he started flying here, it would invite trouble.
It would surely attract the pursuit from both the Golden Turtle and other creatures, just as Li Mingwu had encountered earlier.
Moreover.
From that recent event, Lin Jing had also discovered something.
Although the Golden Turtle was quite sensitive to sensing Qi, it seemed its spiritual intelligence had not been developing for long.
Therefore, in the face of Lin Jing’s sudden appearance and just as sudden disappearance, its reaction was not very strong.
……
After observing, Lin Jing planned to initiate Fixed Point Teleportation once more.
Now, he was far away from that Golden Turtle.
Just two more teleports and he would be out of the valley; once out of the valley, Lin Jing wouldn’t have to worry about being sensed by the Golden Turtle.
He could then quickly leave the area.
After losing the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, the giant golden turtle would surely go insane upon its return; to avoid any repercussions, it was best to leave promptly.
As for Li Mingwu and Daoist Long, they no longer required Lin Jing’s concernâ€”he would let them face the ire of the giant golden turtle.
……
Sometime later.
