After two Fixed Point Teleportations, Lin Jing was directly transported out of the valley, appearing on the mid-slope outside the valley.
This location was already quite distanced from the valley, and Lin Jing was also wearing the cloak made from the hide of a strange beast.
Thus, the Golden Turtle did not sense Lin Jing’s presence.
At this moment.
This mountain, as well as many strange beasts nearby, had all been awakened by the earlier giant golden turtle and were all chasing after Li Mingwu and Daoist Long.
There wasn’t a single strange beast left in the area.
Without concern for disturbing any strange beasts, Lin Jing quickly accelerated his pace and swiftly left the region.
……
Having left the valley, Lin Jing, to avoid any accidents, did not stop for two days and two nights.
It wasn’t until he reached the edge of the central region that Lin Jing finally relaxed.
He still hadn’t properly examined the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit he had collected.
Therefore, after relaxing,
Lin Jing once again entered the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing saw the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit still floating in its original place.
At the sight of the Five Elements True Spirit, Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown.
This Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit seemed somewhat uncomfortable in the System Space.
Lin Jing looked up at the Five Elements True Spirit in front of him.
The aura of metallic attribute on the Five Elements True Spirit was much fainter than when he had first brought it in.
The white glow it emitted had also dimmed.
Seeing this, Lin Jing immediately stepped forward to examine it closely.
After observing,
Lin Jing understood what was happening.
The reason for this was not the System Space itself, but rather the surrounding environment.
Previously,
this Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit had always been in the Metallic Realm of the Five Elements, where the spiritual energy of the metallic attribute was extremely dense.
It was precisely by relying on this dense metallic attribute spiritual energy that it was able to be nurtured.
Now that it was in a normal environment where the five types of spiritual energies were balanced and the metallic attribute spiritual energy was not as dense, the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit naturally felt discomfort.
If that was the case, then it would be easy to solve.
All Lin Jing needed to do was turn one of the Spirit Fields into a simulation of the Metallic Realm.
Knowing how to resolve the issue, Lin Jing then left the System Space.
As soon as he left the System Space, Lin Jing directly grabbed a piece of the black ground and lifted it up.
The black ground of the Metal Realm was likely some kind of metal, and exceptionally hard.
But this hard metallic ground was nothing in Lin Jing’s hands.
With just a little effort, he was able to lift a large piece of it.
Subsequently,
Lin Jing, holding the large chunk of black metal, re-entered the System Space.
Back in the System Space, Lin Jing directly concentrated his Soul Spirit power and wrapped around the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit.
As such, Lin Jing, holding that chunk of black metal and using his Soul Spirit power to envelop the Five Elements True Spirit, walked towards the back of the Spirit Field.
Upon reaching the back of the entire spread of the Spirit Field, Lin Jing opened the system panel and used the Spirit Field Expansion function directly.
Since the other Spirit Fields already had Spirit Plants growing in them, Lin Jing did not want to waste them, so he used the Spirit Field Expansion function to carve out a new Spirit Field.
As Lin Jing finished operating, the system’s notification sound immediately chimed:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host has expanded the Spirit Field, spending 2100 Harvest Points.
Current remaining Harvest Points: 65548.”
As the system prompt concluded, a piece of vacant land beside Lin Jing began to change.
After a while, this vacant land transformed into a new Spirit Field.
With the Spirit Field formed, Lin Jing directly tossed the black metal into it.
He then called out the System and used the Environment Simulation function to replicate the environment of the Metal Realm.
The Metal Realm environment simulated by the System Space was the same: black soil combined with golden and silvery lights, exactly like that in the external Metal Realm.
Lin Jing, then, transferred the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit to that Spirit Field.
And sure enough, as soon as it was relocated into the Spirit Field,
the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit immediately seemed different, as Lin Jing distinctly felt that its radiance became more brilliant.
Lin Jing didn’t know how others preserved their Five Elements True Spirits, but this method of preservation probably could only be done by himself.
After setting up the Five Elements True Spirit, Lin Jing did not linger in the System Space and directly left.
Having obtained the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, it seemed there wasn’t much left in the Metal Realm.
As for the treasure mentioned by Li Mingwu, Lin Jing had not seen it in the pit.
It might not exist, or it might be located elsewhere.
Lin Jing wasn’t sure.
However,
he did not plan to search for the treasure he wasn’t even sure existed.
And next,
it was time to leave the Metal Realm and go to the next layerâ€¦
…
…
Traveling from the easternmost edge of the Metal Realm to the middle core region took Lin Jing just over a month.
But leaving the core area to reach the extreme west of the Metal Realm took him less than a month.
The westernmost part of the Metal Realm was different from the east.
The sky here was no longer pure white,
but had a tinge of blue amidst the white.
Clearly, this must be under the influence of the next layer.
The next layer was the Wood Element Realm, filled with flowers, grass, and trees, naturally differing in color from the Metal Realm.
When Lin Jing arrived at the extreme west of the Metal Realm, he could see five pillars of light in different colors rising to the sky from a great distance away.
These five pillars were the Teleportation Array to the next layer.
This Teleportation Array could be activated simply with the Five Elements Command Token in hand; depending on which Token each person had, they would use different Teleportation Arrays.
In his hand, Lin Jing had the Five Elements Fire Command.
So,
his choice was the red pillar of light.
In this westernmost place, there were no more beasts,
Ling Jing did not delay and flew at full speed.
In no time at all, he arrived at the location of the red pillar, and indeed, below this red light was the Teleportation Array.
Upon his arrival, Lin Jing did not immediately step onto the Teleportation Array but first observed it for a moment.
Seeing nothing unusual,
Lin Jing then, holding the Five Elements Fire Command, stepped onto the Teleportation Array…

chapters.title: Chapter 694
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 694: Chapter 303 Wood Spirit Chapter 694: Chapter 303 Wood Spirit Lin Jing stepped into the Teleportation Array, and then the Teleportation Array activated, during which no problems were encountered.
Afterward.
Lin Jing was teleported away from the Metal Realm.
When the power of that teleportation dissipated and the things before Lin Jing’s eyes became clear again, he found himself surprisingly appearing midair.
This Teleportation Array, is indeed random…
Lin Jing, who appeared midair, did not panic, but immediately stabilized his figure.
Then.
...
He directly probed out with his Divine Sense, exploring his surroundings.
In the Wood Element Realm, Divine Sense was also suppressed.
Just like in the Metal Realm, his Divine Sense range was limited to within a hundred meters.
With his Divine Sense suppressed, Lin Jing stood in the void and then looked down.
The distance between Lin Jing and the ground below wasn’t too high, merely about a kilometer.
He could even see the forest beneath him.
The woods below were lush and verdant, where various flowers, grasses, and trees densely covered the entire ground.
Even the soil at the very bottom was not visible.
And.
Among those woods, trees a hundred meters tall stood one next to another.
This place seemed like an ancient forest rarely visited by humans.
Just as Lin Jing was preparing to descend to explore the forest below, suddenly.
Below in the forest, a violent fluctuation of wood attribute Spiritual Power suddenly appeared and then vanished.
After the fluctuations of the wood attribute Spiritual Power disappeared, countless green birds flew out from various places within the woods.
These birds were not large but were incredibly numerous.
They could even be described as filling the skies.
As if Lin Jing had invaded their territory, these birds flew out of the woods and directly swooped towards Lin Jing in the air.
Seeing these birds swooping in, Lin Jing’s brows slightly furrowed.
Then he gathered his Spiritual Power and unleashed a palm strike.
Lin Jing’s palm strike formed a huge palm imprint in the sky.
It even enveloped a considerable area below.
Many birds who could not dodge in time were directly hit by the palm imprint.
However, those birds struck by Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power-formed palm imprint did not burst apart.
They did not even spill blood on the spot.
Instead, they turned into a flurry of leaves, falling back down.
These birds were actually transformed from fallen leaves.
ƝονǤο.сօ
Lin Jing’s palm imprint, after passing through the birds, directly fell into the woods below.
This palm strike was immensely powerful.
On the ground below, a gigantic palm imprint was formed, measuring a kilometer across.
Under the imprint, those trees that had tightly covered the ground were all reduced to dust.
The original gray-brown soil also became visible.
Just after this palm strike.
Several finger-thick vines suddenly appeared in the dense forest below, shooting straight towards Lin Jing.
Lin Jing noticed these vines as soon as they appeared.
He also prepared himself, as Spiritual Power gathered once more.
However…
As the vines charged at him and Lin Jing was ready, gathering Spiritual Power to sever the vines, suddenly.
Another surge of Spiritual Power fluctuated from below the forest.
As this fluctuation arose, Lin Jing immediately sensed it.
He quickly looked toward the source of this Spiritual Power fluctuation.
He saw, standing atop the canopy of one of the trees, a creature less than three feet tall that resembled a being grown from a tree itself.
This being, much like a tree person, was made entirely of tree bark, with a crown of leaves on its head, and a garment sewn from leaves draped over its body.
Moreover.
In its hands, it held a bare root radiating Spiritual Power.
The wood attribute Spiritual Power fluctuation Lin Jing had just felt, was emanating from this tree person.
Upon seeing this tree person, Lin Jing immediately thought of the Wood Spirit that Li Mingwu had mentioned before.
This must be the Wood Spirit.
The Wood Spirit looked at Lin Jing and then waved the strange root in its hand.
As it waved the root in its hand.
Lin Jing felt the wood attribute Spiritual Energy surrounding him change.
This wood attribute Spiritual Energy, as if under the control of the Wood Spirit, formed an invisible wall of Spiritual Power around him.
At this moment.
The vines had reached Lin Jing’s side, attempting to entangle him.
Seeing this, Lin Jing directly transformed his gathered Spiritual Power into blades of wind and slashed out.
Yet, as the blades of wind were unleashed, they slowed down upon encountering the invisible wall of Spiritual Power and dispersed in the air before reaching their target.
Lin Jing understood that his blades of wind were nullified by the Spiritual Power wall surrounding him.
At this moment.
The vines had already surrounded him and seemed intent on binding Lin Jing.
Knowing that using Spiritual Power was futile, Lin Jing naturally stopped the pointless effort.
Then.
Lin Jing reached out and touched the invisible wall of Spiritual Power before him.
Upon contact with the wall of Spiritual Power, Lin Jing felt his own Spiritual Power being sealed.
If Lin Jing were an ordinary cultivator, his Spiritual Power being sealed, along with the vines that were about to strike, would likely make it difficult for him to escape.
But Lin Jing was not only a caster of spells but also a Body Refinement Cultivator who practiced the Martial Dao; the invisible wall of Spiritual Power did not affect him significantly.
Knowing that the invisible wall of Spiritual Power’s primary function was to restrain his own Spiritual Power, Lin Jing no longer hesitated.
He stepped forward, breaking out of the range of the invisible wall of Spiritual Power, and the vines that originally sought to entangle Lin Jing abruptly grasped at nothing.
Seeing Lin Jing break through the invisible wall of Spiritual Power, the tree person was taken aback.
It hastily waved the root in its hand, attempting to surround Lin Jing with the invisible wall of Spiritual Power once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 695
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 695: 303 Chapter 695: 303 And the vines, following suit, bent back and surged toward Lin Jing once more.
But the invisible wall of Spiritual Power was entirely ineffective against Lin Jing.
Seeing the invisible Spiritual Power wall unable to stop Lin Jing, the Wood Spirit swung its roots again.
Suddenly,
a surge of thousands of vines rose instantly from the large tree at its feet, forming a large wooden ball around itself.
However, after breaking through the barrier, Lin Jing had already reached the treetop, right in front of the Wood Spirit.
Then,
Lin Jing directly gathered Five-Colored Aurora and probed into the wooden ball, which was unable to block the aurora at all.
The Five-Colored Aurora easily penetrated it.
...
However…
After the Five-Colored Aurora entered, the vine-formed wooden ball rapidly withered and turned yellow, and the wood elemental aura within it quickly vanished.
Lin Jing then simply waved his hand, and the wooden ball immediately turned to sawdust, scattering in all directions.
The Wood Spirit inside, however, was nowhere to be seen.
It seemed that the Wood Spirit had used this method to escape.
Lin Jing then spread his Divine Sense, scanning the surroundings.
He also scrutinized the farther areas earnestly, attempting to locate the Wood Spirit.
However,
after a complete sweep, he still couldn’t detect any trace of the Wood Spirit.
Finding a Wood Spirit adept at hiding in the Wood Element Realm, where wood-attributed Spiritual Energy was dense,
was probably as hard as finding a needle in a haystack.
ɴօνǤօ.сο
After another thorough search by Lin Jing, the Wood Spirit was still nowhere to be found.
Thus,
after pondering for a while, Lin Jing decided to leave the place.
As for the Wood Spirit, if it didn’t show up, so be it.
But as soon as it did, Lin Jing was determined to seize the opportunity and capture it.
After reflecting, Lin Jing then headed into the sky, ready to depart.
However,
it was at that moment,
Lin Jing felt the wood-element Spiritual Power fluctuation again, this time, further from him than before.
Feeling this fluctuation of energy, Lin Jing immediately turned his head to look in the direction it came from.
He saw in the distance, at the top of a treetop,
the Wood Spirit still waving that peculiar root in its hand.
With its waving, a large number of trees beneath began to move.
Countless vines extended from the branches, swaying as they rose and converged toward Lin Jing’s side.
The Wood Spirit clearly was not convinced and was controlling so many trees to attack him.
All these vines, like tentacles, crept upwards.
The scene was akin to a pool of blood in hell, with countless arms stretching out from within.
It was both spectacular and eerie.
There were simply too many vines; if Lin Jing used the same method as before, it would be too troublesome.
Therefore,
this time Lin Jing activated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, and a purple flame rose up.
He spread a wide swath of flames in his hand, scattering them toward the vines that extended below.
On encountering Lin Jing’s purple flames, the vines quickly retracted, and some, unable to escape, caught fire instantly.
However, the flames did not persist for long, as the large trees severed the connection with the vines as soon as they began to burn.
Vines that lost their connection to the main body withered away instantly.
Next,
Lin Jing once again activated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, gathering purple flames.
However, this time, before Lin Jing could release the flames, all the vines had already retracted.
At this time,
the Wood Spirit, Lin Jing having repelled all the vines, once again resorted to old tactics, attempting to form a wooden ball and escape using that strange technique.
Seeing this, Lin Jing stepped forward, accelerating instantly and closing a great distance in a flash.
The Wood Spirit, seeing Lin Jing’s speed so fast, became flustered for a moment before hurriedly speeding up the formation of the wooden mass.
Witnessing this, Lin Jing accelerated once more and finally appeared in front of the forming wooden ball just as it was about to close.
By then, the interior of the wooden ball had already closed, while the outer layers continued to do so.
At that moment, Lin Jing reached in with his hand to grab and pull the Wood Spirit out.
However,
when Lin Jing reached inside, he grasped nothing; the wooden ball was completely empty.
Lin Jing’s brows furrowed slightly, then he withdrew his hand.
As Lin Jing’s hand was drawn out, the wooden ball withered away, and a gust of wind blew it into fine sawdust, dispersing with the wind…
The Wood Spirit had escaped again.
After the Wood Spirit fled, Lin Jing immediately began searching in the vicinity.
The Wood Spirit had a very unusual method of escape; there was no Spiritual Power fluctuation when it fled.
Even with his Divine Sense extended, Lin Jing couldn’t perceive anything.
After meticulously searching the nearby area once more, Lin Jing still could not find the Wood Spirit.
Looking at the lush greenery before him, coupled with the very rich Spiritual Energy, finding the Wood Spirit seemed harder than reaching the heavens.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing decided to first enter the System Space, to lie in wait for the rabbit and see if he could catch it.
The Wood Spirit seemed to be sentient, likely even monitoring him, which was why it chose to attack just as he was about to leave.
If so, then Lin Jing would set an ambush, to see if it would fall for it.
Having made up his mind, Lin Jing quietly summoned the System in his mind and then silently chanted,
“Enter System Space.”
Then,
Lin Jing took a step from the treetop, and the next moment, he disappeared from the spot.
…
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing did not delay, immediately activating Observation Mode.

chapters.title: Chapter 696
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 696: Chapter 303: Wood Spirit_3 Chapter 696: Chapter 303: Wood Spirit_3 As Observation Mode was activated, Lin Jing’s perspective once again appeared above the dense forest.
At this moment,
below Lin Jing’s observational view was the canopy of the hundred-meter-tall giant tree he had previously been in.
Within Observation Mode, Lin Jing watched every movement below, uncertain whether the Wood Spirit would come.
The reason for this was simply a gamble.
If it really did show up, then Lin Jing would take immediate action, capture it first, and resolve it later; if it didn’t appear, it would mean it was probably scared and had truly fled, so he could ignore it.
…
Lin Jing continued to monitor the area in Observation Mode.
...
And he paid attention to all suspicious sounds.
After observing for quite some time, he detected nothing unusual.
Just when Lin Jing thought that the Wood Spirit would no longer appear and was about to exit Observation Mode and leave,
there was some disturbance in the forest below.
Lin Jing quickly adjusted the observational view to the midst of the dense forest.
Within the forest, from one of the giant tree trunks, a head emerged.
This head belonged to the Wood Spirit.
After the Wood Spirit poked its head out, it looked around left and right and, seeing nothing amiss,
it then extended its body from the tree trunk.
No wonder Lin Jing had been unable to find it; the Wood Spirit had been hiding inside the tree trunk.
Quickly,
the Wood Spirit walked out from the tree trunk.
Surprisingly, the Wood Spirit came out from the tree trunk, but there were no cracks on the trunk.
It was as if it had merged into the trunk itself.
After the Wood Spirit came out from the trunk, it went directly to the canopy where Lin Jing had previously been.
Standing on the canopy, at the spot where Lin Jing had just disappeared, the Wood Spirit tilted its head and looked downward.
It seemed very perplexed.
Seeing the Wood Spirit like this, Lin Jing knew his guess was right.
The Wood Spirit was indeed monitoring him.
Lin Jing’s sudden disappearance had clearly been witnessed by it.
However,
since it had appeared again, Lin Jing naturally would not let it escape this time.
Through Observation Mode, Lin Jing noticed that the Wood Spirit was currently engulfed in confusion, its vigilance significantly reduced.
This was a perfect opportunity.
Therefore,
Lin Jing directly exited Observation Mode.
After exiting Observation Mode, Lin Jing did not dare to delay even a moment and immediately left the System Space.
Upon leaving the System Space, Lin Jing was already prepared.
Exiting the System Space and reappearing in the outside world, Lin Jing’s position was only a few feet away from the Wood Spirit.
The moment Lin Jing appeared, the Wood Spirit seemed to sense the danger and immediately trembled.
It didn’t even have time to look back before it prepared to use its strange escape technique again.
Numerous vines had already started extending from the tree, wrapping towards the Wood Spirit.
However,
given the proximity, Lin Jing certainly would not let it escape this time.
No sooner had he emerged than Lin Jing took a step forward and grabbed onto its arm.
At the same time, the Five-Colored Aurora that Lin Jing had already conjured flowed along the Wood Spirit’s arm into its body.
ƝοѵǤο.с0
But before Lin Jing could relax, the arm he was holding in his hands turned into decayed wood in an instant.
The decayed wood couldn’t withstand Lin Jing’s grasp and instantly turned into powder.
It was, indeed, an attempt by the creature to sever its limb and survive.
Seeing this tactic effective, the Wood Spirit quickly seized the opportunity to try and escape.
However,
although it had severed its limb to escape, the Five-Colored Aurora had successfully entered the Wood Spirit’s body.
Seeing this, Lin Jing controlled the Five-Colored Aurora inside its body to start stirring, ready to burst at any moment.
At the same time, Lin Jing communicated through Divine Sense without caring whether the Wood Spirit understood or not:
“Stop!”
“If you try to escape again, I will detonate the Five Elements Power inside you, and you will surely die.”
After Lin Jing communicated this, the Wood Spirit trembled and indeed stopped.
Then,
it turned around, a face full of pleading, looking at Lin Jing.
At the same time, a childish voice entered Lin Jing’s ears:
“I…
I won’t run!”
“You…
please don’t kill me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 697
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 697: Chapter 304: Negotiations with the Wood Spirit Clan Chapter 697: Chapter 304: Negotiations with the Wood Spirit Clan The Wood Spirit could indeed understand.
Lin Jing had guessed correctly; this Wood Spirit possessed spiritual intelligence.
Seeing the pleading look in the Wood Spirit’s eyes at that moment, Lin Jing did not soften his heart.
Instead, he once again gathered several streams of Five-Colored Aurora and injected them into the body of the Wood Spirit.
At the same time, he transmitted his voice:
“As long as you don’t play any tricks and honestly answer my upcoming questions, I won’t harm you.
However, if you have other ideas, I will immediately detonate the power within you.”
“Do you understand?”
The Wood Spirit hastily nodded:
“Understood…
Understood…”
Lin Jing nodded; only then did he relax, assessing the Wood Spirit before transmitting his voice and asking:
“Why did you attack me?”
The Wood Spirit looked at Lin Jing, a hint of grievance in its eyes, and then responded:
“You…
...
are an invader!”
“You outsiders, invaders, will destroy our home.”
“Are you calling yourself an invader?”
Taken aback upon hearing this, Lin Jing paused for a moment.
ƝονǤᴑ.ᴄᴑ
He then realized that this Wood Spirit had always lived in the Wood Element Realm and naturally considered it home.
Since he had intruded suddenly, in that perspective, Lin Jing truly was an invader.
The Wood Element Realm was a necessary destination, invader or not; it had to be this way.
Lin Jing then asked again:
“Does your tribe always attack invaders proactively?”
The Wood Spirit nodded, then shook its head.
After that, the Wood Spirit transmitted,
“A long time ago, we originally would not attack invaders proactively.”
“But later, invaders from the outside world came.”
“They not only killed our tribespeople indiscriminately but also tried to steal the True Wood Spirit, which our tribe has protected for generations.”
The True Wood Spirit, that is indeed the True Wood Spirit.
No wonder this Wood Spirit attacked him on its own; that was the reason.
Just at that moment.
The Wood Spirit transmitted again:
“Invader, what you desire is the True Wood Spirit, but the True Wood Spirit has already been gone for many years.”
“Could you please stop killing our people?”
“If you promise not to kill our people, I will go and beg the old chieftain to give you some other treasure.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing fell silent for a moment, then looked at the Wood Spirit and transmitted:
“I see you are quite powerful; if I did not have some methods, I might have really fallen for your trick.”
“Your tribespeople, although not as strong as you, should not be much worse, right?”
“How come they are no match for those invaders?”
At that, the Wood Spirit slightly lowered its head, its gaze evasive, not daring to meet Lin Jing’s eyes:
“I…
I am somewhat different…”
Seeing this, Lin Jing immediately knew the Wood Spirit was definitely hiding something.
Therefore.
Lin Jing directly transmitted to the Wood Spirit:
“Come here, let me check your body.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, the Wood Spirit immediately became nervous and involuntarily stepped back two paces.
This action made Lin Jing even more suspicious.
Earlier, when Lin Jing had injected the Five-Colored Aurora into the body of the Wood Spirit,
he had discovered something was off within the Wood Spirit’s body.
Inside it was a presence akin to the True Wood Spirit.
If Lin Jing had not encountered the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements True Spirit, he might have overlooked it, but having been in contact with the Metallic Attribute True Spirits, he could sense the presence of a similar True Spirit.
Now.
This action further confirmed his suspicion.
This Wood Spirit had a significant connection to the True Wood Spirit.
Seeing the Wood Spirit’s reluctance to come forward, Lin Jing transmitted directly:
“I have already detected the True Spirit within you; I just want to check, not harm you.”
Hearing Lin Jing say it directly, the Wood Spirit trembled and then, with a voice nearly crying, transmitted:
“Please, don’t kill me…”
“The True Spirit has already fused with me and cannot be extracted; even if you kill me, the True Spirit will also dissipate with me.”
“Please…”
Speechless, Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirit; it appeared very frightened.
He wondered where it had found the courage to attack him initially.
Lin Jing continued, transmitting:
“I’ll see what exactly is inside you; if it’s really as you say, as long as you cooperate with my inspection, I won’t kill you.”
“But if you do not cooperate…”
Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirit, his mind stirred, and the Five Elements Power inside the Wood Spirit’s body immediately became agitated.
The Wood Spirit shuddered in fear, looking at Lin Jing and nodding repeatedly.
“I…
I will cooperate.”
Having said that, the Wood Spirit reluctantly approached Lin Jing.
Lin Jing then spoke, asking the Wood Spirit:
“What is your name?”
“Ba…
Baba MÃ¹lÇŽng…”
“Baba MÃ¹lÇŽng, good!”
Lin Jing nodded.
Just as he was about to continue questioning, he sensed several ripples of energy approaching from afar.
Upon sensing these energy ripples, Lin Jing turned his head toward the direction from which the energy was coming.
Upon perceiving the energy, even Baba MÃ¹lÇŽng hurriedly raised his head, following Lin Jing’s gaze to look.
However, upon sensing the energy, Baba MÃ¹lÇŽng appeared exceptionally excited.
Lin Jing looked toward the front and quickly saw several figures appear.
These figures were also Wood Spirits.
Very similar to Baba MÃ¹lÇŽng.
All wore crowns made of woven leaves and cloaks made of leaves as well, even holding staffs resembling tree roots in their hands.
The Wood Spirits moved quickly; within moments, they had reached Lin Jing.
Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirits ahead, his brow slightly furrowed.
At that moment, the oldest-looking Wood Spirit among them took a step forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 698
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 698: Chapter 304 Negotiations with the Wood Spirit Clan_2 Chapter 698: Chapter 304 Negotiations with the Wood Spirit Clan_2 It first looked towards Papa Mulang, who was currently standing beside Lin Jing, and then turned its gaze towards Lin Jing.
Following that,
the aged Wood Spirit directly spoke to Lin Jing:
“Esteemed Human Cultivator, please release our clan member.”
This Wood Spirit had the strongest aura among those present and was even capable of speaking human language; it must be the elderly clan leader.
However,
Lin Jing was not certain and needed to ask.
Thus, Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirit and then asked:
“And who might you be?”
The aged Wood Spirit then responded:
“I am the clan leader of the Wood Spirit tribe.”
After speaking, it pointed toward Papa Mulang beside Lin Jing and continued:
“This clan member is of great importance to our Wood Spirit tribe.
We sincerely hope that you can spare it, and our Wood Spirit tribe will be eternally grateful to you.”
“Otherwise, our Wood Spirit tribe would rather sacrifice our entire clan to keep you here.”
“We hope you will carefully consider this and avoid a situation where both sides suffer losses.”
Having said this, the Wood Spirit clan leader bowed deeply to Lin Jing.Seeing that the attitude of the Wood Spirit clan leader was not good, but judging from his actions, Papa Mulang was indeed very important.
Otherwise,
the Wood Spirit clan leader would not have reacted in such a way.
...
Lin Jing, without further ado,
simply looked at the few Wood Spirits, especially at the clan leader, and said:
“I have no intention of being your enemy either.”
“However…”
“Before you ask me to release it, shouldn’t you first ask what it has done?”
Upon hearing this, the Wood Spirit clan leader immediately turned to look at Papa Mulang.
Papa Mulang, like a child who had misbehaved, quickly lowered his head, not daring to meet the eyes of the clan leader.
Immediately, the clan leader understood that it must have provoked Lin Jing first, which was why Lin Jing had captured it.
Following that,
the Wood Spirit clan leader’s expression became serious, and then he spoke out a strange syllable:
“Â¥%#…”
Papa Mulang, feeling somewhat ashamed, slowly raised his head.
Then, the same strange syllables also came out of its mouth.
Just like that, the two Wood Spirits began to communicate.
…
…
At first, only the Wood Spirit clan leader and Papa Mulang were communicating.
Latterly, the other few Wood Spirits beside the clan leader also joined the conversation.
Although Lin Jing could not understand them, he was not in a hurry and waited patiently.
Until a quarter of an hour later, when the Wood Spirits had finished communicating.
After they were done, the Wood Spirit clan leader bowed to Lin Jing and then said:
“Esteemed Human Cultivator, I am truly sorry.”
“I have not disciplined my clan member properly, and for that, I apologize to you.”
After saying this, the Wood Spirit clan leader also gave a stern look to Papa Mulang beside Lin Jing, then added:
“Papa Mulang, apologize at once.”
Upon hearing this, Papa Mulang quickly bent at the waist and gave Lin Jing a bow, at the same time sending a telepathic message:
“I’m sorry!”
Soon after,
the Wood Spirit clan leader once again spoke to Lin Jing:
“Human Cultivator, the fault does indeed lie with my clan member.
I beg you to be magnanimous and spare it.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, looked at the Wood Spirit clan leader and answered directly:
“I can release it, but not right now.”
Hearing the first half of the sentence, the Wood Spirit clan leader was initially pleased, but the latter half made him freeze.
After a moment of silence, the Wood Spirit clan leader spoke again:
“I know that you have come here seeking the True Spirit of Wood.”
“You must have sensed the presence of the True Spirit of Wood within Papa Mulang.”
“However, the True Spirit of Wood has now fused with Papa Mulang and cannot be extracted at all.”
“Even if you did manage to forcefully remove the Wood Spirit from Papa Mulang’s body, it would surely die, and the fused True Spirit of Wood would also certainly dissipate.”
“The mistake was made by Papa Mulang.”
“Our Wood Spirit clan sincerely apologizes to you.”
“But if you truly intend to extract the Wood Spirit from Baba Mulang’s body, then we of the Wood Spirit clan will surely fight you to the death,”
As the Wood Spirit Patriarch’s voice fell, the few behind him also stepped forward to show their determination.
It appeared that this Baba Mulang that Lin Jing had captured was indeed very important to the Wood Spirit clan.
If Lin Jing killed it, he would likely find it difficult to take a single step in the Wood Element Realm.
At this moment.
The Wood Spirit Patriarch spoke again:
“If you can let Baba Mulang go, our Wood Spirit clan will certainly thank you handsomely,”
After hearing this, Lin Jing directly said to the Wood Spirit Patriarch:
“I can let Baba Mulang go, but only when I leave the Wood Element Realm, otherwise it is impossible…”
“If I really let it go now, who knows if your Wood Spirit clan will go back on your word and retaliate again?”
“Only by keeping it by my side do I remain safe.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, the Wood Spirit Patriarch’s gaze turned grim:
“Do you actually intend to threaten our clansmen?”
“I just said, if you are willing to spare Baba Mulang, our Wood Spirit clan will certainly not trouble you, and will even present you with a grand gift,”
“This promise, I assure you as the Patriarch of the Wood Spirit clan.”
The Patriarch spoke solemnly.
After finishing, the Patriarch once again looked at Lin Jing with cold eyes:
“If you take Baba Mulang away, keeping it with you, who knows if you will take the opportunity to extract the true Wood Spirit from within him?”
Lin Jing, hearing this, looked directly at the Wood Spirit Patriarch and said:
“I am keeping Baba Mulang by my side only to ensure my own safety; I have no intention of taking its Wood Spirit.”
Facing Lin Jing’s statement, the Wood Spirit Patriarch seemed unconvinced:
“You cultivators from outside come here for the true Wood Spirit, and now the opportunity is right before you.
ƝοѵǤο.ᴄο
I do not believe that you can resist temptation?”
“Keeping Baba Mulang by your side, I cannot rest assured.”
“Just let Baba Mulang go, and our Wood Spirit clan will not break our word.”
The Wood Spirit Patriarch after saying this, waited a moment, seeing no intention from Lin Jing to release the captive.
The look in his eyes became hostile immediately.
And the Wood Attribute Spiritual Power around him became more active.
The other Wood Spirits beside the Patriarch, upon seeing this, also lifted their root-like staves, similarly gathering massive amounts of Wood Attribute Spiritual Power around themselves.
For a while.
All of the momentum was directed at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing’s brows were tightly furrowed as he looked at the Wood Spirit Patriarch.
He also grabbed Baba Mulang into his hand.
However, Lin Jing had only intended to protect himself.
If he truly came into conflict with the Wood Spirit clan, that was not what Lin Jing desired.
Therefore.
Lin Jing extended his hand, gathering a mass of Five-Colored Aurora, facing the Wood Spirit Patriarch.
He then directly spoke to the Wood Spirit Patriarch:
“I presume you are aware that we Human Cultivators need the true essence of Wood to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.”
“I possess all Five Elements within me; I do not need the true essence of the Five Elements to advance to the Solidifying Body Realm.”
“I’ve said before, this true essence of Wood is not so important to me, I am only keeping it by my side to avoid your clan’s potential treachery.”
“If you really don’t trust us, then we will just have to end up destroying each other.”
After saying this, Lin Jing’s grip on Baba Mulang tightened.
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, not only the Wood Spirit Patriarch but also the other Wood Spirits beside him fell silent.
After a moment of silence, the Wood Spirits beside the Patriarch began to communicate with each other in strange, archaic tones that Lin Jing could not understand.
Their discussion was very intense.
It seemed there were two sides, holding different opinions, arguing vehemently.
Yet the Wood Spirit Patriarch did not participate.
It was not until a period that felt as long as the burning of an incense stick that both sides seemed to have reached an agreement.
Afterward, one of the Wood Spirits spoke at length to the Patriarch.
Then.
After listening, the Patriarch nodded his head.
He then said to Lin Jing:
“You may keep Baba Mulang by your side for now.”
“However…”
“We have several demands that you must agree to.”
“Otherwise, we will have no choice but to wage war on you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 699
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 699: Chapter 305: Negotiations Concluded, Wood Spirit Clears the Way Chapter 699: Chapter 305: Negotiations Concluded, Wood Spirit Clears the Way Lin Jing nodded upon hearing this:
“Please speak…”
The Wood Spirit chieftain looked at Lin Jing, then spoke directly,
“Firstly…”
“Baba Mulang can stay by your side as a hostage, but we need to send two people to follow you at all times to ensure you do not harm Baba Mulang.”
Lin Jing thought for a moment, then nodded and said,
“That’s acceptable!”
“However…”
“You can send your people to follow us, but they must not get too close, and they must not attempt to take Baba Mulang away.”
“Should there be any attempt to forcefully take Baba Mulang before I leave the Wood Element Realm, I will immediately detonate the power within Baba Mulang’s body.”
“At that time, his death is certain, and a war between me and your Wood Spirit clan is inevitable.”
“Fine.”
“Before you leave this place, our other clansmen will not approach you, nor will they try to forcefully take Baba Mulang.”
Although the expression of the Wood Spirit chieftain was displeased, he nodded in agreement.
Lin Jing nodded, then asked,
“What’s your second condition?”
The Wood Spirit chieftain spoke directly,“Our second condition is that you must leave here as soon as possible, not using this as a pretext to linger in this realm.”
“Baba Mulang also needs to return to his clan soon.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“That’s naturally not a problem.”
“There seems to be nothing of interest here, anyway.”
“If possible, I would even appreciate your help in clearing the obstacles along the way to speed up my departure.”
No sooner had Lin Jing spoken than the Wood Spirit chieftain replied,
“Leave that to us.”
“Since you wish to leave quickly, that’s exactly what we would hope for.”
“Rest assured, with your word, we will not let you encounter any hindrance along the way.”
“We just hope that before you leave, you will also gladly remove the power embedded in Baba Mulang’s body.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“That’s no problem.
As soon as we are near the Teleportation Array, I will immediately remove the power left inside Baba Mulang’s body and let him go.”
The Wood Spirit chieftain glanced at Lin Jing, then continued,
“One last thing, it’s not so much a condition as a question.”
“I’d like to ask how many people you’ve brought with you this time, and what their capabilities are?”
“I’m asking not because I wish to do anything, but because I don’t want to entangle too much with you Cultivators from the outside.”
“I just want to safeguard my people.”
After listening, Lin Jing spoke directly,
“Five people.”
“And each of them is stronger than me.”
Having said this, Lin Jing again asked the Wood Spirit chieftain,
“Do you know if anyone came here before me?”
The Wood Spirit chieftain nodded and said,
“Our people control the entire Wood Realm.
Any little movement cannot escape our eyes.”
“Before you, there were already two people who arrived in this Wood Realm.”
“And…”
“Upon arriving here, after identifying their bearings, they soon left, not lingering here long.”
“And you are the third to arrive in this Wood Realm.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing quickly understood.
Presumably, those who had left were the elder of the Yan Family and Bai Yi.
As for Li Mingwu and the Dragon Taoist, they had been in quite a predicament after startling the golden giant turtle.
Even if they escaped the golden giant turtle and seized the chance to reach that deep pit, they would probably be at a loss.
...
They might still be searching for the mastermind who had stolen the Metallic Attribute of the Five Elements’ Spirit, not arriving so quickly.
Ɲονց0.сο
Having clarified all this, Lin Jing then continued,
“You should be cautious about the remaining two people.”
“They are not simple characters, and both have strong Cultivation.”
“If you don’t want conflict with them, I advise you to hide as much as possible and avoid contact.”
Upon hearing this, the Wood Spirit chieftain frowned and said,
“Are you saying they might pose a threat to us?”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Based on my understanding of them, that is very likely.”
“And they are the kind who will not stop until they achieve their goal.”
“If they learn that Baba Mulang carries the Wood Attribute Spirit, they will definitely do everything to take it.”
After hearing this, the Wood Spirit chieftain furrowed his brow and said,
“If that’s the case, we might have to lure them near that Demonic Tree…”
“Demonic Tree?”
“The one you mentioned, is it dangerous?”
Lin Jing asked the Wood Spirit chieftain.
The Wood Spirit chieftain nodded:
“In the center of the Wood Realm, there is a Demonic Tree a thousand zhang tall, extremely formidable.
Although it has some spiritual intelligence, it is utterly unreasonable and has exterminated all living beings within a thousand li around it, leaving not even a blade of grass.”
“Even our clansmen dare not get too close to that Demonic Tree.”
“As long as they enter the range of that Demonic Tree, it wouldn’t be easy for those two to escape.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing’s eyes darted about, then he suddenly had an idea and directly said to the Wood Spirit chieftain,
“I do have a plan…”
“But I’m not sure what you think of it?”
The Wood Spirit chieftain looked puzzled at Lin Jing, then said,
“What’s the plan, please tell…”
Lin Jing then, from his Space Ring, took out a piece of cloth with a trace of aura on it.
This was the corner of Lin Jing’s robe marked by the Dragon Taoist.
After taking out that corner of the robe, Lin Jing said to the Wood Spirit chieftain,
“This belonged to one of those two people I mentioned.”
“It has their trace left on it.”
“If they try to search for Wood Spirits, you can use this piece of cloth to draw them into that dangerous area.”

chapters.title: Chapter 700
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 700: Chapter 305: Negotiations Concluded, Wood Spirit Clears the Way_2 Chapter 700: Chapter 305: Negotiations Concluded, Wood Spirit Clears the Way_2 “Of course, if you could bring the bait along, that would be even better,”
Hearing Lin Jing speak like this, the Wood Spirit chieftain suddenly fell silent.
After a moment, he looked at Lin Jing again, his eyes slightly wary, and said,
“You wouldn’t happen to be thinking of using us to help you eliminate your enemies?”
Lin Jing laughed and replied,
“They are indeed my enemies,”
“But the initiative lies with you,”
“If they don’t provoke you and leave immediately after they arrive, then there’s no need for you to provoke them,”
“If they are truly searching for the Wood Element Five Elements Power and even come after you, it’s not too late to use this method then,”
“Don’t you think so?”
After hearing this, the Wood Spirit chieftain did not make a move yet.
The other Wood Spirits beside him began to communicate with each other.
This time, they did not argue.
Just moments later, they reached a consensus.
Then, one of the Wood Spirits whispered something in the ear of the Wood Spirit chieftain.
After listening, the Wood Spirit chieftain also nodded.
...
Subsequently,
The Wood Spirit chieftain said to Lin Jing,
“You’re right; not everyone is like you,”
“After all, our Wood Spirit ancestors have long warned us that most outside cultivators are ruthless,”
“We agree to your proposal,”
Lin Jing smiled, and then directly channeled his Spiritual Power, sending over the piece of cloth.
The Wood Spirit chieftain did not hesitate, directly condensed Wood Element Spiritual Power to catch the fabric, and then brought it in front of himself.
After receiving the fabric, the Wood Spirit chieftain inspected it and, seeing nothing out of the ordinary, he stashed it away.
Lin Jing then reminded,
“The range of the mark’s sensation on this goes for a thousand miles; you must be careful not to expose yourselves,”
The Wood Spirit chieftain nodded,
“Rest assured,”
“As soon as they come in, our people will be able to detect them immediately,”
After speaking, the Wood Spirit chieftain continued,
“That’s all we ask for, do you have any other requests?”
Lin Jing thought for a moment and then asked,
“I know, in each realm, apart from the Five Elements Power, there should be one extremely precious item,”
“I’d like to know, what is the treasure of your Wood Realm?”
Upon hearing this, the Wood Spirit chieftain’s face darkened instantly,
“There isn’t one,”
“Our Wood Realm doesn’t have the kind of treasure you’re talking about,”
The Wood Spirit chieftain’s reaction made it very hard for Lin Jing to believe his words.
Still,
he had just managed to reach an agreement with the Wood Spirits and naturally didn’t want to fall out over this issue,
Better to stay out of trouble,
and to leave the Wood Element Realm as soon as possible.
…
Next,
Lin Jing talked with the Wood Spirit chieftain for a while and then, as both had agreed,
Lin Jing took Babalon and left.
Two of the Wood Spirits who had been with the chieftain followed Lin Jing, watching his every move,
fearful that Lin Jing might harm Babalon.
As for the Wood Spirit chieftain, he led the rest of his people forward, informing his tribe to clear a path for Lin Jing.
The journey through the Wood Element Realm not only presented no danger, but even had locals clearing the path,
which could be said to be quite smooth sailing,
except for not gaining anything, all was well.
Lin Jing was transported to a place toward the southern side, while the Teleportation Array was on the very eastern edge of the Wood Realm.
Lin Jing, escorting Babalon, did not travel very fast; it would take about a month to reach the eastern edge,
Still,
with the Wood Spirits clearing the way, there was no danger along the path, so Lin Jing didn’t need to hurry.
…
…
In the blink of an eye, half a month passed, and Lin Jing had been in the Wood Realm for half a month.
Throughout this journey, Lin Jing could not say it was very comfortable, but it was certainly quite pleasant.
As for Baba Mulang, he basically only moved within a hundred meters of Lin Jing.
Of course, the Five Elements Power within him needed reinforcement by Lin Jing every two or three days.
Although it seemed that an agreement had been reached with the Wood Spirits.
But Lin Jing would not dare to gamble and place his reliance on others.
As for the two Wood Spirits who had been following behind, they kept a distance of a thousand meters from the two, a distance proposed by Lin Jing.
A thousand meters did not prevent them from keeping watch.
The Wood Spirit Tribe did not say anything, they just silently complied.
During this time, aside from Lin Jing, the one who was probably enjoying himself the most was Baba Mulang.
After the initial panic, Baba Mulang also discovered that Lin Jing would not harm him.
Instead, he became somewhat interested in Lin Jing.
Of course.
What he was actually most interested in was the outside world.
Their Wood Spirit Tribe had lived generation after generation in the Wood Element Realm, isolated from the world and never venturing out.
Even the little they knew of the outside world was from records left by their ancestors.
Therefore, they were both curious about and somewhat fearful of the outside world.
ɴ0νǤօ.сο
Especially someone like Baba Mulang who, although over a hundred years old, was only equivalent to a teenager in human years.
Still at an age where everything sparked his curiosity.
Naturally, he was exceedingly curious about the outside world that Lin Jing spoke of.
In the time they spent together, he had grown much more familiar with Lin Jing and frequently sought out Lin Jing to ask about the outside world.
When Lin Jing was free, he would also explain the outside world to Baba Mulang.
Of course.
Lin Jing not only explained, but sometimes he would also inquire with Baba Mulang about certain situations within the Wood Element Realm.
At first, Baba Mulang was somewhat guarded, but later relaxed his vigilance under Lin Jing’s subtle strategies.
Lin Jing came to understand.
Why Baba Mulang was so important.
The Wood Spirit Tribe belongs to the Wood Elves.
Naturally close to plants, they could even control them.
But there was also a drawback: Wood Spirits could only be born in places with exceedingly dense wood-type Spiritual Energy.
Not to mention a tribe of Wood Spirits developing; the amount of wood-type Spiritual Energy needed to form a tribe was even more exaggerated.
For such a race to continue.
Apart from wood-type Spiritual Energy, there needed to be a True Wood Spirit.
Each generation, the Wood Spirit Tribe would have a ‘Destiny’, whose mission was to merge with a True Wood Spirit.
Allowing a True Wood Spirit to merge with their tribe’s Destiny, thus blessing the tribe with its protection and ensuring the survival of the entire race.
And Baba Mulang, was that ‘Destiny’.
In the Wood Spirit Tribe, the previous Destiny had died many years ago, and their entire tribe had already diminished a great deal.
If Baba Mulang were to die as well, it was very possible that before the next True Wood Spirit appeared, this entire tribe would have disappeared.
It was for this reason that the Wood Spirit Tribe’s Elder dared to stake the entire tribe’s survival on Baba Mulang.
And Baba Mulang’s attack on Lin Jing was actually an accident.
Baba Mulang was supposed to stay within the tribe, but out of playfulness, he snuck out.
After all, Baba Mulang was nothing more than a child of around ten years old, naturally lively, and that was perfectly normal.
Moreover, after merging with the True Wood Spirit, Baba Mulang’s actual strength was not weak.
It was just that he lacked combat experience, and many of his tactics were almost useless against Lin Jing.
But his ability to escape was indeed quite good.
Otherwise, Lin Jing would not have been able to catch him only after using the System Space.
It can only be said that curiosity killed the cat.
If he had not been curious about Lin Jing’s sudden disappearance, he would not have been caught by Lin Jing.
During this time, Baba Mulang indeed asked about this matter, wanting to know how Lin Jing managed to disappear suddenly.
Lin Jing naturally could not answer.
He could only say to him mysteriously, “Secret,” leaving him there scratching his head…
…
Just now, Baba Mulang again asked Lin Jing about some extraordinary stories of the outside world.
After Lin Jing finished telling him and as he was about to leave,
Lin Jing stopped him, and then asked,
“Doesn’t your Wood Realm have any rare treasures?”
“Last time I brought it up, why did your tribe’s Elder seem to have a rather troubled complexion?’
“Is he hiding something from me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 701
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 701: Chapter 306: Trading the Undying Longevity Grass Chapter 701: Chapter 306: Trading the Undying Longevity Grass Baba Mulang hesitated for a moment, but ultimately still told Lin Jing.
“In our Wood Realm, there originally was a rank seven rare Spirit Grass, the Undying Longevity Grass.”
“Undying Longevity Grass!” Upon hearing about the Undying Longevity Grass, Lin Jing immediately became spirited.
The Undying Longevity Grass was the main ingredient for concocting the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
Coupled with the Eternal Life Vine, the elixir brewed could significantly increase a cultivator’s lifespan.
Although the lifespan increased wasn’t as exaggerated as a myriad of years, the lifespan a Supreme Grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir could add was still as much as a thousand years.
A Nascent Soul Cultivator’s lifespan was only about a thousand years, which illustrates just how powerful the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir was.
This thousand years of lifespan, when given to those top cultivators, was enough for them to accomplish many things.
...
Lin Jing then spoke to Baba Mulang,
“Having the Undying Longevity Grass should be a good thing, right?
So why does your clan chief seem not very happy about it?”
Baba Mulang sighed and continued,
“Sigh…”
“That Undying Longevity Grass should have been the most precious Spirit Plant in our Wood Realm, but unfortunately, the place where it grew wasn’t so favorable.
It grew too close to a Demonic Tree which often went berserk, and as you can imagine…”
“The Undying Longevity Grass was growing well but unfortunately, the Demonic Tree suddenly went mad and extended past its boundary, swallowing it whole.”
“In the end, it was the clan chief who personally took action and managed to wrestle the roots of the Undying Longevity Grass away from the Demonic Tree.”
“However, the roots of the Undying Longevity Grass that were retrieved, even after being replanted by the clan chief, remained in a state neither dead nor alive, failing to grow normally.”
“That is also why the clan chief harbors such a great resentment.”
“No wonder, so that was the issue.” Lin Jing suddenly understood.
Then, Lin Jing asked Baba Mulang again,
“Do your Wood Spirits need rare Spirit Plants too?”
Baba Mulang communicated via telepathy,
“Of course.”
“We not only need rare Spirit Plants, but we also cultivate some ourselves.”
“Just like human cultivators can obtain Spiritual Power from Spirit Stones for cultivation, we can also draw the Wood Element’s Spiritual Power from Spirit Plants to help us grow.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing promptly spoke,
“Doesn’t that mean your cultivation is similar to ours?
Both are about increasing your own Spiritual Power to become stronger.”
“Hmm.”
Baba Mulang nodded, “The clan chief once said this is also considered our way of cultivation.”
“Since your cultivation method is similar to human cultivators, does that mean the spells you used before are similar as well?” Lin Jing then asked another question.
Baba Mulang replied,
“Actually, there is some difference with the cultivation of spells.”
“The spells I use partly stem from innate inheritance, while the rest are taught by the clan chief.”
Lin Jing listened, frowning in thought for a while.
After pondering, Lin Jing said to Baba Mulang,
“Baba Mulang!”
“How about you contact your clan chief for me?
I want to propose a trade with him.”
“A trade?”
Baba Mulang looked up, puzzled as he gazed at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“If this deal goes through, your Wood Spirit clan might become stronger once again.”
“Really?” Baba Mulang looked at Lin Jing with a mix of astonishment and doubt in his eyes.
Lin Jing then continued,
“As for the specifics, I am not yet clear.”
“It’s a matter that only your clan chief, once he arrives, can discuss with me clearly.
You just need to tell those two clansmen following you that I have something to discuss with your clan chief.”
Although Baba Mulang did not understand why, after hesitating for a moment, he turned and began to communicate with the two Wood Spirits following behind him.
Lin Jing did not understand the language of the Wood Spirit clan.
But he was able to guess what their conversation entailed from their gestures and expressions.
After Baba Mulang spoke with the two clansmen behind him, from the reaction of the two Wood Spirits,
they seemed to be confused and even had a distrust towards Lin Jing.
It wasn’t until after a good while of back-and-forth that the other side finally relented.
Then, one of the Wood Spirits stayed to keep an eye on Lin Jing, while the other quickly disappeared into the dense forest.
Clearly,
he was off to notify the Wood Spirit clan chief.
……
The Wood Spirit clan’s efficiency was indeed commendable.
In less than six hours, the Wood Spirit clan chief appeared before Lin Jing.
ɴονǤօ.сᴑ
“You have something to ask me?”
The Wood Spirit clan chief looked at Lin Jing with impatience in his eyes.
Lin Jing paid no mind to it and directly inquired of the Wood Spirit clan chief,
“I would like to ask, can your Wood Spirit clan cultivate human cultivation techniques?”
Upon hearing this, the Wood Spirit clan chief’s brows furrowed slightly, before he said outright,
“Our Wood Spirit clan is quite different from humans, so naturally, we cannot cultivate human cultivation techniques.”
“And another thing…”
“Did you come to find me just for this matter?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing sighed helplessly and said,
“Sigh…
I had previously obtained a wood element cultivation technique that could help Spirit Plants grow, and I was hoping your Wood Spirit clan could cultivate it.”
“Now it seems, you can’t cultivate it either, what a shame.”
But before Lin Jing could finish his sentence,
the Wood Spirit clan chief’s eyes widened.
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, the clan chief immediately asked,
“What kind of cultivation technique can actually help Spirit Plants grow?”
“Come…”
“Let me take a look.”
Seeing the Wood Spirit clan leader’s reaction, Lin Jing didn’t say anything.
Instead, he directly took out the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique that Yue Qiniang had imprinted for him from his Space Ring.
Next.
Lin Jing opened up the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique and then tore it in half from the middle.
After tearing it, Lin Jing threw the first half to the Wood Spirit clan leader.
Seeing Lin Jing’s action, the Wood Spirit clan leader was so angry he nearly couldn’t speak, pointing at Lin Jing.
“You…”
“That’s truly a waste of heaven’s gifts.”
Lin Jing smiled and said:
“I assume, clan leader, you know that I’m doing this because I have a request.
If I gave you the complete cultivation technique, I suppose the item I seek would be out of reach.”
The Wood Spirit clan leader took the half-piece of the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique, then looked at Lin Jing with an expression that was both irritated and complex.
“As expected…”
“I knew it, you asking me to come, definitely wasn’t for anything good.”
“Speak, what do you want?”
Lin Jing didn’t beat around the bush and directly said:
“I’ve heard that you have a rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass which you have always been unable to grow.”
“What I want is exactly that Undying Longevity Grass rhizome.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, the Wood Spirit clan leader wasn’t angry.
Instead, he turned his gaze towards the side at Baba Mulang.
Baba Mulang seemed as if he had done something wrong and immediately lowered his head.
At this moment, Lin Jing spoke:
“Clan leader!”
“As the leader of the Wood Spirits, your actions naturally have to consider the entire clan’s well-being.”
“If this cultivation technique can indeed be used by your Wood Spirit clan, then the value of a single Undying Longevity Grass is actually nothing in comparison.”
“Don’t you agree?”
After hearing this, the Wood Spirit clan leader looked at Lin Jing and nodded.
“You’re absolutely right.”
“However, I still want to ask, why do you want the rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass, do you really think you can grow it?”
With the System Space, Lin Jing could certainly grow it.
However.
That, of course, was not something he could reveal.
“I’ve long heard of this Undying Longevity Grass and have also seen it recorded in books about Spirit Grass.”
“The reason I want the rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass is one, to see if it is truly as described in the books, and another is, naturally, I also wish to attempt to cultivate it.”
“Just because your Wood Spirit clan couldn’t grow it in the Wood Element Realm doesn’t mean we Human Cultivators can’t.
I intend to take it out and find someone to help take a look.”
After listening, the Wood Spirit clan leader gave Lin Jing a strange look and then said:
“A Spirit Grass that even our Wood Spirit clan fails to cultivate…”
“If you humans want to grow it, I think you’re being too naive.”
Lin Jing just laughed and said:
“It’s just a trial.”
“Even if I can’t grow it, I wouldn’t lose anything.”
“On the other hand, if this cultivation technique can indeed be practiced by your Wood Spirit clan, then your clan might be able to use it to grow stronger.”
“Don’t you wish for that?”
Lin Jing’s words silenced the Wood Spirit clan leader momentarily.
As the leader of the Wood Spirit clan, he naturally wished for his clan to grow stronger.
Afterward.
He looked at the half of the cultivation technique in his hand, then glanced at Lin Jing:
“Wait here for a moment.”
Having said that, he took the cultivation technique and started to go through it.
Ever since he knew that the Wood Spirit clan leader had the Undying Longevity Grass, Lin Jing had been tempted.
Then.
Lin Jing extracted some information from Baba Mulang.
And learned that the Wood Spirit clan also needed Spirit Plants.
So.
Lin Jing began to consider, what could be the most important thing for the Wood Spirit clan?
Thus.
Lin Jing thought of the cultivation technique, Shenglin Revival Wood Technique.
The Wood Spirit clan had always lived in the Wood Element Realm, rarely in contact with the outside world, not only were their resources limited, requiring self-sufficiency, but their cultivation techniques were certainly not many in number.
Moreover, such special techniques that could aid the growth of Spirit Plants and even shorten their growth cycles were even rarer.
By practicing such a technique, reducing the growth time of Spirit Plants and making them mature faster would mean that they could obtain more cultivation resources.
The more cultivation resources they acquired, the stronger their clan would naturally become.
This Shenglin Revival Wood Technique was more than suitable for the Wood Spirit clan.
Only.
Lin Jing wasn’t sure whether this cultivation method, originally belonging to the Human Race, could be practiced by their Wood Spirit clan?
……
When the Wood Spirit clan leader saw the cultivation technique, his eyebrows were tightly furrowed.
He flipped through the technique in his hand, slowing down with each page.
Sometimes, he would linger over a pair of pages for more than a moment.
The book wasn’t very thick, but by the time the Wood Spirit clan leader finished going through the half of the technique he had, six hours had passed.
He read very carefully, and during that time, Lin Jing didn’t disturb him.
He just waited quietly with Baba Mulang.
Only after flipping through the last page did he come back to his senses, then involuntarily looked towards the remaining half of the Shenglin Revival Wood Technique in Lin Jing’s hand…

chapters.title: Chapter 702
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 702: Chapter 307: Babamulang’s Wish, Leaving the Wood Realm Chapter 702: Chapter 307: Babamulang’s Wish, Leaving the Wood Realm “What do you think?”
“Do you want to make the trade?”
Lin Jing, seeing that the Wood Spirit Clan leader had finished reading the half of the Cultivation Technique he held, asked.
However.
The Wood Spirit Clan leader did not directly respond but said to Lin Jing:
“The first part of this Cultivation Technique does indeed seem interesting; however, it is a Cultivation Technique of the Human Race.”
“I have been deducing it all this time, trying to slightly modify this Cultivation Technique to suit our Wood Spirit clan.”
“Regrettably, the part you gave me is too little, and I simply cannot deduce it properly.”
“So…”
“Let me see the other half you hold, and if I can review the latter half, I will know if this Cultivation Technique can be adapted for our Wood Spirit clan.”
Having said this, the Wood Spirit Clan leader again spoke to Lin Jing:
“As for the Undying Longevity Grass, indeed, we cannot cultivate it ourselves; if this Cultivation Technique truly is useful, I will certainly be willing to exchange it with you, you can be assured of that.”
Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirit Clan leader, then tore the half of the Cultivation Technique he held and threw half of it over.
Without the complete Cultivation Technique, having half or three-quarters doesn’t make much of a difference.
After all, they won’t be able to practice it anyway.
Thus, Lin Jing was not worried.
After catching the small portion of the Cultivation Technique thrown by Lin Jing, the Wood Spirit Clan leader immediately began to review it again…
...
……
It took the Wood Spirit Clan leader four hours to finish reviewing this part of the Cultivation Technique.
After finishing, the Wood Spirit Clan leader once again began to ponder deeply.
This time, his contemplation was not short.
A long time later, the Wood Spirit Clan leader raised his head and said to Lin Jing:
“For this Cultivation Technique, I’ll trade with you.”
“Just wait here for a moment, I’ll go get the rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass.”
“Good!”
“Then I’ll just wait here for you,” Lin Jing said.
The Wood Spirit Clan leader nodded and then left directly.
After the Wood Spirit Clan leader had left, Lin Jing and Baba Mulang waited there for the Wood Spirit Clan leader to return.
At this moment, Baba Mulang was also very curious, asking Lin Jing:
“Does such a miraculous Cultivation Technique truly exist in this world?”
“One that can accelerate the growth of Spirit Grass?”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Of course.”
“This world is vast, with countless remarkable people; there are even more miraculous Cultivation Techniques than this one…”
After hearing this, Baba Mulang.
Bowed his head, seemingly pondering something…
……
The Wood Realm Clan leader did not take long to return, and he came back quite quickly.
Upon his return, the Wood Spirit Clan leader handed a wooden box directly to Lin Jing.
Then he said to Lin Jing:
“The rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass is in the box.”
Lin Jing nodded and then opened the box directly.
Inside the box, which was filled with soil, a hint of emerald green peeked out.
This hint of green was a half-inch segment of a grass blade, already missing its upper part; the broken part had not yet regrown.
The books had recorded that the Undying Longevity Grass had leaves a finger-width wide, entirely emerald green, with golden-yellow, sinuously curling rhizomes stretching an entire zhang…
Looking at this remaining fragment of a grass blade, it was indeed as the books described.
Lin Jing then gently moved aside a layer of soil.
The golden rhizome was also revealed.
Ɲονǥᴑ.с0
It too was as the books had recorded.
The most crucial part was that, even though it was so severely damaged, the aura emitted from the break was still refreshing and uplifting.
This was indeed the rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass.
“Now that you have the rhizome of the Undying Longevity Grass, shouldn’t you hand over the final part of the Cultivation Technique to me?”
Lin Jing covered the soil back up, then stored the wooden box away.
Then.
He directly threw the final part of the Cultivation Technique to the Wood Spirit Clan leader.
“There, the Cultivation Technique is yours now.”
“You can check, guaranteed fair and square.”
The Wood Spirit Clan leader carefully caught the Cultivation Technique thrown by Lin Jing, giving Lin Jing a glance:
“You don’t even know to cherish such a Cultivation Technique.”
“Truly a waste of natural resources…”
Having received the Cultivation Technique, the Wood Spirit Clan leader quickly started checking it.
This time, he read very quickly.
After reading the Cultivation Technique, the Wood Spirit Clan leader directly said to Lin Jing:
“It appears there’s no issue with the Cultivation Technique for now.”
“Next, I will take this Cultivation Technique back for further research, and if there’s any issue, I will come back to you.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“No problem.”
“But preferably within half a month.”
“Because I will be leaving here after half a month.”
“Once I leave, I might never come back in my lifetime, you should know this.”
The Wood Spirit Clan leader directly said:
“Rest assured!”
“You won’t need half a month; a few days should yield results.”
…
…
With the Cultivation Technique obtained, the Wood Spirit Clan leader left with it.
As for Lin Jing, he continued on his journey, heading east.
Soon.
Another half a month passed, and Lin Jing finally reached the far east of the Wood Element Realm, seeing several pillars of light that reached the sky.
During this time, the Wood Spirit Clan leader did not come looking for him.
Afterward, Lin Jing, accompanied by Baba Mulang, moved forward, approaching the Teleportation Array.
The Wood Spirit Clan leader appeared once more.
This time the Wood Spirit Clan leader was not alone; ten other clan members were behind him.
After appearing, the Wood Spirit Clan leader, his eyes calm but also holding a bit of wariness, directly said to Lin Jing:
“You have reached the Teleportation Array now, according to our agreement, isn’t it time to release Baba Mulang?”
Lin Jing glanced at Baba Mulang and nodded.
“Naturally, it should be so.”
Then,
Lin Jing directly activated the Five Elements Divine Art, extracting the several streaks of Five-Colored Aurora from Babamulang’s body.
The Five-Colored Aurora had been lurking within Babamulang’s body, causing no harm or discomfort to him.
When Lin Jing extracted all the Five-Colored Aurora from Babamulang’s body, it marked the final agreement between the two parties.
After removing the Five-Colored Aurora, Lin Jing looked towards Babamulang and communicated telepathically:
“All set, Babamulang!”
“You are free now, go back.
Your chieftain and your people are waiting for you.”
Lingering with Lin Jing during this period, Babamulang seemed somewhat reluctant to part ways suddenly.
But he knew well that he ultimately belonged to the Wood Spirit tribe.
Babamulang raised his head, looking at Lin Jing, and transmitted telepathically:
“Having always heard you speak of the outside world, I too wish to explore it.
However, being the Destiny of the Wood Spirit tribe, I am destined to devote my life to them and cannot leave this place.”
“Perhaps in my next life, I will be able to leave and see the world beyond.”
At those words, a sense of loss filled Babamulang’s eyes.
Lin Jing looked at Babamulang and then spoke:
“Not necessarily…”
“Perhaps in this life, you could take your people and leave this world.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Babamulang suddenly looked up at him.
This time, there was a light in his eyes.
Lin Jing smiled slightly and said to Babamulang:
“Go on!”
“Don’t keep your chieftain waiting too long.”
Babamulang nodded and then left Lin Jing’s side, running towards the Wood Spirit tribe.
Upon reaching his people, the chieftain of the Wood Spirits immediately pulled Babamulang aside and inserted a massive amount of Spiritual Power attribute to wood into Babamulang’s body.
Clearly,
Though they had interacted with Lin Jing for a considerable period, they still did not trust him completely.
Just as Lin Jing also did not fully trust them.
At this moment,
Lin Jing was only a few steps away from the teleportation pillar.
Even if they planned to betray him, Lin Jing was not worried.
The Teleportation Array connected these Five Elements Realms and was not something they could destroy.
Additionally, once activated, the transmission could not be interrupted.
Therefore,
as long as Lin Jing stayed near the Teleportation Array, he did not have to worry about them betraying and attacking him.
After verifying that Babamulang was unharmed,
the caution in the Wood Spirit chieftain’s eyes faded when he looked at Lin Jing again.
However,
some unrest was evident among the Wood Spirits standing behind the chieftain.
They frequently looked at Lin Jing while intensely discussing among themselves.
Judging by the situation, their discussion was certainly about Lin Jing.
Lin Jing could guess that
there was discord among the Wood Spirits.
Apparently, some Wood Spirits wanted to take this chance to attack him.
Though Lin Jing noticed the subtle movements among the Wood Spirits, he did not pay much attention to them.
Instead, he focused on the Wood Spirit chieftain.
Watching the chieftain to see his stance.
The Wood Spirit chieftain did not disappoint Lin Jing.
While those Wood Spirits were clamoring behind him, and Babamulang was ceaselessly trying to mediate,
the chieftain turned back and said something.
The Wood Spirits immediately stopped their bickering.
Then,
the Wood Spirit chieftain turned back and said to Lin Jing:
“Your Cultivation Technique is indeed useful.
I’ve modified most of it, and it’s usable now.”
“For this, we should actually thank you.”
Lin Jing looked at the Wood Spirit chieftain, smiling, and said:
“You could actually give me some Spirit Plants, I wouldn’t mind.”
The corners of the Wood Spirit chieftain’s mouth twitched, then he said:
“Spirit Plants are crucial to us, indeed, we cannot give you any.”
“However…”
“I can bring you some good news.”
“What good news?” Lin Jing asked, looking at the Wood Spirit chieftain.
“Those two Human Cultivators bearing a grudge against you arrived in the Wood Realm three days ago.
As you said, as soon as they entered, they started looking for the true spirit of wood.”
“Now, I’ve already dispatched our people to lead them to the Demonic Tree.”
“Once they enter the Demonic Tree’s range, even with their Cultivation, escaping will be difficult.
Even if they manage to escape, they’re likely to lose half their lives.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but smile broadly:
“Indeed a piece of good news!”
The Wood Spirit chieftain continued speaking:
“Since I have delivered the message, it’s time for you to leave.”
“Alright!”
Lin Jing had no intention of lingering and promptly agreed.
After speaking, Lin Jing also reminded the Wood Spirit chieftain:
“Right…”
“You must be careful with those two.
Although you say the Demonic Tree is formidable, their methods are unfathomable.
I actually think the Demonic Tree might not necessarily be able to handle them.”
After hearing this, the Wood Spirit chieftain frowned slightly, then said:
“Okay!”
“I’ll remember that.”
Lin Jing nodded and then walked directly towards the Teleportation Array emitting red light.
Upon entering the Teleportation Array, Lin Kai immediately invoked the Five Elements Fire Command.
Once the Five Elements Fire Command was sensed, the Teleportation Array changed, the formation beneath lit up, and the red pillar of light radiated even more intensely, enveloping Lin Jing completely.
At this moment,
Outside the formation, Babamulang ran over, waving at Lin Jing while telepathically sending him a message:
“Lin, until we meet again…”
“One day, I will take my people out.”
Lin Jing, wearing a smile, waved back at Babamulang while telepathically sending a message:
“I believe you!”
Then,
the red light exploded, and Lin Jing was teleported away…
