Since the attacker had used a spell similar to Soul Spirit, Lin Jing also had to use the power of the Soul Spirit to understand the situation clearly.
After reaching the Divinity Transformation Stage, the Soul Spirit was essentially Lin Jing’s true self.
If the Soul Spirit was injured, it could be very serious.
Even more severe, if an accident occurred with the Soul Spirit, it could lead to total destruction.
Therefore.
Using the Soul Spirit required extreme caution.
However, Lin Jing had already used his Divine Sense to investigate, and had some understanding of the Soul Spirit power entrenched in the Yan Family elder’s sea of consciousness.
That’s why he dared to use the Soul Spirit.
Lin Jing gathered his Soul Spirit, left his own body, and then entered the Yan Family elder’s body.
This time.
Because he was using his Soul Spirit directly, it was as if Lin Jing himself had entered the Yan Family elder’s body.
He was extremely careful with this step.

chapters.title: Chapter 722
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 722: Chapter 319 Evil Soul_2 Chapter 722: Chapter 319 Evil Soul_2 If one thing was off, he might only get injured, but the elder of the Yan Family would likely face the destruction of his Soul Spirit.
As he probed into the body of the Yan Family elder, Lin Jing once again encountered that special energy.
At this moment, with Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit present, he finally got a clear view of that energy.
The energy was extremely similar to a cultivator’s Soul Spirit, but there were differences; within it, Lin Jing could distinctly feel an extremely evil aura.
It looked like the work of a Demon Cultivator.
Within that evil energy, the Yan Family elder’s Soul Spirit had transformed into a small figure identical to it, and was currently sitting cross-legged there.
The miniature figure formed by the elder’s Soul Spirit continuously meditated while sitting cross-legged, surrounded by a blue light that kept the evil energy at bay.
...
The evil energy occasionally extended black tendrils, attempting to encircle the Yan Family elder’s Soul Spirit.
But upon contact with the elder’s Soul Spirit, those tendrils were immediately repelled by the blue light surrounding him.
It seemed that the evil energy was trying to erode the Yan Family elder’s Soul Spirit.
Seeing this, Lin Jing hurriedly controlled his Soul Spirit to approach the energy mass.
However.
This bundle of evil energy did not attack Lin Jing as his Soul Spirit drew near but instead released a force of repulsion, seemingly trying to push Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit away.
Lin Jing naturally would not allow this evil energy to have its way.
Next, Lin Jing stimulated his Soul Spirit, splitting off part of its power, and attacked the evil energy surrounding the Yan Family elder.
Lin Jing’s attack compelled the Soul Spirit energy to divide some power to counter him.
The evil energy was indeed powerful; even a small portion of it matched Lin Jing’s strength.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly divided another portion of his Soul Spirit power to bind it.
Upon splitting off another portion of his Soul Spirit power, Lin Jing immediately gained the upper hand in the confrontation.
The evil energy appeared to feel the pressure and quickly divided some more of its power.
To resist Lin Jing’s assault.
However.
After dividing off some of its power, the evil energy surrounding the Yan Family elder showed signs of loosening.
It was at this time, presumably, that the elder sensed someone assisting him.
The blue light that enveloped him began to surge, fighting back.
With the combined internal and external assault, the evil energy was momentarily unable to defend and was suppressed.
And it was at that moment.
That the Yan Family elder’s Soul Spirit finally opened its eyes and woke up.
Upon awakening, the Yan Family elder immediately noticed Lin Jing.
“Lin Jing?”
It was clear that the elder was incredibly surprised and even somewhat incredulous.
Lin Jing asked,
“Senior, what exactly is going on?”
“And what is this thing that has appeared in your sea of consciousness?”
The Yan Family elder hastily replied,
“We were careless earlier, getting exposed, and we were chased by a cultivator who practiced the Demonic Path and is in the Solidifying Body phase from Seaheart Island.”
“The thing that has entangled my Soul Spirit is the Evil Soul; it was cultivated by that Demon Cultivator, who slaughtered countless cultivators and refined it from their living spirits.”
“The Evil Soul specifically targets the Soul Spirits of cultivators.”
No sooner had the Yan Family elder finished speaking, the evil energy, the Evil Soul, started to stir again, trying to suppress the elder’s Soul Spirit once more.
Seeing this, Lin Jing once again split off Soul Spirit power, attempting to restrain the Evil Soul, yet it seemed to have grown cunning, only dividing a small portion of its energy to fend off Lin Jing.
While the majority of its power contracted fiercely, and numerous tendrils reached out, entwining around the Yan Family elder’s Soul Spirit.
That small cluster of energy was not much, but Lin Jing could not come up with a solution in that moment.
“Senior, how can this Evil Soul be dealt with?”
Lin Jing continued to resist the Evil Soul while simultaneously asking the Yan Family elder.
The Yan Family elder was also resisting the Evil Soul with all his might, but it was simply too powerful.
“This…
the power of this Evil Soul has already surpassed the realm of Divinity Transformation, only slightly inferior to a Solidifying Body cultivator,”
“You…
although your Soul Spirit is strong now, it’s still not quite enough.”
“If your Soul Spirit were a bit stronger, together, we could…
suppress this Evil Soul, and then I could destroy it.”
The Yan Family elder struggled to convey the situation to Lin Jing because of his resistance to the Evil Soul.
However.
It seemed as though the Evil Soul was sentient, not wanting Lin Jing to know too much, and at that moment it suddenly surged and grew even stronger.
The Yan Family elder also found himself completely unable to resist at that point.
“The reason I’ve fallen into such a state was due to Bai Yi’s betrayal, you must be wary of him if you encounter him,”
After imparting this warning, the Yan Family elder was once again suppressed by the Evil Soul and fell back into a deep slumber.
Without the Yan Family elder, Lin Jing alone was unlikely to have any effect against the Evil Soul.
Lin Jing had no choice but to retreat.
His soul spirit having returned to its place, Lin Jing also opened his eyes.
Before him, the Yan Family Elder still lay in a deep slumber.
Afterward.
Lin Jing rose to his feet, then left the cave dwelling and went to Changyun Yuanlei’s cave abode.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei quickly asked,
“Big Brother!”
“How is the elder faring?”
Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“There’s some trouble, and I am powerless for the time being.”
After speaking, Lin Jing said directly to Changyun Yuanlei,
“For the next period, I need to enter seclusion to enhance my strength.
Before that, there are a few matters I want to entrust to you.”
“What is it, Big Brother, you just say.”
Changyun Yuanlei was not at all vague, and immediately spoke.
Lin Jing said plainly,
“In the coming period, I need to be in seclusion, and since Elder Yan is currently unconscious, I’d like to leave him in your care for a while.”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei said outright,
“No problem, leave it to me.”
Having said that, Changyun Yuanlei then asked Lin Jing,
“Is there anything else?”
Lin Jing nodded his head.
“During this time, help me investigate the possible emergence time of the Soul Tomb.”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded,
“That won’t be a problem either.”
Having said this, Changyun Yuanlei suddenly asked Lin Jing,
“Right, Big Brotherâ€¦”
“During your previous long trip, did you manage to capture any Jade Soul Algae?”
Lin Jing nodded and then took out a piece of Jade Soul Algae from his Space Ring, handing it to Changyun Yuanlei.
“Here, it’s for you.”
When Changyun Yuanlei saw Lin Jing produce the Jade Soul Algae, he said in amazement,
“It’s really Jade Soul Algae!”
“This Jade Soul Algae is extremely precious.”
“Big Brother, are you really giving it to me?”
Lin Jing nodded and then spoke,
“I had good luck this trip, fortunate enough to capture a few pieces; I’m giving one to you.”
“I’ll need to trouble you during this coming period.”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei promptly nodded his head and happily accepted the Jade Soul Algae.
“Rest assured, Big Brother.”
“You focus on your seclusion; leave the rest to me.”
Afterward.
Lin Jing gave a few more instructions to Changyun Yuanlei and then also handed him some Spirit Stones.
Changyun Yuanlei, plagued by bad luck and misfortunate events, had long since depleted the hundreds of thousands of Superior Grade Spirit Stones he had.
Otherwise, he would not have continually thought about heading out to sea to hunt Sea Beasts.
Ɲοѵǥο.сο
The Spirit Stones Lin Jing gave him would allow him to avoid the troubles of the sea and better care for the Yan Family Elder.
As for Lin Jing himself.
He would need to consume the Jade Soul Algae during this period to enhance the strength of his soul spirit.
Previously, Lin Jing captured twenty-three pieces of Jade Soul Algae.
After giving one to Changyun Yuanlei, he still had twenty-two pieces left.
If he consumed and refined all twenty-two pieces of Jade Soul Algae, his soul spirit strength would probably be on par with a Nascent Soul Peak cultivator.
By then, not only would he be able to practice the Spirit Division Technique of the Way of Incarnation, but he could even rescue the Yan Family Elder in one fell swoop.
…
After making all necessary arrangements, Lin Jing found a deserted area on Lost Soul Island.
Then, in this area, he dug a simple cave as a temporary dwelling.
Once the cave dwelling was established, Lin Jing took out an Array Plate and concealed the entire dwelling.
Afterward.
Lin Jing entered the System Space directly from within that cave dwelling.
The situation, although not mentioned by the Yan Family Elder, was clear to Lin Jing that it could not be delayed for too long.
Inside the System Space, with the benefit of increased Flow of Time Speed, Lin Jing would be able to enhance his soul spirit strength more quickly and assist the Yan Family Elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 723
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 723: Chapter 320: Cultivating the Spirit Division Technique, Resolving the Evil Soul Chapter 723: Chapter 320: Cultivating the Spirit Division Technique, Resolving the Evil Soul Cultivation time always flies by quickly.
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
During these three months, Lin Jing had been continuously traveling between the System Space and the real world.
Although Lin Jing still had quite a bit of time remaining for entering the System Space, the consumption over several months was still too much for him to afford.
He could only cultivate in the System Space for a while, then come out and cultivate in the outside world for a while, cycling back and forth like this.
Until now.
…
...
At the moment, within the System Space, Lin Jing just stopped meditating.
Just now, Lin Jing had already completed the refinement of the twentieth piece of Jade Soul Algae, and although his cultivation was still at the seventh level of Divinity Transformation.
His Soul Spirit was incredibly condensed, having reached a level comparable to that of a Divine Transformation Cultivator at the Nascent Soul Peak.
With the current strength of his Soul Spirit.
He should already be able to help Ancestor Yan of the Yan Family deal with that Evil Soul.
But Lin Jing had no plans to leave yet.
ƝονǤο.ƈօ
With the current strength of his Soul Spirit, Lin Jing was also capable of cultivating the Spirit Division Technique from the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique.
Lin Jing planned to first cultivate the Spirit Division Technique, and after completing it, he would go to help Ancestor Yan suppress that Evil Soul.
Lin Jing was doing this to be more confident about the situation.
After cultivating the Spirit Division Technique, it would be like Lin Jing had split out another embodiment of himself, and his Soul Spirit would also divide into two.
After the Soul Spirit separated, each individual Soul Spirit might be weaker than it is now.
But when the two Soul Spirits combined into one, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit would become even stronger.
The stronger the Soul Spirit, the more confident he would be in dealing with that Evil Soul.
Therefore, Lin Jing had to cultivate the Spirit Division Technique first.
Next.
Lin Jing came to the Alchemy Room in the System Space; cultivating the Spirit Division Technique required an extremely strong Divine Sense, otherwise, if the Divine Sense wasn’t strong enough, it would be very easy to fail.
If it were someone else cultivating it, they would have to consume some Spirit Grass or Elixir Medicine to temporarily enhance their Divine Sense.
But Lin Jing didn’t need to; in the Alchemy Room of the System Space, Lin Jing could gain a 70% increase in Divine Sense strength.
With this 70% increase in Divine Sense strength, it was enough for Lin Jing to cultivate the Spirit Division Technique.
Coming to the center of the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing sat down cross-legged.
Next.
He took out the Jade Slip of the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique from his Space Ring and re-examined it to see if he had missed anything.
Although he had already reviewed the Jade Slip of the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique several times, Lin Jing still wanted to confirm everything once more at this critical moment before beginning his cultivation.
After reviewing it, Lin Jing confirmed he had not missed anything, then he put away the Jade Slip, closed his eyes to gather his Soul Spirit, and prepared to start cultivating the Spirit Division Technique…
…
…
It took a full seven days for Lin Jing to finally complete the cultivation of the Spirit Division Technique.
The process of cultivating the Spirit Division Technique was extremely painful, as it involved splitting one’s Soul Spirit into two; natural pain was inevitable.
However.
Fortunately, aside from some pain, the cultivation of the Spirit Division Technique went relatively smoothly, and no other accidents occurred during the process.
After completing the Spirit Division Technique, there were now two Soul Spirits in Lin Jing’s sea of consciousness, both emitting an aura much weaker than before.
But this was a normal phenomenon, as the Soul Spirit had split into two and naturally would be a bit weaker.
On the upside.
Lin Jing’s original Soul Spirit strength had already reached the Nascent Soul Peak and could not be further enhanced.
But now, after splitting into two, his Soul Spirit could continue to improve.
Having completed the Spirit Division Technique, it was natural to test it out.
And the best way to do so was through the use of Puppets.
After all, the creator of the Dao Transformation Divinity Technique was a Puppet Master.
Lin Jing also had quite a few Puppets.
Previously in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, Lin Jing had annihilated the Puppet Guild, seizing many spoils of war, most of which were Puppets.
Also, during his time in the Nanming Domain, the Golden Armor Puppet of Ancestor Yun was also taken by Lin Jing.
Afterward.
Lin Jing took out the Puppet of the Puppet Guild Leader from the Space Ring.
Then, Lin Jing directly used one of the Soul Spirits to enter the Puppet’s body and take control of it.
Even though the Soul Spirit was separate, there was still a connection between the two Soul Spirits, and Lin Jing could easily feel the situation inside the Puppet’s body.
With a thought, Lin Jing began to control the movements of the Puppet.
Even without having studied Puppetry, Lin Jing found controlling this Puppet very smooth, without any sense of hindrance.
After all, having the Soul Spirit inside the Puppet’s body was much more convenient than controlling it with Divine Sense.
After feeling it out for a while, Lin Jing then withdrew the Soul Spirit from inside the Puppet, directly returning it to his own sea of consciousness.
When Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit exited, the Puppet, no longer controlled, immediately collapsed to the ground.
Then.
Lin Jing controlled the two Soul Spirits again, condensing them back into a complete one.
And.
Although the Spirit Division Technique split the Soul Spirit into two, they were closely connected, so even when condensing back into one, there was no disconnection.
After the Soul Spirits merged, the combined strength of Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit surged, even stronger than before he practiced the Spirit Division Technique.
Lin Jing, with his current Soul Spirit strength, may not be able to outmatch a Solidifying Body cultivator, but among Divinity Transformation Cultivators, there were few who could compete.
Feeling the current strength of his Soul Spirit, Lin Jing was now absolutely confident that if he encountered that Evil Soul again, it would definitely be no match for him.
And now, it was time to go out.
…
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing directly appeared in the newly established cave dwelling he had created.

chapters.title: Chapter 724
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 724: Chapter 320: Cultivating the Spirit Division Technique, Resolving the Evil Soul_2 Chapter 724: Chapter 320: Cultivating the Spirit Division Technique, Resolving the Evil Soul_2 After coming out, Lin Jing didn’t delay.
After packing up the Array Plate that he had used to hide the abode, Lin Jing immediately left the dwelling.
By the time Lin Jing returned, Changyun Yuanlei was still cultivating.
Sensing someone’s arrival, Changyun Yuanlei hurriedly came out to check.
Only when he saw that it was Lin Jing did Changyun Yuanlei breathe a sigh of relief.
“Big brother, have you finished your retreat?”
Changyun Yuanlei looked at Lin Jing with a face full of surprise and asked.
Lin Jing had been out for a total of just over three months.
...
And for ordinary cultivators, a retreat was typically measured in years.
Those lasting only a few short months were very, very rare.
Moreover, the higher the cultivation of the cultivator, the longer the retreat, with some cultivators retreating for hundreds or even thousands of years.
Therefore, Changyun Yuanlei was surprised by Lin Jing’s early return.
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“It was just a small spell I was cultivating, so it didn’t take much time.”
“How’s Senior Yan?Is everything okay?”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded and said,
“Senior Yan is still the same, still unconscious.”
Lin Jing nodded and then said to Changyun Yuanlei,
“Thank you for your hard work.”
“In a while, I will help Senior Yan heal his injuries.
Later, I will need you to help me protect outside and not let anyone disturb us.”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded:
“Sure, no problem.”
Lin Jing nodded, and then he gave Changyun Yuanlei a few more instructions.
After the instructions, Changyun Yuanlei left the dwelling and assisted in protecting the two of them from the outside.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing once again took out a defensive Array Plate, activated it, and then went to the front of the Yan Family ancestor.
At this time, the Yan Family ancestor was still the same as before, with no changes.
Subsequently,
Lin Jing first extended his Divine Sense to probe the Evil Soul and discovered it showed no signs of growth.
After confirming there were no issues, Lin Jing then activated his Soul Spirit to exit his body and entered into the Yan Family ancestor’s interior.
The Yan Family ancestor’s body was, as usual.
His body’s Spiritual Power had increased a bit during this time compared to when Lin Jing last saw him.
It was clear that during this period, although the Yan Family ancestor had been constantly combating the Evil Soul, he was also attempting to regather his Spiritual Power.
Lin Jing didn’t pay attention to these details and headed straight for the mind sea of the Yan Family ancestor.
Upon reaching the vicinity of the mind sea, Lin Jing once again saw the Evil Soul.
The Evil Soul at this moment was extending countless black tendrils, tightly enveloping the Yan Family ancestor’s Soul Spirit, and the latter seemed to have grown even weaker, only capable of holding its ground within.
Upon seeing this, Lin Jing no longer hesitated and directly separated a portion of his Soul Spirit’s strength, surrounding the Evil Soul.
The Evil Soul, sensing danger, quickly released most of its controlling power, transforming the tendrils and directing them at Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit.
This time, the strength of Lin Jing’s divided Soul Spirit was much more powerful than before, and the Evil Soul seemed to have sensed this, naturally not daring to neglect it, making Lin Jing its target and launching an attack.
However,
At the moment when the Evil Soul released control over the Yan Family ancestor’s Soul Spirit, the latter also made a move.
This was precisely Lin Jing’s aim.
Facing the black tendrils reached out by the Evil Soul, Lin Jing met them head-on.
His Divine Sense was now much stronger than before, and naturally, he wasn’t afraid of the Evil Soul.
ɴονǤօ.сօ
Upon contact, Lin Jing immediately felt the utmost darkness, madness, and fear among other negative emotions emanating from the Evil Soul.
The Evil Soul seemed intent on affecting Lin Jing with these negative emotions.
But with Lin Jing’s powerful Soul Spirit and resolute will, how could he be easily influenced by this Evil Soul?
Thus, Lin Jing directly drove his Soul Spirit’s power, entangling with the Evil Soul, intending to dismantle and resolve it.
The Evil Soul also seemed to sense Lin Jing’s intentions and quickly divided a portion of its strength from the main body that was restraining the Yan Family ancestor, to resist Lin Jing.
As the Evil Soul divided its strength, the Yan Family ancestor’s Soul Spirit suddenly erupted, instantly releasing a strong burst of blue light.
The Evil Soul was caught off guard, allowing the Yan Family ancestor to escape from its restraints.
After the Yan Family ancestor broke free, the blue light emanating from him did not diminish, but instead grew more and more intense.
Seeing this, the Evil Soul hastened to retract the strength that was entangled with Lin Jing, attempting to re-imprison the Yan Family ancestor.
But naturally, Lin Jing would not allow it to succeed.
As it tried to withdraw, Lin Jing entangled even more aggressively, preventing its escape.
At this time, the Yan Family ancestor also transmitted a message to Lin Jing:
“Well done, Lin Jing.
Just hold it off for a little longer, and I will eradicate this Evil Soul.”
Having said that, the blue light exploding from the Yan Family ancestor’s Soul Spirit grew stronger, slowly enveloping the Evil Soul within.
Just as the Evil Soul was engulfed within, the force of the Evil Soul that had been opposing Lin Jing began to fade away slowly, until it finally dissipated completely.
Lin Jing knew that the ancestor of the Yan Family must have won.
The Evil Soul must have been eradicated by him.
After the power of the Evil Soul dissipated, Lin Jing did not exit immediately but continued observing.
Not until the green light gradually faded and he saw the Soul Spirit of the Yan Family’s ancestor unscathed did Lin Jing exit from the ancestor’s body.
Shortly after Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit left the Yan Family elder’s body, he awoke.
Seeing the elder awake, Lin Jing hurriedly spoke up:
“Senior, how are you doing?”
“You’re alright now, aren’t you?”
The Yan Family elder nodded, then said to Lin Jing:
“It’s all right now.”
“This time, I really owe you one.
Otherwise, I would have truly been finished.”
The Yan Family elder had just awakened, and at that moment, his condition was not very good.
Even after speaking just these few words, he appeared exhausted.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly said to the Yan Family elder:
“Senior, do you need help?”
“I have some Elixir Medicines here that can help you recover quickly.”
The Yan Family elder shook his head, then replied:
“No need…”
“I have my own Elixir Medicines.”
After speaking, the Yan Family elder took out a Jade Vial filled with Elixir Medicines from his Space Ring.
Seeing this, Lin Jing directly spoke to the Yan Family elder:
“Then, Senior, you should recover first.
I will come over again after you have recovered.”
The Yan Family elder nodded, then said:
“All right!”
“I suppose you also want to know about some events that occurred between Bai Yi and me.
I will tell you after I recover.”
Why had the Yan Family elder ended up in such a state?
And what exactly had happened between him and Bai Yi?
And what had they exposed?
Lin Jing was very eager to find out all this.
But considering the current poor state of the Yan Family elder, it was natural to wait for him to recover first.
Lin Jing nodded, then stowed his defensive Array Plate and left the cave.
“Big Brother!”
“You’re done so soon?”
Just as Lin Jing came out, Changyun Yuanlei greeted him.
Since preparations had been made in advance, dealing with the Evil Soul naturally did not take much effort.
So, it was relatively quick.
Lin Jing nodded, then said:
“With proper preparation in advance, things naturally went smoothly.”
“Senior Yan might need to recover for a while, so he might occupy your cave for some time longer.”
“No problem!” Changyun Yuanlei immediately responded.
Lin Jing looked at Changyun Yuanlei, then asked:
“Having been in here for such a long time, do you have any plans for the future?”
After hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei frowned and thought for a moment, then said:
“Big Brother!”
“To be honest, I really have no idea.”
“Before being swept into the Sea of Strange, I was always practicing Alchemy within the family, and I even rarely went out.”
“Even when I had to go out, there were family members accompanying me.”
“Not to hide it from you, Big Brother, but before I was swept in here, everything about me was arranged by the family, whether I liked it or not, and no matter what I did, I had to follow the family’s arrangements.”
“Perhaps it’s precisely because of this that many times, I don’t know what I truly want.”
Having said this, Changyun Yuanlei looked at Lin Jing and continued:
“Before I met you, Big Brother, I thought I would just stay on Fortune Island and just live out my days there.”
“But then I met you, and for some reason, from the first time I saw you, Big Brother, I felt an affinity towards you, as if we had a special destiny in the dark.”
“That’s also why I decided to follow you back to Lost Soul Island.”
“As for what comes next…”
Changyun Yuanlei paused for a moment, then went on:
“I will continue to follow you, Big Brother.
Wherever you go, I shall go…”

chapters.title: Chapter 725
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 725: Chapter 321: Awakening of the Yan Family Patriarch Chapter 725: Chapter 321: Awakening of the Yan Family Patriarch Changyun Yuanlei’s voice fell, and Lin Jing fell silent, lost in thought.
During the time he had spent with Changyun Yuanlei, Lin Jing had come to understand his temperament.
Although he was a son of the Changyun Clan, his outstanding alchemy talents meant he was carefully nurtured by his family and had hardly ventured out, which shaped his current personality.
He was sincere and straightforward with people, harboring no schemes or tricks.
Lin Jing had actually considered helping Changyun Yuanlei leave, but it wouldn’t be easy to do so.
Unless.
He could obtain another Five Elements Command Token.
...
But that Five Elements Command Token was in the possession of others, and even for Lin Jing, obtaining it was no easy feat.
…
…
“I asked you to help me investigate when the Soul Tomb appears, how did your inquiry go?” Lin Jing suddenly turned his head and asked Changyun Yuanlei.
Changyun Yuanlei replied to Lin Jing:
“Big Brother!”
“I have looked into the Soul Tomb.
Its appearance is unpredictable, occurring as infrequently as once every few years to once every few decades.”
“The longest interval between appearances does not exceed a hundred years.”
“Moreover, I found out that the last time the Soul Tomb appeared was fifty-two years ago, so, Big Brother, if you really want to check out the situation in the Soul Tomb, at most it will appear again within fifty years.”
“Additionally…”
“I also learned for you, Big Brother, that before each appearance of the Soul Tomb, a rainbow divine light will appear.
When the rainbow divine light emerges, it can even be seen from Lost Soul Island.”
“So you need not worry, Big Brother.
ƝοѵǤօ.ᴄο
As long as you’re on Lost Soul Island, just wait for the appearance of the rainbow divine light.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded his head.
He then turned to look directly at Changyun Yuanlei and said earnestly:
“I appreciate your hard work.
Once I find a way out, I’ll take you with me.”
“Okay!”
Changyun Yuanlei didn’t seem to believe that Lin Jing could leave the Water Element Realm, responding simply before continuing to caution him:
“However, Big Brother, you must be careful.
Don’t act rashly.
The Soul Tomb is extremely dangerous and leaving it is certainly not easy.”
“If it proves too difficult, don’t force it.”
Lin Jing clearly understood what Changyun Yuanlei’s thoughts were.
Yet, he did not offer an explanation.
…
When the Yan Family ancestor had fully recovered, it was already three days later.
As the Yan Family ancestor emerged, Lin Jing hastened to greet him:
“Senior!”
The Yan Family ancestor nodded, then addressed Lin Jing:
“This time, I owe you my thanks.”
“If it hadn’t been for you, alone I wouldn’t have been able to deal with that Evil Soul.”
Lin Jing quickly replied:
“Senior, you are too kind.”
Following that.
The Yan Family ancestor continued to question Lin Jing:
“The person who saved me before, why don’t I see him here?”
Lin Jing promptly said:
“Changyun Yuanlei has gone to cultivate.
Fearing he might disturb you, he has moved to another place and created a new cave dwelling.”
Upon hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor first looked stunned and then spoke:
“Changyun…”
“Is he from the Changyun Clan?”
Lin Jing nodded and then recounted Changyun Yuanlei’s circumstances to the Yan Family ancestor.
Upon hearing it, the Yan Family ancestor suddenly realized:
“So that’s how it is…”
After saying so, he couldn’t help but express his feelings:
“I can attribute my rescue this time to him as well.”
“Had I not met him, I fear I would have perished before even meeting you.”
Lin Jing also expressed his sentiment:
“Yes, although he seems to be plagued by bad luck.”
“Every time he encounters misfortune, it seems to bring good luck to those around him.”
Speaking of this, Lin Jing suddenly turned his head and asked the Yan Family ancestor:
“By the way, Senior…
“You mentioned earlier that you were betrayed by Bai Yi.
What happened?”
Upon hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor’s expression immediately darkened.
Then, the Yan Family ancestor began to speak to Lin Jing:
“Actually, this matter has to start with that water attribute Five Elements True Spirit…”
…
…
So it went, the Yan Family ancestor explained the situation to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing also learned the gist of the matter from the Yan Family ancestor.
It turned out that after entering, the Yan Family ancestor did not tarry on the first two levels and went straight to the Water Element Realm.
After entering, it was there that the Yan Family ancestor encountered Bai Yi, and at Bai Yi’s invitation, he helped him to explore the water attribute Five Elements True Spirit.
Bai Yi himself possessed a Dual Attribute Spirit Root and had already collected one of the Five Elements Spiritual Roots before entering these ruins.
Now he was only missing two Five Elements True Spirits to complete his set, and one of those he lacked was this water attribute Five Elements True Spirit.
The Yan Family ancestor initially thought they should cooperate as allies and not fall out with Bai Yi, especially with the threat of Li Mingwu present, and it wasn’t an apt time for a falling out on Seaheart Island.
Moreover, Bai Yi promised great rewards, so the Yan Family ancestor agreed to help.
After some planning, the two went to Seaheart Island.
With extensive investigation, they managed to track down the trail of the water attribute Five Elements True Spirit.
That water attribute Five Elements True Spirit had already been obtained by someone, and the one who got it was one of the two ringleaders of Seaheart Island.
But the power of Seaheart Island’s ringleaders had long surpassed Solidifying Body and reached the Dao Integration Stage.
The Five Elements True Spirit naturally held no allure for them.
Thus.
The water attribute Five Elements True Spirit was awarded to one of their subordinates who was at the Divinity Transformation Stage.
That Divinity Transformation Stage cultivator, after obtaining the water attribute Five Elements True Spirit, delayed his breakthrough and kept the True Spirit stored without attempting Refinement.
It was at this moment that the Yan Family ancestor and Bai Yi learned of this news.
Upon hearing it, Bai Yi was restless.
He wanted to claim it by force.
Originally, the two had a plan and were not reckless about taking action on Seaheart Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 726
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 726: Chapter 321: The Awakening of the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 Chapter 726: Chapter 321: The Awakening of the Yan Family’s Ancestor_2 But just as the two of them had made plans, Bai Yi, while tracking the person, stumbled upon a perfect opportunity and acted without even notifying the Yan Family Patriarch.
This action inadvertently alerted the followers of the two Seaheart Elders on Seaheart Island, even drawing the attention of one cultivator who used a special Magical Treasure to detect the aura of their Five Elements Command Tokens.
For ordinary cultivators in the Water Element Realm, the Five Elements Command Tokens might be unknown.
But the followers of the two Seaheart Elders, especially those above the Nascent Soul Stage, had more or less heard of the Five Elements Command Tokens.
They also knew that to leave, one must possess a Five Elements Command Token.
Thus,
under such circumstances, the pursuit of the duo by Seaheart Island had begun.
Bai Yi’s unauthorized action had already displeased the Yan Family Patriarch.
...
However, after the two of them regrouped, Bai Yi’s apologies and explanations had somewhat eased the Yan Family Patriarch’s resentment.
This matter might have been settled there, with no further issues.
However, it was what happened later that truly enraged the Yan Family Patriarch.
While speaking, the Yan Family Patriarch yelled angrily,
“Bai Yi is truly shameless.
If it weren’t for that dire moment, I might never have seen his true colors.”
“What happened at the time?” Lin Jing asked.The Yan Family Patriarch then said,
“Originally, even though we were not a match for that Solidifying Body cultivator, if we had joined forces, leaving might have been possible.”
“But that scoundrel, in order to save his own life, ran off by himself, and even set me up right before he left, attempting to use me to stall the enemy so he could escape.”
“If it weren’t for that setup, which caused me to use up a lifesaving method, I wouldn’t have been helpless when facing the Evil Soul later.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, fell silent as well.
Indeed, it’s hard to truly know someone just by their appearance.
Lin Jing had dealt with Bai Yi a few times, and Bai Yi had seemed decent, not someone who would go to any lengths for his own benefit.
But at the crucial moment, he ultimately revealed his true nature.
“So what does senior plan to do next?”
The Yan Family Patriarch replied,
“Next, we definitely need to prepare to leave.”
After saying this, the Yan Family Patriarch added with a cold tone,
“However…”
“before that, I definitely need to find Bai Yi.”
“Since he set me up at a crucial moment, I naturally won’t let it go, and must make him pay the price.”
Lin Jing nodded upon hearing this,
“Since he did that, he must bear the corresponding consequences.”
After saying this, Lin Jing continued to question the Yan Family Patriarch:
“Senior…”
“Since our possession of the Five Elements Command Tokens has already been revealed, are we still in danger?”
The Yan Family Patriarch then said,
“It’s a bit problematic, but it’s not that serious.”
“Didn’t I tell you before, that Seaheart Island has a special Magical Treasure that can detect the aura of the Five Elements Command Tokens?”
“You don’t need to worry now.”
“In their attempt to track me, they employed that Magical Treasure, but I have already destroyed it.”
“Additionally, the two Seaheart Elders are currently in seclusion, reportedly practicing a special Cultivation Technique, and they aren’t expected to come out any time soon.”
“As long as we’re a bit cautious, there should be no problem.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“That’s good…”
…
…
Afterward.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing said to the Yan Family Patriarch,
“Senior!”
“Aside from the Five Elements Command Tokens, do you know of any other method to leave these Five Elements Ruins?”
The Yan Family Patriarch shook his head and said,
“Aside from the Five Elements Command Tokens, there isn’t a second method to leave these Five Elements Ruins.”
Lin Jing nodded and then spoke again:
“I want to take someone with me from here.”
The Yan Family Patriarch looked at Lin Jing:
“You’re talking about Changyun Yuanlei.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Changyun Yuanlei has some connections with me, even with sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue.”
“Connections with Xing’er and Yue’er?
What’s the story?” the Yan Family Patriarch asked incredulously.
“Previously, sisters Yan Xing and Yan Yue had been abducted, then we rescued them, and three persons, including myself, escorted them back to Spirit Rock Island.”
The Yan Family Patriarch said,
“I’m aware of this.”
“Aren’t those three your friends?”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes,”
“And among those three, one has a special relationship with Changyun Yuanlei, almost to the point of becoming Dao Companions,”
“So it was like that…” Yan Family’s ancestor couldn’t help but be somewhat surprised.
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes,”
“Therefore, I want to help Changyun Yuanlei leave this place.”
After hearing this, Yan Family’s ancestor spoke directly:
“That can be easily done.”
“At that time, I will bring the Five Elements Earth Command directly to Changyun Yuanlei,”
“After all, he once saved my life.
Helping him like this is only right; you don’t need to worry.”
Lin Jing then looked at Yan Family’s ancestor and said,
“Senior!”
“I can also help.”
Yan Family’s ancestor looked at Lin Jing and said,
“There’s no need, Bai Yi is no match for me.”
“The reason I was injured was because of those Solidifying Body Cultivators who were pursuing me.”
At this point, Yan Family’s ancestor sized up Lin Jing, and with a half-smile said,
“If I hadn’t been injured and sensed your Soul Spirit, I might have really believed your cultivation was only at the early Nascent Soul Stage.”
“Your cultivation must be more than that, right?”
Before assisting Yan Family’s ancestor, Lin Jing had considered the problem of exposing his cultivation, but given the urgency of Yan Family’s ancestor’s situation, if Lin Jing had refrained from acting just because of the issue of exposing his cultivation,
then not to mention other things, he himself would not have felt at peace.
Therefore,
Lin Jing had no choice but to set aside his concerns.
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes, senior.”
“Indeed, I have concealed my cultivation, and I hope you forgive me for that, senior,”
Yan Family’s ancestor waved his hand:
“It’s fine!”
“In such a situation, recklessly revealing your cultivation would not have benefited you, but would instead have made people wary.”
“Before this, I was still a bit hesitant, even considering playing dumb with Bai Yi for a while, after all, Li Mingwu and Daoist Dragon are our real enemies,”
“But after sensing your Soul Spirit, I made up my mind not to spare Bai Yi, to take revenge for the deception I suffered.”
At this point, Yan Family’s ancestor looked at Lin Jing and asked,
“Tell me the truth, what exactly is your cultivation level?”
“Divinity Transformation seventh level!” Lin Jing disclosed.
Yan Family’s ancestor nodded:
“That’s enough!”
“With both of us, Li Mingwu and Daoist Dragon will be enough to handle.”
“We don’t need Bai Yi now.”
Continuing,
Yan Family’s ancestor then said to Lin Jing:
“Next,”
“I will go find Bai Yi, take revenge for the deceit suffered, and on the way, I will seize that Five Elements Earth Command from him.”
“As for you, just stay on Lost Soul Island, waiting for the Soul Tomb to appear, and as soon as it does, immediately inform me,”
Having said that,
Yan Family’s ancestor took out a jade token and handed it to Lin Jing.
This jade token, was meant for communication.
As long as Lin Jing input Spiritual Power into it, another token in Yan Family’s ancestor’s hands would react.
That way, Yan Family’s ancestor could be notified.
…
After arranging everything, the two of them met Changyun Yuanlei together.
Afterwards,
Yan Family’s ancestor didn’t stay much longer and left Lost Soul Island.
He went to look for Bai Yi.
As for Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, they continued to stay on Lost Soul Island.
After Yan Family’s ancestor had left, Lin Jing did not stay for long either.
After explaining things to Changyun Yuanlei, Lin Jing also left Lost Soul Island, heading towards the area where the Soul Tomb was located, to continue hunting for Jade Soul Algae.
Since the appearance of the Soul Tomb was unpredictable, Lin Jing naturally could not stray too far, and since he couldn’t leave, naturally he should find something to do.
And the task Lin Jing found was to continue gathering Jade Soul Algae.
Moreover…
Having practiced the Spirit Division Technique, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit had split into two, thus becoming much weaker, and now he needed to continue enhancing his Soul Spirit with Jade Soul Algae.
ɴοѵǤᴑ.сο
Therefore,
Lin Jing needed to head towards the area of the Soul Tomb, to continue capturing Jade Soul Algae and improve the strength of his own Soul Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 727
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 727: Chapter 322: Li Mingwu Reappears Chapter 727: Chapter 322: Li Mingwu Reappears Over a verdant sea surface, a black figure flew past.
As the black figure flew by, its speed was not very fast, and it didn’t even cause the slightest ripple.
Given its behavior, it seemed to be intentional.
Possibly to conceal something, or perhaps to avoid disturbing something.
Quickly,
the black figure stopped.
It turned out to be an elderly man clad in a black robe.
Now hovering in the air, the black-robed elder gazed down at the sea with furrowed brows.
...
“It’s really strange, recently, the Jade Soul Algae seems to be decreasing,” he muttered softly to himself as he eyed the sea below with a frown.
“It’s already the third time, and I haven’t encountered even one Jade Soul Algae; they seem to have all gone into hiding.”
“Could it be that the Soul Tomb is about to appear?”
After speaking, the black-robed elder stroked his chin and waited with knitted brows for a long while.
Only after a long time did the black-robed elder speak again:
“Forget it, let’s try one more time…”
“If I still can’t find any, then I’ll go back.”After saying this, the black-robed elder left once more.
This black-robed elder was, in fact, the Shopkeeper from the Drunken Soul Tavern we met before.
His purpose here was once again to capture Jade Soul Algae.
…
Ɲονǥօ.сο
…
After the black-robed elder left, he selected another spot.
Then, he took out an Ice Crystal Coffin and laid down inside.
After lying down, as usual, the black-robed elder paid no more mind and let the Ice Crystal Coffin free fall and sink to the sea bottom.
This time,
five days passed before the calm sea surface rippled again.
The black-robed elder, dragging the coffin, surfaced.
After emerging from the sea, the black-robed elder’s face was almost as dark as his robe.
Upon coming out, the black-robed elder promptly stored the Ice Crystal Coffin inside his Space Ring and leaped into midair.
He circulated his spiritual power to evaporate the moisture from his body.
The black-robed elder, gazing at the verdant sea surface, murmured:
“It’s truly bizarre.”
“In the past year, the Jade Soul Algae here seems to have become less and less for some reason.”
“Especially this time, I didn’t bump into a single one.
Have all the Jade Soul Algae here been captured, or”
“Or is it because the Soul Tomb is about to descend, and they’ve all gone into hiding?”
“I’ve been here for hundreds of years, and I’ve never encountered this situation before.”
“Something’s not right…”
The black-robed elder muttered to himself while looking down at the now calm sea surface once more.
After observing for a while, the black-robed elder sighed and softly said:
“Alas…”
“Perhaps the Soul Tomb is indeed about to emerge, making this place unsafe.”
“I’d better go back this time.”
After speaking, the black-robed elder took one long, penetrating look at the sea surface.
As if trying to see through the waters themselves.
After that glance, the black-robed elder promptly departed.
Long after the black-robed elder had left, without any sign, another figure emerged where he had been.
After appearing, this figure looked in the direction the black-robed elder had left and shook his head:
“Maybe the Soul Tomb is really about to emerge.”
“This time, I only managed to capture seven Jade Soul Algae.”
“It’s really…
far too few…”
The figure that appeared afterward was none other than Lin Jing.
After speaking, Lin Jing cast a deep look in the direction the black-robed cultivator departed, then turned and left in a different direction.
The black-robed elder left outward, because he couldn’t capture any Jade Soul Algae, so he had to leave.
Whereas Lin Jing left inward.
Because Lin Jing still had to capture more Jade Soul Algae.
…
…
Two years had passed since Lin Jing parted ways with the Yan Family patriarch.
During these two years, the Yan Family patriarch had been relentlessly searching for Bai Yi’s whereabouts, returning only a few times.
Bai Yi had gone into hiding after deceiving the Yan Family patriarch and had not reappeared since.
The Yan Family patriarch was keen to find him but could not come up with any method to do so.
While the Yan Family patriarch kept searching for Bai Yi, Lin Jing continued to capture Jade Soul Algae while awaiting the emergence of the Soul Tomb.
It must be said, in capturing Jade Soul Algae, Lin Jing had a much higher success rate with the help of System Space than the black-robed elder did.
In just two years, Lin Jing had already captured over a hundred pieces of Jade Soul Algae.
Whether Lin Jing had exhausted the local supply of Jade Soul Algae remained uncertain.
Initially, each time Lin Jing emerged, he could find at least a dozen or twenty pieces,
but as the number of his outings increased, the number of Jade Soul Algae he could capture became fewer and fewer.
Especially this time.
Having been out for nearly two months now, Lin Jing had only managed to capture seven pieces of Jade Soul Algae.
Seven pieces, to Lin Jing, were not many.
With the aid of System Space, Lin Jing did not need to wait idly like the black-robed elder to capture Jade Soul Algae.
Lin Jing could use Observation Mode to monitor a vast area of sea containing Jade Soul Algae.
As soon as he detected any trace of Jade Soul Algae in Observation Mode, Lin Jing could immediately use Fixed Point Teleportation to transport himself next to the Jade Soul Algae and, upon capturing them, bring them into System Space.
This method of capture was efficient and fast,
and it even had a high success rate.
Thus,
it did not take long for Lin Jing to capture a significant amount of Jade Soul Algae.
As Lin Jing continued his relentless capture, the amount of Jade Soul Algae here dwindled and became increasingly difficult to capture.
The decline in Jade Soul Algae most greatly affected that black-robed elder.
In the beginning, the black-robed elder occasionally managed to capture a few, but as time went on, the number of Jade Soul Algae he captured became less and less.

chapters.title: Chapter 728
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 728: Chapter 322: The Reappearance of Li Mingwu (2) Chapter 728: Chapter 322: The Reappearance of Li Mingwu (2) Especially in the past year, the amount of catches by the black-robed elder was less than five.
And this time, it was a complete waste of effort, as not even a single Jade Soul Algae was seen.
No wonder the black-robed elder’s complexion had turned so dark; anyone encountering such a situation would likely not remain calm.
If Changyun Yuanlei had seen the black-robed elder’s expression, he probably would have felt extremely pleased.
There was no helping it, since that old man liked to trick people.
Now, ironically, the tricked one had become himself.
…
...
…
Soon.
More than half a month passed by.
On this day, the sea surface once again rippled, and as the waves grew bigger, a figure emerged from the ocean depths.
It was Lin Jing, who had just finished catching Jade Soul Algae.
Upon surfacing, Lin Jing stored the now emerald green Jade Soul Algae and then flew into the air, circulating his Spiritual Power to dry the seawater off his body.
After drying off, Lin Jing looked in the direction of the fog wall.
He was ready to leave.
In this period, Lin Jing had caught three more pieces of Jade Soul Algae.
With these three, Lin Jing now had exactly one hundred and fifty pieces, and with that amount, he no longer intended to continue catching them.
The Jade Soul Algae here had been almost completely harvested by him.
What remained was scarcely worth mentioning.
To try catching more would be time-consuming and laborious, and he predicted that not many pieces could be obtained.
Furthermore,
The more than one hundred pieces of Jade Soul Algae were enough for Lin Jing to use.
Lin Jing had originally caught more, but a portion of them had already been used by him.
After practicing the Spirit Division Technique, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit strength had been split in two, becoming weakened once again.
Therefore,
Lin Jing alternated between catching Jade Soul Algae and using them, significantly increasing the strength of his Soul Spirit.
Now, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit, even when divided, was already on par with the Nascent Soul Peak.
When combined, it exceeded the Nascent Soul Peak.
It could be said that with Lin Jing’s current Soul Spirit strength, if he were to encounter that Evil Soul again, he alone could destroy it.
Also, within the Water Element Realm, the distance Lin Jing’s Divine Sense could probe had increased from the initial one hundred meters to three hundred meters.
That was three times more than before.
These improvements showed just how significantly the Jade Soul Algae had enhanced Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit.
Although one could strengthen their Soul Spirit by consuming Jade Soul Algae, there seemed to be a limit to its usage.
Recently, Lin Jing felt that the effects gained from consuming Jade Soul Algae were diminishing.
This was another reason Lin Jing decided to leave.
After deciding to depart, Lin Jing arrived at the fog wall and then entered the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing hesitated no further and activated the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
“Ding!”
“System notification: Host uses Fixed Point Teleportation, deducting one Harvest Point.
Current Harvest Points remaining: 72103 Harvest Points.”
As the system notification sounded, Lin Jing was teleported away.
After being teleported, Lin Jing directly summoned his Flying Boat and steered it towards Lost Soul Island.
There was still a considerable distance from here to Lost Soul Island.
Even with Lin Jing’s speed on the Flying Boat, it would take about a day to reach Lost Soul Island.
Fortunately, the Shadow Escape Flying Boat was not only fast but also virtually silent during flight, which helped avoid attracting the attention of Sea Beasts.
…
Having left the area where the Soul Tomb was located, Lin Jing hastened his journey back to Lost Soul Island.
In this Northern Marine Domain, due to the dangers present,
very few Cultivators would venture here.
Aside from needing to be cautious about the grey mist, there weren’t many other concerns.
Lin Jing originally thought that his journey this time would be smooth sailing.
Thus,
he picked up the pace to quickly reach Lost Soul Island.
Unexpectedly, during his flight, a strong surge of Spell fluctuations came from the white mist ahead.
These Spell fluctuations were intense, indicating a battle was happening.
Even enclosed in his Flying Boat, Lin Jing could clearly feel them.
Given the intensity of the Spell fluctuations from ahead, the other party’s Cultivation was probably not inferior to Lin Jing’s own.
Thereafter.
Lin Jing immediately became alert and quickly controlled the Flying Boat to stop.
In these Five Elements Ruins, Divine Senses are suppressed to an extreme degree, even cultivators’ Divine Senses are extremely stifled.
Judging from the magical fluctuations coming from ahead, the people in conflict were still some distance away from him.
The Shadow Escape Flying Boat made very little noise when traveling, so it was likely they hadn’t noticed him.
Without any delay, Lin Jing then stowed away the Flying Boat and then entered the System Space.
Given the uncertainty of the situation ahead, it was naturally prudent to investigate first.
Following that,
within the System Space, Lin Jing activated Observation Mode and probed toward what was ahead.
As his viewpoint moved through layers of fog, Lin Jing soon saw two figures in the distance.
As it turned out by coincidence,
these two were precisely the Yan Family Patriarch and Bai Yi.
At that moment, the Yan Family Patriarch wore a cold expression as he looked coolly at Bai Yi.
Whereas Bai Yi looked pale, with his aura also seeming unstable.
Bai Yi frowned deeply, looked at the Yan Family Patriarch, and then spoke,
“Yan Yujiang…”
“Regarding the previous incident, it was an emergency, and I had no choice.
Indeed, I did wrong by you.”
“But you have been chasing me for quite some time, what exactly will it take for you to let me go?”
The Yan Family Patriarch looked at Bai Yi and snorted coldly,
“Hmph!”
“If you want me to spare you, then first hand over that Five Elements Earth Command you have on you.”
“As long as you give up the Five Elements Earth Command, I will let bygones be bygones and spare your life.”
Upon hearing this, Bai Yi’s face immediately darkened,
“Impossible!”
He rebutted straightaway,
“Without the Five Elements Earth Command, I can never leave this place for the rest of my life.
You are sentencing me to death.”
The Yan Family Patriarch then spoke in a cold voice,
“To spare your life is already an act of mercy on my part.
If you refuse to hand it over, then I’ll have to take it from you personally.”
“Do you really think, with your strength, you can escape from my clutches?”
Upon hearing this, Bai Yi’s expression became even more gloomy, and then he spoke in a deep voice,
“Yan Yujiang, I admit that I am indeed no match for you.”
“But if you truly insist on pushing me to a corner, then I will have no choice but to fight to the death with you.”
The Yan Family Patriarch remained expressionless upon hearing this.
But on his body, countless streams of cyan-colored aura had already started to circulate, clearly ready for battle at any moment.
Seeing the Yan Family Patriarch like this, Bai Yi also mobilized the spiritual power within his body, ready to respond at any time, while simultaneously saying,
“I had heard before that Yan Yujiang was magnanimous and often conducted himself with all the grace of a gentleman.
It seems now those claims were unfounded.”
The Yan Family Patriarch snorted coldly and said,
“Humph!”
“I, Yan Yujiang, am most generous to my friends, but from the moment you betrayed me, we have been enemies.”
“As for you, Bai Yi…”
“I had also heard that you were an honorable and well-known figure, known by everyone as a righteous man.
Now it seems, your righteousness is nothing but an empty reputation.”
As the words of the Yan Family Patriarch fell, Bai Yi wanted to argue back, opened his mouth, but ended up saying nothing.
Although Bai Yi did not respond, another voice came at this time:
“Yan Daoist friend, you have misunderstood him.
Ɲονǥᴑ.сο
Bai Yi was truly a righteous man before.”
Hearing this voice made Lin Jing involuntarily startle.
Because the speaker was none other than Li Mingwu.
Unexpectedly, he had appeared here.
As the sound of his voice faded, two figures then emerged from within the white fog.
One was hunched over, with a withered complexion.
The other was dressed like a Taoist.
These two were Li Mingwu and Long Daoist.
As the two emerged from the fog, the Yan Family Patriarch and Bai Yi both instantly became guarded.
However, Li Mingwu seemed unconcerned and spoke directly to the Yan Family Patriarch,
“Yan Daoist friend, you really have misunderstood this Bai Yi.”
“To tell the truth, Bai Yi indeed is a man of integrity.”
“Otherwise, after my disappearance, with the support of a host of good friends, he would not have been able to seize Yue Tian Island with lightning speed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 729
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 729: Chapter 323: Li Mingwu’s Calculations Chapter 729: Chapter 323: Li Mingwu’s Calculations “You’re saying that, aren’t you, Bai Yi?”
At this point, Li Mingwu turned his head and looked at Bai Yi.
Li Mingwu’s words rendered Bai Yi momentarily speechless.
Bai Yi didn’t argue, while Li Mingwu continued,
“It’s just that people change…”
“Especially after having tasted the flavor of power.”
“Just like I did back in the day, Bai Yi is merely treading the path I once took.”
Bai Yi didn’t respond immediately but looked at Li Mingwu, his brows furrowing:
“How did you two appear here?”
As he spoke, Bai Yi turned his head to look at Long Daoren and asked:
“Was it you?
Did you track us?”
Clearly.
As an Island Master of one of the three major islands, Bai Yi should be aware of some of the methods Long Daoren possessed.
However, faced with Bai Yi’s suspicion, Long Daoren directly shook his head and said:
“You should know that my tracking mark cannot escape your notice.”
As soon as Long Daoren finished speaking, Li Mingwu spoke up:“Don’t overthink it, it was me!”
At these words, Bai Yi’s expression changed immediately:
“Did you tamper with something on me?”
After speaking, Bai Yi quickly mobilized his Spiritual Power, examining his body.
Li Mingwu chuckled lightly and said:
“Heh heh…”
“Stop looking, you won’t find the methods I’ve used.”
“From the moment you stepped into Yue Tian Hall, you were trapped as you began cultivating there.”
Speaking of this, Li Mingwu’s eyes displayed a nostalgic expression:
“Speaking of which, I owe it all to Ling Yi…”
“If it weren’t for Ling Yi’s constant help, you probably wouldn’t have fallen for the trap so easily.”
“Speaking of Ling Yi, it really is a pity…”
Upon hearing it was True Lord Ling Yi, Bai Yi’s complexion grew even paler.
...
True Lord Ling Yi had been with him for not a short period.
Before the incident at the Five Elements Cave Mansion erupted, Bai Yi had always deeply trusted True Lord Ling Yi.
If he had indeed done something beforehand that even he hadn’t noticed, it was indeed possible.
Thus.
Bai Yi quickly mobilized his Spiritual Power and examined his body closely.
Yet Li Mingwu disregarded Bai Yi and continued speaking to himself:
“In these hundreds of years, Ling Yi has been working for me, truly loyal.
I had planned to cultivate him into my most capable subordinate.”
“It’s just a pity that, in the end, Ling Yi died by your hand.”
“Sigh…!”
As he spoke, Li Mingwu could not help but sigh.
Although Li Mingwu spoke of it being a pity, his face showed no sign of sorrow.
Having finished, Li Mingwu continued addressing Bai Yi:
“Frankly, this was like avenging yourself in advance.”
Upon hearing this, Bai Yi’s expression became even more turbulent.
Yet he did not give up, the Spiritual Power within him surged wildly, trying to discover the unknown method Li Mingwu had used inside him.
As Bai Yi was inspecting himself, Li Mingwu calmly retrieved a semi-transparent purple gemstone from his Space Ring.
He then casually lifted a hand and projected the purple gemstone, hovering it at the center of his palm.
Afterward.
Li Mingwu directly stimulated his Spiritual Power into the purple gemstone.
As Spiritual Power flowed continuously into it, the purple gemstone began emitting a dazzling purple light.
Simultaneously, as the purple gemstone emitted purple light, a pale purple glow also began to appear within the wildly running Spiritual Power of Bai Yi.
And with time, that pale purple glow grew increasingly intense.
At this time.
Bai Yi’s entire face had turned purple.
Although he was still wildly running his Spiritual Power, he soon found that the control over his Spiritual Power was slipping away.
“What is this thing?”
“What exactly have you done?”
At this moment, a look of terror appeared on Bai Yi’s face.
Li Mingwu replied unhurriedly:
“This object, I call it the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade.”
“As long as you are in prolonged contact with it, it can assimilate the Spiritual Power inside your body.”
“And this Spirit-Integration Demon Jade is extremely concealable; unless I use the master jade in my hand, you will never discover the anomaly within yourself.”
“Unfortunately, during the construction of Yue Tian Hall, I had placed many shards of Spirit-Integration Demon Jade inside.”
“Having lived with this Spirit-Integration Demon Jade for hundreds of years, the Spiritual Power in your body was no longer your own, and you probably didn’t know that.”
At this point, Li Mingwu began to laugh:
“It’s a pity that you, Bai Yi, really do have some means now; if I were to start doing this today, you would probably notice the signs very quickly.”
“But back then, you were just a bit too naive.”
Upon hearing this, Bai Yi’s face turned ashen.
He had not expected that ever since he became the Island Master of Yue Tian Island, he had already been schemed against by Li Mingwu.
Soon.
Li Mingwu’s Spiritual Power turned an ever deeper shade of purple.
And in less than a moment, his Spiritual Power had changed from pale purple to deep purple.
During this process, Bai Yi continually struggled, but to no avail.
Even the Yan Family’s old ancestor didn’t dare to rashly step forward, but instead watched Li Mingwu closely and remained on guard.
After a while.
The deeply purple Spiritual Power in Bai Yi’s body abruptly left his body, transforming into a long rainbow that flew toward the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade in Li Mingwu’s hand.
As Bai Yi’s body’s Spiritual Power continuously dissipated, the color of the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade became deeper and deeper.
Meanwhile, Bai Yi’s cultivation was incessantly decreasing.
Ɲ0νǤᴑ.сο
It turned out that the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade not only assimilated Spiritual Power but could also absorb a person’s cultivation.
With his own Spiritual Power out of control and his cultivation still dropping, Bai Yi was truly at his wit’s end now.

chapters.title: Chapter 730
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 730: Chapter 323: Li Mingwu’s Calculations_2 Chapter 730: Chapter 323: Li Mingwu’s Calculations_2 At that moment,
Bai Yi turned his head and caught sight of the Yan Family’s patriarch.
His eyes lit up instantly as he hastily pleaded,
“Yan, help me!”
“Quick, help me shatter the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade.
Just help me break it, and I’ll give you whatever you want.”
“Otherwise, once I die, they will definitely target you first.
Even at your Divinity Transformation Peak, you won’t be able to handle the two of them.”
“Save me, and only together can we stand against them.”
Upon hearing this, the patriarch of the Yan Family frowned slightly.
However, before the Yan Family’s patriarch could act, the Daoist Master stepped forward, bursting out with a powerful aura, and stood in front of the Yan Family’s patriarch.
As this was happening, Li Mingwu was watching the Yan Family’s patriarch closely and said,
“Yan, your strength is extraordinary.
We have no desire to be enemies with you.
...
Bai Yi has been infected by the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade and is merely struggling in his final moments.”
“Even if you truly saved him, he is already completely ruined.”
“I hope you do not mislead yourself.”
Having said that, Li Mingwu swung his hand, and his spiritual power transformed into a blade edge, severing Bai Yi’s arm.
The severed arm bore Bai Yi’s Space Ring on one of its fingers.
During this process, Bai Yi tried to resist, but he was bound by his own spiritual power and was unable to break free.
As expected.
Bai Yi was completely ruined, even the spiritual power he had cultivated was now controlled by someone else.
After severing Bai Yi’s arm, Li Mingwu then looked directly at the Yan Family’s patriarch and said,
“You see, even with his arm cut off, he is helpless.”
After saying this, Li Mingwu reached out, attempting to grab the arm.
Unexpectedly,
the Yan Family’s patriarch, who had been frowning and inactive, suddenly made a move.
He swiftly produced a green bamboo leaf.
The leaf appeared silently and vanished quickly after appearing.
ɴ0νǤᴑ.сο
In a flash, the disappearing leaf reappeared again.
This time, it appeared right at the severed arm’s finger.
Then, the leaf gently slid across.
The middle finger silently broke off, and the Space Ring fell onto the leaf.
Then, the leaf wrapped around the Space Ring and disappeared in an instant.
The next moment, it returned to the Yan Family patriarch’s hand.
From the leaf’s appearance to its return to the Yan Family patriarch’s hand, the process was very brief.
It was merely a blink of an eye.
The Space Ring had already been snatched by the Yan Family patriarch, even before the Daoist Master could react.
By the time the Daoist Master reacted and tried to intervene, it was already too late.
The Space Ring was now in the hands of the Yan Family patriarch.
Seeing his spoils being snatched away, Li Mingwu’s expression immediately darkened.
“Yan Yujiang!”
“Dare you steal my belongings, and you want to be enemies with me?”
The Yan Family patriarch responded directly,
“I do not wish to involve myself in your grudges.”
“But what I want, I must have.”
Upon hearing this, Li Mingwu said no more useless words and directly controlled the purple spiritual energy leaving Bai Yi’s body, attacking the Yan Family’s patriarch.
Seeing this, the Yan Family patriarch quickly gathered his spiritual power to defend.
At the same time, he retreated while defending.
The spiritual energy kept being drawn out of Bai Yi’s body, and his cultivation level was rapidly dropping.
Divinity Transformation sixth stage…
Divinity Transformation fifth stage…
Divinity Transformation fourth stage…
…
…
Meanwhile, Bai Yi, sensing his continuously falling cultivation, was extremely anxious but had no way to stop it.
He couldn’t control his spiritual power at this point, let alone his own body.
Nor did the Yan Family patriarch show any intention of helping him.
Facing this situation, Bai Yi’s heart gradually sank.
At this moment, he couldn’t help but regret betraying the Yan Family patriarch previously in order to seize the Water Element of the Five Elements True Spirit.
If only he hadn’t engaged in such betrayal, the Yan Family patriarch might still have helped him.
Instead of how it is now, finding himself in such a situation with no one to help.
Just as the fight between them was about to break out, Bai Yi was regretting his actions.
Suddenly, an anomaly occurred.
The entire sky and earth began to shake abruptly.
The previously calm sea below started churning violently.
At the same time, the spiritual power in the area also became rampant.
With the anomaly appearing, colors began to emerge within the vast white fog.
These colors were of the Five Elements, as if hidden rainbows of all colors were concealed in the fog.
Such a phenomenon caused those who were about to fight to stop instantly.
Even Lin Jing, who was observing everything from within the System Space, couldn’t help but look towards the colorful glowing mist.
Realizing what this phenomenon was, Lin Jing immediately understood.
It was the Soul Tomb.
The Soul Tomb had appeared.
As the multicolored light appeared, Bai Yi was the first to realize.
Because
when the white fog appeared, Bai Yi suddenly felt his spiritual power had returned to normal and could be controlled by him again.
After this realization, Bai Yi quickly retracted his spiritual power and immediately planned to escape.
This action of his was naturally sensed by Li Mingwu.
Li Mingwu looked at the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade in his hand, which had returned to its original pale violet semitransparent state.
This anomaly had actually interfered with the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade in his possession.
Now that the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade could not be used, Li Mingwu hurriedly took action and chased after him.
Li Mingwu’s cultivation was already high, and Bai Yi, having his spiritual power absorbed by the Spirit-Integration Demon Jade, had his cultivation greatly reduced.
Now it was only left at the third level of Divinity Transformation.
Escaping was simply impossible.
Seeing Li Mingwu about to catch up, and with his own escape thwarted,
in this desperate situation, Bai Yi seemed to regain his old courage, his eyes hardened with determination, and he turned around to charge at Li Mingwu.
Just as Li Mingwu had said, Bai Yi had indeed been a righteous man full of spirit in the past.
However, ever since he took the position of Island Master of Yue Tian Island, Bai Yi had gradually changed.
Perhaps there really was some scheming from Li Mingwu.
Or perhaps, having held the position of Island Master over the years, Bai Yi had truly changed.
Gradually, the spirited nature was no longer in Bai Yi, and in its place was a more cunning and calculative demeanor.
Otherwise, based on the Bai Yi of the past,
he would not have caused harm to his own allies under any circumstances.
But now,
at this critical juncture of life and death, it seemed to have sparked Bai Yi’s true nature.
The aura he once had seemed to return.
Even facing Li Mingwu, whose cultivation was far superior, Bai Yi charged up resolutely.
Just as the two were about to confront each other head-on, however, another figure suddenly appeared beside Bai Yi.
This figure was the patriarch of the Yan Family.
After appearing, the Yan Family patriarch directly sacrificed a green magical treasure resembling bamboo.
Then he activated the magical treasure, forming countless bamboo shadows in the air, blocking Li Mingwu.
Seeing this scene, Bai Yi was immediately stunned.
On the other side, Li Mingwu’s face turned iron blue, staring intently at the Yan Family patriarch:
“Yan Yujiang, are you really going against me to save Bai Yi?”
The Yan Family patriarch did not answer immediately but took out the Space Ring and handed it to Bai Yi.
“Unseal the prohibition on this, and I will spare your life.”
After saying just that, the Yan Family patriarch remained silent, continuing to face Li Mingwu and staying on guard.
Bai Yi glanced at the Yan Family patriarch, said nothing, and started disarming the seal on the Space Ring.
This time, Bai Yi did not play any tricks.
Because he knew, with his current cultivation level, whether facing Li Mingwu or the Yan Family patriarch, he was bound to die.
Under these circumstances, the Yan Family patriarch stepping forward to protect him was already unexpected enough.
At this point, as long as he could save his own life, Bai Yi would agree to any condition posed by the Yan Family patriarch.
No other reason.
Just because the current Bai Yi had no other choice.
And compared to Li Mingwu, the Yan Family patriarch was more trustworthy.

chapters.title: Chapter 731
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 731: Chapter 324: Li Mingwu’s Enlightenment Chapter 731: Chapter 324: Li Mingwu’s Enlightenment Seeing Bai Yi beginning to remove the prohibition on the Space Ring, the Yan Family ancestor finally spoke:
“Bai Yi’s cultivation has greatly diminished; he no longer poses a threat to you, but I must take away that Five Elements Earth Command.”
Seeing the Yan Family ancestor showing him no respect, Li Mingwu’s expression immediately darkened like gloomy water.
“Bai Yi is now disabled; do you really think that, based on yourself, you can deal with the two of us?”
“Or perhaps, you are also counting on that Lin Jing, who is essentially useless?”
Li Mingwu’s words were utterly unpolite.
He outright dismissed Lin Jing without a second thought.
The reason for Li Mingwu’s arrogance was that, among cultivators of the Divinity Transformation Stage, different levels of cultivation lead to vastly different strengths.
Li Mingwu himself possessed the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Peak, and to contend with him, one would have to be at least in the late stages of Divinity Transformation.
If the gap in cultivation was too large, one couldn’t pose any threat to him at all.
Although Lin Jing had become a Divine Transformation Cultivator, in Li Mingwu’s eyes, Lin Jing, a cultivator in the early stages of Divinity Transformation, was only slightly stronger than a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
...
Therefore, Li Mingwu didn’t take Lin Jing seriously at all.
Add to that the fact that Bai Yi had also been disabled, with his cultivation suddenly plummeting to the Nascent Soul Stage.
One could say that now, the only one who could contend with them was the Yan Family ancestor alone.
While Li Mingwu was speaking, the Long Daoist took this opportunity to move to the other side of the Yan Family ancestor, forming a pincer attack, surrounding both the Yan Family ancestor and Bai Yi.
Seeing this situation, Lin Jing also got ready.
If they really intended to besiege the Yan Family ancestor, then Lin Jing would certainly not stand idly by.
However.
Seeing this, the Yan Family ancestor remained calm and collected:
“You two together are indeed not my match, but if I want to leave with all my heart, you two can’t stop me.”
The Yan Family ancestor and Li Mingwu were both at the Nascent Soul Peak, and their cultivations were not vastly different.
If he wanted to leave with all his heart, Li Mingwu wouldn’t be able to intercept him even if he tried.
If Li Mingwu couldn’t do it, there was even less need to mention the Long Daoist.
Compared to the two of them, the Long Daoist’s cultivation was somewhat weaker, and likewise, he couldn’t stop the Yan Family ancestor who wanted to leave.
Unless they could create a condition that would make it impossible for the Yan Family ancestor to leave.
Seeing the Yan Family ancestor so impervious, Li Mingwu also frowned in contemplation…
Just then, Bai Yi ceased his actions, and afterward, handed the Space Ring to the Yan Family ancestor.
“I have already lifted the prohibition.
Everything I have is in there.”
At this moment, Bai Yi seemed much more sincere.
Although this was also due to the constraints of the current environment, it was a necessity.
After all, with his current cultivation, any slight misstep that displeased the Yan Family ancestor could prompt the ancestor to abandon him.
If he lost the protection of the Yan Family ancestor, Bai Yi’s death was certain.
The Yan Family ancestor took the Space Ring and then probed inside.
Moments later, the Yan Family ancestor retrieved a yellowish-brown token from within the Space Ring.
This was precisely the Five Elements Earth Command.
After examining the token closely and verifying that there were no issues,
The Yan Family ancestor directly said to Bai Yi:
“You may go now.”
“I can hold them off for no more than a quarter of an hour; after a quarter of an hour, I will leave.
Whether you can escape or not will be up to your fate.”
Bai Yi nodded his head, then prepared to leave.
However, just at that moment…
Li Mingwu, who was in front, had also finished pondering and seemed to have made up his mind.
ƝονǤօ.ᴄο
The aura surrounding him surged, pressuring both the Yan Family ancestor and Bai Yi.
Seeing Li Mingwu taking action, the Long Daoist wasted no words and immediately cooperated, blocking the path of Bai Yi’s escape.
Instantly, the atmosphere at the scene became tense and charged.
Seeing this, the Yan Family ancestor’s brows slightly furrowed, and then he directly addressed Li Mingwu:
“Do you really think you can hold me back?”
At this, Li Mingwu laughed, replying:
“Heh heh…”
“Yan Yujiang, you truly live up to your reputation; I was almost deceived by you…”
After speaking, Li Mingwu looked provocatively at the Yan Family ancestor, then spoke directly:
“If you want to leave today, I certainly won’t stop you.”
“But Bai Yi cannot leave today.”
After hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor’s brow twitched lightly and he looked at Li Mingwu, saying:
“Bai Yi is now half-disabled and thus can no longer pose a threat to you.”
“Moreover, I’ve taken his Five Elements Earth Command; unless something unforeseen happens, he won’t be able to leave the Water Element Realm.”
“Even under these circumstances, you still refuse to spare his life?”
Li Mingwu then directly said:
“I said, Bai Yi must die today.”
“Either you hand over Bai Yi and that Space Ring, or you leave right now.”
“But if you choose to leave now, I won’t stand in your way, yet as for Bai Yi, I will never allow this man to go.”
After hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor first glanced at Bai Yi beside him, then turned his head back to face Li Mingwu.
“It seems that you are intent on fighting me today.”
Li Mingwu then smiled, saying:
“If you want to leave, I will not stop you and indeed cannot stop you; but if you wish to fight, then naturally, I can accompany you in battle.”
By the Yan Family ancestor’s demeanor, it appeared that he was unwilling to abandon Bai Yi.
Observing the developments, Lin Jing felt quite perplexed.
Logically, if the Yan Family ancestor wanted to leave, Li Mingwu and the other surely couldn’t stop him.
Moreover, with the Space Ring already in his possession, couldn’t the Yan Family ancestor leave whenever he wished?
But by the looks of it, the Yan Family ancestor seemed to have reservations, seemingly determined to save Bai Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 732
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 732: Chapter 324: Li Mingwu’s Enlightenment_2 Chapter 732: Chapter 324: Li Mingwu’s Enlightenment_2 This inevitably led Lin Jing to ponder.
Why must the Yan Family’s Ancestor insist on saving Li Mingwu at all costs?
Lin Jing looked at the several individuals in the midst of the venue.
Wearing a smile that suggested having all the cards in his hand, Li Mingwu insisted on sparing Bai Yi’s life; he seemed not panicked at all at this moment.
Opposite him was the Yan Family’s Ancestor, his brows furrowed in concentration and a hint of hesitation.
Behind the Yan Family’s Ancestor was Bai Yi, his brow also creased as he looked towards Dragon Daoist.
Finally, there was Dragon Daoist, his expression calm, standing in front of Bai Yi, with his Magical Treasure ready before him, as if prepared to act at any moment.
...
While observing these individuals, Lin Jing was also contemplatingâ€¦
â€¦
â€¦
After a moment, Lin Jing suddenly had a flash of insight while looking at Li Mingwu.
Lin Jing finally understood why, under these circumstances, the Yan Family’s Ancestor still refused to leave and insisted on saving Bai Yi.
The Yan Family’s Ancestor aimed to save Bai Yi not for the sake of Bai Yi himself but for his own purpose.
This time, the Yan Family’s Ancestor’s pursuit of Bai Yi was partially to retrieve the Five Elements Earth Command.
Because he had promised Lin Jing to bring the Five Elements Command Token back.
However,
