just how powerful the third stage of the Divine Fire Triple Realm could be…
…
After storing away the Blazing Marrow Spirit, Lin Jing then started to converse with the Yan Family’s ancestor.
Lin Jing first mentioned the matter regarding Dragon Daoist, and then, he also relayed some information about Li Mingwu that Dragon Daoist had mentioned to the Yan Family’s ancestor.
After listening, aside from being a bit surprised by Lin Jing’s strength,
the Yan Family’s ancestor did not seem to care much about Li Mingwu, and even offered some words of comfort to Lin Jing.
Currently, Li Mingwu was trapped in the Water Element Realm and couldn’t come out immediately.
Having obtained the Fire Attribute Spirit, the Yan Family’s ancestor, after its refinement, would also soon reach the Solidifying Body stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 756
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 756: Chapter 334: Obtaining the Blazing Marrow Spirit, Entering the Earth Realm of the Five Elements_2 Chapter 756: Chapter 334: Obtaining the Blazing Marrow Spirit, Entering the Earth Realm of the Five Elements_2 By that time, as a cultivator who had achieved Solidifying Body, the ancestor of the Yan Family was not afraid of Li Mingwu, and as for the words said by Dragon Daoist earlier, it was best to ignore them.
After their conversation, they went to search for the Changyun Yuanlei together.
Previously, for the safety of the Changyun Yuanlei, they had not brought him along for this mission but had placed him in a safe location.
Now, the Fire Attribute Five Elements True Spirit was already in hand.
And they also got Lin Jing a piece of Blazing Marrow Spirit, which could definitely be described as a huge harvest.
Now that there was nothing left in the Five Elements Fire Realm worth waiting for, it was naturally time to leave.
Careful not to disturb that Molten Python, Lin Jing and the Yan Family ancestor were very cautious when they returned to the central area of the Fire Realm.
...
After crossing the center of the Fire Realm and arriving at the southern edge of the Fire Realm, the two finally met up with Changyun Yuanlei.
The exit of the Five Elements Fire Realm was at the very south.
After the three of them met up, they immediately flew southward.
…
As they were bringing Changyun Yuanlei with them, their pace was somewhat slower.
It took more than half a month for them to fly to the extreme southern part of the Fire Realm.
The Five Elements Fire Realm was not like the Water Realm, where fog was everywhere; without the obstruction of fog, their vision was not affected.
Upon reaching the southernmost part of the Fire Realm, the three of them saw the five differently colored, sky-reaching beams of the Teleportation Array.
Afterward.
The three immediately accelerated and flew towards the direction of the light beams.
Soon after, they arrived near the light beams, and then they descended from the sky, landing right beside the light beams.
Standing before the light beams, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a wave of emotion.
This journey through the Five Elements Ruins was finally reaching a critical moment.
The last of the Five Elements Earth Realm not only had the exit to leave the Five Elements Ruins, but the entrance to the ultimate Five Elements Territory was also within this Earth Realm.
Lin Jing’s most important goal for this trip was to enter the ultimate Five Elements Territory and obtain the subsequent Cultivation Technique of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
As for Changyun Yuanlei, they had already agreed that the first thing upon entering the Five Elements Earth Realm would be to help Changyun Yuanlei leave.
After all, with Changyun Yuanlei’s level of cultivation, it was still too dangerous for him here.
After his reflection, Lin Jing turned and said to Changyun Yuanlei:
“Inside the Five Elements Earth Realm, there is a Teleportation Array that can lead directly out of the Five Elements Ruins.
Once we get to the Earth Realm and meet up, we’ll help you leave first.”
Excited at the prospect of finally being able to leave, Changyun Yuanlei nodded again and again:
“Thank you, Brother!”
“If it hadn’t been for you and the elder of the Yan Family, I would probably have spent my whole life trapped in the Sea of Strange.”
Lin Jing waved his hand, indicating that it was unnecessary.
At this time, the Yan Family ancestor also directly spoke to Lin Jing:
“After entering this final Five Elements Earth Realm, I don’t intend to explore any further.”
“Now that I have obtained the Fire Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, I plan to refine this Five Elements True Spirit and then make a push for Solidifying Body.”
“As for that final Five Elements Territory, it is the place where the legacy of your Five Elements Cultivation Technique lies, so you may go on your own.”
After saying this, the Yan Family ancestor continued:
“But don’t worry, I won’t leave for the time being.”
“After you finish receiving the legacy in the final Five Elements Territory, I will leave with you.”
“Alright…” Lin Jing nodded.
Afterward.
Without too much delay, after their talk, they arrived at the Teleportation Array corresponding to their Tokens.
Upon entering the Teleportation Array, it immediately responded to the Tokens in their hands.
The light beam of the Teleportation Array then emitted a dazzling light.
Suddenly, the Teleportation Array began to operate, and directly transported Lin Jing and the others away.
…
…
The Five Elements Earth Realm was a desert filled with yellow sand that stretched to the horizon; other than the golden sand strewn across the land, only the raging winds filled the sky.
As soon as Lin Jing was teleported in, he landed in the scorching desert with the sun blazing down, and the sand that had been scorched by the sun was extremely hot to the touch.
Standing atop one of the sand dunes, Lin Jing looked out into the distance; the horizon was endless, making it impossible to discern his position.
After observing for a while, Lin Jing rose into the air and flew forward.
The first primary task upon arriving in the Five Elements Earth Realm, naturally, was also to determine his position.
However, within this endless desert, with no landmarks to reference, distinguishing directions became exceptionally difficult.
Fortunately, although there were no landmarks on the ground, that scorching sun in the sky could still serve as a guidepost to direct their way.
This Earth Realm of the Five Elements was different from other places.
The teleportation point here was located at the center of the Earth Realm, and naturally, that was also their destination.
There should be a powerful mythical beast in that location, just like in the other realms.
Therefore, teleporting within the Earth Realm was likely to be the most dangerous.
Even if they wanted to teleport away, they would first need to find a way to lure the beast away.
Fortunately, they already had experience dealing with mythical beasts, so this was not a concern.
Luring the mythical beast away so that Changyun Yuanlei could teleport out was something they were still capable of doing.
…
Within the Earth Realm of the Five Elements, Lin Jing flew in one direction for several consecutive days.
After flying for five or six days, Lin Jing finally noticed some slight changes in the surrounding environment.
Although it was still a desert, the temperature here seemed much lower than before, and the Earth Attribute Spiritual Energy was also somewhat more sparse.
Beyond that…
Lin Jing also discovered some strangely-shaped rocks that had been weathered by the wind, in addition to the desert.
Seeing these, Lin Jing immediately understood.
He seemed to be getting further and further away from the core area of the Earth Realm.
As a result,
Lin Jing immediately changed direction and flew towards the way he had come.
This time, after flying through the desert for nearly a month, he finally arrived at the central area of the Earth Realm of the Five Elements.
The winds and sands were still fierce here, and the Earth Attribute Spiritual Energy was much richer.
After arriving, Lin Jing took out the Jade Token given to him by the elder of the Yan Family and then channeled his Spiritual Power into it.
The Jade Token flickered with light before extinguishing.
A moment later, the light of the Jade Token flickered again.
Clearly, the elder of the Yan Family had received Lin Jing’s message.
Upon seeing the message, Lin Jing felt at ease.
Then he continued to fly towards the central area of the Earth Realm.
The journey was entirely calm.
Since entering the Earth Realm of the Five Elements, Lin Jing had not yet been attacked by any mythical beast.
Of course, occasional sandstorms that blotted out the sky would arise, but even those were hardly a danger to Lin Jing.
This made Lin Jing wonder if there really were no other mythical beasts in the Earth Realm of the Five Elements.
Even though he had not encountered any attacks, Lin Jing remained vigilant.
In this manner, he moved cautiously while observing, heading towards the core area of the Earth Realm of the Five Elements.
Soon,
another day went by.
Lin Jing was nearing the core area of the Earth Realm and had still not encountered any attacks by mythical beasts.
He even used Observation Mode to closely scrutinize the area but did not spot any mythical beasts.
With no mythical beasts in sight, Lin Jing was somewhat relieved and continued onward.
This time, in just half a day,
Lin Jing met up again with the elder of the Yan Family and Changyun Yuanlei.
The Yan Family elder had found Changyun Yuanlei first, then came here to join Lin Jing.
After the three of them united, Lin Jing asked about their situations.
After inquiring, he learned that neither of them had encountered any mythical beasts either.
No mythical beasts, not even any other danger.
This only increased Lin Jing’s puzzlement about the Earth Realm of the Five Elements.
Could it be that there really were no dangers in this realm?
Because of this, Lin Jing and the Yan Family elder discussed the situation further.
However, despite their discussion, they could not come to any conclusive results.
After discussing, the three of them continued forward.
Only this time, both of them were very cautious.
ɴονǤο.сօ
After all, the more abnormal the situation, the more they could not afford to be careless.
After another full day, the three of them finally arrived in the very center of the Earth Realm, the core area.
And those several light pillars then entered the trio’s vision…

chapters.title: Chapter 757
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 757: Chapter 335 Five Elements Territory Chapter 757: Chapter 335 Five Elements Territory Upon seeing the teleportation light pillar, the three of them exchanged glances before continuing to walk toward the direction of the teleportation light pillar.
Just like that.
The three of them arrived at the teleportation light pillar without any incident.
At this time, before their eyes, five Teleportation Formations were laid out in the shape of a pentagram, each at the corners.
In the middle, there was another massive Formation emitting multicolored light.
The surrounding five differently colored Formations were the teleportation arrays for leaving the Five Elements Ruins.
Similar to the Formations in other realms, one could leave the Five Elements Ruins by using the Five Elements Command Token.
...
The one in the middle emitting multicolored light was the Formation that led to the last layer of the Five Elements Ruins, the Five Elements Territory.
This last layer’s Formation also required the Five Elements Command Token to activate.
Looking at the Formations in front of him, Lin Jing couldn’t help but wonder,
“We came here without encountering any danger, which is really strange and unusual.”
The Yan Family ancestor looked around and nodded in agreement.
“Indeed, something doesn’t quite feel right!”
Changyun Yuanlei then spoke:
“Elder, Brother…”“I also feel that something is amiss here, as if there’s a particularly terrifying danger nearby.”
After speaking, Changyun Yuanlei turned to Lin Jing and said:
“My supernatural perception is different from ordinary people, as I have mentioned before, and you, Brother, should also be aware of it.”
“I feel that the danger is nearby.”
Lin Jing nodded upon hearing this.
Changyun Yuanlei had indeed said that his perception was different from ordinary people, often allowing him to sense danger in advance.
This was also one of the reasons why he had never faced any disasters in the Water Element Realm.
Otherwise, with his inherently unlucky constitution, he would have likely died at the handsâ€”or finsâ€”of Sea Beasts or other Cultivators long ago.
Lin Jing wanted to say something else after listening,
but just then, he heard the crazy alerts of the System:
“Warning!”
&”Someone extremely dangerous has entered the alert range and is rapidly approaching, please prepare the host for timely response.”
…
“Warning!”
“Someone extremely dangerous has entered the alert range and is rapidly approaching, please prepare the host for timely response.”
…
“Warning!”
“Someone extremely dangerous has entered the alert range and is rapidly approaching, please prepare the host for timely response.”
…
…
The sudden alerts from the System shocked Lin Jing.
He then hurriedly scanned his surroundings, but found nothing.
However, just at that moment,
the ground under their feet suddenly started making a thunderous rumble, followed by endless gravel beginning to bounce incessantly.
At this point, not just Lin Jing, the other two also sensed the anomaly.
The Yan Family ancestor immediately activated his Spiritual Power in preparation.
The System’s alerts had never been this frantic, clearly indicating that the danger was beyond their capability.
Lin Jing quickly said to the Yan Family ancestor:
“Elder, quickly…”
“Start the teleportation array, we must leave now.”
No sooner had Lin Jing spoken than a terrifyingly formidable aura arrived.
It was then that Lin Jing looked towards the distance and saw the originally flat desert around them begin to rise.
He then looked around again and noticed it was not just in front of them.
Even the dunes behind and on either side were also continuously rising.
It seemed as though the whole sandy realm of the Five Elements Earth Realm was piling up like ocean waves about to engulf the three of them.
Only the ground near the three of them remained still.
Seeing this, even the Yan Family ancestor couldn’t stay calm anymore.
“Quick…”
“We need to leave now.”
Although the danger had not yet manifested, the terrifying aura emanating from it let them know.
It was definitely beyond their capability to handle.
The three of them then hurriedly approached the teleportation array, with the Yan Family ancestor and Changyun Yuanlei directly entering the teleportation array corresponding to their respective command tokens.
Lin Jing entered the middle array, emitting multicolored light.
As the three of them entered the teleportation array, the rising sand dune walls around them grew taller and even began to obscure the sky.
The sand from those dunes also continuously poured down towards their location.
However,
the location where they had just been, that sand unexpectedly continued to sink.
Despite the countless sand pouring around, the sand still did not submerge Lin Jing and the others.
It seemed as if there was a bottomless pit under their feet.
Simultaneously, the three felt the terrifying aura growing increasingly stronger.
They did not hesitate and activated the teleportation array at once.
Upon activation, the three teleportation arrays instantly emitted a dazzling light,
which enveloped the three of them and then lifted them up with the teleportation light.
During the time they were rising with the teleportation array, the sand forming the high walls continued to pour, and slowly the contents inside began to reveal itself.
After the falling sand, a ‘wall’ appeared.
This wall was covered with huge spikes, densely packed, too numerous to count.
ƝօνǤο.сο
And, this wasn’t just one side of the wall.
But rather, it was cylindrical, encasing Lin Jing and the others entirely.
Just as Lin Jing was puzzled about why this wall had suddenly appeared, suddenly below their original location, that endless sand also fell through.
Below, still were those dense, numerous spikes.
Further down was the endless dark abyss.
As Lin Jing gazed down into the abyss, suddenly, a strange beast flew out from the dark depths below.
This strange beast, several zhang long, resembled a worm, and although it had no wings, it could navigate through the void.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 758: Chapter 335 Five Elements Territory_2 Chapter 758: Chapter 335 Five Elements Territory_2 “`
Soon.
The Worm Beast arrived next to Lin Jing.
Upon its arrival, without uttering a word, it charged directly at the teleportation light column where Lin Jing was located.
However.
The Teleportation Array had been activated, and the entire light column was protected by a Formation.
No matter how fiercely the Worm Beast collided with it, it could not disturb the teleportation light column.
Seeing that it could not affect the light column, the Worm Beast became very angry.
...
It opened its huge mouth and let out a shrill, piercing screech.
It was at this moment, Lin Jing noticed.
The creature’s mouth was lined with rows of spikes, extending deep into its body.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Jing immediately understood.
And then, with disbelief, he watched as high walls, covered in spikes and bursting forth from the sand, started closing in from all sides.
The spikes on these high walls were identical to those Lin Jing had seen within the maw of the Worm Beast.
This meant that they were, at that moment, inside the mouth of a monstrosity.
How long the beast was, Lin Jing did not know.
But its mouth was vast enough to swallow a large Immortal City.
From this, it was apparent that the creature was at least hundreds of thousands of zhang in length.
Such a massive beast must surely possess an outrageously high level of cultivation.
No wonder, the System had been frantically alerting them earlier.
At that time.
Lin Jing and the others were in the Teleportation Array, and now, the surrounding sand had all fallen into the giant maw of the beast.
Revealing below, a gigantic white boulder.
And the Teleportation Array where they stood was right on top of this boulder.
Lin Jing had never seen such a white boulder before, but although it was unsupported by the sand beneath, it still hovered in the beast’s mouth, clearly no ordinary rock.
Then, the teleportation light column shone ever brighter, and the spiky walls around them began to rapidly close in.
Certainly, the beast seemed unwilling to let Lin Jing and his companions escape and was preparing to crush them.
Although the Teleportation Array could withstand the smaller Worm Beast, Lin Jing was not sure it could withstand the swallowing might of a beast large enough to consume an Immortal City.
Soon.
The sky above them began to darken.
The gargantuan jaws of the beast closed, and Lin Jing and his companions were fully engulfed within.
And at that very moment, the teleportation light column became even more luminous as the teleportation force was fully activated.
Knowing he was about to be separated from Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei hurriedly spoke to Lin Jing,
“Big brother…”
“If one day, you go to the Inner Sea, you must come find me…”
But before Changyun Yuanlei could finish, the teleportation power was triggered.
Subsequently, Lin Jing and the others were teleported away.
…
After parting from the Yan Family patriarch and Changyun Yuanlei, Lin Jing was transported to a valley.
Upon entering, he immediately felt exhilarated, surrounded by an extremely dense Five Elements Power.
Such rich Five Elements Power, perfectly compatible with his cultivation of the Immortal Five Elements Technique, made Lin Jing feel very comfortable and pleased in this Five Elements Territory.
Afterwards.
Lin Jing surveyed his surroundings and saw the situation clearly.
Having been teleported in, he found himself right above a Teleportation Array, which was situated right at the very center of the valley.
The valley was enclosed by towering mountains, behind which was mist emitting rainbow-colored light, concealing whatever lay beyond.
Above the valley floated colorful clouds of Spiritual Energy in the sky.
The only anomaly was a gigantic statue of the Five Elements Ancestor in front of Lin Jing.
This statue was identical to the one he had encountered in the main hall of the Five Elements Cave Mansion.
However, this statue was an enlarged version of the one in the Five Elements main hall.
Sitting atop the mountain range in front of Lin Jing, it soared nearly ten thousand zhang high, its head almost piercing the colorful clouds in the sky.
Seeing such an immense statue, Lin Jing immediately realized that this must be the destination of his journey.
Then.
Without further delay, Lin Jing began walking towards the statue.
In this valley, Lin Jing sensed no danger; therefore, his pace was naturally quite swift.
“`
Although the valley was not small, Lin Jing traversed it swiftly and arrived at the base of the statue.
Approaching the statue, Lin Jing felt an incredibly rich five elements power above his head.
Lin Jing looked up, gazing above.
That place was right where the statue’s overlapping hands were.
Previously in the Five-Element Divine Temple, it was in the hands of the statue that Lin Jing had obtained a Five Elements Treasure Orb.
And that Five Elements Treasure Orb was still inside Lin Jing’s Space Ring.
Thinking of this, Lin Jing stepped directly into the void and then flew towards the statue’s overlapping hands.
Soon.
Lin Jing arrived beside the statue’s hands.
Standing there, Lin Jing looked inside.
He saw the palm covered by a WÇ” CÇŽi light barrier, which Lin Jing found extremely familiar.
Ɲ0νǤօ.сο
It was identical to the light barrier that enveloped the high platform in the Five-Element Divine Temple before.
However, apart from the familiar WÇ” CÇŽi light barrier, there was another formation that concealed everything tightly inside.
Lin Jing couldn’t even see what was inside this light barrier.
To be on the safe side, Lin Jing decided to try to open the light barrier first.
Afterward.
Lin Jing stepped forward, reaching out to touch the light barrier while channeling the Five Elements Power.
Once he confirmed that the light barrier was identical to the one in the Five-Element Divine Temple, Lin Jing then took out the Five Elements Treasure Orb from the Space Ring.
Then, he held the Five Elements Treasure Orb in front of him and channeled the Immortal Five Elements Technique, concentrating the Five Elements Power and transmitting it through the orb onto the light barrier.
To break the light barrier, there was only this one way.
The statue was immensely huge, and its palms were also quite large.
Accordingly, the light barrier covering the area was much larger, and to open this light barrier required a lot more effort.
This time, Lin Jing spent two days and eventually thinned the WÇ” CÇŽi light barrier until it was about to give way.
Seeing the timing was ripe, Lin Jing then took a couple of steps back.
He then gathered the Five Elements Power again, channeling it through the orb into the light barrier before him.
Just like the last straw that broke the camel’s back, the final bit of spiritual power that entered caused the entire light barrier to collapse.
As the light barrier fell apart, the formation that had been concealing it also seemed to lose its effect, starting to disintegrate.
Within less than half an hour, the entire light barrier completely dissipated, and the formation, apparently due to the loss of support from the light barrier, dissipated on its own.
After the formation faded, Lin Jing finally saw the scene inside.
A small courtyard, a big tree, and a thatched hut, plus the Spirit Fields that were partially concealed by the formation outside.
That was all within the palm.
The courtyard was enclosed by bamboo fences, surrounded by long-abandoned Spirit Fields.
However, one of the Spirit Fields was covered by a formation, hiding any view of the inside.
Inside the courtyard was a large tree and a thatched hut.
The thatched hut wasn’t anything special; it resembled the one Lin Jing had lived in when he worked as a Spirit Farmer for the Qingyuan Sword Sect.
It even looked more dilapidated compared to that thatched hut.
Only the big tree next to the hut made Lin Jing pause in awe.
Because that big tree was a Five Elements Spirit Tree.
It was the very Five Elements Spirit Tree Lin Jing had seen on Immortal Crossing Island.
This Five Elements Spirit Tree was now lush and thriving, although the Five-Star Spirit Fruits had yet to appear on it.
Seeing this Five Elements Spirit Tree, Lin Jing knew this place was no ordinary location.
Now that the WÇ” CÇŽi light barrier had been opened, and the aura of the Five Elements Spirit Tree had escaped from inside,
But Lin Jing still did not act recklessly.
Instead, he extended his Divine Sense directly into the area to explore.
After probing with Divine Sense, Lin Jing thoroughly surveyed the place.
Apart from the inside of the thatched hut and the Spirit Field concealed by the formation, Lin Jing couldn’t detect anything else.
The other areas were laid bare under the investigation of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
No danger was found.
Seeing no immediate danger, Lin Jing steadied his mind, looked towards the thatched hut in front, and then walked towards it.
All the way there, he made his way unhurriedly through the long-abandoned Spirit Fields to the small courtyard in front.
But just as Lin Jing stepped into the courtyard, a voice came:
“You’ve finally arrived.
I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 759: Chapter 336: The Legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor Chapter 759: Chapter 336: The Legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor Hearing this voice, Lin Jing was at first stunned.
Then he stood directly at the entrance to the yard, no longer moving forward, all the while remaining cautiously alert.
No matter what, he hadn’t expected that there would still be someone in this small courtyard.
As Lin Jing remained on guard, that voice came again:
“You needn’t be afraid, I am merely a Divine Sense left behind, specially meant to assist you in obtaining the legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor, and I will not harm you.”
“Besides, I am just a Divine Sense, without any power, I can’t even open this door, let alone harm you.”
Hearing these words, Lin Jing stared intently at the thatched cottage before him.
The cottage could not be probed with Divine Sense, so Lin Jing naturally could not inspect the specific situation inside.
After pondering for a moment, Lin Jing decided to go forward and try.
At the same time, he was prepared.
...
If he found anything amiss, he would immediately enter the Dao System Space.
After thinking it over, Lin Jing stepped forward slowly, walking toward the thatched hut in the courtyard.
Upon reaching the front of the hut, Lin Jing paused for a moment, then reached out and placed his hand on the door of the hut.
“Creak…”
With just a gentle push, the door opened in response.As the door to the hut opened, the inside looked like a completely ordinary room with nothing out of the ordinary.
ɴονǤօ.сᴑ
Lin Jing also saw inside the smiling elder sitting at the table facing him.
This elder, he was identical to the statue.
But he was not a solid entity, rather he was in a state of phantasm.
Seeing the elder, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be slightly stunned.
“You…”
“Could it be that you are the Five Elements Ancestor?”
After regaining his composure, Lin Jing spoke and asked the elder.
The elder gave a slight smile and then spoke:
“You could say that, and yet not…”
“I am just a Divine Sense he left behind, merely to help you undergo the test to see if you qualify to obtain the entire legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was taken aback.
Then he asked the embodiment of the Five Elements Ancestor:
“To obtain the latter half of the Immortal Five Elements Technique, are qualifications needed as well?”
The embodiment of the Five Elements Ancestor nodded:
“Yes, qualifications are needed, but now…”
As he said this, the Five Elements Ancestor looked at his own body and then let out a sigh:
“Alas…”
“Now, whether these qualifications are needed or not is meaningless.”
Lin Jing, puzzled, then bowed and asked the Five Elements Ancestor:
“Senior.”
“I am still somewhat confused, would the senior please elaborate.”
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded and continued:
“Actually, it is like this…”
“Anyone who enters the Five Elements Territory and cultivates the Immortal Five Elements Technique has the opportunity to receive the legacy left by the Five Elements Ancestor.”
“However, to receive the entire legacy, certain conditions are required.”
“If the conditions are not met, then one can only obtain the latter half of the Immortal Five Elements Technique and cannot inherit the entire legacy.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing suddenly understood and then bowed to ask:
“Senior.”
“If one wishes to obtain the entire legacy, may I know what conditions are required?”
The Divine Sense of the Five Elements Ancestor then said:
“To receive the entire legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor, one’s Spirit Root Aptitude must reach the level of the Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root.”
“Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root!”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but take a sharp intake of breath.
“Is there such a Spirit Root in the world?”
As everyone knows, the Heavenly Spirit Root is the pinnacle of a cultivator’s Spiritual Root, and only mono-elemental Spiritual Roots can reach the level of a Heavenly Spirit Root.
The thought of possessing a Spiritual Root that contained all five elements and simultaneously achieving the terrifying level of a Heavenly Spirit Root was unthinkable.
Lin Jing had indeed never heard of such a person existing.
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded and said:
“Yes!”
“He was born with the Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root.”
Upon finishing, the Divine Sense of the Five Elements Ancestor looked towards Lin Jing and then said:
“I see that your Spiritual Root has already reached the level of a True Five Elements Spirit Root, right?”
Lin Jing replied:
“I don’t mean to conceal it from the senior…”
“The reason I have attained my current level is actually because I have consumed Elixir Medicine that enhances one’s aptitude.”
The Five Elements Ancestor heard that and nodding slightly:
“That is inevitable.”
“Actually, if one could enhance one’s own Spirit Root Aptitude to the level of the Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root through other means, that would also be acceptable.”
“After all, such an exceptional aptitude like his is rare, with no one before and likely no one after.”
“Of course, I’m also not sure if, after him, there has been anyone else with such exceptional aptitude.”
“None!”
“A naturally born Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root Aptitude, I have never heard of it.”
Lin Jing stated emphatically.
After speaking, Lin Jing couldn’t help but look at the Divine Sense of the Five Elements Ancestor and then said:
“Senior.”
“If that’s the case, with my aptitude, I am unable to inherit your entire legacy.”
The Five Elements Ancestor looked toward Lin Jing, then helplessly shook his head:
“Actually…”
“You should have been the most suitable for inheriting his legacy.”
“It’s just a pity that you have arrived far too late.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing looked at the Divine Sense of the Five Elements Ancestor, puzzled, and asked:
“What does the senior mean by this?”
The Divine Sense of the Five Elements Ancestor gazed at Lin Jing and explained:
“His legacy is divided into three parts.”
“First, the latter part of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.”
“This latter part was formulated from combining his own Cultivation Technique, with boundless effort, just before his final ascension to immortality.”
“If cultivated to the zenith, one can ascend directly to immortality.”
“Second…”
“Is a Five Elements Golden Core, containing a portion of his own cultivation.
If you refine it, your cultivation can be greatly improved.”
“Especially for you who also cultivate the Immortal Five Elements Technique, refining the Five Elements Golden Core can not only enhance your cultivation but may even increase your understanding of the Five Elements Power.”

chapters.title: Chapter 760
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 760: Chapter 336 Legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor_2 Chapter 760: Chapter 336 Legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor_2 “`
“This third one…”
“It is a Life-Defying Fruit tree that can enhance one’s Spirit Root Aptitude.”
“That Life-Defying Fruit Tree is in the Spirit Field outside, enveloped by the Formation.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, hurriedly turned around to look at the Spirit Field outside.
“Who would have thought, inside that Spirit Field, there’s actually a Life-Defying Fruit Tree growing.”
At this moment, the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor also looked towards the outside Spirit Field and then spoke:
“Actually, with your current Spirit Root Aptitude, just by consuming one Life-Defying Fruit, you could reach the level of a Five Elements Heavenly Spirit Root.”
“It’s just a pity…”
“Even if I wanted to give you that Life-Defying Fruit, with my current power, I can no longer help you open that Formation.”
“If only you could have come here a hundred thousand years earlier…”
After hearing this, Lin Jing’s face grew more puzzled.
However, before he could ask again, the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor spoke again, explaining to Lin Jing:
“The inheritance I’ve left here totals three items.”
“Apart from the successive Cultivation Techniques of the Immortal Five Elements Technique, the other two items require opening the Formation to be retrieved.”
“I am but a spiritual thought, yet my power also comes from the main body; the stronger the main body, the stronger my power.”
“Although I haven’t seen him since he ascended to immortality, there has always been a connection between me and the main body.”“Roughly hundreds of thousands of years ago, I noticed that the main body’s power seemed to be weakening, and correspondingly, my power began to decline as well.”
“Had you arrived a hundred thousand years earlier, with my power, I could have helped you gain all three items of the inheritance.”
“But you have come too late…”
“With my current power, at most I can help you obtain the Five Elements Golden Core, but as for the Life-Defying Fruit, with the remaining strength I have now, I cannot help you get it.”
Lin Jing, taken aback after hearing this, then looked at the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor with a touch of astonishment and said:
“Elder, do you mean that you want to help me get the inheritance without any qualifications or tests required?”
The spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor slightly nodded:
“Yes!”
“I can feel that something unexpected seems to have happened to the main body; his power is declining continuously.
With the rate of this decline, I fear I won’t last until the next person arrives.”
“So…”
“I plan to pass on all of the inheritances left by the main body to you.”
“After all, you are also a person of the main body’s inheritance, and you have the right to inherit these legacies.
To entrust these to you is also to fulfill my mission.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing these words, fell silent.
The spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor continued:
“I only hope that once you’ve received the inheritance, you will quickly improve your Cultivation after leaving and ascend to the Immortal Realm to find out what has happened to the main body.”
“If possible, please try to help the main body.”
“But if it is unfeasible, then so be it…”
“After all, with your strength, even if you truly ascend to the Immortal Realm, you likely won’t be able to do much.”
“Sigh…”
Having said that, the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor sighed again.
Although this spiritual thought appeared as a phantom and its body was semi-transparent, Lin Jing could still see the decline in his eyes.
...
Ɲ0νǤօ.сο
Looking at the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor, Lin Jing felt a sense of solemnity, and then he spoke directly:
“Elder, rest assured…”
“If I am fortunate enough to ascend to the Immortal Realm, I will certainly seek out the Elder’s main body and try to help it through this calamity.”
After hearing this, the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor looked at Lin Jing and nodded with a flicker of relief in his gaze:
“You have my gratitude.”
After he finished speaking, the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor’s eyes gradually firmed, and then, pointing to a side room of the house, he said to Lin Jing:
“Go inside and bring out the box that’s placed there.”
Lin Jing, hearing this, turned to look towards the side room and then walked towards it.
Upon entering the side room, Lin Jing immediately saw the box of unknown material placed on the table.
The box wasn’t big, but it was enveloped by a layer of WÇ” CÇŽi luminescence.
Then,
Lin Jing directly picked up the box, and the moment he touched the box, the WÇ” CÇŽi luminescence on it flowed, forming a layer of protective power that blocked out Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power from the outside.
Just from this surge of power, Lin Jing knew, despite it being a mere box, the luminescence on the box was something he currently was unable to unravel.
“`
Afterward,
Lin Jing, holding the box, came before the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness.
It wasn’t until Lin Jing returned that the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness opened its mouth and said,
“Originally, this trivial matter wouldn’t have required your intervention.”
“However, influenced by my physical form, my power has dwindled substantially, and I have begun to fade.
Now, I can’t even lift this box.”
Having finished speaking, the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness directly addressed Lin Jing,
“Come, watch me…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing turned his gaze toward the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness.
But in the next moment, a five-colored light flickered in the eyes of the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness, and Lin Jing, who was looking into its eyes, suddenly felt an influx of countless pieces of information pouring into his sea of awareness.
Faced with this vast trove of information, Lin Jing didn’t dare to neglect it and quickly began to absorb it.
As this information flowed in, a voice also entered Lin Jing’s sea of awareness,
“This is the latter half of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
I am transmitting it into your sea of awareness.
Don’t be distracted, and understand it well.”
“Next…”
“I will help you open that box containing the Five Elements Golden Pill.”
“After the box is opened, my task will also be considered complete, and the remaining power I possess will be utterly exhausted.
At that time, I will dissipate, and you needn’t worry, this is my mission…”
“Additionally…”
“Once you awaken, you can directly consume the Five Elements Golden Pill, which will assist you in rapidly advancing your cultivation.”
“Given your current level of cultivation, consuming the Five Elements Golden Pill should bring you within reach of the Dao Integration Stage, if not reaching it entirely.”
“While cultivating, you can do so under the Five Elements Spirit Tree, which will enable you to enter the Solidifying Body stage more quickly.”
“Furthermore, you can also absorb the various Five Elements Spiritual Forces within the entire valley to integrate into your body…”
“After I dissipate, there will no longer be another successor coming to this place.
Everything within this valley will belong to you, and you needn’t have any concerns about taking it…”
…
…
The Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness kept speaking to Lin Jing, as if making final arrangements.
And although Lin Jing received this information, his sea of awareness was currently completely occupied by a large amount of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
Lin Jing tried to respond but was unable to do so.
It wasn’t until the Five Elements Ancestor had finished making all arrangements that he finally uttered faintly,
“What a pity…”
“If you had arrived a hundred thousand years earlier, I could have helped you obtain the Life-Defying Fruit.”
“Now, even I cannot open the formation that protects the Life-Defying Fruit, and in the future, no one else will come here, nor will anyone be able to take it away…”
“If you had consumed the Life-Defying Fruit first and then the Five Elements Golden Pill, that advancement…”
“Alas…!”
…
…
After absorbing the entire Immortal Five Elements Technique, Lin Jing awoke three days later.
Upon awakening, Lin Jing’s first action was to open his eyes and look around in search of the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness.
However,
Lin Jing looked around but did not find the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness; indeed, it had disappeared.
Moreover, on the table, there remained the box that had already been opened.
Inside the box was an elixir emitting a five-colored radiance.
Looking at the brilliantly glowing elixir before him, Lin Jing couldn’t help but fall silent.
For opening the box containing the Five Elements Golden Pill, the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness had given its all and ultimately faded away.
Although aware that it was merely divine consciousness left by the Five Elements Ancestor, Lin Jing still couldn’t help feeling a sense of loss knowing it had completely dissipated.
After a moment of silence, Lin Jing then got up, picked up the box that contained the Five Elements Golden Pill.
The box, made of some unknown material, had lost its outer light curtain and had become an ordinary-looking box that elicited no reaction from Lin Jing as he held it in his hands.
Afterward,
Lin Jing didn’t immediately consume the Five Elements Golden Pill but instead closed the box and stored the pill away.
He clearly remembered the Five Elements Ancestor’s divine consciousness’s last words.
Now,
His first priority was naturally to take a look at the Life-Defying Fruit.

chapters.title: Chapter 761
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 761: Chapter 337: Spirit Root Aptitude Enhancement, Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root Chapter 761: Chapter 337: Spirit Root Aptitude Enhancement, Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root Afterward,
Lin Jing walked out of the thatched cottage and headed straight for the spirit field outside.
Upon arriving at the spirit field, Lin Jing stood in front of the formation that enveloped a section of the field, making it impossible to see inside.
Even his divine sense could not penetrate it.
ƝονǤ0.ƈօ
This formation had been laid down by the Five Elements Ancestor.
With Lin Jing’s current strength, he couldn’t possibly break it.
Lin Jing was aware of this, so he didn’t try to probe further.
...
Instead, with a thought, he summoned the System Space and then entered it.
Once inside the System Space, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate, immediately activating Observation Mode.
The next moment,
Lin Jing’s vision changed, and once again from an observer’s viewpoint, he appeared above the external formation.
Then, Lin Jing controlled the observer viewpoint to descend, directly passing through the formation and into its interior.
Although Lin Jing couldn’t break the formation, under the Observation Mode within the System Space, the formation was as if it didn’t exist.
Even if Lin Jing wanted to pick the Life-Defying Fruit, he wouldn’t need to break the formation.
Instead, he could just use Fixed Point Teleportation to enter the heart of the formation.
If the divine sense of the Five Elements Ancestor knew that Lin Jing could obtain the Life-Defying Fruit, who knows what he would think…
…
As soon as he passed through the formation, Lin Jing’s eyes were immediately replaced by a brilliant array of light, and after steadying his mind, he looked towards the source of the light.
In front of Lin Jing was a dwarf green tree, not very tall but extremely beautiful, as if it were a work of art.
At the very top of the small tree, there grew a fruit roughly the size of a walnut, perfectly round and emitting a dazzling nine-colored radiance.
The light that Lin Jing had seen earlier came from this very fruit.
Needless to say,
this must be the Life-Defying Fruit.
The moment Lin Jing saw the Life-Defying Fruit, he was momentarily lost in thought.
Of course,
he wasn’t captivated by the stunning appearance of the Life-Defying Fruit.
Instead, he was considering how he could transplant the tree bearing the Life-Defying Fruit into the System Space without damaging it.
After all, if he could plant a Life-Defying Fruit tree in the System Space, then as long as he had enough Harvest Points, there would be an endless supply of Life-Defying Fruits.
The Five Elements Ancestor had also mentioned that after he disappeared, no one else would come to the Five Elements Territory and Lin Jing could take everything there.
After some thought, Lin Jing quickly formulated a plan.
Subsequently, Lin Jing immediately began to take action.
First of all,
he exited Observation Mode and returned to the spirit field within the System Space.
Then,
Lin Jing proceeded to the back of the spirit field, stood on an empty piece of land, and in the next moment, opened the system panel and chose to open two new spirit fields.
After Lin Jing made his selection, the system’s prompt sounded:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host has used the Spirit Field Expansion function to expand new spirit fields, spending 2,300 Harvest Points, remaining Harvest Points: 74,520.”
…
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host has used the Spirit Field Expansion function to expand new spirit fields, spending 2,400 Harvest Points, remaining Harvest Points: 72,120.”
…
As the two system prompts sounded, changes began to occur in the empty space in front of Lin Jing.
The once solid rocky ground, after a rapid transformation, turned into a grey-brown soil.
This time, Lin Jing had expanded two spirit fields.
One of them was to be used for planting the Life-Defying Fruit,
and the other spirit field was for planting the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
Since he was planning to transplant the Life-Defying Fruit into the System Space, Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t leave the Five Elements Spirit Tree behind.
After the expansion of the spirit fields was completed, Lin Jing immediately opened the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
As Fixed-Point Teleportation was activated, Lin Jing’s viewpoint reappeared outside, and he then set the teleportation target location inside the enclosed spirit field within the formation.
Once the location was set, Lin Jing started the teleportation.
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Host has used Fixed-Point Teleportation, deducting one Harvest Point, remaining Harvest Points: 72,119.”
With the system prompt’s announcement, the next moment Lin Jing appeared out of thin air within the formation.
Upon entering the formation, Lin Jing immediately felt an incredibly dense, almost terrifying concentration of spiritual energy.
Even the ground below was imbued with spiritual energy; just by standing in this spirit field, Lin Jing could feel the almost tangible spiritual energy within the soil.
Compared to the spirit fields outside the formation, it was worlds apart.
Lin Jing then probed the ground below the spirit field and, after some investigation, found nothing unusualâ€”it was simply a typical spirit field with an exceedingly high concentration of spiritual energy.
He guessed that it was due to that formation that the spiritual power within this formation was so dense.
In fact, the density of this spiritual energy was much higher than that of the spiritual power inside his own System Space.
And this concentrated spiritual force existed just for this lone Life-Defying Fruit tree, indicating that the rank of the tree was also not low.
…
Lin Jing approached the Life-Defying Fruit tree, looking at the fruit at the top.
The Life-Defying Fruit was incredibly dazzling, and the aura it emitted was extraordinary.
Just standing there, Lin Jing felt a special aura, which gave him an almost ethereal sensation.
He even felt as if his spiritual root was stirring with anticipation.
Of course, the spiritual root wouldn’t actually move.
It was just that this special aura permeated everything and even seeped into his body, causing him to sense it, which created the illusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 762
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 762: Chapter 337: Spirit Root Aptitude Enhancement, Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root_2 Chapter 762: Chapter 337: Spirit Root Aptitude Enhancement, Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root_2 After observing for a moment, Lin Jing shifted his gaze towards the whole Life-Defying Fruit tree.
Lin Jing planned to move the entire Life-Defying Fruit tree, along with the soil of this Spirit Field, all together into the Spirit Field.
Originally, transplanting the Life-Defying Fruit Tree would have required some soil to simulate the current environment, so he decided to handle it all at once.
Then, Lin Jing did not delay and began to take action immediately.
Lin Jing gathered his spiritual power and probed beneath the Life-Defying Fruit Tree.
After clarifying the position below, he solidified his spiritual power and separated this piece of the Spirit Field.
After the separation, Lin Jing wrapped the Life-Defying Fruit tree with his spiritual power while simultaneously summoning the System.
...
“Enter System Space!”
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, he, along with the entire Life-Defying Fruit tree, disappeared from the spot and entered the System Space.
After teleporting into the System Space, Lin Jing just regained his sight and immediately took the Life-Defying Fruit tree to the newly developed Spirit Field.
Thereafter,
Lin Jing quickly planted the entire Life-Defying Fruit tree.
After the Life-Defying Fruit tree was planted, the environment of this Spirit Field also changed, even without Lin Jing having to select it intentionally.
The change exactly resembled the Five Elements Territory.
Immediately after, Lin Jing summoned the system panel and used the function to observe Spirit Plants, starting to check the Life-Defying Fruit tree.
Rank Nine Spirit Plant: Life-Defying Fruit Tree
Current Environment: Five Elements Territory.
Spirit Plant Status: Already matured, can be harvested at any time.
…
This was clearly a mature Life-Defying Fruit tree.
Looking at the Life-Defying Fruits on it, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be somewhat tempted.
However, Lin Jing did not rashly harvest them, but after observing the Life-Defying Fruit tree for a while and finding no abnormalities, he used Fixed Point Teleportation to leave the System Space.
Lin Jing used Fixed Point Teleportation, and when he appeared again, he was already outside the Formation.
Afterward,
Lin Jing walked towards the Five Elements Spirit Tree in the courtyard.
Next, Lin Jing followed the same process, taking the soil underneath along, and transplanted the whole Five Elements Spirit Tree into the System Space.
After transplanting the Five Elements Spirit Tree, Lin Jing immediately checked the status of the Five Elements Spirit Tree.
Rank Seven Spirit Plant: Five Elements Spirit Tree
Current Environment: Five Elements Territory.
Spirit Plant Status: Environment matched, growing rapidly, remaining time until maturity: 5000 years.
…
The Five Elements Spirit Tree could grow Five Elements Spirit Fruits, and consuming the Five Elements Spirit Fruits made it easier to merge with the Five Elements True Spirit, allowing one to enter the Solidifying Body phase more quickly.
Previously, while on Immortal Crossing Island, Lin Jing had heard some of this from an old ape, but at that time his cultivation was too low, so the old ape did not reveal too much to him.
What he knew now was all information Lin Jing found out later.
Lin Jing then looked at the Five Elements Spirit Tree and saw a sprout the size of a mung bean prepared to start growing on top of it.
Seeing the situation, he had to hasten the ripening of a Five Elements Spirit Fruit before advancing to the Solidifying Body phase, as only by consuming the Five Elements Spirit Fruit could he enter the Solidifying Body phase faster.
ṅοѵǤο.сο
After transplanting the Five Elements Spirit Tree, Lin Jing left the System Space again.
This time,
Lin Jing left the statue and came to the valley.
The entire valley was filled with Five Elements Spiritual Force, especially the colorful clouds above the valley, all in the colors of WÇ” CÇŽi.
Lin Jing then walked through the entire valley,
even exploring the colorful luminous fog outside the valley.
After a thorough exploration by Lin Jing, he finally understood the entire situation of the Five Elements Territory.
The Five Elements Territory was not large; it was basically just the area of this valley.
The colorful fog outside the valley was not abundant; after probing inside, Lin Jing found it spanned only about a hundred yards.
Further inside, he had already reached the boundary.
He could probe no further.
And this whole Five Elements Territory seemed to be an independent space that had been developed.
It was even quite inferior compared to other realms.
Indeed, the other realms seemed like individual small worlds.
After clarifying the whole situation of the Five Elements Territory, Lin Jing returned to the small courtyard in the hands of the statue.
Next,
Lin Jing planned to consume the Life-Defying Fruit to enhance his Spirit Root Aptitude.
Once his aptitude was elevated, he planned to consume the Five Elements Golden Core to raise his cultivation.
Once again returning to the System Space, Lin Jing entered the Spirit Field.
Afterward, Lin Jing carefully approached the Life-Defying Fruit tree and picked the fruit from it.
Once the Life-Defying Fruit was harvested, the colorful glow it emitted instantly vanished, and the fruit itself turned into an unremarkable gray.
The whole Life-Defying Fruit tree began to change color after Lin Jing had picked the fruit.
Soon, the tree turned from jade green to a deep green, and the tree itself no longer had the vitality it did before.
Afterward.
Lin Jing checked the status of the Life-Defying Fruit tree once more.
Supreme Grade Spirit Plant: Life-Defying Fruit Tree
Current Environment: Five Elements Territory.
Spirit Plant Status: Environment matched, insufficient Spiritual Power for growth, slow growth in progress, time until maturity: two hundred thousand years.
Seeing the growth time of this Life-Defying Fruit, Lin Jing was left speechless for a moment, unsure of what to say.
The growth of the Life-Defying Fruit required such a long time.
Although it was in a slow-growing state and needed two hundred thousand years, Lin Jing estimated that even if the Spiritual Power in his space were sufficient, it would still take at least one hundred thousand years for the Life-Defying Fruit to fully mature.
One hundred thousand years was indeed not a short time.
However.
After that, Lin Jing thought…
The Life-Defying Fruit tree, being of the highest rank in the Cultivation World and particularly special and rare, was the only plant guaranteed to enhance one’s Spiritual Root Aptitude completely.
Countless top powers desired but couldn’t even acquire one.
Thinking of this, Lin Jing came to terms with it.
After picking the Life-Defying Fruit, Lin Jing took it with him to the Alchemy Room within the System Space, as enhancing aptitude must be done in the Alchemy Room.
Upon entering the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing walked to the center, then directly sat down cross-legged in the middle of the room.
After sitting down, Lin Jing took a deep breath and steadied his emotions.
Unlike other Spirit Plants, a heavenly and earthly plant like the Life-Defying Fruit didn’t require processing into Elixir Medicine; it could be consumed directly.
Of course, some had tried to turn the Life-Defying Fruit into Elixir Medicine, aiming to extract its medicinal power so that more people could enhance their aptitude.
But unfortunately, even using every possible method, they had not succeeded.
It was merely a waste of a Life-Defying Fruit.
Once his emotions were steady and his Spiritual Power had stabilized within his body, Lin Jing took out the Life-Defying Fruit and put it into his mouth.
No sooner had Lin Jing put the Life-Defying Fruit into his mouth than the fruit began to transform into medicinal power, flowing into his abdomen.
At the same time, Lin Jing’s Spiritual Root, along with his body, seemed to feel this medicinal power and started reacting as well.
This chain reaction even made his spirits somewhat joyful.
However, now was not the time for him to be happy, as the medicinal liquid from the Life-Defying Fruit had not yet been refined; if not refined promptly, the power contained within the liquid would quickly dissipate.
Thus.
Lin Jing hurriedly stabilized his spirit and began refining the medicinal liquid within his body…
The refinement of the Life-Defying Fruit was not easy.
It took Lin Jing a full three days to completely refine the medicinal liquid contained within the Life-Defying Fruit.
The refined medicinal liquid of the Life-Defying Fruit turned into a fluid emitting a multicolored glow, continuously flowing through Lin Jing’s meridians.
Now that the medicinal liquid had been refined, the next step was to absorb it into his body and change his Spiritual Root…
…
…
After refining the Life-Defying Fruit’s spiritual liquid, Lin Jing spent another month absorbing all the medicinal liquid.
After absorbing the medicinal liquid, Lin Jing felt as if he had become the darling of the universe.
Even as Lin Jing simply sat there without moving, endless Spiritual Power continuously surged toward his body.
The speed of Spiritual Power circulating within Lin Jing’s body also increased significantly.
Afterward.
Lin Jing quickly opened the system panel to check his status:
Lin Jing (111/2000)
Spiritual Root: Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root (Supreme Grade)
Cultivation: Divinity Transformation Eighth Layer (2%)
…
…
Sure enough, his Spiritual Root Aptitude had improved, becoming a Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root…

chapters.title: Chapter 763
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 763: 338 Chapter 763: 338 Twenty years of time might not seem like much for the Five Elements Territory, which has existed for countless thousands of years.
But since the spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor dissipated, this Five Elements Territory seemed to have lost its guardian, devoid of its soul.
Just twenty short years had passed, and the valley no longer looked the same, beginning to show slight changes.
The Five Elements Spiritual Force throughout the Five Elements Territory was slowly dissipating, and the Spiritual Force within the valley had also become thinner compared to before.
At that moment, at the center of the valley in the Five Elements Territory, a person was seated in meditation, cultivating.
Around him, Five Elements Spiritual Force continuously surged from all directions, enveloping him in layer upon layer, forming a protective shield made of Five Elements Spiritual Force.
The person inside, however, seemed unaware, simply sitting there quietly, allowing the surrounding Five Elements Spiritual Force to seep into his body.
...
If one looked closer, they would not find it difficult to recognize that this person meditating in the center of the valley was Lin Jing.
At this time,
Twenty years had passed since Lin Jing’s Spirit Root Aptitude had been enhanced.
With no delay after enhancing his Spirit Root Aptitude, Lin Jing immediately began the refinement of the Five Elements Golden Core.
The Five Elements Golden Core was a legacy left by the Five Elements Ancestor, containing the pure cultivation he had once possessed.
After Lin Jing began refining the Five Elements Golden Core, the pure cultivation within surged into his body, crazily circulating and aiding him in elevating his realm.
Lin Jing did not dare to delay and immediately began absorbing the pure cultivation contained within the Golden Core to its fullest.
Afterward, in just over two years, Lin Jing made a breakthrough from the eighth level of Divinity Transformation, leaping directly to the peak of Nascent Soul Peak.
Speaking of two years, when adding the time spent in the System Space, Lin Jing actually took a total of ten years.
Ten years to consecutively break through two major realms, reaching the perfect state of Nascent Soul Peak.
Such a rate of breakthrough was unheard of.
If it were to be revealed, it would certainly shock countless people.
Furthermore,
this was the result of Lin Jing deliberately controlling his pace, avoiding too rapid an advancement that could destabilize his cultivation.
He even intentionally slowed down his breakthrough velocity.
Without such control, Lin Jing had no doubt that with the aid of the Five Elements Golden Core, he could reach the peak of Divinity Transformation in just a year, not even needing two.
After advancing to Divinity Transformation Peak, Lin Jing temporarily stored the Five Elements Golden Core away.
The spiritual thought of the Five Elements Ancestor had once stated that even if the Golden Core could not bring Lin Jing to the Dao Integration Stage, it would be almost as good.
Lin Jing had only advanced from the eighth level of Divinity Transformation to Nascent Soul Peak, so the cultivation contained within the Golden Core was not much depleted, and the core itself had barely changed.
Having reached the peak of Divinity Transformation, Lin Jing had reached a crucial juncture for advancing to the Solidifying Body Realm; at this point, no further breakthrough was needed.
Instead, he needed to gather the true spirits of Five Elements and cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Body to enter the Solidifying Body Realm.
Before cultivating the true Five Elements spirits, Lin Jing first ripened a five-star Spirit Fruit.
After consuming the Spirit Fruit, Lin Jing then began the cultivation of the Five Elements Spiritual Body.
Just like that…
Lin Jing spent another seventy years cultivating the true Five Elements spirits.
During these seventy years, Lin Jing cultivated not just one,
but a full set of five.
Even though he originally possessed a Metallic Attribute among the true Five Elements spirits, Lin Jing did not use it but instead cultivated on his own, developing a set that was entirely his own.
Only his self-cultivated Five Elements True Spirits, completely aligned with his own body, could bring out the strongest power.
Lin Jing certainly didn’t forget that point.
While cultivating the Five Elements True Spirits, Lin Jing made good use of the remaining time within the System Space, entering to cultivate whenever time permitted.
Therefore, these seventy years of cultivation also included the time spent within the System Space.
After recalculating, adding the time taken to reach the peak of Divinity Transformation, a total of twenty years had elapsed in the outside world.
It can be said that Lin Jing only took twenty years to advance from the eighth level of Divinity Transformation to the peak.
Meanwhile, he had also completed the cultivation of five Five Elements True Spirits.
With his cultivation reaching its limit and the Five Elements True Spirits fully prepared, Lin Jing was just one step away from the Solidifying Body Realm, only lacking the celestial baptism of Heavenly Tribulation.
…
At this time,
In the valley of the Five Elements Territory, Lin Jing appeared to be cultivating, but he was actually waiting for the Tribulation Lightning to descend.
Lin Jing continuously absorbed the surrounding Five Elements Power, not disguising at all, allowing his peak Divinity Transformation cultivation aura to overflow completely.
This was just to attract Heavenly Tribulation.
Lin Jing had been sitting here for three days already.
If it were the outside world, with the cultivation aura that Lin Jing currently released, the Tribulation Lightning would already be upon him.
ƝᴑνǤ0.сο
Because the Five Elements Territory is a separate space isolated from the outside world, it became extremely difficult to attract Heavenly Tribulation.
Just like the previous situation in the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.
However, with the lessons learned from the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, even though the Heavenly Tribulation had not yet arrived, Lin Jing didn’t panic at all but remained calm and collected, continuing to absorb the surrounding Five Elements Spiritual Force.
As this continued, time gradually passed.
The first day…
The second day…
The third day…
…
…
Soon, seven days had passed, making it ten days since Lin Jing had been seated in this valley, and the sky still showed no changes.
Lin Jing also remained seated, seeming unconcerned.

chapters.title: Chapter 764
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 764: Chapter 338 Tribulation_2 Chapter 764: Chapter 338 Tribulation_2 Actually, that was not the case.
Although Lin Jing had been sitting in meditation all this time, he could feel with his breath that the Heavenly Tribulation was getting closer and closer, seemingly about to descend soon.
Feeling the impending arrival of the Heavenly Tribulation, Lin Jing was neither excited nor panicked, but continued to sit in meditation, absorbing the Five Element Power around, as if he were an old monk deep in meditation.
Time hurried along, and it wasn’t until the evening of the tenth day that the sky above the Five Elements Territory began to change.
Suddenly, the originally multicolored auspicious clouds were pushed out by a mass of dark clouds that abruptly appeared.
At first, these dark clouds were not too large.
But as time went on, the area covered by the dark clouds grew larger and larger, until finally the dark clouds covered the entire sky of the Five Elements Territory, and the original multicolored auspicious clouds had been squeezed out of sight long ago.
...
Once the dark clouds spread out completely, the rumbling sound of muffled thunder began to resonate within them.
As the dark clouds lowered, the sound of the muffled thunder grew louder and louder.
ƝᴑνǤᴑ.сο
At the same time, the vast and mighty terrifying pressure also started descending from the dark clouds towards Lin Jing in the valley.
It was not until then that Lin Jing finally opened his eyes and stood up, looking up at the Tribulation clouds overhead.
Black Tribulation Lightning arcs fused within the dark clouds, bringing an even more terrifying oppressive atmosphere.
This Heavenly Tribulation, just by feeling its aura, one knew it was no ordinary one.
It seemed that this time, his full strength would need to be exerted.
As time passed, the Tribulation Lightning within the clouds gradually increased, and the rolling sound of thunder within was ceaseless.
The Tribulation clouds, carrying tremendous heavenly might, kept pressing down on Lin Jing…
Just then, countless free-floating lightning arcs within the clouds suddenly converged towards the center of the Tribulation clouds.
And at the center of the entire Tribulation cloud, a brilliant light suddenly shone.
“Boom!”
There was a thunderous roar.
A Black Tribulation Lightning bolt from the center of the clouds struck down, heading straight for Lin Jing’s head.
This Tribulation Lightning was fast and swift, and before even the blink of an eye, it had already struck above Lin Jing’s head.
Upon being hit by this Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing did not panic, but instead stretched out his hand towards the sky, directly and firmly catching the lightning.
This Tribulation Lightning, though it looked formidable, was actually only the first strike, and its power was still manageable.
It posed no threat to Lin Jing.
Soon, nine breaths of time passed and the Tribulation Lightning had dissipated.
And Lin Jing, situated within it, was unharmed as usual.
The reason for this was not only because the first strike of Tribulation Lightning was limited in power.
Another reason was that after breaking through to the Nascent Soul Peak, Lin Jing had spent seventy years cultivating the Five Elements True Spirit.
During the cultivation of the Five Elements True Spirit, although Lin Jing did not intentionally enhance his cultivation, his Cultivation nonetheless solidified unconsciously.
It could be said that Lin Jing’s cultivation at this time was extremely solid, and he could easily withstand the first few strikes of Tribulation Lightning without issue.
After the first strike of Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing did not rest but continued to look up at the Tribulation clouds in the sky, as if expecting the second strike of Tribulation Lightning to fall…
The Tribulation clouds in the sky, as if angered by Lin Jing’s dismissive attitude, did not take long after the first strike had dissipated for the second strike of Tribulation Lightning to follow immediately…
The second strike of Tribulation Lightning, though stronger than the first, was still limited.
Lin Jing handled it with ease.
And so, one after another, the Tribulation Lightning struck down.
The third, fourth, and fifth strikes of Tribulation Lightning did not cause Lin Jing to expend much effort.
It was not until the sixth strike that things changed.
This sixth strike of Tribulation Lightning was somewhat thicker than the previous ones.
The power of the Heavenly Tribulation it contained was also stronger than the first five.
After the sixth Tribulation Lightning dissipated, some minor wounds finally appeared on Lin Jing’s body.
The black lightning arcs also attached themselves to those wounds on Lin Jing, attempting to hinder the healing.
However.
Just some black lightning arcs posed no threat to Lin Jing at all.
Lin Jing then willed his thoughts, and his body’s wounds began to quickly move, absorbing the black lightning arcs into his body.
The next moment,
Lin Jing’s injuries began to heal rapidly.
In less time than it takes to brew a cup of tea, the wounds on his body had all but vanished.
Following that,
Lin Jing looked up, gazing into the Tribulation clouds in the sky.
At that moment, the Tribulation clouds were no longer sending down Tribulation Lightning but instead began to change.
Soon, multicolored lights started shining through from those black Tribulation clouds.
Gradually, the dark clouds began to transform rapidly, and before long, they all turned into multicolored colors.
Even the occasional Tribulation Lightning appearing within the clouds also turned into multicolored lights.
Lin Jing’s brow furrowed slightly as he spoke,
“Silent Extinguishing Celestial Lightning…”
This Tribulation Lightning was something Lin Jing had encountered before; it was the same Silent Extinguishing Celestial Lightning he had faced during his last advancement to Divinity Transformation.
Last time, it was only the final strike that was the Silent Extinguishing Celestial Lightning.
Unexpectedly, this time, as early as the seventh strike, the Silent Extinguishing Celestial Lightning had already appeared.
Seeing the Silent Extinguishing Celestial Lightning’s appearance, Lin Jing dared not be careless any longer, and then he summoned the System before saying,
“System!”
“Activate Bonus Attachment!”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the next moment, a system prompt entered his ears.
“Ding!”
“Bonus Attachment activated successfully, deducting 5 Harvest Points, current remaining Harvest Points: 60712.”
With Bonus Attachment activated, Lin Jing immediately felt his Divine Sense become incredibly solid; even the terrifying pressure from within the Tribulation had ceased to feel as intimidating.
Afterwards,

chapters.title: Chapter 765
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 765: Chapter 338 Tribulation_3 Chapter 765: Chapter 338 Tribulation_3 Lin Jing focused his mind, preparing to face the annihilating celestial lightning.
“Boom!”
He didn’t have to wait long, as the seventh Tribulation Lightning descended directly from the clouds above.
Whether it was the WÇ” CÇŽi clouds above Lin Jing’s head or the WÇ” CÇŽi lightning falling from them, both were incredibly dazzling.
Even to call them breathtakingly beautiful wouldn’t be an exaggeration.
But it was precisely this beautiful phenomenon that concealed a tremendous, destructive intent capable of annihilating everything.
As the Tribulation Lightning struck above Lin Jing, he immediately met it head-on while circulating the Overlord Divine Physique and Immortal Five Elements Technique to resist the murderous intent brought by the lightning.
As Lin Jing faced the Tribulation Lightning,
he suddenly discovered something astonishing.
...
As the annihilating celestial lightning fell, aside from its terrifying Heavenly Tribulation Power, it also carried an immensely horrifying Five Elements Spiritual Force.
If this Five Elements Spiritual Force had been directed at someone else, it might have been a different story.
But its target was Lin Jing.
As the terrifying power of the Heavenly Tribulation tore through Lin Jing’s body, the fearsomely substantial Five Elements Power surged into his body immediately afterward.
However, Lin Jing needed just a flick of his Immortal Five Elements Technique to control that Five Elements Power.
With a single thought from Lin Jing, the Five Elements Power surged into the wounds, healing all his injuries completely.
Afterward,
Among this cycle of destruction and healing, repeated over and again, Lin Jing stubbornly endured the Tribulation Lightning.
Only nine breaths later, when Lin Jing examined his body again, he found it smooth and unscathed, as if it hadn’t been harmed at all.
As Lin Jing wondered what had happened, just as he began to explore, he noticed that the Five Elements Spiritual Force around him had thinned somewhat.
Afterward, Lin Jing looked around.
He noticed that not only the Five Elements Spiritual Force around him, but even the mists outside the valley had thinned somewhat.
Lin Jing immediately understood what was happening.
It turned out that when the annihilating celestial lightning fell, it absorbed nearby spiritual power, but within the Five Elements Territory, the area was filled with Five Elements Spiritual Force.
And these Five Elements Spiritual Forces were precisely what was used in Lin Jing’s practice of the Immortal Five Elements Technique.
Therefore, as the annihilating celestial lightning fell, it naturally carried these Five Elements Power with it.
And Lin Jing took this opportunity to control the Five Elements Power for his own use.
Realizing this, Lin Jing felt much more relaxed when he looked up at the clouds of Tribulation once more.
After the seventh Tribulation Lightning had passed,
The clouds in the sky brooded for a while before releasing the eighth Tribulation Lightning.
And like the seventh Tribulation Lightning, this one too came with an endless amount of Five Elements Spiritual Force.
In the midst of this lightning, Lin Jing appeared to be hurt.
However, after the lightning passed,
Lin Jing was unchanged, as usual.
ɴονǤο.с0
After the eighth Tribulation Lightning dissipated, what followed was the last, the ninth Tribulation Lightning.
The ninth Tribulation Lightning was different from the previous eight.
It not only carried the destructive power of the Heavenly Tribulation but also wielded attacks specifically aimed at the Soul Spirit.
Especially since advancing to the last Tribulation of the Solidifying Body Realm, this lightning was crucial in condensing the Five True Spirits of the Five Elements and cultivating the Five Elements Spiritual Body.
Lin Jing gazed at the sky, then began to wait for the ninth Tribulation Lightning to fall.
“Boom!”
The ninth Tribulation Lightning answered and fell.
As soon as this lightning struck, it came with countless pressures of heaven and earth, crushing down on Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit.
And furthermore, the Five Elements Power contained in this lightning directly influenced Lin Jing’s newly condensed Five True Spirits.
Under this tremendous pressure, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit and the Five True Spirits were slowly merging.

chapters.title: Chapter 766
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 766: Chapter 339: Advancing to the Pinnacle of the Solidifying Body Realm Chapter 766: Chapter 339: Advancing to the Pinnacle of the Solidifying Body Realm This ninth Tribulation Lightning lasted for a full nine breaths.
After nine breaths, the Tribulation Lightning dissipated.
And the entire space once again returned to tranquility.
However, after the vanishing of the Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing, who should have endured the harshest damage from the last lightning, was sitting quietly in the valley as if he had sustained no injuries at all.
This ninth Tribulation Lightning was indeed the last one.
Therefore, after the ninth one had dissipated, the tribulation clouds in the sky began to slowly scatter, and the Five Elements Spiritual Force that had been disturbed by the Heavenly Tribulation was gradually restoring some order.
Yet, even as the tribulation clouds had dispersed and the Five Elements Territory was restored to normal, Lin Jing still sat there without moving, and no sound emanated from him.
...
It was as if Lin Jing had perished, leaving only his body behind, sitting motionless, and around him, there was no longer the gathering of the Five Elements Power.
In the entire Five Elements Territory, since there were no seasons, there was also no concept of heat or cold.
And so, time passed day by day.
It was uncertain how much time had gone by, but Lin Jing’s body was covered with leaves that had blown in from who knows where, and he himself seemed to have turned into a statue.
On this day…
The long-peaceful Five Elements Territory suddenly burst forth with a surge of intense Spiritual Power fluctuations, so powerful that they directly disrupted the entire Five Elements Territory’s Spiritual Force.
And the source of this Spiritual Power was none other than Lin Jing who was sitting in the valley of the Five Elements Territory.
After these fluctuations appeared,
The next moment,
A humanoid phantom emerged from within Lin Jing’s body.
After this humanoid phantom appeared, it grew larger and larger, until it eventually became a hundred zhang tall.
On closer inspection, this phantom’s attire was identical to Lin Jing’s.
Even its facial features were no different from Lin Jing’s.
After the appearance of the phantom, it looked toward the statue of the Five Elements Ancestor in front of it, paused for a moment, and then bowed deeply in a gesture of respect.
ṅονǤ0.сο
After the bow, the humanoid phantom quickly shrank until eventually, all of it retracted back into Lin Jing’s body.
Only when the phantom had fully retracted, did Lin Jing, who had been sitting in meditation for who knows how long, finally open his eyes again.
At this moment,
His eyes still faintly revealed joy, and the corners of his mouth couldn’t help but curve upward:
“Three years…”
“After three years, I have finally cultivated the Five Elements Spiritual Body.”
Surviving the Heavenly Tribulation did not truly mean entry into the Solidifying Body Realm; the real marker of entering the Solidifying Body Realm was the gathering of five True Spirits of the Five Elements and the cultivation of the Five Elements Spiritual Body.
The phantom just now was the True Spirit of the Five Elements that Lin Jing had cultivated.
After surviving the Tribulation, Lin Jing had only initially gathered the five True Spirits of the Five Elements, but only after the Tribulation did the real cultivation of the Five Elements Spiritual Body begin.
