With only three years, Lin Jing had cultivated the True Spirits of the Five Elements, which was an astoundingly fast pace.
In this, the role of the Five Elements Spirit Fruits was undeniable.
Of course,
There was another factor, which was when he helped that old ape hasten the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Tree on Immortal Crossing Island.
By helping the old ape hasten the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Tree, some of the Spiritual Power contained within the tree had remained inside Lin Jing’s body,
silently altering his physique.
This change was not apparent and didn’t assist much with daily cultivation, yet at this moment, it revealed its value.
If not for that moment of accelerating the ripening of the Five Elements Spirit Tree for the old ape, the time Lin Jing would have needed to cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Body would have been much longer than now.
It was that subtle change, coupled with the fact that Lin Jing consumed an actual Five Elements Spirit Fruit, that allowed him to cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Body completely in just three years.
Otherwise, it would have taken Lin Jing at least thirty years to successfully cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Body.
Having successfully cultivated the Five Elements Spiritual Body also signified that he had completely entered the Solidifying Body Realm, leaving Lin Jing in a most joyous mood at this moment.
With a thought, Lin Jing gave a slight shudder, and all the leaves and dust piled upon his body dissipated.
Then, Lin Jing took a step forward.
The next moment, he was floating above the valley.
Standing in the air above the valley of the Five Elements Territory, Lin Jing surveyed the entire territory.
The baptism of the Heavenly Tribulation had left the Five Elements Territory far messier than before, and now, looking at it, the whole territory had almost entirely changed from when he first entered.
The Spiritual Force of the entire Five Elements Territory had also been significantly depleted by the Heavenly Tribulation, and even the colorful clouds in the sky had lost their previous brilliance and had thinned out a bit.
Lin Jing knew, ever since the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor had dissipated, the Five Elements Spiritual Force of this territory had been slowly fading away.
Even if he didn’t absorb them, these Five Elements Spiritual Forces would dissipate bit by bit, until one day they would completely disappear.
To Lin Jing, these Five Elements Spiritual Forces were precious means to enhance his cultivation, and it would be a waste to let them just fade away.
Therefore, Lin Jing decided, he would not leave here for the time being.
Instead, he planned to absorb all the Five Elements Spiritual Force of this territory.
Once the absorption was complete, he would then leave.
Having made his decision, Lin Jing no longer hesitated and went straight to the small courtyard on the palm of the Five Elements Ancestor’s statue.
Upon arriving, Lin Jing made his way to the thatched hut where the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor once resided.
For the next period, Lin Jing intended to stay here and continue the Refinement of the Golden Core.
While elevating his Cultivation, he would simultaneously absorb the Five Elements Spiritual Force of this territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 767
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 767: Chapter 339: Advancing, Peak of the Solidifying Body Realm_2 Chapter 767: Chapter 339: Advancing, Peak of the Solidifying Body Realm_2 …
…
Time flew by like a white steed flashing past a crevice.
Because there were no seasons within the Five Elements Territory, time seemed to have paused here, making it hard for one to sense its passing.
Only the gradually diminishing Five Elements Spiritual Power within the Five Elements Territory could let one realize that time was indeed trickling away.
A long time passed once again, and the Five Elements Spiritual Power within the Five Elements Territory gradually depleted, losing its former splendor, and the entire Five Elements Territory fell into a dead silence.
Only in the palm of the Five Elements Ancestor was there a slight fluctuation of spiritual power.
...
Ɲονɢο.сο
At this moment.
In the small courtyard at the center of the statue’s palm, Lin Jing was sitting cross-legged.
In his hand was a Golden Core, covered in cracks and devoid of any color.
This Golden Core was precisely the one the spiritual mind of the Five Elements Ancestor had given to Lin Jing.
However, all the cultivation within the Golden Core had been absorbed by Lin Jing, causing the entire core to become filled with cracks.
Just then, a slight “crack” sound came from the Golden Core, followed by a spread of cracks.
Soon…
The sound kept spreading, and the entire Golden Core completely shattered into several pieces.
After the Golden Core shattered, in less than a breath’s time, it turned into powder and then vanished.
A long time passed after the Golden Core disappeared before Lin Jing slowly opened his eyes.
After opening his eyes, Lin Jing looked down at his palm, where there was nothing left.
Lin Jing then couldn’t help but shake his head and sighed,
“Sigh…!”
“Even after absorbing all the spiritual power of the Five Elements Territory and the cultivation from the Golden Core, I still failed to advance to the Dao Integration Stage.”
Actually, the cultivation left by the Five Elements Ancestor in the Five Elements Golden Core, as well as the spiritual power of the entire Five Elements Territory, were not small in amount.
After absorbing either one, Lin Jing’s cultivation would have significantly increased.
However, while cultivating the Immortal Five Elements Technique, Lin Jing was also using spiritual power to cultivate the Overlord Divine Physique, pushing his Body Refinement cultivation upwards, which naturally required much more spiritual power than others.
Therefore…
Even after Lin Jing had refined all the cultivation within the Five Elements Golden Core and absorbed all the Five Elements Spiritual Power of the territory, he only managed to break through to the pinnacle of the Solidifying Body Realm.
Actually, Lin Jing also entertained the thought of giving up cultivating the Overlord Divine Physique and abandoning the enhancement of his Body Refinement cultivation.
Because cultivating just the Immortal Five Elements Technique would have been sufficient, and cultivating the Overlord Divine Physique while being a Body Refinement Cultivator seemed somewhat redundant.
The main reason was that in order to cultivate the Overlord Divine Physique, one had to re-cultivate the realms one had already achieved once over.
The amount of spiritual power expended was also twice that of others.
However.
After a bit of thought, Lin Jing dismissed this idea.
The current Lin Jing, whose Spiritual Root had reached that of the Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root, did not lag behind other genius cultivators in terms of cultivation speed.
Additionally, he had System Space, an against-the-heaven tool, where the flow of time was multiplied.
Lin Jing did not need to worry about his cultivation speed being too slow due to the Body Refining techniques, with System Space having his back, these were no problems at all.
Another point was during the tribulation.
Every time Lin Jing faced a Heavenly Tribulation, it seemed stronger than what others faced.
The ability of Lin Jing to successfully survive every tribulation was significantly due to the Overlord Divine Physique.
Cultivating the Overlord Divine Physique allowed Lin Jing’s body to absorb the Tribulation Lightning, reducing the damage he sustained during the tribulation.
And this time during the tribulation, one of the reasons Lin Jing appeared to suffer little damage was because of his cultivation of the Overlord Divine Physique.
Another was due to the abundant Five Elements Spiritual Power in the Five Elements Territory, which Lin Jing could use at any time to repair his wounded body.
Therefore, this tribulation was passed by Lin Jing with more shock than harm, safely overcoming it.
Had he not cultivated the Overlord Divine Physique, Lin Jing might not have been able to heal his body proactively before being turned to ash by the devastating Heavenly Lightning.
So, the Overlord Divine Physique should not be abandoned but continued to be cultivated.
Moreover, by cultivating the Overlord Divine Physique, he became a Body Refinement Cultivator, thereby gaining another method to combat foes, so why not embrace it?
…
After sighing, Lin Jing stood up.
Then, he counted on his fingers for a while.
After calculating, Lin Jing realized that he had spent over thirty-seven years cultivating up to the present.
That is to say, the time spent in the outside world, combined with the time spent in the System Space, added up to a total of one hundred and fifty years.
In that time, Lin Jing had cultivated from the first level of the Solidifying Body Realm to the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm.
Although he had the aid of the Five Elements Golden Core and Five Elements Spiritual Force, which accelerated his cultivation a bit, the cultivation Lin Jing needed to break through was twice that of others.
This pace of cultivation, under normal circumstances, could be considered extremely rapid.
But Lin Jing’s cultivation was aided by the Five Elements Golden Core.
Therefore, this speed was not considered fast.
Instead, it was extremely slow.
During this period, Lin Jing wasn’t constantly cultivating.
Many times, to prevent his cultivation from breaking through too quickly and becoming unstable, Lin Jing would periodically slow down his cultivation to solidify his gains.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have taken a full one hundred and fifty years to reach the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm, even with the aid of the Five Elements Golden Core.
During the times he solidified his cultivation, Lin Jing was not idle; whenever he had time, he would refine some elixirs.
With continuous alchemy, his Alchemy Proficiency naturally increased significantly.
As a result, Lin Jing’s alchemy level also made another breakthrough, directly advancing to a Seventh Grade Alchemist.
Since those low-tier Spiritual Plants matured very quickly, Lin Jing planted most of the Spirit Fields with them.
Throughout this period, by utilizing the rapid maturation of these low-tier Spiritual Plants, Lin Jing not only gained many Harvest Points but also refined quite a few low-tier elixirs of Flawless quality during his alchemy sessions.
And these low-tier elixirs, whether Flawless quality or other qualities, were of no use to Lin Jing himself.
So…
Lin Jing converted all of the elixirs he refined, including those Flawless elixirs, entirely into Harvest Points.
In this way, up to this point, the Harvest Points accumulated in the System Space had reached as many as nine hundred and eighty thousand.
He needed less than twenty thousand Harvest Points to upgrade the System Space again.
…
After reviewing his harvest, Lin Jing looked towards the outside valley and then took a step forward.
The next moment,
Lin Jing appeared in the airspace above the valley.
The valley was no longer the same as when Lin Jing first entered; it had become extremely desolate.
The colorful auspicious clouds in the sky had also disappeared, revealing a grey, murky sky, and even the colorful mist that had previously been outside the valley had vanished completely.
The entire Five Elements Territory was enveloped in a grey fog.
Looking around the entire valley, Lin Jing finally turned towards the statue of the Five Elements Ancestor.
There was nothing left in the valley.
It was time for him to leave.
Following that,
Lin Jing bowed respectfully to the statue of the Five Elements Ancestor, then turned around, planning to step into the Teleportation Array and leave the place.
But just as he was about to leave, a sudden change occurred…
The Formation in the valley below began to emit a strong light.
It seemed, from the outside, that someone was activating the Formation, attempting to enter.
At this moment, that someone was still trying to enter here, which was indeed odd.
Lin Jing then looked towards the Formation in the valley.
The light emitted by the Formation grew stronger and stronger, and within that light, a figure slowly became visible.
After the figure appeared, the light from the Formation immediately dimmed.
When the teleportation light completely disappeared, Lin Jing could clearly see the figure within the light.
It was none other than Li Mingwu.
The appearance of Li Mingwu left Lin Jing quite astonished.
He thought that Li Mingwu had stayed in the Water Element Realm, and that he would not meet him again in these Five Elements Ruins.
Unexpectedly, just as he prepared to leave, Li Mingwu appeared again.
Seeing Li Mingwu, Lin Jing couldn’t help but smile.
It seemed this was fate.
His grudge with Li Mingwu was destined to be settled here in these Five Elements Ruinsâ€¦

chapters.title: Chapter 768
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 768: Chapter 340: The Resentment with Li Mingwu Chapter 768: Chapter 340: The Resentment with Li Mingwu Lin Jing and Li Mingwu’s grievance can be described as long-standing.
It can be said that soon after he arrived in the Southern Outer Sea, a series of events entangled him with Li Mingwu.
During this period, Li Mingwu, a potential enemy, constantly loomed over Lin Jing, forcing him to act cautiously.
Especially after the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm incident, Lin Jing’s grievances with Li Mingwu, after having truly encountered him for the first time, became irreconcilable.
After that, Lin Jing had been extremely cautious, daring not to expose himself slightly, growing from an original Junior Cultivator at the Golden Core stage to now being at the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm.
This time, in the Five Elements Territory, Lin Jing’s gains were huge, particularly his cultivation, which advanced significantly.
It can be said that with Lin Jing’s current state, Li Mingwu certainly couldn’t reach him.
...
Now, Li Mingwu had also come to this Five Elements Territory, and it was time to settle their grievances.
…
After teleporting here, Li Mingwu immediately spotted Lin Jing, and showed a moment of astonishment upon seeing him.
Obviously, Li Mingwu hadn’t expected Lin Jing to still be here.
After his initial shock, Li Mingwu quickly recovered and his gaze towards Lin Jing carried that indifference typically seen from higher-echelon cultivators towards those of lower rank.
“I didn’t expect you to still be here, I must say, my luck isn’t too bad.”
“It’s good, actually.
I can settle things with you here instead of having to go out and search for you.”
Since Lin Jing appeared as usual, without showing his true cultivation, Li Mingwu saw him as still unchanged from before.
Yet when Lin Jing looked at Li Mingwu, he noticed his substantial changes.
Firstly, he seemed younger, no longer bearing his previous decrepit form, but rather taking on the appearance of a venerable immortal with youthful features.
Furthermore, it was his cultivation that had changed.
Now Lin Jing saw at a glance that Li Mingwu had successfully advanced, becoming a cultivator at the first level of the Solidifying Body Realm.
If Li Mingwu had advanced to the Solidifying Body Realm, then it meant that Bai Yi was probably in great peril.
After all, for Li Mingwu to advance, he needed to seize the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit from Bai Yi.
And now…
Li Mingwu having successfully advanced to Solidifying Body, the fate of Bai Yi could be easily surmised.
…
Lin Jing looked at Li Mingwu, completely unruffled, and spoke in an even tone:
“Since you’ve successfully advanced to the Solidifying Body stage, it appears that Bai Yi is probably in great peril.”
Li Mingwu looked at Lin Jing, then his lips slightly curled upwards:
“It seems you are not foolish, you figured out that I’ve advanced to the Solidifying Body stage.”
“Indeed…”
“Bai Yi’s Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit was seized by me, and naturally I wouldn’t let him live.”
“Speaking of which, I really owe him thanks.
The Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit suits me quite well.”
Having said that, Li Mingwu quickly extended his Divine Sense to meticulously probe Lin Jing.
Lin Jing’s current cultivation far surpassed Li Mingwu’s, so even though the latter probed actively, he couldn’t detect anything due to Lin Jing’s deliberate concealment.
After probing, Li Mingwu looked at Lin Jing with disdain, saying:
“You really can pretend…”
“Knowing I’ve advanced to the Solidifying Body stage yet still so calm, I would have thought you too had advanced to the Solidifying Body stage if I hadn’t seen your cultivation remain unchanged.”
“However…”
“No matter how strongly you feign composure, it is useless, for the gap between the Solidifying Body stage and the Divinity Transformation Stage is something you will never understand.”
It was quite normal for Li Mingwu to think this way.
The last time he saw Lin Jing in the Water Element Realm was just over fifty years ago.
ṅοѵǤօ.сο
Back then in the Water Element Realm, Lin Jing was only at the seventh level of the Divinity Transformation Stage.
Now, only a little over fifty years had passed, and Li Mingwu couldn’t believe that Lin Jing might have surpassed him in such a short time.
After finishing his thoughts, Li Mingwu looked coldly at Lin Jing and said:
“Actually, since the very beginning at the Five Elements Palace, I’ve been suspecting whether the uncontrolled burst of the Wooden Attribute Spiritual Power was your doing?”
“And have you been targeting me all along?”
“I couldn’t understand this at first, everything seemed accidental.
But since the last time in the Water Realm when you showed your true power and saved Bai Yi, I’ve been reflecting on past events and slowly piecing things together.”
“Now I think back, several of my plans failed, and it seems you were always involved.”
“Exploring the Five Elements Palace, the Wooden Attribute Spiritual Power I controlled suddenly exploded around me, exposing me and leading to Bai Yi and his companions attacking me, forcing me to flee prematurely.”
“At the trade fair in Bihai City, the Jade Soul Algae I wanted ended up in your hands.”
“Not to mention the Water Element Realm, your schemes against Bai Yi allowed him to escape, forcing me to remain in the Water Realm, missing the appearance of the Soul Tomb.”
“It delayed me by more than fifty years until the Soul Tomb reappeared, allowing me to come here.”
“To say that all these were coincidences would be too much of a coincidence.”
After finishing, Li Mingwu’s gaze became frosty, carrying the unmatched aura of a Solidifying Body cultivator, pressing down on Lin Jing:
“Now, do you still intend to argue?”
Confronted with Li Mingwu’s oppressive aura, Lin Jing remained unfazed.
Instead, he looked at Li Mingwu, his eyes calm, and slowly said:
“Do you know?”

chapters.title: Chapter 769
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 769: Chapter 340: The Resentment with Li Mingwu_2 Chapter 769: Chapter 340: The Resentment with Li Mingwu_2 “Actually, in terms of destiny, my connection with you is truly extraordinary,”
Lin Jing’s words caused Li Mingwu to pause, then he frowned and looked at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing ignored Li Mingwu and continued:
“The first time I learned of your name was on an uninhabited island.”
“On that island, there was a skeleton, and the skeleton belonged to ‘Ling Yin Real Person.'”
“It was in his will that I learned of your name, and also obtained the ‘Five Elements Fire Command.'”
“Ling Yin, it was actually him…”
After speaking, Li Mingwu looked at Lin Jing, a look of realization dawning in his eyes:
“So, from that time, you started paying attention to me.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes, and no…”
“At that time, the disparity in our cultivation was simply too vast; I could only inquire about your news indirectly.”
After speaking, Lin Jing continued:
“The second time I truly interacted with you was in the ‘Devouring Spirit Blood Realm.’
“You, along with ‘Ling Yi Real Person,’ set up a grand scheme, intending to refine a thousand Golden Cores to help you advance to the Solidifying Body Stage.”
“You actually entered the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm…”
Li Mingwu’s eyes narrowed slightly, a dangerous glint appearing in them.Yet Lin Jing seemed oblivious, nodding lightly.
“Yes!”
“If I hadn’t done everything in my power to summon the Heavenly Tribulation and break open the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, I’m afraid none of us would have escaped.”
“So…
Ɲονɡᴑ.сο
it was you…”
Upon hearing this, Li Mingwu’s face became gloomy, and the look he gave Lin Jing grew even more dangerous.
Lin Jing, however, continued to look at Li Mingwu calmly and said:
“That’s right, it was me.”
“If you hadn’t been injured by the Heavenly Tribulation back then, I wouldn’t have had so many chances to catch my breath.”
At this moment.
...
Li Mingwu’s gaze towards Lin Jing was fraught with evident murderous intent, yet he did not act rashly and instead spoke again, asking Lin Jing:
“So you’re saying, earlier in the Five Elements Cave Mansion, when the Five Elements Wood Hall was opened, guiding that explosive spiritual power to attack me was also your doing.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“That’s right.”
“I knew that once you entered the Wood Hall, you’d obtain the elixir medicine for soul spirit healing inside.
If you recovered, then I would be in danger.”
“So I deliberately guided that violent spiritual power to explode near you, to force you to reveal your true nature.”
…
…
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Mingwu couldn’t help but laugh in anger, his gaze toward Lin Jing filled with surging killing intent:
“Good!”
“Good!”
“Good…!”
“Hahaha…”
“It’s really wonderful.
“To think that after thousands of years of wandering, I’ve been played by you, a mere ant, more than once.”
“You really are something…”
Even as Li Mingwu’s rage became uncontrollable, Lin Jing remained utterly calm and continued to speak:
“There’s actually more…”
“The Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit of the Metal Realm was also taken by me.”
“I originally thought that without the Five Elements True Spirit, you wouldn’t be able to advance to the Solidifying Body Stage.”
“But unexpectedly, you already had plans and set your sights on Bai Yi.
In the end, I still couldn’t prevent you from advancing to the Solidifying Body Stage.”
“Sigh…!”
“It’s truly a pity.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Mingwu could no longer suppress his anger.
His rage transformed into endless murderous intent, and with the wild momentum of the Solidifying Body cultivation, it pressed down on Lin Jing.
And behind him, a shadow that was dozens of meters tall also appeared.
This silhouette was undoubtedly the Five Elements Spiritual Body that Li Mingwu had refined.
Upon its appearance, it did not hesitate at all, immediately raising a palm and bringing down an overwhelmingly mighty blow towards Lin Jing.
Even the Five Elements Spiritual Body was being utilized; it was clear that Li Mingwu had lost his sanity at this point, disregarding everything else, intent on obliterating Lin Jing right there and then.
Dao Integration cultivators wielding Five Elements Spiritual Bodies could manipulate the Spiritual Power around them for their own use.
And even their power could be stronger than that harnessed by Divine Arts.
However, all the Spiritual Energy in the Five Elements Territory was absorbed by Lin Jing.
Even when Li Mingwu attacked Lin Jing using his Five Elements Spiritual Body,
there was no Spiritual Power to call upon.
This Five Elements Spiritual Body, while seemingly formidable, was actually quite limited without Spiritual Power to harness, and it was even weaker than Divine Arts.
Li Mingwu had simply assumed that Lin Jing was still at the seventh level of Divinity Transformation, which led to his overconfidence in using the Five Elements Spiritual Body to launch an attack on Lin Jing.
Moreover, Lin Jing’s words had caused Li Mingwu to lose his rationality.
That’s why Li Mingwu didn’t hold back anything, wishing to kill Lin Jing right there and then.
However,
faced with Li Mingwu’s unrestrained attack, Lin Jing was in no hurry, just looking at Li Mingwu in front of him and then gently stretching out his palm, patting lightly.
This pat seemed light, but the terrifying force it carried was alarming.
After Lin Jing’s palm struck out, the palm imprint immediately left his hand, transforming into a huge palm imprint emanating a WÇ” CÇŽi radiance.
This palm imprint was not very large at first, but as it flew out, it grew larger and larger.
By the time it neared Li Mingwu, this massive palm imprint had grown to nearly a hundred zhang, surpassing the Five Elements Spiritual Body that Li Mingwu had condensed.
Li Mingwu, upon seeing this enormous palm imprint and feeling the terrifying aura emanating from it, was suddenly stunned.
And then,
Li Mingwu’s face filled with fear, and he couldn’t help but try to retreat.
However, Lin Jing’s palm was extremely fast.
There was no time for Li Mingwu to regret anything as the palm imprint had already descended.
“Boom!”
The gigantic WÇ” CÇŽi palm imprint fell, striking the Five Elements Spiritual Body that Li Mingwu had condensed.
Upon the originally ethereal Spiritual Body, countless cracks appeared immediately,
and it almost exploded on the spot.
After enduring this palm, Li Mingwu’s Spiritual Body shrank back into his body in an instant.
With his Five Elements Spiritual Body injured, Li Mingwu himself naturally suffered greatly; as his Spiritual Body retracted into his own body, Li Mingwu couldn’t hold on any longer,
and directly “puff,” he spat out a large mouthful of fresh blood.
The palm imprint Lin Jing struck with had diminished considerably and become much dimmer,
but despite its fading light, it did not dissipate.
Instead, it retained a formidable momentum and continued to move towards Li Mingwu’s body.
Having just been injured when his Five Elements Spiritual Body was harmed, Li Mingwu was already in a bad state.
And that huge palm imprint still had remaining force, coming at him again.
Li Mingwu, seeing this, immediately turned deathly pale.
Looking at Lin Jing, his eyes revealed an utterly disbelieving expression.
Lin Jing’s palm was too strong, something he simply couldn’t defend against.
He had no idea why Lin Jing could be so powerful.
However…
Now wasn’t the time for him to think further, as the palm imprint was about to strike again.
Li Mingwu quickly took out two Magical Treasures from his Storage Bag.
He deployed one of them immediately, placing it in front of him and activating it to form a Protective Shield, enveloping himself within it.
The other, he commanded to fly towards the palm imprint.
“Explode!”
With a shout from Li Mingwu, the Magical Treasure flying towards the palm imprint violently exploded.
Blocked by the self-destructing Magical Treasure, the palm imprint once again dimmed, almost reduced to a mere afterimage.
Yet, that residual palm imprint still struck Li Mingwu but was blocked by the Protective Shield he had activated.
Seeing the palm imprint finally held off, Li Mingwu dared to relax slightly.
Afterward, Li Mingwu raised his head to look towards Lin Jing, the corner of his eyes twitching uncontrollably, but he tried to appear calm as he said:
“Are you Lin Jing?”
“No, that’s impossible.”
“Lin Jing’s Cultivation could never reach such a level.”
“The power of that palm just now, only a Dao Integration late-stage cultivator, or even a Dao Integration cultivator, could unleash.”
“You can’t possibly be Lin Jing…”
“Who in the world are you?”
“Could it be that you are the Five Elements Ancestor?
Did you take over his body?”
Clearly, Lin Jing’s strength had taken Li Mingwu by surprise, giving him an unreal sensation.
That’s why he thought the person who was acting against him might be the Five Elements Ancestor.
Lin Jing, however, looked at Li Mingwu and spoke calmly:
“You’re wrong!”
“I indeed am Lin Jing.”
“Only, my Cultivation has improved a bit faster than yours, that’s all.”

chapters.title: Chapter 770
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 770: Chapter 341 End of the Road Chapter 770: Chapter 341 End of the Road After hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Mingwu was stunned for a moment before he suddenly realized what was going on and couldn’t help but look behind Lin Jing at the statue of the Five Elements Ancestor:
“I understand now…”
“It’s the inheritance, you’ve received the inheritance of the Five Elements Ancestor.”
“Only in this way could you have advanced so rapidly in cultivation in such a short period of time.”
Having said that, Li Mingwu stared intently at Lin Jing, hoping to find confirmation on his face.
However, Lin Jing merely hooked the corner of his mouth in a smile and did not refute.
Seeing Lin Jing’s tacit acknowledgment, Li Mingwu’s heart immediately sank.
He hadn’t expected that within the Five Elements Territory, there would be such amazing benefits.
Benefits that allowed Lin Jing, a seventh-layer Divinity Transformation cultivator, to rise to a level far beyond his own reach in just over fifty years.
At this moment, Li Mingwu was filled with regret.
If he had known this would happen, he would have braved the Soul Tomb at the first opportunity and arrived at this place before Lin Jingzhi, no matter what it took.
...
Even if he couldn’t receive the inheritance of the Five Elements Territory, he couldn’t let Lin Jing have it.
But now it was too late to say anything; Lin Jing had already obtained the inheritance of the Five Elements Territory, and his cultivation had soared drastically because of it.
In Li Mingwu’s eyes, Lin Jing’s cultivation might not have reached the Dao Integration Stage yet, but it was probably not far off.
With his own current level of cultivation, he was definitely no match for Lin Jing, and considering the grudges between the two of them, it was unlikely that Lin Jing would let him off easily.
Thinking of this, Li Mingwu’s brow furrowed deeply.
If he couldn’t think of a proper solution soon, then the Five Elements Territory would become his burial ground.
…
While Li Mingwu was racking his brains, Lin Jing was also observing him carefully.
Lin Jing knew that under these circumstances, Li Mingwu was surely not going to sit and await his fate; he would try by all means to escape from this place.
To do so, he must figure out a way to distract Lin Jing while selecting a route of escape.
And to escape the Five Elements Territory…
Lin Jing then glanced at the Teleportation Array in the valley.
That was the only way out.
The location of the Teleportation Array was not too far from Li Mingwu; with his speed, Li Mingwu could reach it in the blink of an eye.
Lin Jing had just finished his contemplation.
But Li Mingwu seemed to have prepared himself, as he first cleaned the bloodstain on the corner of his mouth and then, unusually calm, walked straight towards Lin Jing.
As Li Mingwu walked towards Lin Jing, he also removed the Space Ring from his hand.
Then, holding the Space Ring, Li Mingwu said to Lin Jing:
“Lin Jing!”
“I apologize for what happened before.”
“Inside this Space Ring are all the treasures I’ve collected over thousands of years.
It contains countless Magical Treasures, precious items, and even a Supreme Grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.”
“As an Alchemist, you must have heard of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
It is extremely rare, capable of increasing a cultivator’s lifespan, and exceedingly difficult to refine.”
“One Supreme Grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir can increase a cultivator’s lifespan by a thousand years.”
“You can rest assured that this Supreme Grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir is genuine.
Since you’ve seen Ling Yin’s remains, you can probably guess my lifespan.”
“The reason I’ve lived this long is because I took a Supreme Grade Lifespan Extension Pill.”
“As long as you’re willing to let me go, I will give you all the treasures I’ve collected, including that Supreme Grade Lifespan Extension Pill.”
Lin Jing’s gaze remained calm as he looked at Li Mingwu but did not respond.
“If you don’t believe me, I can give you the Space Ring first so that you can check the items inside.”
Having spoken…
Ɲοѵǥ0.сο
Li Mingwu promptly started working to remove the seals on the Space Ring; as he continuously formed hand seals, the barriers on the ring began to lift one by one.
With the seal completely lifted, Li Mingwu looked at Lin Jing and said:
“I have fully removed the seal on the Space Ring.
If you’re willing to let me go, everything inside is yours.”
“And after I leave, I will leave the Southern Outer Sea straight away, never to appear again, nor will I pose any threat to you or those around you.”
“I can swear on my Soul Spirit to this.”
After speaking, Li Mingwu frowned slightly as he looked at Lin Jing, waiting for his reaction.
Once Li Mingwu finished speaking, Lin Jing fell into a brief contemplation…
Knowing Li Mingwu as he did, Lin Jing understood Li Mingwu was a person who would not stop until he achieved his goals and such a person would not be willing to be manipulated by others.
Now that Li Mingwu was actively begging for mercy, it was undoubtedly a huge joke to Lin Jing.
However, having lived for thousands of years with complex schemes and myriad tricks, Lin Jing was certain that Li Mingwu must still have a card up his sleeve to save his life, and even with a much higher cultivation level, he could not afford to take it lightly.
After a brief contemplation, Lin Jing thought of a strategy that would turn the tables, prompting Li Mingwu to voluntarily reveal his ace in the hole.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing appeared calm as he looked at Li Mingwu, with eyes so piercing they seemed to see right through him.
A moment later, Lin Jing spoke directly:
“When I was accepting the inheritance of the Five Elements Ancestor, I acquired a method of applying the Soul Spirit.”
“This method allows the Soul Spirit to be implanted deep within a cultivator’s mind; any abnormal movement by the subject would be instantly detected by the practitioner.”
“Moreover, this method was created by the Five Elements Ancestor at the peak of his prowess; unless undone by the practitioner himself, no one else can break it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 771
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 771: Chapter 341: The End_2 Chapter 771: Chapter 341: The End_2 At this point, Lin Jing’s eyes flashed with a sharp gleam as he stared intently at Li Mingwu and spoke:
“To be honest, considering the grudges between us, no matter what you say, even if you swear on your Soul Spirit, I find it very difficult to trust you.”
“But…”
“As long as you agree to let me implant the Divine Sense Technique into your Sea of Consciousness, I’ll believe you.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Mingwu couldn’t help but lower his head, deep in thought.
It was clear he was hesitating.
However, Li Mingwu didn’t hesitate for too long before he raised his head to look at Lin Jing again.
“Fine…”
“As long as you spare my life, what harm is there in having the Divine Sense Technique implanted by you?”
Having said that, Li Mingwu threw the Space Ring, whose restrictions he had already removed, toward Lin Jing.
It seemed that he truly intended to use all the contents of the Space Ring to exchange for his life.
…
But just as…
...
The moment the Space Ring was thrown, Lin Jing unexpectedly made another move, with a huge palm print launching once again toward Li Mingwu.
Seeing Lin Jing striking at that moment, Li Mingwu was instantly filled with anger, hastily retreating backward at high speed while pointing at Lin Jing and furiously saying:
“You…”
However, before he could finish speaking, he saw the mocking look in Lin Jing’s eyes.
Realizing that his ruse had been seen through, Li Mingwu dropped all pretense.
Immediately after, Li Mingwu formed a hand seal with one hand, and the Space Ring that had been flying towards Lin Jing exploded in midair.
As the Space Ring burst apart, Li Mingwu’s hand produced a pitch-black, shining Exotic Stone, and his body was shrouded in a black, semi-transparent protective barrier.
At this moment, Li Mingwu’s lips curled into a smirk as he looked at the exploded Space Ring hanging in the air…
…
After the Space Ring exploded, a black tornado emerged from within it, and as soon as it appeared, it swept towards the massive palm print Lin Jing had struck.
In just a moment, the giant palm print Lin Jing had unleashed was completely engulfed by the black tornado and swept away.
This black tornado was capable of devouring Spiritual Power.
After swallowing Lin Jing’s palm print, the black tornado suddenly grew much larger.
And as it grew, the true form of this black tornado was revealed; it was actually made up of countless black beetles.
They were individually small, but extremely unified.
Countless black beetles congregated together to form this black tornado.
Seeing that these black beetles could consume his palm print, Lin Jing’s brow furrowed slightly.
Afterward.
Lin Jing once again concentrated two strands of Five-Colored Aurora, as thin as hair, and shot them towards two of the larger black beetles within the whirlwind.
The speed of the Five-Colored Aurora was rapid, and in just a moment, it neared the two black beetles.
But the two black beetles reacted quickly too, and as soon as the Five-Colored Aurora approached them, the beetles opened their jaws, as wide as half their bodies, and swallowed the strands of Five-Colored Aurora.
Just like that, the two strands of Five-Colored Aurora were directly consumed by the black beetles.
After swallowing the Five-Colored Aurora, the two black beetles paused for a moment and then their bodies began to grow wildly; in only a short amount of time, the two beetles, originally the size of mung beans, had increased several times in size, becoming as large as thumbs.
After the two beetles grew, Lin Jing could even see the ferocious red glow in their eyes.
Having devoured the two strands of Five-Colored Aurora, the two black beetles then fixed their attention on Lin Jing.
They opened their mouths, issuing a shrill scream, and instantly all the black beetles swarmed toward them.
Seeing this scene, Lin Jing’s brows knitted more tightly together.
Even the Five Elements Divine Art seemed to be ineffective against these black beetles; he truly didn’t know how to deal with them.
Even so, Lin Jing didn’t give up.
He then directly channeled the power of his Divine Sense, rushing towards the whirlwind.
However.
No sooner had Lin Jing’s Divine Sense made contact with the black beetles than it was repelled.
These black beetles, though appearing to be independent entities, were actually connected by a mysterious force.
This mysterious force protected the black beetles, making it impossible even for Divine Sense to penetrate.
Seeing that Divine Sense was useless, Lin Jing then turned his gaze to Li Mingwu who was behind the black beetles.
At that moment, Li Mingwu was hiding behind the black, semi-transparent shield with a cold smirk on his lips as he watched Lin Jing.
It seemed he was very confident in these black beetles.
The black beetles quickly completed their assembly.
The next moment, they rushed directly towards Lin Jing.
Knowing that spells were useless against them, Lin Jing no longer used magic but instead burst forth at high speed towards Li Mingwu.
Seeing Lin Jing suddenly appear, Li Mingwu immediately channeled Spiritual Power into the black Exotic Stone in his hand.
The next moment.
The black Exotic Stone emitted black light, and the protective shield around Li Mingwu grew even brighter.
ɴ0νǤᴑ.сο
Upon Lin Jing’s arrival, he threw a punch which landed on the black, semi-transparent protective barrier.
However.
After flashing a few times, the black shield managed to block Lin Jing’s full-powered punch.
Despite Lin Jing’s full-powered punch, the black shield showed no signs of change.
And then.
Li Mingwu spoke:
“These Demon Yin Devouring Spirit Beetles can only be used this once.
They are my last trump card.
I didn’t want to use them, but you forced me.”
As Li Mingwu spoke, Lin Jing was also not idle, trying several methods in succession but failing to break through the black protective barrier around Li Mingwu.

chapters.title: Chapter 772
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 772: Chapter 341: The End_3 Chapter 772: Chapter 341: The End_3 Seeing this, Li Mingwu couldn’t help but let out a cold laugh:
“Don’t bother wasting your energy.”
“Unless you exterminate those Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects, you won’t be able to break this protective shield.”
Just then, the black beetles surged forth like a tornado, coming again.
In the blink of an eye, they had already closed in on Lin Jing.
Lin Jing, seeing this, didn’t delay any further, but instead took a step forward, bursting with extreme speed, circled around the swarm of insects, and left the area.
Since Li Mingwu’s protective shield was related to those Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects, he would first eliminate the insects before dealing with Li Mingwu.
When Lin Jing left, he headed straight for the statue of the Five Elements Ancestor.
Li Mingwu, seeing this, also hurriedly controlled the Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects to follow.
Soon after.
...
Lin Jing flew directly into the palm of the statue.
And those Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects followed suit, flying into the palm of the Five Elements Ancestor statue after Lin Jing.
Li Mingwu saw this and followed as well, moving toward the direction of the statue.
However, perhaps because he was maintaining the protective shield, Li Mingwu’s speed was not very fast.
While Li Mingwu was still halfway through the valley, he discovered several cracks appearing on the black exotic stones in his hand.
At the same time, the black protective shield around him was also rapidly dimming.
Li Mingwu realized something was wrong and his face turned pale with alarm.
Problems with the black exotic stones in his hand meant that the Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects had encountered trouble.
The Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects were cultivated by a Demon Cultivator at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and dealing with these insects would normally require a Cultivation at least at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Li Mingwu had obtained these Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects by chance and had been carefully preserving them ever since as his trump card.
The supposed infallible Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects had unexpectedly encountered problems with Lin Jing.
Li Mingwu didn’t know how Lin Jing had managed to eliminate those insects, but he knew that with their death, his own demise was certain.
Thus.
Li Mingwu made a decisive decision and rushed towards the valley’s Teleportation Array.
Only…
Before he could get close to the Teleportation Array, he felt an extremely terrifying presence coming from behind him, along with a voice that reached him from midair behind him.
“Your trump card is exhausted, what follows is your end…”
This voice was Lin Jing’s.
It was only then that Li Mingwu noticed the black exotic stones in his hand had shattered into several pieces.
He hadn’t expected Lin Jing to resolve the situation with all the Demonic Yin Soul-Devouring Insects so quickly and to be in pursuit.
Li Mingwu was overwhelmed with fear, partly due to sensing Lin Jing’s terror and also because he felt so close to death at this moment.
Li Mingwu didn’t want to die…
Just as when he had betrayed Ling Yin before, Li Mingwu had betrayed many people in order to gain more resources for Cultivation.
Everything he had done was for the sake of survival.
Is there any fault in wanting to live?
No!
For Li Mingwu, using any means was justified.
Ɲ0νǤ0.ƈο
If he hadn’t used all the tricks at his disposal, how could he have survived until now?
How could he have advanced to the Solidifying Body Realm with a lifespan approaching three thousand years?
He would probably have died a thousand years ago if not for his striving.
Now.
Having just advanced to Solidifying Body and with at least two thousand years of lifespan left, naturally, Li Mingwu didn’t wish to die just yet.
Seeing that it was too late to flee, Li Mingwu turned around, intending to beg for mercy:
“Don’t kill…”
However, upon turning around, what he saw was a terrifying and overwhelmingly murderous palm print…

chapters.title: Chapter 773
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 773: Chapter 342: Incident at Li Yan Island Chapter 773: Chapter 342: Incident at Li Yan Island This palm was almost his full force.
One could imagine its power.
Li Mingwu had just begun to plead for mercy when Lin Jing’s palm had already come crashing down.
And then,
in the fearful gaze of Li Mingwu, his body slowly dissolved under this palm, eventually disappearing entirely.
Even Li Mingwu’s soul spirit couldn’t escape and was destroyed along with his body under this palm.
Thus,
With one palm, Li Mingwu was fallen.
After Li Mingwu’s death, Lin Jing stood in the void, looking down at the huge palm imprint he had just created.
...
At the same time, to prevent Li Mingwu from having other life-saving methods, Lin Jing urged his Divine Sense, scanning everything below.
Only a long time later, after confirming that there were no accidents and Li Mingwu had indeed perished, did Lin Jing withdraw his Divine Sense.
After withdrawing his Divine Sense, Lin Jing looked around, examining the entire Five Elements Territory, and then his gaze fell on the Teleportation Array below.
This time, he truly needed to leave.
Following that,
Lin Jing descended into the valley and then stepped into the Teleportation Array.Upon stepping into the Teleportation Array, there was no response.
And then,
Lin Jing placed the Five Elements Fire Command in front of the Formation Eye of the array, and the Teleportation Array, which had shown no reaction before, began to light up.
Soon, the light from the Teleportation Array grew stronger, soaring into the sky; the Five Elements Fire Command also popped out from its needle-like position, landing back in Lin Jing’s palm.
Lin Jing caught the Five Elements Fire Command, and the tearing force of teleportation also arrived at this moment.
Feeling the tearing force of teleportation, Lin Kai knew he was about to leave, and it was very likely that he would never return in this lifetime.
Afterward,
Lin Jing looked up at the massive statue of the Five Elements Ancestor in front of him, bowed deeply as a final salute.
The next moment, the power of teleportation activated.
Lin Jing was then carried away by this teleportation force, leaving the Five Elements Territory.
…
Ɲονɡο.сο
Yelin Island is a medium-sized island within the Thousand Islands Domain.
It ranks significantly among medium-sized islands, and Yelin Island is famously home to a Nascent Soul Cultivator, Lord Yelin.
It can be said that in the sea area around Yelin Island, it is highly revered.
Of course,
All these honors were before Li Yan Island became famous.
Ever since Li Yan Island and its Li Yan Marketplace started developing, the reputation of Li Yan Island gradually rose.
The prosperity of Li Yan Island quickly spread among many cultivators, and Yelin Island was no longer mentioned by others.
Lord Yelin was frustrated but helpless.
Only because the Island Master of Li Yan Island, Lin Jing, was also a Nascent Soul Cultivator, and it seemed that he even had some connection with Bai Yi, the master of one of the three great islands, Yue Tian Island.
Of course,
That was not the main point.
The most important thing was that at the last trading conference he attended, he saw with his own eyes that Lin Jing even had an inseparable relationship with the Yan Family of Spirit Rock Island.
And even the old ancestor of the Yan Family personally spoke up in his favor.
This treatment made Lord Yelin extremely envious.
You must understand, that was the Yan Family’s old ancestor, a person at the peak of Divinity Transformation.
No, actually,
It should be above Divinity Transformation.
It was said that the Yan Family’s old ancestor had returned from an adventure in ancient relics decades ago with a fortunate encounter.
He had even successfully advanced to a level above Divinity Transformation not long ago.
Being able to connect with such a person made Lord Yelin so envious that he almost turned red.
Although highly envious, this fortune had not fallen on him, and all Lord Yelin could do was helplessly sigh.
As for Lin Jing, he couldn’t afford to provoke him.
Even if he had complaints, he could only bury them in his heart.
Of course,
Even if truly jealous, Lord Yelin definitely wouldn’t show it; rather, he needed to act magnanimously to establish a good relationship with Lin Jing.
This day,
Lord Yelin was cultivating in his private Night Court Palace on Yelin Island; just as he had begun his cultivation, he suddenly felt a unique wave of spiritual power above the Night Court Palace.
This sudden emergence of spiritual power immediately alerted Lord Yelin, causing him to neglect his cultivation and quickly leave the secret chamber where he was practicing.
After Lord Yelin came out, he looked up to see a phantom Teleportation Array, which had appeared out of nowhere above the Night Court Palace.
Upon seeing this, Lord Yelin went directly into the air next to the Teleportation Array, intending to carefully observe it.
However, just then, the Teleportation Array burst into intense light.
Clearly, the Teleportation Array was activating because someone was about to teleport out.
Seeing this, Lord Yelin quickly stepped back,
While stepping back, he also summoned his Magical Treasure, facing the Teleportation Array, ready for battle.
Carefully guarding against the person about to emerge from the Teleportation Array.
The light from the Teleportation Array grew stronger, and slowly, a silhouette began to appear within it.
Soon, as intense light flashed from the Teleportation Array, and after the light subsided, the Teleportation Array disappeared as well.
After the Teleportation Array vanished, a person appeared where the Teleportation Array had been.
Upon the disappearance of the light from the Teleportation Array, Lord Yelin quickly looked at the newly emerged person.
Upon seeing him, Lord Yelin was immediately taken aback,
“Lin…
Lin Jing…
Lin Daoyou…”
The one who had emerged from the Teleportation Array was Lin Jing.
After emerging, Lin Jing heard someone calling him and quickly looked in the direction the voice had come from.
He saw a person in front of him, his face full of surprise, looking at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 774
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 774: Chapter 342: Incident at Li Yan Island_2 Chapter 774: Chapter 342: Incident at Li Yan Island_2 And the person, Lin Jing also knew.
It was none other than Night Approaching True Monarch.
Seeing Night Approaching True Monarch, Lin Jing was also somewhat surprised:
“Night Approaching…
is it you…”
After speaking, Lin Jing directly unfolded his Divine Sense and probed the surroundings.
The improvement in his cultivation had greatly expanded the range of his Divine Sense.
In just a short moment, Lin Jing had scanned the island, and after finishing, he clearly understood his location, which was Yelin Island.
ṅονǤο.сο
...
Yelin Island was not very far from Li Flame Island; with Lin Jing’s current speed, it would take less than half an hour to reach Li Flame Island.
Knowing that he was not far from Li Flame Island, Lin Jing’s mood greatly improved.
He wondered how Lin Jue, Li Qingqing, and Ye Yun were doing.
And what had become of Li Flame Island now?
The time he had been away was not short at all.
It had been more than fifty years.
By now, it was likely that both Lin Jue and Li Qingqing had transcended the Heavenly Tribulation and advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Thinking of this, Lin Jing couldn’t wait to return immediately.
However, just then, the arrival of a voice interrupted Lin Jing’s train of thought.
“Lin Daoyou…”
“How did you suddenly appear here?”
Lin Jing looked towards Night Approaching True Monarch in front; it was he who had just asked the question.
Even now, Night Approaching True Monarch was still at the Nascent Soul Stage, and Lin Jing could see through his level of cultivation at a glance.
At this time, Night Approaching True Monarch had only advanced a minor realm since the last time Lin Jing had seen him.
Clearly.
Night Approaching True Monarch was stuck here.
Without assistance from others or a great opportunity, it was likely that he would find it difficult to break through to the Divinity Transformation Stage in this lifetime.
Lin Jing had only met him a few times and wasn’t acquainted with him; they had almost had a conflict over an issue in the Fang Market.
Naturally, he wouldn’t think of helping him without reason.
To Lin Jing, Night Approaching True Monarch was merely a passerby, not someone who warranted too much attention.
Lin Jing looked towards Night Approaching True Monarch and stated directly:
“I did not intend to disturb, please do not take offense.”
Night Approaching True Monarch’s face broke into a smile as he hurriedly said:
“Lin Daoyou jests, I was merely curious, how could I possibly blame you?”
Lin Jing gave a slight nod:
“If that is so, then I will take my leave.”
After he spoke, Lin Jing took a step and in the next moment, he disappeared from sight.
Originally…
Night Approaching True Monarch had wanted to talk some more to Lin Jing, to foster a closer relationship.
However, in the next moment, Lin Jing vanished.
Seeing Lin Jing suddenly disappear, Night Approaching True Monarch’s pupils shrank sharply, and his complexion changed dramatically:
“He…
he is certainly not at Nascent Soul Stage…”
“What realm is he really in?”
“Could it be…”
“Above Divinity Transformation?”
…
After leaving Yelin Island, Lin Jing covered the distance to the nearby sea region of Li Flame Island in less than two quarters of an hour.
Before his arrival, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached there first.
The Divine Sense at the peak of the Solidifying Body Stage spread out, instantly enveloping the entire Li Flame Island.
The Li Yan Marketplace had expanded.
Compared to before, the Li Yan Marketplace was now even more bustling.
Under Lin Jing’s observation with his Divine Sense, the crowd in the marketplace ebbed and flowed, the scene extraordinarily lively, almost comparable to the Fang Market of Bihai City.
Adjacent to the Li Yan Marketplace was Li Yan City.
Li Yan City, too, had grown larger than before.
And Li Yan City had also changed its name to Li Yan Immortal City; that giant name plaque was hanging at the city gate.
It would be difficult for Lin Jing to overlook it.
Because of the limited area of Li Flame Island, as the city and marketplace grew in size, the Spirit Field area had to shrink in proportion.
Lin Jing noticed through the Formation that the Spirit Fields had reduced to about half their size from before, leaving only the central part where the high-grade Spirit Fields were located.
With Lin Jing’s current level of cultivation, none of the formations on the entire Li Flame Island could block his Divine Sense from probing.
After scanning the Spirit Fields, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense went directly into the forbidden area in the northern part of Li Flame Island and inside the small courtyard of several people.
He wanted to see what they were all doing.
But when Lin Jing’s Divine Sense entered the forbidden area of Li Flame Island, he found only two people inside.
One of them was Li Qingqing.
The other, Ye Yun.
At that moment, Ye Yun was lying on the bed in Li Qingqing’s courtyard, eyes tightly closed, his breath barely discernible.
And Li Qingqing was standing beside the bed, looking at Ye Yun on the bed, her brows slightly furrowed.
Seeing this scene, Lin Jing’s expression suddenly turned grim.
Afterward.
Lin Jing burst forth at top speed, flying towards Li Yan Island.
With his extreme speed, in the blink of an eye, Lin Jing had arrived above Li Yan Island.
Upon reaching Li Yan Island, Lin Jing didn’t delay and went straight to the formation, arriving at Li Qingqing’s small courtyard.
“Qingqing, what happened?”
Lin Jing suddenly blurted out, startling Li Qingqing, who had been watching Ye Yun, causing her to tremble.
Then, Li Qingqing turned her head to look behind her.
She saw Lin Jing approaching.
“Lin Jing, brother…”
Li Qingqing was momentarily bewildered, seemingly unable to believe Lin Jing’s sudden arrival.
Lin Jing nodded gently,
“Hmm, I’ve returned!”
After speaking, Lin Jing looked towards Ye Yun, who was lying on the bed, and asked again:
“What happened to Ye Yun?”
“And where is Lin Jue?
Why isn’t she here?”
Li Qingqing snapped back to reality, looked at Lin Jing, her eyes uncontrollably turning misty red:
“Lin Jing, brother, you’ve finally come back.”
Li Qingqing’s eyes were red as she looked up at Lin Jing, her semblance at that moment was like that of a wronged woman, appearing pitifully charming.
Seeing this, Lin Jing’s heart softened, and then, with a tender look in his eyes, he told Li Qingqing softly:
“You’ve really been wronged during this period.”
Li Qingqing, looking at Lin Jing, shook her head and then turned to Ye Yun on the bed and said:
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“Lin Jue was taken away by someone.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing’s heart flared with anger, and he couldn’t help frowning:
“Who exactly?”
“Dare to come to Li Yan Island and forcibly take Lin Jue away.”
Li Qingqing said:
“It was people from the Changyun Clan.”
“They found out about Lin Jue’s identity as the Lin Family heir and came specifically to take Lin Jue.”
“The Changyun Clan?”
Hearing about the Changyun Clan, Lin Jing’s brows furrowed slightly.
He had just saved Changyun Yuanlei in the Five Elements Ruins, and now his sister had been taken away by the Changyun Clan.
What exactly was the Changyun Clan up to?
Lin Jing then looked towards Ye Yun, who was lying on the bed:
“And what about Ye Yun?
Was it also the doing of the Changyun Clan?”
Li Qingqing nodded:
“Ye Yun wasn’t here when the Changyun Clan arrived.”
“He went to negotiate with the Changyun Clan members of his own accord after he returned and learned that Lin Jue had been taken, wanting to bring Lin Jue back.”
“However, in just half a day, Ye Yun was carried back by someone from the Changyun Clan, and when Ye Yun was brought back, he was already like this.”
“Up to now, Ye Yun has been in a sleeping state.”
Lin Jing’s brows wrinkled slightly as he looked at Ye Yun lying on the bed.
He was aware of the affection between Ye Yun and Lin Jue.
If anything happened to Lin Jue, Ye Yun would definitely do whatever it takes to ensure her safety.
And now, given such circumstances, it was clear that the other party’s cultivation was definitely not low.
Afterward, Lin Jing asked Li Qingqing:
“Do you know the cultivations of the people from the Changyun Clan who came here?”
Li Qingqing nodded and said:
“They mentioned it…”
“The leader of the Changyun Clan people, he is of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and there were two others with him, both of them Dao Integration Stage cultivators.”
“Transcendance Tribulation Stage…”
Lin Jing was somewhat surprised.
A Bandit Cultivator of the Tribulation Stage had come here specifically to take Lin Jue away.
This showed that Lin Jue was more than ordinarily important to the Changyun Clan.
Thinking this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but worry for Lin Jue.
However, with Lin Jue already taken away, even with his concern, he was too far to quench the nearby fire.
Now he had to first check Ye Yun’s condition instead.
Afterward.
Lin Jing stepped forward, came to the side of the bed, and then stretched out his hand to Ye Yun’s wrist.
Next, Lin Jing concentrated his spiritual power, probing directly into Ye Yun’s body.
Soon.
At Ye Yun’s Dantian, Lin Jing found a huge mass of spiritual power that did not belong to Ye Yun.
This spiritual power was entrenched in Ye Yun’s Dantian and was not causing any harm to his body.
On the contrary, it seemed like the mass of spiritual power was continuously nourishing Ye Yun’s body.
After a brief examination, Lin Jing knew that it wasn’t harmful to Ye Yun, but it wasn’t the reason that had caused Ye Yun to fall asleep either.
There must be something else on Ye Yun.
If there were no surprises, the main cause of Ye Yun’s sleeping state should lie within his sea of consciousness…

chapters.title: Chapter 775
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 775: Chapter 343 The Purpose of the Changyun Clan Chapter 775: Chapter 343 The Purpose of the Changyun Clan Afterward, Lin Jing withdrew his Spiritual Power and propelled his Divine Sense toward Ye Yun’s sea of consciousness.
Before making contact with Ye Yun’s sea of consciousness, Lin Jing discovered that around it was a sphere of Divine Sense, enveloping it.
This Divine Sense was incredibly strong, yet it had not intruded into Ye Yun’s sea of consciousness, only surrounding it.
It seemed that the members of the Changyun Clan had done this intentionally, causing him to fall into a deep sleep.
The one who deployed this tactic had a level of cultivation much higher than Lin Jing’s, something he could sense just from the aura of their Divine Sense.
However, it appeared that they didn’t intend to harm Ye Yun nor had they thoughts of taking his life.
Therefore, this Divine Sense was, relatively speaking, easier for Lin Jing to break through.
...
After that,
Lin Jing activated his Divine Sense, slowly approaching the sphere of Divine Sense and began to gradually disperse it.
Under the gradual dispersal from Lin Jing, the Divine Sense offered no resistance and was steadily dissipated.
Before long, Ye Yun’s Divine Sense gradually awoke and began to stir.
In about half an hour, Lin Jing had completely dispersed the sphere of Divine Sense, clearing it away entirely.
After Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense, Ye Yun immediately woke up.
The awaken Ye Yun rolled off the bed, stepped down, and “thump” knelt before Lin Jing.
“I’m sorry, Master!”
“I failed to protect Lin Jue and let him be taken away by the people from the Changyun Clan.”
Looking at Ye Yun, Lin Jing sighed helplessly and then reached out to lift Ye Yun:
“Get up, this isn’t your fault.”
After saying so, Lin Jing surveyed Ye Yun and then asked:
“You’ve had contact with the people from the Changyun Clan; do you know why they took Lin Jue away?”
Ye Yun nodded, saying:
“I do!”
“They mentioned that, like the Lin Family from ten thousand years ago, the Changyun Clan seems to have encountered an inexplicable curse.”
“Especially in recent centuries, members of the Changyun Clan have often met with various accidents.”
“The lucky ones might only get injured.”
“The severe cases either disappear mysteriously or die outright.”
“They took Lin Jue away in hopes of finding a method to break the curse from the descendants of the Lin Family.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing frowned deeply:
“The fact that Lin Jue is a descendant of the Lin Family should only be known to a few of us; how did they find out?”
Ye Yun hastily spoke:
“It was Lin Jue’s grandfather, he once let slip this information, though at the time not many believed it, yet they still managed to find out.”
After finishing, Ye Yun added:
“They previously also investigated you, Master, because of my relationship with Lin Jue, they suspected you had some connection with the Lin Family, but Lin Jue managed to deflect their suspicions.”
Apart from Lin Jue’s concealed gender, Lin Jing had made no real effort to hide his relationship with her.
To Lin Jue, Lin Jing was genuinely caring, treating her as if she were his own sister.
As for the exposure of his identity, Lin Jing had long considered it and prepared for problems that might arise if it became known.
After all, several well-acquainted people already knew of his identity as a Lin Family descendant.
It was actually Lin Jue, with only a few around her knowing of her lineage.
Lin Jing had thought that his identity would be exposed first.
Yet unexpectedly, it turned out Lin Jue’s side was revealed first.
Lin Jing looked at Ye Yun, then continued speaking:
“When I was examining your body just now, I found that they apparently didn’t intend to hurt you, and they showed mercy.”
“What’s the story there?”
Having finished, Ye Yun, with a look of shame, could not help but lower his head:
“I’m sorry, Master…”
“I was too rash.”
“After hearing that Lin Jue was taken, I lost all reason and went after them, wanting to bring Lin Jue back.”
“I didn’t consider the gap between us and the consequences that might follow from such actions.”
Lin Jing looked at Ye Yun, and spoke softly:
“Your feelings for Lin Jue…
I understand!”
“Nevertheless, you indeed acted impulsively.”
“With their level of cultivation, they could have killed you with a flick of their fingers, and it’s fortunate they didn’t strike you down.”
“From now on, whenever you face anything, you must think it through and decide after careful consideration.”
Ye Yun nodded:
“Yes, Master.”
“I will remember.”
After speaking, Ye Yun continued:
“When I found them, Lin Jue hadn’t been harmed.”
“Also, I heard that they took Lin Jue with the intention of having him become a son-in-law.”
“What?”
“Having Lin Jue as a son-in-law?”
On hearing Ye Yun’s narration, Lin Jing was immediately astonished.
Ye Yun nodded and said:
“That’s right.”
“Lin Jue himself told me this.”
“They must not know Lin Jue is a woman, otherwise, they wouldn’t have done this.”
“For now, Lin Jue may be safe.”
“But I worry that her identity as a woman may be exposed because of this.”
“Indeed, that’s a possibility.” Lin Jing nodded in agreement.
ɴονǤօ.ƈο
After saying this, Lin Jing suddenly recalled something and quickly looked up to ask Li Qingqing:
“By the way…”
“How long has it been since they left?”
“Three months.”
“Ye Yun was returned by them three months ago as well,” Li Qingqing replied.
Lin Jing nodded and then pondered for a moment.
After a short while, Lin Jing said to Li Qingqing and Ye Yun:
“I will need to leave in a couple of days to visit the Inner Sea.”
“Even though Lin Jue seems to be out of danger for now, given the current state of the Changyun Clan, there is no guarantee that there won’t be problems.”

chapters.title: Chapter 776
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 776: Chapter 343 The Purpose of the Changyun Clan_2 Chapter 776: Chapter 343 The Purpose of the Changyun Clan_2 “And in the Inner Sea, there are enemies of the Lin Family.
If they learn that Lin Jue is in the Inner Sea, it’s hard to guarantee that they won’t harbor some ill intentions.”
“It’s not safe for Lin Jue to go to the Inner Sea.”
“In the next few days, I plan to make a trip to the Inner Sea to see if I can bring Lin Jue back.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, Ye Yun quickly raised his head, his eyes flickering with light, and spoke to Lin Jing:
“Master, I will go too…
”
However.
Lin Jing looked at Ye Yun, shook his head, and said:
“No…”
“The Inner Sea is dangerous, and your cultivation is too low.”
“Moreover, this trip to the Inner Sea might well lead to encounters with old enemies of the Lin Familyâ€”even my own identity could easily be exposed.”
“I cannot take you with me this time.”
“I understand, Master!” Ye Yun replied, his eyes immediately dimming.
Although he knew Lin Jing said this for his sake, Ye Yun did not persist and simply nodded, albeit despondently.
…
Lin Jue was already on his way to the Changyun Clan, and it was hardly possible for Lin Jing to catch up now.
...
Moreover, even if Lin Jing could catch up, could he possibly snatch someone from the hands of a Tribulation Cultivator?
Therefore.
This matter had to be approached slowly.
Fortunately, having learned that Lin Jue was likely in no immediate danger, Lin Jing could be at ease.
Having just emerged from the Five Elements Ruins after decades, Lin Jing had lost touch with the outside world and was cut off from information.
His first task was to gather some information to see what had happened to the Changyun Clan and then decide what to do next.
The Seven Seas Hall was undoubtedly the best choice to quickly obtain this information.
The information regarding the Changyun Clan could definitely be purchased there.
…
Purchasing information from the Seven Seas Hall didn’t even require Lin Jing’s presence; he could just arrange for it to be handled by Yue Qiniang and the others.
After planning everything, Lin Jing looked towards Li Qingqing and Ye Yun.
Decades had passed, and Li Qingqing looked the same as before, her beauty unchanged and still captivating.
But her cultivation had changed significantly.
Li Qingqing was now a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
Of course, there was also Ye Yun.
Decades had passed, and Ye Yun had even cultivated to the sixth level of the Nascent Soul Stage, not far from the late phase of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Now that all the masters of the three major islands had perished.
Even without Lin Jing, with their cultivation levels, they could already walk sideways across the Thousand Islands Domain.
As Lin Jing looked at them, both of them also looked back at Lin Jing, especially Li Qingqing.
Her gaze, though reserved, clearly mixed with deep feelings.
Even Ye Yun, who was nearby, could see it.
“Ahem…
”
Being stared at continuously by Li Qingqing made Lin Jing quite uncomfortable, and he quickly coughed to cover his embarrassment.
“How have you been during this time?”
“I see both of your cultivations have improved quite a bit.”
Li Qingqing sighed lightly, then spoke:
“We’ve been quite well; Li Yan Island has also developed well during this time.”
“Lin Jing, how about you?”
“You’ve been gone so long, only to return now; did you encounter any dangers?”
Lin Jing smiled and then directly replied:
“This trip went quite smoothly.
I didn’t encounter any dangers, but I did gain some fortuitous encounters, and my cultivation has increased significantly.”
Having said this, Lin Jing suddenly shifted the conversation, asking the two:
“By the way…”
“How is your brother doing?”
“And Qiniang, I haven’t seen her since I came back.”
Li Qingqing said:
“My brother is now at the late stages of the Nascent Soul and is currently preparing to try advancing to Divinity Transformation, competing with others for Wan Mo Island.”
“Qiniang is representing me at Yuxing Island, negotiating matters concerning Yue Tian Island.”
“Yue Tian Island’s matters?” Lin Jing couldn’t help but be puzzled.
Li Qingqing then explained:
“Right…”
“Not long after you left last time, within a few years, the life token left by Bai Yi, the Master of Yue Tian Island, shattered.”
“Upon the death of the Island Master of Yue Tian Island, his subordinates began to fight among themselves, each wanting to take sole control of Yue Tian Island,”
“This time, a Nascent Soul Island Master from a medium-sized island near Yuxing Island also wanted to get involved, so he reached out to Zhang Jian and several other Nascent Soul Cultivators in the nearby waters, looking to form an alliance with us to occupy Yue Tian Island together.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing roughly understood what was going on and asked,
“What about True Dragon Island?”
“Why has no one taken over True Dragon Island?”
“True Dragon Island?”
“Could it be that Dragon Daoist has also met with trouble?”
Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing with some astonishment.
Lin Jing nodded:
“The Island Master of True Dragon Island has been killed by me.”
“He probably didn’t leave behind a life token, so no one knows he’s dead.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, both Li Qingqing and Ye Yun were shocked.
To be able to slay Dragon Daoist of the later stages of Divinity Transformation, Lin Jing’s cultivation must surely surpass that of Dragon Daoist.
“Master!”
“If you could slay Dragon Daoist, does that mean your cultivation has broken through Divinity Transformation to the Solidifying Body Realm?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes, my cultivation is now at the Solidifying Body Stage.”
Hearing Lin Jing admit to his cultivation, Ye Yun was instantly taken aback.
ƝοѵǤο.сο
Having been close to Lin Jing all along, Ye Yun deeply felt the terrifying speed of Lin Jing’s cultivation progression.
In just a short amount of time, Lin Jing had broken through from the Golden Core Stage to the now Solidifying Body Stage.
Ye Yun thought that not even a top-tier Spiritual Root Cultivator, touted as a supreme genius, could have advanced more swiftly than his own master.
Lin Jing’s rapid progression naturally filled Ye Yun with immense joy.
However, Li Qingqing, amidst her shock, felt somewhat disheartened.
Li Qingqing’s dejection did not escape Lin Jing’s notice, and he knew why she felt this way.
The higher his cultivation, the greater the gap between him and Li Qingqing, and the widening gap was not a favorable development for Li Qingqing.
Nonetheless, Lin Jing did not comfort Li Qingqing.
Instead, he straightforwardly said to Li Qingqing:
“Qingqing…”
“What do you think about us taking over the three major islands?”
“Ah?”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Qingqing was initially stunned and paused for a moment.
Once she came to her senses, Li Qingqing looked at Lin Jing puzzled and asked:
“Are you serious?”
Lin Jing nodded, then replied,
“Now that the Island Masters of the three major islands are all dead, they have become masterless territories, and if we want to continue growing, we need larger islands with more resources.”
“Now is the best opportunity.”
“With the three Island Masters dead, there are scarcely any cultivators in the Thousand Islands Domain who have reached the stage of Divinity Transformation.”
“Since I have decided, I will certainly make preparations in advance.”
“Before leaving, I will cleanse the entire Thousand Islands Domain, and ask those threatening Divinity Transformation Cultivators to leave.”
“Once the Thousand Islands Domain is cleared, I will directly help your brother take over Wan Mo Island, and we will take over Yue Tian Island.”
“As for the remaining True Dragon Island, I initially wanted to let Zhang Jian take over, but given Zhang Jian’s cultivation, even if he occupies True Dragon Island, there’s a risk something unforeseen might happen.”
“After all, I cannot always be here in the Thousand Islands Domain.”
“For True Dragon Island, I want to contact the Yan Family from Spirit Rock Island and give True Dragon Island to them.”
“As I am in good standing with the Yan Family, giving them True Dragon Island, with the Yan Family elder stationed there, will ensure he looks out for you.”
“This way, even if I am not around, no one would dare make a move against you.”
After finishing, Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing and asked,
“Qingqing, what do you think?”
After pondering for a moment, Li Qingqing nodded and said,
“That would indeed be feasible.
I heard that the Yan Family elder has also advanced to the Solidifying Body Stage.
With him in charge, absolutely no one would dare to casually provoke the Yan Family elder.”
Looking at Li Qingqing seriously, Lin Jing stated:
“Qingqing!”
“Once everything here is settled, I will be leaving.”
“By then, all the affairs will be entirely in your hands.”
“Don’t worry, I won’t make you wait too long.”
“Once I resolve the matters in the Inner Sea, I will come back…”

chapters.title: Chapter 777
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 777: Chapter 344: First Entry into the Inner Sea Chapter 777: Chapter 344: First Entry into the Inner Sea The principal sphere of influence of the Seven Seas Hall was indeed within the demon-ridden Inner Sea.
Within the Inner Sea, the Seven Seas Hall had established a total of seven colossal sea cities.
They are Linghai, Zhenhai, Tianhai, Ninghai, Yuhai, Minghai, and Jihai.
These seven sea cities were each far apart from one another, scattered throughout the Inner Sea.
Moreover…
They were all constructed from entire islands that were transformed, each one immensely large, the smallest among them comparable in size to the three largest islands of the Thousand Islands Domain.
The seven sea cities were not only sizable but also extremely robust.
...
The Seven Seas Hall specifically dispatched top Formation masters to establish powerful barriers around them.
With these formations, they could not only withstand attacks from various Demonic Beasts within the sea, but even in face of assaults from other forces, these colossal sea cities remained unscathed.
In addition to their impressive defense, these sea cities were further interconnected by Teleportation Arrays.
Under normal circumstances, these Teleportation Arrays were used for quick travel.
Anyone could use them, provided they paid with Spirit Stones.
Should an unwary force ever attempt to besiege a sea city, the city’s Defensive Array would activate immediately, simultaneously sealing off the entire city.
At that time, the Teleportation Array would be used for marshaling troops.
The Seven Seas Hall could summon aid from other sea cities through the array to repel external enemies.
Unless all seven sea cities were attacked simultaneously, those attempting the assault would have to face the full might of all the stalwarts of the Seven Seas Hall.
Of course.
All these were settings made during the construction of the seven sea cities; at that time, the Seven Seas Hall was not as strong as it is now, hence such measures were necessary to guard against external threats.
However, today…
As one of the four top forces within the demon-ridden Inner Sea, the Seven Seas Hall now possesses extraordinary power, and naturally, no force would be foolish enough to oppose the Seven Seas Hall or attack these cities.
…
At this moment.
On the Teleportation Array plaza in Ninghai City, the central Teleportation Array lit up with dazzling light.
From the looks of it, some cultivators were arriving in Ninghai City from another sea city via the Teleportation Array.
The light of the Teleportation Array did not last long, merely a few moments before gradually fading away.
And as the light faded, several cultivators emerged within the Teleportation Array, all of whom had just traveled from other sea cities.
Among these individuals who arrived via the Teleportation Array was Lin Jing.
As the light from the Teleportation Array dissipated, the group walked out of the array and dispersed.
After scanning his surroundings, Lin Jing too left the Teleportation Array.
Ninghai City was divided into the Inner City and the Outer City.
The plaza where the Teleportation Array was located belonged to the Inner City.
Leaving the plaza, Lin Jing headed along the streets of Ninghai toward the city center.
The streets of Ninghai City were even more bustling than those of Bihai City in the Southern Outer Sea.
Despite its massive size, Ninghai City was well-organized, with not a trace of disorder evident.
Seeing Ninghai City, Lin Jing couldn’t help but recall the chaos he had witnessed at Yue Tian Island half a year earlier…
It had been six months since Lin Jing left the Thousand Islands Domain.
Half a year earlier, after deciding to take over the three largest islands, Lin Jing took immediate action.
First,
Lin Jing had contacted Li Tangyu and the Yan Family patriarch ahead of time, and after discussions with them, they had all made careful plans.
Then, Lin Jing personally acted, cleansing all the cultivators within the three islands who harbored ulterior motives.
Particularly, the loyal followers of the three former Island Masters, Bai Yi and others, and some concealed Nascent Soul cultivators, were Lin Jing’s main focus.
With Lin Jing’s cultivation, he could easily sweep across the three islands.
It took him less than two days to complete these measures.
While Lin Jing was cleansing the three islands, aside from those with ulterior motives, some came forward to offer their allegiance upon knowing Lin Jing’s power.
The lowest cultivation among these people was in the late stages of Nascent Soul, and there were even two at the early stages of Divinity Transformation who wished to align with Lin Jing.
