They approached Lin Jing purely because of his strength, looking down on the other inhabitants of Li Yan Island.
ƝοѵǤο.сᴑ
After all was done, Lin Jing planned to leave for the Inner Sea.
Accepting these people would not only be hard to manage, but their presence could potentially threaten Li Qingqing and the others.
Therefore,
Lin Jing did not accept a single one of them.
After cleansing the three islands, the subsequent matters did not require Lin Jing’s direct involvement.
Yan Ming was stationed at True Dragon Island by the Yan Family patriarch, also tasked with overseeing the safety of the three islands to prevent disturbances.
Meanwhile, others began to slowly transfer some assets and personnel, starting to settle in Yue Tian Island.
As for Wan Mo Island, since it was inhabited by demon cultivators, they left its management to Li Tan alone.
Finally, Lin Jing gathered with several people.
After meeting, Lin Jing departed directly.
From making the initial decision to finalizing discussions and clearing the three islands, it only took three days.
Finally,
Lin Jing did some preparation, looked into some basic information about the Inner Sea and the Changyun Clan, and left just five days later.
Concerned about Lin Jue’s situation, Lin Jing could not afford to delay long, so after finishing everything, he left.
Leaving the Thousand Islands Domain, Lin Jing headed northward, from the Southern Outer Sea continuously onward to the Inner Sea.
In total, it took him half year.

chapters.title: Chapter 778
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 778: Chapter 344: First Entry into the Inner Sea_2 Chapter 778: Chapter 344: First Entry into the Inner Sea_2 After half a year, Lin Jing finally reached Yuhai City, one of the seven cities of Seven Seas Hall.
Then from Yuhai City, he took the Teleportation Array to get to Ninghai City.
Ninghai City.
In the southern part of the Inner Sea, not far from the Changyun Archipelago.
And the Changyun Archipelago is precisely where the Changyun Clan resides.
After arriving in Ninghai City, there was still a distance to the Changyun Archipelago, and Lin Jing’s next step was to head to the island closest to the Changyun Archipelago, Yue Yun Island.
Only after reaching Yue Yun Island would he truly be close to the Changyun Clan.
...
…
Although Ninghai City was bustling, Lin Jing was not going to stay long.
ɴονǤօ.с0
Here, Lin Jing still needed to gather some information.
After gathering the information, Lin Jing would leave.
Ninghai City was truly vast, and it took Lin Jing over an hour just to walk from the square where the Teleportation Array was located to the center of Ninghai City.
There was no choice; in these seven large sea cities, especially inside the Inner City, ordinary cultivators were not allowed to fly, and as it was Lin Jing’s first visit, naturally, his pace was much slower.
Upon reaching the center of Ninghai City, Lin Jing looked up and saw the tallest building.
Seven Seas Hall.
Among these seven sea cities, the most magnificent and impressive building naturally belonged to Seven Seas Hall.
This street, apart from Seven Seas Hall, also has various guilds and other powers that have set up shops.
For instance, the largest force in the Inner Sea, the Shocking Seas Alliance’s Shocking Seas Guild, and the Changyun Clan’s Changyun Pill Pavilion, both have a presence in these seven sea cities.
Of course.
Seven Seas Hall naturally welcomed various forces to develop in the seven sea cities.
With the presence of various powers, the development of Qihai City was greatly aided.
This was undoubtedly a win-win situation for both parties, and Seven Seas Hall welcomed it warmly.
It didn’t take long for Lin Jing to arrive at Seven Seas Hall.
Just like the Seven Seas Hall in Bihai City, the Seven Seas Hall in Ninghai City was also divided into two parts.
One part served as the main body of Seven Seas Hall, the Seven Seas Guild, selling various cultivation resources needed.
The other part, however, was the fundamental reason for Seven Seas Hall’s development into a top force, which was the Qi Hall belonging to Seven Seas Hall.
Lin Jing had come to visit Qi Hall, naturally.
After all, if he wanted to gather some information about the Changyun Clan, Qi Hall was undoubtedly the best place to go.
The Seven Seas Hall in Ninghai City was several notches higher than the one in Bihai City.
However, there were also quite a few cultivators inside.
After entering Qi Hall, guided by an attendant, Lin Jing came to a room on the fifth floor.
This place was used by Qi Hall for the buying and selling of information.
The information here, without mentioning those highly confidential pieces, included various news about different forces as well as some recent events.
All could be bought here.
When Lin Jing entered the room, he saw an old man sitting behind the counter.
Upon seeing Lin Jing’s arrival, the old man immediately stood up and greeted him with a smile:
“Esteemed Daoist, have you come to buy information or to sell?”
Lin Jing walked up to the counter and spoke directly:
“I would like to buy some information about the Changyun Clan.”
“The Changyun Clan…”
“That’s easy to say.”
“Our information is categorized by different levels, with correspondingly different details provided, and of course, different prices.”
“It’s just that I wonder which aspect of the Changyun Clan’s information you would like to buy?”
Lin Jing spoke:
“I heard that the Changyun Clan has recently accepted a son-in-law, and I want the detailed information on that matter.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, the old man immediately understood.
After that.
The old man pondered for a moment before speaking again and asking Lin Jing:
“You want the most detailed kind, right?”
“Let me be upfront, the more detailed the information, the more expensive it will be.”
“And this information has been collected from various channels and verified events that have occurred, after verification.”
“Also, this information will not involve any true secrets of the Changyun Clan.
If, after reading the information, you find any discrepancies, we will not return the Spirit Stones that have been received.”
“I hope you understand this.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Of course.”
“In that case, I will get the part of the information concerning the Changyun Clan’s recruitment of a son-in-law for you.
Please wait a moment, Daoist.”
After speaking, the old man turned and walked towards the back room of the place.
Leaving Lin Jing to wait there.
As for why it’s essential to purchase information at Seven Seas Hall, the reason is actually quite straightforward.
Lin Jing was alone, and investigating on his own clearly wasn’t suitable.
Personal investigations might yield information of uncertain detail and reliability; whether it could be useful or not was another question.
Furthermore…
The location wasn’t very far from the Changyun Clan, and the clan was experiencing troubled times.
Carelessly probing for information about the Changyun Clan could potentially alert them.
Thus, even if one needed to gather information, it had to be done through other channels, not recklessly on one’s own.
Then there was the issue of time.
Now that he had reached the Inner Sea, he wasn’t far from the Chang Yun Archipelago.
Rather than waste time investigating himself, it was more convenient and faster to spend some Spirit Stones and directly purchase the information.
Moreover, the information obtained from Qi Hall was undeniably the most accurate.
The Elder’s words were just a precautionary reminder in advance.
Shortly.
The Elder walked out of the room.
In his hand, he held a wooden box.
When he returned, the Elder placed the wooden box on the counter in front of Lin Jing.
“The information you asked for is all inside here.”
“This information has been collected and compiled through various channels into the most detailed sort, although it doesn’t involve any secrets of the Changyun Clan or other powers.”
“As for the fee, it’s quite standardâ€”just one thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones.”
One thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones weren’t cheap.
But this information concerned the Changyun Clan, one of the four top powers in the Inner Sea.
Therefore, although it didn’t touch upon the secrets of the Changyun Clan, the information wasn’t cheap either.
Lin Jing naturally understood this.
Before leaving, Lin Jing had over five hundred thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones, but because he needed to rebuild Yue Tian Island and spent a lot, he left a portion for Li Qingqing and had two hundred thousand left.
Therefore,
these thousand Spirit Stones didn’t mean much to Lin Jing.
After that,
without a word, Lin Jing took one thousand Superior Grade Spirit Stones from his Space Ring and handed them over.
The Elder took the Spirit Stones and then handed the wooden box to Lin Jing.
“Fellow Daoist, it’s been a pleasure doing business.”
After saying this, the Elder’s tone shifted:
“Right…”
“Lastly, I must remind you that once you’ve bought this information, you can only peruse it once.”
“After perusal, the Jade Slip inside will self-destruct.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“I am already aware of this, thank you for the reminder, Fellow Daoist.”
After speaking, Lin Jing took the wooden box and then said to the Elder:
“Farewell!”
With that, Lin Jing left the place.
Although he had purchased the information, Lin Jing wasn’t in a rush to check it immediately.
Now that he had the information, what Lin Jing needed to do was to leave Ninghai City first.
After leaving Ninghai City, he planned to review it.
Then.
Lin Jing didn’t delay and walked directly towards the outskirts of Ninghai.
Soon, Lin Jing left the Inner City.
Once he reached the Outer City, the management was relatively less strict compared to the Inner City.
Lin Jing accelerated his pace, quickly making his way out of Ninghai.
About four hours later, Lin Jing appeared in a sea area outside Ninghai.
At this time, Lin Jing was walking through the void, moving forward slowly.
His speed was not fast as he advanced while also looking down at the sea below.
Lin Jing seemed preoccupied, as if something was on his mind.
Shortly after, time passed for a while.
However, Lin Jing suddenly came to a stop:
“The time should be almost up, it’s about to come…”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, a pleasing voice transmitted from within Lin Jing’s sea of consciousness:
“Ding!”
“System notification: System upgrade completed, System Space reopened, new features added, host may enter the System Space to check.”

chapters.title: Chapter 779
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 779: Chapter 345 System Space Upgraded Again Chapter 779: Chapter 345 System Space Upgraded Again System Space, a few days ago, Lin Jing had initiated an upgrade.
As of today, the upgrade was complete.
The reason why Lin Jing was so eager just now was because he was waiting for the successful upgrade of the System Space.
Once the System Space had finished upgrading, Lin Jing didn’t hesitate to summon the System and then he said:
“Enter the System Space!”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the next moment, he disappeared from his original spot.
Inside the System Space, Lin Jing suddenly appeared.
Upon appearing, Lin Jing hurriedly sensed the Spiritual Power within the space.
Indeed, as he had anticipated.
...
The Spiritual Power within this space had once again increased significantly.
After sensing the changes in the System Space, Lin Jing then opened the System panel to start his inspection:
System Space (Level 8)
Remaining Time: 537 hours (Accumulatable: 800 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Range: 104 (80+24) muSpiritual Energy Density: 8
Flow of Time Speed: 8
Daily Entry Time: 12 hours (full)
Required for Upgrade: (750/2,000,000 Harvest Points)
Special Functions: Alert, Observation, Fixed-Point Teleportation, Time Accumulation…
New System Function: Basic Function Upgrade
The basic functions of the System Space have been fully upgraded, and the upgrades are as follows:
Alert Mode: Range has been fully increased, comparable to the host’s Divine Sense range.
(Except in life-threatening emergencies, the Alert Mode will not provide any additional prompts.)
Observation Mode: Range has been fully increased, comparable to the host’s Divine Sense range.
(Observation Mode can be used independently of the System Space, allowing perspective shifts at any time during its use.)
Fixed-Point Teleportation: Range has been fully increased, comparable to the host’s Divine Sense range.
(Fixed-Point Teleportation can be used independently of the System Space, and it can bypass any obstacles during its use.)
After the new function upgrades, whether using Observation Mode or Fixed-Point Teleportation, the base reference point will be the initial location of the host using the function, and it will not change with the host’s movements.
…
Seeing the new functions of the System Space, Lin Jing was overjoyed.
There’s no need to mention the Alert Mode; it is a passive mode.
It’s practical and indeed very useful.
In the Earth Realm before, it was the Alert Mode that played a role, allowing Lin Jing to make a timely decision and quickly escape from the Earth Realm.
Now that the range has increased, and it only activates during life-or-death situations, it can be said to fulfill its intended purpose.
There’s nothing more to say about that.
The key lies in the latter two functions, the Observation Mode and Fixed-Point Teleportation.
These two functions are the ones Lin Jing uses most often, and they are of great help to him.
Observation Mode can observe beyond any Defensive Array.
Not to mention the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
With the ability to bypass any obstacles, as long as the location is within the range of Fixed-Point Teleportation, Lin Jing can go anywhere.
The enhanced range of these two functions was a significant advantage for Lin Jing.
Moreover.
Now, these two functions can be used separately from the space, which means Lin Jing can use them outside the System Space.
He doesn’t have to enter the System Space every time he wants to observe anymore.
In the past.
Every time Lin Jing entered the System Space, he had to avoid crowds and find a secluded spot.
Now, being able to use these two functions without entering the System Space is unquestionably more convenient.
It just so happens that he needs to find Lin Jue now.
This enhancement of the two functions will be very useful.
…
After reviewing the new functions of the System Space, Lin Jing didn’t rush to experiment.
Instead, he directly took out the message he had exchanged for from the Qi Hall from within his Space Ring.
After taking out the wooden box containing the message, Lin Jing opened it directly.
Inside the box was a white Jade Slip.
Then, Lin Jing picked up the Jade Slip and extended his Divine Sense to check the message within…
“The Changyun Clan brought back a man suspected to be a descendant of the Lin Family from the Southern Outer Sea, planning to take him as a son-in-law by marriage into the family, and have him become Dao Companion with Changyun Yuanshuang…”
…
…
Just by seeing this, Lin Jing was shocked.
Changyun Yuanshuang, wasn’t that Changyun Yuanlei’s sister?
Moreover.
Lin Jing had heard from Changyun Yuanlei that his sister and Lu Youjiu were childhood sweethearts, and even Changyun Yuanlei referred to Lu Youjiu as his brother-in-law.
What was going on now?
Lin Jing had originally thought that the Changyun Clan intended to match Lin Jue with another younger member of the Lin Family.
Unexpectedly, this matter actually involved Changyun Yuanshuang.
After his shock, Lin Jing continued to look at the rest of the message.
ɴονǤᴑ.ᴄο
“The son of the Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch, Lu Youjiu, and Changyun Yuanshuang had mutual affection, and upon learning of this, he wanted to go to the Changyun Clan to find out the situation but was stopped by the Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch Lu Jingtao, who forcibly took him back and confined him within the Shocking Seas Alliance.”
This was another piece of shocking news for Lin Jing.
Lu Youjiu was actually stopped by his father.
Then, Lin Jing continued reading further.
“The Changyun Clan has already announced, Changyun Yuanshuang and the Lin Family descendant are to hold their wedding ceremony in three months.”
“Additionally, since being brought to the Changyun Clan, the Lin Family descendant has been protected, and his true origins have yet to be disclosed.”
…
…
Lin Jing’s purpose for coming to the Inner Sea was very clear, and naturally, he also paid attention to some news about the Changyun Clan during his trip.
Some of the news he purchased from the Qi Hall was already known to him, while other bits were previously unknown.
For example, the messages mentioned above were unknown to Lin Jing.
He didn’t expect the person Changyun Clan intended to engage Lin Jue to would actually be Changyun Yuanshuang.
Given these circumstances, Lin Jing could understand Lu Youjiu’s reaction.

chapters.title: Chapter 780
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 780: Chapter 345 System Space Upgraded Again_2 Chapter 780: Chapter 345 System Space Upgraded Again_2 Why did Lu Youjiu’s father, Lu Jingtao, insist on stopping him?
Could there be some hidden reasons behind it?
Regarding these matters, nothing was mentioned in the information Lin Jing had purchased, and naturally, Lin Jing wasn’t aware of them.
After all, if there were indeed secrets involved, then the information wouldn’t have come at such a price.
After viewing the information, the Jade Slip automatically shattered into dust.
After checking the information, Lin Jing didn’t delay; he surveyed the Spirit Plants in the Spirit Field and then immediately left the System Space.
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing deployed his Divine Sense to scan the area and saw that there were no other people around.
...
Thus, Lin Jing directly spoke out, summoning the System:
“System!”
“Enter Observation Mode!”
The system function had been upgraded, and Lin Jing certainly wanted to experience it firsthand.
As soon as Lin Jing’s words fell, the next moment, his perspective shifted above his head.
This time, in Observation Mode, Lin Jing saw himself.
Seeing oneself from another perspective had a very strange feeling.
Then,
Lin Jing raised his hand and moved forward some distance.
All of Lin Jing’s movements, under Observation Mode, were clearly visible to himself.
After observing for a while, Lin Jing then switched back to his own perspective.
The upgrade to Observation Mode allowed not only external usage by Lin Jing but also enabled him to switch perspectives at any time.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄօ
Lin Jing tried out this perspective-switching feature but didn’t find anything peculiar; for the time being, he didn’t know its use.
After testing Observation Mode, Lin Jing then tested the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
The most impressive aspect of Fixed-Point Teleportation was that it could teleport regardless of any obstacles.
Outside of the System Space, the reaction speed of Fixed-Point Teleportation was extremely fast.
Basically, once Lin Jing had chosen the teleportation location, in just an instant, he would suddenly appear at that position.
Moreover, the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function was different from using a Teleportation Talisman or a Teleportation Array.
When using Fixed-Point Teleportation, there were no fluctuations in energy, making it extremely secretive.
Honestly, this function would be quite impressive for making a surprise attack.
With no energy fluctuations, Lin Jing could suddenly appear beside anyone, making it very difficult for them to defend against, naturally making it quite troublesome.
What’s more, Lin Jing was a Body Refinement Cultivator; combined with this function, he became even more invincible.
After testing the two newly upgraded functions, Lin Jing then put away his thoughts and summoned the Flying Boat, flying towards Liyun Island…
…
Liyun Island.
It is the island closest to the Changyun Archipelago.
Because of its proximity to the Changyun Archipelago, many forces cooperate with the Changyun Clan on Liyun Island.
And for that reason, Liyun Island is also quite prosperous, although it can’t compare to the seven cities of the Seven Seas Hall.
But it’s nearly just as busy.
After leaving Ninghai City, Lin Jing flew for more than ten days before arriving at Liyun Island.
As soon as he neared Liyun Island, Lin Jing saw its hustle and bustle.
Liyun Island, and even some surrounding areas, had been developed, looking more like an Immortal City floating on the sea.
Meanwhile, many Cultivators from various forces, as well as some Loose Cultivators, continued to arrive at Liyun Island.
Although the Changyun Clan had some recent mishaps, these hadn’t reached a critical level for the vast Changyun Clan.
The real high-ranking members of the Changyun Clan had not suffered any harm, the old ancestors of the family were all safe, and the real combat strength of the Changyun Clan had not been diminished.
Thus, the interaction of the Changyun Clan with other external forces was still ongoing.
And Liyun Island was still thriving.
Upon reaching near Liyun Island, Lin Jing didn’t directly land on the island but used Observation Mode to observe the entire Liyun Island.
Lin Jing’s current Cultivation was at the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm.
His Divine Sense range had reached a terrifying extent.
The range of Observation Mode was determined by the reach of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
So, once Observation Mode was activated,
Lin Jing directly enveloped the entire Liyun Island within it.
Lin Jing did this because he wanted to see the situation on the island before proceeding there.
Indeed, if he used Divine Sense, the exploration of Liyun Island’s situation would have been faster.
However, this place is Liyun Island in the Inner Sea, where the cultivators generally have high cultivation levels.
Moreover, this is right on Liyun Island.
The cultivators on the island, I presume, are all extraordinary.
Just as in Ninghai City, when Lin Jing was in Ninghai City, he had encountered several cultivators in the Dao Integration stage.
This Liyun Island surely also has many in Dao Integration, as well as Tribulation cultivators, and even the presence of Mahayana cultivators is a possibility.
If he recklessly used Divine Sense, it would likely be detected by those Dao Integration and higher stage cultivators.
Using Divine Sense without discretion could easily offend them.
If he offended them, encountering cultivators with good temper might, at most, teach him a lesson and let it be.
If he encountered those with poor temper, it was even possible that he might lose his life.
However, using Observation Mode did not have this concern.
In Observation Mode, even Mahayana cultivators could not detect Lin Jing’s probing.
…
Lin Jing controlled the observation perspective, began to survey Liyun Island, and at the same time, kept an eye out for news about the Changyun Clan.
Under the observation perspective, one could say it was unrestrictive, with no place able to block the penetration of the observation perspective.
Naturally, Lin Jing wouldn’t conduct his exploration in a straightforward manner from the outside.
Sometimes, Lin Jing would even probe inside some buildings.
Such as the Changyun Pill Pavilion of the Changyun Clanâ€”it was a particular focus of Lin Jing’s attention, and after continuous probing for quite some time, Lin Jing still didn’t get any of the information he wanted.
Just as Lin Jing was about to give up his inquiry and prepare to directly enter Liyun Island.
While passing over Liyun City on Liyun Island, Lin Jing suddenly froze.
Because, on the streets below.
Lin Jing saw a person, someone who looked exactly like himself.
Seeing this person, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be stunned.
Could there actually be someone else who looked exactly like him?
Filled with suspicion, Lin Jing then unconsciously controlled the observation perspective to get closer, carefully observing.
Although the observation perspective lacked some of the fine uses of Divine Sense, within Observation Mode, one could still see much more detail.
After Lin Jing’s careful observation, he then discovered.
This person, though broadly similar to himself, actually had some differences from him.
Looking at this exceedingly similar person, Lin Jing couldn’t help but think of someone…
Subsequently.
Lin Jing directly controlled Observation Mode, following this person who was extremely similar to himself.
Wanting to see where this person was ultimately going.
Under Lin Jing’s observation, this person in Liyun City seemed to be idling around, wandering aimlessly.
Not until he had walked through almost the entire Liyun City did this person enter a small alley.
Once in the alley, this person marched straight ahead until nearly reaching the end of the alley and then stopped.
Then, the person took out a jade token from his hand.
Next, he affixed the jade token to one of the walls.
After the jade token was placed against it, a light screen silently appeared on the wall.
Afterward.
The person stored away the jade token and stepped directly into the wall.
This place turned out to be a formation.
Seeing this, Lin Jing hurriedly controlled the observation perspective to pass through the wall and followed inside.
When Lin Jing’s observation perspective passed through the formation and inside the wall, the scene before his eyes immediately underwent a huge change.
Unexpectedly, behind this wall turned out to be a deeply hidden courtyard.
The person who looked extremely like him also immediately relaxed upon entering this courtyard.
Afterward.
The figure of the person rapidly transformed, and soon, the person who looked extremely similar to him changed into another appearance.
Furthermore.
This newly transformed appearance was also very familiar to Lin Jing.
Seeing this appearance, even while in Observation Mode, Lin Jing couldn’t help but curl his lips into a smile.
It turned out this person was none other than Yan Wanfei, the master of transformation techniques…

chapters.title: Chapter 781
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 781: Chapter 346 Old Friends Meet Chapter 781: Chapter 346 Old Friends Meet “San He, I’m back!”
As soon as Yan Wanfei entered the yard, he immediately shouted toward the house inside the yard.
“How is it?”
“Did you notice anything unusual?”
A familiar voice responded, and from the rooms in the yard, another person familiar to Lin Jing came out.
It was Holaw Three Rivers.
“Nothing…”
“Your guess might be right, the heir of the Lin Family brought back by Changyun Clan probably isn’t the Lin brothers.”
“Disguised as the Lin brothers, I’ve wandered all over Liyun Island, especially visiting the Elixir Pavilion and some properties of Changyun Clan.”
“And yet, they had no reaction at all.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded and then spoke:
“I knew it…”
“The Lin brothers have always been cautious; they certainly wouldn’t expose themselves so easily.
Moreover, we found out that the reason the Lin heir was found was because of his grandfather.
“When I was with the Lin brothers before, I never heard that they had a grandfather.”
“Yes, indeed!”
Yan Wanfei nodded in agreement.Holaw Three Rivers also fell into thought.
...
Sometime later, looking puzzled, Yan Wanfei asked Holaw Three Rivers:
“San He…”
“Who do you think they brought over from the Southern Outer Sea?”
Holaw Three Rivers glanced at Yan Wanfei and couldn’t help but roll his eyes at him:
“All the information was found by both of us together; if you don’t know, do you think I would?”
Realizing his mistake, Yan Wanfei smacked his forehead and said:
“Oh, right!”
“I almost forgot.”
Facing this simpleton, Holaw Three Rivers initially wanted to say something more, but in the end, he just curled the corner of his mouth and said nothing.
He had given up on this simpleton.
Not minding this at all, Yan Wanfei continued to speak, asking Yan Wanfei:
“San He, Brother Jiu should be arriving soon, right?”
“Once Brother Jiu arrives, we’ll be able to start our action.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded and said:
“Mhm!”
“Our appointed time is almost here; he should arrive in the next couple of days.”
As soon as Holaw Three Rivers’ voice fell, Yan Wanfei chuckled:
“Heh heh…”
“That’s our Brother Jiu, locked up by his dad with a restriction, and yet he still managed to escape.”
Holaw Three Rivers looked at Yan Wanfei, the corner of his mouth twitching slightly, and then he said:
“Brother Jiu had help; otherwise, on his own, he definitely couldn’t have lifted the restriction placed by his father.
Do you really think the restriction set by a Mahayana cultivator is that easy to break?”
After hearing this, Yan Wanfei scratched his head and said:
“Heh heh…”
“I thought Brother Jiu used some special method.”
After saying this, Yan Wanfei then looked at Holaw Three Rivers and asked:
“San He, do you know who helped Brother Jiu?
To be able to lift the restriction his dad placed, they must have a high cultivation, right?”
After pondering for a moment, Holaw Three Rivers replied:
“I remember Brother Jiu once mentioned that the helper seems to be a vice hierarch of Shocking Seas Alliance, who has a good relationship with Brother Jiu’s father.
He treats Brother Jiu very well, almost like an elder to him.”
“No wonder…”
…
…
Afterward, the two didn’t talk much.
Having chatted for a while, Yan Wanfei was then dragged away by Holaw Three Rivers, claiming they were going to buy formation materials.
Seeing this, Lin Jing exited Observation Mode.
Since both of them were there, Lin Jing thought that he might as well take this opportunity to meet with them.
From their conversation just now, it seemed like they were about to take action.
It was just a question of what they planned to do and whether their objectives were the same as his.
If their goals were similar, it would be perfect to work together with them.
After exiting Observation Mode, Lin Jing directly went to Liyun Island and headed toward Liyun City.
Upon entering Liyun City, Lin Jing reactivated Observation Mode to find out the whereabouts of the two.
It didn’t take long for Lin Jing to spot them at a shop specializing in formations.
Subsequently.
Lin Jing, with a clear purpose, headed straight for the street where the shop was located.
Lin Jing arrived at the street, and before reaching the shop, saw the two of them walking out of the shop.
ƝονǤօ.ᴄᴑ
Upon seeing them appear, Lin Jing took the initiative to greet them:
“San He, Brother Yan…”
Hearing this voice, the two of them were startled and then turned their heads in unison to look at Lin Jing.
Upon recognizing Lin Jing.
Yan Wanfei stood there dumbfounded, with an expression of disbelief.
Even Holaw Three Rivers was shocked, standing there, momentarily at a loss for words.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly walked up, laughing as he approached:
“What are you guys doing here?”
It wasn’t until Lin Jing finished speaking that Yan Wanfei regained his composure, rubbing his eyes before looking at Lin Jing again.
Realizing he hadn’t seen wrongly, Yan Wanfei immediately became excited:
“Holy shit…”
“Brother Lin!”
“It should be me asking you, how come you are here?”
As soon as he finished speaking, Yan Wanfei seemed to realize something, then suddenly came to his senses, and turned to Holaw Three Rivers and said:
“Why would Brother Lin suddenly appear here…
this shouldn’t be happening…”
“Holy shit…”
“The one who abducted sister-in-law, it couldn’t really be Brother Lin, could it?”
“Now that he’s appearing here, could it be that he has escaped from Changyun Clan?”
But Holaw Three Rivers didn’t pay attention to Yan Wanfei.
After coming back to his senses, he looked Lin Jing up and down and then asked:
“Brother Lin…”
“How come you’re here on Liyun Island?”
Lin Jing approached the two, giving them a careful once-over, and then glanced around before speaking:

chapters.title: Chapter 782
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 782: Chapter 346 Old Friends Meet_2 Chapter 782: Chapter 346 Old Friends Meet_2 “This matter is a long story, and I can’t explain it clearly here,”
Upon glancing around, Holaw Three Rivers noticed the street was bustling with cultivators coming and goingâ€”it indeed wasn’t a place for conversation.
Therefore,
Holaw Three Rivers directly said to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin, let’s go…”
“I will take you to a secluded place.”
Having said that, Holaw Three Rivers led Lin Jing in another direction down the street, and Lin Jing, without hesitation, immediately followed.
Yan Wanfei also tactfully refrained from further comment, following alongside Lin Jing, although he kept looking Lin Jing up and down.
Quickly,
Under the guidance of Holaw Three Rivers, the trio arrived at the alley they had visited before.
After entering the alley, Holaw Three Rivers took out a token, faced a wall ahead, and then formed a hand seal with one hand.
ɴονǤօ.ƈο
In a short while, the wall began to change, revealing a light screen.
...
Next, Yan Wanfei walked directly towards the light screen, and as he did so, he turned his head to Lin Jing and said:
“Brother Lin, follow me…”After Yan Wanfei finished speaking, the next moment he stepped into the light screen and vanished.
Once Yan Wanfei had gone inside, Holaw Three Rivers pointed towards the light screen and said to Lin Jing:
“After you, Brother Lin…”
Lin Jing nodded, then stepped forward directly into the light screen.
Upon entering the light screen, an expanse suddenly opened up before Lin Jing’s eyes.
This place was precisely the small courtyard they had been to before.
As Lin Jing entered, Yan Wanfei immediately approached him and asked:
“Brother Lin…”
“What exactly is your cultivation level now?”
“Why do I feel like I can’t see through you anymore?”
At this moment, Holaw Three Rivers also walked in, nodding and saying:
“I have the same feeling.”
“I have just entered the Divinity Transformation, but when facing Brother Lin, I always feel there’s an indescribable ethereal quality about him.”
Lin Jing looked at them with a smile and said:
“It’s been almost 130 years since we last parted, hasn’t it?”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded and replied:
“137 years.”
Lin Jing looked at Holaw Three Rivers, gave a slight nod, and then continued:
“In all these years, Brother Yan has already reached the Nascent Soul Peak Stage, and Brother San He has even entered the Divinity Transformation.”
“It seems you have had quite a good time here in the Inner Sea.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded, then said:
“After arriving at this Inner Sea, we have always had Brother Jiu’s help, and we never lacked resources for cultivation, so naturally, our cultivation levels have risen quickly.”
“But as for you, Brother Lin, I can’t even see through your cultivation level anymore.”
Yan Wanfei also nodded eagerly:
“Yes!”
“What exactly is your cultivation level now, Brother Lin?”
Lin Jing then spoke:
“My current cultivation level is in the Solidifying Body Realm…”
As soon as Lin Jing’s words fell, Yan Wanfei couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise:
“A Solidifying Body Realm cultivator…”
Even Holaw Three Rivers, despite being mentally prepared, couldn’t help but have his breathing hitch upon hearing Lin Jing’s cultivation level.
When they last parted, Lin Jing’s cultivation was merely at the second layer of the Golden Core Stage.
Now, upon meeting again, Lin Jing had leaped across several major realms and had become a Solidifying Body Realm cultivator.
All this had happened within the span of 137 years.
With only 137 years, Lin Jing advanced from the second layer of the Golden Core Stage to the Solidifying Body Realm.
The pace of his cultivation was simply inconceivable.
Originally,
With the pace of the two of them, advancing over a hundred years from the Golden Core Stage, they had leaped across two major realms.
One reached the Nascent Soul Peak Stage, and the other entered the early stage of Divinity Transformation.
Such speed of cultivation progress could be considered extremely formidable.
Yet even that pace couldn’t compare to Lin Jing’s, whose rate of increasing his cultivation level was simply terrifying.
Yan Wanfei looked Lin Jing up and down with a face full of disbelief:
“Brother Lin…”
“Are you…
really a Solidifying Body Realm cultivator now?”
Lin Jing gave a slight smile, then released a bit of his cultivation aura, allowing them to get a sense of it before swiftly retracting his aura and then he said to them:
“To be frank with you two…”
“The reason for my swift advancement in cultivation is that I encountered some serendipitous opportunities, obtaining some cultivation techniques, as well as inheritances of cultivation.”
“That’s why I was able to break through to the Solidifying Body Realm in one fell swoop.”
Hearing this, Holaw Three Rivers suddenly understood and looked at Lin Jing with an envious expression.
And Yan Wanfei was even less able to conceal his admiration.
“`
“So that’s how it is…”
“To have actually obtained a cultivation inheritance, Brother Lin, you’re really lucky.”
Lin Jing smiled and then looked at the two people, asking:
“Since you two are here, where’s Brother Lu?
Isn’t he here?”
Yan Wanfei then spoke:
“Brother Jiu is temporarily not here, he should be arriving in a couple of days.”
“We’re here just to wait for Brother Jiu.”
After saying this, Yan Wanfei directly spoke again to Lin Jing:
“Right…”
“Brother Lin, since you’re here, I actually wanted to ask you about something…”
Before Yan Wanfei could finish speaking, Lin Jing directly said:
“You want to ask about the Changyun Clan and that Lin Family heir, right?”
At these words, Yan Wanfei’s eyes instantly lit up, and he nodded repeatedly:
“Yes…
yes…”
“That’s it.
Some time ago, the Changyun Clan brought back a Lin Family heir from the Southern Outer Sea.
That person couldn’t be you, Brother Lin, could it?”
“I want to know what exactly is going on?”
“Could it be that there are other Lin Family heirs in the Southern Outer Sea?”
Lin Jing nodded and then spoke:
“I came because of that matter.”
“You’re right, in the Southern Outer Sea, aside from myself, there indeed are other Lin Family heirs.”
“The one that the Changyun Clan took away, is indeed her…”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei suddenly came to a realization and said:
“No wonder…”
“I was saying that Brother Lin has always been cautious; surely you wouldn’t so easily expose your identity.”
“As expected, it’s as I predicted…”
Hearing these words, Holaw Three Rivers’ mouth twitched slightly, and with a contemptuous look at Yan Wanfei, he said:
“Wasn’t that my line?”
Yan Wanfei, unconcerned, directly argued:
“I had thought of it long ago, just didn’t say it…”
At this shameless fellow, Holaw Three Rivers was already too tired to comment further and chose to ignore him.
Instead, he continued to ask Lin Jing:
“So, Brother Lin, have you come here to rescue that fellow sect member, your brother?”
Lin Jing looked at them, was silent for a moment, and then spoke:
“Not a brother, a sister…”
As soon as Lin Jing said this, it undoubtedly caused an earthquake.
After hearing Lin Jing’s answer, Yan Wanfei was so shocked that he took a couple of steps back, looking incredulously at Lin Jing:
“What?”
“It’s your sister?”
“You mean, the person who stole my sister-in-law, and was preparing to become Dao Companions with her, is your sister, meaning she’s a woman?”
Although Holaw Three Rivers wasn’t as exaggerated as Yan Wanfei, his shocked expression was also frozen on his face.
Lin Jing looked at them and nodded.
Seeing this confirmation, Yan Wanfei turned to Holaw Three Rivers and then said:
“What on earth are the people of the Changyun Clan thinking?”
“They actually want a woman to become Dao Companions with my sister-in-law?”
Holaw Three Rivers frowned and muttered to himself:
“How can it be a woman?
That’s not supposed to be…”
“There’s also no news that the person brought back by the Changyun Clan was a woman.”
Seeing the misunderstanding, Lin Jing hurriedly explained:
“Here’s the thing…”
“Although my sister is a woman, she has a special method to disguise herself, and this disguise is extremely effective, undetectable even by Mahayana cultivators.”
“Also, my sister has been presenting herself as a man in public.”
“So, very few people know her true gender is actually female.”
“No wonder…”
After Lin Jing’s explanation, they both suddenly understood.
“Hahaha…”
Soon, a burst of laughter came from the side.
It was Yan Wanfei, who was bending over with laughter.
Lin Jing and Holaw Three Rivers both turned their heads to look at Yan Wanfei, who was holding his stomach and laughing, not understanding why.
Seeing the two of them look at him, Yan Wanfei hurriedly explained:
“Imagine what Brother Jiu’s expression would be if he knew that the one stealing his bride is Brother Lin’s sister, and that she’s a woman.”
“Just thinking about how angry Brother Jiu was when he found out his almost-gotten bride was about to get married, that he was on the verge of eating someone, makes me want to laugh…”
“Hahaha…”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 783
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 783: Chapter 347: The Plan to Poach People Chapter 783: Chapter 347: The Plan to Poach People Lin Jing had grown accustomed to Yan Wanfei’s sudden bursts of ideas.
Even Holaw Three Rivers merely gave him a blank look, too weary to offer further comment.
Then.
Lin Jing inquired about the purpose of their visit.
After their explanation, Lin Jing finally understood that Yan Wanfei and Holaw Three Rivers had come here to stage a ‘kidnapping’ with Lu Youjiu.
Taking someone from the Changyun Clan was a bold thought indeed.
After all, this was the Changyun Clan they were dealing with; setting aside whether they could actually ‘kidnap’ the person, just entering the Chang Yun Archipelago where the clan was located was surely no easy task, right?
...
Attempting to ‘kidnap’ someone directly was undoubtedly impractical.
Even if one were incredibly lucky and actually succeeded, could they really ensure they could get away with the person unharmed?
Lin Jing then shared his concerns with them.
They listened and said not to worry, as long as they could get the person out of the Changyun Clan.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was utterly confused and even more perplexed.
Seeing his confusion, they exchanged a glance…
and then they began to explain to Lin Jing.
…
…
This marriage hurriedly arranged by the Changyun Clan actually wasn’t the will of all clan members, but rather a scheme by only a part of the clan.
The reason for the Changyun Clan’s haste lay in a calamity it had faced, similar to one the Lin Family had once suffered, within the last hundred years.
This calamity had emerged so strangely and suddenly, bearing an uncanny resemblance to the downfall that had happened to the Lin Family before their decline.
It was hard not to let one’s imagination run wild with such coincidences.
Thus.
Some within the Changyun Clan began to believe it was true, considering the calamity to be the result of envy from the heavens against an Ancient Alchemy Family that had survived for too long, and something that had to be endured.
Surviving this challenge would mean the Changyun Clan could continue to exist; failure to do so meant the entire family would dissipate like smoke.
Especially with the precedent of the Lin Family, many within the Changyun Clan strongly believed in this theory.
Of course.
These people only represented a part of the Changyun Clan and could not speak for the entire clan.
There was another faction within the Changyun Clan that regarded the calamity as mere superstition, convinced that all these events were the result of someone’s machinations, part of a conspiracy targeting their clan.
Within the Changyun Clan, opinion was divided between these two theories, forming two factions.
The faction that saw it as a calamity continuously gathered various materials related to ancient families to find a way to overcome it.
The other faction firmly believed in the conspiracy theory.
While the calamity faction investigated the old records, the conspiracy theorists tried to uncover which power was targeting the Changyun Clan.
However, after decades of investigation, the conspiracy theorists within the Changyun Clan not only failed to identify the culprit but also inexplicably suffered numerous casualties.
ɴονǤᴑ.ᴄο
Some, without warning, descended into madness right before everyone’s eyes, causing their cultivation to regress.
There were even more serious cases, such as those who were supposed to endure their Heavenly Tribulation with full confidence and ample preparations, faced unexpected failure at the critical moment, resulting in their demise.
These incidents were not isolated occurrences; in recent times alone there had been several, not to mention those in the past.
Because of these incidents, an increasing number of people within the Changyun Clan started to believe they were cursed by the envy of the heavens.
Consequently, the proponents of the calamity theory within the Changyun Clan became even more active in seeking a solution.
They even raked up some past anecdotes of the Lin Family for reference.
After continuous investigations, those who believed in the calamity theory within the Changyun Clan proposed a seemingly viable plan…
That was to have a direct descendant female from the purest main bloodline of the Changyun Clan become the Dao Companion of the Lin Family heir.
Through the bond between the two, they aimed to transfer the family’s luck and thus surmount the calamity.
In the Changyun Clan, there was only one such direct descendant female, and that was Changyun Yuanshuang.
Therefore, the Changyun Clan approached Lin Jue, intending to match him with Changyun Yuanshuang as Dao Companions.
However, this seemingly perfect proposition wasn’t accepted by everyone within the Changyun Clan.
This included Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather.
Yuanshuang’s grandfather was a firm believer of the conspiracy theory and also the leading figure of that faction.
He was well aware of Yuanshuang’s relationship with Lu Youjiu.
And he greatly approved of their union and was very willing to facilitate their coming together.
If Yuanshuang’s grandfather were present, he would have never agreed to the arrangement.
Unfortunately, her grandfather sustained serious injuries in an earlier investigation.
Due to the severity of his injuries, he had no choice but to go into seclusion to heal.
Once he entered seclusion, the conspiracy faction lost their pillar, and many among them gradually changed their beliefs, slowly starting to believe in the calamity theory as well.
The entire conspiracy faction was soon drowned out by the voices of the calamity faction…
If Yuanshuang’s grandfather were here, he would certainly not have compromised, nor would he have allowed Yuanshuang to marry the heir of the Lin Family.
The calamity faction was well aware of this situation.
So they planned to act swiftly and decisively, aiming to settle everything before Yuanshuang’s grandfather could leave his seclusion.
Once the marriage was completed, and the rice was turned to porridge, it would be too late, even if Yuanshuang’s grandfather emerged from seclusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 784
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 784: Chapter 347: The Plan to Poach People_2 Chapter 784: Chapter 347: The Plan to Poach People_2 By then, he’ll have to agree even if he doesn’t want to.
The Robbery Faction had a good plan, but transferring Qi fortune is no easy task, especially that of the entire Changyun Clan.
Before that, there are many preparations to be made.
If it weren’t for these preparations, the wedding ceremony between Changyun Yuanshuang and Lin Jue would probably have already taken place, and would not necessarily have to wait for three months.
Lu Youjiu’s plan to ‘snatch’ someone was to take advantage of this period to take Changyun Yuanshuang away from the Changyun Clan first.
To delay the marriage as much as possible until Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather emerges from seclusion.
In that case, it does indeed seem feasible.
...
As long as Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather comes out of seclusion, all problems will be resolved at once.
…
Actually,
Lin Jing had also come with the idea of ‘snatching’ someone, coincidentally falling in line with their intent.
However, due to his lack of familiarity with the Changyun Clan, he could only first arrive here and then slowly gather information.
Now that they had already made preparations, there was no need for Lin Jing to make extra efforts.
He could just cooperate with them directly.
Afterwards,
Lin Jing shared his thoughts with Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei.
Upon hearing his idea, they both nodded incessantly, expressing their agreement.
Since the objective was to ‘snatch’ someone, they might as well ‘snatch’ both Changyun Yuanshuang and Lin Jue together.
After discussing, the three of them made a decision very cheerfully.
Now that they had decided, all that was left was to wait for Lu Youjiu to arrive and then discuss further.
…
…
ƝονǤο.с0
By the time Lu Youjiu arrived, it was already the third day.
When Lu Youjiu came to the small courtyard and saw Lin Jing, he too was greatly surprised.
Seeing Lu Youjiu’s expression, Yan Wanfei seemed to remember something.
He immediately started laughing uncontrollably.
Meanwhile, Holaw Three Rivers, who understood what was going on, gave Yan Wanfei a sidelong glance and then started explaining to Lu Youjiu.
When Lu Youjiu heard that the person preparing to become Dao companions with Changyun Yuanshuang was actually Lin Jing’s sister, a woman…
The expression on Lu Youjiu’s face was quite a spectacle, and seeing this, Yan Wanfei laughed even more joyously.
He curled up into a ball, almost beating the ground with his hands.
Seeing Yan Wanfei delight in his misfortune, Lu Youjiu became infuriated, immediately gathering Spiritual Power to form a huge Spiritual Sword.
Then, flipping the sword like a door plank, he slapped it down on Yan Wanfei.
With Lu Youjiu’s cultivation at the Divinity Transformation late stage, Yan Wanfei at the Nascent Soul Peak Stage didn’t stand a chance of escaping.
Before he could even attempt to flee, Yan Wanfei was pinned to the ground by the giant sword.
And furthermore…
Fearing the force wasn’t enough, after embedding Yan Wanfei into the ground, Lu Youjiu slapped him several more times, sinking him deep into the earth.
Only after Yan Wanfei’s repeated pleas for mercy did Lu Youjiu let him go.
After dealing with Yan Wanfei, Lu Youjiu returned to Lin Jing’s side.
As if he couldn’t believe it, Lu Youjiu asked again:
“You’re saying the Lin Family heir is your sister?”
“Are you sure?”
“I received information saying that the Lin Family heir who was brought here is indeed a man.
Many of the older generation cultivators with decent cultivation in the Changyun Clan have confirmed it; there can’t be any mistake.”
Lin Jing nodded and then said:
“I’m not deceiving Brother Lu, the Daoist Treasure my sister uses to conceal her identity comes from the Lin Family.
Not just those older generation cultivators, even cultivators at the Mahayana Realm cannot see through it.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu let out a sigh of relief:
“No wonder…”
“Since it’s a Daoist Treasure from the Lin Family, that makes sense now.”
“After all, the Lin Family was one of the top powers of the Inner Sea ten thousand years ago, and it’s only because of the downfall of the Lin Family that we have the current four major powers.”
Lin Jing then asked Lu Youjiu:
“Brother Lu, what are your next plans?
How do you intend to take them out of the Changyun Clan?”
Lu Youjiu replied:
“Yuanshuang has a cousin she is on good terms with; she can help me get some information.”
“Plus, I’ve already contacted her.
Once she brings the information, we can discuss how to proceed.”
“In that case, excellent…”
Lin Jing nodded.
Afterward,
Lin Jing and Lu Youjiu engaged in a prolonged conversation.
They also shared some of their experiences from recent years.
Lu Youjiu, the son of the Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch Lu Jingtao, naturally did not lack cultivation resources upon his return to the Inner Sea, and his cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds every day.
Although not comparable to Lin Jing, he was still a rare presence within the Inner Sea.
Lin Jing then told Lu Youjiu about inheriting the legacy of the Five Elements Ancestor.
Lu Youjiu was equally envious of Lin Jing’s encounters.
Despite not lacking cultivation resources and having decent talent himself, Lu Youjiu still found himself far surpassed by Lin Jing under such conditions.
To say he wasn’t envious would certainly be impossible.
As they chatted, the conversation soon turned to the Changyun Clan.
It was at this time that Lin Jing brought up Changyun Yuanlei.
As well as the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace.
Changyun Yuanlei was an alchemy genius of the Changyun Clan, usually protected by the family and rarely going out, so even Lu Youjiu had not seen him very often.
It was Changyun Yuanshuang who often mentioned him.
As for the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace, which was taken from Changyun Yuanlei, Lu Youjiu only found out about it afterward.
At the time, Lu Youjiu merely wanted Changyun Yuanshuang to help him find a better Pill Furnace, without giving it much thought.
Who would have expected Changyun Yuanshuang to directly snatch the family-given Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace from Changyun Yuanlei and give it to Lu Youjiu?
Lu Youjiu didn’t ask further and directly took the Pill Furnace to give to Lin Jing.
And Changyun Yuanlei, having had his Pill Furnace taken, naturally didn’t dare say much to his own sister.
Perhaps it was because of this bond that Changyun Yuanlei felt a sense of inexplicable kinship when he first met Lin Jing.
Now that he thought about it, it had been more than fifty years since Changyun Yuanlei emerged from the Five Elements Ruins; he wondered how Changyun Yuanlei was doing now.
Thereafter,
Lin Jing inquired about Changyun Yuanlei’s recent situation.
Lu Youjiu indicated that there seemed to be no change with Changyun Yuanlei, who continued to practice alchemy and cultivate as before.
The incident of Changyun Yuanlei being drawn into the Sea of Strange mists also remained unreported, seemingly concealed deliberately by the Changyun Clan.
After hearing this, Lin Jing nodded thoughtfully.
…
…
Not until the next day did Lu Youjiu receive news that Changyun Yuanshuang’s cousin had arrived, so he led a few people to meet Changyun Yuanshuang’s cousin.
Lu Youjiu was able to come out because one of his elders had secretly let him out, unbeknownst to his father.
Therefore,
when they came out, they all disguised themselves, especially Lu Youjiu, who to avoid detection, even took out a Daoist Treasure specifically for disguise.
After emerging, they headed directly to the largest tavern in Liyun City, called the Cloud Sea Immortal Abode.
Upon entering the Cloud Sea Immortal Abode, they made their way to a luxurious private room under Lu Youjiu’s guidance.
When they entered the room, a lovely and delicate girl was already inside.
After entering the room and closing the door, the Formation within the private room automatically activated.
This formation was an isolation array, designed to prevent other cultivators from spying.
The isolation formation in the tavern was crafted by a top Array Master, preventing even elite cultivators from prying.
Thus, inside this tavern, discussions were generally safe, without worry of leaks to the outside.
Not many taverns could boast such a feature, which required substantial backing; otherwise, a mere tavern couldn’t afford to hire a top formation grandmaster.
The Cloud Sea Immortal Abode’s capacity to be the largest on Liyun Island was precisely due to the support of the Shocking Seas Alliance behind it.
Because he was fairly familiar with his own faction’s power, Lu Youjiu had chosen to meet here.
As they entered the room, the isolation formation automatically activated.
At this moment, the group removed their disguises.
The girl turned to Lu Youjiu and quickly said,
“Brother-in-law Lu, I’m glad you’ve come…”
After speaking, the girl curiously looked over the group,
“Are these your friends?”
Lu Youjiu nodded and introduced the girl to Lin Jing and the others, saying,
“This is Yuanshuang’s cousin, Changyun Qingshuang.”
After saying this, he directly spoke to Changyun Qingshuang,
“These are my friends, planning to join me in this operation.
Just speak directly if you have anything to say.”
The girl nodded and then spoke up to Lu Youjiu,
“Brother-in-law Lu, I’m sorry…”
“I wasn’t able to accomplish what you asked of me…”

chapters.title: Chapter 785
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 785: Chapter 348: Seeing Changyun Yuanlei Again Chapter 785: Chapter 348: Seeing Changyun Yuanlei Again Lu Youjiu listened, slightly startled, then turned to Changyun Qingshuang and asked:
“What’s going on?”
“Could there have been some kind of mishap?”
Changyun Qingshuang sighed helplessly, then complained:
“No mishap…”
“It’s just that my cousin has been guarded so strictly.
My uncles, knowing how close I am to her, fear any trouble and won’t let me near her.”
“I’ve even tried to gather information, but to no avail.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu’s brows knit together slightly, as he muttered to himself:
“Impossible to gather any information…”
Then, Lu Youjiu continued speaking to Changyun Yuanshuang:
“Then can you think of a way to send a message to Yuanshuang?”
Changyun Qingshuang shook her head after listening, then said:
“I’m afraid that’s not possible…”
“Currently, my uncles strictly guard her courtyard, and they simply don’t allow me any chance to see her.”
Just as Changyun Qingshuang finished speaking, Lin Jing suddenly interjected, asking her:
“What about the heir of the Lin Family?Have you seen him?”
“How is he now?”
Changyun Qingshuang turned her head towards Lin Jing, gave him a quick assessment, then replied:
“The Lin Family’s heir is the same, carefully guarded by my uncles, and his courtyard is next to my cousin’s, so they are very close, and I cannot approach him either.”
Lu Youjiu, having listened to what Changyun Yuanshuang had said, furrowed his brow even more.
Yet before Lu Youjiu could further inquire, Yan Wanfei curled his lip, spontaneously complaining:
“Your family guards so tightly, as if guarding against thieves.”
“So, there’s nobody who can freely come and go from that courtyard?”
Changyun Qingshuang thought for a moment, then said:
“There are…”
“Apart from my uncles and grandfather, it seems that only Yuanlei could freely enter or exit the courtyard.”
Hearing this, Yan Wanfei directly spoke to Changyun Qingshuang:
“Then why don’t you just ask Yuanlei to help pass on the message?
Wouldn’t that work?”
Changyun Qingshuang’s brow creased slightly as she shook her head and said:
“That probably won’t work.”
“Due to his alchemy talent, Yuanlei has been closely looked after by the family elders since he was young, and he rarely interacts with us.”
“Because we barely interact, even if we meet, we only greet each other and hardly speak.”
“Moreover…”
“Since he has been valued by the family, from a very young age, he has always been under the careful watch of the uncles, who almost always accompany him.”
“Those uncles, already wary of me due to this affair, would definitely become suspicious if I suddenly wanted to contact Yuanlei without any apparent reason.”
“Therefore, getting Yuanlei to convey a message is simply impossible.”
Yan Wanfei was shocked upon hearing this:
“Ah?”
“I had no idea Yuanlei was so pitiful, being controlled so tightly.
Does he not have any freedom at all?”
Changyun Qingshuang nodded and said:
“Pretty much…”
Yan Wanfei then asked again:
“So even if you wanted to give him a gift out of concern, it wouldn’t be allowed?”
Changyun Yuanshuang shook her head and said:
“It’s not exactly forbidden…”
“It’s just because of the special circumstances lately, and because I am different from them, fearing that I may act recklessly, they are like this.”
“Normally, our family is quite good.”
Hearing this, Lu Youjiu’s eyes suddenly lit up, then he asked Changyun Qingshuang:
“So, you mean you could bring something to Yuanlei?”
Changyun Qingshuang nodded and said:
“Yes.”
“However, even if I wanted to bring something to him, it would have to be under the watchful eyes of the elders, so, Brother-in-Law Lu, if you were thinking of sneaking something else in with it, that wouldn’t work.”
It seemed that Changyun Qingshuang had already guessed Lu Youjiu’s thoughts.
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu nodded gently and said:
“I am well aware of that…”
“I was thinking of having you bring something for Yuanlei that, upon seeing it, he would understand the meaning.”
“Then let him figure out a way to evade your uncles and come find you…”
“That would suffice.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei immediately perked up:
“Letting him come find you on his own, that’s a good plan!”
“Brother Lu, you take something that represents your identity and give it to Sister Qingshuang to bring back.”
Lu Youjiu shook his head and said:
“That won’t work…”
“Something representing my identity would be too conspicuous, and Qingshuang’s uncles would definitely recognize it.”
“Give me a moment to think…”
However,
just then, Lin Jing suddenly spoke up:
“If there was something, I actually do have an item that, once seen by Yuanlei, would certainly make him recognize my identity.”
“And it would also remain unnoticed by his elders.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu promptly turned to Lin Jing and asked:
“What is it?”
Lin Jing, hearing the question, directly took out a small jar for holding liquor from his Space Ring and handed it to Lu Youjiu.
...
Just as Lu Youjiu was about to reach for it, Yan Wanfei, quick as a flash, snatched it away first.
After seizing it, Yan Wanfei couldn’t help but mutter:
“Huh?
“Why is it so light?”
Having said that, Yan Wanfei unhesitatingly opened the jar’s seal.
Suddenly,
the rich aroma of the liquor instantly assaulted the senses.
Yan Wanfei, who was closest, immediately showed a look of intoxication, as if his soul had flown out.
ƝονǤ0.сᴑ
“Such fragrant liquor…”
Yan Wanfei couldn’t help but remark.
Just as he finished speaking, Holaw Three Rivers snatched the jar away from him,
quickly resealed it, then gave Yan Wanfei a kick.

chapters.title: Chapter 786
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 786: Chapter 348: Seeing Changyun Yuanlei Again_2 Chapter 786: Chapter 348: Seeing Changyun Yuanlei Again_2 “Fool, didn’t you hear what Lin Jing said?”
“This wine is of great importance!”
Yan Wanfei, having been kicked by Holaw Three Rivers, immediately wore a face full of grievance:
“I didn’t say I wanted to drink it, just wanted to have a look…”
Immediately after, Holaw Three Rivers handed the jar of wine back to Lu Youjiu.
Lu Youjiu took the wine jar, then looked at Lin Jing:
“It’s this jar of wine.
You give this jar to Changyun Yuanlei, and he will naturally know my identity.”
“At that time, he will definitely go to Qingshuang to inquire about the situation.
As long as he finds Changyun Qingshuang, won’t the rest be easy to handle?”
The jar of wine that Lin Jing had just taken out was none other than the Drunken Soul Wine that had knocked Changyun Yuanlei out twice before in the Five Elements Ruins.
After buying the Drunken Soul Wine, Lin Jing had drunk quite a bit, and now only this little bit was left.
This wine, unique to the Drunken Soul Tavern, could be recognized by its mere scentâ€”once he smelled it, he would understand that he had already arrived.
Knowing he had arrived, Changyun Yuanlei would not remain indifferent.
...
…
Lu Youjiu took the wine jar from Holaw Three Rivers, first opened it to look inside, then immediately sealed it again.
Before, Lin Jing had told Lu Youjiu about his encounter with Changyun Yuanlei in the Five Elements Ruins, and Lu Youjiu knew that this must be the wine that had once made Changyun Yuanlei drunk.
Afterwards, Lu Youjiu looked at Lin Jing and nodded appreciatively.
…
…
The next steps were easy to handle.
Lu Youjiu then took out a new jar, and transferred the less-than-half jar of wine into a beautifully crafted smaller wine jar.
After repacking the wine, Lu Youjiu handed the jar of Drunken Soul Wine directly to Changyun Qingshuang.
Thereafter, Lu Youjiu gave Changyun Qingshuang some pointers on what to do when the time came.
Then, they discussed the plan further.
After the discussion, Changyun Qingshuang departed.
Lin Jing and the others also left the Celestial Residence at Yunhai.
As they were leaving, Yan Wanfei sidled up to Lin Jing.
“Brother Lin…”
“Do you still have any of that wine left?”
“That wine smells so good, just one sniff and you know it has to be delicious.”
Lin Jing then said with a smile:
“I knew you couldn’t let it go.”
Holaw Three Rivers looked at Yan Wanfei with a disdainful expression that was all too evident:
“Sometimes I really don’t want to say it…”
“It’s just one jar, and yet you’re still fixated on it.”
“Heh heh…”
Yan Wanfei, unconcerned, just chuckled.
Lin Jing then added:
“That jar of wine is of special origin, likely very hard to come by again.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei instantly looked disappointed.
But just then, Lin Jing unexpectedly changed the subject:
“However…”
Yan Wanfei perked up, suddenly looking up at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing smiled slightly, then continued:
“Although I can’t produce that exact wine, I can get something similar.
Though there might be some minor taste difference, it will definitely be delicious.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei hastily moved closer to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin…”
“You know me, I rarely ask anyone for anything…”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, quickly put up a hand to stop him from continuing:
“Hold it…”
“I know what you’re going to say next, you can stop there.”
“Just wait a while, let Brother Lu handle this matter first, then I’ll get you a similar jar of wine.”
Although the original Drunken Soul Wine was beyond Lin Jing’s ability to craft, making a similar exquisite wine was still no problem for him.
After all, the main ingredient of Drunken Soul Wine was Jade Soul Algae.
By adding Jade Soul Algae and a few other ingredients that could produce a drunken effect to the wine, one could achieve the intoxicating effect.
Lin Jing had plenty of Jade Soul Algae, and obtaining the other ingredients was not very difficult.
Crafting a few jars of wine similar to Drunken Soul Wine was easily done.
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei nodded repeatedly:
“Heh heh…”
“I knew Brother Lin was the best.”
Lin Jing: “…”
…
…
After returning from Yunhai Celestial Residence, they still had to wait for a while.
Wait for Changyun Qingshuang to send them a message.
This time.
They had waited several days before Lu Youjiu finally received a message from Changyun Yuanshuang.
After receiving the message, Lu Youjiu once again brought a few people to the Cloud Sea Immortal Residence.
It was the same private room as before.
This time, as soon as several people entered, aside from Changyun Qingshuang,
another person was sitting beside her, and this person was none other than Changyun Yuanlei.
Seeing Changyun Yuanlei again, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel somewhat emotional.
He had thought he would not have any dealings with him again for a while.
Unexpectedly, after he had left, he met him again so soon, and this time, it was he who had sought him out.
As Lin Jing and his companions arrived, Changyun Yuanlei quickly looked towards them.
However, since everyone was in disguise, Changyun Yuanlei couldn’t tell which one was Lin Jing.
Afterward.
The door to the private room closed, and the isolation Formation inside was activated again.
Lin Jing and his companions then canceled their disguises, returning to their original appearances.
ɴονǤο.сօ
The instant he saw Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei was both stunned and overjoyed:
“Big brother…”
“I didn’t expect it to really be you.”
“When I was sent out before, I was a bit worried.”
“Seeing that you are unharmed, I’m really relieved.”
Lin Jing smiled, examining Changyun Yuanlei for a moment.
Now, Changyun Yuanlei had reached the late stage of Nascent Soul cultivation.
In just over fifty years, Changyun Yuanlei had advanced from the early stage to the late stage of Nascent Soul, an indeed swift increase in cultivation.
Clearly,
the resources Changyun Clan had invested in him must have been substantial.
After examining him, Lin Jing then spoke:
“It’s been decades, and your cultivation has improved significantly.”
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei looked dejected:
“Big brother…
“Don’t mention it, after I returned, the family’s supervision over me became stricter, and it’s inconvenient for me to do anything.”
“Although my cultivation has increased a lot, I don’t feel free at all.”
“This time out, I exhausted all means, and finally only with my sister’s advice did I manage to temporarily evade the uncles and come out with cousin Qingshuang to meet you all.”
At this point, Lu Youjiu spoke up, asking Changyun Yuanlei:
“How is your sister now?”
Changyun Yuanlei quickly looked towards Lu Youjiu:
“Brother-in-law…
“You don’t need to worry, my sister is fine.”
“And she’s been trying to find a way to leave as well, just hasn’t found a better method yet.”
Having said that, Changyun Yuanlei began to complain:
“I really don’t know what the family is thinking, actually wanting my sister to marry that heir of the Lin Family.”
“If it’s really a clan catastrophe, is sacrificing my sister alone not enough?
I doubt it.”
“And that heir of the Lin Family, I’ve met him, and he seems just ordinary, with nothing particularly special about him.”
“Yet those uncles and grandfathers in the family still want me to get to know him better and get close to him.”
“Really…”
“He’s aiming to take my sister, how could I possibly want to get close to him?”
Having said that, Changyun Yuanlei directly looked towards Lu Youjiu, speaking indignantly:
“Brother-in-law!”
“Cousin Qingshuang already told me about your plan.”
“I fully support it.”
“Take my sister and elope, just the two of you.”
After hearing what Changyun Yuanlei had said, Lu Youjiu fell silent for a moment before speaking:
“Actually…”
“I think you should get to know that heir of the Lin Family a bit more.”
“That way, when the time comes, we can take him with us.”
As Lu Youjiu’s words fell, Changyun Yuanlei was momentarily stunned and then looked towards Lu Youjiu, puzzled:
“But why, brother-in-law…”
“At this point, why would we still want to take him with us?”
Lu Youjiu then looked towards Lin Jing before speaking:
“That heir of the Lin Family has a deep connection with Brother Lin.”
“Brother Lin actually came here this time for her.”
After hearing what Lu Youjiu said, Changyun Yuanlei turned his gaze towards Lin Jing, his eyes filled with great confusion:
“Big brother…”
“That kid, to you…?”
Lin Jing nodded, then spoke:
“Some matters that are to follow will need your help, so there’s naturally no need to keep secrets from you anymore.”
“That ‘kid’ you’re referring to is actually my sister…”

chapters.title: Chapter 787
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 787: Chapter 349: Plan Succeeded, Leaving Changyun Chapter 787: Chapter 349: Plan Succeeded, Leaving Changyun “What?”
“Your sister?”
Changyun Yuanlei initially did not react, not until he pondered it once more, that he suddenly snapped back to reality.
“A female…?”
Apart from Changyun Yuanlei, even Changyun Qingshuang was muttering under his breath, a look of disbelief on his face.
As for Lu Youjiu and the other two, since they already knew about this, naturally, they did not react as intensely as the others.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄᴑ
Lin Jing looked towards Changyun Yuanlei and Changyun Qingshuang and nodded, affirming their realization.
It was only then that Changyun Yuanlei truly recovered, as if he couldn’t believe it, the newly composed Changyun Yuanlei asked again:
“So you mean, the person from the Lin Family who is set to become Dao Companions with my sister is actually a woman, your sister?”
“And not your brother?”
“Then why didn’t any of our family’s uncles notice this?”
“That shouldn’t be possible…”
Lin Jing slightly nodded:
“Do not doubt, Lin Jue is indeed a female.”
“The reason why your family’s uncles didn’t realize this is because her Magical Treasure, which conceals her identity, is rather extraordinary and hails from the former Lin Family.”
“It’s only normal that you discovered it.”Hearing Lin Jing’s explanation, Changyun Yuanlei and Changyun Qingshuang suddenly saw the light:
“No wonder…”
However.
As soon as the two had finished speaking, Changyun Qingshuang turned to Lin Jing and abruptly said:
“If Lin Jue is your sister, doesn’t that mean you are the true heir of the Lin Family?”
Lin Jing gently nodded:
“One could say that…”
“But, the Lin Family is long gone, and the title of its heir holds no significance anymore.”
Changyun Yuanlei quickly interjected:
“Big brother, you are being too modest.”
“That was the Lin Family, the Lin Family from ten thousand years ago, an existence even more formidable than our Changyun Clan.”
Lin Jing shook his head and spoke faintly:
“No matter how formidable, it has still vanished into thin air…”
Lin Jing did not want to dwell on this topic, and after finishing his statement, he directly said to the two:
“Forget it!”
“Let’s not talk about this anymore.”
“I hope you can keep this matter confidential.”
“After all, even though the Lin Family has perished here in the Inner Sea, the old opponents and enemies of the Lin Family are still around.”
“My sister, for now, is only safe within your Changyun Clan; if I had initially taken her to a smaller power, that entire force might no longer exist.”
After hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei nodded repeatedly, then said to Lin Jing:
“Big brother, rest assured.”
“We will definitely not reveal this matter.”
Changyun Qingshuang also quickly spoke, saying:
“I will do the same…”
Lin Jing nodded.
...
Then, Lu Youjiu spoke up, addressing Changyun Yuanlei:
“Yuanlei!”
“We called you here actually to ask for your help, to convey some messages between me and your sister so we can devise a plan to help her escape from the clan.”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei patted his chest and assured:
“Brother-in-law, rest assured.”
“This concerns my sister’s lifelong happiness; I will definitely help as much as I can.”
Lu Youjiu nodded, then continued speaking to Changyun Yuanlei:
“Also, when you return this time, tell your sister about our situation too, so she can be reassured.”
“We must bring her along when we take your sister out.”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded slightly:
“Since she is your sister, big brother, say no more, I will certainly bring her out.”
“Actually…”
“If my grandfather hadn’t met with an accident, my uncles, as well as my other third and fourth grandfathers, wouldn’t have engaged in such activities.”
“I don’t know what my uncles and grandfathers were thinking, why they would so firmly believe in such a catastrophe.”
“Ever since coming out of the Sea of Strange, my grandfather spoke to me just once, and after talking to him, I gradually understood that there really isn’t any catastrophe, it must have been someone’s doing.”
“Look, am I not alright?”
“If there truly were a catastrophe, I wouldn’t have possibly met and been saved by big brother in a place like the Sea of Strange.”
“You know, that is the Sea of Strange.”
“Countless people who have entered, never came out, and me being able to, surely that shows I am quite fortunate, right?”
“If it truly were a catastrophe, in a place like the Sea of Strange, I probably would have been long gone.”
What Changyun Yuanlei said actually made sense.
If heaven truly envied the Changyun Clan, sentencing them to calamity, not just Changyun Yuanlei, but the entire Changyun Clan, likely couldn’t have endured it.
…
Afterward…
Lu Youjiu discussed further with Changyun Yuanlei, entrusted him with a few things, and after everything was settled, they agreed on when to meet next.
After everything was discussed, Changyun Yuanlei and Changyun Qingshuang then departed.
After the two had left.
Lin Jing and the others also prepared to leave.
Just at that moment, Lu Youjiu turned and said to Lin Jing and the others:
“Brother Lin, you three go ahead, I still need to meet with someone else.”
“Brother Ji, who are you going to meet this time?”
Lu Youjiu then said:
“To accomplish this, we alone are not enough; I need others to help.”
“I’ve made an appointment with an elder brother of mine to keep an eye on the Changyun Clan so we can be prepared.”
“Is it Xiao Xu?” Holaw Three Rivers asked.
Lu Youjiu nodded and said:
“Yes, it’s elder brother Xiao Xu.”
“You go ahead, I’ll meet him first.”
Holaw Three Rivers nodded:
“Alright…”
“Then be careful, we’ll go ahead then.”
After saying this, Lu Youjiu bid farewell to the others and left alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 788
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 788: Chapter 349: Plan Succeeded, Leaving Changyun_2 Chapter 788: Chapter 349: Plan Succeeded, Leaving Changyun_2 After Lu Youjiu left, Lin Jing and the other two returned to their former courtyard.
It wasn’t until Lin Jing and his companions were back that Holaw Three Rivers took the initiative to talk about Xiao Xu.
ɴονǤօ.сο
Xiao Xu was the son of a vice-patriarch surnamed Xiao within the Shocking Seas Alliance.
Xiao Xu was several years older than Lu Youjiu.
The two could be said to have grown up together since childhood because of the close relationship between their families, so Lu Youjiu always regarded Xiao Xu as an elder brother.
And Xiao Xu had also always shown a great deal of affection for Lu Youjiu.
...
For instance, this time, when Lu Youjiu was grounded by his father, Lu Jingtao, it was Xiao Xu’s father who took action and lifted the restriction for him.
Otherwise, Lu Youjiu might still be unable to come out.
…
In the following period, everyone was busy preparing.
Changyun Yuanlei was active, constantly relaying messages between them, and with the help of Changyun Yuanlei, Lin Jing also managed to contact Lin Jue without any issues.
Lin Jue was alright, and Changyun Yuanlei’s uncles treated her well and didn’t give her any trouble.
Hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a lot more at ease.
Besides Lin Jue, there was also Changyun Yuanshuang.
During this time, Lu Youjiu had been in contact with Changyun Yuanshuang, and with the help of Changyun Yuanlei, the two even managed to meet secretly.
Time passed swiftly, and more than half a month went by.
Lu Youjiu finally completed his preparations and planned to start the final “rescue” operation.
Three days later, Lu Youjiu returned from outside once more.
After coming back, Lu Youjiu hurriedly summoned Lin Jing and the others, saying,
“Brother Lin…”
“Everything is ready, and we will begin our operation tonight.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei also quickly spoke up, saying,
“Finally ready.”
“Brother Jiu, what do you need us to do?”
Lu Youjiu shook his head and said,
“You don’t need to do anything, just follow Brother Lin.”
“As for Brother Lin…”
At this point, Lu Youjiu looked towards Lin Jing and said,
“Brother Lin, your Shadow Escape Flying Boat has exceptionally strong concealment abilities, and we need to use your flying boat this time.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“No problem!”
“What do I need to do?”
Lu Youjiu said,
“The operation at the Changyun Clan has been fully arranged, and we should avoid causing too much commotion, so we won’t need too many people.
I can go by myself.”
“In a while, I will leave first.”
“Then, you take San He and Niu San with you and head to Black Rock Island, the place we discussed before.”
“After you arrive at Black Rock Island, the three of you just wait there.
I will bring Yuanshuang and Lin Jue to Black Rock Island and meet up with you.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help expressing his concern:
“Going alone, isn’t that too risky?”
But Lu Youjiu shook his head, saying,
“It’s actually safer because it’s just me.”
