“The most important thing is to deceive Yuanshuang’s uncles, and Yuanshuang has already made arrangements for it during this time.”
“Even for myself, to put it plainly, I’m merely there to meet them.”
“So, there won’t be any danger at all.”
“Having you go to Black Rock Island ahead of time is also because the risk of being discovered increases significantly with more people.”
“For the sake of being cautious, it’s better for me to go meet them alone.”
Lin Kai heard this and nodded.
“Okay…”
“Then we’ll do as you say, and head to Black Rock Island.”
…
…
After the discussion, Lu Youjiu left.
Lu Youjiu left during daylight, and when night fell and the darkness enveloped everything, Lin Jing, Holaw Three Rivers, and Yan Wanfei finally left the courtyard.
After leaving the courtyard, the three of them headed outside and continued until they were away from Liyun Island.
Once Lin Jing saw that there was no one around, he summoned the Shadow Escape Flying Boat.
Then, the three boarded the flying boat, with Lin Jing piloting it towards Black Rock Island.
The Shadow Escape Flying Boat was naturally fast.
And with Lin Jing at the controls, the speed was even faster.
When Lin Jing and the others reached Black Rock Island, it was still before Zi Time.
At this point, Lu Youjiu had probably just started his operation, and there should still be some time before they arrived.
Now, the three of them could only wait there.
…
…
Just like that, almost four hours had passed before Lin Jing finally sensed a familiar aura flying towards them.
Upon feeling this familiar aura, Lin Jing looked in the direction it was coming from.
In the pitch-black night sky, several figures were speeding toward Lin Jing.
Moreover, these figures were moving quickly, and in a short while, they had arrived beside Lin Jing and the others.
Lin Jing looked at the newcomers, the leader of whom was Lu Youjiu, and by Lu Youjiu’s side was a woman of stunning appearance and exceptional demeanor.
If one observed closely, this woman bore some resemblance to Changyun Yuanlei.
Behind the two of them followed another two people.
One of them was indeed Changyun Yuanlei.
The other was Lin Jue, who had not been seen for a long time.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Lin Jue was visibly excited and hurried forward to Lin Jing’s side:
“Brother…”
“I’ve finally seen you.”
Lin Jing then looked at Lin Jue, a smile on his face, Lin Jue hadn’t changed much, still the same as before.
Lin Jing then spoke softly, saying:
“Don’t worry, with me here, everything will be alright.”
Lin Jue looked at Lin Jing and nodded firmly.
Following that.
Lu Youjiu introduced everyone to each other.
Holaw Three Rivers and Yan Wanfei, who often accompanied Lu Youjiu, had been doing so for a long time, and Changyun Yuanshuang was naturally more familiar with them.
The only one who was somewhat unfamiliar was probably Lin Jing.
However, after the introduction of both parties, the first thing Changyun Yuanshuang did was to bow to Lin Jing:
“I have long heard about Lin Daoyou’s deeds from Yuanlei, and I am grateful for the help you offered him before.”
“If it had not been for you, Yuanlei could have perished within the Sea of Strange.”
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly gathered Spiritual Power to lift Changyun Yuanshuang:
“Daoyou needn’t be so formal.”
“Yuanlei and I have had a certain fate, and saving him was only natural.”
At this moment, Lu Youjiu spoke from the side, saying:
“Brother Lin indeed has a life-saving grace for Yuanlei.”
“But now is not the time to discuss this, we need to leave here as quickly as possible.
If we delay and they discover something, it won’t be easy to leave.”
Lin Jing also nodded and said:
“Indeed so.”
“Let’s leave first, then discuss the rest.”
Changyun Yuanshuang, hearing this, also nodded and said:
“Indeed so…”
After that.
Without further delay, everyone boarded the Flying Boat and quickly left the area.
After all, they were still close to the Changyun Clan, and it was not wise to linger.
If delayed any longer and discovered by Yuanlei’s uncles and aunts, it would be difficult for them to leave.
This was exactly what Lu Youjiu was worried about.
…
After the Flying Boat had flown a certain distance, Lin Jing spoke to Lu Youjiu:
“Brother Lu, where do we head next?”
Lu Youjiu then spoke:
“Southward, we’ll return to the Southern Outer Sea.”
“In fact, the real difficulties began as soon as we left the Changyun Clan.”
“Yuanshuang’s uncles will surely try to search for us and find a way to bring us back.”
“Only by first leaving the Inner Sea can we temporarily avoid them.”
Lin Jing nodded, then turned to look at Changyun Yuanlei, who was sizing up Lin Jue:
“Actually, I meant to ask before, I remember our plan didn’t include Changyun Yuanlei…”
“So how did he end up coming along with us?”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Changyun Yuanlei immediately realized, and quickly began to complain to Lin Jing:
“Big brother…”
“You know what it’s like.”
“I’ve always suffered in the family, constantly being watched, without any freedom.”
“They say that until I reach Divinity Transformation, I must be supervised…”
“But becoming a Divinity Transformation, that’s not so easy.”
“It just so happened that my brother-in-law was planning to elope with my sister, so I could take the chance to come out and have some fun with you guys.”
“Big brother, you can’t leave me behind.”
“If they take me back, it really would be worse than death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 789
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 789: Chapter 350 Escape Chapter 789: Chapter 350 Escape In the Demonic Beast Inner Sea, southwest sea area.
In this southwest sea area, there is a sea area devoid of any islands, which is extremely unique.
At first glance, it seems no different from a normal sea area.
However, deep within this sea area, many sea Demonic Beasts are lurking in the dark.
Moreover, these Demonic Beasts are extremely aggressive, launching attacks whenever they sense a cultivator’s presence.
Additionally, although this sea area is located within the Inner Sea, the Spiritual Energy here is somewhat inferior even compared to the Outer Seas.
Precisely for this reason, despite its considerable size, very few cultivators venture here.
...
However, today this sea area welcomes some visitors.
At this moment, a flying boat is rapidly cutting through this sea area, leaving behind a trail of energy between the azure skies and the Tianhai Sea.
This flying boat is moving quickly, as if it’s in a hurry to reach its destination, or perhaps it’s fleeing from something.
As the flying boat passes by, the terrifying aura it emits sweeps over the sea surface, stirring the sea Demonic Beasts hidden beneath.
Feeling the aura, the Demonic Beasts don’t flee in all directions like others would, but instead, they promptly surface, their blood-red eyes scanning the surroundings.
Yet the people on the flying boat pay no heed to these sea Demonic Beasts.
After skimming over the water, they immediately continue forward.
By the time the sea Demonic Beasts have surfaced, the flying boat is already nowhere to be seen.
After surfacing and failing to locate the swiftly passing flying boat, the Demonic Beasts linger for a moment before submerging back into the sea.
The entire sea surface then returns to calm once more.
Just as the sea had returned to tranquil,
two figures swiftly flew over the sea.
As these two figures flew by, the Demonic Beasts immediately sensed them.
ɴονǤօ.ƈο
As the two people flew past, the sea Demonic Beasts, already primed to attack, leapt from the water and launched an assault.
These Demonic Beasts are not very strong.
However, they are numerous.
In an instant, dozens of them were attacking the two people.
But as these Demonic Beasts began their attack, a voice rang out from midair.
“These oblivious beasts are such a nuisance…”
Following that voice, a terrifying wave of aura emanated from midair.
A massive light seal descended from above, crashing down, and upon contact, the bodies of these Demonic Beasts instantly exploded.
In a moment, all the attacking Demonic Beasts were dead, their blood copiously spilling into the sea.
This stained the area of the sea red.
After the light seal struck, the surrounding sea surface returned to peace once more.
At this point, one of the two spoke to the person who had deployed the light seal:
“After that delay, I’m afraid they’ve gotten even further away.”
The person who had deployed the light seal remained calm:
“No worries…”
“The deeper we go into this sea area, the stronger the Demonic Beasts become.
Even if they have a flying boat, if they disturb those Demonic Beasts in the central region, they won’t be able to escape.”
“Moreover, with their cultivation, thinking they can cross this sea area is nothing but a fool’s dream.”
“Don’t rush.
I believe they wouldn’t dare venture too deep.
They must be trying to use this place to shake us off and then run away in another direction.”
“We just need to keep chasing.”
The other person looked at the vast expanse of red below them and then said:
“Although these Demonic Beasts are not strong, they are somewhat troublesome; we can’t keep getting delayed by them.”
The cultivator who had cast the light seal also looked down at the sea surface and then nodded, saying:
“Indeed!”
“Next, we can slow down a bit and hide our own aura, trying our best not to disturb these Demonic Beasts.”
The other person, hearing this, nodded:
“That seems the only way.”
Subsequently,
the two concealed their auras and immediately set off, continuing to chase in the direction the flying boat had gone.
…
…
At this moment, in another part of this sea area, within the recently speeding flying boat.
Lin Jing and his group were all inside the flying boat.
Lin Jing was currently piloting the flying boat, while keeping an eye on the external surroundings.
The others inside the flying boat were all looking at Lu Youjiu, who was deep in thought.
For a time, the atmosphere inside the flying boat was rather somber.
After a while, Lu Youjiu suddenly raised his head and then looked at Lin Jing, saying:
“Brother Lin, I’ve made up my mind!”
Hearing this, Lin Jing looked toward Lu Youjiu.
“Made up your mind?”
Lu Youjiu nodded and said:
“Yes!”
“Next, I will sever all contacts with others, and then we’ll change our direction here and enter the Chaotic Sea Area from the southeast.”
“As for the two following us, I’ll be counting on you then, Brother Lin.”
Lin Jing nodded and responded:
“No problem!”
“Just leave those two to me.”
Lu Youjiu then spoke:
“They both have high cultivation, both at the Solidifying Body stage, so you must be careful, Brother Lin.”
Lin Jing replied:
“Don’t worry, dealing with those two is well within my capabilities.”
Lin Jing was naturally very confident in his ability to easily take care of the two tails following them.
One of them was at the mid-stage of the Solidifying Body Realm, and the other was at the later stage of Solidifying Body Realm,
whereas Lin Jing was currently at the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm, just a step away from completing his cultivation and undergoing the Tribulation to enter the Dao Integration Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 790
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 790: Chapter 350: Fugitive_2 Chapter 790: Chapter 350: Fugitive_2 The two of them were simply no match for Lin Jing.
If it weren’t for the fact that Lin Jing had previously tried to avoid causing too much commotion, he would have taken action earlier and resolved the issue with them.
As for why there were other people following behind Lin Jing and his group, we have to start from the beginning, right after several of them escaped from the Changyun Clanâ€¦
After leaving the Changyun Clan, they had intended to depart as quickly as possible, and then use the Teleportation Array in Ninghai City to transmit to another sea city before leaving the Demonic Beasts’ Inner Sea.
ṅοѵǤօ.сο
Although their plan was sound,
plans could never keep up with the changes.
Both Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei had left, even taking Lin Jue with them as they escaped from the Changyun Clan.
The Changyun Clan quickly responded.
...
Once the Changyun Clan had reacted, they immediately began sending out people to scout the nearby seas for their whereabouts.
At the same time, they also thought of the Teleportation Array in Ninghai City, worrying that the group might use it to escape from Ninghai.
There were already people from the Changyun Clan in Ninghai City.
So once they learned that Changyun Yuanshuang and the other two had fled, they immediately notified their clanspeople in Ninghai City.
They set up a guard directly at the Teleportation Plaza, waiting for their arrival.
However, when the group rushed there, they discovered the members of the Changyun Clan guarding the Teleportation Plaza first.
The group could have used their Cultivation Technique to disguise themselves,
but Changyun Yuanlei and Yan Wanfei’s Cultivation was too weak, and even with the disguise, they couldn’t evade the scrutiny of the Changyun Clan.
Even Changyun Yuanshuang was at risk of being discovered.
Therefore, in order to be cautious, the group quickly left Ninghai City before the Changyun Clan became aware of them.
After leaving Ninghai City, the group immediately decided to abandon the use of the Teleportation Array and instead chose to directly board the Flying Boat to leave.
Although they managed to get away this time, the people from the Changyun Clan would certainly not let them escape so easily.
Subsequently,
the group continued to flee amidst the pursuit and blockade of the Changyun Clan’s forces, constantly changing their route in an attempt to shake off the entanglement of the Changyun Clan.
During this time, they had two encounters with a team led by the elder Changyun Yuanshuang, aimed at capturing them and taking them back.
The leaders of the Changyun Clan’s task force sent to capture them all possessed Cultivation at the Dao Integration Stage, which was even higher than Lin Jing’s.
Fortunately, the members of the Changyun Clan had no intention of harming them but simply wanted to take them back.
Thus,
during the negotiation with Changyun Yuanshuang, Lin Jing took the opportunity to launch a surprise attack using the Great Dream Ancient Mirror to immobilize the person.
Afterward, they quickly fled the scene.
The Great Dream Ancient Mirror was indeed a rare Daoist Treasure.
With Lin Jing’s current Solidifying Body stage of Cultivation, activating the Great Dream Ancient Mirror could trap even a Dao Integration Stage Cultivator in an illusion, unable to escape the dream realm.
With the help of the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, the group twice turned peril into safety.
Besides the Changyun Clan, after the group had been on the run for a while, they discovered that another power was also searching for them.
This power was different from the Changyun Clan.
When the people from this power encountered them, they did not hesitate at all and launched an attack on them directly.
Luckily, at the beginning, this power was unclear about the combat strength on Lin Jing’s side, so the people they sent in pursuit were no match for Lin Jing.
Lin Jing easily resolved them.
However, as Lin Jing dealt with those they had sent, it seemed that the power also realized something was wrong.
So,
they sent out two more individuals to continue the pursuit, but this time the individuals sent were of a higher tier in Cultivation.
The two Solidifying Body Cultivators chasing behind Lin Jing were those sent by that mysterious power.
And most crucially,
for some unknown reason, that power seemed to be able to easily locate Lin Jing and his group.
Thus,
there followed the conversation between Lin Jing and Lu Youjiu mentioned above.
…
After flying for a while and finding the right moment, Lin Jing left the Flying Boat.
The others continued piloting the Flying Boat forward.
As soon as Lin Jing stepped out of the Flying Boat and exposed some of his aura, he was immediately met with the same fate as the previous two.
Suddenly,
the Demonic Beasts in the sea, sensing his aura, all charged at Lin Jing with bloodshot eyes.
It seemed that due to this sea region’s characteristics, these Demonic Beasts would only attack foreign Cultivators, while they did not engage each other.
The sea Demonic Beasts that attacked Lin Jing were stronger than those that had attacked the previous two Cultivators, with several of the strongest nearing Divinity Transformation.
Apart from those Demonic Beasts that lunged at Lin Jing, there were more than a dozen others hiding within the sea, controlling various Spells to launch attacks on Lin Jing.
However,
although these Demonic Beasts were somewhat stronger, they were still no match for Lin Jing.
Lin Jing simply activated the Five Elements Divine Art, and immediately countless strands of Five-Colored Aurora rose around him.
Once the Five-Colored Aurora appeared, it quickly struck at the Demonic Beasts assaulting Lin Jing.
“Pft”
“Pft”
“Pft…”
The Five-Colored Aurora passed through their bodies, tearing them apart before they plummeted into the sea below.
Suddenly,
the sea’s surface was dyed a bright red with blood, and a dense stench of blood filled the air.
With Lin Jing’s move, tranquility returned to the sea area, leaving behind only the crimson surface and the strong scent of blood.
Thereafter, Lin Jing extended his Divine Sense over the sea.
Having scanned the sea and ensured there were no more Demonic Beasts in the vicinity, Lin Jing then directly entered the System Space right there.

chapters.title: Chapter 791
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 791: Chapter 350 Escape_3 Chapter 791: Chapter 350 Escape_3 In this place, leaving behind a scent to attract these sea Demonic Beasts, as well as causing such a commotion, was all deliberately done by Lin Jing.
Since he wanted to deal with those two, following him like a tail, he obviously had to attract them first.
And entering the System Space was because Lin Jing didn’t want to go through too much trouble.
Since he planned to take care of the two, he wanted to make it quick and decisive.
…
…
After Lin Jing entered the System Space and his presence vanished, some time passed before those previously dispersed sea Demonic Beasts returned to this place once more.
...
Upon their return, the bodies of the dead Demonic Beasts were devoured by the others until nothing was left.
Even the blood that was floating on the sea surface was gradually dissipating, leaving behind only traces of red, drifting on the nearby waters.
It was at this moment.
Two figures were rapidly flying in from a distance.
These two figures were the two Solidifying Body Realm Cultivators who were in pursuit of Lin Jing and his companions.
After arriving at this place, the two of them stopped.
One of them frowned slightly and looked down at the sea surface.
“They seemed to have been detected by the Demonic Beasts here, which is why they took action and killed the beasts,” said the other.
“The bloodstains are almost gone.
It seems that some time has already passed,” he added.
The one who spoke was in the later stage of the Solidifying Body Realm, the highest in Cultivation among the two of them, and he was clearly the leader.
No sooner had he spoken…
The other, a mid-stage Solidifying Body Cultivator, said:
“We received a message from our young master earlier.
The Flying Boat they were on seems quite extraordinary in terms of concealment.”
“But now they’ve suddenly exposed their presence.
Could something have gone wrong?” he asked.
The later-stage Solidifying Body Cultivator said:
“It’s possible…”
“However, the message the young master received might be inaccurate.
There must be someone quite extraordinary among their party; otherwise, the group before us wouldn’t have suffered losses.”
“We need to be careful as well.”
…
The mid-stage Solidifying Body Cultivator said:
“Hmm, I understand.”
“I will be cautious…”
…
…
Yet before he could finish his sentence, a terrifyingly powerful aura suddenly appeared near them.
This dreadful presence materialized so bizarrely.
However, as a mid-stage Solidifying Body Cultivist, his reaction was very swift.
The instant that aura appeared, he hastily extended his Divine Sense and turned his head to look toward the source of the presence.
As he turned, he saw that behind his companion, a young Cultivator had suddenly appeared without notice.
Moreover, the Cultivation aura emanating from the young Cultivator was extremely frightening, at the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm, even higher than theirs.
What filled him with even more dread was that the young Cultivator had already placed a hand on his later-stage Solidifying Body companion.
Countless streams of Five-Colored Aurora burst forth from his hand, piercing through the body of his companion…
Beyond his shock, his fear intensified.
But before he could react, an incredibly formidable Divine Sense, surged into his own sea of consciousness.
In an instant, his Divine Sense sustained damage.
While the damage to his Divine Sense was not fatal, it caused his head to feel heavy and groggy.
For a short time, it would be difficult to gather his Divine Sense again.
Nevertheless…
During such a critical moment, he had no choice but to forcibly muster his Divine Sense to face the imminent crisis.
Ɲονǥᴑ.ᴄο
Yet.
Just as he was mustering his Divine Sense and turning to look at the young man again, he saw that the young man had somehow produced a mirror Magical Treasure in his hand.
The moment his gaze fell on the Magical Treasure, a beam of light emitted from the mirror and shot towards him.
The opponent was prepared, and he could not avoid it.
He was hit directly by the beam, and upon being struck, he felt groggy, as if about to slip into slumber.
Even the Divine Sense he had just gathered could no longer hold out and began to dissipate gradually.
Right at this moment of drowsiness, a sleep-inducing, mellifluous voice reached his ears:
“Who is your young master?”
Hearing this voice, already groggy and completely off guard, without considering, he blurted out the answer to the other’s question:
“Our young master is Xiao…”

chapters.title: Chapter 792
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 792: Chapter 351 Heading to the Lin Family Ruins Chapter 792: Chapter 351 Heading to the Lin Family Ruins He had barely spoken when a sudden alertness surged in his heart, snapping him awake.
Afterward.
His heart filled with terror, he awoke from the brink of sleep.
When he looked again at Lin Jing, his eyes were full of fear.
At that moment.
It wasn’t just him.
Even his companion, who had just escaped from Lin Jing’s grasp, turned around and looked at Lin Jing with eyes full of fear.
...
Lin Jing’s appearance was so abrupt that both of them had no time to prepare, and Lin Jing’s cultivation was much higher than theirs.
The cultivator at the late stage of the Solidifying Body Realm had also struggled with all his might to escape from Lin Jing’s hold.
Although he had managed to escape, he was severely injured.
At that moment, the two exchanged a look and, without any hesitation, immediately scattered in two directions, preparing to flee.
However, all their movements were under Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surveillance.
Even before they had begun to think about escaping, Lin Jing was already prepared.
Just as they thought of fleeing, a voice issued from Lin Jing:
“Divine SkillsÂ·Five Elements Domain!”As the words fell from Lin Jing’s mouth, both felt instantly that their surroundings were enveloped by a strange force of Five Elements Spiritual Force.
ɴονǤο.ƈο
This Five Elements Spiritual Force not only couldn’t be absorbed by them but was actively resisting them.
Both felt as if they were trapped in a quagmire, trying to escape but continuously pulled back by the numerous Five Elements Spiritual Forces around them, unable to break free.
Even.
They couldn’t even connect with the spiritual power of heaven and earth to perform Divine Arts.
The Five Elements Spiritual Force had formed its own space, isolating them from the outside world.
Unless they left this Domain, they couldn’t harness any external spiritual power.
Looking around at the brilliant and beautiful Five Elements Spiritual Force, both felt a surge of despair that left them feeling helpless.
…
…
Lin Jing had never intended to let them go.
The attack on the mid Solidifying Body Realm cultivator had already provided him with some clues.
Afterward, the two became useless.
Following that,
Lin Jing showed no mercy and directly killed them both, ending the lives of two cultivators whose cultivation had lasted hundreds to thousands of years at the Solidifying Body Realm, all by Lin Jing’s hand.
After their deaths, Lin Jing collected their Space Rings and also retracted the Five Elements Divine Technique.
This was probably the first time Lin Jing had used the Divine Arts since entering the Solidifying Body Realm; upon entering the Solidifying Body Realm, his Divine Arts had grown stronger, but they consumed more energy as well.
He had not held back in the least, operating the Five Elements Domain at full strength just to trap them and resolve the situation quickly.
Under Lin Jing’s full operation of the Five Elements Domain, the effectiveness of the Five Elements Domain was naturally unquestionableâ€”the two injured Solidifying Body Realm cultivators couldn’t resist at all within the domain.
They were then easily killed by Lin Jing.
After retracting the Five Elements Domain, Lin Jing couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief; maintaining the high-intensity Five Elements Domain had also consumed a lot of his energy.
After taking a short break, Lin Jing glanced in the direction Lu Youjiu and the others had left and then followed them.
…
…
Lin Jing was quick and in less than four hours, he caught up with Lu Youjiu and the others.
After catching up with them, Lin Jing immediately called Lu Youjiu aside and shared the information he had gathered with him.
“Xiao…
After hearing what Lin Jing said, Lu Youjiu’s brows furrowed slightly; he lowered his head, pondering Lin Jing’s words.
A moment later, Lu Youjiu raised his head, looking at Lin Jing and said,
“Actually, I had suspected this matter as well.”
“After all, our route was known by almost no one, and brother Xiao Xu was one of the few who knew…
“Xiao Xu’s family and ours have been as close as kin…”
“So, I have always been reluctant to believe that brother Xiao Xu could be involved.”
“But now it seems there might be more to this matter…”
Having said that, Lu Youjiu looked at Lin Jing and spoke,
“Involving you, Brother Lin, I truly feel sorry.”
Lin Jing then waved his hand and said,
“Brother Lu, you’re being too formal.”
Having said so,
Lin Jing directly took out two Space Rings from his person and handed them to Lu Youjiu:
“These are their Space Rings.
When you have the time to break the seals, you can check them for any clues.”
Lu Youjiu nodded and said,
“With this, I’m much obliged to you, Brother Lin.”
Then, Lu Youjiu took the Space Rings and continued to Lin Jing,
“These two Space Rings are rightfully your spoils of war.
After I have examined them, I’ll return them for you to deal with.”
Lin Jing then spoke:
“There’s no hurry, let Brother Lu review them first…”
Afterward, the two returned to the Flying Boat.
For the time being, they chose not to disclose this matter to anyone else, given its connection to Lu Youjiu’s family affairs.
Subsequently, the group continued on their journey.
Having already agreed on a course, this time, Lin Jing piloted the Flying Boat directly towards the southeast.
…
…
The southeast sea area of the Inner Sea was previously controlled by one of the Inner Sea’s top five forces, the Ancient Alchemy Family of the Lin Family.
Though the Lin Family rarely appeared in public, they held sway over the entire southeast sea area.
With the Lin Family around, no power dared to cause trouble in this part of the Inner Sea.
However.
The Lin Family was unexpectedly struck by tragedy ten thousand years ago.
That sudden calamity caused the Ancient Alchemy Family, which had survived since the Ancient Era, to rapidly decline and eventually, they perished completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 793
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 793: Chapter 351: Heading to the Lin Family Ruins_2 Chapter 793: Chapter 351: Heading to the Lin Family Ruins_2 Without the restraint of the Lin Family, the entire southeastern maritime area suddenly plunged into chaos.
And because the decline of Lin Jing had been too bizarre, it was as if it had been cursed by the heavens.
Therefore, those major forces that knew of the Lin Family’s annihilation avoided the southeastern maritime area like the plague.
Even though the Lin Family had been destroyed a long time ago, no major force dared to occupy this region of the southeastern maritime area.
And so, the entire southeastern maritime area became a place of chaos under such circumstances.
Until now, even though the Lin Family had been extinct for ten thousand years, there was still no force occupying this southeastern maritime area.
And this southeastern maritime area had completely become an ownerless Chaotic Sea Area.
...
After spending almost a year, Lin Jing and his companions finally arrived at the southeastern maritime area from the southwestern maritime area.
During this period, they did not contact the outside world, which saved them a lot of trouble and they did not encounter any squads from the Lin Family chasing them again.
In the meantime,
Lin Jing had once disguised himself and entered one of the Immortal Cities to gather some information.
After Lin Jing’s investigation, he discovered that the Changyun Clan was indeed pursuing them, but the intensity was not as great as before.
It seemed as if the Changyun Clan had encountered some other troubles that drew their attention, hence the reduced effort in their pursuit.
Perhaps it was really good luck.
Ɲονǥᴑ.сօ
During this time, they did not even encounter anyone sent by Xiao Xu.
The group traveled very smoothly all the way from the southwestern maritime area to the southeastern maritime area.
After entering the southeastern maritime area, it seemed different from other maritime areas; they flew for a long time without seeing anyone.
Even if they encountered islands, most were uninhabited and deserted.
Especially in recent days, they had flown over the sea for a long time without seeing a single person.
Just as Lin Jing was puzzled by this, Changyun Yuanshuang spoke up:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“The position we are in now is actually not far from the island where the Lin Family used to be.”
“Because the annihilation of the Lin Family was too bizarre, perhaps due to superstition, subsequent maritime charts have never marked the Lin Family ruins again.”
“You see, these past few days we haven’t seen anyone at all, which is precisely because people are too scared to approach the vicinity of the Lin Family ruins.”
“Now that we have come here, do you and your sister want to take a look at the Lin Family ruins?”
Upon hearing these words, Lin Jing was taken aback before turning to look at Lin Jue.
Hearing what Changyun Yuanshuang said, Lin Jue also looked at Lin Jing, and then the two of them fell silent together.
Although they carried the bloodline of the Lin Family, they had never had any contact with the real Lin Family.
Yet, suddenly being informed by Changyun Yuanshuang that they were close to the Lin Family ruins, perhaps out of fear for the familiar or because it was too sudden…
After learning of this, the two of them were not joyous, but rather felt a kind of silence.
And the rest of the group could not help but turn their gazes to Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
After a moment of silence, Yan Wanfei was the first to speak, saying to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin…”
“I think you should take a look, after all, no matter what, you are people of the Lin Family.”
As soon as Yan Wanfei’s words fell, Changyun Yuanlei also chimed in:
“Yeah, big brother…”
“Why not visit the Lin Family for once?
I’ve always heard the elders in my family talk about the Lin Family but have never seen it with my own eyes.”
And the remaining Changyun Yuanshuang, Lu Youjiu, and Holaw Three Rivers looked towards Lin Jing, waiting for his answer.
At this moment, Lin Jue spoke up.
Lin Jue looked at Lin Jing and said softly:
“Brother…”
“Let’s go take a look, shall we?
I’ve often heard grandfather talk about some deeds of the Lin Family, and I would also like to see them.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing nodded:
“Alright…”
Having said that, Lin Jing turned to look at Changyun Yuanshuang.
Then, guided by Changyun Yuanshuang, Lin Jing changed direction and flew towards the ruins of the Lin Family.
While on the way to the Lin Family ruins, Lin Jing said to Changyun Yuanshuang:
“Changyun Daoyou…”
“Please tell me what you know about the Lin Family.”
Changyun Yuanshuang nodded and then began to recount:
“Regarding the affairs of the Lin Family, part of it was told to me by my grandfather, while another part was found in our clan’s library.”
“Because the Lin Family previously had very close relations with our Changyun Clan, the records we hold about the Lin Family are considered the most complete.”
…
“When it comes to the destruction of the Changyun Clan, it is indeed related to divine punishment…”
Upon hearing this, not only Lin Jing and Lin Jue,
but the others as well couldn’t help but look towards Changyun Yuanshuang, obviously, they were not very familiar with this matter.
“Divine punishment?”
“Why would there be divine punishment?”
Lin Jing looked towards Changyun Yuanshuang and asked.
Changyun Yuanshuang straightforwardly opened her mouth and said,
“Because of a legendary Elixir Medicine!”
“Elixir Medicine?”
When the crowd heard about the Lin Family’s Elixir Medicine, they all showed a surprised expression.
Of course,
except for Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei.
When Lin Jing heard about the Elixir Medicine, he couldn’t help but glance at Changyun Yuanlei next to him, and Changyun Yuanlei scratched his head and looked towards Lin Jing, awkwardly smiling.
About this legendary elixir, Lin Jing had previously asked Changyun Yuanlei when they were in the Water Element Realm.
And what Changyun Yuanlei had told Lin Jing, was not much different from what Changyun Yuanshuang said.
Only that Changyun Yuanlei knew about it because he had by chance overheard a conversation between the elders, different from Changyun Yuanshuang’s own investigation.
Changyun Yuanshuang continued to speak, adding,
“Back in the day, the Lin Family wanted to create an Elixir Medicine.”
“This Elixir Medicine was far from ordinary and it was precisely during its creation that they encountered divine punishment.”
“And it was this divine punishment that was the true reason behind the Lin Family’s downfall.”
Upon hearing Changyun Yuanshuang’s words, the crowd unanimously inhaled a breath of cold air, especially Lin Jue, who was filled with indescribable shock.
Who would have thought that the great Lin Family would be destroyed because of an Elixir Medicine, and everyone was curious about the Elixir Medicine that could attract divine punishment.
At this time, Lin Jing spoke up and asked,
“Do you know what that divine punishment-attracting Elixir Medicine actually is?”
Changyun Yuanshuang shook her head and said,
“What exactly the Elixir Medicine was, I don’t know either.
For this reason, I once asked my grandfather and great-grandfather, but when I asked about that Elixir Medicine, they kept silent as well.”
“And within the family, I also did not find any records about that Elixir Medicine.”
“Grandfather and great-grandfather didn’t speak, but I knew they must be aware of something.
Only, the matter of the Elixir Medicine was of great significance, which is why they didn’t tell me.”
After hearing this, everyone nodded.
Such a powerful Elixir Medicine was certainly not something they would be privy to.
Lin Jing also couldn’t help but sigh; he had originally thought that Changyun Yuanshuang might know something.
But even she did not know.
Subsequently.
Changyun Yuanshuang looked towards Lin Jing and began to speak:
“Lin Daoyou…”
“I wanted to ask you just now, upon hearing this matter of the Elixir Medicine, you seem not startled at all?”
“Could it be that you know something about it?”
Before Lin Jing could answer, Changyun Yuanlei on the side was the first to speak up to Changyun Yuanshuang:
“Sister…”
“About this matter of the Elixir Medicine, I had previously spoken to Big Brother Lin in the Five Elements Ruins, and I also told him some things.”
Upon hearing what Changyun Yuanlei said, Changyun Yuanshuang was also somewhat surprised:
“How did you come to know of this?”
Changyun Yuanlei somewhat sheepishly said,
“There was a chance event before, when I eavesdropped on grandfather speaking, and they mentioned it, so I remembered.”
After saying this, Changyun Yuanlei continued,
“But the things I heard are not more than what sister you know.”
“Thinking back now, I was probably discovered by grandfather early on, but he just didn’t expose me.”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanshuang was all the more speechless.
She didn’t expect that the information she had obtained by investigating and consulting various texts had already been acquired by Changyun Yuanlei through eavesdropping.
Changyun Yuanlei truly deserved to be the successor the family intended to cultivate, to be so indulged by grandfather…

chapters.title: Chapter 794
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 794: Chapter 352 Hidden Enemies in the Dark Chapter 794: Chapter 352 Hidden Enemies in the Dark Afterwards,
Changyun Yuanshuang continued to speak to Lin Jing,
“Since Yuanlei has already told you, I will tell you another matter regarding the Lin Family.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded his head.
Then, Changyun Yuanshuang continued,
“Your Lin Family and our Changyun Clan actually have a common enemy, but this enemy has always been hiding in the shadows and has not shown any trace until now.”
Lin Jing was taken aback upon hearing this,
“There is actually such a matter…”
Changyun Yuanshuang nodded and said,
“That enemy is likely a force.”
“This force lurks in the dark, constantly scheming against our family, even the injury my grandfather suffered before was their doing.”
“I learned this from my grandfather, and it was just before he closed himself off for recuperation that he told me about this.”
“Before this, I didn’t mention it as my grandfather didn’t allow me to reveal it until the critical moment, and then tell the successor of the Lin Family.”
“I never understood why my grandfather did this…”
“Now, it seems my grandfather probably knew something.
The successor of the Lin Family he mentioned might not be Lin Jue but you, Lin Daoyou.”
“Me?”“My grandfather actually knew of me?”
After hearing Changyun Yuanshuang’s explanation, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling astounded.
Before Lin Jing had come to the Inner Sea, Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather had already sequestered himself, so how could he have known about him?
“Could it be that they had already started investigating me, knowing my identity?”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but ponder in his mind.
The astonished ones were not only Lin Jing but also the others present.
Changyun Yuanlei even spoke up at this moment,
“Grandfather actually knew about Brother Lin, how come I knew nothing at all?”
Changyun Yuanshuang looked at Changyun Yuanlei, then spoke,
“Grandfather told me this before he closed off, and it was just now that I suddenly understood his intention in telling me this.”
After listening, Lin Jing remained silent for a moment.
...
Then he spoke to Changyun Yuanshuang,
“Changyun Daoyou, please continue!”
Changyun Yuanshuang nodded and then continued,
“According to my grandfather, before the destruction of the Lin Family, it wasn’t just because of that Elixir Medicine, but also because that hidden power had made a move.”
As soon as Changyun Yuanshuang finished speaking, Lin Jing furrowed his brows and directly spoke,
“Regarding the matter of the Lin Family, I’ve also conducted my own investigations.”
“As far as I know, before the destruction of the Lin Family, it seemed as though they had encountered a curse, with many family members perishing unexpectedly, but no enemy was ever seen.”
“Just like what your Changyun Clan is experiencing now.”
Changyun Yuanshuang nodded and said,
“Exactly!”
“Indeed, that’s the case.”
“Ever since accidents started occurring in our family, many of our family members have been wounded or perished due to various bizarre incidents.”
“And my grandfather was constantly searching but never encountered any enemy.”
“And because no enemy was seen, it proves one thing, that the enemy hiding behind this uses extraordinary methods.”
“My grandfather was investigating these enemies hidden in the dark, while also trying to figure out the methods they were using.”
“Only…”
“My grandfather had not been investigating long when he was injured in an accident and had to close off to recuperate.”
After listening, Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown in thought.
“What method can be used in such a way that one’s opposition continues to encounter accidents?”
“Could it be a curse?”
Just as Lin Jing thought of the curse, Yan Wanfei spoke up at that time,
“I heard that in the Northern Devil Region, there’s a strange Demonic Path Technique, the Demonic Curse Technique, which can put people to death out of thin air.”
“Could it be that Demonic Curse Technique?”
As soon as Yan Wanfei finished speaking, Lu Youjiu shook his head and said,
“It can’t be that Demonic Curse Technique.”
“Any technique related to curses always has traces that can be followed, some require prior contact with the victim and they leave hard-to-detect marks.”
“Other Curse Techniques may not require direct contact with the victim but rather involve using Divine Sense.”
“Once the curse is applied, the power of the Divine Sense is immediately detected by the other party, and the victim then understands that someone has cast a Curse Technique on them.”
“Neither the people of the Lin Family previously, nor the members of the Changyun Clan now, have noticed any signs of being cursed before the incidents.”
“Moreover, those Curse Techniques mostly target only those cultivators who are lower in cultivation than oneself.
If faced with cultivators of higher cultivation, it might even backfire, resulting in a loss greater than the gain.”
“And whether it’s the previous Lin Family or the current Changyun Family, all those involved in accidents were not low in cultivation.”
“Therefore, the accidents likely weren’t caused by Curse Techniques.”
Changyun Yuanshuang also nodded at this point and said,
“It’s like that.”
“The members of our family didn’t notice any signs of being cursed before the incidents occurred.”
The bizarreness of the situation was truly inconceivable and far beyond the simple speculations of Lin Jing and the others.
After discussing for a while, the group ended the topic.
Nevertheless, after the topic had ended,
Lin Jing’s furrowed brow had yet to smooth out.
Clearly, Lin Jing was truly concerned about this matter.
ɴοѵǤᴑ.сο
…
A day passed swiftly, and after another day’s flight, the group finally arrived at the ruins of the Lin Family.

chapters.title: Chapter 795
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 795: Chapter 352: The Enemy Hidden in the Shadows_2 Chapter 795: Chapter 352: The Enemy Hidden in the Shadows_2 The Lin Family’s former residence was a massive island.
The size of the island was such that even if the Seven Seas Hall’s seven sea cities were combined, they would still be inferior.
However, the catastrophe ten thousand years ago completely destroyed the entire Lin Family.
Moreover, the island where the Lin Family resided was shattered by divine punishment, sinking into the sea.
Only the areas furthest from divine punishment and some of the outer edges of the island remained above the sea surface.
Lin Jing and his group approached the vicinity of the Lin Family ruins.
As soon as they reached this area, Lin Jing saw a crescent-shaped narrow island lying on the water before him.
...
At that moment, Changyun Yuanshuang spoke up to Lin Jing,
“The crescent-shaped island below is actually part of Ganlin Island.
After the divine calamity, all that remains of the entire Ganlin Island is this small piece.”
Ganlin Island was the island where the Lin Family used to reside.
Lin Jing looked at the narrow crescent-shaped island below, silently nodding without saying a word.
At that moment.
Changyun Yuanlei spoke up to Lin Jing,
“Older brother, let’s go down and have a look.”“Okay…”
Lin Jing nodded, responding with agreement.
Afterward, Lin Jing steered the Flying Boat above the crescent-shaped island, before descending.
Then.
Lin Jing and the others stepped out of the Flying Boat and stood on the island, looking around.
Now the island was dense with trees and rich in Spiritual Energy, no different from ordinary islands.
Yet as soon as he set foot on the island, Lin Jing felt a sense of familiarity, a feeling that came from his bloodline.
After surveying the area, Changyun Yuanlei couldn’t help but remark,
“Just how terrifying was the calamity that occurred back then?”
“Such a large island, yet only so little remains.”
The moment Changyun Yuanlei’s voice faded, Yan Wanfei nodded incessantly,
“Indeed…”
“Just from looking at the little that’s left of this island, one can imagine just how vast the island must have been before.”
At this time, Holaw Three Rivers spoke up to the two,
“I’ve read in some books that the area of Ganlin Island ranked highly in the entire Demonic Monster Sea.
It was even greater than Qihai City combined.”
Hearing this, the two couldn’t help but click their tongues in astonishment.
And at that moment, Changyun Yuanshuang also spoke up,
“And that’s not all…”
“According to rumors, the Lin Family once had an independent space, the Lin Family Secret Realm.
The Secret Realm was where the true core of the Lin Family lay.”
“However, after the Lin Family experienced that catastrophe and was destroyed, the Secret Realm also completely vanished without a trace.”
“Some say…”
“The Secret Realm was obliterated along with the catastrophe.”
“But others say…”
“The Secret Realm wasn’t destroyed with the catastrophe; instead, because the catastrophe nearly wiped out all of the Lin Family’s senior members, the method to enter the Secret Realm was also lost, and naturally, the Secret Realm became inaccessible.”
“For ten thousand years, in fact, many have tried to find the Lin Family’s Secret Realm, but none have succeeded.”
After speaking, Changyun Yuanshuang looked toward Lin Jing and added,
“Perhaps you, Lin Daoyou, could find it?”
Lin Jing first glanced at Lin Jue, who at that moment had a melancholic gaze, surveying her surroundings.
Lin Jing also looked around and then spoke,
“I also know some about the Lin Family Secret Realm.”
“But given the current situation, and that only so little of Ganlin Island remains, even if there is a Secret Realm, I suppose it was likely destroyed under that catastrophe, wasn’t it?”
At this time.
Lin Jue came over, walking up to Lin Jing,
“Brother…”
“Shall we take a look around here?”
Lin Jing looked at Lin Jue, who had an indescribable emotion in her eyes, seemingly more affected than himself.
It was to be expected.
Even though Lin Jing carried the Lin Family’s bloodline, he initially didn’t know his own identity, and it was only later that he learned of his connection to the Lin Family.
And there was another point.
The current Lin Jing, having crossed over from Earth, felt some emotion for the Lin Family, but it wasn’t very deep.
ɴονǤο.сᴑ
This contrasted with Lin Jue.
Lin Jue, since childhood, was taught and nurtured by her grandfather, having a much deeper sense of family than Lin Jing.
Lin Jing looked at Lin Jue and then nodded.
Afterward.
Lin Jing led Lin Jue, flying towards the sunken parts of the island, while Lu Youjiu and the others, seeing this, also rose into the air, following behind Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
As Lin Jing flew above the sea surface with Lin Jue, he also activated Observation Mode.
There is no need to be within the System Space to use Observation Mode, which is undoubtedly much more convenient.
Moreover, because of the System’s uniqueness, even Lin Jue, walking beside Lin Jing, had not noticed anything unusual about him.
While flying, Lin Jing also extended Observation Mode into the seabed to examine the previous appearance of Ganlin Island.
However,
even though he used Observation Mode, Lin Jing saw the appearance of the sea bottom.
But with ten thousand years having passed, the island that sank to the seabed had long fused completely with it and was indistinguishable.
Thus, Lin Jing took Lin Jue forward, flying towards the center of where Ganlin Island once was.
It was said that there lay the real residence of the Lin Family.
The farther they flew, the stronger Lin Jing felt the kinship from his bloodline.
At this moment, Lin Jue suddenly spoke up:
“Brother…”
“I feel as if there is something ahead that is calling to me.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was first startled, then turned his head to look at Lin Jue.
Lin Jue continued:
“It seems to be related to the Secret Realm key within my body.”
“The Secret Realm key, has it responded?”
“Could it be that the Secret Realm truly survived under that terrifying catastrophe?”
Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel surprised.
Lin Jue said:
“Perhaps…”
“But right now, I only have a faint sense of it, as for any other details, I am not sure.”
“Let’s go, let’s have a look…”
After saying that, Lin Jing sped up even more, flying towards the direction in front of them.
And the few people who had been following behind Lin Jing, seeing him accelerate, also quickened their pace to follow.
As the two of them continued to fly towards the center of the former Ganlin Island, the feeling of kinship from Lin Jing’s bloodline became increasingly intense.
And the sensation of being called to, that Lin Jue felt, also grew stronger and stronger.
Finally, after several hours of flying,
Lin Jing and his party arrived at the center of Ganlin Island.
Here, Lin Jing heeded Lin Jue’s instructions and stopped.
Then, Lin Jue, looking down at the sea below, said to Lin Jing:
“Brother…”
“I feel it, it should be right beneath us.”
No sooner had Lin Jue finished than Yan Wanfei, who had just caught up, asked:
“What’s beneath us?”
“The Lin Family Secret Realm?”
Lin Jing and Lin Jue’s conversation had already been overheard by the group.
Lin Jing knew this, of course.
They were all not outsiders, and Lin Jing had never intended to keep them in the dark.
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“The Lin Family Secret Realm might be here.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei’s eyes lit up:
“Truly worthy of brother Lin, the Secret Realm of the Lin Family that so many have sought without success, was located by brother Lin as soon as he arrived.”
Holaw Three Rivers then pursed his lips and said:
“So many people…”
“Do they also have the Lin Family bloodline?”
Hearing this, Yan Wanfei quickly responded sheepishly:
“Indeed, haha…”
Lin Jing then spoke up:
“Actually, it’s not just the Lin Family bloodline…”
“Never mind, let’s go down first, you’ll understand soon enough.”
Having said that, Lin Jing took the lead, bringing Lin Jue with him, descending towards the sea below.
And seeing this, the rest of the group quickly followed, descending towards the sea’s surface.
This place was once the center of Ganlin Island.
It was also where the core members of the Lin Family resided.
Already above the sea’s surface, Lin Jing had once probed the area with Observation Mode.
However,
because it was at the bottom of the sea, most of the building remains Lin Jingzhi had previously seen were already buried under the sea sand.
What little was exposed on the seabed was completely enveloped by various corals and algae, no longer retaining its original appearance.
Even using Observation Mode for the investigation, Lin Jing still couldn’t find the entrance to the Lin Family Secret Realm…

chapters.title: Chapter 796
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 796: Chapter 353: Lu Jingtao, Xiao Yinxuan Chapter 796: Chapter 353: Lu Jingtao, Xiao Yinxuan After entering the bottom of the sea, Lin Jue led the way at the front, while Lin Jing and the others followed behind.
There were Demonic Beasts in the sea, but Lin Jing had already released the aura of his Cultivation when they had dived, deterring the Demonic Beasts.
The beasts dared not approach them at all.
Thus, they continued their descent to the bottom of the sea.
Beneath the seabed lay the ruins of the Lin Family, which had been destroyed and looted long ago.
Various buildings merged into a single view, yet none were intact.
Most of the buildings, in fact, were buried under the sand and mud.
...
Before approaching these structures, Lin Jue first took a moment to sense their surroundings and then swam toward the barely recognizable cluster of buildings.
Upon reaching the cluster, Lin Jue sensed again carefully, felt something, then turned his head toward the nearby area.
In the proximity, besides the indistinguishable building debris, there were various underwater sands and countless chaotic rocks.
It seemed unlikely that anything remained in these ruins of the Lin Family, as the place had been scavenged numerous times since their fall.
If there had been anything valuable, it would have already been taken, leaving nothing behind.
Unable to sense it himself, Lin Jing did not know what had caught Lin Jue’s attention, so he could only watch.
The next moment, Lin Jue moved toward the direction he had been observing.
As soon as Lin Jue arrived there, a dazzling light immediately emanated from his body.
Subsequently, a strange power arose.
This force lifted the long-sealed sand and mud, revealing the inconspicuous rocky ground below.
At that moment,
countless Formation Patterns, initially dim, gradually became brighter and emerged on the ground.
Seeing this, the others also gathered next to Lin Jing, watching Lin Jue in amazement.
At that moment,
a bright light appeared on Lin Jue’s forehead, becoming increasingly prominent.
After a while, the light floated out from Lin Jue’s forehead.
This light, shaped like a crescent moon.
Needless to say, it was the key to entering the Lin Family’s Secret Realm, which Lin Jue had always kept safe.
After the key flew out from Lin Jue’s forehead, the Formation Patterns that were initially floating around Lin Jue also began to gather around the crescent Jade Pendant.
The gathering of the Formation Patterns summoned a special power, and Lin Jue, standing right at the center, was suddenly pushed outward by the force.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly extended his Spiritual Power to pull Lin Jue back to his side.
After pulling Lin Jue back to his side, Lin Jing checked him over and, finding that Lin Jue was unharmed, continued to watch the Formation Patterns in front of them.
At that time,
the Formation Patterns kept changing, and the power emitted by their surroundings grew stronger with the transformation.
Soon, the force triggered the surrounding seawater to form a vortex.
Initially, the vortex was small, but as time passed, it grew larger, affecting Lin Jing and his companions.
Seeing this, they did not dare to delay further,
but retreated to a greater distance.
However,
that was not enough.
Once the vortex had reached a certain size and isolated the surrounding seawater, exposing the entire Formation to the sunlight, a white light suddenly condensed in the center of the Formation Patterns.
This white light emerged and then shot straight from the seabed up toward the surface of the sea.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly left the seabed and flew toward the sea surface, and the others followed suit.
After emerging from the seabed, Lin Jing reappeared above the sea surface.
As they watched, the pillar of light burst from the seabed and did not cease; it continued its surge toward the sky, accompanied by a massive uproar.
After the white pillar emerged from the sea surface, the vortex also grew larger.
At the same time, the crescent Jade Pendant, originally within the seabed’s Formation Patterns, started to gradually rise along with the light pillar.
As the Jade Pendant ascended, it carried the Formation Patterns, which rotated and rose around it in a specific pattern.
As the Jade Pendant climbed higher, the white beam solidified until the Jade Pendant stopped just above the heads of the group and then stabilized.
Once the Jade Pendant stabilized, the surrounding Formation Patterns began to disperse.
As the Formation Patterns dispersed, the Spiritual Power within the white column was absorbed by them.
With the absorption of the Formation Patterns, the white column gradually vanished, leaving behind, between the dispersed patterns, a circular screen of light.
This screen of light resembled a mirror.
Through the screen, Lin Jing could even see the lush scenery inside it.
ƝᴑνǤο.сο
If he was not mistaken, inside this light screen must be the Lin Family’s Secret Realm.
With the appearance of the Lin Family Secret Realm, the group turned and looked at Lin Jing.
“Brother Lin, shall we go in and take a look?” asked Yan Wanfei.
Lin Jing looked at the light screen in front of him and nodded.
Since it was the Lin Family Secret Realm, it was natural to go inside and explore, perhaps even uncover some clues about the Lin Family.
Just as Lin Jing had decided and was preparing to enter the Secret Realm,
he suddenly felt an extremely terrifying presence rapidly approaching them.
Someone had come here, and this person’s Cultivation was not weak.
Just feeling this presence, Lin Jing clearly knew that he was no match for this person.

chapters.title: Chapter 797
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 797: Chapter 353 Lu Jingtao, Xiao Yinxuan_2 Chapter 797: Chapter 353 Lu Jingtao, Xiao Yinxuan_2 It could even be said that Lin Jing did not even qualify to be his opponent.
The person flying towards them, if Lin Jing guessed correctly, must be a Bandit Cultivator undergoing Tribulation.
…
…
At the same time, not just Lin Jing, but also several people around him felt this aura.
When Lu Youjiu noticed this aura, his face immediately turned extremely ugly, and then, furrowing his brows, he looked in the direction from which the aura was emanating.
Very soon.
...
A blurry silhouette appeared from the front at an incredible speed.
Upon seeing this figure, Lu Youjiu’s brows furrowed even more tightly.
At this moment, Lu Youjiu spoke to everyone:
“Brother Lin, and everyone else…”
“I’m terribly sorry, it seems I have dragged you all into this.”
Everyone heard and quickly looked towards Lu Youjiu.
It seemed that Lu Youjiu knew who the person about to arrive was.
However.
Before anyone could ask, that figure appeared in front of everyone.
This was a plain-looking middle-aged man who, despite his ordinary appearance, exuded a wild and domineering aura.
Upon arriving, his first action was not to look at the people gathered there.
Instead, he looked towards the shimmering screen hanging in the void, and said:
“It looks like this is the secret realm of the Lin Family from the legends.
Never thought I’d see the day when I’d witness the Lin Family’s Secret Realm.”
After finishing his words, he then turned his head to look towards the group of people.
After his gaze passed over Lin Jing and the others, it finally settled on Lu Youjiu.
Upon seeing this, Lu Youjiu quickly regained his usual demeanor and then stepped forward, shielding the others behind him.
Next.
ɴονǤᴑ.ƈο
Lu Youjiu raised his arm, greeting the man with a cupped-hand salute and then said:
“Uncle Xiao, have you come here on some errand?”
The middle-aged man surnamed Xiao looked at Lu Youjiu and said directly:
“Lu Youjiu, you have always been smart.”
“You must already know the purpose of my visit here.”
“If you have anything you wish to ask, ask directly.
There’s no need for all this beating around the bush.
It’s tiring for both you and me.
After all, I’ve watched you grow up, and now that it’s come to this point, there’s no need to keep you in the dark.”
After hearing this, Lu Youjiu looked up at this all too familiar person, and then, sighing with a sense of helplessness, he said:
“Uncle Xiao…”
“The time my father placed me under house arrest, you released me, was it all for today?”
The man surnamed Xiao nodded:
“Yes!”
“Then all that my elder brother Xiao Xu did before, was also under your instruction.”
“Correct!”
“All of it was arranged by me,” said the man.
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu fell silent.
A moment later, Lu Youjiu spoke again, asking:
“Before coming here, I had already lost contact with elder brother Xiao Xu, and our appearance in this place was a spur-of-the-moment decision.”
“How, then, could you have known, Uncle Xiao?”
The man simply smiled:
“Actually, it’s not hard to guess.”
“The chase you were facing was orchestrated by me.”
“I made preparations in every possible direction you might have fled.
No matter which direction you chose, it would be futile; you had nowhere to run but to the Chaotic Sea Area.”
“Since you’ve come to the Chaotic Sea Area, being so close to the Lin Family’s old Ganlin Island, how could you possibly not come here?”
“Even if you truly hadn’t come, I would have found a way to make you come here.”
“You had no choice!”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu’s brows furrowed slightly, and then, looking at the man named Xiao, he asked again:
“Uncle Xiao!”
“I want to know, why?”
“Our families are so close, why would you do this?”
The man surnamed Xiao looked at Lu Youjiu and went on:
“Why do this?”
“Discussing this serves no purpose.”
“Emotions, when you think they matter, they do; when you decide they don’t, they become worthless.”
“There are things I want that your father can’t give me, so I have to turn to others.”
“Naturally, if I want someone to help me obtain something, then I must first give up something.”
“This…”
“It’s the reason I am here today.”
After hearing this, Lu Youjiu fell silent again, then spoke after a moment:
“So, Elder Xiao, you’re not planning to let us go, are you?”
The man surnamed Xiao looked at Lu Youjiu, his eyes filled with regret:
“Little Jiu…”
“Although I don’t wish to hurt you, this matter isn’t up to me.”
“But rest assured, after all I watched you grow up, if I really do send you off, I won’t let you suffer even a little bit.”
Upon hearing this, Lu Youjiu’s expression suddenly relaxed, and then he seemed to come to a resolution.
“Elder Xiao!”
“I think you should understand my father well, he didn’t get to where he is solely by martial force.”
“If I’m not guessing wrong, he must also be aware of your arrival here.”
Upon hearing this, the man surnamed Xiao laughed softly, saying:
“Haha…”
“Little Jiu is indeed Little Jiu, even now, you can stay so calm.”
Having said that, the man surnamed Xiao called out directly:
“Jingtao!”
“Since you’re already here, stop hiding and come out!
”
“It’s about time for the two of us brothers to have a good talk.”
As the words of the man surnamed Xiao fell, a middle-aged man suddenly appeared not far from everyone.
This man’s appearance was quite abrupt, and none present knew how he had appeared.
After the middle-aged man appeared, Lu Youjiu heaved a sigh of relief, then his face showed joy, and he respectfully said to this newly appeared middle-aged man:
“Father!”
The middle-aged man looked at Lu Youjiu and then nodded slightly.
The suddenly appeared middle-aged man was none other than Lu Youjiu’s father, Lu Jingtao, the Alliance Hierarch of the Shocking Seas Alliance.
After Lu Jingtao signaled to Lu Youjiu, he turned his head to look at the man surnamed Xiao opposite him, and then spoke:
“Xiao Yinxuan…”
“You’re right, it’s about time for the two of us brothers to have a good talk.”
Lu Jingtao did not exhibit his aura like Xiao Yinxuan, but when facing Xiao Yinxuan, he exuded an indescribable confidence from his bones.
Lu Youjiu’s father, Lu Jingtao, was a cultivator in the Mahayana Realm, much stronger than Xiao Yinxuan, so he naturally had no concerns facing Xiao Yinxuan.
However.
Seeing Lu Jingtao appear, Xiao Yinxuan also showed no hint of panic.
As if everything were within his expectations.
At this moment.
Xiao Yinxuan looked at Lu Jingtao and said:
“Lu Jingtao, I truly admire you.
From an insignificant member of the Shocking Seas Alliance, you defeated all the direct disciples nurtured by the Elders and climbed step by step to your current position as the Alliance Hierarch.”
“Such an achievement, from the founding of the Shocking Seas Alliance to now, you are the only one, it’s truly admirable.”
“To be honest, if it were possible, I’d really like to be friends with you for a lifetime.”
Lu Jingtao looked at Xiao Yinxuan and said:
“But you still chose to be my enemy, disregarding our many years of friendship.”
Xiao Yinxuan shook his head helplessly, then replied:
“Everyone has their own ambition…”
“Although we have a good relationship, there are some things that you just can’t give me.”
“I can only try to rob and snatch for myself…”
After hearing this, Lu Jingtao’s brow furrowed slightly as he looked at Xiao Yinxuan and said:
“You’re obsessed…”
Upon hearing this, Xiao Yinxuan looked at Lu Jingtao in front of him, a smile appearing on his face:
“Maybe so…”
“But I feel pretty good about it.”
Lu Jingtao looked at Xiao Yinxuan in front of him, and then spoke again:
“If you turn back now, you are still my brother, and we can be like before.
I promise all will be forgiven, and no one in the Alliance will trouble you.”
Listening to Lu Jingtao’s words, Xiao Yinxuan laughed self-deprecatingly:
“Haha…”
“All will be forgiven…”
“What a phrase, all will be forgiven!”
“Lu Jingtao, there’s no need to say anything more.
You know, since I’ve started this, I can’t turn back now, and we can’t return to how we were before.”
“It’s better for us to stand on our grounds and have a proper fight…”

chapters.title: Chapter 798
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 798: Chapter 354: The Person Behind the Scenes Chapter 798: Chapter 354: The Person Behind the Scenes Lu Jingtao finally stared at Xiao Yinxuan for a long time, seeing that Xiao Yinxuan had indeed made up his mind, he knew that whatever he said would be in vain, so he stopped trying to persuade him:
Thus he spoke:
“If that’s the case, there’s nothing more to say.”
After saying this, Lu Jingtao erupted with momentum, instantly pressing towards Xiao Yinxuan.
“Tell me, who is the person behind you?”
The momentum that burst forth from Lu Jingtao was much stronger than that of Xiao Yinxuan.
This powerful momentum, as soon as it was released, made Lin Jing and others behind him, who were not enveloped by the momentum, feel the immense pressure.
However.
ƝοѵǤօ.сο
Just as this momentum pressed towards Xiao Yinxuan, Xiao Yinxuan’s body also erupted into a stronger momentum, countering Lu Jingtao.
“Mahayana Realm…”
Feeling the momentum emanating from Xiao Yinxuan, Lu Jingtao couldn’t help but feel somewhat surprised.
...
“You have also entered the Mahayana Realm.”
“Could it be that this is thanks to the person behind you, helping you to advance?”
Xiao Yinxuan gave a cold smile:“Of course.”
“And this is just the first step; as long as I cooperate with him, I can gain even more.”
Lu Youjiu, calm and unhurried, looked at Xiao Yinxuan and continued:
“To help you improve your cultivation and fulfill your desires, such people are not abundant, and the forces behind him must also be considerable.”
“So, who is the person behind you?”
“Whom are you actually working for?”
Xiao Yinxuan looked at his former friend, paused for a moment, and then said:
“What?”
“Are you that eager to meet him?”
Lu Jingtao looked at the Xiao Yinxuan in front of him and nodded:
“Yes, I want to know.”
After hearing this, Xiao Yinxuan looked at Lu Jingtao and directly said:
“If that’s the case, then I will fulfill your last wish, as a way to conclude the final bit of rapport between us.”
Having said that, Xiao Yinxuan directly took out a talisman that glowed with golden light from his body.
Then, he threw the talisman to one side.
After the talisman flew out, it exploded nearby.
The explosion of the talisman formed a vortex.
Then, from within that vortex, a more terrifying presence was transmitted, a presence that was even more fearsome than that of Lu Jingtao.
This mere presence, as it reached the ears of the people behind Lu Jingtao, felt like entering a ghastly hell of evil spirits.
It was shocking and terrifying.
The next moment, suddenly a very gentle presence enveloped the group, isolating them from that terrifying presence.
Lin Jing hurriedly looked up.
It was Lu Jingtao, who had conjured a light screen to wrap around the group.
Lu Jingtao looked towards the vortex, where a figure was slowly appearing.
Seeing this figure, Lu Jingtao also frowned slightly.
Then, without turning his head, he said to Lin Jing and the others:
“You guys leave here first.”
As soon as Lu Jingtao finished speaking, Lu Youjiu began to act, urging everyone to leave quickly.
Everyone knew that under such circumstances, staying here would be of no help, only causing more chaos.
Thus, they did not hesitate to evacuate the place.
However, not long after Lin Jing and the others had left, they felt that terrifying presence attacking again.
At the same time, an extremely chilling voice arose beside their ears:
“Since you’ve come, don’t leave.”
This voice, like a thunderclap out of nowhere, exploded next to their ears, as if someone was whispering right beside them.
And this voice, possessing some magical power, made them involuntarily turn back to look.
Turning back, they saw a figure stepping out of the vortex, clad in tattered black robes, with disheveled hair, appearing like a hunchbacked old man.
This old man, wearing a tattered black robe, some parts of which were even frayed to tatters, and with his tangled hair, seemed as if he hadn’t washed for hundreds of years.
Plus, the old man was hunched over, stooping his body.
If this man in the black robe were thrown onto the street, no doubt, anyone who saw him would think he was a hunchbacked old beggar who had been begging for many years.
Not only that, but he also seemed like a slovenly old beggar who couldn’t even take care of himself.
The only odd thing was that the old man was holding a strange black book in his hand.
This odd book had a blood-red skull on the cover, and chains stretched from the four corners of the book, locking the skull in place.
As this old man walked out from the vortex, a weird black mist kept emanating from him.
Seeing this old man, Lu Jingtao frowned slightly, and then inquired:
“You are the person behind Xiao Yinxuan?”
The man in the black robe chuckled twice and said:
“Hehe…”
“Yes, it’s me!”
Lu Jingtao carefully examined this man in the black robe and then asked again:
“Mahayana pinnacle…”
“With your level of cultivation, it’s impossible that I haven’t heard of you.”
“So, who exactly are you?”
The black-robed old man looked at Lu Jingtao, his eyes revealing a hint of strangeness, and then he smiled and said:
“Hehe…”
“My name is Ye Mingyi.”
“Of course…”
“Saying my name, you might not be aware of who I am.”
“You can call me by my title, Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall.”
“Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall!”
Upon hearing this title, even Lu Jingtao was immensely startled.
As Lu Jingtao was already so shocked, it goes without saying for Lin Jing and the others.
What kind of existence is the Seven Seas Hall?
Among the four major forces existing within the Inner Sea of demons and spirits, the Seven Seas Hall could arguably be considered the strongest.
Even the Shocking Seas Alliance, strong as it is, could not compare to the Seven Seas Hall.
Unexpectedly, the person behind Xiao Yinxuan turned out to be the Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall.
The title of Supreme Elder is an esteemed one.
Unlike other elders, their authority is vast, and sometimes even surpasses the Hall Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 799
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 799: Chapter 354 The Person Behind the Scenes_2 Chapter 799: Chapter 354 The Person Behind the Scenes_2 It could be said that when the Supreme Elder issued an order, the entire Seven Seas Hall had to obey.
Anyone who opposed the Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall was essentially opposing the entire Seven Seas Hall.
Lu Jingtao looked at Ye Mingyi and spoke,
“From the looks of it, you’ve been planning this for a while, intending to extend your reach into my Shocking Seas Alliance.”
Ye Mingyi looked at Lu Jingtao, his lips curling into a sinister smile,
“That’s obvious.”
“As long as you, Lu Jingtao, die here today, I can have Xiao Yinxuan take your place as the Alliance Hierarch of the Shocking Seas Alliance.”
“Then, the Seven Seas Hall and the Shocking Seas Alliance can form an alliance.
At that time, whether it be the Changyun Clan or the Ice God Palace that has remained hidden from the world, none will have any power to resist us.”
Upon hearing these words, Lu Jingtao fell silent for a moment before speaking again,
“I’m afraid that, by then, both forces will have fallen into your hands, right?”
Ye Mingyi shook his head and replied,
“To speak so belittles me.”
“Power doesn’t hold much attraction for me.
I only want to consolidate the two forces to help me accomplish a task.”
“What task?” Lu Jingtao frowned slightly as he asked Ye Mingyi.
As Lu Jingtao’s words ended, Ye Mingyi didn’t immediately answer, but instead turned his head to look towards Lin Jing and his group.
His gaze swept over Lin Jing and the others, lingering especially on Lin Jing, Lin Jue, and the siblings Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei.
...
Then, with a sinister chuckle, Ye Mingyi said,
“Naturally, it is to completely obliterate the Lin Family and the Changyun Family…”
Having said that, Ye Mingyi’s gaze turned cold as he looked at Lin Jing and Lin Jue,
“I thought the Lin Family had been utterly destroyed, but it turns out there were fish that slipped through the net.”
“What a nuisance.
It seems that in the end, I’ll have to take matters into my own hands and eradicate the Lin Family once and for all.”
Ye Mingyi’s statement was arrogant.
But with his cultivation, he indeed had the capital to be so.
However…
No sooner had he finished speaking than another resounding voice came from afar,
“I didn’t expect…”
“That the one causing trouble in the shadows would turn out to be a fish that slipped through the net of the Ye Clan.”
Along with this voice came an overwhelming and terrifying presence.
Upon hearing this voice, the Seven Seas Hall’s Supreme Elder immediately furrowed his brows and looked towards the source of the sound.
However, the newcomer was swift; by the time the Seven Seas Hall’s Supreme Elder looked in their direction, a figure had already appeared in front of Lu Jingtao.
This person was also an elder.
The elder was as thin as a rake, but the aura he emitted was extremely terrifying, capable of contending with the aura of the Seven Seas Hall’s Supreme Elder.
Seeing this elder, Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei were momentarily stunned, then could not help but cry out in shock,
“Ancestor…”
“The ancestor has actually come.”
As soon as the two had spoken, a number of presences emanated from behind the group.
Including Lin Jing, everybody hurriedly turned around to look, only to see several more elders flying over from behind them.
Seeing this scene, Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei were dumbfounded,
“Grandfather…”
“Second Grandfather, Third Grandfather, Fourth Grandfather, and Fifth Grandfather…”
“They’ve all come…”
These people were indeed several grandfathers of Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei.
Previously, Changyun Yuanshuang had said that her grandfather was recovering from injuries in seclusion and also had disagreements with a few other grandfathers.
Now that they had all arrived together, it seemed there was definitely more to this matter than met the eye.
As the grandfathers reached Lin Jing and the others, Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei quickly went forward to greet them.
After exchanging greetings, with Changyun Yuanshuang’s introduction, Lin Jing and the others also greeted Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfathers.
Following the greetings, Changyun Yuanshuang addressed her own grandfather,
“Grandfather, what in Heaven’s name is going on here?”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather looked at Changyun Yuanshuang and Lu Youjiu, smiled, and said,
“Silly girl…”
“Did you really think your second grandfather and the others wanted to separate you two?”
“It was merely a ruse to lure the enemy into acting, a strategy we came up with.”
“Only by having them make a move, can we seize the opportunity to expose the mastermind behind the scenes.”
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei turned to look at his own grandfather in surprise and uttered,
“Ah…”
“So it is.”
“Then, doesn’t that mean they are using us as bait?”
Upon hearing this, Grandfather Changyun Yuanlei also turned his head to look at him and curled his lips, saying:
“You weren’t supposed to be involved this time, but who knew you would insist on leaving home and rush to join in; thus, we could only include you as well.”
Changyun Yuanlei felt extremely embarrassed after hearing this.
Yet his grandfather didn’t pay him any further attention and instead turned to look at Lin Jing:
“I presume you are the other heir of the Lin Family, Lin Jing.”
Lin Jing looked at the elder before him and gave a respectful bow:
“Lin Jing pays respect to the senior.”
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang gave a slight nod and then spoke:
“The relationship between our Lin Family and your Changyun Family has always been very good.
Ɲ0νǤ0.сο
You don’t have to be reserved when you see us, just treat us like your own elders.”
Before this, Lin Jing indeed knew that there had never been any animosity between the Lin Family and the Changyun Clan.
However, he had not realized that the relationship between the two families could be so close.
Facing Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang’s kindness, Lin Jing found himself somewhat unaccustomed to it for a moment.
Seeing that Lin Jing was a bit uncomfortable, Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang simply smiled and did not say anything further.
After all, the Lin Family had been destroyed, and since they had grown up outside from a young age, they knew very little of the Lin Family’s past relationships.
Such a reaction was only to be expected.
Following that,
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang directly addressed the group, saying:
“A fight might break out here shortly.
Come, I’ll take you to a safe place.”
Afterwards,
they all followed Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang away from that place, continuing until they had gone quite a distance and felt the location was safe before stopping.
Accompanying the group was another grandfather of Changyun Yuanshuang.
After bringing them to this safe haven, Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang turned his head to the other grandfather and said:
“Laowu.”
“I leave this place in your hands.
If anything happens, transfer them to an even safer location.”
“Hmm!”
This fifth grandfather of Changyun Yuanshuang seemed not to be fond of speaking.
During the initial greetings, he had just hummed in acknowledgment and remained silent.
This time was the same; the fifth grandfather of Changyun Yuanshuang nodded, responded with a hum, and said no more.
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang, used to this by now, gave a few instructions to the group after making his arrangements, and then left the place, flying off into the distance.
It wasn’t until Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang had left that Yan Wanfei belatedly exclaimed:
“Isn’t it…”
“What in the world is going on here?”
“Why am I feeling so confused?”
Lu Youjiu looked at Yan Wanfei and then explained:
“Everything we had done before was actually orchestrated by my father and Grandfather Yuanshuang.”
