“Even the plan to snatch the person was.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei was shocked speechless:
“Ah?”
“So all our previous plans took place right under their watch?”
Lu Youjiu nodded, saying:
“Of course.”
“I also only realized after Uncle Xiao…
Xiao Yinxuan showed up.”
“This plan must have begun when Yuanshuang’s elders brought Lin Jue to the Changyun Clan.”
“This includes my house arrest by my father, the arrangement of Yuanshuang and Lin Jue’s marriage, and perhaps even Lin brother’s emergence, which might have also been factored in.”
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei quickly looked at his fifth grandfather and asked:
“Grandfather, is this really the case?”
“Everything we did, was it all part of your plan?”
Fifth Grandfather Changyun Yuanlei looked at him and nodded in response:
“Yes!”
“It was all planned in advance!”
But having just said this, he glanced at both Changyun Yuanlei and Lin Jing, and surprisingly added:
“You and he…”
“You two were not part of the plan.”

chapters.title: Chapter 800
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 800: Chapter 355 Lin Family’s Ancestor Chapter 800: Chapter 355 Lin Family’s Ancestor After Elder Changyun Yuanlei explained, a few of them understood it all.
It turned out that everything was just a conspiracy, meticulously plotted by Lu Jingtao and the elders of the Changyun Clan.
Their purpose was naturally to lure out Xiao Yinxuan and the forces behind him.
Now that the person behind the scenes had appeared, those few could consider their mission accomplished.
What followed,
was likely to be a showdown between them.
The reason for taking Lin Jing and the others away from the vicinity of Ganlin Island was naturally for their safety.
Now, where they were located was a significant distance from Ganlin Island, so even if the two parties really started fighting, it wouldn’t affect this place in the short run.
...
Unfortunately, after arriving here, it was impossible to observe the situation on Ganlin Island.
Lin Jing’s current Observation Mode was calculated based on the range of his Divine Sense, meaning the range of Observation Mode was as extensive as his Divine Sense.
Because the individuals involved over there on Ganlin Island were mostly Mahayana cultivators.
Especially Ye Mingyi and the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan, both of whom possessed peak Mahayana cultivation.
With their cultivation levels, if they were to fight, even being a little closer would expose Lin Jing to the aftermath of the battle, which he was incapable of withstanding.
Naturally, observation was no longer possible.
Although Lin Jing could not observe, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang, who was beside them, could easily discern the situation over there.
Just after replying to them, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang suddenly looked up, gazing in the direction of Ganlin Island.
Then, without another word, he waved his sleeve, releasing several streams of light from the wide sleeves that wrapped around Lin Jing and the others.
Before Lin Jing and the others could react,
Elder Changyun Yuanshuang swiftly carried them away, flying backward.
Just as Elder Changyun Yuanshuang was carrying them away, from the direction of Ganlin Island, two extremely frightening presences burst forth.
At the same time, a black and a white giant shadow appeared above Ganlin Island; these vast shadows were still clearly visible despite the long distance.
These two shadows were none other than Ye Mingyi and the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan.
At this moment, with both releasing their Five Elements Spiritual Bodies, even before the actual combat had started, their terrifying presence could be sensed from many miles away.
Lin Jing and his group, in theory, had already left Ganlin Island, and were a considerable distance away.
But once the two unleashed their aura, within an instant, that terrifying presence reached where Lin Jing and the others were.
Following this, Lin Jing felt the Spiritual Power within his body stagnate slightly and it was not circulating as smoothly as before.
Lin Jing, being at the peak of Solidifying Body cultivation, was already affected to such an extent, not to mention Lu Youjiu and others with lower cultivation levels.
They were feeling even worse, especially Lin Jue, along with Changyun Yuanlei and Yan Wanfei, who were extremely rigid and pale at that moment.
However, luckily they were carried away by Elder Changyun Yuanshuang, who was incredibly fast.
In less than an hour, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang had flown them a good distance away.
Only when the presence of the two became very weak and no longer affected them did Elder Changyun Yuanshuang release them and stop.
At this time,
they could no longer see the situation on Ganlin Island, but they could still feel the atmosphere emanating from there.
From that complex and fluctuating aura, it was not difficult to speculate that at that moment on Ganlin Island, they must be fighting now.
At this time, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang furrowed his brows, looking in the direction of Ganlin Island.
And Lin Jing and the others did not disturb him.
…
…
After quite a while, the aura coming from the direction of Ganlin Island suddenly settled, and there was no more movement.
Ɲ0νǤᴑ.сο
Seeing this, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang immediately spoke up, addressing the group:
“You all wait here for a moment; I’ll go and check the situation.”
Having said that, without waiting for Lin Jing and the others to respond, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang flew forward and soon disappeared from sight.
After he had left, Lin Jing and the rest looked at each other.
“A Mahayana cultivator’s battle, ended so soon?”
Yan Wanfei looked perplexed and turned to Lu Youjiu to ask.
Lu Youjiu then looked towards Ganlin Island and shook his head:
“Unlikely…”
“Generally speaking, the closer the cultivation levels are, the longer the battle will last between cultivators.”
“Both the Changyun Clan’s ancestor and the Supreme Elder from Seven Seas Hall are among the very top in the Cultivation World.”
“If they were really fighting all out, it definitely wouldn’t just be a little disturbance; I think they might still have other concerns, which is why they held back.”
Having said this, Lu Youjiu turned to Yan Wanfei again and continued:
“Of course…”
“This is just my speculation.”
“We’ll probably know the specific situation very soon.”
Yan Wanfei nodded, and then said no more.
…
…
Less than half an hour later, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang returned.
As they were about to ask him something,
before they could even speak, Elder Changyun Yuanshuang once again released several streams of light, wrapped them up, and carried them back toward Ganlin Island.
Soon after, they found themselves back at the entrance to the Lin Family’s Secret Realm on Ganlin Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 801
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 801: Chapter 355: Lin Family’s Ancestor_2 Chapter 801: Chapter 355: Lin Family’s Ancestor_2 At this moment, the place remained calm, showing no signs of change.
Even the entrance to the Lost Secret Realm, which had been opened, was still there, without any trace of battle.
Besides.
Among the people who arrived, Lu Youjiu’s father, Lu Jingtao, and several grandfathers from Changyun Yuanshuang, were all still here without any missing.
The only ones absent were the ancestor of the Changyun Clan, the Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall, and Xiao Yinxuanâ€”the three of them.
After the people arrived, Yuanshuang’s grandfather immediately came over to them.
At that moment.
...
Yuanshuang’s fifth grandfather had already retracted the spell, released the others, and then retreated to the side.
As soon as Yuanshuang’s grandfather approached, Yuanshuang couldn’t wait to ask:
“Grandfather, where are the two of them?”
“And the ancestor, where did the ancestor go?”
Yuanshuang’s grandfather said:
“The two of them ran away.”
“As for the ancestor…” As he spoke, Yuanshuang’s grandfather looked toward the Lin Family’s Secret Realm entrance floating in mid-air, and said:
“The ancestor has entered the Lin Family Secret Realm.”After finishing speaking, Yuanshuang’s grandfather turned his head to look at Lin Jing and Lin Jue, and said:
“You two should hurry in as well, your ancestor is waiting for you, isn’t he?”
“The ancestor?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing and Lin Jue exchanged glances with some confusion.
The Lin Family had perished ten thousand years ago, so where did this ancestor come from?
Not only Lin Jing and Lin Jue, but Lu Youjiu and the others looked equally puzzled.
“Grandfather, did you just say that it’s the Lin Family’s ancestor, Lin Daoyou’s ancestor?”
Yuanshuang asked with confusion:
“Of course…”
“They will understand once they go in and see for themselves.”
After finishing, Yuanshuang’s grandfather also urged the two, saying:
“Go on, don’t make him wait too long.”
“If you’re late, you might really miss seeing him.”
Hearing Yuanshuang’s grandfather’s words, Lin Jing immediately understood.
It seemed that the Lin Family’s ancestor was alive, but not in good condition.
Therefore.
Lin Jing and Lin Jue looked at each other and then nodded in agreement.
Then, Lin Jing gave a cupped-hand salute to Yuanshuang’s grandfather, saying:
“Elder, then we will go in first.”
Yuanshuang’s grandfather nodded: “Go!”
Afterward, Lin Jing and Lin Jue together flew toward the entrance of the Lin Family Secret Realm.
Upon reaching the entrance, Lin Jing stretched out his hand, and it was as if passing through a curtain of water, the barrier at the entrance rippling in circles.
Lin Jing’s hand reached out unimpeded.
Then, without hesitation, Lin Jing took Lin Jue’s hand and stepped directly through, entering the Lin Family Secret Realm.
…
Bleak, in ruins…
This was the sight that greeted Lin Jing at first glance upon entering the Lin Family Secret Realm.
From outside the realm, looking through the entrance, one could see a verdant lushness.
But upon entering, the scenery was vastly different.
Broken valleys, mountains that seemed to have been sheared in half by some terrifying force, and within those valleys, a terrifyingly deep pit that took up almost half the valley and whose bottom could not be seen at a glance…
All of these were the scenes Lin Jing witnessed upon entering the realm.
Inside the Secret Realm, it was as if it had faced an indescribable calamity.
Just then, a voice came from the depths of the Secret Realm, reaching Lin Jing’s ears.
“You’ve come…”
“Come over to me…”
This voice belonged to the ancestor of the Changyun Clan.
Hearing the voice, Lin Jing hurriedly looked up toward the direction the voice was coming from.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.с0
It was deep within the realm, and even with his Divine Sense, Lin Jing could not reach its end.
It appeared that the range of the Lin Family’s Secret Realm was truly vast.
Afterward, Lin Jing continued flying deeper into the realm with Lin Jue.
Along the way, while flying, Lin Jing observed the conditions of the realm.
The entire place was just as desolate and ruined as it had appeared at first glance.
Even on their journey, Lin Jing saw clusters of buildings situated atop mountains.
However, these clearly once sturdy structures built from Qi Refinement materials had long since collapsed, their original forms almost unrecognizable.
Lin Jing and Lin Jue flew for a long time, nearly half an hour, before they reached the deepest part of the realm.
The deepest part of the realm was a city, but now the buildings within the city had all collapsed, and not even the city walls remained intact.
Behind the city lay an extremely tall mountain peak.
At this moment, a breath of air emanated from the mountain peak.
Lin Jing and Lin Jue had just arrived at this place when the voice of the Changyun Clan’s Elder Ancestor came once again:
“Come upâ€¦”
The direction of the voice was indeed from the towering mountain peak.
After hearing this, Lin Jing hesitated slightly, but after a brief moment of contemplation, he took Lin Jue and flew toward the mountain peak.
Although the mountain peak was very high, it was not a difficult task for Lin Jing.
In no time at all, Lin Jing had almost reached the top of the mountain peak.
It was then that Lin Jing heard a conversation between two people above the mountain peak:
“Back then, you, I, and Old Bai, the three of us, were truly too reckless, especially during our time at the Elixir Alliance; Old Bai often had to take the blameâ€¦”
…
“Yesâ€¦”
“It’s just us now, the others wouldn’t dare…”
“Looking back, that was when we were at our most spirited.”
…
“I didn’t expect to see you again.”
“But it’s not bad this way.
Before I die, to be able to see you one last time, it fulfills a wish of mine.”
The one who spoke these words was the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan.
After this sentence was spoken, there was a pause of silence.
A moment later, another voice spoke:
“Are you truly prepared to stake your own life and perish together with Ye Mingyi?”
The Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan laughed in response, quite carefree:
“At this point, since my lifespan is nearing its end, it’s already a foregone conclusion.
Leave the Ascension Pill to Old Bai, and I only hope he can succeed.”
“As for that remnant of the Ye Clan, under no circumstances can we allow him to continue living,
“If he does not die, whether it’s your Lin Family or our Changyun Family, we will all ultimately be destroyed by his hands.”
…
“Ah…!”
“The Lin Family…”
The other voice sighed.
It was just then that the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan’s voice came again:
“Since you’re here, don’t just stand there, come over and see your Elder Ancestor.”
This, of course, was said to Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
In fact, Lin Jing had already reached the summit, but hearing the two in conversation, he hadn’t had the heart to interrupt them.
Now, hearing the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan say this, Lin Jing understood and directly headed towards the center of the mountain top.
Atop the mountain peak was a small courtyard.
Lin Jing and Lin Jue bypassed the large bamboo forest in front of the courtyard and then arrived at the gate of the small yard.
As soon as they arrived, the door to the courtyard automatically opened.
Afterward, Lin Jing and Lin Jue entered the small courtyard together.
Upon entering the courtyard, Lin Jing saw two people sitting opposite each other in a pavilion filled with ancient charm to one side of the courtyard.
One was the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan, whom Lin Jing had seen before.
The other person appeared ethereal and translucent,
Indicating that he was not a solid being.
After Lin Jing and Lin Jue entered, both the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan and the insubstantial phantom turned their heads to look at Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
The phantom appeared to be an elderly man with silver hair, his old face carrying a kind expression and his gaze falling upon Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
At that moment,
The Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan beckoned to Lin Jing and Lin Jue, saying:
“Come and pay respects to your Lin Family’s Elder Ancestor.”
Lin Jing looked at the kindly old man, and even though it was their first meeting, he couldn’t help but feel an innate closeness.
Perhaps, this was the bond of bloodline inheritance.
Following that,
Lin Jing, accompanied by Lin Jue, moved closer to the pavilion, to the Supreme Elder of the Changyun Clan and the old man’s side.
Up close, the feeling of kinship emanating from his own body was even more apparent.
However, although he already knew the other was the Elder Ancestor of the Lin Family, it was still their first encounter, and Lin Jing found it somewhat difficult to adjust.
Nevertheless,
The appropriate etiquette was certainly not to be neglected.
Lin Jing bowed and saluted the phantom elder, saying:
“Elder…
Elder Ancestor!”
Seeing Lin Jing speak, Lin Jue, who had been following behind Lin Jing, also bowed and saluted in the same manner, addressing the phantom elder:
“We pay our respects to the Elder Ancestor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 802
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 802: Chapter 356 Ascension Pill Chapter 802: Chapter 356 Ascension Pill Facing such reactions from Lin Jing and Lin Jue, the Lin Family patriarch not only refrained from blaming them but also looked at them kindly, and said, somewhat excitedly:
“Good…
good…
good…”
“Such good children.”
“The Lin Family is not yet extinct, with you still here, I can finally rest easy.”
As soon as the Lin Family patriarch had finished speaking, the Changyun Clan patriarch looked toward Lin Jing and said directly:
“This child from the Lin Family is more than just good, he is absolutely fantastic.”
“After learning about his identity, I specifically looked into some of his background.”
“I had no idea before I investigated.”
“But this investigation took me by surprise.”
“This child of the Lin Family is so outstanding it makes me quite envious.”
Hearing this, the Lin Family patriarch was visibly surprised, and after glancing at Lin Jing, he looked towards the Changyun Clan patriarch and asked:
“Oh?”
“What do you mean?”
“You’re even jealous of him, I’d like to hear how this young fellow has made you feel that way.”
The Changyun Clan patriarch then spoke and said:“You might not be aware, but this young fellow from your Lin Family reached the pinnacle of Solidifying Body in less than two hundred years.”
Upon hearing this, the Lin Family patriarch quickly turned his head to look at Lin Jing, full of disbelief.
ɴονǤο.ᴄο
Two hundred years, pinnacle of Solidifying Body.
Even the core disciples trained by top sects in the Eastern Spirit Realm didn’t advance in their cultivation so quickly.
And to achieve such rapid advancement in cultivation, apart from those few famously monstrous figures in cultivation history, no one else has managed to do so.
...
But unexpectedly, such a monstrous figure has emerged in the Lin Family at a time when it was nearly wiped out.
Could it really be the case of extreme growth after decline?
Is the Lin Family about to rise again?
Such a thought was naturally understandable.
However, they didn’t know that Lin Jing’s achievements were closely tied to the System.
Only the existence of the System remained unknown to outsiders.
And Lin Jing’s true Spirit Root Aptitude wasn’t as impressive as they thought, as before this, Lin Jing’s aptitude was rather poor.
Of course.
Now, Lin Jing, having consumed several mystical Spiritual Objects to enhance his Spirit Root Aptitude, though not monstrous, was quite good.
…
Meanwhile.
As the Lin Family patriarch looked at Lin Jing in shock, the Changyun Clan patriarch continued:
“More importantly, not only is his cultivation advancement swift, but his alchemic talent is also extraordinary.”
“It seems he has inherited the Lin Family’s alchemic talent, and his skill in alchemy has also progressed rapidly.
By now, I estimate that even if he hasn’t reached Seventh Grade, he must be very close.”
Upon hearing the words of the Changyun Clan patriarch, the Lin Family patriarch stopped paying attention to him, but looked at Lin Jing with eyes filled with excitement and said:
“I still don’t know what your name is.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing quickly gave a respectful bow to the Lin Family patriarch and said:
“Responding to the patriarch, I go by the single name Jing.”
“Lin Jing…” the Lin Family patriarch tasted the name before continuing to ask:
“May I know your current grade in alchemy?”
Lin Jing replied:
“Replying to the patriarch, I’ve had a breakthrough not long ago, and am now a Seventh Grade Pill Master.”
Upon hearing this, although a soul entity, the Lin Family patriarch’s smile was so wide it could not be concealed:
“Seventh Grade Pill Master…”
“Good…
good…”
“I never thought that the Lin Family would produce a prodigy of this caliber at such a time.”
After speaking, the Lin Family patriarch turned to Lin Jue with a gentle voice and asked:
“And you?”
“What’s your name?”
Lin Jue also hastily gave a respectful bow to the Lin Family patriarch and said:
“Replying to the patriarch, my name is Lin Jue.”
“In terms of alchemic cultivation, I am not as talented as my brother; currently, I am only a Fifth Grade Pill Master.”
The Lin Family patriarch nodded continuously, smiling as he said:
“Good…
good…”
“Fifth Grade is also quite good.”
“You both are doing well.”
After saying this, the Lin Family patriarch looked at them, his face full of compassion, and said:
“Without the protection of any power, it must have been very hard for you two to make your way in the world alone.”
“I truly appreciate the hardships you have endured.”
Upon seeing this, Lin Jing quickly comforted him:
“Patriarch, you worry too much; we actually have been managing quite well.”
The Lin Family patriarch then waved his hand and said:
“Back then…”
“Had I not been so determined to produce the Ascension Pill, I would not have incurred heavenly punishment, leading the clan to face the calamity of annihilation.”
“Our Lin Family, at its peak, was untouchable by anyone.”
“It was exactly because I insisted on producing that Ascension Pill that we were struck by the heavenly punishment, resulting in the loss of our strongest combat force and the decline of our entire family.”
“Eventually, this also gave the long-hidden remnants of the Ye Clan a chance to nearly wipe out the Lin Family completely.”
After saying this, the Lin Family patriarch continued, deeply anguished:
“I am the sinner of the Lin Family.”
“If it weren’t for my stubborn actions, the Lin Family might still be powerful, and you two could have received better resources for cultivation and have had better opportunities.”
At this, the Changyun Clan patriarch quickly spoke up, trying to console him:
“Old Lin…”
“It wasn’t your fault!”
“Everything you did was for the purpose of producing the Ascension Pill.”
“And those Ye Clan remnants were exceedingly cautious, too deeply hidden.”
“Even when your Lin Family had no means of resistance at the end, he did not show himself.”
“It was only today, perhaps because he felt the timing was ripe, that he no longer regarded our Changyun Clan seriously, so he let his guard down and was tricked into revealing himself.”
“Had we known earlier that the Ye Clan remnants still existed, we would have successfully eliminated them first before starting on the Ascension Pill.”

chapters.title: Chapter 803
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 803: Chapter 356 Ascension Pill_2 Chapter 803: Chapter 356 Ascension Pill_2 The Lin Family Ancestor couldn’t help but sigh and said,
“Talking about this now, there’s no use.”
After speaking, the Lin Family Ancestor looked towards Lin Jing and opened his mouth to speak again,
“Your alchemic talent is not bad…”
“It’s just a pity that the most important part of the Alchemy Techniques of our Lin Family heritage has been completely lost with the disappearance of Feiling.”
“And I, being but a remnant soul and not the original body, cannot pass on the true Ancient Alchemy Arts of the Lin Family to you.”
“If you had obtained our Lin Family’s Alchemy Techniques, I believe your mastery of the Alchemy Dao would have been even higher.”
At this time, the Changyun Clan Ancestor spoke,
“What Lin Feiling took was only a part of your Lin Family’s Alchemy Dao, wasn’t there other parts?”
“Moreover…”
“After learning their identities, I specifically looked for the Elixir Medicine they had made and found that it was indeed made using your Lin Family’s Alchemy Dao, not a bit off.”
The Lin Family Ancestor shook his head and said,
“Without the part of the heritage that Feiling had, the transmission of the Alchemy Dao is not complete.
Although one can still make elixirs, the higher the rank of the Elixir Medicine, the greater the chance of failure in making them.”
After hearing this, the Changyun Clan Ancestor frowned and thought for a moment, then spoke,
“Such tremendous alchemic talent he has, it would be a pity if he couldn’t cultivate the highest level of Alchemy Techniques.”
After saying this, the Changyun Clan Ancestor turned to the Lin Family Ancestor and said,“Why not let him cultivate our Changyun Clan’s Alchemy Techniques?
What do you think?”
It was at this moment that Lin Jing suddenly spoke up, saying to both of them,
“Elder Ancestor…”
“Changyun Elder…”
“Actually, the part of the Alchemy Techniques that ancestor Feiling took away, I have found, and what I am cultivating is indeed the complete Alchemy Techniques of the Lin Family.”
When the two heard Lin Jing say this, they were both stunned and then immediately reacted.
“What!!!”
The Changyun Clan Ancestor exclaimed in shock.
“Let me see it!”
Although the Lin Family Ancestor was a spirit projection, he was still extremely excited.
Lin Jing nodded and then took out two Jade Slips containing the Lin Family’s Alchemy Techniques from his Space Ring.
Seeing these Jade Slips, the Lin Family Ancestor reached out, and the two Jade Slips immediately flew towards him.
...
Then,
the two Jade Slips were held before the Lin Family Ancestor, and he carefully observed them.
After observing for a while, the Lin Family Ancestor said with immense excitement,
“Indeed…”
“These are the Lin Family’s Alchemy Techniques.”
“Where did you find them?
Did you see Feiling?”
Lin Jing then spoke,
“Elder Ancestor, the latter part of the Alchemy Techniques, I found on Immortal Crossing Island, and I also met ancestor Feiling there…”
“However, when I saw him, he had already turned into a skeleton.”
“Immortal Crossing Island…”
“I had no idea you actually went to Immortal Crossing Island?”
“And you even left there safely, it’s truly unbelievable,” said the Changyun Clan Ancestor with a look of surprise.
Lin Jing nodded his head.
“The fact that I could reach Immortal Crossing Island was actually an accident…”
After speaking, Lin Jing turned to look at the Lin Family Ancestor, who after observing for a while longer, waved his hand and returned the Jade Slips back in front of Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing also put away the Jade Slips once again.
At this time,
the Lin Family Ancestor spoke,
“Feiling was the hope of our Lin Family, at the time with his cultivation, he was actually the last person who should have had an accident.”
“That’s why I entrusted him with the most important latter part of the Alchemy Techniques.”
“Never did I imagine he would still disappear without a trace.”
“Can you tell me about the scene when you found Feiling?”
Lin Jing nodded his head and then recounted the experience of encountering the two skeletons inside the water pool on Immortal Crossing Island to the Lin Family Ancestor.
After listening to Lin Jing’s story, the Lin Family Ancestor also became silent.
This time, the Lin Family Ancestor was silent for quite a while before he came back to his senses.
After he regained his composure, the Lin Family Ancestor stood up and walked towards a house in the small courtyard.
As he walked, the Lin Family Ancestor also spoke,
“Follow me…”
Then,
the Changyun Clan Ancestor, along with Lin Jing and Lin Jue, followed the Lin Family Ancestor into the house in the middle of the courtyard.
From the outside, the house looked like a typical dwelling and had nothing out of the ordinary.
However, as soon as they entered, they discovered that this house was quite different inside.
The whole house on the inside was much larger than it appeared from the outside, and this place was different from what was seen on the outside.
This was a massive Alchemy Room.
Inside this Alchemy Room, utter disarray prevailed.
The entire wall and even the ceiling had been shattered.
From the broken edges, one could clearly see that the materials used to build this Alchemy Room were anything but ordinary.
They were of that incredibly rare and resilient type.
However, even such sturdy materials had been destroyed, which left one to wonder what had actually happened here.
In the middle of the Alchemy Room stood a Pill Furnace, already split into several pieces.
Above the Pill Furnace, floated a round Elixir Medicine that radiated seven-colored light.
At this moment, the remnant spirit of the Lin Family’s ancestor drifted beside the Elixir Medicine and then said to the elder of Changyun Clan:
“Elder Hong…”
“This time, I have to break my word.”
“I can’t give you the whole Ascension Pill.”
Upon hearing these words, the elder of the Changyun Clan looked directly at Lin Jing and Lin Jue:
“You intend to let them consume the Ascension Pill, don’t you?”
The Lin Family’s ancestor nodded and said:
“Now that the Lin Family is gone, there’s not much I can leave for these two children.”
“It’s just this failed Ascension Pill.”
“I plan to give half of the Ascension Pill to them to consume, and the other half, take back with you for you and Elder Bai to research.”
After listening, the elder of the Changyun Clan responded:
“The Elixir Medicine is your creation.
You can arrange it as you see fit; I will have no objections and I believe that even if Elder Bai was here, he would feel the same.”
The Lin Family’s ancestor smiled and said:
“Elder Hong.”
“After I completely dissipate, please take care of these two children for me.”
After hearing this, the elder of the Changyun Clan looked at the Lin Family’s ancestor and solemnly replied:
“Don’t worry.”
No sooner had the elder of the Changyun Clan finished speaking than the Lin Family’s ancestor waved his hand and split the seven-colored Elixir Medicine floating there into two.
This Elixir Medicine was incredibly unique; once divided, what remained automatically reshaped itself into spheres.
However, the newly formed Elixir Medicines were half the size of the original.
As a result, the Lin Family’s ancestor now had two pieces of seven-colored Elixir Medicine in his hands.
One of them, he sent to the elder of the Changyun Clan with a wave of his hand.
“Keep this for now, take it and find Elder Bai with it,” he said.
“I trust that the two of you will succeed in crafting a true Ascension Pill.”
“The task of refining the Ascension Pill, I leave to you both.”
The elder of the Changyun Clan accepted the seven-colored Elixir Medicine and then, looking at the Elixir Medicine, shook his head with a bitter expression on his face.
“Old Lin…”
“I expect I’ll be joining you soon.”
“Leave the Ascension Pill to Elder Bai.”
At this moment, the Lin Family’s ancestor turned to Lin Jing and spoke:
“As for the lifespan issue, don’t be too quick to give up.”
“I think you can let our Lin Family’s lad give it a try; after all, he has inherited all of our Lin Family’s legacy, he might just make it.”
“He…?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing, examined him carefully, and then addressed the Lin Family’s ancestor:
“Alright…”
“Then I’ll do as you say and try him first.”
“If it truly doesn’t work, then we can consider the last step.”
The Lin Family’s ancestor laughed upon hearing this.
Without pause, he split the remaining piece of Elixir Medicine in his hand into two again.
The piece of medicine turned into two pieces.
Following that, the two pieces of medicine flew towards Lin Jing and Lin Jue respectively.
ɴονǥᴑ.сο
Lin Jing was about to ask a question when he found himself immobilized by a force.
And the seven-colored Elixir Medicine flew directly into the mouths of Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
No sooner had the Elixir Medicine entered their mouths than it immediately transformed into an extremely domineering seven-colored Spiritual Power that surged through their bodies.
Overwhelmed by the seven-colored Spiritual Power, Lin Jing had no choice but to sit down cross-legged and revolve his Cultivation Technique to aid digestion.
Lin Jue, likewise, did the same after consuming the medicine, sitting down cross-legged immediately.
It seemed that he too was circulating his Cultivation Technique to absorb the sudden influx of seven-colored Spiritual Power into his body.
As Lin Jing and Lin Jue were fully engaged in digesting the Elixir Medicine,
the Lin Family’s ancestor looked at them with eyes brimming with affection:
“Seeing you both fills me with gratification.”
“With you here, I believe the Lin Family will surely rise again.”
Having said that, the Lin Family’s ancestor turned to the elder of the Changyun Clan and said:
“Elder Hong…”
“After I have completely dissipated, these two children of our Lin Family, I entrust to your care.”
The elder of the Changyun Clan gazed at the Lin Family’s ancestor, his eyes lingering as if to imprint the memory of his dear friend who was about to vanish completely into his heart.
It wasn’t until a good while later that he shifted his gaze and nodded…

chapters.title: Chapter 804
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 804: Chapter 357 Cause Chapter 804: Chapter 357 Cause After the Seven-Colored Elixir entered Lin Jing’s body, it was not refined by Lin Jing.
Instead, just after refining a thread of seven-colored spiritual power, Lin Jing’s cultivation had already reached the perfect state of the Solidifying Body Realm’s pinnacle.
He could not absorb even a bit more.
During this period, it seemed that the Lin Family’s ancestor was also aware of the situation within Lin Jing’s body.
Therefore, he directly helped Lin Jing by guiding him to condense the seven-colored spiritual power inside his body into a Seven-Colored Divine Pill, hovering within his own dantian.
The condensation of this seven-colored spiritual power was extremely difficult, and the slightest distraction could cause the already condensed spiritual power to dissipate again.
As a result.
...
Lin Jing did not dare to relax in the slightest and had to temporarily block out all external perceptions, concentrating all his efforts on condensing the Seven-Colored Divine Pill.
…
…
By the time Lin Jing successfully condensed the Seven-Colored Divine Pill, he did not know how much time had passed.
When he opened his eyes again, Lin Jing hurriedly looked forward, only to find that the spirit of the Lin Family’s ancestor was not there.
Apart from himself, only the Changyun Clan’s ancestor and Lin Jue were present.
At this moment…
Lin Jue had her eyes tightly shut and was sitting cross-legged, obviously not yet having fully condensed the Elixir Medicine.
Meanwhile, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor beside her was channeling spiritual power into Lin Jue’s body, with quite evident fluctuations of spiritual power within her.
It looked like…
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor was apparently helping Lin Jue to condense the Seven-Colored Divine Pill.
Upon seeing Lin Jing awake, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor looked at him and, without speaking, communicated telepathically:
“You’re awake…”
“Wait a moment, your sister will be finished soon.”
Lin Jing nodded, then quietly waited.
Time passed, and it was quite a while before the Changyun Clan’s ancestor withdrew his hand, pulling back his spiritual power.
At this time, the spiritual power within Lin Jue also gradually stabilized.
After the Changyun Clan’s ancestor pulled back his spiritual power, he turned to Lin Jing and said:
“All right…”
“Your sister should wake up very soon.”
Lin Jing nodded, and then, bowing with clasped hands, said to the Changyun Clan’s ancestor:
“Thank you, Senior, for your assistance.”
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor waved his hand and replied:
“Old Lin has already entrusted you to me.
These little matters count for nothing.
You need not be so formal.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing hurriedly asked the Changyun Clan’s ancestor:
“Senior, how long did we spend refining the Elixir Medicine?”
“And our ancestor, he…”
Before Lin Jing could finish, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor’s eyes dimmed.
Seeing the look on the Changyun Clan’s ancestor, Lin Jing understood what had happened.
He did not speak any further.
At that moment, Lin Jue also woke up.
After regaining consciousness, Lin Jue first looked around and finally her gaze landed on Lin Jing:
“Brother…”
“Our ancestor, he…”
It seemed that Lin Jue also had a premonition.
At that time.
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor slowly opened his mouth and said to them:
“You two took a full seven days to condense that Ascension Pill.”
“As for Old Lin…”
“He was already seriously injured with no hope of recovery after the failed attempt to refine the Ascension Pill ten thousand years ago.
He had to abandon his body and hide in the already damaged Innate Dao Treasure, the Pill Furnace, to survive until now.”
“Opening the Secret Realm this time, calling him forth, he appeared voluntarily, wanting to see you all one last time.”
“He was already just a spirit remnant, and after ten thousand years, he could no longer hold on.
After making all the arrangements for you, Old Lin’s spirit completely dissipated…”
Upon hearing this, both Lin Jing and Lin Jue fell silent.
The Lin Family’s ancestor, whom they had just met, had now completely vanished.
Lin Jing had a mixed feeling in his heart at this moment.
The care and affection their ancestor had for them were not feigned, and Lin Jing could feel it clearly.
Seeing the two in such a state, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor again spoke up, comforting them:
“You should not be too saddened.
Old Lin was actually content just being able to see you.”
At these words, Lin Jing remained silent for a long while before finally saying:
“Senior…”
“I want to know about the Ye Clan and the Ascension Pill.”
The Ye Clan and the Ascension Pill were the primary reasons for the Lin Family’s downfall.
As enemies of the Lin Family, the Ye Clan’s actions against them had their reasons.
But as the enemy of the Lin Family, Lin Jing naturally wanted to understand the reasons behind it and, if possible, hoped to do something for the Lin Family in return.
Secondly, there was the matter of the Ascension Pill.
ɴονǤ0.сօ
From the previous conversations of the two ancestors, it was not difficult for Lin Jing to guess that the main reason for the downfall of the Lin Family, aside from the Ye Clan, was precisely that Ascension Pill.
The Lin Family’s ancestor also seemed to have been seriously injured due to this Ascension Pill, leaving him without hope of recovery.
Lin Jing was equally curious about the Ascension Pill and wanted to know what kind of pill it actually was.
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor looked at both Lin Jing and Lin Jue and began to say:
“Actually, even if you hadn’t asked, I would have told you about the Ye Clan and the Ascension Pill.”
Lin Jing and Lin Jue hurriedly turned their gaze to the Changyun Clan’s ancestor, waiting for his answer.
And the Changyun Clan’s ancestor did not hesitate, beginning to narrate to them.
“To truly speak of it, we have to go back a million years…”
Upon hearing about a million years, Lin Jing frowned slightly, then said:
“A million years ago, to think it was so long ago…”
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor nodded and continued:
“A million years ago, there was a sudden great upheaval in heaven and earth, and an extraterrestrial calamity descended at the same time…”
“The South Continent Domain of Ming, you must have heard of it.”
“At that time…”
“An extraterrestrial calamity fell upon the South Continent Domain of Ming, turning most of its regions into the Barren Forbidden Zone, leaving less than one-tenth of its territory that has become the current Nanming Domain.”

chapters.title: Chapter 805
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 805: Chapter 357 Reason_2 Chapter 805: Chapter 357 Reason_2 “And the calamity in the Domain of Ming on South Continent began since then.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I once ventured into the Barren Forbidden Zone, and at its edge, I encountered an elder who told me about this matter.”
“According to that elder, at the center of the Barren Forbidden Zone lies a Samsara Fruit that fell from beyond our world.”
“It is precisely because of the presence of this Samsara Fruit, continually absorbing the life force within the zone, that the Barren Forbidden Zone has remained, with no one daring to approach.”
The elder of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing, somewhat astonished, and said,
“I had no idea you were aware of the matter regarding the Samsara Fruit.”
“Indeed!”
“It is indeed because of that Samsara Fruit that the Barren Forbidden Zone has persisted.”
After finishing, the elder of the Changyun Clan continued,
“In fact, this disaster is only one of them; including Immortal Crossing Island, which also emerged suddenly a million years ago.”
“Actually, whether it’s the calamity in the Domain of Ming on South Continent or the sudden appearance of Immortal Crossing Island, these were just preliminary signs.”
“And the real disaster quietly arrived at that time, but initially, no one knew…”
“The real disaster?
What is it?”
Lin Jue asked.
The elder of the Changyun Clan raised his head, looked through the large hole in the roof of the Alchemy Room, gazed outside, and then slowly said:
“It was since that time that our entire Cultivation World…”
“No…
not just ours…”
“But all the Cultivation Worlds we know of haven’t had a single person ascend…”
“Ah?”
“Unable to ascend?”
Both Lin Jing and Lin Jue were stunned.
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded and continued,
“Even if one’s cultivation had already reached the pinnacle of Mahayana and had surpassed the tribulation of becoming immortal, the legendary channel for ascension no longer appeared.”
“Normally, reaching the pinnacle of Mahayana would attract the tribulation of becoming immortal, and after surpassing this tribulation, the channel for ascension would open.”
“At that time, Immortal Energy would infuse the body, the cultivator’s spiritual power would transform into Immortal Yuan, and thereafter, they would ascend and become an immortal.”
“However, after surpassing the tribulation of becoming immortal, with no channel for ascension appearing, this cut off the path of ascension for all cultivators.”
Amid his shock, Lin Jing asked the elder of the Changyun Clan,
“How could this be?”
“Could there be some problem in the Immortal Realm?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan said,
“Clearly, with such occurrences, there undoubtedly are problems in the Immortal Realm.”
“However, with the level of our cultivations, even if there is a problem in the Immortal Realm, it isn’t something we can investigate.”
“And with the channel for ascension no longer appearing, we also can’t find out exactly what happened in the Immortal Realm.”
“Thus, we began seeking ways to investigate the cause of the troubles in the Immortal Realm.”
“And to probe into the causes of the troubles in the Immortal Realm, we must find ways to enter the Immortal Realm.
Now, without the channel for ascension, entering the Immortal Realm is not such an easy task.”
“But fortunately, in the Outer Spatial Void, alongside other cultivators from different Cultivation Worlds, we have together managed to locate a place, from before the Ancient Era, where someone once smuggled into the Immortal Realm using certain coordinates.”
“These coordinates lead to a section of the Celestial Barrier that is particularly weak; entering from these coordinates allows direct access to the Immortal Realm.”
“However, breaking through this section of the Celestial Barrier is extremely difficult.”
“It not only requires extremely strong cultivation but also the involvement of a true Immortal, using Immortal Yuan to channel the Immortal Energy of the Immortal Realm, in order to succeed.”
“And the Ascension Pill is indeed an unparalleled elixir that dates back to before the Ancient Era.”
“In times before the Ancient Era, when Heaven and Earth first separated, the Spiritual Energy in the Cultivation World was also extremely rich, and the threshold between the Immortal Realm and the Cultivation World wasn’t as stringent as it is now.”
“Even Immortals who had already ascended, under suitable conditions, could also descend to the mortal world.”
“The Ascension Pill is also from that era, brought by a descending Immortal.
Taking the Ascension Pill allows one to become immortal on the spot, without undergoing the process of ascension.”
Hearing the elder of the Changyun Clan’s explanation, Lin Jing was utterly astonished:
“I had no idea the Ascension Pill was so powerful, allowing one to become immortal directly.”
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded:
“It was under such circumstances that the top cultivators from various realms of cultivation world gathered together.
...
After hundreds of years of exploration, they finally found the elixir recipe for the Ascension Pill.”
“After finding the elixir recipe for the Ascension Pill, the group discussed and decided to place the recipe with your Lin Family, who would be responsible for crafting the Ascension Pills.”
“Meanwhile, others continued to search for the materials required to make the Ascension Pill, hoping to cultivate a true Immortal with it.”
“However…”
“This Ascension Pill, originally from before the Ancient Era, was brought down from the Immortal Realm, and many of the spirit plants and immortal materials in the recipe had gone extinct.
Some even existed only in the Immortal Realm, making it completely impossible to gather them all.”
“The group spent tens of thousands of years searching for those materials but ultimately failed to yield any results.”
“Seeing no hope in their search, many had given up and sought other methods.”
“Only your Lin Family remained stubbornly dedicated.”
“In order to study the elixir recipe and find alternative spirit plant materials, your Lin Family spent nearly a million years and efforts of countless generations probing that recipe…”
“Fortune favors the bold, and finally, ten thousand years ago, in the hand of elder Lin, your Lin Family gathered all materials needed to craft the Ascension Pill.”
“This Ascension Pill…”
“Due to the limitation of materials, it differed significantly from the original materials recorded in the elixir recipe.”
“Even though none of us were optimistic then, elder Lin firmly believed that the replaced materials, having compatible properties, were almost perfect substitutes, nearly identical to the original Ascension Pill.”
“Elder Lin, he bet everything of the Lin Family, decisively choosing to begin alchemy.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing somewhat understood.
“The alchemy failed, didn’t it?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan hesitated for a moment, then spoke:
“Yes, the crafting of the Ascension Pill failed…”
“Elder Lin was right, the materials he replaced perfectly matched in properties with those in the original Ascension Pill recipe and could almost perfectly substitute them.”
“When the alchemy reached the final stages, just as the pill was about to form, it triggered a Dan Tribulation.”
“Dan Tribulation?”
It was the first time Lin Jing had heard the term, naturally causing him some confusion.
The elder of the Changyun Clan explained:
“A Dan Tribulation is a phenomenon that might occur when elixir medicines above the ninth grade are about to form, signifying that the pill has exceeded the limit of medicinal pills in its plane.”
“It’s in the process of becoming an Immortal Pill.”
“And the rank of the Ascension Pill is exactly that of an Immortal Pill.”
“It can be said that if the Dan Tribulation were crossed, then the Ascension Pill would have been successfully crafted.”
At this point, Lin Jing asked:
“He couldn’t pass through the Dan Tribulation, could he?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded, saying:
“Yes.”
“Elder Lin had made all necessary preparations to face the possible Dan Tribulation.”
“But when the Dan Tribulation struck, its power exceeded everyone’s expectations.”
“When the Dan Tribulation struck, several of the top experts from your Lin Family, who were assisting in the alchemy, all died under it.”
“And elder Lin himself was severely wounded, forced into a desperate situation, and entered the shattered Innate Daoist Pill Furnace as a lingering soul.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing looked at the broken furnace in several pieces in the alchemy room.
Following Lin Jing’s gaze, the elder of the Changyun Clan also looked towards the pill furnace, then said:
“This is the furnace…”
“It’s also an inherited object of your Lin Family, an Innate Daoist Pill Furnace, albeit now shattered.”
“Such a pity.
.
ɴονǤᴑ.сօ
.”
“Innate Dao Treasures are forged from special innate spiritual objects, which are unique.
Once destroyed, they can never be restored.”
“Even if this pill furnace is ultimately repaired, its rank will be permanently reduced, never regaining its properties as an Innate Daoist Treasure.”
Lin Jing looked at the broken pieces of the pill furnace, and couldn’t help but feel silent…
The attempt to craft the Ascension Pill had turned out so tragic, even the Lin Family’s inherited Innate Daoist Pill Furnace had shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 806
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 806: Chapter 358 Ye Clan Karma Chapter 806: Chapter 358 Ye Clan Karma Subsequently, the Changyun Clan elder continued,
“Even including what you saw, Ganlin Island which had sunk to the seabed, and the dilapidated scenes within this Secret Realm, were all due to that terrifying Elixir Calamity.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing was silent for a moment, and then said,
“Wasn’t it said that the elder had already made preparations, so why did the Elixir Calamity become so terrifying?
Do you know, senior?”
The Changyun Clan elder nodded and then spoke,
“This naturally…”
“You have also taken part of the Ascension Pill, please share your feelings.”
Lin Jing nodded, pondered for a moment about his feelings when he had taken the Ascension Pill, and then spoke:
“This Ascension Pill, I felt it was extraordinary.”
“The Spiritual Power inside is very special, if refined, it could directly enhance one’s Cultivation at an extraordinary pace.”
“However…”
“If one wants to become an Immortal using this Ascension Pill, I still feel it’s quite impossible.”
“The seven-colored Spiritual Power contained in the Ascension Pill is extremely special, and there is no problem in enhancing Cultivation, but I feel it’s fundamentally impossible to become an Immortal with it.”
“There ought to be something missing.”
The Changyun Clan elder nodded and said,
“Lacking Immortal Yuan…”“The most important step in refining the Ascension Pill is to channel Immortal Yuan from the Elixir Calamity.”
“Previously, before the Ancient Era, the Immortal Realm was extremely normal, without any accidents, and channeling the Elixir Calamity would naturally bring down the Immortal Yuan with it.”
“This, before the Ancient Era, was a very ordinary matter, so the person who wrote out this Elixir Recipe didn’t care about this matter and did not include it in the Elixir Recipe.”
“While Lin did find Spiritual Objects that could be substituted in Alchemy, because of a mishap in the Immortal Realm, the Elixir Calamity could not bring down the Immortal Yuan.”
“Originally, one of the functions of the Elixir Calamity was to channel Immortal Yuan, to enhance an Elixir Medicine beyond Ninth-Grade to the level of an Immortal Pill.”
“However, because it couldn’t channel down the Immortal Yuan, the Rank of the Elixir Medicine could not continue to improve, thus causing the Elixir Calamity to become increasingly strong.”
“When Lin realized this, it was already too late to stop the Elixir Calamity, and his attempt to reverse it had also come too late.”
“Until the end, your Lin Family’s Innate Dao Treasure, the Pill Furnace, was destroyed by the Elixir Calamity, and the Elixir Medicine refinement failed, only then did the calamity completely stop.”
“By that time, Ganlin Island, where the Lin Family was located, had already been destroyed by this Elixir Calamity.”
“So that’s what happened…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing murmured to himself.
Just as Lin Jing finished speaking, Lin Jue also spoke,
“But I also heard that before this, our Lin Family had already encountered a Curse, not just this Elixir Calamity, but also other bizarre incidents that occurred to the Lin Family.”
“Just like what you, senior, and the Changyun Clan have encountered during this period.”
“Why is that so?”
The Changyun Clan elder said,
“Speaking of that, it’s unrelated to this Elixir Calamity.”
“Actually, it was all the mischief created by the remnants of the Ye Clan.”
“He…”
Upon mentioning the remnants of the Ye Clan, Lin Jing immediately remembered the hunchbacked old man holding a withered bone book and wearing a tattered black robe.
ƝοѵǤο.ƈο
The Changyun Clan elder nodded:
“The remnants of the Ye Clan had somehow obtained an extremely bizarre Innate Dao Treasure, the Disaster Heavenly Book.”
“The origins of the Disaster Heavenly Book are unknown, untraceable, and it’s unknown who refined it; it can curse Cultivators through the sacrifice of living beings, causing various accidents to befall the cursed individuals.”
“Moreover, during the cursing by the Disaster Heavenly Book, it’s extremely secretive, and undetectable by any means.”
“This is what makes the Disaster Heavenly Book most terrifying.”
“All the bizarre incidents that the Lin Family encountered ten thousand years ago, as well as the recent events that our Changyun Clan has encountered, were actually the work of the Disaster Heavenly Book.”
“Had I not gone on a trip to the Outer Spatial Void a while ago to seek the truth and accidentally heard some news, I would not have imagined that such a bizarre Innate Dao Treasure existed in this world.”
“It is also because I knew of this object that I had some suspicions and thus devised a plan to draw out the oversight from the Ye Clan.”
“The Disaster Heavenly Book, no wonder…”
Then, Lin Jing continued to speak:
“Senior…”
“Since we spoke of the oversight from the Ye Clan, could you tell me more about the Ye Clan?”
The Changyun Clan elder said,
“Naturally…”
“Regarding the Ye Clan, it’s actually quite simple.”
“The Ye Clan, along with us, the Changyun Clan and your Lin Family, are families that have been passed down since the Ancient Era.”
“Originally, at the beginning, although our two families and the Ye Clan couldn’t be said to get along very well, there was still some interaction.”
“It never escalated to the point of enmity.”
“However, just one million years ago, during that disaster, while all of us were striving to create an Immortal using the Ascension Pill…”
“The Ye Clan, ignoring the common conventions of the Cultivation World, secretly refined a human Evil Pill, attempting to use it to cultivate an Evil Immortal.”
“Human Evil Pill?”
“What is a Human Evil Pill?”
With a puzzled face, Lin Jue couldn’t help asking.
The Changyun Clan elder responded,
“The Human Evil Pill is a special Elixir Medicine refined using Cultivators as the main ingredient.”
“Using Cultivators as the main ingredient…”
Hearing this, both Lin Jing and Lin Jue couldn’t help but shiver and gasp in shock.
“The Human Evil Pill, after being consumed, can significantly enhance one’s Cultivation, but it’s too harmfully against heavenly principles and is condemned by the entire Cultivation World.”
“Moreover, there’s a side effect after consuming the Human Evil Pill, where the consumer’s sanity will be gradually eroded, becoming very prone to insanity and murderous rampages.”
...

chapters.title: Chapter 807
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 807: Chapter 358 Ye Clan Karma_2 Chapter 807: Chapter 358 Ye Clan Karma_2 “The cultivation world had long agreed that any forces wishing to refine the Human Wicked Elixir must be destroyed on sight.”
“At that time, the Ye Clan, along with your Lin Family and our Changyun Clan, were the top powers within the Inner Sea of demonic spirits.”
“When the Ye Clan’s secret production of the Human Wicked Elixir was accidentally exposed, the news exploded in the cultivation world, leading many to come to our two families, asking us to investigate the Ye Clan.”
“Given the incident occurred in the Inner Sea, it was our undeniable duty to send people to investigate the Ye’s family.”
“However, the team we sent had just entered the Ye Clan’s territory when they were ambushed by the Ye Clan, suffering heavy losses.”
“At that time, the Ye Clan had almost descended into madness, with the main family members, from top to bottom, having all consumed the Human Wicked Elixir.”
“Realizing they could not hide it any longer, the Ye Clan stopped pretending and began openly plundering all cultivators in their territory who were not part of the Ye Clan.”
“They wanted to use the lives of those hundreds of thousands of cultivators to refine a supremely powerful Human Wicked Elixir and planned to use this elixir to forcibly elevate the Ye family’s ancestor to the Immortal Realm.”
“This brought even greater outrage throughout the entire cultivation world.”
“Thus, our two families took the lead, with assistance from other forces, to band together and erase the Ye Clan from the cultivation world.”
“At the time, we thought we had eradicated all those involved in the Ye Clan’s manufacturing of the Human Wicked Elixir, but little did we expect, one slipped through the net.”
“This has led to all these bizarre incidents.”
After finishing, the Elder of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing and Lin Jue and said:
“This is the entirety of the incident, now do you understand?”
The two nodded repeatedly and said:
“We understand, elder…”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan nodded slightly, then looked at them and continued:“Now, that survivor from the Ye Clan has become a Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall, which is not good news for us…”
Indeed, as the Elder of the Changyun Clan had said.
The Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall held an unrivaled authority in the Seven Seas Hall, and if Ye Mingyi were to leverage his position against the Changyun Clan, it would be very troublesome for them.
But just at that moment…
The Elder of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing again and said:
“Lin Jing…”
“You mentioned earlier that you are now a Seventh Grade Alchemist, right?”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“Yes, elder…”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan smiled and then continued:
“Very good…”
“I would like you to help me refine a batch of elixir medicine, what do you say?”
Hearing the Elder of the Changyun Clan’s words, Lin Jing immediately remembered a previous conversation between his elder and the Elder of the Changyun Clan.
From their earlier discussion, it was not hard to guess that the Elder of the Changyun Clan’s lifespan was not much longer.
And a Seventh Grade Alchemist was just capable of refining a type of elixir that increases lifespan, the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
The one made from the main ingredient, the Undying Longevity Grass, along with the auxiliary ingredient, the Eternal Life Vine, was the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir Lin Jing had previously collected.
...
Depending on the quality of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, it could extend life by at least a few hundred years, and the highest quality, the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, could add up to two thousand years to one’s lifespan.
Lin Jing then spoke:
“Elder, would you like me to help you refine the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir?”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan nodded and then said:
“Honestly…”
“I have lived for tens of thousands of years, and my lifespan is already nearing its end.”
“Originally, before this, I was prepared to risk this little remaining lifespan to forcefully kill Ye Mingyi.”
“But…”
“This idea was persuaded out of me upon meeting Old Lin again.”
“I can die, but after my death, the Changyun Clan will have no one to anchor it.”
“Although we have allied with the Shocking Seas Alliance, and the Seven Seas Hall cannot destroy our Changyun Clan, without someone able to anchor it, our Changyun Clan would find itself in a very difficult situation.”
“So, I accepted Old Lin’s suggestion to try and refine the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir and see if I could live a little longer to deal with the remnant of the Ye Clan in a more secure manner.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment and then said:
“Elder, the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir you need is probably not ordinary, is it?”
“If I’m not mistaken, elder, what you need is likely the Flawless Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir.”
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan nodded gently and said,
“Indeed…”
“If it were a common quality Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir, our Changyun Clan could have produced it.”
“However, I have already consumed a life-extending elixir once before, and consuming it again would have no effect, so I must have a Flawless Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir to increase my lifespan.”
“Although we belong to the same Ancient Alchemy Family as the Lin Family, our alchemy techniques differ.”
“Our Changyun Clan’s alchemy techniques emphasize reliability, ensuring high success rates and quality of the elixirs.”
“As for the creation of flawless elixir medicine, our Changyun Clan hasn’t focused much on that.”
“Therefore, the likelihood of producing flawless quality elixir medicines through our Changyun Clan’s alchemy techniques is not very high.”
“In contrast, your Lin Family’s alchemy techniques are the exact opposite of ours.”
“The people of your Lin Family always enjoy taking risks, and the direction of your alchemy techniques naturally gravitates towards achieving flawless quality in elixir medicines.”
“So, the probability of encountering flawless elixir medicines when your Lin Family refines them is relatively higher.”
“That’s why I wanted to try reaching out to you this time.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment and then replied,
“Elder…”
“Helping you refine the Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir is no problem.”
“However, I cannot guarantee that I will be able to produce a Flawless Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir.”
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan smiled upon hearing this and then said,
“No one can be fully sure of successfully creating a flawless elixir medicine.”
“Moreover, a seventh grade Lifespan Life-Extension Elixir is something no one in the world can guarantee to successfully refine.”
“All you need to do is your best, and even if you don’t succeed, no one will blame you.”
Lin Jing nodded upon hearing this.
“Alright…”
“Since elder has said so, I will certainly give it my all and do my best.”
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing reassuringly and said,
“Don’t put too much pressure on yourself, just do your best.”
…
…
Afterward, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan prepared to leave the secret realm with Lin Jing and Lin Jue.
Before leaving the secret realm, at the urging of the patriarch of the Changyun Clan, Lin Jing also collected the broken Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace from the Lin Family.
Though the Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace was shattered and could not be restored to its original status as an Innate Dao Treasure,
this Pill Furnace was extraordinary; even after repairs, though it might not regain its status as an Innate Dao Treasure, it would still be a supreme-grade Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace.
A supreme-grade Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace is a highly coveted item among other powers and can refine ninth-grade elixir medicines without any problem.
Moreover,
the patriarch of the Changyun Clan also told Lin Jing that the quality of this Pill Furnace was too high, and normal masters of artifact refining could not repair it.
To repair this Pill Furnace, one would need to go to the Eastern Spirit Realm, where there is someone capable of repairing it.
Whenever they go to the Eastern Spirit Realm, they can find that person to help repair this Pill Furnace.
Lin Jing listened and silently noted this matter.
After collecting the damaged Pill Furnace, the three of them left the alchemy room.
Upon exiting, they looked around at the small courtyard with complex expressions.
Ɲονǥᴑ.сᴑ
Then, Lin Jing and Lin Jue bowed towards the courtyard, and afterward, they were led out of the Lin Family’s secret realm by the patriarch of the Changyun Clan.
When the group emerged, the secret realm was already deserted.
Lin Jing learned from the patriarch of the Changyun Clan that because they took too long inside, he had sent the people originally guarding the place back home earlier.
Upon exiting the secret realm, the entrance to the secret realm also disappeared.
And the crescent jade pendant flew back again, merging back into Lin Jue’s forehead.
Soon afterward,
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan led Lin Jing and the two to leave Ganlin Island and flew towards the Chang Yun Archipelago…

chapters.title: Chapter 808
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 808: Chapter 359: Preparation before Alchemy Chapter 808: Chapter 359: Preparation before Alchemy Having just returned to the Chang Yun Archipelago, the Changyun Clan’s Elder Ancestor first made arrangements for Lin Jue, and then, together with Lin Jing, went to the center of the Chang Yun Archipelago, to the place where he usually secluded himself for cultivation.
Here, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan gathered several grandfathers of Changyun Yuanshuang and spoke of having Lin Jing help with the preparation of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
However, as soon as the Elder Ancestor brought up the matter, Changyun Yuanshuang’s third grandfather immediately spoke up, trying to dissuade him:
“Elder Ancestor…”
“Is it really appropriate to have Lin Jing prepare the Elixir Medicine?”
“After all, he has just broken through to Seventh Grade Alchemist not long ago, and he hasn’t even prepared a Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine yet.”
“Our entire clan has put forth all our efforts and has only managed to collect materials for the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir twice.
Opportunities are scarce, we can’t afford to waste them…”
After his objection was voiced, Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather also spoke at this moment, trying to provide comfort:
“Elder Ancestor…”
“I think it’s normal for the third brother to have concerns.
Since you’ve decided to personally take action this time, why not prepare both sets of materials yourself?”
“After all, you’re a rare Ninth Grade Alchemist in the world, and the preparation of Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine is effortless for you, with a much higher chance of producing Flawless Pure Elixir.”
“The Alchemy Techniques of the Lin Family are indeed stronger than our Changyun Clan in preparing Flawless Pure Elixir, but the only one in the Lin Family who can prepare Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine, Lin Jing, is too young.”
“Although he is an alchemy genius and has been promoted to Seventh Grade Alchemist in such a short period of time, his youth means he lacks the experience in preparing Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine, and it may be difficult for him to control the preparation of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.”
After he finished speaking, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan looked at everyone, then said:
“I’m aware of what you all are saying…”“The preparation of Flawless Pure Elixir is different from other qualities of Elixir Medicine, and even as a Ninth Grade Alchemist, I can’t guarantee success.”
“If one batch fails, even if I prepare another, there’s still no guarantee.”
“I’ve already decided, the preparation of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir will be split between myself and Lin Jing, each of us preparing one batch.
If we succeed, all is well.
If we fail, then we’ll continue with the plan I discussed with you before.”
“There’s no need for further discussion.”
Seeing their Elder Ancestor resolute, the several grandfathers of Changyun Yuanshuang could only shake their heads in resignation, then responded:
“As you say, Elder Ancestor!”
The Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded, and then said to Lin Jing:
“In the coming period, I’ll have them prepare some Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine materials for you to practice with and get familiar.”
“After some time has passed, I will begin the alchemy directly.
...
You can observe; if I succeed, there’ll be no need for you to prepare.”
“But if I fail, then the preparation of the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir will be in your hands.”
Lin Jing nodded, saying:
“Although I can’t guarantee success with the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, please rest assured, Elder Ancestor, I will do my utmost.”
After hearing this, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded in acknowledgment, then said:
“Alright, that settles the matter.”
“Everything you need for the alchemy, I will arrange for someone to prepare.”
After finishing, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan inquired about the recent situation in the Seven Seas Hall.
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather replied:
“The identity of Ye Mingyi has been revealed by us.”
“According to our investigation, after we exposed Ye Mingyi’s true identity, it seems that there have been internal divisions within the Seven Seas Hall, splitting into two factions.”
“One faction, led by Ye Mingyi, wants to launch an attack against our Changyun Clan, while the other, led by the current Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall, wishes to strip Ye Mingyi of his powers.”
“However, Ye Mingyi has been operating within the Seven Seas Hall for over ten thousand years, and the majority of those with real power within the hall are closely linked to Ye Mingyi.”
“I suspect that the faction led by the Hall Master will soon be defeated.
Once the Seven Seas Hall falls completely into Ye Mingyi’s hands, they will likely wage war against us.”
After listening, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan pondered for a moment and then continued to inquire:
“What about the Shocking Seas Alliance?”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather continued:
“Xiao Yinxuan’s conspiracies were thwarted and failed.
After being saved by Ye Mingyi, he joined his ranks.”
“However, when Xiao Yinxuan left, he still took a portion of the people from the Shocking Seas Alliance to join the Seven Seas Hall.”
“Lu Jingtao has already represented the Shocking Seas Alliance to fully ally with us.
However, due to Xiao Yinxuan’s incident, the alliance is now undergoing a full reorganization.”
After hearing this, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded lightly, then said:
“The task of liaising with the Shocking Seas Alliance will be entrusted to you…”
“Also, since Ye Mingyi has emerged and we have fully allied with the Shocking Seas Alliance, the marriage of those two youngsters should be arranged if possible.”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather spoke:
“Yuanshuang and the young man from the Lu Family have also been asked about their affair.
Ɲοѵǥօ.сο
They both wish to consider marriage after this matter is settled.”
The Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded after hearing this, then said:
“With our tense situation with Seven Seas Hall, it’s indeed not a good time for these matters.”
“It’s better after everything is resolved…”
“Once the matter ends, we’ll organize a grand ceremony for the two of them.”
After saying this, the Elder Ancestor of the Changyun Clan continued:
“How are the other affairs within the clan being arranged?”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather replied:
“Over the past few days, we’ve already called back most of our clan members who were outside, leaving only a small number of people to gather intelligence and prepare for any attack from the Seven Seas Hall that could come at any moment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 809
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 809: Chapter 359 Preparations Before Alchemy_2 Chapter 809: Chapter 359 Preparations Before Alchemy_2 “`
…
…
Speaking of this, it involved some internal arrangements of the Changyun Clan that were irrelevant to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing did not linger here, but bid farewell to a few people before leaving this place.
ɴονǤ0.с0
After Lin Jing left, a member of the Changyun Clan immediately took Lin Jing to another location within the Chang Yun Archipelago.
There, Lin Jing met Lu Youjiu, the three brothers, the siblings Changyun Yuanshuang and Changyun Yuanlei, as well as Lin Jue.
...
All of them were present.
As soon as Lin Jing arrived, Yan Wanfei hurriedly came forward:
“Brother Lin…”
“I didn’t expect you to already be a Seventh Grade Pill Master, that’s impressive.
You didn’t say anything about it earlier; I thought at most you were Fifth Grade.”
Changyun Yuanlei also chimed in with a faint voice:
“Every day, my grandparents lock me in the alchemy room, and now I’m only a Sixth Grade Pill Master.Even so, they call me an alchemy genius.”
“Big brother, your alchemic talent is far superior to mine…”
Seeing their reactions, Lin Jing knew that they must have learned of his task to concoct the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir for the elder of the Changyun Clan.
Seeing their state, Lin Jing also hurriedly smiled and said:
“Being able to advance to a Seventh Grade Alchemist also involved some luck.”
After speaking, Lin Jing did not want to dwell on this topic and quickly changed the subject:
“By the way…”
“I just heard them talking about the marriage between Brother Lu and our friend from Changyun…”
“I had heard before that the two of you have always had a childhood sweetheart relationship.
How come after such a long time, it has not been settled yet…”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Changyun Yuanlei quickly spoke up:
“I know about this…”
“Actually, it’s mainly because…”
…
…
Lin Jing was quite successful in shifting the topic, as it immediately caught everyone else’s attention.
Yan Wanfei moved up next to Changyun Yuanlei, with Holaw Three Rivers likewise leaning in to listen.
Although they were aware of some details, they certainly did not know as much as Changyun Yuanlei and were naturally very interested in the matters of the past.
It was not just the two of them; even Lin Jue couldn’t resist the temptation and slowly moved closer.
Everything was so harmonious.
The only discordant note was the two people concerned, who couldn’t help feeling somewhat speechless as they watched the others huddle togetherâ€¦
…
…
The Qingming Pill is one of the most lackluster types of Seventh Grade Elixir Medicines.
When cultivators consume a Qingming Pill during their practice, it can increase their cultivation speed for a certain period of time.
Even though it is said to increase cultivation speed, as a Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine, its effect is actually not significant for cultivators at the Solidifying Body stage or even those in the Dao Integration Stage.
After reaching the Divinity Transformation, cultivators must additionally nurture their Soul Spirit alongside advancing their cultivation.
It is generally essential to progress both cultivation and Soul Spirit side by side, even if consuming a Qingming Pill could cause a breakthrough in one’s cultivation level.
However, at that point, it becomes necessary to stop and cultivate the Soul Spirit, waiting for it to catch up with the cultivation level before proceeding further.
For cultivators who have reached the Solidifying Body or even Dao Integration Stage, their Spirit Root Aptitude would not be poor, and thus, advancing their cultivation naturally would not be difficult.
On the other hand, improving the Soul Spirit requires continuous refining over time.
This leads to the situation where the usage of the Qingming Pill is not very significant.
Moreover, another downside of the Qingming Pill is that it is difficult to concoct, being more challenging to produce compared to other Seventh Grade Elixir Medicines.
Despite these drawbacks, the Qingming Pill has been passed down since the Ancient Era.
The sole advantage is probably its simple ingredients, which are not rare and relatively easy to find.
Even the essential herb, Qingming Root, can be cultivated.
Therefore, the Qingming Pill is most suitable as a special Elixir Medicine for training alchemists to improve their proficiency.
…
At this moment,
Within a small but extremely well-protected island in the Chang Yun Archipelago,
Lin Jing was sitting cross-legged in the island’s square.
In front of Lin Jing was the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace, bestowed to him by Changyun Yuanlei, which he had been using consistently.
Located at the central square, the Pill Furnace was glowing red, and although the area beneath it was warped, no flames were visible.
Despite the absence of visible flames, one could clearly feel the terrifying temperature at the bottom of the furnace.
This was the colorless flames condensed from Lin Jing’s Divine Fire Triple Realm, having reached the third level of his practice.
“`
At that time,
Lin Jing was sitting cross-legged, manipulating the flames at the bottom of the furnace while simultaneously extending his Divine Sense, carefully monitoring the activities within the Pill Furnace.
At this moment, a fragrant scent continuously wafted out from the crevices of the Pill Furnace.
Clearly, the Elixir Furnace Medicine had reached the final, critical moment before Pill Formation.
In the square, aside from Lin Jingzhi who was performing alchemy in the center, there were two others on the edge of the square.
These two were none other than Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang and the patriarch of the Changyun Clan.
At the moment, both were observing Lin Jing, who was in the midst of alchemy.
“Elder, what do you think?”
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang’s voice was very soft, as if afraid of disturbing Lin Jing.
“This batch of Elixir Medicine should be good, I estimate that a Supreme Elixir will emerge, but we still need to see his final solidifying pill process, if there are no accidents…”
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang heard this, gently nodded his head, and said no more.
Meanwhile, there was a disturbance in the Pill Furnace on the field.
Seeing this, Lin Jing promptly gathered his Spiritual Power.
The invisible, colorless flame at the bottom of the furnace also surged upward, enveloping the entire Pill Furnace in that twisted space.
Simultaneously, within the Pill Furnace, Lin Jing used his Divine Sense with great care, solidifying the Elixir Medicine that was about to form.
…
Finally,
The Elixir Medicine was fully solidified and completely formed.
The batch of Elixir Medicine had also been successfully refined.
After the Elixir Medicine was completed, the entire fragrance of the elixir suddenly spilled forth, pervading the entire square.
“Supreme Elixir!”
Grandfather Changyun Yuanshuang exclaimed.
The Changyun Clan patriarch nodded and said,
“Indeed, it is a Supreme Elixir.”
As their voices fell, Lin Jing also stood up at this moment and then moved to the side of the Pill Furnace.
With a wave of his hand, the Pill Furnace was immediately opened.
As soon as the Pill Furnace was opened, several elixirs flew out from within.
Lin Jing reached out his hand and directly caught the elixirs.
Then, Lin Jing extended his hand and looked at the several elixirs floating in his palm.
This batch, Lin Jing had refined a Qingming Pill, in total five had formed.
The Qingming Pill is green when formed.
The rounder the pill and the deeper its color, the better the quality of the Elixir Medicine; conversely, the worse the quality.
Of the five elixirs in Lin Jing’s hand, three were not very round and, upon closer inspection, one could even see some impurities.
These three were Medium Grade Elixir Medicines.
Then there were two more, one of which was somewhat round and also showed no impurities.
This was a Superior Qingming Pill.
Beside this Superior Qingming Pill was another slightly larger Elixir Medicine.
This Elixir was different; it had a lush green color, with a green light flowing on its surface, looking extremely beautiful.
Moreover, this Elixir Medicine was exceptionally round, its surface devoid of any impurities.
This Elixir was the Supreme Grade Qingming Pill.
After inspecting the Elixir Medicines, Lin Jing immediately took out a wooden box and placed the elixirs inside it.
Then, Lin Jing carried the wooden box and walked toward the two individuals at the edge of the square.
Upon reaching them, Lin Jing handed the wooden box to the elder of the Changyun Clan:
“Elder, please have a look…”
The Changyun Clan patriarch took the wooden box and then began to examine the elixirs inside.
After a while, he picked up the Supreme Grade Qingming Pill and observed it closely in front of his eyes.
After the examination, the Changyun Clan patriarch put the Elixir back into the box and nodded at Lin Jing.
“Good…”
“Compared to some time ago, there is much progress.”
