“After practicing for a while longer, you can begin preparing the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.”
Lin Jing nodded.
The Changyun Clan patriarch continued,
“Don’t practice alchemy tomorrow; I have already made preparations.
Tomorrow, we will start the furnace to refine the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
Come and observe, to gain some experience before the actual refinement.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded,
“Understood, Elder…”

chapters.title: Chapter 810
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 810: Chapter 360 The First Refinement of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir Chapter 810: Chapter 360 The First Refinement of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir Soon, the two of them left.
As for Lin Jing, he turned around and headed to the other end of the square.
At the other edge of the square lay an Alchemy Room.
Since his arrival at Chang Yun Archipelago, a month had now passed.
During this month, Lin Jing had been concocting Elixir Medicine in this Alchemy Room without ever going out.
Although Lin Jing did not venture outside, every few days someone would deliver the necessary Alchemy Ingredients for his work.
With the Changyun Clan’s support, Lin Jing had no need to worry about the supply of Alchemy Ingredients.
...
Additionally, Lu Youjiu and Lin Jue would occasionally come by to inform Lin Jing about the outside world’s affairs.
The internal strife within Seven Seas Hall seemed about to reach its conclusion, and the situation between Changyun Clan and Seven Seas Hall was becoming increasingly tense.
Even minor frictions had started to emerge.
During this period, neither the Changyun Clan nor the Shocking Seas Alliance had been idle; the Shocking Seas Alliance had been dealing with the aftermath of the Xiao Yinxuan incident, setting them back quite a bit of time.
Now, they were nearly done reorganizing.
On the Changyun Clan’s side, in addition to consolidating their forces to prepare for the conflict with Seven Seas Hall,
The remainder…
Was to prepare for the concoction of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
The Changyun Clan’s ancestral old master, as the top combatant of the entire clan, held a role that could not be underestimated.
Without him stationed at Changyun Clan, even if they were to win the conflict with Seven Seas Hall eventually, the Changyun Clan would still suffer a significant loss of strength.
Therefore,
The entire clan was deeply concerned about the concoction of this Elixir Medicine.
Back in the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing sitting cross-legged, carefully recalled each moment of today’s alchemy process.
This time, Lin Jing did not perform alchemy in the System Space.
No…
It should be said that recently, most of the time, Lin Jing conducted alchemy outside the System Space.
Moreover,
Lin Jing did not use the Bonus Attachment feature; the Elixir Medicine he produced was entirely dependent on his own level of Alchemy Dao.
The main reason for doing so was to hone his genuine alchemy skills, as he needed to create Flawless-grade Elixir Medicine for the Changyun Clan’s old master.
Lin Jing was unsure about concocting a Seventh Grade, Flawless-quality Pure Elixir.
If there had been sufficient time, it wouldn’t have been a problem for Lin Jing to create a Flawless-grade Longevity Life-Extension Pill.
But the issue now was the imminent conflict between the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance versus the Seven Seas Hall.
There wasn’t much time left.
Moreover, there were only two sets of ingredients for the Longevity Life-Extension Pill.
The Changyun Clan’s old master would use one set himself, and only the other set could be used by Lin Jing.
Figuratively speaking, this was Lin Jing’s only chance.
Though Lin Jing’s System Space contained the Undying Longevity Grass and Longevity Vine, these two Spirit Plants took too long to grow.
After coming to the Inner Sea, the System Space had just undergone an upgrade and he didn’t have sufficient Harvest Points to hasten their ripening.
Ɲονǥο.сᴑ
Under these circumstances, Lin Jing could only improve his own alchemy level and then rely on the 10% chance of producing a Flawless Elixir Medicine at the Seventh Grade Alchemy Room to try his luck.
If that didn’t work out, he would have to think of other methods.
…
Afterwards,
Lin Jing replayed the entire process in his mind and, after reflecting, identified a few areas where he could have done better during the alchemy procedure.
Then, pondering for a while, he came up with a few different plans.
Once he had finished his contemplation, Lin Jing couldn’t wait to start experimenting…
…
…
The next morning, the Changyun Clan’s old master was ready to start the Pill Furnace to concoct the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
Lin Jing was also brought early to the heart of Chang Yun Archipelago, the core area of the Changyun Clan, by one of Yuanshuang’s elders.
Here, there was an extremely important Alchemy Room belonging to the Changyun Clan.
Moreover,
In this place rested the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace, the most important Pill Furnace of the Changyun Clan.
Although it didn’t compare to the Lin Family’s now-shattered Innate Dao Treasure Pill Furnace,
It still was a formidable Supreme Grade Daoist Treasure.
And using the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace for alchemy could significantly increase the success rate.
However, due to the special nature of the materials used, the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace couldn’t be stored in ordinary Storage Treasures.
Therefore, most of the time, this Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace was kept in the most secure core area of the Changyun Clan.
The expansive Alchemy Hall that housed the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace could accommodate tens of thousands of people with no issue.
When Lin Jing arrived, the others were already there.
Several grandfathers of Yuanshuang from the Changyun Clan had even activated the hall’s Formation in preparation for the old master’s alchemy session.
In addition to the elders of the Changyun Clan, Yuanshuang and her brother, as well as Lu Youjiu, had also arrived.
Upon Lin Jing’s arrival, he walked straight towards the group.
“Big brother…”
“Brother Lin…”
Changyun Yuanlei and Lu Youjiu, upon seeing Lin Jing, greeted him.
Lin Jing, smiling, said,
“So you have come too…”
“Of course…”
“To witness and learn from the old master’s pill concoction is a must,” Yuanlei said with a laugh.
Lin Jing nodded and responded,
“Indeed…”
“Observing a senior’s alchemy is tremendously beneficial for us.”
Just then…
The Changyun Clan’s old master entered the hall.
Seeing the old master of the Changyun Clan, everyone present greeted him,
“Ancestor…”
“Forebear…”
The Changyun Clan’s old master looked at the crowd and nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 811
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 811: Chapter 360 The First Refinement of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir_2 Chapter 811: Chapter 360 The First Refinement of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir_2 And then, he turned his attention to Lin Jing.
Following that, the Changyun Clan Elder approached Lin Jing and said,
“When I am refining the elixir later, observe carefully…”
“If I fail this time, it will be up to you.”
Lin Jing nodded and said to the Changyun Clan Elder,
“Senior, please be at ease…”
“I will do my utmost and not let you down.”
The Changyun Clan Elder nodded slightly, then walked towards the center of the main hall.
When the Changyun Clan Elder entered the center of the main hall and approached the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace, several grandfathers from the Changyun Yuanshuang immediately activated the formation.
In an instant, a transparent light screen rose in front of everyone, quickly enveloping the Changyun Clan Elder inside the main hall.
Ɲονɡօ.сο
As the transparent light screen rose, another formation pattern emerged beneath the feet of the crowd, and the whole formation began to operate.
The first formation was a shielding formation that could block any external disturbances.
...
The second formation was a special formation with a Gathering Spirit effect; upon its activation, it provided an abundant supply of Spiritual Energy for the interior of the formation.
It also stabilized the interior Spiritual Energy to prevent it from becoming too chaotic and potentially disturbing the alchemy process.
Once both formations had been activated, the Changyun Clan Elder then began making preparations…
The Changyun Clan Elder waved his hand, and dozens of Spirit Plants needed for refining the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir floated up in front of him.
Then, with his right hand raised, a cluster of golden flames burst forth from the palm of his hand.
As the Changyun Clan Elder lifted his right hand higher, the golden flames in his hand grew more and more intense.
Eventually, with a wave of his hand, the golden flames flew towards the floating Spirit Plants in mid-air.
Before the actual refinement of the Elixir Medicine, it was necessary to refine all the Spirit Plants required for the elixir, removing impurities so that the alchemy process could begin.
The Changyun Clan Elder was performing this initial refinement.
Removing impurities and preserving essence.
The Changyun Clan Elder’s display of golden flames was exceedingly powerful, far surpassing even Lin Jing’s Divine Fire Triple Realm.
Under the refinement of the golden flames, the impurities in those Spirit Plants were continuously refined, and the size of the entire plant gradually diminished.
Since these Spirit Plants varied in rank, both high and low, the speed of refinement also varied.
In no long time, some of the Spirit Plants were already refined.
Seeing that some Spirit Plants had been refined, the Changyun Clan Elder directly set aside the refined plants, continuing the refinement of the others.
…
…
As time slowly passed, the Spirit Plants were refined one after another until, at last, only the two most important ones remained.
The Undying Longevity Grass and the Longevity Vine.
These two Spirit Plants were crucial for the creation of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, with the highest ranks and, therefore, the most difficult to refine.
However, despite their difficulty, they began to gradually dissolve within the golden flames.
Eventually.
One hour after all the other Spirit Plants had been refined, these two Spirit Plants were finally refined as well.
After the Spirit Plants were refined, the Changyun Clan Elder didn’t hesitate.
He waved his hand, and the golden flames surged out instantaneously, appearing under the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
The blaze of golden flames was much more vigorous than during the earlier refinement of the Elixir Medicine.
The roaring golden flames enveloped the entire Pill Furnace.
The previously dormant Formation Patterns on the body of the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace were now activated and began to move.
Seeing this, the Changyun Clan Elder promptly channelled his Spiritual Power, introducing the refined, impurity-free Spirit Plants into the furnace in sequence.
After inserting all the Spirit Plants into the Pill Furnace, the Changyun Clan Elder quickly closed the furnace and then sat down with his legs crossed, beginning the actual alchemy process.
As the Elixir Medicine began to be refined, everyone held their breath and concentrated, watching intently at the center of the main hall at the elixir’s refinement.
Especially Lin Jing, who was watching with utmost seriousness, not wanting to miss any detail.
…
…
The higher the rank of the Elixir Medicine, the more difficult its refinement, and the longer the time required.
After the ancestor of the Changyun Clan began the alchemy, six hours had swiftly passed.
In the time of six hours, if it were for low-tier elixirs, the process would have been completed already, but the refinement of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir still had a long way to go.
At this moment.
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan seemed as if he had performed the alchemy countless times, observing the situation inside the pill furnace with ease while skillfully controlling the flames at its base, appearing extremely relaxed.
Although the ancestor of the Changyun Clan appeared very relaxed, a look of utmost seriousness could be seen in his eyes.
As time rapidly flowed, another six hours went by.
This furnace of the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir had now been in the process of refinement for a full twelve hours.
The meticulous observation over twelve hours left many feeling a touch of fatigue, Lin Jing included.
However, this degree of tiredness was a common occurrence for alchemists like them who routinely practiced alchemy, and wasn’t considered significant.
It was then that the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace underwent a change; the formation patterns on the body of the furnace began to move more swiftly.
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan also began to stoke the golden flames, making them burn even more fiercely.
It seemed that the refinement of the elixir furnace medicine was likely nearing its final stage.
After a while longer, with the formation patterns on the furnace body accelerating continuously, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan rose to his feet, staring fixedly at the pill furnace while carefully controlling the golden flames at its base.
Right after the ancestor of the Changyun Clan stood up, white mist began to drift out from the pill furnace.
Accompanying the white mist was the delightful fragrance of the elixir.
By this time, everyone knew they had reached the crucial moment of pill formation.
The outcome of this alchemy was significant.
So, people quickly pulled themselves together, watching the ancestor of the Changyun Clan with tension.
Time seemed to slow to a crawl at this moment, as everyone anxiously gazed at the pill furnace in the great hall, secretly praying.
They hoped that the ancestor could succeed in a single attempt, creating a flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
Just then…
Suddenly, a wisp of colorful light shone out from within the pill furnace.
Upon seeing this colorful light, everyone present, including Lin Jing, was instantly overjoyed.
The appearance of extraordinary phenomena was a must for the emergence of high-grade flawless elixirs, and this colorful light was indeed one such omen.
Seeing this omen, it meant that the refinement of the flawless elixir, barring any accidents, should be a success.
However, in the middle of the assembly, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan remained unflustered and continued to refine the elixir with dedication.
Time ticked away; the colorful light grew brighter, and the elixir fragrance filling the great hall became increasingly intense.
It looked like the flawless elixir was about to be successfully created.
All were filled with anticipation, waiting for the emergence of this batch of flawless elixir.
But just at that moment…
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan, for some unknown reason, abruptly paused, and the golden flames he was controlling suddenly surged violently, engulfing the entire pill furnace in an instant.
What had been going very smoothly up until now was suddenly thrown into disarray by this unexpected development, causing a collective gasp among those around.
Lin Jing was no exception as he quickly looked towards the ancestor of the Changyun Clan to see what had happened.
By the time Lin Jing looked over, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan had already reacted.
After regaining his composure, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan’s face turned extremely grim as he urgently stimulated his spiritual power to bring the flames back to their original state.
However, due to that brief interruption, the colorful light that had appeared was now nowhere to be seen.
Seeing this, everyone realized that something had gone wrong.
This was almost like saying that the flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, which was nearly in their grasp, had failed at the critical moment.
Even so, everyone dared not speak, instead waiting for the ancestor of the Changyun Clan to completely finish refining the elixir.
Soon after.
The elixir was finally complete, and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan withdrew the golden flames from beneath the furnace.
Seeing this, a few of the elders of the Changyun Clan quickly deactivated the formation, and as soon as the formation was open, Changyun Yuanshuang immediately spoke up, asking the ancestor of the Changyun Clan:
“Ancestor, what exactly happened?”
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan’s face was as still as water as he slowly spoke:
“The Disaster Heavenly Book…”

chapters.title: Chapter 812
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 812: Chapter 361: Curse, The 2nd Alchemy Chapter 812: Chapter 361: Curse, The 2nd Alchemy Upon hearing these words,
everyone present fell into silence.
The golden flames that the elder of the Changyun Clan had controlled, which had suddenly gone out of control, turned out to be due to the machinations of the Disaster Heavenly Book.
It seemed that, once again, Ye Mingyi had made a sacrifice to unleash the cursing power of the Disaster Heavenly Book, targeting the elder of the Changyun Clan.
Although the Disaster Heavenly Book was an Innate Daoist Treasure, it wasn’t easy to employ it against a Mahayana Cultivator, especially against those at the pinnacle like the elder of the Changyun Clan.
But.
It depends on the situation.
For instance, right now, during the crucial moment of alchemy for the elder of the Changyun Clan, the sudden emergence of that curse’s power only affected him momentarily, which wouldn’t harm him.
...
Yet, it was exactly this momentary influence that led to the worst outcome, causing the long-prepared alchemy process to fail…
For a time, everyone in the hall fell silent.
No one spoke another word.
The elder of the Changyun Clan swept his gaze over the crowd, and then approached the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
He then directly opened the Pill Furnace.
As the Pill Furnace opened, an extremely rich Elixir Fragrance immediately spread throughout the entire hall.
As the fragrance wafted out, a few Elixir Medicines slowly floated out from the Pill Furnace as well.
Seeing the Elixir Medicines float out, Lin Jing fixed his gaze on them.
In this batch cooked by the elder of the Changyun Clan, a total of six Elixir Medicines were formed.
Among the six, one wasn’t quite as round.
The remaining five were very round.
Especially among them, three which gleamed brightly, were exceedingly round, almost becoming translucent.
These three were Supreme Elixir Medicines while the others were two Superior and one Medium Grade Elixir Medicine.
If not for the incident earlier, these three medicines probably would have transformed into one Flawless and one Supreme Grade Elixir Medicine.
It was exactly that incident that prevented the final transformation of the Supreme Elixir Medicines.
The elder of the Changyun Clan, being a Ninth Grade Alchemist, managed to produce three Supreme Grade and two Superior Elixir Medicines despite such an incident.
Seeing the Elixir Medicines, the elder of the Changyun Clan remained expressionless, directly picking them up in his hand.
After that…
The elder of the Changyun Clan walked toward the crowd.
Other senior members of the Changyun Clan, seeing this, quickly gathered around him.
Lin Jing and Lu Youjiu, along with the Changyun siblings, Changyun Yuanshuang and her brother, due to their lower status, stood towards the back.
“Elder…”
“Elder…”
…
ƝοѵǤο.ƈο
…
At this time, everyone had worried looks on their faces as they watched the elder of the Changyun Clan.
The elder of the Changyun Clan, after pausing, then spoke:
“Enough…
“This alchemy attempt has failed; disperse.”
After he spoke, the elder of the Changyun Clan moved forward, walking out of the hall, and the other Changyun Clan elders quickly made way for him.
As he walked past Lin Jing, the elder of the Changyun Clan looked at him and said:
“This failure is unexpected, but understandable; it was my oversight…”
“There’s no need for you to overthink it.
You should go back as well, and I will come find you later.”
Lin Jing nodded, “Alright, elder…”
Afterwards.
The elder of the Changyun Clan left the great hall.
After the elder of the Changyun Clan left, Lin Jing, Lu Youjiu, Changyun Yuanshuang, and her brother also left together.
Leaving the hall, Lin Jing chatted with the others for a while before excusing himself to return to the small island he was on before.
Lin Jing, after returning, did not continue with alchemy but rather reflected on the elder of the Changyun Clan’s alchemy process.
The elder of the Changyun Clan’s alchemy, from start to finish, had been perfectly controlled.
If not for being disrupted at the last moment, the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir would have been finished.
It was truly regrettable.
Sadly, what should have been a successful batch of Elixir Medicines was ultimately ruined by the influence of the Disaster Heavenly Book.
One can’t help but wonder why the effect of the Disaster Heavenly Book appeared at that moment?
Was it a premeditated plan by Ye Ming?
Or was it something he did on a whim…
About this, Lin Jing had no knowledge.
Lin Jing believed that the elder of the Changyun Clan would know something and that when he came to see Lin Jing, he would certainly share some information.
Lin Jing just needed to wait.
…
Having been told that the elder of the Changyun Clan would come to find him, Lin Jing had been waiting, but this wait lasted until the next day.
Only in the afternoon of the following day did the elder of the Changyun Clan come to see Lin Jing.
As the elder of the Changyun Clan arrived, Lin Jing promptly greeted him:
“Elder…”
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded slightly, then said to Lin Jing:
“I will be leaving for a while.”
“I’ve made arrangements; if you are going to practice alchemy recently, just use the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace and get used to it first.”
“When it’s time to actually do the alchemy, use the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.”
Lin Jing was initially taken aback, then nodded:
“Alright, elder.”
After speaking, Lin Jing paused before asking:
“About today’s alchemy incident…
“Was it Ye Ming who played the trick?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded and said:
“Yes…
“Ye Mingyi had planted a traitor within our family, someone who had been lurking for quite some time.
Everything we’ve been doing recently was leaked by this person.
“Ye Ming feared that I would succeed in creating a Flawless grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, extending my lifespan.
“That’s why he made his move, sacrificing an entire island of cultivators and using the Disaster Heavenly Book to affect me, causing my alchemy to fail.”

chapters.title: Chapter 813
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 813: Chapter 361 Curse, Second Alchemy_2 Chapter 813: Chapter 361 Curse, Second Alchemy_2 “Sacrifice…an entire island…”
When Lin Jing heard this, he couldn’t help but feel a chill run down his spine.
The elder of the Changyun Clan nodded before saying,
“Correct…”
“Although the Disaster Heavenly Book is an Innate Dao Treasure, it is overly special, and to utilize it, a sacrifice must be made.”
“Moreover, depending on the cultivation of the cultivator you wish to curse, the beings required for the sacrifice also vary.”
“I myself am at the pinnacle of Mahayana cultivation and also an ancestor of a family, carrying the fortunes of our Changyun Clan.
For him to curse me and have it take effect, he would definitely need to sacrifice a large number of living beings.”
“I had thought that, with his involvement in the internal strife of the Seven Seas Hall, he would be too busy to bother with us again.”
“Little did I expect that he would still seize this opportunity…”
After finishing, the elder of the Changyun Clan sighed again:
“Our Changyun family has always been united, as solid as iron, with no problems ever emerging before.
But this time, what I really did not expect was that the problem would arise from within our own family.”
“Ye Mingyi has had a longstanding hatred for our two families.
He has been hiding in the shadows for a long time, looking for a chance to exact his revenge.
He would naturally find a way to plant someone in the Chang Yun Archipelago.”
“This was indeed my oversight.I was deceived by the appearance of unity in the family and assumed that Ye Mingyi would not be able to intervene.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing fell silent.
...
In reality,
from the fact that the entire Changyun clan was putting on a performance around the few of them, one could see that the true core of the Changyun Clan was not merely united.
It also managed to smoke out Ye Mingyi, who had always hidden in the dark.
A family so united would naturally not encounter problems easily, and the elder of the Changyun Clan would naturally not think in that direction.
Which is why this mistake occurred.
Since it had already happened, talking about it was pointless.
Lin Jing merely wanted to know what the elder of the Changyun Clan planned to do next.
After all, if the Disaster Heavenly Book could affect the elder of the Changyun Clan, then he was certainly no exception.
Not to mention in alchemy, if Ye Mingyi knew that the elder of the Changyun Clan was planning to have him perform alchemy, and Ye Mingyi used the Disaster Heavenly Book to act against him,
he would certainly not be able to avoid it.
Lin Jing was not the elder of the Changyun Clan; he didn’t have such high cultivation.
If he was really cursed, he would surely not be able to evade it.
By then, let alone performing alchemy, even sustaining injuries could be likely.
It all depended on whether Ye Mingyi was willing to go so far for such a minor character as himself.
But, to put it this way,
the likelihood of Ye Mingyi using the Disaster Heavenly Book against him should not be very high.
In his eyes, Lin Jing was merely an ant, not worth his great effort to use the Disaster Heavenly Book against.
Afterward, Lin Jing asked the elder of the Changyun Clan,
“Then, elder, what do you plan to do next?”
The elder of the Changyun Clan then spoke:
“Ye Mingyi has a deep impression of you, and I fear he will use the Curse Technique.”
“During this time, just stay here.”
“The Curse Technique cannot directly harm a person; it only covertly affects a cultivator’s fortune, placing the cultivator into perilous situations at critical moments.”
“Such as when a cultivator faces tribulation…”
“Or during my alchemy, encountering danger, or in moments of battle…”
“The Curse Technique functions most effectively in these crucial situations.”
“Conversely, during peaceful times, even if afflicted with a curse, no accidents would occur.”
“Therefore, as long as you stay here and do not actively involve yourself in dangerous situations, you will not encounter danger.”
“During this time, I will leave for a while to seek a way to resolve the curse.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
After instructing Lin Jing, the elder of the Changyun Clan did not stay longer and soon left directly.
…
…
After the elder of the Changyun Clan had left, in the following period, Lin Jing continued with his alchemy as usual.
However, this time around, under the arrangements of the Changyun Clan’s elders, he began using the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace to concoct elixirs.
Although the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace is a top-tier Daoist Treasure, it serves as the most powerful pill furnace of the Changyun Clan.
It isn’t owned by any one person, but is a treasure of the entire Changyun Clan.
It can be used without needing refinement.
During this period, while using the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace, Lin Jing found that this Daoist treasure furnace truly was powerful.
It not only made his alchemy easier but even increased the success rate of his alchemy.
Over this period, Lin Jing, without the enhancement of the System Space, actually managed to craft the Flawless Qingming Pill using the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
The emergence of the Seventh Grade Flawless Elixir Medicine thrilled the elders of the Changyun Clan immensely.
They felt somewhat relieved.
Thus, until two months had passed, the Patriarch of the Changyun Clan finally rushed back from outside.
Upon his return, the Changyun Clan Patriarch wasted no time, immediately finding Lin Jing and stating that they could begin alchemy.
For this alchemy session, Lin Jing had been preparing for a long time, and was already ready, needing no further preparations.
Thus,
after discussing, they decided to start the alchemy on the following day.
…
…
The next day…
Still in the core of the Changyun Clan, in the most important Alchemy Room of the Clan.
The entire core of the Changyun Clan gathered there.
This time, in addition to the elders of the Changyun Clan, even Lin Jue attended.
At that moment, Lin Jing stood at the center of the grand hall, beside the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
By Lin Jing’s side was also the Patriarch of the Changyun Clan.
The Formation of the Alchemy Room had already been activated, encapsulating Lin Jing and the Patriarch within a light barrier.
ṅοѵǤᴑ.сο
This formation, however, was different from the last.
This time, above the formation floated a Talisman emitting a golden radiance.
This Talisman, which the Changyun Clan Patriarch had found, was used to temporarily ward off the Curse.
At this moment, the Changyun Clan Patriarch said to Lin Jing,
“In a moment, I will first refine those Spirit Plants for you, and after that, the rest of the alchemy will be up to you.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing nodded.
The materials for alchemy, before actual alchemy begins, must first be refined to remove impurities.
The Cultivation of the Changyun Clan Patriarch was much higher than Lin Jing’s, so his refinement of those Spirit Plants would naturally be superior to Lin Jing’s.
If Lin Jing were to refine those Spirit Plants, it would take at least four hours, but if done by the Changyun Clan Patriarch, an hour was sufficient.
This would not only save time, but also allow Lin Jing to be more relaxed.
Afterwards,
The Changyun Clan Patriarch lifted his hand, once again conjuring that golden flame.
The golden flames soared up, and then, with a gesture from the Changyun Clan Patriarch, the materials for the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir rose into the air and entered the golden flames.
Up close this time, Lin Jing truly sensed the terror of the golden flames.
The golden flames ignited, causing ripples in the surrounding space, let alone the Spirit Plants placed within the flames.
Quickly, the Spirit Plants began to change.
One by one, the Spirit Plants shrank, and their impurities were forced out.
As time slowly passed, the Spirit Plants were soon fully refined.
No more, no less, exactly one hour.
After refining the Spirit Plants, the Changyun Clan Patriarch directly handed them to Lin Jing.
“Next, it’s up to you,” he said.
Lin Jing nodded.
Afterwards,
Having said that, the Changyun Clan Patriarch walked out, and the elders in charge of the formation hastily opened it to allow him to exit.
After the Changyun Clan Patriarch left, the formation closed once again.
Lin Jing then stepped forward to stand in front of the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
First glancing at the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace in front of him, Lin Jing then silently recited in his mind,
“System!”
“Activate Bonus Attachment feature.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the System’s prompt sound rang out in his mind.
“Ding!”
“Bonus Attachment activation successful, 5 Harvest Points deducted, current Harvest Points remaining: 2874.”
For these three months, Lin Jing had been constantly practicing alchemy, but had never done so inside the System Space or used the Bonus Attachment feature.
He did so to maximize his own abilities, hoping to successfully craft the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir in one go.
Now that the real alchemy had begun,
Lin Jing no longer held back and directly activated the Bonus Attachment feature.

chapters.title: Chapter 814
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 814: Chapter 362 Alchemy Success, Arrangements of Ancestor Changyun Chapter 814: Chapter 362 Alchemy Success, Arrangements of Ancestor Changyun After the Bonus Attachment kicked in, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged, and he immediately felt his sea of consciousness become incredibly clear.
This feeling gave Lin Jing more confidence in refining the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
However.
Lin Jing did not become arrogant or complacent but instead concentrated his Divine Sense to continue operating the Divine Fire Triple Realm.
Following that.
A cluster of invisible transparent flames rose from the palm of Lin Jing’s hand.
Because of the barrier formed by the Formation, those Changyun Clan observers of the alchemy process outside could not feel the terrifying temperature of the flames in the palm of Lin Jing’s hands.
...
They could only see the space above his palm suddenly become distorted.
“What kind of flame is that?”
“It doesn’t have any color.”
Not everyone knew that Lin Jing practised the Divine Fire Triple Realm, and even fewer had managed to cultivate the third realm of it.
So when Lin Jing’s colorless flame appeared, it immediately raised questions among the crowd.
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather then spoke up to explain:
“The Divine Fire Triple Realm, the third realm…”
As soon as these words were out, they caused a wave of exclamation around them:“It’s actually the third realm of the Divine Fire Triple Realm, no wonder I’ve never seen it.”
…
“This Divine Fire Triple Realm enhances the flames condensed based on one’s own Cultivation; the higher the Cultivation, the stronger the Divine Fire Triple Realm is.”
“Especially this third realm of the Divine Fire Triple Realm, to cultivate it successfully, one must be aided by Blazing Marrow Spirit, which is extremely rare.”
“That Blazing Marrow Spirit is so hard to find, it hasn’t appeared for a long time, I can’t believe this kid actually found it.”
…
“Indeed…”
“I estimate that if he cultivates to the Mahayana Realm and uses the flame condensed by the Divine Fire Triple Realm, it could probably match the golden flames of the ancestor, right?”
…
“That kid is really lucky…”
“If he fully cultivates the Divine Fire Triple Realm, once he enters the Mahayana Realm, even if it can’t match the ancestor’s golden flames, it’ll probably be close.”
“You must know, those golden flames from the ancestor were obtained from the Outer Spatial Void, which is from beyond the Outer Spatial Void…”
…
…
The outside world was buzzing with discussions, but Lin Jing within the barrier of the Formation wasn’t the least bit distracted.
At this moment, Lin Jing had already opened the Pill Furnace and began adding those refined Spirit Plants into it.
The colorless flames beneath the Pill Furnace were rising up, continuously heating the furnace, and as the Spirit Plants were added, they began to churn incessantly.
Before long, Lin Jing had put all the Spirit Plants into the Pill Furnace.
After the Spirit Plants were added, the next step was to close the Pill Furnace and begin the actual process of Elixir Medicine refinement.
At this point, Lin Jing, like the Changyun Clan patriarch, sat cross-legged in front of the Pill Furnace.
He controlled the flames at the bottom of the furnace, while extending his Divine Sense to monitor the inside of the Pill Furnace.
Time slowly passed by, and Lin Jing gradually entered the zone; the crowd outside that had been discussing moments ago had already quieted down, quietly watching Lin Jing inside the Formation.
One hour…
Four hours…
Six hours…
…
…
Deeply immersed, Lin Jing had almost blocked all perception of the outside world and was completely unaware of the passage of time.
In this way, time flew by, and before he knew it, twelve hours had passed.
Last time the Changyun Clan elder refined Elixirs, it was at the twelve-hour mark when all the Spirit Plants were completely refined into Medicinal Liquid.
ɴονǤ0.ᴄο
But today, even after twelve hours, there was still no sign of activity from Lin Jing’s alchemy.
At this time, Lin Jing in front of the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace remained oblivious to the outside world, continuously controlling the flames at the bottom and refining the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
Twelve hours had passed, and Lin Jing had yet to show any progress, which caused the Changyun Clan observers to furrow their brows with concern.
Of course, except for the Changyun Clan elder…
At this time, the Changyun Clan elder was still watching Lin Jing inside the Formation with the same composure as at the beginning, seemingly not worried at all.
Time quickly passed, and another hour and a half went by.
After seven and a half hours of refinement, there was finally a change within the Pill Furnace.
Elixir Fragrance began to emanate from inside the Pill Furnace.
Smelling the Elixir Fragrance, everyone couldn’t help but relax a little; the presence of the Elixir Fragrance meant the Elixir Furnace Medicine had been successfully refined.
However, this refinement was not ordinary.
What was needed was a Flawless grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, and just the fragrance wasn’t enough.
Therefore, even though everyone was a bit more relaxed, they were not completely at ease.
It was at the moment the Elixir Fragrance appeared that Lin Jing made his move.
Lin Jing concentrated his Spiritual Power and quickly circulated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, making the flames at the bottom of the furnace even more vigorous.
Clearly, at this time, Lin Jing had already refined the dozens of Spirit Plants into Medicinal Liquid, and now it was the final step in Alchemy, beginning the Solidifying Pill process.
As Lin Jing intensified the flames, the Elixir Fragrance, following the white mist, spilled from the crevices around the Pill Furnace, becoming increasingly rich.
Until after a short while, among the Changyun Clan observers watching the refinement, a cry of surprise suddenly rang out:
“Quick, look, what is that…”
Someone pointed towards the edge of the Pill Furnace, where a hint of different color was peeking through the white mist.
Hearing this, everyone also looked in the direction of the edge of the Pill Furnace.
Although the color was very faint, everyone could see it clearly.
“This light…”
“Seems like it is done…”
Someone murmured.
“Brother has succeeded.”
Caught up in the excitement of those around her, Lin Jue also couldn’t help feeling joyful.
“Yes!”
“Lin has made it…”
Lu Youjiu finished speaking and looked at Changyun Yuanshuang, only to meet her gaze looking his way.
Their eyes met, and they exchanged smiles in understanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 815
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 815: Chapter 362 Successful Alchemy, Arrangements of Ancestor Changyun_2 Chapter 815: Chapter 362 Successful Alchemy, Arrangements of Ancestor Changyun_2 When the colorful light appeared, everything became promising.
As everyone was conversing, the colorful light grew brighter and more distinct.
Seeing this scene, everyone from the Changyun Clan was filled with surprise and joy.
Even the Changyun Clan’s patriarch was now smiling.
He looked at the colorful light spilling from the pill furnace and then glanced at the golden talisman on the formation, with its circulating golden light.
He couldn’t help but curve his lips into a smile.
This time, they were fully prepared, and surely no mishaps would occur.
...
While the people from the Changyun Clan outside were extremely excited, Lin Jing, who was inside the formation, dared not relax in the slightest.
This moment was crucial for the pill formation, and the slightest error could result in failure of the elixir furnace medicine.
As time slowly passed, the scent of the elixir grew richer and the colorful light more radiant.
At this critical juncture, the initial excitement had dissipated, and the people of the Changyun Clan outside the formation began to grow tense.
Everyone held their breath and focused intently on Lin Jing at the center of the formation, not even daring to blink…
…
…
Finally…
After a burst of intense flickering from the colorful light, Lin Jing withdrew the flame and completed the alchemy.
This time, the people of the Changyun Clan were not disappointed.
Seeing that Lin Jing had completed the alchemy, they once again erupted with excitement.
Even the elders of the Changyun Clan who were controlling the formation were craning their necks, looking toward the pill furnace in the middle.
Now that Lin Jing had completed the alchemy, they could finally relax a bit.
After finishing the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, Lin Jing stood up and took out a Pure Jade Box from his space ring, readying it.
Once everything was prepared, Lin Jing directly used his spiritual power to open the pill furnace.
The moment the pill furnace was opened, the colorful light surged instantly, turning the entire hall multicolored.
Accompanying this colorful light was the intoxicating, rich fragrance of the elixir.
And at the instant when the colorful light appeared, a nearly transparent elixir also took the opportunity to fly out.
After flying out, the elixir immediately attempted to flee outside the hall.
Lin Jing wasn’t aware when the elixir flew out.
Even the people from the Changyun Clan who were observing the alchemy also saw it.
Upon seeing the elixir, everyone’s faces lit up with immense delight.
“Truly, it’s the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir…”
“Don’t let it fly away.”
A high-grade elixir of Flawless quality would indeed attempt to fly away after being refined.
Unfortunately, the formation had not yet been deactivated, so the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir could not escape.
The moment it reached the edge of the formation, it was blocked and immobilized.
Lin Jing, seizing the opportunity, directly collected the elixir into the Pure Jade Box.
After securing the elixir, Lin Jing then turned around and returned to the side of the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace.
Inside the Radiant Cloud Surprising Immortal Furnace, the other few elixirs also floated out.
Two were superior, one was medium grade, and together with the Flawless Elixir that Lin Jing had already collected, these were all the elixirs he had refined this time.
Afterward, Lin Jing collected the remaining elixirs as well.
Having collected the elixirs, Lin Jing then walked toward the patriarch of the Changyun Clan.
By this time, the formation had already been deactivated.
Lin Jing approached the Changyun Clan’s patriarch and passed him the Pure Jade Box with the three elixirs, saying:
“Elder…”
“Fortunately, I have not failed in my duty.
I have refined the Flawless grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.”
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing and said with a smile:
“Good…
good…”
“I knew I wasn’t wrong about you.”
After speaking, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan took the elixirs handed over by Lin Jing, immediately picked up the Pure Jade Box, and began to examine it.
Inside the Pure Jade Box, the colorful light on the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir had already dissipated.
The whole elixir had now become transparent, and one could clearly see the medicinal liquid inside, shifting between the form of a dragon and that of a crane.
A high-grade Flawless Elixir of this level had already begun to show signs of spirituality; that was why various phenomena appeared.
At this moment, other members of the Changyun Clan also gathered around them.
The people of the Changyun Clan, upon seeing the elixir, couldn’t help but exclaim in awe, and their gazes toward Lin Jing were filled with admiration.
ɴονǤο.ᴄο
Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather also approached Lin Jing and said:
“To refine a Flawless grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir in just one try, you truly are a more dazzling alchemy genius than Yuanlei.”
Lin Jing quickly responded:
“Elder, you flatter me.
It was just luck.”
And Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather spoke up again:
“While it’s true that the art of the Alchemy Dao has some correlation with luck, personal strength is still the most important.
You don’t have to be too modest…”
Just then, another of Changyun Yuanshuang’s great-uncles came over, took a good look at Lin Jing, then, with a smile on his face, he said:
“To be so young and already at the peak of the Solidifying Body Realm, and also a Seventh Grade Alchemist…”
At this point, Changyun Yuanshuang’s great-uncle leaned closer to Lin Jing and bluntly said:
“I heard that you don’t have a Dao Companion yet.”
“You’ve met Yuanshuang’s cousin Qingshuang.
What do you think of her?”
“If you’re interested, we can help…”
“Our Changyun Clan and your Lin Family have always had a good relationship.
If you two got together, that would be adding kinship on top of kinship.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was extremely embarrassed and hurriedly said:
“Elder, you jest…”
“As for the matter of a Dao Companion, I haven’t considered it for the time being…”
“Moreover, the current situation is critical, and Seven Seas Hall is also casting covetous eyes; it really isn’t quite appropriate.”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s great-uncle was unconcerned and straightforwardly said:
“No matter…”
“As long as you two are willing, we can arrange it after this matter is resolved.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was at a loss for words.
He hadn’t expected Changyun Yuanshuang’s great-uncle to be so enthusiastic.
Fortunately, Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather stepped in right afterwards to rescue Lin Jing from the predicament:
“Old Three,”
“It’s the young people’s business.
You shouldn’t meddle here.
We should be focusing on how to devise a plan to deal with Seven Seas Hall.”
“Got it, big brother…”
Changyun Yuanshuang’s great-uncle pursed his lips, and then said.
…
…
After everyone had witnessed the Flawless Elixir, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan dismissed them.
Only Lin Jing and a few of the Changyun Clan’s elders, including Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfather, were left.
Afterward, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan said to the few people present:
“I will go into seclusion for a while to refine this elixir and extend my lifespan.”
“The affairs of the clan will be in your hands in the meantime.”
“Understood, patriarch,” everyone replied in unison.
After that, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan turned to Lin Jing and said:
“Actually, ever since returning from Ganlin Island, I’ve had a plan.
But because of alchemy matters, I haven’t told you.”
“Elder, may I ask what the plan is?” Lin Jing asked, looking at the patriarch of the Changyun Clan with curiosity.
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan explained:
“I plan to send you and Yuanlei to the Eastern Spirit Realm, to join the Elixir Alliance.”
“And by the way, help me deliver something to an old friend of mine there.”
“Join the Elixir Alliance?”
“Why have us join the Elixir Alliance?” Lin Jing was puzzled.
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan then said:
“The Elixir Alliance is the sanctuary of all Alchemists in the entire Cultivation World.
Both you and Yuanlei are rare Alchemy Dao talents.
Joining the Elixir Alliance will allow you to go further on the path of the Alchemy Dao.”
“Also, after this period, the real struggle with Seven Seas Hall is about to begin.”
“At that time, the entire Changyun Clan will be in turmoil, not just you, but also your sister Lin Jue, Yuanshuang, and that boy from the Lu Family, all of you will have to be sent out.”
“All of us together?”
Lin Jing asked.
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan nodded:
“Yes…”
“You’ll all be sent to the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
“However, only you and Yuanlei will join the Elixir Alliance, while the others will be arranged elsewhere.”
After considering for a while, Lin Jing nodded in understanding.
“However…”
“Before going to the Elixir Alliance, there is one more thing I must do.”
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan looked at Lin Jing and asked:
“What is it?”
Lin Jing replied:
“Transcending tribulation, stepping into the Dao Integration Stage!”

chapters.title: Chapter 816
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 816: Chapter 363: Eastern Spirit Realm, Separation Chapter 816: Chapter 363: Eastern Spirit Realm, Separation East Continent Spiritual Realm, the greatest among the Four Domains.
Whether it be Spiritual Energy or cultivation resources, both are the most abundant among the Four Domains.
Even the Demonic Monster Sea cannot compare to it.
Owning the most cultivation resources in the entire Cultivation World, the strength of the entire domain naturally occupies the leading position within the Cultivation World.
If it were a million years ago, perhaps the South Continent’s Domain of Ming could have been comparable.
But a million years ago, that catastrophe completely turned the Domain of Ming into a dead domain, henceforth becoming an existence much like the Nether Realm.
Since then, in the entire Cultivation World, only the East Continent Spiritual Realm remained as the sacred cultivation land of the Human Race.
...
…
That day…
After Lin Jing had a conversation with the Changyun Clan elder, the Changyun Clan immediately began making arrangements for Lin Jing’s Tribulation.
Not long after, Lin Jing, fully prepared, began his Dao Integration Tribulation.
This Tribulation, with the full support of the Changyun Clan, was also extremely smooth.
Without any danger, Lin Jing successfully transcended the Heavenly Tribulation and entered the Dao Integration Stage.
No sooner had Lin Jing finished his Tribulation, before the onlookers could even rejoice, they received news of unusual activity from the Seven Seas Hall.
After some investigation, they learned…
Ye Mingyi, after planning for ten thousand years, had now completely taken control of the Seven Seas Hall and had begun to strike at the Changyun Clan.
The Changyun Clan elder did not delay any further, quickly joining forces with the Shocking Seas Alliance to begin deploying countermeasures.
At the same time, Lin Jing and his companions quietly used a secret Teleportation Array belonging to the Shocking Seas Alliance to teleport to the East Continent Spiritual Realm.
At that moment.
In Immortal City near the Demonic Monster Sea within the East Continent Spiritual Realm, a dazzling beam of light suddenly shot up into the heavens.
The beam pierced through the clouds and reached into the sky, just like a soaring sword slashing toward the heavens.
Upon seeing this light, the passersby on the city streets, who had been hurrying along, merely looked up at the pillar of light and then bowed their heads again to continue on their way.
To the appearance of this light pillar, they were already accustomed and did not find it strange whatsoever.
Because this light pillar was none other than the city’s Teleportation Array.
The appearance of the pillar, of course, indicated that someone had traveled via the Teleportation Array to this Immortal City.
At this moment, within the light pillar in the Teleportation Plaza, unlike the people on the streets…
Some among these onlookers were members of various smaller business associations.
And some were Loose Cultivators.
They stayed here to do small trades with those who teleported from afar, earning Spirit Stones for their daily cultivation.
They were relatively familiar with this transportational light pillar.
When they saw this pillar of light brighter and stronger than what they usually witnessed,
they knew that the people who had teleported were definitely from a faraway place.
To be able to use the Teleportation Array from such a distance, the wealth of those who were about to arrive, even putting aside their cultivation, must be considerable.
Perhaps…
they might encounter some wealthy cultivators with lower cultivation levels.
Seeing this, immediately a part of the onlookers became thoughtful, moving closer to the Teleportation Array.
Another group, however, did not approach but stayed where they were, eyeing the direction of the Teleportation Array intently.
As they moved closer, the luminescence from the Teleportation Array began to fade, and through the light, it was possible to see several blurry figures appearing in the center of the Array.
Until the light completely dissipated moments later, everyone saw clearly the several individuals who had transported.
There were a total of eight people who arrived.
Among these eight, there were five men and three women.
Aside from one whose appearance left something to be desired, the other seven were all undeniably handsome men and beautiful women.
These individuals, undoubtedly, were Lin Jing and his companions.
After arriving, Lin Jing first surveyed his surroundings.
Then he looked toward the crowd in front of the Teleportation Array, who were gazing at him with sparkling eyes.
These people weren’t any different from those Lin Jing had seen in Bihai City or in Linhai City of the Nanming Domain.
As soon as he saw them, Lin Jing understood what they were there for.
Therefore, after only a glance, he shifted his gaze towards the farther edge of the plaza.
At the edge of the Teleportation Plaza, there were also several people looking at Lin Jing and his group.
But unlike those at the front, the eyes of these people clearly harbored ill intentions.
Despite their efforts to hide it, Lin Jing had much higher cultivation than they did, and even their best efforts to conceal could not fool Lin Jing’s eyes.
It seemed…
they must have thought that since his group was young, they would be easy to deal with, which is why they harbored such nefarious thoughts.
Among those people, there were indeed a few Great Cultivators at the Divine Transformation Realm.
Seeing this, Lin Jing did not bother with words.
He snorted coldly and then directly revealed his own imposing aura.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.ƈο
Although Lin Jing did not display much, this terrifying aura caused those who had originally harbored bad intentions to instantly turn pale and hastily scuttle away.
Not just those with bad intentions, but even those gathered in front of the Teleportation Array felt a chill in their hearts upon sensing this aura and quickly dispersed.
Only after everyone had left did Lin Jing retract his own aura and turned to the group, saying,
“Let’s go…”
The group nodded and then followed Lin Jing away from the Teleportation Array.
After leaving the Teleportation Array, Lin Jing and the others did not stay long in the Immortal City, and instead, they left the city straight away.
Once outside, Lin Jing brought out the Shadow Escape Flying Boat, and the group boarded it together.

chapters.title: Chapter 817
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 817: Chapter 363 Eastern Spirit Realm, Separation_2 Chapter 817: Chapter 363 Eastern Spirit Realm, Separation_2 Then,
the Flying Boat soared into the sky, transforming into a streak of flowing light, disappearing into the horizon…
…
…
Inside the Flying Boat, Yan Wanfei spoke to several people,
“I never thought that one day, I too would make it to the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
Lu Youjiu glanced at Yan Wanfei, his lips curling slightly:
“That’s because I have been keeping an eye on you.
Whenever you feel the itch, I am always ready to give you a bit of ‘special training.'”
The others also knew what the ‘special training’ between Lu Youjiu and Yan Wanfei entailed.
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanshuang, Changyun Qingshuang, and Lin Jue, the three women, could not help but cover their mouths and giggle.
Yan Wanfei’s expression immediately turned bitter:
“Brother Jiu…”
“Now that we’ve arrived at the Eastern Spirit Realm, let’s not do this anymore.”
Holaw Three Rivers then spoke up,
“Once we get to the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect, you ought to behave properly.
...
I believe Brother Jiu won’t just give you ‘special training’ for no reason.”
Yan Wanfei put on a pitiful look, turning towards Lu Youjiu, only to see him flirting with Changyun Yuanshuang, paying no heed to him.
Helplessly, he turned towards Lin Jing, envying him:
“I truly envy Brother Lin, who can directly join the Elixir Alliance without having to figure out a way into the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect like us.”
“Thinking about us, Nascent Soul Great Cultivators going to the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect and ending up as mere Outer Sect Disciples, just feels absurd.”
Holaw Three Rivers then spoke up, looking at Yan Wanfei:
“If you were an Alchemy Dao genius, able to reach above Sixth Grade in short order, you could give it a try too.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei quickly shook his head, grumbling:
“Forget it, I know my own limits.”
“An Outer Sect Disciple of the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect it is, then.”
The Spiritual Mist Holy Sect is a particularly special sect within the East Continent Domain.
Its peculiarity lies in the fact that although it is one of the top forces in the Eastern Spirit Realm, it differs immensely from other sects.
While other sects still develop according to the traditional model of External, Inner, and Core Disciples, the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect has already pioneered a new development model.
That is to completely open up their Outer Sect, allowing anyone to join and rejecting no comers.
Similar to the model of the Qi Hall in the Seven Seas Hall, in the Outer Sect of the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect, one can also acquire cultivation resources by completing missions issued by the sect.
One can even take on various missions to earn sect contributions and, through these contributions, receive assistance from the sect.
If one truly has the determination, even joining the Inner Sect is not impossible.
However…
Joining the Inner Sect, unlike entering the Outer Sect, requires one to pass the tests of the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect.
Only those who pass the tests can be taken in as Inner Sect Disciples of the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect.
The purpose of Lu Youjiu and the others’ trip was to head to the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect and join as Outer Sect Disciples.
They intended to undergo trials while quietly waiting for the events in the Inner Sea to conclude.
After all, the current strife in the Inner Sea was far from something they could involve themselves in.
Staying in the Inner Sea would only lead them into danger without being able to do much else.
It was precisely for this reason that the ancient ancestor of the Changyun Clan had sent them all out.
…
After flying for a not so short period, according to a predetermined route, they arrived at another Immortal City equipped with a Teleportation Array, Jingrui Immortal City.
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were heading to the Elixir Alliance, located in the far east of the Eastern Spirit Realm.
Meanwhile, Lu Youjiu and the others were headed for the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect, situated in the southern part of the Eastern Spirit Realm.
At this moment, inside Jingrui Immortal City, there happened to be a Teleportation Array that could directly transport them to the southern part of the Eastern Spirit Realm.
At this location, it was time for the group to split up.
Before even entering the city, as they approached Jingrui Immortal City, they disembarked from the Flying Boat and proceeded on foot towards the city.
Walking on the road to Jingrui Immortal City, Lin Jue felt reluctant to part, walking side by side with Lin Jing.
“Brother…”
“Having to part this time, it looks like we won’t be able to see each other for a while again.”
Lin Jing nodded, then spoke:
“Yes…”
“But don’t worry.
With Brother Lu and your sister Yuanshuang here, they’ll definitely take good care of you.”
Lin Jue shook her head, saying:
“Brother Lu and Sister Yuanshuang are very good to me, that’s not what I mean…”
“I mean you…”
“I thought once this issue was resolved, we could go back, and then we would see Ye Yun and sister Qing Qing again…”
“But with this situation, now that we have come directly to the Eastern Spirit Realm, who knows when we’ll be able to return to Li Yan Island.”
“Sister Qing Qing, she’s still waiting for you.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was momentarily stunned.
Then he recalled that before leaving, he had indeed assured Li Qingqing that his departure this time wouldn’t take long.
But plans can’t keep up with changes.
They hadn’t expected that this journey to the Inner Sea would unearth secrets from ten thousand years past.
It even sparked head-on conflict among the three major powers of the Inner Sea.
ɴοѵǤ0.сο
The group had no choice but to temporarily leave the Inner Sea and take refuge in the Eastern Spirit Realm.
As for the Southern Outer Sea, Lin Jing dared not return carelessly.
After all, their identities were special.
If they left rashly, it would definitely attract attention.
If they really returned to the Southern Outer Sea, it might well bring disaster to the Thousand Islands Domain.
Therefore, even though he knew that Li Qingqing and Ye Yun were waiting for his news, Lin Jing dared not return to the Southern Outer Sea.
However…
Before they left, Lin Jing had already sent a message back to Li Qingqing and Ye Yun through the Changyun Clan.
He estimated they would receive the message very soon.
“This matter came so suddenly, we can’t return rashly, otherwise it could easily bring disaster to Li Yan Island and even to the Thousand Islands Domain,”
“I have already sent back a message, they should receive it very soon.”
After speaking, Lin Jing looked toward Lin Jue and said,
“Don’t talk about me; what about yourself…”
“You and Ye Yun, it’s about time you settled down.”
“After the Inner Sea incident is over, I’ll start making arrangements for you two.”
“Brother~…”
Lin Jue hadn’t expected Lin Jing to suddenly turn the conversation to her, and she couldn’t help blushing.
However, she didn’t voice any objections.
…
…
As they walked and talked, they soon arrived at Jingrui Immortal City.
Jingrui Immortal City was also a relatively large Immortal City.
After entering the city, it took them four hours to reach the plaza of the Immortal City.
The Teleportation Plaza in Jingrui Immortal City was significantly larger than the previous one they had visited in the seaside Immortal City.
However, since this plaza was now deep within the Eastern Spirit Realm, it wasn’t as chaotic as the one in the seaside Immortal City.
At the plaza, Lin Jing and Lu Youjiu were preparing to bid each other farewell.
“Brother Lin…”
“From now on, we will have to part ways.”
Lin Jing nodded, then looked at everyone and sincerely said,
“Brother Lu and the rest of you…
”
“When it comes to Lin Jue, I’ll have to trouble you to take good care of her.”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei immediately slapped his chest and said,
“Don’t worry, Brother Lin…”
“With us here, no one will dare to bully Sister Lin Jue.”
Changyun Yuanshuang also spoke up at this moment, telling Lin Jing,
“You don’t need to worry about Sister Lin Jue.
If anyone should be concerned, it’s me who needs to ask you for a favor.
Yuanlei still needs more of your attention.”
Hearing Changyun Yuanshuang speak like this, Changyun Yuanlei immediately objected:
“Sis…”
“I’m grown-up now, I can handle myself.”
Changyun Yuanshuang then shot Changyun Yuanlei a glance before adding,
“Really?”
“Have you already forgotten the previous incident?”
“Without Brother Lin’s help, you wouldn’t even know if you were sold.”
“When you’re with the Elixir Alliance, you must listen to Big Brother Lin.
If I find out you didn’t, next time we meet, if I don’t beat you so you can’t leave your bed for three days, then I’m not your sister…”
Hearing Changyun Yuanshuang’s fierce declaration, Changyun Yuanlei immediately backed down and quickly pleaded,
“Don’t…
”
“Sis, rest assured.”
“I will definitely listen to Big Brother Lin.”
Satisfied, Changyun Yuanshuang then nodded her head.
After this sibling commotion, everyone couldn’t help but smile.
Then.
Lu Youjiu, along with the others, bid farewell and boarded the Teleportation Array.
After paying the Spirit Stones, they entered the middle of the Teleportation Array, and at this moment, a violet-robed elder overseeing the Array activated it directly.
When the Teleportation Array was activated, a column of teleportation light shot up into the sky.
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei also waved goodbye.
In that column of teleportation light, Lu Youjiu and the others also waved back…
As the light of the Teleportation Array grew stronger, the teleportation column became increasingly bright.
Until the light was so dazzling that the details within it could no longer be discerned.
Suddenly, the entire Teleportation Array experienced a burst of spatial fluctuations, and with these fluctuations, the group was teleported away, vanishing within the Teleportation Array…

chapters.title: Chapter 818
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 818: Chapter 364: Joining the Elixir Alliance, Meeting the Elixir Alliance Alliance Hierarch Chapter 818: Chapter 364: Joining the Elixir Alliance, Meeting the Elixir Alliance Alliance Hierarch Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei watched as several people boarded the Teleportation Array and left.
Not until the light from the Teleportation Array completely faded, and the group disappeared from the array, did the two regain their composure.
“They’re all gone, we should leave as well,”
Lin Jing came to his senses and said to Changyun Yuanlei.
Changyun Yuanlei nodded without speaking.
Afterward,
the two of them walked together towards the city’s edge.
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei wanted to visit the Elixir Alliance, but the Teleportation Array in Jingrui Immortal City could not take them directly there; they needed to continue forward to the next Immortal City and take another Teleportation Array.
Soon,
they left Jingrui Immortal City, and Lin Jing once again took out the Shadow Escape Flying Boat, and together with Changyun Yuanlei, they boarded the flying boat and flew towards the next Immortal Cityâ€¦
…
...
…
The Elixir Alliance City was built in reliance on the Elixir Alliance, a city within the Immortal City.
The entire Elixir Alliance City is divided into the Inner City and Outer City, covering a vast area, ranking among the top three within the Eastern Spirit Realm.
The Elixir Alliance has an extraordinarily special status in the Cultivation World; though it is also a power, it is different from other powers.
The Elixir Alliance exists because of the Alchemy Dao, gathering individuals dedicated to studying the Alchemy Dao and maintaining neutrality, not making enemies with any other powers.
Any power that brings forth a talent in the Alchemy Dao may join the Elixir Alliance to study more advanced Alchemy Techniques.
Moreover, these Alchemy Dao talents who join the Elixir Alliance still belong to their original Sects.
They are invited to join the Alliance and can leave at any time to serve their Sects.
Given the Elixir Alliance’s transcendent status, having its own Pill Masters, it naturally won’t poach these Alchemy Dao talents.
Because of this, one could say that all the Sects within the Eastern Spirit Realm maintain good relations with each other.
A large part of the Outer City of the Elixir Alliance City is where other powers and Sects establish outposts near the Elixir Alliance, to facilitate communication at any time.
As such, the Outer City of the Elixir Alliance City is extremely prosperous.
The Inner City of the Elixir Alliance City, on the other hand, is where the Elixir Alliance truly resides.
Its defenses are tight; without an invitation, it is difficult for ordinary people to enter the Inner City.
After three months, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, passing through numerous Immortal Cities and continuously switching Teleportation Arrays, finally arrived at the Elixir Alliance City.
It was not until they reached the Eastern Spirit Realm that Lin Jing truly realized its vastness.
This made him think back to the Nanming Domain, which used to be known as the Domain of Ming in the South Continent, a place equivalent to the Eastern Spirit Realm.
In terms of area, it was quite comparable to the Eastern Spirit Realm.
However…
Because of the catastrophe a million years ago, the Domain of Ming in the South Continent became a desolate land, leaving only a small corner to become what is now known as the Nanming Domain.
It shows how severe that catastrophe was, reducing the vast Domain of Ming in the South Continent almost entirely to ruins.
If he ever got the chance, Lin Jing really wanted to explore deep within the barren forbidden areas of the Nanming Domain, to see for himself what the Samsara Fruit was.
It was capable of causing such a disaster.
…
After arriving at the Elixir Alliance City, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei exited the Teleportation Array and immediately made their way towards the Inner City of the Elixir Alliance City, without delay.
Walking on the road, the streets of the Elixir Alliance City were bustling, with an endless stream of Cultivators coming and going.
Changyun Yuanlei looked around east and west, constantly expressing his amazement:
“Brother Lin…”
“This Elixir Alliance City is more prosperous than any other Immortal City I’ve seen before.”
“Also, look on both sides of the street at these shops, everywhere they’re selling rare Spirit Plants and all kinds of Elixir Medicine.”
“I just sent out my Divine Sense for a brief investigation, and in just a moment, I found several shops with rare Spirit Plants that are extremely difficult to encounter normally.”
“It’s worthy of being the Elixir Alliance City,”
Lin Jing laughed and said:
“Of course…”
“This is the Elixir Alliance City, there are bound to be many Alchemists here.”
“Furthermore, behind the Elixir Alliance City lies the highest mountain range in the entire Eastern Spirit Realm, Mt.
Jihuang.”
“Besides Mt.
Jihuang, there is also the Mysterious Ghost Forest Plain that is referred to as a forbidden land.”
“These two places are extremely rich in resources, not only having various fierce Demonic Beasts but also rare minerals and Spirit Plants that are very hard to find in other places.”
“With such rich resources, naturally, this Elixir Alliance City will have no shortage of these rare Spirit Plants.”
“No wonder…” Changyun Yuanlei said.
Afterward, the two continued towards the Inner City.
Thus, after spending most of the day, they finally passed through the Outer City and arrived at the entrance of the Inner City.
The Elixir Alliance City is large on the outside but small within.
ƝονǤᴑ.ᴄᴑ
The entire Inner City, being the true location of the Elixir Alliance, is not situated at the very center of the Elixir Alliance City.
Because the Elixir Alliance City is open on three sides, with only the back relying on the highest peak of Mt.
Jihuang.
The Inner City of the Elixir Alliance City is located in the innermost part near Mt.
Jihuang.
In front of the Inner City, there is a majestic hall about thirty feet tall, standing there.
To enter the Elixir Alliance, one must pass through this hall and gain the approval of the people within, then one can enter the Inner City, where the Elixir Alliance truly is.
At the entrance of the hall, Lin Jing looked up at the hall and saw two Cultivators standing guard.
Moreover,
the two guarding the entrance to the hall both possessed considerable Cultivation, only one realm lower than Lin Jing currently.

chapters.title: Chapter 819
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 819: Chapter 364: Joining the Elixir Alliance, Meeting the Elixir Alliance Alliance Hierarch_2 Chapter 819: Chapter 364: Joining the Elixir Alliance, Meeting the Elixir Alliance Alliance Hierarch_2 Lin Jing then led Changyun Yuanlei up the steps.
They hadn’t reached the entrance of the grand hall yet when the two guards at the entrance moved.
The two stepped forward and stopped Lin Jing and his companion.
“You two…”
“This is a restricted area within the Elixir Alliance, no entry without invitation.”
“May I know what brings you here?”
Seeing this, Lin Jing directly took out a token from his space ring and handed it over,
“We are here to find Elder Bai from the Elixir Alliance, please inform him.”
“Elder Bai?”
The two were clearly puzzled, but one of the cultivators still took the token.
He examined the token briefly, and upon recognizing it, he immediately cupped his fists towards Lin Jing and said,
“Please wait a moment.”
After speaking, the cultivator took the token and went inside the grand hall.
Lin Jing and his companion waited in place.
Soon, the cultivator returned, but he no longer held the token in his hand.
...
Upon his return, he gestured with his hand, and the other person who had been blocking Lin Jing and his companion immediately understood and stepped aside.
Then, the cultivator approached Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, and said,
“Please follow me.”
After speaking, the person turned and led the way into the grand hall.
Lin Jing and his companion, seeing this, quickly followed.
Upon entering the grand hall, Lin Jing saw an old man with white hair and beard in the center.
Just standing there, one could feel an extraordinary aura from him, so serene that it seemed to merge with the surroundings.
Just by looking at this elder and feeling his aura, Lin Jing knew he was no ordinary man.
His cultivation was also not low, Lin Jing guessed that the old man’s cultivation was at least at the later stages of Tribulation.
At that moment, the elder was holding the token that Lin Jing had given earlier.
The cultivator who led Lin Jing and his peers bowed respectfully to the elder and then spoke,
“Elder Wen…”
“I have brought them here.”
The elder nodded, then with a wave of his hand, the cultivator understood and immediately withdrew.
After the man left, Elder Wen looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, surveyed them, and asked,
“Where do you come from?
How did you get Elder Bai’s token?”
The token was naturally given to Lin Jing by the Changyun Clan’s ancestor.
Lin Jing then bowed to the elder and opened his mouth,
“Elder!”
“We come from the demonic beasts’ Inner Sea, from the Changyun Clan.
We are here on an errand from our ancestor to find Elder Bai.”
Upon hearing this, the elder suddenly realized,
“You are from the Changyun Clan…”
However, he then shook his head and sighed,
“Your timing is truly unfortunate, Elder Bai has gone to the Outer Spatial Void, he just left recently and likely won’t be back soon.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was momentarily stunned, then quickly responded,
“Elder Bai has gone to the Outer Spatial Void?”
The elder nodded and then said,
“Let’s do this…”
“I will take you to meet our leader of the Elixir Alliance to see what he says.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing quickly bowed and said,
“Thank you, elder.”
The elder waved his hand and then said to Lin Jing,
“Follow me!”
With that, the elder led the way deeper into the grand hall.
Lin Jing and his companion immediately followed.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄᴑ
Following Elder Wen, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei passed through the grand hall and then reached the Inner City.
That was the true base of the Elixir Alliance.
After entering the Inner City, it suddenly became quieter.
Unlike the Outer City, upon entering the Inner City, there was a road at least a hundred feet wide.
The road led straight ahead, and looking down the road to the end, it appeared to end in a very large square.
Moreover, it was very quiet inside the Inner City.
Since their entrance, they hadn’t seen many people.
Just like that.
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei followed Elder Wen along the central avenue toward the square ahead.
Soon, they arrived at the square in front of them.
Upon entering the square, Lin Jing saw the entirety of it and understood why this square was so vast.
In the center of the square was a high platform covered with formation patterns, partitioned into sections.
Moreover, each section had a stone table and a stone pill furnace.
Around the platform, there was also a huge formation encompassing the entire square.
It seemed to be an alchemy competition arena.
Seeing what Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were thinking, Elder Wen turned back and said to them,
“Every hundred years, our Elixir Alliance organizes a grand alchemy conference, inviting alchemists under three hundred years old from the entire Eastern Spirit Realm to participate.”
“Participants who stand out and achieve a certain ranking will receive definite rewards.”
“Moreover, the top three winners can choose to join our Elixir Alliance or any forces they desire.”
Changyun Yuanlei looked at the vast competition area and couldn’t help but speak,
“Alchemists from the entire Eastern Spirit Realm…”
“It’s certainly not easy to place in such a competition.”
Elder Wen nodded and said,
“Of course…”
“Each competition is exceptionally fierce, and many already renowned genius pill masters, with just a slight inattention, end up eliminated.”
After saying this, Elder Wen looked at Changyun Yuanlei and added,
“Since you are from the Changyun Clan, you must also possess exceptional talents in alchemy techniques.”
“If you were to enter the competition, not to mention finishing in the top three, you should surely achieve a respectable ranking.”
Changyun Yuanlei responded with an embarrassed smile,
“Maybe…
maybe so…”
Facing the alchemists from the entire Eastern Spirit Realm, even Changyun Yuanlei, who came from an Ancient Alchemy Family, was not absolutely confident.
After all,
the Eastern Spirit Realm was already the strongest area in the cultivation world, filled with exceptional talents and long-standing sect forces.
It was incomparable to other places.
Perhaps among these forces, there were genius pill masters nurtured by various sects.
Facing these individuals, Changyun Yuanlei was also not very confident.
Seeing this, Elder Wen simply smiled slightly, and then said no more.
He continued leading them deeper inside.
Passing through the square, the trio kept moving inward.
Finally, they arrived at a tower-like high-rise building that was nine stories tall and dozens of feet high.
Following this,
Elder Wen led Lin Jing and the others toward this high-rise building.
After entering the tower with Elder Wen, they ascended until they reached the top.
There, Elder Wen introduced Lin Jing and the others to the true ruler of the Elixir Alliance, the Alliance Hierarch.
Upon entering the ninth floor, Elder Wen approached and spoke to a middle-aged man who was sitting and perusing a scroll,
“Hierarch!”
“These two members of the Changyun Clan carry Elder Bai’s token and seek an audience with Elder Bai.”
Hearing Elder Wen’s words, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch then raised his head and looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei standing behind Elder Wen.
The gaze of the Elixir Alliance Hierarch was penetrating, awe-inspiring, as if it could see right through them, scanning over both Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei.
Lin Jing felt as though he was being seen through.
However, it was not yet time for Lin Jing to speak since Elder Wen had just finished speaking.
Feeling that gaze, Lin Jing remained composed as if unaffected, continuing to stand there.
Changyun Yuanlei turned to glance at Lin Jing, and seeing him motionless, also stood still without moving.
After scanning the two, the Alliance Hierarch then looked back at Elder Wen and asked,
“Where is Elder Bai’s token?”
“Show it to me!”
Upon hearing this, Elder Wen directly took out the token and handed it to the Alliance Hierarch.
After accepting the token and examining it for a while, the Alliance Hierarch nodded slightly,
“This is indeed Elder Bai’s token.”
Following this, the Alliance Hierarch spoke to Elder Wen,
“Alright…”
“You may leave now.
I will take care of them from here.”
“Yes, Hierarch…”
After Elder Wen finished speaking, he then promptly exited.

chapters.title: Chapter 820
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 820: Chapter 365: The Frenzied Elixir Alliance Hierarch Chapter 820: Chapter 365: The Frenzied Elixir Alliance Hierarch After Elder Wen left, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch looked at Lin Jing and another person, then opened his mouth:
“What are your names?”
Lin Jing bowed with his hands clasped and replied:
“In response to my senior, I am Lin Jing!”
