Seeing Lin Jing answer first, Changyun Yuanlei also followed suit with a hand-clasped bow, saying:
“Junior Changyun Yuanlei.”
Upon hearing the responses from Lin Jing and company, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch first looked towards Lin Jing, his eyebrows slightly furrowed as he murmured:
“Surname Lin…”
However, he did not pursue further inquiries, instead, he turned his head toward Changyun Yuanlei and said with a smile:
“So you are Changyun Yuanlei, the alchemy genius of the Changyun Clan…”
“I have heard of you…”
Hearing what the Elixir Alliance Hierarch said, Changyun Yuanlei was caught off guard and then couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise:
“Senior has actually heard of me…”
“Of course…”
The Elixir Alliance Hierarch nodded and then continued:
“What matter did your family’s ancestor send you here to the Elixir Alliance for?”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei hurriedly replied:“Our ancestor sent us to find Elder Bai to deliver some items to him.”
“Also, Elder Bai had previously promised our ancestor two spots in the Elixir Alliance, and our visit this time is indeed to join the Elixir Alliance.”
After listening to Changyun Yuanlei, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch slightly nodded his head:
“The two spots you mentioned were mentioned to me by Elder Bai, I am aware of this matter.”
“As for finding Elder Bai, that’s a bit unfortunate.”
“A few months ago, Elder Bai left and went into the Outer Spatial Void, and he is unlikely to return anytime soon.”
“Even if you wish to find him, in that vast and boundless Outer Spatial Void, it’s like looking for a needle in the sea, practically impossible.”
“If the items you wish to deliver to him are not urgent, then all is well and good, you can just wait for him to return.”
“But if it is urgent, then I am powerless to help, and you can only return to the Inner Sea of the Demon Realm and inform your family’s ancestor of this situation.”
After hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei looked at Lin Jing.
And Lin Jing bowed with his hands clasped towards the Elixir Alliance Hierarch, saying:
“Senior…”
“Elder Changyun had instructed beforehand that this matter is not urgent, if Elder Bai is not present, then we will wait for his return.”
The Elixir Alliance Hierarch looked at Lin Jing and nodded his head.
Ɲ0νǤᴑ.сο
Next, he continued to speak:
“As for the matter of joining the Elixir Alliance…”
At this point, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch paused for a moment before continuing:
“To join our Elixir Alliance, even if you have the spots given by Elder Bai, you still need to participate in an assessment, are you aware of this?”
Lin Jing nodded, saying:
“Of course…”
“Elder Changyun had already informed us of this before we came.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s response, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch gently nodded his head:
“Since you are both aware, then I will find someone to arrange your assessment right away.”
Having said that, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch lifted his hand, condensing a thread of golden light at the tip of his fingers.
The golden light formed and, with a subtle movement of the Elixir Alliance Hierarch’s fingers, the thread of golden light immediately flew out and vanished in the blink of an eye.
After the golden light disappeared, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch spoke again, looking at Changyun Yuanlei and asking:
“Changyun Yuanlei, to what grade of Pill Master have you now advanced?”
Changyun Yuanlei quickly replied:
“In response to senior, I am merely at the Sixth Grade.”
“Sixth Grade…”
The Elixir Alliance Hierarch evaluated Changyun Yuanlei and then nodded with satisfaction:
“For someone your age, to reach the rank of a Sixth Grade Pill Master is indeed commendable.”
After finishing speaking, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch looked at Lin Jing and asked:
“And you?”
“Your cultivation seems quite good, may I know which grade you are at?”
Lin Jing bowed with his hands clasped and replied:
“In response to my senior…”
“I am at the Seventh Grade.”
“Seventh Grade…”
Upon hearing this, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch couldn’t help being somewhat surprised.
After the surprise, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch nodded slightly:
“With your current cultivation, to immerse yourself in the Alchemy Dao, you should have at least five hundred years if not a thousand years.”
“To raise your alchemy cultivation to the Seventh Grade in such a short time, it seems you are indeed an excellent prospect.”
However, no sooner had the Elixir Alliance Hierarch’s voice fallen, Changyun Yuanlei quietly said:
“Brother Lin, his cultivation is not even two centuries old, let alone having five hundred years of alchemy cultivation.”
Although Changyun Yuanlei’s words were soft, they sounded like thunder in the ears of the Elixir Alliance Hierarch.
...
The Elixir Alliance Hierarch immediately widened his eyes and looked at Lin Jing with utter disbelief:
“You are actually less than two hundred years old?”
Lin Jing gently nodded and then said:
“In reply to senior…”
“Before leaving the Inner Sea, Elder Changyun specifically instructed that there was no need to hide this matter from Elder Bai and senior.”
“Indeed, I have not yet reached two hundred years of age.”
Having heard Lin Jing’s personal admission, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch was even more shocked:
“Less than two hundred years old, yet possessing the cultivation of the Dao Integration Stage and also being a Seventh Grade Alchemist…”
Having said this, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch scrutinized Lin Jing, and then spoke again:
“Your surname is Lin!”
“So, are you connected to the Lin Family from the Inner Sea, that clan rumored to have been extinguished…”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Indeed, I am a descendant of the Lin Family that was dispersed.”
After hearing this, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch finally breathed a sigh of relief:
“No wonder…”
“I was wondering how Changyun, that old fellow, would give such precious spots to an outsider.”
“It turns out you are a member of the Lin Family.”
After finishing, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch looked at Lin Jing with a smile and said:
“Since you are a member of the Lin Family, then you are not an outsider.”
“Back in the day, I had a good relationship with your Lin Family’s Fei Ling ancestor, only later for some reason, he disappeared without a trace.”
“After his disappearance, I also searched for a significant amount of time, but alas, in the end, I couldn’t find him.”
“Soon after, your Lin Family also went into decline.”
“Since then, no one from your Lin Family has entered the Elixir Alliance anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 821
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 821: Chapter 365: The Frenzied Elixir Alliance Hierarch_2 Chapter 821: Chapter 365: The Frenzied Elixir Alliance Hierarch_2 “I never thought that today, I would still encounter someone from the Lin Family.”
Having spoken, the Alliance Hierarch of the Elixir Alliance took out a purple token emanating a special aura from his person, and then with a wave of his hand, the purple token flew to Lin Jing.
Next, the Alliance Hierarch spoke:
“Take this token.”
“With this token, you will have much convenience within the Elixir Alliance.
If you need to find me, this token can be used.”
Lin Jing looked at the token, was stunned for a moment, and then looked towards the Alliance Hierarch.
The Alliance Hierarch looked at Lin Jing and then spoke:
“Accept it.”
“Initially, I couldn’t locate Feiling; I’ve felt guilty about it.
Now that I have encountered his descendant, I should naturally take extra care of you.”
Lin Jing nodded and then said,
“Thank you, elder…”
After speaking, Lin Jing took the token that was in front of him.
After receiving the token, Lin Jing pondered for a moment and then said,
“Elder…”
“The ancestor Feiling, he has actually been found.”Upon hearing this, the Alliance Hierarch immediately looked up, eagerly asking Lin Jing:
“Where is Feiling?”
Lin Jing spoke:
“Ancestor Feiling was deceived by a friend and accidentally fell into Immortal Crossing Island.
At Immortal Crossing Island, he perished together with his foe.”
Upon hearing this, the Alliance Hierarch suddenly became absent-minded, murmuring:
“Deceived by a friend, Immortal Crossing Island…”
After a long moment, the Alliance Hierarch looked disheartened and said,
“I understand…”
…
...
Just as the Alliance Hierarch finished speaking, a presence approached from a distance, rapidly closing in on this location.
A moment later, an old man with disheveled hair but clean and tidy robes arrived.
After arriving, the old man directly addressed the Alliance Hierarch:
“Hierarch, what do you need me for this time?”
“I was busy on my end, then I received your message.”
Seeing the old man arrive, the Alliance Hierarch came back to his senses, composed himself, and then said to the old man:
“Elder Qi…”
“These two individuals have just joined our Elixir Alliance.
From now on, they will follow you; take them for the assessment first.”
Hearing the Alliance Hierarch say this, Elder Qi immediately frowned, seemingly very reluctant.
Then, he directly addressed the Alliance Hierarch:
“Wait, Hierarch.”
“The Alchemy Conference hasn’t started yet, so why are you placing them here now?”
“Moreover…”
“I’ve always been busy, as you well know.
My hands are full with the elixir recipe, and I’m at a critical moment; I really can’t spare a single moment.
“For them to follow me, I really don’t have the time to teach them.
Just like that last girl you sent to me, I am still letting her farm.”
The Alliance Hierarch looked at Elder Qi, seemingly helpless, sighed, and then explained:
“Ah…
“Elder Qi, surely you know the state of our alliance.
Under every other elder, there are at least several people.”
“You alone have only one girl, and you’ve left her to her own devices for a long time.
The others already have complaints.”
“These two seats were previously assigned by Elder Bai.
Now that Elder Bai is not here, I’ve temporarily placed them under your care.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Qi immediately looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, observing them closely, and then, puzzled, he spoke:
“Grand Elder?”
Having said this, he turned back to the Alliance Hierarch and continued:
“Even if they were granted seats by the Grand Elder, if you place them under my care, I truly don’t have the time to teach them.”
The Alliance Hierarch then spoke to Elder Qi:
“You need not worry about teaching them.”
“They come from the Changyun Clan and have their own Alchemy Dao heritage; they really don’t need your instruction.
Only guide them a little when they encounter some difficult problems, that’s all.”
“It won’t take much of your time.”
“Changyun Clan…”
Elder Qi turned again to face Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, and after scrutinizing them both,
having looked them over, Elder Qi returned his gaze to the Alliance Hierarch, saying:
“Their cultivation is quite decent, but are they really from the Changyun Clan?”
“Do you really not need me to teach?”
After being asked twice, a slight twitch formed at the corner of the Elixir Alliance Hierarch’s mouth…
In the Eastern Spirit Realm, the reputation of the Elixir Alliance was extraordinary.
Besides its long-standing neutrality, the most important aspect was that once someone successfully joined the Elixir Alliance, they would receive selfless instruction from the seniors within the alliance.
The path of the Alchemy Dao is not easy.
Apart from those who either have a master or are from Alchemy Dao families, there are many loose cultivators who have taken this path.
There’s no need to talk about those with a master or family background, as they naturally don’t need to worry with someone to guide them.
But there are many loose cultivators who have chosen this path, among whom many are exceptionally talented but have taken many wrong turns due to lack of guidance.
The establishment of the Elixir Alliance actually provided these individuals with some opportunities.
Once able to join the Elixir Alliance, they could not only obtain numerous cultivation resources through the alliance but could even receive instruction from the seniors which could save them many detours.
Allowing them to go further on the path of the Alchemy Dao.
Therefore,
everyone who joins the Elixir Alliance is assigned a mentor who is one level higher than themselves in Alchemy Dao, to instruct and help them make quick progress.
However, Elder Qi was different.
Although one of the elders of the Elixir Alliance, he greatly favored researching elixir recipes and spirit plants and disliked interacting with people, let alone teaching disciples.
This undeniably made him an oddity among the many elders.
Facing such an elder who disliked contact and teaching, even the Elixir Alliance Hierarch felt quite helpless.
However…
Although Elder Qi seldom taught disciples, since joining the Elixir Alliance, he had studied numerous elixir recipes, making significant contributions to the alliance.
While the Elixir Alliance Hierarch was somewhat speechless when facing Elder Qi, he quickly stabilized his emotions and, with a smile, said again to Elder Qi:
“Of course…”
“Otherwise, why do you think I placed them under you?”
“I know you’re busy and don’t have time.”
“And these two, coming from the Changyun Clan, really don’t need much instruction from you.”
As he spoke, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch pointed towards Lin Jing and continued:
“Especially this one, who is already a Seventh Grade Alchemist.”
“The girl I arranged under you before, didn’t you say you didn’t have time to teach?
Why not just let him teach her on your behalf?”
“This arrangement is actually for your benefit.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Qi’s eyes lit up, and then he looked towards Lin Jing:
“This kid is a Seventh Grade Alchemist, you aren’t fooling me, are you?”
Even for the Elixir Alliance Hierarch, getting doubted again was somewhat straining.
However, as the leader of the alliance, he maintained his composure and after taking a deep breath, he patiently continued:
“Certainly…”
“They have just arrived, and will soon partake in an examination.”
“I plan to have you oversee the examination.
Whether he is a Seventh Grade Alchemist or not, won’t you know then?”
Under the persuasive guidance of the Elixir Alliance Hierarch, Elder Qi finally nodded:
“Alright…”
“We’ll do it your way.”
“I’ll take them to the examination shortly.
If they pass, then all is well; if not, I will bring them back to you for handling.”
“Alliance Hierarch.”
“Let me be upfront, even if they pass, I won’t have much time to teach them.”
“If you trouble me over this matter, don’t say I didn’t warn you.”
With Elder Qi dragging his feet and repeatedly trying to shirk responsibility, even the Elixir Alliance Hierarch found it hard to contain himself.
The Elixir Alliance Hierarch fixed his gaze on Elder Qi, barely suppressing his anger as he spoke:
“Fine, should they come to me instead?”
“I have already given them my token, so if there really is any problem, let them come straight to me.”
Seeing the Elixir Alliance Hierarch in such a state, Elder Qi knew that his patience might have reached its limit; if he continued to drag this out, he might actually find himself on the receiving end of a beating.
If that were to happen, it wouldn’t be worth it.
With that thought, Elder Qi quickly became much more compliant.
He dared not look directly at the Elixir Alliance Hierarch again, but turned to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, saying:
“Let’s go…”
“I’ll take you to the examination now.”
With that, Elder Qi took the lead and walked out.
After Elder Qi had left, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei bowed to the Elixir Alliance Hierarch and, following Elder Qi, also departed.
Only after they had all left did the Elixir Alliance Hierarch reveal a look of extreme frustration:
“Hisss…”
“Why did my mind go blank and I chose him?
ƝονǤ0.с0
This is just purely making things difficult for myself…”

chapters.title: Chapter 822
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 822: Chapter 366: Assessment Success, Joining the Elixir Alliance Chapter 822: Chapter 366: Assessment Success, Joining the Elixir Alliance Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, following Elder Qi, left the tower-like high building and continued walking toward the Inner City.
In the Inner City, there were many buildings, yet unlike the shops outside, these buildings generally occupied a large area.
Because it was the Inner City, there were very few people along the way, and the three of them only encountered a handful of people.
When these people saw Elder Qi from afar, they immediately greeted him respectfully with clasped hands.
However, Elder Qi ignored their greetings and continued walking forward at a fast pace.
Elder Qi moved quickly; Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, in order not to fall behind, dared not slow down and closely followed him.
The people, seemingly aware of Elder Qi’s disposition, did not delay after greeting him, but continued with their own tasks.
...
Soon.
Under the guidance of Elder Qi, they arrived at a vast hall.
Above the entrance of the hall hung a black plaque inscribed with the words “Elixir Alliance Examination Hall.”
As soon as the three of them entered the hall, a middle-aged cultivator inside saw Elder Qi and hurriedly came forward,
“Elder Qi, why have you come today?”
Elder Qi, pointing at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, said,
“These two are here to participate in the membership examination.”
“Prepare a set of Seventh Grade, and one…”
At this point, Elder Qi looked at Changyun Yuanlei and asked,
“What rank are you now as a Pill Master?”
Changyun Yuanlei quickly replied,
“Senior, Sixth Grade.”
Elder Qi nodded and then continued,
“One set of Seventh Grade and another set of Sixth Grade Pill Master examination materials.”
The middle-aged cultivator, upon hearing Elder Qi’s words, could not help but reveal a surprised expression as he looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei.
Both Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei seemed quite young, yet each bore extraordinary stature.
Their mastery of Alchemy Dao surpassed one another.
Especially Lin Jing, who was so young, yet already a Seventh Grade Alchemist.
It is known that advancing even a single rank as an alchemist is extremely difficult,
especially in the later stages, due to the scarcity of high-grade spiritual plants, making the advancement of an alchemist all the more challenging.
Therefore, even within the Elixir Alliance, there were not many young Seventh Grade Alchemists.
Those Seventh Grade alchemists each spent a considerable amount of time accumulating their skills gradually.
Other than those backed by extraordinary forces and possessing exceptional alchemic talent.
The Seventh Grade alchemists were either white-haired old men or middle-aged cultivators like him.
Seeing the two young men, he assumed both must come from sects or noble families with extraordinary backing.
The middle-aged cultivator, who was almost always in this examination hall, saw much and was very confident in his speculations.
Ɲ0νǤօ.ᴄο
Of course.
His guess was almost always correct, without much error.
Knowing Elder Qi’s disposition, he did not ask further questions but directly clasped his hands and said to Elder Qi,
“Elder Qi, please wait a moment.
I’ll go fetch the materials.”
With that, the middle-aged cultivator turned and walked toward the back of the hall from the left side.
Just then, Elder Qi spoke up again:
“Right…
”
“Don’t forget to tell them the rules of the examination.”
“Yes, Elder Qi.”
The middle-aged cultivator responded and then proceeded to the back of the hall.
It wasn’t long before the middle-aged cultivator reappeared from the back of the hall and came directly to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei.
Then,
he handed over two packages to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei respectively.
As Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei received their packages, the middle-aged cultivator began,
“These are the alchemy ingredients you will need for your examination.
Seventh Grade Qingming Pills and Sixth Grade Condensing Spirit Pills.”
“Both of these elixir medicines are fairly common in Seventh and Sixth Grades; their materials are not difficult to find, so I assume both of you have crafted them before.”
“This membership examination requires you to refine the given materials into elixirs within eight hours.”
“Moreover, the elixirs you produce must include either one supreme elixir or two superior elixirs.”
“If you achieve this, you will be considered successful; otherwise, it’s a failure,”
“Given your status, this shouldn’t be too difficult.”
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei couldn’t help but click his tongue,
“Producing a supreme or two superior elixirs from a single furnace is indeed no simple task.”
Lin Jing looked at Changyun Yuanlei and said,
“These should be manageable for you, I presume.”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded and replied,
“Yes, I am quite confident.”
At that moment, Elder Qi spoke,
“I will be overseeing your examination this time.”
“If I notice any anomalies during your alchemy process, I will intervene immediately.”
“At that point, your examination will be considered a failure and both of you will be expelled from the Elixir Alliance immediately, regardless of your connections to the Grand Elder.”
“Do you understand?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei quickly said,
“Rest assured, Elder Qi, we will surely not engage in any abnormal activities.”
Elder Qi nodded and then said to the two,
“Alright…”
“Follow me, let’s begin the examination.”
The two nodded and followed Elder Qi, walking toward the back of the hall from the right side.
Following Elder Qi, they entered the back of the hall, passed through a long corridor, and then arrived at an even larger hall.
This hall was semi-circular, divided into an outer and inner circle, with the outer circle consisting of rooms separated by formations.

chapters.title: Chapter 823
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 823: Chapter 366: Successful Assessment, Joining the Elixir Alliance_2 Chapter 823: Chapter 366: Successful Assessment, Joining the Elixir Alliance_2 Inside the great hall’s inner circle was a high platform wrapped within a Formation.
This platform was densely covered with Formation Patterns that extended from the platform to the entirety of the hall, reaching into the rooms on the periphery.
The rooms, cordoned off at the periphery, were all the same; each contained a Pill Furnace.
With just a glance, Lin Jing understood clearly.
These rooms were individual Alchemy Rooms.
Next,
Elder Qi pointed at two rooms ahead and said to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei,
“Each of you choose a room.
Once you enter, the Formation will activate, and you can begin alchemy.”
“Oh, right…”
“During alchemy, you may use your own Pill Furnace.”
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei both nodded and then each walked towards one of the rooms.
...
After they entered the rooms, Elder Qi had already moved to the platform in the middle.
Shortly after, the Formation that covered the entire hall began to activate, and the white light emitted from the Formation spread from under Elder Qi’s feet.
Soon, it permeated the whole hall,
as well as the rooms where Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were enclosed.
With the activation of the Formation, their alchemy had officially started.
Lin Jing, unruffled, immediately took out a package and opened it.
Various Spirit Plants inside caught his eye instantly.
These Spirit Plants were all for the concoction of the Qingming Pill.
Lin Jing then picked them out, one by one to inspect.
After the inspection, Lin Jing couldn’t help but nod in approval.
All the Spirit Plants were in good condition, and their quality was commendable.
After checking the Spirit Plants, Lin Jing took out the Cloud Patterned Purple-Gold Furnace from his Space Ring and set it in front of him.
Once he had set the Pill Furnace up, Lin Jing did not delay and immediately began operating the Divine Fire Triple Realm, gathering the colorless flame to start the initial refinement of the Spirit Plants.
While both were busy refining Spirit Plants, Elder Qi looked up, his gaze sweeping across both of them.
“Huh?”
Elder Qi’s gaze lingered when he saw Lin Jing gathering the colorless flame, prompting a soft ‘huh’ from him as he stared a bit longer.
However,
it was only for a moment; then Elder Qi withdrew his gaze and pulled out an Elixir Recipe, studying it closely.
He seemed to pay no attention to the assessment of Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei.
After starting, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei no longer heeded the external environment and focused intently on refining the Spirit Plants…
…
…
Thus, time gradually passed.
Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei, and Elder Qi, really did not disturb each other, each busy with their tasks.
Any other person would likely not behave this way, but Elder Qi was different, never once paying attention to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei after the initial start, until veering past four hours when rich Elixir Fragrance wafted from the front Alchemy Room; then Elder Qi finally raised his head, looking towards the two.
At this moment,
Lin Jing was still sitting cross-legged in front of the Pill Furnace, carefully controlling the bottom flame, while in the other Alchemy Room, Changyun Yuanlei had already risen, increasing the flames to start the final Solidifying Pill phase.
Lin Jing was concocting a Seventh Grade Elixir Medicine, while Changyun Yuanlei was crafting a Sixth Rank Elixir Medicine,
Thus, the time Lin Jing needed to concoct his Elixir Medicine was naturally longer than Changyun Yuanlei’s.
And that rich Elixir Fragrance naturally drifted from Changyun Yuanlei’s Pill Furnace.
As time slowly passed, this Elixir Fragrance grew increasingly potent.
In less than half an hour, Changyun Yuanlei’s concoction was complete.
Having finished crafting the Elixir Medicine, Changyun Yuanlei packed up the Elixir Medicine and the Pill Furnace, causing Elder Qi to deactivate the Formation around Changyun Yuanlei’s Alchemy Room.
ƝονǤᴑ.ƈο
Afterward, Changyun Yuanlei exited and came to Elder Qi’s side, passing the Elixir Medicine to him.
Elder Qi received the Elixir Medicine, inspected it briefly, then nodded to Changyun Yuanlei and said,
“Just wait here until he’s finished.”
With that, Elder Qi turned his attention back to Lin Jing, ignoring Changyun Yuanlei.
Changyun Yuanlei nodded and stood there obediently, watching Lin Jing, who was still busy with alchemy.
…
When the Elixir Fragrance wafted through again, it was half an hour later.
After ten hours of concoction, Lin Jing’s batch of Elixir Medicine had also reached its final Solidifying Pill phase.
Lin Jing circulated his cultivation technique to accelerate the flow of spiritual power, making the colorless flame he was condensing even more vigorous.
In the furnace, the medicinal liquid that had already merged into a single mass was also starting to take shape, and the elixir fragrance drifting in the air was becoming increasingly rich.
…
…
About an hour passed, and just as the elixir fragrance grew more intense, filling the entire examination venue, Lin Jing retracted the flame at that moment.
Needless to say, by now, Lin Jing’s batch of elixir furnace medicine had finally been refined.
Next.
Lin Jing opened the pill furnace, and instantly, that rich elixir fragrance rushed out overwhelmingly.
At the same time, several elixir pills began to slowly rise from within the pill furnace and quickly emerged from it.
Seeing this, Lin Jing immediately stretched out his hand.
The several elixir pills, as if guided, flew into the palm of Lin Jing’s hand.
Afterwards, Lin Jing looked into his palm.
This batch of elixir produced a total of six pills.
Among them, two were supreme elixir.
Just one was enough to indicate that Lin Jing had passed this assessment.
But Lin Jing had refined two.
He had refined the Qingming Pill many times before at the Changyun Clan, and his proficiency made it unnecessary to use bonus attachment for cheating.
Thus, in this assessment, Lin Jing didn’t use the bonus attachment, relying solely on his own true skill.
Apart from the two supreme elixir, the remaining four were two superior-grade, one medium-grade, and one low-grade elixir medicine.
In a batch with two supreme-grade elixir, this production of Qingming Pills was considered supremely excellent among seventh-grade alchemists.
TMost seventh-grade alchemists could not refine them at all; only those seasoned alchemists who had been promoted to seventh-grade for a significant time and had long been famous could occasionally produce them.
After inspecting the elixir pills in his hand, Lin Jing immediately stored them in a jade vial.
Having secured the elixir pills, Lin Jing also collected the pill furnace.
At this time, the formation in the Alchemy Room was already open, and Lin Jing, holding the jade vial, walked out of the Alchemy Room to Elder Qi.
Next.
Lin Jing passed the jade vial in his hand.
Elder Qi took the jade vial, opened it to look inside, then looked deeply at Lin Jing and said,
“Not bad…”
“Your mastery in the Alchemy Dao is extraordinary, to refine two supreme elixir in a single batch is no small feat.
With your current mastery in the Alchemy Dao, there is a good chance you could break through to an eighth-grade alchemist within five hundred years.”
“Once you break through to the eighth grade, you can become an elder of the Elixir Alliance.”
“I have high hopes for you!”
Elder Qi’s generous praise left Lin Jing somewhat overwhelmed, and he quickly responded modestly,
“You flatter me, elder!”
Elder Qi then waved his hand and spoken directly,
“The future will reveal itself in time…”
“For now…”
“Both of you have passed the assessment.”
“Come with me!”
Having said that, Elder Qi left the stage and headed towards the great hall where the three had initially entered.
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei saw this and quickly followed.
Soon.
The three returned to the great hall, where Elder Qi communicated the results of the assessment to the middle-aged cultivator present earlier, then handed over the elixir medications that Lin Jing and another had produced to him.
The middle-aged cultivator took the elixir medications, opened and inspected them to verify their correctness, and then he pulled out one purple and one blue identity token, each distinct in color.
After that…
The middle-aged cultivator handed the one purple and one blue tokens to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei respectively.
Lin Jing and the other extended their hands to receive the tokens.
At this moment.
The middle-aged cultivator spoke to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei,
“Congratulations to you both on joining the Elixir Alliance!”

chapters.title: Chapter 824
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 824: Chapter 367: Junior Sister Ji Xiyue Chapter 824: Chapter 367: Junior Sister Ji Xiyue Afterward, the middle-aged cultivator explained to Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei the history of the Elixir Alliance and how to use the Identity Token.
However, just as the middle-aged cultivator reached the halfway point of his explanation, he was already interrupted by the urgent Elder Qi:
“I have other matters to attend to, so I won’t delay here any longer.
Let’s leave it here for today.
ɴονǤ0.ᴄο
As for the rest, I’ll have someone explain it to them in detail after I return.”
Facing Elder Qi’s urging, the middle-aged cultivator had no choice but to respond:
“If that’s the case, then I won’t delay Elder Qi’s time any further.”
Having said that, the middle-aged cultivator turned to Lin Jing and said:
“Remember, you don’t need to refine the Identity Token before using it; simply drop blood to recognize the master.”
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei nodded.
Then, under Elder Qi’s prompting, the two followed Elder Qi and left the assessment hall.
After leaving the assessment hall, Elder Qi continued to lead Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei deeper into the Inner City.
...
As the three of them walked forward, Elder Qi said to them:
“The Alliance Hierarch has entrusted you to me, meaning from today onward, I am your mentor, and I also bear the responsibility to instruct you.”“However, I am usually quite busy and don’t have much time to offer guidance.
If you encounter any issues, you can jot them down, and I will address them one by one when I am free.”
“If it’s truly urgent, you may directly seek the Alliance Hierarch.
He also said today that if you encounter any difficulties, you can go to him.”
At this point, Elder Qi suddenly stopped, turned around with a stern expression, and told Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei:
“You must remember!”
“While I am secluded for researching elixir recipes, no matter what happens, you must not disturb me, or else, regardless of the reason, I will directly expel you from my tutelage.”
“Do you understand?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing hastily nodded:
“Master, please rest assured, we will certainly heed your teachings and will not disturb you.”
Elder Qi’s expression then eased.
Subsequently,
Elder Qi took out a white jade token, looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei, and said:
“Oh, right…”
“I haven’t yet asked, what are your names?”
Lin Jing promptly bowed and said:
“Master, your disciple’s name is Lin Jing!”
Changyun Yuanlei also bowed and then said:
“Master, my name is Changyun Yuanlei.”
Elder Qi nodded slightly:
“Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei…”
“Alright, I’ve got it!”
After finishing, Elder Qi continued:
“With the two of you, I now have three disciples under me, and among these three, whether it is cultivation or Pill Master rank, you have the highest.
”
“From now on, you will be their senior brother.”
Saying this, Elder Qi handed the white jade token to Lin Jing, and then said:
“This token is my Identity Token as an Elder.”
“Most of the time, I am secluded for the study of elixir recipes and seldom show myself, so I will entrust this token to you.
”
“With this Identity Jade, you will be essentially representing me.
Inside the alliance, it will not only make things more convenient for you, but even when encountering other Elders, they will grant you many conveniences.”
“If there is anything within the alliance, or arrangements from the Alliance Hierarch and council meetings, you will represent me.”
“Furthermore…”
“During my seclusion, the teaching of your two junior disciples, brother and sister, will also fall to you.”
Elder Qi’s arrangements not only granted Lin Jing the position of senior brother but also seemed to push all responsibilities onto him.
Just after being accepted into the sect, Lin Jing found himself to be the senior brother, not knowing whether to laugh or cry about his situation.
However…
Now that he had joined the Elixir Alliance and was assigned a hands-off mentor like Elder Qi, Lin Jing, while astonished at Elder Qi’s peculiar way, had no choice but to accept it.
Fortunately, Lin Jing also preferred being alone, and now under Elder Qi, they would not interfere with each other, making Lin Jing feel that it wasn’t so bad after all.
Except for the junior brother he needed to look after, there was also the junior sister he had not yet met.
As for the junior brother, Changyun Yuanlei, that goes without saying.
Lin Jing was already quite familiar with him, and he did not need Lin Jing’s guidance.
“It’s just that junior sister I haven’t met…”
Thinking this, Lin Jing then asked Elder Qi:
“Master…”
“As for your other disciple, our junior sister, may I ask where she is from and what is her Pill Master rank?”
Elder Qi replied:
“She?
”
“She’s from the Western Demon Region and has followed me for several decades.
She is now a Sixth Grade Alchemist, just like Changyun Yuanlei…”
Upon hearing ‘Western Demon Region,’ Lin Jing’s heart ‘skipped a beat,’ and he couldn’t help but think:
“The Western Demon Region…
Could it be her…?”
…
…
Meanwhile, Elder Qi seemed not to notice Lin Jing’s reaction and continued to speak:
“I’ve already informed her, and she is waiting at my cave dwelling now.”
“Afterward, I will first take you to my cave dwelling.
When you meet, get acquainted with each other, and then have her arrange the cave dwelling for you and familiarize you with the entire Elixir Alliance.”
“As for me, if there’s nothing urgent, I plan to seclude myself and continue my elixir recipe research.”
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei nodded.
After Elder Qi finished instructing them, he continued to lead Lin Jing and the others forward.
In this way, the group passed through many distinct buildings in the Inner City and arrived at a spacious square.
In the middle of this square was a Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 825
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 825: Chapter 367 Younger Apprentice Sister Ji Xiyue_2 Chapter 825: Chapter 367 Younger Apprentice Sister Ji Xiyue_2 Lin Jing glanced over and saw a formation that was very familiar.
This formation, notably, was a Teleportation Array.
However, this Teleportation Array was small and not as large as those in other Immortal Cities.
When the three of them arrived at the Teleportation Array, the two young cultivators guarding it quickly stepped forward and greeted the Elder with clasped hands:
“Elder Qi!”
Elder Qi nodded and then said to them:
“These two have just joined the Elixir Alliance today, and now they are my disciples.”
Upon hearing this, the two hurriedly looked towards Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei and greeted them.
Lin Jing and the others hurriedly responded.
Just then, Elder Qi had already stepped onto the Teleportation Array; seeing this, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei quickly followed suit.
The two young cultivators, likely knowing Elder Qi’s temperament, saw that Elder Qi was ready and did not dare delay, immediately activating the Teleportation Array.
...
…
…
The other end of the Teleportation Array turned out to be within a mountain range.
As soon as they were transported there, what entered Lin Jing’s sight were towering mountains and the endless mountainous wild forests.
In front of them, within sight, was a majestic peak that pierced the clouds, seated atop a mountain range that stretched on for countless miles, standing like a pillar descending from the heavens, steadfast in its place.
Even from a great distance, they could still feel the oppressive presence of the mountain.
Seeing this scene, both Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were momentarily stunned.
During the moment Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were stunned, Elder Qi had already risen into the air.
Following.
Elder Qi looked at Lin Jing and said:
“Follow me…”
“I’ll take you to my cave dwelling first.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing quickly rose into the air, following Elder Qi.
It didn’t take long before the three of them arrived at a valley in the woods, and within this extremely quiet valley was a sizable courtyard.
ƝοѵǤ0.сᴑ
Elder Qi led Lin Jing through the air directly to the valley, and then they landed in front of the courtyard.
Just as the three of them landed, the gates of the courtyard opened, and at the same time, a voice very familiar to Lin Jing came from inside:
“Master!”
“You’re back.”
Following the voice, a slender and breathtakingly beautiful woman walked out from inside the courtyard.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but smile knowingly upon seeing this woman.
He had speculated earlier…
Now…
indeed…
The woman who came out was Ji Xiyue.
Ji Xiyue first looked towards Elder Qi at the forefront, initially not noticing Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei following behind.
However, when she felt a different gaze on her, she couldn’t help but glance back at Lin Jing standing behind Elder Qi.
When Ji Xiyue clearly saw Lin Jing, her eyes lit up, prompting her to exclaim:
“Lin…
Lin Daoyou…”
“How come you are here?”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei was instantly surprised, first looking towards Ji Xiyue up front, then turning his head in disbelief towards Lin Jing.
Obviously, Changyun Yuanlei was very astonished to find that Lin Jing knew the woman who was about to become either his senior disciple sister or junior disciple sister.
But before Changyun Yuanlei could ask anything, Elder Qi had already opened his mouth first:
“You two know each other?”
Upon hearing Elder Qi’s question, Ji Xiyue nodded and replied:
“Yes, Master!”
“I’ve known Lin Daoyou for decades, and I even consulted him on some Alchemy Techniques.”
Lin Jing nodded at this time as well.
Elder Qi listened and nodded slightly:
“Since you two know each other, that’s even better…”
He then directly addressed Ji Xiyue:
“Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei are both my disciples, and you will henceforth be fellow disciples…”
“Lin Jing, being the highest in cultivation and also a Seventh Grade Pill Master, will be your senior disciple brother, and between the remaining two, Ji Xiyue has higher cultivation and will be the senior disciple sister.”
“Changyun Yuanlei, having the lowest cultivation, will be the junior disciple brother.”
“Do any of you have any objections?”
Lin Jing and his companions exchanged glances, then spoke:
“We rely entirely on Master’s decision.”
Elder Qi nodded, then continued:
“In the future, if you two have any issues, go directly to your senior brother, Lin Jing.
If he cannot resolve them, then go find the Alliance Hierarch.”
“As for me, once I come out of closed-door cultivation, I will look for you.”
Ji Xiyue and Changyun Yuanlei both nodded and said:
“Understood, Master!”
Elder Qi nodded slightly, then turned to Ji Xiyue and said:
“Xiyue, later, take these two brothers around to get familiar with the Elixir Alliance.”
“After they are familiar with it, take them to the two caves near your residence; those will be their dwellings from now on.”
“Yes, Master!”
Ji Xiyue bowed, addressing Elder Qi.
Elder Qi nodded again, then said to Lin Jing and the others:
“Alright…”
“Now that everything is arranged, you can go.
I need to start my closed-door cultivation and work on the elixir recipe.”
Elder Qi was indeed straightforward; after assigning Lin Jing and his companions to Ji Xiyue, he immediately dismissed them.
Seeing how decisive Elder Qi was, Lin Jing and his companions did not delay.
They bid farewell to Elder Qi and immediately left the valley.
After they left, a formation enveloped the valley, making it impossible for Lin Jing and his companions to enter even if they wanted to.
After coming out, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei looked dumbly at the valley now shrouded by the formation, then slowly said:
“Has Master always been like this?”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue sighed gently, then replied:
“He has always been like this.
Even I, having followed him for decades, have only seen him a handful of times.”
“You’ll get used to it.”
Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei nodded upon hearing this.
Then,
Lin Jing turned to Ji Xiyue, smiling as he spoke:
“I didn’t expect we would meet again so quickly, Ji Daoyou…”
Ji Xiyue then looked at Lin Jing, sizing him up, then spoke:
“When we parted, your cultivation was not much different from mine, but now I find I can no longer gauge your cultivation.”
Lin Jing then said:
“It was also good luck.
After we parted, I ventured into ancient ruins and came across a great opportunity, which led to a significant breakthrough in my cultivation.”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue couldn’t help but express envy:
“Such fortune as yours really is enviable.”
After this point, Ji Xiyue didn’t inquire further, but looked at Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei:
“Lin Senior Brother…”
“Changyun Junior Brother…”
“Let’s go.
I’ll show you to the caves prepared for you.
After you’ve seen them, I’ll show you around the Inner City and give you a complete tour of our Elixir Alliance.”
“What do you think?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said:
“That would be great; thank you for leading the way, Ji Daoyou.”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue quickly responded:
“Senior Brother Lin, please don’t…”
“Now that our cultivation levels are worlds apart, I dare not assume the title of Daoyou.
It would be better to call me Junior Sister from now on.”
Having said that, Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing, her smile widening, restoring some of her usual demeanor:
“I never dreamed that one day I would be your Junior Sister…”
“Life is indeed full of surprises…”
“But this is good.
Now that you are my Senior Brother, I can continue to openly consult you about Alchemy Techniques.”
“And…”
“By leveraging our relationship, I can consult you on Alchemy Techniques without having to offer anything in return.”
“Thinking about it, I still come out ahead…”
With that, Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing, playfully winked, and then, smiling, said:
“Wouldn’t you agree, Senior Brother Lin?”
Lin Jing: “…”
“Yes!”

chapters.title: Chapter 826
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 826: Chapter 368: Elixir Alliance Mission Hall Chapter 826: Chapter 368: Elixir Alliance Mission Hall Regarding Ji Xiyue’s sudden change, Changyun Yuanlei was somewhat surprised for a moment and consequently turned his head to glance at Lin Jing before looking back at Ji Xiyue.
However, it seemed that Ji Xiyue did not care about it.
Following that.
Ji Xiyue spoke again, addressing Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei:
“Brother Lin, Brother Changyun…”
“Let’s go, I will take you first to see your caves.
After viewing the caves, I will show you around the Inner City, and give you both a proper introduction.”
“I think, given Master’s temperament, he probably didn’t really introduce things to you at all.”
Having heard this, Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei nodded in agreement:
“You’re right, Master said he was in a hurry to return to study elixir recipes and didn’t introduce much, saying that he had left this task to you.”
Ji Xiyue spread her hands and then helplessly said:
“There’s no helping it, our Master has always been this way.
You will get used to it over time.”
“Alright, let’s not talk about Master anymore.”
“I’ll take you to see your caves now.”
Lin Jing and the others nodded.
After that.
...
Ji Xiyue led the two, departing the valley and flying in another direction.
The direction in which the three were flying was towards the mountain peak piercing the clouds.
ƝονǤօ.сᴑ
Looking at the mountain ahead, Lin Jing couldn’t help but speak and ask Ji Xiyue:
“Fellow Daoist Ji, where is the place we are currently located?”
Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing and said:
“Our current location is right at the edge of the Mt.
Jihuang range.”
As her voice fell, Ji Xiyue pointed at the peak ahead and said:
“You see that mountain peak in front?
It is the highest peak of the Mt.
Jihuang range and also the tallest mountain in the entire Eastern Spirit Realm.”
“I’m sure you know, our alchemists, especially when concocting high-grade elixir medicines, require very high levels of spiritual energy as well as a certain environment.”
“The small area around Elixir Alliance City simply cannot support so many alchemists of our Elixir Alliance working on alchemy together.”
“Therefore, the caves of many of our Elixir Alliance Alchemists are mostly here.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing involuntarily turned his head to look around.
Indeed.
In the dense forest within his sight, Lin Jing spotted another courtyard.
Despite the distance, Lin Jing could still see that there were Defensive Arrays activated around that courtyard.
Ji Xiyue followed Lin Jing’s gaze and also saw that courtyard, then she explained to Lin Jing:
“The area we are in has actually been protected by the formations of our Elixir Alliance.
Neither Demonic Beasts nor other outsiders can break in.”
“If there really is a cultivator with profound cultivation who tries to force his way in, the moment he enters this area, he will trigger the formation’s alarm, thus alerting the Alliance Hierarch and the Elders.”
“So here, we don’t have to worry about our own safety at all.”
“Besides the outer formations, each cave also has a Defensive Array.
The purpose of this formation is to prevent disturbances during alchemy and is specifically set up for that.”
Lin Jing looked towards the distant courtyard and gently nodded:
“No wonder…”
…
It wasn’t long before…
Ji Xiyue led Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei to the caves that Elder Qi had mentioned earlier, prepared for the two of them.
The caves of Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei were not far from Ji Xiyue’s, also a courtyard, looking quite similar to Elder Qi’s.
However, in comparison to Elder Qi’s, it was much smaller.
And.
Their caves were also very close to Ji Xiyue’s dwelling.
With this, the three of them could also look out for each other in the future.
After viewing their caves, Ji Xiyue then took the two back to the Elixir Alliance’s Inner City.
Upon arriving at the Elixir Alliance’s Inner City, Ji Xiyue, while familiarizing them with the entire Alliance, introduced them…
“See that great hall in front of you…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing and the other looked forward.
They saw a grand hall situated ahead, which appeared modest, but had a constant stream of people going in and out.
This busy scene of people coming and going was very rare inside the Elixir Alliance.
Previously, as Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei had been walking along, it had been quite desolate, with few people encountered.
Yet the entrance to this great hall was bustling, which sparked Lin Jing’s curiosity.
So, he turned and asked Ji Xiyue:
“What is this place?”
Ji Xiyue replied:
“This is the Elixir Alliance’s Mission Hall.”
“We, upon joining the Elixir Alliance, except for the Elders, won’t receive any resources sponsored by the Alliance.”
“If we want cultivation resources, we must take on tasks issued by the Mission Hall, earn Contribution Points, and exchange these points for the resources we need for cultivation.”
“Of course, if you have the support of a powerful backing, you can also avoid coming to the Mission Hall to undertake these tasks.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing looked at the great hall and said:
“So that’s how it is…”
Ji Xiyue nodded and then continued:
“This Elixir Alliance’s Mission Hall is divided into two parts.”
“One part is open to the public, issuing various tasks such as finding different Spirit Plants, Spiritual Liquids, and other alchemy-related tasks.”
“Most of these tasks carry some risk.
They are released publicly, and anyone can accept them.
After completing the task, they can also earn Contribution Points.”
“These Contribution Points can be exchanged for Spirit Stones and various cultivation resources.
You can even use these points to issue tasks, asking our Elixir Alliance to assist in the concoction of Elixir Medicines.”

chapters.title: Chapter 827
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 827: Chapter 368 Elixir Alliance Mission Hall_2 Chapter 827: Chapter 368 Elixir Alliance Mission Hall_2 “And the other part of the Mission Hall is what you see before you,”
“This part of the Mission Hall generally only has one type of task, which is alchemy.”
“The Elixir Alliance’s Alchemy Tasks are not in short supply, some are issued internally by our alliance, and others are externally commissioned using contribution points, requesting our help with alchemy.”
“Even some are collaborations with other forces, assisting them with alchemy.
All such alchemy tasks will appear here in the Mission Hall.”
“Of course…”
“Besides these tasks, there are also some special tasks.”
No sooner had Ji Xiyue finished speaking than Changyun Yuanlei immediately asked:
“Special tasks?
What kind of special tasks?”
Ji Xiyue looked at the two and replied:
“It’s those that require the crafting of difficult elixirs, such as the Flawless Elixirs.”
“The tasks they issue are not easily completed; naturally, they cannot be compared with ordinary tasks.”
Upon hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei suddenly realized and said:
“Oh, I see…”
“So these are the special tasks.”
“Then, the reward for completing special tasks must also be substantial, right?”Ji Xiyue shook her head:
“Special tasks are not easy to complete.
Generally, the rewards for special tasks are not just contribution points but also include other things.”
“After all, the requirements for special tasks are very high.
If they were to be settled with just contribution points, it might be difficult for the task issuer to gather enough points to issue the task.”
Changyun Yuanlei nodded after listening and said:
“I understand.”
Ji Xiyue nodded slightly, then turned to Lin Jing and spoke:
“Brother Lin, what do you think?”
“Would you like to go and take a look at the Mission Hall?”
Lin Jing looked toward the Mission Hall and nodded:
“I will inevitably need to come here to accept tasks in the future, so naturally, I should take a look now.”
Having said this, Lin Jing turned around and walked toward the Mission Hall.
Ji Xiyue and Changyun Yuanlei also followed Lin Jing toward the Mission Hall.
As soon as Lin Jing entered the Mission Hall, he saw a book floating in the middle of the hall, opened wide.
...
This book, several meters in length and width, was quite large and also emitted a gentle white light.
Needless to say, this was not a real book, but rather a Magical Treasure.
At that moment, in the main hall of the Mission Hall, many people stood there, holding their Identity Tokens and extending their Divine Sense toward the book in the center.
At this moment, Ji Xiyue spoke to Lin Jing and said:
“That book is a Magical Treasure that records the tasks.
You can also extend your Divine Sense to take a look.”
Lin Jing nodded, then extended his Divine Sense toward the book.
As soon as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense probed into the book, he immediately felt his entire consciousness enter the book.
This book seemed to be a special Magical Treasure capable of accommodating a cultivator’s consciousness.
Once Lin Jing’s consciousness entered the book, he immediately saw a screen ahead displaying various tasks…
“Fourth Rank seventy-two task: Refine the Fourth Rank Qingling Pill.”
“Task requirement: At least four pills formed, one Supreme Grade Elixir.”
“Time requirement: Two days.”
“Task completion reward: 800 Contribution Points.”
…
“Fifth Rank thirty-three task: Refine the Fifth Rank Spirit Gathering Pill.”
“Task requirement: At least four pills formed, two Superior Elixirs.”
“Time requirement: Three days.”
“Task completion reward: 6000 Contribution Points.”
…
…
The screen displayed many tasks, almost all related to elixir refinement.
Lin Jing observed for a while and noticed that the tasks on the screen were not constant.
During the time Lin Jing was observing, two tasks disappeared from the screen.
He guessed that these tasks had been accepted by someone, which is why they had vanished from the screen.
Of course.
As tasks disappear, naturally, new tasks appear.
In that brief moment, three new tasks appeared on the light screen.
Above all, one of these tasks was special.
“Fourth Rank special task number three: Refine the Fourth Rank Nirvana Elixir.”
“Task requirement: One Flawless Nirvana Elixir.”
“Time requirement: Three months.”
“Task completion reward: 5000 Contribution Points, plus one Medium Grade Daoist Flying Sword, and a set of Offensive Techniques that can be cultivated up to Divinity Transformation.”
…
This special task offered not only Contribution Points as a reward but also Magical Treasures and Cultivation Techniques.
It must be that the person who posted the task didn’t have enough Contribution Points, so they used these items as a substitute.
However,
what he requested was the Nirvana Elixir, the most precious among the Fourth Rank Elixir Medicines, and moreover, a Flawless one at that.
It was probable that these items alone wouldn’t be sufficient.
After observing in the Scroll Space for a while, Lin Jing soon gained some understanding of this task.
Following this, Lin Jing’s thoughts stirred, withdrawing his Divine Sense, and his consciousness left the Scroll Space and returned to his own body.
Upon Lin Jing’s return to consciousness, Ji Xiyue immediately came to his side and said,
“You’ve looked over those tasks, haven’t you?
What do you think?”
Lin Jing nodded slightly:
“They seem quite feasible.”
Ji Xiyue smiled and then motioned Lin Jing to look toward the inside of the hall.
In the back of the Mission Hall, there were several rooms where people who had viewed the tasks continuously entered.
Ji Xiyue then spoke,
“When the time comes, if you decide to undertake a task, just choose one here.”
“Then go to the rooms inside and find a Mission Hall disciple to receive the task.”
Lin Jing nodded, indicating he understood.
…
…
After getting a complete understanding of the Mission Hall, the three of them did not linger and left the place directly.
After leaving the Mission Hall, Ji Xiyue led Lin Jing and Changyun Yuanlei to several other places.
By the time the two had familiarized themselves with the entire Elixir Alliance, it was already quite late.
Afterward,
The three of them then left and returned to their respective cave dwellings.
Lin Jing’s cave dwelling was located at the very back of a valley, one side next to a mountain cliff.
The cave dwelling was quite nice, with a courtyard, an Alchemy Room, and it was protected by a Formation.
Moreover, it was a considerable distance from the nearest cave dwelling of Ji Xiyue.
Lin Jing had chosen this place precisely because it was more secluded and suitable for his Alchemy practice.
Standing in the courtyard of his cave dwelling, Lin Jing was contemplating the matters the elder of the Changyun Clan had entrusted to him before his departure.
Before leaving the Changyun Clan, the elder had instructed Lin Jing to bring an item to Elder Bai of the Elixir Alliance.
And that item…
Was the remaining half of the Ascension Pill.
Elder Bai was the Grand Elder of the Elixir Alliance.
He had close relations with the ancestors of both the Lin Family and the Changyun Clan.
ƝονǤ0.сօ
The three were old friends for many years.
This time, due to the circumstances involving Ye Mingyi, it was not easy for the elder of the Changyun Clan to make a move, so he sent himself to deliver the remaining half of the Ascension Pill to Elder Bai at the Elixir Alliance.
As for why it had to be given to Elder Bai…
That seemed to be a pact made ten thousand years ago among the three of them, but the specifics of that pact were unknown to Lin Jing.
Unfortunately, upon Lin Jing’s arrival, Elder Bai was not present.
Left with no option, Lin Jing had no choice but to keep the half Ascension Pill on him and wait for Elder Bai’s return.
Besides the matter of the Ascension Pill, there was another issue Lin Jing needed to resolve.
That was the issue of the Lin Family’s Innate Daoist Pill Furnace.
The Lin Family’s Daoist Pill Furnace had shattered during the refinement of the Ascension Pill.
The elder of the Changyun Clan had also mentioned that this shattered Pill Furnace could be repaired, but there was no one within the entire demon-filled Inner Sea capable of repairing it.
Only in the Eastern Spirit Realm were there individuals capable of repairing the Lin Family’s Pill Furnace.
Lin Jing had asked the elder of the Changyun Clan for the name of the person who could repair the Pill Furnace.
The elder of the Changyun Clan had only given Lin Jing four words: the Xian Duan elder.
Lin Jing had already made plans.
During his time in the Elixir Alliance, he planned to refine Elixirs to enhance his Alchemy Dao cultivation while simultaneously inquiring about the Xian Duan elder, attempting to repair the Lin Family’s Innate Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 828
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 828: Chapter 369: Xian Duan Elder Chapter 828: Chapter 369: Xian Duan Elder The next morning, as Lin Jing was still meditating, Ji Xiyue had already come to find him.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Ji Xiyue spoke straightforwardly,
“Lin Senior Brother, I never got around to asking yesterdayâ€¦”
“How come you were with people from the Changyun Clan?”
“Has your identity…
been exposed?”
Lin Jing naturally understood what Ji Xiyue meant.
Ji Xiyue knew about his identity as the heir of the Lin Family.
Now that she saw him with Changyun Yuanlei, she was naturally quite puzzled.
Lin Jing nodded and then began to speak,
“You could say thatâ€¦”
“Before I came to the Eastern Spirit Realm, I was already in the Demon Demon Inner Sea.”
“In the Inner Sea, I experienced some things and learned some truths about the destruction of the Lin Family.
Now that everything about the Lin Family has been revealed, those who were once hostile to the Lin Family have also appeared.”
“The identity of me as the Lin Family heir thus no longer needs to be concealed.”
After listening, Ji Xiyue nodded in understanding.
...
â€¦
Following that,
Lin Jing spoke and asked Ji Xiyue,
“Xiyue Junior Sister, I need to ask you something.”
“Xiyue Junior Sisterâ€¦” Ji Xiyue, upon hearing this, turned to look at Lin Jing and couldn’t help but cover her mouth and giggle,
“Heheâ€¦”
“I never thought I’d be addressed by Senior Brother Jing like this; it’s truly an honor for this young woman.”
Lin Jing had spoken without much thought, but upon reflection, he realized it was somewhat improper.
He couldn’t help but cough twice to cover his embarrassment,
“Cough…
Cough…”
“Ji Junior Sister, I actually have something I want to ask you.”
Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing, blinked her eyes, and with a smile tugging at her lips, said,
“What would you like to ask, Lin Senior Brother?”
Lin Jing straightened his expression and then spoke seriously,
“Do you, Ji Junior Sister, happen to know about the elder known as ‘Xian Duan’?”
“Xian Duan?”
Seeing Lin Jing get serious, Ji Xiyue also stopped jesting and put away her frivolous demeanor, nodding earnestly,
“Yes, I’ve heard a bit about Xian Duan.”
“What is it?
Do you need to find Xian Duan, Senior Brother Lin?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I have a damaged Magical Treasure that I want Xian Duan to help repair.”
Upon hearing this, Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing and then shook her head,
“Looking for Xian Duan to repair a Magical Treasure?
I’m afraid you might be disappointed.”
“What do you mean?” Lin Jing asked, puzzled.
Ji Xiyue then explained,
“Not to mention Xian Duan is elusive, rarely appearing before people, but the location of his abode, Xian Duan Fu, has also been unknown to this day.”
“Finding Xian Duan requires him to take initiative or an extraordinary stroke of luck.”
“Besidesâ€¦”
“Rumor has it, Xian Duan is quite eccentric.
There are countless people who seek his help.”
“It won’t be easy for you to get his assistance to repair a Magical Treasure.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing fell into thought.
Seeing Lin Jing pondering, Ji Xiyue quickly asked,
“What’s the matter?”
“Is that Magical Treasure very important to you?”
Lin Jing nodded and then said,
“Yesâ€¦”
“To be honest, the Magical Treasure I mentioned comes from the Lin Family; it’s extremely important to me.”
Hearing this, Ji Xiyue fell silent for a moment and then spoke again,
“If that’s the case, then all you can do is wait.”
“Xian Duan may be capricious, but sometimes he shows up unexpectedly in an Immortal City, refining artifacts for people.
And if he’s in a good mood, he doesn’t even charge.”
“If you really want to find Xian Duan, Senior Brother Lin, you can only wait for him to appear.”
While considering this, Lin Jing nodded slightly,
“That’s the only way thenâ€¦”
After some thought, Lin Jing looked up at Ji Xiyue and asked,
“Ji Junior Sister, you came so early, there must be something else, right?”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Ji Xiyue nodded repeatedly and then said,
“Indeed, I’ve run into a bit of trouble, so I wanted to seek help from Senior Brother Lin.”
Lin Jing looked at Ji Xiyue and then asked,
“What trouble have you encountered?”
Ji Xiyue let out a helpless sigh and then said,
“Ahâ€¦”
“Ever since the last time, with your help, I advanced to a Sixth Grade Alchemist, decades have passed, and my success rate in alchemy has always been low.”
“The Elixir Scripture you helped me repair before, so I came to you hoping you could check if there’s any problem I missed again.”
Lin Jing heard this and nodded gently,
“I seeâ€¦”
“No problem, let me take a look for you again.”
Ji Xiyue heard this and immediately broke into a smile.
Then, she took out the Elixir Scripture from before and handed it to Lin Jing.
After Lin Jing took the Elixir Scripture, he immediately began to examine it.
And Ji Xiyue, without hesitancy, came close to Lin Jing’s side and started to look with himâ€¦
â€¦
â€¦
Time flies.
In the blink of an eye, twenty years had passed since Lin Jing arrived at the Elixir Alliance.
For cultivators, twenty years passed in the blink of an eye, fleeting if one did not pay attention.
ƝονǤο.ƈօ
In these twenty years, Lin Jing took on various alchemy tasks from the Mission Hall of the Elixir Alliance to accumulate Contribution Points.
At the same time, he searched for traces of Xian Duan.
Through continuous inquiries, Lin Jing learned a great deal about the deeds of Xian Duan and gradually gained some understanding of him.
He also understood why only Xian Duan could repair the Lin Family Pill Furnace.
After all, Xian Duan was the strongest Artifact Refiner in the Eastern Spirit Realm, and he had even personally forged two Innate Daoist Treasures.
If Lin Jing’s Lin Family Innate Daoist Treasure Pill Furnace couldn’t be repaired by him, then probably no one in the Cultivation World could fix it.

chapters.title: Chapter 829
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 829: Chapter 369 Xian Duan Elder_2 Chapter 829: Chapter 369 Xian Duan Elder_2 Unfortunately, from the beginning until now, Lin Jing had not received any news of the appearance of the Xian Duan elder.
This left Lin Jing quite helpless.
Aside from doing tasks from the Mission Hall and searching for the Xian Duan elder, Lin Jing’s only activity was helping Ji Xiyue deal with the problems she encountered in alchemy.
Changyun Yuanlei practiced the Alchemy Dao of the Changyun Clan, naturally encountering no issues.
This point differed with Ji Xiyue.
Therefore, in these twenty years, Changyun Yuanlei seldom sought Lin Jing, only Ji Xiyue came more frequently.
During this time, Elder Bai had continually been absent in the Outer Spatial Void, and their master, Elder Qi, had also been in seclusion, seemingly researching a tremendously important Elixir Recipe.
...
Elder Qi came out for a brief period during this time, but quickly went back into seclusion.
All things considered, Lin Jing also led a relatively relaxed life, basically refining elixirs daily and then finding time to cultivate.
In such circumstances, Lin Jing’s cultivation had also firmly advanced to the mid-stage of Dao Integration.
Moreover, by continuously performing tasks and alchemy, Lin Jing had accumulated a good number of Contribution Points as well as Harvest Points in the System Space.
…
Inside the System Space, Lin Jing sat in the Alchemy Room, in front of him the Cloud Pattern Purple Gold Furnace encircled by Formation Patterns, constantly revolving around the furnace.
At this moment, the entire furnace was glowing red.
Yet Lin Jing was closely watching the furnace, carefully controlling the colorless flame at the base, daring not be careless.
Given the situation, it seemed another batch of elixir medicines was about to be completed.
Indeed.
As the elixir fragrance in the Alchemy Room grew increasingly rich, this batch of elixir medicine also gradually took shape.
Ɲονǥ0.ᴄο
Soon after, the crisp sound of a system prompt entered Lin Jing’s ears:
“Ding”
“System Prompt: Congratulations Host, for refining a Flawless Elixir and receiving a reward: 100 Harvest Points.”
“Elixir successfully refined, Alchemy Proficiency +160.”
Hearing the system prompt, Lin Jing immediately relaxed.
Following,
Lin Jing extinguished the flame, then opened the furnace, and took out several elixir medicines from it.
This batch of elixirs totaled five pillsâ€” one Flawless, one Supreme Grade, two Superior grades, and one Low Grade.
This batch of elixir that Lin Jing had refined was to fulfill a task from the Mission Hall, specifically to create a batch of Fifth Grade elixirs.
Lin Jing was lucky this time, as he even refined a Flawless Elixir.
The requirement of this task from Lin Jing only asked for one Supreme Grade elixir.
But Lin Jing’s batch not only produced a Supreme Grade elixir, completing the task, but even extended to producing a Flawless one.
Since he refined a Flawless Elixir, it naturally belonged to Lin Jing himself.
After all, the value of a Flawless Elixir was far greater than that of a Supreme Grade elixir and was not included in the task.
If traded, it would be a loss.
Regarding the occurrence of Flawless Elixirs while completing alchemy tasks, the Elixir Alliance had its own method of handling.
Either keep the Flawless Elixir for oneself or hand it to the Mission Hall in exchange for Contribution Points.
In any case, they would not let the alchemist suffer a loss.
Only, the chance of a Flawless Elixir appearing was too low.
Although the Mission Hall had many alchemy tasks, those who refined Flawless Elixirs during task completion were extremely rare.
In these twenty years, Lin Jing had only encountered two instances where a Flawless Elixir appeared during an alchemy task.
Only…
Refining Flawless Elixirs was not a difficult matter for Lin Jing.
With the enhancement from System Space, in these twenty years, he had indeed refined numerous Flawless Elixirs.
However, Lin Jing absolutely could not reveal these Flawless Elixirs; otherwise, it would likely astonish everyone, and Lin Jing would be unable to explain.
Therefore, these Flawless Elixirs were all handed over for System recycling, turning into Harvest Points needed to upgrade the System Space.
Because of this, Lin Jing’s Harvest Points had already reached over six hundred thousand.
Continuing this way, in just another fifty years, the System Space would be able to upgrade again.
…
After taking out the Elixir Medicines, Lin Jing distributed this batch, encasing the Flawless Elixir in a Pure Jade Box and tucking it away.
The other pills, used to complete the task, were put into a Jade Vial.
After sorting the elixirs, Lin Jing looked around, then packed up the furnace and left the System Space.
After leaving the System Space, Lin Jing did not delay and immediately left his cave dwelling to fly to the inner city of the Elixir Alliance.
Next, he was definitely going to the Mission Hall to hand over his alchemy task.
He also planned to use his Contribution Points to exchange for some alchemy ingredients.
From his cave dwelling to the Mission Hall, with Lin Jing’s speed, it took less than half an hour.
Upon arriving, he crossed the main hall and went directly to the area behind it.
Behind the main hall of the Mission Hall were several rooms, each housing an Elixir Alliance cultivator.
The task handover took place in these rooms.
Lin Jing arrived at the back of the main hall and directly entered one of the rooms.
As soon as he entered, the Elixir Alliance cultivator inside immediately greeted him with a bow,
“Senior Lin, you have come again.”
Clearly, this cultivator was already very familiar with Lin Jing.
Lin Jing nodded, took out his Identity Token, and then from his Space Ring, he took out two vials of elixir medicine and handed them to the cultivator in front of him.
“These are the two tasks I accepted last time, please check them.”
The Elixir Alliance cultivator took Lin Jing’s Identity Token and the two vials of elixir medicine and then smiled,
“Senior Lin, being a Seventh Grade alchemist, there surely won’t be any problems with these Fifth Grade elixir medicines.”
Even though he said this, he still opened the jade vials to check them, and only after confirming they were correct, did he put the vials away.
After storing the vials, the cultivator took out another token from his body, and stuck it together with Lin Jing’s Identity Token.
Then, the Elixir Alliance cultivator activated his Spiritual Power and began to gesture over the two tokens, aligning something.
Soon, the Elixir Alliance cultivator finished his gesturing.
Afterwards,
he returned Lin Jing’s Identity Token and then spoke,
“Senior Lin…”
“In this instance, you have completed the fifth-rank tasks number seventy-five and eighty-nine, these two tasks together award a total of 13,000 Contribution Points, which have now been recorded for you.”
“You can check through your Identity Token.”
The Identity Tokens issued by the Elixir Alliance not only served to prove one’s identity but also to record these Contribution Points.
Lin Jing took the Identity Token and then activated his Cultivation Technique, channeling Spiritual Power into the Token.
Instantly, a series of numbers appeared on the Identity Token: 17525000
This was the total Contribution Points Lin Jing had earned over the years by carrying out alchemy tasks in the Alchemy Hall.
It was over seventeen million.
Moreover, these weren’t even all of his Contribution Points, as Lin Jing often used many, mostly exchanging them for alchemy ingredients to convert into elixir medicines.
After all, whether it was about advancing his alchemist grade or aiming to earn Harvest Points to upgrade his space, making elixir medicines was essential for Lin Jing.
Keeping so many Contribution Points was of little use; it was better to exchange them all for alchemy ingredients to make into elixir medicines.
After checking the Contribution Points, Lin Jing then left the place.
Next,
Lin Jing returned to the main hall of the Mission Hall, ready to undertake a new task.
Upon arriving at the main hall of the Mission Hall, Lin Jing extended his Divine Sense towards the scroll in the center.
The next moment…
Lin Jing’s consciousness was pulled into the space within the scroll, coming to the Scroll Space where he directly looked to the mission display screen ahead.
The Alchemy tasks in the Elixir Alliance were numerous and dazzling, with most tasks being of the fifth and sixth rank.
For Lin Jing, these tasks were not difficult; with his current level of alchemy, he could freely choose any of these tasks, and there were basically no problems completing them.
However, some tasks might be more time-consuming, which is why Lin Jing would be selective.
Moreover, apart from those common tasks, there were also special tasks within the rewards.
Some special tasks might offer rare Spirit Plant rewards, while others, awarding Contribution Points, could amount to dozens of regular tasks for Lin Jing.
Therefore, Lin Jing always looked through the special tasks first, each time he took on new tasks.
As Lin Jing continued browsing, suddenly, the reward for a special task caught his eye.
Lin Jing immediately concentrated and began to examine this special task:
“Fifth-rank special task number two: Refine a fifth-rank Revival Elixir.”
“Task requirement: One Flawless Grade Revival Elixir.”
“Time limit: half a year.”
“Task completion reward: 5,000 Contribution Points, plus one Supreme Grade Dao Artifact personally refined by the elder Xian Duan, and an opportunity given by a disciple of Xian Duan to refine an Artifact.”

chapters.title: Chapter 830
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 830: Chapter 370: Meeting Senior Han Again Chapter 830: Chapter 370: Meeting Senior Han Again “Refiner Immortal, Refiner Immortal Mansion disciples…”
I never expected to come across a bit of news about the Refiner Immortal Mansion in this special task.
Such tasks for crafting the Pure Elixir Medicine, even if they are issued, are rarely completed.
Most of those who issue the tasks do so with an attitude of just giving it a try.
Actually, more often…
They focus their energy elsewhere, searching for the Pure Elixir Medicine they need.
If Lin Jing didn’t accept this task, it’s very likely that when the time came, with no one having completed it, the issuer would simply cancel the special task.
But the special task today, Lin Jing absolutely had to accept.
...
Lin Jing had already waited twenty years, without receiving even a tiny bit of information about the Refiner Immortal Mansion, and now that he finally encountered it, Lin Jing didn’t want to miss out at all.
Especially that last part, the opportunity for Refiner Immortal Mansion disciples to refine an artifact, with this chance, he could meet a disciple from the Refiner Immortal Mansion.
Only by meeting this disciple from the Refiner Immortal Mansion could he have an opportunity to see the Refiner Immortal Elder.
Lin Jing did not hesitate and immediately decided to accept this task.
Afterward, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense, and his consciousness returned to his body.
Then…
Lin Jing walked through the Mission Hall’s great hall and continued towards the back of the hall…
…
…
Not much later…
Lin Jing left the Mission Hall with the task and the Spirit Plants needed for crafting the Revival Elixir.
After leaving the Mission Hall, Lin Jing made a detour to the Immortal Herb Hall within the Elixir Alliance.
The Immortal Herb Hall, as the name implies, is where the Elixir Alliance stores Alchemy Ingredients.
Besides the Immortal Herb Hall, there are places like the Spirit Tool Hall, Treasure Hall, and Scripture Pavilion within the Elixir Alliance.
In these places, Contribution Points can be used to exchange for various Magical Treasures and exotic stones, among other things…
After accepting a task from the Mission Hall, you can come to the Immortal Herb Hall to collect the ingredients needed for your task.
Except for some special tasks, each task only allows for one collection of ingredients; if the alchemy fails, you have to use your own Contribution Points to exchange for more ingredients.
ɴ0νǤο.сο
Upon arriving at the Immortal Herb Hall, Lin Jing collected a set of ingredients for crafting the Revival Elixir.
Knowing that one set of ingredients might not be enough, he then used Contribution Points to exchange for several more sets of ingredients needed for the Revival Elixir.
After exchanging for the Alchemy Ingredients, Lin Jing immediately left, returning to his cave dwelling, ready to begin crafting the Revival Elixir.
…
Three months later, outside the Elixir Alliance Outer City.
In a courtyard prepared by the Mission Hall in the Outer City, Lin Jing was currently sitting beside a table inside the cottage, waiting for someone’s arrival.
The one Lin Jing was waiting for was the person who had issued the Fifth-Rank special task number two.
This person was suspected to be a disciple of the Refiner Immortal Mansion.
In fact, Lin Jing had already crafted the Pure Revival Elixir shortly after taking on the task.
However, to avoid any trouble and also to wait for a couple more months, Lin Jing didn’t come to complete the task until now.
And the condition Lin Jing set for completing the task was to meet the issuer in person.
One of the rewards for the special task was related to Artifact Refining, so it was natural for both sides to meet eventually.
Therefore, the other party didn’t refuse and directly chose a courtyard offered by the Mission Hall for the meeting.
At this point, Lin Jing had already been waiting for some time, and according to the time they had agreed upon, the person should be arriving soon.
Just as Lin Jing was thinking about this, he felt a presence outside.
Sensing this, Lin Jing instantly became vigilant and then immediately extended his Divine Sense outwards.
He saw a burly man with a beard and late-stage Divinity Transformation cultivation striding toward the courtyard.
Seeing the burly man approach, Lin Jing also stood up and walked out of the room.
The burly man arrived at the courtyard, pushed the door open, and walked in, while Lin Jing, at the same time, stepped out of the house.
The two met face to face just like that, looking directly into each other’s eyes…
As their eyes met, Lin Jing didn’t find it particularly surprising, but the bearded burly man, upon seeing Lin Jing, was completely stunned.
Just as Lin Jing was about to ask something, the bearded burly man had already spoken first.
“Lin…
Lin Jing…?”
The bearded burly man looked at Lin Jing with a mix of confusion and disbelief, as if he couldn’t believe what he was seeing.
Hearing the burly man call out his name, Lin Jing was also taken aback and, after a moment of realization, he scrutinized the man closely, then asked:
“Do you know me?”
