They caused heavy losses to the hostile forces, forcing them to retreat from the East Continent and disappear from then on.
By the time Lin Jing arrived at the Shi Family, two months had already passed.
The area of the Eastern Spirit Realm was simply too vast; even with Lin Jing’s speed, it still took him two months.
After all, this time Lin Jing was traveling from the Far East Region, where the Elixir Alliance was located, to the Northwest Region where the Shi Family resided, nearly spanning the entire Eastern Spirit Realm.
The long journey naturally took a continuous stretch of time.
...
Moreover, this was under the circumstance of continuously using Teleportation Arrays to travel; without them, it might have taken dozens of years for Lin Jing to reach the Shi Family.
The Shi Family was situated on a desolate mountain; the entire mountain was flattened by the Shi Family, forming what is now known as the Shi Family estate.
Lin Jing arrived at the foot of the mountain where the Shi Family’s desolate mountain was located, and looked up.
The clouds above were swirling, obscuring any visibility.
These were not ordinary clouds, but a Defense Array that the Shi Family had expended enormous effort to construct.
This array was extremely formidable; not only was its defense astonishing, but it could even block the Divine Sense explorations of peak Mahayana Cultivators.
After observing for a while, Lin Jing did not see anyone else at the foot of the mountain.
Thus,
Lin Jing directly stepped forward, heading towards the mountain.
But as soon as Lin Jing stepped into the range of the desolate mountain, he felt a wave of Divine Sense sweeping over him, and then he was locked in by a force.
Following that…
came a voice from ahead:
“Who dares to trespass onto the Shi Family’s property?”
With this voice, a figure flew down from the mountain ahead and then arrived in front of Lin Jing.
The figure was a middle-aged man in a gray robe, his aura fluttering his robe noisily.
The cultivation aura of this middle-aged man was very formidable, at least at the mid-stage level of Tribulation.
At this time, his expression was devoid of any emotion, his gaze cold as he looked at Lin Jing, seemingly very unwelcoming towards Lin Jing, this intruder, as if he might strike out at any moment.
Facing this middle-aged man, Lin Jing did not hide his intentions, but directly stated his purpose:
“Esteemed senior…
“I am a disciple of Elder Qi from the Elixir Alliance, specifically ordered by my master to come to the Shi Family.”
“A disciple of Elder Qi from the Elixir Alliance?” The middle-aged man’s eyes sparkled upon hearing this, he first assessed Lin Jing and then spoke:
“If you say you are a disciple of Elder Qi from the Elixir Alliance, do you have any proof?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing was momentarily stunned, and then said:
“Proof?”
“It seems I really don’t have any, but I do have an identity token from the Elixir Alliance.”
Elder Qi, often engrossed in studying elixir recipes, generally left his disciples to their own devices, naturally leaving behind no particular proof.
After hearing this, the middle-aged man couldn’t help but scoff and then said:
“Heh…
“With so many people in the whole Elixir Alliance, what’s so special about an identity token?”
“If you don’t have anything to prove your relationship with Elder Qi, then leave as soon as possible and come back after you get the proof.”
After saying this, the middle-aged man’s gaze became sharper, his aura even more imposing, pressuring Lin Jing.
This middle-aged man, it seemed, had a particular prejudice against Lin Jing, as if specifically targeting him.
It was Lin Jing’s first time coming to the Shi Family, and he had never met this middle-aged man of the Shi Family before, so he wondered why he would act like this.
Lin Jing fell silent for a moment, and then spoke:
“I indeed do not have any token given by Elder Qi.”
“However…”
“I do have another item, which might serve as proof.”
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man’s expression instantly turned solemn, and he said coldly:
“You just said you had nothing, and now you suddenly change your story, aren’t you playing games with me?”
Lin Jing did not bother to argue further, but took out a stone token from his Space Ring.
This token, which was given to him by Grandpa Shi San after he had passed his Divinity Transformation Heavenly Tribulation.
Although he did not have a token from Elder Qi, he did have a token left by Grandpa Shi San, whose cultivation was undoubtedly esteemed within the Shi Family.
And the token he had given him was most likely a kind of proof.
No sooner had Lin Jing taken out the stone token than something unexpected happened.
The moment the token was exposed, it immediately emitted a strong glow, and along with this glow, the token left Lin Jing’s palm and swiftly flew upwards.
ṅοѵǤ0.сο
Seeing this, Lin Jing was somewhat bewildered.
Lin Jing, facing the middle-aged man, saw his expression change abruptly when he spotted the Shi Token, and he immediately turned his head toward Lin Jing and said,
“The Shi Family’s Shi Token…”
“Who exactly are you?
Why do you have the Shi Token in your possession?”
However.
Before Lin Jing could answer, the Shi Token had already crossed the barren mountain and flown above the Shi Family.
There, in the sky above the Shi Family, it erupted into an extremely dazzling light, throwing the entire Shi Family into chaos.
In an instant, disturbances began within the entire Shi Family.
In no time, several extremely terrifying presences emanated from the Shi Family.
Witnessing this scene, the middle-aged man’s face dramatically changed, and he looked behind him toward the barren mountain, unable to help but exclaim,
“Terrible!”
“This is the end…!”
Just then, three figures directly appeared above the two men.
Lin Jing looked up, only to see three elders above them, each radiating an extremely formidable aura.
Under such auras, Lin Jing felt as if he was truly ant-like.
All three elders were in the Mahayana Realm.
Moreover, Lin Jing recognized the elder in the middle.
It was Elder Shi San.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Elder Shi San also couldn’t help being surprised:
“Eh?”
“It’s you…”
Lin Jing hurriedly bowed to Elder Shi San and said,
“I’ve seen the elder…”
At this moment, Elder Shi San descended from mid-air, and the other two elders followed suit, landing in front of Lin Jing.
It was only then that Elder Shi San introduced him to the other two,
“This is the one I have told you about, whom we met in the Nanming Domain, the master of Shi Tian.”
Hearing this, the two also showed an interested expression and sized Lin Jing up.
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man immediately lowered his head, not daring to raise it again.
At this moment, Elder Shi San was already looking at the Shi Token in the sky.
Following that.
Elder Shi San stretched out his hand, and the Shi Token flew directly into his hand.
Afterwards.
The bright light emitted by the Shi Token also dissipated.
The two Mahayana Realm elders, after sizing up Lin Jing, one of them then spoke,
“This young kid, his cultivation is not low at all!”
“Didn’t you say before that Shi Tian’s master had just reached Divinity Transformation?”
At this time, Elder Shi San
Elder Shi San also couldn’t help but look at Lin Jing, and after observing him, he also expressed surprise:
“Dao Integration peak…”
“How long has it been?
You have already reached the peak of Dao Integration.
Such a rate of cultivation improvement is unheard of.”
Lin Jing then replied,
“Elder Shi, after parting with the elder, I encountered several opportunities and obtained not a small fortune, which is why my cultivation was able to advance this quickly.”
Elder Shi San nodded, then asked Lin Jing,
“You’ve come to my Shi Family and even produced the Shi Token, could it be that you’ve encountered some trouble?”
Upon hearing Elder Shi San ask this, the middle-aged man trembled slightly.
But the attention of Elder Shi San and the others was entirely on Lin Jing, seemingly unaware of this man’s slight movement.
Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“Elder Shi…”
“I have joined the Elixir Alliance and am now a disciple of Elder Qi.
I came here because I received a message from my master.”
“As for showing the Shi Token, it was only to verify my identity.
I did not know the Shi Token had such an effect; I’m very sorry to have disturbed the elders.”
Elder Shi San nodded gently.
He then turned around, looked at the middle-aged man of the Shi Family, and his eyes showed a hint of anger:
“A disciple of Elder Qi comes to my Shi Family, yet he needs to prove his identity.”
“Shi Jianxing, I need you to give me an explanation!”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 842: Chapter 376: Fate Chapter 842: Chapter 376: Fate “`
As Grandfather Shi San’s voice fell, the middle-aged cultivator named Shi Jianxing immediately shivered and hastily knelt to the ground, his voice trembling:
“Elder…
elder…”
“It was my foolishness that led me to harbor selfish thoughts, which brought about such despicable acts.
Please punish me, elder.”
As Shi Jianxing’s voice fell, an elder of the Shi Family to the left of Grandfather Shi San looked towards Shi Jianxing and said:
“It seems, it was for the sake of the Void Immortal Thunder Stone.”
And on the right side of Grandfather Shi San, another Shi Family elder nodded:
“Hmm…”
“During the previous discussion about the Void Immortal Thunder Stone, Jianxing was right there.
He had intended to refine a Daoist Treasure, and it just so happened that he lacked a Void Immortal Thunder Stone.”
“Had Elder Qi not proposed to give the Void Immortal Thunder Stone to his own disciple, the Void Immortal Thunder Stone would have certainly been his.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing also instantly understood what was going on.
So all this was related to the Void Immortal Thunder Stone.
No wonder he was so hostile towards me.
He probably felt aggrieved in his heart.
...
Grandfather Shi San looked at Shi Jianxing, who was kneeling on the ground, his expression stern, and he spoke in a cold voice:
“As a member of the Shi Family, no matter what you encounter, the family will try to help you.
Even if the Void Immortal Thunder Stone can’t be allotted to you, you would be compensated in other ways.”
“The allocation of the Void Immortal Thunder Stone is a family decision, but because of your dissatisfaction, you offended a guest of the clan, and that breaks the family rules.”
“Breaking the family rules requires punishment.”
After speaking, Grandfather Shi San looked towards the elder on his right and said:
“Elder Five…”
“You are in charge of the family’s disciplinary affairs.
You decide the punishment for Shi Jianxing.”
Grandfather Shi San’s elder on the right nodded, pondered for a moment, and then said:
“There happens to be a need for a guardian in the depths of Shi Yuan.
Let him take on that duty.”
Upon hearing these words, Shi Jianxing’s body couldn’t help but tremble,
and the elder in charge of the family’s discipline, with a serious expression, looked towards Shi Jianxing and spoke directly, announcing his punishment:
“Shi Jianxing!”
“For provoking a family guest without reason and breaking family rules, you are now sentenced to guard Shi Yuan for a hundred years.”
“Do you have any objections?”
Upon hearing this, Shi Jianxing faced the elder and bowed deeply, saying:
“Jianxing is willing to accept the punishment.”
With that, the matter was considered resolved.
Afterward, Grandfather Shi San and another elder took Lin Jing to the Shi Family’s residence on the desolate mountain.
The elder in charge of discipline took Shi Jianxing in a different direction.
…
While walking on the road, Grandfather Shi San turned to Lin Jing and said:
“I really didn’t expect that you would be Elder Qi’s disciple and that you’ve entered the Elixir Alliance.
It seems your Alchemy Dao cultivation is also quite impressive.”
While speaking, Grandfather Shi San handed the Shi Token back to Lin Jing:
“This Shi Token is a kind of symbol within our Shi Family.”
“With it, no one from the Shi Family can disrespect you without cause, and when necessary, you can use it to request help from the Shi Family once.”
“Keep holding on to it.”
Originally, when Lin Jing first received the Shi Token, he had thought it was just a common token representing status.
It wasn’t until he presented the Shi Token and saw it stirring by itself, alarming the entire Shi Family, that Lin Jing realized something was amiss.
And through Grandfather Shi San’s explanation, Lin Jing finally understood that the token actually held such great significance.
Lin Jing nodded and then safely stored the token away.
Subsequently, Lin Jing spoke up, asking Grandfather Shi San:
“Elder Shi…”
“Didn’t you go to the outer realms’ void previously to find a recovery method for Shi San?”
“What was the outcome?”
“How is Shi San now?”
Upon hearing this, Grandfather Shi San’s expression softened, and he lightly nodded, saying:
“The result was fairly good…”
“His body has largely recovered, only his Soul Spirit has not yet fully healed, and he’s missing the final Elixir Medicine to make a complete recovery.”
“Once he’s recovered, he’ll be able to start cultivating.”
As he said this, Grandfather Shi San looked at Lin Jing and continued:
“We had been unable to find a way to heal Shi San before and thought his recovery was hopeless.
We were prepared to let him live out his life as a mortal, which is why we named him Shi San.”
“Now everything has changed, Shi San’s destiny has turned around, and he will no longer be the mortal Shi San.”
“Therefore…”
“We’ve also changed his name.
He is no longer called Shi San but Shi Tian.”
“Shi Tian…” Lin Jing said softly.
He then nodded and remarked, “Good name!”
…
…
The three of them made their way up to the top of the desolate mountain and entered the Shi Family.
Upon entering, Grandfather Shi San…
No, it should now be Grandfather Shi Tian.
Grandfather Shi Tian led Lin Jing straight to a courtyard covered by a Formation within the Shi Family.
Inside a room in the courtyard, Lin Jing saw Shi Tian again…
Compared to the last time they met, Shi Tian’s appearance had not changed at all, still the same as before.
Only…
He had not completely recovered yet and was still in a deep slumber at this time.
ɴονǤ0.ƈο
Right now, Shi Tian lay on the bed with his eyes tightly closed, as if asleep.
Thanks to Grandfather Shi Tian’s explanations on the way, Lin Jing was aware of Shi Tian’s current state.
Shi Tian’s body had fully recovered, and he only needed to take one more Elixir Medicine to wake up completely.
And this final Elixir Medicine was the Soul-Returning Pill, which Elder Qi had researched and Lin Jing had once refined.
It was only now that Lin Jing realized…
the new Elixir Recipe that Elder Qi had been researching all along was for Shi Tian.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 843: Chapter 376: Fate_2 Chapter 843: Chapter 376: Fate_2 After visiting Shi Tian, Shi Tian’s grandfather took Lin Jing to another place.
An alchemy room within the Shi Family.
In the alchemy room, Lin Jing saw his master, Elder Qi.
At that moment, Elder Qi was at the very center of the alchemy room, enveloped by a formation, utterly focused on concocting a batch of elixir medicine, so much so that even as Lin Jing and the others arrived, Elder Qi did not get distracted in the slightest.
At this time.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.ᴄο
Shi Tian’s grandfather spoke to Lin Jing:
“This batch of elixir medicine has been in the works for several hours; it should be finishing soon.
...
Let’s wait here for your master to complete the alchemy process.”
Lin Jing nodded.
Shi Tian’s grandfather looked toward the central pill furnace with a hint of worry on his face before saying:
“I just hope that this batch of elixir medicine will be useful and that it will awaken Shi Tian…”
Indeed, the concoction process for this batch of elixir medicine was not short, and without even an hour passing, the fragrance of the elixir had already begun to waft through the room.
And Elder Qi, in the center of the alchemy room, also rose from his seated meditation position, channeling spiritual power and intensifying the flames beneath the furnace to start the final pill solidifying step.
At this time, Shi Tian’s grandfather also looked nervously toward Elder Qi in the center of the alchemy room, who was in the process of solidifying the pills.
Considering that Shi Tian was involved, no matter how calm he usually was, he couldn’t help feeling anxious now.
As the fragrance of the elixir grew stronger and filled the entire alchemy room, the batch of elixir medicine finally reached completion at this moment.
Then.
Elder Qi opened the pill furnace, and several pills flew out; seeing this, Elder Qi swiftly waved his hand and collected the pills.
Although Elder Qi was quick, Lin Jing still saw everything very clearly.
These pills were indeed Soul-Returning Pills.
Moreover, among these pills, there was one that was particularly round and its surface faintly emitted a certain glow.
Clearly, it was a Flawless Pure Elixir.
After collecting the elixir medicine, Elder Qi finally looked up and turned his gaze toward Lin Jing.
Then, the formation opened, and Elder Qi stepped out of the alchemy room at this time.
Upon seeing Elder Qi, Lin Jing promptly bowed and said:
“Master!”
Elder Qi nodded slightly and replied:
“Mm!”
After that, Elder Qi turned his head and said to Shi Tian’s grandfather:
“Fortunately, there were no accidents, and a supreme grade elixir medicine was created.”
Shi Tian’s grandfather seemed somewhat excited as he responded:
“Good…”
“I hope nothing unexpected occurs this time.”
At these words, Elder Qi knitted his brows slightly and said:
“If even this supreme grade elixir medicine doesn’t suffice, then we’re in trouble.
I specially tailored this Soul-Returning Pill recipe for your grandson’s condition, experimented with it dozens of times, and studied it for a hundred years…”
“There definitely shouldn’t be any issues with the recipe.”
“If there were any problems, they would already have been discovered.”
“If it still does not work this time, I fear only the Flawless Soul-Returning Pill can fully restore your grandson Shi Tian and awaken him.”
After hearing this, Shi Tian’s grandfather’s expression turned somewhat more troubled as he sighed:
“Flawless elixir medicine…”
“Refining a flawless elixir is by no means an easy feat.”
“Alas…”
“Let’s try this first, and then we’ll talk about what to do afterwards.”
Subsequently.
Shi Tian’s grandfather and Elder Qi left the alchemy room together and rushed towards the courtyard where Shi Tian was resting.
Along the way, Shi Tian’s grandfather turned back to look at Lin Jing, then said to Elder Qi:
“I never imagined that you, who seldom take on disciples, would actually accept him…”
“It must be fate.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Qi first paused, then turned back to look at Lin Jing, and turned again to Shi Tian’s grandfather with a puzzled expression:
“What?”
“You know each other?”
Shi Tian’s grandfather then explained to Elder Qi:
“He is the one I mentioned before, my grandson’s master.”
After hearing this, Elder Qi turned to Lin Jing in disbelief and exclaimed:
“So that’s how it is.”
“Indeed, it must be fate.”
Then, Elder Qi continued:
“Since you’ve known each other beforehand, it’s just as well.
I won’t hide it from you anymore.
My disciple has another identity.”
On hearing this, Shi Tian’s grandfather was also puzzled:
“What identity?”
“Could it be that he comes from an influential background?”
Elder Qi nodded and said:
“My disciple is actually from the Lin Family of the Demonic Monster Sea.”
“Demonic Monster Sea, Lin Family…” Grandpa Shi Tian seemed a bit dazed for a moment, obviously not having caught on.
However, a moment later, he quickly came to his senses:
“You’re talking about…”
“The Ancient Alchemy Family, the Lin Family.”
Grandpa Shi Tian turned his head, his gaze continually sweeping over Lin Jing, as if seeing him for the first time, sizing Lin Jing up thoroughly.
This time, he was truly shocked.
Full of interest, Grandpa Shi Tian looked at Lin Jing and repeatedly said:
“I didn’t expect this, really didn’t expect this…”
At that moment, Elder Qi turned to Lin Jing and spoke again:
“If this Supreme Soul-Returning Pill fails to awaken your grandson, then we’ll have to try making a Flawless Soul-Returning Pill.”
“As for the success rate of Pure Elixir Medicines, in the entire Cultivation World, if the Lin Family were to take second place, I’m afraid no one would dare claim to be first.
If we want to make another Flawless Soul-Returning Pill, we can only rely on my disciple.”
Upon hearing this, Grandpa Shi Tian’s gaze toward Lin Jing became a bit more solemn:
“Young Brother Lin, if it really comes to that, I hope you will…”
Before Grandpa Shi Tian could finish, Lin Jing hastily said:
“Please rest assured, senior.”
“After all, I am Shi Tian’s master.
If it really comes to that, I will definitely give it my all.”
Hearing this, Grandpa Shi Tian quickly replied with a smile:
“Good…
good…”
“My grandson Xiao Tian is indeed a man of great fortune, having a disciple of the Lin Family as a master.
This time, he will surely be able to awaken.”
…
…
Before long.
The three of them arrived at the small courtyard where Shi Tian was.
Once they were there, Elder Qi handed the Supreme Soul-Returning Pill to Grandpa Shi Tian.
Then Grandpa Shi Tian, with the elixir in hand, entered the room, leaving Lin Jing and Elder Qi outside.
Shi Tian’s condition was special; the treatment could not be disturbed by any noise, hence they left Lin Jing and the other outside.
After Grandpa Shi Tian had entered, a formation activated, enveloping the entire room.
At this time.
Elder Qi began to speak to Lin Jing:
“I’m not usually good at socializing, and Shi Yuan is one of the few old friends I have.”
“Previously, when he was looking for a cure for his grandson, he went to the Outer Spatial Void.
It was there, in the Outer Spatial Void that he unintentionally obtained a piece of Void Celestial Thunder Stone.”
“Originally, I was unaware…
“Until recently when I found out you needed the Void Celestial Thunder Stone to repair your Lin Family’s Pill Furnace, I then informed him about your need.”
“I never thought it would be such a coincidence that he just happened to have one.”
“So I sent you a message, inviting you to come here personally.”
“I intended to introduce you to each other first through the message, and then for you to take the Void Celestial Thunder Stone, but it turns out you already knew each other.”
Lin Jing nodded lightly:
“I knew Senior Shi from earlier days.”
“I was aware of his journey to the Outer Spatial Void.”
“This time coming to the Eastern Spirit Realm, I intended to stay at the Elixir Alliance for a while to repair the family’s Elixir Furnace before visiting the Shi Family.”
“But I didn’t expect that you too, Master, would be an old friend of Senior Shi.”
Elder Qi nodded:
“Perhaps this is fate…”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes…”
Afterward, the two fell silent, turning their gaze towards the direction of the room.
The formation outside the room not only shielded all disturbances from the outside world but also isolated all signs of life from within.
What the situation inside was at this moment, both were completely unaware.
And so.
The two waited for four hours before the formation finally reopened.
As soon as the formation opened, they both hurriedly looked towards the room.
At that moment, the room’s door suddenly opened.
The voice of Grandpa Shi Tian, weary, came from inside.
“Come in!”
In his voice, there was a sense of heaviness and also of fatigue.
Hearing this voice, Lin Jing realized something was wrong.
Then, Lin Jing and Elder Qi both entered the room.
Upon entering, the first thing they saw was Shi Tian still lying on the bed and Grandpa Shi Tian sitting beside the bed, his face showing signs of fatigue.
Only after they came in did Grandpa Shi Tian speak:
“As you can see…”
“This time, it was a failure.”

chapters.title: Chapter 844
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 844: Chapter 377 Tribulation Chapter 844: Chapter 377 Tribulation Lin Jing witnessed this scene and was rendered speechless.
He hadn’t expected that this time it would actually fail.
At that moment, Shi Tian’s grandfather turned his head and looked towards Lin Jing:
“Lin Family boy, it’s up to you now.”
Lin Jing first looked at Shi Tian, who was lying on the bed, then turned his head and said to Shi Tian’s grandfather:
“Elder, please rest assured, I will give it my all.”
However, as soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Elder Qi had already begun to speak, addressing Shi Tian’s grandfather:
“Given Lin Jing’s level in Alchemy Dao, crafting this Soul-Returning Pill should pose no problem, but his Pill Furnace is somewhat lacking, which is a limitation.”
“If we want him to craft this Soul-Returning Pill, it would be best to first resolve the issue with his Pill Furnace.”
Upon hearing this, Shi Tian’s grandfather looked up at Lin Jing and asked:
“I heard from your master that your Pill Furnace currently lacks the Void Immortal Thunder Stone, right?”
Lin Jing nodded and replied:
“Yes, elder!”
“All other materials have been gathered, only the Void Immortal Thunder Stone is missing.”
Shi Tian’s grandfather continued to inquire:
“Have you found an Artifact Refiner?”
“If not, I can help you.”But as soon as Shi Tian’s grandfather finished speaking, Elder Qi interjected:
“I hadn’t told you previously, but Lin Jing has already found an Artifact Refiner, and it’s none other than the old fellow Xian Duan.”
“Xian Duan…” Shi Tian’s grandfather was momentarily stunned, then looked at Lin Jing incredulously:
“I never expected you could find that old man Xian Duan to help you refine…”
Lin Jing quickly said:
“It was a coincidence; an old friend of mine happens to be a disciple of Elder Xian Duan.”
“That’s how I managed to contact Elder Xian Duan and ask for his help.”
Shi Tian’s grandfather nodded and then said:
“That’s good.
I also have some acquaintance with Xian Duan.
I’ll go find him myself…”
Soon after.
Shi Tian’s grandfather, Elder Qi, and Lin Jing discussed a plan and decided to set out together to return to the Elixir Alliance.
Elder Qi helped gather the Alchemy Ingredients for crafting the Soul-Returning Pill, while Shi Tian’s grandfather, taking the Void Immortal Thunder Stone, found old man Xian Duan to help Lin Jing recast the Pill Furnace.
...
Meanwhile, Lin Jing was to stay temporarily at the Shi Family home, continuing Alchemy while waiting for their return.
After the discussion, Shi Tian’s grandfather began organizing everything.
He first summoned people from the Shi Family and briefed them on the situation.
Then, he took Lin Jing to the Shi Family’s private Alchemy Room and indicated that Lin Jing could use all the Alchemy Ingredients available there.
The reason for this was naturally to keep Lin Jing continuously in the state of alchemy, thereby preparing him to craft the Soul-Returning Pill.
Once everything was arranged, Shi Tian’s grandfather and Elder Qi left together.
After the two left, Lin Jing unhesitatingly headed to the Shi Family Alchemy Room and began crafting Elixir Medicine…
…
…
Shi Tian’s grandfather, upon his departure, ended up being away for half a year.
It wasn’t until half a year later that Shi Tian’s grandfather returned.
He had left with Elder Qi.
However, upon his return, Elder Qi was not with him; instead, he had returned with another person…
Old man Xian Duan.
Incredibly, old man Xian Duan had come to the Shi Family home with Shi Tian’s grandfather.
Seeing old man Xian Duan, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be somewhat surprised.
However, he soon came to understand.
After all, Shi Tian’s grandfather had previously mentioned that he had some connections with old man Xian Duan, and now that the two had come back together, he guessed they must have had some matter to attend to.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but think…
“Could this be related to my Pill Furnace?”
After their return, Lin Jing made sure to meet them immediately.
Having met old man Xian Duan, and following his explanation, Lin Jing finally understood that this visit was indeed about his Pill Furnace.
The recasting of the Jinhong Furnace was mostly complete.
Only the final refining step remained to be done.
And this final step, the refining, was a bit more troublesome, requiring the summoning of Tribulation Lightning to complete with its assistance.
ɴօνǤօ.сο
Moreover,
the Tribulation Lightning should ideally be that which the owner of the Pill Furnace himself must overcome.
In this way, there would be no need for further refinement, and once the refining process was complete, it would achieve a perfect integration with the owner, fully unleashing and even surpassing the potential of this treasure.
And Lin Jing had just reached the peak of Dao Integration, not far from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, so Shi Tian’s grandfather directly brought old man Xian Duan along to guide Lin Jing in completing this final refining.
Thus,
for the following period, Lin Jing once again entered seclusion, preparing to condense his Cultivation and attempt the Tribulation.
Time passed quickly…
Three months flew by, and Lin Jing had finally fully condensed his Cultivation, ready to undertake the Tribulation.
Lin Jing had already been close to undergoing the Tribulation, and after another six months of alchemy, although he didn’t practice much, the potency of the Ascension Pill within him continuously advanced his Cultivation.
After half a year, Lin Jing was just a hair’s breadth from undergoing the Tribulation,
and then, after these three months of condensing, Lin Jing had finally achieved complete Cultivation, ready to begin the Tribulation.
At this time,
in a wilderness handpicked by Shi Tian’s grandfather for its suitability for undergoing the Tribulation, Lin Jing was seated cross-legged, waiting for the Heavenly Tribulation to descend.
And beside Lin Jing stood a fierce-looking furnace that was half a meter tall.
This was the Jinhong Furnace, recast by old man Xian Duan, now only lacking the final Tribulation Lightning refining to be fully recast.
This wilderness was specially chosen by Shi Tian’s grandfather for Lin Jing, highly suitable for undergoing the Tribulation, and around Lin Jing, Shi Tian’s grandfather had also employed the power of the Shi Family to lay several formations for the Tribulation.

chapters.title: Chapter 845
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 845: Chapter 377 Tribulation_2 Chapter 845: Chapter 377 Tribulation_2 In a somewhat remote part of the wasteland, Grandpa Shi Tian and Elder Xian Duan, along with several ancestral elders of the major families, stood guard around, helping Lin Jing as protectors.
At this time, everyone was looking toward Lin Jing in the center, waiting for him to face the Tribulation.
After an indefinite wait, the sky slowly began to change.
The originally clear blue sky gradually began to gather dark clouds, which seemed endless, flocking in from all directions.
Until finally, those dark clouds converged above Lin Jing’s head and gathered more and more densely, forming the precursor to the coming Heavenly Tribulation clouds above him.
These Tribulation clouds obscured Lin Jing, as well as the entire sky around, turning the region’s daylight into pitch darkness.
It was as if daylight had suddenly turned to night.
...
At the same time, within the entire wasteland, an extremely oppressive atmosphere filled the air, as if it were a prelude to disaster.
Fortunately, before the preparations for the Tribulation, all the Demonic Beasts in the wasteland had been driven away; otherwise, faced with such a scenario, those beasts would likely be thrown into a panic.
Seeing this, Grandpa Shi Tian and the other ancestral elders could not help but retreat a distance further away.
Shortly after their retreat, within the pitch-black Tribulation clouds, colorful lights began to appear.
Following these splashes of color were the sounds of muffled thunder rolling across the sky.
And it was at this time that Lin Jing opened his eyes, stood up, and looked toward the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace beside him.
Next, Lin Jing extended his hand and waved towards the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace; the heavy-looking cauldron slowly floated upward.
The process of the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace floating was somewhat slow and even wobbled a bit, like a child who had imbibed alcohol.
The JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace was still in the process of being reforged and was not yet fully controllable, which is why it behaved as it did.
Only after this Tribulation Lightning and a thorough tempering of the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace, with Lin Jing’s bloodline also integrated into the body of the cauldron, would the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace be truly complete in its reforging.
After making the JÄ«ng HÃ³ng Furnace circle around him and becoming slightly more adept, Lin Jing then raised his head to look towards the Heavenly Tribulation lightning in the sky.
This lightning at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage was different from all previous ones; as soon as it appeared, it was colorful.
Ɲονǥο.ƈο
This was the same as the Tribulation Lightning similar to the JÃ­ MiÃ¨ Celestial Lightning that Grandpa Shi Tian had spoken of.
…
Time passed by, and within the overhead Tribulation clouds, the arcs of colorful lightning became increasingly dense.
The thunderous rumbling sounds from within the clouds became more frequent, and at the same time, the oppressive aura filling the world grew stronger.
“This young lad’s Tribulation Lightning seems quite extraordinary,” said Elder Xian Duan, looking at the Tribulation clouds and Lin Jing, frowning.
Grandpa Shi Tian appeared relatively composed:
“This kid is indeed different…”
“When he faced his Divinity Transformation lightning tribulation, I was beside him.
He had already attracted this colorful Tribulation Lightning at that time.”
Elder Xian Duan was taken aback upon hearing this.
He quickly turned his head, looking at Grandpa Shi Tian with surprise:
“Divinity Transformation lightning tribulation, he had already drawn the colorful Tribulation Lightning?”
Grandpa Shi Tian nodded.
Elder Xian Duan then turned his head back, looking towards the arcs of colorful lightning sporadically appearing in the clouds above Lin Jing, and said:
“Isn’t it said that only the legendary JÃ­ MiÃ¨ Celestial Lightning is colorful, but this Tribulation Lightning…”
At this point, Grandpa Shi Tian spoke up, continuing:
“It’s not the same, right…”
Elder Xian Duan nodded.
“Indeed, it’s not the same.”
Grandpa Shi Tian nodded in agreement, before adding:
“The JÃ­ MiÃ¨ Celestial Lightning is what we Mahayana cultivators encounter when we undergo the tribulation to become immortals.
In theory, it should not appear on his body.”
“But look at the lightning arcs in the clouds above his head, they are clearly different from the JÃ­ MiÃ¨ Celestial Lightning.
The JÃ­ MiÃ¨ Celestial Lightning has nine colors, but the lightning in the clouds above his head only consists of five colors.”
Elder Xian Duan nodded and said:
“Indeed…”
“Those arcs of lightning indeed only have five colors.”
At this time, Grandpa Shi Tian continued:
“This time…”
“To assist him through the Tribulation, I made many preparations.”
“And, having seen his previous encounters with Tribulation, I know this young fellow isn’t simple.
I believe nothing will go amiss; we just need to watch.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Xian Duan felt somewhat relieved:
“Alright, then I’ll see how he gets through this Heavenly Tribulation…”
As the conversation between the two terminated, the brewing of the Tribulation clouds in the sky also reached completion.
“Boom!”
A multicolored bolt of lightning thick as a bucket descended from the Tribulation clouds, piercing through the Formation, and struck directly towards Lin Jing’s head.
At this moment, Lin Jing, who had long been waiting, saw the Tribulation Lightning fall and did not hesitate; he directed the Jing Hong Furnace above his head to receive its assault.
The Jing Hong Furnace at this time was indeed in need of this Tribulation Lightning’s baptism.
This first bolt of Tribulation Lightning, though colorful, wasn’t excessively powerful, and its might was further diminished by the grand Formation.
When the Tribulation Lightning hit the top of Lin Jing’s head, he barely defended himself and allowed the Jing Hong Furnace to meet it head-on.
One breath…
Two breaths…
Three breaths…
After three breaths, the Tribulation Lightning dissipated.
This first bolt of Tribulation Lightning lasted only three breaths.
Once the Tribulation Lightning scattered, Lin Jing beneath it was revealed once more.
At this moment, Lin Jing’s body and the Jing Hong Furnace above were both streaked with lightning arcs.
These lightning arcs didn’t last long, vanishing after a moment.
However, after the disappearance of the lightning arcs, the exterior of the Jing Hong Furnace seemed to have undergone some changes, though these changes were subtle and hardly noticeable without close scrutiny.
…
After the first bolt of Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing did not rest, but instead looked up at the sky, waiting for the second bolt to descend.
While Lin Jing gazed up at the Tribulation clouds, bursts of lightning within them suddenly grew violent.
Countless arcs of lightning appeared in an instant, converging toward the center of the clouds.
Seeing this, Lin Jing immediately knew that the second bolt of Tribulation Lightning was about to arrive.
He quickly gathered his Divine Sense and Spiritual Power, urging the Jing Hong Furnace forward to meet it.
At the same time, the second bolt of Tribulation Lightning descended in response…
“Boom!”
Compared to the first bolt, the second bolt of Tribulation Lightning seemed thicker and brought a stronger sense of oppression.
But for Lin Jing, this was still nothing substantial.
The second bolt of Tribulation Lightning also lasted for three breaths.
After those three breaths, when the Tribulation Lightning faded, Lin Jing was about to retract the Jing Hong Furnace but noticed the multicolored lightning arcs still hadn’t dissipated in the Tribulation clouds above him; they continued to converge towards his head.
Realizing this, Lin Jing didn’t dare to be careless and continued to direct the Jing Hong Furnace, ready for the third bolt of Tribulation Lightning to come.
Indeed.
The lightning arcs from the second bolt had not completely vanished when an explosive noise burst above Lin Jing’s head…
“Boom!”
This explosion occurred just above Lin Jing’s head.
The sound of this surging thunder carried an unmatched oppressive force, rushing straight toward Lin Jing’s sea of consciousness, attempting to throw it into disarray.
However, Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit was formidable, and such pressure could not pose any threat to him at all.
With just a flicker of his mind, Lin Jing stabilized his Soul Spirit and completely negated the impact.
During this time, the third bolt of Tribulation Lightning also fell.
This third bolt of Tribulation Lightning was somewhat stronger than the previous two bolts combined.
Yet, when this Tribulation Lightning hit Lin Jing, it still did not cause significant damage.
It only created some small wounds on Lin Jing’s body, which, as soon as they appeared, quickly healed.
And so it went…
Quickly, three breaths passed.
Once the Tribulation Lightning vanished, it took but the blink of an eye for Lin Jing’s body to recover as usual, as if he had never been injured at all.
When the third bolt of Tribulation Lightning had dissipated, and the Elder Xian Duan saw Lin Jing again, he just happened to witness the healing of Lin Jing’s wounds.
Then, Elder Xian Duan turned his head to look at Grandpa Shi Tian beside him:
“This kid, he has also cultivated Body Refining Techniques…”
“It seems you’ve known this for a long time.”
Grandpa Shi Tian looked toward Lin Jing and said with a slight smile:
“Yes…”
“And back when he was cultivating, I even gave him some guidance for a while…”

﻿Chapter 846: Chapter 378 Tribulation Success, System Space Upgrade Chapter 846: Chapter 378 Tribulation Success, System Space Upgrade After the three strikes of Tribulation Lightning had passed, the tribulation clouds in the sky experienced a brief period of stillness.
However, this pause was not long…
Shortly after the stillness, the tribulation clouds swiftly resumed their movements.
Then, the scope of the tribulation clouds began to expand again, while Shi Tian’s grandfather and Elder Xian Duan, among the few who had been aiding Lin Jing as protectors, once more retreated a bit further.
At this time, Lin Jing looked up at the sky, only to see the tribulation clouds pressing lower and lower.
Witnessing this scene, Lin Jing’s eyebrows furrowed involuntarily.
With only three strikes of Tribulation Lightning gone, the clouds had already undergone a change; hence, the remaining strikes would certainly be more powerful, and his situation would become even more perilous.
...
In less than a quarter of an hour, the tribulation clouds once again rumbled with muffled thunder, and the colorful lightning arcs reappeared within the clouds.
This time, the lightning arcs were somewhat different.
Lin Jing looked closely and discovered that the colors of the lightning arcs had changed.
Instead of five colors, there was an additional color, now presenting a spectrum of six colors.
When others had faced their Heavenly Tribulations, colored Tribulation Lightning had never appeared, but for himself, starting from the Divinity Transformation, there had been a constant appearance of colored Tribulation Lightning.
Why such a situation had arisen, Lin Jing did not know.
Lin Jing had also searched through ancient histories, but found nothing of note, nor any similar experiences recorded.
It seemed that such circumstances were unique to him alone.
Although the power of this colored Tribulation Lightning was much stronger compared to other strikes, fortunately, Lin Jing had also practiced Body Refining Techniques such as the Overlord Divine Physique during his training.
The Overlord Divine Physique was equally extraordinary, even capable of absorbing the force of the Tribulation Lightning to temper his body.
It could not only reduce the damage inflicted by the Tribulation Lightning on him but also enhanced his body’s healing capabilities by more than just a bit.
Therefore, despite facing a more terrifying Heavenly Tribulation than others, he could still rely on the Overlord Divine Physique to safely endure it.
…
At this moment.
The appearance of the six-colored lightning arc caused the aura emanating from the tribulation clouds to become increasingly fearsome.
As the six-colored lightning arcs appeared more and more frequently in the tribulation clouds, the rumbling of muffled thunder became more incessant and dense.
Lin Jing, meanwhile, stared at the tribulation clouds in the sky, bracing himself for the next descent of the Tribulation Lightning.
And then…
The lightning arcs within the clouds converged once again.
Upon seeing this, Lin Jing immediately began to wield the Jing Hong Furnace above his head to resist the upcoming strike of Tribulation Lightning.
At the same time, a faint glow that was hardly noticeable enveloped Lin Jing’s body.
Very soon…
With a “boom” of thunder, another thick, colorful Tribulation Lightning struck from within the clouds and hurtled straight towards Lin Jing’s head.
Instantly, the Jing Hong Furnace was completely engulfed by the Tribulation Lightning, followed swiftly by Lin Jing who was beneath it, similarly submerged in the lightning.
…
…
This fourth strike lasted twice as long as the previous three, a full six breaths.
When the six breaths had passed and the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing re-emerged.
After this strike, significant wounds appeared on Lin Jing’s body.
These were not simple cuts; the torn wounds were generally an inch or so long.
Such injuries, if suffered by ordinary cultivators, would likely result in gushing blood, completely staining their bodies red.
However…
For Lin Jing, these wounds were not a significant concern.
Furthermore, Lin Jing’s extraordinary healing abilities quickly clotted the fresh blood flowing from the wounds.
Soon, the wounds on Lin Jing’s body visibly healed at a rapid pace.
After the healing, Lin Jing still did not relax.
Instead, he continued to look up at the tribulation clouds above and remained ready at all times.
Next…
ƝοѵǤο.сᴑ
After some time had passed, the fifth and sixth strikes of Tribulation Lightning fell, each more powerful than the one before.
Despite the protective formations and the Jing Hong Furnace above his head reducing some of the Tribulation Lightning’s power, Lin Jing still sustained heavy injuries.
Especially the sixth strike, which left a large black burn on Lin Jing’s body.
After the sixth strike descended, the sky cleared momentarily, with the tribulation clouds pausing before resuming their buildup.
Lin Jing hastily took this opportunity to madly circulate the spiritual power within his body, repairing his injuries.
Up next were the final three strikes of Tribulation Lightning.
These last three strikes were the most formidable, and Lin Jing dared not let his guard down.
Seeing this situation, Lin Jing did not hesitate and directly activated the Bonus Attachment, followed by a system prompt that resounded in his Divine Sense:
“Ding!”
“Bonus Attachment activated successfully, deducting 5 Harvest Points, remaining Harvest Points: 1995726.”
After the system’s prompt, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense surged instantly, boosting his confidence significantly.
…
…
This time…
The tribulation clouds took even longer to build up, and by the time their buildup was complete, Lin Jing’s injuries had already healed.
Meanwhile, the colorful lightning arcs within the clouds underwent yet another change, turning into seven colors.
Nine colors signify the annihilating celestial lightning.
Now Lin Jing’s Tribulation Lightning had reached seven colors, suggesting that the power of the lightning was not far off.
“Crack!”
The seventh strike of Tribulation Lightning was both urgent and swift; as the lightning arcs still surged within the clouds, it already descended.
Moreover, this seventh strike was very thin, resembling a slender, colorful bamboo pole, which appeared directly above Lin Jing’s head.

﻿Chapter 847: Chapter 378 Successful Tribulation, System Space Upgrade_2 Chapter 847: Chapter 378 Successful Tribulation, System Space Upgrade_2 This thin thread of Tribulation Lightning might seem to lack terrifying power at first glance.
But at the emergence of this seventh bolt of Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing sensed the terrifying aura within it.
Lin Jing didn’t dare to underestimate it, immediately activating his Overlord Divine Physique, again covering his body with that faintly indiscernible radiance, to resist the incoming Tribulation Lightning.
After the Tribulation Lightning struck down, it first hit the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace, causing it to sink slightly; in the next moment, the seven-colored lightning rapidly spread over the entire surface of the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace.
Then, the seven-colored lightning arcs passed through the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace and struck Lin Jing’s body.
Lin Jing’s body instantly cracked open, with countless blood spurting out.
This splattered blood did not fall to the ground but seemed to be attracted, sprinkling over the body of the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace.
...
Moreover, once the blood stuck to the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace and under the action of the Tribulation Lightning, it seemed to slowly meld into the body of the furnace.
One breath…
Two breaths…
Three breaths…
…
…
The duration of this seventh bolt of Tribulation Lightning lasted a full nine breaths.
By the time the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, wounds covered Lin Jing’s body, and in some places, the bones were deeply visible.
However, the seven-colored lightning arcs rampaging in Lin Jing’s wounds, caused his injuries to recover even faster.
Meanwhile, the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace above Lin Jing, after being baptized by this seventh bolt of Tribulation Lightning, seemed to have undergone some changes.
ƝᴑνǤᴑ.сο
A faint radiance started to emerge on its body, and a distinct aura began emanating from the body of the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace.
Lin Jing also noticed that he had a mysterious connection with the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace, his control over it becoming smoother as well.
Soon.
Lin Jing’s injuries healed once again.
After his recovery, Lin Jing quickly looked around.
This time, the Shi Family had set up five layers of overlapping composite Formations to assist with the Tribulation.
This combination was indeed formidable.
Up to this point in the Tribulation, not a single layer had broken.
However, during the strike of that seventh bolt of Tribulation Lightning, the first two Formation layers had already sustained some damage, and it seemed this composite Formation would not hold much longer.
…
Before the eighth bolt of Tribulation Lightning had fully formed, the oppressive aura in the sky was already suffocating.
Others who felt this aura couldn’t help but furrow their brows.
In particular, Grandfather Shi Tian looked towards Lin Jing with a frown, a trace of worry showing on his face.
On the contrary, Lin Jing, under the Heavenly Tribulation, had no extra thoughts.
He was completely focused, staring intently at the sky waiting for the eighth bolt of Tribulation Lightning to fall.
“Boom!”
The eighth bolt of Tribulation Lightning was still thick and even more formidable than the previous ones.
As the Tribulation Lightning fell, the first to withstand it was the compound Formation set up by the Shi Family.
Upon contact with the Tribulation Lightning, the first two already slightly damaged Formation layers shattered instantly, and the third collapsed after a brief resistance, disappearing on the spot.
Then, the Tribulation Lightning penetrated the remaining two layers of the Formation, directly hitting the JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace and Lin Jing.
Instantly, Lin Jing was engulfed in lightning, making it impossible to see the situation inside.
…
…
When nine breaths had passed, the sight that greeted the onlookers was Lin Jing in a deep crater formed by the impact of the Tribulation Lightning.
This wasteland was already different from the outside world, with extremely hard terrain that not even an ordinary cultivator could damage.
Yet under the terrifying Tribulation Lightning, a crater formed, a thousand zhang in circumference and over a dozen zhang deep.
At this moment, most parts of Lin Jing’s body were exposed, with bones showing through.
The colorful lightning arcs continued to wildly traverse his body, incessantly burrowing into Lin Jing’s flesh.
At the same time, above Lin Jing’s head.
The JÄ«nghÃ³ng Furnace was the opposite of Lin Jing’s condition; although lightning arcs traveled over it, the light emanating from the body of the furnace grew brighter and brighter.
The Tribulation Clouds above Lin Jing were still thickening and pressing lower, with countless lightning arcs continuing to gather towards the center of the clouds.
Even the surrounding Tribulation Clouds began to narrow their range, converging towards the middle.
And the Tribulation Clouds above Lin Jing became increasingly dense, the oppressive weight growing heavier.
Moreover, the aura emanating from within was becoming more and more terrifying…
A short respite later, all the lightning arcs in the Tribulation Clouds above Lin Jing suddenly vanished, disappearing into the clouds.
Yet the sound of muffled thunder continued unabated.
Seeing this, Lin Jing didn’t care that his body had not fully recovered and quickly stood up, frantically circulating his Spiritual Power, waiting for the final bolt of Tribulation Lightning to come.
“Boom!”
The final bolt of Tribulation Lightning still fell.
This last bolt of Tribulation Lightning was still of seven colors, without any further changes.
Although it was still seven-colored, its power had become much stronger than the eighth wave of Tribulation Lightning that had just passed.
As the Tribulation Lightning struck down and touched the Formation, the remaining two layers of the Formation instantly collapsed.
This combined Formation had finally fulfilled its purpose at this moment.
After destroying the Formation, the terrifying ninth wave of Tribulation Lightning descended straight toward Lin Jing…
The next moment.
The Tribulation Lightning engulfed Lin Jing, along with the Jinghong Furnace.
This last wave of Tribulation Lightning carried not only a force of destruction that was difficult to resist but also an extremely terrifying divine soul pressure that acted directly upon the soul spirit.
Combined, they were like an apocalypse, seemingly determined to completely erase Lin Jing from existence.
Despite the horror of this Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing would not sit idly by waiting for death…
In the first instant, Lin Jing exerted his full strength, striving to resist.
In the second instant, as the power of the Tribulation Lightning grew, Lin Jing’s body began to fail and started to crumble.
In the third instant, the Tribulation Lightning’s strength continued to mount, causing severe fractures in Lin Jing’s body.
Countless droplets of spiritual blood spilled from his wounds, surging upward to be absorbed by the Jinghong Furnace above his head.
In the fourth instant, after absorbing Lin Jing’s spiritual blood, the Jinghong Furnace flipped over and shielded Lin Jing within…
The fifth instant…
The sixth instant…
…
…
Thus, time quickly reached the ninth instant.
By the time of the ninth instant, a crack suddenly appeared in the Tribulation Clouds above Lin Jing’s head, surprising everyone present.
“A spatial crack…”
“What kind of Heavenly Tribulation is this kid undergoing?
Why is there a spatial crack appearing here?”
Old Xian Duan couldn’t help but exclaim out loud.
Grandpa Shi Tian’s expression was also solemn, silently watching the spatial crack within the Tribulation Clouds.
Mere moments later, a stream of colored light emerged from that spatial crack.
This stream of colored light was different from the Tribulation Lightning, it was nine-colored, containing two more colors than the seven-colored Tribulation Lightning.
Just as the colored light appeared, it caught the attention of Grandpa Shi Tian and Old Xian Duan.
However, before they could take a closer look, the colored light instantly merged into the Tribulation Lightning and disappeared without a trace.
And right after that nine-colored light vanished into the Tribulation Lightning, the final moment of the Tribulation Lightning passed, and it completely dissipated.
At the same time, the spatial crack that had appeared in the Tribulation Clouds also disappeared without a trace.
At this point.
Grandpa Shi Tian turned to Old Xian Duan, who also turned his head around at the same time, looking back.
Grandpa Shi Tian spoke up, saying:
“You saw it just now…”
Old Xian Duan nodded and then asked Grandpa Shi Tian:
“That nine-colored light…”
“What was it?”
Grandpa Shi Tian shook his head:
“I’ve never seen anything like it…”
After speaking, Grandpa Shi Tian pondered for a moment and then, with a furrowed brow, he ventured:
“It looks like, it might be the legendary Immortal Yuan.”
Old Xian Duan nodded in agreement, saying:
“It does look like it…”
“But I’ve never seen Immortal Yuan either, so I can’t confirm.”
…
…
While the two were discussing that nine-colored light, it approached Lin Jing in an instant and was actively absorbed by the System Space.
After that.
The System Space shook violently, immediately issuing several notification sounds:
“Ding!”
“System notification: Congratulations to the host for successfully overcoming the Heavenly Tribulation, Cultivation has improved, advancing to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, reward granted: 2000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System notification: Congratulations to the host for obtaining a strand of Immortal Yuan, reward granted: 10000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System notification: Enough Harvest Points accumulated for System Space upgrade, System Space now beginning upgrade.
All functions of the System Space will be suspended during the upgrade, total upgrade time: 216 hours.”

﻿Chapter 848: Chapter 379: Level 9 System Space, the Nascent Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Phase Chapter 848: Chapter 379: Level 9 System Space, the Nascent Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Phase After the ninth Tribulation Lightning passed, the spot where Lin Jing was located had become a massive pit.
Lin Jing was sitting cross-legged at the bottom of the pit, his entire body charred and almost indistinguishable as human.
If it weren’t for the faint breaths still emanating from his body, it would be quite difficult for one to not doubt whether he was still alive at this moment.
Above Lin Jing’s head, the Jing Hong Furnace was emitting an exceedingly brilliant light, the furnace body inverted and situated above Lin Jing’s head.
From the mouth of the furnace, a Wu Cai light screen cascaded down, enveloping Lin Jing completely within it.
At this time.
The Heavenly Tribulation had passed, and the tribulation clouds in the sky began to disperse.
...
In no more than the time it takes to brew a cup of tea, the entire expanse of tribulation clouds had completely vanished, and the sky had once again returned to its clear and boundless state.
Seeing the tribulation clouds recede, Grandfather Shi Tian and Elder Xian Duan immediately came to the edge of the pit and looked inside.
Upon seeing the Jing Hong Furnace, Elder Xian Duan promptly concentrated his Divine Sense and probed towards it, but just as his Divine Sense made contact with the Jing Hong Furnace, the furnace trembled slightly and repelled his Divine Sense back to him.
Having his Divine Sense repelled by the Jing Hong Furnace, Elder Xian Duan was not startled but pleased, and he quickly spoke up:
“The Innate Dao Treasure Jing Hong Furnace has succeeded!”
After speaking, he turned his head to look at Grandfather Shi Tian beside him.
At this moment, Grandfather Shi Tian was looking at Lin Jing with a slight frown, as if contemplating something.
Only when Elder Xian Duan glanced over did Grandfather Shi Tian speak up, saying to Elder Xian Duan:
“That nine-colored light just now, one couldn’t feel its breath at all, as if it disappeared into thin air.”
Hearing this, Elder Xian Duan also carefully inspected Lin Jing, and after observing for a moment, Elder Xian Duan spoke:
“Indeed, it’s just like that…”
Having said that, Elder Xian Duan looked at Grandfather Shi Tian and said:
“I am now doubting whether what appeared in that spatial fissure was really Immortal Yuan or not.”
Grandfather Shi Tian looked towards Lin Jing, and then spoke:
“Let’s wait until this young man has recovered, and then we’ll inspect him closely to see if there’s anything amiss with him.”
Elder Xian Duan nodded in agreement:
“That’s all we can do now…”
…
…
When Lin Jing fully recovered, it was already two days later.
Upon regaining consciousness, Lin Jing immediately extended his Divine Sense to feel the state of his body internally.
Upon entering the Tribulation, a cultivator’s Dantian undergoes a tremendous change; now, Lin Jing’s Dantian was like a nebula within a vast universe.
If he were to engage in combat, this nebula would provide a continuous supply of Spiritual Power, replenishing him, so that he would never again fall into a state of Spiritual Power depletion.
Yet, entering the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, the most important thing is not the Spiritual Power, but the comprehension of space, as cultivators can sense the existence of the space barrier after reaching the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.
Ɲ0νǤο.сο
Of course, they would also be able to cross the boundary wall and travel to the Outer Spatial Void.
Lin Jing stretched out his hand towards the space in front of him.
As Lin Jing extended his hand, his Divine Sense instantly surged out, sensing the space ahead.
In Lin Jing’s perception, he could faintly sense the existence of the boundary wall, an indescribable spatial barrier that seemed to imprison the entire Heaven and Earth.
This feeling was something that couldn’t be sensed before reaching the Tribulation stage, no matter what.
Although he could somewhat feel the presence of the boundary wall, Lin Jing could also clearly perceive that this boundary wall was incredibly tough, far beyond what he could break through at his current level.
Even Grandfather Shi Tian, a cultivator of the Mahayana Realm, had to go to places like the Demon Race Secret Realm, where the space barrier was weak, and had to open it at the most vulnerable moment, right after his own tribulation.
Now that Lin Jing had just entered the Tribulation stage, it was even less thinkable.
After perceiving, Lin Jing drew back his hand, and even his extended Divine Sense was retracted.
After withdrawing his Divine Sense, Lin Jing raised his right hand, and the Jing Hong Furnace, which was originally floating beside him, quickly shrank to the size of a palm and fell into Lin Jing’s hand.
Having been baptized by the Tribulation Lightning, the Jing Hong Furnace absorbed a lot of Lin Jing’s essence blood during the last phase of tempering.
In this way, it was almost as if Lin Jing had used the Blood Refining Skill, tempering the Jing Hong Furnace once more.
Following that.
Lin Jing operated the Jing Hong Furnace, manipulating it a bit to feel this newly refined Innate Dao Treasure Pill Furnace.
This tempered Jing Hong Furnace was in perfect harmony with Lin Jing’s intentions, as if it was an extension of himself, and it was effortless to control.
After briefly feeling it out, Lin Jing put away the Jing Hong Furnace, ready to leave.
Having put away the Jing Hong Furnace, Lin Jing looked up towards the entrance above the pit.
He saw that the entrance above the pit was covered by a Formation, a Formation used to conceal one’s aura, seemingly laid out specially to prevent disturbances.
Afterward.
Lin Jing stepped out and left the pit directly.
Just as Lin Jing stepped out of the pit struck by the Tribulation Lightning, he looked up and saw two figures in the distance.
These two were Elder Xian Duan and Grandfather Shi Tian, Shi Yuan.
Lin Jing had not expected that after two days, both of them would still be waiting here.
Thereafter, Lin Jing flew directly towards them.
Arriving in front of them, Lin Jing clasped his hands and greeted the two elders:
“Elderly sirs…”
But just as Lin Jing finished speaking, the two of them stepped forward, one hand each, grabbing both of Lin Jing’s arms, and before he could react, he felt two streams of Spiritual Power surge into his body.
These two streams of Spiritual Power circulated within his body briefly and withdrew not long after.
The two men also released their hands at this time.
Then, Grandfather Shi Tian and Elder Xian Duan exchanged glances, shaking their heads at each other.
After that, Grandfather Shi Tian spoke:

﻿Chapter 849: Chapter 379 Level 9 System Space, The Embryonic Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Period_2 Chapter 849: Chapter 379 Level 9 System Space, The Embryonic Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Period_2 “`
“No!”
Elder Xian Duan nodded.
Faced with this situation, Lin Jing was somewhat bewildered for a moment.
But he quickly caught on.
The reason the two of them were like this was probably because of that strand of Immortal Yuan.
Although Lin Jing had been overwhelmed by Tribulation Lightning and had no energy left to do anything else, through the System notification, he knew that he had obtained a strand of Immortal Yuan.
However, at the time, the Tribulation Lightning was in its last breath, most terrifying, so Lin Jing didn’t dare to be distracted in the slightest.
Naturally, he was also unaware that a space rift had appeared during his Tribulation, so the origin of that Immortal Yuan was unclear to Lin Jing.
...
But as soon as that Immortal Yuan appeared, it was absorbed into the System Space.
Now the System Space has begun upgrading and cannot be entered, and that Immortal Yuan has been sealed inside it as well, even if Lin Jing wanted to take out that Immortal Yuan, he could not do so now.
At this moment,
Grandfather Shi Tian spoke, asking Lin Jing,
“During the last bolt of Tribulation Lightning, did you feel anything unusual?”
And at this moment, Elder Xian Duan also looked towards Lin Jing, apparently very eager to know the answer to this question as well.ƝονǤᴑ.ᴄօ
It seemed that the two of them might know something.
And Lin Jing just so happened to be unaware of where that Immortal Yuan came from, this was the perfect opportunity to ask.
Lin Jing then said,
“There was a strange sensation, but at that time I was fully focused on resisting that last bolt of Tribulation Lightning, so I didn’t pay much attention to it.”
After speaking, Lin Jing asked the two,
“Did something happen while I was undergoing Tribulation?”
The two exchanged a glance, and then Elder Xian Duan spoke,
“Yes…”
“When you were undergoing Tribulation, a space rift appeared.”
“And something emerged from that space rift, we wanted to confirm it.”
“Space rift!”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, was immediately astonished.
Just having advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, Lin Jing had experienced the toughness of the boundary walls, he had never expected that a space rift would appear during his Tribulation.
“May I ask what emerged from that space rift?” Lin Jing continued to inquire.
Grandfather Shi Tian then said,
“It seemed like Immortal Yuan, but as soon as it appeared, it merged into your Tribulation Lightning and disappeared without a trace.”
“Immortal Yuan is only mentioned in a few words in ancient texts from the Ancient Era, none of us have seen it in reality.”
“Therefore, we’re not entirely sure whether it was indeed Immortal Yuan or not.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, nodded,
“I see…”
Then, Elder Xian Duan spoke,
“Alright, let’s not talk about this anymore.”
“You have now successfully passed the Tribulation and have advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, next you should properly prepare and begin Alchemy.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Indeed…”
“Now that the Surging Furnace is complete, it’s time for me to prepare for Alchemy.”
Then Grandfather Shi Tian spoke up,
“There’s no rush for Alchemy now.”
“You just advanced, your Cultivation is still not very stable, you need to seclude yourself for a period and stabilize your Cultivation first.”
“And I need to make another trip to the Elixir Alliance.”
“Your master, Elder Qi, is currently helping me collect materials for refining Soul-Returning Pills, I have to go there again.”
“After collecting the materials, we can begin Alchemy.”
Lin Jing nodded upon hearing this.
…
It wasn’t long after returning to the Shi Family that Grandfather Shi Tian and Elder Xian Duan left together, while Lin Jing continued to stay in the Shi Family, beginning to stabilize his Cultivation.
Time passed quickly, and in the blink of an eye, several days went by.
One day, while Lin Jing was meditating, a System notification came through, startling Lin Jing from his meditative state:
“Ding!”
“System notification: System upgrade complete, please check promptly.”
Eager to hear the System notification after waiting for so long, Lin Jing immediately entered the System Space.
As soon as he entered the System Space, Lin Jing immediately noticed a huge change in the System Space due to this upgrade.
Now in the System Space, apart from the normal Spirit Field and the Alchemy Room,
There were some new areas that had been expanded on the edge of the System Space, and seeing these three areas, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be puzzled and immediately went to the edge of the System Space to investigate.
Arriving at the edge of the System Space, Lin Jing looked forward.
In front of him, those three areas, each about a hundred acres in size, lay adjacent to the previous edge of the System Space.
One of the areas was a patch of black soil without any discernible peculiarities.
The second area was a clear spring.
And the third area looked like a barren mountain.
However…
When Lin Jing tried to step forward to enter these three areas, he found himself blocked by an invisible barrier, preventing him from entering.
It seemed that these three areas had been isolated from the System Space.
Lin Jing wasn’t clear about what was going on, so he opened the system interface to see if there was an explanation there.
Then, Lin Jing spoke directly to open the system interface, and at once, an information panel appeared in front of him:
System Space (Level 9) (Evolution Stage)
Remaining time: 337 hours (Accumulable: 1000 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field range: 135 (100+35) acres
Spiritual Energy Density: 10
Flow of Time Speed: 10
Daily entry time: 12 hours (Full)
Requirements for upgrade:
Samsara Holy Fruit (0/1)
Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus (0/1)
Divine Tree of Dao Principle (0/1)
Alchemy Room (7/9)
Evolution Stage (0/10)
Evolution Points required per stage: 100,000
Special Functions: Alert Mode, Observation, Fixed Point Teleportation, Time Accumulation…
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 850
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 850: Chapter 379: Level 9 System Space, The Embryonic Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Period_3 Chapter 850: Chapter 379: Level 9 System Space, The Embryonic Form of the Dao Realm in the Evolutionary Period_3 System Space entered the evolutionary phase, beginning to evolve towards a complete Dao Realm prototype.
As the evolutionary stage increases, System Space will undergo different transformations.
The Harvest Points obtained from the space can be converted into Evolution Points at a ratio (10:1)
Note: System Space will continually decrease the strength of all functions as the evolutionary stage increases, until all functions completely disappear, becoming a true Dao Realm prototype.
It is hoped that the host will make a careful choice to evolve.
The upgrade of System Space this time unexpectedly revealed so much more content, and its true nature seemed to have been revealed.
Especially upon seeing the end, Lin Jing was completely dumbfounded.
This System Space turns out to be transformable into a Dao Realm prototype.
...
Lin Jing had heard of the Cultivation World and the Immortal Realm, but he had never heard of the Dao Realm.
ɴονǤᴑ.ᴄο
As for what exactly this Dao Realm is, Lin Jing also didn’t know.
It seemed to be related to the world, but what kind of world, Lin Jing really didn’t know.
If he could collect all the necessary items for System Space’s upgrade, and the evolutionary phase progresses to completion, perhaps System Space could grow into a true world of its own.
A world that belongs to him.
This System Space had already existed when Lin Jing crossed over.
Lin Jing previously did not know what it was, or why it appeared on him.
But the existence of System Space, being able to help him improve his cultivation, Lin Jing didn’t think too much about it and just used it…
Until now.
Now it seems that the ability of System Space to transform into a Dao Realm prototype is truly extraordinary, and it must have quite significant origins.
Although Lin Jing still does not know its origins now, as the System Space continually upgrades, Lin Jing believes that one day, he will understand all of this.
And for this upgrade of System Space…
Lin Jing looked at the system panel for the conditions required for the upgrade.
Samsara Holy Fruit, Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Each one looked extremely complex.
“Samsara Holy Fruit…”
“If I’m not mistaken, it should be the Samsara Fruit, right?”
Lin Jing thought to himself as he looked at the system panel.
The Samsara Fruit that fell from beyond the Nanming Domain almost destroyed the entire domain.
Everyone knows that the Samsara Fruit is no ordinary object.
But the Samsara Fruit is too terrifying; within its area of effect, it continuously absorbs the lifespan of cultivators, and the closer one is to the Samsara Fruit, the more terrifying the speed of lifespan absorption becomes.
Even cultivators in the Mahayana Realm can’t withstand the lifespan absorption of the Samsara Fruit and cannot approach it.
Let alone capturing it.
And for Lin Jing to upgrade System Space, he first needs to approach the Samsara Fruit, then capture it into System Space.
This goes without saying, it certainly is not an easy task.
…
Besides the Samsara Fruit, the second exotic item required for the upgrade of System Space is the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus…
This Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus instantly made Lin Jing think of Immortal Crossing Island, wondering if the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus could be related to Immortal Crossing Island…
But if it is related to Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, the difficulty in obtaining it might not be lower than that of the Samsara Fruit.
…
Moreover…
The last exotic item required for the system upgrade is named Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Just from its name, Lin Jing knew it was not simple, and he had never heard even a bit of information about this Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
It is estimated that the difficulty in obtaining this Divine Tree of Dao Principle is not less than that of the Samsara Fruit and Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus…

chapters.title: Chapter 851
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 851: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill Chapter 851: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill After checking the System Panel, Lin Jing closed the panel and then turned to look at the three newly added areas.
A plot of black land, a clear spring, and a barren mountain…
They corresponded exactly to the Samsara Holy Fruit, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, and the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Without a doubt, these three new areas were specifically designated for the collection of the special Spirit Plants needed to upgrade the System.
However, there was no display related to these three areas on the System Panel, and Lin Jing himself was barred from entering; he simply couldn’t get in.
As for information regarding these areas, Lin Jing was completely clueless.
But…
...
Lin Jing believed that since these three additional areas existed within the System Space, it was certainly possible to find information about them.
After pondering briefly, Lin Jing reopened the System Panel, and then accessed the panel that contained information about the Spirit Field.
There, Lin Jing indeed found data about those three areas:
Nine Heavens Samsara Zone: The growing site of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Lotus Pond Immortal Spring: The growing site of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Dao Realm Divine Mountain: The growing site of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Three great World Seed areas, essential for the growth of the Immortal Dao Realm Seed.
They are independent from the System Space.
Prior to the collection of the World Seeds, the host is temporarily unable to enter.
When collecting the World Seeds, the host simply needs to approach the World Seed, with no action required; the System will assist the host in obtaining the World Seed.
(Note: There is a connection between the three great World Seed areas and the Immortal Dao Realm Seed.
The host may use the System’s help to locate the position of the Immortal Dao Realm Seed.)
After reading, Lin Jing closed the System Panel; he now had an understanding of the three areas.
Then, Lin Jing spoke up to summon the System:
“System!”
“Detect the locations of the three great Immortal Dao Realm Seeds.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the System’s prompt sound began to ring:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: The preliminary locations of the three great Immortal Dao Realm Seeds have been detected.
Please check, host.”
Right after the System’s prompt ended, a broken visual representation appeared before Lin Jing’s eyes.
The scene in this visual depicted what appeared to be the ruins of an abandoned Immortal City.
It seemed to have been deserted for a long time, many of the buildings were dilapidated, and everywhere was desolate and run-down.
In the center of the Immortal City stood a gigantic statue towering hundreds of feet high.
The exterior of the statue, weathered by time, had completely peeled off, and it was no longer distinguishable.
Only by its main body could one tell that the statue was sculpted in the shape of a Human Cultivator.
The head of the Human Cultivator statue was missing half, and on that remaining half of the statue’s crown sat a fruit resembling the yin-yang symbol with its black and white colors.
Furthermore, at that moment the black and white colors of the fruit were continuously rotating.
Then…
The visual slowly zoomed out, and the scope of what it displayed grew ever wider.
Lin Jing gradually saw the entire Immortal City more clearly.
The area of the Immortal City was indeed not small, even larger than the city of the Elixir Alliance.
Such a large Immortal City was truly a rare sight.
Next, the visual continued to zoom out.
Lin Jing gradually distinguished the surrounding landscape of the Immortal City, including tall mountains and large rivers…
However, the once verdant mountains were now utterly barren, turned a dark brown color, and the river that flowed through the city had also turned dark brown, with no waves in sight.
In the entire visual, everywhere was a scene of deathly stillness.
It was then that the first visual slowly faded and eventually vanished…
…
Before Lin Jing had time to ponder, another visual reappeared.
This second visual wasn’t as desolate as the first.
In the visual was a pond filled with algae-ridden mountain spring water; at its center stood a Black Lotus that had long since died and rotted away to half its size.
Then, the visual started to rise upward, and it ascended quickly.
During this process, more and more parts of the scene were revealed.
The location shown in this second visual seemed to be amid a mountain range.
The visual moved higher and higher.
Suddenly…
It seemed as though the visual passed through a Formation, and the scene within it changed.
Although it still appeared to be within a mountain range, this mountain was very different from what had just been depicted.
In fact, the initial mountain spring could no longer be found in this visual.
At this moment, the visual also began to fade slowly, on the verge of completely dispersing.
However, just then…
A massive Golden Giant Eagle appeared within the visual.
With wings outstretched, the Golden Giant Eagle was so large that it could cover the sky, spanning a thousand kilometers.
It seemed to be escaping, constantly looking back while flying forward at high speed.
When it looked back, Lin Jing saw that it seemed to be holding something in its beak…
Seeing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be somewhat stunned because the Golden Giant Eagle gave him a very familiar feeling.
Ɲ0νǤο.ƈο
But by then, the visual had faded, and Lin Jing couldn’t see clearly, so he wasn’t quite certain.
Thus, he watched the visual intently without diverting his gaze.
Finally.
Just before the visual completely disappeared, a dark shadow appeared within…
Seeing this, Lin Jing was utterly certain of where this second visual originated from.
Immortal Crossing Island!
This second visual was definitely from Immortal Crossing Island.
Because.
What appeared in the visual just now was precisely the Golden Giant Eagle and the Black Owl that Lin Jing had encountered on Immortal Crossing Island, Little Gold and Little Black.
If it weren’t for Little Black’s appearance, Lin Jing would not have been so sure, but with both beasts appearing together, there was no doubt.

chapters.title: Chapter 852
chapters.content:
