﻿Chapter 852: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill_2 Chapter 852: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill_2 The beasts looked significantly larger and seemed to have their cultivation improved considerably.
Even with the improvement in cultivation, they still behaved as before, enjoying chasing and frolicking.
…
After the second image disappeared, the third image quickly appeared.
This time, what appeared on the screen was a pitch-black scene.
In the darkness, a section of withered root with a faint glow floated there.
The place was so dark that Lin Jing couldn’t tell where it was for a moment.
...
ƝονǤօ.сᴑ
The screen was pitch black, and the withered root simply floated in mid-air, giving the impression of being in the Outer Spatial Void.
However, the scene was too dark to make out anything else.
Thus, Lin Jing was also uncertain.
As the view zoomed out, it remained the same.
Eventually.
Until the image completely disappeared, Lin Jing still saw nothing but darkness; in the end, he was unable to see any object that could give a clue.
After the image ended, no new images appeared.
Lin Jing then began to ponder.
The three images just now were very hard to confirm.
The first one, needless to say, was the location of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
And the second, a corrupted Black Lotus in a mountain spring pool, was surely the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
And the last image, that faintly glowing withered root, must be the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Looking at the condition of these three treasures of the Immortal Dao Realm, it seems rather dire.
Particularly the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus and the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
The Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus had turned into a Black Lotus and had decayed to half its size.
The Divine Tree of Dao Principle was even worse off, reduced to only a segment of withered root.
Only the Samsara Holy Fruit was somewhat better, with its black and white auras continuously rotating.
Among those three images…
The first depicted a desolate scene, truly resembling the Barren Forbidden Zone in the Nanming Domain.
Lin Jing had entered the Barren Forbidden Zone before, and the scene within the Barren Forbidden Zone indeed had some similarities with the scene in the first image.
However…
Even if it was confirmed to be in the Barren Forbidden Zone of the Nanming Domain, the Barren Forbidden Zone is so vast that finding it would still be a great effort.
Luckily, it has been confirmed that the Samsara Holy Fruit is within an Immortal City, which has an exceptionally large scope, and there is also a huge statue in the city, which is a very distinct feature.
Next, Lin Jing needs to gather some information on the Nanming Domain to locate that Immortal City.
Given the city’s vast size and its extremely distinct features, clearly not just any Immortal City, it should be relatively easy to find.
By then, Lin Jing just needs to check the information, confirm its location, and after making the necessary preparations, he can set out to find the Samsara Holy Fruit.
As for the second image, needless to say, it is inside Immortal Crossing Island, and once entering Immortal Crossing Island, finding the location of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus wouldn’t be difficult.
The only troublesome aspect is how to enter Immortal Crossing Island.
…
And that last image…
This last image was pitch black, seeing nothing at all, and he really was powerless for now; only after obtaining the Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus could he try to find a way later.
…
…
In the blink of an eye, another two months had passed.
During this time, Lin Jing frequently entered the System Space to cultivate, soon stabilizing his cultivation.
Two months later, Grandfather Shi Tian finally returned from the Elixir Alliance.
This time, only Grandfather Shi Tian came back.
Elder Qi stayed because the grand alchemy conference of the Elixir Alliance was about to begin, making the entire Elixir Alliance extremely busy, and he was no exception.
As a result, Elder Qi stayed within the Elixir Alliance, not coming over together.
At the same time, Grandfather Shi Tian also brought another piece of news to Lin Jing.
That is, the Grand Elder of the Elixir Alliance, Elder Bai, had also returned not long ago because of the alchemy conference.
Elder Bai had left the Elixir Alliance and gone to the Outer Spatial Void before Lin Jing entered the Elixir Alliance, and now he had finally returned.
It seems that after this alchemy session, he must quickly go back to the Elixir Alliance to deliver the remaining half of the Ascension Pill to Elder Bai.
…
This time, Grandfather Shi Tian brought back a total of five sets of ingredients for making the Soul-Returning Pill, which he handed over to Lin Jing.
And besides these five sets of ingredients, the Shi Family continued to gather these materials at various places in the Eastern Spirit Realm.
After all, they needed Flawless-quality Soul-Returning Pills for this alchemy session.
Just five sets of ingredients, in their eyes, were far from enough to produce Flawless Soul-Returning Pills.
But it was different for Lin Jing.
With the boost from the Alchemy Room in the System Space, making a Flawless Soul-Returning Pill with five sets of ingredients was not too difficult for Lin Jing.
Moreover, this was only using a level seven Alchemy Room; if enough Harvest Points were available to upgrade the Alchemy Room to level eight, the chances of making Flawless Elixir Medicine would increase further…
Then, Lin Jing was almost certain that he could produce a Flawless Soul-Returning Pill.
After Grandfather Shi Tian handed over the ingredients for making the Soul-Returning Pills, Lin Jing spent a few days preparing and then immediately started alchemizing the first batch of Soul-Returning Pills.
The Alchemy Room where Lin Jing worked was a rather secluded one owned by the Shi Family.
Since Lin Jing had instructed early on that he did not like to be disturbed while alchemizing, he was basically not bothered during this time.
Although Lin Jing usually practiced alchemy without disturbance, for making this Soul-Returning Pill, he still had to tell Grandfather Shi Tian beforehand.
When Lin Jing informed Grandfather Shi Tian that he was about to make Soul-Returning Pills, Grandfather Shi Tian was visibly surprised upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 853
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 853: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill_3 Chapter 853: Chapter 380: Three Scenes, Refining the Soul-Returning Pill_3 Subsequently, after asking a few questions and confirming that Lin Jing was ready, Grandfather Shi Tian nodded.
Then.
Granfather Shi Tian took Lin Jing to the Alchemy Room to start the preparations for alchemy.
This alchemy session was particularly important, something the Shi Family and others could not overlook.
Therefore, the Soul-Returning Pill could not be prepared inside the System Space, but had to be manufactured inside the Shi Family’s Alchemy Room.
In fact, it was also fine in the Shi Family’s Alchemy Room, as long as the Bonus Attachment was activated.
Upon arriving at the Alchemy Room, Lin Jing used the token given by Grandfather Shi Tian to activate the room’s Formation.
...
This formation was a complex one, not only providing a vast amount of Spiritual Energy needed for alchemy, but also shielding everything from the outside world to avoid disturbances.
Once the formation was activated, Lin Jing then moved to the center of the Alchemy Room and summoned the Shocking Flood Furnace.
Ɲονǥ0.ᴄο
As soon as the Shocking Flood Furnace was summoned, the atmosphere in the entire Alchemy Room immediately became somewhat different, given it was an Innate Daoist Treasure, it was bound to be different.
After summoning the Shocking Flood Furnace, Lin Jing then took out the ingredients for the Soul-Returning Pill.
After retrieving the ingredients, Lin Jing operated his Divine Fire Triple Realm and then began the initial Refinement of the materials…
Lin Jing was already extremely skilled at refining Alchemy Ingredients and hardly made mistakes.
Moreover, due to his improved Cultivation, the power Lin Jing wielded using the Divine Fire Triple Realm was stronger than before.
He took just one “time period” to completely refine all the ingredients needed for the Soul-Returning Pill.
After the refinement was complete, the actual process of pill manufacturing began.
At this point, Lin Jing sequentially introduced the ingredients into the Pill Furnace and then activated the Bonus Attachment, initiating the manufacturing of the Soul-Returning Pill.
…
…
The manufacturing of the Soul-Returning Pill this time might have been due to the Shocking Flood Furnace, or perhaps because his skills in the Alchemy Dao had improved, elevating him to an Eighth Grade Pill Master.
The production of the Soul-Returning Pills this time was much easier than the last.
Soon, twelve hours had passed.
And from Lin Jing’s Shocking Flood Furnace, the fragrance of elixir began to emanate.
At this moment the previous time, Lin Jing had already been sweating and feeling dizzy, but now, he was still energetic with no issues at all.
With the appearance of the Elixir Fragrance, the Elixir Furnace Medicine had reached the final stage of pill solidification.
At this time, Lin Jing operated his Divine Fire Triple Realm at full strength, continuously increasing the furnace’s bottom flame temperature for the final solidification of the pill.
At the same time, the entire Shocking Flood Furnace also underwent a different change.
At this moment, Lin Jing felt a special connection with the Shocking Flood Furnace, as if he could sense all the changes inside the furnace even without using his Divine Sense.
Soon.
A quarter of an hour had passed, and the elixir was completely refined.
After the pill was fully refined, Lin Jing opened the Pill Furnace, and immediately, several pills flew out.
In the moment those several pills appeared, a hint of disappointment emerged in Grandfather Shi Tian’s eyes.
This batch of pills did not produce any Flawless Elixir Medicine.
However, just after a short while, Grandfather Shi Tian hid the disappointment in his eyes, then turned again to look at Lin Jing in the center of the formation,
planning to comfort him once he came out.
At this point.
Lin Jing reached out and caught the several pills in his hand.
Lin Jing glanced at the pills in his hand…
Two Supreme Grade, one Superior Grade, and three Medium Grade.
The quality of these pills was already quite good.
However, after examining the pills, Lin Jing did not show a pleased or disappointed expression, but simply placed them into a Jade Vial and stored them away.
After storing the pills, Lin Jing seemed to have no intention of coming out, but instead took out another batch of ingredients for the Soul-Returning Pill and began their initial refinement…
Looking at this,
Lin Jing planned to not stop and to refine another batch immediately…

chapters.title: Chapter 854
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 854: Chapter 381: Flawless Soul-Returning Pill, Shi Tian Awakens Chapter 854: Chapter 381: Flawless Soul-Returning Pill, Shi Tian Awakens Seeing this scene, Grandpa Shi Tian couldn’t help but frown deeply.
It wasn’t unheard of to concoct two batches of elixir medicines in a row, but that was usually only feasible with elixirs of a lower rank.
For Lin Jing, as a seventh-grade alchemist, to directly concoct two batches of seventh-grade elixir medicines in succession was not entirely unprecedented, but it was extremely rare.
If it weren’t due to some kind of special circumstance that left no choice, a normal person wouldn’t opt for this approach.
Concocting elixir medicines is already extremely taxing on the mind, especially so for higher-ranked elixirs.
An ordinary alchemist would be quite exhausted after concocting just one batch and would have no choice but to rest.
But this time, Lin Jing had just finished concocting one batch.
...
Ɲ0νǤο.ᴄο
And the batch of Soul-Returning Pills he had just concocted appeared to be quite good, containing two supreme-grade elixir medicines.
Logically, he should have taken some time to rest and then prepare thoroughly before starting on the second batch of Soul-Returning Pills.
But now…
Lin Jing didn’t even pause to rest for a moment before starting on the second batch of elixirs.
Lin Jing’s actions left Grandpa Shi Tian very puzzled.
But now that Lin Jing had started, even if he wanted to stop him, it was impossible.
He could only let him continue the concoction process.
Grandpa Shi Tian looked at Lin Jing and couldn’t help but sigh.
Admittedly, Lin Jing was now a Tribulation cultivator, his spiritual power was virtually endless, and he didn’t have to worry about its depletion.
But Lin Jing’s divine sense had already been significantly exhausted during the first batch of Soul-Returning Pills; it would probably not sustain him for the second batch now.
Grandpa Shi Tian had no idea what Lin Jing was thinking, why he didn’t rest before starting on the second batch of Soul-Returning Pills.
But he was already prepared for Lin Jing’s failure.
After Lin Jing’s failure in concoction, he would properly educate him not to be so ambitious.
In Grandpa Shi Tian’s opinion, this was the right thing to do.
However, at this moment, Lin Jing had his own plans.
During the final solidifying pill stage just now, Lin Jing had given his all in the concoction and seemed to have suddenly triggered a resonance with the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
It was at that moment that Lin Jing had realized if he could harness such a connection from the beginning of the alchemy process, then his subsequent concoctions would proceed exceptionally smoothly.
Even the chances of creating a Flawless Elixir would greatly increase.
Therefore,
Right after completing the previous batch of elixir medicines, Lin Jing didn’t rest and immediately began the concoction of the second batch of Soul-Returning Pills.
Although he had just concocted a batch of Soul-Returning Pills and his divine sense was inevitably a bit exhausted, even though it had been enhanced with bonus attachment,
These were not insurmountable issues for Lin Jing, who had his own methods for dealing with the exhaustion of divine sense.
…
In this second preliminary refinement of spirit plants, when Lin Jing operated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, he seemed to enhance his spiritual power output, making the five-colored flames even more vigorous.
By the time all the materials finished refining, he had used less time than during the first refinement.
After the preliminary refinement of the spirit plants, Lin Jing directly took out something like seaweed from his space ring and placed it in his mouth.
Jade Soul Algae could strengthen the soul spirit and quickly replenish the exhausted divine sense while enhancing it.
Seeing Lin Jing suddenly produce the Jade Soul Algae, Grandpa Shi Tian was taken aback.
From the looks of it, Lin Jing’s double batch concoction wasn’t a mere spur of the moment impulse but something he had prepared for in advance.
Afterward, Grandpa Shi Tian set aside his earlier thoughts and continued to watch Lin Jing’s alchemy process.
…
After consuming the Jade Soul Algae, Lin Jing’s divine sense quickly recovered.
As his divine sense was restored, Lin Jing also felt that his soul spirit was slightly strengthened, albeit the enhancement wasn’t very pronounced.
Then,
Lin Jing once again activated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, gathering colorless flames and preparing to start the alchemy process.
This time, Lin Jing initiated the process by directly urging his spiritual power to control the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
At the same time, he concentrated his soul spirit, meticulously sensing the connection with the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
Before long…
The Elixir Furnace Medicine resonated and began to emit a crimson light, and Lin Jing once again felt the unbreakable bond between himself and the Elixir Furnace Medicine.
It was at that moment that Lin Jing started to insert the preliminarily refined materials into the pill furnace in order, one by one.
After all the materials were put in, Lin Jing immediately sealed the furnace and went all-out in controlling the flames to start the concoction process.
…
…
This time during alchemy, in addition to controlling the flames and inspecting the conditions inside the furnace, Lin Jing had to keep sensing the Elixir Furnace Medicine’s state constantly.
Compared to before, his divine sense was depleted far more severely.
However, since he had just consumed the Jade Soul Algae, which greatly aided in the recovery of his divine sense,
Lin Jing didn’t feel tired at that moment.
Suddenly,
As time passed, ten hours quickly went by.
It was then that an elixir fragrance emanated from within the pill furnace.
After just ten hours, Lin Jing had completed the concoction, leading to the final solidifying pill stage.
Moreover, the elixir fragrance this time was even richer than the one before.
After the elixir fragrance emerged, Lin Jing accelerated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, further intensifying the colorless flames to begin the final step of solidifying pill.
At this time, the Elixir Furnace Medicine continued to radiate a crimson glow, and its surface was aglow with lustrous patterns.
However, Lin Jing was currently focused on the changes within the pill furnace, particularly the medicinal liquid, and automatically ignored the furnace’s surface changes.

chapters.title: Chapter 855
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 855: Chapter 381: Flawless Soul-Returning Pill, Shi Tian Awakens_2 Chapter 855: Chapter 381: Flawless Soul-Returning Pill, Shi Tian Awakens_2 …
As time trickled by, the elixir fragrance escaping from the pill furnace had filled the entire alchemy room.
Besides the fragrance, there were faint multicolored lights shining through from the pill furnace.
Seeing these lights, the first to react was not Lin Jing, who was fully concentrated on alchemy, but rather his Grandpa Shi Tian, who trembled involuntarily upon seeing the multicolored lights and quickly steadied himself.
The next moment, Grandpa Shi Tian couldn’t help but breathe rapidly, and his eyes shone with marvel as he looked at Lin Jing.
However, he soon realized his composure had slipped, hurriedly calmed his mind, held his breath, and continued to watch Lin Jing.
But despite his efforts, his hands hidden in his sleeves couldn’t help clenching tightly.
...
…
The appearance of the multicolored light signaled that the final step of pill formation was not far off.
Indeed…
In just a short while, the elixir furnace medicine was fully refined.
Although the pill furnace had not yet been opened, the radiance pouring out was already vivid and clear.
Lin Jing then stepped forward and, with a thought, the Startling Crane Furnace automatically opened.
As soon as the Startling Crane Furnace opened, the colorful light immediately streamed out, filling the entire alchemy room.
At the same time, one elixir seemed to take this opportunity to fly swiftly out of the pill furnace, as if trying to escape…
Lin Jing was already prepared, and as the elixir shot out from the Startling Crane Furnace, he promptly reached out, enveloping it with spiritual power.
Following that,
Lin Jing brought the escaping Pure Elixir before his eyes and inspected it closely.
This Pure Elixir was entirely translucent, with glowing brilliance on its surface, and inside, the semi-transparent medicinal liquid flowed like it had a life of its own.
After observing it, Lin Jing didn’t dare to delay and immediately took out the prepared Pure Jade Box, placing the Soul-Returning Pill within.
After placing the Pure Elixir in the Pure Jade Box, Lin Jing then turned his head to look back at the pill furnace.
By this time, the furnace’s remaining elixirs also floated out, but unlike the seemingly sentient Pure Elixir, which was incredibly fast, these other elixirs came out at a slow drift.
Lin Jing reached out his hand and collected these additional Soul-Returning Pills into his grasp.
These remaining pills were one of Supreme Grade, one of Superior, and one of Low Grade.
In total, three elixir medicines, but with the Pure Elixir setting a high precedent, Lin Jing only glanced at the three before storing them in the Jade Vial.
After putting away the elixirs, Lin Jing didn’t dally and immediately walked over to Grandpa Shi Tian.
As Lin Jing approached, Grandpa Shi Tian, who couldn’t wait, hurriedly deactivated the formation.
Lin Jing arrived before Grandpa Shi Tian and proffered a salutation:
“Elder, I have successfully completed the task!”
At this time, joy was already uncontrollable in Grandpa Shi Tian’s eyes.
Seeing Lin Jing emerge, he quickly said,
“Well done; I never imagined you’d succeed in refining the Flawless Soul-Returning Pill with just two chances.”
“Come…”
“Let me have a look at that Flawless Pure Elixir.”
Lin Jing nodded, promptly handing over the Pure Jade Box and two jade vials.
However…
In Grandpa Shi Tian’s eyes, only the Pure Jade Box mattered.
He reached out and took the Pure Jade Box; the two jade vials, on the other hand, stayed in Lin Jing’s hands.
After receiving the Pure Jade Box, Grandpa Shi Tian carefully held it, constantly turning the box to observe the Flawless Soul-Returning Pill within.
Only after quite some time did Grandpa Shi Tian finish his scrutiny.
Then, he said to Lin Jing,
“Let’s go, now we’ll go to see Shi Tian.”
Lin Jing nodded and then gestured towards the Startling Crane Furnace, which immediately shrank and flew back into his hand.
Afterward, the two made their way out of the alchemy room.
But as soon as they opened the door of the alchemy room, they were surrounded by several people.
These individuals were from the Shi Family, closely related to Shi Tian, and only Grandpa Shi Tian had accompanied Lin Jing into the alchemy room earlier to avoid disturbing his focus during alchemy.
The others had been waiting outside the alchemy room.
One of the Shi Family elders hurriedly inquired of Grandpa Shi Tian:
“Big brother, what’s the result?”
Grandpa Shi Tian looked at Lin Jing and couldn’t help smiling:
“Tian has found himself a good master!”
Upon hearing this, the others immediately understood the implication, and their faces burst into joy:
“Does that mean…
it was a success?”
Grandpa Shi Tian nodded and then took out the Pure Jade Box to show them, causing their eyes to bulge in astonishment at the Flawless Pure Elixir inside the box.
“It really was successful…”
“Fantastic, now Tian has hope for recovery.”
…
“The Innocence Soul-Returning Pill, indeed…”
“Tian’er really found himself a good master!”
…
“Yes, yes…”
…
…
The sight of the Innocence Soul-Returning Pill left everyone overjoyed, and they ceaselessly praised Lin Jing.
However, Grandfather Shi Tian quickly stopped the others and took the Pure Jade Box away.
Next, they would proceed to the small courtyard where Shi Tian was, to have him take the pill and see its actual effects.
Ɲ0νǤο.сο
Subsequently…
The group left the Alchemy Room and headed towards the courtyard where Shi Tian was located.
After arriving at Shi Tian’s courtyard, Grandfather Shi Tian instructed Lin Jing and the others to wait outside while he himself went into the room.
As soon as Grandfather Shi Tian entered the room, a light barrier appeared, enveloping the entire room within the barrier.
What followed was a long wait…
Actually, the time wasn’t very long; it was barely over two hours when the light barrier had already dissipated.
After the barrier lifted, Grandfather Shi Tian’s voice came from within:
“You can come in now.”
Lin Jing and the others exchanged glances before walking into the room together.
Upon entering the room, Lin Jing directly saw Shi Tian lying on the bed and Grandfather Shi Tian standing by the bedside.
And the now open and empty Pure Jade Box was also placed on a table not far from the bed.
Seeing this, Lin Jing’s heart couldn’t help but ‘thump’ uneasily.
Could it be that the Pure Elixir Medicine also had no effect?
At that moment, another elder of the Shi Family approached Grandfather Shi Tian, and looking at Shi Tian lying on the bed with a slightly furrowed brow, he softly said:
“Big Brother…”
“What’s Tian’er’s condition now?
Why hasn’t he woken up?
Could it be that the Innocence Soul-Returning Pill also had no effect?”
Grandfather Shi Tian shook his head:
“Tian’er is now out of danger, but he still needs some time to fully recover.
If all goes well, he should awaken very soon.”
Upon hearing this from Grandfather Shi Tian, Lin Jing immediately relaxed…
Next.
So, they just waited here, for Shi Tian to fully awake.
Perhaps because Shi Tian had been asleep for too long, or maybe for some other reason, he did not wake up as soon as Grandfather Shi Tian had said he would.
It was after another six hours that Shi Tian finally began to stir.
Just awakened, Shi Tian seemed very weak.
He slowly opened his eyes, and the first person he saw was his grandfather:
“Grandfather…”
“Did I sleep for a very long time this time?”
“I only remember, I had a very long and long dream.”
Grandfather Shi Tian quickly helped Shi Tian sit up, speaking excitedly:
“From now on, you will never have to sleep again.”
“And from now on, you can cultivate just like us.”
Shi Tian looked at his grandfather, and although he still appeared weak from just having woken up, he still forced himself to sit up and smiled:
“Grandfather…”
“I knew it, you didn’t lie to me; you really did it.”
At this point, Lin Jing and the other members of the Shi Family also gathered around.
Seeing them, Shi Tian was momentarily startled, then said:
“Third Granduncle…”
“Fifth Granduncle…”
“You’re all here…”
It was then that Shi Tian also saw Lin Jing.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Shi Tian couldn’t hide his joy and addressed him:
“Master…”
“I didn’t expect you to come too.”
“I thought I might never see you again in this lifetime.”
Lin Jing then replied softly:
“Don’t think nonsense, with your grandfather here, he won’t let anything happen to you.”
“Yes!”
“I know!”
Shi Tian looked towards his grandfather and nodded firmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 856
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 856: Chapter 382: Return to the Elixir Alliance Chapter 856: Chapter 382: Return to the Elixir Alliance After awakening this time, Shi Tian did not stay conscious for too long before he fell into a deep sleep again.
After all, his body was still that of a mortal, and now that he had just recovered, he naturally needed to rest and recuperate for a while before he could fully return to normal.
After Shi Tian fell asleep, his grandfather and the other members of the Shi Family began to make arrangements for his complete recovery.
At the same time…
Shi Tian’s grandfather also started making preparations for Shi Tian’s cultivation.
…
…
...
Soon, half a month had passed in the blink of an eye.
In this half-month, after recuperation, Shi Tian’s body had fully recovered, and he had also embarked on the path of cultivation.
Shi Tian was now a junior cultivator with a first layer in Qi Refinement.
Since Shi Tian was no longer in any danger, it was time for Lin Jing to leave.
So on this day, Lin Jing took leave of Shi Tian’s grandfather, preparing to leave the Shi Family and return to the Elixir Alliance.
As Lin Jing was taking his leave, Shi Tian was also present.
Hearing that Lin Jing was leaving, Shi Tian couldn’t help but feel reluctant.
“Master…”
“I was hoping you could stay a little longer.
I didn’t expect you to leave so soon,” Shi Tian said.
Lin Jing responded with a slight smile,
“I’ve been out for quite a while this time, and now that you are safe and sound, it’s time for me to return.”
“Besides, after returning, there are some matters to attend to.
If I am late, I’m afraid it will cause a delay.”
Hearing this, Shi Tian felt reluctant but still nodded and then said,
“Since you have matters to attend to, Master, then go ahead.”
“Let’s wait for this period to pass.
Once my cultivation improves, I’ll ask Grandfather to take me to the Elixir Alliance to see you.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Hmm…”
“Your cultivation is too low right now.
You should focus on practicing and laying a solid foundation first.”
“When your cultivation has improved, let Shi Senior take you for a good tour and have a look at the entire Cultivation World.”
“Hmm!”
Shi Tian nodded his head.
…
After leaving the Shi Family, Lin Jing did not delay and immediately set off for the Elixir Alliance.
Ɲ0νǤ0.сο
It took Lin Jing over a month to travel from the Elixir Alliance to the Shi Family, but going back, it only took him just over half a month to return from the Shi Family to the Elixir Alliance.
Nothing else…
It was just that with the improvement of his cultivation, Lin Jing was able to move faster.
When he emerged from the Teleportation Array of the city of the Elixir Alliance, Lin Jing was momentarily stunned by the sight of the bustling city.
The entire city of the Elixir Alliance was unprecedentedly lively due to the Alchemy competition.
The city of the Elixir Alliance is, in itself, one of the top three giant Immortal Cities in the entire Eastern Spirit Realm.
But now, this vast Immortal City seemed a bit crowded.
The streets of the city of the Elixir Alliance were teeming with crowds of people coming and going.
Many forces from different Sects and Alchemists from various regions were all gathered here.
Such a grand gathering naturally would not only attract Alchemists.
In addition to the Alchemists, there were various merchant guilds and some smaller forces hoping to find Alchemists for their groups at the Alchemy competition.
In the Alchemy competition of the Elixir Alliance, besides the Alchemists with backing from powerful factions, there were also many Loose Cultivator Alchemists.
Many of these Loose Cultivator Alchemists, although skilled in the Alchemy Dao, were clear about their limitations.
With their own strength, it was basically impossible for them to win the top three places and successfully join the Elixir Alliance.
Therefore..
Their next best goal was to achieve a certain rank in the competition, which would then elevate their value.
Afterward, they could join a faction of their choice as an Offering Priest Alchemist.
Besides these Alchemists, there were also many smaller forces that did not have an Alchemist and thus wished to find a skilled Alchemist during the competition to invite into their fold.
This situation was a win-win for both parties, and the Alchemy competition was precisely the opportunity to facilitate this.
Therefore, the Alchemy competition of the Elixir Alliance was often very lively.
…
Walking on the streets of the city of the Elixir Alliance, Lin Jing was surrounded by the hustle and bustle of the crowds, with the hawkers on both sides of the street calling out endlessly.
These hawkers were small merchant guilds and Loose Cultivators trying to make a profit during the Alchemy competition.
Aside from the calls of the hawkers, there was the occasional discussion among the pedestrians.
Their conversations were mainly about the current Alchemy competition.
For instance, the three people in front of Lin Jing were discussing who might win the top three places in the competition.
One Blue-Robed Cultivator began by asking his two companions,
“Who do you think is most likely to make the top three in this Alchemy competition?”
One of his companions, a Yellow-Robed Cultivator, immediately replied,
“I’ve heard that the son of the Sect Master of Ziyun Pill Sect will also participate in the competition.
It seems likely that he will secure one of the top three spots.”
No sooner had the Yellow-Robed Cultivator spoken than another companion with brown hair said,
“I’ve heard that there’s a Loose Cultivator in this competition who is suspected of having received an extraordinary legacy.
His skill in the Alchemy Dao has reached the Seventh Grade, and if nothing unexpected happens, he should also secure a place.”
“There’s also Qingxi Sect, which has a young prodigy Alchemist.
In the last Alchemy competition, he participated at just over a hundred years of age.”
“However, due to his short time in cultivation and insufficient foundation, he barely made the top thirty and was eliminated.”
“Coming back this time, with a century of accumulation, he is likely to achieve a commendable ranking.
Even making it into the top three isn’t out of the question.”
The other two nodded in agreement upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 857
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 857: Chapter 382 Return to Elixir Alliance_2 Chapter 857: Chapter 382 Return to Elixir Alliance_2 Clearly, they agreed with this point of view as well.
Just then, another person nearby overheard their conversation and couldn’t help but turn his head to look at the three of them before suddenly speaking up:
“It seems you all are quite knowledgeable about the Alchemy Conference.
Haven’t you forgotten, however, that among the top three positions, there is another popular candidate…”
Upon hearing this, the group hastily looked up at the person, noticing that his cultivation was comparable to their own.
The blue-robed cultivator who had spoken first immediately gave a polite gesture and said:
“It seems, fellow cultivator, you’re also quite informed about the Alchemy Conference.”
“Indeed…”
“There truly is another who could be in the top three.”
“The Holy Maiden of Yunxian Sect, if she were to participate, entering the top three wouldn’t surprise me at all.”
“However, I heard from a message from Yunxian Sect that their Holy Maiden is about to break through to the Solidifying Body Realm and doesn’t intend to participate in this Alchemy Conference.”
The man shook his head at this:
“It seems you, fellow cultivators, have been here in the city of the Elixir Alliance for some time, haven’t you?”
The three nodded:
“Indeed, we departed early to attend this grand event and have been here for over a month already.”
The man nodded and then continued:
“No wonder you’re not aware…”“Just a few days ago, news came from Yunxian Sect that their Holy Maiden had successfully advanced to the Solidifying Body Realm and is now prepared to participate in this Alchemy Conference.”
“I also only learned of this news when I passed through a city under the Yunxian Sect a couple of days ago.”
“With the Alchemy Conference about to start, the Yunxian Sect Holy Maiden should also be arriving soon.”
The blue-robed cultivator nodded before replying:
“If that’s the case, then the competition for the top three spots at this Alchemy Conference is going to be even fiercer.”
“Yes…”
“Yes…”
The other two also echoed in agreement.
…
Yunxian Sect’s influence is not small, ranking among the top within the entire Eastern Spirit Realm.
In the Elixir Alliance, there is an Elder with the surname Lei from the Yunxian Sect, which is why Lin Jing had some understanding of the Yunxian Sect.
...
However, as Lin Jing often practiced alchemy alone and seldom interacted with others, he had only occasionally seen this Elder Lei and exchanged a few greetings, not being very familiar with him.
After finishing their conversation, the people in front discovered that their sects were not far apart from each other and even had some connections.
Afterwards, having made each other’s acquaintance, the four of them left together.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing continued along the street towards the Elixir Alliance’s inner city.
Upon returning to the inner city, he noticed that it, too, had undergone significant changes, with the most apparent being the massive square he had seen the first time he entered.
The square, now decorated, looked quite lively.
It seemed that the upcoming Alchemy Conference was to be held in this square.
Having crossed the square, Lin Jing did not linger in the inner city; instead, he immediately headed back to his dwelling.
This time, instead of going directly to his own residence, Lin Jing went straight to Elder Qi.
Having returned from the Shi Family, he definitely needed to greet Elder Qi first.
Standing outside Elder Qi’s dwelling, Lin Jing halted, gave a respectful gesture, and said:
“Master…”
“Your disciple has returned.”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, the door to the dwelling automatically opened, and Elder Qi’s voice came from inside:
“Come in, let’s talk inside.”
Lin Jing nodded and then entered.
Inside Elder Qi’s dwelling, doors opened one after another, guiding Lin Jing to where Elder Qi was in seclusion.
The place where Elder Qi usually secluded himself was a vast study, surrounded by several large bookshelves filled to the brim with various books and secret scrolls.
Only a space in the center of the room was left empty.
When Lin Jing entered, Elder Qi was holding a tattered scroll, furrowed in thought.
It was not until Lin Jing approached that Elder Qi shifted his gaze from the scroll and looked at him, saying:
“Shi Yuan has already informed me about what happened at the Shi Family.”
“In just two batches of alchemy, you directly produced a Flawless Soul-Returning Pill.”
At this point, Elder Qi paused, carefully observing Lin Jing before continuing:
“Tell me the truth, have you already advanced to an Eighth Grade Alchemist?”
After hearing this, Lin Jing gave a respectful gesture and replied:
“Yes, Master…”
“Before I created those Soul-Returning Pills, I had already reached the level of an Eighth Grade Alchemist.”
Elder Qi nodded upon hearing this:
“I thought as much…”
“If my guess is correct, you’ve reached the eighth grade as well.”
“Now that you’ve been promoted to an eighth-grade alchemist, we can arrange for your eighth-grade alchemist’s assessment.”
“Once you pass the assessment, you will be the ninth elder of the Elixir Alliance.”
“By that time, since we’ll both be elders of the Elixir Alliance, you won’t need to call me master anymore; just address me as Qi Fellow.”
Lin Jing heard this and fell silent without a word.
Within the Elixir Alliance, the relationship between master and disciple is unlike that of other sects in the outside world, resembling more that of a teacher and student.
In circumstances like Lin Jing’s, although not common within the Elixir Alliance, they are not unheard of.
After that, Elder Qi continued:
“Oh, right…”
“The Grand Elder has returned and mentioned that once you’re back, you should go see him.”
“After you have visited your junior brother and sister, I will take you to meet the Grand Elder.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes, Master…”
Elder Qi nodded in response and then waved his hand:
“Alright, you can go back first.”
“Once I finish studying this scroll in my hand, I will come to find you.”
Having said that, Elder Qi no longer paid attention to Lin Jing but continued to pick up the damaged scroll and furrowed his brows in study.
Lin Jing did not disturb Elder Qi, but clasped his hands in a bow and then retreated.
ɴονǤօ.сᴑ
…
After leaving Elder Qi’s place, Lin Jing did not directly return to his own cave dwelling but went to visit Ji Xiyue and Changyun Yuanlei first.
Seeing Lin Jing, Changyun Yuanlei was the most excited and hastily said to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin…”
“The last time Elder Qi told us that you would be helping the Shi Family with their alchemy and might not be able to return for a while, I thought it would take a long time for you to come back.”
“I didn’t expect you to return so soon.”
Lin Jing nodded and then said:
“I was just lucky.
I managed to refine the elixir medicine the Shi Family needed, so I rushed back immediately.”
“By the way…”
“Didn’t you tell me last time that your sister and the others were coming?
When will they arrive?”
Hearing this, Changyun Yuanlei quickly spoke:
“Brother Lin, I was just about to tell you this.”
“My sister and the others sent a message saying they were delayed by some matters and might arrive a little later.”
Lin Jing heard this and nodded gently:
“Hmm…”
Then Lin Jing turned to Ji Xiyue:
“How about you?”
“You haven’t encountered any problems during this time, have you?”
Ji Xiyue curved her lips into a small smile and then said:
“The only problem I had was with that Elixir Scripture, and you’ve already solved that for me, so now there are no problems at all.”
Lin Jing nodded:
“That’s good.”
Ji Xiyue then looked at Lin Jing, sized him up for a moment, and laughed:
“And you?”
“Before you left, you said that you were about to be promoted to an eighth-grade alchemist.”
“With your rate of promotion, even if it hasn’t happened yet, it shouldn’t be far off.”
Lin Jing paused upon hearing this, then replied:
“I’ve already been promoted to the eighth grade.”
“And I’ve already discussed this with Elder Qi.
It won’t be long before I start the eighth-grade Pill Master assessment.”
Ji Xiyue was momentarily stunned upon hearing this, her smile freezing before she could fully react.
When she did come to, Ji Xiyue looked at Lin Jing and couldn’t help shaking her head with a wry smile:
“I thought I had already overestimated you, but it turns out I still underestimated you.”
“Although you are a descendant of the Lin Family from the Ancient Alchemy Family, with exceptional alchemic talent, I too am a rare alchemy genius from the Western Demon Region.”
“Who would have thought you’d be breaking through continuously like there are no bottlenecks…”
“In front of you, my alchemic talent is practically not worth mentioning.”
Changyun Yuanlei, who was standing on the side, also nodded in agreement, speaking with a touch of resentment:
“Me too…”

chapters.title: Chapter 858
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 858: Chapter 383: Inner Sea Affairs Concluded, Alchemy Conference Begins Chapter 858: Chapter 383: Inner Sea Affairs Concluded, Alchemy Conference Begins Not long after, Elder Qi came looking.
Following that, Lin Jing accompanied Elder Qi to meet Elder Bai.
Elder Bai, being a Grand Elder of the Elixir Alliance, usually stayed in his own cave dwelling unless there was some business.
But now, with the Alchemy Conference about to commence, even Elder Bai, as the Grand Elder, was much busier than usual.
Therefore, to meet Elder Bai, one could no longer go to his cave dwelling.
Lin Jing followed Elder Qi back to the Inner City.
Later, on the top floor of a tower-like building within the Elixir Alliance’s Inner City, they met Elder Bai.
...
Elder Bai, with hair and beard all white, wore flowing white robes, giving him an almost ethereal aura that seemed to lift him above the mundane world.
However, his aged features were hard to conceal, adding a sense of twilight years to his otherworldly demeanor.
Elder Bai, the ancestral patriarch of the Lin Family, and the patriarch of the Changyun Clan were all contemporaries and good friends with a close relationship.
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan had previously, due to his short remaining lifespan, intended to forcefully act to kill Ye Mingyi using his last years.
It was the ancestor of the Lin Family who had advised against it, causing the Changyun Clan’s patriarch to change his mind.
In the end, it was Lin Jing who had crafted a Flawless grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir that temporarily resolved the lifespan crisis of the Changyun Clan’s patriarch.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.сᴑ
Since Elder Bai was from the same era, it was likely that his remaining lifespan was not much either, which explained his aged appearance.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, Elder Bai immediately showed a warm smile, examining Lin Jing carefully:
“I’ve heard about you, you’re a child of the old Lin family…”
Lin Jing clasped his hands together and said to Elder Bai:
“Yes, Elder…”
Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing, nodding with satisfaction:
“Good…
good…”
“Although Old Lin is no longer with us, as long as you are here, the Lin Family still exists, and that’s good…”
No sooner had Elder Bai finished speaking, than Lin Jing took out an unimposing looking treasure box and handed it to Elder Bai:
“Elder Bai…”
“This is from Elder Changyun for you.”
Elder Bai looked curiously at the treasure box in Lin Jing’s hand, but accepted it nonetheless:
“What’s inside here?”
Taking the treasure box, Elder Bai didn’t open it right away, instead asking Lin Jing first.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing directly said:
“An Ascension Pill!”
“An Ascension Pill?” Elder Bai, upon hearing this, was immediately astonished.
Lin Jing nodded, then added:
“This was crafted by my ancestor, a failed Ascension Pill.
Elder Changyun asked me to pass it on to you so that you might study it, in hopes of being able to craft a genuine Ascension Pill in the future.”
Subsequently, Elder Bai opened the treasure box, and saw the half-pill emitting a rainbow glow lying inside.
At this moment, Lin Jing spoke again to Elder Bai:
“The calamity that nearly destroyed my Lin Family was because of this Ascension Pill.”
“My ancestor said the reason the Ascension Pill failed was due to the lack of a certain Immortal Yuan.
Only by infusing an Immortal Yuan during the crafting process could the Ascension Pill truly succeed.”
“Now, this pill possesses the ability to enhance Cultivation, but it cannot help one cross the divide between the mortal and the immortal realms.”
Elder Bai observed the pill in his hand for a long time before finally shifting his gaze away, then he said to Lin Jing:
“Initially…”
“When Old Lin decided to craft the Ascension Pill, I was quite skeptical, but his mind was made up and no one could dissuade him.”
“Although this pill failed, I must admit, Old Lin had more foresight and strength than I…”
“All these years, I’ve been searching for a way to achieve immortality, but after so many years of searching, I found that no method could break the insurmountable divide between the mortal and immortal realms.”
“Only this Ascension Pill holds a slim chance.”
“It seems now, Old Lin had indeed led us on the most correct path.”
“Ah…”
Elder Bai sighed, then closed the treasure box again.
Next, Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing and spoke again:
“We’ll explore the matter of this Ascension Pill further when we meet Elder Hong later.
For now, let’s talk about you…”
“How have you been feeling in the Elixir Alliance lately?”
“I also heard from Elder Qi that you went to help the Shi Family with alchemy, right!”
Lin Jing nodded and replied:
“Yes, Elder Bai.”
“I have just returned from alchemy work at the Shi Family.”
“And during this time in the Elixir Alliance, things have been quite satisfactory.”
Just as Lin Jing finished speaking, Elder Qi then said:
“Grand Elder…”
“Lin Jing was recently promoted to an Eighth Grade Alchemist; I think it might be time to arrange for his formal assessment.”
Upon hearing what Elder Qi said, Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing with surprise:
“You’re already an Eighth Grade Alchemist?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded:
“Yes, Elder.”
“It was good luck that I advanced to the Eighth Grade not long ago.”
After thinking for a moment, Elder Bai then said:
“Due to the upcoming Alchemy Conference, things will be quite busy.”
“So…”
“Let’s wait until the Alchemy Conference is nearly over before conducting the assessment for an Eighth Grade Alchemist.”
After finishing, Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing and asked:
“What do you think?”
Lin Jing replied:
“I will follow your decision, Elder.”
Elder Bai nodded, then said to Elder Qi:
“Since Lin Jing has decided on the assessment, after you return, explain to him the details concerning the assessment.”
Elder Qi nodded: “Alright…”
…
…
Not staying long with Elder Bai, the Hierarch of the Elixir Alliance soon arrived to discuss matters of the Alchemy Conference with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 859
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 859: Chapter 383: Inner Sea Matters Concluded, Alchemy Conference Begins_2 Chapter 859: Chapter 383: Inner Sea Matters Concluded, Alchemy Conference Begins_2 Lin Jing and Elder Qi said their farewells and returned to their cave abode.
In the following period, as the Alchemy Conference drew near, the activities within the Elixir Alliance became even busier.
Of course, apart from Elder Qi and Lin Jing’s group of three.
It seemed like everyone else had forgotten them, completely ignoring their existence.
It had to be said that at this time, Lin Jing truly appreciated the benefits of being under Elder Qi’s tutelage; even now, in such circumstances, nobody disturbed them.
Of course, this was also because Elder Qi had very few disciples; even with Lin Jing and the others added, they couldn’t have been of much help.
It would be better to just let them do as they pleased.
...
Just like that…
Time slowly passed, and in no time, half a month had elapsed, and the Alchemy Conference was about to begin.
At that moment, Lu Youjiu and Lin Jue, among others, arrived.
Moreover, they weren’t the only ones; even the patriarch of the Changyun Clan had come with them to the Elixir Alliance.
Seeing the patriarch of the Changyun Clan, Lin Jing was extremely shocked, not expecting that he too would come.
Changyun Yuanshuang hurriedly explained to Lin Jing, and after the explanations, Lin Jing understood.
The conflict in the Inner Sea had ended, allowing the patriarch of the Changyun Clan to leave his family and meet his old friend, Elder Bai.
In this conflict, the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan eventually emerged victorious.
Previously, Ye Mingyi had infiltrated the Seven Seas Hall and, after centuries of plotting within, finally ascended to the position of Supreme Elder.
Moreover, with decades of scheming, he had gained the support of the majority and seized most of the power of the Seven Seas Hall.
In his quest to annihilate the Changyun Clan completely, he had deployed all his resources in an uncompromising extermination plan.
Unfortunately, his final strategy to divide the Shocking Seas Alliance did not succeed, allowing them to ally with the Changyun Clan.
The two factions faced each other as equals.
As the strengths of both sides were fairly matched, both suffered losses during the conflict.
The Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan had already integrated and united, seldom harboring any dissent.
The Seven Seas Hall, however, was different.
Initially, they had disagreements, and it was only through throwing out huge benefits that Ye Mingyi was able to temporarily control the situation.
Now, with such substantial losses, the people of the Seven Seas Hall were disheartened and no longer loyal to Ye Mingyi.
The original lineage of the Hall Master took this opportunity to regain control of the Seven Seas Hall and expelled Ye Mingyi from their ranks.
Meanwhile, the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance seized the opportunity to find Ye Mingyi and severely injure him.
Unfortunately, Ye Mingyi was too cunning; despite many men deployed, they still failed to capture him, letting him escape.
However…
Although Ye Mingyi had escaped, he was surrounded and severely wounded by the patriarch of the Changyun Clan and others from the family, causing his Cultivation to fall into the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, never to regain his former Mahayana Cultivator’s grandeur again.
If nothing unexpected happens, Ye Mingyi’s life would likely never recover, nor could he pose any further threat to them.
Therefore, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan dared to leave and come here.
Hearing of Ye Mingyi’s escape, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel it was a pity.
He didn’t expect that guy to have escaped.
Given Ye Mingyi’s nature, he would definitely bide his time again, figuring out a way to covertly strike at the Changyun Clan.
After all, that had been his approach before.
Regarding this,
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan was very aware, and although he had come to the Eastern Spirit Realm, other members of the Changyun Clan, the Shocking Seas Alliance, and even the Seven Seas Hall were all searching for his whereabouts.
Once they found him, his death was certain.
…
After their reunion, since the patriarch of the Changyun Clan wanted to meet with Elder Bai, he didn’t stay long with these younger ones, but went directly to find Elder Bai.
Only Lu Youjiu and a few others like Lin Jue remained, brought back by Lin Jing to his own cave abode.
Having not seen each other for a long time, they inevitably spoke about their recent experiences.
Lu Youjiu and the others were doing well, mixing well in the Spiritual Mist Holy Sect, and their Cultivation had also improved.
During this time, Lin Jue’s Alchemy Dao Cultivation had also significantly improved, and she had even registered to participate in this Alchemy Conference.
Lin Jue attended the conference not for any other reason, but to broaden his horizons and see how he measured up against others.
For this, Lin Jing naturally offered his full support.
Moreover, it wasn’t just Lin Jue who participated in the Alchemy Conference, Changyun Yuanshuang also joined in the excitement.
She signed up as well.
Although Changyun Yuanshuang’s Alchemic Talent wasn’t as strong as Changyun Yuanlei’s, she had already become a Sixth Grade Pill Master.
Participating in this Alchemy Conference also brought great benefits to Changyun Yuanshuang, hence the Changyun Clan’s elder naturally wouldn’t refuse.
If it weren’t for the fact that disciples who had already joined the Elixir Alliance couldn’t participate again, even Changyun Yuanlei would have wanted to try his luck.
…
Time quickly passed, and a few more days elapsed.
ƝονǤο.ᴄ0
The Alchemy Conference started on schedule.
Lin Jue and Changyun Yuanshuang went to attend the Alchemy Conference together, but Lin Jing didn’t go to the conference site.
In recent days, Elder Qi had procured several materials for Eighth Grade Elixir Medicines for Lin Jing, intending to mentor him before the assessment for Eighth Grade Pill Masters began.
Honestly, this was the first time Lin Jing had received guidance from Elder Qi since he had joined Elder Qi’s mentorship.
Thus, both of these individuals spent several days consecutively immersed in the Alchemy Room.
Only when they had transformed all the materials into Elixir Medicine did they leave the Alchemy Room.
Upon leaving the Alchemy Room, Elder Qi looked at Lin Jing with a very affirmative tone,
“You really have an amazing talent.
By the time we meet again, I think I should call you Elder Lin.”
To which Lin Jing respectfully replied to Elder Qi,
“But in my heart, you will always be my mentor.”
Elder Qi’s eyes revealed a trace of gratification, then he turned and left.
Lin Jing then bowed deeply towards the departing Elder Qi.
During these days, Elder Qi had generously imparted all his understanding of Alchemy Dao to Lin Jing.
Although Lin Jing had the Lin Family legacy and the support of the System, he had never had a guiding teacher in Alchemy Dao before.
Elder Qi was indeed the first.
It could be said that with the experience of these past few days, Lin Jing was now nearly certain of his success in the assessment, even without activating Bonus Attachment.
After exiting, just as Lin Jing returned to his abode, he encountered Lu Youjiu and others who were preparing to watch the Alchemy Dao Conference.
The Alchemy Dao Conference had already started while Lin Jing was with Elder Qi refining pills and had held two rounds.
Most participants had already been eliminated.
They had reached the competition for the top two hundred places.
The upcoming third round was the contention between these top two hundred.
After this round, half would be eliminated, leaving only the last one hundred to compete.
At this time, Lu Youjiu and others were about to watch this third round of competition, also to cheer for Lin Jue and Changyun Yuanshuang.
Lin Jue hadn’t been performing well in the recent matches due to Lin Jing’s absence.
Thus, seeing Lin Jing return just in time, Lu Youjiu and others quickly dragged Lin Jing to the competition venue.
Having just completed his pill refinement, it was a good time for Lin Jing to relax, and since Lin Jue was participating in this Alchemy Conference, he felt he should definitely go and support her.
Thus, Lin Jing gladly agreed and joined Lu Youjiu and the others to the competition venue.
The site of the Alchemy Conference was originally a plaza, but to facilitate the smooth running of the Conference, the surface of the entire venue was elevated and crafted into a huge arena by spells.
Moreover,
the arena was enveloped by a massive Formation, preventing anyone from causing disturbances within.
As the group arrived at the venue of the Alchemy Conference, the event hadn’t officially started yet.
But by then, it was already bustling with people, creating a sea of humanity.
After entering the venue, Lu Youjiu led the way, guiding Lin Jing to a corner at the top with an expansive view of the entire competition arena.
After securing their spots, they then waited there for the third round of the competition to commence…

chapters.title: Chapter 860
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 860: Chapter 384: Holy Maiden of Yun Tian Xian Sect Chapter 860: Chapter 384: Holy Maiden of Yun Tian Xian Sect As time slowly passed, the start of the Alchemy Conference drew near.
The number of people at the venue also increased, quickly filling up the entire place.
Then, after a short while, the competing Pill Masters gradually entered the venue.
Among these people were naturally Lin Jue and Changyun Yuanshuang.
Upon entering the venue, they quickly scanned the stands, searching for Lin Jing and others.
Soon, Changyun Yuanshuang spotted them and pulled Lin Jue aside to point out their location.
Following Changyun Yuanshuang’s gaze, Lin Jue caught sight of Lin Jing and excitedly waved at him, greeting him.
...
Lin Jing also smiled and waved back in response.
Afterward, all two hundred competing Pill Masters entered, and the leader of the Elixir Alliance, along with several Elders, also arrived at the venue.
Upon the arrival of the Alliance Hierarch, a formidable aura surged out, instantly quieting the noisy venue.
This was already the third round of the competition, and the rules had been explained before the first contest, so there was no need for repetition.
Then…
The Alliance Hierarch spoke up, declaring the start of this round.
After announcing the start of the competition, the surrounding Elders dispersed, each taking up positions at different points.
At the same time, the Elders acted, and suddenly a massive Formation appeared out of nowhere, enveloping the Alchemy Conference contest area.
This prevented those observing from influencing the competition inside.
At this moment,
the two hundred participants had already taken out their respective Pill Furnaces, standing by at their positions.
The Elders who had just arrived began distributing the necessary materials for Alchemy to the competitors.
Lin Jing, at this moment, surveyed the contest area, which was vast enough to accommodate two hundred participants without feeling crowded.
These two hundred participants hailed from various parts of the Eastern Spirit Realm, and naturally, their Alchemy Dao cultivation varied.
The content of this third assessment was the same for allâ€” the challenge required crafting a Fifth Grade Elixir Medicine.
For the contenders present, Fifth Grade Elixir Medicine was quite manageable, as anyone who had reached this stage was at least a Fifth Grade Alchemist.
Despite it being Fifth Grade Elixir Medicine, the requirements were not low.
The competition demanded that each participant must create at least one Supreme Grade and one Superior Grade Elixir Medicine.
Faced with these requirements, some participants clearly felt tense, while others appeared confidently assured.
Both Lin Jue and Changyun Yuanshuang, being Sixth Grade Alchemists, naturally appeared very confident facing this challenge.
As Lin Jing observed the contest area, Yan Wanfei beside him continued pointing out individuals, introducing them to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin…”
“The positions of those on stage are based on the rankings from the last competition.”
“See those at the very front?
Those standing there are the hottest candidates for the top three spots in this contest.”
Lin Jing followed the direction pointed out by Yan Wanfei.
He saw that the few people in the front row all appeared confident.
Yan Wanfei then pointed to a man in purple robes standing third in line and began introducing him to Lin Jing:
“Look at the one in the purple clothes; he is the son of the Sect Master of the Ziyun Pill Sect.
His Alchemy Dao cultivation is extraordinary.
There are rumors that he is actually a Seventh Grade Pill Master, although he has not yet revealed his true level of Alchemy Dao cultivation.”
“He passed the previous two contests quite easily.”
Lin Jing nodded slightly as he looked towards the man in purple.
At that moment, Yan Wanfei pointed to a man beside the one in purple, speaking again:
“And him…”
“He is a Loose Cultivator but is said to have received an ancient Daoist Alchemy inheritance which caused his Alchemy Dao cultivation to advance by leaps and bounds.
He is now a Seventh Grade Alchemist.”
Lin Jing turned his head in the direction Yan Wanfei had indicated, seeing a stern-faced young man dressed in black robes.
This young man had caught Lin Jing’s attention earlier; he had remained in that spot since entering the venue and had not interacted with anyone.
Next to him, the person in the first place was a woman.
Her figure was graceful, dressed in a plain white dress, her demeanor ethereal, almost like a heavenly maiden stepping into the mortal world.
However, her face was covered with a light white veil, hiding her true appearance from view.
This woman had caught Lin Jing’s attention as soon as she entered the venue.
It wasn’t for any particular reason, but Lin Jing sensed a familiar aura emanating from her.
After considering it for a long time, Lin Jing was certain that he had never met this woman before, and they shouldn’t know each other.
Yet, for some reason, she gave him a sense of familiarity.
Lin Jing had also extended his Divine Sense, trying to discern her true face beneath the veil, but the veil seemed to be an incredible Daoist Treasure, impervious even to Lin Jing’s strong Divine Sense from the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
At that moment, Yan Wanfei spoke up, saying to Lin Jing:
“Brother Lin…”
“It seems you are quite interested in the Holy Maiden of Yunxian Sect; you’ve been looking at her several times.
Did you know her before?”
Upon Yan Wanfei’s words, Lin Jing suddenly understood that this woman was the Holy Maiden of Yunxian Sect.
ƝᴑνǤᴑ.сο
Lin Jing shook his head, saying,
“I have never met her before.”

chapters.title: Chapter 861
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 861: Chapter 384 Holy Maiden of Cloud Sky Immortal Sect_2 Chapter 861: Chapter 384 Holy Maiden of Cloud Sky Immortal Sect_2 Yan Wanfei nodded, then continued,
“The Holy Maiden of Yunxian Sect is truly incredibleâ€”a genius among geniuses.
In the previous two contests, she completely overshadowed the son of the Ziyun Pill Sect Sect Master and the Seventh Grade Pill Master Loose Cultivator, securing first place in the competitions.”
“If there are no surprises this time, she is bound to be the first-place winner of this contest.”
Hearing this, Holaw Three Rivers curled his lip and then turned to ask Yan Wanfei,
“If the Holy Maiden of Yunxian Sect is a genius among geniuses, then what about Brother Lin?”
“You must know that Brother Lin is also under three hundred years old, yet he is already an Eighth Grade Alchemist.
If not for the fact that he has already joined the Elixir Alliance, he would be eligible to participate in this Alchemy Competition.”
“Moreover, Brother Lin is not only an Eighth Grade Alchemist, but also a powerhouse at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage before the age of three hundred.
What do you say to that?”
Yan Wanfei was taken aback upon hearing this.
After a while, Yan Wanfei glanced at Lin Jing beside him and then said with a bitter face,
“That’s entirely different, isn’t it!”
“She’s merely a genius among geniuses, but Brother Lin is a freak among freaks.
How can they be compared?”
“Think back to when we were in the Southern Outer Sea, we were all just at the Golden Core stage of cultivation…”
“How long has it been since then?”“I’ve only just entered the Divinity Transformation Stage, while Brother Lin has already become a Transcendance Tribulation Stage expert that we can only look up to.”
“Who can compare to him?
Who dares to compare with Brother Lin?”
With that, Yan Wanfei changed the subject and said to Holaw Three Rivers,
“You should be extremely grateful now, it’s because of my simple and honest nature that I was able to hit it off with Brother Lin from the first meeting and become friends.”
“Otherwise, with your straightforward and stubborn temperament, you would’ve offended countless people by now.”
Holaw Three Rivers, upon hearing this, pursed his lips, offering no rebuttal.
...
When he first met Lin Jing, Holaw Three Rivers was indeed wary of him.
After all, it was their first meeting and they were strangers; it was natural to be cautious.
Furthermore, afterward, Holaw Three Rivers had specifically apologized for that incident, and it was already a thing of the past.
In contrast, Yan Wanfei’s honest nature was indeed rare in the Cultivation World.
However, having bickered for many years, Holaw Three Rivers rarely lost out and was not one to be suppressed by Yan Wanfei’s words, which was clearly not his style.
So,
Holaw Three Rivers looked at Yan Wanfei and spoke in a deep voice,
“I remember someone always wanting to ask Brother Lin for a sparring match…”
Upon hearing this, Yan Wanfei shook his head frantically,
“No…”
“I dare not, I’ve learned my lesson, please have mercy.”
…
…
The two enjoyed their banter, while Lin Jing and Lu Youjiu exchanged glances before helplessly shrugging.
Then, Lin Jing ignored the two of them and continued to watch the center of the arena.
At this moment, the distribution of the Alchemy Ingredients required by everyone for the contest was nearly complete, and the competition was about to truly begin.
But just then, Lin Jing suddenly felt a gaze on him.
Lin Jing followed the gaze and discovered that the person looking at him was none other than the Alliance Hierarch of the Elixir Alliance.
At this time…
The Alliance Hierarch was motioning for Lin Jing to come over.
Seeing this, Lin Jing nodded,
And after explaining to Lu Youjiu and the others, he rose to his feet and stepped forward.
The next moment…
Lin Jing appeared not far behind the Alliance Hierarch.
Seeing Lin Jing’s arrival, the Alliance Hierarch turned and said to him,
“Come…”
“Have a seat next to me.”
Lin Jing looked at the seats beside the Alliance Hierarch; they were arranged for the Elixir Alliance Elders serving as judges.
Since he was not yet an Elder, it seemed rather inappropriate to join them.
Thus, Lin Jing spoke up,
“Alliance Hierarch, I am currently just a disciple within the Elixir Alliance, this seems somewhat improper.”
The Alliance Hierarch was unperturbed and replied,
“There’s nothing wrong with that.
After all, you are now an Eighth Grade Alchemist and are about to participate in the Eighth Grade Alchemist assessment.
As long as you pass, you will be the ninth Elder of the Elixir Alliance.”
“Sitting with us, there’s nothing inappropriate about it.”
“Moreover…”
“I plan to let you participate in the judging of the upcoming event, so naturally, you’ll need to sit here.”
At this moment, the materials required for the Alchemy Competition had already been distributed, and several Elders had returned.
Seeing the Elders return, the Elixir Alliance Hierarch said to them:
“This is Lin Jing, who was previously under Elder Qi; I assume you’ve all met him before.”
“Now Lin Jing has been promoted to an Eighth Grade Alchemist and is about to undergo assessment.
If he passes, he will be our Elixir Alliance’s ninth Elder.”
“I would like to have him join us in judging this competition, what do you all think?”
Among the Elders present, other than the Grand Elder, Elder Bai, and Elder Qi, the rest were all there.
During his decades at the Elixir Alliance, though Lin Jing seldom ventured out, he had encountered and become acquainted with the others.
However, not many knew about Lin Jing’s promotion to Eighth Grade Alchemist, as the notice for this assessment was not issued long ago.
Moreover, due to the preparations for the Alchemy Competition, everyone had been too busy to take much notice of Lin Jing’s recent advancement.
Hearing this, the Elders all turned their gaze towards Lin Jing.
One of the white-bearded Elders even expressed his surprise:
“You’ve advanced to an Eighth Grade Alchemist so quickly.”
This Elder with the white beard was Elder Lei.
He too was an Alchemist from Yunxian Sect, and apart from being an Elder of the Elixir Alliance,
he was also the head of Yunxian Sect’s Elixir Hall.
At that moment, Lin Jing gave a respectful bow and said to the Elders:
“Greetings to the seniors…”
“It was really by chance that I managed to break through to the Eighth Grade not long ago.”
Another Elder, Elder Wen, nodded slightly at Lin Jing:
“The path of the Alchemy Dao grows ever more difficult the higher one ascends.”
“Especially the last two stages, advancing is incredibly tough, and there are many who remain stuck there, never able to make further progress for the rest of their lives.”
“Since you were able to break through, it surely wasn’t just luck.
Aside from diligence, your innate and exceptional Alchemic Talent must have played a significant role.”
After Elder Wen finished speaking, the others also voiced their agreement.
Especially the previously mentioned Elder Lei, who slapped his forehead and said with a laugh:
“I almost forgot, you come from an extraordinary background, and your Alchemic Talent is astounding.
Advancing to Eighth Grade Alchemist really isn’t a difficult task for you.”
With that said, Elder Lei directly addressed the Alliance Hierarch:
“I have no objections!”
“If this young man has already reached the Eighth Grade, then let him join us in the judging.”
Following Elder Lei’s remarks, the other Elders also expressed their agreement.
Subsequently,
Lin Jing no longer demurred and walked forward to take his place in the seats reserved for the judging panel of Elixir Alliance Elders.
…
Lin Jing’s action immediately caused a stir, as the seat he took was almost equivalent to that of an Elixir Alliance Elder.
People observed that Lin Jing seemed quite young and were surprised, speculating about his background.
Of course,
There were others who knew Lin Jing, such as Lu Youjiu and his companions, who were aware of Lin Jing’s status as an Eighth Grade Alchemist and were not too astonished that he took that seat.
Even other disciples within the Elixir Alliance were shocked to see Lin Jing sitting there, secretly wondering
if the Elixir Alliance was about to gain another Elder…
And it wasn’t just the audience watching the Alchemy Competition; even the participants in the arena turned their gazes towards the scene.
Feeling their eyes on him, Lin Jing then looked down at the crowd.
In most of their eyes, there was bewilderment.
Of course, some people didn’t care and were planning their strategies for the upcoming alchemy process while looking at the Alchemy Ingredients in front of them.
Lin Jing also saw Lin Jue.
When Lin Jue noticed Lin Jing looking over, he smiled and waved.
Lin Jing smiled back and nodded slightly.
Then, Lin Jing shifted his gaze to the forefront, where the most likely contenders for the top three spots were.
They seemed not to be paying much attention to what was happening here.
Except for one…
It was the masked Holy Maiden from Yunxian Sect, who was now looking in his direction…

chapters.title: Chapter 862
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 862: Chapter 385: The End of the Third Contest Chapter 862: Chapter 385: The End of the Third Contest However, when Lin Jing turned his head to look at her, she quickly turned away as if she dared not meet his gaze.
This action by the Holy Maiden of the Tianyun Holy Sect left Lin Jing perplexed.
Could it be that she knew him?
Just as Lin Jing was puzzled, Elder Lei, who sat next to him, stood up and announced the start of the third Alchemy Conference.
As soon as Elder Lei finished speaking, the Pill Masters participating in the conference below began to take action.
And the Cultivators watching the conference in the stands were also drawn in, turning their attention to the events unfolding.
Elder Lei looked around and then sat down.
...
As soon as he sat down, Elder Lei leaned close to Lin Jing and said,
“Lin lad…”
“Earlier, I saw you looking at our Tianyun Holy Sect’s Holy Maiden, do you perhaps know her?”
As soon as Elder Lei finished speaking, Lin Jing quickly responded,
“Senior misunderstands, we have never met face-to-face, I am just a bit curious.”
Elder Lei nodded upon hearing this and then looked towards the Holy Maiden,
“This young girl has lived in our Tianyun Holy Sect since childhood and is dearly loved by everyone in the sect.”
“To tell you the truth, she is also an exceptionally talented in Alchemy Dao.If nothing unexpected occurs, she is certainly expected to place in the top three of this competition, and might even win the championship.”
However, just at that moment, Elder Lei suddenly changed his tone,
“Initially…”
“This young lady’s talent is astonishing, and she is the pride of everyone in our Tianyun Holy Sect.
ṅοѵǤᴑ.сο
Even I have high hopes for her.”
As he said this, Elder Lei looked at Lin Jing as if he were seeing some incredible creature, sizing him up and down before sighing deeply,
“But compared to you, her Alchemic Talent seems rather insignificant.”
“I truly don’t know what kind of monstrous talent you are to have advanced so quickly.”
After saying this, without waiting for Lin Jing to respond, Elder Lei continued talking and asked Lin Jing,
“Speaking of which…”
“I remember you’re also not yet three hundred years old, right?”
As Elder Lei spoke these words, the other Elders also looked over.
Facing the Elders’ gazes, Lin Jing felt somewhat uneasy and could only give a forced smile, saying to Elder Lei,
“Yes, senior…”
Elder Lei, undeterred, nodded slightly,
“Under three hundred years old, an Eighth Grade Pill Master, and also Cultivation…”
“Cough…”
Elder Lei was saying this when the Elixir Alliance Hierarch, sitting in the middle, coughed lightly and then spoke,
“Regarding Lin Jing’s real age and Cultivation, Elder Bai informed you a few days ago, do not forget it.”
Hearing this, Elder Lei hastily fell silent and then gave an embarrassed smile,
“A slip of the tongue, my apologies…”
“Alliance Hierarch, please rest assured, this matter will not be disclosed.”
After this reminder from the Alliance Hierarch, the other Elders no longer continued to focus on Lin Jing, instead turning their heads to watch the events in the pavilion.
Only Elder Lei, at this moment, leaned close to Lin Jing and whispered,
“Lin lad, what do you think of our Tianyun Holy Sect’s Holy Maiden?
Are you interested in becoming our Tianyun Holy Sect’s son-in-law?”
Elder Lei’s words were so sudden that Lin Jing, caught off guard, even choked on his breath.
“Cough…cough…”
Lin Jing had to cough twice and tried to ease the awkwardness,
“Senior jests…”
But hearing this, another Elder named Li beside Elder Lei turned his head, looking towards Elder Lei teasingly,
“With your entire Tianyun Holy Sect treasuring this young maiden so much, are you really willing to give her away?”
Elder Lei responded,
“How is it giving her away?
Didn’t I just say, we’d take Lin lad as our Tianyun Holy Sect’s son-in-law.”
“With Lin lad’s talent, he is more than a match for our Holy Maiden.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Li rolled his eyes,
“You really know how to wish for the best…”
“With Lin lad’s talent, not to mention your Tianyun Holy Sect, which force in the entire Cultivation World wouldn’t scramble to have him?”
“If Lin lad is willing to come to our Qinglin Daoist Institute, we would immediately regard him as our Daoist Disciple, and even directly groom him as the next leader.”
As the two spoke freely, Lin Jing, caught in the middle, once again attracted the attention of the other Elders.
However, their conversation also prompted another reminder from the Alliance Hierarch,
“Both of you, that’s enough…”
“Lin Jing has his legacy, and won’t join any of your Sects.
Right now, the competition is underway; let’s focus on the contest and drop the matter of Lin Jing.
No further discussion is needed.”
Following the Alliance Hierarch’s remarks, the two immediately behaved and turned their attention back to the pavilion.
Lin Jing also breathed a sigh of relief and directed his attention to the pavilion.
At this point, the competition had just begun; everyone was engaged in the first step of Alchemy, performing initial Refinement on the materials they had just received.
Among the competitors, their Cultivation varied widely, and even the flames they wielded differed.
Some participants used only the flames controlled by Cultivators themselves and began Alchemy with at most one Art of Fire Control.
Others, backed by powerful forces, had obtained special flames, enhancing the strength of their fire.
Consequently, their Refinement speeds also varied.
Soon…
Someone completed the Refinement of materials, and this individual was none other than the Holy Maiden of the Tianyun Holy Sect.
Following her completion of Refinement, the Sect Master’s son from Ziyun Pill Sect and the Loose Cultivator also quickly finished their Refinement.

chapters.title: Chapter 863
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 863: Chapter 385: The End of the Third Match_2 Chapter 863: Chapter 385: The End of the Third Match_2 The three individuals, whether in terms of controlling the flame or their cultivation, were fairly similar; hence, naturally, the time it took to complete the refinement was also nearly the same.
Almost immediately after each other, all three had completed the initial refinement of their ingredients.
After completing the initial refinement, the real alchemy began.
Once all three were prepared and had started the alchemy process, other participants gradually finished refining their ingredients.
After the refinement was completed, no one dared to delay further; they immediately placed the ingredients into the Pill Furnace and began crafting the elixirs.
…
…
...
The competitors were all in the same square, and although everyone’s position was protected by a small Formation,
having so many people conducting alchemy in the same area was bound to cause some interference.
Initially, when the alchemy began, the differences among the participants were not significant, and everyone looked competent.
But after some time, the gaps began to emerge.
Those positioned at the front appeared more stable, each methodically following their usual steps to craft the Elixir Medicine.
However, towards the back of the venue, some Pill Masters, whether due to nerves or something else, began to panic.
Not long after, with a loud “bang,”
someone failed to control the temperature and accidentally caused their furnace to explode.The ingredients provided by the Alchemy Dao Assembly were limited to one batch per person; a furnace explosion meant elimination.
The Cultivator whose furnace had exploded stood frozen on the spot until after a while before he finally snapped out of it.
Then, a disciple from the Elixir Alliance, who had been prepared for such incidents, stepped forward and escorted him out of the competition venue.
That loud bang, as if it were a signal,
was followed by a few more explosions, with several more Cultivators causing their furnaces to explode during the process.
In just an hour, more than a dozen people had left the competition venue.
