To collect these two World Seeds, Lin Jing must first know their precise locations and all related information.
The collection within the Scripture Pavilion of the Elixir Alliance could be compared with those long-inherited top Sects, and the records regarding the Nanming Domain and Immortal Crossing Island therein must also be abundant.
Lin Jing only needed to find the information he was searching for here, and then he could set off to return to the Southern Outer Sea.
“Elder Lin…”
Upon arriving at the Scripture Pavilion, the disciple guarding the pavilion saw Lin Jing and hastily paid respect.
Lin Jing nodded and then proceeded upstairs in the Scripture Pavilion.
The Scripture Pavilion had a total of seven floors, and as an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, Lin Jing naturally had unimpeded access and could go anywhere.
After arriving at the Scripture Pavilion, Lin Jing didn’t stop anywhere else and directly headed to the seventh floor.
Because the information Lin Jing wanted to examine concerned the million-year-old calamity and the secrets of Immortal Crossing Island.
Such confidential materials would certainly not be kept elsewhere.
They could only be on the seventh floor of the Scripture Pavilion.
Each floor of the Scripture Pavilion is protected by a Formation that could only be accessed with an Identity Token.
Nevertheless, as an Elder of the Elixir Alliance with an Elder Token in hand, Lin Jing naturally passed through unhindered.
Ascending, Lin Jing quickly arrived at the seventh floor.
Here, in the middle, was a massive circular bookshelf safeguarded by a Formation.
This bookshelf, neat up and down, was arranged with numerous slots, each holding a Jade Slip.
Furthermore, each Jade Slip was labeled with its contents.
Lin Jing then began to search around this circular bookshelf.
Soon after, he found several Jade Slips that contained records about the Nanming Domain and Immortal Crossing Island and used his Elder Token to open the Formation, retrieving them.
Taking out the Jade Slip labeled “South Continent Geography Record,” Lin Jing immediately activated his Divine Sense and delved into it.
Before, in those three frames, the Immortal City Lin Jing saw, he did not yet know what place it was, so naturally, he needed to identify it first.
Only then could he confirm its location and search for the Samsara Holy Fruit.
After the Divine Sense entered the Jade Slip, what Lin Jing saw was an immense map replicating the Nanming Domain in reduced scale, with every location clearly labeled.
The map, clear and easy to understand, was quite straightforward.
Lin Jing then began to examine the map.
Yet, as the map was so extensive, finding what he was looking for wasn’t that easy.
So…
Lin Jing started from the areas he was familiar with and gradually narrowed his search for the Immortal City with the immense statues.
…
After some time passed in his search, Lin Jing finally found a similar Immortal City marked on the map.
Primordial Immortal City.

chapters.title: Chapter 874
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 874: Chapter 391: Samsara Holy Fruit and Immortal Crossing Island Chapter 874: Chapter 391: Samsara Holy Fruit and Immortal Crossing Island Upon sighting the Primordial Immortal City, Lin Jing also spotted some records about it.
“The Primordial Immortal City, its founding era unknown, was the place of cultivation for the world’s first Cultivator to ascend before his ascension.
After he ascended, the people established this city in remembrance of him.”
At the same time, the map within the Jade Slip also held illustrations and descriptions of this statue.
The statue in the Primordial Immortal City represents the very first Cultivator in the Cultivation World who ascended.
ɴ0νǤᴑ.сο
However, no one knows his true face, so the face of the statue is blank, having a form yet lacking features.
Though faceless, Lin Jing could still discern from the statue’s silhouette that this indeed was the same statue featured in the first of the three scenes he had previously seen.
...
And the map revealed herein, though slightly different from that first scene’s Immortal City, had no major differences overall.
It could thus be seen that the Immortal City featured in that first scene must be the Primordial Immortal City.
After identifying the Immortal City in the scene, Lin Jing then proceeded to study the entire map, noting the location of the Primordial Immortal City.
Having noted down the exact location of the Primordial Immortal City, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense from the Jade Slip.
Now that he had determined the position of the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing had another issue to clarify…
The reason the Samsara Holy Fruit had turned the entire South Continent’s Domain of Ming into a ‘Nether Realm’ was primarily due to the fruit’s power to devour Vitality.
Under the Samsara Holy Fruit’s consumption, not a single creature could survive within the Barren Forbidden Zone, let alone living beings, not even ordinary flowers, grass, or trees could live there.
Within the entirety of the Barren Forbidden Zone, nothing remained but desolation and ruin, except for the Yin Spirits trapped by the Samsara Holy Fruit, unable to escape.
To obtain the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing also needed to understand just how terrifying the fruit’s Vitality consuming power was.
Although the System Space could actively collect the Samsara Holy Fruit, to do so, he first had to approach the fruit to enable the System’s collection.
Lin Jing had previously heard that after the calamity unfolded in the South Continent’s Domain of Ming, many Cultivators went to investigate, but none could enter within a certain range of the Samsara Holy Fruit, due to its terrifying Vitality-devouring power.
In the end, continuous exploration became impossible, and everyone had to give up.
Next on Lin Jing’s agenda was to check the exploration records relating to the Barren Forbidden Zone.
…
…
After reviewing several Jade Slips, Lin Jing finally found what he had hoped forâ€”the records of explorations into the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Greatly pleased, Lin Jing quickly began to examine them.
In these records, Lin Jing finally found the documented speed of the Samsara Holy Fruit’s devouring of Vitality.
These records were also calculated based on lifespan, the same method that Lin Jing previously used when venturing into the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Previously inside the Barren Forbidden Zone, Lin Jing estimated that having spent just over three months there, upon checking the System panel, he discovered he had consumed ten years of his lifespan.
The ratio, when calculated, was roughly 1:40.
To stay one day in the Barren Forbidden Zone was actually equivalent to the loss of forty days of Lifespan.
And in the documented Jade Slip, Lin Jing saw a more detailed record.
The rate at which Samsara Holy Fruit devoured Vitality differed with distance; the closer one was to the fruit, the faster the Vitality would be devoured.
Following the exploration of the Barren Forbidden Zone, those who had investigated gathered to specifically discuss this issue.
They then divided the entire Barren Forbidden Zone into three regions.
These three regions were the outer perimeter, the inner area, and the core.
The outer perimeter had the slowest Vitality-devouring rate, and the lowest lifespan consumption proportion, reaching at most 1:100.
For those who ventured into the exploration with tens of thousands of years of lifespan, they could tolerate this ratio.
However, upon entering the inner area, the proportion increased, ranging from 1:100 to 1:1000 within this region.
Staying a day inside this area could consume up to three years of lifespan.
Even those top-tier Cultivators who went to probe did not dare to squander their lifespan so; hence most stopped at this point.
Only a handful dared to continue probing further into the interior.
Finally, there was the core region’s Vitality consumption; within the core region, everyone could feel their Vitality being continuously drawn out of their bodies.
And the rate at which it was being drawn was incredibly terrifying.
Back then, those few remaining individuals endured their Vitality being devoured as they sought to delve deeper into the core region to continue their investigation.
It was a shame, however, that as they advanced further inward, the devouring force became increasingly terrifying, until, at a considerable distance from the Primordial Immortal City,
They could only catch a glimpse of the Samsara Holy Fruit from afar, realizing at this point that the Vitality-devouring force had become exceedingly frightening.
It had even reached a ratio of one to several hundred thousand.
Meaning, staying there for just one day would diminish their lifespan by a thousand years.
Even with such a devouring speed, they could only barely see the Samsara Holy Fruit, with its true distance still afar.
By this time, they realized that even with their Cultivation, they could not venture any further.
Even though the distance required only an instant to close,
Once they neared the Samsara Holy Fruit, they couldn’t endure the horrifying force of Vitality consumption.

chapters.title: Chapter 875
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 875: Chapter 391: Samsara Holy Fruit and Immortal Crossing Island_2 Chapter 875: Chapter 391: Samsara Holy Fruit and Immortal Crossing Island_2 So, the crowd no longer took risks.
After glancing at the Samsara Holy Fruit, they quickly left.
Leaving the Barren Forbidden Zone, they each returned home and recorded what they had seen and heard for future generations.
Coincidentally, at the time, there was an elder from the Elixir Alliance who was one of the few who ventured into the Barren Forbidden Zone.
The records left in the Elixir Alliance about the Barren Forbidden Zone and the Samsara Holy Fruit were from his hand.
However…
The Jade Slip Lin Jing was reading was not the original one left by the elder who had entered the Barren Forbidden Zone.
...
Due to the passage of time, the original recorded scrolls had long been damaged; what Lin Jing was seeing was compiled by later generations.
Nevertheless, it was sufficient, and Lin Jing did indeed find some of the information he wanted.
To others, this Vitality Devouring Power might be an unsolvable problem.
But for Lin Jing, it was not without a solution.
Lin Jing possessed System Space; although the Vitality Devouring Power of the Samsara Holy Fruit was terrifying, it could not affect the inside of the System Space.
As long as Lin Jing was inside the System Space, he could resolve the issue of Vitality Devouring.
Additionally, the System Space possessed a Fixed-Point Teleportation Function, allowing Lin Jing to simply use this feature.
He just needed to enter the space immediately after teleporting, staying outside the System Space as little as possible, thus minimizing the cost of obtaining the Samsara Holy Fruit.
It could be said that as long as the Samsara Holy Fruit did not devour all vitality instantaneously, it could not pose a real threat to Lin Jing.
According to the information Lin Jing found, the process of the Samsara Holy Fruit devouring vitality was gradual, not instantaneous.
That’s right…
Besides the Vitality Devouring of the Samsara Holy Fruit, another threat existed in the Barren Forbidden Zone of the Nanming Domain, the Yin Spirits.
Millions of years after the disaster, Yin Spirits did not appear immediately; they started to emerge hundreds of years after the disaster.
Thus, during their initial exploration, there was no threat from the Yin Spirits, but Lin Jing, if he were to enter the Barren Forbidden Zone, had to be careful.
However.
Lin Jing possessed System Space, so the threat from the Yin Spirits was similarly minimal for him.
After reviewing the records related to the Nanming Domain and the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing returned the Jade Slips to the shelf.
Then he began looking for information about Immortal Crossing Island.
Immortal Crossing Island, like the Barren Forbidden Zone, appeared suddenly a million years ago.
Unlike the Barren Forbidden Zone, which was formed due to the Samsara Holy Fruit, Immortal Crossing Island appeared suddenly, without any warning.
And most of the time, Immortal Crossing Island remained elusive, only appearing sporadically every ten thousand years.
Moreover, in these million years, aside from Lin Jingzhi, no one who set foot on Immortal Crossing Island had ever walked off it.
Therefore, there were essentially no records about the interior of Immortal Crossing Island.
Of course, Lin Jing was also aware of this fact.
Lin Jing was not investigating the interior of Immortal Crossing Island.
What he was investigating was the exact times of its appearance and the phenomena that occurred when it appeared.
To make proper preparations.
After searching, Lin Jing finally found a Jade Slip related to Immortal Crossing Island at the bottom of the shelf.
Taking out the Jade Slip, Lin Jing then entered his Divine Sense into it and began perusing…
After reviewing, Lin Jing finally understood the times when Immortal Crossing Island appeared and the phenomena that occurred at those times.
Immortal Crossing Island appeared once every ten thousand years, with a variance of five hundred years before or after this ten-thousand-year mark, sometimes earlier or later, not fixed.
Moreover, the location and timing of Immortal Crossing Island’s appearance were also not fixed.
It could appear anywhere in the four Outer Seas or the Inner Sea.
And its appearing time could sometimes last a few months or, other times, only a few days or even a few hours.
At this point, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling overwhelmed.
The timings of the appearances of Immortal Crossing Island were so unstable; if it had already appeared and he happened to miss it, wouldn’t he have to wait another ten thousand years?
If that were the case, it would be troublesome.
“Could it be necessary to make another trip to Qinghuang Palace and use the Teleportation Array there, trying to teleport to Immortal Crossing Island again?” Lin Jing wondered.
But that teleportation was an accident, and it would be difficult to enter Immortal Crossing Island using that method again.
The last time Immortal Crossing Island appeared was before the Lin Family’s downfall, around the time when Elder Fei Ling disappeared; Lin Jing knew this.
From then until now, it was almost exactly ten thousand years.
If nothing unexpected happened, Immortal Crossing Island should appear again within the next five hundred years.
If he could seize the opportunity to enter Immortal Crossing Island during this upcoming appearance, that would be good.
If not, Lin Jing would have to think of other ways…
Moreover, in addition to this information, Lin Jing also found records of the phenomena that occurred when Immortal Crossing Island appeared.
Before Immortal Crossing Island appeared, special phenomena would rise.
At that time, the entire Demonic Monster Sea would tremble, and the Demonic Beasts would become unusually active; every cultivator in the Demonic Monster Sea could sense the anomaly.
After Immortal Crossing Island appeared, a multi-colored light screen stretching thousands of miles would descend from the sky.
One only needed to pass through this light screen to enter Immortal Crossing Island.
And once inside the light screen, there was no way out.
However, the location of the light screen’s appearance was uncertain.
The Demonic Monster Sea was so vast that even a light screen stretching thousands of miles might not be discovered.
It was easy to miss it.
As for the problem of getting out of Immortal Crossing Island, Lin Jing wasn’t worried, but the issue of getting in.
ƝᴑνǤο.сο
Then, Lin Jing continued to look further.
Originally, he wanted to check if there were other ways to enter Immortal Crossing Island, but after examining the entire Jade Slip, he found no other methods of entry.
Not until he had finished going through the content in the Jade Slip did Lin Jing withdraw his Divine Sense and put the Jade Slip back in its original place.
After putting the Jade Slip back, Lin Jing then continued looking for other Jade Slips concerning Immortal Crossing Island.
After Lin Jing’s search, he found other Jade Slips with records about Immortal Crossing Island.
However, after examining a few more Jade Slips, all the records were more or less the same, with none of the alternative methods to enter Immortal Crossing Island that Lin Jing wanted to know.
In the end, Lin Jing still couldn’t find any, resigned, he had to leave.
After coming out of the Scripture Pavilion, Lin Jing didn’t go straight home.
Instead, he went directly to Elder Bai.
At Elder Bai’s place, not just Elder Bai but also the ancestor of the Changyun Clan was there.
Upon seeing the two, Lin Jing bowed with a fist-in-palm salute:
“Elder Bai…”
“Elder Changyun…”
The two nodded their heads, and then Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing and asked,
“What brings you here?”
Lin Jing nodded and then spoke,
“Yes, Elder Bai,”
“Now that the disputes in the Inner Sea have ended and there are no dangers, I am planning to leave the Elixir Alliance temporarily and go back to the Southern Outer Sea.”
Lin Jing did not inquire about Elder Bai about the matter of Immortal Crossing Island because even the top records in the Elixir Alliance Scripture Pavilion didn’t have it, and it was unlikely Elder Bai knew the way into Immortal Crossing Island.
Moreover, Lin Jing did not quite want them to know about his plans to go to Immortal Crossing Island, otherwise, it would be hard to explain.
“Do you plan to return to the Southern Outer Sea?” Elder Bai asked, a bit puzzled after listening.
Lin Jing nodded.
But before Lin Jing could speak, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan interjected,
“Elder Bai, you might not know…”
“The Thousand Islands Domain in the Southern Outer Sea is actually Lin boy’s territory, and one of his disciples and his beloved are waiting for him there.”
“If it weren’t for my worry that Ye Mingyi might retaliate against Lin Jing because of the Lin Family, I would have let him go back earlier, not letting him come to your Elixir Alliance.”
After listening to the ancestor of the Changyun Clan, Elder Bai instantly understood.
Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing and smilingly said:
“I see…”
“In that case, you should indeed go back.”
Then, Elder Bai continued,
“If you want to go back, just go directly, you don’t have to worry about the Elixir Alliance.”
“We might also leave soon to go to the Outer Spatial Void, and once we are gone, the Elixir Alliance should be more relaxed.
Later, if you want, you can also bring your beloved to the Elixir Alliance.”
After speaking, Elder Bai looked at Lin Jing again and asked:
“By the way…”
“When do you plan to leave?”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing pondered for a moment, and then spoke,
“In a few days…”
“After settling some matters here, I will leave with Yuanshuang, Yujiu, and those few disciples of mine.”
“All of you together?”
Upon hearing this, Elder Bai was initially surprised, then understanding dawned, and he said,
“Alright!”
“With your current level of cultivation, you should basically not encounter any dangers, and taking them with you is also feasible…”

chapters.title: Chapter 876
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 876: Chapter 392 Gu Xian of the Seven Seas Hall Chapter 876: Chapter 392 Gu Xian of the Seven Seas Hall Bihai City, the largest city in the Southern Outer Sea, could be said to have always served as the most important hub of the Southern Outer Sea.
Especially after the two major Sects from the Western Demon Region established a Teleportation Array here, countless Cultivators wishing to travel to the Nanming Domain or the Western Demon Region would first come to Bihai City and then take the Teleportation Array to the other domains.
Because of this, its status in the Southern Outer Sea was unshakable.
At this moment, at the Teleportation Plaza of Bihai City, a beam of light soared into the sky, exceptionally dazzling, piercing the heavens.
As the light faded, three people appeared atop the Teleportation Array.
These three were none other than Lin Jing, Lin Jue, and Luo Luo.
“We’re finally back!”
After the teleportation light dissipated, Lin Jue looked at the familiar scene before him, a smile inevitably forming on his face.
...
Having said that, Lin Jue turned his head and addressed Lin Jing,
“Brother!”
“We’ll be home soon.”
Lin Jing raised his eyes and scanned the area.
Despite decades having passed, everything here remained the same, unchanged.
After scanning his surroundings, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes, we’re just about to be home…”…
After speaking with Elder Bai at the Elixir Alliance a few days prior, they had set off not long after, departing from the Elixir Alliance.
At the time of departure, Lu Youjiu, the siblings Changyun Yuanshuang, and Ji Xiyue, all tagged along, a lively group indeed.
After leaving the Eastern Spirit Realm, the first place they headed to was naturally the Inner Sea.
Upon arriving at the Inner Sea, they did not hurry to leave but stayed for some time at the Changyun Clan.
Originally, they had planned to come together to the Southern Outer Sea.
However, just before they were prepared to depart, both Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang needed to stay in the Inner Sea for a while due to some matters.
Thus, their plan to come to the Southern Outer Sea was temporarily shelved.
They could afford to delay, but Lin Jing and his companions couldn’t wait in the Inner Sea.
So, after discussing with the group, Lin Jing along with Ji Xiyue departed together.
From the Inner Sea to the Southern Outer Sea, there was a good distance without any Teleportation Arrays; however, the path leading to the Western Demon Region had plenty of them.
Furthermore, there was an extremely long-range large Teleportation Array directly connecting to the heartland of the Western Demon Region.
Therefore, after leaving the Changyun Clan, they traveled through various Teleportation Arrays to the Western Demon Region.
After entering the Western Demon Region, Lin Jing and the others followed Ji Xiyue to the Xingluo Elixir Sect.
At the Xingluo Elixir Sect, Lin Jing received a warm reception, particularly when they learned that Lin Jing was an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, their enthusiasm towards him increased even more.
Even the members of the Yuling Dao Sect, upon hearing this news, hurriedly came to visit Lin Jing.
Ultimately, Lin Jing, unable to withstand the overwhelming hospitality from the two Sects, took Lin Jue and Luo Luo and left the Western Demon Region, finally returning to Bihai City.
Ji Xiyue, however, stayed at the Xingluo Elixir Sect.
ɴονǤᴑ.ᴄο
Before they departed, Ji Xiyue mentioned that this return to the Xingluo Elixir Sect wouldn’t be for too long and she should return to the Elixir Alliance soon.
She also asked about the time Lin Jing would return to the Elixir Alliance.
However, Lin Jing did not provide a definite answer, as his main purpose this time was to acquire the Samsara Holy Fruit and find a way to enter Immortal Crossing Island to obtain the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
…
Subsequently, the three stepped out of the Teleportation Array.
Just as they exited the Teleportation Array, Lin Jing suddenly furrowed his brows, feeling a Divine Sense sweeping over him.
This Divine Sense was incredibly overpowering; judging from its intensity, the owner of this Divine Sense had at least achieved the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of Cultivation, just like himself.
Moreover, from the Divine Sense, it was clear this was no ordinary Bandit Cultivator; their Cultivation was definitely higher than his own.
Lin Jing had advanced to the Tribulation Stage at the Shi Family not too long ago, and was currently only at the early stages of Tribulation.
The owner of this Divine Sense was clearly stronger than Lin Jing, at least being in the middle stage of Tribulation or higher.
As far as Lin Jing knew, the lord of Bihai City was only at the Solidifying Body stage of Cultivation, yet now, in this city, a Bandit Cultivator was hiding.
This could not but alarm Lin Jing.
Moreover, after sweeping over Lin Jing with the Divine Sense, it did not immediately dissipate.
Instead, after withdrawing most of the Divine Sense’s power, it left behind a very faint trace, continuing to monitor him.
Who was this Bandit Cultivator?
Why was he continuously monitoring him?
Lin Jing had no idea about these.
However, Lin Jing, although he sensed this Divine Sense, did not show any sign of it.
Then, Lin Jing turned his head to look at Luo Luo beside him and said,
“Luo Luo…”
“I have an island here in the Southern Outer Sea.
Let’s stay there for a few days first, then in a few days, we’ll head back to the Nanming Domain.”
Luo Luo nodded upon hearing this:
“Okay, Master!”
Next, Lin Jing turned his head again, looking at Lin Jue:
“Do you want to explore Bihai City again?”
Lin Jue turned his head and looked in a certain direction.
The direction Lin Jing was looking at was where Lin Jue and his grandfather had lived previously.
There, she had left many memories.
However, after looking for a while, Lin Jue turned her head back:
“So many years have passed, it’s probably all changed now, and even those we knew before are probably long gone…”
“This time, I won’t go to see it.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Then let’s go.”
“Okay!” Lin Jue nodded.
After that, the three left and walked forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 877
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 877: Chapter 392 Gu Xian of Seven Seas Hall_2 Chapter 877: Chapter 392 Gu Xian of Seven Seas Hall_2 As an ancient Immortal City, mere decades of change are inconspicuous within its bounds.
The streets and other places within the city were as usual as ever.
The three of them departed, making their way out of the city.
After leaving Bihai City, Lin Jing led the two, flying straight out of the maritime area of Bihai City.
It was only after they had flown some distance from the city that Lin Jing finally stopped.
Then, Lin Jing spoke to Lin Jue,
“You take Luo Luo back first, I still have some matters to attend to and will return later.”
Lin Jue looked at Lin Jing with some confusion upon hearing this.
After all, they had been away for decades and had just returned from the Eastern Spirit Realm.
...
What matter could there be that needed his attention?
Despite her curiosity, Lin Jue did not inquire further.
She nodded to Lin Jing after a glance and left with Luo Luo.
Ɲονǥօ.ᴄο
After the two of them had left, Lin Jing remained standing on the surface of the sea, hovering in the void, watching the direction in which they disappeared.
A Bandit Cultivator’s Divine Sense could be vast, covering the entire Bihai City island, including the nearby sea area, once deployed.
Any movement in this region could not escape his Divine Sense.
That is why Lin Jing had Lin Jue and Luo Luo leave first while he stayed behind.
After standing still, Lin Jing continuously monitored that Divine Sense.
He noticed that although he had left Bihai City, the owner of that Divine Sense was still watching him and had not left.
Only when he felt enough time had passed and they had gone far did Lin Jing suddenly speak out,
“If you are so curious about me, dear fellow, why not come out and meet me?”
As he spoke these words, Lin Jing’s gaze remained fixed on the distance, as if unconcerned about all this.
Though it seemed like Lin Jing had made no preparations on the surface, he was ready in the shadows.
The Shocking Furnace was activated, and at any sign of malice from the other party, Lin Jing could instantly wield the Shocking Furnace to face the enemy.
…
…
However…
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than a figure flew swiftly towards him from the direction of Bihai City.
The figure approached Lin Jing with incredible speed, arriving in front of him in the blink of an eye.
Lin Jing turned his head to look at the newcomer.
The person was a tall, thin elder dressed in grey, who did not conceal his aura.
His presence was astonishing, indicating that the grey-clad elder’s Cultivation was at least at the advanced stages of Transcendence Tribulation.
As Lin Jing had predicted, the grey-clad elder’s Cultivation was much higher than his.
Although the elder had high Cultivation, he did not come bearing a threatening demeanor; instead, he approached with a smile and cupped his hands in greeting to Lin Jing,
“It turns out that my friend had already noticed me; I’ve been somewhat rude, it seems.”
Seeing that this elder seemed to have no hostility towards him, Lin Jing’s expression eased somewhat before he turned to the grey-clad elder and asked,
“Since Bihai City, you have been paying attention to me.
Would there be something amiss with me?”
The grey-clad elder hastened to respond,
“I am Gu Xian, an Elder of the Seven Seas Hall.
“I have come to Bihai City in pursuit of a traitor from our Seven Seas Hall, so everyone passing through Bihai City is subject to investigation, to see if they are disguising themselves as the traitor.”
“A traitor?” Lin Jing’s brow furrowed before he said,
“I have indeed heard that the Inner Sea has not been very peaceful recently…”
“Yes, that’s right,” Gu Xian, the grey-clad elder, nodded in response.
After speaking, he looked up at Lin Jing once more and continued,
“From what you have said, it seems you do not come from the Inner Sea.”
“I only wonder where my friend hails from?”
Upon hearing the question, Lin Jing responded directly, “The Elixir Alliance!”
When Gu Xian heard the words ‘Elixir Alliance,’ he was momentarily taken aback before saying,
“I did not expect that my friend actually belonged to the Elixir Alliance of the East Continent, please forgive my shortsightedness for not recognizing which Elder of the Elixir Alliance you study under.”
After saying that, Gu Xian closely examined Lin Jing before continuing,
“I do not wish to deceive you, my fellow Daoist.
Hundreds of years ago, Elder Gu confessed, I went to the Elixir Alliance with the old Hall Master and met several elders there, yet I am relatively unfamiliar with you.”
Elder Gu’s words were exceedingly polite, yet the implication was clearâ€”he had not met Lin Jing before and now doubted Lin Jing’s identity within the Elixir Alliance.
And after those words were uttered, although Elder Gu’s face still bore a smile, Lin Jing distinctly felt the atmosphere in the space become somewhat oppressive.
It was normal for Elder Gu to have doubts about Lin Jing.
After all, it had only been a few decades since Lin Jing joined the Elixir Alliance.
Besides, within the Elixir Alliance, aside from a few elders, there were very few who possessed a cultivation at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, and these few individuals were not unknown.
Lin Jing claimed to be an individual from the Elixir Alliance and also possessed a cultivation at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, but Elder Gu did not recognize him, which naturally aroused his suspicion.
Particularly since Elder Gu’s purpose in coming here was to pursue the traitors of Seven Seas Hall, facing such an unfamiliar person claiming to be from the Elixir Alliance, he naturally had many questions for Lin Jing.
Moreover, he was prepared if Lin Jing could not produce evidence to prove his own identity, it was highly likely that he would make a move directly.
The meaning behind Elder Gu’s actions was clear to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing also had no intention of creating conflict with the other party over such matters, especially since Lin Jing had questions of his own for the other party about those ‘traitors’â€¦
Regarding the ‘traitors’ mentioned by Elder Gu, Lin Jing had a guessâ€”it was very likely related to Ye Mingyi, so he wanted to inquire with Elder Gu.
Following that,
Lin Jing directly presented his Elixir Alliance Elder Token and then spoke,
“I wonder if Elder Gu has heard about the newly promoted elder of the Elixir Allianceâ€¦”
Lin Jing, having been promoted to elder, did not stay long within the Elixir Alliance before he left and began his journey home.
But on the return trip, the journey was long, and they did not rush on their way, even staying for a while in both the Inner Sea and the Western Demon Region.
Therefore, by now, Lin Jing’s promotion to elder had happened three years ago.
The news had spread long ago, and barring any surprises, Elder Gu should be aware of it.
Seeing the token in Lin Jing’s hand and listening to his words, Elder Gu immediately reacted, exclaiming in surprise:
“It’s youâ€¦”
“You are the newly promoted Elder Lin of the Elixir Alliance from three years ago?”
After saying this, Elder Gu spoke again to Lin Jing,
“Linâ€¦ Lin Daoyouâ€¦”
“I wonder if you could let this old man take a look at your Elder Token, as I have seen one before when I met with your Elixir Alliance’s Elder Wen, with whom I got along on the first meeting.”
“Now, due to matters concerning our Seven Seas Hall, it has been a long time since I saw Elder Wen, and I do miss him.
I wonder how is Elder Wen doing now?”
Though Elder Gu was behaving very politely, Lin Jing knew that even now, he still harbored doubts about Lin Jing’s identity.
Lin Jing did not dally and simply tossed over his Elder Token.
Elder Gu caught the token and examined it carefully.
After the examination, Elder Gu seemed to breathe a sigh of relief, and then the oppressive atmosphere in the surroundings also vanished.
Having checked the token, Elder Gu saluted Lin Jing with his hands clasped before speaking,
“I truly apologize for causing so much trouble for Lin Daoyou.”
“I only hope that Lin Daoyou can understand.”
Having finished speaking, Elder Gu returned Lin Jing’s Elder Token along with it.
Lin Jing took the token and replied,
“It’s nothingâ€¦”
“Elder Gu’s actions were for the sake of the Seven Seas Hall, I naturally understand.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Gu, smiling, said to Lin Jing,
“Elder Lin, despite your young age, you are already an elder of the Elixir Alliance, not only endowed with exceptional talent but also with a magnanimous heart, which is truly admirable.”
“It’s a pity that I still have to capture the traitor of Seven Seas Hall and cannot leave for the time being, otherwise I would definitely enjoy a few drinks with Elder Lin.”
Hearing these words, Lin Jing couldn’t help but express his curiosity,
“I have also heard some things concerning the Inner Sea, only knowing that there were some conflicts between your hall, the Changyun Clan, and the Shocking Seas Alliance.”
“Haven’t both sides already ceased hostilities?
How come there’s now a traitor?”
At this, Elder Gu couldn’t help but sigh,
“Lin Daoyou, having been immersed in the Elixir Alliance, you might not be aware that the traitor is truly the instigator behind all that has transpired…”

chapters.title: Chapter 878
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 878: Chapter 393 Trouble Chapter 878: Chapter 393 Trouble Lin Jing heard this and couldn’t help but express some confusion:
“What do you mean by that?”
Gu Xian looked towards Lin Jing, hesitated for a moment, and then spoke:
“Since Daoist Lin is aware of the unrest in the Inner Sea, you must also know who orchestrated it.”
Lin Jing nodded and said:
“I have heard something about it.
The struggle in the Inner Sea was led by the Supreme Elder of your Seven Seas Hall, disputing with the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance.”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Gu Xian spoke again, asking Lin Jing:
“And the outcome?
Does Lin Daoyou know?”
Lin Jing nodded again, and then said:
“I left the East Continent and passed through the Inner Sea, so naturally I heard some things.”
“Your parties have been in conflict for several decades without conclusion, but isn’t it true that after negotiations, you shook hands and made peace?”
“Moreover, I have also heard rumors that there was unrest within your Seven Seas Hall.
It was after this unrest that the Hall Master of Seven Seas Hall stayed hidden, and the Supreme Elder took charge of the Inner Sea conflict.”
“After the unrest, the Hall Master reappeared and took control of the entire Seven Seas Hall, whereas the Supreme Elder, who led the conflict, disappeared.”
Hearing this, Gu Xian nodded and then said:“Indeed, what Daoist Lin says matches with the message that has been spread to the outside world.”
“However, there are some hidden details that are not known to the outside world…”
At this point, Gu Xian looked at Lin Jing and then began to speak:
“I won’t hide it from you, Daoist Lin.
After all, this is not a secret to many, and although it’s unknown to outsiders, with your current cultivation, it is only a matter of time before you find out.”
“Why don’t I just tell Daoist Lin, and at the same time, ask for a small favor?”
Lin Jing, somewhat surprised to hear this request for help, then asked:
“What do you need help with, Daoist Gu?”
Gu Yan began to speak:
“I won’t hide it from you, Daoist Lin…”
“That ‘traitor’ I mentioned earlier is none other than the Supreme Elder of our Seven Seas Hall, Ye Mingyi.”
At Gu Xian’s words, Lin Jing immediately showed a look of astonishment and exclaimed:
“The Supreme Elder of your Seven Seas Hall is a traitor?”
“How is this possible?”
After speaking, Lin Jing seemed to not believe Gu Xian’s words and quickly said:
“Daoist Gu, you must be jesting with me.”
“That is the Supreme Elder we’re talking about, the most cultivated and venerable member of the Seven Seas Hall, not a role that just anyone can fill.”
“Within a Sect, the rights of the Supreme Elder can even surpass those of the Sect Master, holding the power of appointment and dismissal over him.
How can such a person become a traitor?”
Hearing Lin Jing’s response, Gu Xian was earnest, looking at Lin Jing and saying:
“I am not deceiving you, Daoist Lin…”
“It’s true!”
“As for the specifics, they involve some secrets of our Seven Seas Hall, which I cannot reveal to you.”
“But what I want to tell you is that our Seven Seas Hall’s Supreme Elder indeed betrayed his predecessor, the previous Supreme Elder who had taken him into the Sect, and departed from the original intention of the Seven Seas Hall.”
“He has never considered the Seven Seas Hall as his own Sect or family, but merely used it as a tool for his revenge.”
“He is called a traitor because he betrayed the Seven Seas Hall.”
Seeing the serious expression on Gu Xian and his sincerity in revealing this matter,
Lin Jing also seriously asked:
“What would you have me assist you with?”
Gu Xian pulled out a Transmission Jade Pendant and then said:
“In our last great battle with the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance, the three parties collaborated, planning to capture Ye Mingyi by trickery.”
“Unfortunately, even though we joined forces in secret, and severely injured Ye Mingyi, driving him to a desperate situation, he still managed to escape.”
“Ye Mingyi was severely injured at the time, his cultivation fell to the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, and his combat power was severely compromised due to the severity of his injuries, perhaps not even able to exert the strength of the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.”
“What I would like is for Daoist Lin to keep an eye out for any suspicious cultivators, and if you encounter one, I’d be grateful if you could inform me.”
After speaking, Gu Xian handed the jade pendant to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing hesitated for a moment, then took the jade pendant and said:
“Alright…”
“If I do encounter a suspicious cultivator, I will certainly inform Daoist Gu.”
After Ye Mingyi’s escape, the three major powers of the Inner Sea have all been searching for him.
...
Ɲονǥօ.сᴑ
He is extremely cunning and nobody knows where he has hidden himself, and he has not been found to this day.
In addition to the three major powers of the Inner Sea, if there was anyone Ye Mingyi harbored the greatest hatred towards, it could only be the Lin Family.
The reason Lin Jing agreed to help Gu Xian was not only to assist Gu Xian, but also to obtain information about Ye Mingyi from him.
Even though Ye Mingyi had been severely injured, Lin Jing couldn’t let his guard down.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing and Gu Xian talked for a while.
From Gu Xian, Lin Jing learned that in addition to the Southern Outer Sea, there were members of the Seven Seas Hall guarding the other three Outer Seas.
Now that Ye Mingyi was seriously injured and his combat power greatly reduced, the best chance to capture him was now.
If they waited until his injuries healed and his combat power was restored, it would be impossible to strike against him again.
After their conversation, Gu Xian bid farewell to Lin Jing and returned to Bihai City.
And after saying goodbye to Gu Xian, Lin Jing continued to fly towards the direction of the Thousand Islands Domain.
Lin Jing’s cultivation was far superior to that of Lin Jue and Luo Luo, so naturally his speed was much faster than the two of them.
Although they had left earlier, it didn’t take long for Lin Jing to catch up with them.
After catching up with the two of them, the trio continued to fly towards the Thousand Islands Domain together.
…
Before long, Lin Jing brought Lin Jue and Luo Luo to the Thousand Islands Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 879
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 879: Chapter 393 Trouble_2 Chapter 879: Chapter 393 Trouble_2 Entering the Thousand Islands Domain, Lin Jing immediately extended his Divine Sense toward Li Yan Island.
Although they had moved to Yue Tian Island before Lin Jing left, they had lived on Li Yan Island for a long time, so it was only right to check on it.
As Lin Jing’s Divine Sense extended, it enveloped all the islands along the way within its range.
The actions of the cultivators on the islands could not escape Lin Jing’s investigation.
In no time, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached Li Yan Island.
Under the scrutiny of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, Li Yan Island had changed significantly, likely due to the evacuation, as the previously bustling Li Yan Marketplace had far fewer people.
Furthermore, the population of Li Yan City had also dwindled, with only the Spirit Fields remaining there.
...
However, while investigating Li Yan Island, Lin Jing unexpectedly discovered an old acquaintance.
It was none other than Yue Qiniang.
Logically, Yue Qiniang should have been at Yue Tian Island; Lin Jing wondered why she was here.
Subsequently, Lin Jing spoke to Lin Jue before immediately stepping forward and flying towards Li Yan Island first.
Inside the City Lord’s Mansion in Li Yan City, Yue Qiniang seemed troubled as she paced back and forth in the courtyard with her head down and brow furrowed.
Just as she walked forward with her head lowered, she suddenly noticed something amiss.
It seemed that a shadow had suddenly appeared in front of her.
Without a sound, a shadow had appeared, and she hadn’t noticed it at all.
This caught Yue Qiniang by surprise, and she quickly lifted her head to look forward.
However, as Yue Qiniang looked ahead, she was momentarily stunned…
Just then, a voice came from in front of her:
“Qiniang, what’s bothering you?
You seem distracted; did something troublesome happen?”
The person who had suddenly appeared was naturally Lin Jing.
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, Yue Qiniang quickly reacted with a delighted expression:
“Island Master, you…
you’re back…!”
Lin Jing nodded, saying,
“Yes!”
“I just returned and noticed you seem unsettled.
Did something happen?”
Upon hearing this, Yue Qiniang looked at Lin Jing and after scrutinizing him, she spoke:
“Island Master, may I ask what your Cultivation level is now?”
“I feel I understand you less and less, and when you arrived just now, you were so silent.
Even though you were right in front of me, I didn’t notice you.”
Lin Jing looked at Yue Qiniang and seemed to understand her implication, but he didn’t respond directly to her question.
Instead, he spoke:
“From the sound of it, you really are in trouble.”
“And the opponent is powerful, aren’t they?”
Yue Qiniang nodded:
“Indeed.”
Then she lifted her head and looked at Lin Jing, speaking again:
“Island Master…”
“Qing Qing may be in danger; you should check on her.”
“Qing Qing is in danger?”
Lin Jing was startled upon hearing this.
Then he hurriedly asked:
“Where is she, on Yue Tian Island?”
Yue Qiniang shook her head, saying:
“No…”
“Do you remember the Uninhabited Island where you helped me with my Tribulation?”
“Qing Qing and her brother, Mr.
Li, both are there.”
“They both are there?”
“Is someone undergoing Tribulation?”
Yue Qiniang nodded:
“It’s Mr.
Li undergoing Tribulation.”
“Qing Qing went to help, but this Tribulation is very likely to be disturbed by a formidable foe, and the disrupter might be highly skilled in Cultivation.”
“Since I’m only at the Golden Core Stage and can’t be of much help, Qing Qing asked me to stay here, and she didn’t tell me much.”
Lin Jing had been away for decades.
Even after all this time, Yue Qiniang remained at the Golden Core Stage, unable to break through to the Nascent Soul.
It couldn’t be helped, Yue Qiniang’s aptitude was extremely poor, although the Cleansing Spirit Elixir given by Lin Jing had improved her Spiritual Root Aptitude considerably.
Yet even so, she had only reached the level of an ordinary cultivator.
Just like the former Zhang Chenfan, whose talent was extremely poor, no matter the methods used or the Lifespan exhausted, he remained at the Golden Core Stage.
Yue Qiniang was certainly much better off than Zhang Chenfan, and meeting Lin Jing was her greatest fortune.
At this moment, she was still in the Golden Core Stage, but being just over two hundred years old, she had a lot of life left and her cultivation had already reached the Golden Core Peak.
It seemed that advancing to the Nascent Soul stage should not be far off.
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing immediately spoke up:
“Wait here for me, I’ll go and check.”
After saying this, Lin Jing was about to leave.
It was at this moment that Lin Jue and Luo Luo arrived.
Seeing them, Lin Jing spoke again, saying:
“You two wait here, I have some things to take care of.”
The two who had just arrived were stunned by Lin Jing’s words, but Lin Jing did not pay attention to them and stepped forward, disappearing from sight.
It seemed like a matter of urgency.
After Lin Jing left, Lin Jue turned his attention to the Yue Qiniang below.
Then, Lin Jue descended from mid-air to stand in front of Yue Qiniang, excitedly said:
“Qiniang, I’m back!”
Upon seeing Lin Jue, Yue Qiniang couldn’t help but feel excited and said:
“Seeing the Island Master, I knew you would be alright.”
Lin Jue nodded vigorously, “Hmm.”
Then Lin Jue asked Yue Qiniang:
“What happened?
Why did my brother leave so hurriedly just after returning?”
Yue Qiniang then explained:
“It’s about Qing Qing’s sister…”
“Ah?”
“Qing Qing’s sister?
What’s wrong with her?”
Upon hearing that it involved Li Qingqing, Lin Jue also became anxious and quickly questioned Yue Qiniang.
Yue Qiniang quickly tried to console:
“Qing Qing’s brother is undergoing Tribulation, and he might encounter some trouble, which involves Qing Qing.
That’s why the Island Master left so hurriedly.”
“Don’t worry, the Island Master has already gone to handle it…”
“Seeing how fast the Island Master went, he must be highly skilled in cultivation and should be able to resolve this trouble.”
Upon hearing this from Yue Qiniang, Lin Jue felt relieved:
“Right!”
“With brother there, surely nothing bad will happen.”
Seeing Lin Jue so confident, Yue Qiniang felt puzzled and asked again:
“By the way…”
“Things were urgent just now, and I didn’t have time to ask more, what is his cultivation level now?”
What Lin Jue said next left Yue Qiniang shocked, standing still for a long time…
“My brother…”
“He is now a Great Cultivator in the Transcendence Tribulation Stage.”
…
…
ƝᴑνǤο.сο
The Demonic Monster Sea region is vast, mostly consisting of endless seas.
Although there are several islands within the sea, they are like stars in the sky, actually a very small part of the whole sea area.
Most of the Demonic Monster Sea consists of vast open sea areas, along with the occasional uninhabited islands scattered throughout.
Because it is so open, many places in this maritime region are very suitable for cultivators to undergo Tribulation.
At this moment, above an uninhabited island in the Southern Outer Sea, dark clouds loomed, enveloping the small island.
Below the dark clouds stood a man in a black robe.
If Lin Jing were here, he would certainly recognize him.
This man in the black robe was Li Tangyu, whom he had not seen for a long time.
The dark clouds above his head thundered continuously, and occasionally, lightning arcs appeared.
Clearly, these dark clouds above Li Tangyu were Tribulation clouds.
And Li Tangyu was preparing for his Tribulation.
Looking again at Li Tangyu, although he was standing under the Tribulation clouds, he wasn’t focusing on the clouds above but was frowning intensely, looking ahead.
In front of him, outside the range of the Tribulation clouds, a few people were confronting each other.
One of the groups was notably Li Qingqing, Ye Yun, and even the old ancestor of the Yan Family.
Opposing them were several demon cultivators, their bodies surging with Demonic Qi, clearly not ordinary people.
Moreover, the leader among the demon cultivators, whose aura was formidable, seemed to be on par with the old ancestor of the Yan Family, apparently having reached the Solidifying Body stage as well.
The two groups were confronting each other, a scene ready to erupt into conflict at any moment…

chapters.title: Chapter 880
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 880: Chapter 394 Old Acquaintance Chapter 880: Chapter 394 Old Acquaintance At that moment, the Demon Cultivator who had been confronting the Yan Family ancestor spoke up and addressed the Yan Family ancestor:
“You of the Yan Family must truly have no fear of death to oppose the great Demon Lord.”
“If you leave now, all can be forgiven, but if you insist on opposing the Demon Lord, once his lordship personally arrives, not just you, your entire Yan Family will no longer exist.”
As he said this, the Demon Cultivator’s eyes turned fierce, and he looked at the Yan Family ancestor with a chilling tone:
“This concerns the survival of your Yan Family, think carefully!”
Hearing this, the Yan Family ancestor looked directly at the Demon Cultivator opposite him and firmly said,
“In life, there are things one does and things one does not do…”
“Since I have decided to protect them, I naturally will not shrink back, and there’s no need for you to scare me with this.”
“Besides, to destroy our Yan Family, just with that Demon Lord, I’m afraid he’s not up to the task.
Though our Yan Family has declined, we still have some strength left.”
“Your Demon Lord may be powerful, but he is just at the level of Dao Integration.
Here in the Outer Seas, Dao Integration does not mean you can act without restraint.”
“If the Demon Lord truly wishes to annihilate our Yan Family, then we, the Yan Family, will not hesitate to fight you to the bitter end.”
After the Yan Family ancestor finished speaking, the Demon Cultivator’s brow furrowed slightly, clearly acknowledging the Yan Family ancestor’s words were not empty threats; he was well aware of this.
Seeing that there was no breakthrough with the Yan Family ancestor, the Demon Cultivator turned his gaze towards Li Tangyu beneath the tribulation clouds and then spoke:
“Li Tangyu, the great Demon Lord is very fond of you, he has high hopes for you.”
“As long as you follow the Demon Lord, become one of his subordinates, and inform us of the whereabouts of the Cultivator who took the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, we will not only cease causing trouble, but we will wholeheartedly protect you and aid you in your Tribulation.”“Otherwise, even with them present, they won’t be able to stop us.
If we make our move, your tribulation this time will surely fail.”
Facing the threat from the Demon Cultivator, Li Tangyu sneered coldly and replied directly,
“Hmph…!”
“Don’t even think about it…”
His patience already thin from being snubbed twice, the Demon Cultivator’s restraint was immediately worn away.
The Demon Cultivator looked at the group and spoke with a cold voice,
“Since that is the case, there’s nothing more to say.”
With that, the Demon Cultivator no longer wasted words and promptly brought out his Magical Treasure.
Seeing this, the other Demon Cultivators spread out and each summoned their own Magical Treasures, facing the Yan Family ancestor and Li Qingqing’s group.
...
At the same time, the Yan Family ancestor along with Li Qingqing and Ye Yun also summoned their Magical Treasures, and a standoff began against the Demon Cultivators.
Only Li Tangyu, with tribulation clouds churning above his head, where the sound of muffled thunder kept rumbling, and arcs of Tribulation Lightning became increasingly dense.
It appeared that the Tribulation Lightning was about to descend.
If at this time, Li Tangyu was disturbed by the Demon Cultivators, even if he did not die, he would sustain grave injuries…
Yet at that moment, the Demon Cultivators would certainly not let him be, for if Li Tangyu succeeded in his Tribulation, he would become an even greater threat.
Li Tangyu’s Cultivation had improved much too rapidly, to the point where even the Demon Lord felt wary.
If they could not subdue him, there was no chance they would let him live.
This was the word given to the Demon Cultivator by the Demon Lord before he set out.
“Boom!”
Finally, the tribulation clouds above Li Tangyu’s head finished brewing, and the first Tribulation Lightning fell.
Li Tangyu had no choice but to temporarily gather his Divine Sense, no longer paying attention to the outside world circumstances, exerting all his strength to withstand the falling Tribulation Lightning.
This strike of Tribulation Lightning was like a signal, and as it fell, the Demon Cultivators made their move at that moment.
They seemed to have a very good understanding and coordination.
Among them, the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator summoned his Five Elements Spiritual Body, and at the same time brought out his own Magical Treasure, attacking the Yan Family ancestor and the others, including Li Qingqing.
The other Demon Cultivators behind, their Magical Treasures shining brilliantly, emitting dazzling light, gathered swiftly and flew rapidly towards Li Tangyu under the tribulation clouds.
They acted without hesitation and cooperated extremely smoothly, clearly not the first time they had engaged in such actions.
Seeing that Li Tangyu’s Tribulation was about to be disturbed, Li Qingqing was incredibly anxious and quickly made a move to block them.
However, her attack was directly stopped by the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator.
Not only did Li Qingqing’s attack get blocked, but so did the attacks from the Yan Family ancestor and Ye Yun.
The Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator stood like an immovable mountain in front of them, preventing them from breaking through.
After stopping their attacks, the Demon Cultivator spoke with a disparaging tone, looking at them saying,
“Just an early-stage Solidifying Body Realm, plus a few ants, and you think you can stop me?”
“That’s just naive…”
However…
No sooner had the words of the Solidifying Body Realm Demon Cultivator finished did an extremely terrifying presence suddenly appear.
The Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator immediately felt a chilling fear upon sensing this terrifying presence, which was so intense that even the Demon Lord’s aura paled in comparison.
“Could this be an encounter with a Tribulation Cultivator?”
The Solidifying Body Realm Demon Cultivator hardly had the time to react to this frightening presence before he immediately sensed that something was wrong.
Ɲονɢօ.сο
Because this terrifying aura seemed directed straight at him.
With that thought, he quickly gathered his Divine Sense, trying to resist the terrifying aura pressing down on him.
However…
In the next moment, an extraordinarily powerful Divine Sense attack had already surged into his own sea of consciousness.
Under this powerful Divine Sense assault, the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator’s mental defenses were like they were unguarded, easily breached by the Divine Sense.
“Pugh…”
With just one Divine Sense attack, the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator was grievously hurt and could not help but spurt blood as he retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 881
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 881: Chapter 394 Old Acquaintance_2 Chapter 881: Chapter 394 Old Acquaintance_2 At the same time, it wasn’t just him, the Demon Cultivators planning to disrupt Li Tanyu’s Tribulation standing behind him were also similarly affected.
Everyone suddenly suffered heavy injuries at that moment.
Severely injured, the brilliant light formed by the convergence of their Magical Treasures that intended to interfere with Li Tanyu’s Tribulation dissipated.
From sensing that terrifying aura to everyone being severely injured, it all happened in the blink of an eye.
Only after the Demon Cultivators were all injured, looking behind Li Qingqing and the others with a face filled with fear, did Li Qingqing and her group come to their senses.
Subsequently,
the group turned around to see a person walking towards them.
“Sorry, I came back a bit late.”
Turned out, this person was Lin Jing who had just hurried over.
...
Lin Jing arrived and looked at the familiar faces in front of him.
Li Qingqing, Ye Yun, Yan Family’s Old Ancestor, Zhang Jian, and even the Divine Toad…
When they saw Lin Jing, their expressions varied.
Li Qingqing’s eyes slightly reddened as she stared intently at him for a long while before shaking her head,
“Not late, not late…”
Ye Yun, upon seeing Lin Jing, showed a face full of joy and directly said,“Master, you finally came back.”
The Yan Family’s Old Ancestor and the Divine Toad were both fixedly staring at Lin Jing, their eyes filled with disbelief.
Zhang Jian was completely stunned.
After a moment of stupor, Zhang Jian turned his head to look at the Demon Cultivators and then back to Lin Jing, inevitably asking,
“Just now, did you do all that?”
Clearly, Zhang Jian was still somewhat in disbelief that the one who emitted that terrifying aura could be Lin Jing.
Just then, the first bolt of Tribulation Lightning dissipated, and Li Tanyu had safely passed through the first lightning tribulation.
The moment the lightning dissipated, Li Tanyu swiftly looked over.
Seeing the Demon Cultivators, now gathered together, all looking weak and injured, he was immediately shocked.
Moreover, the Demon Cultivators, looking ahead, had eyes filled with undeniable fear.
Li Tanyu, seeing this scene, followed the Demon Cultivators’ gaze forward.
He coincidentally saw Lin Jing looking their way.
Seeing Lin Jing, Li Tanyu was immediately overjoyed.
But before he could speak, Lin Jing’s voice had already reached him,
“Focus on your tribulation, don’t get distracted.
I’ll handle everything here.”
Li Tanyu, hearing this, quickly nodded,
“Okayâ€¦”
…
After speaking, Lin Jing turned his head to look at those few Demon Cultivators.
Before he had arrived, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense had already detected the situation here ahead of him, and seeing the critical situation, he had used his Divine Sense to attack without hesitation, severely injuring those few Demon Cultivators.
However, Lin Jing did not take their lives.
While on Li Yan Island, Lin Jing hadn’t gotten much information from Yue Qiniang, and before killing these people, he always wanted to understand the situation thoroughly.
Ɲονɡօ.сο
Also, among those Demon Cultivators, one of them was an ‘old acquaintance’ of his.
At that time, Lin Jing’s ‘old acquaintance’ was avoiding eye contact, desperately trying to dodge his gaze.
However, Lin Jing didn’t bother with them at the moment but turned to Li Qingqing and the others,
“I just came from Li Yan Island, Yue Qiniang told me that you might be in danger, so I hurried over.”
After speaking, Lin Jing glanced at the Demon Cultivators and asked,
“What’s the deal with them?”
Ye Yun, hearing this, hurriedly started explaining to Lin Jing,
“These people are from the Demon Domain of the Northern Continent, underlings of a Demon Cultivator who calls himself a Demon Lord.
They came here to find the Great Dream Ancient Mirror.”
“Looking for the Great Dream Ancient Mirrorâ€¦”
Lin Jing, hearing this, turned his head to look at one of the Demon Cultivators.
This person was Lin Jing’s ‘old acquaintance’ and the previous owner of the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, the Moon Demon Sect Leader.
Previously, during the snatch for the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, because of the remnant soul inside the mirror, the Moon Demon Sect Leader chose to abandon the mirror and fled to save his life.
After Lin Jing dealt with the remnant soul in the mirror, the Moon Demon Sect Leader was nowhere to be found, and Lin Jing had not been able to catch up.
And now, here he was, encountering him again.
Since this matter involved the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, the Moon Demon Sect Leader was undoubtedly implicated.
Without saying anything else, he must have known the Great Dream Ancient Mirror was on him, and he was the only one who could have identified him and targeted the people around him.
Following that,
Lin Jing looked towards the Moon Demon Sect Leader, and at the same time, the aura of a Tribulation Cultivator’s cultivation exploded from his body, pressing towards the Moon Demon Sect Leader:
“All of this was your doing, right?”
In fact, from the moment Lin Jing had arrived, the Moon Demon Sect Leader had already noticed him.
However, that terrifying yet somewhat familiar aura on Lin Jing made the Moon Demon Sect Leader daze for a moment.
There used to be a time when Lin Jing and he were both at the Nascent Soul Stage.
Even his cultivation was slightly higher than Lin Jing’s.
But now, in less than two hundred years, Lin Jing, who was once at the same level of cultivation as himself, had advanced leaps and bounds to a level he could only look up to.
Originally, the Moon Demon Sect Leader thought he was quite fortunate to have encountered the Demon Chief and joined under him.
With the help of the Demon Chief, it only took him a little over a hundred years to break through the Nascent Soul and ascend to Divinity Transformation.
But this small pride of his paled in comparison to Lin Jing’s achievements, and instantly seemed worthless.
The Moon Demon Sect Leader had no doubt that from the aura emanating from Lin Jing, he could probably crush him to death with just one hand.
Now, under Lin Jing’s oppressive aura, the Moon Demon Sect Leader immediately became timid and, facing Lin Jing’s inquiry, he naturally did not dare to hide anything, quickly starting to explain:
“Not…
not me…”
“I only told the Demon Chief that you acquired the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, everything else was done by the Demon Chief.”
“Our presence here today is actually under the orders of the Demon Chief, intending to bring Li Tanyu under his command and incidentally to probe information about you.”
After speaking, the Moon Demon Sect Leader immediately lowered his head, not daring to meet Lin Jing’s gaze.
Seeing the Moon Demon Sect Leader’s current humble appearance, Lin Jing couldn’t help but shake his head.
The Moon Demon Sect Leader of the past, cunning and decisive, possessed quite the demeanor of a hero and even managed to escape amidst the encirclement of the two major Sects in the Northern Devil Region.
But now, having followed that Demon Chief, the current Moon Demon Sect Leader had turned into this humble figure.
This made Lin Jing a bit sentimental…
…
…
If the Moon Demon Sect Leader knew what Lin Jing was thinking, he would definitely be frustrated to the point of vomiting blood.
The reason he was like this was all because of Lin Jing.
The current Lin Jing was simply too terrifying.
Before even showing himself, he had already severely injured several of them.
Even though he was once a leader of a Sect, cunning and decisive, faced with Lin Jing who could crush him to death with one hand, he didn’t dare harbor any thoughts.
How could he not be humble?
However, after the Moon Demon Sect Leader finished speaking, a Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm beside him couldn’t help but glance at the Moon Demon Sect Leader, clearly dissatisfied with the Moon Demon Sect Leader’s performance.
But because of Lin Jing’s presence, he also didn’t dare make any inappropriate actions.
“Where is the Demon Chief now?”
Lin Jing spoke again, asking the Moon Demon Sect Leader.
As Lin Jing finished speaking, the Moon Demon Sect Leader did not speak but looked towards the leading Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm.
Without having to speak, Lin Jing understood his meaning.
It seemed that only the leading Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm knew the whereabouts of the Demon Chief.
Lin Jing then, likewise, looked towards that Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm.
“You tell us…”
“Where is the Demon Chief now?”
The Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm kept his head low, not daring to meet Lin Jing’s gaze, but his brow was tightly furrowed, remaining silent.
It seemed the Demon Cultivator was unwilling to reveal the whereabouts of the Demon Chief.
At this moment, facing Lin Jing’s interrogation, the Demon Cultivator remained silent, and Li Qingqing and several others also remained silent, quietly waiting for Lin Jing to question the Demon Cultivator.
For a time, the surroundings became eerily silent.
Only the distant sound of thunder from the Tribulation Clouds echoed.
Moreover, the muffled thunder from the clouds became more and more urgent.
It appeared that the second Tribulation Lightning was about to descend.
Seeing the Demon Cultivator in the Solidifying Body Realm remain silent, Lin Jing naturally would not indulge him, and directly said:
“Before this second Tribulation Lightning falls, if you still do not speak, then there will be no need to speak anymore…”

chapters.title: Chapter 882
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 882: Chapter 395: Vanquish the Demon, Reminisce about the Past Chapter 882: Chapter 395: Vanquish the Demon, Reminisce about the Past You could tell that the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator was very hesitant, even after Lin Jing had finished speaking, the person’s brow remained tightly furrowed, lips sealed.
And just at that moment, within the Tribulation clouds, the originally rumbling thunder suddenly ceased.
Immediately after, a “crack” of a startling boom resounded, the second bolt of Tribulation Lightning descended with the speed of lightning that can’t be covered with one’s ears.
The second bolt of Tribulation Lightning descended so quickly, the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator hadn’t anticipated it at all, and his face turned deathly pale.
He hastily began to speak:
“I say…
Ɲοѵǥօ.сο
I…”
But as soon as he opened his mouth, it was already too late.
...
An incredibly formidable Divine Sense had broken through his defenses, penetrating into his Sea of Consciousness.
As for Soul Searching, Lin Jing did not use it often, but that did not mean he was incapable of employing it.
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense invaded the Solidifying Body Demon Cultivator’s Sea of Consciousness, directly sifting through his memories.
As Lin Jing probed, everything from his memories was suddenly laid bare, defenselessly spread out beneath Lin Jing’s Divine Sense.
Then, Lin Jing directly spurred his Divine Sense, probing the man’s Soul Spirit.
Finally, after a period of investigation, Lin Jing had indeed obtained the answers he sought…
…
…
The Demon Sect Hierarch hailed from the Northern Devil Region and had the same origins as the Moon Demon Sect Leader.
Originally, when the Great Dream Ancient Mirror appeared, it was obtained by the Moon Demon Sect Leader and thus provoked the pursuit and assassination by two major forces of the Northern Devil Region, leading to a desperate flight to the Southern Outer Sea.
The incident had caused such a stir that many came to know of it afterward.
And this Demon Sect Hierarch was one of them.
Unlike others, the Cultivation Technique he practiced was in great harmony with the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, hence, he was even more determined than others to secure it.
However, to avoid the chase of the two great powers, the Moon Demon Sect Leader had exhausted every trick in the book and finally escaped their pursuit, vanishing without a trace.
It took a long time for the Demon Sect Hierarch to locate the Moon Demon Sect Leader again.
Upon finding the Moon Demon Sect Leader and learning of the theft of the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, the Demon Sect Hierarch had intended to kill him on the spot, but the Moon Demon Sect Leader, realizing the gravity of the situation, quickly showed his true heart to the Hierarch, promising earnestly to help find Lin Jing who had taken the mirror.
Subsequently, the Moon Demon Sect Leader swore an oath on his Soul Spirit and publicly ingested the Demon Elixir given by the Hierarch to control him, earning the Hierarch’s trust.
Because Lin Jing, after obtaining the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, had gone directly to the Nanming Domain, and before that, this Moon Demon Sect Leader did not know Lin Jing at all.
It was precisely for this reason that their search had been delayed for so long, finally tracing it back to Lin Jing.
Other than the Great Dream Ancient Mirror, there was also the matter concerning Li Tangyu.
Li Tangyu was favored by the Demon Sect Hierarch due to his not inconsiderable talent; he wanted to take him under his wing.
That’s why, at the critical moment of his Tribulation, people were sent to forcibly coerce him into submission.
…
…
Now that he had obtained the knowledge he wanted, they were naturally of no further use.
Lin Jing, expressionless, looked at the few Demon Cultivators before him.
Facing Lin Jing, whose realm was several levels higher than their own, they couldn’t even muster the courage to resist.
Afterward…
Lin Jing simply waved his hand, and a Five-Colored Aurora flew out, passing directly through the Demon Cultivators’ bodies amidst their terrified gazes.
In the next instant, the bodies of the Demon Cultivators shattered, turning to flying ash…
Even just before death, the terror in their eyes hadn’t faded.
With a single action, Lin Jing wiped out several Demon Cultivators, including the Solidifying Body Cultivator, leaving only one person alive.
Naturally, that person was the Moon Demon Sect Leader.
Just now, as Lin Jing acted, his counterparts of comparable Cultivation level didn’t even put up a fight before turning to ash.
The massive discrepancy left the Moon Demon Sect Leader unable to muster the will to resist or flee for the moment.
But since Lin Jing hadn’t killed him, there must be a reason.
Now, facing Lin Jing again, his eyes no longer held fear.
“Why didn’t you kill me?” the Moon Demon Sect Leader asked Lin Jing.
Lin Jing looked at the Moon Demon Sect Leader and simply said, “I give you two choices…”
“One, you can survive, but I will reduce a portion of your Cultivation, waiting for others to seek revenge on you.”
“The second is for you to dispel your own Cultivation.”
Upon hearing this, the Moon Demon Sect Leader immediately understood Lin Jing’s intention and, looking at Lin Jing, said directly, “Is it because of Shuangyue, and that Wei Zhengqing…”
Lin Jing nodded, then added another sentence: “Also their daughter!”
At this, the Moon Demon Sect Leader couldn’t help but shake his head and chuckle bitterly, murmuring, “For Shuangyue…”
“To obtain the Enlightenment Elixir and progress to the Divinity Transformation, I personally killed Shuangyue, yet ultimately, I allowed that father and daughter to escape.”
“And now, although I have achieved Divinity Transformation, I am controlled by others, having lost my freedom.”
“All of this…
is fate…”
Having said that, the Moon Demon Sect Leader sighed resignedly and then directly spoke to Lin Jing: “I choose the first…”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing wasted no words.
He simply extended his hand toward the Moon Demon Sect Leader.
At once…
Demonic Qi churned within the Moon Demon Sect Leader’s body, escaping sporadically.
This process was excruciating, and the Moon Demon Sect Leader could only bite down hard, forcibly enduring the immense torment.
As the Demonic Qi continued to escape from within the Moon Demon Sect Leader, his Cultivation also steadily declined.
Early Divinity Transformation…
Nascent Soul Peak Stage…
Nascent Soul Late Stage…
…
…
In this way, the Moon Demon Sect Leader’s Cultivation kept dwindling until it reached the early Golden Core stage, at which point Lin Jing finally stopped.

chapters.title: Chapter 883
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 883: Chapter 395: Exterminate the Demon, Reminisce_2 Chapter 883: Chapter 395: Exterminate the Demon, Reminisce_2 From the Nascent Soul Early Stage to the Golden Core Early Stage, the gap couldn’t be said to be small.
The Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect had done so much before, even at the cost of his own freedom, to join under the Demon Lord, only to have the Divinity Transformation Cultivation he had acquired disappear at this moment…
Although the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect was still alive, his heart was as dead as ashes, and even his eyes had become a dead still.
Perhaps it was this very misfortune that caused his heart to feel dead while at the same time made him fear Lin Jing no more.
Next, the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect forcibly circulated the Spiritual Power inside his body to stabilize his figure and, with those eyes full of deathlike stillness, said to Lin Jing,
“Now that you have ruined my cultivation, can I leave now?”
Lin Jing lifted his hand, a streak of flowing light flew out, transformed into a seal, and entered the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect’s body.
This seal left inside the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect’s body could not only suppress his cultivation but also detect his location at any time.
Moreover, the seal Lin Jing left behind could not be removed unless one’s cultivation was much higher than Lin Jing’s.
...
The reason Lin Jing did this was actually for Wei Zhengqing and his daughter.
When Luan Shuangyue died at the hands of the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect, Wei Zhengqing wanted revenge, but, helpless due to his low cultivation, he could only wish for it.
Now that Lin Jing had reduced the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect to the Golden Core Early Stage, he did it to give Wei Zhengqing an opportunity.
Otherwise, unable to avenge personally, it would have impacted Wei Zhengqing’s state of mind, and he likely wouldn’t have been able to go far on his cultivation path.
After instilling the seal into the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect, Lin Jing spoke directly,
“You can go now…”Hearing this, the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect looked up at Lin Jing and then said,
“When you see father and daughter, tell them that I will be waiting for them in Bihai City, waiting for them to seek revenge.”
Having said that, the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect turned around, mounted his Magical Treasure, and left the place.
…
It wasn’t until the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Demon Sect had left that Lin Jing turned around, facing Li Qingqing and the others.
Lin Jing, having turned around, first gave a cupped fist salute to the Yan Family Patriarch and the Divine Toad and spoke directly,
“Thank you both seniors for your assistance!”
But just as Lin Jing’s words it fell silent, the Yan Family Patriarch and the Divine Toad hurriedly said,
“This is a small matter, not worth mentioning…”
“Actually, with your current cultivation, we should be calling you senior.”
To which Lin Jing replied,
“Senior Yan, you’re mistaken!”
“Although my cultivation is higher than yours, both of you seniors are much older than I am, and both have provided me with significant assistance in my early years.”
“What’s more, this time, both of you seniors risked such dangers to help my friend.
I am very grateful for what the two of you have done.”
“It’s just a title, the two seniors should not be so concerned about it.”
As Lin Jing’s words settled, the two exchanged glances, and then their hearts were set at ease.
To say who in the world could truly be selfless, of course, there are, but certainly not many.
The reason the Yan Family Patriarch and the Divine Toad had responded to Li Qingqing’s request to help Li Tanyu in passing her tribulation was partly because of Lin Jing.
This was nothing to be ashamed of, mutual benefit and reciprocity are commonplace, not just in the Cultivation World but even among ordinary people in the mortal realm.
Since Lin Jing emerged from the Five Elements Ruins, they had seen Lin Jing’s potential.
So, after Lin Jing went to the Inner Sea, they still offered a lot of help to Li Qingqing and Ye Yun and even braved the pressure brought by the Demon Lord to protect Li Tanyu.
Lin Jing was also very aware of this, but the fact that the Yan Family Patriarch and the Divine Toad chose to help Li Qingqing, besides having faith in him, was genuine sincerity.
Lin Jing wasn’t the kind of person who would be ungrateful.
Since they had helped him, he would definitely find a way to repay them.
…
Later on, the Yan Family Patriarch observed Lin Jing for a moment and then asked,
“When you first arrived, I already sensed the aura on you.
Your aura is far more terrifying than that of a Dao Integration cultivator.”
“Have you now become a Tribulation Passer Cultivator?”
There was no need to hide his own cultivation matters, Lin Jing directly replied,
“Yes, I have now become a Tribulation Passer Cultivator.”
Even though they were mentally prepared, Lin Jing’s answer still greatly shocked the two of them.
And Li Qingqing, Ye Yun, and Zhang Jian, who were standing by, were simply stunned.
Before Lin Jing left, he had already reached the pinnacle of the Solidifying Body Realm, which Li Qingqing knew.
She had thought that Lin Jing would, at most, be at the Dao Integration Stage by now.
But unexpectedly, after just a few decades, Lin Jing had leaped past Dao Integration and entered the Tribulation Passing Stage.
ƝοѵǤօ.ᴄο
Such a speed, even for Li Qingqing who was extremely familiar with Lin Jing, was nothing short of incredible.
Li Qingqing was already in such a state, so there was even less need to mention Zhang Jian, who was completely numb.
Only Ye Yun, after the shock, could not hide his delight, seemingly more joyful than if he had entered the Transcendance Tribulation Stage himself.
At this moment, Ye Yun spoke up, asking Lin Jing,
“Master…
“Now that you’ve advanced to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, is Ye Yun…
is she alright…?”
“After you left, I heard that there was a huge conflict in the Inner Sea, involving several of the top powers in the Inner Sea.”
“Because of this, I was worried for a long time.”
“If it weren’t for the instructions you gave me before you left, I would have gone to the Inner Sea alone.”
Lin Jing then spoke,
“Don’t worry.”
“Lin Jue is fine, she’s currently on Li Yan Island.”
“You were right not to go to the Inner Sea because I only stayed in the Inner Sea for a short time during that conflict before I left for the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
“This time we came back, we came directly from the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
No sooner had Lin Jing finished speaking than the Patriarch of the Yan Family asked,
“You went to the Eastern Spirit Realm, did you have some fortunate encounter there?
Is that why your cultivation has advanced so rapidly, breaking through to the Transcendance Tribulation Stage in just a few decades?”
Lin Jing looked at the Patriarch of the Yan Family and shook his head,
“It’s not like that…”
“Indeed, I did encounter a stroke of fortune, but it was not in the Eastern Spirit Realm.”
At this point, Lin Jing paused, then spoke again,
“To be truthful with both seniors…”
