With such a terrifying speed, if there hadn’t been something like System Space, which could serve as a temporary refuge, even a Mahayana cultivator with a lifespan of twenty thousand years wouldn’t have been able to withstand this horrifying vitality-devouring force.
...
Additionally,
the speed of this vitality devouring was somewhat different from the information he had researched before.
Perhaps it was because too much time had passed, and the Samsara Holy Fruit had undergone some unknown changes, or perhaps it was because no one had ever come as close to the Samsara Holy Fruit as Lin Jing had.
This was what had caused such a situation.
ƝονǤ0.сᴑ
Having thought about it, Lin Jing then decided not to wait any longer and planned to directly use the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function to teleport above the statue where the Samsara Holy Fruit was located.
Although the vitality-devouring power was terrifying, Lin Jing, who was at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of cultivation, had a lifespan of ten thousand years, whereas he had only cultivated for three hundred years.
With over nine thousand years of lifespan left, Lin Jing had enough time to approach the Samsara Holy Fruit and let System Space take it inside.
It could be said that as long as Lin Jing approached the Samsara Holy Fruit, this task would be accomplished; there would likely be no accidents.
Moreover,
even if there were any mishaps, Lin Jing could simply hide inside the System Space.
Even if he lost some lifespan as a result, he could manufacture some Flawless-quality Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs to compensate for his lost lifespan.
Thinking this way, there really wasn’t anything to worry about.
Having decided, Lin Jing immediately began to act.
Learning from his previous lessons, Lin Jing first used Observation Mode to scout the statue where the Samsara Fruit was located, along with the surrounding area.
After the scouting confirmed there were no threats nearby, Lin Jing once again activated the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
Fixed-Point Teleportation function activated, Lin Jing directly selected the spot above the statue’s head, near where the Samsara Holy Fruit was located, and executed the teleport.
“Ding!”
“System notification: Host has used Fixed-Point Teleportation, deducted one Harvest Point, current remaining Harvest Points: 51253.”
As the system notification sound fell, Lin Jing began to feel the tearing force of the teleportation.
The next moment, Lin Jing materialized on top of the statue in the middle of Primordial Immortal City.
As soon as he appeared, Lin Jing felt an extremely terrifying vitality-devouring force.
This vitality-devouring power was so overwhelming that Lin Jing felt his vitality rapidly leaving his body.
Lin Jing’s originally black hair also turned white visibly fast at that moment, and even his body was rapidly aging.
The moment Lin Jing appeared, those Yin Spirits that had been wandering around Primordial Immortal City seemed to suddenly regain consciousness, all turning their heads to look at the position of Lin Jing on the statue.
“Roar…”
Many Yin Spirits roared in unison and then charged towards Lin Jing, throwing caution to the wind.
The terrifying vitality-devouring power, coupled with the numerous Yin Spirits, put Lin Jing into a very dangerous situation in an instant.
However, just at that moment, a sudden system notification broke through everything at this critical moment.
“Ding!”
“System notification: Congratulations to the host for finding one of the three World Seeds, the Samsara Holy Fruit, reward granted: 1000000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System notification: Samsara Holy Fruit is being collected, any operations in System Space are currently disabled, please wait momentarily, Host.”
As the system notification sound fell, Lin Jing noticed that the Samsara Holy Fruit, not far from him, was enveloped by a transparent energy screen and began to slowly rise from the crater on the statue’s head.
At that moment, Lin Jing also noticed that the previously extremely terrifying vitality-devouring force had suddenly disappeared.
Even those Yin Spirits that were about to charge at him seemed to lose control and fell into a stupor, motionless.
The Samsara Holy Fruit, enveloped by the energy screen, seemed unaffected, with its black and white colors rotating continuously like a Tai Chi Diagram, without the slightest pause.
As the Samsara Holy Fruit rose higher under the cover of the system light screen, up to the level of Lin Jing’s chest, it suddenly vanished from sight.
As the Samsara Holy Fruit disappeared, another system notification reached Lin Jing’s ears:
“Ding!”
“System notification: Samsara Holy Fruit collection complete, System Space functionality restored.”
With the Samsara Holy Fruit collected into System Space, Lin Jing could now return to System Space.
However,
at this moment, Lin Jing wasn’t in a hurry to go back inside System Space because his attention was caught by the many Yin Spirits in Primordial Immortal City.
After the Samsara Holy Fruit had been retracted into System Space, these previously dazed and indestructible Yin Spirits started to change.
The dense aura of death that had enveloped these Yin Spirits was slowly dissipating, and the aura around all the Yin Spirits was also becoming more tranquil.

chapters.title: Chapter 895
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 895: Chapter 401: Collecting the Samsara Holy Fruit_2 Chapter 895: Chapter 401: Collecting the Samsara Holy Fruit_2 And the gaze of the Yin Spirits also shifted from the initial chaos, gradually becoming lucid, and with this transformation, their cultivation began to dissipate as well.
In just a short time, these Yin Spirits had all transformed completely, becoming average Yin Spirits without any trace of cultivation.
After the transformation was complete, all the Yin Spirits in this city regained their previous memories, waking up completely.
However, once these Yin Spirits became conscious, their spiritual bodies also began to slowly dissolve.
These people had died in the disaster a million years ago and it was only because of the Power of Reincarnation emanating from the Samsara Holy Fruit that they had remained undying as Yin Spirits until now.
Now that Lin Jing had taken the Samsara Holy Fruit into the System Space, without the support of the Power of Reincarnation from the fruit, they were bound to completely disperse.
It was then that Lin Jing, observing his surroundings, noticed that all the Yin Spirits in the entire Primordial Immortal City were looking in his direction, respectfully bowing towards him.
...
Having survived a million years in the state of Yin Spirits was not a blessing for them, but a punishment.
Just like the first Yin Spirit Lin Jing had encountered before, which had momentarily regained clarity before dissolving, their first desire upon awakening was for Lin Jing to save them, to free them…
These Yin Spirits also longed for someone to save them, didn’t they?
And now, Lin Jing had accomplished just that.
For this very reason, all the Yin Spirits in the entire Primordial Immortal City were deeply grateful to Lin Jing.
Standing atop the statue, Lin Jing silently watched everything before him, his heart inevitably filled with a multitude of emotions.
After a short while…
The Yin Spirits began to disappear gradually.
One, two, three…
Eventually turning into whole swathes…
They dissipated like smoke in the wind, leaving nothing behind.
After a few breaths, all millions of the Yin Spirits within the Primordial Immortal City had vanished, completely returning to the world.
And now, within the Primordial Immortal City, only Lin Jing remained.
With the Samsara Holy Fruit’s influence gone and the Yin Spirits dispersed, the entire Barren Forbidden Zone ceased to exist.
In not too long a time, this Barren Forbidden Zone would slowly regain vitality; the Spiritual Energy would gradually return, and it would once again become a sacred place for cultivation.
In time, there would likely be cultivators who would come here to establish Sects, mortals who would migrate to live and multiply.
However, this process would require a lengthy period.
Since the Samsara Holy Fruit had fallen into the South Continent’s Domain of Ming, it had not only devoured vitality but also Spiritual Power.
Originally, the South Continent’s Domain of Ming had dozens of major Spirit Veins underground, but under the terrifying consumption of the Samsara Holy Fruit, these veins had all dried up, turning the fruit’s influence range into a barren wasteland, known as the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Now that Lin Jing had taken away the Samsara Holy Fruit, the main culprit behind all this was gone, opening up the possibility for the Barren Forbidden Zone to recover.
Even without the Samsara Holy Fruit, for the Barren Forbidden Zone to fully recover, it would take tens to hundreds of millions of years, which would likely not be sufficient.
…
After all the Yin Spirits had dispersed, Lin Jing expanded his Divine Sense in full, enveloping the entire Primordial Immortal City within it, and began to explore the city.
After a million years of corrosion, this once top-three-ranked Immortal City in the South Continent’s Domain of Ming had become extremely fragile.
Even the immensely powerful city-protecting Formation had completely vanished under the effect of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense easily penetrated the entire city, having investigated everything within the Immortal City.
There was nothing left here.
Under the influence of the Samsara Holy Fruit’s power, even the Daoist Treasures of cultivators would decay over time, eventually crumbling completely.
If it were for a brief period, some treasures might have remained, but a million years was far too long, and no treasures of any quality could withstand it.
ƝοѵǤ0.сο
After the investigation, Lin Jing retracted his Divine Sense, then summoned the System and spoke,
“Enter System Space.”
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, he disappeared from the spot, and the next moment, he appeared inside the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing hastened to the edge and checked on the Samsara Holy Fruit that had been acquired by the System.
At that moment, the Samsara Holy Fruit was rooted in one of the three special areas that had emerged after the System upgrade.
The place where the Samsara Holy Fruit was located was the very ground for the growth of the fruit, within the Nine Heavens Cycle of Reincarnation.
The three special cultivation areas of the World Seed were still isolated, and Lin Jing was unable to approach.
Rooted in the land of the Nine Heavens Cycle of Reincarnation, the devouring power that the Samsara Holy Fruit emanated could not affect the inside of the System Space.
Since the Samsara Holy Fruit had been collected into the System Space, Lin Jing assumed he could now view the information about the Samsara Holy Fruit through the System Space.
Lin Jing then directly summoned the system panel, and in the system panel, he immediately saw the introduction to the Samsara Holy Fruit:
Immortal Dao Realm World Seed: Samsara Holy Fruit (Incomplete)
Growth Environment: Nine Heavens Samsara Realm
Growth Years: ???
(World Seed shares the lifespan with the Immortal Dao Realm; if the Immortal Dao Realm exists, the World Seed thrives, if the Immortal Dao Realm perishes, the World Seed is destroyed.)
(The Samsara Holy Fruit, one of the three great World Seeds of the Immortal Dao Realm, possesses the Power of Reincarnation.)
Note: Currently, this fruit is incomplete, the Power of Reincarnation is chaotic, devouring all surrounding vitality and spiritual power, and within its influence, all deceased creatures do not enter reincarnation, forever controlled by this World Seed.
(Injecting Immortal Yuan is required to repair its incomplete state and stabilize its power of reincarnation to restore it to normal.)
…
Seeing the introduction about the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing understood the main reason for the formation of the Barren Forbidden Zone.
It turns out that because the Samsara Holy Fruit was incomplete, it was such; if the Samsara Holy Fruit were normal, it probably wouldn’t be like this.
The conditions for repairing the Samsara Holy Fruit afterward gave Lin Jing quite a headache; he had not expected that repairing the Samsara Holy Fruit would also require Immortal Yuan.
It seemed he would need to find a way to obtain more Immortal Yuan.
…
…
After checking the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing directly operated the system panel to check his lifespan.
The horrifying force of vitality devouring he felt when approaching the Samsara Holy Fruit had left Lin Jing somewhat chilled even now.
Just in that instant, Lin Jing felt that a lot of his vitality had been devoured, and now that the matter of the Samsara Holy Fruit was resolved, he needed to take a look.
As the system panel switched to display his information, Lin Jing quickly looked:
Lin Jing (251/8392)
Spiritual Root: Supreme Grade Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root
Cultivation: Tribulation First Layer (32%)
Cultivation Technique: Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, Five Elements Divine Art, Overlord Divine Physique, Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique, Divine Fire Triple Realm…
…
…
He hadn’t noticed before, but now, seeing his lifespan abruptly shortened by more than a thousand years, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a sense of dread.
He had only been near the Samsara Holy Fruit for about a couple of breaths after Fixed Point Teleportation before the System Space appeared and wrapped around the Samsara Holy Fruit.
But even such a short time, without even touching the Samsara Holy Fruit, so much of his vitality was devoured, a whole thousand years of lifespan was lost.
No wonder there was such a noticeable change in Lin Jing’s body right after teleporting.
Although he had previously taken the Flawless Eternal Youth Elixir, under such terrifying devouring power of vitality, the elixir probably couldn’t withstand it.
But thankfully, now that he had successfully collected the Samsara Holy Fruit, there was no longer a need to worry.
As for the lifespan he had lost, it seemed he needed to find some time after returning to concoct a batch of Flawless-grade Longevity Life-Extension Elixir to replenish it.
Having finished checking, Lin Jing then closed the system panel and took one last look at the Samsara Holy Fruit before leaving the System Space.
Stepping out of the System Space, Lin Jing reappeared atop the statue in the Primordial Immortal City.
Standing on the statue, Lin Jing gazed into the distance.
At this moment, the entire Barren Forbidden Zone had no Yin Spirits, nor was it devouring any vitality.
It would probably be noticed soon, and people would come to investigate.
Lin Jing had to leave quickly before anyone noticed, lest they see him leaving from this spot and start making connections.
About the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing didn’t want anyone to know it was his doing, including Li Qingqing and Lin Jue.
After all, the Samsara Holy Fruit was not of this realm and could not be taken by ordinary people; if word got out, it would bring endless trouble to him.
As for what to do after leaving…
Next, Lin Jing needed to find a way to obtain the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
He already knew the location of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, which was on Immortal Crossing Island, but the island’s appearances were somewhat unpredictable, and entering it was not so easy.
For the time being, Lin Jing could only wait…

chapters.title: Chapter 896
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 896: Chapter 402: Return to Nanshan Immortal City, Enter the Demon Race Secret Realm Chapter 896: Chapter 402: Return to Nanshan Immortal City, Enter the Demon Race Secret Realm As he left, because the Samsara Holy Fruit was no longer there and the Yin Spirits had all dissipated, Lin Jing no longer needed to use the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function of the System Space like before; he moved bit by bit.
His speed naturally increased significantly.
It only took him three to four days to leave the Barren Forbidden Zone and return to Yunling Town.
This trip altogether took Lin Jing ten days to obtain the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Although it took a bit longer than he had anticipated, the result was still satisfactory.
After arriving in Yunling Town, Lin Jing made a special effort to investigate.
Through his investigation, Lin Jing found out…
...
Due to the infamous reputation of the Barren Forbidden Zone and the fact that apart from barrenness, there was nothing else inside, no one would go there unless they were lost by accident.
It had been several years since anyone had entered the Barren Forbidden Zone, and since Lin Jing took the Samsara Holy Fruit only three to four days had passed; naturally, the abnormal conditions within the Barren Forbidden Zone had not yet been discovered by anyone.
From this situation, it seemed the abnormal conditions in the Barren Forbidden Zone might still take some time to be discovered.
After discovering the information he wanted, Lin Jing did not stay in Yunling Town but directly left the place.
Leaving Yunling Town, Lin Jing then flew directly toward Nanshan Immortal City.
Before returning to Nanshan Immortal City and reuniting with everyone, Lin Jing especially stimulated his Spiritual Power to turn the white hair caused by the Samsara Holy Fruit back to pitch black.
Next,
Lin Jing returned to the Li Family at Nanshan Immortal City and reunited with everyone once more.Once he returned to the Li Family in Nanshan Immortal City and saw everyone again, out of concern, Li Qingqing and others naturally inquired about Lin Jing’s whereabouts.
Faced with their questions, Lin Jing casually made up an excuse to satisfy them.
No one thought much about it, and then they joyfully reunited.
Not long after Lin Jing had returned, the Ning Family heard the news and also came to the Li Family.
Since the elder ancestor of the Ning Family and Elder Master Li were already acquainted, and Ning Yue had also come to know Li Qingqing and Li Tan thereby.
So, upon learning that Lin Jing had come back as well, the elder ancestor of the Ning Family, bringing Ning Yue along with Luo Luo and a few others from the Ning Family, had been waiting in Nanshan Immortal City and had not returned to the Ning Family.
Upon seeing Lin Jing again, aside from marveling at Lin Jing’s Cultivation,
Ning Yue was more immersed in reminiscing about the past…
Now, Ning Yue had also reached the Nascent Soul Stage, managing the entire Ning Family quite well.
Due to the absence of the troubles brought by the Howling Sky Wolf Clan, the two major Sects from the Western Demon Region had also withdrawn.
As early as last time, because the high-levels of the Nanming Immortal Sect practiced Demonic Techniques, the entire Nanming Immortal Sect was disbanded, and only two Sects remained out of the three major Sects in the Nanming Domain, which were now led by the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion.
Currently, the entire Nanming Domain was still led by the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion; apart from these two Sects, the rest included other Sect forces and some Cultivation families.
Because of Li Qingqing’s support, the Li Family, as well as the Ning Family, which had two Nascent Soul Cultivators, were considered powerful families in the entire Nanming Domain.
Naturally, no one dared to bully them.
Actually,
With Li Tan’s Solidifying Body Stage Cultivation, he already far surpassed the old ancestors of both the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion; if he were willing to come back to lead the family, the Li Family could be called the number one family in the Nanming Domain without exaggeration.
However, Li Tan had his own matters to handle and unfortunately could not lead the Li Family.
The same was true for Luo Luo.
She also had a cultivation level of the Solidifying Body Stage; if she were willing to lead the Ning Family, naturally the Ning Family would be the strongest family of the entire Nanming Domain.
But Luo Luo was already a disciple of the Immortal Celestial Sect, where she had better opportunities for development than she would have in the Nanming Domain, which would only limit her growth; how could she come back to lead the family then?
Even if Luo Luo agreed, the entire Immortal Celestial Sect and the Ning Family likely wouldn’t agree either.
Although the Nanming Domain was the homeland for several of them, its Spiritual Energy was thin, and it had very limited cultivation resources, no longer able to meet their needs.
Now that they had better opportunities for development elsewhere, it was natural for them to leave in search of better prospects.
As the saying goes, “People climb to greater heights and water flows to lower depths,” that is precisely what was happening…
This time returning, Lin Jing saw Ning Yue, but he did not see Wei Zhengqing and Yan Xiong.
According to Ning Yue, Wei Zhengqing, and his daughter Wei Siyue, along with Yan Xiong, had left the Nanming Domain decades ago.
ɴ0νǤօ.сο
Before leaving, Wei Zhengqing had come to find Ning Yue and had informed him about his departure, suggesting from the tone of his words that once he left, he might never return.
Concerning Wei Zhengqing and Ning Yue, although Lin Jing felt it was a pity, both had their own thoughts and persistence; he could only lament that they were destined to meet but not fated to be together.
…
…
After coming back, Lin Jing stayed in Nanshan Immortal City for a few days, walked around, and even visited the small courtyard where he had lived before, staying there for two days.
After staying for a few days, Lin Jing decided to head to the Demon Race Secret Realm and go to the top of Qinghuang Peak to see if Huang Qingling, Elder Yu, Elder Bai, and the others had returned during the time Lin Jing was away…
Once he had decided, Lin Jing found Li Qingqing and Li Tan and shared his plans with them.
Upon hearing that Lin Jing planned to go to the Demon Race Secret Realm and then visit Qinghuang Palace to look for traces of Huang Qingling, Li Qingqing and Li Tanyu immediately decided to join Lin Jing and see for themselves.

chapters.title: Chapter 897
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 897: Chapter 402: Return to Nanshan Immortal City, Enter the Demon Clan Secret Realm_2 Chapter 897: Chapter 402: Return to Nanshan Immortal City, Enter the Demon Clan Secret Realm_2 Lin Jing gladly agreed.
So…
The next morning, Lin Jing, along with Li Tangyu and Li Qingqing, set out for the Demon Race Secret Realm.
When the Demon Race Secret Realm was first discovered, it was full of rich Spiritual Energy, rare Spirit Plants, and various resources, making it a rare treasure trove.
However, since its discovery, the Secret Realm had been plundered successively by three major Sects and then by the Howling Sky Wolf Clan.
Moreover, after the Howling Sky Wolf Clan retreated, the Demon Race Secret Realm was reopened, allowing anyone from the Nanming Domain to enter and explore.
After years of exploration, the Demon Race Secret Realm had been nearly picked clean, making it very difficult to find any treasures.
...
The Demon Race Secret Realm wasn’t far from Nanshan Immortal City.
With the speed of the few people, they arrived there quickly.
When Lin Jing reached the entrance of the Demon Race Secret Realm, he found that the entrance had been turned into a new Immortal City.
This entire Immortal City, although not as large as Nanshan Immortal City, still covered a sizeable area.
Moreover, the Immortal City was jointly managed by the Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion.
ƝονǤᴑ.ƈ0
Any Cultivator who wanted to enter the Demon Race Secret Realm would have to pay Spirit Stones for the privilege.
And the fee was not cheap.
Even so, from time to time, some people would strike it lucky and make a considerable profit from their finds, which in turn attracted even more people to the Demon Race Secret Realm in search of treasure.
Thanks to the entrance to this Demon Race Secret Realm, the two Sects were making a fortune.
When Lin Jing and the others arrived, they entered the city but didn’t head directly to the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Instead, they went to an Elixir Pavilion that the Li Family had set up in the city.
Since Li Qingqing often stayed in the Thousand Islands Domain and rarely came back, the Li Family’s home in Nanshan Immortal City needed someone to take care of it.
Therefore, Li Qingqing arranged for Elder Jin to look after the Li Family’s old house in Nanshan Immortal City.
As for the Elixir Pavilion, it was handed over to Li Qingqing’s good-for-nothing third uncle, who was tasked with overseeing it, giving him something to do so he wouldn’t be idle and cause more trouble.
Upon arriving, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu, of course, went to see their third uncle to check how the Elixir Pavilion was doing under his management.
When they walked into the Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion, Li Qingqing’s third uncle, seeing the trio, came out smiling broadly to greet them.
It must be said…
Li Qingqing’s third uncle was indeed lucky.
Originally, he had almost no hope of advancing his rank, but just then, due to the old ancestor of the Nanming Immortal Sect, Lin Jing conveyed a message to Li Qingqing, moving the entire Li Family to the Thousand Islands Domain.
And so, he followed suit, brought along to the Thousand Islands Domain by Li Qingqing.
Later, in the Thousand Islands Domain, he benefited from the Li Family’s connections to acquire numerous cultivation resources, advancing all the way to the peak of the Foundation Establishment stage.
Knowing that her third uncle had reached the peak of Foundation Establishment, Li Qingqing naturally wouldn’t neglect him, preparing for him some Cultivation True Elixirs and other Elixir Medicines needed for crossing the Tribulation.
After that, Li Qingqing’s third uncle successfully crossed the Heavenly Tribulation and advanced to the Golden Core Stage.
Perhaps it was for this reason that Li Qingqing’s third uncle became very obedient to her from then on.
He did not have any complaints about Li Qingqing’s arrangements.
Compared to before, his third uncle might not have had the talent or suitability to manage the family, but leaving him here, not involved in the management of the Elixir Pavilion, but just to preside over it, was quite a good decision.
“Qing Qing…”
“Tan Yu…”
“And Lin Gongzi, what brings the three of you here?”
After Li Qingqing’s third uncle arrived, he quickly greeted the trio and asked.
“Third Uncle…”
“Third Uncle…”
Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu greeted their third uncle, and then Li Qingqing spoke:
“We plan to take a trip to the Demon Race Secret Realm and thought to stop by our Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion here first.”
“How is our Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion doing these days?”
Li Qingqing’s third uncle replied:
“The Elixir Pavilion is doing well, Qing Qing, don’t worry.”
“Although I, your Third Uncle, don’t have much talent and am not suited to manage the family, guarding the Elixir Pavilion is still no problem,” he said.
Because of the previous incident with the Yun Family, he was almost used by them, with the intention of making Li Qingqing compete for the position of Family Head.
This matter was later laid out in the open, and it made Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle realize his own limited talent and that he was not fit to manage the family.
So now he has let go, and being able to help guard the Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion was actually quite good.
Moreover, since Li Qingqing took over the family, he had never been treated poorly and even helped him advance to the Golden Core Stage, exceeding most cultivators.
What could he be dissatisfied with?
“Come…”
“Let’s first take a look inside our own Elixir Pavilion, then later Third Uncle will take you to the entrance of the Secret Realm.
Currently guarding the entrance is an old friend of father’s, Elder Wang.”
“Elder Wang will certainly be very surprised to see you.”
Elder Wang must be none other than the one from the Qingyuan Sword Sect, there couldn’t be another.
Afterward, the three of them, led by Li Qingqing’s Third Uncle, took a tour around the Li Family’s Elixir Pavilion and looked around.
After the tour, they left the Elixir Pavilion together and went to the Demon Race Secret Realm entrance in the city.
There, they indeed encountered Elder Wang guarding the entrance.
By then, Elder Wang had advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage and become a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
However, when he saw Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu, he found, to his shock, that he could not see through the cultivation levels of either one.
Li Qingqing, throughout these years in the Thousand Islands Domain, had always been abundant in cultivation resources, and his cultivation progress was not slow, having long become a Divine Transformation Cultivator.
Li Tangyu, needless to say, had directly advanced to the Solidifying Body Realm, surpassing the elder ancestor of Qingyuan Sword Sect.
Beyond his shock, Elder Wang hastily inquired about their cultivation levels.
When faced with Elder Wang’s questions, they did not hide anything and directly revealed their cultivation.
Hearing their levels of cultivation, especially Li Tangyu’s, Elder Wang was utterly stunned.
It wasn’t until a good while later that Elder Wang snapped out of it and then looked at the two, inevitably filled with many emotions.
After this shocking revelation, Elder Wang became like a late-in-life elder, recounting all sorts of past events.
He even mentioned Elder Master Li.
He said that if Elder Master Li were still alive, he would certainly feel proud of them.
But as Elder Wang said this, Li Tangyu couldn’t help but bow his head.
The previous Li Tangyu could be described as a young man achieving early success, with a spirit not unlike the gust of the wind.
But everything changed once he left the Nanming Domain.
He encountered unprecedented hardships; the whole person even fell into the Demonic Path and became a Demon Cultivator.
Even the Alchemy Technique he once took pride in was abandoned by him.
If his grandfather knew that he had fallen into the Demonic Path, became a Demon Cultivator, and abandoned Alchemy Technique, who knows what his grandfather would think…
…
They didn’t stay long there; after the chat, Elder Wang personally took them to the entrance of the Demon Race Secret Realm.
Under Elder Wang’s arrangements, they directly went through the entrance to the Secret Realm and entered the Demon Race Secret Realm.
This time entering the Demon Race Secret Realm was different from before.
Although the environment here was still the same as before, Lin Jing felt that, compared to before, the Spiritual Energy was much thinner.
Perhaps it was because it had been open too long and the Demon Race Secret Realm had been almost fully explored, which would explain its current state.
Turning his head to look around, Lin Jing then directly expanded his Divine Sense, probing the surroundings.
After entering the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, Lin Jing’s range of Divine Sense had reached an unimaginable level.
Yet, at this newly transported entrance, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense already reached Qinghuang Peak.
However, even though Lin Jing’s Divine Sense could reach Qinghuang Peak, the Formation there still blocked it from penetrating further.
He was never able to sense the Qinghuang Palace above Qinghuang Peak.
Just from this fact alone, it was foreseeable how extraordinary the background of Huang Qingling must be.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing turned to Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu and said,
“Let’s go…”
“I’ll take you up Qinghuang Peak to see if Qing Ling and the others have returned.”

chapters.title: Chapter 898
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 898: 403 Chapter 898: 403 Qinghuang Peak, known as Tongtian Peak when first discovered by the three major sects.
Hidden in clouds that reached into the sky, its true height remained a mystery.
The entire mountain of Qinghuang Peak was covered with numerous formations.
Even the invading Howling Sky Wolf Clan, along with two major sects from the Western Demon Region, had tried to break through these formations.
But even they could not dismantle the formations on Qinghuang Peak and ultimately had to give up reluctantly.
Thus, to this day, nobody had managed to ascend Qinghuang Peak apart from Lin Jing and his friends who were first there.
It wasn’t long before the three arrived at a dense forest.
...
Upon reaching this dense forest, Lin Jing suddenly stopped and descended from the sky.
Although puzzled, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu also followed Lin Jing down.
After landing, Lin Jing looked at the greatly changed dense forest and shook his head before speaking to the two,
“This was where Qingqing, Zhang Yuan, and I encountered that calamity previously.”
“It was also here that Wu Cai Immortal self-destructed, Elder Yu and Elder Bai were seriously injured, and Zhang Yuan resisted the orders of the Zhang Family Patriarch, Zhang Chenfan, ultimately perishing here…”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu turned their heads, observing their surroundings.
Lin Jing continued,
“Unfortunately, so much time has passed, and this place has changed since then.”After Lin Jing finished speaking, Li Tangyu suddenly remarked,
“Zhang Family Patriarch, Zhang Chenfan, kept such a low profile usually; who would have thought he could be so ruthless.”
“What a pity for Brother Zhang Yuan…”
“Yes…”
Li Qingqing nodded and then said,
“Lin Jing, didn’t you say they were all saved by Sister Qing Ling?”
“We should still be able to see them again.”
Lin Jing looked towards the direction of Qinghuang Peak and said,
“Perhaps…”
After speaking, Lin Jing took one final look at the place, then suppressing his emotions, said to the two,
“Let’s go, let’s check out Qinghuang Peak first.”
“I hope they have already returned.”
“Okay…” both replied simultaneously.
The trio then took off again, flying towards Qinghuang Peak.
…
…
Before long, Lin Jing and his companions arrived at the foot of Qinghuang Peak, where Fang Market was situated.
The market housed many cultivators entering the Demon Race Secret Realm, clearly becoming a gathering place for cultivators within the Secret Realm.
The three were familiar with this place.
This was exactly where they, led by the Li Family Elder, had entered the Spirit Cleansing Cave before.
ƝοѵǤօ.с0
Lin Jing had already extended his Divine Sense into the Spirit Cleansing Cave.
It had been restored and utilized again by the two major sects, and the amount of Cleansing Spirit Liquid inside had also increased since before.
Now, the access to Spirit Cleansing Cave was not limited to members of the two major sects and their families but was open to all cultivators in the Nanming Domain.
However, entry into the Spirit Cleansing Cave required a significant amount of Spirit Stones, the fees being quite high; not just loose cultivators, but even ordinary families couldn’t afford it.
If the three could go up Qinghuang Peak without drawing attention, that would be ideal.
Thus…
Lin Jing and his companions did not enter the Fang Market but bypassed it and flew around to another side of Qinghuang Peak.
Continuing this way, they arrived at the foot of Qinghuang Peak, making sure no one else was nearby.
As soon as they neared Qinghuang Peak, Lin Jing immediately felt the Divine Phoenix power hidden within him stir.
Following that,
Lin Jing, together with Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu, made their way up Qinghuang Peak.
As Lin Jing climbed higher, he got closer to the formations on Qinghuang Peak and the Divine Phoenix power stirring within him became more conspicuous.
Finally…
When the trio reached the formations, the Divine Phoenix power inside Lin Jing burst forth and transformed into a Divine Phoenix phantom in mid-air.
The Divine Phoenix phantom screeched and charged upwards towards the peak of Shenhuang Peak.
As the Divine Phoenix passed, the formations parted, creating a pathway to the peak of Shenhuang Peak.
Seeing this path appear, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu were both astonished.
The formations on Qinghuang Peak, which had troubled others for so long, had opened a pathway to the peak for them.
“Time waits for no one, let’s go…”
Lin Jing spoke and then proceeded along the newly formed path, heading upwards.
Seeing this, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu quickly followed Lin Jing toward the peak of Qinghuang Peak.
After the trio passed, the separated formations closed again, returning to their original state.
With the formations behind them closing, they increased their pace, flying towards the peak.
The three of them, being high in cultivation, were naturally fast and soon reached the top.
There, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu finally saw the Qinghuang Palace Lin Jing had spoken of.
The entire Qinghuang Palace was grand and majestic, impressing them upon their first sight.
After reaching the peak, Lin Jing then turned his attention to the grand hall at the center.

chapters.title: Chapter 899
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 899: Chapter 403 Qingyuan Sword Sect Ancestor’s Invitation_2 Chapter 899: Chapter 403 Qingyuan Sword Sect Ancestor’s Invitation_2 Following that,
Lin Jing led the two directly toward the grand hall.
Upon reaching the entrance of the hall, Lin Jing looked inside and couldn’t help but feel a wave of disappointment.
The interior of the hall was exactly the same as the last time he had seen it.
Clearly, they had not returned.
Though this was the case, Lin Jing still led the two into the hall.
After entering, Lin Jing spoke to the two saying,
“This place is where Qing Ling is located.”
After finishing, Lin Jing pointed toward the deep center of the hall at a high platform and spoke again,
“And there is where the true body of Qing Ling is located.”
“Just looking at the situation here, it’s exactly the same as when I last came, it seems they have not returned.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Li Qingqing and Li Tangyu both nodded and then said,
“They couldn’t have just vanished into thin air, they must have gone somewhere else.”
Lin Jing nodded,
“That’s what I think too.”
“We just don’t know where they have gone or if they will come back here.”
After finishing, Lin Jing again spoke to the two,“Let’s go, I will show you around firstâ€¦”
“After we have looked around, let’s head back directly.”
The two nodded, and under Lin Jing’s lead, they toured around Qinghuang Palace.
After finishing the tour, the three of them left Qinghuang Palace together.
...
…
Venturing down from Qinghuang Peak, Lin Jing and his companions also took a look around the Demon Race Secret Realm before leaving the realm a day later.
As the three of them left the Demon Race Secret Realm and returned to the entrance of the realm at Immortal City, unexpectedly, two people were there waiting for them.
Lin Jing knew both individuals, and their appearance surprised him, yet it was entirely reasonable.
Because these two…
were none other than the Elders of Qingyuan Sword Sect and Yiyun Pavilion.
Their visit was not for anyone else but for Li Tangyu.
The former Li Family young master who, in an extremely short period of time, had surpassed them to become a practitioner of the Solidifying Body Realm.
How could they not be startled?
In order to probe the secret behind Li Tangyu’s rapid advancements and how he obtained the Five Elements Spirit, and moreover, to forge good relations with this newly advanced cultivator from the Li Family,
thus, these two great sect Elders personally came.
Behind the two Elders, Elder Wang stood, looking somewhat embarrassed at the group.
Since his return, Li Tangyu had not revealed his cultivation level in front of outsiders.
It was only in front of his grandfather’s good friend, Elder Wang, that he had shared a bit.
Clearly, it was Elder Wang who had let this slip.
However, Lin Jing fully understood such actions by Elder Wang, as he was an Elder of Qingyuan Sword Sect and naturally had to think for the sect.
Moreover, if Li Tangyu could occasionally reveal a word or two, even if Li Tangyu and Li Qingqing were usually too busy to stay at the Li Family, Qingyuan Sword Sect could still help look after the Li Family in the Nanming Domain.
This was a win-win situation.
Therefore, Elder Wang took the initiative to inform the Qingyuan Sword Sect Elder about Li Tangyu.
However…
Li Tangyu had not told Elder Wang about his practice of Demonic Techniques.
Otherwise, he certainly would not have done so.
Facing the two great Sect Elders, Li Tangyu naturally knew their intentions.
Li Tangyu didn’t want to entangle further with them; he simply spoke the truth, stated he had learned the Demonic Path and released some of the demonic Qi from his body.
The two Elders, upon hearing Li Tangyu’s words and sensing the demonic Qi, couldn’t help but be shocked and immediately became defensive.
Even Elder Wang was startled.
Then…
Li Tangyu explained to the two Elders and reassured them that, although he practiced Demonic Techniques, he was not a person who committed indiscriminate murder; additionally, with the Li Family being in the Nanming Domain, he wouldn’t cause harm to the Nanming Domain.
Hearing this, the two finally relaxed.
Then the two Elders didn’t dwell on this matter any further and laughed it off.
Afterward, their attention turned to Lin Jing and Li Qingqing.
Since Li Qingqing occasionally returned to the Nanming Domain, the two were already aware of her identity and clear about her cultivation level.
But Lin Jing…
The Qingyuan Sword Sect Elder looked at Lin Jing and then spoke,
“Lin Jing…
Lin Daoyou, right.”
“We have met before, right here when Senior Shi from the East Continent Spiritual Realm joined a mission to annihilate several Solidifying Body Realm demon cultivators from the Western Demon Region, and Lin Daoyou was with him.”
“Only when we left, Lin Daoyou mentioned that Senior Shi had gone to the Outer Spatial Void.
We’ve never had the chance to see Senior Shi again, which is quite regretful.”
“I wonder if Lin Daoyou has had any contact with Senior Shi?”
Earlier, in order to avoid trouble, Lin Jing had concealed his own cultivation level.
Ɲονցᴑ.сο
Hence, Elder Wang, and even now the two great Sect Elders, were unaware of Lin Jing’s specific cultivation level, still believing him to be at the Divinity Transformation Stage as before.
For this, however, Lin Jing naturally wouldn’t go to explain; otherwise, it would only lead to many complications which would not be worth the trouble.
Lin Jing then spoke,
“I haven’t been in contact with Senior Shi for a while.”
Hearing this, the Qingyuan Sword Sect Elder shook his head and sighed then said,
“I see…”
“That’s quite a pity.”
After finishing, the Qingyuan Sword Sect Elder continued looking at Lin Jing and spoke,
“When Lin Daoyou and Senior Shi appeared together last time, it certainly shocked many people.”
“One of our Qingyuan Sword Sect Elders recognized Lin Daoyou, realizing that you used to be a member of Qingyuan Sword Sect.
How I didn’t know before is truly an oversight of this old man.”

chapters.title: Chapter 900
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 900: Chapter 403: Invitation from the Ancestor of Qingyuan Sword Sect_3 Chapter 900: Chapter 403: Invitation from the Ancestor of Qingyuan Sword Sect_3 “I would like to invite Lin Daoyou to join the Qingyuan Sword Sect once again,” “how does Lin Daoyou feel about this?”
Upon learning that Lin Jing had joined Qingyuan, something the ancestor of the Qingyuan Sword Sect hadn’t lied about was that before this, he truly didn’t know Lin Jing was someone from the Qingyuan Sword Sect.
What was his identity?
That was the ancestral master of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, why would he bother with a disciple of the Qingyuan Sword Sect?
Oh no…!
He wasn’t even a disciple, but a Spirit Farmer of the Qingyuan Sword Sect.
The status of a Spirit Farmer was the lowest within the sect, even lower than that of a servant disciple.
Ɲ0νǤο.ƈο
...
It was only after Lin Jing appeared alongside Grandfather Shi Tian and advanced to the Divinity Transformation Stage that he began to draw the attention of others.
It was then that the ancestral masters of the two great sects began to take note of Lin Jing and investigate his identity.
When they discovered Lin Jing’s identity, in fact, the ancestral master of the Qingyuan Sword Sect was deeply shocked, as Lin Jing had managed to reach the Divinity Transformation Stage in such a short period of time.
Apart from his connections to Elder Shi of the Eastern Spirit Realm, his own innate talent was also extraordinary.
However, even though that was the case, if it weren’t for Elder Shi’s involvement, the ancestral master of the Qingyuan Sword Sect wasn’t very optimistic about Lin Jing.
After all, to their eyes, Lin Jing was also at the Divinity Transformation Stage, while they were pursuing a realm beyond Divinity Transformation.
Unless Elder Shi from the Eastern Spirit Realm intervened on his behalf, Lin Jing alone would not be able to offer them any assistance.
They had also inquired about Elder Shi and suspected that his relationship with Lin Jing might not be that close.
After all, that was one of the top powers of the Eastern Spirit Realm, how could he have any special connection to Lin Jing, who hailed from a Spirit Farmer background at the Qingyuan Sword Sect?
Therefore, when they first came out, they contacted Li Tanyu first and only afterward, Lin Jing.
After all, Li Tanyu was a true Solidifying Body Cultivator, a being they longed to emulate.
If they could obtain even a couple of pointers from Li Tanyu, it would be greatly beneficial to them.
Unfortunately, Li Tanyu was a Demon Cultivator.
The teachings of a Demon Cultivator were different from their cultivation methods, so they couldn’t offer any guidance, leaving them no choice but to give up.
…
…
Faced with the invitation from the ancestral master of the Qingyuan Sword Sect, Lin Jing didn’t bother with pleasantries and directly declined:
“My ties with the Qingyuan Sword Sect have already ended, as for joining the Qingyuan Sword Sect,” “let’s forget about it…”
Upon hearing this, the ancestral master of the Qingyuan Sword Sect felt a slight displeasure in his heart, but he didn’t make a scene and instead, without insisting, directly said:
“If Lin Daoyou is unwilling, then let it be.”
Afterwards,
The two exchanged a few courtesies with Li Tanyu and then promptly left.
After the two left, Elder Wang stepped forward with a face full of shame and said to Li Tanyu:
“Tanyu, I’m sorry…”
“I initially thought I could help your Li Family forge a closer relationship with the Qingyuan Sword Sect, so even if the two of you were not around, the Li Family wouldn’t face any trouble.”
“I didn’t expect that you…”
Li Tanyu looked at Elder Wang and consoled him:
“It’s alright, Grandfather Wang.”
“You didn’t know in advance, it’s not your fault.”
Elder Wang looked at Li Tanyu, his voice tinged with distress:
“I remember how full of life and vigor you were back then, detesting Demon Cultivators the most and never associating with them.”
“What have you gone through all these years out there?”
Elder Wang looked at Li Tanyu, his eyes filled with affectionate concern:
“How did you…”
“How did you end up like this now?”
To this, Li Tanyu merely smiled and then said:
“Grandfather Wang…”
“Everything is in the past now.”
“The way things are now is actually quite good…”

chapters.title: Chapter 901
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 901: Chapter 404: Lu Youjiu’s Wedding, Lin Jing’s Gift Chapter 901: Chapter 404: Lu Youjiu’s Wedding, Lin Jing’s Gift After leaving the Demon Race Secret Realm and returning to Nanshan Immortal City, several days passed, and Li Tangyu decided to leave with Bai Zhi, heading for the Northern Devil Region.
Their journey to the Nanming Domain had come to a point where they needed to part ways.
At the final moment of parting, a few of them gathered for a joyous celebration at the Drunken Immortal Pavilion.
After the celebration, Li Tangyu departed.
After Li Tangyu’s departure, it was time for Lin Jing and Li Qingqing along with others to leave.
Days later, Li Qingqing had arranged everything for the Li Family and then left Nanshan Immortal City with Lin Jing, Lin Jue, and Ye Yun.
After this departure, Lin Jing planned to take them directly to the Elixir Alliance, naturally including Luo Luo.
...
After bidding farewell to Ning Yue, Luo Luo left with Lin Jing.
Ning Yue, as the current Family Head of the Ning Family, naturally needed to consider the whole Ning Family.
She did not leave but stayed at the Ning Family’s residence in Linxian City.
Although Ning Yue didn’t leave, Lin Jing had a conversation with Ning Yue and the old ancestor of the Ning Family before leaving.
Now, here in the Nanming Domain, it was indeed not suitable for cultivators to cultivate or for families to develop.
Even though Lin Jing had taken away the Samsara Holy Fruit, which was the root cause of all these changes, it was not something that could be restored overnight to the South Continent’s Domain of Ming from a million years ago.
It would take at least several tens to hundreds of millions of years for the Nanming Domain to possibly recover slowly and become a sought-after cultivation holy land again.
Now, leaving the Nanming Domain seemed more appropriate.
Furthermore, both Ning Yue and the old ancestor of the Ning Family were Nascent Soul cultivators, and their family’s strength was not weak.
Thus, Lin Jing invited Ning Yue to take her family to develop in the Thousand Islands Domain, where both the density of Spiritual Energy and the cultivation resources far surpassed those of the Nanming Domain.
This location was also more suitable for the development of the Ning Family.
After some consideration, both felt that this proposition was feasible.
However, since the Ning Family was already deeply rooted in Linxian City, even if they wanted to leave, they would need some time to prepare in advance.
Later, they replied to Lin Jing, deciding to handle all affairs of the Ning Family in Linxian City over a few years before relocating en masse to the Thousand Islands Domain.
Agreeing with their decision, Luo Luo was delighted that in the Thousand Islands Domain, under Lin Jing’s protection, Ning Yue, as the Family Head, would have a much easier time.
Even if Luo Luo wanted to return to visit Ning Yue, it would be much more convenient.
…
After leaving, the group returned to the Thousand Islands Domain.
Upon returning to the Thousand Islands Domain, Lin Jing left alone for a few days.
Days later, Lin Jing returned, bringing the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, and went to find the Divine Toad.
He then traded the Five Elements True Spirit with the Divine Toad.
The Divine Toad, overjoyed to get the Five Elements True Spirit he wanted, couldn’t wait to go into retreat to hit the Solidifying Body stage.
Lin Jing then left the Divine Toad’s place and went to Spirit Rock Island to find the old ancestor of the Yan Family.
Before going to the Nanming Domain, Lin Jing had said he would help increase their cultivation, and he naturally would not go back on his word…
…
…
Thus, six months passed in the blink of an eye.
After six months of refinement, the Divine Toad finally refined the Metallic Attribute Five Elements True Spirit, gathered all five elements within himself, and was ready to undergo Tribulation to enter the Solidifying Body stage.
The Divine Toad undergoing Tribulation, Lin Jing and the old ancestor of the Yan Family naturally offered their help.
With their assistance, the Divine Toad safely overcame the Heavenly Tribulation and entered the Solidifying Body stage.
With the old ancestor of the Yan Family’s cultivation enhanced and helping the Divine Toad reach the Solidifying Body stage, Lin Jing had essentially completed what he came back to do.
Next, it was time for them to leave.
Just as Lin Jing was planning to leave, suddenly, a joyful wedding invitation arrived from the Inner Sea to the Thousand Islands Domain…
Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang had already set an auspicious time to get married and extended a special invitation to Lin Jing and his group to attend the wedding.
Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang, after so many twists and turns, had finally attained their deserved fruition.
Seeing the wedding invitation, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling happy for them and definitely planned to attend their wedding.
It happened that they were planning to leave and return to the Elixir Alliance anyway.
After attending the wedding, Lin Jing and his group could directly return from the Inner Sea to the Elixir Alliance, making it even more convenient.
So…
After making some preparations, Lin Jing took Li Qingqing, Lin Jue, Ye Yun, and Luo Luo, preparing to leave the Thousand Islands Domain.
Before leaving, Lin Jing met with the old ancestor of the Yan Family and the Divine Toad once more to inform them of his departure and then asked them to take extra care of Yue Tian Island and Li Yan Island.
Upon hearing this, they quickly assured him that they would definitely protect Yue Tian Island and Li Yan Island.
After meeting the old ancestor of the Yan Family and the Divine Toad, Lin Jing then left with the group.
…
…
Departing from the Southern Outer Sea, it took over two months for the group to reach the Inner Sea.
It was only when they arrived at the Inner Sea that they learned how lively the event of Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang getting married was.
The Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan were top forces in the demon and monster-filled Inner Sea, so the extent of the liveliness was imaginable without saying much.
Even before the wedding had begun, the event had already spread throughout the entire Inner Sea.
Most cultivators in the Inner Sea were talking about it.
The groom was the son of Lu Jingtao, the Alliance Hierarch of the Shocking Seas Alliance, and the bride came from the Ancient Alchemy Family of the Changyun Clan, a direct descendant.
This union, causing such a sensation, was quite natural.

Moreover, to celebrate this event, the Changyun Clan’s Changyun Pill Pavilion had even boldly announced:

chapters.title: Chapter 902
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 902: Chapter 404: Lu Youjiu’s Wedding, Lin Jing’s Gift_2 Chapter 902: Chapter 404: Lu Youjiu’s Wedding, Lin Jing’s Gift_2 Regardless of who it was, anyone who purchased Elixir Medicines from the Changyun Clan within a month of the wedding day would receive a twenty percent discount.
The Changyun Clan had such an initiative, and the Shocking Seas Alliance naturally could not be without a response.
Although the Shocking Seas Alliance did not have an Elixir Pavilion, they did have other businesses.
In other businesses, the Shocking Seas Alliance also offered certain discounts.
Besides the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance, even the Seven Seas Hall announced a statement: Any cultivator who possessed an invitation and was traveling to the Changyun Clan to attend the marriage ceremony could ride the Teleportation Arrays of the seven sea cities without any fee; it was completely free of charge.
Ever since Ye Mingyi’s failure, with the control having returned to the hands of the Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall, the Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall reconciled with both the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan.
All three parties had been in conflict because of Ye Mingyi, but now Ye Mingyi had become a common enemy for all three parties.
...
Naturally, the previous discontent among them was resolved.
…
After discussions between the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan, the location of their wedding was set on Jinghai Island, where the headquarters of the Shocking Seas Alliance was located.
When Lin Jing and his party arrived at Jinghai Island, there was still some time before the day of the weddingâ€”half a month away.
At this time, however, the headquarters of the Shocking Seas Alliance was already adorned with lanterns and colored banners, all in a festive atmosphere.
As Lin Jing and his company reached Jinghai Island, Lu Youjiu and several others were informed and hurriedly came out to greet them.
However, it wasn’t just Lu Youjiu and his group who had come to welcome them; Lu Jingtao, Lu Youjiu’s father, along with the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, also arrived.
Lin Jing, now not only Lu Youjiu’s friend but also the successor of the Lin Family, and having joined the Elixir Alliance, was currently the ninth Elder within it.
Therefore,
when Lin Jing arrived, the Shocking Seas Alliance naturally could not continue to treat him with the courtesy due a junior member of the family.
Even though Lin Jing was an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, his cultivation and age, by comparison, were still far inferior to theirs.
Plus, considering his friendship with Lu Youjiu,
hence when meeting Lu Jingtao and the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, Lin Jing did not act arrogant or complacent because of his status as an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, but instead greeted them with the etiquette due from a junior:
“This junior pays respects to Elder Lu, Elder Song…”
When Lu Jingtao heard Lin Jing’s greeting, he quickly spoke up:
“Now that you are an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, you represent the Elixir Alliance when you are outside.
Your status has changed; there’s no need for you to use the courtesy of a junior.
Let it pass this time, but remember for the next time.”
Lin Jing nodded and replied,
“Thank you for the reminder, Elder Lu.
I am fully aware; however, although I am an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, whether in terms of age or cultivation or considering our relationship, I am still a junior.
Addressing the two Elders with junior’s etiquette is not unreasonable.”
“To address the two Elders with a junior’s etiquette is also in keeping with the etiquette of the cultivation world, and it will not dishonor the Elixir Alliance.
Even if our Alliance Hierarch sees me, he would certainly not blame me.”
In the Cultivation World, in addition to ranking by cultivation and age, relationship and lineage are also taken very seriously.
Although Lin Jing is now an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, whether by his age, cultivation, or the position he currently holds in relationships, he is invariably a junior.
In the face of Lu Jingtao and the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, it was natural that he should behave with the courtesy due from a junior.
The Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance was an old man with grizzled hair and a stooped figure.
Though he appeared very elderly, occasional glimpses of the energy emanating from him revealed that he was anything but simple, likely, like the ancestors of the Changyun Clan, a peak Mahayana cultivator who had practiced for countless years.
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, the Supreme Elder looked at him approvingly and nodded, saying,
“Hmm…”
“Unperturbed by honor or disgrace, not bad…”
“Jingtao has been praising you a lot before, saying you are quite remarkable.
It seems Jingtao was not wrong about you.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing bowed to the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance and said,
“You flatter me, Elder.”
The Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance looked at Lin Jing and smiled as he spoke:
“With your current cultivation and status, there shouldn’t be much that is difficult for you.
What you lack now should be your own power base.”
“Do you have any thoughts in this regard?”
“If you have such intentions, you can come to me anytime, and I will spare no effort to help you rebuild the Lin Family.”
Upon hearing these words, Lin Jing was momentarily startled, then quickly responded, hurriedly bowing to the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance:
“Thank you for your generous offer!”
“`
“Regarding the rebuilding of the Lin Family, I indeed have some thoughts, but now is not quite the right time.
With my current level of cultivation, trying to rebuild the Lin Family, I’m afraid, will still be quite difficult.
I need to practice and temper myself more.”
“`
Hearing this, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance said with a smile,
“It seems you already have some ideas in mind.
In that case, I’ll say no more.
Should you have any needs, feel free to come find me.”
At this moment, Lu Jingtao also spoke up,
“If you truly have the intention to rebuild the Lin Family, just say the word.
Both our Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan will help you.”
Lin Jing looked at the two, nodding and said,
“Thank you both, seniors.”
As soon as Lin Jing’s voice fell, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance quickly said,
“That will do…”
“Let’s go inside first.
Whatever needs to be said, we should invite our guests in before we talk.”
Following this…
Lin Jing and the others were led into Jinghai Island.
After entering Jinghai Island, Lin Jing also met several of Changyun Yuanshuang’s grandfathers and, showing respect as the younger generation, greeted each of them.
They also chatted with Lin Jing for a while and, after the conversation, they left with Lu Jingtao and the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance.
Leaving Lu Youjiu and others to stay with Lin Jing’s group.
Speaking of which, although Lin Jing’s cultivation level was much higher than the others, their ages were not much different, and they were also good friends.
Compared to Lu Jingtao and Elder Changyun Yuanshuang, Lin Jing was more willing to stay with Lu Youjiu and the others.
Once gathered again, spurred on by Yan Wanfei, they naturally could not avoid a bout of hearty drinking.
After the third round of drinks, Lin Jing also took out the congratulatory gifts he had prepared earlier, two Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs.
Two pieces of Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs indeed left everyone stunned for a good while.
You should know, in the past, refining just one Longevity Life-Extension Elixir for the ancestor of the Changyun Clan had caused quite a sensation.
Now that Lu Youjiu was getting married, Lin Jing simply brought out two Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs.
You must understand that these were Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs, and moreover, Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs.
Ordinary Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs, upon consumption, could increase a person’s lifespan, but one could only consume one in their lifetime.
Once one had been taken, if a second one was consumed, it would have no effect whatsoever.
However, the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs could break this limitation, no matter how many are consumed, their medicinal effects remain undiminished.
This is the terrifying aspect of the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs.
One Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir could increase lifespan by 2,000 years out of thin air.
And these 2,000 years of lifespan, in the eyes of those top cultivators with little lifespan left, were exceedingly precious.
Most of these individuals had already consumed Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs, and ordinary ones could no longer have any effect on them.
Only Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs could enable them to escape the life-and-death crisis of an impending end of lifespan.
Therefore…
Even if they had to spend all their wealth, they would want to get a Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, but how could such Flawless Elixirs be easily obtained?
To say nothing of how difficult it is to find the materials for refining Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs, the chance of a Flawless Elixir appearing was one in ten thousand.
This had been the case with the Changyun Clan before…
With the effort of the entire clan over a long time, countless materials were collected, yet even so, they could not refine a Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
It caused the whole clan to become disheartened, and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan was already prepared for the worst, ready to meet his end together with Ye Mingyi.
In the end, it was Lin Jing who took action and refined the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, solving the problem.
ƝονǤ0.сօ
Such Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs are so precious that offering just one would be remarkable.
But Lin Jing had now actually brought out two at once, how could this not shock everyone?

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 903: Chapter 405: The Scheme Against Ye Mingyi Chapter 903: Chapter 405: The Scheme Against Ye Mingyi Lu Youjiu emerged from his daze and, upon seeing the Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixir that Lin Jing handed over, did not reach out to take it but instead spoke up,
“Lin Brother, this…”
“This is too precious.”
Lin Jing then placed the Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixir directly into Lu Youjiu’s hand and spoke,
“These two Elixir Medicines, being able to concoct them was a matter of luck.
Just as I finished making them, your wedding invitation arrived.”
“Such a coincidence must be destiny.”
“Now it’s perfect, presenting them to you as a wedding gift.”
“But this…”
“It’s really too valuable.”
“A single Flawless quality Longevity Life-Extension Elixir is enough to drive the entire Inner Sea mad, especially those Mahayana Realm old monsters whose own lifespans are not much, but whose power is exceedingly formidable.
For them, even more so.”
“Today you also met Elder Song, our Shocking Seas Alliance’s Supreme Elder.”
“I’m sure you can tell, Elder Song is in the exact situation; his remaining lifespan actually isn’t much, and he has been seeking Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs for a long while.”
“Unfortunately, up until now, he still hasn’t found one.”
“If you were to give this Longevity Life-Extension Elixir to Elder Song, as long as the conditions you ask for aren’t too excessive, I believe he’d agree without hesitation.”
“To give away such a precious elixir to me, isn’t that a pity?”Lin Jing looked at Lu Youjiu with a smile and said,
“Actually, you could give one of these elixirs to Elder Song and say that this is my wedding gift to you.
As for the other, you can keep it for yourself, so that no one else will know.”
Upon hearing Lin Jing’s words, Lu Youjiu immediately looked up, his eyes filled with scrutiny as he regarded Lin Jing,
“Lin Brother…”
“That’s not like you!”
“You’re usually very cautious; it stands to reason that you wouldn’t do this, so is there something else going on?”
Lin Jing looked back at Lu Youjiu with a faint smile and said,
“Lu Brother!”
“If I do this, I surely have my own reasons.
You need not decline; just accept it.”
Hearing Lin Jingzhi’s words, Lu Youjiu looked up towards Lin Jing.
Seeing Lin Jingzhi’s serious expression that didn’t seem to be joking, Lu Youjiu then nodded and spoke,
“Alright…”
“In that case, I shall accept Lin Brother’s kindness.”
“Thank you, Lin Brother.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing smiled and then said,
“Lu Brother’s wedding is a grand celebration; this is just a small token of my sentiments.
There’s no need for thanks.”
…
...
…
Two days later, an astonishing piece of news broke out and swiftly spread across the entire demon and spirit Inner Sea.
At Lu Youjiu’s grand wedding, the son of Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch Lu Jingtao, someone had presented a Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
The explosive news instantly brought the whole Inner Sea to a boil.
In the following days, virtually all powers within the demon and spirit Inner Sea, along with those old monsters who had been hidden for ages, all emerged to bring their congratulations and wedding gifts to Jinghai Island.
Among these people, some might have had some friction with the Shocking Seas Alliance or the Changyun Clan, not to the point of outright hostility, but definitely not with the intention of coming here.
But once the news of the Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixir broke, regardless of their prior bad relationships, they all shamelessly showed up.
Even the normally reclusive Ice God Palace sent representatives to Jinghai Island, bringing wedding gifts for the union of Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang.
Their intentions, however, went without saying.
In response, both Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch Lu Jingtao and the Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder were all beside themselves with worry.
And now…
On this day, the Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder went directly to find Lin Jing.
ƝονǤօ.сᴑ
As soon as he saw Lin Jing, the Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder immediately said,
“Lin lad…”
“You this…
you…”
*Sigh*
“You say you’ve given away the Elixir Medicine, but why let this news get out?
Such astonishing news, once leaked, is bound to cause an uproar, with no one able to remain unmoved.”
The Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder appeared to be in urgent need, but Lin Jing was completely calm, smiling at the Supreme Elder,
“Elder…”
“You must have already consumed that Flawless Elixir Medicine that Youjiu gave, haven’t you?
How does it feel?”
The Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder responded, his mouth twitching slightly,
“No…”
“The Elixir Medicine is in my hands now, but with so many people coming here this time, I dare not consume it directly.”
“If they found out that I had already taken the elixir, I fear they would tear down my Shocking Seas Alliance.”
Having said this, the Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder took a deep breath and continued,
“Fortunately, we suppressed the news before it spread.
Now, although the news of the Pure Longevity Life-Extension Elixir has been leaked, your identity has not been revealed.”
Then, the Shocking Seas Alliance Supreme Elder looked at Lin Jing, sighing,
*Sigh*
“You’ve been too careless.
Even if you really wanted to give away a Flawless quality Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, you shouldn’t have let this matter slip out.”
“If people knew that it was you who sent the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, those people would definitely find you first.”
“At best, they would negotiate nicely with you, asking you to help with Alchemy.
If you refuse, they would probably turn on you, and even abduct you to make you concoct for them.”
“Even if we intervene and suppress them, they will not let it go after leaving, and in any case, this matter will ensure you’ll never have a day of peace.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing, with an apologetic expression, said:
