﻿Chapter 904: Chapter 405: The Scheme Against Ye Mingyi_2 Chapter 904: Chapter 405: The Scheme Against Ye Mingyi_2 “Senior, I’m sorry…”
“Because of this matter, it has brought trouble to you all.”
“Actually, my identity doesn’t need to be concealed.
If they were to ask, Senior, you can directly reveal my identity to them.”
Upon hearing this, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance was stunned for a moment and then looked at Lin Jing, but his gaze was full of confusion:
“This matter…”
“From what you’re saying, seems like there’s another explanation for this matter?”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Yes, Senior!”
After speaking, Lin Jing looked towards the Shocking Seas Alliance’s Supreme Elder with a serious expression and said earnestly,
“Actually, I did this deliberately.”
“Did it deliberately?
Ɲ0νǤο.ᴄο
Why would you do that?” Lin Jing’s words made the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance even more puzzled.
Lin Jing began to explain,
“I wanted to use this incident, using the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir as bait, to have the top cultivators of the Demonic Monster Sea help me do something.”
Upon hearing this, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance was also taken aback, and promptly asked,“What is it?”
“Find Ye Mingyi!” said Lin Jing.
“Ye Mingyi is utterly cunning and unmatched in his concealment skills.
Originally, to destroy the Lin Family, he hid for ten thousand years.”
“Even after the total destruction of my Lin Family, he never showed himself.”
“This person is far too dangerous.
...
Now that he is hidden in the shadows, I felt uneasy, so I planned to use the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir to flush out most of the cultivators in the Demonic Monster Sea and locate Ye Mingyi.”
While saying this, Lin Jing paused and then continued,
“Senior…”
“If those people wish to know my identity, feel free to tell them about my status as the heir of the Lin Family, and you can also tell them that if anyone can find traces of Ye Mingyi, I will personally assist in refining Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs for them.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance frowned slightly, then sighed and said,
“Ah~!”
“Lin…young one…”
“After Ye Mingyi went into hiding due to serious injuries, not only the Seven Seas Hall, but also our Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan have been searching for him.”
“You really didn’t need to get involved.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“This person is the main culprit responsible for the destruction of my Lin Family.
What I’m doing is merely to give an explanation to the many ancestors of the Lin Family.”
“If I don’t do something, even if Ye Mingyi is truly punished, I doubt I could rest easy.”
“I hope you can understand, Senior.”
Hearing what Lin Jing had to say, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance looked at him and then said,
“I understand your feelings.”
“Although the Lin Family had declined due to the matter with the Ascension Pill, it was nowhere near destruction.
It was precisely Ye Ming’s revenge that led to the complete downfall of the already declining Lin Family.”
“Since you seek vengeance for the Lin Family, our Shocking Seas Alliance wholeheartedly supports you.”
“Rest assured, I will do as you requested and reveal your identity as the heir of the Lin Family.”
“And you need not worry; with me here, absolutely no one will harm you.”
“Thank you, Senior!”
Lin Jing finished speaking and then once again addressed the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance,
“Senior…”
“Actually, I am unclear about one thing.
I can understand why the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan would pursue Ye Mingyi, but why would the Seven Seas Hall also participate in hunting down Ye Mingyi?”
“And it seems that the Seven Seas Hall hates Ye Mingyi even more deeply than you do.”
“Logically speaking…”
“Since Ye Mingyi was a Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall, even though his actions in inciting the Inner Sea struggle caused losses to the Seven Seas Hall, it shouldn’t have gone so far.”
“But after the incident, not only was Ye Mingyi stripped of his position as Supreme Elder, he was expelled from the Seven Seas Hall and pursued by them.
Why is this so?”
After Lin Jing finished speaking, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance then spoke to Lin Jing,
“You probably aren’t aware, are you?”
“This matter is not well known, and for the sake of face, the Seven Seas Hall has also not disclosed it publicly.
The main reason is that Ye Mingyi ascended his position illegitimately.”
“Ascended his position illegitimately?” Lin Jing looked at the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, waiting for him to continue.
The Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance nodded and continued,
“Ye Mingyi joined the Seven Seas Hall when he was young, and because of his remarkable talent and extraordinary methods, he was favored by the previous Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall and became his disciple.”
“Until the previous Supreme Elder encountered a mishap due to an adversary and perished, Ye Mingyi, who had already reached the Mahayana Realm, became the top combat force of the Seven Seas Hall.”
“After that, he helped the Seven Seas Hall through several difficulties and ultimately won everyone’s trust, being elected as the new Supreme Elder.”
“Perhaps there are no absolute secrets in the world, or perhaps time was just too long, Ye Mingyi could not wait any longer.”
“After annihilating your Lin Family, perhaps in a rush to move against the Changyun Clan, he felt restrained.”
“So, the old Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall encountered an accident and suddenly diedâ€¦”
“After the death of the old Hall Master, the new Hall Master had too shallow experience and his cultivation was somewhat unsatisfactory, failing to command respect.”
“In such a situation, the entire Seven Seas Hall was left with only one leader, that was the Supreme Elder.”
“It was at this time that Ye Mingyi reorganized the Seven Seas Hall and began his offensive against our two forces.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing instantly understood what had happened:
“Did Ye Mingyi orchestrate the incident with the old Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall?”
The Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance said,
“Yesâ€¦”
“Even the former Supreme Elder’s demise was Ye Mingyi’s doing.”
“He wanted to take revenge on your Lin Family and the Changyun Clan, so he had to have power in his hands, and thus he took this step.”
“Alasâ€¦”
“While leading the forces of the Seven Seas Hall against our Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan, the new Hall Master of the Seven Seas Hall took this opportunity to find evidence of the old Hall Master’s sudden death and the former Supreme Elder’s fall, and the situation was suddenly reversedâ€¦”
“Ye Mingyi also lost everything shortly after the revelations came to light and was severely wounded and fled from our united assault.”
“As for why the Seven Seas Hall now despises Ye Mingyi so much, it is precisely because of this.”
At this point, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance slightly shook his head and then spoke:
“Ye Mingyi is a ruthless person, he stops at nothing to achieve his goalsâ€¦”
“From the beginning, he used the Seven Seas Hall as a tool for his revenge, and everything he did was aimed at taking revenge on your two families.”
“For this, he even did not hesitate to initiate a massive war sweeping through the Inner Sea, never caring about our lives or the lives of the cultivators of the Seven Seas Hall, as long as he could have his revenge.”
“When the truth came to light, he naturally became the common enemy of everyone.”
After hearing this, Lin Jing murmured quietly,
“So that’s how it wasâ€¦”
After Lin Jing spoke, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance spoke again, asking Lin Jing,
“I wonder if you have any more questions, and I can answer them one by one.”
Lin Jing bowed respectfully and said to the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance,
“For now, I have none, thank you for clarifying.”
The Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance nodded and then spoke,
“If so, I will go and handle the matter for you, you just wait.”
“Alrightâ€¦”
“Thank you, elder,” Lin Jing replied.
…
…
After this conversation with Lin Jing, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance disclosed Lin Jing’s identity.
When people heard that there was a descendant of the Lin Family still alive and his Alchemy Dao was extraordinary, they were all eager, persistently asking the Hierarch of the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Supreme Elder to introduce them to Lin Jing.
Lin Jing also timely appeared and met with everyone, and took the opportunity to outline his requests.
The requests of Lin Jing were few, totaling three.
The first was that he wanted to perform alchemy, but he must provide his own materials, and he could not guarantee the success rate of alchemy; if it failed, no one was to blame.
This was undoubtedly necessary; if one wanted help with alchemy, they naturally had to prepare their materials.
As for the success rate, that goes without sayingâ€”alchemy inherently carries a risk of failure, especially with the Flawless Elixir Medicine, where the success rate is miserably low.
If not for being a descendant of the Lin Family, no one could guarantee the success rate of the Flawless Elixir Medicine, let alone promise to produce it for others.
The second was that Lin Jing would perform alchemy only within the territories of the Shocking Seas Alliance and the Changyun Clan to ensure his own safety.
With this, no one had any objections; if one could not ensure their own safety, who could peaceably engage in alchemy?
And the thirdâ€¦
It was permissible to help with alchemy, but he would need to activate all his influence to help him locate Ye Mingyiâ€¦

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 905: Chapter 406 Ye Mingyi’s Restraint Chapter 905: Chapter 406 Ye Mingyi’s Restraint Regarding the third point, some people knew well, while others looked perplexed.
They didn’t understand why this was happening.
The grudge between the Lin Family and Ye Mingyi, after the conflicts in the Inner Sea, was actually no secret anymore.
But even so, there were still a large number of people, who spent years in seclusion and simply did not care about these matters; they had no idea what was going on.
So,
there were those in the know, who briefly explained the grudge between the Lin Family and Ye Mingyi to those who were clueless.
Only after hearing this did these people understand, and they all suddenly displayed expressions of realization.
After understanding, everyone expressed great admiration for Lin Jing.
...
After the three conditions were proposed, everyone agreed and declared that they would mobilize all their connections to search diligently for Ye Mingyi’s whereabouts.
…
Following the meeting with Lin Jing and the others, the entire Inner Sea and even the far-reaching Outer Seas were set into motion.
Their sole objective was to find Ye Mingyi.
Even the bounty initially listed on the Qi Hall’s reward board for finding Ye Mingyi had suddenly increased several times over.
Even the slightest clue related to Ye Mingyi could be sold at Qi Hall for a handsome price.
While the entire Demonic Monster Sea was actively searching for Ye Mingyi, the wedding of Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang officially began.
Particularly on the wedding day, the entire Jinghai Island was immersed in a festive atmosphere.
As weddings were already joyous occasions that attracted many well-wishers, Lin Jing baited many reclusive powers with the offering of Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs,
making the wedding even more bustling.
This had the members of the Shocking Seas Alliance bustling to extremes,
especially Lu Youjiu’s father, Shocking Seas Alliance Hierarch Lu Jingtao, who was so busy he barely touched the ground, experiencing agony mingled with joy…
…
…
However bustling the days were, they would eventually pass, and life would return to calm.
After the successful completion of Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang’s wedding, and after the celebrations, everyone departed to search for Ye Mingyi.
After the wedding, Lin Jing and his group stayed there for another two months.
However, after two months, they still had not received any news of Ye Mingyi.
Ye Mingyi was truly no ordinary man; even after mobilizing most of the Demonic Monster Sea, they had not found a single trace of him.
Lin Jing had even heard that many, unable to find Ye Mingyi in the Demonic Monster Sea, had expanded their search to the four continents.
They seemed determined not to give up until they found Ye Mingyi.
A month later, still without any news of Ye Mingyi, the group finally set off again, heading towards the Eastern Spirit Realm.
As for the matter of Ye Mingyi, with the Changyun Clan and the Shocking Seas Alliance watching over it, if there were any news, they would directly inform Lin Jing.
…
Ye Mingyi was indeed no ordinary person.
Even though they had gathered most of the forces in the Demonic Monster Sea, they still could not find his whereabouts, nor did they know where he might have hidden.
Thus, time swiftly passed.
ṅονǤᴑ.сο
In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had passed, and during this century, Lin Jing spent most of his time in the Demonic Monster Sea, sometimes in the Inner Sea, sometimes returning to the Thousand Islands Domain.
As for the Elixir Alliance, Lin Jing only occasionally returned there.
However…
As time gradually passed, the fervor of searching for Ye Mingyi slowly declined until ten years ago, when most had given up after continuously failing to find any trace of Ye Mingyi, and the fervor completely died down.
Although they had not found Ye Mingyi, but during this period, Lin Jing still assisted, crafting three Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs for the three efforts that contributed the most.
Had it not been for this, the fervor for searching for Ye Mingyi might have died down eighty years earlier.
Lin Jing’s assistance in crafting the three Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs allowed this fervor to continue until ten years ago before it finally dissipated.
Although they had not found Ye Mingyi’s trace, the three powers that received the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixirs did not let Lin Jing suffer any loss, sending him many Spirit Plants necessary for alchemy.
Although these Spirit Plants were also quite precious, what Lin Jing hoped for more was to find Ye Mingyi’s whereabouts.
Unfortunately, once Ye Mingyi had hidden himself, he no longer showed any traces, leaving Lin Jing quite helpless.
After a hundred years, not only Lin Jing’s group, but even the Seven Seas Hall had reduced their efforts in searching for Ye Mingyi.
Today, Lin Jing was in System Space on Yue Tian Island, examining the system panel.
System Space (Level 9) (Evolution Phase)
Remaining Time: 725 hours (Accumulable: 1000 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Range: 135 (100+35) acres
Spiritual Energy Density: 10

Samsara Holy Fruit (?/1) (Incomplete, requires Immortal Yuan)
Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus (0/1)
Law God Tree (0/1)
Alchemy Room (9/9)
Evolution Stage (0/10)
Each Stage Required Evolution Points: 100000
Special Functions: Alert Mode, Observation, Fixed Point Teleportation, Time Accumulation…
…
…
Lin Jing (348/12392)
Spiritual Root: Five Elements Supreme Grade Heavenly Spiritual Root
Cultivation: Tribulation Peak (68%)
Cultivation Technique: Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, Five Elements Divine Art, Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique, Divine Fire Triple Realm…
Sub-Occupation: Eighth Grade Alchemist (3256572/5000000)
After a century of continuous cultivation, Lin Jing’s cultivation level had reached the peak of Tribulation, and he was just a step away from Mahayana.
Actually…

chapters.title: Chapter 906
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 906: Chapter 406 Ye Mingyi’s Endurance_2 Chapter 906: Chapter 406 Ye Mingyi’s Endurance_2 Lin Jing, who possessed the System Space, had spent a significant amount of time cultivating.
Due to the enhanced flow of time in the System Space, although it was also a hundred years for others, Lin Jing had gained hundreds of years of cultivation time out of thin air.
His cultivation could have progressed even faster.
If Lin Jing had truly wished, he could have elevated his cultivation to the pinnacle of the Tribulation stage and passed the Heavenly Tribulation to advance to the Mahayana Realm two decades ago.
However, Lin Jing had not yet obtained the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus and still needed to make a trip to the Immortal Crossing Island, so he did not continue to improve his cultivation level but kept it at the pinnacle of the Tribulation stage without attempting further breakthroughs.
Most of this time, when Lin Jing was not cultivating, he spent most of it performing alchemy.
Thus, during this period, Lin Jing had accumulated quite a few Harvest Points, and not long before, he had upgraded the Alchemy Room in the System Space to the ninth level.
...
Following that,
Lin Jing opened the Alchemy Room panel and checked it again…
Alchemy Room: Ninth Level
Divine Sense strength increase: 100%
Alchemy success rate increase: (Ninth Rank 10%), (Eighth Rank 20%), (Seventh Rank 30%), (Sixth Rank 40%), (Fifth Rank and below 50% (full))
Elixir Medicine quality improvement: (Ninth Rank 10%), (Eighth Rank 20%)…
Chance of producing Flawless Elixir Medicine: (Ninth Rank 10%), (Eighth Rank 20%)…
Upgrade required: None (Has reached the highest level of the Alchemy Room, cannot be upgraded further.)
…
…
The ninth-level Alchemy Room had reached the maximum level and could no longer be elevated.
Now, apart from collecting the remaining two World Seeds, breaking through the Evolutionary Stage in the System Space would require gathering the many Evolution Points.
Evolution Points needed to be exchanged with Harvest Points, and Lin Jing wanted to evolve the System Space and see the appearance of the System Space after its evolution, so he needed to continue collecting Harvest Points.
Oh right…
He also needed Immortal Yuan to fix the broken world fruits acquired to truly complete the collection task.
After reviewing, Lin Jing then closed off the System panel and left the System Space.
Coming out of the System Space, Lin Jing left his usual cultivation room and planned to go to Yue Tian City for a stroll.
But just then, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense suddenly sensed a familiar aura quickly approaching Yue Tian Island.
It seemed a familiar person was arriving.
Feeling this aura, Lin Jing vanished in an instant and appeared in the skies above Yue Tian Island the next moment.
When Lin Jing appeared above Yue Tian Island, the familiar person had also arrived near him.
Seeing this person, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be somewhat surprised and asked the person,
“Gu Dao, why are you not in Bihai City and instead coming to my Yue Tian Island today?”
It turned out that this familiar person was Gu Xian, an Elder who had always been stationed at Bihai City’s Seven Seas Hall.
Gu Xian responded to Lin Jing,
“Lin Daoyou…”
“I am here today to bid farewell to you.”
“I am leaving!”
After listening, Lin Jing was initially taken aback but then spoke again,
“Gu Dao…”
“Is the Seven Seas Hall going to give up on searching for Ye Mingyi?”
Gu Xian nodded his head:
“Ye Mingyi has hidden too deeply; it has been so long, if it were possible to find him, he should have been found by now.”
“The probability of finding him in the future is also extremely slim.”
Lin Jing listened and frowned slightly.
Gu Xian was right; considering Ye Mingyi’s ability to remain hidden for so long without being found,
if he did not want to be discovered, probably very few people could find him unless he revealed himself willingly.
But he was no fool; if he really appeared willingly, it would certainly be because he was well-prepared and felt he could handle the situation, or else he would never expose himself and put himself in danger.
Meanwhile, Gu Xian continued to speak:
“Over the past hundred years, Ye Mingyi, despite being gravely injured initially, might have already recovered,”
“Even if his cultivation has permanently declined and he cannot return to his peak state, he should not be underestimated.”
“Lin Daoyou, you must be very carefulâ€”given your unique identity, he’s hiding in the shadows and is likely to come looking for trouble.”
“It would be best, Lin Daoyou, if you returned to the Elixir Alliance, or stayed in the Inner Sea.
That way, even if Ye Mingyi has recovered from his injuries, he wouldn’t dare to appear so freely to harass you.”
“But if you are in the Southern Outer Sea without any support from others, Ye Mingyi might not have as many concerns.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing nodded and said,
“Thank you for the warning, Gu Xian.
I will heed your advice.”
Gu Xian nodded, then conversed with Lin Jing for a while longer before saying goodbye and departing.
With Gu Xian’s departure, the Seven Seas Hall had completely abandoned their search for Ye Mingyiâ€”it was probable that not just Gu Xian, but others from the Seven Seas Hall who were spread across the three other Outer Seas had also withdrawn.
After Gu Xian left, Lin Jing stayed where he was, gazing in the direction Gu Xian had gone for a long time without averting his eyes.
At this moment,
No one else knew what he was thinking…
…
…
With Gu Xian gone, life continued day by day.
Although Gu Xian had issued a warning, Lin Jing did not head to the Inner Sea but instead remained in the Thousand Islands Domain.
Soon, half a month had passed since Gu Xian left.
That day, Lin Jing suddenly received a message that Lu Youjiu and Changyun Yuanshuang’s first child was about to be born, and they had specifically invited Lin Jing to celebrate.
Cultivators, while cultivating, have a reduced ability to reproduce compared to ordinary humans.
Ɲοѵǥο.сο
Many cultivators, even though they may have been dao companions for hundreds of years, still have no childrenâ€”a common phenomenon in the Cultivation World.
Especially the higher the cultivator’s level, the weaker their reproductive capability, making it even harder to conceive offspring.
The last time Lin Jing had left the Inner Sea was two years ago.
At that time, the couple was still deeply affectionate and showed no signs of such news.
Yet in just two years, they unexpectedly shared their joyous newsâ€”it was quite a stroke of good luck that they had a child after being together for a hundred years.
Such a happy occasion was naturally something Lin Jing could not miss.
After receiving the news, Lin Jing informed Yue Qiniang, then soared into the sky, leaving the Thousand Islands Domain.
After leaving the Thousand Islands Domain, Lin Jing did not go to Bihai City to take the Teleportation Array, but instead flew directly towards the north.
The Teleportation Array in Bihai City could only go to the Western Demon Region.
If he detoured through the Western Outer Sea into the Inner Sea, not only would it take a longer route, but it would also cause much inconvenience.
Lin Jing’s speed had increased a lot compared to when he first underwent Tribulation.
With his current speed, it was better to head directly to the Inner Sea without using a Teleportation Array.
…
Leaving the Thousand Islands Domain, Lin Jing flew continuously for several days.
In just a few days, he crossed most of the Southern Outer Sea and reached the last sea region bordering the Inner Sea, the Solitude Sea region.
This sea region, close to the Inner Sea and connected to the silent deep sea of the Inner Sea, had few islands and was rarely inhabited by cultivators, hence its name.
When Lin Jing entered this sea region, he didn’t pay it any particular attention; after all, he had passed through here before and was already very familiar with the area.
Other than being extremely desolate, this sea region was generally free from danger.
However…
As Lin Jing was about to pass through the Solitude Sea region as usual, a sudden abnormal phenomenon occurred.
This entire desolate sea region, which had just been calm, suddenly started to shake, creating colossal waves.
And accompanying the huge waves were Demonic Beasts originally lying dormant in the sea, now also stirring up.
Even two Demonic Beasts, taking advantage of the turbulent waves, directly lunged at Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing waved his hand, and the two Sixth-Rank Demonic Beasts immediately burst apart and died instantly.
However, after destroying those two Demonic Beasts, Lin Jing immediately became alert, unfolding his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
Yet…
In Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, an extremely terrifying cultivator was rapidly flying towards Lin Jing’s location.
At the same time, an old and eerily penetrating voice also reached Lin Jing’s ears at that moment:
“Descendant of the Lin Family…”
“Heh heh…”
“You’ve been searching for this old man for so long, wanting to avenge the Lin Family?”
“Now, as you wish, this old man has come!”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 907: Chapter 407 Ye Mingyi Appears, Enters Immortal Crossing Island Chapter 907: Chapter 407 Ye Mingyi Appears, Enters Immortal Crossing Island The person who had arrived was none other than Ye Mingyi, who had long been hidden from sight.
Ye Mingyi moved extremely fast.
In just the blink of an eye, he appeared in front of Lin Jing.
Looking at Ye Mingyi before him, Lin Jing could feel the terrifying aura emanating from him.
Without question, he knew Ye Mingyi wouldn’t show himself now unless he had come prepared.
Seeing Ye Mingyi once again, Lin Jing couldn’t help but study him carefully.
Compared to the last time, Ye Mingyi seemed even older, his features gaunt as if he were a man who had lived countless years, with his lifespan nearly exhausted and on the verge of passing away.
...
Moreover, from his person, one could also sense an indescribable aura of death.
Indeed, it was true.
Ye Mingyi, like the Lin Family patriarch and the Changyun Clan patriarch, belonged to the same generation.
Although the three had age differences, they weren’t significant.
Previously, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan was at the end of his lifespan.
It was only after consuming a Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir that Lin Jing had helped refine, did he gain an additional two thousand years of life and resolved his lifespan crisis.
Although Ye Mingyi was a bit younger than the Changyun Clan patriarch, the difference wasn’t much.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄօ
It stood to reason that his lifespan must also be running out by now.
However…
Despite Ye Mingyi’s extremely aged appearance, the aura surrounding him was still terrifying.
Although not as overwhelming as when Lin Jing first saw him, the difference wasn’t too great.
Merely judging by this aura, Lin Jing estimated that Ye Mingyi’s previous injuries, while not returning him to the peak Mahayana Cultivation he had possessed during their first meeting, meant he still possessed at least a middle-stage Mahayana Cultivation or higher.
…
Lin Jing stared at Ye Mingyi, who had suddenly appeared, and spoke directly,
“Ye Mingyi!”
“Is all of this your doing?”
Although Ye Mingyi had appeared abruptly, Lin Jing seemed to have anticipated it, showing no sign of surprise.
Faced with such a reaction from Lin Jing, a trace of confusion appeared on Ye Mingyi’s face:
“Eh?”
“Seeing me appear, you’re not the least bit surprised?
Could it be you already knew I would come looking for you?”
Lin Jing looked towards Ye Mingyi and said outright,
“Of course…”
“I certainly knew you would show up.”
“Otherwise, why would I have gone to such lengths a hundred years ago to seek you out?”
“The purpose was to make you come to me of your own accord.”
Seeing Lin Jing’s confidence and hearing him openly speak the reason for seeking him out a hundred years ago, Ye Mingyi became even more puzzled and stared at Lin Jing,
“If you knew I was going to seek you out, why would you still dare to come here alone?
Are you overconfident in yourself, or do you underestimate me?”
Lin Jing shook his head and said,
“Not at all…”
“It’s precisely because I respect you that I am behaving this way.”
“I know that if you wanted to hide, no one could find you, not even with the entire power of the Demonic Monster Sea, unless you chose to reveal yourself willingly.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to locate you.”
“Now it seems, my conjecture was indeed correct.”
Ye Mingyi furrowed his brows and then spoke,
“Knowing this, you still dare to act alone…”
“This really makes me unable to see through you.”
“Before this operation, I had already mastered the movements of all the Changyun Clan and Shocking Seas Alliance members.
Now, there’s no one to protect you, just you on your own.”
“I really don’t understand, what confidence do you have that you dare to face me alone?
Could it be true folly, or do you have some kind of trump card?”
Saying this, Ye Mingyi scrutinized Lin Jing with a probing gaze.
Lin Jing just smiled slightly and said,
“Why don’t you take a guess…”
“What kind of trump card do I have that makes me so fearless?”
After Lin Jing finished speaking, Ye Mingyi’s brows furrowed even more.
Then, with a glint in his eyes, he carefully observed Lin Jing as if trying to see through him.
After scrutinizing for a moment, Ye Mingyi didn’t seem to discover anything.
Instead, he let out a cold snort and said directly,
“Hmpf…!”
“Even if you truly have a trump card, what of it?”
“In the face of absolute Cultivation suppression, any trump card becomes a joke.
Without reaching Mahayana, you will never be my match.”
As he said this, Ye Mingyi was supremely confident.
Indeed…
Between each major Cultivation realm, there lay a vast chasm, difficult to cross, but once someone successfully advanced, the resulting increase in strength was significant.
Especially at higher realms, the increase in strength brought by a breakthrough was even more substantial.
Lin Jing was currently at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, facing Ye Mingyi, who was likely at the middle or even later stages of Mahayana.
He was simply no match for him.
If the two were to battle, Ye Mingyi would only need to make a move, and within half an hour, Lin Jing would likely perish on the spot.
It was exactly because the gap in Cultivation between Lin Jing and him was so great that Ye Mingyi dared to show himself and appear before Lin Jing.
What Ye Mingyi said was absolutely correct and indeed the truth, yet Lin Jing’s expression remained unchanged, showing no trace of fear.
Lin Jing looked directly at Ye Mingyi and said,
“I know why you’ve shown up today, and I also know that you will not kill me,”
“At least not in the short term.”
Hearing what Lin Jing said, Ye Mingyi was momentarily stunned and then suddenly burst into laughter,
“Ha ha ha…”
“Is this confidence of yours?”
“You are indeed clever, knowing that I would come for you and why, but are you so sure I won’t kill you?”
Lin Jing looked at Ye Mingyi without a hint of hesitation and spoke directly,
“Of course…”
“The reason you came looking for me is to have me refine the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, to extend your own life.
Before the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir is produced, you will definitely not let me die.”

chapters.title: Chapter 908
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 908: Chapter 407 Ye Mingyi Appears, Enters Immortal Crossing Island_2 Chapter 908: Chapter 407 Ye Mingyi Appears, Enters Immortal Crossing Island_2 Hearing what Lin Jing said, Ye Mingyi looked towards him, a smile curling on his lips, yet paired with his withered appearance, it seemed particularly unsettling:
“Immortal?”
“Hehe…”
“I don’t know why you are so confident, nor do I understand where your confidence comes from.”
Having said this, Ye Mingyi took out a Glazed Jade Mirror immediately, but the mirror was flawed with intertwining cracks, looking as if it could shatter at any moment.
Upon retrieving the mirror, Ye Mingyi didn’t hesitate at all; he directly drove his Spiritual Power into it.
As the Spiritual Power entered the mirror, a nine-colored light screen erupted from its surface, shooting towards the sky.
After the appearance of the nine-colored light screen, it quickly spread out, and in an instant, it had enveloped both Ye Mingyi and Lin Jing.
Such speed left Lin Jing completely unable to react.
While Lin Jing had only stepped back slightly when Ye Mingyi took out the Glazed Jade Mirror, the next moment, the light screen had already engulfed him.
Before being enveloped by the nine-colored light, Lin Jing had stepped back, but after being engulfed by the light screen, he stood still instead.
...
And then…
Lin Jing made no resistance at all and just stood there, letting the light screen envelop him.
After the light screen had entirely enveloped both of them, it didn’t linger, and the next moment…
The entire heaven and earth spun, Lin Jing’s vision was completely obscured by the nine-colored light, and even her Divine Sense was suppressed within her body, unable to probe outward.
However, this situation didn’t last long.
After her Divine Sense was suppressed, the next moment, Lin Jing felt a certain indescribable change around her body in space.
It seemed as though she had suddenly left the Sea of Silence and was teleported to another place.
As the change passed, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense also recovered, and she could probe outside her body once more.
However, just as Lin Jing’s Divine Sense recovered…
She sensed danger approaching her and swiftly retreated.
As she retreated, the nine-colored light in front of her quickly dissipated.
Following this, Lin Jing could finally see everything in front of her clearly.
In front of him was a nine-colored light screen, and the reason Lin Jing’s vision had been obstructed by the nine-colored light just now was precisely because he had been inside that light screen.
ɴονǤօ.с0
He had just exited from the nine-colored light screen.
Until he had moved out of the light screen’s range, Lin Jing saw clearly that he was still over a sea.
But unlike before, this sea was incredibly calm, totally different from before.
However, above the sea’s surface, there was a gigantic tail, large enough to cover the sun, slapping towards him.
This enormous tail also carried an extremely terrifying aura, far surpassing Lin Jing himself, and just sensing this aura, Lin Jing knew that he absolutely could not withstand a single strike from this tail.
Therefore, Lin Jing instantly dodged, escaping the area covered by the tail.
“Boom!”
The tail fell, striking the sea, creating a massive wave.
Fortunately, Lin Jing had moved far enough away that this wave didn’t reach him.
After dodging the tail attack and the subsequent wave, Lin Jing finally saw the colossal creature in the sea clearly; it was a giant Demonic Beast resembling a whale, over ten thousand zhang in size.
It was indeed the whale’s tail that had swiped at Lin Jing just now.
This giant whale, after delivering one strike, did not rest and quickly lifted its enormous tail again…
But this time, the target of the Demonic Beast’s attack wasn’t Lin Jing, but rather it raised its tail to strike at the nine-colored light screen.
However…
This time when the tail struck, a massive surge of Spiritual Power erupted within the light screen.
This huge surge of Spiritual Power stirred up the nearby sea into massive waves.
After the surge of Spiritual Power erupted, a black spear formed from Spiritual Power pierced through the light screen and flew out.
The black gleam of the long halberd shot forth, blood red light soaring into the sky along with a vast amount of blood blossoms scattering into the sea.
Then,
The giant whale suddenly flipped over, hastily diving into the deep sea until its tail appeared.
Lin Jing saw that on its tail was a massive gash.
At that moment, fresh blood was still flowing from the gash, but the giant whale, no longer concerned with anything else, fled directly into the sea.
After the giant whale had fled, a figure slowly emerged from the rainbow-colored light screen.
The person who appeared was none other than Ye Mingyi.
Upon appearing, Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing, his expression calm,
“Since I’ve brought you here, there’s no point in hiding anything anymore, let’s just speak forthrightly…”
“I’ve been preparing for this for a long time.”
“Ever since a hundred years ago, when you produced the Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, I’ve been watching you.”
“However, at that time I was severely injured and dared not show my face, but it was, in fact, a good opportunity to act in secret and probe your past.”
“I must say, you’re quite careful.
Despite all my efforts to investigate, I could uncover barely anything about your past.”
“That shows you’re no fool.”
“A hundred years ago, when you sought me out without hesitating to expose your identityâ€”though it seemed rationalâ€”it was very irrational compared to your usual cautious self.”
“You, being so cautious, must certainly understand the consequences of exposing your identity; you would have known I’d come looking for you.”
“Yet under such circumstances, you persisted in doing as you pleased, not taking me into account at all, almost as if you were intentionally drawing me out.”
“Plus, when you saw me, you were not at all afraid and even admitted that what you had done a hundred years ago was to draw me out.”
“From this, it’s clear you must have a life-saving ace up your sleeve.”
“Besides that…”
“I also discovered that you obtained a small portion of the Ascension Pill, so your cultivation has progressed terrifyingly.”
“Even though you’ve hidden your cultivation at the early stages of Tribulation, if I’m not wrong, your current cultivation has at least reached the later stages of Tribulation, or even possibly the peak of Tribulation.”
“I’m well aware of all this.”
“But even if you possess the peak cultivation of Tribulation, it’s still not enough.”
Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing, a trace of mockery on his lips, and then said,
“As I mentioned before, even if you do have an ace, what of it?”
“Whether it’s the Lin Family, the Changyun Clan or the Shocking Seas Alliance, I know them well.
Even if you obtained some sort of lifeline from them, it would only be those items from the Ancient Era with immense killing power, or items with a strong ability to protect life, like Forbidden Artifacts and special Talismans.”
“The difference in our cultivation is huge, and even with those Forbidden Artifacts, you can’t match me.”
“And I also know that the Changyun Clan once had a Ninth Grade top-level Talisman from the Ancient Era, which can open a transmission channel and transport a designated person thousands of miles to one’s side.”
“You’re not afraid of me because you must be carrying that Talisman, right?”
“You want to use yourself as bait along with the Changyun Clan to deal with me?”
“I’m telling you…”
“Here, unless that Talisman is a true Immortal Talisman, it won’t work at all.”
“And not just that Talisman, but even those special Talismans that can traverse spaces will lose their effect.
Once you enter here, you won’t be able to escape.”
Lin Jing hurriedly looked around.
Other than the rainbow-colored light screen in front, all other directions were boundless seas.
Only far behind them was an island floating on the sea.
Seeing this, Ye Mingyi sneered and then said directly,
“Stop looking.
This is Immortal Crossing Island.”
“Immortal Crossing Island, you must have heard of it, no one who enters here can ever leave.”

chapters.title: Chapter 909
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 909: Chapter 408: Lin Jing’s Trump Card Chapter 909: Chapter 408: Lin Jing’s Trump Card Lin Jing heard the words, ignored Ye Mingyi, and immediately turned around, flying towards the small island behind him.
Seeing Lin Jing flying away, Ye Mingyi was in no hurry and followed Lin Jing with a leisurely pace, as if toying with prey.
Not until he got close did Lin Jing finally make out the scene on the island…
The beach, the dense woods, and that familiar stone stele…
“Immortal Crossing Island, Road to Becoming an Immortal.”
“Once one enters the Immortal Crossing, there’s no return.”
The inscriptions on the stele had remained unchanged, just as before.
ƝᴑνǤ0.сο
Seeing this, a look of joy instantly appeared on Lin Jing’s face, and then he turned around to look at Ye Mingyi, who was following behind him, and said,
“Indeed, I was not wrong…”
“You were actually able to enter Immortal Crossing Island before it appeared.”
Hearing Lin Jing’s words, Ye Mingyi sensed something ominous and couldn’t help but frown.
...
Then, he looked at Lin Jing in front of him and directly asked,
“What do you mean by that?”
“Why would you know that I could enter Immortal Crossing Island ahead of time?”Faced with Ye Mingyi’s question, Lin Jing did not hide anything and directly replied,
“While you were investigating me over the years, did you think I did not investigate you?”
“Otherwise, why would I spend most of my time in the Demonic Monster Sea during these hundred years, if not to uncover more about your deeds?”
“Let me tell you…”
“Long before this, when I was looking into the incidents prior to the disappearance of Lin Feiling the Elder, I found that the time of his disappearance didn’t match…”
“When Lin Feiling the Elder disappeared, the downfall of the Lin Family, no one knew where he went, and to this day, very few people are aware of it.”
“Others may not know, but I know that his disappearance was due to someone deceiving him to come to Immortal Crossing Island, and once someone enters the island, it’s almost impossible to leave, let alone send messages out.”
“That’s why his disappearance has become an enigma.”
“Decades ago, when I entered the Lin Family’s secret grounds, I happened upon some records about Lin Feiling the Elder’s unusual tales and discovered that the time of his disappearance did not match up with the emergence of Immortal Crossing Island.”
“When Lin Feiling the Elder disappeared, Immortal Crossing Island had not yet appeared in the world.”
“It was after Lin Feiling the Elder’s disappearance that Immortal Crossing Island appeared, and I happen to know that his disappearance has something to do with you.”
“So, I boldly guessed that you could enter Immortal Crossing Island before it opened.”
“Now it seems, my guess was indeed correct.”
After hearing Lin Jing’s words, Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing, with a dangerous glint in his eyes, and his face turned grim:
“I want to know…”
“Lin Feiling’s disappearance, unknown to all, how did you come to know that he vanished on Immortal Crossing Island?”
Lin Jing then smiled and said,
“You have investigated me, but there’s something you probably don’t know.
Actually, I’ve been to Immortal Crossing Island long ago.”
“Besides a few close companions, I haven’t told anyone else about my visit to Immortal Crossing Island.”
“Moreover, about me taking the Ascension Pill, originally not many people knew of it, but I deliberately did not conceal that part.”
“After all, compared to other things, advancement in cultivation could not be hidden from you no matter what, so I might as well make the matter of the Ascension Pill public.”
…
“You’ve actually been to Immortal Crossing Island?”
“Impossible, no one can leave once they enter Immortal Crossing Island, how did you get out?”
After hearing what Lin Jing had to say, Ye Mingyi’s face became uglier, but it seemed he still found it hard to believe that Lin Jing had been to Immortal Crossing Island.
Lin Jing looked at Ye Mingyi in front of him, with a sharp light flashing in his eyes, and then said,
“If I’m not mistaken, this is probably your first time personally entering Immortal Crossing Island, right?”
After saying these words, Lin Jing continued to observe Ye Mingyi to see how he would react.
However.
Ye Mingyi remained silent to this, making no reaction at all.
Lin Jing didn’t pay Ye Mingyi any more attention, but continued to speak,
“Earlier in the outside world, the Glazed Jade Mirror you produced, though it can bring people to Immortal Crossing Island, I guess it can’t be used at any time.”
“The giant tremor in the sea outside just now should have been the sign of Immortal Crossing Island emerging, and your Glazed Jade Mirror, I suppose, could only be used when Immortal Crossing Island is about to appear.”
“And perhaps, it’s even possible for you to leave through this mirror at any time, otherwise you definitely wouldn’t dare to come in with me.”
“Am I mistaken or not?”
After Lin Jing finished speaking, Ye Mingyi was no longer silent and simply nodded:
“Your guess is indeed not incorrect.”
“The treasure in my hand is called the Passing Immortal Jade Mirror.”
“Although the Passing Immortal Jade Mirror can allow one to enter Immortal Crossing Island ahead of time, it can only be used before the island emerges.”
“It’s also true that one can leave Immortal Crossing Island with this treasure, but likewise only when the Path to Immortality surfaces.”
“If the time of Immortal Crossing Island’s emergence passes and it conceals itself again, even with the Passing Immortal Jade Mirror, it’s impossible to leave.”
“Additionally, Immortal Crossing Island appears once every ten thousand years, and during this period, the Passing Immortal Jade Mirror can also be used only once.”
“Ten thousand years ago, I used a good friend of Lin Feiling’s and opened the passageway before Immortal Crossing Island appeared, letting the two of them enter.”
“Yet I myself did not go in.”
Upon saying this, Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing and asked,
“You say you’ve been to this Immortal Crossing Island…”
“I’m curious, during the times when Immortal Crossing Island was hidden, how did you get to it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 910
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 910: Chapter 408: Lin Jing’s Trump Card_2 Chapter 910: Chapter 408: Lin Jing’s Trump Card_2 “There’s also the question, since you have entered Immortal Crossing Island, how did you leave?”
Facing Ye Mingyi’s query, Lin Jing didn’t hide anything and directly spoke up:
“The reason I could enter Immortal Crossing Island was purely accidental due to an unexpected event during teleportation…I accidentally fell here…”
“As for leaving…”
“Immortal Crossing Island originally has an exit that leads to the outside world, but the conditions to leave are extremely strict.”
“I just happened to fulfill those conditions to leave, and that’s why I left Immortal Crossing Island.
The reason others couldn’t leave is that they did not fulfill the conditions for leaving Immortal Crossing Island.”
With Lin Jing’s explanation, Ye Mingyi immediately came to understand:
“So that’s how it is…”
“If you put it that way, then I understand.”
Having said that, Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing and continued:
“I suppose after you came in, you encountered Lin Feiling, or rather his remains, and you obtained something important from him that belongs to the Lin Family, which is why you said I’ve never entered Immortal Crossing Island.”
Lin Jing remained silent, which counted as tacit agreement.
Next.
Ye Mingyi looked at Lin Jing and then spoke again:
“There’s one last thing…”
“You have been scheming since a hundred years ago until you entered Immortal Crossing Island, where you finally revealed yourself.”“With all this calculation, it seems you intended for me to bring you to Immortal Crossing Island.
Could it be that there is something here that you absolutely have to obtain?”
Having finished speaking, Ye Mingyi narrowed his eyes and gazed at Lin Jing.
Lin Jing looked at Ye Mingyi and said bluntly:
“There’s nothing I can tell you!”
Upon hearing this, Ye Mingyi’s expression turned stern:
“Since you’ve been to Immortal Crossing Island before, I won’t beat around the bush with you.
You are of great use to me now, so I won’t kill you, but I will ensure you won’t pose a threat to me.”
“Controlling you to serve my purposes is more beneficial than killing you.”
Having said this, Ye Mingyi’s aura suddenly surged, and a huge black shadow appeared behind him.
...
Then.
Ye Mingyi reached out his hand towards Lin Jing.
The huge shadow behind him also extended its hand towards Lin Jing, and at the same time, countless streams of black mana converged into several black dragons, coiling towards Lin Jing.
And then…
Something unbelievable happened to Ye Mingyi, just as the black dragons were about to entwine Lin Jing, he disappeared.
Lin Jing’s disappearance was sudden and silent, this abnormal phenomenon made Ye Mingyi become more cautious.
However…
In the next moment, Lin Jing suddenly reappeared.
Lin Jing suddenly reemerged just as silently, and before this, Ye Mingyi hadn’t sensed it at all.
ṅονǤο.сο
Moreover…
The spot where Lin Jing reappeared wasn’t far from Ye Mingyi but actually quite close, within a hundred paces.
This unusual move by Lin Jing also startled Ye Mingyi.
Although Lin Jing only had the Cultivation of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, this action made Ye Mingyi immediately wary of Lin Jing.
Ye Mingyi speculated that Lin Jing must be about to use that ‘trump card’ in his hand.
Thus…
At the moment Lin Jing appeared, Ye Mingyi had already brought forth a defensive Daoist Treasure to protect himself.
At the same time, he swiftly retreated, guarding against Lin Jing’s surprise attack.
However…
What Ye Mingyi did not expect was that Lin Jing, at that moment, brought out a black and white fruit and rushed towards him.
This move by Lin Jing caught Ye Mingyi off guard for a moment…
“A fruit…?”
“At such a critical moment, he actually threw a fruit at me?”
Just as Ye Mingyi had no time to ponder further, in the next moment, he felt the vitality in his body, which was already sparse, rapidly leaving his body, absorbed by the black and white fruit.
This terrifying sensation made Ye Mingyi’s soul tremble.
It was then that Ye Mingyi remembered what the fruit before him was…
“Samsara Fruit…”
Ye Mingyi, now filled with fear, exclaimed in alarm,
“The rumored Samsara Fruit of the Nanming Domain has disappeared, and it’s actually in your hands…”
“Why…
does this Samsara Fruit…
belong…
to…
you…”
The vitality-absorbing power of the Samsara Fruit was indeed too horrific; in just a short while, Ye Mingyi’s presence grew weaker and weaker…
His already scarce vitality was completely devoured by the Samsara Holy Fruit in the brief period of those few sentences.
The next moment…
Ye Mingyi’s presence vanished completely and he fell from the sky.
Seeing that Ye Mingyi had been utterly devoured of his vitality by the Samsara Holy Fruit and had died, Lin Jing didn’t dare linger and promptly re-entered the System Space.
After entering the space, Lin Jing quickly summoned the System and sent the Samsara Holy Fruit from the outside world back into the System Space.
Only when the Samsara Fruit reappeared in the System Space’s Nine Heavens Samsara Plane did Lin Jing leave the System Space and reappear outside.
What Ye Mingyi said was correct; Lin Jing indeed had an ‘ace up his sleeve’, and that ace was the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Actually, even before initiating the first plan, Lin Jing had already analyzed various possibilities.
He had even anticipated that Ye Mingyi might set up an ambush for him.
Therefore, before the plan was implemented, Lin Jing had already been thinking about what could bait Ye Mingyi and ensure his successful execution.
In the end, after much contemplation, Lin Jing thought of Ye Mingyi, who belonged to the same era as the old ancestors of the Lin Family and the Changyun Clan, and that his lifespan was not plentiful.
Once that occurred to him, the idea of the Samsara Holy Fruit instantly came to Lin Jing’s mind.
Then, Lin Jing conducted an experiment and found, through his trials, that he could take out the Samsara Holy Fruit from the System Space.
And after taking it out, the Samsara Holy Fruit, still being incomplete, retained its dreadful vitality-absorbing power.
Having confirmed that the Samsara Holy Fruit could be taken out, Lin Jing’s subsequent plan could commence.
Just now, in the brief moment that he took out the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing felt a significant amount of his own vitality being devoured.
At least a thousand years of his lifespan was lost.
If Lin Jing himself had lost so much lifespan, then even more so for Ye Mingyi.
With the remaining lifespan he had, he could not withstand the devouring of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Thus, before he could finish speaking, his vitality was wholly consumed, leading to his complete downfall.
After coming out of the System Space, Lin Jing looked directly down below.
Ye Mingyi had died, but his body had fallen onto the sand beneath.
Lin Jing then extended his Divine Sense downwards towards Ye Mingyi’s corpse.
However, no sooner had his Divine Sense touched upon it than Lin Jing found that indeed, there was no life remaining, and he was as dead as one could be.
After the exploration, assuring himself of Ye Mingyi’s death, Lin Jing could finally ease his heart.
Then, Lin Jing approached the body of Ye Mingyi, motioned with his hand, and collected Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring and the Daoist Treasure that had protected him just before.
After collecting these items, Lin Jing activated the Divine Fire Triple Realm, conjured a colorless flame, and threw it onto Ye Mingyi’s body.
Even though Ye Mingyi had been powerful in life, now that he was deceased, only his corpse remained, which couldn’t withstand the incineration of the colorless flame.
Soon, Ye Mingyi’s body was burnt to nothing.
Having dealt with Ye Mingyi, Lin Jing then turned his head, looking towards the dense forest ahead.
Although the Samsara Holy Fruit had been taken out for only a short time, it still had a considerable impact on Immortal Crossing Island.
The most evident of which was the dense forest near the shoreline of Immortal Crossing Island, which had all become withered.
In just that short span of time, the vitality of those trees and plants had been drained, and the Demonic Beasts that lived in the dense forest had likewise perished greatly.
Such was the horror of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
If not necessary, Lin Jing really didn’t want to use the Samsara Fruit.
But he was facing Ye Mingyi this time, and if he didn’t use the Samsara Holy Fruit, it would not be easy to deal with him.
After all, Ye Mingyi was exceedingly patient, and would not show himself if there was even the slightest hint of danger.
Fortunately, with the dwindling lifespan that Ye Mingyi had left, the extraction time of the Samsara Holy Fruit was short.
Although it caused some destruction, it wasn’t too severe.
Even within the interior of Immortal Crossing Island, places far from the Samsara Fruit remained lush and green, not much affected.

chapters.title: Chapter 911
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 911: Chapter 409: Demon Cultivator of the Cangyun Realm Chapter 911: Chapter 409: Demon Cultivator of the Cangyun Realm After observing for a moment and confirming that he had not caused irreparable damage to Immortal Crossing Island, Lin Jing then withdrew his gaze.
Following thatâ€¦
He immediately summoned the System and reentered the System Space.
Upon entering the System Space, Lin Jing took out Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring and the Daoist Treasure he had previously used for defense.
After taking them out, Lin Jing picked up the defensive Daoist Treasure and began to examine it.
It was a tortoise shell-shaped Daoist Treasure, only palm-sized.
When used, one only needed to inject Spiritual Power into it, and a layer of tortoise shell-shaped Spiritual Shield would unfold, enveloping the user for protection.
Ye Mingyi had been using this treasure to defend himself against Lin Jing’s attacks.
...
Unfortunately, though the treasure could block attacks, it was capable of withstanding the life-devouring power of the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Even protected by the treasure, Ye Mingyi was still devoured clean of his vitality by the Samsara Holy Fruit, leading to his complete fall.
There’s nothing particularly special about this Daoist Treasure, and after inspecting it, Lin Jing simply put it away, paying it no further mind.
Next was Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring.
Lin Jing then extended his Divine Sense towards the Space Ring.
But just as his Divine Sense probed, it encountered a backlash from the prohibitions left on the Space Ring by Ye Mingyi.
The backlash was extremely strong, and with it, a vast surge of Demonic Qi also made its presence known.
Seeing this development, Lin Jing immediately retreated.
After the surge of Demonic Qi emerged, it swiftly transformed into the visage of an old face rising amidst the demonic vapors.
The old Demon Cultivator’s face appeared, scanning the area before bursting into loud laughter.
“Ha ha haâ€¦”
“Damn Xuanqing Realm cultivators, you sealed me away for so long, and finally, I’m free.”
“When I get out, I will definitely lead the cultivators of the Demonic Path of our Cangyun Realm and Jiuyou to annihilate every single one of the Xuanqing Realm cultivatorsâ€¦”
Hearing the Demon Cultivator’s words, Lin Jing couldn’t help but be surprisedâ€¦
“I didn’t expect this Demon Cultivator to not be from the Xuanqing Realm, but rather a cultivator from the Cangyun Realm.”
â€¦
â€¦
The Xuanqing Realm is where Lin Jing currently resides in the Cultivation World, and the Cangyun Realm is another Cultivation World that is roughly equivalent to the Xuanqing Realm.
The two Cultivation Worlds are located differently but are both accessible to the Outer Spatial Void, where they may encounter each other.
Apart from the Xuanqing and Cangyun realms, there’s also the Jiulin Realm.
These three Cultivation Worlds seem to belong to the same spatial area and can meet in the Outer Spatial Void.
Although entering the Transcendance Tribulation Stage allows access to the Outer Spatial Void, if not necessary, no cultivator of that stage would venture there.
The Outer Spatial Void is extremely dangerous; even Mahayana Realm cultivators could fall if they are not careful.
ƝονǤᴑ.сᴑ
What’s more, apart from Xuanqing Realm cultivators, those from the Cangyun Realm and Jiulin Realm also lurk within, and if you encounter a native cultivator, you might still remain unharmed.
But if one meets cultivators from the other two realms, it’s quite a different story…
Cultivators from the three realms are sometimes hostile to each other in the Outer Spatial Void, but not absolutely; if it benefits themselves, they may choose to cooperate.
However, generally speaking, encountering cultivators from the other two realms is far more dangerous.
For a genius cultivator like Lin Jing who reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage at a young age, if he encounters cultivators from other realms in the Outer Spatial Void…
Even if he does nothing, it’s very likely he would be targeted for assassination by cultivators from the other two realms.
After all, eliminating a genius from another realm’s Cultivation World would be advantageous in the resource struggles within the Outer Spatial Void.
Fortunately, aside from native cultivators, it is exceedingly difficult for others to enter another Cultivation World.
Even if they manage to force entry, the suppressive force of the Heavenly Dao would reduce their Cultivation.
If not for this, the three major Cultivation Worlds might have long been at war, leading to widespread havoc and destruction.
Lin Jing knew about all this because he had read about it in the Elixir Alliance’s Scripture Pavilion.
Moreoverâ€¦
Aside from Lin Jing, there are very few below the Mahayana Realm who are aware of this information, as those who enter the Outer Spatial Void are mostly Mahayana Realm cultivators.
Soâ€¦
The information regarding the Outer Spatial Void and the other two worlds is not really accessible to cultivators of Lin Jing’s Cultivation.
Only Mahayana cultivators are allowed to peruse it.
The reason Lin Jing could access it was thanks to his status as an Elder of the Elixir Alliance, which allowed him to check in advance.
â€¦
Inside the System Space, the voice of the Demon Cultivator from the Cangyun Realm had barely faded when a system warning was issued:
“Warning!”
“A special Spiritual Body has entered the System Space, proceed with elimination immediately!”
The sound of the System warning immediately alerted the Demon Cultivator:
“Who’s there?”
“Who’s speaking?”
While speaking, the Demon Cultivator looked towards Lin Jing:
“Is it you?”
“Do you want to kill me?”
But just as his words fell, he felt an extremely terrifying danger about to befall him.
Yet the young man standing not far in front of him made no moves, nor did he show any sign of energy.
Clearly, it wasn’t the young man who was causing the dangerous sensation.
While the Demon Cultivator was preparing to seek out the source of danger, that inexplicable and terrifying crisis suddenly befell him without warning.
“What is thisâ€¦”
“Ahâ€¦ noâ€¦”
With a resentful howl, the newly appeared Demon Cultivator from the Cangyun Realm instantly perished, disappearing without a trace.
Lin Jing had decided to inspect Ye Mingyi’s Daoist Treasure and his Space Ring in the System Space in order to be prepared for such occurrences.

chapters.title: Chapter 912
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 912: Chapter 409 Cangyun Realm Demon Cultivator_2 Chapter 912: Chapter 409 Cangyun Realm Demon Cultivator_2 Indeed, an unexpected event had occurred.
Lin Jing had thought that under the devouring of the Samsara Holy Fruit, Ye Mingyi would find a way to leave his body and hide his Soul Spirit.
Yet, what emerged from the Space Ring was not his Soul Spirit, but a lingering soul self-proclaiming to be a Demon Cultivator from the Cangyun Realm.
Thus, it seemed that Ye Mingyi had truly perished, with no possibility of any remnant soul surviving.
After all, no matter how cunning and full of schemes Ye Mingyi was, he would never have anticipated that Lin Jing would obtain the Samsara Holy Fruit, and naturally, he hadn’t prepared for it.
Therefore, when Lin Jing took out the Samsara Holy Fruit, the unprepared Ye Mingyi was destined to fall.
…
...
Not until the spiritual body of the Cangyun Realm Demon Cultivator had completely dissipated did Lin Jing pick up the Space Ring again and extend his Divine Sense into it once more.
On this attempt, perhaps because of the influence of the Cangyun Realm Demon Cultivator, the backlash of the prohibition was still present but much weakened compared to before.
Even to the extent that it could not pose any threat to Lin Jing.
Then, Lin Jing mobilized his Divine Sense and began to forcefully decrypt the Space Ring.
After several days of continuous decryption, Lin Jing had finally completely broken the prohibition on the Space Ring, allowing his Divine Sense to probe inside.
As soon as he entered the Space Ring, Lin Jing was immediately dazzled and captivated by what he saw.
True to being a former Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall, Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring contained many treasures.
Firstly, about the Spirit Stones, there is no need to go into detail.
Lin Jing glanced and saw a mountainous pile of Spirit Stones, all gathered there.
These Spirit Stones were all Superior, with not a single Medium Grade or Low Grade stone.
Besides the pile of Spirit Stones, next to it, there was another pile of even more brilliant Supreme Grade Spiritual Power, also heaped up there.
At a glance, Lin Jing saw that there were, at the very least, hundreds of thousands of these Supreme Grade Spirit Stonesâ€”this count was something Lin Jing had not even dared imagine before.
Apart from the Spirit Stones, in another corner of the Space Ring, there were over a dozen Daoist Treasures lying there.
Among these Daoist Treasures, Lin Jing also spotted the Transcendent Celestial Mirror used for teleportation to Immortal Crossing Island.
When Ye Mingyi had taken out the Transcendent Celestial Mirror, it had already acquired several cracks, and now, the cracks appeared more numerous than when Ye Mingyi first revealed it.
From the looks of it, even though the Transcendent Celestial Mirror could still access Immortal Crossing Island, its uses were likely limited.
Apart from the Transcendent Celestial Mirror, the other dozen Daoist Treasures here were also extraordinary.
These Daoist Treasures varied in type, including both offensive and defensive ones, and even a Pill Furnace was among them.
Moreover, these Daoist Treasures were not of low rank, at least all above Medium Grade.
However, Lin Jing’s main target was not these Daoist Treasures but the Innate Dao Treasure, the Disaster Heavenly Book, which had once belonged to Ye Mingyi.
After a brief inspection, Lin Jing passed over these Daoist Treasures and continued his search.
Eventually, after some searching, Lin Jing found a wooden box in another corner of the Space Ring that could isolate Divine Sense.
Lin Jing then directly took this wooden box out from inside the Space Ring.
Upon retrieving the wooden box, Lin Jing proceeded to open it.
Opening the wooden box, the Disaster Heavenly Book lay inside.
However, the Disaster Heavenly Book was already damaged, with cracks sprawling all over it, and one part of it had completely split open.
The Disaster Heavenly Book was damaged.
Lin Jing had heard about the damage to the Disaster Heavenly Book long ago.
ƝονǤօ.ƈ0
It happened during a fierce battle between the ancestor of the Changyun Clan, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, both wielding Innate Dao Treasures, and Ye Mingyi.
Had the Disaster Heavenly Book not been damaged, Lin Jing would never dare reveal himself under Ye Mingyi’s watchful eyes.
Moreover, not just Lin Jing, but the ancestor of the Changyun Clan, the Supreme Elder of the Shocking Seas Alliance, and even other members of the Seven Seas Hall did not wish for the existence of such a potent weapon as the Disaster Heavenly Book.
Destroying the Disaster Heavenly Book was inevitable.
Lin Jing sought the Disaster Heavenly Book because it was an Innate Dao Treasure, distinct from other treasures.
If the Disaster Heavenly Book could be restored, it could also be a great weapon threatening people.
However, to use the Disaster Heavenly Book, a sacrifice was needed to unleash its maximum power, and Lin Jing did not favor such an evil Innate Dao Treasure.
Even if it could be restored, Lin Jing needed to consider carefully.
The reason he wanted to find it was, whether to repair it or not, such evil weapons of mass destruction were safest when kept in one’s own hands.
…
…
Having confirmed the existence of the Disaster Heavenly Book, Lin Jing then returned it to the wooden box.
After that, Lin Jing also placed the wooden box back inside Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring.
While putting back the wooden box, Lin Jing noticed a token next to it.
This token was neither gold nor jade, and it emanated a rising Demonic Qi, clearly forged from no ordinary material.
Moreover, it was engraved with the characters “Jiuyou.”
Upon seeing the “Jiuyou” on the token, Lin Jing immediately understood that this token must belong to a Demon Cultivator of the Cangyun Realm.
He had previously stated that he planned to lead the Jiuyou Demonic Path of the Cangyun Realm to exterminate the cultivators of the Xuanqing Realm.
But right after he finished speaking, he was eradicated by the System Space, and his grand dream of annihilating the Xuanqing Realm cultivators naturally burst as well…
After that…
Lin Jing scanned inside Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring once more and, seeing nothing else of interest, withdrew his Divine Sense from the Space Ring.
After checking the items inside Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring, Lin Jing then left the System Space.
Coming out of the System Space, Lin Jing reappeared on the beach where he was before.
Next…
He turned his head, looking in the direction of the desert of Immortal Crossing Island.
When Lin Jing had last left Immortal Crossing Island, he was at the Trial Grounds in the desert.
Additionally, there, he had encountered the skeletal remains of Elder Feiling and obtained the latter half of the Lin Family’s Alchemy Dao.
However, when he had left last time, Lin Jing had not taken Elder Feiling’s skeletal remains with him but had left them on Immortal Crossing Island.
Now, having located the Lin Family’s position, although Ganlin Island no longer existed, the Lin Family’s secret grounds were still there.
It was time to bring Elder Feiling’s skeletal remains back for a proper burial.
He could not let his remains stay here indefinitely.
Thinking this, Lin Jing soared into the air, flying toward the direction of the desert.
On his previous visit to Immortal Crossing Island, Lin Jing was merely at the Foundation Establishment Stage, but this time, he had reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
Compared to last time, his cultivation had immensely increased, naturally making him much faster than before.
From the seaside beach to the desert oasis, it took Lin Jing less than four hours.
Upon reaching the oasis, Lin Jing entered the water, fished out the skeletal remains of Elder Feiling, and paid his respects.
Then.
He gathered up Elder Feiling’s skeletal remains.
As for the other skeleton, which had caused Elder Feiling’s fall here, Lin Jing did not bother with it and let it stay there.
Despite how powerful this skeleton had been in life, under the erosion of time, it would probably only last a few tens of thousands of years at most before completely decomposing, melding into the sands and silt of the oasis.
Having taken Elder Feiling’s skeleton, Lin Jing was about to leave when suddenly a disturbance occurred; an entrance, reflecting a world of swirling sands, appeared above the oasis.
It turned out to be the entrance to the Trial Grounds, suddenly appearing at that momentâ€¦
Lin Jing looked up at the sky, where a full moon hung.
Lin Jing then realized that tonight was the night of the full moon, and the entrance to the Trial Grounds typically opened on such nights.
Glancing at the entrance to the Trial Grounds, Lin Jing could not help but shake his headâ€¦
The timing of the appearance of the entrance to the Trial Grounds was indeed curious; he had just arrived, and it had appeared, almost as if Immortal Crossing Island did not welcome him and wanted him to leave.
However, Lin Jing was not in a rush to go out this time.
He still had an important task to complete.
He had yet to acquire the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
It would not be too late to leave after getting the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotusâ€¦

chapters.title: Chapter 913
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 913: Chapter 410: News of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus Chapter 913: Chapter 410: News of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus Afterward, Lin Jing turned around and left the place.
Once he left the desert region, Lin Jing returned to the beach where he had previously seen the Immortal Crossing Island stele.
Then, setting out from there, Lin Jing flew toward the interior of Immortal Crossing Island.
Due to the use of the Samsara Holy Fruit just now, the outermost layer of the dense forest had turned completely yellow, and the entire forest was devoid of Demonic Beasts, making the surroundings eerily quiet.
It was not until he climbed over the mountain at the outer edge of the forest that the yellow color gradually faded, returning to a lush green.
After walking some more and climbing over a few more mountains…
The sounds of insects and birds in the forest began to emerge, and the entire forest regained its former vitality, no longer feeling lifeless.
...
Lin Jing continued inward…
Before long, Lin Jing arrived at the place where he first met Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei.
This place was not far from the Old Ape’s territory, and soon he would reach the Old Ape’s previous location on Lake Center Island.
Whether it was still there, he did not know.
Thinking this, Lin Jing continued forward.
Soon, Lin Jing reached the lakeside where the Old Ape used to reside.
Looking across the lake, Lin Jing was taken aback to find that Lake Center Island, where the Five Elements Spirit Tree had been, had completely disappeared.
The entire island, along with the Five Elements Spirit Tree, had vanished without a trace.
Seeing this, Lin Jing furrowed his brow and directly extended his Divine Sense toward the center of the lake.
He saw that where the island should have been, there was now only a flat lakebed.
This lakebed was extremely smooth, not naturally formed, as if someone had directly sheared off the entire island.
ƝᴑνǤ0.сο
Seeing this, Lin Jing frowned and pondered,
“Could they have met with an accident?”
“No…”
“From the three scenes I saw before, I clearly saw Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei; they should not have encountered any accidents.”
Thinking this, Lin Jing stretched out his Divine Sense to explore outward, hoping to find traces of Xiao Jin and Xiao Hei.
However…
After extending his Divine Sense, Lin Jing searched around but failed to find any trace of the two beasts or the Old Ape.
And besides these three, within the range of Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, he could not detect any other Demonic Beasts above the Nascent Soul Stage.
Now at the peak of his Tribulation cultivation, his range of Divine Sense was expansive.
If he couldn’t find them, something must be wrong on Immortal Crossing Island.
After exploring, Lin Jing withdrew his Divine Sense and then looked ahead.
His position was still on the outskirts of Immortal Crossing Island, just past the lake and a bit further before reaching the more internal areas.
Last time he had entered, the Old Ape had mentioned that the Demonic Beasts inside Immortal Crossing Island were even more formidable and extremely dangerous, posing potential deadly threats to Lin Jing.
Thus, Lin Jing did not advance further inward after arriving here last time.
However, this time, his cultivation had improved since the last time, and he was not afraid even if he truly encountered formidable Demonic Beasts.
Therefore, he planned to venture further inside this time.
Having made up his mind, Lin Jing did not hesitate, directly leaping into the air and flying toward the inner part of Immortal Crossing Island.
While the outskirts of Immortal Crossing Island were limited in size, its inner areas were extensive.
Lin Jing continued flying for several hours but still could not traverse Immortal Crossing Island and remained in the internal areas.
Along the way, he expanded his Divine Sense, exploring for any potentially appearing Demonic Beasts.
However, despite his exploration, he still found no traces of Demonic Beasts at the Nascent Soul Stage or above.
The highest he encountered were only at the Golden Core Stage.
As for Demonic Beasts above the Golden Core Stage, they seemed to have vanished suddenlyâ€”all without a traceâ€”and not just the Demonic Beasts, even the rare Spirit Plants were nowhere to be seen.
Similar to the previously vanished Lake Center Island, the dense forest only contained multiple deep pits and open spaces.
Besides…
Lin Jing also realized the disappearance of all higher-level Demonic Beasts without any massive fight marks or the scent of blood.
It was as if the high-level Demonic Beasts of Immortal Crossing Island had collectively relocated and left altogether.
Following this, Lin Jing continued flying deeper into Immortal Crossing Island.
In this manner, several more hours quickly passed.
Lin Jing had finally traversed the inner part of Immortal Crossing Island and arrived at the central area of Immortal Crossing Island.
Upon entering the center of Immortal Crossing Island, Lin Jing encountered something differentâ€”a transparent barrier.
Upon seeing the transparent barrier, Lin Jing stopped moving forward and descended from the air, landing in front of the barrier.
The barrier was completely transparent, allowing Lin Jing to see some scenes inside, though his Divine Sense could not penetrate through.
This transparent barrier acted like a spatial partition, isolating everything beyond it.
Had his Divine Sense not been blocked, Lin Jing might have easily overlooked it.
Upon reaching the barrier, Lin Jing observed and tested it briefly, finding that the barrier seemed intended solely to block outsiders from entering the central area of Immortal Crossing Island and did not attack or counter.
Since the barrier could block his Divine Sense, it certainly wasn’t easy to break.
Lin Jing looked at the clear barrier in front of him, choosing not to attempt breaking through.

chapters.title: Chapter 914
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 914: Chapter 410 News of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus_2 Chapter 914: Chapter 410 News of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus_2 Rather than initiating, Lin Jing directly called out the System, silently saying to himself:
“System!”
“Enter System Space.”
Following that, the scene in front of Lin Jing blurred, and he was enveloped by the tearing force brought on by the teleport.
The next moment…
The scene in front of him cleared up, and Lin Jing found himself within the System Space.
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing spoke again:
“System!”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
Following that…
The scene in front of Lin Jing changed again, and within the blink of an eye, his view shifted to the outside from Observation Mode.
Once the observation perspective appeared, Lin Jing controlled the view and peered into the screen.
When Lin Jing controlled the Observation Mode and ventured into the screen, he was instantly stunned by the sight within.
...
The scene inside the screen was completely different from what could be seen on the outside.
From the outside, the screen showed a lush dense forest, but upon entering, Lin Jing saw a winding, rugged mountain range.
Moreover, aside from the mountain range, Lin Jing also found traces of other Demonic Beasts.
Moreover, this Demonic Beast, Lin Jing had seen before.
ɴօνǤ0.сο
It was the black bear that had attempted to snatch the Spirit Fruit from the old ape at Lake Center Island when the Five Elements Spirit Fruits matured.
Despite so much time having passed, its unique aura still allowed Lin Jing to recognize it immediately.
Since this black bear was here, the old ape, as well as Little Gold and Little Black, were likely also present.
Afterwards, Lin Jing continued to control the observation view and explore further inside.
This time, unlike previously in the outside world.
Inside the screen, there were numerous Demonic Beasts with high Cultivation levels.
Not far ahead, Lin Jing saw two shadows, one gold and one black, swiftly streaking across the sky in front of the observation view.
Seeing this, Lin Jing quickly controlled the observation perspective to look at those two shadows.
Indeed…
As Lin Jing expected, the two shadows were none other than the Golden Giant Eagle, Little Gold, and the black hawk, Little Black.
At that moment, Little Gold was leading, with Little Black following closely, both moving at high speed, playfully chasing each other.
Seeing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
As long as they were alright.
However, just as the two creatures were playfully chasing each other, suddenly a gray shadow appeared from below, rushing towards them.
The gray shadow was faster.
In an instant, it appeared directly in front of Little Gold.
Then Little Gold was suddenly startled and quickly flapped its wings to stop its forward flying motion.
At this point, Lin Jing also caught a clear glimpse of the gray shadow.
It was the venerable senior, the old ape.
Seeing the sudden appearance of the old ape, not only Little Gold, but also Little Black behind quickly stopped.
Upon seeing the stern expression on the old ape’s face, the two creatures immediately drooped their heads, resembling children who had made mistakes.
“Come, follow me back!” the old ape said to the two creatures.
After speaking, it turned around and flew down into the mountains below.
Little Gold and Little Black, heads still drooped, followed the old ape down as well.
