Seeing this, Lin Jing also controlled the observation perspective to follow the three creatures into the mountain range below.
Entering the mountains, the three creatures came to a valley below and then descended into it.
Lin Jing, controlling the observation perspective, also entered the valley.
As soon as he entered the valley, Lin Jing noticed a lake at the center of the valley, and at the center of the lake was an island identical to the one he had seen in the outside world,
where the Five Elements Spirit Tree Lin Jing had once tended grew.
Seeing this, Lin Jing instantly understood.
It seemed they had ‘relocated.’
The Five Elements Spirit Tree had also been moved from the previous island to this location.
Back on the island, the old ape, facing the two creatures, spoke sternly:
“You two, running around again…”
“Don’t you know that Immortal Crossing Island is about to open, and you can’t just go out as you please?”
“If you accidentally leave the range of the light screen, once you go out, you can’t come back, and when the external cultivators arrive at Immortal Crossing Island, they will capture and roast both of you.”
Upon hearing this, the two creatures couldn’t help but shiver, then they quickly lowered their heads and whimpered softly, as if they knew they were in the wrong.
Seeing this, the old ape seemed to feel pity, and he sighed helplessly.
“Forget it…”
“Though you two are mischievous, at least you know what’s important and wouldn’t easily leave, right?”
The two creatures nodded repeatedly.
Little Gold even came closer, stretched out its head, and rubbed against the old ape, seemingly demonstrating its good behavior.
The old ape found this comforting and gently stroked Little Gold’s head while speaking:
“This place is different from where we used to live, aside from us, there are other Demonic Beasts that have moved here too.
If you accidentally provoke them, even I might find it hard to rescue you.”
“Do you understand?”
The two creatures whined and nodded continuously, indicating that they understood.
Little Gold even gestured and chirped at the old ape, seemingly saying that neither it nor Little Black had invaded any other Demonic Beast’s territory.
The old ape watched Little Gold’s gesticulation and suddenly paused.
Then…
The old ape stared at the two creatures for a long time until a while later, he directly spoke to the two creatures,
“Did you two go again to that unoccupied mountain range in the north?”
Upon hearing what the old ape said, Little Gold froze, then immediately lowered its head, and Little Black did the same, burying its head into its chest after the old ape finished speaking.
“Speak…”
The old ape looked at the two creatures and spoke again, but his tone had become much harsher than before.
Although Little Gold and Little Black could not speak, they still possessed intelligence like two children, and the creatures seemed to realize their mistake.
After a moment, the two creatures slightly raised their heads, glanced at each other…
After eye contact, the two creatures slowly raised their heads to look at the old ape again.
Then…
After hesitating for a while, the two creatures nodded slightly, but right after nodding, they again lowered their heads, as if preparing themselves for the upcoming storm.
Seeing the two creatures admit, the fire that had just subsided in the old ape flared up again.
Then, no longer indulging the two creatures, the old ape directly scolded,
“You two really don’t know what’s good for you.”
“Last time, a Demonic Beast at the Dao Integration Stage had just gone in to explore that place and disappeared, and there’s still no news.”
“How long has it passed, and you two run there again.”
“Don’t you know that the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus might possibly be located there on our Immortal Crossing Island?”
“That place is so dangerous, yet you dare to go there, are you not wishing to live?”
Little Gold, upon hearing this, buried its head even lower.
While Little Black, at that moment, moved forward a bit and pulled out a dark vine root from its shiny black feathers.
This vine root was equally dark.
As an Alchemist, Lin Jing immediately recognized that this vine root was a grade-seven Spirit Plant, one of the supporting herbs used in making the Longevity Life-Extension Elixir.
After pulling out the dark vine root, Little Black placed it right in front of the old ape.
The old ape took the vine root, looked at it carefully, and then directly spoke:
“You two…”
“Even if there are High-Grade Spiritual Plants there, you can’t just venture out like that.”
“Don’t you realize how dangerous that place is?”
“Furthermore…”
“I naturally know that there are many rare plants there.”
“But you can’t just go there casually, and you mustn’t go there anymore…”
As the old ape continued to ‘preach’, the two creatures kept their heads down, not daring to lift them, enduring the scolding.
As Lin Jing watched this, he silently controlled the observation perspective, leaving the scene.
The old ape, Little Gold, and Little Black were all safe, and Lin Jing was relieved; he also decided not to disturb them, choosing not to meet them.
From what the old ape had said, Lin Jing learned that the mountain range to the north was potentially the location of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Furthermore, since Lin Jing had seen Little Gold and Little Black in the second picture, it was very likely that the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus was there.
Lin Jing planned to head there now, to the northern mountain range to investigate…

chapters.title: Chapter 915
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 915: Chapter 411: Obtaining the Immortal Golden Lotus, Unexpectedly Entering the Void Chapter 915: Chapter 411: Obtaining the Immortal Golden Lotus, Unexpectedly Entering the Void Lin Jing left the old ape and controlled the observation angle, continuing to explore northward.
On the way, he passed by some other peaks and encountered other Demonic Beasts, and finally, after some time, Lin Jing arrived within a serene mountain range.
Here, there were no Demonic Beasts, but there were many rare Spirit Plants; more importantly, Lin Jing felt a strangely familiar sensation about this place.
Upon seeing this mountain range, Lin Jing swiftly recalled the second image he had previously seen.
After comparing his memories, he realized that the terrain here closely resembled that depicted in the image just before it had disappeared.
Having confirmed his rough location, Lin Jing then proceeded forward based on the location displayed in that second image.
As Lin Jing continued onward, finally, as he passed over a mountain peak, the scene suddenly changed dramatically from before.
...
Upon reaching this location, everything became familiar.
This was the exact location shown in the second image, where the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus was indicated.
Upon arriving, Lin Jing completely set his mind at ease.
Then, Lin Jing continued moving forward and, before long, he saw the Mountain Spring Pool covered in green algae and the decayed Black Lotus that was in the second image.
However, unlike last time, there were skeletal remains of a Demonic Beast beside the pool.
It seemed that a Demonic Beast had died here.
At this moment, Lin Jing recalled the old ape’s words and immediately understood that this must be the Dao Integration Demonic Beast that had come to explore here.
A Dao Integration Demonic Beast dying here did not surprise Lin Jing.
After all, this was the location of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, which, like the Samsara Holy Fruit, is one of the three great World Fruits.
Seeing that the Samsara Holy Fruit could devour a person’s vitality, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus must also possess other unknown special dangers.
Now having reached the location of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, Lin Jing did not rashly leave the System Space.
The dangers associated with the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus were still unclear to him, hence the need for utmost caution.
At this time, the last thing he should do was leave the System Space.
Instead, he should first use Observation Mode to explore and see what dangers the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus posed.
Following that…
Lin Jing controlled the observational angle, diving into the algae-covered pool.
Just as he entered the pool, Lin Jing spotted dangers lurking beneath the water.
Several varicoloured serpent-like Demonic Beasts continuously roamed beneath the algae.
Occasionally, they would lift their heads with eyes emitting a green glow, peering through the water surface at the outside world.
Seeing nothing unusual outside, they would retract their heads and continue roaming as before.
These serpent-like Demonic Beasts, aside from their colorful appearance which made them seem highly dangerous, also had sharp fangs several inches long at the corners of their mouths.
Seeing this, Lin Jing understood.
These serpent-like Demonic Beasts were probably specifically guarding the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Below the visible Black Lotus on the water surface, was a pitch-dark lotus stalk and Lin Jing controlled the observational angle, following the stalk downward.
At the bottom of the pool, he discovered a huge snake that was dozens of meters long and several fathoms wide.
This giant snake was significantly larger than the ones Lin Jing had seen earlier, and its colors were also more vivid.
At the moment, the giant snake was sleeping with its eyes closed.
Beneath its coiled body, at the root of the Black Lotus, a few traces of colorful light peeked through.
It seemed that this must be the root of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Lin Jing controlled the observational angle and maneuvered around the coiled body of the giant snake, probing beneath it.
He indeed saw a segment of lotus root with nine colors, embedded in the mud under the giant snake.
However, half of that lotus root had turned black, only the latter half still displayed the nine colors.
ƝονǤ0.ƈο
After exploring, Lin Jing soon realized.
It seemed this Black Lotus was indeed the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, with the blackened portion likely having rotted.
Only the half emitting the colorful light was the intact Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
After exploring, Lin Jing instantly made a decision.
If he wanted to acquire the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, he would need to act as quickly as he did with the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Otherwise, not only would those colorful serpent-like Demonic Beasts potentially attack, but the giant snake at the bottom of the pool would likely emerge immediately.
Since that giant snake and those serpent-like Demonic Beasts could stay by the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, they must not be underestimated and treated like ordinary Demonic Beasts.
Although Lin Jing had now reached the Transcendance Tribulation Stage of cultivation, he did not want to accidentally turn into a pile of bones due to carelessness.
However…
When he had retrieved the Samsara Holy Fruit, the System Space had been unable to operate for a period.
Being one of the three major World Seeds, acquiring this Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus would likely result in the same situation.
In that case, when collecting the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, he needed to prepare more thoroughly to deal specifically with any attacks from those serpent-like Demonic Beasts.
After deciding,
Lin Jing immediately exited Observation Mode.
Then, Lin Jing adjusted his own state and also prepared the Jinhong Furnace in advance.
Once everything was ready, Lin Jing immediately activated the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function.
Using the Fixed-Point Teleportation Function, Lin Jing chose a teleportation location not far from the Mountain Spring Pool.
“Ding!”
“System notification: Host uses Fixed-Point Teleportation, deducting one Harvest Point.
Current remaining Harvest Points: 137,254.”

chapters.title: Chapter 916
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 916: Chapter 411: Obtaining the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, An Unexpected Journey into the Void_2 Chapter 916: Chapter 411: Obtaining the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, An Unexpected Journey into the Void_2 With the activation of Fixed Point Teleportation, in the next moment, Lin Jing’s vision began to blur, and he felt a tearing force generated by the teleportation coursing through his body.
Then, the next moment…
Lin Jing left the System Space and appeared at the location he had just selected.
As soon as Lin Jing appeared, he heard the system’s prompt tone:
“Ding!”
“System Prompt: Congratulations to the host for finding one of the three great World Seeds, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, and for receiving the reward: 1,000,000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System Prompt: The Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus is currently being collected and no operations within the System Space can be performed.
Please wait momentarily, host.”
As the system’s prompt fell, a force belonging to the System Space extended, enveloping the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
This force instantly alarmed the colorful snake-like Demonic Beasts in the water.
In a flash, they surged out of the water towards Lin Jing.
...
“So fast…”
Seeing the Demonic Beasts charging towards him, Lin Jing couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise, having barely reacted in time despite prior preparation.
Though the aura emitted by these snake-like Demonic Beasts was much weaker than Lin Jing’s, their speed was extraordinary.
Furthermore, as they attacked, Lin Jing clearly saw the sharp fangs they bared, glistening with colorful pearls of light, which Lin Jing knew immediately must be a potent poison.
However, fortunately, Lin Jing had made preparations in advance.
As the snake-like Demonic Beasts flew towards him, the Jinghong Furnace had just been infused with Spiritual Power, forming a golden light barrier around it.
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
“Bang!”
Several loud impacts were heard as the Demonic Beasts, caught off guard, collided directly with the golden light barrier surrounding the Jinghong Furnace.
The massive force of the impact made Lin Jing take two steps back.
As for the snake-like Demonic Beasts, after the collision, they were left dazed and dropped to the ground.
Seeing this, Lin Jing immediately flipped the furnace, positioning its mouth towards the fallen Demonic Beasts, then he activated the Five Elements Divine Art and used the Jinghong Furnace.
Instantly, multicolored rays of light surged out of the Jinghong Furnace.
Upon touching these rays, the still-dizzy Beasts that hadn’t reacted let out piercing shrieks.
ƝονǤ0.с0
Enveloped by the multicolored light, the bodies of the Beasts disintegrated as if they were wood decayed over many years, falling apart at the slightest touch.
And like that, the snake-like Demonic Beasts struggled in immense pain, their flesh dissolving away continuously.
In no time at all, the flesh of the Demonic Beasts completely disintegrated, leaving nothing behind but clean, white bones.
After resolving the crisis brought by these snake-like Demonic Beasts, Lin Jing was just thinking of relaxing a little when an even greater danger loomed.
At this moment…
The entire Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus was enveloped by the power of the System Space and was slowly rising from the green-algae-filled Mountain Spring Pool.
The giant serpent that had been slumbering at the bottom of the pool was also awakened.
It raised its head from the water and looked at Lin Jing with its bright, large eyes.
The aura of the giant serpent was much stronger than that of the smaller snake-like Demonic Beasts and was even more terrifying than Lin Jing’s.
Lin Jing estimated that the giant serpent’s Cultivation level must be at least in the late Mahayana stage.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, the giant serpent immediately opened its huge mouth, ready to launch an attack.
However, just at that moment…
The system wrapped around the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus and disappeared, taking it into the System Space.
As soon as the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus was brought into the System Space, a sudden change occurred…
The pool that the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus had been planted in suddenly transformed.
An extremely terrifying suction force emanated from it.
In an instant, the water in the pool vanished, leaving behind only a bottomless, dark hole whose destination was unknown…
Even the giant serpent that had been about to attack Lin Jing was taken by surprise by the terrifying suction from the black hole and was drawn into it.
Just as Lin Jing hadn’t had time to rejoice, the suction from the black hole increased again and pulled Lin Jing in as well…
…
…
The gravitational pull generated by the black hole was exceptionally powerful, yet fortunately, Lin Jing’s cultivation was not low.
Although he was sucked into the black hole, Lin Jing was not injured.
However, inside the black hole, Lin Jing couldn’t control his own body.
He could only be dragged along by the terrifying gravitational force and plummet deeper into the black hole.
This time, for some unknown reason…
Although the System had already swallowed the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus into the System Space, the System Space still hadn’t returned to normal.
None of the functions of the System Space could be used.
Lin Jing could only be dragged toward the depths of the black hole, unable to enter the System Space to hide.
During this process, Lin Jing could even see the giant serpent in front of him, also immobilized, its body unable to move.
But its two gleaming eyes were staring fixedly at him.
In the abyss-like black hole, Lin Jing and the serpent fell for a long time.
After roughly several hours, Lin Jing finally saw a speck of light in the pitch-black bottom of the hole.
Lin Jing looked toward the bottom of the hole and found that, apart from the pitch darkness, there were occasional twinkling lights.
It looked just like the starry night sky.
Very soon…
Lin Jing and the serpent drew closer to the luminous bottom of the hole, and the bottom that resembled a starry sky was almost within reach.
Just then, the serpent in front vanished without a trace.
While Lin Jing was puzzled, he felt as if he had been flung out, passing through a barrier, and had arrived in a special space.
After coming out, Lin Jing immediately looked around.
This place was pitch black, with no sky or ground, and not even spiritual energy existedâ€”only specks of stars and the endless void remained.
Lin Jing was now floating in this void.
Seeing everything around him, Lin Jing suddenly thought of a placeâ€”the Outer Spatial Void!
Only the Outer Spatial Void could be like this.
Had he been thrown directly into the Outer Spatial Void by the black hole?
But before Lin Jing could get a clear view, a terrifying presence came from beside him.
Lin Jing swiftly turned and looked in that direction.
He saw that the giant serpent was now glaring at him, lunging towards him.
However, just at that moment, the pleasing sound of the System’s prompt came once again:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: The collection of the Samsara Holy Fruit is complete.
System Space functions have been restored to normal.”
At this critical moment, Lin Jing was finally able to enter the System Space once again.
With his current level of cultivation, Lin Jing was certainly no match for the serpent.
It was better to flee immediately.
So,
Lin Jing didn’t hesitate and directly summoned the System, entering the System Space.
As Lin Jing entered the System Space, only the giant serpent, stunned to see Lin Jing suddenly disappear, was left behind at the original spot.
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing didn’t delay, not even taking a moment to look at the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus that had been collected into the System Space.
He immediately activated Observation Mode, reappearing in the outside world with an observer’s view.
At this moment, Lin Jing saw the serpent snap out of its daze and then quickly reacted.
Soon after, the serpent let out an angry hiss, and after the hissing, it frantically searched nearby for Lin Jing’s figure, as if it had gone mad.
Presumably, it thought that Lin Jing was hiding nearby, concealed in form.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing, within Observation Mode, watched the serpent and also surveyed the surroundings.
This was a space of void, dark everywhere, with only some distant twinkling stars adding a touch of detail to this pitch-black space.
This place was very similar to the descriptions of the Outer Spatial Void that Lin Jing had seen in the Elixir Alliance’s Scripture Pavilion; if nothing unexpected happened, this was probably the Outer Spatial Void.
Looking at this space, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling somewhat speechless.
He hadn’t expected…
The Outer Spatial Void that others tried countless methods to reach, he had blundered into so foolishly…

chapters.title: Chapter 917
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 917: Chapter 412 Land of Immortal Remnants Chapter 917: Chapter 412 Land of Immortal Remnants Inside the boundless void, the giant serpent continuously searched for Lin Jing’s traces, angrily shattering any occasional drifting meteorites with its tail.
This scene was fully captured by Lin Jing in Observation Mode; he chose not to rashly go out, but rather, watched as the giant serpent went mad.
Originally, Lin Jing had planned to leave on his own after the serpent had calmed down.
However, just as the serpent was raging, its body suddenly split open in the middle for some unknown reason.
The split was extremely neat, as if it had been cleaved by some invisible sword.
Moreover, the wound was very deep, almost severing the serpent into two.
The appearance of this terrifying wound immediately caused the serpent to panic and hastily move away from the area it had just been in.
...
Seeing this, Lin Jing suddenly remembered the description of the Outer Spatial Void he had seen in the Elixir Alliance’s Scripture Pavilion…
Spatial cracks.
Spatial cracks were crises that could appear at any time in the Outer Spatial Void, capable of severing anything.
Even the hardest Daoist Treasure in the world could not withstand it.
ɴονǤᴑ.сο
Moreover, spatial cracks appeared silently and invisibly; only by using Divine Sense to probe could one detect signs of them and thus avoid them in advance.
Actually, in the Outer Spatial Void, crises like spatial cracks were nothing unusual.
There were naturally even more dangerous occurrences.
One of them was the spatial vortex.
Although spatial vortices appeared less frequently than spatial cracks, and were not as concealed as spatial cracks,
Spatial vortices were far more dangerous; spatial cracks could be detected early and avoided by Divine Sense, and even if one did encounter smaller spatial cracks, at most they would result in injury, not posing a real threat to life.
But spatial vortices were different.
Once a spatial vortex appeared, it would engulf all cultivators nearby, and within the range of the vortex, no matter how they tried to escape, they could not.
Once caught in a spatial vortex, one could only watch helplessly as they were sucked into the center of the vortex, disappearing without a trace.
As to where the spatial vortex would transport those it engulfed, it was unknown.
After all, no one who had been sucked into a spatial vortex had ever reappeared.
…
The giant serpent, almost severed into two halves by the spatial crack, looked towards the area it had just left, sensing danger but unable to find anything.
This circumstance terrified the serpent.
After turning its head to look around and finding nothing, it glanced one last time at the place where the spatial crack had appeared, then immediately dragged its injured body and fled from the area.
After the serpent left, Lin Jing controlled the observational viewpoint to look towards the place where the spatial crack had appeared.
The appearance of spatial cracks was unpredictable in time and location, but each occurrence did not last long, especially those smaller cracks, which usually only appeared for a moment before disappearing.
By the time Lin Jing probed, the spatial crack had already disappeared, leaving nothing behind except the blood spilt from the serpent’s wound, floating nearby.
After observing, Lin Jing exited Observation Mode and returned to the System Space.
Upon returning to System Space, the first thing Lin Jing did was go to the edge of System Space, to the place of the three separate zones, to check the newly acquired Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Immortal Dao Realm World Seed: Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus (Incomplete)
Growth Environment: Transcendent Lotus Pond
Growth Lifespan: ???
(The lifespan of the World Seed is tied to the Immortal Dao Realm; as long as the Immortal Dao Realm exists, the World Seed thrives; if the Immortal Dao Realm perishes, the World Seed too will vanish.)
(Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, one of the three major World Seeds of the Immortal Dao Realm, possesses the power of transcendence.)
Note: The World Seed is currently incomplete and can’t produce the power of transcendence.
(The transcendental power possessed by the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus allows cultivators to surpass the Void Immortal phase and achieve true immortality; infusing Immortal Yuan is required to repair its incomplete state and restore its transcendental power to its normal condition.)
Seeing the information about the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
Void Immortal phase, True Immortal…
Could this be the classification of realms after achieving immortality?
That’s what the description seemed to indicate.
The realms after achieving immortality had never been widely known.
If it were the Ancient Era, when the channels between the Immortal Realm and the Cultivation World for ascension were still open, perhaps people then might have known.
But now, with the Immortal Realm closed off, it had been a million years since anyone had ascended.
As for the few remaining pieces of information about the Immortal Realm left behind before, not to mention the classification of realms after ascension, such highly confidential matters were even less likely to be known.
Naturally, Lin Jing did not know either.
After checking the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, Lin Jing subsequently closed the System panel and then left the System Space.
Like the Samsara Holy Fruit, the Transcendent Golden Lotus was also in an incomplete state and required Immortal Yuan for repair.
Now that he knew the current situation of the Transcendent Golden Lotus, staying in the System Space was meaningless; Lin Jing reasoned it would be better to find a way to locate Immortal Yuan.
Of course.
Before looking for Immortal Yuan, he definitely needed to establish his current location and then find a way to leave and return to the Cultivation World.
After transporting him and the giant serpent, the black hole had disappeared; Lin Jing wanted to return through the black hole but could not.
Now, to get back to the Cultivation World, he would have to find another method.
Or…
He could choose not to return.
He could go looking for Elder Bai and the forefathers of the Changyun Clan.
Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan’s forefathers had left for the Outer Spatial Void and had not returned since.

chapters.title: Chapter 918
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 918: Chapter 412: Land of Immortal Remnants_2 Chapter 918: Chapter 412: Land of Immortal Remnants_2 “`
Having arrived in the Outer Spatial Void myself, naturally, I could also try to find out about their whereabouts.
Moving in the Void required the constant use of Divine Sense to search for any possible spatial cracks.
After coming out of the System Space, Lin Jing immediately urged his Divine Sense to unfold in the Void.
However, as soon as he did, Lin Jing immediately realized.
His Divine Sense was severely suppressed, and the range he could explore was roughly only one-tenth of what it had been before.
Such suppression of Divine Sense caused Lin Jing’s brows to furrow.
The suppression of Divine Sense was not a small matter.
...
It would inevitably affect his speed, increase the time required for his exploration, and make him even more vulnerable.
The Outer Spatial Void was already vast and boundless, and encountering other cultivators here was extremely difficult.
Furthermore, finding a way back was even more challenging.
Now that his Divine Sense was suppressed, his speed of exploration had slowed down quite a bit.
With this method, it seemed it might take an unknown amount of time to leave.
Looking at the endless void before him, Lin Jing subsequently thought of the System Space.
With the range of Divine Sense limited, the Observation Mode of the System Space was not part of Divine Sense, and presumably, it should not be restricted.
With this in mind, Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode.
In Observation Mode, after experimenting, Lin Jing found that using Observation Mode to explore was the same as always, unaffected by any restrictions.
In this case, it would be easy to handle.
Lin Jing could use Divine Sense to explore for possible dangers around him, while also using Observation Mode to explore farther distances, thus slowly determining his whereabouts.
Subsequently…
After observing, Lin Jing found that in the direction where he was located, three directions were completely void, with not even a flicker of starlight to be seen.
Only one direction had twinkling stars.
Lin Jing then set off in this seemingly different direction.
…
…
The Void was vast, with only floating meteors and the occasional appearance of spatial cracks.
Lin Jing had traveled in this Void for many months, but he had not encountered any living creatures, not even the fleeing giant serpent he’d seen before.
In the Void, unable to determine his position, he did not know where he was or how far he was from the gathering place of cultivators in the Void.
Even the direction he was heading in, he could not be sure whether it was right or not.
But Lin Jing could only keep moving in this one direction, hoping to encounter other cultivators.
That day…
After traveling a distance, Lin Jing entered the System Space to rest for a moment.
After resting, he planned to set off again.
However, before leaving the System Space, Lin Jing habitually used Observation Mode to check his surroundings.
Since entering the Outer Spatial Void, in order to avoid accidents, Lin Jing always explored his environment before leaving the System Space to ensure his safety.
However, this exploration brought him an unexpected joy.
In Observation Mode, Lin Jing discovered two cultivators had entered his exploration range.
This discovery made Lin Jing breathe a sigh of relief.
What Lin Jing feared the most was being transported to some unknown area of the Outer Spatial Void.
The Outer Spatial Void was boundless, and its scope was incalculable.
If he truly got lost in the Outer Spatial Void, it would be really troublesome.
Fortunately…
In just a few months, he had encountered other cultivators, which proved that his transmission location was not particularly remote.
As long as he reached the gathering place of the Human Race in the Void, everything would be easier to handle.
The two people were an Elder and a middle-aged cultivator, both of whom had peculiar attire that Lin Jing had never seen before, which was also significantly different from what he was accustomed to seeing.
From this, it could be inferred that these two were likely not from the Xuanqing Realm, but from other parts of the Cultivation World.
After seeing the two, Lin Jing did not rashly appear but instead controlled the Observation Mode’s perspective to follow them.
He wanted to see if he could obtain some useful information from their conversation.
The two seemed to be searching for something, flying forward while observing their surroundings.
After searching for a while, the two stopped, apparently communicating with Divine Sense for a moment.
After their exchange, the two landed on a huge meteor floating in the Void.
After stopping, the Elder among them took out an Array Plate, and then took out a Supreme Grade Spirit Stone to activate it.
Once the Array Plate was activated, the Formation in it immediately appeared and enveloped both of them.
Seeing the Formation begin to operate, the two sat down cross-legged and began to meditate to recuperate.
“`
Seeing this, Lin Jing understood.
It turned out that the Array Plate the elder had taken out was one used to convert the Spiritual Power within Spirit Stones into Spiritual Energy.
There was no Spiritual Power in this Outer Spatial Void, and if there was a loss of Spiritual Power, one could only recover it through Spirit Stones or other Spiritual Objects.
And at this moment, they were indeed recuperating their Spiritual Power.
While they were recovering their Spiritual Power, Lin Jing did not rashly show himself but continued to use Observation Mode, watching and quietly waiting.
Both of these people were in the Mahayana Realm.
The elder was in the late Mahayana phase, while the other, a middle-aged cultivator, was in the early Mahayana phase.
Ɲ0νǥ0.сο
Both of their cultivations were not low, and their recovery was very fast.
In less than four hours, both had fully recovered and opened their eyes.
As the two awoke, the middle-aged cultivator spoke to the elder,
“Curved Elder…”
“Now that we’ve almost recovered, if we encounter that giant snake again, we should be able to capture it directly.”
The elder nodded and said,
“Exactly!”
“When we meet it again, we will certainly be able to seize it.”
Lin Jing, upon hearing this, immediately understood what was going on; these two had come here in search of that giant snake.
As the one known as Curved Elder finished speaking, the middle-aged man spoke up again, addressing the Curved Elder,
“Curved Elder…”
“Actually, I still don’t quite understand.”
“Why would a giant snake suddenly appear in this Land of Immortal Remnants, which is clearly a dead zone, and moreover, this giant snake seems to be an unclaimed Demonic Beast.”
Curved Elder responded directly,
“Where this giant snake came from, I am not too clear.”
“But I felt a trace of an aura similar to Immortal Energy emanating from it.”
“Immortal Yuan…?”
The middle-aged cultivator couldn’t help but exclaim,
“Curved Elder, are you saying that this giant snake may have come into contact with Immortal Yuan?”
“That’s a possibility…”
Saying this, Curved Elder paused for a moment, then turned his head, looked at the middle-aged cultivator, and said,
“You must know, the place we are at now is the Land of Immortal Remnants.”
“There have always been rumors that within this Land of Immortal Remnants, there are nine Immortal Yuan hidden, it’s just that no one has been able to find any trace of them.
Although some believe this rumor, there are also some who think it’s just an unfounded tale.”
“However, a hundred years ago, quite a few people witnessed an Immortal Yuan tearing through the sky and entering the Xuanqing Realm.”
“It was the appearance of this Immortal Yuan that made everyone ecstatic, rushing to this Land of Immortal Remnants to search for Immortal Yuan.”
“Especially within the Xuanqing Realm, those two old men with the surnames Bai and Changyun, it’s said that they need Immortal Yuan for a big matter and were more eager than anyone, arriving at this Land of Immortal Remnants immediately.”
“But…”
“After so many years of searching, among the Immortal Yuan of this Land of Immortal Remnants, other than the two old men from the Xuanqing Realm who obtained one,”
“no one else has ever been heard of obtaining this Immortal Yuan.”
“But now…”
“I felt a trace of an aura similar to Immortal Yuan from the breath of that giant snake; if we catch the giant snake, we might be able to use it to find another Immortal Yuan.”
“As long as we obtain the Immortal Yuan, we can directly leave with it and return to the Cangyun Realm.”
“As long as we bring the Immortal Yuan back to the Sect without being discovered, we will have made a great contribution to the Sect.”
“As long as this matter is done covertly without anyone knowing, we will be absolutely safe and won’t have to be hunted like those two old men from the Xuanqing Realm.”
At this point, the middle-aged man also couldn’t help but sneer and then said,
“It’s just that those two old men from the Xuanqing Realm had bad luck, being seen by quite a few at the time they obtained the Immortal Yuan.”
“Now they’re trapped in the Land of Immortal Remnants, their allies outside probably still don’t know their current situation.”
“Even the exit of the Land of Immortal Remnants has been blocked by us and the people from the Jiulin Realm, they are in a dire situation, unable to leave.”
“They also won’t be able to hold onto that Immortal Yuan.”

﻿Chapter 919: Chapter 413: Disguise, Exposure Chapter 919: Chapter 413: Disguise, Exposure Upon hearing the two men’s conversation, Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown.
They suggested that this place was called the Land of Immortal Remnants, and Elder Bai and the ancient ancestor of the Changyun Clan seemed to have been cornered here because of Immortal Yuan.
Just as Lin Jing was planning to continue his inquiry, the two men ended their conversation and proceeded to search for the giant serpent.
Unfortunately, the two had only conversed for such a brief moment before setting off to find the serpent, leaving Lin Jing with limited information.
Especially regarding Elder Bai and the ancient ancestor of the Changyun Clanâ€”who were under siege and whether they were injured.
Lin Jing was utterly oblivious to these matters.
And what exactly was the situation with the Land of Immortal Remnants where he was currently?
...
According to the two, the Land of Immortal Remnants didn’t seem to be the Outer Spatial Void, but a special space with an entrance and exit.
Moreover, the entrance and exit were guarded by cultivators from the Cangyun Realm and the Jiulin Realm…
Lin Jing had been here for several months before encountering these two, and if he missed them, he feared it would be a long time before he met others.
Even if he met other people, it was highly likely they would still be cultivators from the Cangyun Realm and the Jiulin Realm.
After some contemplation, Lin Jing decided to take a risk and make contact with these two men, to see if he could get any valuable information from them.
Of course, he couldn’t just approach them directly.
If he appeared rashly, it would surely raise the two men’s guard and they would be doubly wary of him.
To make contact, it was imperative to do so casually, and it would be best to be seen as ‘one of them.’
Pretending to be one of their own was easy…
When dealing with Ye Mingyi, Lin Jing had encountered the soul remnant of a demon cultivator from the Cangyun Realm, and inside Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring, there was also an Identity Token of that demon cultivator.
ƝονǤօ.ƈ0
Lin Jing still had a fresh memory of that demon cultivator’s aura, capable of imitating it perfectly, and with that Token, he could cause quite a deception.
There was no need for him to follow them; he merely had to ‘happen to run into them’ and ask a few questions, then he would leave on his own.
Minimizing contact would also decrease the chance of exposing himself.
Having made this decision, Lin Jing subsequently took out Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring and extracted the Identity Token from it.
While retrieving the Token, Lin Jing casually scanned the ring’s contents and discovered several powerful Talismans of the eighth and even ninth orders, preserved in special wooden cases.
These Talismans were so powerful that they could pose a threat to even Mahayana-stage cultivators.
For safety, Lin Jing carried these Talismans on his person.
After preparing, Lin Jing then activated the Changyun Hidden Technique to start changing his body shape, appearance, and even his aura.
In no time, a middle-aged man with a lean figure, exuding Demonic Qi, appeared within the System Space.
This man, with eyes cold and sharp, his whole body swirling with Demonic Qi, and the fearsome Token at his waist, resembled none other than a peerless Demon Lord.
Naturally, this middle-aged man was Lin Jing in disguise, and with the help of the Changyun Hidden Technique, the ruse was nearly perfect.
For brief interactions, the two were likely unable to discern the truth.
After his disguise, Lin Jing used Observation Mode to scout ahead in the direction the two were traveling.
Once he’d determined their direction, he used Fixed Point Teleportation to carefully avoid them, then repeatedly teleported ahead of them until he was in their path.
Fortunately, the two were preoccupied with searching for traces of the giant serpent and weren’t moving fast, which allowed Lin Jing to get in front of them.
Once he arrived at the chosen location, Lin Jing exited the System Space and, like the two other cultivators, pretended to be searching for something.
While pretending to search, Lin Jing also engaged Observation Mode to keep an eye on the two men’s positions.
Soon…
Through Lin Jing’s careful planning, the three met.
Upon seeing Lin Jing, the two men were startled and came to a halt, while at that same moment, Lin Jing also turned to look at them and slightly furrowed his brow.
Then.
The middle-aged cultivator among the two men raised his hand, cupped his fist toward Lin Jing, and transmitted a message:
“May I ask, friend, are you a person from the Jiuyou Demonic Path?”
Hearing this, Lin Jing, with furrowed brows, looked at the two and replied through transmission,
“Who might you be?”
The middle-aged man responded,
“We are from the Liuyue Dao Sect of the Xi Cang Continent.”
After speaking, he pointed toward the elder at his side and transmitted once more,
“This is Elder Qu from our sect.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing turned to look at the elder.
As Lin Jing looked at the elder, the latter also fixed his gaze on Lin Jing, and despite the distance between them,
Lin Jing could clearly see a light glimmering within the elder’s eyes which sharpened and became more intense and captivating…
Upon seeing the elder’s eyes, Lin Jing instantly felt as if the elder had seen right through him, and all of his disguises seemed to become ineffective at that moment.
This sudden turn of events startled Lin Jing.
But it was the elder who made the first move, the palm of his hand opening to reveal a giant hand formed from Spiritual Power, rapidly reaching out toward Lin Jing.
It was only after Lin Jing’s concealment had completely failed that the middle-aged cultivator reacted.
Seeing Lin Jing’s cultivation at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage, his face contorted with rage as he charged toward Lin Jing.
However, Lin Jing had already swiftly taken out an extremely powerful ninth-order Talisman and thrown it out as soon as the elder breached his disguise.

﻿Chapter 920: Chapter 413 Disguise, Exposure_2 Chapter 920: Chapter 413 Disguise, Exposure_2 Both of them had higher cultivation levels than Lin Jing, and the elder was even in the late Mahayana Realm, a whole great realm apart.
Lin Jing was definitely no match for the two of them.
Therefore, Lin Jing was very decisive.
When his identity was exposed, he promptly threw out his strongest 9th Level Talisman, momentarily halting their pursuit.
As expected, those Talismans were extraordinary.
As soon as Lin Jing threw them, they emitted a terrifying aura, and soon after, a massive thunder dragon appeared.
Seeing the terrifying thunder dragon, the middle-aged cultivator’s expression changed, and he quickly retreated.
...
Even the giant hand formed from spiritual power was instantly dispersed by the thunder dragon.
And that wasn’t all.
After dispersing the spiritual power giant hand, the thunder dragon continued relentlessly, charging towards the two Cangyun Realm cultivators.
Seeing the thunder dragon approaching, they hastily retreated while simultaneously using their Daoist treasures and spells constantly to drain the thunder dragon’s spiritual power.
Seeing that the two were too preoccupied to care, Lin Jing seized the opportunity, turned around, and fled the scene.
After getting some distance away, Lin Jing decisively summoned the System and entered the System Space.
It was only after entering the System Space that Lin Jing finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He was very puzzled; he had disguised himself well, yet they recognized him immediately upon encounter.
This was a problem Lin Jing needed to clarify.
Therefore…
After entering the System Space, Lin Jing immediately activated Observation Mode, located those two Cangyun Realm cultivators, and continued to observe them.
The 9th Level Talisman was indeed extraordinary; even after Lin Jing had entered the System Space, the thunder dragon it transformed into continued to wreak havoc for a good while before its power was completely exhausted and it dissipated.
It was only after the 9th Level Talisman completely vanished that the two finally relaxed.
“That damn cultivator…”
The middle-aged cultivator still had fury in his eyes as he looked in the direction Lin Jing had escaped, and he cursed.
After cursing, the middle-aged cultivator turned to the elder and asked, “Elder Qu…”
“You were so decisive earlier; you directly used the Divine Art ‘Eye of Truth’ on him as soon as he appeared.
Did you sense something was off the moment he showed up?”
Elder Qu, also looking in the direction Lin Jing had fled, replied, “Although he was well-disguised, it was clear that he is not familiar with the Jiuyou Demonic Path.
People of Jiuyou Demonic Path are naturally extremely arrogant, never courteous to anyone even in this Land of Immortal Remnants.”
“And…”
“This person is definitely not from our Cangyun Realm or Jiulin Realm.”
The middle-aged cultivator nodded and said, “This time our Cangyun Realm and Jiulin Realm collaborated to capture two elders from the Xuanqing Realm, only deploying cultivators from the Mahayana Realm and above.”
“This person is only at the Transcendence Tribulation Stage; he couldn’t possibly be from our two realms.”
Elder Qu nodded slightly, “Exactly…”
“He must also be from the Xuanqing Realm.”
“Since he has appeared here, he won’t escape today.”
“Let’s go…”
“We’ll catch up to him.
With his cultivation, he won’t get far, and we might even get some clues about the two elders, surnamed Bai and Changyun, from him.”
“Hm…!”
The middle-aged cultivator nodded in agreement, and then followed Elder Qu, chasing in the direction Lin Jing had left.
ƝονǤ0.ᴄο
After the two set out, Lin Jing also controlled the Observation Perspective, following behind them.
But soon, the two left the range of Lin Jing’s Observation Perspective.
After they left, Lin Jing didn’t hurry to leave.
Instead, he continued using the Observation Perspective, watching and waiting for the two to return.
Lin Jing’s cultivation had been exposed; the two couldn’t find him, and with his cultivation, he definitely couldn’t run far with Mahayana cultivators in pursuit.
They would chase for a while, fail to find any traces of him, and would surely return.
Lin Jing was very sure of this.
Sure enough…
Before long, the two returned.
At the same time, that look reappeared in Elder Qu’s eyes.
Clearly, he had once again activated his Divine Art named ‘Eye of Truth’.
After the two returned, Elder Qu first looked around the area, and after observing, his brows furrowed.
Then…
Elder Qu stretched out his hand, placing two fingers on his forehead, then concentrated spiritual power in his eyes, making them shine even brighter.
At that moment, Elder Qu turned his head again and looked around.
After a while, he seemed to have found something when he looked at a certain location, paused for a moment, and then directly went to that location.
Lin Jing, seeing this, couldn’t help but feel amazed.
This person’s divine skills were so formidable.
Because the place he had discovered was a location Lin Jing had just passed by.
In this boundless void, just passing through this place would hardly leave any traces.
Even if a bit of aura was left behind, it would likely dissipate quickly.
Moreover, Lin Jing had deliberately reduced his movements when he left, but he was still discovered by this person’s divine skills.
However, fortunately, Lin Jing was inside the System Space, so even if he had been discovered, it was unlikely anything could be tracked down.
Thus, Elder Qu used his divine arts to continuously follow the route Lin Jing had taken before, step by step investigating, and eventually stopped at the location where Lin Jing had entered the System Space.
Seeing Elder Qu stop, the middle-aged cultivator was somewhat puzzled and then asked,
“Elder Qu…”
“Why did you suddenly stop?”
Elder Qu frowned and then spoke,
“His aura disappeared here.”
“Disappeared…” The middle-aged man turned to look around, showing a hint of confusion:
“In the Land of Immortal Remnants, how could he just disappear?”
Elder Qu withdrew his divine skills and then rubbed his temples before speaking,
“At the place where he disappeared, I faintly sensed a trace of spatial energy left by teleportation.”
“If nothing unexpected happened, he must have used a Teleportation Talisman to escape directly.”
“Teleportation Talisman…”
“Hisss…”
Hearing this, the middle-aged man couldn’t help but gasp.
“A Teleportation Talisman, in the Outer Spatial Void, is something that can save one’s life.
If accidentally entangled by a spatial vortex, one can use a Teleportation Talisman to escape.”
“Such a precious Talisman, to be used like that, he’s really squandering it.”
“And he also used a rank nine Thunder Dragon Talisman just now, which is equally rare.”
“He just used it without hesitation; this person must be very wealthy.
I fear the force behind him in the Xuanqing Realm is also not simple.”
“And looking at his appearance, his age must not be very great; he must be a sacred son or a young master of some top force, right?”
After the middle-aged cultivator finished speaking, Elder Qu looked towards the place where Lin Jing had disappeared and said,
“No matter who he is, within this Land of Immortal Remnants, he can’t escape.”
“He has only one way out if he wants to leave.
We, people from the Cangyun Realm and the Jiulin Realm, have already blocked the Land of Immortal Remnants, even the only exit is being guarded.”
“Although his ability to camouflage and hide is indeed good and can deceive most people, his cultivation is only at the Tribulation stage, which is his biggest flaw.”
“As soon as he steps into the exit, his Tribulation-stage cultivation will inevitably be unable to hide, and then he will certainly die.”
“That’s right…”
The middle-aged cultivator, hearing this, nodded repeatedly in agreement:
“The people from our Cangyun Realm and Jiulin Realm who came here are at least at the early Mahayana stage, while his cultivation is only at the Tribulation stage; that is his biggest flaw.”
“Even if he is able to camouflage, it’s futile; as soon as he passes through the exit, he will definitely be exposed.”
Upon hearing the conversation of the two, Lin Jing couldn’t help but fall silent.
From their conversation, Lin Jing could guess that at that exit, there must be something that could detect one’s cultivation.
And it couldn’t be hidden.
If so, he couldn’t continue like this; he needed to think of a way to transcend the Heavenly Tribulation and advance to the Mahayana Realm first.
…
…
While Lin Jing was contemplating, the two outside who couldn’t track Lin Jing decided to leave.
“Elder Qu, since that kid from the Xuanqing Realm has already escaped, let’s not bother about that kid for now.
Let’s continue looking for that giant snake.”
Elder Qu nodded, saying,
“Let’s go…”
“Let’s continue chasing that giant snake.”

﻿Chapter 921: Chapter 414 Tribulation Begins, Immortal Yuan Reappears Chapter 921: Chapter 414 Tribulation Begins, Immortal Yuan Reappears Long after the two had left, Lin Jing emerged from the System Space.
After coming out, Lin Jing quickly departed in another direction, leaving the area.
Having overheard the conversation between the two people earlier, Lin Jing had decided to undergo his Tribulation first and advance to the Mahayana Realm before dealing with anything else.
Otherwise, with his current level of Cultivation, encountering another Cultivator could still pose a danger.
Only by advancing to the Mahayana Realm and reducing the gap with others could he have a certain ability to protect himself.
Even if he wanted to seek out news of Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan to help them, he needed to be able to protect himself first.
Otherwise, even if he found the two of them, he would only be adding to their burden.
...
Since he was going to face the Heavenly Tribulation, he naturally sought out a secluded place to avoid any disturbances during the process.
This time, Lin Jing chose to head in the opposite direction, making his way to the place where he had been transported into this realm.
…
…
About a month later, when Lin Jing found a spot that he felt was suitable for the Tribulation, the commotion of the Tribulation wouldn’t be small, but in the void of this Land of Immortal Remnants, such disturbance was but a tiny wave in the ocean, barely noticeable.
Having selected the location for his Tribulation, Lin Jing then entered the System Space to enhance his Cultivation and prepare for advancing to the Mahayana Realm.
Long before, Lin Jing was not far from the peak completion state of the Transcendance Tribulation Stage.
ƝοѵǤօ.ƈο
After spending just over half a month in the System Space, Lin Jing had elevated his Cultivation to a state of perfection.
What he referred to as half a month was, with the enhancement of the Flow of Time Speed in the System Space, actually equivalent to over half a year of Cultivation.
After having enhanced his Cultivation to a state of perfection, Lin Jing began making preparations for the Tribulation.
The necessary Formation and Defensive Magical Treasures needed to be prepared in advance.
Initially, Lin Jing did not possess many of these items, but he had acquired Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring, which contained a considerable number of valuable goods, including these necessary items.
Once Lin Jing had everything prepared, another ten days had passed.
Including the time spent enhancing his Cultivation, a month had already elapsed in the outside world.
The reason for the extensive preparation time was mainly because of the need to refine these Magical Treasures; inside Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring, there were several Defensive Magical Treasures that Lin Jing needed to refine, albeit briefly.
So, this caused some delay.
A month later, with all preparations complete, Lin Jing left the System Space.
On a gargantuan floating meteorite in the void, he began setting up the Formation.
It had to be said that Ye Mingyi, former Supreme Elder of the Seven Seas Hall, was indeed wealthy.
For instance, the set of Formation Flags Lin Jing used to establish the Formation was an extremely powerful Defensive Array.
When Lin Jing came across this set of Formation Flags, he was overjoyed.
When deployed, the Formation they formed was almost equivalent to a ninth-tier Formation.
Had it not been for the need to refine this set of Formation Flags, Lin Jing could have finished his preparations even a few days earlier.
Furthermore, in addition to the Formation Flags, there were several Defensive Daoist Treasures, like the one that Ye Mingyi once used, which Lin Jing had also refined.
However, Lin Jing only refined the Formation Flags and those Magical Treasures briefly â€” not so they would be as responsive as his own limbs, but enough to be usable.
Fully refining them would have required more time than he had.
Since the Heavenly Tribulation Lin Jing faced at each advancement was extremely terrifying, he naturally had to make these preparations well in advance.
After arranging all the Formation Flags, Lin Jing scattered hundreds of Supreme Grade Spirit Stones within the Formation, which then immediately activated.
Then, Lin Jing walked straight into the Formation, sat down cross-legged, and began adjusting his state, ready to induce the Heavenly Tribulation.
…
…
Time trickled by, and soon Lin Jing had been sitting inside the Formation for several days, vaguely sensing something, but the Heavenly Tribulation had still not arrived.
The arrival of the Heavenly Tribulation could be sooner or later â€” a delay of just a few days wasn’t uncommon or abnormal.
Thus, Lin Jing was not in a hurry and continued to wait…
Soon…
Another few days passed, and Lin Jing’s sense grew clearer, yet the Heavenly Tribulation still had not come.
Under normal circumstances, the Tribulation should have arrived by this time, but its delay was somewhat unexpected.
However, considering that the Heavenly Tribulations he had faced were different from others, and that he was in this place known as the Land of Immortal Remnants, which might differ from the outside world.
Therefore, Lin Jing merely frowned slightly and did not act rashly, continuing to adjust his state and induce the Heavenly Tribulation.
…
…
Unexpectedly to Lin Jing, his wait extended for a full half-month.
Only after half a month did the dark clouds begin to gather above Lin Jing’s head, with dark clouds appearing out of nowhere directly over him.
It was not until this cloud manifested that Lin Jing finally breathed a sigh of relief.
It seemed that the Land of Immortal Remnants was not just an ordinary place.
Lin Jing speculated that, like the Devouring Spirit Blood Realm, it too might be a land that could shield divine secrets.
That’s why the Heavenly Tribulation was delayed.
Of course, this was just Lin Jing’s guess.
Regarding the Land of Immortal Remnants, Lin Jing could say that he knew next to nothing; naturally, he was not clear what the reality of this Land of Immortal Remnants was.
Actually…
What Lin Jing didn’t know was that, during this time, when he was trying to draw down the Heavenly Tribulation, several streams of Immortal Yuan that were originally hidden within the Land of Immortal Remnants, began to emerge intermittently.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 922: Chapter 414 Tribulation Begins, Immortal Yuan Reappears_2 Chapter 922: Chapter 414 Tribulation Begins, Immortal Yuan Reappears_2 This abnormal phenomenon caught the attention of other cultivators within the Land of Immortal Remnants.
Especially those seeking Elder Bai and the ancestors of the Changyun Clan from Cangyun Realm and Jiulin Realm, who paused their search and began to observe the pattern of the appearing Immortal Yuan, attempting to obtain it.
Yet the Immortal Yuan, being extremely fast and hidden, was exceedingly difficult to discover.
Thus, even though the Immortal Yuan occasionally appeared, no one was able to capture it.
Because of this, cultivators from Cangyun Realm and Jiulin Realm directly joined forces, hoping to use their numerical advantage to tightly control an area where the Immortal Yuan had previously appeared and attempt to capture this Immortal Yuan.
They had believed this would entail a long wait.
But unexpectedly, soon after they allied, an Immortal Yuan suddenly appeared.
...
Unlike the others, it did not hide again after appearing.
Instead, it boldly streaked past the cultivators from both sides and swiftly flew in a certain direction.
Seeing this, the cultivators from both sides could no longer care about their previous arrangements and pursued the Immortal Yuan directly.
The speed of the Immortal Yuan was already extremely fast; even cultivators at the peak of the Mahayana were no match, and once it turned invisible, it was nearly impossible to find.
This was why, over the years, only Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan had managed to get one such Immortal Yuan.
ƝονǤօ.ƈο
The fact that Elder Bai and the ancestor previously obtained that Immortal Yuan was largely due to luck.
Now, however, this Immortal Yuan no longer hid and appeared openly; though it was fast, it presented a rare opportunity that everyone was reluctant to miss.
Therefore…
Everyone hesitated no more and chased after it.
Not long after they set out, they discovered two more Immortal Yuan, behaving like the previous one, no longer hiding their tracks.
Three Immortal Yuan together, flying in the same direction.
This situation excited everyone greatly.
Three…
Three Immortal Yuan appeared at once.
In the Outer Spatial Void, it was long rumored that a sudden accident in the Immortal Realm had closed the ascension pathways, making it impossible to ascend to immortality.
The only way to become an immortal was by obtaining Immortal Yuan.
And in the entire Land of Immortal Remnants, there were nine Immortal Yuan.
Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan had gotten one, and another had broken through space a hundred years ago, its whereabouts unknown…
Now, only seven Immortal Yuan remained in the entire Land of Immortal Remnants.
Yet suddenly, three Immortal Yuan appeared, representing three opportunities for ascension placed right before themâ€”how could they not be thrilled?
Naturally, they wouldn’t let go of this rare opportunity no matter what…
…
Of course…
At the time when everyone was pursuing the Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing was unaware of this situation.
At that moment, Lin Jing was observing the slowly accumulating tribulation clouds above him, adjusting his state, preparing to start his tribulation.
As time gradually passed, the tribulation clouds above Lin Jing’s head thickened and the range of the tribulation clouds was considerably larger than ever before.
Moreover, the terrifying heavenly pressure within the clouds was far more intense than before.
Under these tribulation clouds, even though Lin Jing was at the peak of tribulation readiness, he still felt like a slightly stronger ant.
Although the pressure was extraordinarily terrifying, Lin Jing’s heart did not waver in the slightest.
Cultivation itself is a defiance of the heavens, and Heavenly Tribulation is the greatest test for a cultivator.
Cross it and your lifespan increases with boundless prospects.
Fail and you perish; all endeavors cease…
This heavenly pressure was naturally a part of this test.
If he couldn’t withstand even this, then naturally, when the Tribulation Lightning struck, he would surely perish and all would be lost.
Just when the heavenly pressure reached its pinnacle, a rumbling sound of muffled thunder began to emerge within the clouds.
Soon after, colorful lightning arcs occasionally appeared within the tribulation clouds.
Lin Jing lifted his head, gazing intently at the lightning arcs within the clouds.
These arcs, incredibly resplendent, each comprised six colors.
It was indeed the Six-colored Tribulation Thunder.
Indeed…
This Tribulation Lightning was even more formidable than the last time Lin Jing underwent tribulation, manifesting immediately as Six-colored Tribulation Thunder.
Regarding this, Lin Jing had anticipated it beforehand.
He wasn’t panicked but adjusted himself and activated his Overlord Divine Physique, ready to face the impending Tribulation Lightning.
As time ticked away, the rumbling within the clouds became more frequent, and bolts of lightning occasionally escaped the clouds, dancing across its surface.
The appearance of these six-colored lightning arcs brightened the entire void considerably.
And then, at that moment…
“Crack!”
A loud crash resounded as the first bolt of Tribulation Lightning emerged from within the clouds.
The Tribulation Lightning had already locked onto Lin Jing and fell directly towards the top of his head as soon as it appeared.
This first bolt was the Six-colored Tribulation Thunder.
After falling, the bolt passed through the Defensive Array, its force slightly diminished, yet the remaining Tribulation Lightning still submerged Lin Jing.
However…
This was just the first bolt of Tribulation Lightning, and relatively speaking, its power wasn’t very strong, and it became even weaker after passing through the array.
And the duration of this first bolt wasn’t very long either.
Soon…
In just a span of three breaths, this first bolt of Tribulation Lightning had exhausted its energy and completely dissipated.
After the Tribulation Lightning disappeared, Lin Jing reappeared.
At this moment, Lin Jing, having undergone the baptism of the first bolt, was unscathed, and it seemed he hadn’t expended much energy.
After the first bolt, Lin Jing looked up again at the heavenly clouds, waiting for the second bolt to fall.
Meanwhile, he was holding a Supreme Grade Spirit Stone in his hand, continuously restoring the Spiritual Power he had just spent.
Although the expenditure was minimal, being in the void wasn’t like being within the realm where Spiritual Power was readily available.
Thus, even a small expenditure required immediate replenishment to ensure he remained in prime condition to face the subsequent, more formidable bolts of Tribulation Lightning.
Just now, after the first bolt, the accumulated power of Tribulation Lightning in the clouds had been released, and the second bolt needed to gather strength again…
Within the clouds, the situation remained the same as before, with constant deep rumbles, and the lightning arcs occasionally appearing on the surface.
This second bolt took a bit longer to accumulate, but by the time it fell, Lin Jing had fully recovered and once again faced the second bolt in perfect form.
Like the first bolt, this second bolt also lasted for three breaths.
Three breaths later, Lin Jing was still unharmed.
At this time, after the second bolt dissipated and while the third bolt was still brewing, Lin Jing took the opportunity to restore his depleted Spiritual Power…
…
…
The third bolt of Tribulation Lightning didn’t make Lin Jing wait too long, though it was somewhat more powerful than the first two, it was still limited.
After three bolts of Tribulation Lightning, aside from expending some Spiritual Power, Lin Jing suffered no injuries.
Once the third bolt had dissipated,
the Tribulation Clouds began to change, expanding across a larger area and the celestial pressure emanating from within grew increasingly terrifying.
Soon, after the clouds reached a certain extent and ceased to expand, the lightning arcs within them began to change.
Lin Jing looked up at the clouds, watching as the arcs slowly shifted from six colors to seven colors.
Seven colors, which were the colors of the last three bolts of Tribulation Lightning Lin Jing had experienced previously, were now beginning to appear.
As the celestial pressure became intense where Lin Jing was, and as the Seven-colored Tribulation Lightning emerged, all the cultivators in the Land of Immortal Remnants vaguely sensed this pressure.
Especially those who were chasing the three strands of Immortal Yuan, they looked towards the direction the Immortal Yuan were flying, feeling the celestial pressure coming from an unknown distance ahead.
Sensing the celestial pressure, some cautious individuals couldn’t help but frown slightly.
But others became even more excited, their eyes gleaming as they looked ahead.
At this moment, not a single person backed away.
After all, they were Mahayana Realm cultivators who had lived for thousands of years, and each of their experiences was beyond the ordinary imagination.
So whether they were naturally cautious or those who loved adventure, all of them accelerated, flying forward.
Eager to see what was happening ahead that had attracted the three strands of Immortal Yuanâ€¦

chapters.title: Chapter 923
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 923: Chapter 415: The Fake Silent Obliteration Celestial Thunder Chapter 923: Chapter 415: The Fake Silent Obliteration Celestial Thunder Within the Land of Immortal Remnants, other cultivators were lured by the Immortal Yuan, rushing toward where the celestial might was emerging…
But in another deserted expanse of the Land of Immortal Remnants, there floated a meteorite of grayish-white hue, as large as a lofted pavilion.
Such meteorites, countless as the hairs of an ox in the void of space, were plentiful, many even larger than this one.
With no aura emanating from it, at first glance, it seemed of common composition, extremely ordinary, unlikely harboring any rare metallic ores.
Hence, this meteorite floating in the void did not attract attention, and even passing cultivators would not take a second look.
At this moment…
Suddenly, a black figure appeared next to the meteorite.
...
After manifesting, the figure placed a hand on the meteorite, blue light surfaced upon his palm, and then a breath infused into the meteorite.
Moments later, the meteorite transformed, its entire surface revealing innumerable complex Formation Patterns, and at the most densely patterned spot, a pitch-dark opening materialized.
Upon the opening’s appearance, the black figure flashed into the meteorite.
After its entry, the opening on the meteorite disappeared, and the entire meteorite resumed its inconspicuous state once more.
…
ṅοѵǤ0.сο
After the black figure entered the meteorite, his form shifted, and soon an individual bearing a face familiar to Lin Jing appeared.
Should Lin Jing be there, he would undoubtedly recognize this person as the Elder of the Changyun Clan.
Following that…
The Elder of the Changyun Clan spoke directly into the depths, saying,
“Elder Bai, I’m back!”
While speaking, he walked further inside.
The interior of the meteorite had been hollowed out, spacious enough to accommodate a couple of rooms.
As the Elder of the Changyun Clan entered, another figure dressed in white emerged from behind the partition in the middle of the meteorite.
This figure in white was none other than Elder Bai.
After Elder Bai appeared and caught sight of the Elder of the Changyun Clan, he promptly spoke,
“Elder Hongâ€¦”
“You must have felt it too, this oppressive force…”
“Do you have any idea what’s going on?”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan replied immediately,
“Of course, I felt it, but even I don’t know what’s happening…”
“Such oppression, even more terrifying than when I endured the Mahayana Tribulation.
It’s as if someone is undergoing the Immortal Ascension Tribulation.”
Upon hearing this, Elder Bai nodded,
“Indeed…”
“The source of this oppressive might is evidently far from us, yet even from this distance, we still feel it.”
“Fear that only the Tribulation of Ascension could wield such a force.”
Having spoken, Elder Bai suddenly changed his tone, asking the Elder of the Changyun Clan,
“By the way…”
“What about the measures you left outside?
Have they spotted the movements of the people from Cangyun and Jiulin?”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan nodded,
“Of course…”
“I was just about to discuss this with you.”
“The surveillance means I left behind observed the emergence of three traces of unhidden Immortal Yuan, and these three streams are moving together toward the source of that might.”
“And I also saw that the people from both realms of Cangyun and Jiulin have all mobilized, pursuing those three streams of Immortal Yuan.”
“Immortal Yuan…”
Hearing this, Elder Bai couldn’t help but frown slightly,
“Could it truly be someone undergoing the Ascension Tribulation?”
“That shouldn’t be…”
The Elder of the Changyun Clan nodded slightly in agreement,
“It indeed shouldn’t…”
“Since the sudden catastrophe a million years ago, no Ascension Tribulation has descended.
It’s very likely not the Ascension Tribulation but some other wonder or perhaps a disaster.”
“But now, with so many from the realms of Cangyun and Jiulin present, even if a wonder emerges, it’s not something we could contemplate.”
“Our current priority should be finding a way to quickly leave this place.”
Elder Bai nodded and then said,
“You’re right, we need to figure out a way to leave as soon as possible.”
At this point, Elder Bai looked at the Elder of the Changyun Clan and asked,
“Now that they have all gone after that stream of Immortal Yuan, what do you think about this opportunity?”
Upon hearing this, the Elder of the Changyun Clan pondered while speaking,
“This opportunity…”
“Although most of them have gone after those three streams of Immortal Yuan, there will undoubtedly be people guarding the entrance, making it difficult to force our way through.”
“But…” the Elder of the Changyun Clan frowned slightly before continuing,
“If we miss this chance, it might be very hard to encounter such an opportunity again…”
As he said this, the Elder of the Changyun Clan’s gaze became resolute, and he declared outright,
“It’s possible!”
“Let’s seize this opportunity to give it a try.”
“However, before doing so, we must prepare in advance.
If we fail, we must have a way to retreat in one piece.”
Elder Bai nodded in agreement, saying,
“Of course…”
…
Meanwhile, in Lin Jing’s situation, amidst the Tribulation Clouds, lightning flickered and converged, the fourth round of Tribulation Lightning fully brewed with a thunderous roar.
The fourth bolt of Tribulation Lightning descended straight onto Lin Jing’s head.
As the lightning passed through the Formation, the Formation visibly shook but quickly stabilized.
Weakened by the Formation, the fourth bolt of Tribulation Lightning struck Lin Jing.
The pillar of lightning, as thick as a thousand-year-old tree, completely enveloped Lin Jing.
Within the lightning, Lin Jing channeled his Spiritual Power to resist the damage from the Tribulation Lightning, while simultaneously invoking the Overlord Divine Physique to absorb the lightning, continuing to refine his body.
The duration of this fourth round of Tribulation Lightning was unlike the previous three, lasting much longer.
Only after six full breaths did the fourth bolt of Tribulation Lightning exhaust its strength, dissipating entirely.

chapters.title: Chapter 924
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 924: Chapter 415 False Silent Extermination Celestial Thunder_2 Chapter 924: Chapter 415 False Silent Extermination Celestial Thunder_2 After the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing, who had been submerged in the Tribulation Lightning, was once again exposed.
Under the fourth streak of Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing appeared slightly more disheveled compared to the third one, and some wounds had appeared on his body.
However, with the incredible healing power of Lin Jing’s Overlord Divine Physique, it only took the blink of an eye for these wounds to restore to their original state.
Having endured the fourth streak of Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing hastily took out two Supreme Grade Spirit Stones to accelerate the absorption of Spiritual Power within them in hopes of quickly recovering his condition.
And then…
Before Lin Jing could fully recover, the fifth streak of Tribulation Lightning was already falling.
The fifth strike caused the Formation to shake even more violently, and when the Tribulation Lightning struck Lin Jing, his injuries were somewhat more severe than before.
...
But with Lin Jing’s strong recovery power, such injuries were still nothing of concern.
When the fifth streak of Tribulation Lightning vanished, shortly after, the sixth streak arrived with force.
This sixth streak of Tribulation Lightning was far more powerful than the previous fifth oneâ€”it even reached several times the strength of the fourth one.
After withstanding the sixth streak, Lin Jing’s body was torn and blood flowed freely.
Nonetheless, even with such wounds, they still healed in a very short time.
The wounds on his body were actually not a concern.
ƝονǤ0.ƈօ
The key issue was that after resisting this streak of Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing’s Spiritual Power within had been significantly depleted.
If this had been within the realm, it would not be a problem, as, with Lin Jing’s Cultivation at the Transcendance Tribulation Stage, replenishing his lost Spiritual Power would’ve been achievable in an instant.
But this was the Outer Spatial Void, with no Spiritual Power to replenish, one could only absorb from Spirit Stones or consume Elixir Medicine.
And with Lin Jing’s current Cultivation, few Elixir Medicines could make up for his exhaustion.
Therefore, after the sixth streak of Tribulation Lightning fell, Lin Jing hurriedly sat down cross-legged, using the Supreme Grade Spirit Stones to start replenishing the Spiritual Power he was lacking.
In reality…
If it were a normal depletion, even in combat with another, such consumption of Spiritual Power wouldn’t be much.
And wouldn’t require immediate replenishment.
But Lin Jing was currently facing the Heavenly Tribulation.
Although the previous streaks of Heavenly Tribulation didn’t seem significant, and the Spiritual Power they consumed wasn’t much to speak of,
the further back they went, the more perilous the Heavenly Tribulation became.
Especially the last three streaks of Tribulation Lightning, they took a huge toll on Lin Jing, and with very short intervals in between the strikes, there was no chance to replenish in time.
Thus, Lin Jing had to seize every moment he could to absorb Spiritual Power during the interlude of the impending streaks of Tribulation Lightning, to maintain himself in the best condition possible to face those last three streaks.
…
While Lin Jing was replenishing his Spiritual Power, the tribulation clouds in the sky underwent change once more, and the lightnings within the clouds added one more color, transforming into the eight-colored Tribulation Lightning.
After the appearance of the eight-colored Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing immediately felt an aura of terror.
Following that, Lin Jing hurriedly stood up, looking towards the tribulation clouds above.
Although he hadn’t fully recovered internally, he had no choice but to face the seventh streak of Tribulation Lightning that was about to fall.
At the same time, Lin Jing also took out the Protective Dao Treasures he had prepared in advance, obtained from Ye Mingyi.
After taking out a few Protective Dao Treasures, Lin Jing promptly summoned the System and activated the Bonus Attachment feature.
With the last three streaks of Tribulation Lightning reaching the power of eight colors, they were the strongest Tribulation Lightnings.
Facing these final three streaks, Lin Jing naturally could not afford to be careless; he had to give it his all.
Not long after Lin Jing had prepared, the seventh streak of Tribulation Lightning was ready, plummeting down from the tribulation clouds.
Upon descending, the first to be struck was the Formation formed by Formation Flags.
The Formation had already suffered damage during the sixth streak of Tribulation Lightning.
Now facing an even stronger seventh streak on top of this damage…
The moment it touched the Formation, the entire Formation completely collapsed, and those several Formation Flags were utterly destroyed.
After the Formation was shattered, Lin Jing promptly operated the few Daoist Treasures to meet the Tribulation Lightning.
Fortunately, those Daoist Treasures successfully withstood the bombardment of the Tribulation Lightning, absorbing part of its force.
The remaining Tribulation Lightning once again engulfed Lin Jing.
One breath…
Two breaths…
Three breaths…
…
…
Starting with the seventh streak, the duration of the Tribulation Lightning increased to nine breaths.
After nine breaths, the Tribulation Lightning dissipated, revealing Lin Jing who had just been submerged by it.
After enduring the purging of the Tribulation Lightning, Lin Jing’s wounds were so deep that bones were visible, with some bones even cracked apart.
And there were constant flashes of eight-colored lightning arcs rampaging over Lin Jing’s wounds, preventing them from healing.
But fortunately, after persisting for a while, these lightning arcs merged into Lin Jing’s body and were absorbed by him.
