After absorbing these lightning arcs, Lin Jing’s body quickly recovered, and it seemed that his physique had undergone some differences compared to before.
However, Lin Jing ignored these changes, for the eighth streak of Tribulation Lightning in the tribulation clouds above his head was already fully brewed, ready to descend.
“Boom!”
Without giving Lin Jing any time to recover, the eighth streak of Tribulation Lightning had already fallen.
After shattering the defensive Daoist Treasures fashioned for protection, this eighth streak of Tribulation Lightning struck Lin Jing squarely.
Those defensive Daoist Treasures were all collected by Ye Ming, and Lin Jing didn’t feel the slightest regret even as they were shattered.
By protecting him against the Tribulation Lightning, these Daoist Treasures fulfilled their intended purpose.
The eighth streak of Tribulation Lightning, naturally, lasted for nine breaths as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 925
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 925: Chapter 415: The False Tranquil Extermination Celestial Thunder_3 Chapter 925: Chapter 415: The False Tranquil Extermination Celestial Thunder_3 After the eighth Tribulation Lightning dissipated, Lin Jing below looked extremely devastated.
There wasn’t a single spot on his body that was intact.
But even in such a condition, Lin Jing suddenly revealed a smile.
Having just overcome the eighth Tribulation Lightning, although several Daoist Treasures had been destroyed, the Turtle Shell Dao Treasure previously used by Ye Mingyi had only sustained slight damage.
Ɲονցօ.сο
Despite being merely a Superior Daoist Treasure, it was quite extraordinary, offering some resistance against the Heavenly Tribulation.
Lin Jing had not refined this treasure before, thinking it was nothing more than an ordinary Daoist Treasure; it seemed he had misjudged its true worth.
...
Although the treasure couldn’t withstand the devouring power of the Samsara Holy Fruit, its defensive capability was indeed remarkable, no wonder Ye Mingyi had brought it out against him previously.
With this Daoist Treasure, crossing the ninth Tribulation Lightning should not be too difficult.
Next, Lin Jing focused on recovering his body while keeping a close watch on the tempestuous clouds above, anticipating the descent of the last strike of Tribulation Lightning.
However…
After Lin Jing’s body had fully recovered, the final strike of Tribulation Lightning still hadn’t arrived.
As Lin Jing grew puzzled, he noticed the clouds of the tribulation beginning to shrink, the vast expanse drastically condensing.
Within those clouds, the lightning arcs began to exhibit an additional colorâ€”though this last color was faint and barely noticeable.
“Nine-colored Tribulation Lightning is the sign of Jiemie Celestial Lightning.”
“Could this lightning be transforming towards Jiemie Celestial Lightning?”
Lin Jing looked up at the lightning arcs in the clouds with a subtle change in expression, his brow involuntarily furrowing.
If this last lightning was indeed Jiemie Celestial Lightning, surviving it peacefully would be no easy feat.
…
…
Fortunately, the nine-colored Jiemie Celestial Lightning did not fully materialize.
The colors of the lightning finally fixed in that state.
When the clouds contracted to a mere thousand zhang in size, all the lightning arcs appeared simultaneously, converging in the center of the storm.
Then, the nine-colored lightning, with the faintest last hue, struck Lin Jing.
Seeing the lightning descend, Lin Jing did not dare to delay, hurriedly maneuvering the Turtle Shell Dao Treasure for defense.
However…
This last lightning, although not reaching the true Jiemie Celestial Lightning, had formed nine colorsâ€”labeling it a pseudo-Jiemie Celestial Lightning would not be an exaggeration, and its power was indeed terrifying.
Under the assault of this pseudo-Jiemie Celestial Lightning, just in the first breath, several cracks appeared out of nowhere on the robust Turtle Shell Dao Treasure.
By the second breath, those cracks began to grow larger.
Then, the entire Turtle Shell Dao Treasure began to be riddled with cracks, but fortunately, it somehow held together.
In the third breath, the Turtle Shell Dao Treasure was already in a state of near-collapse, its defensive capability significantly compromised, and Lin Jing endured more of the lightning’s force, his wounds splitting open relentlessly.
In the fourth breath, the already battered Turtle Shell Dao Treasure could not hold on and shattered completely.
As the Turtle Shell Dao Treasure collapsed, Lin Jing immediately summoned his Innate Dao Treasure, the Jinhong Furnace, and activated it to resist the overhead Tribulation Lightning.
Although the Jinhong Furnace wasn’t a defense-oriented Daoist Treasure, it could still fend off some of the lightning’s inflicted damage.
Thus, Lin Jing, utilizing the Jinhong Furnace, endured until the seventh breath, and after the seventh breath, he was nearly unrecognizable as a human being.
By the eighth breath, virtually all the flesh on Lin Jing’s body had been eroded by the lightning, even his bones had worn away significantly.
It was apparent that the lightning’s power had surpassed the limits Lin Jing could withstand.
Even his Soul Spirit had become incredibly weak from the bombardment of this final strike of lightning.
And yet, the lightning continued relentlessly, as if vowing not to cease until Lin Jing was entirely obliterated.
This final lightning had one last breath to go, the strongest of all, and with Lin Jing’s current condition, it seemed very unlikely he would endure through it.
At this moment…
It was the most perilous moment in Lin Jing’s life.
Unless a miracle occurred, Lin Jing was likely to perish under this last strike of Tribulation Lightning…

chapters.title: Chapter 926
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 926: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan Chapter 926: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan However…
Just when Lin Jing was in the most dangerous moment, three tri-colored lights swiftly charged into the Tribulation Lightning, approaching Lin Jing who was undergoing Tribulation.
The sudden arrival of these three tri-colored lights took Lin Jing by surprise, for he was extremely familiar with this auraâ€”it was the Immortal Yuan that he had acquired during his last Tribulation.
Last time he underwent Tribulation, Immortal Yuan had appeared.
This time too, Immortal Yuan appeared again.
And this time, there were three strands of Immortal Yuan.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel puzzled, wondering why the Immortal Yuan would actively approach him, especially during his Tribulation.
...
Although he knew that the Immortal Yuan had come close to him, Lin Jing dared not let his mind wander too much at this critical moment of his Tribulation.
At this moment, the Tribulation Lightning was still wreaking havoc above him, and Lin Jing was still struggling against the terrifying final strike of the Tribulation Lightning.
However…
What happened next astonished Lin Jing even more.
After the arrival of the three Immortal Yuan, they first circled around Lin Jing and then released an even stronger light, enveloping him completely.
Immediately after, Lin Jing felt enveloped by a strange force, and his body, nearly eroded by the Tribulation Lightning, quickly recovered back to normal.
Even his Spiritual Power had recovered a great deal in that instant.
At that moment, the ninth and final strike of the Tribulation Lightning came.
Lin Jing had braced himself for what he thought would be an even more fearsome lightning, ready to withstand it.
Unexpectedly, when this Tribulation Lightning struck, most of its power was absorbed by the Immortal Yuan that surrounded him.
When the Tribulation Lightning hit him, its power was only comparable to the eighth strike, and he easily resisted it.
After absorbing the power of the Tribulation Lightning, the Immortal Yuan directly entered Lin Jing’s body.
The next momentâ€¦
Lin Jing felt an incredible connection with the three strands of Immortal Yuan; as the Immortal Yuan entered his body, Lin Jing seemed to enter a very strange state, his Divine Sense starting to extend uncontrollably outward.
This extension of the Divine Sense happened quickly, and soon exceeded the maximum range his Cultivation could normally detect; yet, even at this point, it did not stop and continued to stretch further.
After a while, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense detected a strand of Immortal Yuan hidden in the void, attached to a meteorite.
Its aura was not discernible at all, but under Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, it shone like a candle in the night, very conspicuous.
Even…
A cultivator flew right past it, completely failing to detect the presence of that Immortal Yuan.
Seeing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but marvel:
“It’s no wonder that acquiring Immortal Yuan is so difficult; its ability to conceal itself is extremely powerful.”
“Even when it’s this close, it remains undetected.”
“But…”
“Why am I able to clearly detect the hidden Immortal Yuan?”
“Could it be because of those three strands of Immortal Yuan?”
But before Lin Jing could ponder further, his Divine Sense continued to expand, stretching further outward.
At this moment, Lin Jing saw cultivators speeding through the void, headed in the direction of his current location.
Then…
After seeing that cultivator, many more followed, flying towards his current location.
Seeing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but frown; the group of cultivators totaled more than twenty, and the lowest amongst them were at the early stages of Mahayana, with even a few at the peak of Mahayana.
At this time, their goal was unified, all flying towards his location.
At this moment, the final strike of Tribulation Lightning had ended, and the tribulation clouds in the sky began to dissipate.
Lin Jing’s body was unharmed, but in his peculiar state, his Divine Sense kept extending outward, and at this moment he could not control his body at all, unable to do anything.
This state was completely beyond his control, even if Lin Jing wanted to exit it, he couldn’t achieve it now.
Fortunately, those cultivators were still some distance away from Lin Jing, and he could only hope that he would recover in time before they arrived.
Meanwhile, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense continued to extend outward.
Not long after…
Lin Jing discovered the second strand of Immortal Yuan.
This second strand of Immortal Yuan appeared in someone’s hand, held tightly.
Ɲ0νǤօ.сο
Next to this person was an early Mahayana cultivator and the floating corpse of a giant serpent.
At this moment, Lin Jing also saw clearly the person who had acquired the Immortal Yuanâ€”it was Elder Qu from the Liuyue Dao Sect of the Cangyun Realm in the Xi Cang Continent.
Unexpectedly, they had truly acquired a strand of Immortal Yuan, and judging from the situation, it even seemed related to the giant serpent.
Following this, Lin Jing quietly noted this down.
They had mentioned before that once they obtained the Immortal Yuan, they would find a way to leave quietly, presumably not letting it be exposed.
Once all this was over and his Cultivation was stabilized, Lin Jing planned to find a way to possibly seize the Immortal Yuan from them…
However, Elder Qu’s Cultivation was too high; even if Lin Jing advanced to the Mahayana Realm, he likely wouldn’t be a match for him.
Therefore, even if he wanted to forcefully take the Immortal Yuan, it would require well-laid plans, and assistance from others would be ideal…
Just as Lin Jing was considering how to seize the Immortal Yuan of the two from the Liuyue Dao Sect of the Cangyun Realm, his Divine Sense continued to extend out.

chapters.title: Chapter 927
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 927: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Obtained Immortal Yuan_2 Chapter 927: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Obtained Immortal Yuan_2 This time, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense extended even more swiftly, and before long, he discovered another Immortal Yuan in motion.
And this Immortal Yuan was moving at a tremendous speed, without any cultivators nearby.
Soon…
After approaching a meteorite, the Immortal Yuan plunged directly into it, vanishing from sight.
Next…
The Divine Sense continued to extend, and this time, Lin Jing saw the elderly ancestors of the Changyun Clan and Elder Bai.
The two had suddenly appeared next to a massive meteorite, seemingly having used a Teleportation Talisman.
...
Moreover, both looked somewhat disheveled, with varying degrees of injuries on them, as if they had just fought a battle.
Upon appearing, they swiftly swept past the meteorite and came next to a rather inconspicuous meteorite.
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan then extended a hand and infused the meteorite with Spiritual Power.
Suddenly, the meteorite underwent a transformation, illuminating the Formation that was hidden on its surface, and a dark hole appeared on the meteorite.
The next moment, both flickered into the meteorite, and after their entrance, the hole disappeared, the meteorite reverted, its Formation concealed once again, returning to its previous unassuming state.
Previously, Lin Jing had heard from two people of the Liuyue Dao Sect that Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan’s ancestor were being pursued because of an Immortal Yuan.
Now, it appeared to be true.
Although they had hidden the Immortal Yuan, just moments ago, Lin Jing had sensed the presence of Immortal Yuan on Elder Bai’s person.
This was not discovered through the use of Divine Sense, but rather seemed to be a mutual sensing between Immortal Yuans that allowed Lin Jing to perceive the Immortal Yuan on Elder Bai.
Before Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan’s ancestor went to the Outer Spatial Void, Lin Jing had once given Elder Bai an Immortal Yuan.
But inexplicably, this Immortal Yuan had been exposed, which led to their current predicament.
…
…
After locating Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan’s ancestor, the Divine Sense kept extending, swiftly locating five Mahayana pinnacle cultivators, searching for something in the void.
They too bore signs of battle, with two of them sustaining injuries of varying degrees.
These must be the ones who had fought with Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan.
No wonder, despite their own Cultivation levels, both were fleeing; they were actually up against five Mahayana pinnacle cultivators of comparable strength.
They naturally stood no chance against the concerted assault by five cultivators of their own tier.
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense swept past the five Mahayana pinnacle cultivators who were searching for clues to Elder Bai and the Changyun Clan ancestor and continued to extend outward.
Soon, Lin Jing discovered a blindingly bright light, like that of a portal, within a hole.
At that portal, a vast Formation enveloped the entire entrance, guarded by two Mahayana cultivators.
This portal was undoubtedly the exit from the Land of Immortal Remnants.
Upon seeing the exit, the speed of the Divine Sense increased once again, and after some time, Lin Jing finally located another Immortal Yuan.
Right after spotting this Immortal Yuan, Divine Sense stopped extending, and Lin Jing withdrew from this strange state.
Emerging from this peculiar state, Lin Jing lifted his gaze and saw that the clouds of Tribulation in the sky had completely dissipated, and his Cultivation had entered the early Mahayana phase.
Furthermore, having just undergone Tribulation, his Cultivation was already stable, without need for further time to consolidate.
Because the group of cultivators was fast approaching, Lin Jing didn’t dare to delay.
He hastily called up the System and entered the System Space.
Just as Lin Jing entered the System Space, several system alerts arrived in succession:
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the Host for obtaining an Immortal Yuan, reward: 10,000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the Host for obtaining an Immortal Yuan, reward: 10,000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System Notice: Congratulations to the Host for obtaining an Immortal Yuan, reward: 10,000 Harvest Points.”
Following the alerts for the acquisition of three Immortal Yuans, Lin Jing then saw the three Immortal Yuans swiftly fly towards the peripheries of the System Space, to those three special lands.
One of the Immortal Yuans passed through the barrier of the Nine Heavens Reincarnation land and directly merged with the Samsara Holy Fruit.
As the Immortal Yuan integrated with the Samsara Holy Fruit, the Samsara Holy Fruit began to undergo transformation.
Its black and white hues spun wildly, tinting the entire Nine Heavens Reincarnation land with the lustrous nine-colored brilliance of the Immortal Yuan.
After the first Immortal Yuan merged into the Samsara Holy Fruit…
Another Immortal Yuan entered the space where the Transcendent Lotus Pond was situated, merging with the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus within.
After this Immortal Yuan integrated with the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, the entire plant too started to transform.
At first, the black exterior of the lotus body began to wither and turned to dried yellow.
But in just a moment, that withered outer layer began to peel away, revealing specks of gold light.
The other two World Seeds also began to transform due to the addition of the Immortal Yuan.
Only the third Immortal Yuan, upon entering the System Space and like the others ecstatically flying towards the third special placeâ€”the Dao Realm Divine Mountainâ€”circled inside but found nothing.
Ɲ0νǤ0.ƈο
In the end, it had to leave the Divine Mountain forlornly and return to Lin Jing.

chapters.title: Chapter 928
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 928: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan_3 Chapter 928: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan_3 Just like that…
It was as though a child had returned home, crestfallen without receiving a gift.
Following the return of the Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing saw that the changes within the Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus were still ongoing.
He didn’t wait any longer and instead summoned the System, activating Observation Mode.
Through Observation Mode, he began to examine the outside situation.
Shortly after Lin Jing had activated Observation Mode, he noticed someone had entered the range of Observation Mode.
Then, in the blink of an eye, a second…
...
A third…
A fourth…
…
…
The group of people Lin Jing had seen while in that strange state had now arrived at his location.
Fortunately, that strange state had not lasted long.
Otherwise, he would have certainly been surrounded by them, making escape difficult.
In just a moment, these twenty-some people had already reached the site of Lin Jing’s Tribulation.
Upon arriving, these individuals didn’t rashly approach but instead began to carefully investigate from a distance.
This time, all of these people were present, allowing Lin Jing a good opportunity to observe them in detail.
Although they were all Cultivators from the same group, they were clearly divided into two factions, each led by a Cultivator at the peak of Mahayana.
Without a doubt, this must be a joint force of Cultivators from both the Cangyun Realm and the Jiulin Realm; that’s why there were so many people.
Originally…
Due to an upheaval a million years ago, Cultivators from the Cultivation World were no longer able to ascend.
Those Cultivators who had reached the Mahayana Realm could only continue to stay within their respective Cultivation Worlds or even this void, searching for a chance to become immortal.
As a result, the number of Mahayana Cultivators in the Cultivation World kept on increasing…
Until the passage of time took its toll, causing even Cultivators of the Mahayana Realm to reach the end of their lifespans and perish, finally diminishing the number of Mahayana Cultivators.
But a single Mahayana Cultivator has a lifespan of twenty thousand years.
If it had been a million years earlier, they would have either ascended to the Immortal Realm or perished in the Trials of Becoming Immortal.
Ɲονǥᴑ.сօ
It simply would not have been possible to see so many Mahayana Cultivators acting together like this.
This time, for the Immortal Yuan held by Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan, apart from these twenty-some people, there were also a few who had fought with Elder Bai and the others earlier.
For this Immortal Yuan, the combined forces of the Cangyun and the Jiulin Realms’ Mahayana Cultivators had already reached thirty in number.
Although there are now more Mahayana Cultivators compared to a million years ago, these thirty Mahayana Cultivators still almost made up half of the top forces of both realms.
The fact that this single Immortal Yuan had attracted so many individuals showed just how strong the allure of this Immortal Yuan was to these Mahayana Cultivators.
…
After observing for a while, someone took the lead in speaking up.
The first person to speak was the leader from the Cangyun Realm, that peak Mahayana Cultivator.
After observing the situation, he turned his head to the Mahayana Cultivator leading the Jiulin Realm and said,
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, what do you make of this place?”
The Jiulin Cultivator replied,
“If nothing is unexpected, someone has been undergoing Tribulation here.”
“And moreover, judging by the lingering aura of the Tribulation Lightning, this Tribulation is quite extraordinary; it seems to be the Tribulation of Becoming Immortal.”
“However, the Tribulation of Becoming Immortal hasn’t descended for a million years, so why now?”
As he said this, the leading Jiulin Cultivator furrowed his brows and then addressed the Cangyun Cultivator,
“What do you think, Fellow Daoist Li?”
The leading Cultivator from the Cangyun Realm looked towards the place where Lin Jing had undergone his Tribulation and then said,
“My thoughts are the same as yours, Fellow Daoist Jiang.
“It does seem like someone has been undergoing the Tribulation of Becoming Immortal here.”
“However…”
“Currently, this Land of Immortal Remnants is under the control of our two realms, and aside from those two individuals from the Xuanqing Realm, there’s no one else.”
“And those two from the Xuanqing Realm tried to force their way out when we arrived and were stopped by Fellow Daoist Qin; they couldn’t possibly be the ones undergoing Tribulation.”
“And this Tribulation Lightning couldn’t have appeared out of nowhere.”
“Therefore, I suspect that within this Land of Immortal Remnants, there may be other people we are unaware of.”
“Fellow Daoist Jiang, what do you think?”
The Jiulin Cultivator surnamed Jiang, upon hearing these words, nodded slightly,
“Your guess indeed does have some reason.”
“The Tribulation Lightning could not have appeared out of nowhere; either there are other people inside this Land of Immortal Remnants,
“Or there is an entrance we do not know of; after all, since its appearance until now, we have not completely explored the full extent of the Land of Immortal Remnants.”
“If there are other ways in and out, then we probably aren’t fully aware of them.”
Upon hearing this, the Cultivator surnamed Li from the Cangyun Realm nodded gently,
“Indeed…”
After finishing his words, he looked once more towards the place where Lin Jing had undergone his Tribulation, and then directly walked in.
After entering, the Li surnamed Cultivator rapidly formed hand seals and then gathered purple light, swiping it in front of him.
Then, his eyes glowed with a purple light as he carefully examined the site of Lin Jing’s Tribulation.
Seeing this action from the Li surnamed Cultivator, a sigh of helplessness rose from the bottom of Lin Jing’s heart.
Pupil Skill, it was always Pupil Skill…
These people from the Cangyun Realm seemed to have a fondness for cultivating Pupil Skills.
Elder Qu from the Liuyue Dao Sect was one, and now this Li surnamed Cultivator was another.
Moreover, the Pupil Skills of both individuals, whether in their method of use or the light they emitted, were different.
It was clear that these were two different Pupil Skills.
It seems that in future encounters with Cultivators from the Cangyun Realm, one must be more careful.
After using the Pupil Skill to inspect the area, the Li surnamed Cultivator retracted it.
After retracting the skill, he didn’t speak but instead kept his head down, lost in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 929
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 929: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan_4 Chapter 929: Chapter 416: Successful Tribulation, Acquired Immortal Yuan_4 The cultivators from Jiulin Realm, along with others, quietly watched him without disturbing him.
After a moment, the cultivator with the last name Li raised his head, and at that moment, the cultivator with the last name Jiang hurriedly spoke:
“Li, my friend, what did you see just now?”
It was only after Jiang had finished speaking that Li slowly began to talk:
“Incredible…”
“Truly incredible…”
“Such terrifying Tribulation Lightning, and yet he successfully transcended it.”
“Who?”
“Who is he?”
Jiang hurriedly asked.
Li shook his head, saying:
“I don’t know.
The Heavenly Tribulation was too terrifying; it threw this entire space into chaos.
ƝονǤᴑ.сᴑ
I couldn’t make out much.”
“However, I could sense the aura of Immortal Yuan and some residual spatial fluctuations from the teleportation.”
“It’s clear that those three streams of Immortal Yuan were specifically heading here, and the spatial fluctuations indicate that the person has already left after transcending the tribulation.”Upon hearing this, Jiang could not help but click his tongue:
“There really are such terrifying people in the world, to transit such frightening Tribulation Lightning safely.”
“Could it be that he has truly become an immortal?”
As soon as the words about becoming immortal were mentioned, everyone started discussing the person who had transcended the tribulation here.
Upon hearing this, Li slightly furrowed his brow, then spoke:
“It’s unlikely…”
“Apart from the aura of those three streams of Immortal Yuan, I didn’t detect any other presence.”
“It’s just a pity that this space has been disrupted by the dreadful Heavenly Tribulation, and I cannot use the Trace Origin technique.
...
Otherwise, even at the expense of my lifespan, I would activate Trace Origin to reconstruct everything that happened here.”
“Alas…!”
“What a pity…!”
After saying this, Li paused for a bit, then spoke again to the crowd:
“Next, we must continue our search for those two elders from the Xuanqing Realm; we must obtain the Immortal Yuan on them.”
“As for this place…”
“We don’t know which realm this person is from, but since he doesn’t wish to appear, let’s not concern ourselves with him for now.”
“If you encounter any cultivators with unknown cultivation bases in the Land of Immortal Remnants, you must all be careful not to offend them and notify us immediately.”
“Given the strength this person has shown, none of us here is likely his match, probably only that terrifying Empress of the Demon Clan could contend with him.”
“Remember, if you encounter any strange cultivators, you must treat them with respect and must not take them lightly.”
After Li had finished speaking, the cultivators from Cangyun Realm replied in unison:
“Understood…”
“Rest assured, friend Li.”
And Jiang, turning to the cultivators from Jiulin Realm behind him, said:
“You must also bear in mind what friend Li just said.”
“Don’t worry, we understand the importance.”
The cultivators from Jiulin Realm responded.
…
Afterwards, the cultivators from the two realms did not linger and soon left the area to continue searching for traces of Elder Bai and the ancestors of the Changyun Clan.
Lin Jing, using Observation Mode, watched them leave and did not immediately exit the System Space but decided to wait a few more days before coming out.
After all, they had just left, and if he came out right away, who knew if they might suddenly return?
After ending Observation Mode, Lin Jing continued to stay inside the System Space.
In this way, Lin Jing stayed in the System Space for about a hundred days, which equated to ten days in the outside world.
During this time, he continuously observed the changes in the Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
After such a long time had passed, the changes in the Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus began to slow down.
And the reactions they caused also started to diminish, clearly indicating that these two World Seeds were about to be completely repaired.
Finally…
On this day, Lin Jing received the long-awaited system notifications:
“Ding!”
“System Notification: Samsara Holy Fruit is fully repaired and has returned to normal; the Nine Heavens Samsara Lands have been integrated into the System Space.”
“Ding!”
“System Notification: Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus is fully repaired and has returned to normal; the Transcendent Lotus Pond has been integrated into the System Space.”

chapters.title: Chapter 930
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 930: Chapter 417: Illusion Realm Chapter 930: Chapter 417: Illusion Realm As the System’s prompt sound ceased, Lin Jing hastily made his way toward the edge of System Space, where the three special realms were located.
Arriving at the edge of System Space, Lin Jing discovered…
those three special realmsâ€”two of them were connected to System Space, and the originally transparent barriers had vanished.
The Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus were now directly exposed before his eyes.
The Samsara Holy Fruit, once within reach, no longer possessed that vitality-devouring power.
From it, Lin Jing could only sense a very unique Power of Reincarnation.
And as for the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, it had at that time turned into a lush green color, with specks of gold among the green.
...
Even the root of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, which was originally radiating nine-colored lights within the Transcendent Lotus Pond, was now visible as nine-colored, through and through.
After inspecting the two World Seeds, Lin Jing stepped into the Nine Heavens Reincarnation realm.
However, as soon as Lin Jing entered the Nine Heavens Reincarnation realm, the scene before his eyes changed drastically, and he was drawn into an Illusion Realm.
Just appearing in the Illusion Realm, Lin Jing was somewhat perplexed, not understanding the current situation and immediately became cautious.
Until the ground beneath Lin Jing’s feet suddenly cracked open, while he himself felt nothing, he then realized that he was in the midst of an Illusion Realm.
What followed…
Lin Jing turned his head to look around, only to discover that he was at the top of a mountain.
The sky was a burning red, as if engulfed in flames, while the ground was shaking violently and gigantic fissures appeared from time to time.
The scene was like the end of days.
And in front of Lin Jing stood a strikingly handsome and noble man, and a beautiful woman with a stunning presence.
Although Lin Jing had never seen these two before, they seemed incredibly familiar to him.
So, he approached a little closer to carefully observe the pair.
He was only a dozen steps away from the two.
But being in the Illusion Realm, they were oblivious to Lin Jing’s presence.
Upon closer observation, Lin Jing was shocked to find that both individuals bore some resemblance to Huang Qingling.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but be surprised.
Could these two have some relation to Huang Qingling?
Behind the two, there was a space that looked strikingly similar to the formation of the Nine Heavens Reincarnation realm.
Even within that space, Lin Jing could see the Samsara Holy Fruit.
Seeing this, Lin Jing seemed to understand that it was the Samsara Holy Fruit that had pulled him into this Illusion Realm.
“Huang, is there really no way out now?”
The beautiful woman’s eyes were full of despair as she looked towards the majestic man.
The majestic man, on the other hand, gazed up at the sky that was as red as a blaze, silent for a moment before speaking:
“Now that the pillar of heaven has been shattered, the Immortal Dao Realm will soon collapse; I also have no solution.”
“Their conflict will hasten the downfall of Immortal Dao Realm.
This entire Immortal Dao Realm will completely collapse as a result, and our Divine Phoenix Clan will naturally be unable to escape this fate.”
Upon hearing this, the beautiful woman’s eyes filled with even greater sorrow, continuing to speak:
“What about Qing Ling?”
“Qing Ling has just been born; must she be buried here with us?”
At this point, a look of pleading emerged in the woman’s eyes:
“Is there really no way to send Qing Ling out of Immortal Dao Realm?”
“After all, she is still so young; must she be entombed with us?”
The man turned back to look at the beautiful woman, a softness in his eyes, before saying:
“Qing Ling is our child.
I will naturally find a way to send her out of Immortal Dao Realm; you don’t have to worry about that.”
“Later, I will seal Qing Ling, and send her, together with the relic of our Divine Phoenix Clanâ€”the Samsara Holy Fruit, and the small world of Qinghuang Palace we prepared for her, to the Lower Realm.”
Hearing this, the beautiful woman looked at the noble man, and tears uncontrollably welled up in her eyes:
“As long as Qing Ling can survive, that’s all that matters…”
The majestic man nodded, speaking gently:
“This sealing, I will seal her for a long time, at least a million years.
I just hope that when she awakens, everything will be over and the Immortal Dao Realm restored to normal.”
“I guess that by the time she wakes up, we won’t be here anymore.
Do you have any last words for her?”
The beautiful woman looked at the majestic man and then shook her head:
“No…”
“I hope Qing Ling can grow up normally.
I don’t want her to bear the pain of her parents’ deaths, nor do I want her to seek revenge on those two people.”
“Those two, they are unique characters in this Immortal Dao Realm.
ƝονǤο.с0
No matter how Qing Ling cultivates, she is unlikely to match them.”
“If possible, I hope to erase some of Qing Ling’s memories, to make her forget about us, to forget about this affair.”
The noble man looked at the beautiful woman, then wrapped his arms around her, saying softly:
“Okay…”
“If you wish it so, then we’ll do it that way!”
What came next…
Lin Jing watched as the two separated and the noble man returned, this time with a sleeping little girl in his arms.
Although the little girl looked to be only seven or eight years old, her features still revealed that she was Huang Qingling as a child.
And afterward…
A stone bead emerged in front of the man.
Then with a wave of his hand, a portal appeared atop the stone bead.
Through the entrance of the portal, a small world could be seen.
After that, the man beckoned with his hand, taking out the Samsara Holy Fruit from the space that resembled the Nine Heavens Reincarnation realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 931
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 931: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_2 Chapter 931: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_2 Following that, the man holding the Samsara Holy Fruit, embraced Huang Qingling and entered this small world.
Apart from the lush forest, inside the small world was an extremely high mountain peak, on which a palace complex was built.
This architectural complex was very familiar to Lin Jingâ€”it was none other than Qinghuang Palace.
The small world that the man had opened must undoubtedly be the Demon Race Secret Realm.
After placing Huang Qingling in the grand hall of Qinghuang Palace, the man waved his hand, enveloping the entire Qinghuang Peak within a barrier.
However, when the man emerged from the small world, the entire heavens and earth began to tremble violently.
At that moment, the man condensed his mana and tore open a crack in space.
...
Then he concentrated the power in his body, wrapping the jade bead, and sent it out through the spatial rift.
After the man dispatched the jade bead, the illusion realm, along with the Samsara Holy Fruit, also left the space.
As they left, Lin Jing glimpsed, through the rift, a massive collapse of the space where the man was.
The man used all his strength to conjure a giant light screen, attempting to envelop all before him and prevent the catastrophe from happening.
Yet, such a disaster was not something he could prevent; in just a moment, he was gravely injured and fell from the sky, while the beautiful woman, at that moment, flew towards the man, catching him in her armsâ€¦
Thereafter, the illusion realm where Lin Jing was situated, carried far away by the Samsara Holy Fruit, could see no more.
In the illusion realm, Lin Jing watched as the jade bead had just passed through the spatial rift and not yet completely left the Immortal Dao Realm, when a force from the Immortal Dao Realm, illuminated by nine-colored light, swept over it.
The force collided with the jade bead, dissipating the power that the gallant man had accumulated at the surface of the bead to protect it.
The jade bead, now full of cracks, luckily withstood that attack.
Thus, the bead, riddled with cracks, traveled through the void, and before long, it approached a spatial boundary of the Cultivation World.
But just then, a sudden spatial rift appeared, and the flying jade bead struck it precisely.
The already crack-riddled bead completely shattered at that moment, and the Samsara Holy Fruit that had been inside fell out.
The tumbling Samsara Holy Fruit, by a twist of fate, collided with the boundary wall, shattering it instantly and falling into the Cultivation World.
Following closely behind, the bead also entered the Cultivation World through the hole created by the Samsara Holy Fruit.
From the moment the Samsara Holy Fruit shattered the boundary wall, it became damaged, and the ensuing events were the origin of a catastrophe.
The Samsara Holy Fruit landed precisely within the Primordial Immortal City in the heart of the Nanming Domain.
In an instant, the Nanming Domain was struck by the Samsara Holy Fruit’s landing impact, and in a flash, ninety percent of the population perished…
And those few who were fortunate to survive with heavy injuries were swiftly consumed by the Samsara Holy Fruit’s terrifying vitality-devouring power, not lasting long before they succumbed…
Originally…
This was indeed the true cause of that disaster a million years ago.
Ɲ0νǤօ.ᴄο
At this point, the illusion ended, and Lin Jing too came back to his senses; however, his heart was incredibly heavy.
From Huang Qingling’s parents’ conversation just now, Lin Jing learned that the main cause of all this was merely a struggle between two people from the Immortal Dao Realm.
It seemed neither of the two were ordinary; their battle caused the Divine Phoenix Clan’s dwelling to collapse.
And as a result, Huang Qingling was sent to the Lower Realm, falling into this Xuanqing Realm, and the Samsara Holy Fruit, after shattering the boundary wall, became damaged, its power of reincarnation becoming chaotic, creating an extremely terrifying upgrade in devouring power, leading to the deaths of more than ninety percent of the people in the Nanming Domain.
The entire Nanming Domain thus became wasteland, turning into the Barren Forbidden Zone.
With such terrifying power from just their fight, the two must have also played a role in the impossibility of ascension in the Immortal Realm around the same time.
The reason why ascension was no longer possible in the Immortal Realm must have something to do with them.
And who exactly were these two people?
So terrifying that they could cause the Immortal Dao Realm itself to collapse.
…
After some time passed following the end of the illusion, Lin Jing slowly recovered his senses.
Having regrouped, Lin Jing approached the Samsara Holy Fruit and subsequently called out the system panel to examine it:
Immortal Dao Realm World Seed: Samsara Holy Fruit
Growth Environment: Nine Heavens Reincarnation Lands
Lifespan: ???
(The World Seed shares its life with the Immortal Dao Realm; if the Immortal Dao Realm survives, the World Seed thrives, if the Immortal Dao Realm perishes, the World Seed withers.)
The Samsara Holy Fruit possesses the power of reincarnation, stabilizing the reincarnation cycle of a realm, making it an indispensable World Seed for the Immortal Dao Realm.
(Note: After reaching the Emperor Venerate Realm, one can use the Samsara Holy Fruit to comprehend the Power of Reincarnation and achieve the Unique Sovereign Realm, as the Power of Reincarnation is one of the essential forces for advancing to the Unique Sovereign level.)
Seeing the introduction of the Samsara Holy Fruit on the system panel, Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel a little startled.
Emperor Venerate Realm and Unique Sovereign Realm…
Could this Emperor Venerate Realm be that of the legendary Immortal Emperor?
The name of the Immortal Emperor, Lin Jing had only seen in an ancient tome within the Elixir Alliance’s Scripture Pavilion, which contained records of the Ancient Era.
Whether this realm really existed was unclear from the records, as it was quite vague; was it truly a realm or merely a title?
The accounts in that ancient tome were very unclear, and Lin Jing was not very sure.

chapters.title: Chapter 932
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 932: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_3 Chapter 932: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_3 As for the Unique Sovereign realm, Lin Jing had never even heard of it.
However…
Just from the name “Unique Sovereign,” one could tell that it was anything but simple.
What kind of incredible being could claim to be a Unique Sovereign within the Immortal Dao Realm?
Perhaps even the Five Elements Ancestor, who was gifted with exceptional talent and had created the formidable Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, wouldn’t be able to achieve this.
It was unknown, however, what realm the two individuals who caused the collapse of the Immortal Dao Realm belonged to.
Could it be the Unique Sovereign realm?
...
…
…
ƝονǤօ.сᴑ
However…
These realms were too far out of Lin Jing’s reach, and thinking about them was pointless for him at the moment.
After inspecting the Samsara Holy Fruit, Lin Jing then departed from the Nine Heavens Samsara locale and approached the Transcendent Lotus Pond.
No sooner had he stepped into the Transcendent Lotus Pond than Lin Jing was once again pulled into an Illusion Realm.
With the experience from last time, Lin Jing didn’t panic this time, but quickly turned around to survey his surroundings.
He found himself atop a mountain peak shrouded in clouds and mist.
There, on the mountain peak, stood a majestic and imposing Immortal Palace, and hanging above the grand hall of this palace were the three powerful characters “Primordial Immortal Palace.”
Inside the courtyard of the Primordial Immortal Palace, Lin Jing spotted a pond filled with lotuses and among them, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus.
Although the Primordial Immortal Palace was located on an exceedingly high peak, Lin Jing still felt as if the entire mountain was shaking violently.
Moreover, the sky here appeared as it did in the Illusion Realm he had just witnessed, painted a fiery red.
At that moment, above the Primordial Immortal Palace, a man dressed in white stood in the void, his eyes looking forward, corners of his mouth lifted in a mysterious smile.
Right then, a figure flew swiftly towards him, and upon arrival, shouted out:
“Primordial Immortal Emperor, do you intend to destroy the Immortal Dao Realm?”
This person was clearly furious, and his roar dispersed the clouds and mists with its imposing force.
As the clouds dissipated, Lin Jing could see the newcomer clearly, and to his surprise, he was quite familiar with this figure.
It was the Five Elements Ancestor.
Although Lin Jing had never met the real Five Elements Ancestor, he had seen a statue of him as well as a divine will left behind by him at the Five Elements legacy site.
Therefore, upon seeing the Five Elements Ancestor again in this Illusion Realm, Lin Jing felt a peculiar sense of kinship.
Upon arrival, the Five Elements Ancestor, looking furious, turned towards the man in white.
Light of various colors rapidly coursed through his hands, indicating he might attack at any moment.
Faced with the angry Five Elements Ancestor, the man in white chuckled lightly, then spoke:
“Five Elements Ancestor…”
“No…”
“Now you should be called the Five Elements Emperor.”
“Indeed, you are truly the second person to ascend to the Emperor Venerate Realm, I indeed did not misjudge you.”
Confronted with such a demeanor from the man in white, the anger in the eyes of the Five Elements Ancestor intensified, and he retorted angrily:
“Xian Wuming, as the first cultivator from the Cultivation World to ascend to the Immortal Dao Realm, and gaining the reverence of many from both the Immortal Dao Realm and the Lower Cultivation World, you used this Power of Faith to obtain the great fortune of the Immortal Dao Realm, successfully breaking through to the Emperor Venerate Realm.”
“Your achievements can be attributed to the collective Power of Faith from all beings within the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“But now, you wish to destroy the Immortal Dao Realm, what exactly are your intentions?”
“Do you consider this fair to those who have placed their faith in you?”
Lin Jing watched the two of them, listening to the words of the Five Elements Ancestor, and he finally understood.
It turned out that the man in white was the Primordial Immortal Emperor.
Moreover, he was the first person from the Cultivation World to have ascended to the Immortal Dao Realm, the very individual depicted in the statue at the center of Primordial Immortal City.
“Why…?”
The Primordial Immortal Emperor looked at the Five Elements Ancestor before him, then chuckled lightly and said:
“I am the Primordial Immortal, who led the Human Race onto the Immortal Road, earning their faith, and rightfully so.”
“But what of it?”
At this point, the Primordial Immortal Emperor’s smile faded and his eyes shifted, betraying no emotion.
Thus, the Primordial Immortal Emperor continued speaking to the Five Elements Ancestor:
“Even with such achievements, enabling the entire Immortal Dao Realm to flourish more than ever, I still cannot gain the recognition of the Immortal Dao Will, which refuses to acknowledge me as its master.”
“Without the recognition of the Immortal Dao Will, I will never be able to advance to the Unique Sovereign realm.”
“What use is the Emperor Venerate Realm?”
“Without reaching the Unique Sovereign realm, I will forever remain a fish in the net, a turtle in a jar, never escaping the control of this universe, ultimately just a slightly stronger ant beneath the heaven’s eyes.”
“Only by reaching that Unique Sovereign realm can I truly coexist with heaven and earth, break free from all these bindings, and become the master of the entire Immortal Dao Realm.”
Having said this, the Primordial Immortal Emperor, with a look of disdain for all beings, turned to the Five Elements Ancestor:
“Since the Immortal Dao Will refuses to recognize me as its master, then I shall shatter the heavenly pillar, destroy it, exposing the Immortal Dao Heart within, and force out the will of the Immortal Dao, to refine the Immortal Dao Heart myself.”
“Once I have refined the Immortal Dao Heart, the entire Immortal Dao Realm will still be mine, and through that, I shall achieve the Unique Sovereign realm.”
Upon hearing this, the Five Elements Ancestor looked at the Primordial Immortal Emperor, his expression turning icy, and he questioned:
“You destroy the heavenly pillar, force out the Immortal Dao Will, and forcefully refine the Immortal Dao Heart, causing the entire Immortal Dao Realm to collapseâ€”you should be clearer on this than anyone.”
In response to the interrogation of the Five Elements Ancestor, the Primordial Immortal Emperor just looked at him and smilingly said:

chapters.title: Chapter 933
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 933: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_4 Chapter 933: Chapter 417 Illusion Realm_4 “This is naturally clear.”
“Actually, I’m here because I want to have a battle with you.”
Upon hearing these words, the Five Elements Ancestor looked up at the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, furrowing his brows:
“You wish to use this battle between us to hasten the collapse of the Immortal Dao Realm, thereby stripping away the will of the Dao, to facilitate the refinement of your Immortal Dao Heart.”
The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate chuckled and nodded:
“Actually, you have no choice.”
“I have already breached the Heavenly Pillar, and it is collapsing.
The Immortal Dao Realm won’t last long and will completely disintegrate.”
“This battle was chosen by me, you cannot avoid it, you can only accept it, and you cannot stop my plan.”
“Even if you don’t take action, the Immortal Dao Realm will collapse all the same, and perhaps your intervention might even delay my plan.”
Hearing these words, the Five Elements Ancestor’s eyebrows furrowed even deeper…
What the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate said was indeed true.
With the Five Elements Ancestor’s freshly advanced power at the Emperor Venerate level, he was unable to stop the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, but if he did not resist, that would not impact the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate’s plan either.
He could only fight, using battle as a means to thwart the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
Although this method might cause the Immortal Dao Realm to collapse more quickly, the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate’s plan was already in motion.
Besides him, no one else could stop it.
...
“So be it, let’s battle!”
After deciding, the Five Elements Ancestor no longer hesitated, immediately launching an attack, with a Five-Colored Aurora blanketing the skies, assaulting the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, with a wave of his hand, released a burst of nine-colored light instantly, colliding with the Five Elements Ancestor’s Five-Colored Aurora.
At the same time, the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate did not forget to gather up the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus from the pond below.
Thus, the Illusion Realm, following the movement of the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, shifted with the battle between the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate and the Five Elements Ancestor.
Once the two began fighting, true cataclysm ensued: countless mountains collapsed, the earth cracked open, and rivers shifted position.
Lin Jing saw that those immortals who had gone through untold hardships to become divine, in this battle were simply struck by the aftershocks and instantly turned to ashes.
Even those grand and magnificent Immortal Cities and Palaces were affected by the residual force of the two’s battle, reduced to ruins.
Not a single immortal was able to escape.
Indeed…
What the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate said was not unreasonable; even the immortals of the Immortal Dao Realm, under such a battle, became no better than ants.
If there were truly a battle at the Unique Sovereign level, even those at the Emperor Venerate Realm would be the same.
And if there were an even higher realm…
…
This way, Lin Jing watched as the two fought from one end of the Immortal Dao Realm to the other, even causing the immensely vast continent to fracture and split.
Until at last, it seemed the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate completely unleashed, using Immortal Techniques, each more formidable than the last.
The resulting damage grew increasingly severe.
The Five Elements Ancestor, though unwilling, did not dare hold back in the face of the formidable Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
Lin Jing watched as they even fought their way to the habitat of the Divine Phoenix Clan.
Here, Huang Qingling’s father, the emperor of the Divine Phoenix Clan, tried to resist but was struck by an Immortal Technique from the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate and sent flying.
The beautiful woman, upon seeing this, rushed to his side and caught him in her arms.
It was then that the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate glanced over, spotted the nearly closed spatial rift, and the Stone Bead Microcosm that was about to drift away.
And then,
He didn’t engage in idle talk, but directly waved his hand, and a nine-colored light immediately probed out along the space fissure, seemingly trying to snatch back the stone bead.
Ɲ0νǥօ.сο
Upon seeing the Primordial Immortal Emperor take action against the stone bead, Huang Qingling’s father’s eyes burst with rage, wanting to rise and stop him.
However, he was already injured, and the sudden move from the Primordial Immortal Emperor left him with no chance to defend himself.
But thankfully,
the Five Elements Ancestor saw what was happening and directly intervened with the Five-Colored Aurora, blocking most of the nine-colored light, only allowing a small strand to rush into the space fissure, while the remaining out-of-control nine-colored light struck the small world of the stone bead.
Fortunately, the small world of the stone bead had previously been fortified with multiple layers of defense by Huang Qingling’s father, which just managed to withstand that residual attack.
Seeing his attack blocked, he first cast a cold glance at the Five Elements Ancestor, then turned his gaze to Huang Qingling’s parents below and snorted disdainfully,
“Hmph!”
“The Divine Phoenix Clan, you are truly exemplary, actually sending one of the three great World Seeds, the Samsara Holy Fruit, out of the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“The Samsara Holy Fruit is essential for my ascension to the Unique Sovereign Realm.”
“Now that you have sent it away, I will have more trouble finding it in the future, which is infuriating.”
“So be it then…”
“Let’s extinguish the Divine Phoenix Clan first, to quell my anger.”
Hearing this, the Five Elements Ancestor snorted coldly and said,
“Hmph!”
“You were planning to destroy the Immortal Dao Realm and refine the Immortal Dao Heart to advance to the Unique Sovereign Realm.
You never intended to spare anyone in the first place, so why bother finding so many excuses?”
Upon hearing this, Huang Qingling’s father immediately understood the whole story.
Then, Huang Qingling’s father respectfully bowed to the Five Elements Ancestor and said,
“Thank you, Elder Five Elements, for saving my daughter…”
“I had some misunderstandings about the elder before, not knowing there was such a hidden truth.”
After speaking, Huang Qingling’s father turned his head to the Primordial Immortal Emperor, his face filled with righteous indignation,
“How can such a person be called the Primordial Immortal, how can he gain the faith of all beings and achieve the Emperor Venerate Realm.”
“It’s truly the biggest joke…”
Having said that, Huang Qingling’s father declared,
“From this day forth…”
“You, Xian Wuming, are the eternal enemy of the Divine Phoenix Clan.”
His voice resonated like a proclamation from the heavens and earth, spreading out for countless miles.
Then, Huang Qingling’s father transformed into his true form, becoming a tremendous Divine Phoenix, and with a piercing screech, he charged toward the Primordial Immortal Emperor.
The Five Elements Ancestor wanted to stop him, but upon seeing the resolute look in the eyes of Huang Qingling’s father, who had transformed into the Divine Phoenix, he did not intervene.
His eyes determined, he knew he was no match for the Primordial Immortal Emperor, yet he had already prepared to meet his death.
After Huang Qingling’s father charged out, Huang Qingling’s mother followed suit, transforming into a Divine Phoenix and rushing at the Primordial Immortal Emperor.
However…
How could the two of them be opponents of the Primordial Immortal Emperor?
With just one move from him, the two of them were thoroughly annihilated.
After them, other members of the Divine Phoenix Clan, in human form or transformed into giant Divine Phoenixes, also threw themselves at the Primordial Immortal Emperor like moths to a flame, heedless of life and death.
The Five Elements Ancestor, at this critical moment, engaged in battle with the Primordial Immortal Emperor once more, the great battle reigniting…

chapters.title: Chapter 934
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 934: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders Chapter 934: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders “When the nest is overturned, no egg remains intact.”
The entire region inhabited by the Divine Phoenix Clan, due to the battle between the Five Elements Ancestor and the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, was utterly destroyed.
Even before this catastrophe, the whole clan had launched a suicide assault, charging towards the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
Some of the Divine Phoenixes, too timid to fight, attempted to flee but couldn’t escape far before dying in the residual effects of the two Emperor Venerates’ combat.
It could be said that after this battle, the entire Divine Phoenix Clan in the Immortal Dao Realm had ceased to exist.
The only survivor was Huang Qingling, who had been sent away early on.
Following the battle, the fight between the two grew even more intense, and it spread to other regions within the Immortal Dao Realm, nearly causing the entire realm to collapse.
In the end…
...
The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, wishing to completely eliminate the Five Elements Ancestor, opened up his own minor world, intending to lure in and annihilate the Five Elements Ancestor.
However…
This gave the Five Elements Ancestor an opportunity, who directly shattered the minor world.
The Immortal Golden Lotus, which had been taken into the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate’s minor world, along with Immortal Crossing Island, were both snatched by the Five Elements Ancestor.
After seizing the Immortal Crossing Island, the Five Elements Ancestor didn’t keep it but, like Huang Qingling’s father, sent the Immortal Golden Lotus along with the Immortal Crossing Island from the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate’s minor world out of the Immortal Dao Realm.
Only after sending the Immortal Crossing Island out of the Immortal Dao Realm did the Five Elements Ancestor resume the battle with the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
From this, it seemed that the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate also needed the power of the Immortal Golden Lotus to ascend to the Unique Sovereign Realm,
Because after the Five Elements Ancestor sent the Immortal Golden Lotus out of the Immortal Dao Realm, the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate became increasingly frenzied, attacking the Five Elements Ancestor with even more ferocity.
However…
The Illusion Realm that Lin Jing could witness was tied to the Immortal Golden Lotus.
As it was sent out of the Immortal Dao Realm, Lin Jing could no longer see what was happening within the Immortal Dao Realm.
Nor did he know how their battle continued.
…
…
When the small island, along with the Immortal Golden Lotus, was sent into the Xuanqing Realm, the Illusion Realm that Lin Jing experienced also vanished.
After the Illusion Realm disappeared, Lin Jing remained in place, unable to regain his composure for a long time.
These two Illusion Realms had informed Lin Jing of many things, the cause of the catastrophe in the Nanming Domain, as well as the upheaval within the Immortal Dao Realm.
ɴονǤο.ᴄο
He just didn’t know, what was the final outcome of the battle between the Five Elements Ancestor and the Primordial Immortal Emperor?
Subsequently, Lin Jing remembered that when he saw the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor within the Five Elements Ruins, the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor had once said…
Tens of thousands of years ago, his power began to wane, until a hundred thousand years ago, the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor still had the strength to open the seal, but when Lin Jing entered that heritage site, the consciousness of the Five Elements Ancestor no longer had the extra power to do so.
The consciousness left by the Five Elements Ancestor was closely connected to its real body; the stronger the real body, the stronger the consciousness.
It was, therefore, highly possible that the Five Elements Ancestor hadn’t perished, but his power was continuously declining.
It was very likely that a hundred thousand years ago, the Five Elements Ancestor suffered a severe injury, or even total suppression.
Which would explain why the power of the consciousness he left in the Five Elements Ruins significantly weakened, to the point where it couldn’t even open its own seal.
From this, one could also infer…
The battle between the Five Elements Ancestor and the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, two beings of the Emperor Venerate Realm, had persisted for nearly a million years, demonstrating just how terrifying the Emperor Venerate Realm was.
Who knew what state the current Immortal Dao Realm was in?
Had the battle between the Five Elements Ancestor and the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate ended?
Or was it still continuing?
Without access to the Immortal Dao Realm, Lin Jing naturally didn’t have the answers.
…
After the Illusion Realm ended and Lin Jing regained his senses, he summoned the System and inspected the Immortal Golden Lotus from the system panel:
Immortal Dao Realm World Seed: Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus
Growing Environment: Transcendent Lotus Pond
Growth Duration: ???
(The lifespan of the World Seed and the Immortal Dao Realm are intertwined; the realm exists, the seed thrives; the realm perishes, the seed withers.)
The Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, one of the three great World Seeds of the Immortal Dao Realm, possesses the Power of Transcendence, allowing a Void Immortal to become a True Immortal, essential to the Immortal Dao Realm.
(Note: After attaining the Emperor Venerate Realm, one may draw upon the Power of Transcendence from the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus to reach the Unique Sovereign Realm; this power is indispensable for ascension to the Unique Sovereign state.)
Indeed, this Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus was an indispensable element for ascending to the Unique Sovereign Realm.
Beside this Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, Lin Jing could indeed sense a type of immortal power somewhat similar to Immortal Yuan, but he could only feel it and not absorb it for his own use.
The Samsara Holy Fruit and the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus had been restored, but now that the World Seeds were repaired, Lin Jing could only admire them, unable to use them.
Previously, before their restoration, Lin Jing could use the Samsara Holy Fruit’s wild Power of Reincarnation to deal with his enemies.
But now that the Samsara Holy Fruit was repaired and the Power of Reincarnation had calmed, concealing itself within the fruit, it became impossible to employ against adversaries.
Otherwise, with so many Mahayana Cultivators in the Land of Immortal Remnants, if he could gather them together, just by bringing out the Samsara Holy Fruit, the terrifying force of Vitality Devouring could probably wipe them out in one fell swoop.
Now, Lin Jing could only ponder it…
…
After observing the two restored World Seeds, Lin Jing then turned his gaze towards the third special place, the Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm.
Lin Jing had yet to obtain the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, and at this time, the Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm was still separated from the System Space by a transparent barrier.

chapters.title: Chapter 935
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 935: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_2 Chapter 935: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_2 The last time he saw those three images, the Divine Tree of Dao Principle was located in an utterly dark void.
There were no points of reference, and its exact location was unknown.
Now having obtained two of the three great World Seeds, the only one left was the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Once he had it, he could consider evolving the System Space.
Having failed to obtain key information about the location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle last time, Lin Jing prepared to investigate further.
After making up his mind, Lin Jing spoke up, summoning the System:
“System!”
“Locate the current position of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.”
As Lin Jing’s words fell, the System’s prompt tone began to sound:
“Ding!”
“System promptâ€”preliminary location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle detected; host, please check.”
Following the System’s prompt, a fragmented image appeared before Lin Jing.
This was a void where countless broken walls and debris floated aimlessly.
...
ɴօνǤ0.сο
The weakly glowing dead wood roots that Lin Jing had seen before also floated among these ruins.
As the image unfolded, the whole scene began to change, expanding the depicted area.
From the image, Lin Jing saw more and more things.
Gradually, the entire section of broken walls and debris was revealed, and Lin Jing was able to perceive that this appeared to be a Sect.
However, this Sect, along with the blessed land it was located on, was completely destroyed.
Numerous boulders and fragments of buildings were chaotically floating in the area.
As the image continued to widen, Lin Jing also spotted a half-broken plaque.
The plaque was fractured, with the back half missing, leaving only the front portion and a somewhat blurred large character.
Lin Jing looked closely; despite the wear, he could still faintly make out an “Immortal.”
Then…
The perspective in the image continued to pull back, and Lin Jing nearly saw the entirety of the area.
In addition to the broken structures and mountains, Lin Jing even saw several bodies of cultivators also floating around…
This isn’t right…
Just as a body floated past the foreground of the image, Lin Jing suddenly realized something was wrong.
It seemed not to be a cultivator’s body.
It seemed to be…
An Immortal.
â€¦
â€¦
The image abruptly ended here.
After viewing it, Lin Jing was thrown into deep thought.
The Sect and the shattered mountains didn’t reveal much, but the bodies Lin Jing saw at the end explained everything.
The location shown in the image, if nothing else, was likely within the Immortal Dao Realm.
Immortal Dao Realm…
If it really was the Immortal Dao Realm, then obtaining the Divine Tree of Dao Principle might indeed be difficult.
The Immortal Dao Realm was closed off and inaccessible.
If it was sealed due to the battle between the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate and the Five Elements Ancestor, then it seems that their battle might still be unresolved.
But if the closure was due to the collapse of the Immortal Dao Realm, then it was impossible to predict whether their battle had ended.
Nor could one determine whether there were still dangers inside.
From the image just now, Lin Jing saw no rampant immortal power, it was incredibly calm, so it was difficult to predict whether there were still dangers inside the Immortal Dao Realm.
Moreover, Elder Bai and the ancestors of the Changyun Clan wished to forcibly break through the spatial barriers of the Immortal Dao Realm to enter.
Now that he had discovered the location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle was within the Immortal Dao Realm, he could also take a more in-depth look at the situation inside to prevent any potential dangers.
…
After the image disappeared, Lin Jing prepared to leave the System Space.
Next, Lin Jing planned to assess the external situation and then search for Elder Bai and the two ancestors from the Changyun Clan.
“System!”
“Enter Observation Mode.”
Afterward, Lin Jing entered Observation Mode and began to survey the surroundings.
As Lin Jing conducted his survey, he found no trace of anyone else nearby.
With his advancement to the Mahayana Realm, his Divine Sense had expanded considerably.
Of course, the range that Observation Mode could survey was also much larger.
After using Observation Mode to scrutinize the area and finding no trace of anyone, it was evident that a long time had passed, and those people had already dispersed to continue searching for Elder Bai and the ancestors of the Changyun Clan.
After observing, Lin Jing directly left the System Space and appeared within the Land of Immortal Remnants.
After coming out, Lin Jing oriented himself and then activated Observation Mode, exploring while flying forward.
The direction Lin Jing chose was not the previously detected location of Elder Bai and the ancestor from the Changyun Clan.
Instead, he headed in a different direction.
After entering that strange state previously, Lin Jing had detected a stream of Immortal Yuan attached to a meteorite not far from himself in the void.
Lin Jing planned to see if that Immortal Yuan was still there; if it was, he could collect it on the way.
This way, he would gain another strand of Immortal Yuan.
Therefore, the direction Lin Jing headed was exactly where that Immortal Yuan was located.
…
…
That stream of Immortal Yuan was not very far from Lin Jing’s position, and after his advancement to the Mahayana Realm, his speed had also increased a lot.
Soon, Observation Mode had already detected the meteorite’s location.
Lin Jing continued forward, and quickly, his Divine Sense also detected that piece of meteorite.

chapters.title: Chapter 936
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 936: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_3 Chapter 936: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_3 “`
Although Divine Sense had already detected the meteor, Lin Jing did not feel any presence of Immortal Yuan from it.
He wondered if the Immortal Yuan had already left.
Though Divine Sense failed to perceive the presence of Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing continued to advance, intending to inspect it in person to see if anything could be discovered.
However…
Just as Lin Jing was about to approach the Immortal Yuanâ€”about a thousand zhang away from itâ€”the streak of Immortal Yuan that had entered his body earlier began to stir.
The Immortal Yuan circulated within Lin Jing’s body before leaving and rushing forward.
Seeing this, Lin Jing hastily followed that streak of Immortal Yuan, charging ahead.
...
The Immortal Yuan that emerged from Lin Jing’s body, upon reaching the meteor, began to orbit around it.
And it was only when Lin Jing was approximately ten zhang from the Immortal Yuan that he detected the Immortal Yuan attached to the meteor.
He really had quite the luck; he didn’t expect the Immortal Yuan to still be here.
And, the hidden Immortal Yuan within his own body, surprisingly, proved useful by aiding him in the search for other Immortal Yuan.
The ability of Immortal Yuan to conceal itself was just too perverse; not even the Divine Sense of someone in the Mahayana Realm could detect it.
Only when one personally came within ten zhang of it could they detect the existence of the Immortal Yuan.
Fortunately, he had the aid of that Immortal Yuan.
He estimated that if it were just him, the Immortal Yuan by the meteor might have fled again before he could get close to it.
Afterward…
Lin Jing collected the Immortal Yuan, storing it in the System Space.
Upon securing the Immortal Yuan, the System’s notification sounded once more, awarding Lin Jing another ten thousand Harvest Points.
And after taking the Immortal Yuan, it seemed to recognize an owner, re-entering his body again.
Moreover, with the Immortal Yuan inside his body, Lin Jing could sense its presence but could not feel its energy at all.
Lin Jing was indeed puzzled about the situation with the Immortal Yuan.
He did not understand why those three streaks of Immortal Yuan helped him during his tribulation at such a critical moment.
These three streaks of Immortal Yuan seemed different from the rest, not only helping him with his Tribulation but also aiding in finding other Immortal Yuan.
However, the Immortal Yuan Lin Jing obtained just now, and the one that had just entered his body, were different.
The latter, after being obtained by Lin Jing, lay in his palm quiet like a dead object.
This odd situation made Lin Jing wonder if it might be related to the three World Seeds within the System Space, considering two of the three Immortal Yuan had directly entered the World Seeds to help repair them.
Only this one remained, since Lin Jing had not yet acquired the Divine Tree of Dao Principles, so it was temporarily residing in his body.
Of course, this was just Lin Jing’s speculation.
It was also possible that the Immortal Yuan behaved this way because of the System Space…
However…
None of this was important, as long as the Immortal Yuan was harmless to him.
…
After obtaining the Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing changed direction and flew towards where Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan were located.
Time passed quickly, and after a few days, Lin Jing finally saw the meteor he had encountered in that strange state through the Observation Mode.
Before approaching it, Lin Jing used the Observation Mode to scout around, and just then, he discovered the two of them leaving the meteor.
After they left the meteor, they headed directly towards Lin Jing’s location.
Soon…
Lin Jing saw the two of them.
Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan were initially cautious when they first saw Lin Jing.
But when they came before him and conducted a careful investigation, they relaxed.
Afterward, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan asked Lin Jing somewhat surprisedly,
“How did you suddenly appear here?”
Lin Jing replied,
“I encountered Ye Mingyi before, and you could say he brought me here.”
Having said that, Lin Jing recounted the encounter with Ye Mingyi to both the ancestor of the Changyun Clan and Elder Bai.
Of course…
There were many details he couldn’t reveal, so Lin Jing concealed some or substituted parts, as it related to the System Space, and naturally, some things couldn’t be divulged.
Having just finished speaking, Lin Jing added,
“During my Tribulation, I happened to enter a strange state, where I saw you two.”
“But, because the commotion of the Tribulation was too great, it attracted many others, so for my own protection, I could only use the Teleportation Talisman I found in Ye Mingyi’s Space Ring to temporarily get away until now.”
“So the Tribulation that caused such a commotion was yours…”
Both of them were left dumbfounded after hearing this.
The commotion created by Lin Jing’s Tribulation was comparable to the tribulation of ascending to immortality, and he actually survived such terrifying Tribulation Lightning, which greatly surprised them both.
However, after inquiring about Lin Jing’s Cultivation, they believed his story.
ƝᴑνǤᴑ.сο
Indeed, Lin Jing had just advanced to the early stage of the Mahayana Realm.
Lin Jing went on to say,
“Actually, if we’re talking about it, my success in the Tribulation was largely thanks to Ye Mingyi.
Without the treasures and Formation he left behind, I might really have failed this time.”
Hearing this, the Changyun Clan ancestor could not help but sigh,
“Perhaps this is destiny…”
“Your Lin Family nearly got annihilated because of Ye Ming, yet you managed to survive the most difficult Heavenly Tribulation on the path of cultivation because of him.”
“`

﻿Chapter 937: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_4 Chapter 937: Chapter 418 Location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Meeting with the Two Elders_4 Elder Bai spoke up at this moment:
“Enough…”
“Stop with the sentimentality.
There’s some danger here, and who knows when others might find us.
We better head back first.”
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded in agreement, and then the two of them took Lin Jing back to the previous meteorite.
After returning, Lin Jing asked both of them:
“When I approached this place just now, you knew right away.
Could it be that you have left some means of control here?”
Elder Bai then said:
“Indeed…”
“Hong and I obtained an Immortal Yuan here in the Land of Immortal Remnants, which was discovered by cultivators from both Cangyun and Jiulin realms.”
“They mobilized a lot of people to encircle us, intending to snatch the Immortal Yuan, so naturally, we needed to be very careful.”
“This meteorite, along with those seemingly inconspicuous small meteorite fragments around us, actually form a huge Formation.
Inside here, we can also monitor all movements outside.”
“All this is thanks to Hong’s methods.”
“If not for these measures, we would probably have been discovered by them a long time ago.”Hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help feeling puzzled and then asked them:
“Didn’t I give you an Immortal Yuan earlier?
Why did you still come to the Land of Immortal Remnants to find Immortal Yuan?”
“Could it be that in addition to Immortal Yuan, there’s something else in this land?”
As soon as Lin Jing finished speaking, the ancestor of the Changyun Clan spoke up:
“As a matter of fact…”
“The Immortal Yuan you gave us earlier, we used to offer to that Empress of the Demon Clan.”
Lin Jing was startled after hearing this.
...
“Why would you do that?”
The ancestor of the Changyun Clan continued to explain:
“We wanted to break through the barriers of the Immortal Realm and check the internal situation of the Immortal Realm, and we needed the help of the Empress of the Demon Clan.”
“When we sought her help, she made a request that we find her an Immortal Yuan, and then she would assist us.”
“It just so happened that during my last visit to the Land of Immortal Remnants, I discovered an Immortal Yuan and figured out its appearance pattern, giving us a fair chance to obtain it.”
“So, we directly gave her the Immortal Yuan you provided us, and then came here, to the Land of Immortal Remnants, to capture this Immortal Yuan.”
“However, some accidents occurred while capturing the Immortal Yuan, and we were discovered by others from the Cangyun and Jiulin realms.”
“Even though we successfully captured the Immortal Yuan, we were also encircled by people from the Cangyun and Jiulin realms in this Land of Immortal Remnants.”
“Originally…”
“When your Tribulation caused that great commotion, we planned to break out during the chaos.”
“But in previous encounters, they had marked us with some means, leaving imprints on us that we could not erase.
With these marks, we couldn’t disguise ourselves and had to try to break out through the entrance forcibly.”
“And at the exit of the Land of Immortal Remnants, their defenses were too tight.
We tried many times, but ultimately we couldn’t escape.”
“I see…”
Lin Jing immediately understood all the reasons after listening and also realized something.
That’s why previously, in that bizarre state, he could only detect eight Immortal Yuans; the last one was undetectable because it was in the hands of the Empress of the Demon Clan.
Now, the Immortal Yuan that the Empress of the Demon Clan had obtained, although it was acquired during his first Tribulation, goes without saying that it also originated from the Land of Immortal Remnants.
This fact, Lin Jing had already understood from the conversation he had overheard from Elder Qu of the Liuyue Dao Sect in the Cangyun Realm.
Elder Bai and the ancestor of the Changyun Clan had given away the Immortal Yuan they originally possessed to the Empress of the Demon Clan, but because of the Immortal Yuan, they fell into a perilous situation once more.
This caused Lin Jing to feel somewhat helpless.
He was also very curious about the Empress of the Demon Clan; why did she also need the Immortal Yuan?
