chapters.title: Chapter 949
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 949: Chapter 423 Crisis (3rd chapter of the day, additional chapter)_3 Chapter 949: Chapter 423 Crisis (3rd chapter of the day, additional chapter)_3 Ultimately…
Their traces were still discovered not long ago.
After their traces were discovered, the two of them started to fight against the people from the Cangyun Jiulin while retreating.
At the same time, they tried to shake off the pursuers from those two realms, but those people from Cangyun Jiulin relentlessly chased them until now.
And each battle involved at least three Mahayana peak cultivators from the opposing side, making it difficult for them to gain any advantage.
The two were constantly pursued by people from the two realms, depleting their spiritual power.
Such frequent battles naturally led to huge consumption, and they also had no time to stop and recover the depleted spiritual power.
...
Before long, their spiritual power was nearly exhausted, and they estimated it would soon be completely depleted.
After fighting for a while, the two of them found an opportunity and escaped.
However, the injuries on their bodies and the trauma to their soul spirits were already too severe to continue escaping.
Afterward, the two of them stopped.
Elder Bai, upon stopping, summoned the little spiritual power he had left to heal their injuries while struggling to speak:
“Old Hongâ€¦”
“It seems that this time, we are really going to fall.”
Beside him, the elder from Changyun Clan, who seemed to be slightly better off, cracked a smile and said:“To die, is to dieâ€¦!”
“It’s just a pity, in the end, we didn’t fulfill Old Lin’s wish, couldn’t concoct the Ascension Pill, and visit the Immortal Realm.”
Elder Bai, upon hearing this, turned his head to look at the open and impulsive elder from the Changyun Clan, and couldn’t help but smile:
“You…”
“Being an elder of the Changyun Clan, you are still so impetuous and unrestrained.”
“I suddenly remember Lin kid, if it wasn’t for him helping you concoct that Flawless Longevity Life-Extension Elixir, wouldn’t you have truly gone to fight Ye Mingyi to the death?”
The elder from the Changyun Clan then laughed:
“Of courseâ€¦”
“You know, I always do what I say.”
“But…”
“Fortunately, we had Lin kid, so that we could still fight side by side up to now.”
Just as the elder from the Changyun Clan finished speaking, a voice came through:
“You are right, this is your last time fighting side by side, because next, I want you to pay with your lives for my junior.”
As this voice came, several figures quickly arrived, confronting Elder Bai and the elder from the Changyun Clan.
There were six people who arrived, all of whom were Mahayana peak cultivators.
Especially the daoist dressed cultivator in the middle, his expression cold and his gaze icy, he stared at Elder Bai and the elder from the Changyun Clan.
This was the Sect Master of the Liuyue Dao Sect, who once had a brief encounter with Lin Jing at the entrance to the Land of Immortal Remnants.
ƝοѵǤο.с0
It was also because of him that Elder Bai and the elder from the Changyun Clan were in such a dire state now.
After finishing speaking, the Sect Master of the Liuyue Dao Sect turned to the other cultivators and said:
“Fellow daoists, as we agreed earlier, one stream of Immortal Yuan goes to you.”
“And another stream of Immortal Yuan, which was originally ours from Liuyue Dao Sect, naturally belongs to us.”
“Of course, I won’t take this Immortal Yuan for nothing; I will give you fellows some benefits as I promised before.”
“Besides…”
“Soon, I will use some extreme measures on these two, until their souls disperse.”
“I assume you fellows have no objections?”
One by one, the people voiced out:
“Of course not.”
…
“Daoist Li is joking; of course, we have no objections.”
…
“As long as the benefits Daoist Li discussed with us are in place, the rest is none of my concern.”
…
…
Just as the group was reaching an agreement, a terrifying pressure suddenly filled the space, making it hard to breathe.
Along with this pressure, a cold voice devoid of any emotion also transmitted:
“How?”
“You want to seize my Immortal Yuan, without even asking my opinion?”

chapters.title: Chapter 950
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 950: Chapter 424 Majesty of the Demon Emperor, Birth of the Void Immortal Chapter 950: Chapter 424 Majesty of the Demon Emperor, Birth of the Void Immortal As the sound arrived, the complexions of several people changed dramatically.
Especially the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect, whose face looked extremely ugly compared to the others.
The nearly obtained Immortal Yuan had turned ephemeral due to that voice.
If others were unaware of the meaning of that sound, they would certainly not forget it.
Because they had all participated in that grand melee at the beginning and had witnessed the majesty of the owner of that voice with their own eyes.
On the contrary, Elder Bai and the elder from the Changyun Clan relaxed upon hearing this sound, exchanged a smile, and instantly eased up.
“That lad is really timely…”
“If he were any later, these fellows would have torn us old bones apart.”
After relaxing, the elder from the Changyun Clan immediately turned and started chatting with Elder Bai.
...
“Indeed…”
“The lad was indeed timely.”
A smile inevitably appeared on Elder Bai’s face.
At this moment, the six people from Cangyun and Jiulin were furrowing their brows, looking towards the direction from where the sound had come.
Quickly…
The figure they least wanted to see, the fearsome Demon Empress of the Demon Clan, still appeared in their sight, followed by a young cultivator unknown to them.
The arrival of Huang Qingling made them gather together, all on their guard.
However, Huang Qingling completely disregarded their clustering behavior.
What defines an Immortal?
What defines a mortal?
How could these mortals understand the gap between immortals and mortals?
Even someone like Huang Qingling, despite being a wounded Void Immortal, was beyond their comprehension.
The six of them, even if they attacked all at once, were no match for Huang Qingling.
Therefore, she naturally disdained their grouping.
Huang Qingling ignored them all and spoke directly to Elder Bai:
“I have already discussed with Lin Jing.
ƝοѵǤᴑ.сο
Give me an Immortal Yuan, and I will lead you out.”
Lin Jing nodded repeatedly.
Elder Bai understood immediately and took out an Immortal Yuan, handing it over to Huang Qingling.
Huang Qingling beckoned, and the Immortal Yuan flew directly into her hand.
Then, Huang Qingling, in front of everyone, stowed the Immortal Yuan away.
Having put away the Immortal Yuan, Huang Qingling then spoke to Elder Bai and the Changyun elder:
“What are you still doing here?
Follow me.”
The two nodded and immediately followed her.
Originally, when Huang Qingling stowed away the Immortal Yuan, they said nothing and dared not say anything.
But now that the two elders were leaving, even if they were fearful of Huang Qingling, they had to speak up.
One of the six hurriedly spoke as the two elders were leaving:
“Demon Emperor…”
“You can have the Immortal Yuan…”
“We won’t compete with you for it.”
“You want to protect these two, that’s fine too.
We won’t stop you.”
“But they have another Immortal Yuan on them, obtained by the Cangyun Realm’s cultivators.”
“They can go, but that Immortal Yuan must be left behind.”
After this person finished speaking, the others also echoed:
“Exactly…”
“They can go, but that Immortal Yuan must be left behind.”
The Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect, seeing the situation, couldn’t help but close his eyes, silently grieving for his fellow disciple.
That grudge, it seemed, he wouldn’t be able to avenge anytime soon.
Moments later, the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect opened his eyes and also looked at Huang Qingling, saying:
“Demon Emperor…”
“Those two killed my fellow disciple and snatched his Immortal Yuan from him.”
“Since, Demon Emperor, you want to protect these two, I won’t pursue my disciple’s matter for now, but that Immortal Yuan they carry, which belonged to my disciple, must be returned.”
Despite their protests, Huang Qingling remained unmoved, instead furrowing her brows, urging the hesitant Elder Bai and the Changyun elder to hurry up.
“What are you two waiting for?
What else do you plan to do here?”
Hearing this, they no longer hesitated and quickly joined Huang Qingling.
Huang Qingling’s dismissive attitude infuriated the group.
Even though they were afraid before, the repeated dismissiveness of Huang Qingling angered them.
Among them, the black-robed elder who had appeared when Lin Jing left the Land of Immortal Remnants spoke with fury:
“Demon Emperor…”
“What do you mean by this, showing such disdain and not considering us at all?”
Huang Qingling turned to look at them and then coldly smirked:
“You lot, I really don’t take seriously.”
The black-robed elder was choked by Huang Qingling’s words, becoming so angry he was momentarily at a loss for words:
“You…”
“You…”
After quite a while, he regained his composure and continued:
“Demon Emperor…”
“Don’t push us too far.
Among our two realms, there are many cultivators with numerous strategies.
I refuse to believe that combining our two realm’s forces, we cannot kill a single Demon Emperor?”
Huang Qingling turned to face the man as her cultivation surged, causing the group to break out in a cold sweat:
“If you truly have the courage, then come.
I will be in the city of the Demon Emperor waiting for you.
I am curious to see whether you cultivators of the Cangyun and Jiulin realms are numerous?”
“Or if I kill more?”
After speaking, Huang Qingling no longer paid any attention to them and turned away, leaving.
Seeing this, Lin Jing and his companions also followed Huang Qingling, leaving the area.
The others could finally breathe a sigh of relief only after they had completely departed.

chapters.title: Chapter 951
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 951: Chapter 424 Majesty of the Demon Emperor, Birth of the Void Immortal_2 Chapter 951: Chapter 424 Majesty of the Demon Emperor, Birth of the Void Immortal_2 Until then, these people began to reproach the robed elder:
“Daoist friend…”
“You were too reckless, if you truly angered the Demon Emperor, she would need hardly any effort to kill us.”
“Have you forgotten the great chaos last time?”
“She struck only once and suppressed all of us; we can’t even begin to fathom her terrifying cultivation.”
After these words fell, another cultivator quickly spoke:
“If we truly anger the Demon Emperor, let it be known, Jiulin Realm will disassociate from Cangyun Realm immediately; don’t blame us.”
The Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect also shook his head and then spoke:
“Daoist Mo…”
“You indeed acted recklessly.
If the Demon Emperor were to make a move, none from Cangyun Realm in this foreign realm could escape.”
After realizing his mistake, the robed elder was also filled with fear, and hastily apologized to the others:
“I’m very sorry…”
“I really lost control of myself, acted too impulsively.
I hope you Daoist friends can forgive me.”
The Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect then comforted him:
“It’s alright; understanding this is good.”“After all, there is still Immortal Yuan in the Land of Immortal Remnants, we can just search for it again if needed.”
“Right…”
After finishing, the robed elder looked towards the direction Huang Qingling had left, slightly puzzled, and asked:
“What exactly is the cultivation of that Demon Emperor?”
“She appears to only have the peak Mahayana cultivation, but her combat power is terrifyingly abnormal.”
The others also looked in that direction and said:
“Perhaps, she has already surpassed the peak of Mahayana, it’s just that we cannot see through her true cultivation.”
“Having surpassed the peak of Mahayana, that would beâ€¦”
“Immortal…”
…
ƝοѵǤο.сᴑ
…
After escorting Elder Bai and the elder of the Changyun Clan out of the Land of Immortal Remnants, the group left the place.
During this period, encountering other people from the Cangyun and Jiulin realms, no one dared to interfere.
...
The group left smoothly.
After leaving for a considerable distance, Huang Qingling opened her mouth again, asking Elder Bai:
“How goes the collection of materials for the Ascension Pill?”
“When do you plan to break the barrier to the Immortal Realm?”
Upon hearing this, Elder Bai responded:
“With this Immortal Yuan, the materials for the Ascension Pill are now ready.
Alchemy can begin soon.
Once the Ascension Pill is made, I will consume it to advance to the Void Immortal Realm, then prepare and try to open the barrier to the Immortal Realm.”
“This time won’t be too distant.”
Huang Qingling nodded and then directly said:
“If that’s the case, you all stay in my Demon Emperor City during this period.”
“Elsewhere, they might seek revenge or try to steal the Immortal Yuan, but in Demon Emperor City, they dare not come…”
As Huang Qingling spoke these words, she was very confident, seemingly certain they wouldn’t dare to come.
But it’s true…
If they really had dared to make a move, they would have done so back in the Land of Immortal Remnants, rather than waiting until now.
Since they didn’t dare to act under such pressing circumstances, they must be very fearful of Huang Qingling, and even less likely to act in the future.
It’s hard to know what kind of power Huang Qingling showcased during that great chaos to instill such fear.
“Thank you, Demon Emperor!”
Upon hearing this, Elder Bai and the elder of the Changyun Clan also quickly expressed their gratitude.
…
…
The group then returned to Demon Emperor City.
Elder Bai also promptly began gathering those allies who had previously collaborated with him.
These people and their behind-the-scenes forces all had good ties with the Elixir Alliance and were mainly the providers of most materials needed for the Ascension Pill this time.
When these people arrived at Demon Emperor City and saw Elder Bai and his companion, they too expressed their apologies regarding the incident of being trapped in the Land of Immortal Remnants.
Elder Bai, however, did not mind and even comforted them.
After all, the people who acted against them from both the Cangyun and Jiulin realms were too many.
Even if all the top cultivators of the entire Eastern Spirit Realm were mobilized, they wouldn’t stand a chance against those two realms.
It was even possible that all the top cultivators of the Eastern Spirit Realm could be entirely wiped out in one swoop.
That’s why, when considering whom to seek help from, they didn’t think of them but instead had Lin Jing seek out Huang Qingling directly.
Only Huang Qingling…
Could save them under those circumstances.
And indeed, the two were rescued by Huang Qingling.
After gathering the allied members, the materials for the Ascension Pill were also ready.
Then…
Elder Bai and the elder of the Changyun Clan, to avoid any slip-ups that could lead to alchemy failure, began their final study of the Elixir Recipe for the Ascension Pill.
This time, they even included Lin Jing.
Lin Jing, now a ninth-grade Alchemist, naturally could participate.
Thus, a year passed.
A year later, a void not far from Demon Emperor City was struck by Tribulation Lightning.
This Tribulation Lightning was terrifying; although it could not match the furor of Lin Jing’s previous tribulation, it was nearly as intense.
Furthermore…
This Tribulation Lightning was different from the usual one faced by cultivators, it wasn’t just nine strikes but countless continuous strikes, lasting for a significant period.
Even the duration of the Tribulation Lightning was much longer than usual for cultivators.
Though protracted, the Tribulation Lightning ceased after nearly half a day.
When the Tribulation Lightning ceased, under it, an extremely dazzling display of multicolored lights suddenly burst forth.
It was as if an Immortal Treasure had appeared, drawing all the cultivators who had rushed there upon seeing the Tribulation Lightning.

chapters.title: Chapter 952
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 952: Chapter 424: The Majesty of the Demon Emperor, the Emergence of the Void Immortal_3 Chapter 952: Chapter 424: The Majesty of the Demon Emperor, the Emergence of the Void Immortal_3 However, these cultivators who rushed over halted immediately upon seeing the figure that terrified them, not daring to advance any further.
Then…
Only a few days had passed when astonishing news spread rapidly:
Someone in the Xuanqing Realm had refined Elixir Medicine of the Immortal class.
Consuming it allowed them to become an Immortal on the spot, becoming the sole Void Immortal Realm powerhouse among the three major Cultivation Worlds.
After this news was released, the entire Outer Spatial Void was in an uproar, everyone eagerly inquiring about who had refined such a heaven-defying Elixir Medicine.
Moreover, what kind of Elixir Medicine was it exactly, that it could allow one to become an Immortal instantly?
Upon hearing this, cultivators from Xuanqing Realm were shocked but also thrilled.
...
Being in the Outer Spatial Void, Xuanqing Realm had always been weaker and was often suppressed by people from the other two realms.
Now that a Void Immortal Realm powerhouse had appeared, wouldn’t that mean no one would dare to oppress them arbitrarily in the future?
Meanwhile, cultivators from Cangyun and Jiulin became quite panicked after hearing the news, fearing what the Immortal in the Void Immortal Realm might do to them…
However.
Their worries seemed completely unnecessary.
After the news had been out for quite a while, the Void Immortal Realm cultivator did not make any public appearances, nor did they make any unconventional moves.
Shortly thereafter, several of the most prestigious Mahayana peak cultivators from Cangyun and Jiulin jointly announced a message.
From now on, cultivators from the three realms were forbidden from slaughtering each other.
They were to conserve energy and prepare, as the Immortal from Xuanqing Realm planned to open the barriers to the Immortal Realm and lead everyone inside.
Meanwhile…
The Land of Immortal Remnants was no longer sealed off, now open to all, including those from Xuanqing Realm.
ɴ0νǤο.сο
The news shocked everyone even more, followed by boundless joy.
The Immortal Realm had been sealed for a million years, and being unable to ascend had weighed heavily on everyone’s minds, becoming their greatest affliction.
If they were able to ascend to the Immortal Realm, it would be a great boon for all cultivators of the three major Cultivation Worlds…
With this news, the Immortal from Xuanqing Realm, undoubtedly, became immensely revered and profoundly appreciated by all cultivators.
Especially the cultivators from Cangyun and Jiulin, who even improved their attitudes toward the other cultivators of Xuanqing Realm considerably.
While a celebratory atmosphere permeated the outside world and everywhere buzzed with harmony, inside Demon Emperor City, things appeared not to have changed significantly.
In one of the courtyards within Demon Emperor City, Lin Jing sat opposite to the elder ancestor of the Changyun Clan, engaged in conversation.
Originally discussing matters pertaining to the Lin Family, the elder ancestor of the Changyun Clan suddenly spoke to Lin Jing:
“Lin lad…”
“Old Bai has already secluded himself to stabilize his Cultivation to prepare for the final efforts to open the barriers to the Immortal Realm.
The Demon Emperor has also secluded himself, stating he needed to prepare.”
“This seclusion of theirs, I estimate, will last several years.”
“With nothing pressing during this period, what do you plan to do?”
Hearing this, Lin Jing replied:
“Now that the Land of Immortal Remnants is unrestricted, many people have already rushed over there to search for Immortal Yuan.”
“I also plan to go into the Land of Immortal Remnants to see if I can find a thread of Immortal Yuan.”
Seven strands of Immortal Yuan had already appeared in the Land of Immortal Remnants, but currently, two strands are still hidden within, undiscovered.
Now that the Land of Immortal Remnants is unrestricted and open to all, it’s likely that such circumstances will not allow these two strands of Immortal Yuan to remain hidden for long.
They are expected to be found soon.
Now possessing a special Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing could more easily find Immortal Yuan than others.
With such uniquely favorable conditions, he naturally couldn’t pass up the opportunity; naturally, he also aimed to secure the remaining two strands of Immortal Yuan first.
The elder ancestor of the Changyun Clan nodded and said:
“I see…”
“That’s good, I’ll accompany you then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 953
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 953: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space Chapter 953: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space In the blink of an eye, ten years had already passed.
Elder Bai had completely stabilized his cultivation and emerged from isolation.
After absorbing three streams of Immortal Yuan, Huang Qingling had also fully recovered from her injuries, her cultivation reaching its peak and even surpassing Elder Bai by quite a bit, no longer having any concerns.
Naturally…
During these ten years, Lin Jing also unsurprisingly collected the remaining two streams of Immortal Yuan.
All nine streams of Immortal Yuan in the Land of Immortal Remnants were thus taken away, leaving not a single one behind.
However, the others did not know about this.
...
At this moment, many were still tirelessly searching for Immortal Yuan within the Land of Immortal Remnants.
As for Lin Jing, of course, he would not interfere, nor would he reveal the fact that there were no Immortal Yuan left.
After all, sometimes, leaving others with a sliver of hope was also a good thing.
In these ten years, apart from collecting Immortal Yuan, Lin Jing occasionally used the System’s functionality to track the whereabouts of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
After this period of relentless investigation, Lin Jing discovered that the Divine Tree of Dao Principle did indeed seem to be in the Immortal Dao Realm, and its location was unstable, constantly wandering in the void.
Beyond observing the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Lin Jing also took the opportunity to survey the landscapes within the Immortal Dao Realm.
The Immortal Dao Realm was filled with ruins everywhere, not even a single intact place remained.
Over the years, Lin Jing had observed dozens of times, following the ever-shifting location of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, surveying many places.
Yet he saw no signs of any living creatures.
Everywhere, there were only ruins left behind after the great battle.
And in these numerous observations, Lin Jing also found that there was no danger lurking within the Immortal Dao Realm.
It seemed that after the great battle, all had returned to silence; all living beings had vanished just like that.
Even traces of the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate and the Five Elements Ancestor were not found by Lin Jing.
But…
As long as there was no danger, it was good; if there was no danger, then Elder Bai and the others could break through the barrier of the Immortal Realm and successfully enter the Immortal Dao Realm to see the situation for themselves.
…
…
The Spatial River, located in the depths of the void, beyond the junction of three Cultivation Worlds.
Since the Ancient Era, there were rumors that the source of the Spatial River led to the Immortal Dao Realm, and by breaking the spatial barrier at the end of the Spatial River, one could reach inside the Immortal Dao Realm.
However, the Spatial River itself was dangerous, especially the void where its source was located, with constant spatial rifts and spatial whirlpools frequently appearing.
Moreover, besides spatial rifts, not even meteorites were commonly seen in that place, and no resources would appear, so no one would ever go there.
The location chosen by Elder Bai to break the Immortal Realm barrier was precisely at the end of the Spatial River.
ƝονǤᴑ.сο
After making preparations, Elder Bai and Huang Qingling led Lin Jing and their group on their journey.
In addition to Lin Jing, the Changyun Clan’s patriarch, Elder Lei, and several allies of Elder Bai from the Eastern Spirit Realm also went together.
And…
Elder Bai did not hide his intention to break through the barrier of the Immortal Realm, and now he traveled openly and magnanimously towards the direction of the Spatial River.
Their march was naturally seen by the cultivators of the Cangyun Realm and the Jiulin Realm.
Consequently, those cultivators also organized themselves to follow Elder Bai and the rest toward the direction of the Spatial River.
Even the Sect Master of the Liuyue Dao Sect, as well as other individuals they had encountered in the Land of Immortal Remnants, followed the crowd and flew towards the Spatial River.
This was a significant event for entering the Immortal Realm; these people had been stuck at the peak of Mahayana for countless years, and who among them did not wish to breakthrough and become an Immortal?
Now that Elder Bai, a Void Immortal of the Void Immortal Realm, was leading the charge to break through the Immortal Realm barrier, they naturally could not miss this opportunity.
Seeing the Sect Master of the Liuyue Dao Sect, Lin Jing could not help but take a few more glances.
At this moment, the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect seemed to have moved past the demise of his junior brother; his eyes no longer held hatred, but rather anticipation for the Immortal Realm, desire…
And not just him, the other Mahayana peak cultivators also felt the same.
Thus, the cultivators of all three worlds appeared unified for the first time, marching grandly towards the Spatial River.
The Spatial River was in the depths of the void, far from the nearby vacuum of the three worlds, and naturally, it would take considerable time to reach it.
It took them more than three years to finally arrive at the end of the Spatial River.
There, the group rested a while, and Elder Bai and Huang Qingling began to explore nearby and started their preparations.
Several days later, after the preparations were complete and they had chosen the location where they would break the barrier, they were ready to begin.
By this time, most of the cultivators from the three worlds had already arrived, everyone watching from a distance, eager to witness the moment of breaking through the barrier to the Immortal Realm.
Although Lin Jing had already seen the situation inside the Immortal Dao Realm, he was equally full of anticipation, wanting to enter and see it for himself.
Once the preparations were completed, Elder Bai directly gathered a nine-colored light, covering that entire expanse of void.
This nine-colored light was comprised of immortal power, an existence far surpassing Spiritual Power.
After the nine-colored light covered the entire space, Elder Bai did not stop but continued to gather the nine-colored light, charging towards the void up ahead.
Before long, the void began to change, slowly peeling open bit by bit, revealing an interior resembling a crystal barrier of light.
This barrier of light, appearing here, blocked all of Elder Bai’s nine-colored Spiritual Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 954
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 954: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_2 Chapter 954: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_2 People became excited upon sighting the light barrier, for it indicated that their endeavor was already halfway to success.
Just then, Huang Qingling made a move.
With a single step, Huang Qingling appeared before the light barrier.
Following that, an aura, utterly terrifying and even stronger than the one surrounding Elder Bai, emanated from Huang Qingling’s body.
The emergence of this aura made everyone’s heart skip a beat.
At that moment, Lin Jing suddenly understood why the people in the Land of Immortal Remnants had been so afraid of Huang Qingling.
Faced with such a horrifying aura, they were like mere ants, how could they dare to resist?
...
Next…
Huang Qingling raised her hand, and a massive Divine Phoenix phantom appeared.
The phantom was nearly transparent at the beginning, but as Huang Qingling continued to gather immortal power, it became more and more solidified.
Until at last, the entire Divine Phoenix phantom looked as real as if an actual Divine Phoenix had descended into the world.
The formidable pressure emitted from the Divine Phoenix made it difficult for everyone to even lift their heads.
Not to mention, if this spell were directed at all present, it was likely that everyone there would perish on the spot.
Fortunately, the target of this spell wasn’t the people, but the barrier of the Immortal Realm.
After the Divine Phoenix phantom solidified, Huang Qingling waved her hand and it rushed toward the Immortal Realm’s barrier.
“Boom…!”
As the Divine Phoenix phantom struck the spatial barrier, a massive explosion ensued, and the violent aura produced by the explosion swept outward, engulfing all those present.
Seeing this, everyone hastily employed their respective methods to defend themselves.
Thankfully, it was only the aftermath of the explosion, and since they were far from the Immortal Realm barrier, no harm was done.
After the explosion, people hardly cared about their own safety as they looked towards the barrier’s location.
There, the spatial barrier was riddled with cracks that were expanding.
Upon seeing this, Huang Qingling waved her hand, and a streak of red light rushed toward it, like the last straw breaking the camel’s back.
As the red light struck the Immortal Realm barrier, the barrier could no longer withstand it and shattered instantly.
As the Immortal Realm barrier completely broke apart, people had no time to celebrate before being shocked by what they saw.
Through the breached barrier, they sensed not even a hint of Immortal Energy but beheld a fearsome scene instead.
Within the barrier, devoid of Immortal Energy and lacking the coveted land of the Immortal Realm, was the same expanse of void as outside.
And…
Floating within the void were fragmented Immortal Mountains and countless Immortal Stones, along with the ruined architecture of Immortal Palacesâ€”all drifting there.
What was most terrifying, though, were the mutilated bodies of immortals and Immortal Beasts, also floating amidst the broken mountains and stones.
In light of this, everyone’s expressions changed dramatically, aside from Lin Jing.
Even Huang Qingling and Elder Bai couldn’t help but furrow their brows.
Then, Elder Bai gathered immortal power and prevented the Immortal Realm barrier from healing at the breach.
After completing this, he and Huang Qingling entered through the breach into the barrier.
Seeing this, Lin Jing and the others quickly followed, entering the Immortal Dao Realm through the opening in the barrier.
Once inside the Immortal Dao Realm, Lin Jing too couldn’t help but frown.
Inside, the space was just as void of Spiritual Power and Immortal Energy as the outside, filled only with endless emptiness.
Of course, there were also the floating remains of the shattered Immortal Palaces, as well as the few bodies of immortalsâ€”fragmented yet emitting an aura still terrifying.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing looked further in, and the scenes that came into view appeared almost identical to the current one, seemingly without any difference.
The other cultivators, shocked by the sight before them, reacted differently.
Some, seemingly unable to believe what lay before their eyes, kept flying further inside, seeking to uncover the truth.
Others flew toward the bodies of the immortals, hoping to find some clues on them.
However, the auras lingering on the bodies of these long-deceased immortals prevented anyone from approaching.
Of course, there were also those ‘clever ones’.
ɴονǤο.сο
They rushed toward the ruined Immortal Palaces immediately, hoping to find some treasures or Cultivation Techniques left by the immortals.
While everyone was busily engaged in their own activities,
Suddenly…
Lin Jing, whilst observing, noticed a piece of withered wood slowly drifting through the void.
Upon seeing this piece of withered wood, Lin Jing became excited and swiftly flew toward it.
This piece was none other than the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, which Lin Jing had often scrutinized using Observation Mode.
Long periods of observation had made Lin Jing extremely familiar with this piece of wood, so he couldn’t possibly mistake it for anything else.
What he hadn’t expected was that on his journey to avoid suspicion, he had not entered the System Space to observe it, yet it had drifted here, near the spatial barrier.
Lin Jing couldn’t help but feel that his luck was indeed good.
The Divine Tree of Dao Principle, devoid of any energy, would seem inconsequential to others; just a short piece amidst the many fragments of celestial trees floating in the void.
Naturally, no one paid it any attention.
Thus, Lin Jing managed to approach the Divine Tree of Dao Principle without any issues.
Upon Lin Jing’s approach, the System Space immediately extended an invisible force, enveloping the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.

chapters.title: Chapter 955
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 955: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_3 Chapter 955: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_3 At the same time, a notification sound from System Space echoed:
“Ding!”
“System Notification: Congratulations host on finding one of the three World Seeds, the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Reward obtained: 1,000,000 Harvest Points.”
“Ding!”
“System Notification: The Divine Tree of Dao Principle is currently being absorbed.
Any operation within System Space is unavailable.
Please wait momentarily.”
However…
As the system notification sounded, Lin Jing also felt an unusual force silently entering his body and then disappearing within him.
Lin Jing was immediately startled and hurriedly stimulated his Divine Sense to check his body.
However,
just then…
...
An anomaly suddenly occurred.
Within the Immortal Dao Realm, countless multicolored lights suddenly appeared.
Upon their appearance, they immediately swept toward the nearby cultivators.
When cultivators came into contact with these multicolored lights, their bodies immediately disintegrated, and their Soul Spirits were instantly taken away by the lights, disappearing without a trace.
A Mahayana Realm cultivator perished in an instant, and no one expected the Immortal Realm to be so dangerous.
In a moment, everyone’s expressions dramatically changed, no longer caring about exploration and they hastily fled toward the barrier exit.
With one person fallen, naturally, there came a second, a third…
These multicolored lights were too numerous and exceedingly fast, impossible to dodge or withstand.
ɴονǤᴑ.ᴄο
In just a moment, several people’s bodies disintegrated, their Soul Spirits taken by the multicolored lights.
Seeing this, Lin Jing didn’t bother to check his own body and hurriedly flew outside.
It seemed the multicolored lights were targeting him specifically, as several lights followed close behind him.
The lights moved swiftly and, with Lin Jing’s speed, they were extremely difficult to evade.
Moreover, with System Space unavailable, Lin Jing couldn’t escape into it even if he wanted to.
Seeing a light about to reach him, that unusual force from before suddenly appeared and caused the multicolored light to change direction.
This force was actually helping him.
For a moment, Lin Jing was quite bewildered.
However, now was not the time to be baffled.
Apart from the earlier multicolored light, several more were still chasing him.
Lin Jing continued to hurriedly flee forward, now not far from the barrier exit.
Just then, those multicolored lights suddenly accelerated and chased after him.
At the same time, another figure also arrived here, just like him.
Lin Jing turned his head and saw that this person was the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect, who was also being followed by several multicolored lights.
The lights behind him were even closer, rapidly nearing him.
The Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect was also very anxious at this moment.
At that time, he looked at Lin Jing.
Then, the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect launched a spell instantaneously, striking toward Lin Jing.
Seeing this, Lin Jing hurriedly defended himself, but this delayed his escape.
The Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect took advantage of this moment to surpass Lin Jing, flying ahead of him.
Clearly…
When his life was threatened, the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect couldn’t care about anything else.
However, this was indeed effective.
After overtaking Lin Jing, the Immortal Yuan chasing behind him also changed direction and chased after Lin Jing together.
Regrettably, he was too focused on saving his own life and didn’t pay attention to the surroundings, even missing Huang Qingling, who was ahead.
The previous scene was all witnessed by Huang Qingling, who became extremely angry.
Although she no longer had the same feelings toward Lin Jing as before, she retained all the memories of her divided Soul Spirit and naturally didn’t want her “old acquaintance” to perish here.
Huang Qingling’s gaze turned icy, and she unleashed a palm strike that instantly transformed into a phantom of a Divine Phoenix, rushing toward the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect.
After the strike, Huang Qingling stopped paying attention to the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect and turned to Lin Jing, attempting to rescue him.
However…
It was half a step too late for Huang Qingling, as she could only watch the multicolored lights slowly approach Lin Jing.
But in that critical moment, Huang Qingling saw Lin Jing suddenly disappear from the spot.
The next moment…
Lin Jing mysterically reappeared behind her.
Such a bizarre situation, even Huang Qingling was momentarily startled.
Finally, it was the scream of the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect that brought her back to reality.
Faced with Huang Qingling’s furious strike, even the Sect Master of Liuyue Dao Sect, a peak Mahayana cultivator, could not withstand it.
He was instantly overwhelmed by the phantom of the Divine Phoenix, becoming the first cultivator since entering the Immortal Dao Realm who didn’t die under the multicolored lights.
At this critical moment, Huang Qingling couldn’t worry about much else and directly said to Lin Jing,
“Hurry up and get out, it’s too dangerous to stay here.”
As she spoke, Huang Qingling faced off against a swooping multicolored light.
It seemed that reaching the level of a Void Immortal made it possible to fend off these multicolored lights.
Looking at Elder Bai, who was currently struggling against three multicolored lights, it was evidently challenging.
Others faced these multicolored lights with no means at all, only these two managed some self-defense.
Seeing this, Lin Jing didn’t linger any longer; he rushed through the barrier and left the Immortal Dao Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 956
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 956: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_4 Chapter 956: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_4 Lin Jing let out a sigh of relief only after coming out.
It was really too dangerous just now.
If it hadn’t been for the System Space returning to normal at that critical moment, allowing Lin Jing to use the Fixed Point Teleportation Function in time, he might have really perished within the Immortal Dao Realm.
Just now…
Because of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Lin Jing had ventured too deep.
So, upon exiting, Lin Jing realized that the ancestors of the Changyun Clan, including Elder Lei, had already come out and were waiting on the outside.
Seeing Lin Jing emerge, the ancestors of the Changyun Clan also couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
...
Lin Jing then approached the elders of the Changyun Clan to join them in looking toward the boundary wall.
At the Immortal Dao Realm barrier, cultivators were flying out in panic from inside, while at an unseen location, there were immense fluctuations.
Not long after…
At the mouth of the boundary wall, a vast expanse of nine-colored lights suddenly emerged, obscuring the entire gap in the barrier.
It seemed that these nine-colored lights intended to trap all the remaining people inside.
But just then, a violent fluctuation came, and the nine-colored lights at the gap were instantly dispersed.
Afterward…
A large group of cultivators rushed out from inside.
After all these cultivators had emerged, Huang Qingling also followed them out.
It wasn’t until a good while after Huang Qingling had come out that Elder Bai, with dazzling light emanating from his body and an aura even more powerful than Huang Qingling, walked out from the gap in the barrier.
At this moment, Elder Bai’s eyes shimmered with nine colors, truly as if he were an Immortal descending from the Immortal Realm.
After Elder Bai came out, he immediately retracted the immortal power at the mouth of the boundary wall, and then the barrier slowly began to heal.
Until the barrier was completely healed and once again replaced by the void, Elder Bai still stood there, looking at the barrier, lost in thought.
It was only after a long time that Elder Bai’s aura gradually calmed down, and the glow around his body also faded away.
Only then did Elder Bai turn around and say to the remaining people:
“Let’s go.”
With that, he walked straight ahead.
The return journey was different from the journey there; everyone was steeped in immense loss.
Moreover, there were about half as many people as there had been on the way there.
The slightly less than half of the cultivators all suffered their fate within the Immortal Dao Realm.
Actually…
Perishing in the Immortal Dao Realm was not really the issue.
The key point was that this trip to the Immortal Dao Realm allowed them to see its true nature, severing their hopes.
Especially Elder Bai who, on the way back, was silent throughout the journey without conversing with anyone.
After returning, the news about the Immortal Dao Realm quickly spread.
Although many people had gone together to the end of the cosmic ruins, some had not followed.
But once the news spread, the entire Outer Spatial Void was shrouded in an atmosphere of despair and confusion.
No path lay ahead, what could they do?
If even the Immortal Realm had collapsed, where should they, the practitioners, ultimately go?
Just when everyone was in despair…
Lin Jing was also extremely frustrated.
He had observed for a long time before, and there had been no issues, but just during this entry into the Immortal Dao Realm, problems had arisen.
And it was at the critical moment of seizing the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
“Could it be that it was because I seized the Divine Tree of Dao Principle that those nine-colored lights appeared?” Lin Jing couldn’t help thinking.
Those nine-colored lights were extremely similar to the Immortal Technique of the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate; Lin Jing even suspected that it was the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate who had taken action.
But who was the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate?
That was the Emperor Venerate of the Immortal Dao Realm.
Dealing with them, he didn’t even need to make a move; just with a glance, none of them could escape, so why bother with such complications?
For a moment, Lin Jing was also a bit perplexed.
On the way back, because he had been with the others all the time, Lin Jing hadn’t entered the System Space to check the conditions inside.
Only after returning, when everyone had dispersed, and Elder Bai had made arrangements to discuss matters with the elder of the Changyun Clan, did Lin Jing find the opportunity to enter the System Space to take a look.
ṅοѵǤ0.сο
However…
Just as Lin Jing entered the System Space, he was immediately startled.
For inside the System Space, there was unexpectedly a ‘person.’
It could not quite be called a person, but rather a virtual shadow.
Upon seeing Lin Jing enter, the shadow immediately smiled and then said:
“You’ve finally come in, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”
Lin Jing looked at the shadow with a surprised face and then said:
“Five Elements Ancestor…”
“How come you are here?”
“And you’re unharmed?”
It turned out that this shadow appearing inside the System Space was none other than the Five Elements Ancestor.
What really amazed Lin Jing was not just the appearance of the Five Elements Ancestor but more importantly, within his System Space, the Five Elements Ancestor hadn’t triggered the eradicating function of the System Space.
The Five Elements Ancestor smiled and said:
“You mean, the space where the will of the Immortal Dao resides?”
Lin Jing, hearing this, couldn’t help exclaiming:
“What?”
“The will of the Immortal Dao?”
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded and said:
“It seems you don’t know yet.”
“This space is actually the space formed by the will of the Immortal Dao.
You can enter and exit freely because the will of the Immortal Dao has already recognized you as its master.”
Hearing this, Lin Jing understood.
Previously, in the Illusion Realm, Lin Jing saw the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate wanting to destroy the Immortal Dao Realm because he did not get the recognition of the will of the Immortal Dao.
But unexpectedly, this will of the Immortal Dao was actually his own System Space.
Afterward…

chapters.title: Chapter 957
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 957: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_5 Chapter 957: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the True Form of System Space_5 Lin Jing looked at the Five Elements Ancestor before him and asked,
“How do you know all this?”
“And why are you unharmed?”
The Five Elements Ancestor chuckled and replied,
“The reason I know this, and why the annihilation rules here do not target me, is naturally because I was the first master of this Immortal Will after it was created.”
“It’s also for this reason that I’m knowledgeable about every phase of the Immortal Will, including the state of the System Space before its evolution.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing couldn’t help but say,
“So, you are the true owner of the System Space?”
The Five Elements Ancestor shook his head and answered,
“Not exactly an owner…”
“When the Immortal Will acknowledged its master, it was actually a bit too late; by that time, I was already at a disadvantage in my struggle with the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.”
“Just after the Immortal Will recognized its master, I was defeated and sealed by the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.”
“Otherwise…”
“The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate would have stood no chance against me.”
Lin Jing looked at the Five Elements Ancestor and remembered the special power that had suddenly appeared in the Immortal Dao Realm before asking,
“You must have come with the Divine Tree of Dao Principle when I obtained it, right?”
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded and said,“That’s correct, it was at that moment.”
After the Five Elements Ancestor finished speaking, Lin Jing continued,
“Since you’ve appeared here, there must surely be a reason, and I know what it is.”
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded and sighed,
“That’s right…”
“In the battle with the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, I lost.”
“Before my defeat, I had sent the Immortal Will out of the Immortal Dao Realm, and in the end it was obtained by you; moreover, the Immortal Will also recognized you as its master.”
“Undoubtedly, you are fortunate.”
“But with obtaining the Immortal Will and enjoying the convenience it brings, you also have to face the dangers that come with it.”
“The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate is currently refining the Immortal Dao Heart in the Immortal Dao Realm.
If he completely refines the Immortal Dao Heart, he’ll be able to control the Immortal Dao Realm in another way.”
“By then, he will certainly not be satisfied with just the Immortal Dao Realm; all of the Cultivation Worlds beneath the Immortal Dao Realm will probably suffer.”
“And the most endangered, of course, is you.”
“Once he finishes refining the Immortal Dao Heart, he’ll naturally find out that the Immortal Will is in your possession.”
Upon hearing these words, Lin Jing frowned and then looked up at the Five Elements Ancestor,
“Since you have come here, you must surely have a solution.”
The Five Elements Ancestor looked at Lin Jing and nodded,
“In that battle with the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate that lasted a million years, the entire Immortal Dao Realm was nearly destroyed.”
“But an Emperor Venerate’s cultivation cannot be killed; he can’t kill me, and I can’t kill him, we can only seal each other.”
“Starting tens of thousands of years ago, I was completely suppressed by the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, and a few hundred years ago, I was utterly defeated and sealed by him.”
“All of this is true, but it is also a strategy of mine.”
“Before being sealed, I sent the Immortal Will out of the Immortal Dao Realm and split off a soul fragment that merged into the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, waiting for the Immortal Will to find a new master, to return to this Immortal Dao Realm, so that I could tell him everything.”
“In fact, from the moment the Immortal Will first acknowledged me as its master, I already understood that to completely defeat the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, I would have to rely on the Immortal Will.”
“Unfortunately, when the Immortal Will acknowledged me as its master, it was already too late; by that time, I was being suppressed by the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate and could no longer defeat him.”
“So I could only send out the Immortal Will, awaiting the arrival of the next person destined for it.”
“Fortunately…”
“You appeared.”
“You’ve been acknowledged by the Immortal Will and you’re practicing the Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique I passed down.”
“Such a perfect match is simply fated.”
Then, the Five Elements Ancestor looked at Lin Jing with a solemn expression and declared,
“I think to defeat the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, you must take action.”
“With the Immortal Will recognizing you as master, and with the possession of the three World Seeds, I can help you achieve the Unique Sovereign realm.”
“You are the one to defeat the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.”
“Me?”
Lin Jing was somewhat baffled,
“How can I, not even a Void Immortal yet, achieve the Unique Sovereign?”
“You can!”
“But only temporarily,” the Five Elements Ancestor said.
However, after speaking these words, the phantasm of the Five Elements Ancestor suddenly became unstable.
The apparition furrowed its brow and said to Lin Jing,
“There’s been an accident with the main body; this soul fragment can’t last for long, I can’t talk to you much longer.”
“If you want to know everything, let the Immortal Will fully evolve, and naturally you will understand all that you want to.”
“I’ll wait for you in the Immortal Dao Realm; remember not to take too long.
Otherwise, once the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate completely refines the Immortal Dao Heart, everything will be…
too late…”
As the Five Elements Ancestor spoke his last words, his phantasm began to fade until his voice fell silent.
The phantom completely dissipated from view.
...
After the Five Elements Ancestor vanished, Lin Jing was left alone in the entire System Space.
Lin Jing stood in place, pondering the Five Elements Ancestor’s words.
Regarding all that the Five Elements Ancestor had mentioned, Lin Jing already believed some of it, but not entirely.
ƝονǤο.ᴄο
Since he had said that by evolving the Immortal Will, that is, the System Space, Lin Jing himself would know everything.
Then it wouldn’t be too late to see everything for himself after the evolution of the System Space was complete…
Next.
Lin Jing looked toward the Divine Mountain within the System Space, where the Divine Tree of Dao Principle resided.
Originally, when the Divine Tree of Dao Principle was brought into the System Space, that special Immortal Yuan had already left Lin Jing and entered the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.

chapters.title: Chapter 958
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 958: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the Original Appearance of System Space_6 Chapter 958: Chapter 425: Entering the Immortal Dao Realm, the Original Appearance of System Space_6 The Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm had now, like the land of the Nine Heavens Reincarnation and the Transcendent Lotus Pond, merged into the System Space.
Lin Jing then went straight to the Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm.
As soon as Lin Jing entered the Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm, he was once again pulled into an Illusion Realm.
In this Illusion Realm, Lin Jing saw the cause of all these events, and the words previously spoken by the Five Elements Ancestor were also confirmed here.
This made Lin Jing trust in the words of the Five Elements Ancestor even more.
Soon…
The Illusion Realm ended, and Lin Jing arrived beside the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
...
He then opened the System panel to inspect the Divine Tree of Dao Principle:
Immortal Dao Realm World Seed: Divine Tree of Dao Principle
Growth Environment: Divine Mountain of the Dao Realm
Growth Lifespan: ???
(The World Seed’s lifespan is linked to that of the Immortal Dao Realm; if the Immortal Dao Realm exists, the Seed thrives; if the Immortal Dao Realm perishes, the Seed withers.)
The Divine Tree of Dao Principle, possessing the Power of Laws of Heaven, is the foundation for all laws in the Immortal Dao Realm, an indispensable World Seed for the realm.
(Note: After achieving the Emperor Venerate Realm, one can comprehend the laws of the Dao Realm with the aid of the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, attaining the state of Unique Sovereign.
The laws of the Dao Realm are an essential force for ascending to the Unique Sovereign Realm.)
Indeed…
This Divine Tree of Dao Principle was also an essential World Seed for ascending to the Unique Sovereign Realm.
After inspecting the Divine Tree of Dao Principle, Lin Jing then left System Space.
Ɲονɢօ.сο
Right after leaving System Space, Lin Jing was sought out by the patriarch of the Changyun Clan.
The patriarch of the Changyun Clan seemed to be in a very bad mood.
After informing Lin Jing that Elder Bai was looking for him, he left on his own.
Lin Jing was somewhat unclear about the reason, but he still set aside this matter for the time being and went to see Elder Bai.
After seeing Elder Bai, Elder Bai’s direct words startled Lin Jing.
“My lifespan isn’t much longer, the matters of the Elixir Alliance, I’ll leave them to you all from now on.”
“How could that be?”
“Elder Bai, you’ve clearly just advanced to the Void Immortal Realm, gaining tens of thousands of years in lifespan, how can it be nearly exhausted?”
Mahayana cultivators generally have twenty thousand years of lifespan, but if they break through the barrier between mortals and immortals, advancing to the Void Immortal Realm, it would directly increase their lifespan to one hundred thousand years.
A lifespan of one hundred thousand years, how could it be so easily depleted?
Even using some Forbidden Immortal Technique, it couldn’t possibly consume so much.
It was for this reason that Lin Jing was so startled upon hearing Elder Bai’s words.
Elder Bai, however, appeared very resigned and directly said to Lin Jing:
“Previously in the Immortal Dao Realm, I used a Forbidden Immortal Technique that far exceeded my Cultivation.
After using that Immortal Technique, no matter how much lifespan I had, it would dissolve within thirty years, leading me to fall again into reincarnation.”
“Isn’t there any way to remedy this?”
Lin Jing asked anxiously.
Elder Bai shook his head, saying,
“There isn’t…”
“Once this technique is used, there is no saving it.”
“Moreover…”
“Having pursued this Immortal Road for twenty thousand years without hope in sight, I’ve grown tired, I don’t wish to continue anymore.”
“If possible, perhaps becoming a mere mortal wouldn’t be so bad.”
Upon hearing this, Lin Jing hurriedly said,
“Elder Bai, the Immortal Road is not hopeless, it’s just that it has not been found yet.
I believe that one day, I will find that path.”
Hearing this, Elder Bai smiled and said,
“You have such determination, which is good…”
“I believe you will find that path.”
“However, I can’t accompany you any longer.”
Lin Jing became somewhat anxious,
“But, Elder Bai…”
However, before Lin Jing could finish speaking, Elder Bai interrupted him:
“Actually, I had already come to terms with it before I used the Forbidden Technique.
Otherwise, I wouldn’t have used it.”
Saying this, Elder Bai smiled at Lin Jing,
“Now, there are still twenty-something years left before the thirty-year term ends.
I plan to return to the Xuanqing Realm, then find a place to seclude myself and spend the last years of my life.”
“Of course…”
“You all can come visit this old man, but don’t come to persuade me.
I’m tired and want to rest.”
“After these twenty-something years pass, I will naturally dissolve, and then I will be reborn and fall into the cycle of reincarnation.”
“This end is much better than for others, don’t you think?”
Lin Jing was silent, nodding:
“Yes!”
Compared to the end of other cultivators, being able to re-enter the cycle of reincarnation and be reborn is the best outcome.
And Elder Bai continued:
“After being reborn, maybe I’ll be a scholar, or perhaps a cowherd, or maybe a rich young master.”
“All possibilities…”
“If one day after my reincarnation you meet my reincarnated self, please do not lead me to cultivate.”
“As for cultivation…”
“This lifetime is enough, I do not wish to go through it a second time.”
As Elder Bai spoke, Lin Jing listened silently.
At that moment, the patriarch of the Changyun Clan entered with red eyes, carrying two jars of aged wine.
“Old Bai…”
“Why talk about these things.”
“Come, let’s drink.”
“It’s been a long time since we’ve drunk together.
With old Lin gone, it’s good that we have the young Lin here as a substitute.”
“Today, we’ll drink to our heart’s content.”
Elder Bai looked at the patriarch of the Changyun Clan and then said with a smile:
“Good…”
“Let’s not think about those things today.”
“Let’s, together, drink to our heart’s content…”

chapters.title: Chapter 959
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 959: Chapter 426: The Final Evolution of the System Space Chapter 959: Chapter 426: The Final Evolution of the System Space They had been drinking for three days straight; and later on, Elder Lei and several others also joined in.
Perhaps the impact of this matter was too great for everyone, and for a while, it was difficult for them to accept.
Therefore, they indulged excessively in this drinking session.
After this period of drinking, they bid farewell to Huang Qingling and left together, returning to the Xuanqing Realm.
Whereas Huang Qingling insisted on searching for the lost fragments of the Demon Race Secret Realm, hoping to find her lost memories and chose to stay here.
She had thought that as long as she could enter the Immortal Dao Realm, it would be easier to search for her lost memories.
But unexpectedly, the Immortal Dao Realm had become such a state and was also so dangerous that even she could not stay inside indefinitely.
...
Eventually, she had to give up.
Seeing Huang Qingling so persistent, Lin Jing even felt an impulse to tell her the truth.
But recalling the entrustment of Huang Qingling’s parents, and also that he really should not explain how he came to know of the events a million years ago,
He then suppressed that impulse.
After returning to the Xuanqing Realm, Lin Jing went back to the Elixir Alliance and began to be busy every day.
Since returning, Elder Bai had resigned from his position as the Grand Elder of the Elixir Alliance and retired to the mountains.
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor also retired with Elder Bai, each settling in a neighboring small courtyard in the mountains.
They continued to live as normal.
And Lin Jing, every once in a while, would visit them,
And every time, he would bring several jars of fine wine to drink merrily together.
Twenty-some years, for mortals, passed very slowly, but for cultivators with long lifespans, it passed very quickly.
Especially for someone like Lin Jing, a Mahayana Realm cultivator who had cultivated for twenty thousand years, it was only a very small part of his life.
Elder Bai underwent reincarnation.
It was twenty-five years after they returned.
After Elder Bai’s reincarnation, the Changyun Clan’s ancestor protected the last two courtyards they lived in with a formation.
Then,
The Changyun Clan’s ancestor left the place filled with loneliness and returned to the Changyun Clan.
And at that place, only the formation-protected simple courtyards were left.
Of course, there was also that lonely grave.
…
Since then,
Time seemed to accelerate, passing incredibly fast.
In the first hundred years after returning…
Huang Qingling also returned from the Outer Spatial Void, and upon his return, he chased out all the cultivators from the Demon Race Secret Realm, taking full possession of it.
Two hundred years after returning…
Lin Jue and Ye Yun finally achieved fruition in their cultivation and became Dao companions.
That day,
Everyone gathered together, and even Huang Qingling came to congratulate.
But after the laughter, Li Qingqing was foolishly gazing at Lin Jing.
But now, after so many years, Lin Jing still seemed oblivious…
Until three hundred years after returning, Lin Jing went to the Outer Spatial Void again, and this stay lasted two hundred years.
When he returned from the Outer Spatial Void, five hundred years had already passed since his last return from there.
And after returning this time, Lin Jing didn’t go to the Elixir Alliance nor returned to the Thousand Islands Domain; instead, he went straight to the Nanming Domain and entered the Barren Forbidden Zone.
That day…
The Barren Forbidden Zone was filled with thunder, and it lasted the whole night.
Even outside the Barren Forbidden Zone, one could feel the terrifying power, as though it were the apocalypse itself.
Some cultivators wanted to enter to investigate, but they hurriedly came back out not long after entering.
Such a terrifying force was naturally unbearable for those cultivators, and they knew they should not provoke whoever was causing such a commotion.
Ɲονǥօ.ƈο
So, it was best to keep away as soon as possible.
Not long after the thunder, there appeared the Nine-colored Immortal Light, hovering undispersed above the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Many people speculated that an Immortal Treasure had emerged, yet no one dared to go in and check.
…
Outside the Barren Forbidden Zone, there is Yunling Town.
Originally because it was close to the Barren Forbidden Zone, there were no fields, and even the mountainsides were not casually entered due to the existence of the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Thus, Yunling Town had never been prosperous.
Until six hundred years ago, when the bizarre phenomenon that reduced one’s lifespan in the Barren Forbidden Zone disappeared, Yunling Town gradually began to develop.
And since then, although the Barren Forbidden Zone, lacking Spiritual Energy, wasn’t regarded highly by those cultivators, and even its development wasn’t as good as the towns near Immortal Cities,
But on the edge of the Barren Forbidden Zone, with the disappearance of the life-reducing bizarre phenomenon, the people of Yunling Town lived quite comfortably.
A few miles from Yunling Town, there is a hillside where the grass is lush and thrives vigorously, and the entire hillside is covered in grass except for a single dense tree at the top of the hill.
Such a hillside is rather suitable for grazing sheep.
At this time, under the big tree at the top of the hillside, there really was a young boy, head resting on a straw hat, with a foxtail grass in his mouth, reclining under the tree with his legs crossed, swaying leisurely as if quite content.
And not far from him, a dozen sheep were leisurely grazing on the grassland.
It turns out this young boy was indeed a shepherd.
While the boy was enjoying this leisurely moment, a middle-aged man in a short shirt, carrying a woodcutting axe, walked past the hillside.
Upon seeing the man, the boy quickly got up and shouted to the man:
“Old Chai…”
