chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 960: Chapter 426: The Final Evolution of the System Space_2 Chapter 960: Chapter 426: The Final Evolution of the System Space_2 “Why did you wake up so late for woodcutting today?”
The man, seeing the young boy, also shouted with his robust voice:
“You little lamb, my family name is Liu, not Chai, don’t call me Old Chai just because I chop wood.”
The young boy, hearing this, also laughed, saying:
“You’re one to talk, Old Chai.”
“I am Bai, not Yang, yet you still call me little lamb.”
“Isn’t it just because you called me that first that I then called you that?” the man argued.
The young boy simply waved his hand, saying:
“Forget it, let’s not talk about this…”
“Old Chai, why did you get up so late today?
Aren’t you afraid your wife won’t let you into the bed if you don’t chop enough wood?”
The man, hearing this, scolded with a laugh:
“You little rascal, your hair hasn’t even fully grown yet, and you know so much; you must have spent quite some time peeping at the village girls bathing.”
After saying that, the man complained:
“It was all because of the strange thunder last night, which kept me awake all night.”
“Today, when I got up, I heard everyone talking about it.
They said that last night inside the Barren Forbidden Zone, there must have been a cultivator undergoing Tribulation.”
“The commotion was extraordinary.”
“It is said that some cultivators had just entered, and then they came back out right away.”
“The person inside, he must be a Great Cultivator.”
“Also, this morning, with the continuous appearance of the nine-colored Immortal Light, it is said that an Immortal Treasure has emerged, obtained by that Great Cultivator.”
The young boy, hearing this, suddenly lost interest:
“I thought it was something serious.”
“So it’s just this…”
“You little bugger…” the man said to the young boy:
“That’s a Great Cultivator possessing an Immortal Treasure, aren’t you interested in becoming his disciple?”
“Maybe you have a decent Spirit Root Aptitude and that Great Cultivator will take notice and accept you as his disciple on his own initiative.”
“Once you become that Great Cultivator’s disciple, it won’t be long before you can travel the skies and move mountains, would you still be herding sheep?”
The young boy responded:
“I really don’t…”
“Who cares about cultivators?
Is it even more comfortable than herding sheep?
ƝᴑνǤᴑ.сο
I doubt it.”
“I still find herding sheep more comfortable.”
“You…”
The man, pointing at the young boy, seemed frustrated but finally heaved a sigh, saying helplessly:
“Sigh…”
“I really don’t understand what you think.
...
Everyone else dreams of joining an Immortal Sect and becoming a cultivator who can fly to the heavens and hide inside the earth, but you have no interest at all, just wanting to be a shepherd.”
The young boy smiled and said:
“Maybe in my past life, I was a cultivator who grew tired of it?”
Looking at the young boy in front of him, the man was momentarily speechless, and then turned around and walked away towards the forest behind the hill.
Seeing that the man was leaving, the young boy quickly called out to him:
“Old Chai, don’t go!
Let’s chat a bit more.”
The man, without turning his head, said:
“No more…”
“You little lamb.”
“While you’re chatting, your sheep are getting full, but my wood is still unchopped, and I don’t want to end up unable to get into bed when I get home.”
The young boy, laughing, replied:
“Like I said, my family name is Bai, not Yang.”
“My family name is Liu, not Chai…” the man’s voice faded as he went farther.
On the hillside, there was still the young boy and his dozen or so sheep.
The sky was very blue, with white clouds floating, and a light breeze blew, tousling the boy’s hair.
The young boy then lay down, looking at the distant sky, and murmured softly:
“Maybe…”
“My previous life really was that of a cultivator tired of the cultivating life…”
The young boy looked towards the distant sky, and above him in the cloud that he could not see, Lin Jing was watching this cultivator-weary boy.
Shortly thereafter, Lin Jing left.
From the beginning to the end, Lin Jing never appeared to disturb the young boy.
…
…
After he left, Lin Jing called out the System and entered the System Space.
The first thing Lin Jing did upon entering the System Space was to open the system panel.
Immediately, that scene of the system panel appeared in front of Lin Jing:
System Space (Level 9) (Evolution Stage)
Remaining time: 1000 hours (Accumulative: 1000 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Range: 135 (100+35) acres
Spiritual Energy Density: 10
Flow of Time Speed: 10
Daily Entrance Time: 12 hours (Full)
Upgrade Required:
Samsara Holy Fruit (1/1)
Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus (1/1)
Divine Tree of Dao Principle (1/1)
Alchemy Room (9/9)
Evolution Stages (0/10)
Evolution Points Needed per Stage: 100000
Special Functions: Alert Mode, Observation, Fixed Point Teleportation, Time Accumulation…
Harvest Points Remaining: 10000000 (Full)
…
Lin Jing (866/100000)
Spiritual Root: Five Elements Heavenly Spiritual Root (Supreme Grade)
Cultivation: Void Immortal (0%)
Cultivation Technique: Immortal Dao Five Elements Technique, Five Elements Divine Art, Ling Yin Imperial Sword Technique, Divine Fire Triple Realm…
Sub-Occupation: Ninth Grade Alchemist (Full)
…
Alchemy Room: Level 9 (Full)
Increase in Divine Sense Strength: 100%
Increase in Alchemy Success Rate: (Ninth Grade 10%) (Eighth Grade 20%), (Seventh Grade 30%), (Sixth Rank 40%), (Fifth-Rank and below…50% Full)
Improve in Elixir Medicine Quality: (Ninth Grade 10%) (Eighth Grade 20%), (Seventh Grade 30%), (Sixth Rank 40%), (Fifth-Rank and below…50% Full)
Appearance Rate of Flawless Elixir Medicine: (Ninth Grade 10%) (Eighth Grade 20%), (Seventh Grade 30%), (Sixth Rank 40%), (Fifth-Rank and below…50% Full)
…
Everything that had happened inside the Barren Forbidden Zone was orchestrated by Lin Jing.
Lin Jing had spent five hundred years elevating his cultivation to the pinnacle of Mahayana, and he had also stayed in the Outer Spatial Void for a full two hundred years.
He had even gathered two sets of materials for manufacturing the Ascension Pill.
Then…
He returned to the Nanming Domain and directly refined both sets of materials into Ascension Pills in the Barren Forbidden Zone.
Moreover, before this, Lin Jing had taken one of the Ascension Pills himself, elevating his cultivation to the realm of Void Immortal.

chapters.title: Chapter 961
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 961: Chapter 426 The Final Evolution of System Space_3 Chapter 961: Chapter 426 The Final Evolution of System Space_3 Now that he had reached the Void Immortal Realm, Lin Jing was prepared for everything; it was about time to begin the evolution of the System Space.
Subsequently…
Lin Jing closed the system panel and started evolving the System Space.
Lin Jing first converted all of the ten million Harvest Points into Evolution Points.
Then, the evolution began.
Evolution First Stage…
Immediately, there were some differences in the System Space, accompanied by a system prompt:
“Ding!”
“System prompt: Evolution has entered the first stage; System level has decreased; Alchemy Room level has decreased; all functions have been downgraded.”
System Space (Level 9) (Evolution First Stage)
Remaining Time: 900 hours (accumulable: 900 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Area: 125 (90+35) mu
Spiritual Energy Density: 9
Flow of Time Speed: 9
Daily Entry Time: 12 hours (full)
Evolution Stage (1/10)Remaining Evolution Points: 900,000
…
...
…
Evolution Second Stage, the space changed again…
System Space (Level 8) (Evolution Second Stage)
Remaining Time: 800 hours (accumulable: 800 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Area: 115 (80+35) mu
Spiritual Energy Density: 8
Flow of Time Speed: 8
Daily Entry Time: 12 hours (full)
Evolution Stage (2/10)
Remaining Evolution Points: 800,000
…
…
After that came the third stage of evolution…
Fourth stage…
Fifth stage…
…
…
Until evolution reached the ninth stage.
By this time, the System Space had undergone significant changes, reverting to the state it was in when Lin Jing first obtained it.
System Space (Level 1) (Evolution Ninth Stage)
Remaining Time: 100 hours (accumulable: 100 hours)
Host: Lin Jing
Spirit Field Area: 10 mu
Spiritual Energy Density: 1
Flow of Time Speed: 1
Daily Entry Time: 2 hours
Evolution Stage (9/10)
Remaining Evolution Points: 100,000
…
…
At this point, the Spirit Field in the System Space had disappeared, as had the Alchemy Room, which reverted to its original state.
Fortunately, Lin Jing knew that such conditions would occur during the evolution of the System Space.
He had already moved those rare Spirit Plants out of the System Space and planted them elsewhere.
Now there was only one evolution left, and the System Space would return to its original state.
Without any hesitation, Lin Jing chose to evolve.
After this evolution began, there were no more system prompts, and Lin Jing suddenly found himself in the outside world.
At that moment, he could no longer sense the existence of the System Space.
The System Space had completely disappeared.
After the disappearance of the System Space, a cluster of mystical lights appeared deep within Lin Jing’s sea of consciousness.
Lin Jing then stimulated his Soul Spirit to approach the lights.
When Lin Jing’s Soul Spirit touched the lights, he unexpectedly entered another space.
This space was vast, stretching beyond what the eye could see, but it was devoid of life, utterly barren everywhere.
In the center of the space stood three towering mountains, each supporting a World Seed.
The Samsara Holy Fruit, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, and the Divine Tree of Dao Principle had appeared in this space in such a manner.
Lin Jing merely thought, and the next moment, he found himself instantly appearing between three towering mountains.
He hadn’t expected it to be so magical; within this space, Lin Jing was like a sovereign, able to appear at any location he desired.
In the valley between the three mountains, there was a valley enclosed by high peaks.
And in that valley, there was a cluster of nine-colored light floating there, identical to the light within Lin Jing’s sea of knowledge.
Lin Jing’s thoughts shifted, and the next moment, he appeared beside this light.
This time, before Lin Jing could take any action, the light pulled him into a void space.
In this nothingness, Lin Jing couldn’t feel his own body, and could only observe the void space changing like a god watching from aboveâ€¦
What was displayed here seemed to be the formation of a realm; Lin Jing watched the space transition from the initial void into a realm space.
After thatâ€¦
Mountains, rivers, and lakes appeared within the space, followed by the emergence of various creaturesâ€¦
Just then, Lin Jing saw a person arrive here.
This individual’s presence was indistinct, and his realm inscrutable, as if he were merely a mortal.
Yet, just by standing there, doing nothing, his face remained obscured from view.
After this person’s arrival, with a casual beckoning, the space underwent tremendous changeâ€”plants grew wildly, and countless nine-colored lights began to emerge within the space.
And thenâ€¦
Lin Jing also saw the entire space continuously expanding; a Nine-Colored Jade Pillar sprouted out of nowhere, stretching up to the heavens above.
After thatâ€¦
The individual extended his hand, and three seeds materialized out of thin air.
Then he scattered the seeds, and after being released, the three seeds quickly grew into the Samsara Holy Fruit, the Transcendent Celestial Golden Lotus, and the Divine Tree of Dao Principle.
Thereafter, the person extended his hand again, and countless nine-colored lights converged, ultimately forming a heart-shaped, dazzling light.
The dazzling light slowly condensed, eventually forming a heart-shaped white jade emitting nine-colored light, and at that moment, the heart-shaped white jade was placed inside the Nine-Colored Jade Pillar.
Having done all this, the person turned his head and looked towards ‘Lin Jing.’
He then reached out and grabbed him in his hand.
“It seems you are the innate spirit of this realm; hence, you shall become the space will of this realm.”
“However, before that, you need some modifications.”
As the person spoke, nine-colored lights began to flicker on ‘Lin Jing,’ presumably starting the transformation.
This transformation process was not as quick as before, but took quite some time, and during this period, that individual kept muttering to himself:
“In the beginning…”
“Let’s make it like this…
It should be quite interesting…”
“As for the name…”
“Um…”
“Let’s call it System Space!”
…
…
After that, the person continued the transformation until a good while later, when the modifications were complete, he exhaled a sigh of relief.
“Phew…”
“Finally, the transformation is complete.”
“Next, it’s all about whether someone can bond with you and fully comprehend you.”
“If someone manages to fully understand you, they could reach our level of existence.”
Having said this, the person put ‘Lin Jing’ into the Nine-Colored Jade Pillar, that heart-shaped entity radiating nine-colored light.
Afterward, the person left this place.
Once the person had left, the space continued to change, and the passage of time within the space began to accelerate rapidly.
Lin Jing couldn’t do anything but watch.
Until at last, a person appeared and arrived in this space.
This person was different from the others; he had ascended from the Lower Realm in a certain manner…
It was also after this person’s appearance that the entire space once again underwent a transformation, with countless people flying and burrowing, able to destroy heaven and earth with a mere wave of a hand.
What followed were the second, the third…
Until later, another peerless genius emerged, taking the entire space by storm and shocking all beings within…
As for what came after, there is no need to say; the first ascendant was the Primordial Immortal, Emperor Venerate, and the peerless genius was the Five Elements Ancestor.
In the end, the two engaged in a great battle, destroying the entire Immortal Dao Realm.
After countless years, the Five Elements Ancestor, unable to defeat Primordial Immortal, Emperor Venerate, seized an opportunity before being sealed and sent the will of Immortal Dao out.
Lin Jing watched as the will of Immortal Dao traversed countless spaces, eventually descending upon himself who had just been in a car accident…
And at that moment, everything abruptly halted.
Lin Jing regained consciousness once more.
Having witnessed all this, Lin Jing understood everything.
He also knew that what the Five Elements Ancestor had said was all true.
Afterward,
Lin Jing’s thoughts shifted.
The next instant, he reappeared in the external world.
Although the system was no longer present, the space still existed, and the three great World Seeds were all still there.
Ɲονǥο.сօ
Lin Jing also knew what he needed to do next…

chapters.title: Chapter 962
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 962: 427 Chapter 962: 427 Nanshan Immortal City, Li Family.
Li Qingqing would return to the Li Family every so often, and for all these years, she had never made an exception.
500 years had passed, and even she had become a Dao Integration Stage powerhouse, not far from reaching the Tribulation stage.
At this moment, Li Qingqing stood in the courtyard, gazing at everything that remained familiar around her with nostalgia filling her eyes.
However…
Just then, a familiar figure appeared before her.
Li Qingqing hurriedly looked up at the figure and exclaimed in surprise,
“Lin Jing, brother…”
“You’ve…
...
returned.”
The person who had appeared was Lin Jing.
Lin Jing looked at Li Qingqing before him; it seemed she was always like this, always waiting for his return, and even now, it remained the same.
“Qingqing…”
Watching Li Qingqing, Lin Jing hesitated to speak, but he knew he had to.
“Lin Jing, brother, speak, I’m listening,” said Li Qingqing with a smile.
Lin Jing was silent for a moment before he spoke,
“I’m going to have to leave again soon.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing tried to mask her feelings, but couldn’t hide the disappointment in her eyes.
“How long will this trip be?”
“Is it dangerous?”
Li Qingqing asked these words gently, but the bitterness at the corners of her mouth was difficult to conceal.
Lin Jing hesitated, then said,
“This time shouldn’t be too dangerous.”
“As for how long it will be, I’m not sure.”
“Maybe soon, or maybe a long time…”
Li Qingqing was taken aback by his words and paused for a good while before asking Lin Jing again,
“When are you leaving?”
Her voice was still so gentle.
Lin Jing paused for a moment and replied,
“It should be in the next couple of days.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing instantly fell silent.
After a long while, she looked up and silently gazed at Lin Jing,
“Stay a little longer this time.”
“After all, we don’t know when you’ll be able to come back.”
Lin Jing heard this and looked at Li Qingqing, nodding his head,
“Alright…!”
…
…
Five days later, still in the Li family courtyard.
Lin Jing handed a Space Ring to Li Qingqing and then said,
“The items in here are enough for you to advance your cultivation to the Mahayana Realm.”
“And at the very bottom, I’ve prepared a gift for you.
I have sealed it, and only when you reach the peak of Mahayana can it be opened.”
Li Qingqing stepped forward and embraced Lin Jing, speaking softly,
“Although I don’t know what your mission entails, I understand that what you’re doing is no ordinary matter.
Whatever you do, remember to be extremely careful.”
“I’ll always be waiting for you.”
As Li Qingqing came into his arms, Lin Jing also opened his, enveloping her and gently stroking her hair, saying,
“If all goes well this time, we shouldn’t have to be apart again in the future.”
Li Qingqing looked up at Lin Jing and said,
“Alright…”
“Then I’ll wait for you.”
…
…
Lin Jing left but did not leave the Nanming Domain; instead, he went to another place, the Demon Race Secret Realm.
In the Demon Race Secret Realm, within the Qinghuang Palace.
Lin Jing stood before Huang Qingling and got straight to the point,
“Qing Ling…”
“Help me open the barrier to the Immortal Realm; I need to go there.”
Huang Qingling showed no reaction to Lin Jing’s familiar way of addressing her as he had since the time of sharing his soul.
She did not refuse.
Instead, she looked at Lin Jing with curiosity and asked,
“You should be well aware of the situation in the Immortal Dao Realm, and you surely understand its dangers.
Now that you’ve just advanced to the Void Immortal Realm, why would you want to enter the Immortal Dao Realm?”
Lin Jing replied with determination,
“This time, I have a reason that compels me to go.”
Huang Qingling heard this and said nothing, just gazed steadily at Lin Jing before her.
ƝονǤᴑ.ƈο
Lin Jing did the same, his gaze firm, meeting Huang Qingling’s.
After a moment, Huang Qingling looked away, as if conceding,
“All right!”
“I’ll help you this time.”
Having said that, Huang Qingling continued,
“When do you plan to go to the Immortal Dao Realm?”
“Now,” Lin Jing replied directly.
“So urgently?”
“Won’t you prepare further?” Huang Qingling asked with a slight frown.
Lin Jing nodded,
“Everything is ready; we can leave now.”
“All right!”
“If that’s the case, I won’t ask any further,” Huang Qingling conceded.
The spatial barrier of the Demon Race Secret Realm could connect directly to the Outer Spatial Void, and Grandfather Shi Tian, Shi Yuan, had once taken this route to the Outer Spatial Void.
After leaving the Qinghuang Palace, the two immediately made their way to the Outer Spatial Void.
Upon entering the Outer Spatial Void, they did not linger and flew straight to the end of the Void Sky River.
Both being of Void Immortal cultivation, their speed was naturally much faster than the last time they had come.
With their full speed unleashed, reaching the end of the Void Sky River would not even take half a month.
Along the way, Huang Qingling chuckled and said to Lin Jing,
“Last time you asked for my help, it cost three Immortal Yuan.
What about this time?
What are you prepared to offer?”
For some reason, since returning from the Outer Spatial Void last time, Huang Qingling had begun to change.
She became less cold and aloof, occasionally revealing some emotions, like now, sometimes even joking with Lin Jing.
This gave Lin Jing a faint illusion that the Huang Qingling of before seemed to have returned.
Especially now, having left two hundred years ago and just returned from the Outer Spatial Void, these two hundred years apart did not make him feel distanced from Huang Qingling; rather, they seemed even closer than before.
This made Lin Jing wonder if it was all an illusion, but the illusion felt so real.

chapters.title: Chapter 963
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 963: Chapter 427: Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale) _2 Chapter 963: Chapter 427: Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale) _2 Lin Jing also smiled and said,
“Of course…”
“Since I asked you to make a move, naturally I wouldn’t come empty-handed, I have prepared a gift for you.”
After saying that, Lin Jing took out a multi-colored jade box and handed it to Huang Qingling:
“This is the gift I’ve prepared for you.”
After saying that, Lin Jing added,
“Don’t look at it now, wait until I enter the Immortal Dao Realm, then you can open it.”
Holding the multi-colored jade box, Huang Qingling couldn’t help but become curious:
“What kind of gift is it?
It’s so mysterious.”
Lin Jing gave a mysterious smile and said,
“Don’t worry, you will definitely like this gift.”
Hearing Lin Jing say this, Huang Qingling looked at Lin Jing somewhat suspiciously,
“Are you sure?”
Lin Jing nodded,
“Of course!”
“In that case, I’ll accept it first.”…
…
After reaching the end of the Void Sky River, the two of them worked together to break the barriers of the Immortal Dao Realm once again, exposing it once more.
Before leaving, Lin Jing instructed Huang Qingling,
“I’ve left an Ascension Pill for Qing Qing, she can take it once she breaks through to the peak of Mahayana.”
“Before then, I’ll need you to take good care of her.”
Huang Qingling nodded, then asked Lin Jing,
“This time you enter the Immortal Dao Realm, are you sure there’s no danger?”
Lin Jing nodded and said, “There might be some danger, but it should be minor.”
Huang Qingling nodded and said,
“Well…
given your mysteriousness, you probably have many methods up your sleeve.
Since you said there’s not much danger, I reckon it will be fine.”
Then…
...
Lin Jing spoke directly to Huang Qingling,
“Let’s go…”
After saying that, Lin Jing directly passed through the barrier into the Immortal Dao Realm.
And once inside the Immortal Dao Realm, Lin Jing immediately retracted the immortal power used to stabilize the barrier breach, and at that moment, the barrier began to slowly heal.
It was then that Huang Qingling suddenly spoke out to Lin Jing who had already entered the System Space,
“When you leave this time, when can we see you again?”
Hearing this, Lin Jing turned his head to look at Huang Qingling and said,
“Perhaps, when one day you can feel the power of ascension, you’ll see me again…”
As Lin Jing’s voice fell, the breach in the barrier healed once again.
And Lin Jing remained in the Immortal Dao Realm.
…
…
Inside the Immortal Dao Realm, upon a mere thought from Lin Jing, a cluster of nine-colored light appeared.
Ɲ0νǤօ.сο
Then…
Lin Jing’s Divine Sense reached into that cluster of nine-colored light.
The next moment, Lin Jing suddenly felt that everything in the entire Immortal Dao Realm was enveloped within his Divine Sense.
Of course, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense wasn’t naturally so exaggerated.
It was so because what Lin Jing held, that cluster of nine-colored light, was the will of the Immortal Dao.
Under this Divine Sense, Lin Jing saw in the center of the Immortal Dao Realm, a broken Nine-Colored Jade Pillar with two people sitting crossed-legged atop it, and between them, a heart-shaped white jade emanating nine-colored light.
One of them, his body continuously flowing with nine-colored light, entering into that heart-shaped white jade.
And that originally heart-shaped white jade was then changing color, only lacking a small point at the tip of the heart before turning completely red.
Although it was the first time Lin Jing truly saw this person, he had seen his face many times before.
He was none other than the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.
And the other person on the jade pillar was wrapped in the power of nine colors, only vaguely revealing a human form.
It must be the sealed Five Elements Ancestor.
Seeing this scene, Lin Jing also sighed in relief,
“It seems, it’s not too late!”
After saying this, Lin Jing merely thought, and the next moment, he appeared atop the broken Nine-Colored Jade Pillar.
Upon Lin Jing’s arrival, neither of the two showed any reaction.
This was because the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate was currently using all his strength in the Refinement of the Immortal Dao Heart, and before the refinement was complete, he couldn’t possibly wake up.
Lin Jing didn’t bother with the Primordial Emperor Venerate, but instead directly approached the figure enveloped in the nine-colored light.
Then, he reached out his hand, bringing the will of the Immortal Dao close to that figure.
Instantly, the colorful light wrapping around this person dispersed, and the person within was revealed.
This person was none other than the Five Elements Ancestor.
The Five Elements Ancestor had just been unsealed and was still somewhat weak, but he immediately turned his gaze toward the Immortal Dao Heart in front of him.
“Thank goodness, it’s still in time…”
After saying that, the Five Elements Ancestor turned to look at Lin Jing and said,
“You must understand all of this by now.”
Lin Jing nodded and gave a respectful bow,
“Yes, senior…”
The Five Elements Ancestor nodded, then spoke,
“The only plan now is to use my cultivation to help you reach the Emperor Venerate Realm, and then by harnessing the three Great Dao seeds along with the will of the Immortal Dao, let you breakthrough to the Unique Sovereign Realm.”
“However, this method has a disadvantage, it can only last for nine breaths.”
“I understand this already…” Lin Jing nodded.
But after saying this, Lin Jing looked at the Five Elements Ancestor with some concern and said,
“Senior…”
“But, if you lose your cultivation, I’m afraid…”
The Five Elements Ancestor looked at the opposite Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate with a resolute gaze and directly said,
“This is the only way to stop him.”
“For the sake of the Immortal Dao Realm, and for the countless cultivators of the Cultivation World in the Lower Realm, sacrifices must be made.”
“We have to lend them this broken path of cultivation…”
After saying this, the Five Elements Ancestor stretched out his hand, and Lin Jing was immediately pulled in front of him.
The next moment…
Lin Jing suddenly felt an immense surge of immortal power and Immortal Yuan flowing into his body.
And his cultivation started to increase rapidly at an incredible pace.
While enhancing Lin Jing’s cultivation, the Five Elements Ancestor spoke to Lin Jing:

chapters.title: Chapter 964
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 964: Chapter 427 Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale)_3 Chapter 964: Chapter 427 Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale)_3 “Since you already know everything, you must also know there’s still some time left after the destruction of the Immortal Envoy Emperor Venerate.”
“You can use your Unique Sovereign cultivation to facilitate the entire Immortal Dao Realm’s restoration.”
“When the time comes, I’ll leave it to you.”
Lin Jing nodded and said,
“I understand, senior…”
It didn’t take long for the cultivation of the Five Elements Ancestor to completely fall, while Lin Jing ascended to the Emperor Venerate Realm.
“The remainder…
I’ll leave to you…”
After the Five Elements Ancestor’s cultivation dropped completely, his life also reached its end, and after these words, he disappeared with a smile.
To stop the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, to restore the Immortal Dao Realm, the Five Elements Ancestor sacrificed himself, achieving the Emperor Venerate cultivation for Lin Jing, and ultimately, he himself dissipated.
After the Five Elements Ancestor dissipated, Lin Jing merely willed it, and the Immortal Dao will merged back into his sea of consciousness.
At the same time, within the space of Immortal Dao Will, the power of the three great World Seeds surged from within, converging into Lin Jing’s body.
The power of the three great World Seeds, along with the Immortal Dao will in Lin Jing’s sea of consciousness, caused Lin Jing’s cultivation to continue to rise.
...
At the same time, Lin Jing’s Divine Sense, and its connection to the entire Immortal Dao Realm, grew increasingly close.
…
…
At this moment, the Immortal Dao Heart turned completely red.
And then, a terrifying aura spread out from the body of the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate opposite Lin Jing.
In just an instant, an overly excited voice cried out,
“Hahaha…”
“I’ve succeeded, I’ve finally refined the Immortal Dao Heart, I am the true ruler of the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“Five Elements Emperor, you’ve lost.”
But as soon as he finished speaking, he immediately realized something was wrong.
Before him, there was no trace of the Five Elements Ancestor, but a strange man standing there.
And from this stranger, he couldn’t sense any presence.
“Who are you?”
The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate immediately became wary and hurriedly asked the man in front of him.
But the man looked at him calmly and directly said,
“The Five Elements Emperor hasn’t lost.
It’s you who have lost, Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate.”
As the man’s words fell, a moment later, an indescribable aura emanated from him.
Then the man didn’t hesitate and directly spoke,
“I, Lin Jing, in the name of the ruler of the Immortal Dao Realm, strip you of your Emperor Venerate cultivation and return it to the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“I, Lin Jing, in the name of the ruler of the Immortal Dao Realm, strip you of your Emperor Venerate’s Power of Laws and return it to the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“I, Lin Jing, in the name of the ruler of the Immortal Dao Realm, strip you of your Emperor Venerate Soul Spirit and return it to the Immortal Dao Realm.”
…
…
This voice, like a curse, drove the fear within the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate to grow and spread rapidly.
After the voice fell, the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate found that the Immortal Dao Heart he had just refined suddenly lost its response, and the Dao Heart once again turned white.
And his cultivation, his comprehension of the Power of Laws, and his Soul Spirit, were all rapidly being drawn out of his body and dissipating into the entire Immortal Dao Realm.
“No…”
“Sovereign…”
“It’s impossible, I should have been the sovereign, it’s not possible…”
The Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate roared, but it was to no avail.
In just an instant, the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate, the instigator of the destruction of the Immortal Dao Realm, completely dissipated.
And all that he had acquired before was also returned to the Immortal Dao Realm.
After stripping the Primordial Immortal Emperor Venerate of everything, Lin Jing no longer paid attention to the Emperor Venerate.
Instead, he scanned the entire Immortal Dao Realm with his Divine Sense, and spoke again,
“I, Lin Jing…”
“In the name of the ruler of the Immortal Dao Realm, return my cultivation to the Immortal Dao Realm, to aid in its repair.”
As soon as his words fell, even though not even nine breaths’ worth of time had passed, massive amounts of immortal power and Immortal Yuan, as well as various Powers of Laws, began to surge from within Lin Jing’s body.
And Lin Jing’s cultivation began to fall rapidly.
ɴ0νǤᴑ.сο
At the same time, the entire Immortal Dao Realm began to change; countless shattered Immortal Mountains and lands began to converge and slowly assemble.
Even the Immortal Pillar under Lin Jing’s feet began to slowly repair…
Lin Jing watched everything before him and couldn’t help but show a slight smile,
“I believe it won’t be long…”
“We will meet again in this Immortal Dao Realm.”
…
…
Time flies.
In the blink of an eye, three thousand years had passed since Lin Jing left.
Two thousand years, such an interval for mortals, even the dynasties among mortals probably would have changed countless times.
For Li Qingqing, however, these three thousand years had allowed him to succeed in ascending from the Dao Integration Stage to the pinnacle of Mahayana, reaching the zenith of the Cultivation World.
Moving forward, only by taking the Ascension Pill could he break through again.
At this time, in the Li Family within Nanshan Immortal City of the Nanming Domain, Li Qingqing and Huang Qingling sat opposite each other, conversing.
Huang Qingling, holding the ascension pill contained in a jade box, asked,
“Qing Qing…”
“Do you plan to take this Ascension Pill now?”
Li Qingqing nodded and said,
“Yes, Sister Qing Ling…”
“I plan to take the Ascension Pill now, to advance to the rank of Void Immortal.”
“After I reach the rank of Void Immortal, I need Sister Qing Ling to help me open the boundary wall, as I wish to go to the Immortal Dao Realm, to see him.”
Upon hearing this, Huang Qingling was at a loss for words,
“You…”
“Don’t you know how dangerous the Immortal Dao Realm is?”
Li Qingqing nodded and said,
“I know…”
“But he is there.”
Li Qingqing’s words left Huang Qingling even more speechless,
“Qing Qing, you…”
“Sigh…!”
“There’s really no arguing with you.”
“I don’t even know when you fell for him.”
Upon hearing this, Li Qingqing first smiled, then her face took on a reminiscent hue, and she said,
“Perhaps it was that time, when I was captured and placed in the auction house, at my most helpless moment.”

chapters.title: Chapter 965 (END)
chapters.content:
Chapter 965: Chapter 427 Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale)_4 Chapter 965: Chapter 427 Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm (Grand Finale)_4 “And it was then that Lin Jing suddenly appeared…”
“I understandâ€¦” Huang Qingling nodded.
At that moment, Li Qingqing suddenly spoke up, addressing Huang Qingling:
“It’s just you, Sister Qingling, whose soul fragment has awakened and recovered all feelings for Brother Lin Jing.
Don’t you have any feelings for him?”
After hearing this, Huang Qingling’s face involuntarily flushed red; then, she quickly spoke up to cover it:
“Who would have feelings for him…”
Following that, Huang Qingling gritted her teeth and said:
“That scoundrel…”
“He knew I had been searching for clues about my parents all along, yet he waited until the very last moment before leaving to give them to me.”
“It made me search in vain for so long.”
Li Qingqing couldn’t help but laugh upon hearing this:
“Hehe…”
“You’re right, Sister Qingling, he is a scoundrel.”
At this time, Huang Qingling also quickly spoke up:
“Alright, alright…”
“Just take the Ascension Pill first.When the time comes, I’ll help you enter the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“However, we must agree beforehand that if it’s safe, you can go, but if there’s danger, you must come back immediately.”
“Before he left, I promised him I would take good care of you.”
Li Qingqing nodded, then said:
“Don’t worry, Sister Qingling.”
“I know my limits.”
…
…
A month later, at the end of the void-like celestial river, in the same original location, Huang Qingling and Li Qingqing, both with immortal power surging around them, frowned as they looked towards the empty space in front of them.
Li Qingqing asked Huang Qingling:
“What’s happening?”
“Why can’t the barrier to the Immortal Realm be opened?”
Huang Qingling’s brows furrowed as she stared at the barrier in front of them.
...
ƝονǤօ.ƈᴑ
They had broken it twice before, each time easily opening the barrier to the Immortal Realm, but this time, despite their long efforts, they had failed to open it.
Clearly, there must have been tremendous changes in the Immortal Dao Realm, and these changes could possibly relate to Lin Jing.
Huang Qingling then spoke up, sharing her speculation:
“There must have been some changes inside the Immortal Dao Realm that we are unaware of, and it’s highly likely that these changes are related to Lin Jing.”
Li Qingqing, looking at the spatial barrier that remained unmarked despite their attacks, sank into a profound sense of loss:
“Changes in the Immortal Dao Realm…”
“Does that mean we really have no way to see Brother Lin Jing again?”
Upon hearing this, Huang Qingling paused before speaking:
“Perhaps there is still a way…”
“Only, it’s not something we can control.”
“What way?”
Li Qingqing, immediately regaining her spirit, asked Huang Qingling urgently.
Before Huang Qingling could speak, as though replying to Li Qingqing, the entire world seemed to undergo a drastic change…
Both of them could distinctly feel as though there was a heavenly calling, as if wanting to lead them to another place, more fitting for them.
It seemed like the rhythm of ascension.
Feeling this calling, Huang Qingling’s eyes instantly lit up as she excitedly said:
“This is it…”
“Before Lin Jinglin left, he said that if we felt the power of ascension, we would be able to see him again.”
“Ascension…”
Hearing this, Li Qingqing’s eyes instantly became filled with determination.
And at that moment…
Above their heads, a portal radiating nine-colored light appeared.
Accompanying the appearance of the portal were the forming, colorful clouds of tribulation.
However, just as the tribulation clouds began to form – before any Tribulation Lightning could fall – they seemed to detect the cultivation of the two, and immediately dissipated without reappearing.
After the tribulation clouds vanished, the portal opened with celestial music resonating within, and Immortal Energy spilled out, making one feel instantly refreshed and clear-headed.
Following the appearance of the portal, the Immortal Energy paved a path of nine colors right to their feet.
Huang Qingling and Li Qingqing looked at each other, then stepped onto the nine-colored path in response to the calling power.
Then…
The two of them followed the nine-colored path into the portal, disappearing from sight.
…
…
“This is…”
“The Immortal Dao Realm?”
Li Qingqing and Huang Qingling, facing the scene before them that surpassed anything in the Xuanqing Realm in magnificence and feeling the thick Immortal Energy, murmured.
Just as their words fell, a very familiar voice, one which they would never forget in their lifetime, reached them:
“That’s right…”
“This is the Immortal Dao Realm.”
“Qingqing, Qingling…”
“Welcome to the Immortal Dao Realm!”
…The end of the book
